title: Participated in a PROJECT!
body: A number of weeks ago, I was invited* to participate in a postal art exchange that spanned the globe AND attempted to keep track of the time and distance of travel for each entry! The project has been identified as: [THE LATENCY LEDGER](https://objkt.com/tokens/KT1KQq4AkumBWai8z4owGcfkbRpzGxK5vCMr/0)\n\n(* The \

for the event was a frequent correspondent of ours, æther cavendish, who managed to coordinate the chaos with considerable understanding and aplomb!)

For my part, I intended to send a small package to South America, something that I USED to do rather frequently for less than TEN BUX (USD) per package. [R.I.P. - Clemente Padin... He was one of the GOOD ONES...] The first package that I put together for The Latency Ledger, which was intended to land in Guatemala and was not LARGE by any estimate, received a $300.00 (USD) cost quote. Yeah... No.


![MAIL ART - x1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23tcE3Ve5U2sSrTzfF5RoRxJwempARSva6zwwY5L6CdVvRgEMMQYW4ot1MG1Ufyo8f9Xi.jpg)


![MAIL ART - x2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23wCSgF4ztefZVjeWzxkHQVJsXRKGKGBAbHSawSFProUVX8wfUjrhpTsX9E91WhQ3c1DA.jpg)


![MAIL ART - x3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23uFoFmwCpxaULvhykaQiALhAmsPL3zjz7JDwmdCUtoJHMum6PXzHDVPzASBMd56Sha87.jpg)


![MAIL ART - x4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23wqnNBN3qJW6QjP9twzyh7PB9TZZq5PURLbtS91NsyxPxTzeXUXGm3cRxqhVX19ZHoVL.jpg)


![MAIL ART - x5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23yJGTZFBGjosF1EoUHnYAYmxaEpDW7YLvkc8iu3PqejtXA27bc2Q81Ae9rbzJ1KXuJca.jpg)


![sketch-1772658966511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23xyZ9dgBbhuzYe83HvBYavZYBthqHWnh4TG26gCDNu5EDhQ52dbgyRTkR7z31QYUdhKM.jpg)


I took the package home, re-evaluated the contents, (sadly) ejected a few extraneous items, and was able to downscale enough to utilize a recycled greeting card envelope for the second shipping container! (Meaning, the package could be sent for two \

stamps, which I can swing!) I was BACK in the game!!

![20260305_184927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23w2qURhdxK2ZeoMvontPG9mUddnUdC3VLsGHBmvjDSGW2VdMtedV8gdfdRakd2Ui63GB.jpg)

My contribution went out and, a few days later, I received a cool collection of materials in the post from California, USA! I snapped numerous photos of the un-enveloping, and I sent them to the Post Master for inclusion in the project archive and catalog!


![20260309_175342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23tvaH7DpT9NFmL8RNrBbiohyRejHk3zSv8Q445AukJrS68Zx9qkhDncTVr8NswMuhTFE.jpg)


![20260309_175346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23wWprYR4u4yWp1RmTXRs6Amp6c5XMmzNQvhrggawfVnigrHRaBr3uDr9ZYBfqskyMyQZ.jpg)


![20260309_175352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23tmDLR6jNhtyHQn1a7kn8o22A7RgdjTnWXVPntPy1EaDzqF1vK5XyPy7MGAS8tGzgWg4.jpg)


![20260309_175532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23vsd5T7CyGWhc5DfbN6JyjqLDmcKBrXoJCCCPiCtkpHnXK9jRbH5JxjmoHZHKeLiWxKk.jpg)


![20260309_175547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23tcEBKPccXpHcpw297ddKgkgiAkYTELUBLrUjtc84eepLAMYyhkMFiuWjZ71QHFuiy2w.jpg)


![20260309_175629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23y98ddjaTvC3jyohTW8fAxDYtLZmxmxFevnxgg5qxz9dvtdCa1Ygs56Z13kSZBQrWuLV.jpg)


![20260309_180054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/Ep1YGciGTzkSemaFjWVwpnAgGscqe6YLybzshtqjsjkyLBoqpEmFPzqvjFoZ3i9kZBP.jpg)


![20260309_180058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/EonpJf6iC7X4XakXRygG5mW2qvXbKLPjWk8gTWtPZt62E6DrQ4KchHcVCFBiYzqK8y9.jpg)


![20260309_180107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23vi1t5im1yz4U8o6zRvnVaqWhwy3MCqvLHDrEzNyeoxrc1ggj9vj69aZDUinAuUavaqi.jpg)


![20260309_180119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23xVXhCWgNB4YA76JoCCNfFiQikKN5hGsVc42RFkiQTSGBoXN3PaobTuBfRisz9EBEzK7.jpg)


[Honestly, If you've never experienced the THRILL of receiving ART thru the mail, you are SERIOUSLY missing out!!! Get involved in a mail art circle immediately, for your own sanity!]

Time moves on...

Once MOST of the individual packages landed, the Post Master created a fantastic, engaging presentation about the project, which Mariah and I watched as soon as we spotted it! Very cool to be part of such a thought provoking project!!

TO SEE THE PRESENTATION and some of the art involved, visit HERE:

https://objkt.com/tokens/KT1KQq4AkumBWai8z4owGcfkbRpzGxK5vCMr/0

Make sure that you check out the catalog! It explains the entire process and is quite a piece of work all on its own!!! Thanks, sincerely, to the POST MASTER for inviting me to join! Now.... I need to go make some more postcards to drop in the mail!


![sketch-1772728362753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richardfyates/23ydLycouJAfwRakhZtu5fsdzhthEhifMVn5vuX3bzYsb6ixTggnLFKSfwRkAQxBibizc.jpg)

title: Cool View - PhotoFeed Contest
body: > I don’t know who discovered photography, but whoever did was a genius and deserves to be awarded every single day because it is pure magic! It was a hot afternoon. I stood in my colleague’s office, laughing, talking, and forgetting all my tasks and deadlines for a moment. While I stood there, I decided to peek through the window, and I was greeted by an amazing sight that not only needed to be seen but also to be photographed.
> Capturing these little moments and staring at the pictures were the highlights of my day, and I just couldn’t wait to share them with you all.
> I love everything about these pictures and I hope you all love them too😃
> *This is my entry for the PhotoFeed Landscape Photography Contest.* All images are mine except otherwise stated. **Thanks for stopping by** **Loads of Love🥰🥰** **XOXO**

title: My 2026 Mixed Media Art Projects (January 1 - March 31)
body:
This is a Curated Collection of posts highlighting my mixed media art projects I shared in various communities, but primarily Alien Art Hive from January 1st through March 31st, 2026.

The publications contain a mix of original designs from mixed media and short stories and poetry that accompany some projects. In all projects, I provide a detailed explanation of my processes and procedures, together with a short analysis of the inspiration for my designs.

When possible, I also include short story fiction related to the designs that explain or expound upon the project's theme.

I hope you enjoy my compilation as you look back on the various projects. Thanks for your visit.

![Apophysis-InABlueSpace-LUNAPICMask.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/48PTGvVQt6WfyEFQpno68NQ8wZn2X2QDk1oiAevB1m13GPDcnpc9HG2arcMWw9Bzdg.jpg)

Esta es una selección de publicaciones que destacan mis proyectos de arte con técnicas mixtas, los cuales compartí en diversas comunidades, aunque principalmente en Alien Art Hive, entre el 1 de enero y el 31 de marzo de 2026.

Las publicaciones contienen una mezcla de diseños originales en técnica mixta, así como relatos cortos y poesía que acompañan a algunos proyectos. En todos los proyectos, ofrezco una explicación detallada de mis procesos y procedimientos, junto con un breve análisis de la inspiración para mis diseños.

Siempre que es posible, también incluyo relatos cortos de ficción relacionados con los diseños que explican o profundizan en el tema del proyecto.

Espero que disfrutes de mi recopilación mientras repasa los distintos proyectos. Gracias por tu visita.

body.title: What do natural disaster tell us?//MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
body.body:
The earth is made by God perfectly. It is not like this before.

https://youtu.be/8BRqyAUjhW0?si=l0AD1qhu160gD-dZ

  First of all, I want yo invite your attention to what happened during the time of Noah. It was accepted by almost all believers of the bible that it is a global flood. A global flood not a local flood. A flood can be called also a natural disaster and if we are going to expect that is global flood the more it will be emphasized that it is a natural disaster. If it is not local than it is a natural disaster.
Why? Because q local flood may be caused by a breaking up of a dam just like what happened some time ago in a particular place where a dam has been broken, and a whole village was washed up by the dam which broke.
It cannot be called a natural disaster, it can be called a manmade disaster. The breaking of a dam because of the inferior construction materials that were used is caused by man. A whole village was washed away. Now, if it is a local flood during the time of Noah when there are no dams yet that were erected. Even if it is local flood, it is not a manmade disaster but a natural disaster. If you are one of those who believed that it is a global flood
 Then it is emphatically a natural disaster.


But what is my understanding our understanding of such disasters?  Genesis 7 verse 11 says, in the six hundredth year of Noah' s life,  in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
In order to sustain the flood that will eliminate all flesh,save those that are in the ark, according to the bible in Genesis 7 verse 11 it what we call as a tectonic plates of the earth. It is what the science call tectonic plate of the earth. They are broken and whenever these tectonic plates are moving it may cause earthquakes.

body.title: My Actifit Diary: April 21 2026
body.body:
Time keeps ticking on. Slowly now. I try to speed it up, but it doesn’t work. There’s nothing left I can do. Just wait. And wait. I filed all the paperwork. The court has 10 days to respond. Working days, of course. Means that I should have a response by Friday. And then there will be weekend. Nothing ever goes fast here. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2fb35c34-cd81-4c56-b8f9-e4d6a5747afc.jpg) Today I was able to cry a little. It’s not the pain that I used to feel when it happened the first time. It has changed now. Back then, it was mostly about the injustice, the impotence. It was more about me back then. Now it’s more about her. Missing her. Knowing that she misses me. Knowing that everything that’s happening will leave a mark on her, will cause her problems. Hoping that for miraculous reasons it won’t. That no matter what way I choose there will be negative impact on her, and that I have to choose the least bad. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3f907db2-e32f-4d4c-a8d7-55c089467d8a.jpg) I keep my mind of things through work. And running errands. Tomorrow I’ll head to Quito to get my passport renewed. After that, I’ll have to do a transfer of visa and all that stuff. I already got all the permits for the bakery, so that’s done. Making some videos for social media platforms to promote our bread and products. Make experiments, like the pictures above show. Work is better than Whiskey. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1ec99523-b599-4603-a79e-74dab7c30034.jpg) It doesn’t always work. I do my meditations and such, but yesterday, when falling asleep, I had a curious type of what I think was an anxiety attack. Every time I drifted away into sleeping, I suddenly felt like I wasn’t breathing, and woke up with a deep breath and the heart pumping accordingly. I tried to calm myself down again, do the heartmath technique, but it happened all over again. Took quite a while to overcome it. I have to get up at 4.15am tomorrow, catch the bus at 5am. So I better go to bed now. I wish you a good night!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@beelshops/actifit-beelshops-20260422t020120228z)_

>

body.title: Charlie's Story, In due time
body.body:
Good morning, my dear and esteemed friends of Hive and Buskeria. A new week has arrived, and I'm back with you. On this beautiful Tuesday, I've written a new story for you, and I'll share it with you in just a moment. Before you start reading, let me tell you who it's about: Charlie, an older gentleman. The story explores whether it's too late to pursue music when you're older. If you want to know what happens, I invite you to keep reading. So, with that said, let's begin.

> Buenos días mis queridos y muy estimados amigos de hive y de Buskeria. Llega una nueva semana y yo regreso con ustedes. En este hermoso martes he escrito una nueva historia para ustedes y en unos instantes se las voy a compartir. Antes de que empiecen a leer les digo sobre quien será, es sobre Charlie, un señor mayor. La historia trata sobre si es demasiado tarde para llegar a la música cuando eres mayor. Si quieren saber por todo lo que pasa les invito a seguir leyendo. Entonces con esto dicho ya podemos comenzar.

<div class=\

> ![1776717615786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23ywoANcue3FYq7CyFQwNhDJEhLrMmtcxtJDYDyFnHgXYQbK6LDRYox6Ce2zaKrJKtt1K.jpg) Image created by me in canva For as long as he could remember, Charlie had always worked in the large coal mines surrounding the vast region of Buskeria. He started working in the mines when he turned 20. But before going into the mines, at 18, he longed for a different life. He loved opera and listened to it on the radio constantly. He had a beautiful voice, so he hoped that one day he could become a great opera singer too, like the ones he heard on the radio. In fact, after leaving school at 18, he completed a two-year course to learn to sing opera. It almost seemed like everything was set. But a major economic depression hit the region at that time. And many theaters and venues for opera and music in general closed. So, since Charlie couldn't live on air, he took advantage of that time of great depression to earn a living in another way. The closest thing he had left was working in the coal mines. It wasn't the best, but at least the pay was good, and he could get by. By then he was already in his twenties. So he had to pause for a while; his desire to sing opera weighed heavily on him. Waiting a little longer wouldn't hurt. But the years in the mines passed quickly. And his youth flew by. He didn't realize it, but the Great Depression had already passed. But he still hadn't done anything to get out of the mines. > Desde que tiene memoria Charlie siempre ha trabajado en las grandes minas de carbón que rodean la gran región de Buskeria. Comenzó a trabajar en las minas desde que cumplió los 20 años. Pero antes de entrar en las minas, a sus 18 el quería otra vida distinta. Le encantaba la opera, y la escuchaba en la radio a todas horas. Tenía una gran voz, así que esperaba que algún día más adelante el pudiera ser un gran cantante de pera también, como los que escuchaba en la radio. De hecho luego de salir de la escuela a los 18 pasó un curso de dos años para aprender a cantar opera. Casi parecía que todo estaba listo. Pero en la región de Buskeria en ese tiempo surgió una gran depresión económica. Y muchos teatros y lugares para cantar ópera y la música en general cerraron. > Así que como Charlie no podía vivir del aire aprovechó ese tiempo de gran depresión para ganarse la vida de otro modo. Lo más cercano que le quedaba era trabajar en las minas de carbón. No era lo mejor pero al menos pagaban bien y podría salir adelante. Para ese entonces ya tenía sus 20 años. Así que tuvo que pausar por un tiempo pesaba el su deseo de cantar opera. Por esperar un poco no iba a pasar nada. Pero los años en las minas fueron pasando rápido. Y su juventud pasó volando. No se dio cuenta pero la gran depresión ya había pasado. Pero el aún no había hecho nada para salir de las minas.

> ![matt-seymour-jFnxkiKikUw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/EoyPvPNayS92hxmhYPchq5dWkEZE1Q4js9uPADzvN9qZesswmyPKTe8SHpxGiLThkNP.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) It wasn't that he didn't want to do anything, literally; it was that while working in the mines, during the Great Depression, he met his future wife. They had four children. Since times were tough, he preferred to stay in his secure job rather than pursue uncertain dreams. He also had the responsibility of supporting his wife and children. So, his dream of becoming an opera singer was postponed more and more. Despite constantly putting it off, he never stopped loving opera and longed for the day he could finally become a great singer. During that time, he pursued other, more secure projects, such as starting a small business selling coal he obtained from the mines, and his wife took up sewing. These were secure businesses that provided stability, and they didn't want to change that for anything. So, during that time, Charlie resigned himself to the idea that music might not come to him and that he would have to accept it as if it were just a dream. > No es que el no quisiera hacer nada literalmente, es que mientras trabajaba en las minas y aún había gran depresión el conoció a su futura esposa. Con ella tuvo 4 hijos. Como eran tiempos difíciles prefirió continuar en su empleo que era ya seguro que irse a buscar sueños que eran inseguros. Además tenía la responsabilidad de mantener a su esposa e hijos. Así que su sueño de ser un cantante de ópera fue aplazándose cada vez más y más. A pesar de que él lo aplazaba constantemente nunca dejó de sentir amor por la opera, y añoraba el día que si pudiera llegar a ser un gran cantante. > En ese tiempo de siguió otros proyecto más seguros como la creación de un pequeño negocio de venta de carbón que obtenía en las minas y su mujer se dedicó a la costura. Eran negocios seguros que le daban estabilidad y no querían cambiar eso por nada. Así que en ese tiempo Charlie se hizo a la idea de que tal vez la música no llegaría a el y tendría que conformarse como si fuera una ilusión.

> ![mavic-101-Xk5LrqUJUss-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/EoprWXpL5jhqCttqEkh3cTeGDAgiEPcGu74diyT4UfdDFDNet1sq9y25DAP1LPRoNA4.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Many years later, his four children left home to make their own lives. His wife retired, and he retired from mining. They no longer needed to work because his children helped them, and he had a good pension from all his years in the trade. Although he had a full life—not the best, but full of valuable things—he still felt the emptiness of what he could never be, or perhaps never even sought. His wife, who was always with him at home, asked him what was happening and why he seemed so unwell since his retirement. That was the first time he confessed what was bothering him. She was very surprised because she told him that if he had told her earlier that he wanted to be an opera singer, she would have encouraged and supported him. He cut her off, saying there was no point in talking about it; it was too late. But his wife told him that this wasn't going to be the end of it. Even though he was older, she wasn't going to let him go to his grave without fulfilling that dream. So she herself called a musical theater to reserve a day for him to show everyone his hidden talent. He laughed a lot but liked the idea. They went to the theater together, the two of them, their four children, and their own families. At the theater, they saw him sing. They saw his true hidden talent and wondered why he had never pursued it. But his mother told them all to be quiet and simply said that it's never too late when the music is good. And indeed, it wasn't too late; Charlie now had the opportunity to go and find what he had longed for. > Muchísimos años después sus 4 hijos se fueron de casa a hacer su propia vida. Su esposa se jubiló y el se retiró del trabajo minero. Ya no les hacía falta trabajar porque sus hijos los ayudaban y tenía una buena pensión de todos sus años en el oficio. A pesar de que el tuvo una vida plena, no la mejor pero su llena de cosas valiosas el aún sentía el vació de lo que nunca pudo ser, o quizás nunca buscó. Su esposa que siempre estaba con él en casa le preguntó qué era lo que estaba pasando. Y por que desde que se había jubilado el también se le veía tan mal. Esa fue la primera vez que el le confesaba lo que le pasaba. Ella se sorprendió mucho porque le decía que el si el le hubiera comunicado antes que el quería ser cantante de opera lo hubiera motivado y apoyado. > El le cortaba la conversación diciendo que para que hablar de eso, ya es muy tarde. Pero su esposa le dijo que eso no ser iba a quedar así. Aunque era mayor de edad no iba dejar que se fuera a la tumba sin cumplir ese sueño. Así que ella misma llamó a un teatro musical para pode reservar un día para que el le demostrara a todos su talento oculto. El se rió mucho pero le gustó la idea. Fueron juntos al teatro, ellos dos y sus 4 hijos y sus propias familias. En el teatro lo vieron cantar. Vieron su verdadero oculto y se preguntaban por que nunca lo buscó. Pero su madre los mandaba a callar a todos y solo les decía que nunca es demasiado tarde cuando la música es buena. Y en efecto aún no era demasiado tarde, Charlie tenía la oportunidad ahora de ir a buscar lo que tanto había ansiado.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2603).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23z7FqzbQ1mA7HtAp7KGWhR4atHSUnhgUMDGPsL5yHVEZVCvoxKgNLE68zc8JV6MC1ueH.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![gn1jDQ32cWwVTCDB_a9361470d4ef5b760eaad583cc086ca8.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/gn1jDQ32cWwVTCDB_a9361470d4ef5b760eaad583cc086ca8/gn1jDQ32cWwVTCDB_a9361470d4ef5b760eaad583cc086ca8.webp)
![72pJzk3G5xlDW2hW_2301.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/72pJzk3G5xlDW2hW_2301/72pJzk3G5xlDW2hW_2301.webp)
![sOFpv1slJtMvVSfk_2304.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/sOFpv1slJtMvVSfk_2304/sOFpv1slJtMvVSfk_2304.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>


上班的间隙，我收到了老二所在的幼儿园的老师朋友发来的视频，她笑着打趣让我快看看自家孩的表现。原来幼儿园当天开展了防拐安全演练，老师请来陌生人扮演坏人，只用一句有糖吃的简单诱惑，就引诱了小朋友跟随离开。而我的二娃，竟是所有孩子里跟着陌生人跑得最快的那一个。

看到消息的那一刻，我忍不住连发几个捂脸的表情，又好笑又无奈。视频里的小家伙毫无防备，开开心心地跟着陌生的坏人往前走，全然察觉不到潜藏的危险，真是天真无邪极了！

笑过后，心底又有点庆幸这只是演习，这给我实实在在敲响了警钟，我才意识到，平日里对二娃的防拐安全意识教育远远不够。三岁的孩子能有什么心思呢？抵挡不住零食和糖果或者玩具的诱惑，这是小孩的天性，但需要我们家长去帮忙引导，把一切可能降到零！

为人父母，我们永远无法做到无时无刻寸步不离，生活里总有疏忽粗心的瞬间，有时候一秒钟的走神，都有可能让孩子脱离视线。想到老大也曾经因为奶奶的疏忽走掉过，吓了全家一大跳，对于安全教育，我觉得还是不能掉以轻心。

body.body: 1/6 🧵 @shortsegments breaks down a big shift: Hive may finally be getting what it’s lacked for years — a direct highway to outside capital. If Altera’s HBD-Bitcoin pool works as pitched, Hive stops being a hard-to-reach island and starts looking like an actual connected economy.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/6 🧵 The core idea is simple and strong: instead of forcing users through centralized exchanges, Altera lets people swap native Bitcoin into Hive’s ecosystem through a decentralized route. That matters because exchanges are bottlenecks. When they choke, Hive traffic chokes with them. A direct bridge changes that.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/6 🧵 The smartest part of the article is the point about **mechanical demand** for HBD. This isn’t just “please value our stablecoin.” The swap flow itself uses HBD as part of the route, which means usage can create recurring demand. That’s a much better story than pure speculation. Utility beats vibes.

body.body: 4/6 🧵 @shortsegments also hammers on the “real Bitcoin, not wrapped IOUs” angle. That’s a serious distinction. Wrapped assets always introduce extra trust assumptions, and those assumptions love exploding at inconvenient times. Native-asset swaps are cleaner, harder to fake, and way more aligned with the whole point of decentralization.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 5/6 🧵 Security is the other big piece: the system relies on validators/guardians, threshold signatures, and SPV-style verification so no single actor controls the vault. In plain English: no lone idiot or bad actor should be able to run off with the funds. For cross-chain infra, that’s not a bonus feature — that’s the whole damn game.

title.title: Combinación Perfecta [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
>

Combinación Perfecta. Tenemos para tí una rutina de ejercicios, donde todo el cuerpo estará activo a través de la ejecución de un circuito, a base de planchas, crunch abdominal y sentadillas demasiado potentes. Esta sesión implica quema de muchas calorías, ganancia de fuerza, estabilidad y control corporal. Las planchas son un ejercicio muy completo, donde gran parte de los músculos están involucrados; y aunado a la acción en la región abdominal, en conjunto con las sentadillas, los resultados de la jornada serán superlativos. Solo te digo que debes iniciar; trabaja poco a poco y tu cuerpo se adaptará rápido, vente conmigo y dale movimiento a tu vida. >The Perfect Combination. We’ve got an exercise routine for you that engages your entire body through a circuit featuring planks, abdominal crunches, and powerful squats. This session helps you burn plenty of calories while building strength, stability, and body control. Planks are a very comprehensive exercise that engages a large number of muscles; combined with the abdominal work and the squats, the results of this workout will be outstanding. All I’m saying is that you need to get started; work your way up gradually and your body will adapt quickly. Join me and get your life moving.

![1000445003.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6X8ip1PJSek4tQPEVUzZtHcwTLkTbzK9XWUtbDGVUoreocDPzkPDUnYZgm5Kq.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **RODILAZOS CON TOQUE DE PALMAS DEBAJO DE PIERNA**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos abiertos a los lados a nivel de hombros. >[**Warm-up 1**, **KNEES TO CHEST WITH CLAPPING UNDER THE LEG**]() >[Position]() >Feet hip width apart; arms extended to the sides at shoulder height.
![1000444975.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKYMe9T7KmDKPdRybNZLWXSk5i4NXxF8tF7FbYrYbwLJux2cfBM78UCCJSgTt69.gif)
[Ejecución]() Ya ubicados en la postura indicada; vamos elevando las rodillas de forma alterna, flexionando un poco el torso y chocando las palmas debajo de la pierna que se eleva. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Once you’re in the correct position, lift your knees one at a time, bending your torso slightly and clapping your hands beneath the leg you’re lifting. Do this for 3 minutes.
![1000444977.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKVVA82A9TgcJexZG7xzmTZ814MZC5PtfeSJXHAC4dCtUVomRk5nXSQ59MAAEh6.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TROTE CON TOQUE DE PIE OPUESTO**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de hombros, con codos flexionados y brazos a los lados. >[**Warm-up 2**, **JOGGING WITH CROSS-STEP**]() >[Stance]() >Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, elbows bent, and arms at your sides.
![1000444981.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKWvPmD5Ni23ifFqNKd43URi6vCv8L37RpdqTvZSghQvJ2f4tc29iHH31ZB84YA.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos de actividad; vamos ejecutando el trote, elevando las rodillas y tocando los pies con las manos opuestas. >[Execution]() >For 3 minutes, we’ll jog in place, lifting our knees and touching our feet with the opposite hand.
![1000444983.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKWvPmD5Ni1PrDqU45LEgwCDppmE5BJu2p62XAnoWvDSomjGovUeqwcSnWJf5Hf.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **RODILLAZOS LATERALES EN PLANCHA CON APOYO DE CODOS**]() [Postura]() Para realizar este ejercicio usamos alguna protección para los codos; puede ser un cojín. Ahora; nos ubicamos boca abajo, apoyando ambos codos sobre el cojín, piernas casi juntas y cadera un poquito elevada. Las manos se colocan a los lados de la cabeza. >[**Station 1**, **SIDE KNEE RAISES IN PLANK POSITION WITH ELBOW SUPPORT**]() >[Position]() >To perform this exercise, use some kind of elbow protection, such as a cushion. Now, lie face down with both elbows resting on the cushion, legs almost together, and hips slightly raised. Place your hands on either side of your head.
![1000444985.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6WmsUAnNhfRfsmr3CTe7h4H4JuaDULqNJAuzEhKuocUHnD3XVGH8b3q5pjysr.gif)
[Ejecución]() Todo el cuerpo trabaja y se mantiene en tensión; acción predominante en abdomen cadera y piernas. Para realizar el movimiento; mantenemos la postura indicada, mientras durante 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series, vamos dando rodillazos laterales. >[Execution]() >The entire body is engaged and remains tense; the movement primarily targets the abdomen, hips, and legs. To perform the exercise, maintain the recommended posture while performing 20 repetitions in 4 sets of side knee lifts.
![1000444987.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK3eHs9Zd3kEXhjTpE6XQoRFy38gF1JCqc7kkNkUXmNAkLmYUSvrkQ624bJCkEU.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **CRUNCH ABDOMINAL CON FLEXIÓN DE RODILLAS, PIERNAS ABIERTAS Y TOQUE DE PIES JUNTOS**]() [Postura]() Nos sentamos en el piso extendiendo los pies y elevando las piernas; los pies permanecen juntos. Elevamos un poco el torso y flexionamos los codos, ubicando las manos frente al rostro. >[**Station 2**, **AB CRUNCH WITH KNEE BEND, LEGS APART, AND TOES TOGETHER**]() >[Posture]() >Sit on the floor with your feet extended and your legs raised; keep your feet together. Lift your torso slightly and bend your elbows, placing your hands in front of your face.
![1000444989.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK55nfgPV3dswaLBWKdM49DLtvYfSZiL38rn4eCxYKDraz7nCszk678nLcu5FdP.gif)
[Ejecución]() Trabajo total para todo el abdomen; glúteos y piernas en total acción, brazos trabajan en segundo plano. Para ejecutar el movimiento; flexionamos las rodillas, las cuales van contra el abdomen con piernas abiertas y planta de pies juntas. Acercamos un poco el abdomen y tocamos los pies con ambas manos. Serían 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >A full body workout for the entire abdomen; the glutes and legs are fully engaged, while the arms work in the background. To perform the movement, bend your knees so they come toward your abdomen, keeping your legs apart and the soles of your feet together. Tuck your abdomen in slightly and touch your feet with both hands. Do 20 repetitions for 4 sets.
![1000444993.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK55nfjNX85Ez1eqkBJeBkp882n84ScjFt3YwCpAU61ye6wdo5cGMhNZXDgn3WL.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **SENTADILLAS CON APERTURA DE PIERNAS EN SALTO Y TOQUE DE PISO**]() [Postura]() Iniciamos con piernas juntas y brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Station 3**, **SQUATS WITH A LEG SPLIT, JUMP, AND TOUCH THE FLOOR**]() >[Position]() >Start with your legs together and your arms extended downward at your sides.
![1000444995.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZnbGvZQtSg3nGLsbo88ZZGaaYXMuLoZ8B7erq4Xjua35QkPjeYLWzSj7AN4KZ.gif)
[Ejecución]() Tren inferior siempre activo, desarrollo y fuerza total. Abdomen trabajando a millón. Una vez activos en la postura indicada; ejecutamos saltos diagonales de lado a lado, cayendo en sentadilla abierta y tocando el piso con la mano del lado de la apertura. Flexionamos el torso en cada sentadilla con toque de piso. Son 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Keep your lower body engaged at all times, focusing on full range of motion and maximum strength. Engage your core intensely. Once you’re in the starting position, perform diagonal side-to-side jumps, landing in a wide squat and touching the floor with the hand on the side of the jump. Bend your torso forward at the bottom of each squat as you touch the floor. Perform a total of 20 repetitions over 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwHcgbNPGoVoN2P9okwbm3H4ReB8XhJnP2fr9r2VWic8/1776797173890.gif)
[**Relajación**, **APERTURA LATERAL DE BRAZOS Y PIERNAS**]() [Postura]() Piernas juntas; codos flexionados con brazos a nivel del pecho. >[**Relaxation**, **SIDE STRETCH FOR ARMS AND LEGS**]() >[Posture]() >Legs together; elbows bent with arms at chest level.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMuMzbZw9vCAwM7sjrKsaHJ6YF3ornCt3XTymDtqCiEs/1776797174220.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, vamos abriendo las piernas a los lados de forma alterna, acompañado de la extensión de codos. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; during 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we alternately open our legs to the sides while extending our elbows.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBCeEFcip7qJH2zmRjgLgH9ewueeMYuZSLXz1163jbtM/1776797174345.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

title.body:
It's interesting to hear that there are more similarities than differences even with a non European country. It goes to show how easy it is to make assumptions when we haven't experienced things. Is Nepal more tropical than SA, is that what makes it feel warmer there? 

I started cooking from scratch more again when we came here and learnt to cook a wider range of foods. Do you find that some fruits and vegetables are harder to come by here? For us what was available was very similar to what we could get in the UK, but the more tropical fruits were much better. I'd never tasted a sweet kiwifruit before coming here. 😆 

We'll have to try Khukuri. I don't think I've tried Nepalese food before. 

I noticed a lot more people seem to have allergies here, but I'm not sure why. Nearly everywhere has gluten free options too. I was talking to my sister over Christmas and she was telling me that not many places in the UK have gluten free options even now, yet here it's in high demand and some places are even completely gluten free. I've developed intolerances to wheat recently, so gluten free is on my radar. 

>people run all the time, even in the sunny mid day

We'll need to change that saying \
to include Aussies. 😆 I have to admit to wondering if some people are crazy when I see them running on scorching hot days. Rainy days I can just about understand, but not in the heat.

title.title: Surfeo la vida [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
<center>


![IMAG 1 Surfeo la vida.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/EpxrG33QtCwBBNLYEiqrbRn1GJbXUSxM7aE9qbcb8b8f79z9d8b3d7sRYxSFy8W53AK.gif)



<sub>Imagen de mi propiedad tomada del álbum digital personal, editada en Canva. 
</sub></center>

<div class=\

> Desde que el mundo es mundo, el ser humano ha vivido la vida en un vaivén de emociones, **surfeabamos** olas grandes, medianas, pequeñas, que enfrentamos. El tamaño ¿no importará? Pero nunca debemos descuidarnos con estas, porque podríamos ahogarnos. Y algunas veces nadaremos a su ritmo o en contra de estas, y cada quien decidirá cómo hacerlo; lo importante será el estar consciente de que cada arrastrada hacia la orilla traerá cosas positivas, aunque al momento no lo veamos. Al decidir **surfear**, debemos estar conscientes de hasta dónde podrán llevarnos. ¿Estamos preparados para aterrizar en la orilla y con posibilidad de que seamos arrastrados mar adentro con todas sus consecuencias? ¡Por supuesto que sí! Porque la vida estará compuesta de todos los tamaños de olas, unas tras otras, y estará en nosotros el decidir cómo surfearlas, enfrentarlas o no. ¿Y quién no surfeó, sin ser surfista, olas de todos los tamaños? Incluso algunas veces será sano el dejarnos llevar e ir nadando; algunas las disfrutaremos, otras nos atropellará, que, dependiendo del tamaño de esta, se moverá, para saber hasta dónde será capaz de llevarnos y también hasta dónde seremos capaces de enfrentarlas. Eso será parte de la vida. Y particularmente en el transcurrir de la vida, más de una vez me arrolló una ola. ¿Quién dijo ola? Un remolino, pero logré salir. Queridos lectores, nunca nos dispersemos así veamos una simple ola en calma, pues esta podrá chupar nuestra inmunidad y la del que esté con nosotros y será horrible pensar por un momento lo que nos podría pasar. Más aún si tenemos a nuestro lado a personas que dependerán de la decisión que tomemos. Ante una ola, un remolino, nunca perdamos la calma, y justo en esos momentos habrá que agarrarnos a lo que creemos como tabla de salvación, y siempre he recibido respuesta positiva. Creo en Dios, respiraré profundo y clamaré al cielo y trabajaré para estar tranquila, porque el desespero no nos llevará a nada bueno. Cuando estemos inmersos en esa ola, que nos quitará la respiración, siempre mantener la calma será nuestra mejor arma y eso aplicará para todo en la vida. >Since the dawn of time, human beings have lived their lives amid a constant ebb and flow of emotions, **riding** the big, medium, and small waves we face. Does size really matter? But we must never let our guard down, because we could drown. >And sometimes we’ll swim with them or against them, and each of us will decide how to do it; the important thing is to be aware that every pull toward the shore will bring positive things, even if we don’t see them at the moment. When deciding to **surf**, we must be aware of how far they might take us. Are we prepared to land on the shore and face the possibility of being swept out to sea with all its consequences? Of course we are! Because life will be made up of waves of all sizes, one after another, and it will be up to us to decide how to surf them, face them, or not. >And who hasn’t surfed—without being a surfer—waves of all sizes? Sometimes it will be healthy to let ourselves go and swim along; some we’ll enjoy, others will knock us down, and depending on the wave’s size, it will move, so we can see how far it’s capable of taking us and also how far we’re capable of facing them. That will be part of life. >And especially as life has unfolded, I’ve been swept away by a wave more than once. Who said “wave”? A whirlpool—but I managed to escape. >Dear readers, let us never lose our focus, even when we see a simple, calm wave, for it could sap our resilience and that of those with us, and it would be horrifying to even imagine for a moment what might happen to us. >This is even more true when we have people by our side whose lives depend on the decisions we make. When faced with a wave or a whirlpool, let’s never lose our composure; in those very moments, we must cling to our beliefs as a lifeline, and I have always found that this approach yields positive results. I believe in God; I will take a deep breath, cry out to heaven, and work to stay calm, because despair will lead us nowhere good. When we are caught in that wave that takes our breath away, staying calm will always be our best weapon, and that applies to everything in life.

body.title: ¿Aprovecharon las ofertas de Victoria?
body.body:
>  ![335424.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23yx1uBcM148DEnU9AjgnAZQveEqFLhvZjYeaYMxqEaUKNjHy4PZmkbDSrt4phxD9UZb5.png) Holisss que tal amigos Margariteñitos como yo,  como están? Por aca todo muy bien gracias a Dios muchisimo mejor y que continue asi, espero que por su lado también. Yo no se ustedes pero este fin de semana en el Sambil Margarita si que fue bastante potente debido a que muchas de nosotras las mujeres o algunas trabajamos de lunes a viernes o tambien estan las que no trabajan y las que si trabajan ese día la cuestión era que yo sentí como que toda margarita se fue para el sambil ese día de verdad que si jajajajaja.
Hey there, how are you, my fellow Margariteños? How are you all doing? Things are going really well here, thank God – much better than before, and I hope it stays that way. I hope things are going well for you too. I don’t know about you, but this weekend at Sambil Margarita was absolutely buzzing, because lots of us women—some of us work Monday to Friday, and then there are those who don’t work—and for those of us who did work that day, it felt like the whole of Margarita had turned up at Sambil that day, honestly, it really did, hahahaha.
![20260419_091547.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/241tQX8pWqdidipzecL614xrVBKMVLSf8M97nonwojYT6oSc7Zrp7fwrQwpGp1poPkxA5.jpg) ![20260419_092912.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wCBnSNEC9XsoozwtZDkNrpDH55fjJXRk5NYRvY2n21Nwh18qpiwKk5HCPTvo75qhWka.jpg) El chismesito es que la marca de Victoria Secret, estuvo con unas ofertas que la verdad que les puedo decir, saben que a mi me da mucha risa porque mi cuñada en mi caso yo no sabía pues que estaba la oferta y ella me dice eso esta por todo tik tok y yo me sentí como la mas india porque les digo una cosa yo siempre estoy muy activa por el tik tok pero yo nunca vi nada asi que bueno los pica piedras o quizas los mas en las nubes y yo jajajaja.
The gossip is that Victoria’s Secret had some offers on – and honestly, I can tell you, you know, it makes me laugh because my sister-in-law told me about it – I hadn’t actually realised the offer was on – and she said, ‘It’s all over TikTok,’ and I felt like such a clueless person because, let me tell you, I’m always very active on TikTok but I’d never seen anything like it, so I guess it’s the people who are a bit out of touch or perhaps a bit in the clouds, and me, ha ha ha.
![IMG-20260419-WA0016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wCA61k2Avzk78NAtQxfWE3R8Anj58BHLVMcMUb5F28nMidNW2XXiWh4ZVg81bLNPCCz.jpg) ![IMG-20260419-WA0017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EpCALxLtMuNtZqfaFxdqUHWySrKz9yRPmrahhBUFM9qTEcx6SyZgQi9VC1Q4DQ4RHrC.jpg) Pero para terminarles de contar los splash y lociones de la marca estaban a un precio de 11$ casi que un 50% de descuento y obviamente estamos hablando de algo de calidad no es nada asi como tal que se pueda llamar cualquiera cosa, y creanme la gente lo sabia porque ademas que tienen cashea con ese oferton la gente hacía colas tras colas interminables o no se si yo porque me sentía mejor el ultimo día que ya fui de verdad que el ultimo día pero era un horror la gente se mataba por no qudar por fuera incluso se llevaban de cajas que todos sabemos que eso era para revender la cuestión es que apesar de la gente todo estaba muy surtido y aunque se logro el objetivo entre varias amigas despues termine pasando rabia por un arnes que quería para jade muy bello y solo había talla XL jajajajaa pero creanme ojala no se hubieran perdido ese ofertón ¡Saludos!
But to finish the story, the brand’s body sprays and lotions were priced at $11 – almost a 50% discount – and obviously we’re talking about a quality product; it’s not just some run-of-the-mill thing you could call anything, and believe me, people knew it because, as well as the cash back on that offer, there were endless queues. Or maybe it was just me, because I felt better on the last day – I actually went on the very last day – but it was a nightmare; people were fighting tooth and nail not to miss out, and they were even taking boxes full, which we all know was for resale. The thing is, despite the crowds, there was plenty in stock, and although achieved our goal with a few friends, I ended up getting annoyed about a harness I wanted for Jade – it was really beautiful, but they only had size XL, hahaha – but believe me, I wish you hadn’t missed out on that massive sale! Cheers!
![Screenshot_20260419_104246_WhatsApp.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/48XfEmhVyLfzBn4hgYYfHeTjVRbeoBxQwzdvg3KnW4qRgAJuL9q7jmdw72LdNbd9Cw.jpg) ![20260419_094945.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vsLK7DAEk2Lx3cBbtNARyuvkgpK22o4wLSX9ArsCWarL1hsBxpSM8Va9jsPWVCr7mMV.jpg)

body.title: Promotional photos for radio hosts in my city | monomad challenge.
body.body:
> Hello, friends, good evening. I hope you’re all doing well. Today I want to share with you some quick photos I took for the mother of one of my dearest friends, who has been living abroad for several years now. She wrote to me asking if I could take some photos of her mom with her partner because she’s going to resume her radio show—she’s one of the best radio hosts in the city. When I say “resume,” it’s because some time ago she suffered a serious illness, and thank God, thanks to her determination, she’s recovering from it. She wants to get back to her life little by little. Anyway, friends, when my friend asked me this, I said yes without a doubt, and we planned the day for them to come to the studio to take the promotional photos, and that’s how it went. We got some beautiful photos that will be useful for her project, and here they are, friends. I hope you like them, and if you do, let me know. She got a makeover and everything to make the work more diverse; they were delighted, and that’s what’s most important and rewarding for me. Now then, friends, without further ado, here are the photos. >Hola amigos muy buenas noches, espero todos se encuentren muy bien, el día de hoy quiero compartir con ustedes unas fotografías casi exprés que realice para la mama de una de las amigas mas queridas que tengo que esta fuera del pais desde hace algunos años, ella me escribió para pedirme el favor de que le hiciera unas fotografías a su mama junto a su compañero porque va a retomar su programa de radio ya que ella es locutora, de las mejores de la cuidad, cuando les digo retomar es porque hace algún tiempo ella recayó en una enfermedad grave y gracias a Dios y su formaleza esta saliendo de ello y bueno, quiere regresar a su vida poco a poco, en fin amigos cuando mi amiga me pidió esto sin duda alguna le dije que si y planificamos el día para que vinieran al estudio a hacerse las fotografías promocionales y asi fue, logramos unas lindas fotos que le servirá para su proyecto y acá se las dejo amigos, espero les agraden y si es asi me lo dejan saber, ella tuvo cambio de look y todo para hacer mas diverso el trabajo, quedaron encantados y eso es lo mas importante y gratificante para mi, ahora si amigos, sin mas ahora les dejo las fotografias.

body.title: Wisdom of the Bible: Limit the time when you are in the presence of fools, but linger as much as possible among those who are thoughtful. Ben Sira 27:12
body.body: The Book of Ben Sira in the Bible, after beginning by presenting the importance of wisdom and the fear of God, delivers a series of varied maxims without a precise order on different issues of daily life, such as the importance of humility, duties towards priests and the poor, and, in particular, the importance of good and bad company.\nThe principles exposed by Ben Sira in his sapiential book are deeply practical and show the importance of seeking and living wisdom as a spiritual treasure that must be discovered, taught, and lived.\nAnd regarding friendships and companionship, the master Ben Sira wisely taught the following phrase: \
Ben Sira 27:12. This phrase from Ben Sira has a very precise practical meaning, because there is another phrase from the sapiential books that is very similar and says the following: \

Proverbs 13:20.
Like any wise man, Ben Sira wondered what benefit could be gained from the company of fools, and concluded with his spiritual quote that, practically, more than benefits, with fools, there are only problems. And this is because fools only follow their passions and fleeting desires, without any long-term guidance in their actions; a fool thinks one thing one day and another thing the next day, depending on what suits him personally.
In contrast, wise and thoughtful people direct their thinking towards the most excellent thing, wisdom, and subject their thinking to the most perfect science, which makes these people predictable, benevolent, progressive, and edifying. In practical terms, then, blessedness consists of seeking out the wise and avoiding the foolish. But this is ultimately a voluntarist assertion, because in the end, like seeks like, and just as wise people do not like the company of fools, fools are repulsed by the company of wise people.
![Wisdom of the Bible. Limit the time when you are in the presence of fools, but linger as much as possible among those who are thoughtful. body.title: Laundry Asset Management System: A Complete Guide
body.body: >Managing large volumes of textiles, uniforms, and linens can be a challenging task for commercial laundries, healthcare providers, and hospitality businesses. Without proper tracking, items can easily be misplaced, overused, or lost, leading to increased costs and inefficiencies. A Laundry asset Management system offers a smart solution by providing real-time visibility and control over all laundry assets.

>A modern system uses advanced technologies such as RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) to track each item throughout its lifecycle. From collection and washing to delivery and reuse, every piece of linen is monitored accurately. This ensures that businesses always know the exact location and status of their inventory, reducing losses and improving accountability.

>One of the biggest advantages of a laundry asset system is real-time inventory management. Instead of relying on manual counting, businesses can instantly access updated stock levels and usage data. This not only saves time but also minimises human errors. With automated tracking, organisations can maintain optimal stock levels and avoid both shortages and overstocking.

>Another key benefit is improved operational efficiency. The system streamlines processes such as sorting, counting, and reporting, allowing staff to focus on more productive tasks. Automated reporting tools provide valuable insights into textile usage, helping managers identify inefficiencies and make data-driven decisions.

>A Laundry asset Management system also enhances customer satisfaction. By ensuring accurate deliveries and timely service, businesses can build trust with their clients. Real-time tracking allows companies to respond quickly to customer queries and provide reliable updates, improving transparency and service quality.

>Additionally, these systems help reduce operational costs. By minimising losses, improving asset utilisation, and automating routine tasks, businesses can significantly cut expenses. They also support scalability, making it easier to manage multiple locations and growing workloads without compromising efficiency.

>Laundry asset Management system is essential for businesses looking to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance service quality. With real-time tracking, automation, and data insights, it transforms traditional laundry operations into a modern, streamlined, and highly productive system.

body.body:
![584d48ce0a44bd1070d5d46f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJg3BnVxoiM2NuNHqgzjQovf9NYMeSJ4EYmngpiJMp61Su8EWJJbQuCKSGUjh45.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

For the third straight game the A's have proven that no lead is safe when you're playing them. For three straight games the A's have shown great fight, successfully completing comebacks two of the three contests. 

The A's were punched in the mouth early again yesterday, but they [punched back!](https://youtu.be/HlINQyMh0W8?si=ciDD0NeJ6Ow93aLI) They came back in pretty cool fashion too. After being down 3-0 the A's hit three consecutive **solo** shots by Carlos Cortes (his second of 2026), Nick Kurtz (his third of 2026), and Shea Langeliers (his seventh of 2026)! Carlos Cortes is a player that I've been getting good vibes from in general as I get to know the roster more. Then in the eighth the A's buried the Mariners once and for all with three insurance runs. Just an awesome win to get back above .500 and inconvenience the Mariners who were the AL West Champions a year ago.

J.T. Ginn had an acceptable outing on the mound which I can appreciate. He pitched 5 1/3 innings allowing three runs.

Jacob Lopez takes the mound tonight. It would be a great time for him to have a good start as he's been shaky to start the year. It would be really big to further bury the Mariners early in the season.

When people think of the AL West, most people think about the Astros or Mariners...but the A's are coming in hot I tell ya!

The weather is ideal in Seattle, let's go!

body.title: Empatía de cartón  (esp-eng)
body.body:
<center>![1000024321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23zbTpMdtkLgHQaDV269ELfrPGPpj1Nr8GaNburSTCiuBtWttd8r4xwKKTQ6rbQzobuFg.jpg)</center>

​Hoy me vi a mí misma ante esta duda, y es que me considero una mujer empática que se coloca en el lugar del otro; sin embargo, esta postura, por más emocional y simbólica que sea, no llega a ser totalmente completa.

​—¿Pero por qué expreso esto?—, la razón está tan a la vista, de manera hasta absurda, y sin embargo uno no la ve, o más bien no la nota, porque hemos decidido no mirar a ese costado que ha palidecido en sus colores y luces.

<center>![1000024327.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xKvd3RQVtQWXdnHrw9tgdFNk7iSMtU8NbQ7Pv46LRczcgjLkyXcS2cELXKgoijNSmLp.png)</center> 

​Bien se dice que la empatía es ponernos en el lugar del otro, pero caemos y pecamos de eruditos superados, quizás sintiendo ilusamente que nuestro “discurso motivacional” tendrá un poder mágico y absoluto, logrando que aquella persona mejore al cien por ciento.

​La banalidad emerge en nuestro ser como si nuestra boca fuera la dueña absoluta de una verdad que “no conocemos ni vivimos”. Es aquí donde me frené en este camino de “empatía de cartón” para volver a la verdadera raíz de la empatía.

<center>![1000024326.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23vi1YRzhQBdb7s9aQNJEyEZYjd7Lory51qp5JccnGAMB74Rr4tgR9xpsXMfrZWif9fM5.png)</center> 

​Si bien es cierto, es completamente imposible poder sentir lo que siente aquella persona que está sufriendo, ya sean dolores del alma, la mente o físicos. Es ahí donde veo con dolor que mis palabras “motivacionales y esperanzadoras” dejan de tener sentido ante aquel o aquella que está sufriendo.
​Entonces analizo, y la empatía no es competencia de hablar sobre quién ha sufrido más, quién ha cruzado más pruebas difíciles, porque la empatía hacia la otra persona no necesita otro protagonista que compita en el asunto.

​Es ahí donde comprendo que el mejor apoyo que uno puede brindar es el “silencio”, ese que acompaña, que respeta los tiempos individuales, que contiene el llanto sin juzgar, sin decir que “todo estará bien” porque sabemos que eso pasará, pero no sabemos cuándo.

​Ese apoyo, moral y espiritual en el silencio del momento, donde los abrazos hablan al igual que las miradas, es la empatía verdadera, porque realmente uno no sabe cuánto dolor cargan esas almas y cuerpos; no lo sabemos realmente, ni menos podemos llegar a imaginarlo. Ahí es donde esa anécdota personal pasada, donde nosotros sufrimos, deja de tener sentido, porque —¡vamos! Nadie que está mal quiere escuchar cosas malas— y ante aquel evento, donde esa persona se suelta, el llanto en un sollozo ahogado y se quiebra como lo hacía el bebé buscando el calor de su madre, no necesita nada más que nuestra real compañía, sin especular, sin comparar, solo acompañar y escuchar.

<center>![1000024328.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23z7DqkrhGGPKrj9x1HPn1k3iZ6vnJuYm7ALC9jAw4MKVJGbdsXpPfRjtfHSbqNbThUA2.png)</center> 

​En algún punto el ser humano olvidó las reales esencias de lo bueno y, en medio de ese olvido, anexó esas partes que eran innecesarias, donde las comparaciones entre vivencias explotan, creando más dolor e incertidumbre en el proceso.

​Por este motivo es que consulto:

​¿Eres realmente empático o caes en el lado absurdo de las comparaciones pasadas?

***​”Tu dolor lo desconozco, pero estoy ahí para escucharte, en silencio educado, que acompaña, estando atenta para abrazar tus lágrimas sin impedir que estas nazcan.”***
***
### <center>English</center>
***
<center>![1000024321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23zbTpMdtkLgHQaDV269ELfrPGPpj1Nr8GaNburSTCiuBtWttd8r4xwKKTQ6rbQzobuFg.jpg)</center>

Today I found myself grappling with this dilemma: I consider myself an empathetic woman who puts herself in other people’s shoes; yet this approach, however emotional and symbolic it may be, falls short of being entirely comprehensive.

‘But why am I saying this?’ The reason is so obvious, almost absurdly so, and yet one does not see it, or rather does not notice it, because we have decided not to look at that side which has faded in its colours and light.

<center>![1000024327.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xKvd3RQVtQWXdnHrw9tgdFNk7iSMtU8NbQ7Pv46LRczcgjLkyXcS2cELXKgoijNSmLp.png)</center> 

It is rightly said that empathy means putting ourselves in another’s shoes, but we fall into the trap of acting like self-important know-it-alls, perhaps deluding ourselves that our ‘motivational speech’ will possess some magical and absolute power, capable of making that person improve one hundred per cent.

​Banalities emerge from within us as if our mouths were the absolute masters of a truth that ‘we neither know nor experience’. It is here that I paused on this path of ‘cardboard empathy’ to return to the true root of empathy.

<center>![1000024326.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23vi1YRzhQBdb7s9aQNJEyEZYjd7Lory51qp5JccnGAMB74Rr4tgR9xpsXMfrZWif9fM5.png)</center> 

​Whilst it is true, it is completely impossible to feel what that person who is suffering feels, be it pain of the soul, the mind or the body. It is there that I see, with pain, that my “motivational and hopeful” words cease to make sense to the one who is suffering.
​So I reflect, and empathy is not a contest about who has suffered more, who has faced the most difficult trials, because empathy towards another person needs no other protagonist to compete in the matter.

​It is there that I realise the best support one can offer is ‘silence’—the kind that accompanies, that respects individual timelines, that holds back tears without judging, without saying ‘everything will be alright’ because we know that will happen, but we do not know when.

That support—moral and spiritual—in the silence of the moment, where hugs speak just as much as glances, is true empathy, because we really do not know how much pain those souls and bodies carry; we do not really know it, nor can we even begin to imagine it. That is where that past personal anecdote, where we ourselves suffered, ceases to make sense, because—come on! No one who is suffering wants to hear bad things—and in the face of that moment, when that person lets go, weeping in a choked sob and breaking down just as the baby did, seeking his mother’s warmth, he needs nothing more than our genuine presence, without speculation, without comparison, just to be there and listen.

<center>![1000024328.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23z7DqkrhGGPKrj9x1HPn1k3iZ6vnJuYm7ALC9jAw4MKVJGbdsXpPfRjtfHSbqNbThUA2.png)</center> 

At some point, human beings forgot the true essence of what is good and, in the midst of that forgetfulness, added on those unnecessary elements, where comparisons between experiences run rampant, creating more pain and uncertainty in the process.

​For this reason, I ask:

​Are you truly empathetic, or do you fall into the absurd trap of past comparisons?

***​“I do not know your pain, but I am here to listen to you, in polite silence, offering companionship, attentive to embrace your tears without preventing them from flowing.”***
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/1000009838.png)</center>

<center>

​<sub>Las imágenes usadas fueron creadas en Gemini AI.</sub>
<sub>El texto fue traducido en DeepL versión free.</sub>
​</center>

body.title: Three small great wonders in my garden [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGsQC8YQT1utEc6mrmzU4rHGi1bSfkGt1zRrxDTwhE4K/1776821158847.jpg)



***
***
There are days when the garden decides to give you something unexpected and when you least expect it, there is a tiny detail that reminds you why you love getting your hands dirty and observing the slow growth of plants.

This morning it happened to me. I went out with my cup of coffee, with no other purpose than to water a little and remove some dry leaves, and I came across three wonders that filled me with immense joy.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZoEY8o6W8MaaaYvRxRD3gtnHYo32H6zXKdG9pYkwqENC/1776821361930.jpg)


***
The first was given to me by a cactus I have had for years and whose name I still do not know. Today it has a huge bud, of such an intense purple that it seems from another world. It is a flower about to open, fleshy, almost obscene in its excess of color. I do not know how I did not see it before, but I stood looking at it, caressing with my eyes that violent and beautiful explosion. It seems as if the cactus had been keeping a secret for months and decided that it was time to tell me.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNPuczmTed86r5S7EprLRmw5LXswEWpEHKhbKb3HVnLm/1776821363374.jpg)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyxC3n9MBJGoLh2LjCktXUUREbALWsnmj7FLGKCUV75V/1776821362644.jpg)

***
The second surprise was more discreet, but just as exciting. My Echeveria has started to bloom. They are thin stems that rise silently, and at their tips what will be the flowers begin to take shape. I love how echeverias bloom without fanfare because it gives the feeling that the plant is stretching its neck to see what lies beyond itself.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUF5uZcRtKRzJYGwDGL8BKs4o5K4NCqhLQR5zbjaMKLfe/1776821604814.jpg)


***
But what stole my heart the most was the third. On one of my mammillarias, those round, friendly cacti full of little white bumps, I saw a small red fruit. It is a tiny little dot, like a miniature pepper among the spines, generously sheltering the seeds of future generations. I felt like an explorer discovering a hidden treasure. That little red ball, so small it is almost invisible, contains all the promise of what is to come.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePponvPdZcT1QpuUPQy7Wm79ZtiD64o1uzSULm68sj8V/1776821604127.jpg)


***
Suddenly I felt that my garden is not just a collection of pots and soil, but rather a tiny world that pulsates, that shudders, that decides to surprise me when I least expect it. I do not need great achievements or spectacular landscapes because with a purple bud, some pink bell flowers, and a red fruit the size of a tear, I have more than enough to feel that today has been a beautiful day.
<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYweGm8mMxKLmFZYSPAHak3F6Zz1vgqfa4B6ixGv588XE/1776476176320.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** 🍃
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.

### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center> Tres pequeñas grandes maravillas en mi jardín</center>



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYygpBfx3i4eD6w8wV7DT6AtXztYQREE8qutTjGMiJ2CS/1776821159432.jpg)



***
***


Hay días en que el jardín decide regalarte algo inesperado y cuando menos lo buscas, ahí está un detalle diminuto que te recuerda por qué amas esto de ensuciarte las manos y observar el crecimiento lento de las plantas.

Esta mañana me ha pasado. Salí con mi taza de café, sin más propósito que regar un poco y quitar alguna hoja seca y me encontré con tres maravillas que me han llenado de una alegría inmensa.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZoEY8o6W8MaaaYvRxRD3gtnHYo32H6zXKdG9pYkwqENC/1776821361930.jpg)

***
La primera me la ha dado un cactus que tengo hace años y cuyo nombre sigo sin saber. Hoy tiene un botón enorme, de un púrpura tan intenso que parece de otro mundo. Es una flor a punto de abrirse, carnosa, casi obscena en su exceso de color. No sé cómo no lo vi antes pero me he quedado mirándolo, acariciando con la mirada esa explosión violenta y hermosa. Tal parece como si el cactus hubiera estado guardando un secreto durante meses y hubiera decidido que ya era hora de contármelo.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNPuczmTed86r5S7EprLRmw5LXswEWpEHKhbKb3HVnLm/1776821363374.jpg)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyxC3n9MBJGoLh2LjCktXUUREbALWsnmj7FLGKCUV75V/1776821362644.jpg)


***
La segunda sorpresa estaba más discreta, pero igual de emocionante. Mi Echeveria ha empezado a florecer. Son tallos finos que se elevan sin hacer ruido, y en sus puntas empiezan a dibujarse lo que serán las flores. Me encanta cómo las echeverias florecen sin estridencias porque da la sensación de que la planta está estirando el cuello para ver qué hay más allá de ella misma.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUF5uZcRtKRzJYGwDGL8BKs4o5K4NCqhLQR5zbjaMKLfe/1776821604814.jpg)


***
Pero lo que más me ha robado el corazón ha sido la tercera. En una de mis mammillarias, esos cactus redondos y simpáticos, llenos de bultitos blancos, he visto un pequeño fruto rojo. Es un puntito diminuto, como una miniatura de pimiento entre las espinas, resguardando con generosidad las semillas de futuras generaciones. Me he sentido como un explorador que descubre un tesoro escondido. Esa bolita roja, tan pequeña que casi no se ve, contiene toda la promesa de lo que vendrá.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePponvPdZcT1QpuUPQy7Wm79ZtiD64o1uzSULm68sj8V/1776821604127.jpg)


***
De repente he sentido que mi jardín no es solo un conjunto de macetas y tierra, más bien es un mundo diminuto que late, que se estremece, que decide sorprenderme cuando menos lo espero. No necesito grandes logros ni paisajes espectaculares pues con un botón púrpura, unas campanitas rosas y un fruto rojo del tamaño de una lágrima, tengo más que suficiente para sentir que hoy ha sido un día hermoso.

<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1776476176416.jpg)

body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - License to do Something
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - License to do something. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRGGItZxhNZtARhYw8nHNqnd_cSqN6gT-gfMn1y8kSMmQ&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRGGItZxhNZtARhYw8nHNqnd_cSqN6gT-gfMn1y8kSMmQ&s=10)
[Source ](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRGGItZxhNZtARhYw8nHNqnd_cSqN6gT-gfMn1y8kSMmQ&s=10)

A license to do something meant that the license holder has gone through the proper training and is fully qualified to perform the task he or she is license to do. 
A license is a document usually issued by regulatory bodies commission by the government of a country to be in charge of reviewing and issuing. 

This piece of document is unlike any card or any piece of paper one gets, it's a certification of skill of the holder and with that it also comes with regulatory and legal responsibility.

A piece of license that I think all country has it and is very much common is the driver's license. With this license, holder will be able to handle motor vehicle, like driving it, parking it. The process of obtaining the license is the same as any others, first, you enroll in a driving school or engage an instructor and then you go through lessons of training for a full syllables to ensure you pick up the skills to operate in a safe manner. Once you have learnt and done enough practice, you go for driving test under the supervision of a qualified certifier. Once pass, you will have a license to drive.

And in order for government to want to license, it usually mean the action or trade will affect the lives of the practitioner or others like driver, doctors and electricians.

body.title: What happened Chelsea
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAjxUPXxDnyXHsb7sYb4NKqng4mESTdfR2NnZYy6fjNp/1776821584098.jpg)

ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာ EPL Round 34 ပွဲစဉ် ၁ ပွဲ ကစားသွားခဲ့၏။ Brighton vs Chelsea တို့၏ ပွဲစဉ် ဖြစ်၏။ Brighton က ၃-၀ ဖြင့် ဂိုးပြတ် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့၏။ ယခု ရှုံးပွဲကြောင့် Chelsea အနေဖြင့် EPL မှာ ၅ ပွဲဆက် ရှုံးပွဲ အဖြစ် ကြုံတွေ့သွားခဲ့ရပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ Round 29 မှာ Aston Villa ကို အဝေးကွင်းမှာ ၁-၄ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရပြီး နောက်ပိုင်း ၅ ပွဲဆက်ကို ရှုံးနိမ့်ထားခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ New Castle ကို ၀-၁၊ Everton ကို ၃-၀၊ Man City ကို ၀-၃၊ Man United ကို ၀-၁၊ Brighton ကို ၃-၀ တို့ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်ထားခဲ့၏။ ဘယ်သို့ ဖြစ်သွား သနည်း။

UCL ဝင်ခွင့်ကနေ Europa League ဝင်ခွင့်သို့ လျော့ကျ။ ဟော ခုဆို Conference League ကန်ရဖို့သာ ရှိတော့၏။ ဒီအတိုင်း ဆက်သွားရင် Conference League ဝင်ခွင့်မှာ ဆုံးရှုံးသွားရနိုင်၏။ ခု ရှုံးပွဲကြောင့် အဆင့် ၆ နေရာကို Brighton လက်ထဲ လွှဲပြောင်း ပေးလိုက်ရ၏။ Europa ကနေ Conference League ကစားခွင့်သို့ ရောက်သွား၏။ အဆင့် ၈ ကနေ ၁၂ ထိ အသင်းတွေကပါ Chelsea ၏ လက်ရှိ နေရာကို ချိန်းခြောက်နေခဲ့၏။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTawUT1Ui76eyimTSbHo9cEZacVrScAKkGniMTxsT1jC7/1776821584116.jpg)


UCL ဝင်ခွင့် ရနေရမယ့် သို့မဟုတ် UCL ဝင်ခွင့်အတွက် ကြိုးစားနေရမယ့် Chelsea က Europa & Conference League အတွက် ကြိုးစား ရုန်းကန်နေရတယ် ဆိုတာကြီးကတော့ မဖြစ်သင့်ပေ။ မနှစ်က Conference League Champion ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပြီးနောက် Conference League မှာပဲ မင်းမူ ကြီးစိုးဖို့ တွေးနေခဲ့သည်လားတော့ မပြောတတ်တော့ပေ။

United နည်းပြ Michael Carrick နှင့် မရှေးမနှောင်းမှာ Chelsea ကို ကိုင်တွယ်ခွင့်ရခဲ့သည့် နည်းပြ Rosenior ကို ထုတ်‌ပယ်ပေးဖို့ လေသံတွေ ကျယ်လောင်စွာ ထွက်ပေါ်လို့ လာနေပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ Man City ကို ၀-၃ ဖြင့် ရှုံးတုန်းကတော့ Chelsea fan တွေကအစ ပျော်နေကြ၏။ နို့ပေမဲ့ ခုလို ရှုံးပွဲဆက်လာတော့ ပျော်ဖို့ မကောင်းတော့ပေ။ 

Round 35 မှာက Nottm Forest နဲ့ တွေ့ရမှာဆိုတော့ တန်းဆင်းဇုန် ဖိအား ရှိနေသည့် Nottm Forest က Chelsea ကို နောက်ထပ် ရှုံးပွဲ တွေ့စေဦးမလားမပြောတတ်ပေ။ Round 35 မကန်ခင်မှာ FA Cup Semifinal အဖြစ် Leeds အသင်းနှင့် ကစားရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ Round 36 မှာ Liverpool နှင့် အဝေးကွင်း၊ Round 37 မှာ Tottenham နှင့် အိမ်ကွင်း၊ Round 38 မှာ Sunderland နှင့် အဝေးကွင်း ပွဲစဉ်များ ကစားရပေလိမ့်မည်။ လက်ကျန် ပွဲစဉ်တွေက Chelsea အတွက် တကယ် ခက်ခဲပေလိမ့်မည်။

_(photos from Premier League Page)

Viajé a tres estados de Venezuela y, como buena runner, aproveché cada espacio para entrenar. Mi primera parada fue Caracas. Tenía cinco años que no visitaba la capital. Al principio me sentí abrumada porque ha vuelto el caos que la ha caracterizado. El domingo 12 de abril entrené en el Cortafuego, no pude registrar el entrenamiento en Strava porque el GPS enloqueció y arrojó datos erróneos.

El lunes 13 corrí en la pista de atletismo del Pedagógico, ¡me encantó! Al día siguiente viajé a Lechería (Anzoátegui). Tenía seis años sin visitar el mar y este encuentro fue hermoso. Corrí a orilla de la playa en un circuito de tierra y subí al cerro El Morro el martes y el miércoles. La vista era increíble.

El viernes viajé a La Victoria (Aragua) y el sábado a las 6:00 a. m. ya estaba en la Hacienda Santa Teresa, lista para correr la Race 13K, una carrera explosiva y muy rápida. Logré el tercer lugar en la categoría Máster A, tiempo 1 hora 27 segundos, D+ 300 metros.

Sé que pude haberlo hecho mejor, pero no dormí lo suficiente antes de la carrera. El aire acondicionado del hotel donde me quedé me afectó considerablemente. Esa noche precompetencia me sentí bastante mal porque mis fosas nasales y mi garganta se irritaron. De cualquier manera, he aprendido a celebrar mis logros y sé que lo di todo. Me encantó la ruta y la experiencia. Mi última parada fue Caracas y el domingo por la mañana corrí 30 minutos en el parque Los Caobos.

Ese mismo día regresé a Mérida con el corazón llenito de gratitud. De esta manera, cierro mi primera temporada de trail y vuelvo al asfalto.

¡Seguimos!

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: ¿Es eso cierto? / 5 Minute Freewrite: is that right?
body.body:
>

# Dudas



#

Hay tipos de noticias para informar y el peso de darla a quien corresponde y sea de su interés, es incluso una responsabilidad grande o pequeña, pero tiene su importancia; cuando se trata de decir algo bueno, alegre que lleva consigo emociones en las cuales también se espera reacciones de la persona que recibe la buena nueva hay un espíritu de celebración. Como hay variación en la personalidad de las personas también hay mucha diferencia en su forma de expresarse, comportarse y se notara más euforia en uno y otros con más calma actuaran porque suelen ser menos expresivos.

Entonces es notable esa distancia existente en la forma como reaccionan las personas ante una noticia positiva a una negativa, evidentemente la emoción no es la misma. En ambos casos cuando el nivel de intensidad es tan alto y una respuesta humana es quedarse paralizado o cuestionar si lo que están diciendo realmente es verdad o no, bien sea malo o bueno surge una interrogante común y es pensar en **¿Es eso cierto?**, quizás lo pones en duda. Porque puede ser algo que esperabas saber hace mucho tiempo, que te costó mucho trabajo y esfuerzo por eso la sorpresa.

Además, cuando tristemente se trata de una noticia lamentable menos quieres aceptar ni creer en que eso que te están diciendo sea cierto, la mente se puede bloquear al escuchar algo que te afecta mucho y ponerse en negación es una forma de reaccionar bastante válida. Entonces es necesario buscar un equilibrio para tratar de controlar las emociones, a veces hay que respirar y aunque tome un tiempo procesar lo que está escuchando sea bueno o malo.
​



​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>

​

# Questions


#
There are different kinds of news to share, and the responsibility of conveying it to the right person—and ensuring it’s of interest to them—is a task that may be big or small, but it’s significant. When it comes to sharing something good and joyful—something that evokes emotions and elicits a reaction from the person receiving the good news—there’s a spirit of celebration. Just as people’s personalities vary, so too do their ways of expressing themselves and behaving. Some will show more euphoria, while others will act more calmly because they tend to be less expressive.
​
So it’s striking how differently people react to positive news versus negative news; clearly, the emotional response isn’t the same. In both cases, when the intensity is so high and a natural human response is to freeze or question whether what is being said is actually true—whether it’s bad or good—a common question arises: **“Is that true?”** You might doubt it. Because it could be something you’ve been waiting to hear for a long time, something that took a lot of hard work and effort, which is why it comes as a surprise.
​
Furthermore, when you’re faced with sad or unfortunate news—news you’d rather not accept or believe is true—your mind can shut down when you hear something that deeply affects you, and going into denial is a perfectly valid way to react. So it’s important to find a balance to help manage your emotions; sometimes you just need to take a deep breath, even if it takes a while to process what you’re hearing, whether it’s good or bad.
​

#

做了两天抗阻运动，手臂肉肉有点酸[捂脸][捂脸]今天休息一天吧！虽然想减脂，但是没想到太累了，整个人觉得好累！问了朋友和豆包，原来一个星期做三次可以了，不能每天做！我不知道啊哈哈，喜欢出汗的感觉！

虽然昨晚没怎么出汗，但是太累了。我做多了两组运动，太心急想身上肉肉紧致点儿！想身体越来越好，但是不能这样高强度运动的！我要继续调整方案锻炼身体，三个月后再查一下血脂和血糖的问题！

后来再出门跑步了，觉得跑步和做体操比较好，虽然累，也没昨晚做的运动累！整个人都不想动了，希望明天能好起来啦！明天朋友过来广州玩，我怕我陪不了他走太多的路了！

做完手术两年几没运动，现在突然这样，就是身体受不了，吃力了！傻傻的我太心急，平时都是散步几千步而已！或者做深蹲和保健操的，一下子高强度的运动，觉得整个人不好了！

不过病友们说她们也做健身的，也是脂肪包肌肉，说有酸痛的感觉就是好事！酸只是打破你的平时不运动开关，力量运动就是每一次都要做到酸，每一次每一次不停进步！我明白了哈哈😊……

不管啦，继续做运动，努力加油。越来越好的！
