body.title: A Day in My City (Eng/ Esp)
body.body:
> Today I ran some errands, did some shopping, and visited various places around my city—partly to walk and get some exercise, as my doctor recommended, and partly just for my own enjoyment, because I love walking through the streets of my city; even though I’ve known it my whole life, it always surprises me every time I go out to explore it, and I never tire of seeing it and photographing it. And when I do, I feel the need to share with you what my eyes see.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23x1Dc23CXFMSVnxkXxFNBm7QpGVhZqYxxZgCB3hP4MWzC99nQ89vFw6gXo8KgwLtngbS.png)
People’s daily lives, the coming and going of cars and the subway, my visits to the different shopping centers—which always have new things on display whenever I go—and, besides, I love observing the combination of the city’s urban landscape and nature; because my city is a very colorful city, filled with trees, plants, and flowers, and surrounded by our imposing Mount Ávila, which can be seen from any point in the city, since it completely encircles it. You could say that Caracas is a valley bordered by beautiful mountains no matter where you look at it from.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23vYd52nN9KPqeSpmi3pMXvqytT2hb358SsBiiacxHN5kB85sbpaT5QZFHcNjhY7LWaLz.png)
But aside from that, I also like to walk through the different spaces we have available, such as plazas, walking paths, parks of all kinds, and the various stores for whatever you want or are looking for. As my friends say, the thing is, you just need to have money to treat yourself to whatever you want; in my case, after walking quite a bit and doing my shopping, the tropical heat of these lands got to me, and I decided to eat a delicious fruit popsicle—in this case, blackberry, filled with condensed milk; it was really tasty. While I was eating it, I took the opportunity to rest at the ice cream shop and watched people go by, and after resting up, I continued on my way home.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23xyT4sptKvjRCPR2MSnwNVQ9HVmKAgC1j8kuEBuzaaqoTUiWhxrcwqJiy12qvugqQUuf.png)
But that encouraged me even more to keep taking photos of everything that caught my eye, to immortalize my beloved streets; perhaps a few years from now all this will change, and I’ll be left with my photos as a memory, because, like everything else, changes are always happening in a city as bustling as this one. Fortunately, many structures remain for cultural reasons, especially iconic places like the block where the Bolívar family home stands or the Plaza del Venezolano, among many other spots; so the essence of the city center isn’t lost.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23tvefbPbBrnzUL88TViKcnyKjqFh9QdfjtDkQdnSwYv8oKv8Y1ihYtmwzAYafbNHDX7X.png)
When I walk through these streets, I take the opportunity to organize my thoughts, ideas, and especially everything related to #Hive, since it’s impossible not to see something I want to share with the different communities on this beautiful blockchain, and today was one of those days when I saw many interesting things that I’ll share later. For now, I wanted to show you some of our streets, avenues, shops, and businesses as part of one of my routines that I love to do every now and then, because there’s nothing like going out to see how life unfolds and enjoying what we love. I hope you enjoy my tour; it was a pleasure to share it with you. Cheers!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/242Nh76MPo2sTkpgqzaRjuNbL4WsN21vtTMmKjXrYgiuRbL3HxGNWTqLFug82gzHRrpDe.png)

Esp

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23w2esv6dBP6VZo5HLrTJgK1eaHWKxLqyxiXSVsaxddE2AahpF7xWzvtk1dUDR2E3QJjz.png) El día de hoy estuve haciendo varias diligencias, unas compras y unas visitas a varios lugares de mi ciudad, con el propósito de caminar y hacer ejercicios también, según las indicaciones de mi médico y también por gusto propio, pues me encanta transitar por las calles de mi ciudad, porque aunque la conozco desde que soy yo, siempre me sorprende cada vez que salgo a recorrerla y es que no me canso de verla y fotografiarla y, al hacerlo, nace en mí la necesidad de compartirles lo que mis ojos ven. La cotidianidad de las personas, el ir y venir de los carros, del metro, mis visitas también a los diferentes centros comerciales, que cada vez que los visito tienen cosas nuevas en exhibición y, aparte, me encanta observar la combinación entre el urbanismo propio de la ciudad y la naturaleza; porque mi ciudad es una ciudad muy colorida, acompañada de árboles, plantas, flores y rodeada por nuestra imponente montaña Ávila, que se puede divisar desde cualquier punto de la ciudad, ya que la rodea completamente. Se podría decir que Caracas es un valle bordeado por hermosas montañas desde donde se le mire. Pero aparte de eso, también me gusta caminar por los diferentes espacios que tenemos a disposición, como plazas, caminerías, parques de todo tipo y las diferentes tiendas para todo lo que se quiera y se busque. Como dicen mis amigas, lo que hay es que tener dinero para darse cualquier gusto; en mi caso, luego de caminar bastante y realizar mis compras, me atacó el calor tropical de estas tierras y decidí comerme una rica paleta de helado de frutas, en este caso mora, rellena con leche condensada; estaba muy rica. Mientras la comía, aproveché y descansé en la heladería y vi a las personas pasar y, luego de estar descansada, seguí mi camino rumbo a casa. Pero eso me animó más a seguir tomando mis fotos, de todo lo que me llamaba la atención, para así inmortalizar mis calles queridas; quizás unos años más tarde todo esto cambie y me queden mis fotos para el recuerdo, porque, como todo, los cambios siempre se están dando en una ciudad tan movida como esta. Afortunadamente, muchas estructuras se mantienen por cuestión cultural, sobre todo los lugares icónicos, como la cuadra de la casa de los Bolívar o la Plaza del Venezolano, entre muchos otros lugares; entonces no se pierde la esencia del centro de la ciudad. Cuando camino por estas calles, aprovecho y pongo en orden mis pensamientos, ideas y sobre todo con lo que tiene que ver con #Hive, pues es inevitable no ver algo que quiera compartir en las diferentes comunidades de esta linda blockchain, y hoy fue un día de estos en que vi muchas cosas interesantes que ya compartiré posteriormente. De momento, les quise mostrar parte de nuestras calles, avenidas, tiendas y negocios, como parte de una de mis rutinas que me encanta realizar de vez en cuando, porque nada como salir a ver cómo la vida sucede y disfrutar de lo que amamos. Espero que disfruten mi recorrido; fue un placer compartirlo con ustedes. !Saludos.!
![Añadir un título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/EpLjnqM8ptWQ4Du5t5CwS6WYp1eCBU7DpXt3ACNMACzh5nnshNkUPpfATytGxcHuqFx.png)

body.title: All the blue in the world / Un Cuento Azul / 2do Concurso #HiveBlue 2026 (ENG / ESP)
body.body:
Un abrazo a toda la comunidad, agradezco la oportunidad de participar en esta hermosa convocatoria y quisiera invitar a @yuslenismolina y @roswelborges a participar a pesar del tiempo. Gracias.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQVzSfKEHcLo8Fs4zDKq8givYu8oddhnCiXeWjEdhnt3/img_20260415_115541.jpg)

Dylan seguramente cayó en el tanque de pintura. Cuando nos dimos cuenta, lo sacamos y revisamos; no había golpes ni heridas, pero era totalmente azul. Intentamos lavarlo y lo cepillamos fuerte, pero seguía igual de azul. Luego probamos decolorantes y hasta nuevos tintes para cambiarle el color y que fuera como los demás niños, pero a él parecía gustarle cómo era.

​Nosotros insistimos e insistimos en nuevos productos y nuevas ideas, mientras él iba aprendiendo a mover sus alas y a flotar. Muchas veces lo vimos saltando de nube en nube o conversando con las mariposas; cuando descubrió el mar, su azul parecía brillar, tanto que a veces se confundía con las olas.

​Un día lo descubrimos mientras nos abrazaba con su sonrisa. «Qué niño tan raro», comentó alguien. Fue entonces cuando corrimos hasta la tienda más cercana, compramos otro de esos tanques bien grandes de pintura y buscamos ese azul que lo hacía brillar. Sin pensarlo ni una vez, nos lanzamos dentro, salpicando paredes, pisos y hasta esos rostros que nos miraban preocupados.
​No sé, pero al salir de allí, todo se sentía más ligero.

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnBRKVgvAMYrAycyLZZSCX444cEu8F2Tg7GhGsRS2xas/banners_20para_20linkedin_20agencia_20de_20marketing_20digital_20minimalista_20azul_20251026_025157_0000.png)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQVzSfKEHcLo8Fs4zDKq8givYu8oddhnCiXeWjEdhnt3/img_20260415_115541.jpg)

Dylan must have fallen into the paint vat. When we realized it, we took it out and checked; There were no bumps or wounds, but it was completely blue. We tried to wash it and brush it hard, but it was still the same blue. Then we tried bleaches and even new dyes to change his color and make him like the other children, but he seemed to like the way he was. 

​We insisted and insisted on new products and new ideas, while he was learning to move his wings and float. Many times we saw him jumping from cloud to cloud or talking with the butterflies; When he discovered the sea, its blue seemed to shine, so much so that it was sometimes confused with the waves. 

​One day we discovered him while he hugged us with his smile. \

someone commented. That's when we ran to the nearest store, bought another one of those big tanks of paint and looked for that blue that made it shine. Without thinking once, we threw ourselves inside, splashing walls, floors and even those faces that looked at us worried. 
​I don't know, but when I left there, everything felt lighter.

body.title: Turning Old Cell Phones Into CPU Miners
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvXaf1ZkbTk1FDM98YSjchJEBWrJgwC5wBLfuPDbUCGR/image.png)</center>

There is something satisfying about putting old hardware back to work.

A lot of people have old Android phones laying around with cracked screens, weak batteries, or no real purpose anymore. They may not be powerhouses, but they can still be turned into little worker units. In my case, I wanted a way to get CPU miners running on old cell phones and then manage them from a Windows machine without having to baby each phone one by one.

That is where this setup comes in.

I put together a GitHub repo here:

**https://github.com/PaulMoon410/win\_mine**

That repository is a PowerShell-based starter kit for running miners from Windows through **PuTTY `plink` over SSH**. The repo includes a shared config file, a miner template, start/check/kill scripts, and multi-device monitoring scripts. The README specifically lists `miner\_common.ps1`, `bot\_TEMPLATE.ps1`, `cell\_start.ps1`, `cell\_check.ps1`, `cell\_kill.ps1`, `monitor\_all.ps1`, and `start\_all.ps1` as the core files in the workflow.

## Why I like this setup

Instead of tapping around on each phone every time I want to start or monitor a miner, I can use one Windows machine as the command center.

My repo is built around that idea:

* one shared config file for miner settings
* one template script for a single miner
* one script to start them all
* one script to check them all
* one script to kill them all
* one script to monitor output across multiple devices

The repo README calls it a reusable starter kit for running miners from Windows via **PowerShell + PuTTY `plink`**, and the included notes say the scripts use **SSH on port 8022**.

## What you need

Before using the Windows launcher side, you need a few basics in place on the phones.

For Android, **Termux** is one of the easiest ways to create a Linux-like command-line environment on the device. You will generally want:

* Termux installed
* package lists updated
* OpenSSH installed
* Git installed
* compiler/build tools if you are compiling the miner on-device
* your miner binary placed in the expected folder
* SSH running on the phone so Windows can connect to it

On each Android phone, inside Termux, a typical setup looks like this:

```bash
pkg update \&\& pkg upgrade -y
pkg install openssh git clang make -y
passwd
sshd
```

That gets the phone closer to being reachable over SSH and gives you the basic tools needed to pull code and build software in Termux. The exact miner build can vary depending on whether you are using `cpuminer-opt`, `cpuminer-multi`, or another CPU miner source tree.

## Put the miner where the Windows scripts expect it

My repo already assumes certain working directories for the phones configured in `miner\_common.ps1`.

Right now, the sample config in the repo shows three miner entries:

* device `157` using `u0\_a312@192.168.1.157` with working directory `\~/cpuminer-multi`
* device `188` using `u0\_a171@192.168.1.188` with working directory `\~/cpuminer-opt`
* device `189` using `u0\_a451@192.168.1.189` with working directory `\~/cpuminer-opt`

So the practical part is simple:

* clone or place your miner source in the folder you want
* compile it if needed
* make sure the executable exists where the script expects it

In `miner\_common.ps1`, the default executable is set as:

```powershell
$Script:MinerExecutable = \

```

The same file also sets the sample pool, wallet placeholder, and password argument placeholder.

## What to edit in the GitHub repo

The first file to edit is:

```powershell
miner\_common.ps1
```

That same script currently contains examples like:

* `PlinkPath = \

`
* a sample pool of `stratum+tcp://yescrypt.na.mine.zpool.ca:6233`
* device definitions for `157`, `188`, and `189`

So after downloading the repo, the first job is replacing all the placeholder values with your actual setup.

Old cell phones are not going to compete with real mining hardware. They are small CPU workers. They are more useful for experimentation, learning, testing pools, running low-power background mining, or making use of hardware that would otherwise just collect dust.

The bigger value here, at least to me, is the system itself:

* learning how to get Linux-like tooling running on old phones
* building remote management through SSH
* controlling multiple tiny nodes from one Windows terminal
* turning junk hardware into something functional again

That is the kind of project I enjoy, because it feels like squeezing life out of equipment people already wrote off.

記得去年去越南的時候, 我只是覺得, 好浪費, 難得去到越南, 都沒機會去試下Youtube 上經常看到的越式洗頭, 雖然都知道網上說的價錢是假的, 甚麼5刀可以洗個頭按摩兩小時, 對我來說, 20/30刀的價錢倒沒所謂, 主要是人生苦短, 未試過的就想試下.

可惜, 跟著甚麼人出差, 注定你的生活是甚麼, 跟一個悶到沒的再悶的人出去, 只有聽他在飯局講廢話, 講政治, 講一些他認為是道理的道理, 其實都是歪理. 這種飯局對我來說的意義近乎零, 我都是抱著那是工作的一部份而已. 

你問我, 我享受那頓飯不? 別傻了, 我雖然不裕, 但這些年出去吃的每一頓, 我自己都可以負擔得起, 如果我有的選, 我情可出差的每一頓都自費, 換來的是多幾個小時的休息時間. 

所以嘛, 去年去越南我有甚麼印象特別深刻的? 大概就是當時在商場逛的那家KVV店, 跟大家重溫一下, KVV店是一家賣玩具的retailer, 他主打賣國產品牌的玩具盲盒, 基本上都是同行了. 不一樣的是, 他永遠不可能是公司的客戶, 因為人家賣的東西很便宜, 我們家賣的東西出名貴. 

然後, 吃不到的葡萄是酸的, 有人就一直去踩這種定位為低價的客戶垃圾, 你別理, 人家開到越南去, 本事可大了. 我只是打工的, 沒資格說三道四去批評公司的營運方針, 反正公司不是我的, 我也不可能一輩子呆在這裡. 只是, 我也有自己的看法, 就是說, 你做不了人家的生意, 大概是你沒本事. 人家的量可大了, 為甚麼其他廠能做到, 我們做不了? God knows !

為甚麼突然說起KVV這家店呢, 因為在啤酒小鎮就有一家店, 我見到這家店, 好自然跟湘一起進去看看, 因為大家都想看看那邊有沒有賣我家鴨鴨, 可惜都是沒有, 看來我家鴨鴨在大陸是完全沒人氣的喔? 

看鴨鴨是一個目的, 另一個目的, 就是跟湘說我在越南的時候也看過這家店, 找個話題聊天啊, 最近我變得越來越不想說話嘛, 大概是心累, 希望有一個真正安靜的環境給我自己好好休息吧. 但日益繁重的工作, 越發嚴峻的營商環境, 令到我每天上班都在高壓狀態, 有時想好好休息都是奢望. 不過這個情況應該好快會改變了. 每年都有週期嘛, 再熬一陣子吧.

說回KVV, 基本上跟越南那邊大同小異, 但這裡是啤酒小鎮, 擺件主題都是啤酒為主, 所以這家店也很識做, 有一個櫃位是專賣那種小小的酒板的. 挺特別. 看完之後, 基本上都先打算在地面看看攤位, 其他打卡的擺設這樣囉. 明天再分享吧, 今天還是一堆事情要處理, 得趕緊了. 

2026.4.22

body.title: Making a delicious Guacamole! [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
>
###### Hello, my dear friends. Welcome back to my kitchen! Today I’m sharing a delicious recipe with you: homemade guacamole. With just a couple of ripe avocados and a few ingredients, you can whip up a dip for a get-together with friends. This time, I used only sweet peppers; the original guacamole has a spicy kick. If you like that kick, substitute one of the sweet peppers for a spicy one. These avocados were a gift, I’m so jealous of those who have an avocado tree in their backyard, ha ha ha. I usually make this recipe by eye, but I’ll give you the standard measurements.
#

>
###### ¡Hola mis queridos amigos. Bienvenidos de nuevo a mi cocina ¡ Hoy les comparto una receta deliciosa: Un Guacamole casero. Con apenas un par de aguacates en su punto y unos pocos ingredientes, puedes tener listo un Dip para una picada entre amigos. En esta ocasión, usé solo ajíes dulces, el guacamole original tiene un toque picante, si te gusta con ese toque, sustituye uno de los ajíes dulces por uno picante. Estos aguacates fueron un regalo, que envidia les tengo a quienes tienen mata de aguacate en su jardín jajaja. Esta receta generalmente la hago al ojo por ciento pero les dejo las cantidades standart.
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png) ###
Ingredients - Ingredientes
#####
4-6 people / 4-6 personas
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)
> Un aguacate grande o 2 pequeños 2 tomates perita pequeños 1 cebolla mediana 3- 4 ajíes dulces Cilantro to taste Aceite de girasol o de oliva 1 limón Sal al gusto

> 1 large avocado or 2 small ones 2 ripe tomatoes 1 medium onion 3-4 sweet peppers Cilantro al gusto Sunflower or olive oil 1 lemon Salt to taste
![5127589162541321351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EpnEDgqUiBoY9ixBsBK6Nt7siuSHpEHw7FEvCiVsAeT6BaZqaMuFyMMTs2R9fzpTxj3.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png) ###
Preparation | Preparación
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> **Paso 1**: Se empieza picando los tomates, la cebolla y los ajíes dulces en cuadros pequeños. Luego, corta el cilantro pequeñito. #
**Step 1**: Start by dicing the tomatoes, onion, and bell peppers into small cubes. Then, finely chop the cilantro.
![5129840962355007326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/Eokf1NKPhz9ZkhWcbsUTNmV5EAaA8u2HtxKwWmWba7F8SSaLAV1rJ6YB1yVGrtYD1gY.jpg) ![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> **Paso 2**: Pelamos el aguacate y se corta en trozos. Luego, con la ayuda de un tenedor lo trituramos dejando algunos trozos enteros. #
**Step 2**: Peel the avocado and cut it into pieces. Then, using a fork, mash it, leaving a few pieces whole.
![5132092762168691687.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EogQnwSH9uu2gWDp3f24Kuqq3fzD1V4n1Qu5KBfSbhBibniEJt5A5vYTgetETAwGSQZ.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> **Paso 3**: Se incorporan los vegetales picados y mezclamos.
**Step 3**: Add the chopped vegetables and mix.
---
![5129840962355007346 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EoK7qmeU21wkkwwstWEyarTt8tJdhKDsKMTTjYDduXgDR4DRyAnDSc1cNxHn9GPpKh8.jpg) ![5132092762168691688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EoptosSCPhQha7Jbvt1YoN63ETCe2P1GjRuaCeviVGB2S5BT5aQeKuAvk2rjJjKfoiG.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> **Paso 4**: Se agrega un chorrito de aceite, se exprime el limón y le añadimos la sal al gusto. Probamos y rectificamos sabores. El aceite y el limón ayudan a no se oscurezca la mezcla.
**Step 4**: Add a splash of oil, squeeze in the lemon juice, and add salt to taste. Taste it and adjust the seasoning as needed. The oil and lemon juice help prevent the mixture from turning brown.
--- |![5129840962355007329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23xAbh9QdhnYxyL9c6vDqFSK96SDsigZkMoTXaiiGpxPjPQ8Br2Hfq3kqXvUDqvLPPF6o.jpg)|![5129840962355007328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/24242NZg7mWPGfRBz6H2mgXhkSdf2gwnZT8GGfYiCoZHWA9ix2NmdaTtS13189oiXmQYJ.jpg)|![5129840962355007327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/24242NbQ9cwk3np54N66Fstthp9oajXHjb2Uo8qfDMzD54cCzohVbpAfa6GwujPqbpCDh.jpg)| |-|-|-|

> **Paso 5**: Para una presentación más bonita, utilicé la mitad de otro aguacate: retiré la semilla, saqué un poco de su pulpa y rellené con la preparación.
**Step 5**: To make it look nicer, I used half of another avocado: I removed the pit, scooped out some of the flesh, and filled it with the mixture.
--- ![5129840962355007335 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/Ep3foLnRYPHg3deBtbbXxwhUz95XPsawPH5fFgaNm5PSvAjEUbCvnZbArjpLXDMq2P4.jpg) ![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)
**Step 6**: You can chill it for a few minutes to enjoy it cold. Serve it with nachos, toast, crackers, or cassava chips. Try this trick: leave the avocado pit in the mixture to keep it from turning brown.

> **Paso 6**: Puedes refrigerarlo unos minutos para disfrutarlo frío. Acompaña con nachos, pan tostado, galletas o con casabe. Utiliza el truco de dejar la semilla del aguacate dentro de la mezcla para que no se ponga oscura.

body.title: Anemic Ruleset: When all Units are Fragile!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSG9yboYyKCnqYuPyMgtTkDcMnfe1UqCpnCAeU86xHNqu/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

The Anemic ruleset is new in Splinterlands. Under this ruleset, all units start with a max health of four regardless of their original stats. This means that units with high health lose their advantage and units with high damage and self sustain take center stage. In this post, I'll share how I play the Anemic ruleset and try to take advantage of the battle conditions. I'll show a sample battle, the units I chose and how they synergize with each other.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJ55R4gtSSUEJWnbhvNmWvF6WoPfu4dr8fz8guSSwYDT/image.png)

The enemy and I both used the same Death splinter. There were similarities but there were differences as well. Instead of the usual format of my posts, I'll do a head to head comparison of our units.

## Archon


|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Thalgrimore     |     Reklah     |     I used the Frontier archon Thalgrimore. Although he is a Frontier archon, he has the advantage in this battle over the enemy's because his debuff that decreases enemy health affects all units while Reklah only decrease the health of two of my units.     |



## Tank

|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Ujurak Brave (5)     |     Ujurak Brave (3)     |     We had the same tank but mine was at level five against the enemy's level three. This is crucial since my tank has the Silence ability. This battle is about damage and survival so debuffing his magic damage means my units receive less magic damage and therefore survive longer.     |

## Melee Debuffer

|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Fenmoor Gorgon (3)     |     Fenmoor Gorgon (3)       |     We had the a similar unit in level three Fenmoor Gorgon. This unit has the Demoralize ability that decreases melee damage. Although we have the same unit, I had the advantage since the enemy's card was debuffed and had less magic damage.     |


## Speed Buff

|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Silverleaf Warlock (3)     |     Silverleaf Warlock (3)       |     Another similar unit  was a level three Silverleaf Warlock. This unit has the Swiftness ability and adds to the team's speed. This is crucial since the faster team gets to eliminate the other team before they can act. In this case, no team claimed a speed advantage although I had the advantage in damage output since the enemy's card was debuffed and had less magic attack.     |


## Self Sustain Unit

|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Shadowfey Shiek (2)     |     Shadowfey Shiek (2)       |     Another unit that was the same was a level two Shadowfey Shiek. This unit has can sustain itself with its Life Leech ability, increasing its health each time it deals damage. Again, the enemy's magic attack is less than mine, giving me the advantage.    |

## Healer and Self Sustain Unit

|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Arachne Weaver (3)     |     Arachne Weaver (2)       |     This card presents my biggest advantage. Aside from its healing ability, my unit has the Scavenger ability. It enabled my unit to increase its health even beyond its max health of four and therefore became tanky as the fight progressed.    |

## Different Units

|My Card|Enemy Card|Comments|
|------------|------------|------------|
|     Dark Arborist  (4)     |     Shire Knacker (3)       |     Finally we have different cards. I had the magic card Dark Arborist while my enemy had a ranged unit Shire Knacker. Here the advantage is the enemy's since the Shire Knacker has the Snipe ability, targeting the more vulnerable units without armor in the middle positions.    |

***

# Final Thoughts

The Anemic Ruleset presents another fun challenge for players to deal with. Under this ruleset focus on high damage units, units with healing and self sustaining units for survival. It also helps the team if its faster to attack first and eliminate enemies before they can strike back. It's also important to fill all slots and avoid high mana units that will deny slots to other cards. Due to the low health of individual units, it's crucial that all slots are occupied to increase the overall team's health pool. I hope readers learn something from this post and see you in the next one!

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.title: Un día cualquiera… que en realidad lo es todo
body.body:
![IMG_20260421_145453_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/243MDb52eVTbGgUWCzQUgnwraGJwcBRNneG4hzd9EtSXv4PFCqetxGom2Qadz3ypgghDa.jpg)

![IMG_20260421_145459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23zS9pQPweUb6oFmBHARq5NazfLgJNGoaLP2M9fNx5BpcRy2ATQhuE6zjr4pQ7CmgBwBU.jpg)


Hoy fue un día a medias.
De esos que no son perfectos, pero tampoco malos. De esos que, sin darte cuenta, terminan siendo importantes.
Salí de una guardia de 24 horas. Cansado. Con sueño acumulado y el cuerpo pidiendo descanso. Pero en mi caso, como en el de muchos, el día no termina cuando sales del trabajo… el día continúa.
Llegué a casa. Y llegar ya es bastante.
Porque sí, vengo de un lugar donde la vida no siempre es fácil. Donde hay apagones, donde falta lo básico, donde incluso moverse o resolver algo sencillo puede convertirse en un reto. En Cuba, si no pasas trabajo, parece que el día no fue real.
Pero aun así, llegué.
Y al entrar, estaban ellos: mi esposa @diazktty  y mi hijo, Lukas
Nos saludamos, nos abrazamos, nos dimos ese cariño que no necesita palabras. Afuera pueden faltar muchas cosas, pero en ese momento no faltaba lo importante.
Llegó la corriente, y con ella empezó la rutina. Mi esposa se puso con las cosas de la casa: cocinar, lavar, resolver. Yo me quedé con Lukas
Y así se nos fue el día.
Jugando. Riéndonos. Descubriendo sus pequeñas “maldades”, porque ya está en esa etapa en la que todo es curiosidad. Y entre todo eso, también hubo cansancio. Hubo un momento en que tuve que parar y dormir, porque el cuerpo no da más.
Pero incluso ese descanso tuvo sentido.
Porque al despertar, el día seguía… y nosotros también.
Algo que me gusta de nuestra dinámica como pareja es que muchas veces no necesitamos hablar para entendernos. Si uno tiene que dejar algo a medias para atender algo más importante, el otro simplemente toma el relevo. Sin discutir. Sin planearlo. Solo pasa.
Es nuestro pequeño acuerdo silencioso.
Hoy fue así: a veces ella con Lukas, a veces yo. A veces yo lavando, a veces ella cocinando. Cambiando roles, ayudándonos sin hacer ruido, funcionando como equipo.
Al final del día, recogí la ropa porque el clima amenazaba con lluvia. Luego nos sentamos un rato, tranquilos, viendo algo, compartiendo.
Y ahí entendí algo.
El día fue cansado, sí.
Pero también fue bueno.
Porque más allá del agotamiento, jugué con mi hijo. Me reí con mi familia. Estuvimos juntos.
Y al final, eso pesa más que cualquier cansancio.
Ojalá la vida siga siendo así:
con dificultades, sí… pero también con risas.
Con problemas… pero en familia.
Porque mientras estemos juntos, siempre vamos a encontrar la forma de seguir adelante.
 Gracias a la comunidad BBH que sin ella no estuviera aquí 
 Gracias a @cathyarrow por su amistad incondicional 
 A @bradleyarrow que con su proyecto es un genio 
 Agradecer a todos los que me leen por su apoyo 
Que nunca les falte el amor ❤️ y que Dios les bendiga 🙏

Saludos a toda la comunidad de HIVE, con el fin de promocionar el contenido matemático dentro de nuestra querida red social, a continuación les presento la siguiente sección en la cual se estará publicando un problema matemático a ser resuelto, los problemas abordarán diversas áreas de la Matemática (Aritmética, Álgebra, Geometría, Análisis, entre otros).

Los invito a compartir sus soluciones, sin más preámbulo les presento el problema

Un tanque contiene 200 litros de agua con sal disuelta. Inicialmente hay 20 gramos de sal. Se empieza a agregar una solución salina que contiene 2 gramos de sal por litro a razón de 5 litros por minuto. Al mismo tiempo, la mezcla sale del tanque a razón de 5 litros por minuto (el volumen se mantiene constante). ¿Cuánta sal (en gramos) habrá en el tanque después de 10 minutos?


La matemática es la ciencia de la abstracciones, que presenta cierta belleza austera para todo aquel que decide dedicarse a su estudio.

Me despido deseándoles feliz blogging.

links.title: [Es-EN] 🌊 La Ola que me enseña a vivir/The Wave that Teaches Me to Live
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWUuEsTkBSyL7wuRsX2WrGXM1JFxYuURhz8DAcBk1iRQx/img_2492.jpg)

A veces la vida se parece demasiado al mar… y otras veces somos nosotros los que no entendemos que estamos dentro de él.

Hay días en los que todo está en calma, como si el mundo respirara suave, sin prisa. Y de repente… llega una ola. Grande, inesperada, fuerte. De esas que te desordenan los planes, los pensamientos y hasta el corazón.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXTTR2h3sScT7pmTicddXyXchuKUzRwqEUH34pbrrtSLq/img_2496.jpg)

Yo he aprendido que no todas las olas vienen a derrumbarte. Algunas vienen a despertarte.

Si la vida fuera un mar, yo sería una surfista aprendiendo todavía a no caerme cada vez que el agua se mueve. Mi tabla no sería perfecta, estaría llena de marcas, de intentos, de golpes… pero también de equilibrio ganado a base de no rendirme.

He entendido que el miedo no desaparece, pero se puede aprender a surfear con él al lado. Porque sí, da miedo levantarse cuando la ola es grande. Da miedo intentar otra vez cuando ya has caído una vez… o muchas.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaoABZGambq2Mb6m78NpymhCVoKBFxLdNoPCggpeBtb8u/img_2482.jpg)


Pero, ¿y si el miedo también es parte del viaje?

Me imagino enfrentando cada ola con la respiración firme, mirando hacia adelante, sin prometerme no caer… sino prometerme volver a intentar.

Y me pregunto:
¿Qué sería de nosotros sin olas?
Quizás una vida demasiado tranquila… pero también sin historias, sin aprendizajes, sin crecimiento.

Porque al final, no se trata de evitar las olas…
Se trata de aprender a bailar con ellas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUG2M6XdgZvzYG5rRu7eWTXFLY2z6kGhenGvnAUnS5XH/img_2419.jpg)
__________________________________________________


Sometimes life feels just like the ocean… and sometimes we forget we are already inside it.

There are days when everything is calm, as if the world is breathing softly without hurry. And suddenly… a wave arrives. Big, unexpected, strong. The kind that shakes your plans, your thoughts, and even your heart.

I’ve learned not every wave comes to break you. Some come to wake you up.

If life were an ocean, I would be a surfer still learning how not to fall every time the water moves. My board wouldn’t be perfect—it would be full of marks, attempts, and falls… but also balance earned through not giving up.

I’ve understood that fear doesn’t disappear, but you can learn to surf beside it. Because yes, it is scary to stand up when the wave is huge. It is scary to try again after falling once… or many times.

But what if fear is also part of the journey?

I imagine myself facing each wave with steady breath, looking forward, not promising I won’t fall… but promising I will try again.

And I wonder:
What would we be without waves?
Maybe a too quiet life… but also without stories, lessons, and growth.

Because in the end, it’s not about avoiding the waves…
It’s about learning how to dance with them.

<div class=\

> 

Saludos, estimados gamers que dan vida a #HiveGaming. ¿Adivinen quién tiene nuevo teléfono para jugar League of Legends Wild Rift y Mobile Legends Bang Bang? Oficialmente es esta Hiver, su fiel servidora y gamer desde que inició con su comunidad.

> Greetings, fellow gamers who bring #HiveGaming to life! Guess who has a new phone to play League of Legends: Wild Rift and Mobile Legends: Bang Bang? It's officially yours truly, Hiver, your loyal servant and a gamer since the beginning of this community.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>

<center>

<center>![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-21 at 6.37.23 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EpCAu3dWeUd3yHkzpzkFu1wd9fWA9wJ1WyvPEmcwPwjgLMCqtxUPtszy8HbTwEB9aFP.jpeg)</center>


</center>

<div class=\

>

El día sábado de la semana pasada decidí finalmente hacer una inversión en un nuevo teléfono celular que me permitiera jugar LoL Wild Rift y MLBB, juegos que desde hacía bastante tiempo deseaba probar en un teléfono y que mi antiguo Redmi Note 9A no me permitía por su escasa memoria y su obsolescencia.

Con los nervios y la emoción a mil por hora me acerqué a la tienda [Canguro](https://www.instagram.com/cangurove/) de mi ciudad, una pequeña tienda con gran variedad de teléfonos y lo mejor es que están a un buen precio o al menos accesibles para mi bolsillo.

> Last Saturday, I finally decided to invest in a new cell phone that would allow me to play League of Legends: Wild Rift and Mobile Legends Bang Bang, games I'd been wanting to try on a phone for quite some time, but which my old Redmi Note 9A couldn't handle due to its limited memory and obsolescence.
>
>With nerves and excitement running high, I went to the Canguro store in my city, a small shop with a wide variety of phones, and the best part is that they're reasonably priced, or at least affordable for me.

<center>![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 3.20.12 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23x1BEhE1P6VKo1UmmX4d8LDaxjezpwtSFUxCmNXDEvJiz958eHqhtqrGUJjpKRp5FE3R.jpeg)</center>

La chica que me atendió fue bastante amable y paciente ya que no me decidía por ninguno y mientras consultaba con un amigo para saber la respuesta correcta y cuál se ajustaba tanto a mi presupuesto y a mis exigencias mínimas para poder comprarlo.

Mi plan era invertir en un Motorola G06 cuyo precio estaba bastante bueno y por ello se agotó de inmediato, sólo una semana para que los vendieran todos, así que tuve que elegir un **Redmi A5** con 128 Gb de Memoria y 8 GB de Ram. Los otros modelos que le seguían tenían menos capacidad de memoria y un procesador un poco más rápido, del resto todo era parecido, así que opté por ese.


>The girl who helped me was quite kind and patient, as I couldn't decide on any of them. I consulted with a friend to find the right option and which one fits both my budget and my minimum requirements for buying it.
>
>My plan was to invest in a Motorola G06, which was quite reasonably priced and therefore sold out immediately, taking only a week to sell them all, so I had to choose a **Redmi A5** with 128 GB of memory and 8 GB of RAM. The other models below it had less storage capacity and a slightly faster processor, but otherwise, everything was similar, so I opted for that one.


<center>![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 3.20.12 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23uFTZ1Msj2dtGLnV48xeJdNWpZpe9e3xQjAbjaSifgeUTq5r2CshBE9rpQACtwmdRBiu.jpeg)</center>

También agregué a la compra el protector de la pantalla y un forro protector de silicón color rosa pastel más un PopSockets sencillo que combinara con el color.

Mientras que el teléfono me vino con algunos accesorios inesperados pero útiles. Como por ejemplo un forro transparente, su cargador con enchufe normal sin necesidad de colocarle un adaptador y su cable USB.

>I also added a screen protector and a pastel pink silicone protective case to the purchase, along with a simple PopSocket to match the color.
>
>Meanwhile, the phone came with some unexpected but useful accessories, such as a clear case, a charger with a standard plug (no adapter needed), and a USB cable.

<center>![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 3.20.12 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23wCC5FxS9bCwjo42qNbpmyNeo72dZM9m1zXbrRDUmjCxy1UWk59qcictS9ZmmzDpciUi.jpeg)</center>


<div class=\

> Además, decidí también probar la famosa aplicación llamada *Cashea* que se ha vuelto súper popular en mi país y que al igual que muchos venezolanos se ayuda con ella para sacar equipos electrónicos u otros accesorios a crédito. Yo estaba muy nerviosa porque era mi primera vez usando esa aplicación, pero gracias a Dios las chicas que me atendieron en la tienda fueron muy atentas conmigo y me tuvieron paciencia. Al final logré comprar mi teléfono con una pequeña inicial del 60% y quedé pendiente de abonar 3 cuotas más en mes y medio. > I also decided to try the popular app Cashea, which has become incredibly popular in my country. Like many Venezuelans, I use it to buy electronics and other accessories on credit. > >I was very nervous because it was my first time using the app, but thankfully, the women who helped me at the store were very attentive and patient. In the end, I managed to buy my phone with a small down payment of 60%, and I'm due to pay three more installments in a month and a half.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 3.20.12 PM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eo6Kvofdy1ii1poTWPiDy2TtwX46Nx3rGUY96jGM9ouws8FEZnHADzM7as5vuJ1cG44.jpeg)
Lo bueno de este equipo es que apenas lo compré logré instalarle tantas aplicaciones que había dejado de usar y las más importantes como LOL Wild Rift y Mobile Legends Bang Bang. Como pueden ver, no tengo niveles muy altos, sobre todo el MLBB porque apenas si lo empecé a jugar y aún estoy aprendiendo cómo usar mi teléfono nuevo para grabar las partidas y compartirlas con ustedes más adelante. > The great thing about this phone is that I managed to install so many apps I'd stopped using as soon as I bought it, including important ones like League of Legends: Wild Rift and Mobile Legends Bang Bang. > > As you can see, I'm not very skilled, especially in MLBB, because I've only just started playing and I'm still learning how to use my new phone to record matches and share them with you later. |![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-21 at 6.35.27 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23uFH1dVVgdKGHRMqSf2isaEDAH9ycVTWTBHp7F8h4eHmpFehBP355VsLACEzo4Cnj9Ea.jpeg)| |-| |![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-21 at 6.35.27 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23w2mG5W8hVoVsL2eBfZaCJDNQey7yJr3JahqMdtxo6mA1a42V2awuMZAkMC619tA7NDm.jpeg)| Yo me siento satisfecha con mi nuevo teléfono y estoy feliz de poderlo pagar por cuotas. Gracias a toda la ayuda que me ha brindado esta plataforma, logré alcanzar esta meta tan soñada. Espero traerles pronto una partida de estos juegos, ¡hasta la próxima! 🌸 > I'm so happy with my new phone, and I'm thrilled to be able to pay for it in installments. Thanks to all the help this platform has given me, I was able to achieve this dream. I hope to bring you a gameplay video of these games soon. See you next time! 🌸

links.title: Film Review: Doctor Strange (2016)
links.body:
![(source:  tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/cpB6Nb53kQUVFT3m2xXWyfnsnob.jpg)

All those who dreamed of a world where science would be valued above all else have finally got their way in 2020. At least that's the impression one might get based on the fact that a group of people with impressive academic titles, on the basis of their own interpretation of indisputable scientific facts, gained the power to keep billions of people under house arrest. And, of course, anyone who doubts the interpretation of those facts due to various prejudices, selfish interests, fake news or conspiracy theories is opposing science and represents a subversive element who, if they cannot be hanged from the nearest flagpole, should at least be sent to a re-education camp. Therefore, it is conceivable that certain films, due to similar heretical stances, should be burned or at least locked away in a deep bunker. Such a fate could easily befall even some quite popular and successful films, including those from the Marvel Cinematic Universe. In its anti-scientism, few have stood out as much as 2016's *Doctor Strange*.

The film's protagonist is Dr Stephen Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch), an exceptionally gifted New York neurosurgeon whose spectacular successes at the operating table have made him wealthy, but also extremely arrogant. Everything, however, changes completely when one night he suffers a horrific traffic accident in which his hands are permanently damaged. Striving to restart his career at any cost, Strange spends all his time and money on futile attempts at healing and eventually, like many desperate people in similar situations, turns to alternative medicine. The journey leads him to Nepal where he heard that miraculous recoveries of cripples occur in a place called Kamar-Taj. Strange discovers that the place is led by a mysterious woman called the Ancient One (Tilda Swinton) who turns out to be a sorcerer capable of not only travelling through different universes, but also passing on her magical skills to her pupils. Motivated by the desire to acquire the skills that would heal him, Strange is initially sceptical of mysticism or magic, but eventually accepts it. It soon turns out that this was the right decision because the planet is in danger from Kaecilius (Mads Mikkelsen), a former pupil of the Ancient One who seeks to open a portal to Earth on behalf of Dormammu, a deity from the Dark Dimension.

*Doctor Strange* was made at a time when Marvel and Disney already knew they had a golden goose, so they used the same formula that brought success to previous films in the series. Thus, we again have an origin story that will occupy the first half of the plot and be far more interesting than the second, in which the main hero is forced to use his superhuman powers in a fight against a not very original or interesting villain. The screenplay is rather weak and doesn't allow for much originality or deviation from the formula, although that cannot be said entirely for the final boss showdown. What saves the film is above all the excellent technical execution, which includes the not overly hyped director Scott Derrickson who managed to use the financial and technical resources to very good effect, something that comes to the fore especially in the fight scenes that simultaneously take place in several worlds, and involve astral projections and twisting dimensions in scenes that clearly show the influence of Nolan's *[Inception](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/capsule-film-review-the-inception-2010)*. The same could be said for the cast, whereby the proverbially reliable Benedict Cumberbatch is overshadowed by Tilda Swinton, whose masterful performance in the role of the mysterious and charismatic sorceress is one of the film's main assets, but also the source of controversy related to alleged racist \

, i.e., the hiring of a white actress for a character who in the original comic was Tibetan. Chiwetel Ejiofor is very good in the role of Cumberbatch's rival Mordo, while Mikkelsen genuinely tries to get the maximum out of what the not overly inspired screenwriters left him in the villain role. The always charming Rachel McAdams, on the other hand, fared poorly portraying the clichéd character of Strange's colleague and ex-girlfriend. Despite that, *Doctor Strange* in its not-quite two hours still provides enough quality escapist entertainment and can be recommended for viewing. While it's still possible.

RATING: 6/10 (++)

*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2020/05/14/recenzija-doktor-strange-doctor-strange-2016/).)*

links.title: Don't put excessive pressure on students.
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXwWaTwP2b5LXByDUJcJbn7gN4rnQM6oXkCU7UQKePS6K/pexels-yankrukov-8197500.jpg [Pixabay](https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-in-red-jacket-studying-at-a-classroom-8197500/) Greetings parents and students. How are you all. Today I want to talk to you about a general topic. Basically, there are many students among us. Who are doing well in their studies and they are constantly continuing their education activities. Along with studies, they are playing sports and playing with friends for entertainment. Especially, they are working part-time and they are trying to build their lives in their own way. However, today I want to talk about excessive mental stress on students. Generally, mental stress destroys a person's life. Mental stress has a very bad effect on a person's life and its reaction slowly kills the person. This has an even worse effect on a student. If we give mental stress to our students, they cannot bear it. Their brain is very limited. You know, when they start studying with this brain and remember the mental stress, their education goes away from their brain. When we try to force any subject on students, it has a very bad effect on the students' brain. As a result, students no longer want to study and they have mental problems. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeEipWhgWtjfSoTU9uQhDxVjkPCn6mqogV5WtZUj4e4Z3/pexels-ron-lach-8086357.jpg [Pixabay](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-wearing-a-long-sleeve-shirt-8086357/) There are many families among us. Who want to make their children competent in all aspects. But this is a completely wrong decision. When a child gradually grows up, he creates an opportunity to take his own decisions. Especially if a student is proficient in the English version, he should be tutored on the English version. If your child is an expert in mathematics, then tutor him on mathematics. That is, give him a chance in that subject in which your child shows expertise. You can never force the content on him according to your own wishes. I have seen many families. Who send their children to school for general education. On the way back from school, he has to work for the family. And then the afternoon is play time for the child. But a child is given the opportunity to play in the afternoon from education. On the contrary, he has to roam around the doorsteps of various coaching centers in the afternoon. The afternoon was a golden opportunity for the child to play. But we have forcibly sent him to the coaching center and due to which his brain may be disturbed. Moreover, we send children to madrasas or places of worship early in the morning for religious education along with general education. In other words, we put mental pressure on a student as a guardian and try to make him an expert in all aspects. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZPZEaoE2SgGyMaYQHyB1ZsbW8Maty8rLAvUdBJ99EAUh/pexels-mikhail-nilov-7776754.jpg [Pixabay](https://www.pexels.com/photo/young-man-throwing-papers-and-feeling-upset-7776754/) Basically every brain has its own freedom and feelings. Just the same feelings and decisions are in the brain of a student. If we do not give students the opportunity to study as they like, then they will never be able to organize their lives. As a parent, our responsibility is to never put excessive pressure on students. We should first decide that our children will show interest in the subject that we are good at. We will never try to impose any subject on them as we wish. Basically, children should be given the opportunity to play in the afternoon. Excessive mental pressure for religious education never creates anything good in a child's brain. Let us give a free life to students. Because every brain needs relaxation. So we have to work towards creating a beautiful society free of mental stress. Let us create a stress-free life and try to develop children as human beings. This is the main teaching and principle of our education community. Finally, thank you very much for being with the education community and enjoying my educational post today. Stay tuned to the Education Community to get regular educational blogs. Thank you.

links.body: Cari amici, non vedo l'ora di terminare il mio legato affinchè risulti utile e ricolmo di benedizioni per chiunque legga. Mancano pochi capitoli oramai. Come al solito, prima la versione in spagnolo e poi la traduzione in italiano. ![frame2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pousinha/23wCbVEvmpQh18TBR9sSs2jKetXqhUph5aw3L8yXqNGUkGRessgJvf8LrymKgx5hdiDZX.png) ![torah-2902754_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pousinha/23xAbugHmbWFbpVDFe4ib7ajTSukrMLsJGoCX72koZadmbgwjfwwyZy27KRmXu9DmaHaJ.jpg) ESPAÑOL ABIGAÍL LA SABIA: UNA MUJER FANTÁSTICA: capítulo XXXII Al entrar en la casa, o mejor dicho, ya a cientos de metros de distancia de la mansión, Abigaíl se dio cuenta de que salía un gran alboroto del salón principal. El que se utilizaba habitualmente para las fiestas y los banquetes. Una vez más, Nabal había organizado un banquete con sus hermanos y, para un necio de su calaña, como de costumbre, celebrar significaba emborracharse hasta perder toda noción de la realidad. Abigaíl no sabía absolutamente nada sobre la organización de dicho banquete, al igual que Nabal no tenía la más mínima idea de cómo había pasado ese día su esposa. Después de todo, desde tiempos indefinidos, ninguno de los dos se preocupaba por informar al otro de sus asuntos. Por su parte, Abigaíl, debido a la imposibilidad de conversar civilizadamente con un hombre que enseguida se ofuscaba por cualquier tontería, no tenía sentido dirigirse a Nabal a menos que fuera por cuestiones de vida o muerte. Pero lo que acababa de suceder había sido precisamente una cuestión de vida o muerte. Por su parte, Nabal, debido a que Abigaíl solía retirarse muy pronto de los banquetes, ya ni siquiera le parecía necesario dignarse cortesmente a invitarla. Después de todo, sus hermanos ya sabían muy bien que él había logrado casarse con la mujer más hermosa de todo Judá, es más, de todo Israel, y por lo tanto, mostrarla una vez menos no lo hacía menos envidiable a sus ojos. Ps.: immagen Pixabay free que encuentran aquí: https://pixabay.com/es/photos/torah-hebreo-hebrew-tor%C3%A1- yeshua-2902754/
alt=\
>\n
alt=\

> ITALIANO Una saggezza non comune: il dono di Abigail cap.XXXII Entrando in casa, anzi, già a centinaia di metri di distanza dalla mansione, Abigail si avvide che ne usciva un gran baccano, proveniente dal salone principale. Quello comunemente utilizzato per le feste e i banchetti. Una volta ancora Nabal aveva organizzato un banchetto con i suoi fratelli e per uno stolto del suo calibro, come al solito, banchettare significava ubriacarsi fino a perdere ogni nozione della realtà. Abigail non aveva saputo un bel nulla dell'organizzazione di tale banchetto così come Nabal non aveva la più pallida idea di come sua moglie avesse trascorso quella giornata. Dopotutto, oramai da tempo immemore, nessuno dei due si preoccupava di informare l'altro dei propri affari. Dal canto di Abigail, data l'impossibilità di discorrere civilmente con un uomo che si accendeva come una torcia per ogni nonnulla, non era il caso di rivolgere la parola a Nabal non fosse per questioni di vita o di morte: ma il recente accaduto era stato appunto questione di vita o di morte. Dal canto di Nabal, poichè Abigail era solita ritirarsi ben presto dai banchetti, non gli pareva più nemmeno il caso di degnarsi della garbatezza di invitarla. Dopotutto, i suoi fratelli oramai sapevano benissimo che era riuscito a sposare la donna più bella di tutto Giuda, anzi, di tutto Israele e quindi esibirla una volta di meno non lo rendeva meno invidiabile ai loro occhi. Ps.: immagine Pixabay free che si trova qui: https://pixabay.com/es/photos/torah-hebreo-hebrew-tor%C3%A1- yeshua-2902754/

其中两对夫妻:A男懦弱，但他老婆有受虐倾向；B男擅家暴，他老婆身上总有伤痕，就导致A的老婆和B男搅合一起了，甚至在一次TQ中B男失手虐鲨了A的老婆

links.body: @luchyl, then don’t touch it — that’s a completely valid call. Cropping is optional, not a moral duty, and non-destructive editing exists precisely so photographers can test changes without harming the original file, then revert if it kills the vibe, as [Adobe explains](https://helpx.adobe.com/photoshop/using/nondestructive-editing.html) and [Presets.io breaks down for Lightroom](https://presets.io/a/blog/non-destructive-editing-lightroom-explained). Your own [Crown Of Thorns’ Bloom](https://inleo.io/@luchyl/crown-of-thorns-bloom-photofeed-contest-macro-photography-166-2dk) already works as-is, so “leave it alone” is often the smarter artistic choice anyway.

links.title: The (loud) sound of underground movies.
links.body: One of the things I appreciate most within the movie industry today (in general) is the fact that movies with less commercial appeal, less managerially strong, or without huge budgets manage to break down previously unimaginable barriers. Part of this mission is accomplished because of the influence coming from the internet, which is gaining increasing prominence with the participation of the audience (which is usually very loyal).\n<center>[Beyond The Void](https://www.longlivethevoid.com/news/top10mostdisturbem)</center>\nThere is life outside the Hollywood circuit. Anyone who truly appreciates cinema knows this. The world is too vast in its magnitude, and for decades, it considered the United States the \

of cinema. This has changed, and with the strength of underground movies getting more relevance, audiovisual productions created outside the mainstream industry have increasingly more artistic freedom when it comes to experimentation and fluid personal expression.\nAny and all technical conventions within a more \

narrative can be properly tested. The result tends to be controversial, especially because of the more conservative audience. Each director and screenwriter chooses to explore themes that are still considered taboo for society as a whole, and end up becoming the target of controversy for \

the counterculture of more comfortable conventions. I love this kind of artistic transgression.
When a movie proves to be much more than just a mere product of pure entertainment, it really grabs my attention because I know I'm about to watch something that will challenge my mind to go beyond the trivial. This doesn't happen easily, so these movies need to be loaded with relevance so that I can buy into the whole idea it's trying to sell me. Cinema needs more and more of these types of movies because they reflect the present.
<center>[The Ringer](https://www.theringer.com/2018/10/18/movies/the-30-best-truly-independent-films-of-the-21st-century)</center>
The weight of these projects is always very strong. Despite all the progress in terms of recognition that has already occurred and is still happening, underground movies are still \
as if they were in a different scenario with less relevance within the very industry of which they are evidently a part. The good side is that there are still many filmmakers willing to \

this bubble, showing that the cultural power of these projects is much more than just shocking.
---
<center>**El sonido (potente) del cine independiente.**</center>
Una de las cosas que más aprecio de la industria cinematográfica actual (en general) es que películas con menor atractivo comercial, menor capacidad de producción o presupuestos reducidos logran romper barreras antes inimaginables. Parte de este éxito se debe a la influencia de internet, que cobra cada vez más protagonismo gracias a la participación del público (que suele ser muy fiel).
Existe vida fuera del circuito de Hollywood. Cualquiera que aprecie de verdad el cine lo sabe. El mundo es inmenso, y durante décadas se consideró a Estados Unidos la \

del cine. Esto ha cambiado, y con la creciente relevancia del cine independiente, las producciones audiovisuales creadas fuera de la industria *mainstream* gozan de mayor libertad artística para la experimentación y la expresión personal.\nCualquier convención técnica puede ser puesta a prueba dentro de una narrativa más \

. El resultado suele ser controvertido, sobre todo por el público más conservador. Cada director y guionista elige explorar temas que aún se consideran tabú para la sociedad en general, y termina convirtiéndose en blanco de la polémica por \

a la contracultura de las convenciones más establecidas. Me encanta este tipo de transgresión artística. Cuando una película demuestra ser mucho más que un simple producto de entretenimiento, capta mi atención de inmediato porque sé que estoy a punto de ver algo que desafiará mi mente y me llevará más allá de lo trivial. Esto no sucede fácilmente, por lo que estas películas deben estar cargadas de relevancia para que pueda conectar con la idea que intentan transmitirme. El cine necesita cada vez más películas de este tipo porque reflejan el presente. El peso de estos proyectos siempre es muy grande. A pesar de todo el progreso en términos de reconocimiento que ya se ha producido y que aún continúa, las películas independientes siguen estando marginadas, como si pertenecieran a un escenario diferente con menor relevancia dentro de la misma industria de la que evidentemente forman parte. Lo positivo es que todavía hay muchos cineastas dispuestos a romper con esta barrera, demostrando que el poder cultural de estos proyectos va mucho más allá de lo meramente impactante. ---
**O (alto) som dos filmes underground.**
Uma das coisas que eu mais aprecio dentro da indústria cinematográfica atualmente (de um modo geral), é o fato dos filmes que tem menos força comercial, que são gerencialmente menos fortes ou que não tem orçamentos grandiosos conseguirem quebrar barreiras antes jamais imaginadas. Uma parte dessa missão é feita por causa da influência que é vinda da internet, e que ganha cada vez mais proeminência com a participação do público (que geralmente é bem fiel). Existe vida fora do circuito hollywoodiano. Quem aprecia cinema de verdade sabe disso. O mundo é grande demais na sua magnitude, e por décadas, considerou o território estadunidense como a “meca” do cinema. Isso mudou, e com a força dos filmes underground conseguindo mais relevância, as produções audiovisuais que são criadas fora da indústria *mainstream *tem cada vez mais liberdade artística quando falamos sobre a experimentação e expressão pessoal líquida. Toda e qualquer convenção técnica dentro de uma narrativa mais “ousada” pode ser devidamente testada. O resultado tende a ser controverso, em especial, por causa do público mais conservador. Cada diretor e roteirista escolhe explorar temas que ainda são considerados como tabus para a sociedade como um todo, e acabam então se tornando alvo de polêmicas por “ferirem” a contracultura das convenções mais comodistas. Eu adoro esse tipo de transgressão artística. Quando um filme se mostra muito mais do apenas um mero produto de puro entretenimento, isso capta demais minha atenção porque eu sei que eu estou prestes a assistir algo que vai desafiar à minha mente a ir além do trivial. Isso não acontece com facilidade, então, esses filmes precisam vir carregados de relevância para eu possa comprar toda a ideia que ele está querendo me vender. O cinema precisa cada vez mais desses tipos de filmes, porque eles refletem o agora. O peso desses projetos sempre é muito forte. Apesar de todo o avanço em termos de reconhecimento que já houve e que ainda acontece, os filmes underground ainda são “marginalizados”, como se estivessem em um outro cenário com menos pertinência dentro da própria indústria da qual ele evidentemente faz parte. O lado bom, é que ainda há muitos cineastas dispostos a “furar” essa bolha, mostrando que o poder cultural desses projetos são muito mais do que chocar. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-loud-sound-of-underground-movies-atn)

body.title: Strategies and Scenarios for \
to Grow in 2026 [ES-EN]
body.body:
> Splinterlands es un juego veterano que nació en el 2018 como un juego de cartas tipo TCG en el que cada carta tiene un valor palpable, lo que quiere decir que existe la posibilidad de ganar dinero real jugando, por supuesto para esa época era algo muy innovador, de hecho, la era dorada de los famosos “PlayToEarn” fue en el 2021 inicios del 2022, donde todos estos tokens incluido el SPS y el ecosistema de Splinterlands explotaron sin precedentes, en la actualidad el sistema funciona diferente y muy pocos juegos de esa época han conseguido mantenerse. Splinterlands es uno de esos juegos que se han mantenido durante todos estos años, incluso pasando varios Criptoinviernos seguidos, pero, el mercado ha madurado, los proyectos no son como antes, el ecosistema de criptomonedas ya ha sido adoptado por las instituciones financieras y los juegos “PlayToEarn” ya no son el centro de atención, aunque, si hay una comunidad que esta bastante activa relacionada con estos temas, la mayoría por no decir todos los tokens de juegos, se encuentran en mínimos, ademas de que estamos en mercado bajista, esto es muy natural, sin embargo, hoy quiero explicar varias estrategias, aspectos y formas de lograr que “Splinterlands” crezca. **En este post, compartiré mis impresiones sobre como hacer crecer varios aspectos importantes del juego, por supuesto en el desarrollo verán de que se trata, así que, si quieren saber todo esto, quédense y lean hasta el final este post:** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Estrategias para aumentar la base de “Jugadores”
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Antes de comentar las estrategias y/o aspectos que yo noto que pudieran impulsar el juego, debo aclarar que esta es solo mi opinión al respecto, no estoy diciendo que esto deba aplicarse si o si, es solo lo que yo haría si estuviera trabajando en el jugo en el departamento correspondiente, pero como dije, son pensamientos míos, sin embargo, este tipo de cosas me gusta compartirlas para lograr vistas y quizás esto pueda escalar al equipo. Con esto en cuenta, para traer a nuevos “Magos de batalla” a nuestras filas, reducir el coste de entrada, mas la diversificación de la experiencia de juego, es crucial, por supuesto, en esto se ha avanzado realmente mucho con respecto a años anteriores, pero, hay puntos que hay que atacar todavía y son los siguientes: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Estrategias

>* **Marketing y accesibilidad:** Esto es muy importante si queremos hacer crecer la base de jugadores en Splinterlands, básicamente lo que podría hacerse son video anuncios sobre el juego en las redes sociales, todos los juegos hacen esto, y les funciona, la idea no es crear algo innovador sino replicar lo que en realidad funciona, y darle un toque único para diferenciarnos de la competencia, ademas estos videos se pueden agregar en las pantallas de carga en conjunto con lo anterior para apalancarnos y conseguir trafico orgánico. Algo obligatorio es optimizar la experiencia de los jugadores en la versión del juego de móviles, en la actualidad todos nos los pasamos mas en los móviles, así que esto es muy importante. > >* **Experiencia de Usuario:** Esto ya ha mejorado mucho, ciertamente cuando ingresas el juego te guía por lo que debes hacer, aun así, no esta optimizada para todos los jugadores en el mundo y hay cosas que pueden agregar para mejorar, por lo que, esto es muy importante de hacer, incluso antes de hacer lo primero, ya que antes de que ingresen queremos tener el mejor producto y juego posible para que todos entiendan cómo funciona el juego. > >* **Recompensas y Gameplay:** Esto ha mejorado mucho, las recompensas en todos los niveles del juego ya están establecidas, inclusive para los jugadores gratuitos, por lo que, esto debe seguir apoyándose, ya que estoy seguro de que la gran mayoría de jugadores nuevos son muy cautelosos, no están dispuestos a invertir en algo que no les genera ganancias de forma gratuita, aunque sean pocas, pero, en la actualidad podemos hacerlo y esto pasa, pero podemos mejorarlo aún mas. > >* **Integración con otras cadenas:** Algo muy importante y que no se esta tomando en cuenta es la integración del juego con otras cadenas, y no hablo de solo la economía como el DEC o el SPS, hablo del juego como tal, ya que pudiera estar en otras cadenas, bien sea “Base, Arbitrum”, incluso ser uno de los juegos en la “HyperEVM”, son cosas que yo haría.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/EoChdyUgKDFXxDmxGqbuFDXnFL8e4PWa4uCxiJtPPyWqvcEbAnb2vcCrzTGabFrWD6G.png)
# Escenarios de impacto en el SPS y su “Capitalización de Mercado” https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> El pilar de todo el juego en el aspecto económico y de progresión se centra mucho en el SPS, de hecho, es el token de “Gobernanza”, funciona como multiplicador de las recompensas, por lo que, su utilidad es innegable, sin embargo, necesitamos exposición impulsos y una serie de detalles para que esto funcione. **Con esto claro, estos son los escenarios que pudieran funcionar:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Escenarios

* **Escenario 1:** Necesitamos un ingreso masivo de “Ballenas o Inversores”, esto multiplicara de forma exponencial la demanda del SPS con la entrada de estos jugadores con mucho capital, ademas, lo que saben del ecosistema, buscaran de entrar tener un boto fuerte en la “Gobernanza” y adicional obtener un buen multiplicador en sus recompensas para ganar muchos mas GLINTS y SPS por batalla. Esto aumentaría la capitalización de mercado del SPS de forma muy rápida. * **Escenario 2:** Necesitamos mas jugadores gratuitos, no todo se trata de las ballenas y del dinero que traen en el ecosistema, los pequeños jugadores también pueden aportar valor, especialmente si la entrada es masiva, ademas, esto generara una entrada de actividad impresionante a la red en la que el juego se basa, me refiero a la red de “Hive”, esto quiere decir que, no solo se beneficiaria “Hive” si no todo la red en general, lo que indirectamente beneficia a todo el ecosistema de “Splinterlands”.

![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Consideraciones Finales https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Existen factores adicionales que pueden servir para que “Splinterlands” como juego destaque, algunos ya funcionan, otros están en sus etapas iniciales o al final de una etapa importante, o sencillamente los tenemos pendientes por crear, y la verdad es que todo lo que he comentado en conjunto con estos aspectos, la verdad es que podría ser mucho fácil atraer a nuevos jugadores. Con todo esto, el juego ya tiene aspectos que mencionare, otros no, los ya existentes pueden seguir mejorando, pero estamos esperando que esto suceda, en todo caso, este post es más algo informativo, al final estamos construyendo nuestro futuro. Así que, estos factores son: >* **Personalización avanzada:** Esto ya ha avanzado mucho en Splinterlands, de hecho, pueden redecorar sus propios avatares, sin embargo, hay muchos jugadores que quieren mejorar varias cosas. > >* **Land Phase 3:** Estamos esperando con muchas ansias la llegada de esta actualización, ya podemos crear cartas en las tierras, pero aun faltas los objetivos o hechizos que pueden ayudar a que todo el ecosistema se vuelva más complejo pero increíble. > >* **Creadores y herramientas:** Las herramientas son imprescindibles y los creadores, como yo somos muy importantes para apoyar todos estos esfuerzos. Con todo esto claro, pudiéramos impulsar a “Splinterlands”. Espero que les haya gustado y si necesitan ayuda pueden comentar esta publicación.
### Nos vemos en el \

> Splinterlands is a long-standing game that launched in 2018 as a TCG-style card game in which each card has tangible value, meaning there’s a chance to earn real money by playing—which, of course, was highly innovative at the time. In fact, the golden age of the famous “Play-to-Earn” games was in 2021 and early 2022, when all these tokens—including SPS—and the Splinterlands ecosystem exploded in popularity like never before. Today, the system operates differently, and very few games from that era have managed to survive. Splinterlands is one of those games that has stuck around all these years, even through several crypto winters in a row, but the market has matured, projects aren’t what they used to be, the cryptocurrency ecosystem has already been adopted by financial institutions, and “Play-to-Earn” games are no longer the center of attention, although there is a fairly active community around these topics. Most, if not all, gaming tokens are at their lows, and given that we’re in a bear market, this is quite natural. However, today I want to explain several strategies, aspects, and ways to help “Splinterlands” grow. **In this post, I’ll share my thoughts on how to improve several key aspects of the game. Of course, you’ll see what I mean as we go along, so if you want to know all about it, stick around and read this post all the way through:** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Strategies for Growing the Player Base
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Before discussing the strategies and/or aspects that I think could improve the game, I should clarify that this is just my opinion on the matter. I’m not saying this should be implemented no matter what; it’s simply what I would do if I were working on the game in the relevant department. But as I said, these are just my thoughts. However, I like to share these kinds of ideas to get feedback, and perhaps this can be passed on to the team. With this in mind, to attract new “Battle Mages” to our ranks, lower the barrier to entry, and diversify the gaming experience, it is crucial—and, of course, significant progress has been made in this regard compared to previous years—but there are still areas that need to be addressed, namely the following: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Strategies

>* **Marketing and Accessibility:** This is very important if we want to grow the player base in Splinterlands. Basically, what we could do is create video ads about the game on social media—all games do this, and it works for them. The idea isn’t to create something innovative, but to replicate what actually works and add a unique touch to set ourselves apart from the competition. Additionally, these videos can be added to loading screens alongside the above to leverage our efforts and drive organic traffic. It’s essential to optimize the player experience in the mobile version of the game; these days, we all spend more time on our phones, so this is crucial. > >* **User Experience:** This has already improved significantly; certainly, when you start the game, it guides you through what to do. Even so, it isn’t optimized for all players worldwide, and there are things that could be added to make it better. Therefore, this is very important to do—especially before launching the game—because we want to have the best possible product and game experience ready before players start playing, so that everyone understands how the game works. > >* **Rewards and Gameplay:** This has improved significantly; rewards are now in place at every level of the game, including for free-to-play players. We should continue to support this, as I’m sure the vast majority of new players are very cautious and unwilling to invest in something that doesn’t offer them free rewards—even if they’re small. While we can currently do this and it’s working, there’s still room for improvement. > >* **Integration with other chains:** One very important aspect that isn’t being taken into account is the game’s integration with other blockchains—and I’m not just talking about the economy, like DEC or SPS; I’m talking about the game itself. It could run on other blockchains, such as “Base” or “Arbitrum,” or even be one of the games on “HyperEVM.” These are things I would do.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/EoChdyUgKDFXxDmxGqbuFDXnFL8e4PWa4uCxiJtPPyWqvcEbAnb2vcCrzTGabFrWD6G.png)
# Impact Scenarios for the SPS and Its “Market Capitalization” https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> The cornerstone of the entire game’s economy and progression system revolves heavily around the SPS; in fact, it serves as the “Governance” token and acts as a multiplier for rewards, so its utility is undeniable. However, we need exposure, momentum, and a number of details for this to work. **With that in mind, here are some scenarios that might work:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Scenarios

* **Scenario 1:** We need a massive influx of “whales or investors”; this will exponentially increase demand for SPS as these well-capitalized players enter the market. Furthermore, given their knowledge of the ecosystem, they will seek to gain a strong voice in “governance” and, additionally, secure a significant multiplier on their rewards to earn many more GLINTS and SPS per battle. This would rapidly increase the market capitalization of SPS. * **Scenario 2:** We need more free players; it’s not all about the whales and the money they bring into the ecosystem. Smaller players can also add value, especially if there’s a massive influx of new users. Furthermore, this will generate an impressive surge of activity on the network the game is built on—I’m referring to the “Hive” network. This means that not only would “Hive” benefit, but the entire network as a whole, which indirectly benefits the entire “Splinterlands” ecosystem.

![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Final Thoughts https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

>

There are additional factors that can help “Splinterlands” stand out as a game; some are already in place, others are in their early stages or nearing the end of a major phase, or we simply haven’t implemented them yet. The truth is that, when you consider everything I’ve mentioned in conjunction with these aspects, it could actually be quite easy to attract new players.

All things considered, the game already has some aspects I’ll mention, while others I won’t; the existing ones can still be improved, but we’re waiting for that to happen. In any case, this post is more of an informational piece—after all, we’re building our future. So, these factors are:

>* **Advanced customization:** This feature has already come a long way in Splinterlands; in fact, players can customize their own avatars. However, there are many players who want to improve various aspects of it.
>
>* **Land Phase 3:** We’re really looking forward to this update. We can already create cards in the lands, but we’re still missing the objectives or spells that can help make the entire ecosystem more complex yet incredible.
>
>* **Creators and tools:** Tools are essential, and creators like me play a vital role in supporting all these efforts.

Now that we've covered all that, we can move on to \

I hope you enjoyed it, and if you need any help, feel free to leave a comment on this post.

body.title: Sushi King - The greatest Sushi in Miri?
body.body: Good morning to all my wonderful friends. Hope that all of you are doing well. My wife and I were hungry, and we wanted to eat some sushi. So, we went to eat Sushi at Sushi King. At times, they have a sushi bazaar where all the sushi becomes cheaper. Let's have a meal at Sushi King - This sushi restaurant is Malaysian-owned and also operated here. This is quite popular.
/> You need a member for whom you can claim points for discounts and free sushi.

/> There is a conveyor belt at this restaurant where the chef makes plates of sushi and places them on the belt. The hard part is resisting the temptation to constantly want to grab a plate of sushi. There is a lot of sushi that goes around on plates with a clear plastic cover. More than 100 types of sushi are available.

/> The sushi that is available on the Conveyor belt. The kitchen at the back is constantly creating new sushi and putting it on the conveyor belt. The best plates are the ones in purple. Usually, I grab a lot of the purple plate sushi during bonanzas.
/> The Prawn Tempura ================= This is one of the must-try dishes here at Sushi King. The prawn aka ebi is deep fried in flour and beneath that is a roll of sushi rice.

/> Add some mayonnaise, and you've got a wonderful meal. You can taste the juiciness of the prawn inside the deep-fried shell. Salmon Sashimi. This is one of my favourite dishes here. You can enjoy the salmon meat that melts directly into the mouth. Yummy.
/> Fried Sesame Balls Inside these delicious sesame balls is red bean paste.
/> Takoyaki These are fried flour with squid inside and some sauce. Fried into the shape of balls. Delicious.
/> Thank you very much for reading my post. Have a great day ahead. @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice
