body.title: Trabajo de cambio de ritmo 2x1.😎🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️🔥
body.body: > Dia Martes, dia de entrenamiento oficial de intervalos, el entrenamiento que siempre nos reta, ya que mide nuestra capacidad para no abortar, y medir que tan fuerte somos, porque si hay que ser fuerte para hacer estos entrenamientos que nos retan pero son muy necesario en nuestra rutina de entrenamientos semanales, para poder progresar y/o mantenernos. sali a las 5:45 am, y calente 15 minutos por fuera del estadio, ya que el estadio lo abren a las 6:00 am, y como ando con el tiempo adelanto el calentamiento. Cuando llegue al estadio ya estaba abierto y estaban varias personas entrenando. De una vez comence con el trabajo de cambio de ritmos que en esta ocasion estaba configurado en 2 minutos rapidos, y 1 minuto lento, configure este trabajo en el reloj,hasta completar 6 kilometros, aproximadamente cadao dos minutos me daba una distancia aproximada de 360 - 380 mts, un total de 15 repeticiones de esta configuracion realice. Ya las ultimas 5 me costaron mas, ya se sentia el nivel de cansacio, pero me dije termini porque termino en nombre de Dios el trabajo, porque despues ando con arrepentimientos. --- Al terminar las 15 repeticiones, me senti agradecida y feliz porque termine completa la tarea. Termine roja como un tomate, asi me dejaron los intervalos en este dia, porque si que han estado intensa las temperaturas, y con un trabajo de este estilo de tanta actividad fisica, se pone a trabajar a toda maquina el cuerpo. Luego del trabajo de cambio de ritmos segui con el enfriamiento, que realice hasta llegar a casa. Que alegria se siente cuando se termina completo un entrenamiento de este estilo. Seguimos con los entrenamientos para seguir mejorando, y preparandome para siguientes retos.💕. En total realice 8,60 kilometros entre calentamiento, intervalos y enfriamiento. . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Tuesday is our official interval training day—the workout that always pushes us to our limits, as it tests our ability to stick with it and gauges just how strong we are. You really have to be strong to tackle these challenging workouts, but they’re essential to our weekly training routine if we want to make progress and/or maintain our fitness. I left at 5:45 a.m. and warmed up for 15 minutes outside the stadium, since the stadium opens at 6:00 a.m., and since I’m running on a tight schedule, I moved the warm-up up. When I arrived at the stadium, it was already open and there were several people training. I immediately started the interval training, which this time was set to 2 minutes fast and 1 minute slow. I set this on my watch until I completed 6 kilometers; approximately every two minutes, I covered a distance of about 360–380 meters. I did a total of 15 repetitions of this interval. The last 5 were harder; I could really feel the fatigue setting in, but I told myself to finish because I always finish the work in God’s name—otherwise, I end up with regrets. --- >After finishing the 15 repetitions, I felt grateful and happy that I had completed the task.I ended up as red as a tomato—that’s how the intervals left me today. The temperatures have really been intense, and with a workout like this that involves so much physical activity, your body really goes into overdrive. After the pace-change workout, I continued with the cool-down, which I did all the way home. What a joy it feels to complete a workout like this. We’ll keep training to keep improving and preparing for the next challenges.💕. In total, I covered 8.60 kilometers between the warm-up, intervals, and cool-down. --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/MBgXEgkYw2b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/MBgXEgkYw2b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/trabajo-de-cambio-de-ritmo-2-x-1)

\n\n

In this case, to get there, it seems that we leave the town, until we leave behind the entrance to Cabimas, Jejeje, the road is a little wide, the roads are still so good, but I like the idea of going to a different place.

\n\n

>We arrived at the old parcel, where we had a small house 🏡 with its good conditions, just like that we would go to spend the afternoon. I was enchanted by the environment, very green 💚, on those sides it was constantly raining, and you could see it in the vegetation.

\n\n

>We were invited to bathe in a tank or pool that looked delicious, but we didn't have any prepared water, just like that, he took photographs, the water came from the wells and manantiales that were obtained by these flows.

\n\n

>We were having a few beers, in my case a little, we went with my sister, and another one when I had a car. After a mouse, we visited the plot of another señor, who we also know.

\n\n

>My husband was happy with his beer 🤭 I decided to drink in the tank of this other installment, he was happy, I always accompanied him so I didn't drink alcohol with him.

\n\n

>We spent a very different afternoon, I really enjoyed it, among friends, family, without many people, the important thing is to spend it well.

\n\n

>For this reason, what is least planned is what best sells us, so that we will continue with improvisation, still united as always. We ended the afternoon with a beautiful sunset in the middle of nature 🏞️.

# **

🇪🇸Spanish🇪🇸

**

>Durante los días de descanso por la semana santa, por lo general siempre nos quedamos en casa 🏡 o si salimos a pasar un día diferente es relativamente cerca, aunque les he comentado que en nuestro municipio no tenemos muchos lugares a donde ir.

\n\n

>Teníamos previsto visitar el boulevard de Cabimas, que la alcaldía tenía planificada una serie de actividades, sin embargo cuando salimos de casa 🏡, veo que cambiamos de ruta. Ya en el camino mi esposo me comenta de que vamos a la parcela de unos vecinos, zona rural.

\n\n

>Primera vez que en lo personal voy a ese lugar, siempre han sido mis vecinos pero nunca hemos coincido en compartir por aquel lugar. El caso es que para llegar allá, parece que saliéramos del municipio, hasta dejamos atrás la entrada de Cabimas, Jejeje, el camino es un poco largo, las carreteras no están tan bien, pero me gustó la idea de ir a un lugar diferente.

\n\n

>Llegamos a la parcela del vecino, allí tienen una pequeña casa 🏡 con sus buenas condiciones, aún así solo iríamos para pasar la tarde-noche. Me encantó el ambiente, mucho verde 💚, por aquellos lados llueve constantemente, eso se nota en la vegetación.

Trump continued. \nHowever, President Trump said the maritime blockade against Iran will continue and other preparedness will continue. \nPresident Trump's declaration of a cease-fire came the day before the expiration of the \

President Trump said the previous day that the two-week ceasefire with Iran is due on the evening of the 22nd, Eastern time. 
Trump has repeatedly threatened to extend the two-week cease-fire if it expires and will resume attacks if Iran does not comply with the agreement, but he ultimately chose to extend it as it approached its expiration date. 

>I cited Pakistan's request for arbitration as the reason for the extension of the ceasefire and the division within Iran.  
Without Iran's acceptance and large variables, a ceasefire of more than a few months could be possible. 

>However, Iran said it could not immediately recognize President Trump's announcement of extending the ceasefire.
Iran's state broadcaster reported on the 22nd (local time), shortly after President Trump announced the extension of the ceasefire, that Iran would not recognize the extension of the U.S. ceasefire and would act in Iran's national interest. 
It seems that we cannot accept a unilateral ceasefire declaration in which the maritime blockade is maintained at a time when we have not given a definite answer to holding a second round of negotiations until the last minute in opposition to the maritime blockade against Iran. 
In this case, it is not easy to secure the momentum for negotiations, making it difficult to make a breakthrough. 
The U.S. delegation led by Vice President JD Vance was originally scheduled to leave for Pakistan earlier in the day, but will reportedly stay at the White House until later in the day. 
Skeptic observations are being made about whether negotiations can resume before the two-week ceasefire expires.

description.title: Hive Music Festival semana 184. Cover instrumental by @juancarlossaez
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMZxVuAarHnkdKFEiBuvyp2HABpYKK5885xsFLCdXjQX/1776817485997.jpg)


https://youtu.be/QzOukBmndyM?si=CWG-_hrTdi_q92tm

Hoy vamos a tocar Blue Bossa, un tema de Kenny Dorham. Es una pieza que muchos músicos conocen porque aparece bastante cuando uno empieza a tocar jazz, pero aun así cada vez que la trabajas le encuentras algo distinto.

La vamos a hacer a flauta y guitarra. En este formato se siente interesante porque la melodía queda bien clara en la flauta, mientras la guitarra sostiene todo lo que pasa por debajo. Es una canción donde si uno no está pendiente, se pierde fácil, porque aunque no es larga, tiene cambios que te obligan a ubicarte bien.

Hay una parte que suena más cercana a la bossa y otra que se mueve un poco más hacia el jazz, y ese contraste es lo que le da el carácter. No se queda en una sola idea todo el tiempo, va cambiando y eso hace que no se vuelva monótona.

Cuando la tocamos, tratamos de no correrla y de que cada parte tenga su espacio. Si te adelantas o te quedas atrás, se nota enseguida, así que hay que ir bien concentrado. No es una canción para tocar distraído.

También tiene eso de que cada vez que la tocas puede salir diferente, sobre todo si improvisas un poco, pero siempre tienes que volver al punto correcto para que todo encaje.

Esperamos que les guste 

English 

Today we're going to play Blue Bossa, a piece by Kenny Dorham. It's a song many musicians know because it comes up quite often when you start playing jazz, but even so, every time you work on it, you find something different.

We're going to play it with flute and guitar. In this format, it feels interesting because the melody is very clear on the flute, while the guitar supports everything else underneath. It's a song where, if you're not paying attention, you can easily get lost, because even though it's not long, it has changes that force you to stay on track.

There's a part that sounds closer to bossa nova and another that moves a bit more towards jazz, and that contrast is what gives it its character. It doesn't stay on a single idea the whole time; it keeps changing, and that's what keeps it from becoming monotonous.

When we play it, we try not to rush it and to give each part its space. If you get ahead or fall behind, it's immediately noticeable, so you have to be very focused. It's not a song to play distractedly.

 It also has that quality that each time you play it, it can sound different, especially if you improvise a bit, but you always have to return to the right place so that everything fits together.

We hope you like it.

description.title: Aprendiendo a ser mamá junto a Lukas: abrazando los momentos difíciles.
description.body:
![IMG-20260414-WA0094(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23y8soJXYuvKBaZJbxtSyXrZ79goxuzTE12UEgG2HzPNHTE19k2UrdLrEz9PQTXL9VEBA.jpg)


Ser mamá de Lukas, que acaba de cumplir un año, es una aventura que mezcla alegría infinita con desafíos inesperados. Hay días en los que su risa ilumina mi mundo, y otros en los que sus llantos y gritos parecen no tener razón. En esos momentos, me siento perdida, preocupada y, a veces, irritada. Me pregunto: “¿Por qué me molesta tanto? ¿Soy una mala madre por sentirme así?”
He aprendido que estos momentos no me hacen menos madre; me hacen humana. Cada lágrima, cada grito sin motivo, es también una oportunidad para crecer, para aprender paciencia y para descubrir nuevas formas de conectar con Lukas. No hay manual perfecto, y aceptar mis propias emociones me ayuda a ser más compasiva con él y conmigo misma.
Criar a un pequeño como Lukas que no le gusta estar solo , le gusta caminar mucho , no le gusta estar en su corral , juega suelto en la casa y toca todo lo que no se puede , le encanta la herramientas de papá , los Pozuelos de mamá , me enseña que la maternidad no es solo sobre los momentos perfectos y las sonrisas constantes. Es también sobre reconocer la frustración, aprender a respirar profundo, y recordar que el amor sigue siendo la guía más poderosa. Y aunque a veces me sienta fallando, cada abrazo y cada risa compartida me recuerda que estoy haciendo lo mejor que puedo.



Mensaje para todos los mamás y papas que me lean :
Ser madre es un viaje lleno de incertidumbres y emociones intensas. Aprender a aceptar nuestros momentos difíciles nos permite celebrar, con más gratitud, los instantes de ternura y alegría que hacen que todo valga la pena.




“Hay días que siento que todo se me escapa de las manos, y otros en los que la risa de Lukas me recuerda por qué todo vale la pena. Mamás, papás… ¿les pasa lo mismo? Compartamos estos momentos, porque ser imperfectos también es ser humanos. 💛

description.title: Mis 8 años en Hive
description.body:
>

# Mis 8 años en hive

Cuando hablamos de tiempo, quizás podemos pensar que 8 años es poco, pero si lo miramos todos los días, en semanas, en amigos, conexiones y relaciones virtuales construidas en ese lapso de tiempo, podemos encontrar una vida, o mejor dicho, un estilo de vida.

Muchas de las historias que se han encontrado con la mía en mis escritos, o el Discord, en su gran mayoría son virtuales, de muchos países diferentes. Todo esto derivado del tiempo que tengo en la blockchain, lo que me ha permitido conocer a muchas personas que de otra manera no hubiese tenido la oportunidad de conocer. Personas que, pese a la diferencia de horarios, de pensamientos y culturas, hemos podido encontrar puntos en común para dialogar. Además, he aprendido de temas que nunca me hubiese imaginado que iba a animarme a estudiar.

8 años de continuo compartir, donde en la compañía de amigos nació la idea del programa de Karaoke Party Night, luego transformándose en Encuentro de talentos y que luego se convirtió en una linda comunidad de amigos creativos, Empowertalent. 8 años de escuchar canciones, problemas, consejos, alegrías, logros y mucho más. 

Un tiempo donde valoro a cada alma encontrada en este gran universo y que agradezco el apoyo que me han brindado en cada idea que se me ha ocurrido llevar a cabo.

Este es un tiempo de celebración; también es oportuno agradecer a todos los que han pasado por mi vida y los que aún siguen en ella. Porque siempre he compartido estas palabras: \

, y hoy aún me preguntan por qué sigo en Hive y les respondo sin titubeos, porque escribir aquí se convirtió en parte de mi diario, mi espacio de relajación y un estilo de vida.

Escribo para mí, porque lo disfruto, y los temas de la comunidad cuando pienso que pueden ayudar a otros; me brinda una gran satisfacción cuando los leo. Y hoy, aunque mi vida está bastante ocupada, sigo cada semana creando temas inspirados en la energía del amor y la creatividad como una vía para exaltar el talento de todos los que alguna vez visitan mi comunidad.

Gracias y los espero con una taza de café y torta de naranja para compartir con alegría y buena vibra en los comentarios.

Los invito a compartir sus momentos en Liketu y sus @talentos.

Con cariño
Angelica7

**English version**

# My 8 Years on Hive
When we talk about time, we might think 8 years is a short time, but if we look at it day by day, week by week, in terms of friends, connections, and virtual relationships built during that time, we can find a life, or rather, a lifestyle.

Many of the stories that have intersected with mine in my writing or on Discord are mostly virtual, from many different countries. All of this stems from my time on the blockchain, which has allowed me to meet many people I otherwise wouldn't have had the opportunity to meet. People with whom, despite differences in time zones, thoughts, and cultures, we've been able to find common ground for conversation. Furthermore, I've learned about subjects I never imagined I'd be interested in studying.

Eight years of continuous sharing, where, in the company of friends, the idea for the Karaoke Party Night program was born, later transforming into a Talent Showcase, and then becoming a wonderful community of creative friends, Empowertalent. Eight years of listening to songs, problems, advice, joys, achievements, and so much more.

A time where I value every soul I've encountered in this vast universe and am grateful for the support they've given me with every idea I've had to bring to fruition.

This is a time for celebration; it's also a fitting time to thank everyone who has been a part of my life and those who are still in it. Because I've always shared these words: \

and even today, people still ask me why I'm still on Hive, and I answer without hesitation: because writing here has become part of my journal, my space for relaxation, and a way of life. I write for myself because I enjoy it, and I contribute to community topics when I think they might help others; it gives me great satisfaction when I read them. And today, even though my life is quite busy, I continue to create topics every week inspired by the energy of love and creativity as a way to highlight the talent of everyone who ever visits my community. Thank you, and I'll be waiting for you with a cup of coffee and orange cake to share joy and good vibes in the comments. I invite you to reflect and share your moments with Liketu and your @talentos too. Fondly Angelica7 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@angelica7/mis-8-anos-en-hive)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrwb6nuCHbppTsRDCnWrThusFK2z4FEBN9Be8FB8jzh4/llalaa.jpg)



Saludos amigo, nuestro gimnasio sigue creciendo y tomando forma, la cual es algo muy emocionante y refleja todo ese trabajo, además ustedes han sido parte de todo es proceso para que se pueda ver con ese estilo, genera dinero y a la vez seguir creciendo. Estamos tenemos que hacer un par de mejoras aprovechando que estuvo reuniendo algo de dinero extra para así pueda avanzar, donde vamos a comenzar primero que nada en contar a la presa para el tema de publicidad, ya que esto se vence y la imagen de marca donde antes tenía 15 personas por minuto, ahora tendré 18 por minuto, lo cual marca la diferencia, para así poder conseguir muchas más cosas importantes para el gimnasio.


>Hello, friend. Our gym continues to grow and take shape, which is really exciting and reflects all the hard work that’s gone into it. Plus, you’ve all been a part of this process, helping us achieve this look, generate revenue, and keep growing. We need to make a couple of improvements now that we’ve managed to save up some extra money to move forward. First and foremost, we’ll start by renewing our media contract for advertising, since the current one is expiring. Our brand visibility, which used to be 15 people per minute, will now be 18 per minute—a significant difference—allowing us to secure many more important resources for the gym.

<div class=\

> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9uPyTACkHPmjXP3hYyAaTxfXvxHoUnxYexgwozCdiNf/image.png) Tenemos que mejorar la comodidad de las personas y por eso ya tenia disponible la opción de cambiar el parking de bicicletas, la cual bates tenía una pequeña capacidad y son las primeras personas que llegarán al gimnasio, son las que la podían usar y muchas otras personas se quedaban sin ese servicio. La mejora fue bastante costosa, ya que estaba en el nivel uno y la llevamos al nivel tres, pero lo importante es que la capacidad de bicicletas subió y ahora pueden colocar nueve y eso es bueno. Por ahora esa es la última mejora, ya después necesito comprar otras cosas y poder seguir ampliando el parking de bicicletas. >We need to improve convenience for our members, which is why we’ve already made it possible to upgrade the bike rack. The old one had limited capacity, and only the first people to arrive at the gym could use it, while many others were left without that service. The upgrade was quite expensive, since it went from level one to level three, but the important thing is that the bike capacity increased, and now we can fit nine bikes, which is great. For now, that’s the latest improvement; later on, I’ll need to buy other things so we can continue expanding the bike parking area.

> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdrZqqyU13CrCXTmkuEtcjPUL1DQTAqLfSdHNyiK5wx1G/image.png) La cantidad de personas que entra y sale de este gimnasio es muy grande, la cual es un gran ejemplo de que estamos haciendo las cosas bien y ahora es que nos falta mucho más por hacer y construir. Uno de los espacios que me das mas ganancia son las máquinas de press banca, por el mismo hecho de que más hombres la usan y allí he invertido más dinero, para ganar más, donde ya era momento de volver a mejorar y que siempre se mantengan nuevas modernas las maquinas, donde estaban en el nivel 100 con una ganancia de 181 billetes por persona y ahora las mejoramos y las lleve al nivel 150 y nos dará 1054 billetes por máquina, siendo algo muy bueno y a la vez se podrá recuperar parte de la inversión. >A huge number of people come and go from this gym, which is a great sign that we’re doing things right—but we still have a lot more to do and build. One of the areas that brings in the most revenue is the bench press machines, simply because more men use them, so I’ve invested more money there to earn more. It was time to upgrade them again so the machines always stay new and modern. They were at level 100, generating 181 bills per person, and now we’ve upgraded them to level 150, which will bring in 1,054 bills per machine—a great result—and at the same time, we’ll be able to recoup part of the investment.

> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSi3KTw1jh3FDr2DBUg3ScUQeazaGtozcf7p3d3NgH7Cd/image.png) Este es un juego que requiere de muchas horas de juego y a la vez paciencia para así poder ese creciendo en cada uno de los espacios a que tenemos disponibles en el gimnasio y a la vez lograr que las personas se puedan sentir tranquilos, puedan hacer sus ejercicios y así todo el mundo poder ganar. Además, las estadísticas siguen subiendo, la cual es algo que me tiene feliz y habla de las cosas buenas que estamos haciendo, donde nos quedamos sin dinero, pero el próximo objetivo será poder comprar más máquinas de spinning y poder darle vida, ya que en las estadísticas es el menos rentable y eso tiene que cambiar, para así poder llegar a la cima con este gimnasio de tycoom. >This is a game that requires many hours of play and patience so that we can grow in each of the spaces available to us at the gym, while also ensuring that people feel at ease, can do their workouts, and that everyone comes out a winner. Plus, the stats keep going up, which makes me happy and shows the good work we’re doing. We’re running out of money, but our next goal will be to buy more spin bikes and bring that area to life, since it’s the least profitable according to the stats—and that has to change so we can reach the top with this Tycoom gym.

 Formal Data Rectification Request Under UK GDPR Article 16

Dear Mr Hill,

Thank you for your response of today, to my formal Challenge  of 13-04-2026. I note your position but it does not address the substantive issues raised in my correspondence.

1. The \
Defence Is Legally Unsound\nYou state that I did not appeal the 2019 decision and that it is therefore \

A decision based on fraudulent or materially inaccurate evidence is void from the outset and cannot be validated by the expiry of an appeal deadline.
See: Bellinger v Bellinger [2003] UKHL 21 – \

The CII's 2019 decision was based on a purported Certificate of Conviction that:
(a) The Court Manager at Harrow Crown Court (Mr Steven Williams) has confirmed in writing has no underlying sealed order - his email of 4 March 2016 states: \

(b) Is contradicted by the Caseman court record system which shows no conviction recorded.
(c) Relates to an alleged offence of \

at a property I owned, as confirmed by the Land Registry.
(d) Your own investigator, Ms Hirosha Thilangarajan, admitted on a recorded call that she did not have a sealed court order (timestamp 11:50 of the recording previously provided to the CII).
A decision based on a certificate that the issuing court says has no underlying order is a nullity.

2. The FCA Has Now Confirmed No Action Against Me As An Individual

On 17 April 2026, the FCA's Jeremy Parkinson confirmed in writing:
\

The FCA has also:
Removed references to convictions and tribunal decisions (October 2025)
Removed my name and address from historical records (January 2026)
If the regulator itself has confirmed no action exists against me, on what basis does the CII maintain sanctions?
Furthermore, Church Hill Finance is a sole trader business. The FCA has confirmed there is no action against the individual. A sole trader has no separate legal personality from the individual. Therefore the FCA's confirmation that there is no action against me necessarily means there is no action against Church Hill Finance.

3. Formal Request Under UK GDPR Article 16
Regardless of the CII's internal appeal procedures, I have a statutory right under UK GDPR Article 16 and Common Law, to the rectification of inaccurate, misleading and false personal data.
The CII holds and publishes data stating that I was subject to disciplinary sanctions based on a criminal conviction. That conviction is now contradicted by:

(a) The issuing court's own manager (no order exists)
(b) The FCA itself (no action against individual)
(c) The CII's own investigator (no sealed court order)

description.title: Have You Ever Been Hurt by Silence?
description.body:
https://shorturl.at/B7vdB

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDjpzJ6RsPT1KkEcjh6RcxpbPmjwtWe9NYPGKk9QYWGW/1776816846447.jpg)

Have you ever waited for a message that never came?
Have you ever opened your phone again and again, hoping to see a reply from someone important?
Have you ever felt that strange feeling when someone who once cared suddenly becomes quiet?
If you have experienced this, then you already know something important about life: sometimes silence hurts more than words.
Many people think harsh words break hearts. Yes, they can hurt. But at least words give clarity. When someone speaks, you understand what they feel. Silence is different. Silence leaves questions inside your mind, and those questions slowly disturb your peace.
I remember a moment from my own life that taught me this lesson.
A few years ago, I had a friend who was very close to me. We used to talk almost every day. We shared jokes, problems, and even small everyday things. Sometimes we would talk late at night about life and our future dreams.
At that time I believed this friendship would last for many years.
But slowly things began to change.
First the messages became shorter. Then the replies started coming late. Sometimes hours passed, sometimes a whole day. At first I ignored it because I thought maybe he was busy. Life gets busy for everyone.
But after some time, the silence became clear.
The strange thing was that nothing bad happened between us. There was no fight, no harsh argument, no angry words. Everything simply faded into silence.
And honestly, that silence felt heavier than any argument.
Sometimes I even wished he would say something direct like, “I don't want to talk anymore.” At least that would have given me an answer. But silence leaves you guessing. You keep thinking: Did I say something wrong? Did I do something that hurt them?
These thoughts keep running in your mind.
Another time I felt something similar was when I started sharing my thoughts online. I began writing small posts and expressing my ideas. I was excited because it was something new for me.
But many people I knew stayed completely silent.
They saw my posts, but they never reacted. No comment, no encouragement, nothing. At first it felt a little strange. But later I understood something important.
Not everyone will support every step of your journey.
Some people walk with you only for a certain distance. After that, they choose another path.
And that is part of life.
Over time I stopped focusing on those who stayed silent. Instead, I started appreciating the people who actually showed support. Sometimes a simple comment or kind word from a stranger can feel more meaningful than silence from someone you know.
Life slowly teaches us where to put our energy.
Now whenever I see someone standing alone and looking at the sunset or the sea, I sometimes wonder what thoughts are inside their heart. Because loneliness does not always mean being physically alone.
Sometimes the deepest loneliness comes when someone you care about stops speaking.
So let me ask you one more question.
If someone important in your life suddenly became silent today… would you reach out first, or would you stay silent too?
Sometimes a small message can save a relationship. Sometimes a simple “How are you?” can mean more than we realize.
And sometimes, breaking the silence is the bravest thing a person can do.

description.body:
> Feliz martes mi gente bella y positiva,hoy estoy animada de estar en esta gran comunidad **EmpoderarTalent**, deseándole muchas Bendiciones. Es grato estar participando en la iniciativa de mi querida amiga @angelica7, la cual invita esta semana en [ Encuentro de Talentos](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-la-ola ), con el Tema **La Ola**. > _Greetings, my beautiful and positive friends! Today I’m excited to be part of this wonderful **EmpoderarTalent** community, and I wish you all many blessings. It’s a pleasure to be participating in the initiative of my dear friend @angelica7, who is hosting this week’s [Talent Gathering](. https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-la-ola ), with the theme **The **._
![GridArt_20260421_122511546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EppPW5jMbQtmVPNWg3B6qpQaBjDSFBqSSUfxWXuZ7nxS3tgU7eB5ZnYf2CmC9XS6gvZ.jpg)

> En el mar la vida es más sabrosa, en el mar te quiero mucho más, pues allí me divierto, me relajo y todo me sabe a gloria de aquí al infinito. Soy superamante del mar, pues aquí nací y sigo; desde pequeña me lanzaba en el mar y jugaba con las olas, ese movimiento que, dependiendo de la época del año, son más fuerte que en otras. > Life is more delightful by the sea; I love you so much more by the sea, because that’s where I have fun, relax, and everything feels like pure bliss—from here to infinity. I’m a huge fan of the sea, because I was born here and still live here; ever since I was little, I’ve been diving into the sea and playing with the waves—that movement that, depending on the time of year, is stronger than at other times.
![IMG_20260418_161735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23zbW41ssJJLhY8JgcH6hjmAbNFAv5CSjEqBWXiL1SMXUWHE7YCQYA5ZnVyjmYz2JpnnN.jpg)

> Cuando niña me gustaba cuando el mar tenía olas fuertes; eran tan altas que quería estar en su cresta. Sentía tanta emoción al poder lanzarme en esas olas altas, así me arrastrara a la orilla; era pura adrenalina. Se decía que cuando estas olas eran tan grandes, el mar estaba bravo; pues ahora sé que es de acuerdo a la época del año y el clima. Existe mar de leva o fondo que es cuando el mar se propaga a otro nivel y trae oleaje fuerte, provocando erosión y aumentos anormales en el nivel del mar. >As a child, I loved it when the sea had big waves; they were so high that I wanted to ride their crests. I felt such a rush when I could throw myself into those towering waves, even if they dragged me back to shore; it was pure adrenaline. People used to say that when these waves were so big, the sea was rough; now I know it depends on the time of year and the weather. There is also swell or deep-sea swell, which is when the sea propagates at a different level and brings strong waves, causing erosion and abnormal rises in sea level.
![IMG_20260418_160955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/245J1qppBisJcgDj1hCpNkkRJ7ZxX2LWgg1m4aiE6NC216JJE1GZMnSqBXj23Xji5837U.jpg)

> Visito con frecuencia este ambiente marítimo, pues afortunada soy de tener el mar tan cerca. Al llegar, disfruto de todos sus elementos, camino descalza en la arena, me siento en la orilla a observar esa inmensidad kilométrica de mar; aunque me gusta mucho su serenidad, también me gusta escuchar el ruido de las olas que van y vienen y en cada sonido trae calma, es terapéutico. >I often visit this seaside setting, as I’m lucky enough to have the ocean so close by. When I arrive, I take in everything around me: I walk barefoot on the sand and sit on the shore to gaze out at the endless expanse of the sea. While I love its serenity, I also enjoy listening to the sound of the waves as they roll in and out—each sound brings a sense of calm; it’s therapeutic.
![IMG_20260418_161003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EqUhEgTxDWSjwZjWhJgBppZwxQEBw4Ge8eoc2USppCSngi2mQ7DVsBpvhqU8n7PPefN.jpg)

> Las olas van y vienen como los triunfos, alegrías, tristezas y desaciertos; allí tenemos que tener fortaleza para enfrentar todas las situaciones que se nos presentan en la vida. Aprovechar esos tiempos de felicidad, y canalizar los tristes, porque todo pasa, nada queda estático; hay tiempos malos y buenos en donde debemos aprender y crecer. > Waves come and go, just like triumphs, joys, sorrows, and mistakes; we must find the strength to face all the situations that life throws our way. We should make the most of the happy times and channel the sad ones, because everything passes—nothing stays the same; there are good times and bad times, and we must use them to learn and grow.
![IMG_20260418_160600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoK8iCc56iHpg5Fx4awWv4oaAbeqXex8xi6Z7p5gZPzjt9KWoCWWJ4z3fJp54emmNTA.jpg)

> > Even though we’ve been talking on video calls, you know it’s not the same. Still, I hope everything goes well for you in that country. I’m glad that all these new experiences are fulfilling for you and that you’re learning more every day, and above all, may God watch over you and protect you in everything you do. I hope time flies so you can return to your country soon to spend time with your loved ones—first and foremost your family, and then your friends, including me. I don’t think I’ve told you this in our conversations. A huge hug, beautiful sister. I love you so much.
![IMG_20260418_162342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23z7GDCctk4gsbPJYawEfRv4eUWytgXXgUgp1kARSbrsK2EBFnTdisbhDgiS4GM6conXQ.jpg)
Siempre habrán Olas en nuestras vidas, esperemoslas con emoción y fuerza, ellas traen muchos aprendizajes en donde todo pasará. Me encantó escribir estás líneas dando mi opinión de este tema, que tiene mucha tela que cortar. Invito a participar a @ninaeatshere **Gracias por su atención, hasta la próxima, mis aventureros.** >There will always be ups and downs in our lives; let’s face them with excitement and strength, for they bring many lessons along the way. I loved writing these lines to share my thoughts on this topic, which has a lot to unpack. I invite you to join the conversation @ninaeatshere. **Thank you for your attention, and until next time, my adventurers.**

description.title: Three Songs by Nickelback | Music & Natto (Three Tunes Tuesday Edition) [ENG/SPA]
description.body: > Hello, fans of good music. It’s already Tuesday, so today I’m going to talk to you about three special songs that shaped my teenage years and early adulthood as the Rock fan that I am. This time we’re sticking with Alternative Rock, but we’ll switch things up a bit with a more “grunge” vibe, if you will. This time I do plan to participate in this weekly contest that our great colleague @ablaze has organized for the Music community. Last week I couldn’t participate due to some electrical issues I had at home. I’m going to talk about Nickelback, a Canadian Rock band that became quite popular in the early 2000s. With many hit singles and a strong presence in the Post-Grunge subgenre, this band was one of the first I was introduced to when I was just a teenager. Their songs have a pretty strong rhythm and vibe, something I could sense even without fully understanding what their lyrics were about. Even now, I feel a certain emotion and nostalgia when I listen to them.

>
Hola, fanáticos de la buena música. Ya es martes, así que hoy toca hablarles de tres canciones especiales que han marcado parte de mi adolescencia y juventud como fanático del Rock que soy. Esta vez seguimos con lo alternativo, pero cambiaremos un poco el ritmo a algo más “grunge”, si se podría decir. Esta vez sí pienso participar en este concurso semanal que nos trae nuestro gran compañero @ablaze para la comunidad de Música. La semana pasada no pude participar debido a ciertos problemas eléctricos que tuve en casa. Les hablaré de Nickelback, una banda de Rock de origen canadiense que llegó a popularizarse bastante a principios de los años 2000. Con muchos sencillos exitosos y una gran presencia en el subgénero Post-Grunge, esta banda ha sido de las primeras que me han inculcado cuando apenas era un adolescente. Sus canciones poseen un ritmo y un sentimiento bastante fuertes, algo que lograba presentir sin siquiera entender del todo de qué tratan sus letras. Aún ahora siento cierta emoción y nostalgia cuando los escucho.

>\n\nLet's start with one of the best-known and most talked-about singles—at least on my old Playlist. It's an emotional, powerful, and nostalgic song that I used to listen to all the time during my \
phase (yeah, what an embarrassing phase, but whatever). \

is the fourth single from their fifth studio album, All The Right Reasons (2005). While it sounds like Rock, its predominant subgenre is Post-Grunge. The song’s lyrics speak of a plea, a request for salvation and redemption from the singer. It’s unclear whether the song is about a request for forgiveness from a romantic interest or more of a plea for salvation from a divine entity, but well, that’s up to each person’s interpretation. What catches my attention is how the lyrics describe the person’s state as if they were in a prison or a city with high walls and no way out. The repeated phrases we hear throughout the song, such as “all I need is you,” “come please, I’m calling you,” and “hurry, I’m falling”, convey that person’s desperation to be saved soon. That state of desperation, despair, and ruin is something we’ve all likely felt at some point in our lives. That feeling or thought that we don’t deserve to be “saved” because of all the mistakes we’ve made or what we’ve become in the end. However, there will always be that special person who will reach out to us, teach us “what is wrong with the good,” and thus allow us to show them “what we can be.” But the real reason or meaning of “being saved” and whether it’s truly worth it depends on what we end up seeking in the end.

>
Empecemos con uno de los sencillos más conocidos y de los más sonados, al menos en mi vieja Playlist. Una canción emotiva, fuerte y nostálgica que siempre escuchaba cuando estaba en mis épocas de rockero depresivo (si, vaya etapa más vergonzosa, pero bueno). Savin' Me es el cuarto sencillo de su quinto álbum de estudio titulado All The Right Reasons (2005). Si bien suena a Rock, su subgénero predominante es el Post-Grunge. La letra de la canción habla de una súplica, una petición de salvación y redención por parte del cantante. No es seguro si la canción habla de una petición de perdón por parte de un interés amoroso o es más una petición de salvación por parte de una entidad divina, pero bueno, todo queda a interpretación de cada quien. Lo que me llama la atención es cómo la letra describe el estado que posee esa persona como si estuviera en una cárcel o en una ciudad con paredes altas y sin salida. Las repetidas frases que escuchamos a lo largo de la canción como “todo lo que necesito es a tí”, “ven por favor que te estoy llamando” y “date prisa que me estoy cayendo” denotan esa desesperación de la persona en ser salvada pronto. Dicho estado de desesperación, hundimiento y perdición es algo que posiblemente todos hayamos sentido en algún momento de nuestras vidas. Esa sensación o pensamiento de que no merecemos ser “salvados” debido a todos los errores que hemos hecho o por lo que nos llegamos a convertir al final. Sin embargo, siempre existirá esa persona especial que nos extenderá la mano, nos enseñará “qué es lo malo del bien” y así poder demostrarle “lo que podemos ser”. Pero es más la razón o el sentido de “ser salvados” y de su de verdad vale la pena lo que terminemos buscando al final.

> Let’s talk now about another great song—not as popular as the previous one or the next one on this list, but still one of the most-played tracks on my old Playlist as well. This is one of the happiest songs—if you can call it that—in Nickelback’s vast musical repertoire. “When We Stand Together” is the first single from the Canadian band’s seventh studio album, Here and Now (2011). The rhythm I mentioned is due to its blend of Pop and Rock. The song’s lyrics speak of unity and staying positive in the face of life’s difficulties. Many see this song as an anthem dedicated to unity, a call to collective action in the face of various global problems such as famine, wars, and the like. Lines like “people pretending everywhere,” “there are bullets flying through the air,” and “then we just turn it off” speak to society’s indifferent attitude toward these global problems. The song repeats several times that being united will lead us to victory—something many of us have likely heard countless times in many places. Honestly, I didn’t realize this song was a kind of critique of today’s society and its ignorance or indifference toward world events or the crises that many people around them seem to face. Since it has a cheerful or upbeat rhythm, you could say, I thought it was talking about something positive—and in part, that’s true, of course. However, I won’t deny that I’m not entirely comfortable with the topics the song addresses—not because I dislike them, but because I don’t want to say anything about them to avoid causing any misunderstandings.

>
Hablemos ahora de otra gran canción, no tan popular como la anterior o la siguiente de esta lista, pero sigue siendo de las más sonadas de mi vieja Playlist también. Esta es una de las canciones más alegres -si se podría decir así- que tiene Nickelback en su enorme repertorio musical. When We Stand Together es el primer sencillo del séptimo álbum de estudio de la banda canadiense titulado Here and Now (2011). Dicho ritmo que mencioné es debido a su mezcla de Pop con Rock. La letra de la canción habla de la unidad y ser positivos ante las dificultades de la vida. Muchos toman esta canción como un himno dedicado a la unión, un llamado a la acción colectiva ante diversos problemas globales como lo es la hambruna, las guerras y demás. Frases como “personas fingiendo en todas partes”, “Hay balas volando por el aire” y “luego simplemente lo apagamos” nos habla sobre la conducta indiferente de la sociedad ante dichos problemas mundiales. La canción repite varias veces que el estar unidos nos llevará a la victoria, algo que posiblemente muchos habremos escuchado repetidas veces en muchos lugares. Sinceramente no sabía que esta canción fuera una especie de crítica a la sociedad actual y su ignorancia o despreocupación por los acontecimientos mundiales o las crisis que parecen muchas personas a su alrededor. Ya que posee un ritmo alegre o movido, podría decirse, pensaba que era algo positivo de lo que hablaba y en parte es así, claro. Sin embargo, no voy a negar que dichos temas del cual habla la canción no me terminan de agradar, no porque no me gusten, sino porque no quiero mencionar nada al respecto para no causar ningún malentendido.

>\n\nWe’ll wrap up this post with Nickelback’s most popular song, the one that catapulted them to massive success in the early 2000s with millions of streams long before Spotify became a household name. \

is the first single from their third studio album, Silver Side Up (2001). The song features the recognizable Post-Grunge rhythm that—even back then—was the subgenre that set this band apart forever. Its lyrics speak of the self-discovery of a broken man who sees himself through the eyes of another person. That other person can be whatever you want, but from what I’ve gathered, the song is about an old love. Everyone has had an ex-partner who expected a lot from us, and because we weren’t “wise man,” we ended up making so many mistakes that now we find ourselves “knocked down,” as if we were “at the bottom of a bottle”—figuratively speaking, of course. Lines like “I’m sick of seeing without feeling” show us a state of numbness on the person’s part—that state we all go through at some point in our relationships, after so many mistakes and betrayals. “How You Remind Me” is the song I can relate to the most on this entire list; especially because of the line “that’s how you really remind me of who I truly am,” which perfectly describes that image you end up seeing of yourself through the eyes of the person you once loved at some point in your life. Yes, I had that experience in the past with someone I loved and “gave a heart worth breaking.” Or perhaps her disappointment stemmed from my having broken her heart, since seeing “who I really am” turned out to be worse for her than I ever imagined.

>
Finalizamos este post con la canción más popular de Nickelback, la que los llevó al éxito total a principios de los años 2000 con millones de reproducciones mucho antes de que Spotify llegase a ser una plataforma conocida. How You Remind Me es el primer sencillo del tercer álbum de estudio titulado Silver Side Up (2001). La canción posee el reconocido ritmo Post-Grunge que -ya en aquella época- fue el subgénero que distinguió a esta banda para siempre. Su letra habla del autodescubrimiento de un hombre roto que se ve a sí mismo ante los ojos de otra persona. Esa otra persona puede ser lo que tú quieras, pero por lo que terminé de entender, la canción habla de un antiguo amor. Todo el mundo ha tenido una ex-pareja que esperaba mucho de nosotros y por no ser un “hombre sabido”, terminamos cometiendo tantos errores que ahora mismo nos encontramos “derribados”, como si estuviéramos “en el fondo de una botella”, de manera figurativa, claro. Frases como “estoy harto de ver sin sentir” nos muestra un estado de insensibilidad por parte de la persona, ese estado en el cual pasamos todos en algún momento de nuestra relación, luego de tantos errores y engaños. How You Remind Me es la canción con la que me puedo llegar a identificar más de toda esta lista; sobre todo por su frase “así es como realmente me recuerdas, de lo que realmente soy”, la cual describe perfectamente esa imagen que uno termina viendo de uno mismo ante los ojos de esa persona que llegaste a amar en algún momento de tu vida. Si, tuve esa experiencia en el pasado con una persona que amé y le “entregué un corazón que vale la pena romper”. O puede que su decepción fuese por yo haberle roto su corazón ya que, al ver “lo que realmente soy” para ella terminó siendo peor de lo que me imaginé.

>
Tell me, do you know Nickelback too? Which of their songs is your favorite? Leave your answer in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿conoces también a Nickelback? ¿Cuál de todas sus canciones es tu favorita? Déjame tu respuesta en los comentarios.

description.title: Freewrite || Trapped in the Heat
description.body:
![PSX_20260422_070056.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUUsyzPiKo7aRF7Zv8bjQ7c8Mbsb2TsXHftpVvnmWMPSN/PSX_20260422_070056.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
That morning felt different. The sun wasn't high yet, but it was already as hot as midday. The usually smooth road slowly transformed into a sea of vehicles, stopped, waiting for each other, with no certainty of when they would be able to move again. I could only sit on my motorcycle, staring ahead, watching the seemingly endless line of vehicles.

To my left and right, people were starting to get restless. Some were complaining softly, others were busy playing on their phones, and still others were simply standing still, resigned to the situation. A woman in a pink jacket was sweating, while in front, a student in a white uniform sat upright, staring blankly at the road. Everyone had different goals, but that morning we were united by one thing: traffic jams.

Not far ahead, a large truck carrying motorcycles could be seen, contributing to the traffic jam. The narrow road forced vehicles to take turns, lengthening the queue. Time seemed to pass more slowly than usual.

But amidst this frustrating situation, a simple lesson resonated deeply. That in life, not everything is within our control. Sometimes we need to pause, take a breath, and patiently accept the situation.

I finally chose to enjoy the moment. Observing my surroundings, feeling the occasional breeze, and realizing that a journey isn't just about getting to the destination, but also about what we experience along the way.

And as the vehicle slowly began to move, I smiled a little. The journey continued, as did the long day that was still waiting to be lived.

description.title: Frente a las olas // Facing the waves
description.body:
>

Tal como la vida se asemeja a un camino y a un largo viaje, el mundo frente a nosotros parece ser un ancho mar que día a día se expone con total libertad. Ante una gran variante de dimensiones y profundidades siempre nos esforzamos por mantenernos a flote, aunque eso conlleve a la acción de tener que afrontar turbulencias y tempestades. De forma constante las olas llegan hasta nosotros, una particularmente diferente a la otra, exigiendo una respuesta, una reacción o algún indicio de que tenemos la actitud para no dormirnos en medio de las aguas. A veces toca ir en dirección opuesta a las olas, mientras que en otras solo es cuestión de dejarse llevar por la corriente. >Just as life resembles a path and a long journey, the world before us seems like a vast sea that unfolds before us day by day with complete freedom. Faced with such a wide variety of dimensions and depths, we always strive to stay afloat, even if that means having to weather turbulence and storms. Constantly, the waves reach us, each one different from the next, demanding a response, a reaction or some sign that we have the resolve not to drift off in the midst of the waters. Sometimes we must go against the waves, whilst at other times it is simply a matter of letting ourselves be carried along by the current. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ2Rbmyd97G2MJFNNJ8arRsGa1WTHQX8MQa6Vw6Tw2qHq/IMG_20260330_110946_908.jpg Dicen que las olas justo al llegar a la orilla suelen golpear con mayor fuerza e intensidad, algo que de seguro muchos en algún momento hemos podido experimentar. Quizás al estar un poco más adentro las olas no te afectan con tanta fuerza y hasta sacan de ti la habilidad para nadar y al mismo tiempo disfrutar del mar. Pensar en esto es como considerar una lección que la misma naturaleza nos da, y es la de ser perseverantes y constantes ante esos problemas que quizás al principio parecen bastante fuertes pero que luego sacan lo mejor de ti, no a modo de sobrevivencia sino con la actitud y la intención correcta para poder disfrutar de lo que haces para darle más color y brillo a tu vida. ¿Cómo contemplas la ola que hoy está frente a ti? ¿Es como un obstáculo, un problema, un reto o una prueba para superar? Según la actitud y el enfoque allí mismo estará la fuente de la fuerza y la disposición para lanzarte al agua con o sin tabla, de manera temeraria con la convicción de que lo puedes lograr y que por muy grande e intimidante que pueda ser la ola más grande es tu determinación. ¿Y que hay si en algún punto de tu vida no supiste manejar una gran adversidad? Quizás no tengas la oportunidad de reivindicarte ante la misma ola pero el propio mar se encargará de traer un escenario similar para el cual estarás con más experiencia y mejor preparado. >They say that waves tend to crash with greater force and intensity just as they reach the shore, something that I’m sure many of us have experienced at some point. Perhaps if you’re a little further out, the waves don’t hit you quite so hard and even allow you to swim whilst enjoying the sea. Thinking about this is like considering a lesson that nature itself teaches us: to be persevering and steadfast in the face of problems that may seem quite daunting at first but which later bring out the best in you—not merely for survival, but with the right attitude and intention to enjoy what you do, thereby adding colour and sparkle to your life. >How do you view the wave standing before you today? Is it an obstacle, a problem, a challenge, or a test to be overcome? Depending on your attitude and approach, that is where you’ll find the source of the strength and resolve to launch yourself into the water – with or without a board – boldly, with the conviction that you can do it, and that no matter how huge and intimidating the wave may be, your determination is greater still. And what if, at some point in your life, you didn’t know how to handle a major setback? You may not get the chance to redeem yourself against that very same wave, but the sea itself will ensure a similar scenario arises, for which you will be more experienced and better prepared. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUNauyBKso3KG35pvxKQ1PdDCPXj4Sw6FgFcKkAFTTA5N/thestorychef-water-282784_640.jpg Las expectativas de la vida suelen ser como olas que logramos divisar en la distancia. Algunas se tardan en llegar mientras que otras no son como en un principio las pensamos, y aunque nunca dejen de pasar ciertas cosas en nuestra vida también nos damos cuenta de que hay cabida para dar algo por perdido, algo que sencillamente no podrá llegar ahora ni más adelante. Es como si de pronto te encuentras ante una realidad que no viste venir y para el cual no estabas preparado, y no queda más remedio que el asumir la manera en la que puedes plantarte ante esa ola, dominarla desde la misma cresta o sumergirte para solo dejarla pasar. En ocasiones trato de visualizar mi realidad a través de ciertos temas, y en este caso puedo verme como ese surfista que sobre su tabla empieza a remar con sus propias manos pero sin un destino específico. Por instantes solo me basta mirar hacia el horizonte como si estuviera esperando una ola que no termina de llegar o que probablemente jamás ha existido. Ante los vientos de incertidumbre no hay temor ante un mar que jamás se podrá secar, ni tampoco ante la ausencia de unas olas que en su constancia y ritmo mantienen un rumbo fijo. Solo es cuestión de encontrar el sentido por el cual todo parece seguir tras un propósito que te mantenga a flote sobre las olas que al ir y venir van trayendo enseñanzas y dejando experiencias que nunca más podrán regresar. >Life’s expectations are often like waves we can just make out in the distance. Some take a long time to arrive, whilst others turn out differently from how we first imagined them; and although certain things will always happen in our lives, we also realise that there is room to accept that some things are lost—things that simply cannot come to pass, either now or in the future. It is as if you suddenly find yourself faced with a reality you did not see coming and for which you were unprepared, and you have no choice but to accept the way in which you can stand your ground against that wave, ride it from the crest itself, or dive beneath it just to let it pass. >Sometimes I try to visualise my reality through certain themes, and in this case I can see myself as that surfer who, standing on his board, begins to paddle with his own hands but without a specific destination. At times, it is enough for me simply to gaze towards the horizon, as if I were waiting for a wave that never quite arrives – or that probably never even existed. In the face of the winds of uncertainty, there is no fear of a sea that can never run dry, nor of the absence of waves whose constancy and rhythm keep a steady course. It is simply a matter of finding the meaning behind why everything seems to follow a purpose that keeps you afloat on the waves which, as they come and go, bring lessons and leave experiences that can never return. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS1gRBaFqDbtFayYZSGiYy6BcKWJUH2wrSKvH7vP6cUrR/de_txadow-surf-321358_640.jpg --- La primera imagen es de mi propiedad // The first image is my own --- Enlaces de las imágenes // Image links: https://share.google/Wsnpmo4irZxRM3UTD https://share.google/3cvRECfQR1ZdZY7pb --- ***Gracias por darle valor a esta publicación con tu tiempo y atención.*** ***Hasta pronto.*** --- >***Thank you for taking the time to read this post.*** >***See you soon.***

description.body:
>

>Private life, public life and secret life... Fate is the one who shuffles the cards, the playing cards, and we just play them. There are those who do want out of personal desire to be alone, and it is wonderful to be alone with oneself, and there are those who have not had the blessing of a soulmate, and are still waiting for it... In the casino, there are for all the betting and gambling games. In this sense, forcing things does not work... We cannot reject suffering, we live in spite of suffering. A very difficult task is to accept something that hurts. >I remember that... I postponed a coffee with a great friend and after a short time she passed away... How it hurts, that feeling is horrible, not to schedule that cup of coffee for another time... *I don't have time* is a phrase used for pure excuses, there is always time for everything as long as you can and really want. If we need to complain, fight or make tension to get what we want does not work. Above all, because many times we do not succeed, and if we succeed we will be left with the frustration that it was not because the other wanted, but because you forced it. To really connect, today is difficult. We're all so busy *getting better* that we forget to share. It is true that sometimes it is not enough just to send messages on social networks. Of course, not all realities are the same and in this my country believe me there is always something to take care of to keep us alive and safe more than a coffee ☕ We all have busy lives, but when they don't want to match up with one, it shows. I had to understand this, but over time I realized that this was happening to me with supposed friends. Today I thank God for pruning the tree and leaving only the true s branches that despite the storms always remain. Time is the most valuable thing we have, so I have learned to give my time only to those who truly appreciate it. No one has time for what they don't care about. Besides, in this life, everything is temporary. There are also times when insisting ceases to be interest and begins to be wear and tear. When we invite to share with intention, with respect, but on the other side there are only excuses, silences or times that never match the answer is no longer in the.what they say, but in what they do. *That's where the real value comes in: knowing how to stop yourself*. Taking a step back is not giving up, it's choosing yourself. It is to understand that our time also has weight, that our presence is not something to be begged for, and that who really wants to share a coffee with you, finds the moment, not the excuse. Sometimes the best decision is not to insist more, or beg anyone else, but to look at ourselves, to readjust our energy and remember that we deserve reciprocity, clarity and a real desire to share. Because when someone sweats too much, we shouldn't do it to ourselves. The good news is that life is not for holding on to, it's for inhabiting the present as the only thing that really belongs to us...To those who quietly read me, my post is not perfect, but is mine. Janitze 💐

description.title: The Zunzún: the tiny jewel of the Caribbean
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXYVLL7KRuouQ2Kc6p2oihoLGTzzZ5mQ9D5j22m4p8Xv/img_2098.jpg)

The “zunzún,” as hummingbirds are called in Cuba, is one of the smallest and most fascinating birds in the world. It belongs to the hummingbird family, known for their incredible ability to hover in the air as if they were magically suspended. In Cuba, there is even an endemic species called the bee hummingbird (zunzuncito), considered the smallest bird on Earth.

These tiny creatures symbolize energy, freedom, and natural beauty. Their wings move so fast they almost disappear, creating a soft humming sound that inspired their name. Seeing one is already special, but seeing two together feels like witnessing a small miracle of nature—delicate, weightless, and full of life, reminding us that true beauty often lives in the smallest things

description.body:
>



Hola. Tengo bastantes fotos de mis días de semana santa, y quise de alguna forma hacer una entrada para publicarselas. Y es que, esta semana santa fue diferente, a mi novio le ofrecieron trabajar, y pude acompañarlo un par de días donde debía realizar ese trabajo en la playa, lo cual me gustó bastante.
> Hi. I have quite a few photos from my Easter break, and I wanted to write a post to share them with you. This Easter was different; my boyfriend was offered a job, and I was able to spend a couple of days with him at the beach, where he had to do the work, which I really enjoyed.



![Green and Yellow Scrapbook Friends Photocollage A3 Document.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbiJwB8H5rkG2998NFW5pq9VbEiyrLARfASVxBWwZuxma/Green%20and%20Yellow%20Scrapbook%20Friends%20Photocollage%20A3%20Document.jpg)


En semana santa la mayoría dispone su tiempo para ir a la playa, y nosotros realmente tratamos de ir a los lugares menos concurridos, por ser fecha santa, tratamos de mantenernos al margen, la cantidad de personas trae caos, y no soy amiga de eso. Y en efecto, el día que fuimos a playa \

, la cantidad de personas era abismal, fue un día donde la verdad ni ganas de disfrutar la playa, no había sillas, la música no permitía conversar, y fue un día caótico en todos los sentidos. \n> During Holy Week, most people spend their time at the beach, and we really try to go to places that aren't so crowded. Because it's a holy time, we try to stay away; the number of people brings chaos, and I'm not a fan of that. And indeed, the day we went to San Luis beach, near the \

the number of people was overwhelming. It was a day where I honestly didn't feel like enjoying the beach at all. There weren't any chairs, the music was so loud you couldn't talk, and it was a chaotic day in every sense. ![IMG_20260403_144632.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7broCVyWwLnU9naAttvAvyxYscG7QYc18DqR1vS8Kys/IMG_20260403_144632.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260420_212605_com_hihonor_photos_GalleryMain.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPcB8YRcvNQLhVTxUZki7FMdqvaqw5pDWrD1epmYJcjny/Screenshot_20260420_212605_com_hihonor_photos_GalleryMain.jpg) De igual forma, al estar con mi familia, pude dejar esa ansiedad por lo caótico del sitio , y algo que si disfrute, fue observar el paisaje y la puesta de sol. De mis momentos favoritos en la vida es estar en la playa cuando está poniéndose y/o ocultandose el sol, esa energía me ayuda a mantenerme en el presente, relajarme y disfrutar los colores, tomar fotos y darme cuenta lo afortunada de tener una buena salud y a mi familia completa y sana. > Likewise, being with my family allowed me to let go of that anxiety about the chaos of the place, and something I truly enjoyed was observing the landscape and the sunset. One of my favorite moments in life is being on the beach at sunset; that energy helps me stay in the present, relax, and enjoy the colors, take photos, and realize how fortunate I am to have good health and my whole, healthy family. ![IMG-20260403-WA0104.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdAbsC1G3RM8QckxaPnFiA2AWjnrwx7RZiXVRpeMihV7n/IMG-20260403-WA0104.jpg) ![IMG_20260403_180228.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcFJRedkJGtmdrT7y5v9Qpa8mB5wSv7jcjfEpUrvxUkDW/IMG_20260403_180228.jpg) ![IMG_20260403_182652.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRAHCH5TBvibb3gb4jATRi4PAFsHhptWPi7ma1sz2gnC8/IMG_20260403_182652.jpg) Con mi mamá en ciertos momentos nos alejabamos del bullicio a unos kioskos para tomar algo y conversar, sin prisas ni interrupciones, también porque había espacio donde mi novio debía trabajar, sin embargo, disfruté bastante esos lapsos de tiempo con ella, solo nosotras dos. Esos momentos son los que quedan en mi mente y guardo con bastante amor, con mi mamá no es necesario tener un tema en específico de conversación, hablamos de todo y de nada, tenemos mucha conexión, hasta en los momentos de silencio, nos mirábamos y reíamos, sin necesidad de palabras. > My mom and I would sometimes escape the hustle and bustle to some kiosks to have a drink and chat, without any rush or interruptions. There was also space where my boyfriend had to work, but I really enjoyed those moments with her, just the two of us. Those are the moments that stay with me and that I cherish. With my mom, we don't need a specific topic of conversation; we talk about everything and nothing. We have a deep connection, even in moments of silence, we would look at each other and laugh, without the need for words. ![IMG-20260403-WA0103.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3kbYpUP6qTQhzcKMv78p1JTyhuMmYpUJt6vjCDgJiqM/IMG-20260403-WA0103.jpg) Como ya les comenté, uno de mis momentos favoritos es el atardecer, pero, lo que realmente lo hace especial es poder compartirlo con mi novio. Lo que más disfruto es que, al vivir en una zona costera, en 10 minutos estamos en la playa, así que, esta tradición se ha convertido en algo habitual para nosotros, especialmente en Semana Santa. Además, siento un gran agradecimiento porque mi novio siempre se esfuerza por cumplir mis deseos y acompañarme en estos pequeños grandes momentos, que se están convirtiendo en recuerdos que guardaré por siempre, y que me da placer poder compartir aquí en hiveblog. > As I mentioned before, one of my favorite times of day is sunset, but what truly makes it special is being able to share it with my boyfriend. What I enjoy most is that, living in a coastal area, we can be at the beach in just 10 minutes, so this tradition has become a regular thing for us, especially during Easter week. I'm also incredibly grateful because my boyfriend always goes out of his way to fulfill my wishes and be with me during these precious moments, which are becoming memories I'll cherish forever, and which I'm happy to share here on Hiveblog. ![IMG-20260403-WA0107.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcNMZmDnLPwGC2wdipRZ4yFYD419Uy1G98nnmcHVcfimP/IMG-20260403-WA0107.jpg) ![IMG-20260403-WA0086.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNgaSqi13hRcTB7jTabCLFJmrXydct8xCzoTMcEgS5Lat/IMG-20260403-WA0086.jpg) Para finalizar, quiero dejar un mensaje dando gracias a todos los que pasan por mi blog y hacen que escribir siga siendo un momento de paz y felicidad para mi, en este abril-2026 cumplí 5 años usando esta plataforma y agradezco profundamente que se haya vuelto parte de mi vida. Muchísimas gracias por todo Hiveblog, por más años haciendo comunidad. > Finally, I want to express my gratitude to everyone who visits my blog and makes writing a peaceful and happy experience for me. This April 2026 marked five years of using this platform, and I am deeply grateful that it has become such a part of my life. Thank you so much for everything, Hiveblog, and here's to many more years of building community. ![IMG_20260403_144711.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW1hdp8ywt3ML4Bt4RxbTBMkgt9ws27xfpbSMTySoXNEn/IMG_20260403_144711.jpg) ______ #lifestyle Fotografía por | Photography by: @mairimmorales, HONOR MAGIC 7 LITE. description.title: 21 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3080: licence to do something
description.body:
/>

“OK, but, see, I don't get it. Why do people need a license to do something?”

Five-year-old Robert Edward Ludlow III was watching 16-year-old Tom Stepforth rejoice because at last he had his driver's license.

Six-year-old Grayson Ludlow, Lil' Robert's first cousin adopted as his brother by their grandparents, had the answer at their level.

“It's like blueprints,” he said as he pulled out his white crayons and blue construction paper. “Sometimes you gotta have a plan and show you know how to do something.”

“Driving is like building?” said Lil'' Robert.

“No,” Grayson said. “The building stands there when it's done right. The car moves. You gotta know even more stuff to drive.”

“Is this why Papa doesn't talk much when he drives in the city?” Lil' Robert said.

“Yep, because most people out here probably just used crayons and paper to draw a license and don't know what they are doing,” Grayson said. “Papa says he is a defensive driver, so, he is defending us with his skills.”

“Yep, that is right, because Papa has a ton of real licenses,” nine-year-old George said as he joined the conversation. “Papa can drive a car, a big bus, a big truck, a tank, and fly a helicopter.”

“Oh, wow – I wanna ride in all that!” Lil' Robert said.

“No, not really – the last two has folks shooting at you,” George said.

“Never mind,” Lil' Robert said.

“Yeah, traffic is bad enough already,” Grayson said. “Just the big trucks alone are sometimes too much.”

“Yeah – remember that time that this big truck driver got ticked off with Papa for whatever dumb thing but didn't know who he was dealing with?” George said.

“Yeah,” Lil' Robert and Grayson said.

“That was a wild situation, though,” ten-year-old Andrew said. “I mean, we didn't see it all, but I've looked it up since. I don't think there's ever been a truck and its driver that got a crook in their backs the same way on the same day before.”

Lil' Robert, Grayson, and George looked at each other.

“Because Papa,” Lil' Robert finally said.

“Yep,” George and Grayson said.

“Yep,” Andrew said. “You can drive an 18-wheeler if you want to, but maybe don't think that's going to protect you if you mess with Capt. Robert Edward 'Hell-to-Pay' Ludlow, because if you do … see, what Papa needs is warning signage so folks don't think they re dealing with a more fit version of Colonel Sanders who eats broiled instead of fried chicken.”

“No,” Grayson said. “What people need is to mind their own business and stop thinking they own the whole road.”

“Yeah, but y'all know ain't nobody doing that first part!” George said.

“You know, if Papa needs a peacetime nickname, it could just be 'The Finisher,'” eleven-year-old Eleanor Ludlow said as she joined the conversation. “I've never seen Papa start any mess with anyone, but boy, does he finish!”

“Yeah, that really works, like my biological grandfather found out – and see, this is why warning signage won't work, Andy,” ten-year-old Glendella Ludlow said as she joined the conversation. “Astor Ludlow my biological grandfather has known Upgrade Papa all his life, and still started mess and got destroyed. It's like you always see somebody reading the 'Keep Off the Grass' sign and going up there to walk on it anyway – it's like some people have a magnet attached that pulls them irresistibly to doing something stupid.”

“Yeah, basically some people want to see if they can – I forgot about that,” Andrew said. “Warning signage might get even more people and their vehicles put into traction – never mind. Back to the drawing board.”

“Here you go,” Grayson said, and gave his big brother white crayons and blue construction paper.

Capt. Robert Edward Ludlow Sr., aka “Hell-to-Pay,” newly aka “The Finisher,” walked through oblivious to the conversation just had about him because he was on the phone, and getting ready to go out of the house some distance so as not to have the little ones hear his deep, powerful voice when he was done dealing with the foolishness he was hearing. He did, however, say something in their earshot.

“Now, listen, my company would rather not have any trouble, but if yours does, my friendly advice is, just be sure you're ready.”

“Ooo,” Lil' Robert and George said.

“I don't like designing funeral homes, but, I feel like I need to,” Grayson said as he pulled over some more blue paper.

“That's already at like that C1 on the piano – that person is about to have their entire world blown out through the subwoofers,” said Andrew as he put his head in his hands.

“I'm just praying this person has enough sense to not get it so Upgrade Papa drops him off below A0!” Glendella said.

“Yeah, that's a good idea because sheesh!” Eleanor said. “Who needs the infra-bass drama!”

“But sometimes people need it,” Grayson said. “They keep messing with folks until they meet someone that teaches them why you don't do that. That's why God made Papa.”

Capt. Ludlow stopped on the porch, and then turned around and walked back, still talking, but his voice in a safer range for everyone in earshot.

“That's what I was waiting for you to understand. Trying to bluff me when all we have to do is come to an understanding was not even necessary, to say nothing of dangerously unwise. We can be so much better working together than not. We are not even competition to each other, so why have me act like I thought you were? Why can't we just prosper together?”

There was a pause, and then the little ones saw their (grand)father begin to smile.

“Yes, I know men like us usually don't think like that, and instead get scared and act foolish. But we are mature men of intelligence now; there is no need for us to revert to destructive behavior when there is money and legacy to be made. Let's keep our grandchildren's future in mind, too.”

He dazzled his own in the room with his full smile before walking on, and they stared at his back in astonishment as he went.

“Whoever that was figured it out!” George said.

“And there is a Father even bigger than Papa, and He heard us,” Glendella said as she and Andrew slumped into each other from relief.

“Another entire career, spared,” Eleanor said. “'The Finisher' finished kindly today, with God's help.”

“God is good, although people sometimes really aren't,” Grayson said.

“Well, yeah!” Lil' Robert said.
