description.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

> El velocímetro de seguro marcaba los cien kilómetros por hora y el viento, ese viejo compañero de rutas, silbaba contra el parabrisas con una confianza que el conductor también sentía. En las carreteras de Venezuela, manejar a esa velocidad es siempre un acto de fe y valentía, una danza entre los huecos del asfalto y la esperanza de llegar a tiempo y a salvo. De repente, el ritmo cambió, no fue un estallido violento, sino un sutil y rítmico golpeteo que se transmitió desde el volante hasta las palmas; un clic-clic-clic metálico que vaticinaba el desastre. El conductor sintió cómo la dirección perdía su firmeza, volviéndose pesada, caprichosa, como si el carro quisiera arrodillarse en plena autopista.
# ***
Un Suspiro de Goma en el Asfalto
*** Al bajarse del vehículo,, @lanzjoseg, todavía con la adrenalina quemándole la nuca, lo vio..., allí estaba, como un parásito de acero incrustado en la carne negra del neumático. Si observan detalladamente la imagen que capturó más tarde en el taller el amigo @lanzjoseg, notarán la ironía del momento. Un trozo de metal grisáceo, curvo y desafiante, se ha hundido profundamente en uno de los surcos longitudinales del caucho. No es un clavo común; parece un resto de alambre acerado, una astilla del caos urbano que decidió que el viaje terminaría allí. Se aprecia cómo la punta desaparece en la goma, mientras el resto del cuerpo queda fuera, doblado...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSs9i3RDkPgpd6Q7SyyMehZMNStZWN2awSrM4sx12bCz/lanz.png) [Imagen de la iniciativa, cortesía de @lanzjoseg.](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSs9i3RDkPgpd6Q7SyyMehZMNStZWN2awSrM4sx12bCz/imagen.png)
Estando en un taller de esa tierra nuestra Venezuela, la visión se vuelve más cruda. En mi lejano y amadada Venezuela, un caucho pinchado no es solo un inconveniente técnico; es una herida en el presupuesto y una prueba a la paciencia. Mirando de cerca la foto, noto el desgaste de las estrías, el polvo acumulado en los flancos que cuentan historias de kilómetros recorridos bajo el sol inclemente. Sé, por el diseño y la estructura que se muestra, que este neumático no utiliza tripa. Es un caucho \

, lo que técnicamente salvó a @lanzjoseg de un reventón catastrófico a gran velocidad, permitiéndole orillarse antes de que el aire se escapara por completo. En la penumbra del taller, rodeado de otros cauchos usados que se apilan en el fondo de la imagen, entiendo que la seguridad es un equilibrio precario. Ese objeto pequeño, que apenas resalta sobre la superficie rugosa, tiene el poder de detener toneladas de ingeniería. La carretera nos enseña que no somos dueños del camino, sino simples huéspedes. Cada vez que encendemos el motor, aceptamos un contrato invisible con el azar. Por eso, al mirar esa herida de hierro, comprendo que en la vía nunca se debe bajar la guardia; hay que estar siempre presto, con el sentido alerta y la voluntad dispuesta, porque el imprevisto no avisa, simplemente se incrusta en nuestra ruta para recordarnos nuestra fragilidad.
*** ***

> #### Bienvenidos todos a esta, mi participación de la semana en el TopFiveFamily. Si es de tu agrado participar, aún estás a tiempo. Este es el enlace [**Observa⇾Piensa⇉Escribe**](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-8fe489d7947e8). **Recuerda cumplir las reglas…**
https://images.ecency.com/DQmPEDSUoeART53SjCKf8Xt6UDCtSJhXdavhjxG59nJJdLd/imagen.png Portada de la iniciativa.
*** ***
🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆

###
Dedicado a todos aquellos escribas que contribuyen, día a día, a hacer de nuestro planeta, un mundo mejor
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnceTgTBLgAUkErZfdoePC7twytC1CTcqQYDKkU4Lrrd/1024espa_ol8.gif) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)

*** *** ***

> The speedometer was surely showing a hundred kilometres per hour, and the wind—that old travelling companion—whistled against the windscreen with a confidence that the driver also felt. On Venezuela’s roads, driving at that speed is always an act of faith and courage, a dance between the potholes in the tarmac and the hope of arriving on time and in one’s own two feet. Suddenly, the rhythm changed; it wasn’t a violent burst, but a subtle, rhythmic tapping that travelled from the steering wheel to his palms—a metallic click-click-click that foreshadowed disaster. The driver felt the steering lose its firmness, becoming heavy and erratic, as if the car wanted to bring itself to a halt right in the middle of the motorway.
# ***
A Rubber Sigh on the Asphalt
*** As he got out, the adrenaline still burning at the back of his neck, he saw it... there it was, like a steel parasite embedded in the black flesh of the tyre. If you look closely at the image captured later at the garage by my friend @lanzjoseg, you’ll notice the irony of the moment. A piece of greyish metal, curved and defiant, has sunk deep into one of the tyre’s longitudinal grooves. It is no ordinary nail; it looks like a scrap of steel wire, a splinter of urban chaos that decided the journey would end there. You can see how the tip disappears into the rubber, whilst the rest of the body remains outside, bent...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSs9i3RDkPgpd6Q7SyyMehZMNStZWN2awSrM4sx12bCz/lanz.png) [Image of the initiative, courtesy of @lanzjoseg.](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSs9i3RDkPgpd6Q7SyyMehZMNStZWN2awSrM4sx12bCz/imagen.png)
Standing in a workshop in our beloved Venezuela, the reality hits home all the harder. In my distant, beloved Venezuela, a flat tyre isn’t just a technical hiccup; it’s a blow to the budget and a test of patience. Looking closely at the photo, I notice the wear on the treads, the dust accumulated on the sidewalls that tell tales of kilometres travelled under the relentless sun. I know, from the design and structure shown, that this tyre does not use an inner tube. It is a ‘tubeless’ tyre, which technically saved @lanzjoseg from a catastrophic blowout at high speed, allowing him to pull over before the air escaped completely. In the dim light of the workshop, surrounded by other used tyres piled up at the back of the picture, I realise that safety is a precarious balance. That small object, barely standing out against the rough surface, has the power to stop tonnes of engineering. The road teaches us that we are not masters of the road, but mere guests. Every time we start the engine, we accept an invisible contract with chance. That is why, looking at that iron wound, I realise that on the road one must never let one’s guard down; one must always be ready, with one’s senses alert and one’s will prepared, because the unexpected gives no warning—it simply embeds itself in our path to remind us of our fragility.
*** ***

description.title: Fundación gana a Gigantes en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División de Futsal
description.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes la participación del equipo de Fundación en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División de Futsal, que se está desarrollando en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to our friends at Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you the Fundación team’s performance in the Second Division Futsal Opening Tournament, which is currently taking place in the community of Villa de Cura, in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260421_130224733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xAcMBLPxztPKMbTCCBAqmdgradZ6dpCzj5dLQPod5DmLvBRfCgn1hYMnm8tGm1om71T.jpg) Cabe destacar que está es la tercera jornada de juegos, que se realizó el día domingo 19 de abril, en las instalaciones de la cancha del sector La Coromoto, de la parroquia Villa de Cura, en la cual participaron por el equipo de Fundación las categorías Sub 8, Sub 14B, Sub 16A y Sub 18, contra las delegaciones de Gigantes y Verona. El primer encuentro se inició a las 9:00 am. con la categoría Sub 14B de Fundación vs Gigantes, en el primer tiempo, los dos equipos atacaron constantemente la portería, sin hacer efectiva los goles, sin embargo después el equipo de Gigantes obtiene su primer gol, después Fundación logra empatar, casi finalizando este tiempo. >It is worth noting that this was the third round of matches, which took place on Sunday 19 April at the football ground in the La Coromoto area of the Villa de Cura parish. The Fundación team fielded their Under-8, Under-14B, Under-16A and Under-18 sides against teams from Gigantes and Verona. The first match kicked off at 9:00 am with the Under-14B team from Fundación taking on Gigantes. In the first half, both teams constantly attacked the goal without scoring; however, Gigantes then scored their first goal, before Fundación managed to equalise towards the end of the half. ![IMG_20260419_095430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23x19PBL3bNN7oPdRyNCNhDo6URQpJuEkS9HfuypEfYXAFqCNSfhsjqNfMyXwsXoCW9Rh.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_095853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23y8vGLa71CxPBbU8PiHj9GY9etujWnbApJo5AkEMQif9ugSpfzNdCRn2vM8XzvzxfRYD.jpg) Posteriormente pasaron a jugar el segundo tiempo, se pudo observar por parte del equipo de Fundación que algunos jugadores no estaban acoplados a sus demás compañeros, debido a que están nuevos en el equipo y para esto son estos encuentros para mejorar el desempeños de los muchachos dentro de la cancha. El técnico realizó algunos cambios de los titulares para permitir la participación de los demás jugadores, que no entraba jugando con la misma rápidez que el titular, bajando un poco la defensa y el equipo rival logra concretar dos goles más, pero Fundación, nuevamente recuperar el dominio de la pelota, concretando dos goles para quedar empatados 3 x 3. >As the second half got underway, it was clear that some of the Fundación players were not yet in sync with their teammates, as they are new to the squad; matches like this are designed to help the lads improve their performance on the pitch. The manager made some changes to the starting line-up to allow other players to take part; these players did not start the match with the same pace as the regulars, causing the defence to drop back slightly, and the opposition managed to score two more goals. However, Fundación regained control of the ball and scored two goals of their own to level the score at 3–3. ![IMG_20260419_101102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xyR3mAVs4m9aV3nMMe66CuMQtsNax2pynJYMfKKAidaygw6KcSBN2mwmmzEwUFTpbE7.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_143735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xKtRmzXd8iRu7eBA7bNLCWdptTi5ybZ18GSCgBYHfvwPLVjC7a6pdqDsxCSjWtMT1He.jpg) Después pasaron a jugar la categoría Sub 18 de Fundación vs Gigantes, en el primer tiempo las dos delegaciones jugaron con gran intensidad, marcando el primer gol Fundación, pero faltando pocos segundos para finalizar este tiempo, el equipo de Gigantes, empata 1 X 1. En el segundo tiempo Fundación continuó jugando con gran intensidad, pero el equipo rival no pudo con mantener una buena defensa, lo cual aprovechó Fundación para aumentar el marcador a cuatro goles más y ganan con un amplio marcador de 5 X 1. >Next up was the Under-18 match between Fundación and Gigantes. In the first half, both teams played with great intensity; Fundación scored the first goal, but with just a few seconds remaining, Gigantes equalised to make it 1–1. In the second half, Fundación continued to play with great intensity, but the opposition were unable to maintain a solid defence, which Fundación capitalised on to add four more goals, winning by a comfortable margin of 5–1. ![IMG_20260419_144231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23w2jC3mQrGu9PF5BveFnFumNVep4D1B1L559Vn5m6kY6xFyf84cY65gANEg119MtnvPJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_145202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wgFggiBnwtjx92D1qF4ZRcdZL8SjRm7TVYyTmJ7fEzJF5QoCYWGYr3aqunueercXbF5.jpg) Por último se presentaron las categorías Sub 16A de Fundación vs Verona, en el primer tiempo las dos delegaciones estuvieron atacando y tratando de marcar los goles, pero el portero no dejaba pasar la pelota en la portería. Después Fundación inicia el marcador con un gol y luego el equipo de Verona logra empatar a 1 X 1. Seguidamente Fundación, intensificó sus ataques a la portería, para marcar dos goles más y ganan 3 X 1 . En el segundo tiempo el técnico hizo algunos cambios de los titulares, pero estos no mantuvieron una buena defensa, lo cual cual aprovechó el equipo rival para empatar 3 X 3, nuevamente entraron los titulares y marcaron un cuarto gol, para ganar 4 X 3, en un partido bien cerrado los últimos minutos. >Finally, the Under-16A match between Fundación and Verona took place. In the first half, both teams attacked and tried to score, but the goalkeeper kept the ball out of the net. Fundación then opened the scoring with a goal, before Verona managed to equalise to make it 1–1. Fundación then stepped up their attacks on goal, scoring two more goals to win 3–1. In the second half, the manager made some changes to the starting line-up, but the substitutes failed to maintain a solid defence, which the opposition capitalised on to draw level at 3–3. The starters were brought back on and scored a fourth goal to win 4–3 in a closely contested match in the closing minutes. ![IMG_20260419_150242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wCBsBTmnMgJcYBbYSpt3qo1e2hiiBML4F6cRgqT3C6Fnz2tcyj2H98cJUJnF4GJQ8sT.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_144847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wqdokyzMCXsVoaBQmT4Q4AuiiWFjmHp9M15ytfhJhbVpJr2BxYNRhLwVX2rUhXTe6Jo.jpg) ![GridArt_20260421_125740318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23sdvHwhEY8UZ9KsP2sb6cWGNVKiNzUdVa9gdbHYLrJ35ZByptQSAybgTjSb7aUVV8WC8.jpg) Para finalizar, de tres partidos, Fundación gana dos, en la categoría Sub 16A, Sub 18 y un empate en la 14B, con estos finaliza esta jornada de juegos que se desarrollaron desde el día viernes, sábados y domingo. >To round off the day, Fundación won two of their three matches in the Under-16A and Under-18 categories, and drew one in the Under-14B category. This brings to a close this round of fixtures, which took place on Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. description.title: Quiet and Genuine Friends / Wednesday / Back to Mapita
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8k1dT3es79zzCNpgFyg4Sx5t2ZEdq2q2zbV8KLo5rhM/messenger_creation_811eff9b_129d_43ad_8caf_9bb44023bb62.jpeg)

### Quiet and Genuine Friends
I do hear from people who prefer having a quiet life. I share the same thoughts, probably due to age, our preferences changes. Back then, I can listen to loud music all day. Now, I can still listen to them (rock music) but with minimal volume. Even solemn music was played in lower volume. 
I get triggered with noise, giving me some headaches. Even spending time with friends, I prefer a quiet atmosphere, conversations that's worth participating with. What more with people who deeply cares and are genuine. For sure we have some \

but felt like they're more of acquaintances. Oftentimes, it's difficult to find genuine friends but they do exist. 

### Wednesday 
Feeling quite irritated because of the heat. Electric fan seemed to help minimally. I heard about thunderstorm in some places, but we don't need that. A simple rain will do to neutralize the temperature. I've been saying it's not too hot the past few weeks, but it's being felt now. 

### Back to Mapita
I remember the first time when we went here. That was 2021. So it was five years ago, and compared to now, it's prettier then. Today, we can see a lot of solar power plants which costed huge lands and trees.

description.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![Cumpleaños de mi esposo (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23y8x2faiNazWoiUmaCJKjknEF7pSVN5Fq7L4XM6682kM89m6HEpVi1ZL638w2CpyJrWd.jpg)

>\n \nHola, gente de esta comunidad de #empowertalent, nuevamente me encuentro por aquí para seguir participando como cada martes en el encuentro de talentos. Esta vez nuestra amiga @angelica7 nos invita a participar con un tema muy interesante que podemos asociar con la vida, la ola. Les cuento que cuando iba escribiendo, venía a mi mente un tema de una telenovela colombiana llamada \

ya que a cada momento cantaban y bailaban esta canción que tanto me gustaba y dice así: 🎵🎶 Sobre las olas un barco va; sobre las olas un barco va; Y va y se va, y va y se va; Y va y se va, y va y se va ra ra ra 🎵🎶 Así es la vida, como una ola que viene y se va.

Sí, amigos, la vida es como una ola llena de cambios constantes a los que nos enfrentamos cada día, en la que vivimos todo tipo de experiencias, ya sean positivas o negativas, y que, al final, se desvanecen tal y como llegaron. La vida está llena de emociones, tristeza, alegría, momentos formales e informales que debemos aceptar, así como de momentos que debemos celebrar, porque la vida es dinámica y nunca se detiene.

Ademas, vivimos múltiples experiencias y momentos que nos permiten crecer. Como las olas llegan de diversos tamaños y cada una se presenta de manera diferente, así es la vida con sus altibajos. Mientras escribo esto, pienso cuando estoy en el mar bañándome con mi nieto y a él le fascina la playa y disfruta de las olas. A veces me dice: \

, y él se goza de este momento; en la vida también disfrutamos de esas situaciones favorables cuando estamos en nuestro mejor momento. Por eso sostengo que la vida, como las olas, viene con mucha fuerza y puede arrastrarnos y golpearnos fuertemente; por ejemplo, la muerte de un ser querido, especialmente la de un hijo. Por ello, debemos levantarnos para seguir adelante. La vida, amigos, es parecida a una ola porque se mueve caprichosa y arbitrariamente, así como las olas. Los distintos momentos que pasamos en la vida nos causan desasosiego, desesperación y agotamiento. Al igual que las olas del mar nos hacen recordar a veces que la vida puede ser tranquila y suave en algunos instantes, pero también agitada y turbulenta en otras ocasiones; aunque estas olas puedan presentarnos circunstancias inestables y difíciles, como sucede con la vida misma, también nos ofrecen cosas muy valiosas y buenas que nos llenan de mucha emoción y alegría. De este modo, al igual que en la vida hay momentos bellos, como un surfista disfruta del presente de atrapar una ola, aunque sabe que el deleite acabará pront De este modo, al igual que en la vida hay momentos bellos, un surfista disfruta del presente de atrapar una ola, aunque sabe que el deleite acabará pronto. Por eso nos aferramos a la idea de que la vida es hoy y debemos vivirla al máximo sin darle muchas vueltas; a veces con alegrías, tristezas o lágrimas, porque la vida es hermosa, así como las olas que tienen ritmos incontrolables, pero es posible honrarlos. En ocasiones, lo más transformador ocurre justo después de habernos entregado por completo a la espera y a la fe. 
![IMG_20240104_170331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/243BcV1hxVCJdCgnjefoBtYYmXrXTJZ3scLugbkoLFh3SPb9VuZJtQoWA49v8s5iYjwLs.jpg) ![IMG_20240104_172226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zbMF4Q7gVXauVeQwsLvJweC2ckac7YCViBEwGWWVEJJeThCHSNQZ7QerPpbuJxbetpA.jpg) ![IMG_20240104_173052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xedizw6F98KMUL8gQsVLDu4DFVjtM9Q6sK3J5YFvXzts8o4fKSzWwxx2C5PbaUbhSn3.jpg)
--- # English --- >Hello, everyone in the #empowertalent community! I’m back here again to join in on the talent gathering, just like every Tuesday. This time, our friend @angelica7 has invited us to participate with a very interesting theme that we can relate to life: the wave. I’ll tell you that as I was writing, a song from a Colombian soap opera called “Vecinos” came to mind, since they were constantly singing and dancing to this song that I loved so much, and it goes like this: 🎵🎶 A ship sails over the waves; a ship sails over the waves; And it comes and goes, and it comes and goes; And it goes and goes, and it goes and goes ra ra ra 🎵🎶 That’s how life is, like a wave that comes and goes. >Yes, friends, life is like a wave full of constant changes that we face every day, in which we go through all kinds of experiences—whether positive or negative—and which, in the end, fade away just as quickly as they came. Life is full of emotions, sadness, joy, and both formal and informal moments that we must accept, as well as moments that we must celebrate, because life is dynamic and never stops. >We also go through many experiences and moments that help us grow. Just as waves come in all sizes and each one breaks differently, so does life with its ups and downs. As I write this, I think about when I’m at the beach swimming with my grandson—he loves the beach and enjoys the waves. Sometimes he says to me, “Let’s catch this wave, Grandma—it’s coming bigger, stronger, and higher, and it’s going to carry us all the way to shore,” and he revels in that moment; in life, too, we enjoy those favorable situations when we’re at our best. >That is why I maintain that life, like the waves, comes with great force and can sweep us away and hit us hard; for example, the death of a loved one, especially that of a child. That is why we must pick ourselves up and move forward. Life, my friends, is like a wave because it moves capriciously and arbitrarily, just like waves. The different moments we experience in life cause us anxiety, despair, and exhaustion. >Just as the waves of the sea sometimes remind us that life can be calm and gentle at times, but also rough and turbulent at other times; although these waves may present us with unstable and difficult circumstances, as is the case with life itself, they also offer us very valuable and good things that fill us with great emotion and joy. >In this way, just as there are beautiful moments in life, a surfer enjoys the present moment of catching a wave, even though he knows the joy will soon end. In this way, just as there are beautiful moments in life, a surfer enjoys the present moment of catching a wave, even though he knows the joy will soon end. That is why we cling to the idea that life is today and we must live it to the fullest without overthinking it; sometimes with joys, sorrows, or tears, because life is beautiful, just like the waves that have uncontrollable rhythms, but it is possible to honor them. Sometimes, the most transformative things happen right after we have completely surrendered to waiting and faith.

description.title: Crown Of Thorns' Bloom - PhotoFeed Contest Macro Photography 166
description.body:
Today’s Tuesday — which means it was choir practice day for me, as usual. After work I headed straight to church. Luckily, it was a clement weather today, no rain, good stuff! 😅 

I got there in no time, and had a bit of a wait while the others arrived. I wandered over to the Marian Shrine to pass the time. A typical Marian Shrine is usually surrounded by flowers, and this one wasn't any different. It has lots of beautiful flowers in different colors. Each one them, well-kept, just asking to be noticed.

Since I had some minutes to spare, so I figured, why not get busy? And I swung into action, capturing what I could. 

Spotting the *crown of thorns flower (Euphorbia milii), I switched to macro shot. I needed to picture the essence of it's pink - orange colored bract. And they even had a visitor - an insect (Oecophylla longinoda). It stood, still, like it belonged to the flower. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbnjdZ3dnqWjdF6vSo2fXSUi7vpAfvYMhLfUyi16xWonD/1776815728092.jpg)
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoEtZw63YcytR7mGE5TcSGvfhKNSoMe2qhRhXW7BhtZX/1776815728289.jpg)


I caught them together in macro, every detail: the velvety petals, the gloss on the insect’s back, the way the light hit.




Just a beautiful shot. I tell you, sometimes the wait is where the best moments hide.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZuavB1TQ4H4UZnrridAehLxZjNowSUYK7oFXXXdCBNmQ/1000013948.png)

description.title: My progress in Frontier Format in Splinterlands and my progress in Rising Star Game.
description.body:
Splinterlands

My journey in the Frontier format continues in Splinterlands, and I've decided I'll start playing in the Wild format soon, but first I'll wait for this season to end.

I chose the Wild format because one of my goals with Splinterlands is to have fun, and for that reason I want to play with all the cards available in the game, and that's only possible in the Wild format.

## Why didn't I choose the Modern Format?

As I mentioned before, my goal is to use all the cards in Splinterlands, but in the Modern format I can only use cards from the following sets:

- Conclave Arcana
- Rebellion
- Foundations

The disadvantage of choosing the Wild format is that the rewards are smaller and there are many bots, but that doesn't mean I'll play in the Wild format forever. It's more of an experience for me to have more fun playing Splinterlands, and in the near future I'll move to the Modern format.

Another alternative is to play in the Modern format and the Wild format at the same time, but first I'll take it slow and test it out.

The rewards in Wild format are SPS and Glint. I will also receive Fortune tickets for a chance to get valuable cards in the Loot Chests I receive as I level up.

## Frontier Format

In Frontier format I'm still in Bronze league but I'm having fun learning about the game and earning some rewards. I haven't been lucky enough to get any valuable cards in the daily Frontier format rewards yet, but that's not a problem.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUr38yjshvcL6C153R3DV7QsSS3ncjXTJUmT8V3py8eGP/d.png 


That was my reward for the day and soon I will reach Bronze II league and increase my rewards in Frontier Format.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@arkartus/my-progress-in-frontier-format-in-splinterlands-and-my-progress-in-rising-star-game-bfj)

### ¡Bienvenidos a una nueva entrada en mi blog gente linda de Hive! ###

#

>Welcome to a new entry of my blog pretty Hive people! 

#  

Tenía días con ganas de ir al cine, y por fin se dió la oportunidad. Lamentablemente el primer día no se pudo porque se fue la luz, y nos tocó ir otro día, y la verdad es que no sé si valió la pena porque la película fue extremadamente larga y aunque no considero que fuera mala, tampoco fue del todo buena. Lo que sí me gustó es que nos fuimos a comer y estaba muy bueno.

#

I’d been wanting to go to the movies for days, and finally the chance came up. Unfortunately, we couldn’t go on the first day because the power went out, so we had to go another day, and honestly, I’m not sure if it was worth it because the movie was extremely long, and while I don’t think it was bad, it wasn’t exactly good either. What I did like was that we went out to eat afterward, and the food was really good.

description.title: Splinterlands:Gearnut's Trample Rampage —3 vs 5 Heroics! Dar Tottem Gearnut & Abyssal Elemental Carried the Win, While My Gladiator Sat Idle 🤗 🔥.
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTuFbR2jzVpTs5n5mC6GQd4iAFwaMFupvo1kdr5eKTNf9/1776759908060.jpg)


Hey Splinterlands community! 
If you’ve ever doubted the raw power of **Trample** in chaotic guild brawls, this battle will change your mind.I just rewatched my latest submission and **Dar Tottem Gearnut** (the tanky Life/Gnome melee beast with massive health) absolutely stole the show. In a 3 vs 5 format where my lean team faced a full five-monster opponent squad—including the ruthless Gladiator **Captain Katie** with her **Bloodlust**—Gearnut turned the tide with devastating chain attacks.

In addition, If the Brawl system has ever handed you a tiny selection while your opponent gets a full competitive squad, this replay is pure motivation. I'm still deep in the grind building my Gladiator packs, so my card pool is limited and my team turned this apparent mismatch into a clean, satisfying victory against a dangerous 5-monster lineup.


Lastly, a connection issue prevented my summoner from fully activating one of its strongest features — and yet we still pulled off the win.





**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**The battle**:
**Ruleset and Lineups**.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU75iia949fcduwFaK5FWQpTM6vCyeB7gBSC57DqaSM1t/1776761166631.jpg)

The total mana cost was 30 and you are to chose splinters from fire,water earth and life units.And there was no modifier for this battle as well.



**My Team –Small, Synergistic and Tougher Than It Looked**.
**Summoner: Elias Max Pruitt** (7 mana)
This legendary Life/Water summoner provided excellent baseline buffs to the whole team: **+1 Melee Attack** and **+1 Shield (Armor)**. It can also bestow a strong targeted ability on one unit — either **Repair + Cleanse** (for ongoing healing and debuff removal) or **Armored Strike + Piercing** (extra armor and armor-ignoring damage).
Unfortunately, the network glitch meant that extra targeted buff never activated on Dar Tottem Gearnut. He only received the standard team buffs. No extra healing, no cleanse, no piercing —just raw stats and Trample.The fact we still dominated makes this win even sweeter!.


**My 3-Monster Lineup (30 Mana Total)**:
* **Dar Tottem Gearnut**(Position 1 –Tank) — The undisputed **MVP**. This tanky life/Gnome promo card boasts a massive health pool, boosted armor (+1 from the summoner), and the devastating **Trample** ability. Every time hi
is melee attack (amped by +1 Melee) killed an enemy, he immediately chained another full melee swing on the next monster in line.In a crowded 5-monster board is under Standard rules, those forward chains were pure destruction.
* **Abyssal Elemental**(Position 2) —Delivered consistent **Magic Attack** pressure and the clutch **Resurgence** ability. When it died, it resurrected once per battle at full health and armor (debuffs cleared), giving me a vital second life and keeping the momentum alive.
* **Gladiator Helmet Kharafax** (Position 3) —Not completely idle! With 0 attack power at his current level, he couldn’t fight back offensively or trigger Bloodlust (since he never landed kills).However, he played a valuable support/tank role: he drew enemy attention, absorbed hits, and bought precious time for the carries to work.Meanwhile, he steadily stacked +1 max health every time any monster died on the board via Scavenger.Thanks to the relentless pressure from Gearnut and the Abyssal Elemental, he had plenty of bodies to scavenge from and helped the team endure longer.




**Opponent’s 5-Monster Squad (Cute Kitties guild)**
**Summoner: Chuul Jujinchi**
* **Lioceros** (Tank) — Melee + **Thorns**
* **Blackmoor Nymph** — Magic + **Immunity**
* **Captain Katie** — Magic + **Snipe + Bloodlust** (the main scaling threat)
* **Mad Ogre Anarchist** — Melee + **Opportunity**
* **Aria Bandit** — Ranged + **Snipe + Dodge**

My opponent brought a well-rounded squad with defensive tools, backline sniping, and snowball potential — a clear numerical advantage under the clean Standard ruleset with 30 total mana.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

**Round 1**
**It was a clear mismatch in unit count (3 vs 5), and my opponent's mix of Thorns reflection, Immunity tankiness, dual Snipe threats, and Opportunity flexibility made it tough for my compact team to break through. Elias's buffs gave my melee some extra bite and survivability, but the extra bodies on his side allowed his team to trade efficiently and maintain pressure from multiple angles**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNPVSQ5iCmd2FsYR1WSGsaFn7m2jhf8MpYqzNpMCFR4xA/1776762636142.jpg)


**Round 2, Scene 3 to 7,Abyssal Elemental was eliminated,but its resurgence ability brought him back and dealt -1 to the health of all units**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPAMGipK2tZMC5LrHa3fcqZ6rkxghaHpYeATwYyp39ai/1776778320088.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRqWpgzotnMt4sN7oxwArcaJ2dq1aZp5GiZ6ZKrkBj6H3/1776778320190.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmFekwhL2AUECzqvyYaNBvDhMtY69aCFA21hHseU6quf/1776778320243.jpg)


**Round 3, my opponent lost his monster,and Dar performed is first trample move**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZDZkXcK8hgFo33LpEmJWtgDCQwBZmBc3cYNmuokfKhz/1776778320296.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTpDcnqJHnnkB3oXxBCWt4672vVaWrxgnX6e3zFNbqKAy/1776778320343.jpg)

**First trample by Dar activated, every time is melee attack killed an enemy, he immediately chained another full melee swing on the next monster in line as displayed**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVcLxYxuepCzuzc4xSA61LxYWF6NWE3L3fHPuByXHUpi/1776778638402.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkaAFBEv2dkcidW9B4aQxzR3KJiKvdLmPu1u5adnE9sm/1776778638474.jpg)


**Round 3,scene 12,death of Abyssal Elemental**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqxHBfKbUCagu8nTDMaBfmwQSxT1TWv9g4qJzkKrasXX/1776778638521.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb21TyKiN78ZiB1AQ2pXjRGNr6ks2a2z6tMkMmumKYFxr/1776778638570.jpg)


**Round 4,scene 3,second trample performance displayed**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzJBrhMDYRXG6pBR2pZyTzGtgiQVAV8vX9kwzKPBnYTu/1776778638625.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxyqxjZa7CfHYZKaAg15GdMSR5miCe5ZP9XgtdFMSJvf/1776779645360.jpg)


**Round 6,scene 2 to 6,final trample carried out**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU51J7nCdgNnSXmqZCasZ4gdcMACJ8om4Pvy6Toh1jBEi/1776779645425.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaBHU268yv69pcxgZL1Z7JbYmBBNQezW6MQBS6QwSqwap/1776779645466.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb41JkWzdZqUdTuWTR2cUcUrHFpJXY9fG7Sro9o4otD9y/1776779645509.jpg)

**Game over**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrQCBrEZK1bQGJ8QWAc4f9f9Ytg7v5deJxXaMspTgmHM/1776779645555.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQPLFeTBVb95TvjWc2UvnTHV33jWX1jzfn2PzAdLbp6p/1776780040323.jpg)

Watch this exciting brawl battle [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_7n09wn6GY5D3rGR9nbXS?ref=zusi78) and appreciate the **trample** ability.








![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)




**My verdict**
I had planned to give Dar 'tottem' Gearnut either **Repair + Cleanse** (for ongoing healing and debuff removal) or **Armored Strike + Piercing** (extra armor and the ability to ignore enemy armor).
Unfortunately, due to a network issue, that targeted ability never triggered. Gearnut only received the baseline team buffs (+1 Melee and +1 Armor). No extra healing, no **cleanse, no piercing** — just the standard package. Imagine how much tankier and more unstoppable he would have been with **Repair or Piercing** on top of his already massive health pool!



**Why I’m Really Happy Despite the Network Issue**
This win proves that even when things don’t go perfectly,limited cards from the Brawl system + a connection problem blocking the summoner’s best targeted buff — smart ability usage and core synergy can still deliver.
Dar ‘Tottem’ Gearnut showed exactly why he’s becoming a favorite: massive health + Trample is a nightmare for crowded boards. The Abyssal Elemental’s Resurgence provided the insurance I needed. And even passive **Helmet Kharafax** quietly did his job by stacking health via Scavenger.
Imagine if the network had cooperated and Gearnut got **Repair** (constant healing) or **Piercing** (ignoring enemy armor) on top of everything else,that would have been even more ridiculous!
The combination of **Trample + Resurgence + Bloodlust/Scavenger** created a perfect strategy. and synergy.



Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)


Thank you for reading and watching my post.Keep swinging hard, guildies!
— @zusi78, signing off.

description.title: the Modern Gold III rank
description.body:
Today I have begun a new chapter in the game. As a result of long days of hard work, daily efforts, and various combat experiences, I have finally passed the Modern Gold III rank. This is no ordinary rank—it is a stage that can only be reached by players who are able show the right combination of strategy, patience, and strength. At the moment passing the rank, I felt a joy that is difficult describe in words. It felt like all the trouble, competition and hard work had been rewarded in an instant.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUc7CQk3Qm8L5DNYc5jYY42QM6gALnSqfDGquECrhvgDn/1776815641061.jpg)

UNLOCKED was displayed in big letters on the screen when I unlocked the rank. I will never forget that particular moment. At this point, I felt as though I had not only reached a new level but also had my strategy, patience, and tenacity acknowledged.The lock was opened new horizons opened—now I face greater challenges  greater rewards than before.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWwrcwzpxXNWD4Lcbc6H7PhDEABEEhhaPprG6EH3Q9be/1776815641289.jpg)

The first touch of the reward was small but extremely pleasant.  When looking at the scrolls, merits, and special legendary cards together, it felt like every step of the journey was worth it. First, I noticed the various chests—they were even more amazing. While the small chests provided regular scrolls, the large and colorful chests provided special cards and legendary items. As I opened these chests, I could see the different appeal of each card and item.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfy2xSxvEmxYv3Gv5S4DrWF4SVMZNZUzj4juh8p9WR27/1776815641216.jpg)

When I opened first chest I found a regular scroll. Although it was nothing special this scroll reminded me that every small step leads a big achievement. It is small things that ultimately lay the foundation for achieving a big goal. Then I noticed the legendary cards and potion charges. These charges allow you to use special abilities in the game. This is very important to me, because such items provide an additional advantage in battle.

The next chests were more exciting. There I found two legendary cards—Coralforged and Husk of the Hunter.  Coralforged is a powerful elemental character that will increase both my team's attack and defense. Husk of the Hunter is an undead character that provides special attack and defense abilities. Such cards will not only strengthen my team's strategy, but also give me a marginal advantage against various players.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYi2NqhdyFT8uPtdp9akPGZ7xT8GYLHmoBUqoBpFkvnYW/1776815641373.jpg)

In addition, I have the Phlegmor card—Divine Construct. It is a very powerful and strategic character which is effective in long-term battles. If I use these cards appropriately I will be able gain a great advantage over my opponents. me increase my strength and attack during special combat moments.

As part. reward, I have also been given Merits—over 400 Merits in total. These Merits can be used in future leagues, which will allow me to earn bigger and more important rewards. This is a clear indication that my regular fighting, strategy, and planning have not only promoted me in rank, but are also leading me towards even bigger rewards in the future.

 Also, reaching this rank opens up a new level  competition. It is not just a numerical improvement but a mental and tactical improvement. Now I will be fighting against stronger opponents where the outcome each match will measure not only but also my consistency perseverance and practice.

 Every battle, every strategy and every step has brought me  this moment. This moment is not only a joy but also symbol  inspiration.

While I am enjoying these rewards, I have started to plan for future battles. It is necessary to plan how to use Coralforged, Husk of the Hunter, Phlegmor and Legendary Potion charges. Understanding the power  each card and the importance each item is crucial. By adopting the right strategy, I will  able establish myself better in this rank.

Reaching the Modern Gold III rank and receiving these chests and cards is a memorable moment. It motivates me face new challenges and makes every battle more exciting.

This achievement is not just a new rank but a new chapter where every day brings new strategies new battles new joy. I am ready—for bigger challenges, stronger opponents and bigger rewards. Today is memorable joyful and inspiring day.

description.title: Thinking about life!
description.body:
Did you ever start off your day in a good mood and suddenly you are feeling down in the dumps.

My day started off great, went to work, had a good shift. 
Drove home and all of a sudden I felt overwhelmed. 
I am the person that everyone counts on, turns to for everything. 
My family and friends.

My Grandson, nephew and 2 cousins are Graduating from grade 12.
They are selling tickets, 12 each, on a $450 worth of gift cards.
Guess who is selling them? ME!
I offered to sell them so they don't have to pay $200.00 Grad fee.
I sold 36 tickets in under an hour.

I am the next of kin of a lot of my family.
Also, Power of attorney of my Dad, Aunt and Uncle.
If they all dies at the same time I will be called the Angel of death.

Sometimes it gets overwhelming.
I would not change it because it's what makes me who I am!
I hope this makes sense.
Menopause is playing a part of my life.

Only for @bradleyarrow I don't know what I would do.
He knows how to calm me down.
He is my rock, my best friend, he knows how to bring me back to reality.

Oh my, I hope this post makes sense, I am all over the place with my blog.
Stay tuned, I promise to blog longer and it will make more sense!

Its time to say goodnight.

Good night and God bless!🙏
Life is good!💞

description.title: Phillies lose sixth straight game... | Jesús Luzardo on the mound tonight
description.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Well the Phillies were threatening early yesterday but they ultimately couldn't do anything with the bases loaded. The Cubs found themselves in a similar situation the very next inning but took full advantage of it with a four run second inning. Aaron Nola is looking a lot like 2025 Aaron Nola once again... I'm really getting concerned about him. I feel as if he might be washed. He looks like a fourth starter in a rotation rather than a second that many thought he would have been. 

Offensively, the Phillies are averaging less than two runs a game in the past six games. They have scored two or less for five straight games. It's just gross offense.  

The Phillies are now 8-14. That's a crazy thing to type honestly. I don't know how the Phillies can fix this situation except by just simply playing better. 

It would be nice to ask more from the pitching. The pitching is less of a problem than the offense, but I'm mostly saying the pitching should be better simply to get a win. Simply to throw this sad offense a bone. Basically I'm hoping for a great pitching performance as a form of pity. Simply because this offense is pitiful.

Now, the pitching has been bad often too. It's not at all a night and day difference between pitching and hitting but yeah. 

Jesús Luzardo has to be better starting tonight. He has been pretty much just as bad as Taijuan Walker this season.

Mathematically speaking, the Phillies really need to fight, starting tonight. I don't know if they are overthinking or what but they just gotta lock in and start being pros.

I'm very happy they are giving Felix Reyes another shot tonight! Lets see what the Phillies got. Gotta start somewhere, why not tonight?

description.title: Pollo al puerro (ajoporro) y mantequilla [ES][EN]
description.body:
> El ajoporro, o también conocido como puerro, nació para ser combinado con mantequilla, o al menos para mí así lo pienso. Ambos ingredientes se combinan tan bien que pueden ser la base de cremas, guisos o salteados. En este caso, he decidido preparar un pollo que se impregne de la combinación del sabor de la mantequilla y el ajoporro. Aunque también tiene un poco de ajo y pimienta negra, los sabores estrellas son esos dos ingredientes que hacen magia. > Leeks were made to be paired with butter—at least that’s how I see it. These two ingredients go so well together that they can form the basis of soups, stews, or stir-fries. In this case, I’ve decided to make a chicken dish that soaks up the combination of butter and leek. Although it also has a bit of garlic and black pepper, the star flavors are those two ingredients that work their magic. ![IMG20260418172631-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/Eonmw9cvQwLWwDgd2VuLDDEkvKF2btQoXeCZn6BaRnQadZetWdGJQvbpxFdVUqj8M9V.jpeg) A la mantequilla se le ha realizado el proceso de convertirla casi en ghee, ya que no se le retiró nada de lo lácteo. Eso permite aprovechar ese sabor tostado que para muchos les recuerda el sabor a nuez. Se puede hacer esta versión sin convertir la mantequilla en ghee y se obtienen otros matices de sabores. Por supuesto que se pueden agregar otros vegetales, pero la verdad, así tal cual es suficiente para disfrutar de una buena comida. > The butter has been processed to the point of almost becoming ghee, since none of the milk solids were removed. This allows you to enjoy that toasty flavor, which many people find reminiscent of nuts. You can make this version without turning the butter into ghee, which yields different flavor nuances. Of course, you can add other vegetables, but honestly, this recipe as is is enough to enjoy a delicious meal. ![IMG20260418172802-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EoyQQzakXJNCYda8DLXoTXY1NNXV6PNFPFGqvcmqApeSGa4Z7R3eVJk9DwmC8mbva7F.jpeg) ![IMG20260418172613-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/Eoc8wCTzggeFVzXAt8x2rydrGNvExcHrzAzhrM7TCgHjSpiBCH8rVBQUxucFtEVXMPR.jpeg) Si quieres aprender a preparar este pollo al puerro y mantequilla, estos son los ingredientes que yo utilicé: > If you want to learn how to make this chicken with leeks and butter, here are the ingredients I used: ![17338874770083186545070987094077.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/246bKsfbzTQeu6kJmETVNgqsUaKD5PEoEr7VWZd7KJ2ZJPMVRQvdgnHyzwiAnrKsjBdtb.png)

Ingredientes || Ingredients

- 250 gr de puerro - 400 gr de pechuga de pollo - 70 gr de mantequilla - 3 dientes de ajo - 1/2 cucharadita de salsa de soya oscura - Sal y pimienta al gusto. - 250 g leeks - 400 g chicken breast - 70 g butter - 3 cloves of garlic - 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce - Salt and pepper to taste.
![17338874770083186545070987094077.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/246bKsfbzTQeu6kJmETVNgqsUaKD5PEoEr7VWZd7KJ2ZJPMVRQvdgnHyzwiAnrKsjBdtb.png)

Preparación || Preparation

- Lo primero es lavar y cortar el puerro en trocitos pequeños. Me gusta cortar el puerro primero por la mitad, para así poder lavar la tierra que entra y luego, si corto en trocitos. > - First, wash and chop the leek into small pieces. I like to cut the leek in half first so I can wash off any dirt that gets inside, and then chop it into small pieces. ![20260421_112831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23wMaJhA8kZipvEcU9qPgzdVgg1tuU7WMRj2zPQmgdYTmLRLix932QmqQ2n17NeLNbbV4.jpg) - En una sartén, colocar la mantequilla y llevar a fuego bajo. La idea es dejar cocinar la mantequilla hasta que los sedimentos lácteos se comiencen a tostar y se evapore el agua. Una vez listo este casi ghee, se reserva. > - Place the butter in a skillet and heat over low heat. The idea is to let the butter cook until the milk solids begin to brown and the water evaporates. Once this ghee-like mixture is ready, set it aside. ![20260421_112915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23w2sLyXThZD25nSEwEwXvmeoFroo7YCKhYzGSNcuEBwiXnuMSZReUX1YWnVnJJ6PfBSa.jpg) - Le coloco la mitad de la mantequilla al pollo y llevo a cocinar. La idea es cocinar bien el pollo y ya al final agregar la salsa de soya, sal y pimienta. Siempre teniendo presente la sal que contenga la mantequilla. > - I spread half the butter over the chicken and start cooking it. The idea is to cook the chicken thoroughly and then add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper at the very end. Always keep in mind the salt already in the butter. ![20260421_113050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23tmUJcA911rKavQrVZYzQNJWsDFv2UDPA54AHGsfNq6oYE8GiT74meSy1Wh8jHE95ofK.jpg) - Se agrega el resto de la mantequilla al puerro ya cortado, se revuelve y se agrega al pollo. Se mezcla y se cocina primero unos 5 minutos a baja llama y con tapa y luego otros 5 minutos sin tapa y removiendo de vez en cuando. La idea es que el puerro se suavice y adquiera una textura cremosa. Una vez listo, se sirve a gusto. > - Add the remaining butter to the chopped leek, stir, and add to the chicken. Mix well and cook for about 5 minutes over low heat with the lid on, then another 5 minutes without the lid, stirring occasionally. The goal is for the leek to soften and develop a creamy texture. Once ready, serve as desired. ![20260421_113132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23tvkR5wCDk7XDeWpXGcaiZGrfDA5kdn19DUsJNVVjFoVsCBv4mSqjxZjmnezGZaiZLNQ.jpg) Ya el pollo está listo. Yo acompañé con puré de papas, plátano horneado y brócoli. Si se agregan papas sancochadas, fritas, tostadas o en puré, la experiencia se mejora por completo, ya que las papas y el puerro también nacieron para estar juntos. Con esta preparación, mi idea es compartir una opción con pocos ingredientes, pero que igual se pueda comer saludable y sabroso. > The chicken is ready. I served it with mashed potatoes, baked plantains, and broccoli. Whether you add boiled, fried, roasted, or mashed potatoes, the dish is taken to a whole new level, since potatoes and leeks are a match made in heaven. With this recipe, my goal is to share a simple dish with just a few ingredients—one that’s both healthy and delicious. ![IMG20260418172715-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EogPGJ2mCXi4N4w1AXGZc6y8GYbEq9Kovv9Hr3FguoWC95dE1Eg5qqgjy1FgTTFGNgb.jpeg) Déjame saber en los comentarios si has utilizado ghee o mantequilla clarificada con puerro y cuál ha sido tu experiencia. ¡Hasta una próxima receta! > Let me know in the comments if you've used ghee or clarified butter with leeks and what your experience was like. See you in the next recipe! ---

Todas las fotografías fueron tomadas por mí con un Realme 7 pro. No autorizo a nadie reutilizarlas. description.body: >Nuevo día, nueva receta, hoy comparto un almuerzo para resolver en pocos minutos, el ritmo de la vida a veces nos agonía, no tenemos tiempo para estar en familia y menos para hacer dedicar horas en preparar comidas muy elaboradas, por ello hoy les brindo un paso a paso práctico, tips útiles para lograr un arroz perfecto y la preparación de un revoltillo de huevo con papas y cebolla caramelizadas. Una combinación de sabores que no tiene como fallar, lo mejor de todo es que no tienes que invertir horas en la cocina, es un plato rendidor, accesible y claro; delicioso. Sigue leyendo para saber más de la receta.\n\n

>New day, new recipe. Today I’m sharing a lunch you can whip up in just a few minutes. The pace of life can sometimes be overwhelming—we don’t have time to spend with family, let alone spend hours preparing elaborate meals. That’s why today I’m offering a practical step-by-step guide and useful tips for making perfect rice and a scrambled egg dish with potatoes and caramelized onions. It’s a combination of flavors that can’t go wrong. Best of all, you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen. It’s a filling, affordable, and—of course—delicious dish. Keep reading to learn more about the recipe.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
##### TIPS:

>No les voy a mostrar paso a paso como hacer un arroz, porque siento que es algo básico que muchas personas saben hacer, sin embargo; te daré 5 pasos claves que sigo para que mi arroz quedé suelto y perfecto, en su punto exacto de sal.\n\n

>I’m not going to walk you through every step of how to make rice, because I feel like it’s something basic that most people already know how to do; however, I’ll share the 5 key steps I follow to ensure my rice turns out fluffy and perfect, with just the right amount of salt. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoGyRhHsJFYsT1H3pG5mLBmV1QUevgaRL9kPY5NwVu47ccJx7c6CV7aJqgiyNCvhDfu.jpg - Muchas personas lavan el arroz antes de cocinar, en mi caso no lo lavo, si lo lavas este primer paso sería el segundo paso para ti. Sofríe el arroz con un poco de aceite, debes sofreír bien, a un punto que el arroz este semi-dorado, añade un cucharada pequeña de sal junto con el arroz. > Many people rinse the rice before cooking; I don’t rinse it, though. If you do rinse it, this first step would be your second step. Sauté the rice in a little oil; make sure to sauté it well, until it’s lightly browned, then add a teaspoon of salt along with the rice. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoiUgA4eMMQXipnTTztPFVkCZbu6fRVvdgFEPDq1dBDw5ZnoisB9syZMW4p6UZwtGVm.jpg - Verifica que el arroz este semi-dorado, no quemado, que cada arroz este bañado en el aceite. > Make sure the rice is lightly browned, not burnt, and that each grain is coated in oil. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EpNmseAxiucUxENR5HGneAP8tPtw69zg3As5gn7pnsYPGMrKt7sMqV4JTrcEkv2zpsS.jpg - Añade el agua como normalmente lo haces, cuando el agua esté secando baja el fuego, el fuego debe ser bajo en este punto de la cocción. > Make sure the rice is lightly browned, not burnt, and that each grain is coated in oil. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoEq1CkMCeyK5pgqk3JizQcSasdeLx5vfuUcWRq42BcCZJrKr2dvQKzPZ8hZ8LM4KL8.jpg - Añade una tapa cuando bajes la temperatura, para que el arroz termine de cocinarse con el vapor que va a emitir al tapar. > Add a lid when you lower the heat, so the rice can finish cooking with the steam that will be released when you cover it. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EpNoofEzrfsAt2ofPhzVKKXNCYgT8j6qUCNymrs3dwxNL32eqhFXgtrZg2ByjZXCDo6.jpg - Finalmente cuando el agua seque, apaga el fuego y deja reposar el arroz al menos 10 minutos antes de comer. > Add a lid when you lower the heat, so the rice can finish cooking with the steam that will be released when you cover it.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:
>3 huevos, 1 cebolla grande, 3 papas grandes, aceite, sal y condimentos al gusto.\n\n
>3 eggs, 1 large onion, 3 large potatoes, oil, salt, and seasonings to taste. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:

>Cortar y lavar los vegetales será el primer paso, corté las cebollas en forma de media luna, las papas en cuadrados pequeños. A continuación, calentamos un sartén, añade aceite suficiente para sofreír los vegetales, incorporara los vegetales y comienza a mezclar.\n\n

>The first step is to chop and wash the vegetables. I sliced the onions into half-moons and diced the potatoes into small cubes. Next, heat a skillet, add enough oil to sauté the vegetables, add the vegetables, and begin to stir. ***

>Mientras que los vegetales se cocinan, debemos batir los tres huevos y dejar reservados, los vegetales deben llegar a un punto en qué la cebolla caramelice, en ese momento añadan un poco de agua y coloquen una tapa, es para ayudar en la cocción de la papa.\n\n

>While the vegetables are cooking, beat the three eggs and set them aside. Cook the vegetables until the onion is caramelized; at that point, add a little water and cover the pan to help the potatoes cook through. ***
>Cuando la papa esté blanda, añadan los huevos batidos y sal, mezclen hasta cocinar el huevo, y de esta forma tan fácil tendrán el revoltillo listo.\n\n
>When the potatoes are tender, add the beaten eggs and salt, stir until the eggs are cooked, and just like that, your scrambled eggs are ready. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eou8GPH9PYuM4nxnDeCLFFFpFfmAp22KPsU3gayeWs6W6Wty1KEJWsJDxSUZWRi8N7m.jpg
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![IMG_20260421_144523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eoke8W9QgTV2SkKEy21i4umejaJTbErNZUnPSGBMzCVLzvTipmQEkrhwjzgZJ2H71wn.jpg)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23uQvwdiDCmL41U253iYZMMKMV5eqpQpcgCyuAuc9xjmyiZARzSJZxw2bnKCJSj8bnCi8.gifLos huevos siempre serán una buena opción cuando queremos resolver un almuerzo, fáciles de preparar, se pueden mezclar con otro ingredientes y son económicos, espero que está versión de revoltillo les haya gustado, añadan más vegetales, cuántos tengan en casa, mientras más colores incorporen, mejor sabor tendrá su revoltillo, gracias por llegar hasta aquí, dime en los comentarios si ya has comido huevos de esta manera. > Eggs are always a great option when you’re looking for a quick lunch—they’re easy to prepare, can be mixed with other ingredients, and are affordable. I hope you enjoyed this version of scrambled eggs. Feel free to add more vegetables—whatever you have on hand. The more colors you incorporate, the better your scrambled eggs will taste. Thanks for reading this far. Let me know in the comments if you’ve ever tried eggs this way.

> I finally got to the point that I can let Ellie make the coffee now, without correcting anything

Wow now I bet she's happy about that! When you live together there WILL be a period of adjustment - god knows Jamie and I used to fight in that stage of our union! - but you settle into a rhythm after a while. Sometimes you just need to let shit go and realise even though they do things differently, it doesn't matter and isn't worth niggling over. 

I do have a heap of natural remedies on hand, and when that fails, I turn to other things. Had to laugh, I went to doc just to confirm I was doing what I knew I should be, and he asked what I was doing. I said I was using comfrey cream. 'What's that? Com - free?' he said. I do wish they'd give these doctors at least a crash course on common and useful herbal remedies.

茄子煲是一道让人垂涎欲滴的美食，茄子的绵软与浓郁的酱汁相互交融，瞬间唤醒了味蕾。每一口都充满了丰富的层次感，柔滑的茄子吸收了汤汁的精华，令我不禁想一口接一口。加上香菇和青椒的搭配，让这道菜既丰盛又营养，真是令人陶醉的享受！这样的家常粤菜，总是让我倍感温馨，仿佛回到了母亲的厨房。

description.title: 最强倒春寒
description.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![kmRyX1msRkqeZqJh_fj6.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/kmRyX1msRkqeZqJh_fj6/kmRyX1msRkqeZqJh_fj6.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

从周天开始降温，先是沙尘暴来袭，接着就是阴雨天。其实周一并没有下雨，只是降温了，冷到必须穿外套，大概和秋天气温差不多。周二凌晨开始下雨，早上起来看到外面还在唏哩哗啦的下雨，一点停的意思都没有，家里也比较冷。早上吃完饭我把雨衣找出来，让孩子背上书包穿好雨衣，准备送孩子上学。坐电梯下楼时候遇到楼下邻居家也送孩子上学，邻居说下雨了开车送孩子上学，那就让孩子趁邻居家车去上学吧，我直接去公司上班。

路上只要是个路口就堵车堵的很厉害，因为下雨来公司上班的同事比较少，可能因为通勤麻烦都在家办公了。到了中午我去食堂吃饭，此时外面雨下的比较大，看起来是中雨。吃完饭回到公司，我琢磨着这么大的雨下午接孩子放学会很麻烦，于是就决定中午回家办公，这样下午接孩子时候不背电脑包比较轻松一些。到家后我躺在沙发上睡了一觉，午睡很舒服。到了下午5点多我去接孩子，看到外面基本不下雨了，那正好不用披雨衣了。

接孩子回来后，孩子说家里冷，可不是么气温只有10度左右，我把孩子冬天衣服找出来让孩子穿上。看天气预报明天就会转晴，并且气温回升到20多摄氏度。没想到到了4月中下旬居然还有寒流，而且降温幅度很大，山区里估计下雪了。不管怎么说这波降温下雨把沙尘暴赶走了，往后都是大晴天，希望不再有沙尘暴天气。

---

title.title: [Retrogaming] Chpt 2 / Story 2: Escaping from the Woods! | Warioland II (Game Boy Color)
title.body:
>**My 3speaking Today**   Hey, what's up, players! For my part, I hope you’re having a great Tuesday. As usual, let me warmly welcome you to my gaming channel on 3speak and this post : ) . Guys, honestly, today while I was playing this wonderful video game, Wario, I was remembering that this series of games, so to speak, was recommended to me about two years ago by a YouTuber who, back then, had a very small YouTube channel focused on retrogaming. I thought he uploaded really good and informative content on the subject, since in that niche, these days there tends to be an abundance of generic content where it seems like all the retro gaming YouTubers are repeating the same material, and very few recommend content that is, so to speak, fresh or little-known, but not necessarily of low quality. On this YouTuber’s recommendation, I was introduced to the wonderful world of the antihero of the Mario universe—that is, the world of Wario—and this was through the first game where you can control our yellow antihero: ***Warioland: Super Mario World 3***, which I consider a fantastic video game that you should play at least once in your life. Today I feel a bit sad to discover that this YouTuber didn’t continue his retrogaming channel project on YouTube, mainly because his videos weren't getting enough views, which eventually wore him down and left him disappointed, since his videos usually involved a lot of editing and hard work : / . It's sad to see how projects like this, with so much heart behind them, don't end up succeeding… But I guess those are just the rules of the algorithm…   Today, on the other hand, I’m happy to say we’re already on our seventh gameplay session of Warioland II, where we’ve now entered the lands of Wario’s world. This time, we’re escaping from the woods after being forced to abandon our castle in order to hunt down the members of the Black Sugar Gang, who dared to invade our domain and steal our riches. Once in this forested area, we encounter a truly impressive number of **‘new enemies’**; for example, one of the ones I liked the most was the **‘penguin bomber’**, which is a kind of penguin that throws bombs the moment it sees us, and which made my progress a bit difficult at certain points along the way. Another aspect that caught my attention was how varied this woods section is, since it’s not just about wooded areas, but also features caves filled with underground water and mazes whose paths we must uncover by using our destructive powers, thereby acquiring more riches (coins).   Finally, since speedrunning doesn't really appeal to me, I was once again completely focused on Wario's greed—that is, collecting as many coins as possible for our loot, ha ha! So completing the course or the story quickly isn’t my priority; my priorities in this game are: finishing the story, enjoying playing as Wario, learning more about Wario’s lore, and collecting as many coins as possible for Wario’s fortune, oh, and of course, since this channel is all about that, above all I want to enjoy retrogaming, since this is more of a—let’s say—therapeutic activity for me, something I plan to tell you more about later in greater detail. With nothing else to say, I’ll sign off for today, but not before thanking you for all your support that you've given to this 3speak channel; I’m truly grateful, players 😃✨. Cheers. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjZUumkMzuDaaTdF8cd3PwrNnq57q7XSij3HdG1NDcWb/barra_3shorts.png # **Some technical details:** **1.** Video game: Warioland II (Game Boy Color) (USA ROM version) **2.** Emulator used: Action mGBA v0.10.5 (Win x64) **3.** Video capture software: Action V 4.4.0 (Win x64) **4.** Edited and rendered: Capcut (Professional Edition x64) **5.** mGBA Emulator Video Config: > * Display Driver: Opengl; > * Vsync: On; > * Frame Skip: 0; > * Shader: H2QX (scaled 2x algorithm developed by Singron); > * Enhancements: > *Video Renderer: Opengl*; > *High-res Scale: 2x*. https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjZUumkMzuDaaTdF8cd3PwrNnq57q7XSij3HdG1NDcWb/barra_3shorts.png

title.title: [ENG/ESP] International Day of Creativity and Innovation
title.body:
A necessary introduction

Today, on Creativity and Innovation Day, it’s worth pausing for a moment to reflect on the role we play as content creators on social media, and especially on @hive. We are not mere information broadcasters: we are craftsmen of meaning, mediators between human experience and the digital space. In this world we live in, where social media can amplify both light and noise, creativity and innovation are not aesthetic luxuries—they are ethical responsibilities. To create is to choose what kind of footprint we leave.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8Ar4LohpFqXJQ9kJBNUKrpLx5BgCDLeS4VNnj3K1Zft/1776815289872.jpg)



Here are five ways content creators can elevate the quality of what we do, and in doing so, contribute to society.

1. Turn information into meaning
Creativity allows us to go beyond simply repeating data or trends. An innovative creator transforms information into an experience that illuminates, questions, or inspires. It’s not just about “posting”—it’s about offering something that helps people better understand the world: a metaphor that opens a door, a story that humanizes a problem, a reflection that invites thought. When we create meaning, we provide value.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsj1QioYDjao6oEn4CYjwdcvCMgMoh6yuiW1anSHKKMP/1776815006673.jpg)


2. Cultivate a responsible aesthetic
Aesthetics are not superficial; they are a form of ethics. The way we design, narrate, and present influences how people feel and process what they see. Innovating in form—with thoughtful images, well-written texts, coherent narratives—is a way of respecting the audience. Creativity, when exercised with intention, raises the collective standard and fights the saturation of empty content.

3. Promote content that builds
Social media can be a field of noise or a space for connection. The difference is made by those who create. To innovate is to dare to propose deeper, more human, more useful dialogues. It means choosing topics that matter, asking questions that open up conversations, moderating with respect, and building community. A creative creator doesn’t just seek likes—they seek bonds that transform.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHQByEnLaSPFC14o8P36b4gcuBNhuEAkaFZvoQdAqwCW/1776815436423.jpg)


4. Embrace diversity as a creative engine
Innovation is born when we look beyond our personal borders. Listening to other voices, incorporating different perspectives, recognizing invisible stories—all of this expands the creative horizon. In a digital ecosystem where homogeneity threatens to prevail, diversity is an act of resistance and an endless source of ideas. Creating from plurality contributes to a more just society.

5. Bet on authenticity as a form of innovation
In times of algorithms and masks, authenticity is revolutionary. It’s not about exposing everything, but about creating from an honest, coherent, and conscious place. Creativity flourishes when we stop imitating and start exploring our own voice. And that voice, when genuine, has the power to touch, inspire, and accompany others.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtMt7Km4tFYKdg5eb5qFLJ48Wb8pj182vrQo9jn8rrbM/1776815063384.jpg)


A final comment.

Today is a good day to remember: creating is an act of social responsibility. Every post can be a spark that illuminates, an idea that plants a seed, an emotion that provides comfort. Creativity and innovation are not just tools; they are paths to making social media a more human, more beautiful, and more meaningful space.

Note: I used DeepL Translate. 
The photos are my own.





ESPAÑOL 




Una introducción necesaria 


Hoy, en el Día de la Creatividad y la Innovación, vale la pena detenernos un momento y pensar en el papel que desempeñamos quienes creamos contenidos en las redes sociales y, de manera especia, en @hive. No somos simples emisores de información: somos artesanos de sentido, mediadores entre la experiencia humana y el espacio digital. En este mundo en el que vivimos donde las redes sociales pueden amplificar tanto la luz como el ruido, la creatividad y la innovación no son lujos estéticos, sino responsabilidades éticas. Crear es elegir qué tipo de huella dejamos.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8Ar4LohpFqXJQ9kJBNUKrpLx5BgCDLeS4VNnj3K1Zft/1776815289872.jpg)



Aquí les dejo cinco maneras en que los creadores de contenidos podemos elevar la calidad de lo que hacemos y, con ello, aportar a la sociedad.



1. Transformar la información en significado
La creatividad nos permite ir más allá de repetir datos o tendencias. Un creador que innova convierte la información en una experiencia que ilumina, cuestiona o inspira. No se trata solo de “publicar”, sino de ofrecer algo que ayude a comprender mejor el mundo: una metáfora que abre una puerta, una historia que humaniza un problema, una reflexión que invita a pensar. Cuando damos sentido, aportamos valor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsj1QioYDjao6oEn4CYjwdcvCMgMoh6yuiW1anSHKKMP/1776815006673.jpg)

2. Cultivar una estética responsable
La estética no es superficial; es una forma de ética. La manera en que diseñamos, narramos y presentamos influye en cómo las personas sienten y procesan lo que ven. Innovar en la forma —con imágenes cuidadas, textos bien escritos, narrativas coherentes— es una manera de respetar a la audiencia. La creatividad, cuando se ejerce con intención, eleva el estándar colectivo y combate la saturación de contenidos vacíos.



3. Promover publicaciones que construyan
Las redes pueden ser un campo de ruido o un espacio de encuentro. La diferencia la marcan quienes crean. Innovar es atreverse a proponer diálogos más profundos, más humanos, más útiles. Es elegir temas que importan, formular preguntas que abren, moderar con respeto y generar comunidad. Un creador creativo no busca solo like o me gusta, sino vínculos que transformen.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHQByEnLaSPFC14o8P36b4gcuBNhuEAkaFZvoQdAqwCW/1776815436423.jpg)


4. Integrar la diversidad como motor creativo
La innovación nace cuando miramos más allá de nuestras fronteras personales. Escuchar otras voces, incorporar perspectivas distintas, reconocer historias invisibles: todo eso amplía el horizonte creativo. En un ecosistema digital donde la homogeneidad amenaza con imponerse, la diversidad es un acto de resistencia y una fuente inagotable de ideas. Crear desde la pluralidad es aportar a una sociedad más justa.



5. Apostar por la autenticidad como forma de innovación
En tiempos de algoritmos y máscaras, la autenticidad es revolucionaria. No se trata de exponerlo todo, sino de crear desde un lugar honesto, coherente y consciente. La creatividad florece cuando dejamos de imitar y empezamos a explorar nuestra propia voz. Y esa voz, cuando es genuina, tiene la capacidad de tocar, inspirar y acompañar a otros.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtMt7Km4tFYKdg5eb5qFLJ48Wb8pj182vrQo9jn8rrbM/1776815063384.jpg)



Un comentario final

Hoy es un buen día para recordarlo: crear es un acto de responsabilidad social. Cada publicación puede ser una chispa que ilumine, una idea que siembre, una emoción que acompañe. La creatividad y la innovación no son solo herramientas; son caminos para hacer de las redes un espacio más humano, más bello y más significativo.

Las fotos son de mi propiedad.

title.title: Turning My Pencil Sketch into Digital Art
title.body:
Hello Beautiful Sketchbook Community! 

Warm greetings to all creative minds and art lovers here.  I am excited to share the full process behind this floral geometric pattern design — from the first pencil sketch on paper to the final polished digital illustrations.

This artwork combines symmetry, floral beauty, and repeating pattern structure, making it perfect for wallpaper, textile print, surface design, or decorative art. Here is how I created it step by step. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWC5PL93CsDBjfFcPFkTi4vNsu51NrtT2UGTXprM1qaHy/1776814636007.jpg)

STEP 1: Pencil Sketch Foundation
I began with a diamond grid layout on lined paper to guide the repeating pattern. Using a ruler, I drew evenly spaced diamond shapes to build a neat geometric base.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXA5aU5RGob83wW4ELo1WviJwqXAZq5MoHYzNeA3Hf1Vg/1776814803891.jpg)

STEP 2: Main Flower Shape
Inside each diamond, I sketched a floral motif.
First, I created the lower leaf-like petals that curve upward. Then I added rounded layered petals at the top to form a blooming flower.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme1J5EV7H4qhP23GDnDnez6JCSvGrHqyKhbMhXNRwkhXp/1776814829516.jpg)

STEP 3: Inner Details
Next, I drew small line accents inside each petal to give texture and depth. I also added curved line details inside the leaves for a natural flowing look.

STEP 4: Background Pattern Texture
To fill the empty spaces inside the diamond, I added tiny scallop shapes. This gave the design a delicate ornamental texture and made the flower stand out beautifully.

STEP 5: Clean Line Art Digitally
After finishing the pencil sketch, I recreated the design digitally. I used smooth clean outlines, corrected symmetry, and arranged the motif into a repeating seamless pattern.

STEP 6: Coloring the Design
For the flower petals, I chose a soft pink tone.
The center lower petal was colored golden yellow.
The leaves were shaded with rich green tones for contrast and elegance.

I then proceeded to make the digital Illustration in different versions. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQ4iUwBQrts31JFULbeB9uCcR8DYmaJLiywuiwLHrmRW/1776814885220.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPEjNqGj5UUNsuVjAjFJKxknJv4RKJbmfqxigVNcBjDyp/1776814885283.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNonQbxChHdk7BTMDV5PAuTT7LcUMKi3R14LfzcpEHiE/1776814885356.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabBGAyteiV7Qy99rWFxnLKbix2WtQChhjagUySm9Di1L/1776814885417.jpg)

This design shows how a simple pencil sketch can transform into a professional digital surface pattern. Never underestimate your rough sketches they are the beginning of something beautiful.

Thank you for viewing my process! 💕
