title.title: Mono de fuego con limpiapipas. (ESP/ENG)
title.body:
Saludos queridos amigos de Hive Diy, un gusto saludarles sean bienvenidos a mi espacio de creatividad, una vez más compartiendo en la comunidad de artesanos y ya es hora de compartir un nuevo post cargado de arte.

>Greetings dear friends of Hive DIY, it's a pleasure to greet you and welcome you to my creative space. Once again, I'm sharing with the community of artisans, and it's time to share a new post full of art.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCqTak878Jkzo5FYTmxsj2xKsNhxwpvWiTLAbj2nChkV/1001411035.jpg




En esta oportunidad les traigo el mono de fuego, carta de Splinterlands que decidí recrear a través de una figura con limpiapipas, en esta carta se muestra una imagen del mono con una llama entre sus manos haciéndolo interesante y a la vez encantador.

>This time I bring you the fire monkey, a card from Splinterlands that I decided to recreate through a figure with pipe cleaners. This card shows an image of the monkey with a flame in its hands, making it interesting and charming at the same time.


<center>
![Flame Monkey.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaoQ5Y9pmpgbAZUuUa4qJ4x14Dm9oaivMEmhneYUCRb82/Flame%20Monkey.png)
[Flame Monkey](https://www.splintercards.com/untamed_reward_flame-monkey) 
</center>


Realicé esta figura de cuerpo completo, y se que les gustará el resultado tango como a mi, a continuación los materiales y el paso a paso.


>I made this full-body figure, and I know you'll like the result as much as I do. Below are the materials and the step-by-step instructions.


<center>
![ezgif-8110025d79c3e15e.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcEvhki1EAkdd7XKn8K4C48fZgjkasXikUHTFBvRo9qug/ezgif-8110025d79c3e15e.gif)
</center>


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


| Materiales|Materials|
| --------|---------|
| Limpiapipas marrón claro | Light brown pipe cleaner|
| Limpiapipas color beige| Beige pipe cleaners|
| Tijera, silicón | Scissors, silicone|
| Esfera #3 y #4 |Sphere #3 and #4|
| Sombra de ojos| eye shadow |


![1001405418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wqnnoVSFwp8Lbson8fp6DvMHfepXmWbtU6oL771gFw57ojCBZRJtWz3J4VkgrXodhN2.jpg)


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)



### *Paso a paso / Step by step*
#



El primer paso que vamos a realizar será seleccionar las esferas de anime una de tamaño #3 y #4 por lo que será una figura mediana.

>The first step we will take is to select the anime spheres, one of size #3 and #4, so it will be a medium-sized figure.


|![1001405421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tbuWZym7Yo5X52c1TysMnoRj9oDmoNDes9iSM261QtvbBstoY3b3qge8FJY7NJPnSo1.jpg)|![1001405483.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u67Pe2gvcZm5YgE5HmnvknYxbJijk7swtrhFv294eKqdMVUycLwemmrCWSZD5XSUcpS.jpg)|
|-|-|



Ahora voy tomar el limpiapipas marrón y lo vamos a enrollar en un palillo y realizamos la forma de la cara sobre la esfera, cubrirnos hasta la parte trasera dejando descubierto el centro ya que allí vamos a utilizar otro color.

>Now I'm going to take the brown pipe cleaner and wrap it around a toothpick and make the shape of the face on the sphere, covering it all the way to the back, leaving the center uncovered since we're going to use another color there.

|![1001405498.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi4KMsQqPeYKmg3pHDDuFyAEwJW3j8wwbJvErHNRHZioKyGXVQNPPLuLVtT4JLCskJr.jpg)|![1001405548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQtFLAgZhVDrwoBwW8XpAQj1nENnxooKNz6oTKpjH6hDSi8ZN1bth5uMw5H9VnnvSWL.jpg)|![1001405567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wqrocgmrkuft2jp1vsGNGbp6Xb99dL6W7BYPRPFZKpGUtkWLw2QTJb6qpQMENwcVP1D.jpg)|
|-|-|-|



|![1001405569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFXv1ANUmzYc4Gsf7QF1gQAeDCh9Esdbdg32CGhrh22VWUjCrbqcVL9wxDXg1pTHgWc.jpg)|![1001405583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoGyotVuMo88AJDcGhvpFXTLU7NKcbGjEcuwDKqXMifRdaJa2kZp1Sru7KzmvMiSMvf.jpg)|
|-|-|




Luego en medio cubrimos con el limpiapipas color piel, después cubrimos la esfera de #3 con limpiapipas marron. 


>Then in the middle we cover with the skin-colored pipe cleaner, then we cover the #3 sphere with brown pipe cleaner.

|![1001405591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u69QqPVdzUoGaPCrxoxQhK1kdSoAYQUZjnP4qrQcCwqZnsjz3sMNnPeTuFNxZFAQ98S.jpg)|![1001405606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u6BUiuGiB6GmhgAc3waSEP4PJpvNBXPEbPGSH1QBhrWMM7b1hZqEhKPppeYgQdY4xFc.jpg)|![1001405841.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi1wzZ61iFHdehifjVd782pKecho1yXzk67y2zvLL72LYHMK4iCcdBH2qC5Rehtn9jS.jpg)|
|-|-|-|


|![1001405842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tvkRCFAVYs9GgfPYbqtVDQ2XCGbqn4nf7kAW4c4Mews2pyC1ULeMh3D7yW3x6beNACC.jpg)|![1001405865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQvf8VZEeDZABuPUnDH7MqWP2TJYx631LZUH8LA3Jx77STHhbupjrYuoczHjt4tE2nv.jpg)|
|-|-|




Ahora vamos introducir un palillo en el centro de la cabeza pero en la parte inferior, unimos el cuerpo con la cabeza peor antes aplicamos un poco de silicón.


>Now we're going to insert a toothpick into the center of the head, but at the bottom. We'll join the body to the head, but first we'll apply a little silicone.


|![1001405866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFXjtTYCzcjpSMNxgBf9oBxsXSJpqgJ9L7rnhVrpFu44rrSzVcWWCKLK2ikByLv4v5p.jpg)|![1001405889.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u69VYBNnZ96HDZzapZQfviC3h4CyLUTRUBoKr1CT6yJVdJTAUj4buGTBoTtLdsv6uA1.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![1001405904.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmQYC7kiEx2Ze5qGCvnCCyySmx4v76Y2Pf3FsQ6mNCaVCDhygWAseYeNQT1GZExQyWT.jpg)|![1001405905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tvm2pkLy1BNidQv3CvYWXruJcHrW1iPX8riXqMDuDRUi2wWegZY4qTQu2xoUL6VJZqz.jpg)|
|-|-|



Luego cubrirnos con otro limpiapipas piel sobre la cara, y aplicamos un poco de sombra marrón en los bordes, también realicé las cuatro patitas con el limpiapipas marrón y pegamos.

>Then we covered the face with another skin-colored pipe cleaner, and applied some brown shadow to the edges. I also made the four little legs with the brown pipe cleaner and glued them on.

|![1001405908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wMf7JeKjKGokm43km8p69gU4kQkXkmuEYmHQYJHTy5RkMGGCFRmF17GUU3zmRtHM9mZ.jpg)|![1001405914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vsV3m9DwgWuZ1kHUikGwwXwHVKTfF82FDdhWDqWGH1G2sNkT3mvV1zhUxEPoZZK37XX.jpg)|
|-|-|


|![1001405927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tvksic569MpGwzH5wPnStUJWut5fADjQLU9Bd86BHtBz5i7XZajiNhsLXXvpWs14AVe.jpg)|![1001405937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wCGNWJGnmKotdqgU87baARRVGa5cd64yv5MK3C2QenhimgSNBGgJWJDWPJKw4PLQZeE.jpg)|
|-|-|



Realicé las orejas con una pequeña pieza de limpiapipas marrón, por último realicé sus ojitos con limpiapipas color negro, también realicé la boca con el alambre de color negro. Para la cola utilicé un limpiapipas marrón y lo enrollamos.


>I made the ears with a small piece of brown pipe cleaner, and finally, I made the eyes with black pipe cleaners. I also made the mouth with black wire. For the tail, I used a brown pipe cleaner and wrapped it around.

|![1001405940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi82sQh1bQQ2JKVf3Hp3GZj6PMEBTjwr8uZgDryxU4a5AYCJtqbuUt2UkyqnbrUVeeU.jpg)|![1001405968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi5t2ma5eqhV1jygqfsyW4P534qzs9t1u3EtsuTevSq4P6YjgJ5AUn8GTjwRm8HdU7C.jpg)|
|-|-|




Espero les haya gustado el resultado final, muchas gracias por el apoyo y por visitar mi publicación, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad con más ideas creativas.

>I hope you liked the final result, thank you so much for your support and for visiting my post, see you next time with more creative ideas.


![1001410378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tvo7JybpmFX9Z4qDc8o2E9F3s4zAyxToYgoPLBTuG8ZEbm5SG3qab7dvMZHh13QNELX.jpg)

![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


![1000095868.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWG8Jt6SU3neCCGF5ZCDw8KzpFGS63KR5cYgcCEoKEYgi/1000095868.png)

title.title: 狗是人类最忠实的朋友，它们总是带给我们无尽的欢
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc8f92e648d4e53474cb5e68e501ebec262137638c63d2adfbb78d55972fb7ebf6f7864e7e8fd0feece76074fbb5f3fc8f977070addac51964b36c737c051efa3_640.jpg)</center>

***

狗是人类最忠实的伙伴，它们的陪伴总能带来无尽的快乐和温暖。每当看到狗狗摇 tail、兴奋地扑过来，心中的烦恼似乎都随之消散。无论是一起散步、玩耍，还是静静地依偎在一起，狗狗的纯真和无条件的爱让人倍感珍贵。与它们相处的时光，仿佛都显得格外珍贵而美好。

***

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 21 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g53fe9def068cf45f870fc0d2af4cf222f8dc9907775370e337e6d87bd5c68799eb05a735f5132a3371dc76168f7a789ded96c48e20eb4547840872e1cfd2483a_640.jpg)
오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거운 시간이었어요. 도심의 공원에서 산책하는 도중, 오래된 친구를 우연히 만났습니다. 우리는 서로의 근황을 이야기하며 오랜만에 반가운 대화를 나눌 수 있었어요. 그 과정에서 공원 근처의 작은 갤러리에서 열리고 있는 전시회를 발견했는데, 지역 아티스트들의 작품이 전시되어 있더라고요. 미술 작품을 감상하면서 새로운 영감을 받을 수 있었고, 그곳에서 만난 사람들과의 짧은 대화도 즐거웠습니다. 이렇게 산책이 단순한 운동을 넘어 새로운 사람들과의 교류의 기회가 되기도 하네요! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Curiosity Over Fear
title.body: />\n\nA beautiful creature longing to explore the beautiful world. \

However, his curiosity overwhelmed him. He then decided. His eyes gently noticed how tall he was. He got scared and decided to calculate the physics using the SUVAT equations, but it was too complex.

Tiny creatures of similar sizes, and some with bigger sizes, flew nearer, flapping their wings and doing what he felt was an acrobatic display of free will.

He saw the king of the skies, the eagle, and wondered why they looked so different. He wondered why they don't speak like his parents.

\
Oba sighted his parents from afar with meals at hand.\n\nMum shouted, \
Soon Oba devoured his portion from the delicacies his mum brought.\n\nAfter eating, Oba said, \
His mum smiled and said to him, \

Oba laughed.

Oba grew big and was ready to fly. He stood up and moved closer to the edge of the tree shoots, and his mum encouraged him to flap his wings. Mum shouted, \

The once timid Oba gave it an attempt, and he flew. For a moment he didn't know how to, and he was about to crash. Unbeknownst to him, his mum caught him mid-flight.

Oba and his mum laughed, knowing fully well that he was in safe hands. Mum encouraged him once more. Oba's weak wing muscles flapped harder, and he flew for a while before crashing one more time. Oba shouted, \

His mum was impressed to see him take his first flight, though not a completely successful one. Other members of the family applauded and celebrated Oba for being courageous during his first flight. Some began narrating the first flight of their own kids and told him to be brave. The old vulture they called Yeye narrated his mum's first flight as a wonder because she flew without her own supervision. She said that she was scared that her baby was gone—not until she was able to see her appear behind her. Everyone celebrated with lion's meat. Oba took the next flight, and he joined the flight squad. Years later, he was crowned the lead vulture and soon married into a beautiful family. **Do I think Oba would be a good dad?** * * *

description.body: It is both fascinating and frightening how modern tools have created a kind of ‘mirage of competence’. As you rightly point out, we are reaching a point where it is difficult to distinguish between genuine talent and a process that has been finely tuned by AI or a social media algorithm. We sometimes forget that the ease of today’s tools can stunted the cognitive processes we once took for granted. Being ‘duped’ is the result of our own expectation that the world will continue to operate under the old rules.

description.title: Deep Within...
description.body: > This photograph was the perfect choice to accompany these words of catharsis, for right now, I feel just like those bushes. The outermost layer is green, displaying life, rebirth, and strength; yet deep within, in the lower regions, one can still feel the lingering effects of having passed through the fire, along with all those wounds that have yet to fully heal. Yes, focusing on the positive, on smiling and putting my best foot forward, has helped me a great deal; it has undoubtedly brought good things my way. Yet, like any human being, there is always something not quite resolved that lurks within my own darkness. It’s not that I enjoy writing these things here and often, I even hope that no one is reading, but I have to admit that my blog has been my greatest companion, and writing helps me reflect and renew my way of thinking. There is something about myself that has been troubling me over the past few weeks. I finally possess the necessary tools to defend myself against the things that cause me pain, yet at times, those very tools work against me, for I still find myself making mistakes all too often. No matter how much I attend church, meditate, take walks in nature, filled spaces, or tell myself that everything is fine, there are certain factors that trigger my lowest emotions and, more often than not, those factors are other people. A few days ago, I began to think that people were really messed up, people at work, people on the street, and even my friends. And that is what caught my attention: How could everyone be messed up except for me? The answer to that question is very obvious: I am the one who still hasn't resolved my internal conflicts. I am glad to realize, on my own, that I am losing my way. I don't want to delude myself by having shitty days spent criticizing the attitudes of others, only to then sit down and write beautiful phrases on my blog. No; the truth is that I haven't handled my pursuit of my goals all that well, and I think I’ve forgotten that other people have their own truths, too... As always, it seems my worst enemy is myself, especially my tongue, because, whether intentionally or not, I have certainly hurt a great many people. I have tried to distance myself from whatever causes me pain, situations, places, people and I don't think there is anything wrong with that. However, a little bit of all those things is present in our day to day lives; and rather than simply walking away, the true elegance of striving to be better each day lies in learning how to deal with it all, ideally without even getting upset. If something rattles me and triggers an angry reaction, then I know I’m not ready—especially when it involves people who aren't even trying to hurt me. After all, so many of the things that seem to be happening are actually just things I’ve imagined in my head — classic!. If you’ve read this far (which I hope you haven’t), I want to ask you not to misunderstand me. I am not an aggressive person; in fact, the only thing I do is hurt myself every time I let negative feelings, such as anger, frustration, sadness, and mistrust, surface. It all stems from a past that was quite rough, though, just between us, at 37 years old, I still find it striking that I haven't quite managed to fully settle into the kind of person I want to be, especially considering how hard I’ve been working on it. One thing I am absolutely clear on right now is that I need to stop talking so much and become a more observant person. In fact, I was always quite quiet, but at some point, as a form of self-defense, I started speaking up and making myself more visible in everything I did. Perhaps that was necessary at the time, but it isn't anymore. Talking too much can be at odds with the pursuit of inner peace; although I’ve also considered that I might simply be surrounded by the wrong kind of people, ultimately, I cannot change others, I can only work on myself. I am writing these words to release the stress that is clouding my mind right now, and to uphold my personal commitment to keep improving as a human being. Anyway, thanks for reading, though I won't mind at all if you don't reply to this particular post! 😅 Wishing you all the best. 🙏

description.title: 健康狀態更新 - 複診復健
description.body:
大家好鴨。我是拉叔，好久沒有用自己的臉跟大家打招呼了。複診時在神經專科這裡小小自排一個上來，順便傳給身邊的幾個朋友報告一下我還活著。朋友也說，拉叔看起來已經像拉伯伯了😂我自己倒是沒注意到，這麼自己細心看一哈，還真的看起來蒼老了許多。頭髮少了很多，還有些許大小眼，頸項折疊，眉鎖之間皺紋全部顯露了出來。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhZjo4WeVDBj6rLwQDbXcQi1eLPGkqFduegGXf16QRip/1776811891860.jpg)

雖然我還是有堅持吃藥，可是血壓還是不停地一直攀升。吃那方面我是盡量遷就，基本上都是很少肉、少鹽、少糖，三不五時就是母老虎給我準備沒加工素菜和水果當午餐。晚餐基本能免則免，睡前一小杯高鈣低脂奶，含有omega可以幫助降壓的。儘管如此，血壓還是一直不停飆升，每個星期進步一點點，我都開始懷疑這藥是到底是要讓我屎快點？還是我身體真的不能再自我調節了？

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbn1P1bLy5WF692vioJFAaB9bhs9ruPNar8cnJ84WeAs/1776811891946.jpg)

時間滾回去大早上，把大小姐送去學院以後，我就自己開車回家，把車子停好了就走路去地鐵站。我們家離地鐵站大概一公里左右。走路時可以五分鐘到，不過還得過馬路，有些行人道又有車子堵住，必須繞路，所以九曲十三彎過後，一般從我們家走去地鐵站還是會耗時十五分鐘左右。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQYt5n25WhGFog1jLkb8vRNoH9XqaT2s1fxHmah5nrc8/1776811891998.jpg)

目前用的兩種藥物，一種是胃藥。主要作用是防止胃液過度，導致胃病。好端端為什麼要吃胃藥呢？那是因為第二種藥物，阿斯匹林血清藥，將血液跳稀好讓堵塞的血管可以繼續通血。現在的節奏是，早上睡醒第一件事情先吃胃藥，然後上班吃過早餐後才吃阿斯匹林。複診日也不例外，早餐就在地鐵站裡面解決，隨便買了個三明治，找個護士堆坐下，一邊吃一邊聽護士姐姐們的聊天。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVUMYWZooCMKYhXvcA8vbTLaDLZZ1fqUznXFZLKEo3DL/1776811892056.jpg)

這次的復健課程還有其他7位童鞋。一眼看過去，現在的文明病痛還真的有年輕化的趨向。我以為我“年輕”，沒想到眼前還有比我更年輕的“小哥哥、小姐姐”。比我年輕不代表真的很年輕😂運氣差一點都變成別人的姥姥和貝貝了😂 上圖為回程時拍下的一幕，早上十一點，該上班的已經上班去了，所以後面看到地鐵到站開門是空的。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZivDfRfwp898a67Z1je33LzjhQt2Mq8fJuiHmFDKzECT/1776811892119.jpg)

跟來的時候相差十萬八千人，整個地鐵站幾乎只有我和哪一位在刷短視頻開得很大聲的印度大叔。說回去復健，復健師還是上次那個小姐姐，不過這次沒有機會撩妹，因為太多人在一起，我總不能自私到霸占著小姐姐鴨，所以我也沒有太多出其不意的表現自己，只是適當的跟著大家做每一個復健鍛煉動作。鍛煉完畢，小姐姐給拉叔安排下一次回來，時間定在下個月中，相隔四個星期呢。復健師小姐姐對拉叔這次的表現覺得有點失落，原來她想說讓拉叔帶動氣氛一哈。畢竟大家都是健康出了狀況的人，所以一起復健時可以互相鼓勵和扶持。有她這句話就可以了，我拉叔可是唯恐天下不亂的人😂 五月中的party，你給我小心點，把你的鍛煉中心給翻過來。

description.title: [EN/PT] Pajuçara Beach - Maceió
description.body: > # [EN] If paradise exists, it’s in Maceió. With a vast coastline of stunning beaches, each one more beautiful than the last, and a sea of an incredible, almost emerald hue. On one of our days there, we spent the day along the city’s waterfront and visited some very “Instagrammable” spots, like Pajuçara Beach. We also went to Marco dos Corais and the famous chair where practically every tourist takes a photo using the hashtag #MaceioÉMassa. We spent the whole day exploring this region, and it was very special to get to know each place. At night, we went to Maceió Shopping Park and wrapped up the day by exploring the northern part of the city in a very fulfilling way. The sea in this region is something special: when the tide is low, coral formations appear, with plenty of seaweed, and you can see little fish swimming among them—a simple yet memorable experience. I cherished every moment with my wife. Maceió is a wonderful city, full of natural beauty and very welcoming people. Without a doubt, it’s a destination well worth visiting. ---- # [PT] Se o paraíso existe, ele é em Maceió. Com um vasto litoral de praias deslumbrantes, cada uma mais bonita que a outra, e um mar com uma cor incrível, quase esmeralda. Em um dos nossos dias por lá, passamos o dia na orla da cidade e visitamos alguns pontos bem “instagramáveis”, como a Praia de Pajuçara. Também fomos ao Marco dos Corais e à famosa cadeira onde praticamente todo turista tira foto usando a hashtag #MaceioÉMassa. Aproveitamos o dia inteiro explorando essa região e foi muito especial conhecer cada lugar. À noite, fomos ao Maceió Shopping Park e fechamos o dia conhecendo a parte norte da cidade de forma bem proveitosa. O mar nessa região é algo à parte: quando a maré está baixa, aparecem as formações de corais, com bastante presença de algas, e é possível ver peixinhos nadando entre eles — uma experiência simples, mas marcante. Aproveitei cada momento ao lado da minha esposa. Maceió é uma cidade maravilhosa, cheia de belezas naturais e com pessoas muito acolhedoras. Sem dúvida, um destino que vale muito a pena conhecer. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-pajucara-beach-maceio)

description.body:

# ​¿Te interesa la tecnología, la inteligencia artificial o tienes una idea que te gustaría convertir en algo real? ⚡

​Blitz Guadalajara es un hackathon diseñado para que puedas aprender, experimentar y construir en un ambiente práctico, relajado y colaborativo. No necesitas ser experto en programación: aquí te ayudamos a aterrizar tu idea y convertirla en un proyecto funcional usando tecnología de última generación.

​Durante dos días podrás conectar con estudiantes, emprendedores, builders y personas con ganas de crear, mientras trabajas en soluciones a problemas reales, ya sea para tu propio emprendimiento o una nueva idea.

​📅 24 y 25 de abril📍 Guadalajara

​Ven a construir, aprender y llevar tus ideas al siguiente nivel 🚀

​No necesitas experiencia previa en Web3. Solo curiosidad y ganas de experimentar.

​Lo que haremos

- ​⚡️ Monad 101 para entender lo esencial con claridad
- ​🛠️ Talleres hands-on con guía paso a paso
- ​👥 Equipos para colaborar desde el inicio
- ​🧑‍🏫 Mentorías dedicadas con Frutero para destrabarte en tiempo real
- ​🤝 Networking con builders y comunidad local

### ​¿Para quién es?

- ​Devs Web2 que quieren probar onchain sin presión
- ​Estudiantes que prefieren práctica sobre teoría
- ​Builders en etapa temprana que quieren claridad y guía
- ​Personas buscando comunidad y teammates en GDL

### ​Cómo se vive

**​Bienvenida → Monad 101 → workshops → Equipos → Sandbox de creación con mentoría → Cierre**
​

## Evaluación, premios y cierre

​Cerraremos con una evaluación de proyectos y un showcase de lo construido. Habrá premios para los proyectos destacados y terminaremos con palabras finales y próximos pasos para seguir en la ruta builder.

​🎟️ Cupo limitado. [Regístrate para recibir la ubicación exacta aquí](https://luma.com/blitz-gdl-apr-2026?tk=TOVvon).

​🏆 **$18,000 MXN en premios**

​🥇 1er lugar — $10k 🥈 2do lugar — $5k 🥉 3er lugar — $3k​

### ​Sobre Monad

​Monad Protocol es una blockchain Layer 1 compatible con EVM y diseñada para ultra alto rendimiento. Monad ofrece un desempeño sin precedentes de hasta 10,000 transacciones por segundo, manteniendo compatibilidad total con los smart contracts de Ethereum.

description.title: “Silver Adventures”- Captain Joshua Slane – 21AP26- 'Not This Time Chief!'
description.body: Trayan asked in surprise at seeing her, \
Bleujay replied with a roll of her eyes as she sat down and took a plain off the large tray, \

* They all cheered in a warm welcome back.

The warm feelings and kind words exchanged between the crew was a cheery scene. But none of them knew what the day would bring, no, not one of them.

*(See: https://hive.blog/pirates/@joshuaslane/silver-adventures-captain-joshua-slane-10ap26-there-will-be-fire )*

〰️⛵〰️ ⛵〰️ ⛵ 〰️⛵〰️

![aaaa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma2iBt1QohAbfr4RLi4kbm4e6TjaXUgVAdFqWQTcoa5M6/aaaa.jpg)

*[On the Silverton…sunrise the next morning…]*

Just as the Captain had said the night before, at sunrise the anchor was hoisted and the forward jib and fore topgallant sail were unfurled. It only took a moment for the sails to fill, and the big ship righted itself against the current of the river and headed steadily south upstream...

“Are we going to face-off against the Seneca again?!” Standing Officer Fat-elvis asked anxiously as he eyed the eastern tree line.

![Fat-Elvis.6..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfXCujm21ZQA8anP8P27pwRuREZGGRK3jTC1TJwPTwGy8/Fat-Elvis.6..jpg)

“We feel proud! For doing nothing here...except defending our pirate freedom!” Standing Officer Trayan replied in a determined tone.

![Trayan.7..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRyzfKSNJAeig2xzQ9fBbrSWmXmiCVNSy7CxuH1L4pRk/Trayan.7..jpg)

“I hope you’re right…”

Meanwhile, before the first hour was up, Junior Petty Officer Pocketechange called out from the crow’s nest…

![nest.2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf2iiyj2ucMRE6TKCCqq7X7VYg9b1Qh9krwXGQDYPwBwY/nest.2.jpg)

**“Yo! Seneca warriors assembling on the east bank!”**

![pocketechange.3..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRMm3cjMeZ4NM3wCthwZ7Xg5DLn1ZR9ZRd8yNrZUuLNmF/pocketechange.3..jpg)

*”Hoo mony mate?!”* The Captain called back from the bridge.
![C-Slane.2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUaWQRNAtBZ9SnpvfDTPHbqLtJSRp3t7wNMKB7HXdCue2/C-Slane.2.jpg)
*“At least a hundred Sairrr! And another fire is being built!”*

The Captain turned to Warrant Officer Lupega…”Station yerself at th
 Galley stairs Officer! Ahh needs yer voice to relay orders tae Commander Errisl doon in th’ upper gin deck!”
“Aye-aye Sairrr!” 

![Lupega.10..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdxqgy2pHSRRuJrzSByYdRKaSRJKgy3f5z6KtTR1pwd1/Lupega.10..jpg)

And with that Lupega dashed down the bridge stairs and stook at the archway.

*[Seneca Village….]*
![tee-pees.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgpqWWS7Y2qJjXBZyYoXvvY2PCdabY6AsxozfcS9f3Ho/tee-pees.jpg)
*“These devils come again!”* *[Translated]* Chief Minetoh bellowed in frustration as Running Fox alerted him to the sighting, *“Man the fire arrows! This time finish them!”*
![Chief Minetoh (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPGNnnxwvQ3kWtrTydNhcR8xgDJjxmhChqUW9wnauqzu1/Chief%20Minetoh%20(2).jpg)

*“Right away Chief!”*
![Running-fox.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbBcJM9bh7oPv6U9WZyCNrWGVvSEnTWttdWvzByP86Gyc/Running-fox.jpg)
As the river bend now filled with the ominous dark silhouette of the great frigate, the warriors quickly stoked the fire which was brewing on the east bank of the river, just a quarter mile north of the Chief’s Longhouse!

*[On the Silverton…]*
![Bridge.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRKMGwTuT6Q92xd1T6RmqfS7646fpQUdDg8UmYfFY4kv/Bridge.jpg)
The Captain watched closely with his longscope as the Seneca laid more branches on the war fire and several archers already were readying their fire arrows…

*“Nae thes times Chief!”* He whispered to himself as he lowered his scope, *“Lupega!”*

*”Aye Sairrr?!”*
*“Give Commander Errisl th’ order tae fire cannons one an' two! Tells her tae snuff-oot ‘att fire!”*
*“Aye Sairrr!”*

Not more than fifteen seconds after Lupega yelled the order down to the upper gun deck and all fire and hell belched out of the two forward deck guns!
![silverton-shooting.5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR9ZvZupJHEpxqy4ev2LGpQg54nagRwRPdqSp7uDfohon/silverton-shooting.5.jpg)
![Anchor-epilog.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBrzRNzCK8GohnVKkT77B6MtydmLYNuvDuWSaEFa1shm/Anchor-epilog.jpg)

〰️⛵〰️ ⛵〰️ ⛵ 〰️⛵〰️

😉 -**Keptin**

description.title: ✨Desde una chapa de refresco a un broche personalizado✨.//✨From a soda bottle cap to a personalized brooch✨.(Esp-Eng)
description.body:
>Hola a todos ustedes amigos,en esta noche les vengo a mostrar como hice un broche usando una chapa de metal de refresco,así que si ves una por allí no la botes,mejor has un broche con ella y así tendrás un broche único y personalizado y además ayudando al ambiente,ya que he visto que es un material un tanto difícil para desaserse y entonces una buena opción es darle un segundo uso así que aprovechemos este tipo de materiales.* # > Hello everyone, tonight I'm going to show you how I made a brooch using a metal soda can tab. So if you see one lying around, don't throw it away! Instead, make a brooch out of it and you'll have a unique and personalized brooch, and you'll also be helping the environment, since I've noticed that it's a somewhat difficult material to get rid of, so giving it a second life is a great option. Let's take advantage of these kinds of materials! --- # #
Materiales/Materials
 #
![1000262945.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRb6ZSWkjUHAJHeGKe3PF6f681VzXreqd82soiJAqqNY/1000262945.png)
# * Esmalte de uñas color negro * Brillo de uñas * Silicón líquido * Un alicate de bisutería * Un alfiler de gancho * Una argolla * Una lija * Un dibujo o etiqueta # * Black nail polish * Nail polish * Liquid silicone * Jewelry pliers * Safety pin * Jump ring * Sandpaper * A drawing or label # #
Paso a paso/Step by step
 #
![1000262742.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWbz3B5fnWsTFT9i4aJR3AQqQ7PGu6rtVPKDZRTdykZhJ/1000262742.jpg)
![1000262743.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3jw8KZqX3Q9pwLjEGFnUVjccZSyqGdqAiZMV9GezKFk/1000262743.jpg)
![1000262761.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRWt73qHyV9HaUvdFG9XmabssEVALReoqJbEfwytQf1fy/1000262761.jpg)
# * #### Paso 1 **

>Inicie por lijar la base de la chapa para que así se abdiera mejor el esmalte,y así después fue aplicando el esmalte negro par tapar toda la base de la chapa,y después deje secar bien.** > * #### Step 1 > Start by sanding the base of the sheet metal so that the enamel would adhere better, then apply the black enamel to cover the entire base of the sheet metal, and then let it dry completely. ---
![1000262762.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPik3RnpXmEuFmHvDz54odVjxKXb6iWriK2mrniXQp6zj/1000262762.jpg)
![1000262763.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSxUakPNthErvJ6fiStbex6oaNNoWJXvBR13kGDRHhvFK/1000262763.jpg)
# * #### Paso 2 **

>Luego pase a continuar a colocar la etiqueta colocando un poco de silicón líquido para que pegue bien,y deje que se secara bien.** > * #### Step 2 > Then proceed to place the label, applying a little liquid silicone to ensure it adheres well, and let it dry completely. ---
![1000262764.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVxBuECKhCsffCD89CPv8NAWjqTPbs4AWFEk2qR3SaaUR/1000262764.jpg)
![1000262765.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdfF5rHAMx1Av5dC5gC8BoGEzxPGvXLY9MaNnR791rLuM/1000262765.jpg)
![1000262766.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4TpZRkNBtFnkatCu43S6QqLCvbvFokuuZnCSogPCZJJ/1000262766.jpg) ![1000262947.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaCiqCE3Qktxv4QtmRVhEjsjJ7Rs3PRmWBkCc9CkzPWky/1000262947.jpg)
# * #### Paso 3 **

>Después pase a colocar la argolla que dervira para aguantar el alfiler a la chapa, entonces lo que hice fue hacerle como un doblado como una curva,luego lo coloque en el medio del alfiler. Ya teniendo eso así,con la ayuda del alicate fui doblando la parte del medio de la chapa de modo que aguantarán la argolla para que no se salga.** > * #### Step 3 > Next, I attached the jump ring that would hold the pin to the metal plate. I bent it into a curve and then placed it in the middle of the pin. With that in place, I used pliers to bend the middle part of the metal plate so that it would hold the jump ring securely in place. ---
![1000262768.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTorPGumfC5khEgiLuZpHNHSRw2Lo2DwmRWL3bHxuN9rw/1000262768.jpg)
# * #### Paso 4 **

>Y como último acabado,le aplique una capa de brillo para darle un toque más brillante y darle un poco de durabilidad.** > * #### Step 4 > And as a final touch, I applied a layer of gloss to give it a shinier look and a bit more durability. --- #

![1000262769.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPBiXrmxFJYKCqwtmg9uSh4NGceRDCJJkVPthAV8pDKEf/1000262769.jpg)

A mí en lo personal me gusta mucho los broches,parches y llaveros pero para darle personalidad a mis bolsos¿ Y tú en dónde lo colocarias? ich habe es geschafft, ich darf jetzt alles fahren was es in Deutschland an Kraftfahrzeugen gibt. Ich habe heute meine letzte Fahrprüfung bestanden. Der Dienstherr dachte, ich soll mal alle Führerscheine machen die es gibt, man weiß nie wann man es mal braucht und die aktuellen Strukturen bereiten sich drauf vor, dass wir vor ganz anderen Problemen stehen könnten. Probleme von denen wir jetzt noch nicht einmal wissen, was sie bedeuten. Ich meine stellt euch einmal vor, ihr habt eine Einheit im Einsatz und die muss ausgetauscht werden. Man kann dann entweder zehn Mannschaftswagen schicken oder halt einen Reisebus und ich muss sagen, der Reisebus ist wahrscheinlich die angenehmere Option. In ihm braucht man nur zwei Fahrer, da man die Ruhezeiten einhalten muss. Auf der anderen Seite müsste man zwanzig Fahrer einteilen, was eine Herausfoderung ist, vor allem da immer mehr Mannschaftswagen über 3,5 Tonnen zulässigem Gesamtgewicht sind. Und damit kommen Führerscheine ins Spiel, wir haben zwar in Bayern unsere Helferführerscheine, viele haben dann doch noch nen alten Führerschein oder einen C1 Führerschein, aber dass sind dann doch relativ wenige, wenn man sich überlegt, dass man 20 Fahrer braucht. Und auf der anderen Seite werden die großen Einsatzfahrzeuge immer größer. Früher hatte man LKWs mit 7,5 Tonnen zulässiger Gesamtmasse, heute reden wir da meistens von LKWs die bei 12 Tonnen und mehr sind. Und da wirds dann sogar mit den alten Führerscheinen und Helferführerscheinen schwierig, denn sind wir mal ehrlich, wer hat alles einen großen LKW Führerschein, wenn man nicht das Glück hat ehemalige Soldaten aus Logistikeinheiten vor sich zu haben. Oder Berufskraftfahrer, die aber auch immer weniger werden. 

Mal schauen wie das ganze weitergeht. Ich kann nur sagen, es macht Spaß diese großen Maschinen zu fahren. Vor allem mit der ganzen Technik die da mit dran hängt. Es ist um Welten einfacher zu fahren, als die meisten PKW. Also in dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.

 ## **Welcome to my Week 15 #SlothySavers update!** 🦥 
   
Once again, I'm late to post my Slothysavers weekly report. I've been travelling for the last couple of days. And this time I have a genuine reason to be late. 
  
 Well, time is flying fast, and we are already in Week 17, which means 16 weeks are completed and part of the past now. The strange thing about time is you never feel it moving, only after, when you look back, and the distance shocks you. We keep saying later, like later is a place we can get to whenever we want. It isn't. So don't wait. If you have to do something, do it now. 

Days turn into weeks, and Weeks turn into months before you even notice. But looking back, I'm glad I stayed consistent, still here, still saving, still growing. #SlothySavers by #slothbuzz has been such a great challenge for staying motivated and reminded me that small steps taken over time actually add up to something good.

description.title: A picture is worth a thousand words
description.body:
The picture below looks like that of an ancient vulture. It has creamy feathers, a hooked beak, a watchful dark eyes and it looks like a creature that has seen a thousand seasons past.
 
**Story**

A traveler wandered into a barren land. It was a land people rarely travel through. There he met a cinereous vulture with creamy feathers and watchful dark eyes. One could tell it had lived a thousand years hiding in one of the mountains that was once standing.  It looked hungry, and might have traveled a far distance before succumbing to its longing for food. Only a few greener fields had survived the rise of civilization.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhfkhw5adzqpdYVUWsfbn9T5t5okR5P6NifQ9TMekrN5/1776811255836.png)


[photo source](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tc90pi)

The vulture tried to escape as he reached for it, but its strength failed it. The stranger bent forward and dropped a piece of his meat and poured some water for it to drink. He stepped back and watched the vulture hungrily devour the meat after which it reached for the water. 

With a tear, and watchful eyes, it looked at the stranger, and waited for a little time before flying away. The stranger felt satisfied but left a burden in his heart as he continued his journey of how civilization may bring to extinction creatures that once lived.

description.title: 76ers get demolished in Game 1 of NBA Playoffs First Round vs Celtics | Game 2 tonight
description.body:
![nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AK3eyGpWbyoaTTjJeeKnj44681PrD7tPGkoXMiDJYKDywwjPDVKgyqJH3UhvszU.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/nba/nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo/)

Yikes that was a tough, tough watch on Sunday. My prior optimism about the series pretty quickly evaporated. The game was never close.

Nevertheless I will say the game felt extremely strange. The Sixers were missing shots at a comically fast rate and frankly it didn't make sense. It was frustrating and the Celtics certainly played great defense as they often do, and the Celtics also seem to have the size advantage which is problematic. But I don't know I got the feeling that the Sixers were more inexperienced and nervous for this game. Tyrese Maxey and Paul George have good playoff experience and a few other veterans have mild experience but a lot of other players haven't really tasted much playoff basketball. All in all I just felt the Celtics were way more composed. The Celtics have been making deep runs for awhile and were literally champions only two years ago.

Also, the Celtics are obviously the favorites. They are a deeper, more complete team. They're a great team. The Sixers on this roster need to create their own story and prove they belong. The Celtics are just more talented especially without Joel Embiid. Embiid is just one player, but he's a great player. The domino effect his presence adds to the team and how defenses defend the Sixers is large. I'm not sure if the Sixers would win the series with Embiid but they would be way more competitive.

But fate determined Embiid is not here. Plenty of teams get crushed in a seven game series and turnaround to look better. It's hard to imagine the Sixers shooting that badly twice in a row. Hopefully they got the jitters mostly out of them and felt the punch to the mouth they took. I say hopefully they felt the punch because if they have pride they won't get caught that hard again going forward. Not to say they won't lose again but hopefully none of the losses are as bad as Sunday was.

Meh. But yeah I'm just hoping for a better game. If the Sixers can't win the series I hope they don't get swept! If they somehow managed to force this to six games that would be impressive!

It's playoff basketball LET'S GO!!! A lot of teams would prefer being where the Sixers are right now, this has been a fun year watching this scrappy squad.

description.title: Inspiration and purpose / LOH Contest 285
description.body:
>



<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23yJR54Aiojh4racxaFzDrFLcehCxBv7J7hfc2L6Wgtqneae3HEiBgpEci5iRv1ks3KmL.jpg
[Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mano-escritorio-de-madera-dibujo-a-mano-papel-bond-6617288/)
</center>

# Español

#### ¿Cuál es un libro, vídeo de YouTube, película o lección de vida sobre el autodesarrollo que realmente le ha impactado? Podría tratarse de habilidades, dinero, propósito, relaciones, salud o crecimiento personal. Comparte lo que te enseñó y por qué lo recomendarías a otros

Una de las películas que me motivado mas en los últimos años  fue Miss Potter, esta narra la historia de una escritora y e ilustradora de cuentos infantiles que logró hacerse su lugar en una epoca en donde las mujeres no eran reconocidas en ese rubro y que además logró consolidar su estilo de arte como algo rentable. 

A pesar de que tuvo una familia de dinero en cuyo círculo se acostumbraba a que las mujeres se casaran y se dedicarán al hogar, ella logró ser una mujer independiente, que haciendo lo que amaba pudo dejar el cobijo de sus padres y vivir felizmente incluso casándose a una edad avanzada para los estándares de la época.

Esta película me inspiró mucho porque al igual que la protagonista al dedicarme a las artes algunas personas no han tomado en serio mi trabajo, lo veían como un simple pasatiempo, algo de lo que no se puede vivir, sin embargo, hasta ahora no he renunciado a lo que me gusta y me he dado a respetar a través de las creaciones,  a pesar de que vivimos en una época diferencia aún sigue existiendo discriminación hacia las mujeres en el arte, minimizando sus trabajos como si se tratarán de simples cosas que se hacen para perder el tiempo, abogo por el respeto a la mujeres artista y artesanas y esta película sin caer en polémicas me mostró que siendo firme y constante se puede lograr vivir del arte.

#### En este momento de tu vida, ¿cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir? ¿Cómo describirías tu propósito en este momento y qué te mantiene avanzando cada día?

Mi principal razón para seguir adelante es mi hijo, sumado al amor que le tengo, tengo un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad que se une al hecho de que como madre soltera él depende solo de mi, por lo tanto no puedo déjame caer, incluso en las peores circunstancias cuando he caído en depresión trato de no hundirme por completo y seguir viviendo por el, es un niño maravilloso que me llena de valor y orgullo. 

<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23tmQ5oPy8FFPT6mdXWt73T4jX7T8xfw5ZmLUZGVYUMfpGQ9wA3AcmAH3c4gmFma6g2A2.jpg
[Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-sentado-mesa-nino-23224837/)
</center>

# English

#### What is a book, YouTube video, movie, or life lesson about self-development that has truly impacted you? It could be about skills, money, purpose, relationships, health, or personal growth. Share what it taught you and why you would recommend it to others.

One of the movies that has motivated me the most in recent years was Miss Potter. It tells the story of a children's book author and illustrator who carved out a niche for herself in an era when women weren't recognized in that field and who also managed to establish her art style as a profitable venture.

Despite coming from a wealthy family where it was customary for women to marry and dedicate themselves to the home, she managed to become an independent woman. By doing what she loved, she was able to leave her parents' home and live happily, even marrying at an advanced age by the standards of the time.

This film inspired me greatly because, like the protagonist, when I dedicate myself to the arts, some people haven't taken my work seriously. They saw it as a mere hobby, something you can't make a living from. However, I haven't given up on what I love, and I've earned respect through my creations. Even though we live in a different era, discrimination against women in art still exists, minimizing their work as if it were simply something done to waste time. I advocate for respect for women artists and craftswomen, and this film, without being controversial, showed me that with firmness and perseverance, it's possible to make a living from art.

#### At this point in your life, what do you think is your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose at this moment, and what keeps you moving forward each day?

My main reason to keep going is my son. In addition to the love I have for him, I have a strong sense of responsibility, which is compounded by the fact that as a single mother he depends solely on me. Therefore, I cannot let myself fall apart. Even in the worst circumstances, when I have fallen into depression, I try not to sink completely and to keep living for him. He is a wonderful child who fills me with courage and pride.

https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png

(Lost Woods), es una de las melodías más alegres y reconocibles compuesta por Koji Kondo para el videojuego The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998). Dentro de la historia, es la pieza que Saria le enseña a Link en el Bosque Sagrado, sirviendo como un símbolo de su amistad y permitiéndoles comunicarse mágicamente a la distancia. Musicalmente, es una danza folclórica de ritmo rápido en do mayor, diseñada para ser interpretada en la ocarina dentro del juego, aunque su estructura melódica la ha convertido en un estándar favorito para instrumentos de viento madera. Su pegajoso motivo principal y su energía juguetona han trascendido el título original, apareciendo en múltiples entregas de la franquicia y consolidándose como un pilar de la identidad sonora de Hyrule.** \n\n*\

also known as the Lost Woods theme, is one of the most cheerful and recognizable melodies composed by Koji Kondo for the video game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998). Within the story, it is the piece that Saria teaches Link in the Sacred Woods, serving as a symbol of their friendship and allowing them to magically communicate across distances. Musically, it is a fast-paced folk dance in C major, designed to be played on the ocarina within the game, although its melodic structure has made it a favorite standard for woodwind instruments. Its catchy main motif and playful energy have transcended the original title, appearing in multiple installments of the franchise and establishing itself as a cornerstone of Hyrule's sonic identity.*

I managed to find this flower when my uncle and I were cleaning a new plantation area at the foot of the mountains, I myself do not know the name, but because this flower has extraordinary beauty so I was interested in immortalizing its beauty. This flower has petals that are light purple and purplish white, and if we look closely then we will be able to see long stamens that protrude from the crown of the flower, this flower also has a long stem and there are many very fine hairs, but this flower can not cause itching at all so it is safe to hold. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP43n1wP5benzNKuUCC5apKSbXniqSDEazoF16wUTr8TF/img_20260419_wa0080.jpg) It's safe to say that this flower's population is quite stable in my area,it's not only found in the forest, but also in plantations and on the forest's edge. description.title: Mentalidad Emprendedora: Guía para la mujer cubana (Cap. 1: Rompiendo Barreras).
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVTWc1C84sJyr2UPcmne1NfexBURy4m261s95kZbhQPG5/1776811345741.png)

**Índice de Contenidos**

1. Rompiendo barreras: El poder de creer en ti
2. Conociendo tu terreno: Emprender en la Cuba de hoy
3. Diseñando tu oferta: Productos y servicios irresistibles
4. Ponle precio a tu valor: Finanzas sin miedo
5. Tu vitrina digital: Redes sociales que venden
6. Vendiendo con confianza: El arte de persuadir
7. Resiliencia pura: Superando obstáculos diarios
8. Creciendo en comunidad: Alianzas y tu futuro

**Rompiendo barreras: El poder de creer en ti**
**Capítulo1: Rompiendo barreras: El poder de creer en ti**

Hola, emprendedora. Si estás leyendo estas líneas, es porque dentro de ti hay una chispa que se niega a apagarse. Quizás ya tienes un negocio en marcha, de esos que han nacido entre apagones, colas y una creatividad infinita; o tal vez tienes una idea guardada en una libreta, esperando el \

que parece no llegar nunca. Antes de hablar de presupuestos, de marketing o de logística en nuestro complejo escenario nacional, tenemos que hablar de lo más importante: de ti.\r\nEmprender en Cuba no es solo una decisión económica; es un acto de valentía. Aquí, donde \

es el pan de cada día, la mentalidad no es solo un accesorio, es el motor que determina si tu proyecto sobrevive a la primera tormenta o si se convierte en algo que transforme tu vida y la de tu comunidad. Pero para lograrlo, primero debemos derribar los muros que tú misma, a veces sin darte cuenta, has levantado.\r\n### Las sombras en el camino: Identificando las creencias limitantes\r\nEn nuestro contexto, es muy fácil caer en el pensamiento de que las circunstancias externas dictan nuestro destino. Escuchamos frases como: \
. Estas son las famosas creencias limitantes.\r\nUna creencia limitante es una \

que te has contado a ti misma tantas veces que has terminado por aceptarla como una realidad absoluta. En el caso de la mujer cubana, estas creencias suelen estar alimentadas por una doble carga: la situación económica del país y los roles de género tradicionales. A veces sientes que si dedicas tiempo a tu negocio, estás descuidando a la familia, o que no tienes los conocimientos técnicos necesarios porque \

.\r\nEl primer paso para romper estas barreras es identificarlas. Te invito a que hagas un ejercicio de honestidad: ¿Qué es lo primero que piensas cuando te imaginas teniendo éxito? Si lo que viene a tu mente es miedo, culpa o la sensación de que \

, ahí tienes una creencia que debemos transformar. No dejes que la escasez de recursos materiales se convierta en una escasez de visión. En Cuba, lo que nos sobra es talento; el reto es aprender a confiar en él.\r\n### El Síndrome del Impostor: Esa vocecita que te frena\r\n¿Alguna vez has sentido que, a pesar de tus logros, en cualquier momento alguien se va a dar cuenta de que \

? ¿Que tu éxito es solo cuestión de suerte? Bienvenida al club del Síndrome del Impostor. Es esa sensación de ser un fraude, y es especialmente común entre las mujeres que deciden dar el paso hacia el trabajo por cuenta propia o el sector privado.\r\nEn nuestro entorno, el síndrome del impostor se disfraza de \

.
Entiende algo: si has logrado levantar un emprendimiento en las condiciones actuales de la isla, no eres un fraude; eres una estratega nata. Has aprendido a manejar crisis, a encontrar proveedores donde no los hay y a dar un servicio de calidad con recursos limitados. Eso no es suerte, es capacidad. El síndrome del impostor se cura con acción y con la validación de tus propios pasos. Cada vez que resuelves un problema técnico o cierras una venta, estás demostrando que ese espacio te pertenece.
### El poder de la autorreferencia y el cambio de narrativa
Para creer en ti, necesitas cambiar la historia que te cuentas. En lugar de enfocarte en lo que te falta (que en Cuba siempre parece ser mucho), empieza a enfocarte en lo que ya tienes.
La mujer cubana tiene una capacidad de resiliencia que es envidiada en el resto del mundo. Tenemos una formación académica sólida, una red social de apoyo (la familia, los vecinos, las amigas) que es fundamental, y una habilidad para la improvisación creativa que es, en esencia, puro espíritu emprendedor.
Imagina que tu mentalidad es como el software de un teléfono: si el software es viejo y está lleno de errores, no importa cuán buena sea la señal de internet (las oportunidades), el teléfono no funcionará bien. Actualizar tu \

.
Este cambio de narrativa es lo que te permite ver oportunidades donde otros ven obstáculos. Donde alguien ve un local vacío y deteriorado, una emprendedora con la mentalidad correcta ve el futuro cuartel general de su marca. Donde alguien ve una dificultad para importar insumos, tú ves la oportunidad de crear alianzas con productores locales o de innovar con materiales alternativos.
### Pasos prácticos para empoderar tu confianza
Creer en una misma no sucede de la noche a la mañana por arte de magia. Es un músculo que se entrena. Aquí tienes una hoja de ruta sencilla para empezar hoy mismo:
1.  Haz un inventario de victorias: Escribe una lista de todas las cosas difíciles que has superado en el último año. No tienen que ser solo de negocios. ¿Lograste organizar un cumpleaños sin harina? ¿Reparaste algo en casa sin ayuda? ¿Aprendiste a usar una aplicación nueva para tu trabajo? Todo cuenta. Eres una experta en superar desafíos.
2.  Rodéate de una \

que sume: El entorno en Cuba puede ser muy crítico o pesimista. Busca a otras mujeres que estén en tu misma sintonía. El apoyo entre emprendedoras es vital; compartir experiencias te hará ver que tus miedos son normales y que otras ya han pasado por ahí y han vencido.
3.  Capacitación constante: Nada mata más rápido la inseguridad que el conocimiento. Si sientes que te falta saber de finanzas, de redes sociales o de gestión, busca la manera de aprender. Hoy en día, incluso con las limitaciones de conexión, existen comunidades y materiales que pueden guiarte. Cuanto más sepas, menos espacio tendrá el miedo.
4.  Acepta el error como parte del aprendizaje: En una economía tan volátil como la nuestra, las cosas no siempre saldrán a la primera. No te castigues. Si un plan no funcionó, no significa que tú seas un fracaso, significa que ese plan necesitaba ajustes.
### Tu derecho a prosperar
Finalmente, quiero decirte algo que pocas veces escuchamos: tienes derecho a prosperar. Tienes derecho a querer una vida mejor para ti y para los tuyos, y a sentirte orgullosa de generar tus propios ingresos. A veces, la sociedad nos empuja a sentir que debemos conformarnos, pero el emprendimiento es, en esencia, una herramienta de libertad.
Cuando crees en ti, dejas de pedir permiso para tener éxito. Empiezas a ocupar tu lugar en la mesa con la seguridad de que tu voz y tu visión tienen valor. El contexto cubano es retador, sí, pero tú eres más fuerte que cualquier circunstancia. Tu negocio empezará a crecer justo en el momento en que tú decidas que eres capaz de hacerlo crecer.
No esperes a que las condiciones externas cambien para empezar a confiar en tu potencial. El cambio empieza adentro. Rompe esa barrera hoy, mírate al espejo y reconoce a la mujer emprendedora, capaz y visionaria que ya eres. El camino es largo, pero no lo caminas sola, y el primer paso —el más importante— es creer que puedes darlo.
¡Adelante, que el futuro también se construye con tus manos!

\

description.title: Gintama: Un anime basado en el absurdo / Gintama: An anime based on the absurd
description.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmNRRwYmg3JWVR4zHuEEWvQfaL8fvmGWuNhCcPyi9dKQ4e/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb ](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm3621152769/?ref_=ttmi_mi_36_2)

Cuando mi proveedor de anime (mi hijo) me sugirió que viéramos este anime, tuve que pensarlo dos veces, pues la propuesta era completamente diferente a lo que ya estoy acostumbrada a ver. Al final, le di la oportunidad y fue una decisión acertada, pues rompe con todo lo que se conoce del género.

La trama es bastante simple: un samuray que más allá de ser serio y activo, es perezoso y acepta cualquier trabajo para poder cubrir los gastos de alquiler. Sus compañeros son igual de disfuncionales que él, pero en conjunto logran salvar el día y evitar que la casera los eche del local.

Pero como si eso no fuera suficiente, viven en un estado feudal que ha sido invadido por alienígenas, quienes cada tanto generan conflictos que necesitan ser resueltos, aunque también uno que otro gato por recuperar está en la lista de tareas de este trío.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYz14GToecq9vQgVw6e6erBdNK2fDoPn5zA7gJdy4xAh/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm745102080/?ref_=ttmi_mi_255_1)

Hay personajes recurrentes que sin ser quienes generan los conflictos, le aportan dinamismo a la serie, que está compuesta por capítulos cerrados. Uno de ellos es Otsuu, una jovencita que ha soñado con ser cantante desde niña, siendo también compositora de sus propios temas, los cuales son bastante particulares.

Otro personaje que resulta una crítica al sistema monárquico, es el Príncipe Hata, llamado también Príncipe Baka (príncipe estúpido) que cada vez que aparece tiene una música incidental similar a los cantos yodel suizos.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMoR1w5MSSEjzENSf5K8FAzV2ZSxVk8ArbDnJzEQuM81/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm3982323201/?ref_=ttmi_mi_16_2)

La trama, resulta una especie de oda a la comedia del absurdo, pues aunque hay peleas y conflictos serios, la forma en que son abordados por sus protagonistas, hacen risible cualquier eventualidad, pues al final de todo, se resuelven de alguna forma.

En algunos capítulos vemos a Sakata Gintoki (el protagonista) sacando todo el potencial que tiene, demostrando que no es tan tonto como parece.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDW9m3YTaRoHqC9xmBWhVSyPtpxvg6Vgu72Hcgwtsyiw/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm2041866497/?ref_=ttmi_mi_28_2)

El conflicto con la sociedad que busca encasillar a los hombres maduros, es representado por varios personajes, empezando por Sakata Gintoki, pero también vemos a  Taizou Hasegawa, a quien le llaman MADAO, que es un acrónimo que significa \

, siendo visto como un fracasado por su esposa y amigos.

Y es que ni la policía se salva en este animé! Entre sus miembros se pueden distinguir varios estereotipos sociales, siendo Tōshirō Hijikata el que más llamó mi atención, por su afición a colocarle cantidades exageradas de mayonesa a todo lo que come (hasta al café).

Hacen alusiones a personajes de otros animé, así como también de series y películas de Hollywood, por lo que nadie se salva de ser parte del mundo absurdo de Gintoki y de la sociedad de Edo.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVLW2KRa3oNQXn2CePwMY1wzuEWpqtMhpwTkeamQd1Ek/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm1748199425/?ref_=ttmi_mi_32_2)

Realmente es una serie completamente absurda, pero muy entretenida si solo deseas pasar el rato, además que puedes reírte de tus problemas diarios, pues muchos son representados en ellas, desde obsesiones, fobias, frustraciones o la angustia de los hombres cuando van quedando calvos.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

When my anime supplier (my son) suggested we watch this anime, I had to think twice, since the premise was completely different from what I’m used to seeing. In the end, I gave it a chance, and it was the right decision, as it breaks away from everything we know about the genre.

The plot is pretty simple: a samurai who, far from being serious and active, is lazy and takes on any job just to cover his rent. His companions are just as dysfunctional as he is, but together they manage to save the day and keep the landlady from kicking them out.

But as if that weren’t enough, they live in a feudal state that has been invaded by aliens, who every so often create conflicts that need to be resolved—though rescuing the occasional cat is also on this trio’s to-do list.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYz14GToecq9vQgVw6e6erBdNK2fDoPn5zA7gJdy4xAh/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm745102080/?ref_=ttmi_mi_255_1)

There are recurring characters who, without being the ones to create the conflicts, bring dynamism to the series, which consists of self-contained episodes. One of them is Otsuu, a young girl who has dreamed of being a singer since childhood and also composes her own songs, which are quite unique.

Another character who serves as a critique of the monarchy is Prince Hata, also known as Prince Baka (Stupid Prince), who is accompanied by background music reminiscent of Swiss yodeling every time he appears.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMoR1w5MSSEjzENSf5K8FAzV2ZSxVk8ArbDnJzEQuM81/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm3982323201/?ref_=ttmi_mi_16_2)

The plot is a sort of ode to the theater of the absurd; although there are fights and serious conflicts, the way the protagonists handle them makes any situation seem laughable, since, in the end, everything works out somehow.

In some episodes, we see Sakata Gintoki (the protagonist) tapping into his full potential, proving that he isn’t as foolish as he seems.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDW9m3YTaRoHqC9xmBWhVSyPtpxvg6Vgu72Hcgwtsyiw/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm2041866497/?ref_=ttmi_mi_28_2)

The conflict with a society that seeks to pigeonhole middle-aged men is represented by several characters, starting with Sakata Gintoki, but we also see Taizou Hasegawa, nicknamed MADAO—an acronym meaning “good-for-nothing”—who is viewed as a failure by his wife and friends.

And not even the police are spared in this anime! Among its members, you can spot several social stereotypes, with Tōshirō Hijikata being the one who caught my attention the most, due to his habit of putting excessive amounts of mayonnaise on everything he eats (even his coffee).

They make references to characters from other anime, as well as from Hollywood TV shows and movies, so no one is spared from becoming part of Gintoki’s absurd world and Edo society.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVLW2KRa3oNQXn2CePwMY1wzuEWpqtMhpwTkeamQd1Ek/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0988818/mediaviewer/rm1748199425/?ref_=ttmi_mi_32_2)

It really is a completely absurd series, but very entertaining if you just want to kill some time. Plus, you can laugh at your daily problems, since many of them are portrayed in the show—from obsessions and phobias to frustrations or the anxiety men feel when they start going bald.

***

description.title: Surfeando la vida sin frustrarme 🌊 (Es/En)
description.body:
>

Feliz noche queridos amigos de Hive, es un privilegio tener la oportunidad de poder escribir en esta maravillosa comunidad sobre el tema pautado para esta semana. La verdad es la vida es un auténtico vaivén de olas de diversos tamaños y fuerza. He aquí una verdad fundamental, somos diminutos en comparación con el mar y sus imponentes olas, aún así, el no dejarnos intimidar por tsunamis y tormentas redundará en momentos aleccionadores para todos. Las olas de la vida es un gran tema para desarrollar pero sobretodo todo para reflexionar. Por aquí les dejo mi publicación y de corazón espero que sea de su agrado. Se les quiere muchísimo 🫂 >Good evening, dear friends of Hive. It is a privilege to have the opportunity to write to this wonderful community about this week’s topic. The truth is, life is a constant ebb and flow of waves of varying sizes and strength. Here is a fundamental truth: we are tiny compared to the sea and its imposing waves. Even so, not letting ourselves be intimidated by tsunamis and storms will lead to enlightening moments for everyone. The waves of life is a great topic to explore, but above all, one to reflect on. Here is my post, and I sincerely hope you enjoy it. I love you all very much 🫂

![1000357164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/23y8hWZTWaVyu5izojPztYBHxzAL6mf5oToEyQmi2PGsMAzbFREUHGeNsH2Av5auNgH4Z.jpg)
No es nada fácil mantener una buena coreografía triunfante en las diversas olas de la vida. Es cierto que cuando las podemos surfear sin desgastarnos es una victoria total, no obstante, hay momentos épicos que a pesar de darnos unas cuantas vueltas abruptas con la fuerza del mar nos dejan grandes enseñanzas. No es que quiera ensalzar esos mensajes momentos en los que perdemos el control al surfear una ola pero son los episodio que me han hecho poner los pies sobre la tierra. Es doloroso tener una sacudida o varias que te dejan sin poder respirar, sin embargo, es allí cuando la lección aprendida pesa y su valor es incalculable. Las olas de alegría y bienestar propician esa quietud que renueva fuerzas, además te hacen sonreír genuinamente con un corazón rebosante de felicidad. Esos momentos hay que tatuarlos en nuestra mente porque cuando llegan las olas de aprendizaje es muy difícil recordar aquellos momentos de sosiego, es más, debemos escribirlos y tener a mano esos apuntes para facilitar la búsqueda en aquellos instantes que las sacudidas del mar nos dejan aturdidos. >It’s no easy feat to maintain a smooth, triumphant rhythm through life’s various waves. It’s true that when we can ride them without getting worn down, it’s a total victory; however, there are epic moments when, despite the sea’s force tossing us around a few times, we come away with valuable lessons. It’s not that I want to glorify those moments when we lose control while riding a wave, but they are the episodes that have brought me back down to earth. It’s painful to take a hit—or several—that leave you gasping for breath; yet, that’s when the lesson learned carries real weight, and its value is immeasurable. >The waves of joy and well-being foster that stillness that renews our strength; they also make us smile genuinely, with a heart overflowing with happiness. We must etch those moments into our minds because when the waves of learning arrive, it’s very difficult to recall those moments of calm. In fact, we should write them down and keep those notes close at hand to make it easier to find them in those moments when the sea’s jolt leaves us dazed. ![1000934052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/EpGU4qbRefq4gpb62c7ec9f75E683WBrdKd1Uqrf3SzFkLV9ZVcSvECCnNtDzX9BkTs.jpg) El vaivén de las olas es la definición de cómo es el curso de la vida. En una época vamos inspirados, sintiendo que somos y estamos plenos y en otro momento nos adentramos al mar junto a sus peligros al ser arrastrados por una ola que viene de regreso. Sin importar a qué ritmo estemos en estos momentos, lo ideal es aprovechar cada circunstancia sin dejar de ver lo bueno y extraer la lección de vida que en ese momento nos toca comprender. No es tan sencillo como se escribe pero es la única forma de impedir que la frustración junto a la amargura se instalen en nuestras vidas y eviten que veamos todo lo bueno que hemos vivido al surfear olas bonitas anteriores y las que están por venir. >The ebb and flow of the waves is the very definition of life’s journey. At times we feel inspired, sensing that we are whole and fulfilled; at other times, we venture out into the sea alongside its dangers, swept away by a wave rolling back in. No matter what pace we’re at right now, the ideal is to make the most of every circumstance without losing sight of the good and to learn the life lesson that we need to understand at that moment. It’s not as simple as it sounds, but it’s the only way to prevent frustration and bitterness from taking root in our lives and keeping us from seeing all the good we’ve experienced while riding the beautiful waves of the past and those yet to come.
![1000928127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/Eos2DWmjUFbCUoawcLjqVrBazBXzVXWHgmVQkQgZ3wErneF3K5hGTdQrv6Pa8p5gvcB.jpg)
Cada día tomo mi tabla de surf para cazar la ola más imponente y deslizarme simplemente con su propia fuerza, al paso de ella sin interferir. Hay días maravillosos que traen consigo más de una situación gratificante y dulce como la miel que dejan una sensación de sosiego y me permite dormir plácidamente, por el contrario, hay días que son de continuo aprendizaje y como no todos asimilamos las cosas importantes al mismo tiempo, este aprendizaje puede durar días que producen cansancio y hasta insomnio. Sin importar el día en el que nos encontremos demos gracias porque al final del siempre tendremos ganancias porque todo suma en nuestra vida, se hecho, ya solo por respirar somos afortunados. Cada día de vida es un regalo. >Every day I grab my surfboard to catch the most majestic wave and simply glide along on its own power, riding it without interfering. There are wonderful days that bring more than one rewarding and honey-sweet moment, leaving a sense of calm and allowing me to sleep peacefully; on the other hand, there are days of continuous learning, and since we don’t all grasp the important things at the same time, this learning process can last for days, leading to exhaustion and even insomnia. No matter what kind of day we’re having, let’s give thanks because in the end we’ll always come out ahead—everything adds up in our lives. It’s a fact: just by breathing, we’re already fortunate. Every day of life is a gift.
![Lumii_20210913_003728286.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/23tRzfWtQTGgwsJDBaSjqoitu3aQBLPaupPCpXZ6HgBZc6BZ4nReszfTmrtdsJCnUdYmm.png)
![suma.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/abisag/23wCZGZdgEbnVLgVUCtwwe4ZwSsaqUtDkbeEiZ5qqRMLznULnXDwf3hQos2zAFWcxFcxJ.gif)
Todas las fotos son de mi propiedad tomadas con un Realme 7i. >All photos are my own and were taken with a Realme 7i.

description.title: When Sickness Meets Brokenness
description.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbPjQfs5bdGfXzre9QpvveJWZ3uxyLzDKS5GbAFJGAH6h/1000230888.png 

This is not the kind of post I will putting on the Blockchain, however I just have to let it out, perhaps it might relieves me a little. I am not feeling well, and at the same time, I am completely broke. 

This is not good to hear, but when you have no one reliable near you to share with, the virtual world becomes the next place to share your concerns.

I have been suffering from a back pain for a few months now and have been dealing with it by myself; one of those pains you have to endure as they really never make you stop. So you keep managing it with over-the-counter medicine, thinking it'll go away by itself. At times it even seems to have disappeared so I let myself think that things are normal again and I go back to my usual life without worrying that much about it.

But since two days ago, the pain came back with a  more painful feeling that I can no bare, and it is no longer just in my back, it has spread across the left side of my body, into my chest, down my leg, and even my arm feels weak at sometimes. Sitting is uncomfortable, walking is painful, and there is no position that truly feels like relief.

At this point it is clear that I need proper medical diagnosis and treatment, not just like I have been managing it following over the counter prescriptions. I need visit the specialist hospital where I could undergo a scan to understand what is happening.

And that is where the second problem begins.

I am broke.

And that reality makes everything heavier than it should be.

It is one thing to be sick and know you can get help, it is another thing entirely to be sick and start calculating how to even afford the help you need. Your mind does not rest because while your body is in pain, your thoughts are moving from one option to another, trying to figure out a way forward.

You begin to ask yourself questions you should not be asking in that condition, like whether you can manage it a little longer, whether the pain will reduce on its own, whether you can delay seeing a doctor, and deep down you already know that delay is not the right decision.

And that's the point I am right now.

And I'm feeling the pain, but I'm also feeling the pressure of being broke.

This is a hard place to be in when your body needs you and your pocket is telling you \

, but waiting is not always a good thing when your health is concerned. There are risks involved in waiting when it comes to health, and each movement that you make just reminds you that there is a problem, that something is not right, and that delay could also put you in danger.

It is one of the things about life that nobody really talks about because they would feel so awkward talking about it, and revealing that vulnerability about the situation when most people try to keep that a secret. There's no honor, or wisdom found in that at all, just a situation that puts you at odds with your own physical boundaries as well as your bank accounts all at the same time.

And all I'm trying to do now is to figure out a way to get what I need to get, and stop this condition from escalating. Because the risk of trying not to look for help has now been outweighed, and the risk of just wanting it to disappear is just not working anymore.

Because when the sickness meets brokenness, the pain is no longer just pain but pressure and need.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@thelastdash/when-sickness-meets-brokenness-kke)
