-----

## 1. NEWS

---

### ***Pełna historia włamania na Vercel: pracownik pobierał cheaty do Roblox i otworzył drogę do danych klientów***

Niebezpiecznik publikuje szczegółowe śledztwo wyjaśniające mechanizm włamania na platformę Vercel — o którym informowaliśmy wcześniej jako o potwierdzonym naruszeniu. Okazuje się, że punkt wejścia był absurdalnie przyziemny: pracownik firmy Contex.ai (dostawca SaaS dla Vercel) pobrał cheaty do gry Roblox zainfekowane infostealerem Lumma. To dało atakującym dostęp do infrastruktury Contex.ai i tokenów OAuth do kont ich klientów — w tym Vercel. Drugi pracownik po stronie Vercel kliknął w podejrzany link i dobrowolnie autoryzował OAuth, co pozwoliło atakującym wejść głębiej w systemy platformy. Sprawa jest doskonałą ilustracją, dlaczego zasada minimalnych uprawnień przy OAuth i dokładna weryfikacja dostawców SaaS są absolutnie kluczowe — bo twoje bezpieczeństwo zależy też od bezpieczeństwa programistów, których narzędzia używasz.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wByEXPy6iy8oe9WsMVsrLhdUiesQaJkXgWcFYMU6PSigruiGhCP7uy8Hmi6oE1rzjTm.png)

*Źródło: [Niebezpiecznik](https://niebezpiecznik.pl/post/zhackowali-ich-bo-pracownik-saas-z-ktorego-korzystali-pobral-cheaty-do-gier-czyli-dlaczego-trzeba-uwazac-na-oauth/) [PL] | [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/vercel-security-breach-third-party-attack-context-ai-lumma-stealer/) [EN]*

---

### ***NSA używa Claude Mythos Anthropic pomimo ryzyka supply chain związanego z kompromitacją axios***

Security Affairs ujawnia, że Agencja Bezpieczeństwa Narodowego USA (NSA) korzysta z modelu Claude Mythos firmy Anthropic w swoich operacjach wywiadowczych pomimo trwającego dochodzenia w sprawie kompromitacji biblioteki axios przez Koreę Północną — ataku, który dotknął sam Anthropic. NSA uznała, że korzyści operacyjne z używania Mythos przewyższają ryzyko supply chain. Ta decyzja wywołała dyskusję w środowisku bezpieczeństwa: jeśli nawet agencja wywiadowcza odpowiedzialna za bezpieczeństwo Stanów Zjednoczonych akceptuje tego rodzaju ryzyko, to wyraźnie świadczy o tym, jak dużą przewagę operacyjną daje ten model w wykrywaniu podatności i analizie zagrożeń. CyberScoop zauważa, że to fundamentalne pytanie o model zaufania: czy można ufać narzędziu AI, które mogło zostać dotknięte atakiem na łańcuch dostaw?

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tRv7NLb95wwgsaS7HnX84KdbfKY2awb8kKPh3VZfmRbzb27p9X8CzUYxWqjsjQqEtYP.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191087/ai/the-us-nsa-is-using-anthropics-claude-mythos-despite-supply-chain-risk.html) [EN] | [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/anthropic-mythos-vulnerability-discovery-op-ed/) [EN]*

---

### ***CISA dodaje nowe aktywnie eksploatowane podatności — Cisco, Kentico, Zimbra i inne***

SecurityWeek informuje, że CISA rozszerzyła katalog Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) o nowe aktywnie eksploatowane luki w produktach Cisco Catalyst, Kentico Xperience (popularny CMS), PaperCut, Synacor Zimbra i JetBrains TeamCity. Szczególnie niepokojąca jest podatność w Kentico Xperience — systemie CMS, który jest szeroko stosowany w instytucjach rządowych, mediach i sektorze e-commerce w Europie. TeamCity jest z kolei kluczowym narzędziem CI/CD — jego podatność może prowadzić do kompromitacji pipeline'ów dostarczania oprogramowania. Administratorzy korzystający z tych produktów powinni natychmiast wdrożyć dostępne łatki lub zastosować tymczasowe obejścia rekomendowane przez CISA.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tmRz8fwwmn8GX1phENtg2A8HaWU6ak7YitCNEq4ZCYWZc2whSuCTNS8o3A7375jhGnw.png)

*Źródło: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/organizations-warned-of-exploited-cisco-kentico-zimbra-vulnerabilities/) [EN]*

---

## 2. INCYDENTY

---

### ***Lazarus (Korea Północna) kradnie 290 milionów dolarów z platformy KelpDAO***

Security Affairs i Infosecurity Magazine potwierdzają, że za kradzieżą 290 milionów dolarów z platformy KelpDAO — zdecentralizowanego protokołu finansowego opartego na Ethereum — stoi północnokoreańska grupa Lazarus APT. To jedna z największych kradzieży kryptowalutowych w 2026 roku i kolejny akt w wieloletniej serii ataków Lazarusa na ekosystem DeFi, mający na celu finansowanie programu zbrojeniowego KRLD. Atakujący użyli kombinacji phishingu, exploitacji smart kontraktów i prania pieniędzy przez sieci miksujące transakcje. ONZ szacuje, że Lazarus ukradł ponad 3 miliardy dolarów w kryptowalutach od 2017 roku — finansując tym samym północnokoreański program rakietowy i nuklearny.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vsLA3urC149XAtaXDVGJJRthXmABDUUWWzorW2Yrh5gz1KdzVM3BB1TRckEBVVgh6L5.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191092/digital-id/north-koreas-lazarus-apt-stole-290m-from-kelp-dao.html) [EN] | [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/north-korean-blamed-290m-kelpdao/) [EN]*

---

### ***Wyciek z Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego: 200 tysięcy plików trafiło do darknetu***

Dobreprogramy opisują narastający zakres danych opublikowanych przez grupę Interlock po ataku ransomware na Wydział Zarządzania Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego. Na stronach grupy w darknecie pojawiło się łącznie ponad 200 tysięcy plików. Wśród ujawnionych materiałów znajdują się nie tylko dane osobowe pracowników i studentów, ale też dokumenty wewnętrzne, umowy i korespondencja uczelni. Skala wycieku rośnie — a UW wciąż nie wydał wyczerpującego komunikatu tłumaczącego zakres naruszenia i plan działania wobec osób, których dane zostały opublikowane. Osoby powiązane z UW powinny zachować wzmożoną czujność wobec wszelkich kontaktów i wiadomości, które mogą się powołać na dane z wycieku.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23yJ8Du2stPymxBaqmUFj9Hy32ADNxfB6busrDBPJECco5FQMpzFwHTJkCdFLSBJZGg8f.png)

*Źródło: [Dobreprogramy](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/200-tys-plikow-w-darknecie-wyciek-z-uniwersytetu-warszawskiego-niepokoi,7277763000256864a) [PL]*

---

### ***Atak hakerski na francuski system dokumentów tożsamości ANTS — możliwy wyciek danych***

Security Affairs opisuje cyberatak na witrynę ANTS (Agence Nationale des Titres Sécurisés) — francuskiej agencji zarządzającej bezpiecznymi dokumentami tożsamości, w tym paszportami i prawami jazdy. System obsługuje miliony Francuzów składających wnioski o dokumenty tożsamości. Trwa weryfikacja, czy doszło do wycieku danych osobowych wnioskodawców. Atak na ANTS jest szczególnie wrażliwy, bo zgromadzone tam dane zawierają informacje biometryczne, skany dokumentów i adresy zamieszkania — dane, których skradzienie ma konsekwencje znacznie poważniejsze niż typowy wyciek hasła.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/EoJz5MxM3Q8E1hyBgQdMaZocnMBgR7mc4wineSdjrqXsrXhAu7ADcTmDxosgxrDY6rW.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191069/data-breach/frances-ants-id-system-website-hit-by-cyberattack-possible-data-breach.html) [EN]*

---

## 3. CIEKAWOSTKI

---

### ***Ataki ClickFix na macOS ewoluują: nowe kampanie dostarczają złodzieje danych napisane w AppleScript***

The Register opisuje nową falę ataków ClickFix na macOS, które zamiast tradycyjnych skryptów bash lub programów wykonywalnych dostarczają złośliwy kod napisany w AppleScript — natywnym języku automatyzacji macOS. AppleScript jest wyjątkowo groźnym wektorem, bo ma głęboki dostęp do aplikacji systemowych (Keychain, Safari, Mail) i jest powszechnie używany przez legalne automatyzacje, co utrudnia jego wykrycie. Nowe warianty infostealerów napisanych w AppleScript kradną hasła z Keychain, tokeny z przeglądarek i klucze SSH. Apple wprowadziło ostatnio ostrzeżenia przy wklejaniu komend do terminala — ale AppleScript może być uruchomiony bez terminala.

*Źródło: [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/2026/04/21/macos_clickfix_attacks_deliver_applescript/) [EN]*

---

### ***Korea Północna (Void Dokkaebi) wciąga programistów przez fałszywe rekrutacje i infekuje przez repozytoria kodu***

Trend Micro opisuje aktywną kampanię grupy Void Dokkaebi powiązanej z Koreą Północną, w której hakerzy podszywają się pod rekruterów technicznych i zapraszają programistów na „rozmowy kwalifikacyjne online\

z GitHuba lub innego repozytorium — który jest faktycznie złośliwym pakietem instalującym malware. Kampania dotykała szczególnie deweloperów blockchain, DeFi i AI, bo ich konta i dostępy mają szczególną wartość dla państwa, które systematycznie finansuje swój program zbrojeniowy kradzieżami kryptowalut. Nigdy nie uruchamiaj kodu pobranego w ramach procesu rekrutacyjnego bez wcześniejszej dokładnej weryfikacji w środowisku izolowanym (sandbox lub VM).

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xVgMvYATbovNqZzocMrzVvvex76q99RtGBy6cEoeL5qqwVckm8XX5A5G8LAaD16ydyJ.png)

*Źródło: [Trend Micro](https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/26/d/void-dokkaebi-uses-fake-job-interview-lure-to-spread-malware-via-code-repositories.html) [EN]*

---

### ***Platforma Bluesky atakowana przez 24 godziny atakiem DDoS — proirańska grupa przypisuje sobie odpowiedzialność***

Security Affairs opisuje 24-godzinny atak DDoS na platformę Bluesky — alternatywną sieć społecznościową, która zyskała popularność jako open-source'owa alternatywa dla X/Twittera. Proirańska grupa hacktywistyczna przypisała sobie odpowiedzialność za atak, uzasadniając go polityką Bluesky w zakresie moderacji treści. Bluesky, choć mniejsze od głównych platform, jest coraz bardziej popularne wśród dziennikarzy, badaczy i środowisk opozycyjnych z krajów o ograniczonej wolności słowa — co czyni je atrakcyjnym celem dla grup działających w interesie autorytarnych reżimów. Atak DDoS jako narzędzie cenzurowania alternatywnych platform jest coraz częstszym trendem.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wMyxw4LLz76pk2BvRTk46JLWLcLwjpqmJULZW6hwUkSuDbBC53W9wfZcnF4ikdUdTsk.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191059/security/bluesky-hit-by-24-hour-ddos-attack-as-pro-iran-group-claims-responsibility.html) [EN]*

---

## 4. OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

---

### ***CERT Polska: nowa fala phishingu z fałszywymi powiadomieniami o zwrocie podatku przed końcem rozliczeń***

CERT Polska (moje.cert.pl) ostrzega przed nasiloną kampanią phishingową, która zbiegła się z końcem okresu składania zeznań podatkowych. Oszuści rozsyłają e-maile podszywające się pod Krajową Administrację Skarbową, informujące o rzekomym zwrocie podatku — z linkiem do fałszywej strony imitującej Platformę Usług Elektronicznych Skarbowo-Celnych (e-Urząd Skarbowy). Na fałszywej stronie zbierany jest PESEL, dane osobowe i dane karty płatniczej. Schemat jest szczególnie skuteczny teraz, bo sezon rozliczeniowy to jedyny czas w roku, gdy komunikat „masz zwrot podatku\
. Ofiara widzi prawdziwy e-mail z domeny apple.com, a następnie kontaktuje się z rzekomą linią wsparcia z numeru podanego w towarzyszących materiałach. „Konsultant\

kont przez nadawanie im historii aktywności, aż po skoordynowane amplifikowanie narracji pożądanych przez Kreml. To kolejne zatrzymanie w ramach ukraińskiej kampanii przeciwko cybernetycznym operacjom wpływu prowadzonym na zlecenie Rosji.

![obraz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23x14eKhEuzfHHigCjBDYVSEVkt6b5LqsPNwV57L1wKxQpttAHSghjHQTUwEu3d5zGz9j.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/wojna-w-ukrainie/prorosyjska-farma-botow-rozbita-zatrzymano-jej-tworce) [PL]*

---

### ***Andriej Manojło: rosyjski profesor, który zarządza operacjami wpływu dla Kremla***

CyberDefence24 publikuje szczegółową analizę sylwetki Andrieja Manojły — rosyjskiego profesora nauk politycznych i rzeczywistego architekta wielu operacji dezinformacyjnych prowadzonych przez rosyjskie służby. body.title: POWERUP OR CASH OUT- 80/20 HP MY OWN STRATEGY
body.body:
When I joined hive my local guide made me to know little things I need to know about hive and as i progressed and journey here, i have come to know and learn more about hive; benefits of powering up, the reward, curation and other things, even though am still learning everyday because hive is like a school of education. Learning never stops except you quite learning. So this week's contest topic has always been in front of me daily, if i should just power up all my liquid hive or if I should split it into two, Power up some and keep some for liquid hive and Hbd or cash it out for an exchange. After thinking and digesting on it, i have come to do it this way and here is my reason.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZpQ7gfX2y5Seb3wtGU8UXJKGSu35oeqt3k45opaA6oE/1776809551769.avif)

My strategy is to split it  80/20, that's to say i will Power up 80% and keep 20% as HBD, this is not constant because I might change the equation based on if I earn more or if I earn low. That is to say when I have reached my optimal level, i might decides to split it 50/50 inorder to enjoy my rewards more and when the journey is going bad i might go as far as  99/1 to adjust.

 I have come to know in my 7months experience  here on Hive Blockchain, that the more you Power up the more one get influential on the platform, the quality of your power up also determines the weight of your upvote and also your curation rewards. Powering up and having a quality HP will also attract and  make big curators to notice me even more and some communities as well. Also powering up will remains me that am not quitting hive any time soon and that i pin here no leave no transfer. Poweing up helps to builds my account, so if i have a good quality account it will pay continually and if I Power up constantly for aleast 3 years and not for once powered down, will it worth the time spent to build it? After all I have to put more effort to workhard, post and engage inorder to build and grow my hive, even though now value of hive is discouraging.

Am I going to cash out? Yes I will cash out, like as I said earlier i will keep 20% as HBD and that I won't just power up all my reward to HP but keep some of rewards to be HBD should incase I have some personal needs, i will cash it out and I from there sort out my problem. My data subscription will always come from my hbd so that can keep running and creating because data is not free here in Nigeria. If I don't work, i will earn nothing. My aim it's to build my hive and use it settle things when life happens.

I have come to know that cashing out will feed me today but powering up will rather feeds me for years, but while doing so i don't I need to be hungry and not satisfy my personal needs as I achieve that.

So friends are you going to powerup or cash and how will you split yours and whats your Idea for splitting it.

body.title: One girl with two outfits for her birthday - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wgWfkdmcciqNCojSCJB2ffG3426YVhUSx3Vvw4GMKZGvK9itkx7WS5QfQYnQXpAMqsG.jpg)
Today I am back with a new set of photographs that I took in my new studio, this time for a girl who hired my services because she wanted to have a photo session for her birthday, we coordinated a day and a time and we made her request come true. We started with a couple of full body photos, I put a tall cube on the set so the girl would have somewhere to lean on and wouldn't be nervous without knowing what to do with her hands.
  Hoy estoy de vuelta con un nuevo set de fotografias que tomé en mi nuevo estudio, en esta ocasion para una chica que contrató mis servicios porque queria hacer una sesion de fotos por su cumpleaños, coordinamos un dia y una hora y hicimos realidad su peticion. Empezamos por un par de fotos a cuerpo completo, puse un cubo alto en el set para que la chica tuviera donde apoyarse y no estuviera nerviosa sin saber que hacer con sus manos:  
![IMG_4388.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EoAdBGf8GMUxnJPQzbnMw2EPKesDus5cNBNteotPb2fJjgQqi49cQWoQEKsiKBhKSU3.jpg)
She had brought some glasses so she wanted to put them on and take a photo there with the glasses too.
  Ella habia llevado unos lentes asi que quiso ponerselos y hacer una foto allí con los lentes tambien:  
![IMG_4393.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/Eo8Veyvbdg35Xe8pK1Nfs5t5aoJUNEdfP1r3HX7DqjM3Q8pQU9YW2gaYru8CQcdjn9Y.jpg)
Then I told her to lean on the cube to vary the pose a bit and we took these photos.
  Luego le dije que se apoyara en el cubo para variar un poco la pose y hicimos estas fotos:

</liketuimages>

Aprovechando que estoy de vacaciones de la universidad, hoy quise darle un giro a mi rutina. Aunque extrañé la energía de mi equipo, me fui sola al parque para enfrentar unas series de 400 metros que tenía tiempo sin hacer. No les miento: retomar esa velocidad fue un golpe de realidad, pero lo que más me sorprendió no fue el cansancio en las piernas, sino el esfuerzo del corazón.
​Por primera vez, mi reloj marcó mis pulsaciones máximas. Fue un reto total controlar la respiración mientras sentía el pecho a mil. Además, el solazo de la mañana fue el protagonista. Elegí esa hora a propósito porque en mis últimos fondos dominicales el calor me ha pasado factura, y necesitaba entrenar esa resistencia térmica. Correr bajo ese sol intenso, buscando que mi cuerpo aprenda a gestionar el esfuerzo cuando el clima no perdona, fue una prueba mental durísima.
​Terminar cada serie fue una pequeña victoria. Aunque me faltó el empuje de mi grupo, este entrenamiento en solitario me sirvió para conocer mis límites y entender cómo reacciona mi cuerpo bajo presión extrema. Sé que estos kilómetros sufridos, con el pulso a tope y el sol quemando, son los que realmente me harán fuerte para lo que viene. ¡Seguimos sumando!

狗是人类最忠诚的伙伴，它们用无条件的爱和陪伴温暖着我们的生活。每次看到狗摇着尾巴、兴奋地迎接我回家，心中总是充满了快乐和感动。与狗一起散步，享受阳光和大自然，仿佛所有的烦恼都被抛在了一边。它们不仅是宠物，更是我们生活中不可或缺的朋友。

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 20 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/793b4d8e-bf8e-4926-90ba-aea5513588ca.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Yesterday weather was great, sunny and chilly. So we made sure to start our daily walk a little earlier than usual. We passed by Le Chat relaxing in the dog bed. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f74ce11a-3a0f-48e3-89f6-d13dff8858a8.jpg) And went directly to the small forest behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c433ea3b-d109-40c9-9904-9d30f6bb36d2.jpg) Kaia started as often with some obstacles jumping. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ec65d8d7-7ae7-4139-a246-351845590e35.jpg) And of course we went deeper into the forest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bd95923b-fdbd-4d33-9573-2eb245cc8f09.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/578a02a5-dabd-417c-834c-cf403c696dd9.jpg) Kaia detected something. Like I probably said already, it's funny to me how she (and most dogs with ears up) can orient their ears separately to catch noises in all directions. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bc6300a0-a532-4de1-bfd6-74b7f21fa42e.jpg) It was Le Chat that was on her radar. She quickly ran back to her. She even yelled/yawned at her, but Le Chat stayed near the edge of the forest again, just munching on grass. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/011272b8-d5db-46ce-8556-7e837a74df17.jpg) And that's why we went to the bigger forest next. On a beautiful day like that, of course we did! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/918a8ac4-42e5-4815-a278-57b903138a21.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e5a6afb2-6298-41a4-84d0-3648128cdf90.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3b2a386f-886d-4342-835a-9946b691a991.jpg) A little bit of modeling for Kaia. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0acf6167-0a35-4721-81b4-fc5ff74d055d.jpg) We caught the sunset at one of favorite spots of course. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fb973105-0e48-41fd-93c6-8eff86afa2cf.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/edc559bf-4ce8-4c61-a76c-a1f8b700a185.jpg) And again, the same loop in the forest we take almost every day, to get us on our way back. I like this painted tree, especially with the sun in the background. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5082e54d-b934-48a9-b832-aea6d1dc5902.jpg) Final step count was pretty good. It was a bit of a special day for me and I knew I'd get several phone calls, especially from back home. And for me, that means lots of pacing, hence the higher step count. Still going strong in the #poprzeczka competition in April. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260421t220918704z)_

body.title: My shopping day
body.body:
Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well. Alhamdulillah, today I have come to you with one of my shopping trips. I hope you are with me, and I would love to share a full part of my day with you. Let's get started.

![a4af42c3-876d-4660-87f1-bbd253e0c2fe.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedhGEpLjDRnbXGPHcH16ZZHVaeniqkoS6XkiZmDYNf9K/a4af42c3-876d-4660-87f1-bbd253e0c2fe.jpg)

In the morning, I woke up and saw that there were NOT too many vegetables in my fridge. Although there was fish and meat, I needed some vegetables. So in the morning, I took my son to school, and after finishing school, my son, my husband, and I all went to the market. First, we entered the vegetable market, and when I went there, I saw a lot of fresh vegetables. My mind and eyes were filled with joy.

![d4f48baf-5e30-42d4-8074-2744b33628b5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSDjkTREYxLVXxwfeeHb7YPELrR444KCkh9QZWygriJTP/d4f48baf-5e30-42d4-8074-2744b33628b5.jpg)

To get the white vegetables, you definitely need to go to the market early in the morning, as vegetables are not very good at night or in the afternoon, so we definitely tried to go to the market early. I went to the market around eleven o'clock and saw all kinds of fresh vegetables. There was a shop we knew here, and I tried to buy all kinds of things there.

![dfb02b16-b8aa-47c1-a397-7e77581f1b60.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNPHaoZuZqmmZXKQA16KiQ6yv87QaUNFcLJrDbKrkvTm/dfb02b16-b8aa-47c1-a397-7e77581f1b60.jpg)

Here I needed some vegetables like eggplant, eggplant, tomatoes, carrots, a big gourd, onion, and green chillies. I bought various types of vegetables from the shop next door, and a little further ahead, I bought a big watermelon. I got everything very well. I liked it very much.

![edf3d779-3a66-407c-99b6-dab216e44272.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJFMYBGMhGj45kHKwwWnH3xLF8cQMRF5K9YWMxqrB6o1/edf3d779-3a66-407c-99b6-dab216e44272.jpg)

But anyway, I felt very good and happy to have completed my shopping, and after doing all this shopping I didn't need to stay in the market anymore, so I took a rickshaw again to come home and when I got home on time I packaged each vegetable well and put it in the fridge so that it would last me for a whole week. I will definitely see you in a new post like today. May Allah Hafez

body.title: Convirtiendo tu Entorno en un Oasis de Paz
body.body:
<div class='text-justify'>

<center>https://pictureserver.net/pic_storage/pic/92/ba/undef_src_sa_picid_982787_x_1000_type_whitesh_image.webp?ver=3</center>
<center>[Fuente](https://www.beliani.es/sillon-giratorio-de-boucle-beige-dalby.html)</center>

Nuestra mente es un reflejo del espacio que habitamos. Si entramos en una habitación desordenada, ruidosa o con luz artificial muy fuerte, nuestro sistema nervioso se pone en alerta. Por el contrario, un hogar que invita a la calma puede reducir nuestros niveles de cortisol de forma inmediata. No necesitas hacer una gran reforma; se trata de aplicar pequeños cambios sensoriales que le digan a tu cerebro: \

.

# Los 3 Pilares de un Hogar Sereno
#### El Poder del Orden Visual: 
El exceso de objetos a la vista genera \

en el cerebro. Dedica 10 minutos al día a despejar una superficie (la mesa del comedor o tu mesita de noche). Ver espacios despejados ayuda a que la mente se sienta menos saturada.

#### La Magia de la Iluminación: 
La luz blanca intensa es ideal para trabajar, pero enemiga de la relajación. Al caer la tarde, opta por luces cálidas o lámparas pequeñas. La luz suave le indica a tu cuerpo que es hora de empezar a producir melatonina y prepararse para el descanso.

####  Naturaleza en el Interior: 
Tener una planta cerca o simplemente abrir las ventanas para que circule el aire fresco cambia la energía de una habitación. El contacto visual con el color verde y la ventilación natural son tranquilizantes biológicos comprobados.

# Crea tu \

Elige un lugar de tu casa —un sillón, un rincón con luz natural o incluso tu cama— y decláralo tu Santuario Personal. Que sea un lugar libre de móviles y noticias, reservado solo para leer, respirar o simplemente estar en silencio. Al asociar ese espacio físico con la relajación, tu cuerpo empezará a calmarse automáticamente nada más sentarte en él. # ¡Final de nuestra serie de la Calma! Hemos aprendido a respirar, a estar presentes y a proteger nuestro entorno. Ahora que nuestra mente está en equilibrio, ¿Qué nuevo tema te gustaría que exploráramos a partir de nuestra próxima serie? ***1) Tecnología para la Vida: Guía práctica para perderle el miedo al móvil y usar apps que nos mantengan conectados y entretenidos.*** ***2) El Poder de la Curiosidad: Una serie sobre hobbies y aprendizaje en la madurez para mantener el cerebro joven y motivado.*** _¡Escribe tu opción en los comentarios y sigamos creciendo juntos!_

body.title: Visitamos Shambhala Beach Bar & Restaurant en Ko Chang [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>

Hola a todos! cuando nos cambiamos de hospedaje en la isla Ko Chang (Tailandia), fuímos a quedarnos en unas villas (les haré la reseña muy pronto de estas) que quedaban muy cerca de [Shambhala Beach Bar & Restaurant]([//]:# (!worldmappin 12.13676 lat 102.26841 long  d3scr)), un lugar muy bonito donde comímos delicioso, que además está ubicado frente al mar y donde tuvimos una atención maravillosa pero abajo les cuento más. 

>Hi everyone! When we switched accommodations on Ko Chang Island (Thailand), we stayed at some villas (I’ll review them very soon) that were very close to [Shambhala Beach Bar & Restaurant] ([//]:# (!worldmappin 12.13676 lat 102.26841 long  d3scr)), a very beautiful place where we had a delicious meal. It’s also right on the beach, and the service was wonderful—but I’ll tell you more about that below. 





![photo_2026-04-21_23-29-34.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYqTziaMwNpLnQUnqtuokHaEdSpw8WtVo663Luc1TK6Qz/photo_2026-04-21_23-29-34.jpg)


![photo_2026-04-21_23-08-59.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXGuxETZAboivktiNLuKAvgTNDPJpxoujnQmsNzrfy7ut/photo_2026-04-21_23-08-59.jpg)

Llegamos allí y lo que hicimos primero fue echarle un vistazo a todo el lugar, el cual les cuento que tiene una gran piscina y un bar afuera, además de una mesa para jugar billar. Luego decidimos entrar y una chica nos atendió muy amablemente dándonos el menú, el cual les cuento es variado entre pizzas, pasta, comida tailandesa, sopa, parrillas y algunas entradas o snacks, además de bebidas y postres, y creo que su concepto es platos saludables o más saludables que en otros lugares, pues lo digo porque ordenamos unas papas fritas y estan eran sin aceite. 

>When we got there, the first thing we did was take a look around the place, which, I’ll tell you, has a large pool and an outdoor bar, as well as a pool table. Then we decided to go inside, and a girl served us very kindly, giving us the menu, which, I’ll tell you, offers a variety of options including pizzas, pasta, Thai food, soup, grilled dishes, and some appetizers or snacks, as well as drinks and desserts. I think their concept is to serve healthy dishes—or at least healthier ones than at other places—because when we ordered some french fries, they were made without oil. 



<div class=\

> ![photo_2026-04-21_23-09-08.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSXpUUdRK5Wq7eah7ggSw8CZzDEV7p9kRWjPZTofjwqRu/photo_2026-04-21_23-09-08.jpg) Además de las papas fritas, también ordenamos una pizza y una pasta a la boloñesa para compartir, y para beber 3 jugos de naranja y mientras nos traían todo, Olivia y yo fuímos a dar otro vistazo rápido a la playa y la verdad se veía genial aunque bastante tranquila, pero me encantaba las palmeras allí y que hay muchas tumbonas para relajarse cerca de la piscina, también tenían un columpio. >In addition to the french fries, we also ordered a pizza and a plate of pasta Bolognese to share, along with three glasses of orange juice. While we were waiting for our food to arrive, Olivia and I went to take another quick look at the beach. It actually looked great, even though it was pretty quiet, but I loved the palm trees there and the fact that there were lots of lounge chairs for relaxing by the pool; they even had a swing. ![photo_2026-04-21_23-09-10.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPfZFuNUnUqptKWWniHGS7vig3qS5Av7YNaMdKhvN7EWc/photo_2026-04-21_23-09-10.jpg)

> ![photo_2026-04-21_23-09-04.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7CipQm4BL4dmFLfS1JmDHibxgvNrZDxK5tcGLE2TpW1/photo_2026-04-21_23-09-04.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-21_23-09-05.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQdmqce8cFvrFYYWsU93NVcf8EW7kBhsA4LaxADZ8XvyF/photo_2026-04-21_23-09-05.jpg) Volvimos a la mesa y poco después ya estaban nuestros platos allí, es decir no tardaron mucho tiempo y les cuento que todo estaba delicioso, la pizza suave, la pasta muy sabrosa y las papas ricas también, así que claro que terminamos comiendo todo. Los precios me parecieron bastante bien también y las porciones también, así que sin duda alguna pasamos un momento muy agradable allí, nos relajamos ya que era un un lugar muy cómodo con música e iluminación adecuados y comimos delicioso, por lo que lo recomiendo, a nosotros nos encantó, y como les dije antes la atención también fue muy buena. >We went back to our table, and shortly after, our food was already there—it didn’t take long at all. I have to tell you, everything was delicious: the pizza was light, the pasta was very flavorful, and the potatoes were tasty too, so of course we ended up eating everything. I thought the prices were pretty good too, and the portions were generous, so without a doubt we had a very pleasant time there. We relaxed because it was a very comfortable place with just the right music and lighting, and the food was delicious, so I recommend it—we loved it—and as I mentioned before, the service was also very good.

> ![photo_2026-04-21_23-09-28.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPSr8yTgsbnHZUA1hctu1wMzCd8a7sjC9EZGqi6vpBTir/photo_2026-04-21_23-09-28.jpg)

body.title: 30 Seconds to Mars: In constant metamorphosis of my favorites and my #TTT【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
body.body:
> 

  Saludos, amantes de la música que dan vida a #Music.Hoy es martes y el cuerpo lo sabe, un día especial para compartir con ustedes aprovechando la iniciativa de #TTT propuesta por @ablaze donde cada martes nos recomendamos buena música. En esta ocasión quiero recomendar una de mis muchas favoritas de **Thirty Seconds To Mars**, un grupo de rock que desde que salió me encantó y desde entonces he escuchado todos sus discos.


>   Greetings, music lovers who bring #Music to life. Today is Tuesday, and I know it! A special day to share with you, taking advantage of the #TTT initiative proposed by @ablaze, where every Tuesday we recommend great music. This time, I want to recommend one of my many favorites from Thirty Seconds to Mars, a rock band that I loved from the moment they appeared, and I've listened to all their albums since.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>



<center>![482323410_1193988072091003_3371668575105027820_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Ep7tZT3oE5ch4k8Bajnm2dR9xEEGeKsPS5MpC5zMbZznZjbsDJHKSnHQdoruCiPpGKX.jpg)</center>



<div class=\

> Este grupo lo empecé a escuchar en el 2002, cuando lanzaron su segundo álbum y fue el que los catapultó a la fama. Se hicieron tan famosos con sus hits como The Kill, Beautiful Lie y From Yesterday que en Mtv no dejaban de pasar sus videos.
>\n\nI started listening to this group in 2002, when they released their second album, which catapulted them to fame. They became so popular with hits like \
that MTV played their videos constantly.

> Recuerdo que muchos me decían que ellos eran Emos o Góticos, pero nada que ver, sólo porque Jared Leto usaba delineador negro y un flequillo medio extraño que le tapaba un poco el rostro ya los etiquetaban de esta manera.

> I remember many people telling me they were Emos or Goths, but it was nothing like that, just because Jared Leto wore black eyeliner and a kind of strange fringe that covered his face a bit they labeled them that way.
> Para mí era un grupo de Rock alternativo bastante bueno, inusual y con un estilo que atrapaba. Era diferente a Linkin Park y a Evanescence, tenían su propia marca o sello personal.

> For me, they were a pretty good alternative rock band, unusual and with a captivating style. They were different from Linkin Park and Evanescence; they had their own unique brand or signature sound.

> Actualmente de ellos se siguen diciendo muchas cosas, creo que la gente nunca dejará de hablar de ellos. Hasta los han acusado o cuestionado de tener su propia secta religiosa musical, pero ya esto sería tema para otro post.

> Many things are still being said about them today; I think people will never stop talking about them. They've even been accused or questioned about having their own musical religious sect, but that's a topic for another post.

> Sus creencias religiosas o lo que quieran hacer para ganar dinero no es mi problema mientras sigan haciendo buena música y hoy en día su estilo ha evolucionado tanto, pero mantiene esa esencia con la que empezaron. Ahorita su música se inclina más al pop que al rock y pues me gustaría que volvieran a sus viejas andanzas rockeras.

> Their religious beliefs or what they do to make money isn't my problem as long as they keep making good music. Their style has evolved so much these days, but it still maintains that essence they started with. Right now, their music leans more towards pop than rock, and I'd like them to go back to their old rock roots. ---

> Tengo muchas favoritas de este grupo, sobre todo de su segundo álbum en adelante. De este último disco que han sacado la canción que más me ha gustado es **Life is Beautiful**, más que todo por su letra, no tanto por el ritmo.

> I have many favorite songs from this group, especially from their second album onward. From their latest album, my favorite song is **Life is Beautiful**, mainly because of the lyrics, not so much the rhythm. ---

> **Hurricane**. Esta canción marcó una etapa importante de mi vida. Su letra habla de un amor tóxico y créanme, he tenido tantos que ya perdí la cuenta, creo que en algún momento se la dediqué a alguien que no me quería realmente, al igual que **The Kill**.

> **Hurricane**. This song marked an important stage in my life. Its lyrics speak of a toxic love, and believe me, I've had so many I've lost count. I think at some point I dedicated it to someone who didn't really love me, just like **The Kill**. ---
> Esta canción es una obra maestra, por su ritmo, su letra, simplemente la mejor de su disco a mi parecer. Es mi favorita de favoritas.
> This song is a masterpiece, for its rhythm, its lyrics; simply the best on the album in my opinion. It's my absolute favorite.
> Este es un grupo que haga lo que haga, da de qué hablar entre sus fans o sus haters, yo por mi parte soy team fan, ¿y ustedes? Espero que les haya gustado mi #TTT.
> This is a group that, whatever they do, always gets people talking, whether they're fans or haters. I'm definitely a fan. What about you? I hope you enjoyed my #TTT.

>

body.body:

body.title: La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla | The Wave – I’m the one with the board and the determination to master it
body.body:
![La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xp4Bzraxb6q7Th68MF7uxkNhT56mG5VNYN5JhVYKGTbhuU7yawFY9Z6B7hJiT9mpdYB.jpg)


<div class=\

>

En Español

Saludos a todos, amigos de la comunidad de #EmpowerTalent , con el tema que nos traen cada semana, especialmente con nuestra querida @angelica7 , para invitarnos a escribir sobre: \

, a imaginar la vida como las olas, y que tomen el término como inspiración para sus escritos. ¿Qué les parece si imaginan que son surfistas de la vida? ¿Cómo sería su tabla? ¿Cómo harían para mantenerse en equilibrio? ¿Cuántas veces intentarían enfrentarse a las grandes olas? ¿Creen que el miedo los puede paralizar? ¿Cómo sería una vida sin olas en el mar?, a continuación mi participación: Creo que a todos como personas en algún momento nos toca hacer lo que nos dicen, lo que sí es un poco difícil, es que otros decidan por nosotras, porque después de todo, nadie puede decidir lo que nos conviene, aun así sea que nos equivoquemos en alguna decisión.

Aprender a surfear

Si imagino que la vida es el océano, y soy yo misma quien decide qué ola remar, debo tener en cuenta que para aprender a surfear necesito el equipo adecuado y sobre todo, la mentalidad correcta. Por ejemplo, el material de la tabla depende del nivel de lo que tengo en mi interior, debe ser de un material resistente, que flote sobre la adversidad pero sea lo suficientemente sólido para darme el equilibrio, para mantenerme humilde y conectada con la realidad, ya que si me creo demasiado grande, el viento me tirará; si me encojo demasiado, perderé. Si tenemos la gran capacidad de superar muchas cosas y crecernos ante eventos duros de la vida, porque nadie más que nosotras sabemos bien cómo funciona el mecanismo para ser cada día más optimistas, positivas, pues la vida me va a dar sacudidas, si me encuentro rígida, me rompo, contrario a si fluyo con el movimiento del agua, es posible absorber el impacto. ![La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla (gif).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23yJJYZrKzAtCQkw5ydAMw4HWirWdj7y5KWdukq9pVY8n1owGNbnJRZjRHSBZGF7AszYy.gif)

Evitar desgastar mis fuerzas en olas pequeñas

Cuando puedo enfrentarme a las grandes olas, tantas veces como sea capaz de volver a remar mar adentro, ese límite lo pongo en mi capacidad de recuperar el aliento, así que debo mirar hacia la orilla o hacia la parte de la ola que quiero conquistar, porque cada una de nosotras tiene una poderosa arma en las manos: el amor, la sencillez y la fortaleza. En particular, hace ya más de un año junto con mi hija, nos enfrentamos a un nuevo reto, al mudarme de una ciudad a otra, con todos los trámites necesarios en cuanto al papeleo, de vender primero para después poder adquirir nuestra nueva casa. También en cada etapa vivida, las mudanzas, cambiar de trabajo, superar una ruptura amorosa, la verdad es que son situaciones que requiere de energía, así como evitar desgastar mis fuerzas en olas pequeñas que no me llevan a ningún lado. Percibir que el tiempo se me pasa en frente esperando por pequeños momentos que tal vez no me llenen como lo esperaba y así mientras espero que la vida sea color rosa, me pierdo la aventura de acertar y equivocarme, de reír y llorar, de soñar y vivir y hasta de sentir que me estoy perdiendo de la gran oportunidad de estar viva.

La sal de nuestras lágrimas

No quiere decir esto que en un momento determinado de la vida no sintamos dolor, tristezas o nostalgias, pero de cada circunstancia podremos sacar lo mejor y más positivo para fortalecernos y decir que la lucha continúa y las conquistas son nuestras. Puede que la vida no sea perfecta y no resulte como lo esperamos, puede que haya muchos tropiezos y a veces nos sintamos impotente, pero cuando lleguemos a esta situación dolorosa, sabremos que nadie nos dirigió hacia ahí engañándonos y diciéndonos que jamás tendríamos porqué llorar. Por el contrario, sabremos que la sal de nuestras lágrimas le dará un mejor sabor a nuestros éxitos, que la vida nos premia con todo lo que nos hace sentir bien, más aún al final del día, el mejor surfista no es el que hace las maniobras más extremas, sino el que más se está divirtiendo en el agua y son miles de cosas que podemos hacer y aprender cada día. ![La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23zkk44neYayACc8HPgm9rHaoBYpQvunGp5nZieYieRvDh1KFwDJdrRWWtNQruWqeZVNa.jpg)

La voluntad de dominar el oleaje

Entonces si hoy estoy remando para entrar en una ola, o estoy atrapada intentando salir a flote, es clave evitar pensamientos de miedo que llegan a quererme paralizar. Un ejemplo es cuando disfruto de cada iniciativa que nos invitan a escribir en esta comunidad, al leer y documentarme con nuevos aprendizajes, tan necesarios para fortalecer mi talento. De todos modos, aunque el océano sea inmenso y a veces me llene de temor, soy yo quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominar el oleaje; manteniendo los brazos fuertes, la respiración tranquila y la mirada siempre en ese horizonte donde se está formando mi próxima gran aventura, que puede llevarme a la cresta de la ola. Creo firmemente que con la fe puesta en Dios, me ayudará a enfrentar las olas de la vida, los retos y dificultades, con resiliencia, aceptando lo que no puedo cambiar, con la adaptación a los nuevos cambios y aunque no puedo detener las olas ante un mar impredecible, sé que no estoy aquí en esta vida para dominar el océano, pero puedo aprender a surfear y navegar ante las adversidades. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa y al encuentro de Talentos, deben hacer [Click aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-la-ola). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeZeEupfP2Ys5Yin2yB3q4qodjysvQmFQzzqVuENLu9c4LfDp9pEG4suGmVQVhofzs.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. Las fotografías en mi galería tomadas de mi teléfono Honor Magic6 y editadas en canva Traducido con www.DeepL.com/Translator (versión gratuita) ![La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xp4BzrZXMTjGmCmvnAPAoAPJCBro1ErBABz2QwTgmuoktKFZQRHrFKLZu4y5uZrtafT.jpg)

In English

Greetings to everyone in the #EmpowerTalent community! With the theme you bring us each week – especially our dear @angelica7 – inviting us to write about: “The Wave”, to imagine life as waves, and to take this concept as inspiration for your writing. What do you think about imagining that you are surfers of life? What would your surfboard be like? How would you manage to stay balanced? How many times would you try to face the big waves? Do you think fear could paralyse you? What would life be like without waves in the sea? Here is my contribution: I think that, as people, we all have to do what we’re told at some point; what is a bit difficult, though, is when others decide for us, because, after all, no one can decide what’s best for us, even if we do make the wrong decision.

Learning to surf

If I imagine that life is the ocean, and that I am the one who decides which wave to ride, I must bear in mind that to learn to surf I need the right equipment and, above all, the right mindset. For example, the material of the board depends on the strength I have within me; it must be made of a durable material that floats above adversity yet is solid enough to give me balance, to keep me humble and grounded in reality, because if I think too highly of myself, the wind will knock me off; if I shrink back too much, I will lose. If we have the great capacity to overcome many things and rise to the challenge of life’s hardships—because no one knows better than we do how to become more optimistic and positive each day—then life will throw me a few curveballs; if I’m rigid, I’ll break, whereas if I go with the flow of the water, I can absorb the impact. ![La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla (gif).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23yJJYZrKzAtCQkw5ydAMw4HWirWdj7y5KWdukq9pVY8n1owGNbnJRZjRHSBZGF7AszYy.gif)

Avoiding wasting my energy on small waves

When I can face the big waves, as many times as I am able to paddle back out to sea, I set that limit based on my ability to catch my breath, so I must look towards the shore or towards the part of the wave I want to conquer, because each of us has a powerful weapon in our hands: love, simplicity and strength. In particular, for over a year now, together with my daughter, we have been facing a new challenge: moving from one city to another, with all the necessary paperwork involved, selling our old home first so we could then buy our new one. Also, at every stage of life—moving house, changing jobs, getting over a break-up—the truth is that these are situations that require energy, just as I must avoid wasting my strength on small waves that take me nowhere. I realise that time slips by as I wait for fleeting moments that may not fulfil me as I had hoped, and so, whilst I wait for life to be a bed of roses, I miss out on the adventure of getting things right and making mistakes, of laughing and crying, of dreaming and living, and even of feeling that I am missing out on the great opportunity of being alive.

The salt of our tears

This does not mean that at certain times in life we do not feel pain, sadness or nostalgia, but from every circumstance we can draw out the best and most positive aspects to strengthen ourselves and say that the struggle continues and the victories are ours. Life may not be perfect and may not turn out as we expect; there may be many setbacks and at times we may feel helpless, but when we find ourselves in this painful situation, we will know that no one led us there by deceiving us and telling us that we would never have any reason to cry. On the contrary, we will realise that the salt of our tears will make our successes taste all the sweeter, that life rewards us with everything that makes us feel good; and yet, at the end of the day, the best surfer isn’t the one who performs the most extreme manoeuvres, but the one who is having the most fun in the water – and there are thousands of things we can do and learn every day. ![La Ola - Soy quien tiene la tabla y la voluntad de dominarla (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23zkk44neYayACc8HPgm9rHaoBYpQvunGp5nZieYieRvDh1KFwDJdrRWWtNQruWqeZVNa.jpg)

The determination to master the waves

So whether I’m paddling to catch a wave today, or struggling to stay afloat, it’s crucial to avoid those fearful thoughts that threaten to paralyse me. A good example is when I enjoy every opportunity we’re given to write in this community, reading and learning new things—so essential for honing my talent. In any case, even though the ocean is vast and sometimes fills me with fear, it is I who have the board and the will to master the waves; keeping my arms strong, my breathing steady and my gaze always fixed on that horizon where my next great adventure is taking shape, one that may carry me to the crest of the wave. I firmly believe that by placing my faith in God, He will help me face life’s trials and tribulations with resilience, accepting what I cannot change and adapting to new circumstances; and although I cannot stop the waves in an unpredictable sea, I know that I am not here in this life to master the ocean, but I can learn to surf and navigate through adversity. If you wish to join the initiative and the Talents meeting, you should do the following [Click here](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-la-ola). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeZeEupfP2Ys5Yin2yB3q4qodjysvQmFQzzqVuENLu9c4LfDp9pEG4suGmVQVhofzs.jpg) The designs and images in canva The pictures in my gallery taken from my Honor Magic6 phone and edited in canva Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version) ![@cautiva30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/48GiQXHFXuLXhcZXkK5D2agffwMe5xE3nu6XSwbDyvaimGxptw98DKqiE6TD4LkNoE.jpg)

body.title: Regreso a Clases: Cambios y avances
body.body:
<center>![1000920104.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wMcszjmhE3QtxP8aqPC6KjPBUK6T6XJSKK69fjLUEZLhnz6rXBnQuCk2JLVueTPKX7a.png)</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

En la costa de Ecuador, el año escolar está por comenzar, mis hijos inician clases el 04 de mayo, luego de casi 2 meses de vacaciones. 

Realmente yo soy el tipo de madre que aunque me \

disfruto tenerlos en casa, porque estoy segura de que ellos están bien. Cuando están en la escuela o colegio, mi mente viajaba pensando en el cómo estarán y pidiendole siempre a Dios que me los proteja.
![1000920089.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tSgqctTwKHr5sKoiehKT5ujgUyuhexixRUYY55vGeWmBm25t8DAH6VdoEJj2cGGjfD4.jpg)
Este inicio de clases, ha llegado con todo, pues 2 de mis hijos inician en una escuela diferente, así que eso implica más gastos, ya que aquí cada colegio y escuela tiene su tipo de uniforme. Además de eso, está el costo de la lista de útiles escolares, lista que ni en la Universidad es tan larga xD y tuvimos que comprar al menos 14 libros, entre ambos niños, incluidos libros literarios y un diccionario. Este año ambos verán la materia de Robótica y Computación, además de eso mi hija mayor verá varias materias nuevas, como Química, entre otras. Más allá de los gastos, está la incertidumbre del nuevo colegio, cómo seran los maestros, los niños que estudian allí y esperando que les vaya bien a mis hijos. El lugar se ve bastante limpio, seguro y tranquilo. La escuela tiene buena reputación a pesar de estar en un sector algo feo y un poco peligroso. También cuenta con cámaras de seguridad e inspectores, y por otra parte nos mudamos un poco cerca. Imágenes de referencias en [Pinterest Caratulas Escolares](https://pin.it/5SLKKBt1R) En estos días he estado preparando los últimos detalles para el regreso a clases de mis hijos. También regalando uniforme en excelente estado que mis hijos ya usaron en años pasados a unos niños de su escuela anterior. He estado haciendo caratulas, personalizando útiles y también haciéndoles repasar un poco sus clases pasadas, para que entren preparados. Y bueno, ellos ya quieren ir a clases, aunque luego desean que el año escolar termine pronto jajaja. ---
![17768077867334238715597380559633.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xATp9nePqX8jz3YfCuR2CVbaaH3HRctoG4Q72iG7HfLmhD4YJZrgB672kJ4z43pfVgC.gif)

body.title: Cyborgization is here. ICE agents now have cyber glasses.
body.body:
In 2015, I co authored a chapter in Transpolitica on the topic of cyborgization. Back then it seemed ridiculous, and no one wanted to take seriously this possibility. Now it's 11 years later, and we have a new article showing the ICE and Homeland Security are adopting cyber glasses. Cyber glasses are AI augmented glasses, which turns the agent into an augmented cyborg.

I call this process cyborgization. And it's not a surprise at all. In fact, I would expect that in the future, law enforcement and feds will have compute dominance. That means they'll have cyborg capabilities far beyond what any civilian has. It will not just be cyber glasses. The good use cases of cyborgization, result in higher quality intelligence, higher quality information, and decision support. This decision support role is basically what Palantir is doing now with AI. 

This ability is not exclusive to the feds. Cyborgization is now widespread. Anyone with AI, OpenClaw, Hermes, Meta Glasses
has some version of this. Done right, everyone will have better decision support. The question is will it be done right? It can also be done very wrong. Te article basically calls it the worst case scenario, but police already use body camera, and this if done right, can protect more people from police brutality than it hurts.

This level of surveillance, was also predicted over 10 years ago. The sousveillance was predicted as well. This could go very wrong, because agents are only as good as the users of them. And not every user of agents has the agenda to make life better. What should the regulations be? In any case, the expectation should be that law enforcement and the government will have access to the most advanced models, with the most compute. I would not be surprised if Mythos for example is the sort of model law enforcement would use. Law enforcement also has Palantir, but we also have to know law enforcement aren't the only people who want to do good and who need higher quality information. While law enforcement may get this technology first, it's important to develop open source models, low barriers to access, so that everyone in society has a chance to rise above involuntary ignorance, as this as important as having libraries. 
  
**Reference**
https://gizmodo.com/ices-smart-glasses-are-a-worst-case-scenario-2000749003

body.title: Jaký je život Čecha s cizinkou/Life in Brno with a Foreigner/?[cz/eng] translate by AI...
body.body:
**Jaký je život Čecha s ukrajinskou Rumunkou a dvěma holkama v Brně?**

Kdyby mi někdo pár let zpátky řekl, že skončím v Brně v domácnosti, kde se míchá čeština, ukrajinština a rumunština v jedný větě, asi bych ho poslal někam. No a teď? Jsem v tom až po uši – a upřímně, je to jízda.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5rgF1XDXyyjj5via53LWgPzctQBbWTFANTJbTYmb58u/1776808257072.jpg)

**Ráno** u nás nevypadá jako z reklamy na štěstí. Spíš jak menší exploze. Mladší (6 let) vstane a jede hned na plnej výkon. Vlasy jak po výbuchu, nálada „já to dneska ovládnu“. Starší (11) už má trochu nadhled – takovej ten klidnější vibe, ale pořád v sobě má ten dětskej chaos. A já? Kafe v ruce, snažím se rozklíčovat, kdo na mě zrovna jakým jazykem mluví.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCmNvrw1kahjiRoYEP6BNkdYMruLWmihF4CX5UANgiNz/1776808279986.jpg)

**Doma** to není jazyk, to je freestyle. Jedna věta česky, druhá ukrajinsky, třetí něco mezi tím. Občas jen kývnu hlavou a doufám, že jsem správně pochopil.
Pak vypadneme ven. Brno, jaro, sluníčko, schody někde mezi barákama. Mladší jde dolů jak boss, palec nahoru, absolutní sebevědomí. Starší za ní dělá blbosti, pošťuchuje ji, klasickej sourozeneckej trolling. Přesně ty momenty, kdy je to chaos, ale zároveň čistá radost.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZRPVaoGtmTcsTGtoBU91PeqxMLH4HcmJSbnBpQ6HJj6/1776808302474.jpg)

**A večer?** Totální střih. Gauč, deka, ticho. Obě vytuhnou během pár minut. Jedna rozhozená přes celej gauč, druhá zabalená jak burrito. Najednou klid. Sedíš, koukáš na ně a dochází ti, že ten den, co byl chvílema na hlavu, vlastně stál za to.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQugkxT9oL6VAozmgDxy14Ys1SXi45GqRAtMMU4KUYrn/1776808325039.jpg)

**Jasně**
 není to vždycky pohádka. Kulturní rozdíly občas kopnou. Jídlo jiný, přístup k věcem jinej, emoce jedou víc naplno. Někdy máš pocit, že jsi v rodinný telenovele. Ale aspoň se něco děje.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWwFaaLLsFN8zr7RupzKdHUJdsBEojp8MN8bVR2a2jaU/1776808344323.jpg)

**Brno**
 tomu dává vlastní kulisu. Tramvaje, co jedou, jak chtějí. Parky plný lidí. Děcka, co řvou na hřištích. A ty v tom všem – takovej mix světů na jednom místě. Občas si říkám, že tohle už není klasická česká domácnost, ale malej mezinárodní projekt.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPhCFUw7nYA8FubirwUE2wxZmvyoFPpHE9isp72TWWeyN/1776808452623.jpg)
**Ale víš co?** 
Funguje to.
Ty holky tě naučí věci, který bys jinak neřešil. Trpělivost. Nadhled. A hlavně to, že rodina není o tom, odkud kdo je, ale jak spolu dokážete fungovat.
Je to občas punk. Občas cirkus. Ale většinou prostě dobrý.
A když večer vidíš, jak spí, zachumlaný pod dekou, tak víš, že bys to neměnil.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgnYtCt4ZKshGCAJVmLuG6ArMPKcH9LS311UUXJqnyRm/1776808514955.jpg)

Life in Brno with a Foreigner

If someone had told me a few years ago that I’d end up living in Brno in a household where Czech, Ukrainian, and Romanian all mix together in a single sentence, I would’ve laughed in their face. And now? I’m right in the middle of it—and honestly, it’s one hell of a ride.

Mornings at our place don’t look like a commercial for happiness. It’s more like a small explosion. The younger one (6) wakes up and goes full power immediately—hair like she just survived a blast, attitude like she owns the day. The older one (11) is a bit more chill, like she already knows how the world works… but still brings her own kind of chaos. And me? Coffee in hand, trying to figure out what language I’m being spoken to at any given moment.

At home, it’s not a language—it’s freestyle. One sentence in Czech, another in Ukrainian, third somewhere in between. Sometimes I just nod and hope I understood correctly.

Then we head outside. Brno, spring, sunshine, stairs between buildings. The younger one walks down like a boss, thumbs up, full confidence. The older one messing around behind her, teasing, classic sibling energy. Those moments—pure chaos, but also pure joy.

And then evening hits. Total switch. Couch, blanket, silence. Both of them knocked out within minutes. One spread out across the couch, the other wrapped up like a burrito. Suddenly, peace. You sit there, watching them, realizing that the day—which felt crazy at times—was actually worth it.

Of course, it’s not always a fairytale. Cultural differences show up. Food is different, approaches to things are different, emotions are more intense. Sometimes it feels like living inside a family soap opera. But at least it’s never boring.

Brno sets the scene perfectly. Trams that never run exactly on time. Parks full of people. Kids shouting on playgrounds. And you, right in the middle of it—a mix of cultures, languages, and ways of life. Sometimes it feels less like the Czech Republic and more like a small international world of its own.

But you know what? It works.

Those girls teach you things you’d never learn otherwise. Patience. Perspective. And most importantly—that a family doesn’t have to look “traditional” to actually work.

It’s messy sometimes. It’s a circus sometimes. But most of the time, it’s just good.

And when you see them asleep in the evening, wrapped up in a blanket, you know you wouldn’t trade it for anything.

The video was recorded 15th June 2025. Another day with Alan the town crier helping attract the crowds to my demo and Kozmic Records. I was still giving out loose canvas paintings, but have since stopped as I wanted to make as sure as possible, that people will hang my work on their walls and not store it away somewhere out of sight. Then, came the idea to move the info on the back of the artwork, to the front (Advertism). So each artwork is an advert, hence the Advertism manifesto point \
They give you money once, but Advertism is the payment that keeps on giving. Who said Free Art was free? \n ***\n[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/fMaN9kubnaiKbdTHSxug22)

body.title: Three Tune Tuesday ~ Robert Smith  ~ Birthday Boy #87
body.body:
### Welcome to my #TTT #ThreeTuneTuesday entry! Robert James Smith, born on 21 April 1959, is undoubtedly one of the most renowned and longest-serving lead singers among the most popular bands. The lead singer and principal songwriter was one of the co-founders of the world-famous band ‘The Cure’. The band formed in 1976 and their primary style was punk rock, which grew out of the original movement. His unique vocal tone, as well as his very distinctive style of introducing a gothic and highly theatrical element associated with all the band’s greatest moments, left an indelible mark on the British music scene. Born and raised as a Catholic, he later ‘converted’ to atheism. He received formal musical education from a very early age, which included piano lessons, which he attended with his younger sister. At the age of nine, he began taking classical guitar lessons, but soon stopped attending formal lessons and began learning by ear. I shall let the music speak louder than my words, for there are no words to describe the genius and originality of this unique artist! https://youtu.be/9GkVhgIeGJQ https://youtu.be/ks_qOI0lzho https://youtu.be/ijxk-fgcg7c

body.title: Avatar: Aang, The Last Airbender is a 10/10
body.body:
and I am still thinking about it. If you know me, you know I am the kind of guy who can never really get over Avatar and Naruto. These two series stay with me forever because they are part of who I am. But watching the Avatar movie with human characters was such a bad experience that I really wish I could just unsee it. It was the same thing with the Naruto movie version. Even Boruto and Korra were not a 10/10 for me because they just didn't hit the same way.

After all those bad experiences, I didn't have high hopes for anything new. I thought this would be another disappointment, but it turned out to be VERY VERY good. I have to say it twice because it really was that great. For anyone who is a fan of the original series, this is a must watch. It finally feels like we got something that respects the original story.

What I loved most was how each scene felt like it was made in a nostalgic way to give you constant reminders of the show. If you remember the scene from the original series where Azula cornered Katara and she had to use her sweat to bend water, this movie tries to give you that same feeling. In this version, Katara runs out of water and Sokka brings a bending machine or device to help her. Even though that moment felt a bit unnecessary since the fight had stopped and other benders were there, it felt like the makers were trying to copy that old scene frame by frame. They wanted to create that same tension and atmosphere from the Azula fight just to make us feel nostalgic.

It wasn't just that one time either. The cabbage man is back and his cabbages got ruined again. Hearing him say \

was perfect because that line stays the same in every version and it just feels right. I also felt those same iconic vibes during a scene with Toph. It reminded me so much of when she first used metal bending. The tension in the air was high and then Toph unlocked more of her power. It gave me chills because it felt so much like the original character we love.

Katara’s character was also spot on. She is still kind and can see what is coming. She has that gift of sensing bad people or seeing the good in someone before anyone else does. It reminded me of how she was the first one to see the good inside Zuko. Every bending scene in the movie had these nostalgic moments that felt like they were put there just to refresh our old memories. If you loved the original four books on Nickelodeon, the humor and the way the characters act will make you very happy. It is hard to love something so much and then see it ruined, but this movie actually felt right.

In some parts, it felt like they took inspiration from Kung Fu Panda 3, maybe because the teams were the same or they just liked the style. The way they showed the spirits and spiritual power reminded me of that. I really didn't like the Korra series because of how it handled spirits, but here the characters weren't way too overpowered. Everything felt balanced. I could honestly keep writing and writing about how much I liked it, but I don't want to give away too much. If you have seen the original series, you will find this story very easy to follow. Even though it is a movie and doesn't have as much time for deep character growth, it still feels justified and fun to watch.

body.title: Without structures it faces collapse
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXt9s623yLpdcxoQfodxj3dGR4gw6JJRo5T9zNANKGt6B/1000169858.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/real-estate-team-using-3d-models-explore-construction-layout-options-working-residential_424549972.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=24&uuid=7a399123-ae70-4997-8c5a-addc02b22a91&query=Business+structures+and+SOP+AI+generated+) 
“If the foundation is destroyed, what can the righteous do”. In as much as I will have to do a revisit on this scriptures, the oversight shows the need for a standard layout. No matter how beautiful a [building](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-building-structure) can be, its existence is dependent on its foundation. When this is overlooked, a sudden collapse can be inevitable.  

Where are we heading to? Some people just do [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) for the sake of the [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) involved and [TRY](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-try-currency) to offset the needed and very necessary processes. Even I have to admit the fact that I will need to set up a working structure if I am to run a long lasting [company](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business). There are many structures to look out for; but the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) two are how [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) is done and how money is managed.   

I will be looking at the latter in this [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) because it has been where many [entrepreneurs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) mix it up. How did I even get here? Ok, a [friend](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-friend) was just discussing with me on how someone who was trusted to manage a business decided to disappear overnight. And when talking of disappearing overnight, we have to look at the damages involved. He has put the business in [debt](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-debt) in millions in the process.   

He took advantage of the paying [customers](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) who had put trust in him as the [manager](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-manager) and swindled away with the [fund](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-fund) leaving the business in the fate of arranging for a payback. It is the question of how many actually will want to do business with them again if they finally just get their funds back.   

Where was the entire mistake? Personally, I had to [track](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-track-music) it down to the business [owner](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-owner-insurance) who was ignorant of setting up structures upon a business that is doing [transactions](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-transaction) in millions daily. Why would you put in a manager out of trust to handle  transactions. I am just considering his [greed](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-greed) mentality of avoiding to pay many hands to run the company. So he brought in someone from his place to be an [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) in one manager; the chances of getting dupped was very high.  
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR7ueJu7dRNK8Arr7nBHf8ddw6ukUHmYxVrJKE3QNMBxq/1000169860.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/office-supplies_4114780.htm#fromView=search&page=3&position=31&uuid=a5781914-5463-468c-a9c1-612147dbff89&query=Business+structures+and+SOP+AI+generated+) 
How was he even trusting the daily or weekly reports that were sent to him as concerning the business that he is not around physically to confirm anything. No internal or external [auditor](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-auditor), no [accountant](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-accountant-profession), no cashier, there is no structure that questions where and how money is used. All you did was bring in a one [man](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-man) squad to become all in all.   

Even as a co-partner of my brand, I am working on how to set up structures that will even limit my access to company funds at ease. We all have personal challenges of which we can ignorantly put ourselves as a result of our actions or inactions. With easy access to [cash](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cash), business will bleed.  

To conclude, let me add, business is more than just having money to start or staying in [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit). Setting in the needed internal structures that can combat a crackdown is very possible. There must be different [bodies](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-body) involved in the decision of [expenses](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-expense) if a business must stay healthy long enough.

body.title: Garden in April
body.body:
Hello everyone.
We are already one month into the Spring. Days are longer and warmer. Plants in the garden are already awake for some time. Grass is in its mode as well. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapqFzJ4ku5TqoCKMxowoJm77c1nRHMTsAuUF2XoxguNN/2.jpg)

Good time to have a short garden update. 
I am back home after some time and change in garden is huge.  Leaves showing up on many trees and flowers are everywhere. Cherry grafts are doing well. Figs are still waiting - only branches so far. 
On different note yesterday we had quite strong hail. It lasted for some time and there was a good amount of the ice after all was done. 

This was aftermath of the yesterdays sudden hail. 
Flower petals and leaves were take down. Not that much damage though but we will see later on. I dont remember this strong hail recently and in late April as well. 
 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZURPrFBa3qLpR6KiBEHkvioK5biHMV8RTEpupJFqmqbM/1.jpg)

All in all garden is doing well. Now grass trimming has to be done. 
Cherries are stars of the garden. So many flowers. We have different cherry types - sweet cherries, sour cherries and black cherries. 
 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZThjCzNn6Zxj2NzxfUwGtyGVCxm734cZp8odJQwZADyy/6.jpg)

This year we grafted 4 different cherry types. It looks all of them are doing good for now. New additions are black or dark cherry, Regina, Carmen and Sunburst. Some of them are early and some of them are late sweet cherry types.
As you can see some of the grafts have so many leaves already.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUkLvAS14TyDXpTqcRekzQysSy9BQekmguErCGZNKQTC/5.jpg)

There are many flowers on all apple trees. Can you easily differentiate apple flower from other fruit flowers? Any particular fruit flower that you mix up?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2idiyueoYF3CPjGP6cdFNAXYJHmPh4E8ZGi4GDeX8dF/3.jpg)

Other fruit trees are in good shape as well. Pears and plums doing nice. 
It is still a bit early for the figs. This year we have new addition to the figs in our garden. New smaller size variety is newest addition. 
Grape collection is bigger for two new grape vines. 

All in all all plants are doing good. Now it is time to trim some grass.

Photos by @sammy00.

body.title: My Favorite Conclave Arcana Rare Reward Card: Grove Doomblade
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZzxer9toAuUNjNvR9ta8EVtvvRD431UX47GAfskspqrc/image.png)

## Introduction
When it comes to Conclave Arcana reward cards, I have one clear favorite in the Rare rarity cards: Grove Doomblade. This card is amazing in Reverse Speed ruleset as it has a speed of one, but it is pretty darn good even in regular rulesets and I will be sharing my recent Modern Diamond One League Battle where I used Grove Doomblade in a normal speed ruleset and where it played an important role in winning this battle.

## Grove Doomblade
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekzmBNEvfg19vPA1MrgC61APX7eWNdGYiprxEascGEHn/image.png)</center>

Grove Doomblade is a rare fire splinter Conclave Arcana reward card. It is one of the two rare Conclave Arcana reward cards that I have fully maxed out. The other rare rarity Conclave Arcana card that I have fully maxed out is Mindless Thrall. I have actually maxed out Mindless Thrall card first as I thought I would use it more as it is a neutral card and can be used with any splinter as well as in the ruleset where you can play only neutral cards. It didn't turn out quite that way and I find myself using Grove Doomblade more frequently.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFs62r6mj5xVgqvWyxrYBQAkRcrR6mn399tdPq4JbHSB/image.png)

This card is playable at any level as it starts off with a five melee damage and there are very few force shield cards in modern or at least I don't run into those very often. 

Grove Doomblade has a few important levels, first of those is level four where it gains stun ability which is very useful and then level six where it goes to six melee damage and the last two levels. Level seven it goes to seven damage and level eight where it becomes particularly deadly as it gains Ambush ability where it strikes before the first round of the battle.

## Rulesets 
The rulesets I like using Grove Doomblade in are: Reverse Speed, Collateral Damage as well as Explosive Weaponry ruleset. 

In the Reverse Speed ruleset Grove Doomblade fires first and has the lowest chance of missing so this card is a perfect choice for that ruleset.

In the Collateral Damage ruleset this card is good, because I like using highest damage monsters since every strike will deal damage to the adjacent friendly monsters and I might as well make every strike count.

This card is also perfect for the explosive weaponry ruleset as it deals very high damage to the adjacent enemy monsters.

## The Battle
[Link to the battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_14a3e8c00970012af76d709018f1fe75?ref=seattlea)

In addition to the three rulesets where I like using Grove Doomblade I also like using this reward card with a summoner that provides three monsters a blast ability: Nidhoggr

In this case I am featuring a battle where I used Nidhoggr and Grove Doomblade outside the three rulesets above:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPXx3fWXFwT9sVLaumQfi5SphExf8J4u5mb2gqr7dke7/image.png)

As you can see in this case we have a fairly high mana ruleset where fifty five mana points are available. We have no ranged and no neutral monsters rulesets in effect which eliminates another one of my favorites with this summoner: Venka the Vile.

So my strategy for this battle was to use three high damage monsters: Grove Doomblade with seven melee damage, Dragon Egg Forager that has opportunity ability with five melee damage and Rage that has five magic damage and Life Leach ability. 

In the front I placed a very formidable Oridum Graybrow that self resurrects and has a Spite ability where he retaliates to the monster that defeated him. And in the back I have Calamity a monster that has Last Stand ability and can become quite strong when it is the last card on the board. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSAd3asFtNMGqESchT4A69YhUV5LMo14yWwuUxTvCpatt/image.png)

In the ambush round Grove Doomblade scored a hit on the backline monster, but then in the first round it missed. This is where the speed of one is not always optimal under non-reverse speed rulesets. But let's keep watching the battle...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCRpKu9X1cPJhu2QFbTanU1jDu6GnbKGJrhsd7xug9AN/image.png)

In the second round our Grove Doomblade not only scored a hit on Mahkah Hemlig, but it also scored a stun preventing it from firing its four magic opportunity hit in round three. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPa78ywovjXx2HDisRZi55VyLVcxvLxqqcR1E4uEt9iTr/image.png)

 At the end of round three Grove Doomblade took out two enemy monsters resulting in the situation where we now have four monsters on the board against a single monster on the DannyPanda team! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6vApbSEMuZmm7AESoALBheZNb6BRXzJmt2BqCNz3pJC/image.png)

This lead us to a win and over fifteen SPS tokens collected and Grove Doomblade played an important part in making this happen!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seattlea/23w2jHQotzprYeHGMEMqJKqKLguX6UMdCqxan921gHu24HqEUbikLmJJEKEHhyGcS9QCB.png

If you have some staked SPS please vote for my SPS Validator Node [HERE](https://monstermarket.io/validators?validator=seattlea)

I am also a Hive Witness and would really appreciate your vote for me as a witness: https://vote.hive.uno/@seattlea
