body.title: A momentous meeting over a cup of coffee at the Royal Cafe! [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Happy Tuesday, dear [Cinnamon Cup Coffe](https://ecency.com/created/hive-152524)! It's been a long time since I've written, friends—two months, in fact, since I've been able to share my coffee adventures! But the reason has a lot to do with the title of this publication, since mid-February I had to cease my research activities at the Faculty of Dentistry where I enjoyed every morning the good coffee of its cafeteria and to which I dedicated a very special [post](https://ecency.com/hive-152524/@bulkathos/sharing-a-cup-of-coffee). Time had caught up with me, friends; I had to finish writing my doctoral thesis and I was stuck on interpreting the latest results. You could call it writer's block, but it forced me to isolate myself from my entire social circle, including distancing myself from blockchain, in order to finally find the inspiration that led me to finish my doctoral thesis! You can't imagine the spiritual liberation it was to finish the result of years of research and finally submit it. It was in the first days of April that I finished writing and submitted the manuscript to my advisor for final revisions. A week and a half later, she invited me here to the Royal Café to discuss this final version of the thesis. I had a good feeling about this meeting with my advisor because when she asks me to meet at one of the trendiest cafés in eastern Caracas, it usually means the thesis is ready and won't need any more corrections. And indeed, that was the great news! Not only was it ready to be defended before the grand jury, but they were already asking us to prepare a brief summary of one of the experiments to be published in a peer-reviewed journal! That made it clear to me that more than a meeting to discuss the details of the document, it was a meeting to celebrate the culmination of the laboratory's main line of research. ---
![photo_15_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EokdYeYUsuTJQD9A1ARmujMijaR6SEwrU9t5tqe67noLJ4siozyozgsEqEibqa8BtjJ.jpg)|![photo_14_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23wCBnT2dkT9WCucx2jwgiFxBT27jpNMTGqcfwHJMP8ARAyJ9WFRuy4FcQeYyFVKYAQCH.jpg) --|--

> I had been to this café before, after the pandemic, but at that time it was being remodeled. It was in 2025 that the remodeling was complete and it was relaunched with two spaces: one inside the café where they also sell bread, and an outdoor area to enjoy a good coffee with a sweet treat like a chocolate croissant while taking in the view. Our decision was clear: order a coffee to enjoy at the tables outside the café. They gave us a small chocolate cookie free with our coffee, and since that wasn't enough, we ordered a guava-filled pastry, which we asked them to cut in half to share.
![photo_17_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23x19P6rGsbabeXYMNyiUzBbwRaVWGt1BKTzBEJ7Cy8w58yPva1hFHVPQuyNSjeXbTi6U.jpg) --- ![photo_9_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23w2sLysTNg46Q3nNzYRDUnZi2HBT68mqKMmfCYYA3CeYcnCYAXRgCEhUBR4y6C6G7PTf.jpg) --- ![photo_6_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23yJJTNKSTKFWTwRAgJFbVu4oLbn88Z5rFP7Mdg1hHK5Lqqsc8Ni7EC7CHqucDno6oG88.jpg)

> We both ordered coffee with milk, but my tutor had requested a dark brown coffee since she prefers to savor the strength and body of a good dark coffee, sweetened only by a small amount of milk. The coffee this café typically uses is the classic variety from this part of eastern Caracas: San Antonio whole bean coffee, which they then grind and brew. This produces an extremely pure and highly aromatic coffee, so much so that it tends to intoxicate the senses!
![photo_12_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xVGvYxZ1SYSedgjNHqJittYCrnVHZSRem1zaofzre27jwJRHmitbzyePomAwypZ6CpA.jpg) --- ![photo_13_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23wWuAjq2Jc6R1Fk6a4cprRXxuk1eaxvXyHc47nC37RPpUDqCj9JtsWu1uu5b22JipZwv.jpg)

> Now, in my case, I like to order a large cup of light café con leche, also known as a light brown coffee. Since we were going to enjoy a piece of sweet bread with guava paste inside, I didn't worry about sweetening my cup.
![photo_5_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23ynSEFJa6pKjrVB6ZNFn2GvWn3ox7D4CmWiUjtEKa115sya5qJUjHYAyGJ2KFK21kMxS.jpg) --- ![photo_10_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xefxDZtyrAQd7n469kagACoar2hKCBL6Du5oKf5nS85G3nCQnxGkSZMGnDWdDZ5DTeA.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tSMrH7PFpMumWhjM9R3KW7iuY4sdQxBTqJPsfU19T5oEJbBjqVMUcabrVct7vAK7ggY.png)

> And so we spent the afternoon, enjoying this delicious cup of coffee with guava bread, no longer just a coffee between a tutor and student, but as equals. After so many years of meetings of this type, for the first time we met to discuss the future lines of research for the laboratory and to begin structuring an interdisciplinary research project that will surely be approved and continue developing research for the country.
![photo_3_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoiWE2zvW1krBfXGnZhU8QQzfBu7rCwa6tTBLwzsJM2Tvmv5AJ6KR3Fe4bHBAQu1SkH.jpg) --- ![photo_11_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoeEySG24EJN5e3k1TKipoSc2vTSCvdqfD1uwh7xv3bufEDU6ziU97CLHvRRPipfNZ4.jpg)
>\n\nWell, friends, it was a pleasure to share this experience with you. I titled this post \

because it feels like I'm closing a chapter in my professional career and preparing for new challenges. Capturing moments like these, on a warm afternoon with coffee, makes these memories something I'll cherish. See you in the next post! Best regards. ---
# Versión Español
---
![Front Cafetería Royal.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Ep1WU1Cu3iinjDbRZqAf8hCRQXDZxtTZXMcCbqJpUbUMri1GLdQ6uEWGrmPbMB7TM9J.gif)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tm6xobH8e6bpYBWpGKpaSAmf8R9a6x8oovPj9Feytu9Lk9iBqQGWQmFV24faSmsjVeb.png)

> Feliz martes apreciada comunidad de [Cinnamon Cup Coffe](https://ecency.com/created/hive-152524)! Tenía mucho tiempo sin escribir amigos, de hecho 2 meses sin poder compartirles mis aventuras cafeteras! Pero la razón tiene mucho que ver con el título de esta publicación, desde mediados de Febrero tuve que cesar mis actividades de investigación en la Facultad de Odontología donde disfrutaba cada mañana del buen café de su cafetería y al que le dediqué un [post](https://ecency.com/hive-152524/@bulkathos/sharing-a-cup-of-coffee) muy especial. El tiempo me había alcanzado amigos, ya tenía que terminar de escribir mi tesis doctoral y me encontraba estancado en la interpretación del último resultado. Podrías llamarlo bloqueo del escritor, pero esto me llevó a tener que aislarme de todo mi entorno social incluyendo alejarme de la blockchain para finalmente encontrar la inspiración que me llevó a terminar mi tesis doctoral! No se imaginan la liberación espiritual que significó terminar el resultado de años de investigación y finalmente entregarlo. Fue en los primeros días de abril que terminé de escribir y le entregué el escrito a mi tutora para hiciera las correcciones finales. Una semana y media después me citó aquí en la cafetería Royal para discutir esta última versión de la tesis. Tenía una buena impresión de esta cita con m i tutora, porque cuando me pide que nos encontremos en una de las cafeterías más trending topic del este de Caracas significaba que la tesis ya estaba lista y no necesitaría más correcciones. En efecto esa fue la gran noticia! No solo que estaba lista para ser defendida ante el gran jurado sino que ya nos estaban solicitando que preparáramos un breve resumen de uno de los experimentos para ser publicado en una revista arbitrada! Eso me dejo claro que más que una reunión para hablar de los detalles del escrito era una reunión para celebrar la culminación de la línea de investigación principal del laboratorio. ---
![photo_15_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EokdYeYUsuTJQD9A1ARmujMijaR6SEwrU9t5tqe67noLJ4siozyozgsEqEibqa8BtjJ.jpg)|![photo_14_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23wCBnT2dkT9WCucx2jwgiFxBT27jpNMTGqcfwHJMP8ARAyJ9WFRuy4FcQeYyFVKYAQCH.jpg) --|--

> Ya había estado en otro momento en esta cafetería, posterior a la pandemia, solo que en ese momento la cafetería estaba en proceso de remodelación. Fue en 2025 que ya se había terminado de remodelar y relanzarse con 2 espacios, uno dentro de la cafetería donde también venden pan y un espacio exterior para degustar de un buen café acompañado de un dulce como un croissant de chocolate mientras disfrutas de la vista exterior. Nuestra decisión fue clara, pedir un café para disfrutarlo en las mesas puestas en el exterior de la cafetería. Para acompañar el café nos dieron gratis una pequeña galleta de chocolate, como era poco para acompañar el café, pedimos un pan relleno de guayaba que pedimos cortar a la mitad para disfrutarlo entre los dos.
![photo_17_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23x19P6rGsbabeXYMNyiUzBbwRaVWGt1BKTzBEJ7Cy8w58yPva1hFHVPQuyNSjeXbTi6U.jpg) --- ![photo_9_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23w2sLysTNg46Q3nNzYRDUnZi2HBT68mqKMmfCYYA3CeYcnCYAXRgCEhUBR4y6C6G7PTf.jpg) --- ![photo_6_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23yJJTNKSTKFWTwRAgJFbVu4oLbn88Z5rFP7Mdg1hHK5Lqqsc8Ni7EC7CHqucDno6oG88.jpg)

> Ambos pedimos café con leche, pero en el caso de mi tutora, había pedido un marrón oscuro ya que le gusta saborear en mayor medida la fuerza y el cuerpo de un buen café oscuro, solamente endulzado por la adición de una pequeña cantidad de leche. En este sentido, el café que suele usar esta cafetería es el clásico de esta parte del este de Caracas: San Antonio en grano que posteriormente muelen y lo pasan por la máquina. Esto produce un café extremadamente puro y altamente aromático, tanto que tiende a embriagar los sentidos!
![photo_12_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xVGvYxZ1SYSedgjNHqJittYCrnVHZSRem1zaofzre27jwJRHmitbzyePomAwypZ6CpA.jpg) --- ![photo_13_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23wWuAjq2Jc6R1Fk6a4cprRXxuk1eaxvXyHc47nC37RPpUDqCj9JtsWu1uu5b22JipZwv.jpg)

> Ahora en mi caso, me gusta pedir una gran taza de café con leche claro o también conocido como marrón claro. Como íbamos a saborear un trozo de pan azucarado con dulce de guayaba en su interior, no me preocupo endulzar mi taza.
![photo_5_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23ynSEFJa6pKjrVB6ZNFn2GvWn3ox7D4CmWiUjtEKa115sya5qJUjHYAyGJ2KFK21kMxS.jpg) --- ![photo_10_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xefxDZtyrAQd7n469kagACoar2hKCBL6Du5oKf5nS85G3nCQnxGkSZMGnDWdDZ5DTeA.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tSMrH7PFpMumWhjM9R3KW7iuY4sdQxBTqJPsfU19T5oEJbBjqVMUcabrVct7vAK7ggY.png)

> Así pasamos la tarde, disfrutando de esta deliciosa taza de café con pan de guayaba, ya no como un café entre un tutor y su estudiante, sino como iguales. Después de tantos años en reuniones de este tipo, por primera vez nos reunimos para plantear las futuras líneas de investigación del laboratorio e ir estructurando un proyecto de investigación interdisciplinario que seguramente será aprobado y continuar desarrollando investigación para el país.
![photo_3_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoiWE2zvW1krBfXGnZhU8QQzfBu7rCwa6tTBLwzsJM2Tvmv5AJ6KR3Fe4bHBAQu1SkH.jpg) --- ![photo_11_2026-04-21_13-28-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EoeEySG24EJN5e3k1TKipoSc2vTSCvdqfD1uwh7xv3bufEDU6ziU97CLHvRRPipfNZ4.jpg)

> Y bien amigos, fue un gusto compartir esta experiencia con ustedes. Titulé esta publicación como un momento trascendental porque es sentir que ya estoy cerrando un ciclo de mi carrera profesional y ya me estoy preparando para nuevos desafíos. Sellar momentos como estos, en una cálida tarde con café hace que estos recuerdos los atesore con gran cariño. Nos vemos en un próximo post! Saludos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbRULamAHmDYh1wNZAfafeZaLZVa2QZrWZRPZK7XaqtiEfxQRc5qoDWbMHKaMKKcoZf.png)

> The images and video for the reviews were taken from my Redmi 9c cell phone and the translation was done with the [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator) translate.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uFRPb6piQFB7hn8h21UGhTKwZtbM4bqqzUA2R1W1xdYXhABmxuZo6vJHVNwtczjw21d.png) # Follow me on Hive!
[ ![Coffee Shop banner 2 con Logo.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbnXm7ftapQadzD5an4UU2o86CQqAMYanG47cvs2bZd1N2SZQDWFNa1bf4Z3gMKyHqc.gif) ](https://ecency.com/@bulkathos) --- ![Ecency logo Bulkathos.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23vsn34BaitCjk9Kz1FyeaZm1ZNPDrrm6AR86D2Wz858DntiDErgbN21u4QnRg7MwCibd.gif)

A nuestra llegada a Buenos Aires sufrimos los gritos y peleas de la vecina de arriba, a la que otros vecinos llamaban La Loca. También resulta coincidencia que hace unos treinta y tantos años tuve un aparato muy parecido, con doble casete y la misma antena. Nos acompañó a la playa muchas veces, hasta que lo mandé a reparar y se perdió. 
Si tenía fantasma o mala suerte, seguramente la bruja de mi cuñada lo exorcizó y están libres de todo mal.

Muy buen cuento. Un abrazo fuerte.

body.body:
haha. The Cordial thing has happened to me, some specific ones on plastic bottles. 
The drive thing happens all the time. People are often seen in street back home, here I only entered to Westfield to know that there’s not only the houses here. oh, and people run all the time, even in the sunny mid day. That was pretty what? moment for me. 
I come from Nepal, a young guy trying to find the space, and life. And in between these I cant deny that the mutual experiences with you relates in most of the grounds. 
My english is particularly good, coming from a good study and hometown as a tourist detination added a bit of confidence. Which I got completely bashed in first week when I had to make interactions with Native South Aussies. I got used to the accent over time, still with some old people, I struggle. 

Everything is like Nepal, I call safety and system are better here. As, back home I come from is a bit hot climate, I got used to the place. For first  few months, I hadto keep my wind cheater in sunny days, the breeze is cold here after the sunset. Now, my body has got used to it.  I have seen people dressed as you mentioned, which got me too and sometimes I feel pretty confident to go out in pyjamas . 
System: 
You dont get fine ticket sent to home, or you dont say thank you in evry bus ride. Back home, having that background I would add thank you to anyone working together by the end of the day. I realized I say here likely evry minute. So, people are friendly, and sometimes I doubt the legitimacy of friendly in some regards. its confusing. 

Food: My experience started with Milk. That doesn’t taste well. It felt unsweet. I got used to that, now I am almost to forget what it tastes like back home.

Hello, friends of Gems, how are you? I’m grateful to God for allowing me to share with you once again. Today I’ll be showing you this photo. 

This is the month of yellow flowers in my country, and I say that because during this month, our national tree blooms and turns yellow; it’s known as the Araguaney or Handroanthus chrysanthus, which is its scientific name. 


![IMG_20260421_123534_edit_332910732443688.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZKYAAEzEt7T59sKfUcB1AvxbpSbHANESDanYbALbpcEC/IMG_20260421_123534_edit_332910732443688.jpg)


It usually blooms between February and April, but right now it’s in full bloom, and believe me, it’s beautiful to travel and see the entire landscape turn yellow along the way because of the flowers. 


![Screenshot_20260421_173034_com_whatsapp_StatusPlaybackActivity_edit_333697848604658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfLe51A4XwNgmRawz8wdNoMfs3LKNSTQtyAJ6Yv3jrHvu/Screenshot_20260421_173034_com_whatsapp_StatusPlaybackActivity_edit_333697848604658.jpg)

body.title: My Favorite Childhood Story – A Silver Bloggers Chronicle
body.body:
![goldenhills (1280 x 40 px) (1280 x 80 px) (1280 x 780 px) (1280 x 780 px).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23ydETobYn8W1Pea5br4jys3o3ihZMyto48reW8sSkQyfhvDKUqXEbuiy9gGpeeFakyQ6.png)


If I had to pick a favorite book from my childhood, I would choose “The Black Stallion” by Walter Farley.

It's the first nonpicture book (novel) I ever read. It's also the first book I ever owned; I received a Random House paperback copy as a birthday present on my eighth birthday, which would put the year at 1984.

I would guess that many U.S. readers, especially those of us in the Silver Bloggers cohort, will remember “The Black Stallion.” (I'm curious to know how many readers outside the U.S. will remember it, if any.) The adventure story of a boy and the horse that saves him from a shipwreck (to then become together horse racing champions) was first published in 1941, which makes it a children's classic of the generation just a tad before my parents' generation, who were just starting to read in the late 50s.

I know it was a favorite of my mom and her six sisters. I don't remember who bought me that first book (my mom or one of my aunts), but it was a topic that frequently came up at birthday parties and other family gatherings: Farley wrote 21 books in the [Black Stallion series,](https://theblackstallion.com/web/books/the-series/) most of them about the stallion and the boy, Alec Ramsay, and my aunts were always asking how many I had read or how many I had collected.

Acquiring new Black Stallion books was always part of the appeal for me. I remember sitting on the couch after finishing the first one (for the first time basking in the fading residual of an imagined world) and my dad asking what I thought. I immediately flipped to the series list in the back of the book and showed him all the other books I could get.

Sometimes getting a new Black Stallion meant waiting for my next birthday, but there was also the occasional pilgrimage to the 1980s book lovers' Mecca: the bookstore at the mall, which for my family was Waldenbooks in Concord Mall (Dunlap, Ind.). Dad would pack mom and us kids (five in '84 and 10 by '93) into the station wagon for the trip from the farm to the mall, where we would (too slowly) browse as a group through JC Penny or Sears before heading into the mall proper for the bookstore. I don't know what the rest of the family did (once we entered the bookstore I was allowed to separate from the group), but I headed immediately for the kids' section, for the shelf with the Black Stallion series on it.

I bought one book a trip with my chore money, for around $2 each. I tried to buy them in order, but, this was the '80s: you had to buy what the store had. No hopping on Amazon back then to get exactly what you wanted. I ended up skipping around a bit – I remember reading books late in the series and having to wonder for months (or years?) how the Alec Ramsay family ended up moving from Flushing, New York, to a horse farm upstate, before finally getting the book that told that part of the story.

Of course, the Black Stallion books weren't the only horse books on that shelf at Waldenbooks, and sometimes I already had purchased all the Black Stallions the store had to offer on a particular visit. But, the Black Stallion was my gateway drug and I was hooked; by the early '90s, when we moved farther into the country and the mall trips ended, I had bought or read them all: Black Beauty, the My Friend Flicka trilogy, National Velvet, and of course the Marguerite Henry books (Black Gold being my favorite of hers).

<div class=\
>\n<sub>\n<em>One of my favorite books in the Black Stallion series by Walter Farley – book 9, \

in which the Black Stallion and Alec get in a plane crash and Alec suffers amnesia. As you can see it has been reread a few times ... and travelled a few miles!

Twenty-odd horse novels I bought (or was given) in the '80s, and I still have 18 of them (dog-eared, broken-spined, well read and loved) on my bookshelf. The Black Stallion books in particular, incredibly, still have the unique scent I remember from 40 years ago. I don't know what Random House did to their paperbacks to make them smell so good, but it lasted! My horse-crazy has lasted all this time too, though it remains in the abstract. I dreamed of being a jockey like Alec Ramsay when I grew up, and as a teen in the '90s I seriously studied thoroughbred racing and breeding, subscribing to industry publications like the Thoroughbred Record and the [BloodHorse](https://www.bloodhorse.com/horse-racing/) and religiously reading each issue. I even purchased the annual stud book and studied the bloodlines. I still watch the Kentucky Derby and the Breeders Cup races every year. But aside from a few riding lessons in my college days, I never got involved with horses in real life. Correction: I *have never been* involved with horses in real life … yet. Just because I deferred my dreams until I'm (probably) too old to become a professional jockey, doesn't mean I couldn't get involved with horse racing or horses at some point. Never say never. I believe that. But maybe my childhood dreams won't take the form of horse ownership. Maybe I'll just write a beloved children's classic about horses. *** *** ![2r8F9rTBenJQfQgENfxADE6EVYabczqmSF5KeWefV5WL9WCwdLfK8wNVLEHQvZYiQREccyWxK5G2ch4CSZgaYyLkDLsrmU75s1vZ.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tbAxe9UurHqj93C1PyF6RHyMNFBdcbTNZ9aHXXBCbKxa46oDwugrXpfRaF9sW4BWAtP.gif) *** ***

body.title: The Slow Decline of the British Seaside
body.body:
Like many people in their 50s I have a certain level of nostalgia over the seaside - the sandcastles, sandy ice creams and sunburn. 

But things are different now....

Cheap flights and package holidays have turned the tide against old coastal towns. Nowadays a week in Benidorm is probably going to be around the same price as a week in Margate. 

This shift has gutted the economies of many a coastal towns, which are now some of the poorest places in the country, with lower pay, more people out of work, and worse health than towns further inland.

These towns have been caught up in something of a doom spiral in recent decades: as economies decline, there are fewer jobs, fewer opportunities and more people leave, especially the young...


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23wgF8uyoJL4jdW16wFJbNpMar4sWiZSaXjPZhu9KpKcsBLyUed23VeEmqCf3beyEzbZv.png)


### Plenty of Problems, Few Solutions

This economic slide brings all kinds of social problems with it. Crime climbs, kids slip through the cracks at school, deprivation sets in and just stays. In Hastings and Rye, 63% of children leave school without the basic English and maths GCSEs they’ll need later in life. And this can have generational consequences. 

Plenty of coastal areas feel totally “left behind.” Politicians in London don’t seem to see them or care much, and this is why many of these areas are turning away from Labour - these are the battle grounds for Reform vs Green, think the most recent win for the Greens in Margate. 

### Is There a Way Back?

Not every seaside town is stuck in reverse. Both Brighton and Margate are proper gentrified. 

But honestly, those are outliers.

Getting these towns back on track takes more than a fresh coat of paint or a new pier. They need real investment, good planning, and some new ideas about what they can be. Relying on holidaymakers isn’t enough anymore. They need remote work hubs, green tech, schools, and better digital connections.

They need, maybe, another round of more targeted levelling up.... otherwise they just become dumping grounds for the left-behinds....

Yes, everything you describe is exactly what happens to me when I try to play a game my PC can't run. I've had Oblivion installed for about two years now, and I don't dare delete it because every now and then I get the urge to start a new game. I also have some mods installed to improve the gameplay, especially mods that add items, clothing, armor, and things like that.

I recently enjoyed playing as an Imperial pirate. I downloaded a couple of mods that added pirate outfits, as well as the familiar Dunbarrow pirate base from one of the game's DLCs. It was great: no armor or shields, just the pirate attire and a saber as a weapon, along with some illusion magic to control certain enemies.

On the other hand, I've never played any Dead Space game, not even the original 2008 version. I've only watched gameplay videos, and I'd say the 2008 version has aged very well graphically despite its age. I think I should try to buy the 2008 version; it shouldn't give my PC any problems.

body.title: How did humans survive without the creatures? - Holozing FanLore Future Timeline
body.body:
![3c1a1f76-a094-44ad-b852-cb74f2797c9b.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvaREaiAnh288T1L8eUieqaozCDC5AdqVBPdKQkv3rLscTNVtY5XvfZfb81w12QEeDu.png)

---

We continue discussing the future timeline, as I feel it is the most intriguing the one from which ideas flow most freely for me. This isn't precisely because of the creatures themselves, or even what the humans are doing, but rather because of the central question: how did humans become so advanced in this era without the creatures? What exactly happened there? I believe that is a very good question to ask.

The future timeline in Holozing begins with an event that no one has ever been able to fully explain: the disappearance of the creatures. There was no great war, nor any visible catastrophe; they simply ceased to exist. Some theories suggest a migration to another dimension; others posit a natural reaction from the planet itself. But the only certainty is that the world fell silent.

---


![bd3b037e-ba4a-4693-81da-e8d236cdf5de.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xATg59bQeAboSfFqeVoNmbE6e621cpKAhWqKpZgSaKng6READGtzFbS1EdkTJV9NjqK.png)



---

This initial period is known as the Era of Biological Silence. (Pretty cool, right?)

Rather than collapsing, humanity reacted swiftly. Without the presence of creatures to disrupt ecosystems or pose unpredictable threats, old limitations vanished. Entire regions that had previously been uninhabitable suddenly became accessible.


---



![d627a809-ca74-40e0-9341-87e4e63f9b07.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2idCQM88LfyuVeYBjUKKptSHNsu6W9m79nyvRdaD3rf8nhwt7AMUEzXYbVDpVasoCZ.png)



---

The Elemental Islands territories that had remained untamable for centuries began to be explored, surveyed, and eventually settled. What was once considered sacred or dangerous came to be viewed merely as a resource.

The first few decades witnessed a period of accelerated growth. Cities were erected atop the remnants of ancient habitats, and research centers sprang up with the singular goal of understanding what had been left behind.

---



![rtrthrthr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1Hfo6v9b5j3zBydif5pKUupCP2L3v7EoyEGhy8s2WfKB1kuWWUjnn5ZNaC8hDm7aDi.png)



---

Technology advanced at an unprecedented pace, driven by the study of residual energy traces that the creatures had left embedded in the environment. These energies—difficult to comprehend yet incredibly potent—became the bedrock of a new industrial revolution.

Over time, humanity did not merely adapt to the absence of the creatures; it began to replace them. Artificial systems replicated the functions these beings had once performed—everything from climate regulation to the maintenance of specific ecosystem stability. Everything appeared to be under control.

---



![4f4c3087-11ef-4690-8543-49ae0f60bee3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tmHrfLQHTkcjLMvZ727HvuUgk9Tbob2E6uJjdNU223jK9JxFWYtEMmoXxiyz1BRVgAB.png)


---

The dominant narrative spoke of progress, of a definitive independence from natural forces—of a world in which human beings no longer depended on anything but themselves.

However, cracks were beginning to appear in this growth. As the years passed, anomalies began to appear—zones where residual energy behaved erratically, structures that failed without explanation, and territories where nature seemed to resist human intervention.

Some scientists began to suggest that the creatures were not merely inhabitants of the world, but fundamental components of a far more complex equilibrium.

---


![097f7968-07dd-437e-9b2a-18e1568512e3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u66skXviDWLAUpNTpt2GsUUdGwMUE93ZvmNBF7EUm7YSPdmvarNU6db6oKkjqhUsAwy.png)



---

Society slowly became divided. On one side stood those who championed expansion and total dominion over the environment, convinced that any problem could be solved with more technology. On the other emerged groups who viewed the disappearance of the creatures as a warning a sign that something essential had broken.

body.title: GPT-5.4: A OpenAI Fundiu Raciocínio e Código em um Único Motor
body.body:
## O que é o GPT-5.4

O GPT-5.4 é a fusão do raciocínio avançado com as capacidades de codificação do GPT-5.3-codex — o modelo especializado que a OpenAI usava separadamente para tarefas de programação. Em vez de ter dois modelos que se complementam, agora existe um que faz os dois bem.

Pense como um canivete suíço que finalmente tem uma boa lâmina. Canivetes suíços sempre tiveram muitas ferramentas, mas a faca principal era medíocre. O GPT-5.4 é a versão em que a lâmina principal finalmente ficou afiada.

## O número que muda a conversa

O GPT-5.4 tem 33% menos probabilidade de cometer erros em afirmações factuais individuais do que o GPT-5.2, e respostas completas têm 18% menos probabilidade de conter erros no geral. Isso pode soar como estatística fria, mas na prática significa menos alucinação, menos informação inventada, menos retrabalho para quem usa o modelo profissionalmente.

Para um analista usando IA para redigir relatórios, ou um desenvolvedor pedindo explicações de código, essa redução de erros não é trivial. É a diferença entre confiar na resposta e ter que verificar tudo do zero.

## Contexto de 1 milhão de tokens

O modelo suporta janelas de contexto de até 1 milhão de tokens. Para ter uma perspectiva: um livro de 300 páginas contém cerca de 100 mil palavras. Com 1 milhão de tokens, você consegue processar entre 5 e 10 livros completos em uma única sessão.

Na prática, isso abre possibilidades que antes eram teóricas: analisar bases de código inteiras, processar contratos legais extensos, revisar documentação técnica de produtos complexos sem perder contexto anterior.

## Uso nativo do computador

Uma das adições mais comentadas é a capacidade nativa de uso do computador — no Codex e na API, o GPT-5.4 é o primeiro modelo OpenAI de propósito geral capaz de interagir com interfaces gráficas, clicar botões, preencher formulários e navegar por sistemas como se fosse um usuário humano.

Isso posiciona o GPT-5.4 como um agente de automação real, não apenas um assistente que gera texto sobre o que fazer. Ele consegue executar.

## GPT-5.4 Thinking: a versão que raciocina em voz alta

Existe uma variante chamada GPT-5.4 Thinking que mostra o plano de raciocínio antes de responder. Não é apenas o resultado final — é o processo. Para tarefas complexas como pesquisa profunda na web, análise de dados ou tomada de decisão com múltiplas variáveis, ver o raciocínio do modelo ajuda a identificar falhas antes que se tornem problemas.

Essa versão está disponível para os planos ChatGPT Plus, Team e Pro.

## Tool Search para agentes

Outro avanço relevante para quem constrói sistemas de agentes: o GPT-5.4 inclui um recurso chamado **tool search**, que ajuda o modelo a encontrar e usar as ferramentas certas dentro de grandes ecossistemas. Quando um agente tem acesso a dezenas ou centenas de ferramentas, saber qual usar e quando é tão importante quanto saber como usar.

## O que esperar

O GPT-5.4 não é o fim da corrida — a OpenAI já está no GPT-5.4 e continua iterando. Mas representa o momento em que raciocínio e código deixaram de ser uma escolha e passaram a coexistir nativamente. Para quem usa IA no trabalho diário, isso vale atenção.

body.title: O nos paramos para evitarla o nos dejamos arrastrar por la ola [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> ## Spanish Hola a todos, en mis casi 28 años, solo he ido a la playa en dos ocasiones, siendo la primera con 15 años y la segunda con 17. En ambos casos, casi de visita a la familia de mi abuela, y debo decir que, aunque no sé nadar, fue toda una experiencia encontrarme con toda su amplitud y lo que representa el mar. Y algo que me tomó de imprevisto la primera vez fueron las olas; de por sí soy muy miedosa a las profundidades y sus misterios (lo que se conoce como talasofobia). La curiosidad me ganó y entré con mi tía un poco más adentro de la orilla y, entre el susto de sentir menos el fondo, me golpeó una ola; solo que no me llevó porque mi tía me sostenía fuerte, pero aun así no me dio miedo; al contrario, fue como una emoción. Y es que leyendo un poco sobre el tema que nos propone @talentos para esta semana, no pude evitar recordar esos momentos y la diferencia entre quienes eran arrastrados por esa ola y yo, teniendo esa mano que, aunque sí sentí la fuerza que tenía, pude resistirla y justamente siento y siendo lo segundo, que el rumbo de nuestras vidas es justamente así, como una ola, una que depende de cómo la recibamos; tendremos un resultado distinto. Y es que personalmente, desde que vi en la universidad clases de algoritmo y supe cómo se mueve todo con probabilidades y opciones que pueden ser, yo no he podido evitar aplicar eso a casi cada cosa que hago; es como a veces pensar en qué pasa si hago una cosa o otra y qué desencadena (y aunque puede dar más empujones a esta forma de sobrepensar que tengo, es como eso que me quedó gustando), siento que es como aplicar ese mismo concepto, pero a este panorama de una ola.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTs8USqXdcDdLUEymTA4vjYpLeB9XVuMNjEqQPTLKNc4/1776806748165.jpg
[link](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/desordenada-caos-3192273/)
Y es que, al igual que cada ola, cada vida es diferente y depende de qué tanto queramos sumergirnos. Es donde podemos encontrarnos con unas cada vez más fuertes y que un descuido podría ser un golpe que vamos a sentir fuerte. Aun así, lo que diferencia algo positivo o negativo es si tendremos de dónde sostenernos o si sabremos cómo dejarnos llevar de forma adecuada, y esto porque, si somos bien guiados a él, cómo reconocerlas y cómo disfrutarlas y evitar las que nos pueden generar daño, sabremos que tarde o temprano las olas que elijamos serán seguras para fluir libremente con ellas. Es sin duda una buena manera de ver cómo nos movemos en nuestra vida y cómo a veces incluso surfear una ola de manera aprendida puede representar esa adaptación y preparación para afrontar momentos que se volverán repetitivos e inciertos hasta que podamos deslizarnos con ese aprendizaje que lo da el tiempo, así como el conocimiento mismo que adquirimos año tras año en cada lección de vida, y justamente nos hace conocedores y a estar alerta y precavidos de la ola que tenemos cerca. Así que, bueno, haciendo un poco de reflexión, me gustó mucho adaptar el cómo aprendemos y nos formamos a través de esta visión, tal vez algo metafórica, pero esperando poder haberme dado a entender, por lo que, sin más y esperando sea de su agrado, muchas gracias por leer esta.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRvPbvbZcJwV8niuTy9xti9wsSe6tnbdRWStmH93SGVS/1776806785872.jpg
[link](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/atleta-aptitud-f%c3%adsica-atl%c3%a9tico-9925068/)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqGmWdw7Ng1TFmNLZLU8EEdWdkWakPjZUxFUSqu3HnGK/1723426074530.jpg)
## English Hi everyone, in my almost 28 years, I've only been to the beach twice, the first time when I was 15 and the second when I was 17. Both times it was almost like visiting my grandmother's family, and I must say that, even though I can't swim, it was quite an experience to encounter its vastness and all that the sea represents. Something that took me by surprise the first time was the waves; I'm naturally very afraid of the depths and their mysteries (what's known as thalassophobia). Curiosity got the better of me, and I went a little further out from the shore with my aunt, and amid the fear of feeling the bottom less clearly, a wave hit me; it didn't pull me under because my aunt was holding on tight, but even so, I wasn't scared; on the contrary, it was exhilarating. Reading about the topic @talentos has proposed for this week, I couldn't help but recall those moments and the difference between those being swept away by that wave and me, who had that hand that, although I did feel its force, I was able to resist it. And being the latter, I feel that the course of our lives is just like that, like a wave, one that depends on how we receive it; we'll have a different outcome. Personally, ever since I took algorithm classes in college and learned how everything moves with probabilities and possible outcomes, I haven't been able to avoid applying that to almost everything I do. It's like sometimes thinking about what happens if I do one thing or another and what it triggers (and although it can further fuel this tendency to overthink, it's something I've come to enjoy). I feel like applying that same concept, but to this scenario of a wave.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTs8USqXdcDdLUEymTA4vjYpLeB9XVuMNjEqQPTLKNc4/1776806822553.jpg
[link](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/desordenada-caos-3192273/)
And just like every wave, every life is different and depends on how deeply we choose to immerse ourselves in it. This is where we can encounter increasingly powerful waves, and a moment of carelessness could be a blow we'll feel deeply. Even so, what differentiates something positive from negative is whether we have something to hold onto, or whether we know how to let ourselves be carried along appropriately. This is because, if we are properly guided, learning how to recognize and enjoy them, and how to avoid those that could harm us, we will know that sooner or later the waves we choose will be safe to ride freely. It is undoubtedly a good way to see how we move through life and how sometimes even surfing a wave in a learned way can represent that adaptation and preparation to face moments that will become repetitive and uncertain until we can glide along with the learning that time provides, as well as the knowledge we acquire year after year in each life lesson. This knowledge makes us aware and alert and cautious of the wave that is close to us. So, after some reflection, I really enjoyed adapting how we learn and develop through this vision, perhaps somewhat metaphorical, but hoping I've made myself clear. So, without further ado, and hoping you enjoy it, thank you very much for reading this.

#
Putting in the daily effort
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tRvekyG4gJMoWjUL5bjhZrHnnk1y3C1eVpYS7yTfAHnHgSwEbZTbFZZZ9WJNLre5R1s.png) Image source: Dall-e for both images in this post. ### Greetings Sloth Savers people! Another busy week writing about the Great Little Dragons community and its efforts to get things ready. New liquidity pool. New reporting bots to tell me how much delegation rewards I'm getting. New way to Buy/Sell GLD tokens. Overall its been a productive week and I've been able to make some posts I'm proud of...even if not many people bothered looking. Still so much to do though so much more to come :) ### Hive Power Growing slowly and steadily. Almost 60 more HP added to my stash and at over 40% towards my goal of 700HP. With the low price of HIVE and the power of HELIOS burns I'm getting closer and closer post by post and may actually reach my goal in just over month. As for delegating all my HP to @hiveabbyftp? Well, that is intentional. First: By delegating to the Great Little Dragons delegator I get a weekly distribution (roughly 8%) in GLS tokens. Second: I get upvotes from the @hiveabbyftp curation account. Third: the curator account purchases HELIOS tokens to bring in the @helios.delegator curation. Without those curation upvotes I would be barely moving on Hive. With them I'm making steady progress. Also I looked at all the different delegation returns that GLD community tracks and at 8% @hiveabbyftp is among the best so I'm pretty happy with that. ### HELIOS I spend a bunch of the GLD tokens to increase my HELIOS by over 200 coins towards my 1000 HELIOS goal. I set that goal with HELIOS at 0.17 but it is now at 1.5! That means it is almost 9x the price it was just a short time ago! Of course that makes my goal of 1000 HELIOS kind of unrealistic but I'll keep working towards it. I do know that @tergan, @terganftp, and @hiveabbyftp are all actively working at increasing their stake in the coin so they can call the helios.voter to upvote community posts. Great for me and great for the community. Also looking at the HELIOS token I don't expect the 1.5 price to last. 1.7 or even 2.0 are quite likely before my next slothysavers post :) I'll keep trying for 1000 HELIOS tokens.... but if I get enough HELIOS to sell for 1000 HIVE? I'll consider that a win as well. It will be interesting to see how high the HELIOS tokens soars. ### GLD Held Most of my GLD was sold off. Originally it was doing to be sold for additional off chain investments. However, with the HELIOS price going up considerably and with legs to keep on going higher? I decided to go with what I expect to be the higher yield. ### EDSI tokens I really want to buy EDSI tokens and honestly I could probably pick up 50 tokens fairly quickly. I might do that in the upcoming week or I might just buy more HELIOS before it burns through the current 1.5 sell wall an starts moving on its 1.7 price. Will have to see what the other users do and how many bots keep supporting the current price.

#
I still have a long way to go
Still, it is a slow grind on HIVE. Posting every day takes a lot of time. Making sure everything hits minimum standards so I'm not posting crap is a lot of work. Sometimes I wonder *is it really worth it* with HIVE at such a low valuation. Still in the long term I still believe that the slow and steady wins the race is realistic on Hive so I keep on plodding along. And that's how I'm progressing the Slothy way. <center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Tuesday ☀️ 12022

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931776806445.794868) 

So much for the rain. After two days, all the plants and even the occasional basement in town have been thoroughly watered. This morning was very crisp, barely windy, and very sunny. It took a little while for the sun to warm up as I walked the Luiseninsel loop through the palace park using interval walking and enjoyed a few intense breathing and meditation exercises on the island’s shore. Of course, I also wished the Queen a good morning and paid a visit to the hollow tree. The rain from the past few days was clearly visible throughout the park. Lush greenery everywhere, and even the old alder on the island’s shore is finally unfurling its leaves. In addition to a pair of swans and the usual gray herons and other smaller birds, I also spotted a mother duck with her seven cute ducklings today, but see for yourselves in the photos. It felt good to enjoy it all to the fullest, because starting tomorrow, it’s back to work for a few days. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931776806449.360258) 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931776806464.7079182) 

Soviel zum Regen. Nach zwei Tagen sind dann alle Pflanzen und auch der eine oder andere Keller der Stadt ordentlich gewässert. Der heutige Morgen war sehr frisch, kaum windig und sehr sonnig. Es dauerte ein wenig, bis die Sonne wärmte, während ich die Luiseninselrunde durch den Schlosspark im Intervall-Walking ging und am Ufer auf der Insel ein paar intensive Atem- und Meditationsübungen genoss. Der Frau Königin habe ich natürlich auch einen guten Morgen gewünscht und dem hohlen Baum einen Besuch abgestattet. Dem ganzen Park war der Regen der letzten Tage deutlich anzusehen. Saftiges Grün überall und auch die alte Erle am Ufer auf der Insel entfaltet endlich ihre Blätter. Neben einem Schwanenpärchen und den üblichen Graureihern und anderen kleineren Vögeln habe ich heute auch eine Entenmutter mit ihren sieben putzigen Küken gesichtet, aber seht selbst auf den Fotos. Es tat gut, das alles ausgiebig zu genießen, denn ab morgen heißt es wieder für ein paar Tage einen Showjob erledigen. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931776806477.2516599)

body.title: A journey through time as you visit one of the city’s most important castles [ENG-ESP]
body.body: >Greetings, dear friends of Worldmappin, and welcome to my blog. Today I’m sharing an interesting tour with you—one steeped in history—a must-see destination I’d been meaning to visit for a long time. The good news is that I was finally able to fulfill this small but incredible dream. I had been to the historic district of Cumaná a couple of times, but on both occasions, the castle wasn’t open to the public. What I regretted most was how difficult it was to reach that destination, because the Castle of San Antonio de la Eminencia is located at one of the highest points in the city. It’s so high up that you feel like you’re hiking.

>On those days when the visit didn’t work out, I took several photos; the view is breathtaking. Stone walls line the site, and we found xerophytic vegetation—many cacti, but also flowering plants—as well as small statues and a large building, which serves as the headquarters of the “Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia Foundation.” All these elements make the path very appealing; they allow us to take in the beauty of the place as we climb the steep hill leading to this ancient fortress, whose construction dates back to the 17th century.

![1776713707938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgUrG9e9yGaWYMjbE3uGkzermKy9RP7oFpcFhYEVjtEb/1776713707938.jpg)

>On the very day I least expected it, right after visiting a cousin who lives near the castle, I managed to take the tour. Walking down Miramar Street, in the distance, the imposing architecture of San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle dominates the view; a sign guiding visitors invites you to come in and, of course, begin the tour. Then, at a stone guardhouse, an employee told me she wasn’t sure if the tour was open to the public, but she suggested I go ahead anyway. There are several entrances to the castle, so I didn’t miss the chance to take in the staircases that would lead me to explore this magnificent fortress built on Pan de Azúcar Hill, from where you can look out over the entire city of Cumaná.

>I took the tour thanks to one of the guides who was very kind to me. The first thing we did was climb up to the area where three rooms and a tower were built. These rooms housed important figures, such as the scientist Alexander von Humboldt and the French naturalist, physician, and botanist Amado Bonpland. Nothing remains of these structures; they were destroyed in the earthquakes that struck the city. In this same area, we found the battlements—24 in total—which were small structures used to support the strategic placement of cannons, the largest of which were called culverins. San Antonio Castle has an interesting history; it was a prominent fortification built by the Spanish to protect the city from pirate attacks. Although the cannons were brought from Spain, the castle was built with coral stones brought from the Araya Peninsula in Sucre State. To construct this building, a mixture called calicanto was used, consisting of various materials such as sand, water, lime, aloe vera, blood, and animal manure.
![1776713707688.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUFD78UMf7ppcmw416aSXMjiyxz9XZpT3nkSueFtpT9Zk/1776713707688.jpg)
![1776713707617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EokfZGCQGNXkmYiffD51yG1N9zRqivR4aftHd8SRznBBbawSqvJEQhhvekyDdz7tC4s.jpg)
![1776713707790.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPQwZZwfpgHkBycLEqfHVGAM4ax7T1YZdscQGEtHkLo1H/1776713707790.jpg)
![1776713707728.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmURyEReMLyzK1SkDR7geHR49rSYshdCcZAzTCxmbeqqEW/1776713707728.jpg)
![1776713707017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRc9mBvhC9LNCxw8RfZ8zPqU5CUkvhu4zfccXfmwGxHaY/1776713707017.jpg) View of the city of Cumaná
![1776713707971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/245HjAMzwqfcFH44Ae9JpUm75GDX8SAs4NzS9oUn7hTbWjtcspkBvRkQJw9dJZDGUxWxu.jpg) View of the city of Cumaná
![1776713707498.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUWSd8x863tpmsuaMRCDfEozkiQmVAE6qstQKKiSRqjeL/1776713707498.jpg)
![1776713707531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EqYuhebJrbuMjzwTdwyNgP1zHnwffyzvR4T3jQHgnxn5ZXQszo8PAqEy9KNtYxmJQ9V.jpg)
![1776713707222.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVEDUAg4JUShBn1jLg1HpMvNDZPiyjhpLNvVbA3myoYFp/1776713707222.jpg)
![1776713707257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmadU6Ax3pr1fh7Y7Y6MqvetcUtrBqZT7jVTEKFXXpMbJk/1776713707257.jpg)
![1776713707079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/Ep1Zo3pLUp649Sac7QYVDFoK5U7Z69EsiAvZaRuZJMwwKys2gJKtZ6YNQTpuY67UJne.jpg)

>Due to damage caused by earthquakes, the passage of time, and constant attacks, only the remains of cannons, the dungeon, and the powder magazine remain in the castle. Gunpowder was stored in the powder magazine, a space that required specific conditions to function properly; it could not be damp or hot. This magnificent fortress features four watchtowers, each topped by a lion—the symbol of the Spanish defense. The design of this imposing fortress takes the shape of a four-pointed star. Each point represents a cardinal direction, serving as a reference for orientation against enemy troops.
![1776713707515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQyeTX7THRTksgC5z1U2dj49EeDXzJHzJtpjfvZLv2wX3/1776713707515.jpg)
![1776713707481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EpJaT38SX3kVqZXfYKn3Ctwp95fyubBjfcWZU4zVcMAtcQ4hHBqE3iVPfK52UYsVYCy.jpg)
![1776713707442.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBudUeko354Sd8kbA5Czn1koVZ4XPARPpTRuR16hxSSw/1776713707442.jpg)
![1776713707305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EpNqm2twaeE383eATRq3aQwZHcFZhuKYEB8tHdnVxgWjnFAqApqjAgmrVtiZKAAnjeq.jpg)
![1776713707338.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuLG6av29by3ddKeRBP6sq2PVFGBJi9BNLqKZ7hbchDy/1776713707338.jpg)

>After touring the upper part of the castle, we went down to the dungeon, a gloomy place where prisoners were held. The dungeon still has its original adobe floor despite the passage of time. It was designed with very small windows, barely providing any ventilation; everything was dark, and there one lost track of time—it was impossible to tell whether it was day or night. In each section of the dungeon, a door divided the spaces, making the place even more gloomy. In every corner were cesspools, and for the most extreme conditions, there was the “prison of oblivion,” where captives died of starvation. Important figures in Venezuelan history were held captive in the dungeon, including former presidents José Antonio Páez and José Tadeo Monagas.

>Today, we can see some changes from the original period and design of this fortress, such as murals depicting iconic landmarks of the city and historical artifacts. Among the artifacts are a tobacco press, a grain millstone, a dark brown cannonball that did not explode—it was used solely to break down walls upon impact—and a canno.
![1776713707189.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDG9jKBiFd7HTD8MnWkSxhuYEEBfRfgmJH82ei5gvBHN/1776713707189.jpg)

>San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle was built between 1659 and 1686. It was designated a National Historic Monument in 1965, the year it was restored after suffering severe structural damage in the 1929 earthquake. This site represents an important part of the heritage of the city of Cumaná; it is a premier tourist destination that speaks volumes about its historical identity. I loved this visit from start to finish. If you come to Cumaná, you can’t miss this iconic and wonderful tour. That’s all for my tour, my dear friends. See you next time!.
# Thank you for reading
_The photos are originals taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 phone. The editions were made with the [GridArt application](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US)_
![1776713706965.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcFbobyyyp1zvBi2xJsDpx62Wb5uzqQMCoN4x3WHKEKyu/1776713706965.jpg)
#

>Saludos estimados amigos de Worldmappin, bienvenidos a mi blog. Hoy les comparto un interesante recorrido, cargado de historia, una visita imperdible que tenía pendiente y que quería realizar desde hace mucho tiempo. La buena noticia, al fin pude cumplir este pequeño pero increíble anhelo. Había ido un par de veces al casco histórico de Cumaná, pero en ambas ocasiones la visita al Castillo no estaba abierta al público. Lo que más lamentaba era lo difícil que era llegar a ese destino, porque el Castillo de San Antonio de la Eminencia queda en uno de los puntos más altos de la ciudad. Es tan alto, que te sientes como si estuvieras haciendo senderismo.

>Esos días fallidos respecto a la visita tomé varias fotografías, el panorama es impresionante, los muros de piedra bordean el lugar, encontramos vegetación xerófila, muchos cactus, pero también plantas de flores, estatuillas y un gran edificio, sede de la “Fundación Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia.” Todos estos elementos hacen que el camino sea muy atractivo, nos permite contemplar las bellezas del lugar mientras subes por la empinada colina que te lleva a esta antigua fortaleza, cuya construcción data del siglo XVII.
![1776713707748.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVeFZAbFWkGYSBrw4upatHaCdWCNzoLx1W2si9isbL34/1776713707748.jpg)
![1776713707774.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRcWPZ2eHJMdpveBvUdjojezkLivxh4nkWb3GikxLFnGo/1776713707774.jpg)
![1776713707842.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQyTXLziKPuPvAXfeEzw8AmvHyY8hcfsMbFor2c3USGL/1776713707842.jpg)
![1776713707809.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQXf23CWaPp7MhEBrV28sNzevgdaciv3wdR4ALY1cVA6R/1776713707809.jpg)
![1776713707826.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtLhJWd4T1ivECmkDMPz2iuS4KYZFcBZazAvMsv3dH6H/1776713707826.jpg)
![1776713707874.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmczcoCit5iVEK8MWQEwxKv7sJdQ71hTVtV5iWBeokk5pQ/1776713707874.jpg)
![1776713707890.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeFtbSffYDnrPyQ6BTvPcBUm93Qi62q2p8uyA3wpUMSgk/1776713707890.jpg)
![1776713707905.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXHYz6zp8Usw4GXUas9Q5P1c1VpRBYy1mUBBhs5zmhfuT/1776713707905.jpg)
![1776713707921.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbQy1igs3QKkrFUMMnVoQSabMxzAR8hi8tEn3WXk19TdY/1776713707921.jpg)
![1776713707857.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUrBaB1XkJdeFGeNdX5T2fzkdt5itrGZv5RUsCRs4q6KT/1776713707857.jpg)
![1776713707938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgUrG9e9yGaWYMjbE3uGkzermKy9RP7oFpcFhYEVjtEb/1776713707938.jpg)

>El día menos esperado, justamente, después de visitar a una prima que vive cerca del castillo, logré hacer la visita. Bajando por la calle Miramar, a lo lejos, impera la imponente arquitectura del castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia, un aviso para orientar a los visitantes te invita a pasar, y por supuesto, comenzar la travesía. Luego, en una casilla fabricada en piedras que funge como vigilancia, una funcionaria me dijo que no estaba segura si estaba abierto al público el recorrido, no obstante, me sugirió pasar. Para llegar al castillo hay varias entradas, así que no perdí la oportunidad de captar las escalinatas que me llevarían a conocer esta magnífica fortaleza construida en el cerro Pan de Azúcar, desde donde se puede observar por todo lo alto, la ciudad de Cumaná.

>Hice el recorrido gracias a una de las guías que me atendió amablemente. Lo primero que hicimos fue subir a la zona donde estuvieron construidas tres habitaciones y una torre, en dichas habitaciones, se alojaron importantes personajes, como lo fueron, el científico Alexander von Humboldt y el naturalista, médico y botánico francés, Amado Bonpland. De estas construcciones no queda nada, fueron destruidas en los terremotos ocurridos en la ciudad. En esta misma zona, encontramos las almenas, en total son 24, son casetas que servían de apoyo para la ubicación estratégica de los cañones, siendo los más grandes llamados culebrinas. El castillo San Antonio cuenta una historia interesante, fue una destacada fortificación elaborada por los españoles para proteger a la ciudad de ataques piratas. Aunque los cañones fueron traídos desde España, el castillo fue construido con piedras coralinas traídas desde la Península de Araya, estado Sucre. Para armar esta construcción se utilizó una mezcla llamada calicanto, formada por diversos materiales, como arena, agua, cal, aloe vera o sábila, sangre y estiércol de origen animal.
![1776713707688.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUFD78UMf7ppcmw416aSXMjiyxz9XZpT3nkSueFtpT9Zk/1776713707688.jpg)
![1776713707617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EokfZGCQGNXkmYiffD51yG1N9zRqivR4aftHd8SRznBBbawSqvJEQhhvekyDdz7tC4s.jpg)
![1776713707790.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPQwZZwfpgHkBycLEqfHVGAM4ax7T1YZdscQGEtHkLo1H/1776713707790.jpg)
![1776713707728.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmURyEReMLyzK1SkDR7geHR49rSYshdCcZAzTCxmbeqqEW/1776713707728.jpg)
![1776713707017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRc9mBvhC9LNCxw8RfZ8zPqU5CUkvhu4zfccXfmwGxHaY/1776713707017.jpg) Vista de la ciudad de Cumaná
![1776713707971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/245HjAMzwqfcFH44Ae9JpUm75GDX8SAs4NzS9oUn7hTbWjtcspkBvRkQJw9dJZDGUxWxu.jpg) Vista de la ciudad de Cumaná
![1776713707498.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUWSd8x863tpmsuaMRCDfEozkiQmVAE6qstQKKiSRqjeL/1776713707498.jpg)
![1776713707531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EqYuhebJrbuMjzwTdwyNgP1zHnwffyzvR4T3jQHgnxn5ZXQszo8PAqEy9KNtYxmJQ9V.jpg)
![1776713707222.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVEDUAg4JUShBn1jLg1HpMvNDZPiyjhpLNvVbA3myoYFp/1776713707222.jpg)
![1776713707257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmadU6Ax3pr1fh7Y7Y6MqvetcUtrBqZT7jVTEKFXXpMbJk/1776713707257.jpg)
![1776713707079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/Ep1Zo3pLUp649Sac7QYVDFoK5U7Z69EsiAvZaRuZJMwwKys2gJKtZ6YNQTpuY67UJne.jpg)

>Debido a los daños ocasionados por terremotos, el tiempo y los constantes ataques, en el castillo solo quedan restos de cañones, el calabozo y el cuarto del polvorín. En este último, se almacenaba la pólvora, este espacio tenía unas condiciones especiales para su buen funcionamiento, no podía ser húmedo, ni caluroso. En esta maravillosa fortaleza hay cuatro garitas, sobre estas, un león como símbolo de escudo por parte de la defensa española. El diseño de esta imponente fortaleza tiene forma de una estrella de 4 puntas. Cada una representa un punto cardinal, la referencia para la orientación frente a las tropas enemigas.
![1776713707515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQyeTX7THRTksgC5z1U2dj49EeDXzJHzJtpjfvZLv2wX3/1776713707515.jpg)
![1776713707481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EpJaT38SX3kVqZXfYKn3Ctwp95fyubBjfcWZU4zVcMAtcQ4hHBqE3iVPfK52UYsVYCy.jpg)
![1776713707442.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBudUeko354Sd8kbA5Czn1koVZ4XPARPpTRuR16hxSSw/1776713707442.jpg)
![1776713707305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/EpNqm2twaeE383eATRq3aQwZHcFZhuKYEB8tHdnVxgWjnFAqApqjAgmrVtiZKAAnjeq.jpg)
![1776713707338.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuLG6av29by3ddKeRBP6sq2PVFGBJi9BNLqKZ7hbchDy/1776713707338.jpg)

>Después del recorrido en la parte superior del castillo, bajamos al calabozo, un lugar lúgubre donde mantenían a los prisioneros. El calabozo, conserva su piso original de adobe pese al pasar del tiempo. Fue diseñado con ventanas muy confinadas, apenas para un poco de ventilación, todo era oscuro, allí se perdía la noción del tiempo, no se sabía si era de día o de noche. En cada marco del calabozo había una puerta que dividía los espacios, haciendo más sombrío el lugar. En cada esquina había pozos sépticos y para mayores condiciones extremas, existe la prisión del olvido, donde los cautivos morían de mengua. En el calabozo permanecieron cautivos importantes personajes de la historia de Venezuela, los ex presidentes, José Antonio Páez y José Tadeo Monagas.

>Actualmente, encontramos algunas modificaciones con respecto a la época y el diseño original de esta fortaleza, como incursiones de pinturas que representan lugares emblemáticos de la ciudad y objetos históricos. Entre los objetos, una prensa de hacer tabaco, una piedra de moler granos, una bala de cañón de color marrón oscuro que no explotaba, solo servía para romper muros al chocar contra ellos y un cañón.
![1776713707189.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDG9jKBiFd7HTD8MnWkSxhuYEEBfRfgmJH82ei5gvBHN/1776713707189.jpg)

>El Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia se construyó entre 1659 y 1686, fue declarado Monumento Histórico Nacional en 1965, año de su restauración luego de haber sido severamente dañada su estructura en el terremoto de 1929. Este lugar representa parte importante del patrimonio de la ciudad de Cumaná, un lugar turístico por excelencia que habla por sí mismo de su identidad histórica. Me encantó esta visita, de principio a fin, si vienes a Cumaná, no te puedes perder este emblemático y maravilloso recorrido. Hasta aquí mi paseo, mis queridos amigos, nos vemos en otra oportunidad.

body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g74f9fc4c3c890336b7dbfd11a73495323f6230b2c05111ec8e9ce371b4e528cfb1408c9fb47ddf8082b96d4c3f285352c0b2ba421c9a9f0710da6962417976e7_640.jpg)</center>

***

红烧肉是一道让我感到无比满足的美食。浓郁的酱香味道和鲜嫩的五花肉相结合，每一口都带来温暖的安慰。那种肥而不腻的口感，配上米饭简直是绝配。每次享用红烧肉，仿佛都能感受到家乡的味道，唤起了很多美好的回忆。料理的过程也同样令人愉悦，慢慢炖煮的香气在厨房弥漫，让人期待那一刻的到来。红烧肉，不仅仅是一道菜，更是一种情感的寄托。

***

body.title: El comerciante (cuento corto)
body.body:
*Odio este odio que apunta en mi sien,*
*Grita.*
*Ahora temo*
*Y no es por mí.*

**Esta mi yo**
**Rosamary Argüelles García**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmef9bA5QcTkHHSzpAmMHWruhUoFAeezJGCbi3SGx5Zg8c/1776784761592.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/horse-carriage-buggy-wagon-field-7637951/)

Estoy acostumbrado a que la gente me mire con… sí, hasta con asco, ¿para qué engañarme? Este mensajero me miró así. Mi padre siempre fue aquella muralla que me protegía de las crudezas de este mundo en el que vivimos, y de gente como este... hombre que me ve de esta manera.  Padre siempre estuvo a mi lado desde el primer momento que me colocaron en sus brazos y me trajo hasta esta zona intermedia. No sé por qué habrá hecho eso, ni de qué zona me trajo. Aunque una idea me hago, tampoco quiero saberlo. Solo sé que siempre me han denigrado por mestizo. Todos, excepto mi padre. Gracias a él aprendí este duro oficio que es ser comerciante y me construido un nombre entre tanta desidia. Mi padre… él fue mi escuela y mi hospital, mi almohada y mi colcha… mi madre y mi padre. ¿Dónde estará? ¿Qué habrá sido de él después de tantos ciclos lejos de casa? Y ¿qué rayos quiere el Alcalde conmigo, para llamarme a esta hora de la noche? Los negocios de él siempre fueron con mi padre. Nunca me enteré de qué hablaban una vez que Padre era convocado. Pero ahora que él no está, soy el único en esta ciudad, capacitado para trasladarme a las demás zonas. El único con el conocimiento, herramientas y oficio adecuado. Este es el contacto de que necesito para poder ampliar mi negocio. Vaya, quizás hasta le pueda pedir lo suficiente como para comprarme varias piedras flotantes, que ya a las viejas de mi carro, les he consumido prácticamente toda la magia y casi no flotan.

El viejo Alcalde, político al fin, casi logra esconder su desagrado al negociar conmigo. Solo lo ha logrado al hablar de mi padre, de lo mucho que lo admiraba, de lo honesto, fiel, inteligente y…, en fin, que era único. Sí, lo sé… pero luego de hablar tan bien de él, una mueca, como un tic inconsciente, le levantaba la comisura izquierda del labio y casi cierra el ojo del mismo lado de la cara. Da risa verlo tratar de componerse. Lo tolero todo porque es un buen negocio, mejor paga de la que esperaba y no es mucha la carga a transportar, por lo que tendré espacio para buscar mi mercancía. Solo que nunca le perdonaré al viejo verde este que hable tanto de mi padre y ni siquiera moviera un músculo para buscarlo cuando lo reporté desaparecido. No importa cuántas rocas me dé, ni qué tan nuevo y espacioso sea el nuevo carro para el viaje. No: mi padre es sagrado. Solo por eso, no me da pena haber estafado al Alcalde, así como hice. Se cree muy listo. El sobrenombre de Gran Sabio que le han dado, realmente le queda grande si un pobre mestizo como yo, puede engañarlo para que me de todo lo que pedí. Al final terminé pidiendo cosas que ni necesito.

El carro flota de maravillas. Los asientos son cómodos y los controles… ya los he dominado. Hay que poseer un conocimiento avanzado de comandos mágicos para entenderlos. Por suerte los he aprendido casi todos con mi padre. Ya puedo maniobrar como quiera a esta mole capaz de transportar varias carretas dentro. Con este equipo seré capaz de comprarme mi granja y mi flota de trasporte. Vaya, ¡hasta contratar empleados en varias zonas! Incluso, hasta poder comprar un título de Noble. Es lo que siempre he soñado. Todo, siempre y cuando logre llevarle el paquete al Alcalde, y que este bello carro mío aguante el paso a la otra zona. En esta en particular, el peso de las piedras será mayor y su flotabilidad menor. Hasta yo pasaré mucho trabajo cuando llegue a esta zona, menos mal que tengo el traje perfecto. Cortesía del Alcalde, por cierto. Prefiero por mucho a la otra, donde me siento más cómodo. Si me lo propusiera, creo que algún día pudiera volar como hacen esos choushins largos de allá. Si piensan que soy raro, ellos lo son más. 
Por suerte, traigo varias piedras encantadas especialmente para este lugar al que voy ahora. Desde hace mucho tiempo he querido venir a esta zona. Hay un mercado con piedras, trajes y materiales que no existen ni en mi zona ni en la de los choushins. Materiales por los que son capaces de pagar muy buen precio allá en mi ciudad.

Logro montar la caja dentro del compartimiento de carga del carro. Con lo que le quité el Alcalde, he podido comprar un pequeño tesoro con el que conseguiré todo aquello que siempre soñé: respeto, tierras, títulos… Tanto he comprado que tengo que soltar un poco de dinero para contratar a varios floresiens para poder levantar las cajas del suelo. Es increíble lo mucho que puede pesar hasta una hoja de árbol en esta zona. Lo más extraño de todo este encargo no fue el hecho que viniera hasta aquí, ni el peso desmesurado de la caja del Alcalde, sino que, junto con ella, venga una carta para mí. 
Me despido de los floresiens y reanudo mi viaje. Ya terminaron de acomodar allá atrás todo lo que compré, por lo que no puedo regresar a la misma velocidad que vine. Temo estropear la carga. La del Alcalde puede ser algo muy fino, o no. Eso no lo sé ni me interesa. Es una de las reglas de los mercaderes: si no te dicen qué transportas, no preguntes ni averigües. Lo importante de verdad es que pude comprar muchísimas cosas. Ya me siento un hombre rico… y la carta... ¿La leo o espero a encontrarme con el Alcalde y preguntarle? Qué va, hay demasiadas lunas de por medio.


*Querido Sony:*

*Lamento no haber podido hablarte en persona y tener que usar un medio tan impersonal para contar lo que aquí leerás. Primero, quiero que sepas que no me pasó nada que no supiera que podría pasar. Desde que lograste hacerte de una estabilidad económica y te convertiste en un hombre de bien, has dejado de depender de tu viejo padre. Esto me ha llenado de orgullo. Tanto que no soy capaz de describirlo. Así que decidí dedicarme a una tarea que no pude hacer a tiempo completo mientras crecías y tenía que permanecer a tu lado: Buscar a tu madre.*
*Como sabes, me fuiste entregado poco después que llegaste al mundo. Lo que desconocías era que tu madre fue una joven de la zona de los choushins de la que me enamoré en uno de mis viajes. Pero no era posible para mí, un mercader de esta zona media, quedarme a vivir allí para siempre. Mi cuerpo no está adaptado a flotar. Tú, que has estado en esa zona, sabes lo que le pasa al cuerpo cuando llevas varias lunas allá… bueno, tú sabes lo que le pasa al mío, ya que el tuyo al tener sangre de tu madre en tus venas, se adapta rápido a las características de esa zona. Sé que lo has notado porque eres diferente, Sony, y eso no es nada malo, recuérdalo. Por eso te dije siempre que no te avergonzaras de tu condición de mestizo: tienes lo mejor de ambos lados.*
*Estuve varios ciclos comerciando entre las tres zonas y visitando a mi amada cada vez que podía. Poco a poco me iba enamorando cada vez más. Un amor imposible, pues estábamos separados por zonas, anatomías y costumbres muy diferentes y exclusivas para cada uno de nosotros. Un día, fui hasta la zona de tu madre: Sonya de Ookii ie. Al llegar, no estaba preparado para lo que vi. En el lugar donde estaba su casa, solo quedaba la marca de donde una vez estuvo asentada. Habían soltado las amarras y volado a otro lugar. Al parecer, sus padres se habían enterado de lo nuestro y tomaron medidas. Pero no me rendí, tenía que hallarla. Así pasaron muchos ciclos hasta que la encontré. Más bien, ella a mí. La vi destruida, enferma y con un bulto en los brazos: tú. Me dijo que estaba huyendo de su familia porque querían matarte. A ti, por ser un mestizo y la evidencia de mi ofensa a su casta y nombre. Así que ella huyó y estuvo esperando desde entonces, a que regresara a su ciudad. Quisieron los Dioses que pudiera encontrarme. Le dije que se fuera conmigo, pero no podía, muchas cosas se lo impedían. La mayor de ellas, la fatalidad geográfica que nos separan. Juré que volvería un día con una solución y salí de ahí contigo. Esa fue la promesa que pude cumplir ahora. Es cierto que muy tarde, pero como te he dicho, los mercaderes tienen una sola palabra, y hay que cumplirla.*
*Lamentablemente, para llevar a cabo mi empresa ahora, pasé mucho tiempo en la zona de los floresiens, resolviendo el equipo necesario; y luego en la de tu madre hasta dar con ella. Eso ocasionó daños irreversibles en mi cuerpo y supe que no podría regresar a decirte todo esto en persona. Algo sabías de tu pasado, porque nunca te he ocultado nada. Lo que no, fue porque tampoco preguntabas, por respeto, pienso yo. Ahora lo comparto al tener todos los datos necesarios por si quieres unírtele y conocerla. Ella te estará esperando ahora que no corren peligro. Me alegro de al fin poder hablarle y disculparme por todo.*
*Mandé varios mensajes a la ciudad, con los hombres que había enviado a buscarme mi amigo el Alcalde. Si lees esta carta, es que pudo contactarte. Al parecer estabas de viaje de negocios, por lo que dispuse, con la ayuda de él y de tu madre, quien me ha cuidado hasta ahora, para que mis restos fueran enviados a ti. Entre mis posesiones están los datos de ella. El viaje hasta allá será largo, pero tú puedes hacerlo. Solo tú. La familia tiene que permanecer unida, Sony.*
*Se feliz, hijo mío. Estoy muy orgulloso de ti.*
*Te quiere,*
*Papá.*

El carro se detuvo frente a la residencia del Alcalde. Este, al salir vio que el joven conductor descendía para saludarlo y abrir la puerta del compartimiento de carga. El Alcalde subió enseguida buscando el preciado envío que esperaba desde hacía varios ciclos. Apartó cajas de piedras y minerales preciosos que habían sido comprados en un mercado de la zona de los floresiens. Varias armaduras, trajes especiales y “toneladas” de rocas con hechizos específicos para todas las zonas. En medio de toda aquella mercancía, había un espacio vacío donde supo, por la forma, que allí había estado su carga. Solo que, en vez de esta, lo que había era un papel doblado, con su nombre escrito. El Alcalde lo desdobló, y sonrió al leer:

Gran Sabio:

No puedo entregarle su encargo. Aunque me parece que siempre supo que sucedería. Le devuelvo todo lo que me dio, más un “pequeño extra” que sabrá darle buen uso. 

Siento mucho todo lo que hice, pero la familia tiene que permanecer unida.

Sony.

body.body: > Happy to share on this second day my journey in the battle ranking mode. Here is the element that I found interesting in these 24 hours of battles. My strategy is still in play and I win more games now compared to the previous season.

>

## A:/ Timing

A rapid check of my statistic on the day after execution of my techniques for three days bring many results on the positive side.
I checked this record late today because of the busy action on the first half of the day.



<center>  ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYN4DqxL3AwgYCwuTTfVSQ1jfjY9T6E2yVEduHjvV7tt/image.png) 
</center> 

Modern format shows the current ranking in the Silver League I.
Also, I am happy to read that the win rate is back to 3 win and 1 loss.


<center> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXF5wbrzoaRrdn1SGiaejvyuJoaytoNz2kRQyK7xJoPER/image.png) 
</center> 

If I was not strict about this forced pause after two losses I would be far back with too many losses.

The timing plays a vital role in the fighter your team may encounter in the arena. I played my series of battles in a different time frame compared to the setting I am regularly playing.
