body.title: An Unexpected Comeback in Brawl Stars [ENG🇬🇧/SPA🇻🇪]
body.body: > Hello to the entire Hive Gaming community. To be honest, it's a pleasure for me to start my blog about my hobby, which is playing Brawl Stars. I love this game, and this time I want to tell you about a match I just had. To be completely honest, I didn't think it would turn out so well. # At the beginning of the match, my mobile data wasn't working properly. That complicated the early phase quite a bit. They managed to defeat me easily because I couldn't keep up with the rhythm of my teammates, Kaze and Spike. But even so, trying to maintain control over the gems, we sacrificed ourselves for the team. # The opposing team was made up of a prominent Mr. P, an excellent main Edgar, and an Artillery Grom with his respective Easter bunny skin. Quite beautiful in a terrifying way, to be honest. That skin made him impose respect when it came to giving us the character development of our lives. # To be honest, the match was complicated. Given my situation, the lag limited me a lot. However, as the match progressed, Kaze was harassing Mr. P, giving him a taste of his own medicine. Edgar saw the opportunity to break Kaze's siege against Mr. P and defeated her. That left our team at a numerical disadvantage. # Then Edgar wanted to jump to the center, but Spike was waiting for him there to give him what he deserved. To be completely honest, Kaze carried the match until the moment came when we took control of 16 gems to begin the countdown. # The highlight play of the match was given to the enemy team's Edgar for his good performance in the team fight. But we still won. And that felt quite beautiful, to be honest. # I hope you found it interesting and that you support me to continue making this type of content that I like. See you in a future post.

> Hola a toda la comunidad de Hive Gaming. Para ser honesto, es un placer para mí iniciar mi blog sobre mi pasatiempo que es jugar Brawl Stars. Es un juego que me encanta, y en esta oportunidad quiero contarles sobre una partida que acabo de tener. Para ser completamente honesto, no pensé que saldría tan bien la verdad. # Para empezar, al iniciar la partida los datos móviles no estaban funcionando correctamente. Eso complicó un poco la fase early de la partida. Lograban derrotarme con facilidad por no estar compaginado con el ritmo de mis otros compañeros, La Kaze y el Spike. Pero aún así, tratando de mantener el control sobre las gemas, nos sacrificábamos por el equipo. # El equipo contrario estaba conformado por un prominente Mr. P, un excelente main Edgar, y un Artillero Grom con su respectiva skin de conejo de pascua. Bastante hermoso de una manera aterradora, para ser honesto. Esa skin lo hacía imponer respeto a la hora de darnos el desarrollo de personaje de nuestras vidas. # La partida sinceramente estaba complicada. Dada mi situación, el lag me limitaba mucho. Sin embargo, al transcurrir la partida, la Kaze estuvo asediando al Mr. P dándole una probadita de su propia medicina. Edgar vio la oportunidad de romper el asedio de Kaze contra Mr. P y la derrotó. Eso dejó a nuestro equipo en desventaja numérica. # Entonces Edgar quiso lanzarse al centro, pero allí lo esperaba Spike para darle su merecido. Para ser completamente honesto, la Kaze carreó la partida hasta que llegó el momento en que nos hicimos con el control de 16 gemas para comenzar el conteo de finalización. # La jugada destacada de la partida se la dieron al Edgar del equipo enemigo por su buen desempeño en el Teamfight. Pero aun así ganamos. Y eso se sintió bastante hermoso, para ser honesto. # Espero que les haya sido de interés y que me apoyen para seguir haciendo este tipo de contenido que me gusta. body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776804192571-6cfce512fcebc938.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=danifoodymas/e134ddcf)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=danifoodymas/e134ddcf)


---

---

### **Español**

**Un Domingo de Música Llanera y Familia en La Cascada 🎤🇻🇪**

¡Hola, querida comunidad de Hive y 3Speak! Espero que estén teniendo una excelente semana.

Antes de entrar en detalles sobre el video de hoy, quería ofrecerles una pequeña disculpa por mi ausencia de estos últimos días. Estuve presentando algunas fallas técnicas con mi teléfono, lo que me impidió estar activa como de costumbre. Afortunadamente, ya logré resolverlo y estoy de vuelta con toda la energía para seguir compartiendo contenido con ustedes. ¡Siempre que pueda, aquí estaré presente!

En el video que les comparto hoy, quiero mostrarles cómo viví mi domingo de fin de semana. Fue un día en familia, tranquilo pero con un toque muy especial y diferente. Todo comenzó gracias a la cordial invitación del famoso cantante Arnaldo Nieves, quien nos invitó a disfrutar de su talento en el restaurante \

No solo tuvimos el placer de escuchar a Arnaldo, sino que también estuvo acompañado por la excelente voz de Beatriz Miró. Más tarde, el ambiente se puso aún mejor cuando se unió el cantante Italo Zapata cerrando con broche de oro esta tarde de música llanera.

En el video verán algunas fotos y fragmentos de este encuentro donde aparezco junto a mi mamá y estos grandes artistas, que además son amistades muy bonitas. Fue un momento muy ameno, lleno de risas y, por supuesto, de nuestra gastronomía: ¡degustamos unas sabrosas cachapas con queso de mano, que estaban increíbles!

Pasar tiempo de calidad con personas tan talentosas y queridas hace que la recarga de energía sea total.

Espero que disfruten de este resumen de mi domingo tanto como yo disfruté grabarlo y editarlo para ustedes. Gracias por el apoyo de siempre!

Nos vemos muy pronto en un nuevo video. ¡Se les quiere! 🫶😊

---

### **English**

**A Sunday of Llanera Music and Family at La Cascada 🎤🇻🇪**

Hello, dear Hive and 3Speak community! I hope you are having an excellent week.

Before getting into the details of today's video, I wanted to offer a small apology for my absence over the last few days. I was experiencing some technical issues with my phone, which prevented me from being active as usual. Fortunately, I have managed to resolve it and I am back with all the energy to continue sharing content with you. Whenever I can, I will be here!

In the video I'm sharing with you today, I want to show you how I spent my Sunday weekend. It was a family day, quiet but with a very special and different touch. It all started thanks to the cordial invitation from the famous singer Arnaldo Nieves, who invited us to enjoy his talent at the \

restaurant.

Not only did we have the pleasure of listening to Arnaldo, but he was also accompanied by the excellent voice of Beatriz Miró. Later, the atmosphere got even better when singer Italo Zapata joined in, closing this afternoon of llanera music on a high note.

It was a very pleasant moment, full of laughter and, of course, our gastronomy: we tasted some delicious cachapas with queso de mano, which were incredible!

Spending quality time with such talented and dear people makes for a total energy recharge.

---

### **Español**

**Un Domingo de Música Llanera y Familia en La Cascada 🎤🇻🇪**

¡Hola, querida comunidad de Hive y 3Speak! Espero que estén teniendo una excelente semana.

Antes de entrar en detalles sobre el video de hoy, quería ofrecerles una pequeña disculpa por mi ausencia de estos últimos días. Estuve presentando algunas fallas técnicas con mi teléfono, lo que me impidió estar activa como de costumbre. Afortunadamente, ya logré resolverlo y estoy de vuelta con toda la energía para seguir compartiendo contenido con ustedes. ¡Siempre que pueda, aquí estaré presente!

En el video que les comparto hoy, quiero mostrarles cómo viví mi domingo de fin de semana. Fue un día en familia, tranquilo pero con un toque muy especial y diferente. Todo comenzó gracias a la cordial invitación del famoso cantante Arnaldo Nieves, quien nos invitó a disfrutar de su talento en el restaurante \

No solo tuvimos el placer de escuchar a Arnaldo, sino que también estuvo acompañado por la excelente voz de Beatriz Miró. Más tarde, el ambiente se puso aún mejor cuando se unió el cantante Italo Zapata cerrando con broche de oro esta tarde de música llanera.

En el video verán algunas fotos y fragmentos de este encuentro donde aparezco junto a mi mamá y estos grandes artistas, que además son amistades muy bonitas. Fue un momento muy ameno, lleno de risas y, por supuesto, de nuestra gastronomía: ¡degustamos unas sabrosas cachapas con queso de mano, que estaban increíbles!

Pasar tiempo de calidad con personas tan talentosas y queridas hace que la recarga de energía sea total.

Espero que disfruten de este resumen de mi domingo tanto como yo disfruté grabarlo y editarlo para ustedes. Gracias por el apoyo de siempre!

Nos vemos muy pronto en un nuevo video. ¡Se les quiere! 🫶😊

---

### **English**

**A Sunday of Llanera Music and Family at La Cascada 🎤🇻🇪**

Hello, dear Hive and 3Speak community! I hope you are having an excellent week.

Before getting into the details of today's video, I wanted to offer a small apology for my absence over the last few days. I was experiencing some technical issues with my phone, which prevented me from being active as usual. restaurant.

Not only did we have the pleasure of listening to Arnaldo, but he was also accompanied by the excellent voice of Beatriz Miró. Later, the atmosphere got even better when singer Italo Zapata joined in, closing this afternoon of llanera music on a high note.

In the video, you will see some photos and snippets of this encounter where I appear alongside my mom and these great artists, who are also very lovely friends. It was a very pleasant moment, full of laughter and, of course, our gastronomy: we tasted some delicious cachapas with queso de mano, which were incredible!

Spending quality time with such talented and dear people makes for a total energy recharge.

I hope you enjoy this summary of my Sunday as much as I enjoyed recording and editing it for you. Thank you for your constant support!

>Expansiva semana lleno de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

En este momento de tu vida, ¿cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir? ¿Cómo describirías tu propósito en este momento y qué te mantiene avanzando cada día?

>Es verdad, siempre escribo que cada etapa de la vida que vivimos tiene sus características y hacemos lo que consideramos lo mejor en esos tiempos para estar al día con lo que creemos que es así, a veces no pensamos o nos cuesta aceptar, puede ocurrir que en esos momentos la información que escuchamos es: vamos a hacer esto para obtener estos resultados, así pasamos varios años de nuestra vida.

Observar el mundo que nos rodea es una forma de despertar ante ciertas cosas que nos adormecen en esas etapas de hacer y tener.

>En este momento de mi vida, mi principal razón para vivir es ser Feliz con lo que hago cada día, si es escribir disfrutar esa precipitación de ideas para plasmar sobre un tema en particular, si es caminar en las mañanas hacerlo con entusiasmo y así pase por el mismo sitio cada mañana hacerlo con detenimiento de esos espacios que a veces hay cosas que no nos damos cuenta. Si es en la cocina, ser feliz con la idea de lo que se prepara, así sea con pocos ingredientes tenga un sabor agradable, sea muy nutritivo para quienes lo vamos a disfrutar.

>Son experiencias agradables y las no tan agradables mirarlas desde otra vista para darnos cuenta que por algo nos vino a tocar la puerta. En este momento de mi vida disfruto de una Formación cuyo nombre es Gente Espiritualmente Inteligente, esta formación tiene conceptos de ciencia, neurociencia, neuroplasticidad. Conceptos que van dirigidos precisamente a ir dentro de nosotros, de hecho el profesor lo llama espiritualidad científica.

\n\n

>Esto me hace muy feliz, porque llevo unos cuantos años estudiando estos temas por mi cuenta, lo que me llama la atención, asimilando, comprendiendo, haciendo cambios en el uso de mis palabras y otras cosas más, proceso que ya había iniciado por mi cuenta, ahora con más precisión y guía de quien ya lo ha experimentado.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/2021/2021266e03wogyuph.webp
Contenido escrito propiedad de la autora ©Mercedes Mendoza. Todos los derechos reservados [Divisores](https://www.glitter-graphics.com/dividers?page=94)

>Have a wonderful week filled with health, energy, marvelous ideas, and magic. May it be a time for connection with your inner self and great enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.

At this point in your life, what do you believe is your main reason for living? How would you describe your purpose right now, and what keeps you moving forward each day?

>It's true, I always write that each stage of life has its own characteristics, and we do what we consider best at that time to keep up with what we believe is right. Sometimes we don't think about it, or we find it hard to accept, that at those times the information we hear is: let's do this to get these results, and that's how we spend several years of our lives.

\n\n

>Observing the world around us is a way to awaken to certain things that lull us to sleep during those stages of doing and having.

\n\n

>At this point in my life, my main reason for living is to be happy with what I do each day. If it's writing, it's enjoying the rush of ideas to put down on a particular topic. If it's walking in the mornings, it's doing it with enthusiasm, and even if I pass by the same place every morning, I take my time to appreciate those spaces where sometimes there are things we don't notice. If it's cooking, it's being happy with the idea of ​​what I'm preparing, even if it's with few ingredients, so that it has a pleasant flavor and is very nutritious for those who will enjoy it.

\n\n

>These are pleasant experiences, and the not-so-pleasant ones, I look at from another perspective to realize that they came knocking at our door for a reason. At this point in my life, I'm enjoying a training program called Spiritually Intelligent People. This program incorporates concepts from science, neuroscience, and neuroplasticity. Concepts that are precisely aimed at going within ourselves; in fact, the professor calls it scientific spirituality.

\n\n

>This makes me very happy, because I have been studying these topics on my own for a few years now, which interests me, assimilating, understanding, making changes in the use of my words and other things, a process that I had already started on my own, now with more precision and guidance from someone who has already experienced it.

body.title: UNVEILING OF THE PROMOTIONAL T-SHIRT [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![InCollage_20260421_164102648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/AK56Wja2thkCoviWafDNHzBH46zumnLZzB8e2yRvWeDneDXvXEJHNNUbNAiH2KJ.jpg)


***
### <Center>ESPAÑOL</Center>
***

Saludos amigos, espero todos estén muy bien. 

En esta oportunidad paso por acá para relatar que mi hija mayor este año sale de la escuela básica y va rumbo a la secundaria, realmente el tiempo pasó super rápido. 

Al pasar de los años en las escuelas de acá han adoptados ciertas costumbres de otros países, este es el caso de la revelación de franela de promoción, dónde se realiza un acto con los estudiantes, profesores y representantes, en una caja totalmente cerrada se coloca la franela y luego se abre para ver el modelo de la misma, por supuesto previo a esto, ya los representantes habíamos elegido el modelo y todo lo que debía ir escrito en esa franela.

 
![IMG-20260421-WA0056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23uQtWKuVvvsYWxV87chroAKPY3MZ5Zg9Vh1BPspmmVEfiPCWwgnosf1o3NTwxVLVTsE8.jpg)

![IMG-20260421-WA0058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/EpVBX5ZPPobnVKKs5axqLAFjFP5zcrzurnPFcqWixDu1XwJsg5skGDvHgxFzmcWoQRf.jpg)


Porterior a esto, se va llamando a cada uno de los estudiantes y el representante le coloca la franela, en nuestro caso, mi esposo y yo fuimos al acto y le colocamos la franela a Anna Paula. 


![IMG-20260417-WA0075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23uQvpPaDjPA9SSVPoEXB3Ew9MmchcHbN1tVywmzMLRN3V4ckmbXsoxP3RK5oBTnFccFc.jpg)

![IMG-20260417-WA0073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23vi1YTXtxAeMGwbMsjZycvEUChwKe7mHJH7ya2u9xsuwauHoJTh7E8zeN4qP6PN4ySjT.jpg)

![IMG-20260417-WA0074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23uQvQGbs1bJmsQoHBGFvppEqavBn4jihKHVEvUNS9yR8rn5iBYjNtpC3N8rFv5CiDUGo.jpg)


![IMG_20260417_110156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23zGaCFuEXjW6CWFq6tpn8VdC2zMjQgjAAXx4h1PGvAL2ahRdHsCP3T8MmUAcpTxjPQ8d.jpg)



Luego de haber pasado a todos los estudiantes, se les entregaba las franelas a las profesoras encargadas de dar ambos grados y al final se les entregaba a los padrinos de promoción, que este año, para sorpresa del padrino, los estudiantes eligieron al señor que limpia en la escuela, que es importante resaltar que no solamente se encarga de la limpieza, también los conoce a todos, siempre está dispuesto a apoyarlo, a jugar con ellos y hasta darle un consejo, así que, en lo personal me pareció genial que lo hayan elegido a él, en este acto se le vio bastante contento y conmovido A la vez. 


![IMG-20260417-WA0141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xp26QjK3xqASa8KMEyGT9TNWEekjiNRn5GoWgiSxafytryULk3a483kn7JkZhWZzAJF.jpg)


![IMG-20260417-WA0139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xVM9VSAvy8FjpEorPz778z75c3qeN7Z55FQSgpTwoAnx8kcgXXxpAYdjYFc68h7zkNG.jpg)



Luego de esta parte protocolar, los estudiantes se fueron a un salón donde ambas secciones realizaron un compartir, nosotros como padres decidimos dejarlos a ellos en conjunto con sus padrinos y profesoras para que hablaran comieran, bailaran y se divirtieran un rato. 

Realmente fue un rato muy agradable, a nuestros niños les encantó, lo disfrutaron al máximo, estuvo cargado de diversión, risas, abrazo y emotividad, porque hubo dos niñas que me causaba impresión la manera en qué lloraban, no sé si era porque no estaba su familia, si la persona que pasoy a colocarle la franela no era su mamá o si simplemente era muy emotiva jajaja, lo cierto es, que de igual manera se lo disfrutó. 


![IMG-20260421-WA0061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/EpC9sYwGwmsL2uENwB9DuJWwobEvzmWufHBP1RRTu5f9Y3jB3eWcVZgTZWEcT86zKzm.jpg)


Dentro de poco es la graduación de manera formal, dónde mi hija pasará a la secundaria de manera formal con su grandiosa camisa azul, eso me tiene súper emocionada. Por los momentos estamos en los preparativos de la busqueda del lugar para entregar los diplomas, de las personas encargadas de tomar las fotos, de la decoración y muchas cosas más que les iré relatando a medida que vaya pasando todo. 

### Gracias por leer parte de mi, les mando un abrazo cargado de bendiciones. 

*** 
### <Center>ENGLISH</Center>
***

Hello, friends. I hope you’re all doing well.

I’m stopping by today to share that my oldest daughter is graduating from elementary school this year and moving on to middle school—time really has flown by. 

Over the years, schools here have adopted certain customs from other countries. This is the case with the graduation T-shirt reveal, where a ceremony is held with the students, teachers, and parents. The T-shirt is placed in a completely sealed box, which is then opened to reveal the design. Of course, prior to this, we parents had already chosen the design and everything that was to be written on the T-shirt. 

![IMG-20260421-WA0056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23uQtWKuVvvsYWxV87chroAKPY3MZ5Zg9Vh1BPspmmVEfiPCWwgnosf1o3NTwxVLVTsE8.jpg)

![IMG-20260421-WA0058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/EpVBX5ZPPobnVKKs5axqLAFjFP5zcrzurnPFcqWixDu1XwJsg5skGDvHgxFzmcWoQRf.jpg)


After that, each student is called up, and the representative puts the T-shirt on them. In our case, my husband and I went to the ceremony and put the T-shirt on Anna Paula.

![IMG-20260417-WA0075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23uQvpPaDjPA9SSVPoEXB3Ew9MmchcHbN1tVywmzMLRN3V4ckmbXsoxP3RK5oBTnFccFc.jpg)

![IMG-20260417-WA0073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23vi1YTXtxAeMGwbMsjZycvEUChwKe7mHJH7ya2u9xsuwauHoJTh7E8zeN4qP6PN4ySjT.jpg)

![IMG-20260417-WA0074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23uQvQGbs1bJmsQoHBGFvppEqavBn4jihKHVEvUNS9yR8rn5iBYjNtpC3N8rFv5CiDUGo.jpg)


![IMG_20260417_110156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23zGaCFuEXjW6CWFq6tpn8VdC2zMjQgjAAXx4h1PGvAL2ahRdHsCP3T8MmUAcpTxjPQ8d.jpg) 


After all the students had gone up, the T-shirts were handed out to the teachers in charge of both grades, and finally to the class mentors. This year, much to the mentor’s surprise, the students chose the man who cleans the school—and it’s important to note that he doesn’t just handle the cleaning; he also knows everyone, is always willing to help them, play with them, and even give them advice. so, personally, I thought it was great that they chose him; during the ceremony, he looked both very happy and moved. 

![IMG-20260417-WA0141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xp26QjK3xqASa8KMEyGT9TNWEekjiNRn5GoWgiSxafytryULk3a483kn7JkZhWZzAJF.jpg)


![IMG-20260417-WA0139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xVM9VSAvy8FjpEorPz778z75c3qeN7Z55FQSgpTwoAnx8kcgXXxpAYdjYFc68h7zkNG.jpg)


After this formal part, the students went to a room where both classes had a get-together; we, as parents, decided to leave them with their mentors and teachers so they could talk, eat, dance, and have fun for a while. 

It was truly a very pleasant time; our kids loved it and enjoyed it to the fullest. It was full of fun, laughter, hugs, and emotion—because there were two girls whose crying really struck me. I don’t know if it was because their families weren’t there, if the person who came to put the T-shirt on them wasn’t their mom, or if she was just very emotional, hahaha, but the truth is, she enjoyed it just the same. 

![IMG-20260421-WA0061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/EpC9sYwGwmsL2uENwB9DuJWwobEvzmWufHBP1RRTu5f9Y3jB3eWcVZgTZWEcT86zKzm.jpg)


The official graduation ceremony is coming up soon, when my daughter will officially move on to middle school wearing her gorgeous blue shirt—that has me super excited. Right now, we’re busy making arrangements: finding a venue for the ceremony, hiring photographers, planning the decorations, and many other details that I’ll share with you as things unfold. 

### Thank you for reading a little bit about me; I’m sending you a hug filled with blessings.

body.title: [ENG-ESP]​Traveling through Time and Space 🕳️☄️ | SMASh Contest Round 422
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdN8UKNmLLQt2r1VV8etZsD3gwvv6ERfWDFcnaXuvxCW/1776787373660.jpg)
<center><sub>*[This is my contest photo]*</sub></center>

🌅Although today was also a sunny day perfect for shadow hunting, I found these photos from a while ago in my gallery and decided to take a leap through time and space back to October of last year. Join me on this journey! 🕳️☄️📸

​🏰 *Aunque hoy también fue un día soleado y perfecto para cazar buenas sombras, encontré estas fotos de hace un tiempo en mi galería y decidí dar un salto en el tiempo y en el espacio a octubre del año pasado y traerlos en este viaje conmigo* 🕳️☄️📸

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcN4xZmGHKrHPcmeNZoHHSLzSrewiV8A8ikZYjjr3kDxz/1776787373490.jpg)

🌅We are heading to Venezuela during a trip to the beach on the final days of our vacation.

🏰​*Nos trasladamos a Venezuela durante un paseo a la playa, en los últimos días de nuestras vacaciones.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsQpbun93s9n1b4jWbVoBrXBP8TqkpSAzXnVLPTdXBVX/1776787373556.jpg)

🌅We went to Puerto Cabello and, after spending some time at the beach, we decided to climb up to Fortín Solano—a military fortress built in 1766, located in what is now San Esteban National Park.

​🏰*Fuimos a Puerto Cabello y, después de estar un rato en la playa, decidimos subir al Fortín Solano, una fortaleza militar ubicada en el actual Parque Nacional San Esteban, construida en el año 1766.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTrVZMezahf9JUQ32tgM6B3AitLgCY4tgrFjZPqt18sLh/1776787373583.jpg)

🌅Although we couldn't explore the entire fort because access was limited by the time we arrived, we were able to spend some quality time at the viewpoint at the top of El Vigía crest, which offers spectacular views.

​🏰*Aunque no pudimos explorar el fuerte en su totalidad porque a la hora que llegamos el acceso era limitado, pudimos pasar un buen rato en el mirador de la cima de la cresta El Vigía, desde el cual se pueden apreciar unas vistas espectaculares.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCUzcRS9RrUoDwa9En6WTZVjsEZhRZLq8XHnyamgdq8V/1776787373748.jpg)
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.46253 lat -68.01698 long Shadow Hunting at Fortín Solano in Puerto Cabello d3scr)

🌅Even though we were tired and a bit sunburned, we enjoyed the climb, which is quite steep and great for exercise 👆. In this photo, we were walking the last stretch before reaching the viewpoint, and I loved how the shadows of the fence on the sides of the path ended up blending in with the square tiles on the ground.

​🏰*A pesar de estar ya cansados y algo quemados por el sol, disfrutamos la subida, que es bastante empinada y buena para hacer ejercicio 👆. En esta foto íbamos andando el último trecho que faltaba antes de llegar al mirador y me gustó cómo las sombras del enrejado a los lados del camino se acabaron mimetizando con las lozas cuadradas del suelo.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ94HnCqzbtuH6sR8MzoSupxubVL6c9vdxFqd5ebVswXL/1776789666159.jpg)

🌅A while ago, I shared views here of a cliff in Galicia that also used to have cannon batteries. That was my first time seeing something like that, as I had never been to an old naval watchpost. Now, back in my own country, I found myself in one again. I stood in the center of what used to be the base of one of the cannons and spoke and shouted to feel the acoustic effect created by the location, the rounded shape, and the materials used to build the fort's walls.

​🏰*Hace un tiempo compartí aquí las vistas de un acantilado en Galicia en el que también solía haber baterías de cañón; esa fue la primera vez que yo veía algo así, pues nunca había estado en un antiguo puesto de vigilancia naval. Ahora, de vuelta en mi propio país, volví a estar en uno; me puse de pie en el centro de lo que solía ser la base de uno de los cañones, y hablé y grité para sentir el efecto acústico generado por la ubicación, la forma redondeada y los materiales en los que fueron construidos los muros del fuerte.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQomLW48okM7Z6c6nsYRr26cenR3c926UFUobTSBJhXJV/1776800447622.jpg)

🌅This effect happens because the sound you emit bounces back and returns amplified to the center of the circle, giving the sensation that you're hearing your voice multiplied. Only you, the person standing at the acoustic focus, can feel it. It's a very fun effect, and I've read that it can also be experienced in places like the Whispering Gallery at St. Paul's Cathedral (London), Grand Central Terminal (New York), Castillo de San Felipe in Cartagena de Indias, or in Greek Theaters, where sound reflection allowed thousands to hear the actor in the center.

​🏰*El efecto se debe a que el sonido que emites rebota y regresa amplificado al centro del círculo, dando la sensación de que escuchas tu voz multiplicada; solo tú, que eres la persona ubicada en el foco acústico, puedes sentirlo. Es un efecto muy divertido y he leído que también se puede experimentar en lugares como La Galería de los Susurros en la Catedral de San Pablo (Londres), la Terminal Grand Central (Nueva York), el Castillo de San Felipe en Cartagena de Indias o en los teatros griegos, donde la reflexión del sonido permitía que miles escucharan al actor en el centro.*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVE6zz4YfaUqvHAPXgqYAFsW2DELZi1sPigq9iSBzBEt/1776795003669.jpg)

🌅While this post focuses on my participation in the shadow contest, I don't want to leave without sharing some of the beautiful views of downtown Puerto Cabello that we enjoyed from up there.

​🏰*Aunque este post está enfocado en mi participación en el concurso de las sombras, no me quiero ir sin compartir con ustedes algunas de las hermosas vistas del casco central de Puerto Cabello que pudimos disfrutar desde allí arriba.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyymbe3RLg1vPd68DRM2AbDRkhxzaxxojTHCfNZqVPqw/1776795751481.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZQVvrxj9tEs6LzXEQnbdiUGtVLEzuvU1KvNGhTWPqpw/1776801365015.png)

---

🌅Thank you so much for joining me on this little trip down memory lane and for reading until the end. I hope you enjoyed these shadows and landscapes as much as I enjoyed reminiscing about them. Wishing you a wonderful week filled with beautiful moments. See you in the next post! ✨

🏰​*Muchas gracias por acompañarme en este pequeño viaje al pasado y por llegar hasta el final. Espero que hayan disfrutado de estas sombras y paisajes tanto como yo disfruté recordándolos. Que tengan una semana maravillosa y llena de momentos bonitos. ¡Nos leemos en el próximo post!* ✨

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme9kmqAzxsC6yT1eVLHmvMxDFQTDXmTnTK8SkBhyYroN7/1776795751555.jpg)

body.title: Do we take Price Depreciation into account?
body.body:
>

![Do we take price depreciation into account.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23vsNU4Jw3byT7hCpnu72kH6gK3ExbkHqahjXxkLd3RoFQmfDf71LVjYZu9Yn78isMQZP.jpg)

Do you take into account the depreciation of an asset when you do the math? Depreciation is a finance term that means a replacement of value that the owner should make over time, so that when the product reaches the end of its useful life, there is enough capital to replace the product.

There's that famous saying about a man entering the river, \

which aptly symbolizes the passage of time and the constant change that everything undergoes. In the case of goods, tools, and machines, they suffer constant degradation due to humidity, oxidation of parts, and the lifespan of the materials. It's curious that people don't take this into account when they buy a product. Have you ever heard anyone talking about the depreciation cost of the last phone they bought? I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

>

## Depreciation in Companies vs. Products

The issue of asset depreciation is a term that frequently appears when preparing a company's balance sheet, evaluating assets and liabilities. Assets like machinery, cars, and tools used by a company usually have a useful lifespan, and the value of the asset is divided by this time, with this value being considered annually as a depreciation expense. After all, it's common to expect that when the end of a piece of equipment's useful life arrives, the company will likely have to replace it, not to mention the periodic maintenance required.

The curious thing is that the same thing happens on a smaller scale with individuals. When they buy a phone, a computer, a washing machine, a refrigerator—these are products that, while some may last many years, in the case of phones, tend to have a relatively short lifespan because companies stop performing updates, and parts begin to malfunction. But then why isn't it considered in personal accounting that everyday equipment is depreciating and generating a loss of value?

The reason might scare people, because it implies considering that the more devices and machines they have, the more they depreciate each passing year. In the case of digital products, they end up becoming outdated, no longer receiving program updates because the requirements are constantly increasing, apps are getting larger, demanding more resources.

The parts begin to oxidize, and time causes each of these products, which were perfect the day they \

equipment when they return to it years later, considered obsolete by future generations. This happened with discs, DVDs, USBs, and it continues, a technological depreciation. --- ## Depreciation vs. Cost-Benefit The phrase cost-benefit starts to make more sense when we think about depreciation. A product that is more expensive but has a longer lifespan and higher quality may end up compensating for the higher cost, since it will last longer and be more useful during that time. Another point to consider is when someone buys something very expensive, doesn't use it much, and that durable good ends up being a waste. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

>

![Do we take price depreciation into account.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23vsNU4Jw3byT7hCpnu72kH6gK3ExbkHqahjXxkLd3RoFQmfDf71LVjYZu9Yn78isMQZP.jpg)

Você leva em consideração a depreciação de valor de um bem quando você faz as contas? A depreciação é um termo de finanças que significa uma reposição de valor que o proprietário deveria realizar ao longo do tempo, para quando o produto chegar no seu tempo de vida útil, haver capital suficiente para fazer a reposição do produto.

Existe aquela famosa frase sobre o homem que entra no rio \

, que simboliza bem a passagem do tempo e a constante mudança que tudo sofre. No caso dos bens, ferramentas e máquinas, eles sofrem uma constante degradação, com a humidade, oxidação das peças e o tempo de vida dos materiais. É curioso que as pessoas não levam isso em consideração quando elas compram um produto, você já escutou alguém falando sobre o custo de depreciação do último telefone que comprou? Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

>

## Depreciação em Empresas x Produtos

A questão de depreciação de bens é um termo que costuma aparecer com frequência quando é feito um balanço das empresas, avaliando os ativos e passivos, já que os ativos como máquinas, carros e ferramentas que são utilizados pela empresa costumam ter um tempo de vida útil e eles dividem o valor do bem por esse tempo, e anualmente vão considerando esse valor como um gasto de depreciação. Afinal, é comum esperar que quando a data final de vida útil de um equipamento chegar é bem provável que a empresa tenha que trocá-lo, sem contar que há também uma manutenção de tempos em tempos.

O curioso é que o mesmo ocorre em escala menos com as pessoas, quando elas compram um telefone, um computador, uma máquina de lavar, uma geladeira, são produtos que por mais que um ou outro possa durar muitos anos, no caso de telefones, eles costumam ter um tempo de vida útil até que baixo, porque as empresas deixam de realizar as atualizações e as peças começam a apresentar defeito. Mas então porque não é considerado na contabilidade pessoal, que os equipamentos do dia a dia estão depreciando e gerando uma perda de valor?

Será que o motivo acabaria assustando as pessoas, porque isso implicaria em considerar que quando mais dispositivos, máquinas, ela tiver, todos eles estarão depreciando a cada ano que passar. No caso dos produtos digitais, eles acabam ficando desatualizados, não recebem mais as atualizações de programas porque os requisitos estão cada vez maiores, os apps estão ficando maiores, exigindo mais recursos.

As peças começam a oxidar e o tempo começa a fazer com que cada um desses produtos que no dia que \
estavam perfeitos, mas que quando voltam para ele, anos depois, já são equipamentos \

, que as próximas gerações já consideram ultrapassados. Isso aconteceu com os discos, dvds, usbs e vai seguindo, uma depreciação tecnológica. --- ## Depreciação x Custo Benefício A frase custo-benefício começa a fazer mais sentido quando pensamos em depreciação. Um produto que é mais caro, mas tem um tempo de vida útil e qualidade maiores, pode acabar compensando o custo mais elevado, já que ele vai durar mais tempo e ter um maior proveito durante esse tempo. Um outro ponto de análise é a pessoa comprar algo muito caro, não utilizar tanto, e aquele bem durável acabar sendo um desperdício. ---

![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) No form of bullying can ever be 'better' or a 'slightly less evil form’, because both of them have been known to have great repercussions, not just on the victims, but on their families, careers, and even their futures as well. Because this is something that you just recover from. You don’t take malaria medicine and heal from the effects of bullying. You take paracetamol to get rid of the physical pain, but it does nothing about the internal pain you’re feeling. And that is what both forms of bullying have in common: they’re not entirely physical; they are mental. They feed you pain and make it all about your reality to the point that it seems to be the only thing that you know. You look around, and that is all you see. You can’t see a way out of the problem, and they just won’t stop coming for you. And sadly, many don’t make it through the ordeal. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) Personally, I’ve never been a victim of bullying, but I’m old enough to know what it actually is, and I’ve also seen reports of such cases. A few years back, the entire country was shaken when students in a popular private school here in Nigeria bullied their classmate until they killed him. Prior to that, there were reports that the parents had reported the matter, but nothing much happened until the boy tragically passed, and I believe his death was linked to the bullying. But then, here’s the thing: afterward, what happened? Nothing! The bullies continued going to school, the school didn’t pay any price for what they allowed to happen, and life just went on. Except for the victim and his family, of course. How can parents ever recover from such a harrowing event? ![IMG_20230528_113916~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/242rM25kCuPuDkPWm9n5gHpAAPogvwjTWUku1doohfp2fhue6c7LALoA4JzWXAQqJ3sb8.jpg) In the same vein, I’ve seen people get bullied online. People are harassed, and it’s actually easier to do it online because here people believe that they are safe from the repercussions of such actions. And so, they double down. That’s why someone living in the slums will comfortably broke-shame another person living in the city, and they’d think they’re living life. Online bullying has gotten so bad that many people have abandoned business prospects and endorsement deals just for the sake of their mental health. And there are also moments where people resorted to taking their own lives because of how much their reputation was butchered by the people of the internet. It was terrible. Both of these are bad because they affect the victims mentally. Long after victims treat the physical pain, long after they close down their accounts, they still feel the sting of their ordeal. I wish people would stop being so mean and terrible to others, just for the sake of it. Because when you think about it, there is literally no point to being a bully. There is no gain whatsoever, except the sick and sadistic pleasure that they gain from inflicting pain. A show of power that always ends in tears. But then, if real change is to happen, we have to make sure that bullies don’t get off easy anymore. Because it’s human nature, as long as they believe that they can get away with it, they will have no reason to ever change. We need to do better! ![IMG_20230421_152746~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/EqYvf1yXo43RUALXmvF838V9uAiuuBz3aXrBaifFDc42ut2AadqEh7Xn639xUZJxRkj.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.

This is a _block-hash-breaking_ release, which means you have to update before the transition block number to continue to receive rewards.

body.title: How does tokenization truly help illiquid assets?
body.body:
![019d9a6d-be0d-7674-81df-f5ba31b11662.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23xep3itc1s36HpurhkbdpG6otHRpCSaChkXSZyGKep6PnEVgVSpqbQ3VH4ciGrWCA3cw.webp)


>Tokenization does not automatically make hard-to-trade assets liquid, industry executives said at Paris Blockchain Week, pushing back on the idea that putting private credit, real estate or other illiquid products onchain will by itself create active secondary markets.

This is an excerpt from a recent [Cointelegraph report](https://cointelegraph.com/news/tokenization-illiquid-assets-liquidity-rwa-panel-pbw) on the tokenization of real world assets.

Generally speaking, I would agree with the point being made here, but other parts of the report triggered this article and that part is:

>Francesco Ranieri Fabracci, head of tokenization expansion at Tether, made a similar point. “It’s not that if you put an asset onchain, it will be liquid,” he said, arguing that only a narrower set of instruments, including bonds, money market funds and stablecoins, are likely to achieve consistent liquidity in tokenized markets.

I would argue that this should be taken as a prediction that it is and not some factual statement.

The reason is simple: the entire report fails to emphasize on the whole point of tokenization and the is the fact it's meant to create \

not build the markets themselves.

When people say that tokenizing an asset doesn't magically make it liquid, that is true, but when they argue for a few somewhat liquid known markets being made more liquid, it sounds more like advertising, not independent analysis or judgement.

### Solving the access problem for the alternative market

It should be no surprise that \

that comes from tokenization to illiquid assets because we are essentially dealing with crypto assets and decentralized blockchains, systems built around enabling global access through permissionless infrastructure solutions.

The alternative market discussed here is a reference to the illiquid assets market.

Tokenization solves the access barrier of this market because tokens function on permissionless systems where anyone in the world with a wallet they can acquire with full functionality without KYC or any other common traditional requirements, can access these tokens.

Report [shows](https://caia.org/blog/2025/01/17/tokenization-private-assets-unlocking-liquidity-transparency-access-modern) that capital allocations to alternative investments have surged from $4.8 trillion to $22 trillion over the past two decades, constituting 15% of global assets under management, despite their higher fees, illiquidity, and lack of transparency compared to traditional portfolios. 

This shows the existence of real appetite, which makes the access solution a great importance. 

This access solution layer, conveniently comes with other benefits including higher transparency, potentially much lower fees due to inherent cheap infrastructure layer and also, a chance at increased liquidity.

### Making liquid is a market opportunity

To address the elephant in the room: liquidity.

Tokenization might not magically make illiquid assets liquid, but it comes with solutions that creates the market opportunities for it.

People need to build the markets to achieve higher liquidity because that comes from more than just infrastructure solutions.

It comes with the right marketing.

It comes with presentable evidence of sustainable value generation.

It comes with building \

into the solutions.

Tokenization brings the tools that makes it easier to turn these illiquid assets into active markets.

Globally accessible = larger market to sell to.

Public transaction data = easier system to build trust.

Decentralized = more flexible governance, cheaper economic environment tool.

Permissionless = more opportunities to integrate with several markets and build the best product ever.

Tokenization is a pathway that many will take to build the best financial products of the next decades. Limiting one's perspective to the constraints of current financial systems and asset markets would be a terrible mistake.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@badbitch/how-does-tokenization-truly-help-illiquid-assets-2im)

body.title: It's been a while
body.body:
It's been a while since I've posted on Hive. A lot has happened in the past year so I'll recap. Remember that project Tau I kept posting about? It's finally at test net. In fact, if you're reading this, it's days away from 1.0.

Andrei K, the developer of testnet, just did some updates. You can find the testnet here: https://github.com/IDNI/tau-testnet

I joined Steemit roughly 10 years ago, and during that time TauChain as it was called, was just a whitepaper.  This was before Hive split off into it's own faction. Many of the topics you're reading about today in the news (agents, formal verification, alignment), are what myself and others talked about a decade ago. The problem is, good things can sometimes take a long time to build.

Now we are at a time where we need exactly what Tau is about to bring. Governable artificial intelligence. Sovereign aligned agents. This is contrary to what you see in the mainstream right now, where the agents are corporate controlled, and AI is being positioned as something to compete with or even replace the human. That isn't what I had in mind when I envisioned agents 10 years ago.

On the other hand some events are playing out exactly as I expected. The many smart contract hacks, the technological unemployment, the sharp divisions around how the technology should be used. Some ideas from 10 years ago have not yet been built out, and are now close to being feasible, such as Network States, or cyborgization. 10 years ago these ideas sounded crazy, now they sound inevitable. 

The next few years will be both challenging, and also have opportunities to build great digital communities. That is something I intend to participate in, and that is why now is the time for me to become active again on Hive. I'll be sharing my own projects, some of which will be built on Tau, some which will be built for Hive.

In it, the writer treats illusions and expectations like something sterile, almost pointless. “There is no future in life, the present is the end.” It’s a heavy line, loaded, biased even… but I won’t lie, since 2025 started, I’ve been flirting again with an old acquaintance: nihilism. And I’m not entirely sure we’re built, as a species, to sit comfortably with what that idea implies.

*\n\n*

>There’s nothing new here. Nihilism is as old as thinking itself. Entire libraries exist around it, and honestly, they’re worth diving into if you want to really wrestle with it. But the friction starts when what we feel life should be doesn’t match what reality suggests. Strip it down to biology, for example. What’s the purpose of life? At a basic level, between a cell and you or me, the difference isn’t as grand as we’d like to believe. We reproduce. Cells replicate. Different mechanisms, same outcome. Continuity. That’s it. So where does meaning come from in all that?

* ![20260304_094010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wg8wFEXArq21s5CG7gWNzYfmPX1MYvHeTkXsnaJ88L3RA4E4K3R9Su32Nh7x9iHVmfS.jpg) *

>And this is where things get uncomfortable. Every ambition, every legacy, every moment of pride or despair across human history, all of it shrinks when you place it next to the scale of nature. Carl Sagan understood that better than most. He had a spacecraft turn its camera back toward Earth from billions of miles away and capture what we now call Pale Blue Dot. That image is almost offensive in its honesty. Everything we’ve ever been, every hero, every villain, every war, every love story, all compressed into a barely visible speck.

*\n\n*

>We’ve known for centuries that we’re not special in any cosmic sense. Fragile, temporary, and yet deeply attached to ideas of dominance, control, importance. We call ourselves advanced, civilized, the peak of existence. Meanwhile, places like Chernobyl quietly remind us that even our mistakes can outlast us. Radiation will linger long after our arguments about meaning fade out. Nihilism just strips the decoration off all of this. Words like legacy, honor, nation, reputation… they collapse under its lens.

* ![Screenshot_20260109_224136_Instagram.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tbP7Gk2afuk6efBBdpjrcgJ1vMHR2W2Ekbmjc1Eq4xJ1iewCgTVYt2AUtPdP2Stkoks.jpg) ![20260216_154800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wMQ8C5CGrQ2x8S7w29De9p6RTPT1EXYepTJSUGcdwdMoPWcYiH9vbDZatjF3H7QmBHW.jpg) ![20260216_150726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wgFkV6bc6818eLoHzdT2TiCYg8JTWUGmkXkCivAPcG5RQRgHctdQhyvaE5Ph8DAQ8pn.jpg) *

>And yet, here’s the twist. It doesn’t have to feel dark. That’s the part people resist. If nothing ultimately lasts, then nothing ultimately traps you either. If I disappear today, my daughter might remember me, maybe her children too. But give it a century, and it’s gone. Not tragically. Just… gone. And in that, there’s a strange kind of quiet. A release. No eternal pressure to matter on a cosmic scale.

*\n\n*

>Even figures like Genghis Khan, whose genetic footprint still lingers in millions of people, fade into abstraction. A name, a story, a statistic. That’s all. The rest dissolves. Since we first controlled fire, we’ve been trying to impose meaning onto a universe that doesn’t seem particularly interested in giving us one.

*\n\n*

>That’s why Wanderer above the Sea of Fog hits the way it does. That lone figure standing above the fog, staring into something vast, unknowable… that’s us. Caught between what we want reality to be and what it actually is. And maybe that gap never closes. Maybe nothing matters in the way we wish it did. But maybe that’s exactly why anything can matter at all, even if just for a moment.

* ![20230930_110739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EqN73fHbXHkr6MT2H2rr68jLyZ2qFSmtK6PAJKfzUwAPdn7JZnHUJzu1PHuwmnFfw43.jpg) ![IMG_20230930_125332051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23uQNRNJjhrFXDRHzpaUP4EknnC8GrrbvTgJYwd7WqG5ZXMR7ukjh9kQyNa8Uw2TD2jXM.jpg) ![IMG_20230930_115651147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/Eow9m8cGF2cqAzLVsytvfqQT8qH1fErWt2RWmbwwg3d8PTtsuAoJcEiuDthNunyA7g4.jpg)

body.title: Musical Limits - The Tale of Jamie - ENG- SPA
body.body:
> 

Even before he was born, Jamie was marked by a condition that would change his life forever. He was born left-handed, not right-handed like most people. This didn't affect him at all when he was little; in fact, he didn't even know he was different. But in the future, this would change his life drastically. As a teenager, he became interested in the guitar. He used to listen to a lot of rock music, and watching guitarists play with such skill filled him with a tremendous amount of healthy envy. That's why he wanted to learn to play too.

But it was then that he discovered he had a limitation, one he'd carried since birth: being left-handed. This affected him greatly when he wanted to learn to play the guitar because most of the lessons were designed for right-handed people. Life started setting limits for him early on. But he didn't let them crush him. He continued attending the guitar lessons he went to every afternoon after school. But even though he had the desire to learn, this presented him with many obstacles. To begin with, what they were teaching him didn't match his playing style.

For example, they would tell him, \

But since he played with his non-dominant hand, he did it clumsily. So many people made fun of him and told him he wouldn't go far in music and that he should do something else. Despite all this, he continued learning. The others progressed quickly and played everything they were taught. Jamie was always lagging behind. He had the talent, but he couldn't do it well; that was his limitation.

> Antes de nacer Jamie ya estaba marcado con una condición que cambiaría su vida para siempre. Nació zurdo y no diestro como la mayoría de las personas. Esto no lo afecto de ningún modo cuando era pequeño, de hecho ni sabía que era diferente al resto. Pero en el futuro esto si cambiaria su vida y mucho. En la adolescencia se interesó por la guitarra. Solía escuchar mucha música de rock y ver a los guitarristas tocar con tanta habilidad le daba un envidia sana tremenda. Por eso quiso aprender a tocar también. Pero fue ahí donde descubrió que tenía una limitante, una que llevaba encima desde que nació, ser zurdo. Esto lo afectó mucho cuando quiso aprender a tocar la guitarra, porque la mayoría de las clases sobre como aprender a tocarla estaban preparadas para personas diestras. La vida empezó temprano a ponerle limites. Pero él no se dejó aplastar por ellos. Continuó asistiendo a las clases de guitarra a las que asistía cada tarde después de salir de clases. Pero aunque tenía el deseo de aprender aquello le puso muchos obstáculos. Para empezar lo que le enseñaban no coincidía con su forma de tocar. Por ejemplo le decían tienes que sostenerla así, y tocar de cierta forma. Pero como él lo hacia con una mano que no era la principal lo hacía de forma torpe. Así que muchos se burlaban y le decían que no llegaría muy lejos en la música y que mejor se dedicara a otra cosa. A pesar de todo esto el continuó aprendiendo. Los demás avanzaban rápido y tocaban todo lo que se les enseñaba. Jamie siempre estaba por detrás. El tenía el talento pero no podía hacerlo bien pero esa limitación.
![nastia-petruk-bD2561hvic4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23wWTgGvvDwFf2ao8PEYB1BhKSDNrV7ECWWLGSMXEWbTWRhNrNtfG35X4kAWQVmtwcdVR.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> When the guitar course ended, everyone graduated with the highest possible score, but he received the lowest; he almost failed. It was very sad for him to go through that because his only motivation was his desire to continue, but the results were poor. After that, he tried to get a position as a guitarist in some bands, but none of them accepted him. They didn't want him when they saw his lack of skill with the instrument. When all seemed lost, he had an idea to do things differently. He had always played the guitar with his right hand on the guitar to try to follow the current teaching style, but that didn't suit him. So he decided to try something he had never tried before: holding the guitar at a different angle to play with his other hand, the one he was more comfortable with. But when he did, he realized something: the guitars he had available weren't designed to be played that way. They were bulky on the other side, making it difficult to play with his left hand. Even though it was very annoying, he continued playing that way. That's when he discovered he had been doing it wrong all along. He was surprised to see how well he could play with his other hand; it was almost unbelievable to him. So, even though the shape of the guitars bothered him, he continued playing that way. There were guitars for left-handed people, but they were very expensive, and he couldn't afford one, so he had to play with what he had. Over time, he mastered the technique of playing with that hand. And many bands accepted him. They loved his playing style; few could imitate him.

> Cuando se acabó el curso de aprender guitarra todos se graduaron con la puntuación más alta, pero él con la más baja posible, casi no aprobó el curso. Fue muy triste para el pasar por eso porque lo único que lo motivaba a seguir era su deseo, pero los resultados eran malos. Luego de eso intentó conseguir un puesto como guitarrista en algunos grupos pero en ninguno fue aceptado como guitarrista. Pues cuando veían su bajo dominio del instrumento no lo quieran. Cuando todo estaba casi perdido el tuvo una idea para hacerlo distinto. Desde siempre había tocado con la guitarra del lado derecho para intentar seguir la corriente de lo que se enseñaba, pero eso no pegaba con el. Así que decidió probar algo que nunca antes había intentado, poner la guitarra desde otro Angulo para tocar con la otra mano, la que si dominaba. Pero al hacerlo se dio cuenta de una cosa, las guitarras que tenía disponible no estaban preparadas para tocar de esa forma. Pues eran voluminosas de la otra parte dificultando tocar con la mano izquierda. Aún así aunque era muy molesto, el continuó tocando de esa forma. Ahí donde descubrió que lo estaba haciendo mal desde siempre. Se sorprendió al ver lo bien que podía tocar con la otra mano, era casi increíble para él. Así que aunque era molesto por la forma de las guitarras continuó tocando así. Había guitarras para personas zurdas pero eran muy caras y el no podía permitirse comprar una, así que tenía que tocar con lo que tenía. Con el tiempo dominó la técnica de tocar con esa mano. Y muchos grupos lo aceptaron. Les encantaba su forma de tocar, pocos podían imitarlo.
![jay-lagman-_JddYBwbN9A-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23wMMuNVUQutvq9A9YKjhKXCi8gmyi2wHDMe3e1CCEKgArZiJeApeJYSnJrNQwTamg8Kr.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> When he became famous and earned a lot of money, one of his friends suggested he buy an expensive left-handed guitar. He agreed, since he'd never tried one before. He'd always played right-handed. But he was surprised again; only with guitars not made for him could he play the way he did. His unique style was only achieved with the others. It was very paradoxical, even funny, to him. So he returned the guitar, realizing he couldn't be the person he had worked so hard to become. It's true that life marked him from a young age with this condition, but when you're resourceful and persevere, even if you face some difficulties, you can achieve great things. Jamie managed to overcome physical and even mental limitations. And when he had the opportunity to change for something better, he didn't, because that would change his style. Now he just hopes to continue his ascent to the stars.

> Cuando se hizo famoso y ganó mucho dinero entonces uno de sus amigos le sugirió comprar una guitarra par zurdos cara. Y el accedió, pues nunca antes había probado una. Siempre había usado las diestras. Pero se nuevamente se sorprendió, solo con las que no estaban hechas para él podía tocar de la forma que lo hacía, su estilo único solo lo conseguía con las otras. Era muy paradójico y hasta gracioso para él. Así que devolvió la guitarra al ver que no podía ser quien había conseguido ser con esfuerzo. Es cierto que la vida lo marcó desde pequeño con esta condición, pero cuando eres ingenioso y te esfuerzas aunque pases un poco de trabajo puedes conseguir grandes cosas. Jamie consiguió vencer los límites físicos, y hasta los mentales. Y cuando tuvo la oportunidad de cambiar por algo mejor, no lo hizo, porque eso cambiaria su estilo. Ahora solo espera continuar ascendiendo hacia las estrellas.
![joseph-recca-0115krVNoXw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tkjcwEa52CuiQRbuffxoRBkuLC3JPiczYT5cmJiLZmbRM31cg9EjGKvYQj1BWW8BF5f.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

body.body:
>

![MDB.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/48UGtGggTJ7DdHXf5YSjtFyiUK1dUz8BggLuLsvmzVUa5eprJNA5iCgEaEVpCHNw46.jpg)

Dzień jak co dzień – trochę leniuchowania przed nocną zmianą, ale nie zapomniałem o zaplanowanym treningu. Skoro wtorek, to nie mogło być mowy o spokojnym klepaniu kilometrów; trzeba było się wykazać. Tym razem zadanie było dość łatwe: 6 x 300 metrów (w tempie 5:25 min/km) na przerwie 300 metrów (w tempie 6:10 min/km). W moim przypadku najtrudniejsze okazało się wstrzelenie w zadane tempo – chyba żadne z powtórzeń nie wyszło w 100% poprawnie. Zwykle gdy przyspieszałem, to zbyt mocno i zamiast zadanego tempa biegłem o 10–15 sekund szybciej. W związku z tym Garmin ocenił wykonanie treningu jedynie na 65%.

> ***[ENG] Just a typical day—a bit of lounging before the night shift, but I didn't forget about my scheduled workout. Since it's Tuesday, there was no question of just \

; it was time to perform. The task today was fairly straightforward: 6 x 300 meters (at a pace of 5:25 min/km) with a 300-meter recovery (at 6:10 min/km). For me, the hardest part was hitting the target pace—I don't think a single rep was 100% spot on. Usually, when I sped up, I overdid it and ran about 10–15 seconds faster than planned. As a result, Garmin rated my execution at only 65%.***

![IMG_3903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zGVmGbRfiiXwcK3c4Lafaf7QtX2TbHRzChD9M1ZTpecZiFqaTZphqxFXqNuSD8fZNmC.jpg)

![IMG_3909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/241t1LJZsGB8epwuGDprq6igPabM3wSWa6ePtSrA1dfnT9nfTXMMXFnhPXUG8qFMt6srV.jpg)

![IMG_3910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKSb8FY9mTevbqNCaeGv8KmPrbbjSYGQ4fqxM213HQV8CjNUzpzx1Zj1LFo7ufg.jpg)

![IMG_3901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKrz5cVu52mkdnaZjBoasyaX87xrFtRHhShQkadSwRYhcpkbggBRpAz6MSzoouK.jpg)

Kiedy w zasadzie kończyłem już powtórzenia, zbliżałem się do segmentu „JFK Sprint” – 240 metrów z lekkim nachyleniem w dół. Pamiętałem, że w lutym byłem bliski poprawienia życiówki na tym odcinku, ale nie pamiętałem, jaki dokładnie czas muszę osiągnąć. Postanowiłem więc pobiec tak szybko, jak tylko mogłem. Okazało się, że nie tylko poprawiłem swój rekord z grudnia ubiegłego roku o 10 sekund, ale też zszedłem poniżej minuty! Całkiem nieźle. Po sprawdzeniu klasyfikacji okazało się, że zajmuję 166. miejsce (na 2561 biegaczy), a do pierwszej setki brakuje mi... zaledwie 3 sekund. Mam już cel na przyszłość – czuję, że jestem w stanie to zrobić.

> ***[ENG] Just as I was finishing my reps, I approached the \

segment—240 meters with a slight downhill incline. I remembered being close to a PR on this stretch back in February, but I couldn't recall the exact time I needed to beat. So, I decided to just go as fast as I possibly could. It turns out I didn't just break my record from last December by 10 seconds, but I also went sub-one-minute! Not bad at all. After checking the leaderboard, I found out I'm ranked 166th (out of 2,561 runners), and I’m only... 3 seconds away from the top 100. I have a goal for the future now—I feel like I can definitely do it.*** ![IMG_3912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/ALAECs9XnBYPzdprxRGL7DnjAnsf5YBTd7E7tx37zPxD9iCgpEbVcFJhAd9CJ18.jpg) ![IMG_3916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AK7xHsoWg7kivNugpGpcaDaB5XGDnvT8H7Uqn6m47nZJhWaTFfuK3rF73cKSQxU.jpg) ![IMG_3917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23tGa1PPLAKyuKWawsMcG9LCFvNQz1RbQfKwxUMQYJHgYgy6xAVsCuryk71dkcGvRcgnn.jpg) ![screenshot-connect.garmin.com-2026.04.21-17_16_53.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23yTzBCoc8n9boVa61AzZyEA4aVZa4AN7ZWy7nujCgXPTihsPJy2dnoiXxRuUZRz7VEmC.png) ---

Un problema «minimalista», pero agradable, para la entrega de hoy. Excepto por el peón de e3, ninguna de las piezas negras sobra. Las blancas, por el contrario, tienen muchas piezas sobrantes y, francamente, inútiles. Eso no contribuye a una buena composición. Disfruta resolviendo este rompecabezas.

¿Quieres ejercitar un poco tus habilidades tácticas? Entonces, ¡resuelve este problema de ajedrez! Señala la jugada correcta y una completa continuación. Si lo deseas, puedes señalar los motivos tácticos y demás patrones presentes.

También quiero invitarte a participar en los diferentes torneos de ajedrez en

>lichess.org. Si juegas ajedrez en línea, ¡anímate a participar! Inscripción gratuita.

description.title: The Birth of the Lord Jesus//Mcgi Topic Review part 2
description.body:
https://youtu.be/rzP0TKDizTA?si=MQ2xh9mM5Uqv2pAs

It’s a wonderful privilege to once again reflect on the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

There is no specific passage in the Bible that shows early Christians celebrating the birth of Jesus Christ. The fact that Christmas is widely observed today does not necessarily mean it is biblically authorized. Popular opinion does not define spiritual truth; what truly matters is whether a practice is grounded in Scripture.

The Bible recognizes Mary and Joseph as the earthly parents of Jesus, yet there is no account suggesting they celebrated His birth. Instead, Scripture highlights their faithfulness in observing established religious feasts, especially the Passover. This indicates that their devotion was centered on practices clearly commanded under the law.

In Luke 2:41, we are told that Jesus’ parents traveled to Jerusalem every year for the Passover feast. Verse 42 further explains that they continued this tradition when Jesus was twelve years old. Then in verse 43, after the feast had ended, they began their journey home, while Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem without their knowledge. These passages emphasize their commitment to keeping ordained feasts rather than creating new celebrations.

Moreover, Ecclesiastes 7:1 presents a meaningful reflection, stating that a good name is better than precious ointment, and the day of death is better than the day of birth. This suggests that, spiritually, a person’s legacy and the end of their life may hold greater importance than the beginning.

In conclusion, although Christmas is commonly celebrated around the world today, the Bible does not provide evidence that the early followers of Christ observed His birth in this manner. Instead, it draws attention to other significant spiritual practices.

Thank you for reading.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRvdPEFJW9DDhjKUUAQ5hZaTTnVjhY7aWNUWnrpDEFf15/1776801094560.png)


if you ever ask yourself  this hard question; What really  is the purpose of life, is it just to come here  live for  just a short time get married, give birth to children  and die,  cause definitely  death is totally inevitable,  so then in the grand scheme of things what's  really is  life all about, cause there must be a reason why we are here, why we exist. 

these are tough questions  that we must reflect on, it calls for  deep reasoning and reflection,  there are heights one attends in life it becomes obvious to ask these questions, there is more to life than just sleeping and waking up, if as a person you've  not arrived at this point were it's  too clear you're  not just living for survival but also of purpose and destiny fulfillment, then reality is still far.

Dr myles Munroe in his book \

outlined this to mean man's  core desires to discover Who he is, where did he come from and where he's  headed, everything  he does in life, or how well he lived his life is anchored on the revelation of these three key fundamental principles. 


there is definitely  more to life than what we we see, feel or touch, it goes beyond  our physical  senses, it is this quest to know or want to know that drives us to start thinking  and reasoning  deep, these makes us involved in quest of finding  out what life entails, beyond the physical  realms digging into the supernatural or  spiritual.

he that made life created life  to be lived and enjoyed, free and filled with pleasures but what happen  in some cases where you see some suffer, Tribulations, hunger, sickness and death, but this wasn't  the original plan for mankind.

the plan was to live long well and prosper with purpose. 

this gets  us to start asking what's humanity purpose, a moment of self reflection what is purpose,   what I'm i to doing, what's  my assignment, because the truth is untill we all discover our clear purpose life would mean just an empty vacuum of existence, the purpose of a thing actually  is the reason for it's  existence and untill  that reason is discovered  abuse is inevitable...


so next time you see people do all manner of things living life recklessly, engage in things that are inhumane it's because purpose have not been discovered ...


however once purpose is discovered, life becomes  meaningful, once there is that clear line of purpose it's  easy to now channel the right energy, resources, time and  attention  to it and in the right order of things if that's  done success is inevitable, by extension  one will prosper in the line of what is entails on their  purpose...

description.title: Politik, Aussagen und Realität – ein seltsames Muster
description.body:
https://media0.faz.net/image/w1240/4aff61ba8da1/w5000h2250x0y486/202604/43601.0.2004002759/bundeskanzler-friedrich-merz.webp

## Politik vs Realität – und wieder dieselbe Diskussion - was macht Merz?

Wenn man sich die aktuellen Aussagen von Friedrich Merz anschaut, fragt man sich schon, ob wir noch im selben Film sind.

Die Debatte rund um seine Aussagen zur Rente zeigt das ziemlich deutlich. Wenn öffentlich gesagt wird, dass die gesetzliche Rente künftig im Grunde nur noch eine Basisabsicherung sein wird, sorgt das zwangsläufig für Reaktionen.
[https://www.faz.net/aktuell/wirtschaft/mehr-wirtschaft/kritik-an-merz-aussage-zur-rente-200754471.html](https://www.faz.net/aktuell/wirtschaft/mehr-wirtschaft/kritik-an-merz-aussage-zur-rente-200754471.html)

Das Problem ist nicht einmal, dass die Aussage völlig falsch wäre. Die meisten wissen längst, dass das System unter Druck steht. Das Problem ist eher, wie solche Themen kommuniziert werden und was danach passiert.

https://bilder.deutschlandfunk.de/FI/LE/_3/0b/FILE_30bd8768bf0e90923492cbbd4b3b6c1c/05-bluem-jpg-100-768xauto.jpg

Ähnlich lief es bei der Diskussion um seine Aussagen zum „Stadtbild“ im Zusammenhang mit Migration. Auch dort ging es am Ende weniger um Inhalte als um Wirkung, Ton und politische Reaktionen.
[https://www.deutschlandfunk.de/friedrich-merz-stadtbild-migration-diskussion-100.html](https://www.deutschlandfunk.de/friedrich-merz-stadtbild-migration-diskussion-100.html)

Was sich wiederholt, ist ein Muster: Probleme werden klar benannt, aber statt daraus konkrete Schritte abzuleiten, entsteht erstmal eine Welle aus Empörung, Einordnung und politischem Gegeneinander.

Währenddessen läuft die Realität weiter.

Energiepreise steigen, Unsicherheiten nehmen zu, und viele Menschen merken ganz konkret, dass Dinge nicht mehr so stabil sind wie früher. Gerade beim Thema Rente sieht man das sehr deutlich. Die alte Aussage „Die Rente ist sicher“ kann heute jeder für sich selbst bewerten.

In der Praxis bedeutet das für viele: mehr Eigenverantwortung, mehr Unsicherheit und weniger Planbarkeit.

Und genau da entsteht die eigentliche Lücke. Zwischen dem, was politisch gesagt wird, und dem, was im Alltag ankommt.

Niemand erwartet perfekte Lösungen. Aber irgendwann reicht es nicht mehr, nur zu erklären, warum etwas schwierig ist. Dann geht es darum, Entscheidungen zu treffen, auch wenn sie nicht perfekt sind.

Im Moment wirkt es oft eher so, als würde man versuchen, nichts falsch zu machen, statt bewusst etwas richtig zu entscheiden.

Und genau das sorgt am Ende für den größten Frust.

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday </center>

#

That's right, it's Tuesday folks and for our merry little band of ladies and lads, that means sharing tunes, good vibes and engagement. As another week disappears in the rearview mirror, we have loads of engagement and tunes flying around on Three Tune Tuesday and sure isn't that bloody fantastic! I hope you're ready to share three tunes from wherever you find yourself on this magical spinning lump of rock that we all call home and sure you might even sing us a tune if we're lucky?

It's a time of the week when lovers of music, tunes and craic bring their blockchain community three of their finest and brightest tunes to share and celebrate, so let's roll on and let the tunes flow free.

This is my 256th week waxing lyrical for Three Tune Tuesday and we are still going strong.

It started off with me just sharing tunes into what seemed like a void, but little by little others joined and now I'm thrilled that we have a little corner of Hive where we come and share our tunes every Tuesday, and long may it continue. I almost stopped posting the songs and thoughts a few times, but I stuck with it and now interestingly it is my favorite thing about Hive. I love music and now I have a network of folks around the world who love music too and we share our tunes and catch up with each others tunes and discuss them each week. We get Pop, Metal, Rock, Gospel, Folk, Jazz, Rap, Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Reggae, Bippy bappidy Flange Hop. Ok I made that one up, but you get the idea, we are all learning about new artists, bands, back stories and sure isn't it just mighty!

Something that excites me the most is that we even get musicians sharing their covers of famous songs and even their own songs from time to time here on #ThreeTuneTuesday, which is a real favorite of mine, as that takes talent, time and dedication.

We are adding New posters and retaining our core of regulars here on #TTT which is fantastic. Let's keep it growing. Over the years, I have listened to fantastic music shared from like-minded folk from around the globe and interacted with their posts. This has led me to genres I don't know well and to some amazing new bands and artists and has even introduced me to some musical instruments I did not know existed. It also allows me to upvote smaller accounts and find some really interesting people from all over the world, which is heartening.

I hope you enjoy the tunes - be sure to tell me all about it in the comments below and above all else, please enjoy the rest of your Tuesday - smile at a stranger, rub a dog, be a nice human to someone who was not expecting it - peace out.

For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday....

description.title: The Return of a Curious Visitor
description.body:
> #
The Return of a Curious Visitor

Today I saw a familiar face that I hadn’t seen in quite some time. Not a person, but a cat. One of those neighbourhood characters that quietly comes and goes without explanation, as if operating on a schedule known only to itself. I was at home when I noticed it sitting just outside the glass door, staring in. Not casually either. It was fully engaged. Focused. Watching. The kind of stare that makes you feel like you’re the one being observed rather than the other way around. It took me a moment to recognise it, but then it clicked. This was the same cat that used to wander around here as a kitten. Back then it had that restless, playful energy that kittens tend to have. Always poking its nose where it probably shouldn’t. Always testing boundaries. Windows, doors, gaps in fences. If there was a possible way in, it would at least try to find it. Apparently not much has changed 😂 The only real difference now is size. It’s fully grown, a bit more composed perhaps, but the curiosity is still very much intact. It sat there for a while, peering through the glass as if trying to figure something out. Every now and than it would shift slightly, looking for a better angle, almost like it expected the door to magically open if it studied it long enough. ___ ![curiosity cat.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adetorrent/AK6W6PVGNPovrQnn3mXAVqCXxNVtawzqeCky6taGbxUmfxxmnZBtsuQ6bD79S3S.JPG) *It didn't notice me taking this photo. I hid behind the curtains until it thought I was gone then I slowly pointed the lens at it and snapped. Cats are so quick though. Microseconds after taking the shot, it made eye contact with me. It seems they can also hear though glass.* ___ At one point it moved along the side of the house, no doubt checking the usual spots. Windows first, then back again to the door. There was a clear sense of purpose about it. Not frantic or desperate, just quietly determined. As if it remembered something about this place and was trying to reconnect with it. I opened the door briefly, just to see what it would do. It didn’t rush in. It didn’t even seem surprised. It just stood there, looked up, and then looked past me into the house. Taking it all in. Almost like it was checking whether things were still the same. It didn’t stay long. After a few moments it turned and wandered off, just as calmly as it had arrived. No fuss. No dramatic exit. Just gone again. There’s something about cats that makes you wonder sometimes. The way they move, the way they observe, the way they seem to remember places and people without ever really needing to interact with them directly. If I believed in such things, I might say this one had been here before in another life. That it knew something about this house, or about me, that I wasn’t quite aware of. Of course, it’s probably just a curious cat doing what curious cats do. Checking in on familiar territory. Looking for warmth, or food, or simply something intresting to break up the day. It's probably been spoilt by the neighbours who likely feed it. Still, it felt like more than that for a moment. Peace & Love, *Adé*

description.title: Еміграція — це не подорож. Це смерть старого себе.
description.body:
/>

Ти сидиш у чужій кімнаті.

Дивишся на стіни, які ніколи не стануть твоїми.

І раптом розумієш:

**_Той, ким ти був, — залишився там._**

**_А той, ким станеш, — ще не народився._**

Тебе немає в фотографіях.

Ніхто не пам'ятає твого дитинства, твого голосу, твоїх жартів.

Мова звучить як акцент.

Дипломи — ніби папір.

А досвід — як історія з чужого життя.

І ти починаєш з нуля.

У 30. У 40. У 50.

Руки, які колись вели проєкти, тепер миють посуд.

Голова, що приймала рішення, вчить базові фрази.

Серце, яке любило знайомі вулиці, тепер шукає нові місця в Google Maps.

Найстрашніше — це питання дитини:

**«А коли ми повернемося?»**

І тиша у відповідь.

Бо «додому» вже не існує.

Є лише «звідти» — і «тут».

І між ними — ти.

Розірваний. Втомлений. Але живий.

Коли бачиш емігранта — не питай, чому він мовчить.

Не кажи: **«Радій можливостям».**

Просто знай: він несе в собі цілий світ.

Світ, який більше ніколи не буде таким, як раніше.

Еміграція — це не вибір між добрим і поганим.

Це вибір між неможливим — і невідомим.

Це сила — жити з розірваним серцем.

І все одно — будувати завтра.
