description.title: Wer jetzt noch kauft, ignoriert den Warren Buffetts Indikator/Anyone buying now is ignoring Warren Buffett's indicator.
description.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb94ZcePijzS8VTEeqK8r7TyXYu3fCF1awEFrWVxsugM7/43656.png

Während Anleger weiter zugreifen, erreicht der Buffett-Indikator ein historisches Hoch. Genau solche Phasen endeten oft schmerzhaft.

Warren Buffett hat ihn einst als Warnsignal beschrieben, heute steht er höher als je zuvor: Der sogenannte Buffett-Indikator ist auf rund 232 Prozent gestiegen und sendet damit ein deutliches Alarmsignal für den US-Aktienmarkt. Die Kennzahl setzt den Gesamtwert des Aktienmarktes ins Verhältnis zur Wirtschaftsleistung. Steigt sie stark über den historischen Durchschnitt, gelten Aktien als teuer. Buffett warnte schon vor mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten: Wer bei solchen Niveaus kauft, \

.

Bekannt wurde der Indikator nach einem Fortune-Beitrag aus dem Jahr 2001 – kurz nach dem Platzen der Dotcom-Blase. Damals hatte das Verhältnis zeitweise etwa 200 Prozent erreicht. Anschließend verlor der S&P 500 bis 2002 fast die Hälfte seines Wertes. Auch Ende 2021 kletterte die Kennzahl erneut auf rund 200 Prozent, bevor der Markt im folgenden Jahr deutlich nachgab.

Für Skeptiker ist das ein Warnzeichen: Noch nie waren Aktien gemessen an der Wirtschaftsleistung so hoch bewertet. Hinzu kommt, dass auch klassische Bewertungsmaßstäbe angespannt wirken. Das erwartete Kurs-Gewinn-Verhältnis des S&P 500 liegt bei über 28 und damit deutlich über dem langfristigen Durchschnitt von etwa 17.

Doch es gibt auch Gegenstimmen. Viele Investoren halten den Buffett-Indikator inzwischen für weniger aussagekräftig als früher. Der Grund: Der US-Aktienmarkt wird heute von globalen Tech-Konzernen dominiert, deren Gewinne weit über die US-Wirtschaft hinaus erwirtschaftet werden.




Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.wallstreet-online.de/nachricht/20753563-teuerster-markt-zeiten-kauft-ignoriert-warren-buffetts-crash-warnung

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Durch die gesamten Smartphone Apps ist es unglaublich einfach geworden in Aktien und Kryptowährungen zu investieren. Natürlich bin ich auch zu der Überzeugung gelangt das dadurch viel dummes Geld investiert wird. Hauptsächlich von Menschen die vom Finanzsystem noch überhaupt keine Ahnung haben. Diverse Communitys die sich feiern durch Trading einen Döner gewonnen zu haben verstärken noch zusätzlich diesen Effekt. 

**Wichtigste Erkenntnis meines kurzen Investoren Lebens ist: man kann investieren,muss es aber nicht. Wenn die Märkte irrational erscheinen.**

---

English 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb94ZcePijzS8VTEeqK8r7TyXYu3fCF1awEFrWVxsugM7/43656.png

While investors continue to buy, the Buffett Indicator has reached a historic high. Such phases often end painfully.

Warren Buffett once described it as a warning signal, and today it stands higher than ever before: The so-called Buffett Indicator has risen to around 232 percent, sending a clear alarm signal for the US stock market. The indicator compares the total value of the stock market to economic output. If it rises significantly above the historical average, stocks are considered expensive. Buffett warned more than two decades ago: Anyone buying at such levels is \

The indicator became well-known after a Fortune article in 2001 – shortly after the bursting of the dot-com bubble. At that time, the ratio had temporarily reached around 200 percent.  Subsequently, the S&P 500 lost almost half its value by 2002. At the end of 2021, the indicator climbed again to around 200 percent before the market declined significantly the following year.

For skeptics, this is a warning sign: Never before have stocks been so highly valued relative to economic output. Furthermore, even traditional valuation metrics appear strained. The S&P 500's expected price-to-earnings ratio is over 28, significantly higher than the long-term average of approximately 17.

However, there are dissenting voices. Many investors now consider the Buffett Indicator less meaningful than before. The reason: The US stock market is now dominated by global tech companies whose profits are generated far beyond the US economy.

 I quoted from the following article...

https://www.wallstreet-online.de/nachricht/20753563-teuerster-markt-zeiten-kauft-ignoriert-warren-buffetts-crash-warnung

My personal conclusion:

Thanks to all the smartphone apps, it has become incredibly easy to invest in stocks and cryptocurrencies. Of course, I've also come to believe that this leads to a lot of foolish money being invested, mainly by people who have absolutely no understanding of the financial system. Various communities that celebrate winning a kebab through trading further exacerbate this effect.

**The most important lesson I've learned in my short investment career is: you can invest, but you don't have to. Especially when the markets seem irrational.**

#### picture is mine 

It's another great privilege to put up this write-up, and I thought I wouldn't be able to do it before it expired, but here I am. When I saw it, I had to think twice and find a way to share my own view on the theme for this edition.

Bullying and harassment, both physically and online, have their effects as far as I am concerned. Life, generally, is filled with so many challenges; however, as humans, we must develop ways to ensure we gain access to something better.

Before the advent of technology, there had been all kinds of harassment and bullying going on. God created us with different perspectives to view life, whereas some don't seem to see anything good in the life of an individual, no matter the good you try to do for them. In fact, the more you try to do good, the more they look at you in a different way.

I know of some ladies who have been harassed by men because they refused to yield to their selfish desires of lust. There was a case I handled involving a lady and a lecturer. He kept bullying her because she refused to accept his proposal for a relationship. He gave her a carry-over; hence, the lady couldn't graduate. This kind of harassment does not only exist physically but also online, where many have faced similar situations.

Online harassment is just an advancement of what has been happening in the physical realm of life. Although many use online platforms to falsify a lot of things, some people present themselves as so innocent online, as if they can't even harm an ant, whereas that is not the true representation of their lives.

There was one of my cousins who engaged with a lady online. He had never seen her, but he was carried away by the picture she used on her profile. She looked spotless, gorgeous, and charming. He never knew she was deceiving people. After she won his heart, he almost committed to marrying her before he realized that everything was just a mirage. He couldn't believe that was the reality. This could also be seen among people who are in relationships in the physical realm, where one of the parties tends to pretend.

In conclusion, bullying and harassment, whether physical or online, are serious issues that should not be taken lightly. They affect not only the victims emotionally and psychologically but can also have long-term consequences on their lives and destinies. As individuals, we must learn to treat others with respect, empathy, and dignity, regardless of our differences. At the same time, we must be vigilant and discerning, especially in this digital age where not everything we see is real. It is important to speak up against injustice, support those who are victims, and create safe spaces both offline and online. By doing so, we contribute to building a society where love, truth, and integrity prevail over deceit, oppression, and abuse.

Thanks so much.

description.body: I don't know about others, but I've grown to a stage in my life where a lot of things no longer make sense to me, and it's not because I'm a too matured or born in the 80s....or a weirdo. Sometimes I come across some movies, see the actors, hiss, and discard the movies instantly. Yeah, it has gotten to that extent, and for me to retract my dislike for those things, it's going to take a lot of persuasion from my mind.

/>

There's one Nollywood actor, Bolanle Ninalowo. He does his things excessively in movies, especially how he shows off his muscular physique and how he speaks with an American accent in a very regular manner. There was a particular day I was talking about my dislike for him in the presence of a female friend. The friend told me I was jealous because I don't have a muscular physique and that I'm the opposite of him(yes I know I'm slim. Maybe that's true, but I just don't like how he presents his physique, making it look like it's the only thing he has to offer in a movie.

His accent? Gosh! I hate it when someone is proving what is not supposed to be proved. No lies, he does well with the American accent, but his constant use of that accent in most of the films I've seen him in has made me dislike him. The producers of those movies are not sensible enough to know that the American accent tied to him is becoming too much.

I won't lie, this is the actor that made me stop watching Mr Macaroni's skits. Oh yeah, he was becoming the center of the skits, so I stopped. I don't like seeing what I don't like.

It's been a long time since I watched a Nigerian movie, but even at that, once I come across one or someone tells me about one that has this actor in it, I block my ears immediately.

Thanks for reading.

>Hive Blockchain is very unique. I don't know the ideology behind the blockchain, but I perceive one of the targets is to create a community with absolute balance, where members of the community are taught how to grow their assets, which doesn't disrupt a portion that comes for immediate cash out. I always give a shout-out to the brains behind the project because I perceived they must have sat and thought thoroughly before coming up with such an idea that favours everyone. I know there are people who would want to receive everything they earn instantly, but come to think of it, if the system were designed that way, how would we grow the platform? I know there are whales who are the main backbone of the blockchain, yet all our contributions count. In a situation where everyone is taking away all they have, the system may not really be stable. Hive’s principle of splitting earnings into two: Hive power and Hive is okay with me 100% . I'll be honest, saving Hive as HP has really helped me. If all my earnings come as unstaked Hive, honestly, I am sure that by now, I would have emptied my Hive account. I don't have much, but seeing the little I have as savings is so encouraging. But I won't fail to mention that the time it takes to power down is also too long. We stake a position for the bull, but sometimes when the bull comes, before you unstake, the market is already down again. We know how unstable the crypto market is; such situations hurt a lot, honestly. Coming back to the prompt, I am someone who both wants to stake and position for higher returns and to also cash out some, but frankly speaking, I have not been able to do the saving aspect. For quite some time now, I have been cashing out my earnings. It is not as if I don't want to save, but I can't help it. I have even been powering down for some time. Some people would think that I am not serious, but if I have my way, trust me, I would have been powering up more than everyone on the blockchain. description.title: Beyond the Big Leaves: Unearthing the Secrets of My Phymatosorus Fern 🌿🔍
description.body: > Hello, HiveGarden family! We all love a bit of floral drama. The towering monstera, the velvet touch of a calathea, the sculptural presence of a banana plant. But today, I want to step away from the flowering show-offs and the giant-leaf celebrities. I want to take you on a deep dive into a different kind of green magic—one that sits quietly in the understory but holds a secret world of botanical curiosity. Let me introduce you to my pride and joy: my _Phymatosorus_ fern. At first glance, you might scroll past. It doesn’t have the flashy inflorescence of an orchid or the massive, split leaves of its angiosperm cousins. But look closer. See those leathery, creeping fronds? That intricate pattern of dots on the underside? That, my friends, is where the story begins.
Genus**\n\nThe name _Phymatosorus_ might sound like a spell from a fantasy novel, but its meaning is deeply rooted in science. It comes from the Greek words _phymatos_ (meaning \

). Why? Because this genus is defined by its _sori_—those clusters of sporangia (spore cases) on the back of the fronds. Unlike the neat, round dots on many common ferns, _Phymatosorus_ often has them embedded in a swollen, raised, or even chain-like pattern. It’s like the fern is showing off its freckles in 3D!\n\n

></center>

**A Little Taxonomy Lesson (The Fun Kind) 📚**

Here’s where it gets really interesting for the plant nerds among us. _Phymatosorus_ belongs to the Polypodiaceae family, a vast and ancient lineage of ferns. The genus was formally described by the Italian botanist Rodolfo Emilio Giuseppe Pichi Sermolli, and his work was published in _Webbia_ in 1973. The \

—the botanical reference standard for the whole genus—is _Phymatosorus scolopendria_ (Burm. f.) Pic. Serm. Now, for the curious statistic: While over 30 species have been described under this genus, current botanical consensus (as of June 2012, and largely still accepted) recognizes only **18 accepted species**. Think about that! Nearly half of the proposed species didn't make the cut. Nature is messy, and taxonomy is the art of drawing lines where sometimes there are none. Some of my favorites from the accepted list include: * _Phymatosorus scandens_ (the creeping one) * _Phymatosorus diversifolius_ (true to its name, with variable leaf shapes) * _Phymatosorus pustulatus_ (the name says it all—very bumpy sori!) * And the majestic _Phymatosorus grossus_.

></center>
    

**My Personal Green Companion**

The specimen I’m sharing today is a _Phymatosorus_ that I’ve been growing for just over two years. It didn’t come with a fancy label—just \

But I recognized the rhizome structure and the distinct frond texture. I brought it home, placed it in a bright spot with indirect light (east-facing window, for those taking notes), and gave it a chunky, well-draining mix with plenty of bark and perlite.

And oh, did it reward me.

Its rhizomes are now creeping over the edge of the pot like thick, fuzzy green caterpillars (covered in tiny scales, as many polypods are). The fronds emerge a bright, lime green, slowly darkening to a deep, leathery forest hue. But the real show? Every few months, I flip a mature frond and see those tell-tale _sori_—raised, golden-orange bumps that look like tiny jewels. That’s when I know it’s happy. That’s when I know I’ve created a little pocket of ancient forest in my living room.

**Why This Fern Matters (Beyond the Aesthetic)**

Unlike many ferns that demand a terrarium and constant prayer, _Phymatosorus_ species are surprisingly resilient. They’re epiphytic or lithophytic in nature (growing on trees or rocks), which means they hate soggy feet. Let them dry out slightly between waterings. They’re also incredible air purifiers and offer a texture that no other houseplant can match: the rugged, ancient feel of a plant that has been perfecting its form for millions of years.

**A Question for the Hive 🌍**

So, HiveGarden, I turn the lens to you: Do you have a \

in your collection? A plant that doesn’t get the spotlight but fascinates you every single day? And has anyone else grown _Phymatosorus_? I’d love to hear about your experiences with the creeping rhizomes, the spore propagation, or just your favorite low-light companion.\n\nLet’s celebrate the weird, the wonderful, and the wonderfully leafy. Long live the ferns! 🌿📸

description.title: Rock N' Roll Hall of Fame New Inductees for Three Tune Tuesday!
description.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUJq6iaSTbLTHaWMTHUoF65APVgcpYZJKWSnjLrgKEhG1/image.png




I'm happy to report that this weekend was much better that my last one. No more trips to the Emergency Room and that chest pain has since vanished. Still no explanation as to why it ever happened in the first place! But as long as it's gone I'll take the win! I hope you are all having a great week so far. 

For all of those who know me you know I'm a silver lover, and I can never resist sharing some cool music related silver when I happen upon it.  This morning I found a really nice item being produced for the Solomon Islands celebrating the Fender Telecaster electric guitar.








 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYTKfEhm23QoxMvFu2Kq3PNkSh4ndujnLjciMpWYAwPVx/Screenshot%204952.png 
From APMEX.com

These are legal tender coins from the Solomon Islands that are being produced by PAMP, one of the most respected precious metal producers in the world out of Switzerland. This is a blind box, meaning what you get will be a surprise.  Each of seven varieties are one Troy ounce of solid silver colorized to replicate legendary Telecaster guitars produced by Fender over the last 75 years.  It's amazing to think that the Telecaster has been around that long, and it's still a very popular guitar!

They are only making 4,000 of these, however, since there are seven designs I'm not quite sure how each one is allocated number wise. Still a very cool silver replica of the Telecaster. Sadly, these are way overpriced at $199.99. I guess Fender takes a cut, PAMP takes a cut, and the Solomon Islands take cut... Then APMEX marks it up even more to make a profit, everyone needs their piece of the pie I suppose... I won't be buying one personally, but I do find them very cool. I just refuse to pay that much for one Troy ounce of silver!



Since it is Tuesday it's time for another Three Tune Tuesday.  But first off, I want to say thank you to @ablaze for starting and continuing to sponsor this fun weekly event where you can share three songs that you enjoy. One lucky participant will win some HSBI units, you can't have too many of those! So if you don't already participate feel free to jump in, just use the tag #ttt or #threetunetuesday and it's never a bad idea to do a shoutout to @ablaze .

Since the Rock Hall of Fame announced their inductees for 2026 last week, I thought it might be fun to play a few songs from some of those artists. This year they are inducting: Billy Idol, Iron Maiden, Phil Collins, New Order/Joy Division, Oasis, Sade, Luther Vandross, Wu-Tang Clan, Celia Cruz, Fela Kuti, Queen Latifa, MC Lyte, Gram Parsons, Linda Creed, Arif Mardin, Jimmy Miller, Rick Rubin and Ed Sullivan. 

Do I agree with some of those? No, absolutely not. But no one asked my opinion. And New Order and Joy Division were actually two different bands and shouldn't be grouped together. But like I said, no one asked me!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

## **Billy Idol**

This rock n' roller is a great induction this year.  Just like all the selections in this TTT he comes from England and fronted the punk band Generation X in the late 1970's.  In 1982 he released his self titled solo album which became a huge commercial success shooting him to superstardom. I have had a chance to see him live once, he puts on a great show if you ever get the chance to get some tickets. This song comes off his debut album and is called \

:


https://youtu.be/s21SLyJWMY8?si=3S6t4JlLsBiTqBH9





 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

## **Phil Collins**

Phil Collins is of course a legend in his own right, already in the Hall of Fame with the band Genesis, this is his second induction. He had a huge solo career throughout the 1980's and produced some very memorable music. The one that always sticks in my mind is \

:

https://youtu.be/qTM8fIiUmCA?si=Z-9_bc_ffs7ja4h_




 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

## **Iron Maiden**


It's taken a very, very long time for this band from London to make into the Hall of Fame. First formed in 1975 they really hit the mainstream when they added singer Bruce Dickinson to their lineup prior to producing their 1982 album The Number of the Beast. It is often lauded as one of the best heavy metal albums ever recorded. They are one of the best heavy metal bands of all time and they're induction into  the Hall if long overdue. This song comes off of their album Powerslave from 1984, \

that salutes the airman who flew for the British during World War II.

https://youtu.be/Xg9aQvjMS60?si=i4a2BDVhng_tgNzQ


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

Of course left off the nominee list this year was the ever absent Mötley Crüe.  The Hall of Fame is more about politics than anything anymore, and so many bands that belong are left off simply because  they rubbed someone the wrong way at some point in their career. It's also a shame that the Rock Hall of Fame no longer inducts  rock stars, they induct everybody from all genres. They should have stuck to rock, but like I said earlier, no one ever asked me...

That will do it for this Tuesday, and I hope you enjoyed the picks of the week. Also those coins are pretty cool as well, too bad they are so overpriced! Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below, and as always thank you so much for all of your support. It really does mean a lot to me. Have a great Tuesday everyone!

description.body: > Presentamos la evolución de **Caramelos de Cianuro**, la banda que transformó la irreverencia de los años 90 en una de las carreras más sólidas y premiadas del rock en español a nivel continental.

> We present the evolution of **Caramelos de Cianuro**, the band that transformed 90s irreverence into one of the most solid and award-winning careers in Spanish-language rock across the continent. -----
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
----- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKiRcPi1aFQCEabAWEy7j4ecA21VuSTVYq2BBR76aDuewXVeCArmn1AumCHdCKK.png) # Caramelos de Cianuro: Trayectoria y vanguardia del rock venezolano

>

La fundación de **Caramelos de Cianuro** tuvo lugar en Caracas en 1991, surgiendo inicialmente como un proyecto sin mayores pretensiones de trascendencia comercial. En sus primeros años, la agrupación funcionó como el pasatiempo de un grupo de compañeros que compartían el interés por la música, dedicándose a componer canciones con líricas sencillas que abordaban diversos tópicos cotidianos bajo un prisma de ironía y desenfado. Esta estética, que combinaba el post-punk con elementos del rock alternativo, comenzó a captar la atención de la escena capitalina, diferenciándose por un estilo narrativo directo y poco convencional para la época.

El despegue mediático de la banda se produjo con la promoción radial del tema \

. El impacto de esta pieza sirvió de plataforma para que el grupo, aún en una etapa incipiente, lograra participar en el **Festival Nuevas Bandas** de Caracas. Esta presentación fue fundamental para validar su sonido ante un público más amplio y establecer los cimientos de lo que se convertiría en una de las carreras más longevas y exitosas de la música venezolana. Uno de los episodios más comentados en su historia temprana ocurrió durante un concierto compartido con **Zapato 3** en el recinto Mata de Coco, donde un espectáculo excéntrico generó una fuerte polémica con organizaciones protectoras de animales. Este evento otorgó a la banda una notoriedad que trascendió lo estrictamente musical, captando la atención permanente de la prensa.


A lo largo de las décadas, la banda ha experimentado una evolución sonora constante. Tras consolidarse como referentes del pop-rock con álbumes como \

, la agrupación ha mantenido su vigencia mediante una producción discográfica ininterrumpida. Un hito reciente de gran relevancia fue su nominación a los Premios Grammy Latinos en 2016, compitiendo en las categorías de Mejor Álbum de Rock por su disco \
y Mejor Canción de Rock por el tema \

. Estas nominaciones ratificaron su estatus como una de las agrupaciones más influyentes del rock en español a nivel continental.\n\nEn años recientes, **Caramelos de Cianuro** ha continuado expandiendo su alcance global. En 2021 lanzaron su álbum \

López**, el cual recibió elogios de la crítica por su sofisticación técnica. Durante 2022 y 2023, la banda llevó a cabo extensas giras internacionales que incluyeron presentaciones en ciudades de Estados Unidos, Europa y Latinoamérica. Actualmente, liderada por **Asier Cazalis** y **Pavel Tello**, la agrupación sigue siendo un pilar fundamental de la industria musical venezolana. -----

>

### Caramelos de Cianuro: Trajectory and Vanguard of Venezuelan Rock

The foundation of **Caramelos de Cianuro** took place in Caracas in 1991, initially emerging as a project with no major claims to commercial significance. In its early years, the group functioned as a hobby for a group of friends who shared an interest in music, dedicating themselves to composing songs with simple lyrics that approached various everyday topics through a lens of irony and self-assurance. This aesthetic, which combined post-punk with elements of alternative rock, began to capture the attention of the capital's scene, standing out for a direct and unconventional narrative style for the time.

The band's media breakthrough occurred with the radio promotion of the song \

The impact of this piece served as a platform for the group, still in an incipient stage, to participate in the **Festival Nuevas Bandas** in Caracas. This performance was fundamental in validating their sound before a wider audience and establishing the foundations of what would become one of the longest-running and most successful careers in Venezuelan music. One of the most commented episodes in their early history occurred during a concert shared with **Zapato 3** at the Mata de Coco venue, where an eccentric show generated strong controversy with animal protection organizations. This event granted the band a notoriety that transcended the strictly musical, capturing permanent press attention.\n\nThroughout the decades, the band has experienced a constant sonic evolution. After establishing themselves as pop-rock icons with albums like \

the group has maintained its relevance through uninterrupted record production. A significant recent milestone was their Latin Grammy nomination in 2016, competing in the categories of Best Rock Album for \
and Best Rock Song for the track \

These nominations confirmed their status as one of the most influential Spanish-language rock bands on the continent.\n\nIn recent years, **Caramelos de Cianuro** has continued to expand its global reach. In 2021, they released the album \

López**, which received critical acclaim for its technical sophistication. During 2022 and 2023, the band conducted extensive international tours including performances in cities across the United States, Europe, and Latin America. Currently led by **Asier Cazalis** and **Pavel Tello**, the group remains a fundamental pillar of the Venezuelan music industry. #

description.title: A road trip through eastern Prato, the countryside, modernity, and graffiti./ Un viaje por carretera a través del este de Prato: el campo, la modernidad y el grafiti
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP14VrmEbdf59MCu58kMTJKfZwrGkzF9fKLzjzRPLJxtZ/1776793280998.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? A few days ago I took a tour of eastern Prato and wanted to share my little trip with you. Prato is a large city, divided into several parts, with a large suburb and several hamlets. Today we're going to eastern Prato; before we get there, we have to cover a bit of a road. The nice thing, in my opinion, is that this area, like many in Tuscany, is surrounded by countryside and rural areas. In fact, even before reaching Prato, we pass through various countryside areas with large fields interspersed with pine and cypress trees typical of the area. Then, slowly, as we approach the city, we begin to spot the first houses, scattered here and there among the fields, and then, little by little, various small, increasingly larger clusters of houses. Then you start to get closer to the city and you start to notice a more urban environment, one thing that I particularly liked and struck me was the numerous graffiti painted on the street walls, more or less beautiful but certainly perfect for making walls and roadways less anonymous and grey, then well I have a weakness for graffiti and street art.

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Hace unos días hice un recorrido por el este de Prato y quería compartir mi pequeño viaje con ustedes. Prato es una ciudad grande, dividida en varias partes, con un gran suburbio y varias aldeas. Hoy vamos al este de Prato; antes de llegar, tenemos que recorrer un poco de carretera. Lo bueno, en mi opinión, es que esta zona, como muchas en la Toscana, está rodeada de campos y áreas rurales. De hecho, incluso antes de llegar a Prato, pasamos por varias áreas rurales con grandes campos intercalados con pinos y cipreses típicos de la zona. Luego, lentamente, a medida que nos acercamos a la ciudad, comenzamos a ver las primeras casas, dispersas aquí y allá entre los campos, y luego, poco a poco, varios grupos pequeños, cada vez más grandes, de casas. Luego, al acercarte a la ciudad, empiezas a notar un ambiente más urbano. Algo que me gustó especialmente y me llamó la atención fueron los numerosos grafitis pintados en las paredes de las calles, más o menos bonitos, pero sin duda perfectos para hacer que las paredes y las carreteras sean menos anónimas y grises. Bueno, tengo debilidad por el grafiti y el arte callejero.

As we get closer to Prato Est, the environment is always urban but alternating with fields and you can also notice various factories, it is a very industrial area like almost the whole city of Prato, especially active in the textile and furniture industries, however, arriving right in Prato Est I noticed that the area was very modern, there were many buildings probably of apartments, factories, businesses of various types (many of them Chinese, Prato has a very large Chinese community) various modern buildings that struck me (like a small concrete tower that I believe belonged to a church with a decidedly modern look), or a sort of hourglass sculpture placed in the middle of a road. However, the nice thing is that despite the modern side, Prato Est maintains many green spaces, there are large flowerbeds, fields and tree-lined avenues that intersperse the long rows of modern buildings. I think it's important for a city to have greenery and it's something that not all cities have. However, it's an area that I liked, I liked the contrast between modern and rural, the green areas and also the more urban parts. Prato never ceases to amaze me as a city.

> A medida que nos acercamos a Prato Est, el entorno es siempre urbano, pero se alterna con campos y también se pueden observar varias fábricas. Es una zona muy industrial, como casi toda la ciudad de Prato, especialmente activa en las industrias textil y del mueble. Sin embargo, al llegar a Prato Est, noté que la zona era muy moderna. Había muchos edificios, probablemente apartamentos, fábricas, negocios de diversos tipos (muchos de ellos chinos, ya que Prato tiene una gran comunidad china), varios edificios modernos que me llamaron la atención (como una pequeña torre de hormigón que creo que perteneció a una iglesia con un aspecto decididamente moderno), o una especie de escultura de reloj de arena colocada en medio de una calle. Sin embargo, lo bueno es que, a pesar del lado moderno, Prato Est conserva muchos espacios verdes: hay grandes parterres, campos y avenidas arboladas que se intercalan con las largas hileras de edificios modernos. Creo que es importante que una ciudad tenga zonas verdes, algo que no todas tienen. En definitiva, es una zona que me gustó; me gustó el contraste entre lo moderno y lo rural, las zonas verdes y también las partes más urbanas. Prato nunca deja de sorprenderme como ciudad.

description.body: >Imagen realizada pro IA para este texto. / Image made for this text.

>Muchas veces nosotros nos acostumbramos a una rutina, a una manera de hacer las cosas cotidianas y de participar en ciertos rituales personales, que vamos convirtiendo en hábitos con nuestras prácticas diarias y nuestra participación constante en esas rutinas.

>En mi caso, Hive, las comunidades de la red y el uso del Discord eran una rutina, y lo fue durante varios años, y como rutina, lo veía como algo normal e inclusive, hasta hacía falta la participación cotidiana; sin embargo, hay situaciones que te obligan a cambiar las rutinas y te rompen las estructuras de vida que uno había creado.

>Desde hace unos meses hasta hoy en día, se me han presentado dos situaciones familiares graves de salud con mis padres, que me han obligado a mantenerme alejado tanto de Hive como de otras actividades que realizaba de manera constante, y al parecer la vida misma no me dio una licencia para hacer algo que antes hacía de manera constante.

>Ahora que las situaciones comienzan a mejorar y que las aguas del río vuelven a su cauce, toca comenzar de nuevo y retomar los antiguos hábitos y situaciones que uno tuvo que dejar de manera inesperada por diferentes circunstancias, y el escribir, hacer comunidad y participar en Hive es una de ellas.
>Mis mejores deseos para todos mis lectores y para los miembros de las diferentes comunidades a las que pertenezco.

>Many times we get used to a routine, to a way of doing everyday things and participating in certain personal rituals, which we are turning into habits with our daily practices and our constant participation in those routines.

>In my case, Hive, the network communities and the use of Discord were a routine, and it was for several years, and as a routine, I saw it as something normal and even, even daily participation was needed; however, there are situations that force you to change the routines and break the life structures that one had created.

>From a few months ago to today, I have been presented with two serious family health situations with my parents, which have forced me to stay away from both Hive and other activities that I was constantly doing, and apparently life itself did not give me a license to do something that I used to do constantly.

>Now that the situations are starting to improve and the waters of the river are returning to their course, it's time to start over and resume the old habits and situations that one had to leave unexpectedly due to different circumstances, and writing, making community and participating in Hive is one of them.

>My best wishes to all my readers and to the members of the different communities to which I belong.

description.body: > After a droid's RPG blast spooked a large creature, I attempted a wall run but was eventually taken down. I used a shortcut to return to the meditation point before successfully defeating the droid and a Bedlam Raider. I then ended up stuck at a frustrating dead end for a moment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjf6abSHHCu3cPao3KQNqggMuifsd8dpRSihPZdJ1dF6/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQKQhwW97fvj5bN5AbVi2PgmDydqccaoo6jGY8xXeQKme/screenshot_2_.png) After activating the shortcut, I tried the other way to see what else was hidden in this area. I noticed a droid suddenly shot a hill with an RPG, which really spooked something big. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU2kPenqKgy67gwWLiTUpXgbx8TxQZ6KRywUSzyzcBwpW/screenshot_3_.png) I tried a wall run along the side of the cliff and jumped on the Bedlam Raider standing there to take him down quickly. While I was in the air, the droid started shooting at me with its blaster. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmUSm9ciGugfutzFZRXjE5t49YM7MqbTEDfrqWPjzTzp/screenshot_4_.png) After taking down the Bedlam Raider, I went for the droid with my lightsaber ready for a strike. However, it already overpowered me with a quick burst of fire and took me down before I could close the distance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYA9ebMcnYmfz82r36JvzJaDJdLmWxAeypdhKmWvXGy1x/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5YyxmtUVvvAE5bqQg3gJANcWgW4CrFovJuZt46LemKw/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPi86zkfGoYsnEsv4LesHXCfj2KqTAjaPzxLW729QrK9G/screenshot_7_.png) I had to run a long way to get back to this place from my last save point. This time I decided to try the shortcut I had found earlier, which took me directly back to the meditation point. I just came back through the door, feeling glad that I didn't have to fight through all the smaller enemies again to reach my objective. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVE14431ePf4runJTjvK9VBvnUS8KQSaaKvMdRTSy97JR/screenshot_8_.png) I realized that the shortcut was only for this specific purpose, so I could get back to this place quickly if I died there. But I didn't fully understand the layout at first, so I took the long way around again. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnDjG6XQqL4GZRhhvCRZ5VQEjWBxy6B8vPtsUBFihsQ1/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8dQPqyakw4ZQCCBjffeAurBr4WbYJi27jKjmbFq151L/screenshot_10_.png) This time, I didn't give that droid the same opportunity to take me down like it did before. Right after taking down the Bedlam Raider with a swift strike, I moved quickly and sliced the droid into two pieces. It fell apart in a shower of sparks, and I felt much more confident as I cleared the immediate threat. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdVkcbZ8D7zGgCY7tuHBHVfMBavYE1UmSU8bhgYxVfz7j/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDTU2Z4kiAryLDQNRqX3UERimYoMwX6NBaLqce8QDwcK/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUs1f86aTEuzJY7Jq7fsEjL1tyk1y6uVXAjxXoYT9PNWc/screenshot_13_.png) I moved forward and had to jump into this tar area that felt like it was pulling me down with a strange force. I had to be very quick in jumping onto that steel surface to avoid drowning there. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRvV9ufYNNKuNNBNCj27gvJJtaCs8mUYJk8kCUshkRQm/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWNVBdeLm2JJy1vPicy8wwZPmYmT1viBg77P88shMDRLU/screenshot_15_.png) From there, I could interact with two bombs that were getting blown up once I was pulling them up from the tar. It was a strange mechanism because the bombs were getting regenerated right away after every explosion. I tried to time my movements with the blasts, but the constant noise and fire made it very difficult to focus on the goal. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZWrYXoZwhfkRYvv6gkuUM8JPeFCCjrPDjY2AwekkJLbB/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawNyE7ni8rJy97ujpnAimKELTeWiJX5GREtoLi5Xo3VR/screenshot_17_.png) I kept trying hard to move out of this situation, but I was just kind of lost there in the middle of the machinery. I started trying everything I could, including different jumps and Force powers, but still it looked like a dead end for me. That's all for this session. More moments coming soon and thanks for checking it out. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=ridwanan/7001f4b8)

description.title: It Might Be Just A Dream
description.body:
The idea of a “floating Iceland” honestly feels like something straight out of a dream, hearing it alone brings a lots of imagination. I mean, Iceland on its own already looks magical with its volcanoes, waterfalls, and icy landscapes but imagining it floating in the middle of the ocean? That just takes it to another level. Would I like to go there? Without a doubt, it's definitely a yes. It sounds like the kind of place you would only see in movies, and being able to experience it in real life would really be unforgettable.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd96B7SZ2rBuEhUQ5biRgXTyCweWnXbXuRSR58CQsGpxC/1000205870.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/icebergs-glacier-iceland-ice-cream-4475940/)

At the same time, I can’t ignore the fact that traveling to Iceland is already quite expensive. If we think of the Flights, hotels, food, seriously it all adds up really fast. So if a floating version existed, I can only imagine it might be even more costly. That does make me pause a bit, and asked myself this question, did I have the money to tour it, No. Not everyone has the budget for something like that, and I think travel should feel more accessible, not just something for a small group of people.

That’s why the idea of a one-day adventure there actually sounds perfect to me. If there were an option where you could visit just for a day, maybe through some kind of special tour or experience, it would make it feel much more doable. I can picture it, spending a full day exploring, taking photos, feeling the fresh air, and just soaking in the uniqueness of being on a floating island. Even if it is short, it would still be meaningful.

Now, buying a house on a floating Iceland? That’s where I start to feel a bit unsure. On one hand, it sounds amazing, imagine myself waking up to those views every single day. But on the other hand, I would probably worry about safety and stability. What happens during storms? Would it feel secure? I think I’d personally prefer visiting over living there permanently, I'm a scaredy cat you know. Maybe a short stay or a holiday home would be more my style.

As for making it easier for everyone to go there, I think it would really depend on how it’s developed. If there were affordable travel options, group packages, or even discounts over time, more people could experience it. Another idea could be creating digital or virtual experiences for people who can’t physically travel. It’s not the same, of course, but it could still give people a taste of what it’s like.

When I first heard about the idea of a floating Iceland, I felt excited but also a bit surprised. It’s such a creative and unusual concept, and it really makes me think about how far imagination can go. Even if it never becomes real, just thinking about it makes the world feel a little more interesting. It reminds me that there are still so many possibilities out there, and maybe one day, ideas like this won’t feel so impossible after all.




**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

description.title: Mind, Body, Soul and Spirit
description.body:
#
One person: Many parts

In today's society where it seems that beauty is everything, people often forget that there is much more to a person than the physical. Everywhere there is a message: Stay thin, get fit, stay fit and be happy. I totally agree that a fit body is super important, but it is only **one** part of a complete package. ### Just picture a table. How stable will a one legged table be? How about if you add a second leg? Obviously that table will not stand. How about a table with one broken leg? I wouldn't feel too happy about relying on it. I personally believe that people have four pillars that keep them standing firm, and the person is only as strong as the weakest link. ### The four pillars * The body (physical) * The mind (mental) * The spirit (emotional) * The soul (spiritual) If those four pillars are strong you get a strong individual. Attack one of those pillars and you will weaken the individual.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/terganftp/23xAKMzr3bGmwDx5Xr3bSEtQCQMBZYtHMScdAu1iZT47HMhthjVTt9M8i22UDeh9eeCvJ.png)
If you want to be picky perhaps you will mention people such as Stephen Hawking who had serious physical limitations but also achieved a great deal during his life. I would then point out that considering his disease state, he was an exceptional case, outliving most with his condition by decades. But enough of edge cases. I'll stand by my point. If there are four strong pillars, there is a strong individual.

### But what of those who attack those pillars?
* **What if someone attacks your body?** Is that a serious crime? * **What if someone attacks your mind?** Is that a serious crime? * **What if someone attacks your spirit?** Is that a crime? * **What if someone attacks your soul?** Is that a crime?
I tend to think that attacking any of the four pillars of what makes a person who they are is a crime. Unfortunately, some attacks are harder to quantify and harder to make laws against... **Physical attacks are fairly easy to quantify.** * Was someone hit? * Was someone injured? * Was it bad enough to go to the hospital? * Did it cause lifelong injury? A simple medical report can answer all of those questions.
**Mental and emotional health attacks are much harder to quantify.** * Was someone emotionally attacked? * Was it a joke? Was it serious? * Did it leave someone emotionally or mentally injured? * Was it serious enough to require treatment? * Did it cause lifelong injury? Now it’s tougher. It comes down to how someone feels about it. The same attack against two different people can lead to two very different results. If someone decided to write a comment about this article calling it **utter and total garbage**, I wouldn't enjoy the comment, but I'm strong enough in my sense of self that it would leave very little lasting effect. Someone writing their first article or with a weaker sense of self could be devastated by a nasty comment. Someone using HIVE as their daily source of income? That one negative comment could affect their rewards, reputation, and livelihood. ***Same comment but totally different outcomes***

**Spiritual attacks are even harder to quantify** I was recently in Surabaya, Indonesia where there is a strong Muslim presence. Let's make an assumption that someone decided to serve pork to guests claiming it was beef or chicken. Perhaps serving it in an alcoholic sauce. Sure, much of the alcohol is burnt off, but some remains. Enough spice and the person may never know they ate both pork and drank alcohol. ***Then tell them what you did.*** **Is it a spiritual attack?** * Did it cause injury? * Did it affect the person negatively? * Did it *injure* the person? I think it would require a lot of discussion and lead to a lot of disagreement. An atheist may say the whole argument is nonsense, while others may be horrified at the act.

#
How do we judge?

Unfortunately judges have to decide what punishment fits the crime. Physical crimes are more straightforward. Get the facts, weigh the damage, decide the punishment based on the written laws. Emotional/Mental crimes? Sure you can get the facts. However, weighing the damage is harder. Is there real damage, or is the reaction disproportionate to the intent? **Subjective damages are harder to quantify than objective damages.** Can physical and emotional damage be just as debilitating? Absolutely. Spiritual crimes? Corrupting a person's moral core? I wouldn't even know where to start judging that one. I personally believe that it could ruin a person but… proving it? I wouldn't want to be that judge.

#
Hive Learners prompt

The Hive Learners prompt asks which is worse: Physical or emotional abuse? Real life or digital world abuse? Personally I believe both can be equal depending on the circumstances. * A physical injury can steal a person's livelihood through disability. * An online attack can cancel someone or steal their reputation... which can also steal a person's livelihood. * An online attack can also go after someone's sense of worth. The job and life seem intact, but it invisibly breaks the person. The first is easy to see. The second is more difficult to see. The third may be impossible to see. But they all result in the same thing: **a broken person** They are all equally grave. The difference? * Some are objective * Some are subjective Objective ones are easier to judge. Subjective ones are much harder to judge. They both ***deserve*** the same penalty based on damage but in reality? The judge has a difficult job with objective facts. With subjective facts? I'm very glad I'm not the judge. That's my take on the Hive Learners prompt this week. Feel free to leave comments to support or rebut my stance. I love getting feedback. If you don't feel like leaving feedback? Well, thanks for reading the post anyways. Always enjoy someone reading what I write. Thank you.

description.title: Cuando todo pesa / When Everything Feels Heavy
description.body:
Hay días en los que la fortaleza parece diluirse. Últimamente, me he sentido habitada por un humor que no reconozco: una mezcla de amargura, frustración y una angustia que se me instala en el pecho. Es esa sensación desesperada de querer salir corriendo y, al mismo tiempo, desear hundir la cabeza en la almohada para llorar hasta que el cansancio me venza. Mi campo de batalla ha sido mi propio cuerpo; la hernia hiatal no es solo un malestar físico, es un dolor persistente que me condiciona el ánimo. 

Pero lo que realmente duele es la impotencia económica. Mi presupuesto solo cubre lo básico y, aunque lo agradezco profundamente, porque es mucho más de lo que muchas personas tienen, esa gratitud convive con un miedo paralizante: ¿qué pasa si mi salud empeora o si mi hijo Gabriel se enferma? Ojo, No escribo para buscar soluciones externas, sino para drenar el peso interno y recuperar mi propio centro.


A esto se le suma la incertidumbre laboral. No es que no me mueva; sigo enviando currículums sin recibir respuesta, sumergida en el \
de la espera. El dueño de una empresa muy importante me entrevistó el pasado 24 de marzo y sus palabras fueron: \

Mi encuentro con él, no fue una entrevista de oficina, fría y distante. Por el contrario, fue en un café, un compartir con su esposa y hasta conocer a su padre; me integró a su círculo familiar en apenas un par de horas. 

Cuando alguien actúa así, te envía una señal de confianza absoluta, y por eso, que después de esa \

tan cálida haya seguido un silencio de casi un mes, se siente como un balde de agua fría. Es como si me hubieran abierto la puerta de su casa, me hubieran invitado a pasar con total apertura y, de repente, se hubieran ido a dormir dejándome sentada en la sala sin decir nada más.

Esa promesa suspendida en el aire se vuelve pesada cuando las necesidades reales no saben de pausas ni de calendarios ajenos. Intentar mantener la calma cuando el reloj corre en tu contra es un ejercicio de resistencia que agota los nervios de cualquiera.

En medio de este torbellino, surge el estrés de las relaciones intensas. Tengo una amiga en el extranjero que, con buena intención pero poca empatía real, intenta dirigir mi vida. Hace poco descubrí que me enviaba ofertas de trabajo que otra persona le pasaba a ella; es decir, estaba ventilando mi situación personal con terceros. Se lo manifesté, me pidió disculpas, pero la intensidad no para. Ahora insiste en que haga cursos o que busque trabajo remoto, ¡como si yo no hubiese tocado ya esas puertas mil veces!. Es frustrante recibir lecciones desde afuera sin conocer la realidad del terreno.

Me habla de lo remoto cuando me he topado mil veces con el muro del \

. En ese segundo exacto en que leo esas frases, siento una frustración que me quema por dentro. Es doloroso saber que, aunque uno tenga la capacidad y las ganas, nos cierran las puertas por un estigma que no nos pertenece. Sé que hay muchos venezolanos haciendo desastres en otros países y, lamentablemente, son los que hacen más ruido. Al final, terminamos pagando justos por pecadores, cargando con una reputación ajena que se convierte en un obstáculo insalvable para quienes solo queremos trabajar con dignidad.\n\nOtras veces, tras invitaciones a charlas de YouTube interminables que prometen el cielo, terminan pidiéndote dinero para \

. ¿Cómo le pides dinero a alguien que justamente está buscando la manera de ganarlo? Es una burla a la necesidad. He explorado las vacantes reales, pero la verdad es que están saturadas o simplemente no hay cupo. Es un tema sin fin que drena la esperanza. Por eso, cuando recibo consejos de alguien que no vive mi contexto, la ayuda se siente como una carga. A veces, la ayuda más grande no es un manual de instrucciones, sino el respeto por el proceso del otro.\n\nEscribir estas líneas me ayuda a entender que mi \
tiene nombre: se llama cansancio sistémico. Me permito hoy no ser la mujer \

. Me permito reconocer que el camino está empinado y que tengo derecho a sentirme así. Al ponerle nombre a estas sombras, les quito poder. La paz no es la ausencia de problemas, sino la firmeza de no permitir que nada ni nadie nos pisotée el espíritu mientras encontramos el camino de salida. Mañana seguiré tocando puertas, pero hoy, mi prioridad es defender mi paz mental.

description.title: One Piece continues my favourite live action tv show after season 2
description.body:
>

  I miss writing about TV shows and movies. I have been watching so many TV shows at the same time, probably I am ending season 2 of Monarch and soon I will post about it. But now let's talk about a recently finished TV Show: One Piece Season 2. I am a bit suspicious about talking about this tv show, since I am a fan from the animation/manga version of it. So my views are totally different from a person who never watched the animation or the graphic novel. But it was a great experience like watching season one 3 years ago.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tS2pMpyPdxX4Hs94zpThc93yoDCUojhqmn8Y3B5GhciXXdo5czP5iejzx8EPr7WMj72.png)

>Luffy, our main character talking to a whale. [Screenshot from The Movie Database]

  It is bad that Netflix TV shows take so much time to release new seasons of their shows. I usually forget even about the story. That problem happened with The Witcher and Stranger Things as well. I think that Season 2 of One Piece confirmed the first season as probably the closest live-action to its original animation version.

  You feel that you are watching an identical copy of the animation, including the supernatural powers given by the amazing devil fruit or Akuma no Mi. Luffy's actor and dressing makes you feel that he is skinny with longer arms and legs. It is crazy to exist someone with similar physical attributions than an animation or drawn character. And they kept all the weird characteristics of the original One Piece characters in the live-action. The marine captain who smokes two cigars at once, for example, and the weird uniform used by their crew.

  Of course, they had to rely on computer graphics to recreate characters like Chopper, the cute reindeer that talks. The story is a great fantasy in a magic world where pirates are a bit different from what we are used to in the real world. The actors are indeed playing their original characters from the manga, and we can get attached to the characters' feelings. That is the major victory of this live-action TV show.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tSNDPgiUVfurqkF6X12cMVhaWgWUoKU4zLugtDN8kxPgR1Zhtj4T8ADa3DRaEsU5Rjo.jpg)

> In season 2 the crew starts their path searching the One Piece. [Screenshot from the Movie Database]

  If you love fantasy, you probably would enjoy this crazy story even not knowing about the original story from the manga and later animated. For sure, you would have fun with this different, very different pirate tale in a magical world where whales can talk.

[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wMS5Mk5RaoA6EdKv35TPtYzT2oppCtUWD6qwC5GUBMb877AgJ5rGzJeoTew2bGQJQWZ.png)](https://vote.hive.uno/@gwajnberg)
Banner created in canva

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpjQ6Eiqz8JMMjig1nLZFvxM1sFhvNmiGYA2snkPD7Z4TnmFxxRyih87.png)

 Sinto falta de escrever sobre séries e filmes. Tenho assistido a tantas séries ao mesmo tempo, provavelmente estou terminando a segunda temporada de Monarch e em breve farei uma postagem sobre ela. Mas agora vamos falar sobre uma série que terminou recentemente: One Piece, segunda temporada. Estou um pouco receosa em falar sobre essa série, já que sou fã desde o anime/mangá. Então, minha opinião é totalmente diferente da de alguém que nunca assistiu ao anime ou leu a graphic novel. Mas foi uma ótima experiência, como assistir à primeira temporada há 3 anos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tS2pMpyPdxX4Hs94zpThc93yoDCUojhqmn8Y3B5GhciXXdo5czP5iejzx8EPr7WMj72.png)

>Luffy, nosso personagem principal, conversando com uma baleia. [Captura de tela do The Movie Database]

  É uma pena que as séries da Netflix demorem tanto para lançar novas temporadas. Eu geralmente até esqueço da história. Esse problema aconteceu com The Witcher e Stranger Things também. Acho que a segunda temporada de One Piece confirmou que a primeira temporada é provavelmente a adaptação live-action mais fiel à animação original.

 Você tem a sensação de estar assistindo a uma cópia idêntica da animação, incluindo os poderes sobrenaturais concedidos pela incrível Akuma no Mi. O ator e o figurino do Luffy fazem você perceber que ele é magro, com braços e pernas mais longos. É incrível que exista alguém com características físicas semelhantes às de um personagem de animação ou desenho animado. E eles mantiveram todas as características peculiares dos personagens originais de One Piece na versão live-action. O capitão da Marinha que fuma dois charutos ao mesmo tempo, por exemplo, e o uniforme estranho usado pela tripulação.

 Claro, eles tiveram que usar computação gráfica para recriar personagens como Chopper, a adorável rena falante. A história é uma grande fantasia em um mundo mágico onde os piratas são um pouco diferentes do que estamos acostumados no mundo real. Os atores estão de fato interpretando seus personagens originais do mangá, e podemos nos apegar aos sentimentos dos personagens. Essa é a grande vitória desta série de TV com atores reais.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tSNDPgiUVfurqkF6X12cMVhaWgWUoKU4zLugtDN8kxPgR1Zhtj4T8ADa3DRaEsU5Rjo.jpg)

> Na segunda temporada, a tripulação inicia sua jornada em busca do One Piece. [Captura de tela do The Movie Database]

  Se você gosta de fantasia, provavelmente vai curtir essa história maluca mesmo sem conhecer a história original do mangá e da animação. Com certeza você vai se divertir com esse conto de piratas diferente, muito diferente, em um mundo mágico onde as baleias falam.

description.title: Як небо: про світлі й темні періоди життя
description.body: Іноді небо виглядає так, ніби його хтось його розмалював пензлем.\n\n

/>

Наше життя таке саме.

Є смуги світлі — коли легко, коли виходить, коли ти відчуваєш опору під ногами.  
Є темні — коли нічого не ясно, коли страшно, коли хочеться зупинитись.  
Є тонкі — майже непомітні моменти, які потім виявляються важливими.  
І є широкі — періоди, які здаються безкінечними.

Ми часто хочемо тільки “ясного неба”. Без смуг.  
Але тоді воно було б просто порожнім.

І справа не в тому, щоб позбутися темних відрізків.  
А в тому, щоб навчитися дивитись на них з відстані — як на частину цілого.

Бо тільки здалеку видно, що навіть найтемніша смуга не псує небо. Вона робить його глибшим.

description.title: Today was one of those days when I let go of pressure/Dziś był jeden z tych dni, kiedy odpuszczam/My Actifit Report Card: April 21 2026
description.body:
Today was one of those days when I let go of pressure and chose balance over perfection 💛 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/00d8f3a0-74df-40ca-bc35-b1299c26769c.jpg) There was no intense workout, no breaking records… but there was movement. And that’s what counts. A short session with TRX and dumbbells at home – totally easygoing, no pressure at all. Just enough to get my body moving and remind my muscles they still exist 😄 On top of that, a full day at work on my feet and an evening movie date, so I also got a short walk both ways. Small things, but together they make a difference. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/538eaea1-b054-4099-88be-ac0ac772344d.jpg) Steps? Over 7,500 – which for me is a great level of daily activity. No guilt, no feeling that “I could have done more.” Because the truth is, not every day has to be 100%. Sometimes 60–70% is exactly what we need. Tomorrow I’ve agreed to work overtime, so today I’m consciously choosing rest. Recovery is also part of the process – and I’m learning to treat it just as seriously as training. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/23af8412-c364-4e15-9e68-9d397a2c1077.jpg) Balance. That’s the word that wins today 🧘‍♀️ And by the way – the city at night has its own vibe ✨ The lights, a bit of quiet between the streets, and that moment when you can just walk and breathe. Today’s activity: ✔️ TRX + dumbbells (light home workout) ✔️ On my feet at work ✔️ Walk (movie date 🎬) ✔️ 7,588 steps Today wasn’t perfect. Today was enough. And that is more than okay 💛 Dziś był jeden z tych dni, kiedy odpuszczam presję i wybieram balans zamiast perfekcji 💛 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/951618d7-8aaf-4a85-b1ea-6f4c434b0e6d.jpg) Nie było wielkiego treningu, nie było bicia rekordów… ale był ruch. I to się liczy. Krótka sesja z TRX i hantlami w domu – tak totalnie na luzie, bez spiny. Tyle, żeby rozruszać ciało i przypomnieć mięśniom, że nadal istnieją 😄 Do tego cały dzień w pracy na nogach i wieczorna randka w kinie, więc wpadł też spacer w dwie strony. Małe rzeczy, ale razem robią robotę. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1b53a634-4d19-4e53-b67b-dbf6fc6be9fe.jpg) Kroki? Ponad 7500 – czyli dla mnie idealny poziom codziennej aktywności. Bez wyrzutów sumienia, bez poczucia, że „mogłam więcej”. Bo prawda jest taka, że nie każdy dzień musi być na 100%. Czasem 60–70% to dokładnie to, czego potrzebujemy. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/575d25cd-d159-4884-a648-9998814a7c2b.jpg) Jutro czekają mnie nadgodziny, więc dziś świadomie wybieram odpoczynek. Regeneracja to też część procesu – i coraz częściej uczę się ją traktować tak samo poważnie jak trening. Balans. To słowo dziś wygrywa 🧘‍♀️ A przy okazji – wieczorne miasto ma swój klimat ✨ Światła, trochę ciszy między ulicami i ten moment, kiedy można po prostu iść przed siebie i odetchnąć. Aktywność dnia: ✔️ TRX + hantle (lekki trening domowy) ✔️ Praca na nogach ✔️ Spacer (randka w kinie 🎬) ✔️ 7588 kroków Dziś nie było perfekcyjnie. Dziś było wystarczająco. I to jest więcej niż ok 💛
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@patif2025/actifit-patif2025-20260421t194249687z)_

description.title: What I do when I have a conflict | Lo que hago cuando tengo un conflicto
description.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

>

**No me vas a creer lo abrumada que me sentía ayer.**

Tenía otras metas para esta semana, pero la vida a veces da algunos giros, por lo que debes hacer las cosas que surjan. 

Así que aquí estoy yo. Aplacé algunas actividades, que me preocupan mucho porque son muy importantes. Sin embargo, también hay actividades que me respiran en la nuca. 

Por ello, ordene las actividades por prioridad:

+ *Primero, todo aquello que tenga una fecha próxima.*

En este caso, la universidad es eso en lo que he estado ocupándome (también el motivo de mi ausencia en Hive Blog). Tengo que trabajar en lo que falta del proyecto, también en las diapositivas. 

Puedo decir que ya todo está terminado, solo falta el visto bueno del tutor y podría relajarme un poco. 

O al menos estudiar sin tener nada pendiente. 

Sin embargo, los dos primeros días de la semana han sido muy estresantes. 

He hecho las diapositivas dos veces; en ambas considero que están bien. Pero a mi compañera no le parecen. 

Cree otro diseño; no le gustó. Y simplemente pensé que no voy a estresarme por ello. 

Voy a buscar la opinión del profesor, y de acuerdo a lo que él diga tomaré la decisión. 

Esto me parece más sensato. Porque siento que no llegaremos a un acuerdo. 

No puedo ceder, porque es la diapositiva más importante de nuestra vida universitaria. Debe impactar, debe ser un elemento clave en nuestra defensa. 

Por lo que tengo que asegurarme de que salga bien. 

Pero, en el proceso, no considero que deba tener un nivel de estrés tan alto. Ayer sentí que el dolor de cabeza me la partiría en dos. 

Espero hoy tener buenas noticias de ello, y sobre todo marcar en el checklist de terminados para avanzar con otras cosas que también ameritan atención. Como, por ejemplo, estudiar y dominar el tema por completo. 

Puedo defenderme, puedo salir bien, pero no quiero un bien, quiero que sea excelente, así que a partir de mañana me dedicaré a estudiar arduamente. 

La parte positiva es que hice todo el proyecto, por lo que no es tan difícil estudiar. Conozco cada proceso, solo necesito aprender algunos términos profesionales para poder explicarlo de forma detallada. 

**Pero, ¿qué hice con el estrés que siento?**

Además de tomar la decisión que te mencionaba, solo dije: \

. Vale la pena y mucho distraerse. Sacar todo de tu mente un rato para poder decidir o hacer las cosas mejor. Simplemente sales un rato, conversas, haces otra cosa, lo que sea, sembrar una planta, regar tus plantas o cualquier cosa. Eso, aunque suene insignificante a veces, ayuda un montón a despejar la mente. Ese ha sido mi secreto durante un buen tiempo para tomar decisiones, incluso para elegir las palabras apropiadas para hablar con alguna persona cuando se presenta un conflicto. Y hoy te lo recomiendo a ti también. >! [English version available by clicking here] >You won't believe how overwhelmed I felt yesterday. > >I had other goals for this week, but life sometimes takes unexpected turns, so you have to deal with whatever comes up. > >So here I am. I postponed some activities that are really worrying me because they're so important. However, there are also things that are breathing down my neck. > >Therefore, I prioritized my activities: > >First, everything with an upcoming deadline. > >In this case, university is what I've been focused on (also the reason for my absence from Hive Blog). I have to work on the remaining part of the project, including the slides. > >I can say that everything is finished; I just need the tutor's approval, and then I could relax a little. > >Or at least study without having anything pending. > >However, the first two days of the week have been very stressful. > >I've done the slides twice; I think they're fine both times. But my partner doesn't think so. > >I created another design; he didn't like it. And I just thought I wasn't going to stress about it. > >I'm going to get the professor's opinion, and I'll make the decision based on what he says. > >This seems more sensible to me. Because I feel like we won't reach an agreement. > >I can't give in, because it's the most important slide of our university life. It has to be impactful, it has to be a key element in our defense. > >So I have to make sure it goes well. > >But, in the process, I don't think I should be under so much stress. Yesterday I felt like my headache was going to split my head in two. > >I hope to have good news about it today, and above all, to check it off the list of things done so I can move on to other things that also deserve attention. Like, for example, studying and mastering the topic completely. > >I can defend myself, I can do well, but I don't want just good, I want it to be excellent, so starting tomorrow I'm going to dedicate myself to studying hard. > >The good news is that I did the whole project, so studying isn't that difficult. I know every process; I just need to learn some professional terms to be able to explain it in detail. > >**But what did I do about the stress I feel?** > >Besides making the decision I mentioned, I just said, \

> >It's so worthwhile to take a break. Clear your mind of everything for a while so you can make better decisions or do things more effectively. > >Just go outside for a bit, have a conversation, do something else—anything at all—plant a seed, water your plants, or anything else. > >That, even though it might sound insignificant sometimes, helps a lot to clear your mind. > >That's been my secret for quite some time now for making decisions, even for choosing the right words to talk to someone when a conflict arises. > >And today I recommend it to you too. >Texto de mi autoría. > **Imágenes en el post creadas por mi en estos software:** >+ Iconos hechos en Photoshop, usando como referencia los logos de las redes sociales correspondientes. >+ Banners y portada realizados en Canva en la versión gratuita. >+ Todas las fotografías en el post son de mi autoría, las cuales edito con las apps de Lightroom y Meitu.

description.body:
![pride-flags-15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/241QXaFpGqrS5hdacvHavATHKRkYCpDvzFj28EVghHTNrFyVUHfUfnMhNUPUBhue4hHME.jpg)



An interesting bit of news has come my way and it’s not good news for any of the Lesbians, Gays and Bisexuals who are critical of the gender cult and who live in the Herefordshire area and its surrounds.  After a break of a year when there was not a Pride festival in Hereford because of ‘organisational issues’ it appears that a group has stepped forward to run one in June of this year.

All well and good you might think, someone’s rescued a community event that I understand has, in the past, got some good attendance.  Unfortunately that’s the only bit of good news.

Apparently my sources are telling me that this Pride festival is going to be very Trans friendly and I suspect that it will not be at all welcoming for LGB’s who are critical of the gender identity cult.  I understand that it’s allegedly going to be being run by a local ‘LGBT’ social group called ‘Queers and Beers’ an organisation I’ve been told that is said to be heavily captured by the cult of Trans.

If it wasn’t bad enough that a Pride that should be primarily for LGB people and their friends might end up as a full on trans festival this Queers and Beers group is very heavily invested in the ‘Palestine’ cult as well.  This means that not only will this possibly trans centred Pride be unwelcoming to LGB’s it will also be unwelcoming for Jews and those who are not Jewish but who understand what’s going on in the Middle East and the monstrous behaviour of the so-called ‘Palestinians’.

I can’t imagine a worse event to go to.  A Pride hollowed out by the trans cultists and stuffed full of ‘Palestine’ flags and chants of ‘from the river to the sea’.  Why not just call this an Socialist Workers Party rally and have done with it?  After all it would be much more honest than calling it a pride festival.

This group could have put on something that might have been more relevant to those who are same or both sex attracted but they didn’t.  It’s just going to be a Troon and Terrorist support festival and I’d be surprised if many people are going to schlep long distances to go to that. 

Finally, a question to the organisers of this event should they be reading this piece:  How long would a Gay, Lesbian, Bisexual person or a Transvestite or a Transsexual last if they were suddenly transported to Gaza or to the West Bank?  I think you’d find that it wouldn’t be very long at all before said individual was shot, stabbed, strangled or thrown off of a high building, if that is there any high buildings left standing in Gaza at the moment.

description.body: > I remember coming into the blockchain and the person who onboarded me made sure to spell out some things which have been helpful in my journey here so far, and some of them touch on the topic in this prompt. The person told me to ensure I don't picture Hive as a get-rich-quick scheme; because I'll be getting rewards for my efforts, but to see it as a place and opportunity to learn, grow and connect. I see why he had to spell that out. Being here, I was able to learn, grow and build connections. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXR7ySzUoFHWsjJgWVgca58MG6CN1G1BQ7Aw2mKWLNNh3/file_00000000d44471f8b7a4055c969f417e.png) Beyond that, another piece of advice echoed, which is to avoid the temptation or desire to power down. He informed me that I can withdraw from my HBD rewards, if necessary, but never touch my HP, not even at that stage of a newbie at least. Why? It was advice to help me build myself on the blockchain and to gain some “power” which we know the HP does that. Even when I cashed out from some of my posts; the HBD earnings, to at least have a taste of the blockchain’s reward for my effort, this advice remained with me. The advice helped me gain resilience in building my reputation and growing here on Hive. It wasn't just about cash outs but about having a voice, power and growth. If it were about cashing out only, I guess many of us still around at this time when the currency has fallen, we wouldn't be around. But because growth mattered, we kept showing up even in this period. Funny enough, this is a good time to build one's account, power up and gain that growth on the blockchain. Hola, hoy vuelvo a escribir sobre el gym y cómo me he sentido en esta disciplina. Bueno, aquí me siento más tranquilo; he vuelto a retomar la disciplina de realizar ejercicio. Actualmente estoy yendo al menos cuatro días a la semana y, sí, me siento bien con los días que he cumplido.

Sobre todo, recuerdo que hubo momentos en los que me exigía mucho, y cuando dejaba de ir, se me venían pensamientos de tristeza al perder la constancia. Pero ahora estoy conforme con el ritmo que llevo, y eso me hace sentir feliz.

La versión que quiero construir de mí mismo es una más segura, una que realiza ejercicio para sentirse bien. Una versión que no se obsesiona con el cambio físico, que va a su propio ritmo y que también está orgullosa de sus avances y progresos.

Quiero ser alguien que no se culpa cuando pasan días o semanas sin entrenar, sino que retoma la rutina con más motivación y más ganas que antes. Algo que me inspire a entender que el gym es un espacio para desestresarme, para tener un momento conmigo mismo y saber que puedo crecer en mi disciplina.

Un pequeño hábito que hago en el gym para poder rendir mejor es realizar estiramientos antes de cada ejercicio. Siento que cuando hago esto, todo mi cuerpo “truena”, jeje… no sé cómo explicarlo, pero es como si me estuviera preparando para la hora que pasaré entrenando.

También me gusta escuchar música cuando hago ejercicio; el género que prefiero es la electrónica, porque siento que me da energía y me impulsa a seguir.

Me he preguntado a mí mismo cómo puedo medir si estoy progresando. En mi caso, lo noto cuando siento que puedo levantar las pesas más fácilmente o cuando los ejercicios se me hacen menos difíciles. Es ahí donde entiendo que debo subir de nivel, ya sea aumentando repeticiones o incrementando el peso.

Un ejemplo claro son las pechadas: mientras más constante soy en el gym, más fáciles se me hacen. Es en ese momento cuando sé que los ejercicios están dando resultados.

Mis sentimientos cuando voy al gym, especialmente porque entreno en la noche, muchas veces comienzan con falta de ganas. A veces no quiero ir o no quiero hacer los ejercicios. Sin embargo, luego de unos 30 minutos entrenando, ese sentimiento cambia completamente y empiezo a disfrutarlo.

Hay días en los que incluso me gusta ir porque me siento ansioso, y el ejercicio me ayuda a volver al momento presente, a estar en el “aquí y ahora”. Por eso valoro tanto esta práctica.

Después de una sesión de ejercicio, me siento más liviano y con más energía. Es como si dejara una carga de emociones en las máquinas, como si lograra ordenar mis pensamientos. Luego de la rutina, puedo continuar con mis actividades diarias de una mejor manera.

Me motiva mucho más el bienestar físico que me brinda el gym que los cambios estéticos. Sé que los resultados físicos toman tiempo, así que prefiero quedarme con esa sensación de bienestar que me ayuda a liberar el estrés. Para mí, eso ya es algo muy positivo.

También disfruto mucho que, después de una buena rutina, puedo salir a caminar con mi perrito Loki. Salir a la calle, sentir el viento y observar el paisaje después de entrenar es una sensación muy agradable, y es algo que realmente disfruto.

---
---
---

Hello, today I’m writing again about the gym and how I’ve been feeling with this discipline. I feel calmer now; I’ve started to regain the discipline of exercising. Currently, I’m going at least four days a week, and yes, I feel good about the days I’ve been consistent.

I especially remember that there were times when I pushed myself too hard, and when I stopped going, I would have thoughts of sadness for losing consistency. But now I feel comfortable with the rhythm I have, and that makes me happy.

The version of myself I want to build is a more confident one, someone who exercises to feel good. A version that doesn’t obsess over physical changes, that moves at its own pace, and that is proud of its progress and improvements.

I want to be someone who doesn’t feel guilty when I miss days or even weeks, but instead returns to the routine with more motivation and stronger desire than before. Something that inspires me to see the gym as a place to relieve stress, to spend time with myself, and to know that I can grow in discipline.

A small habit I practice at the gym to perform better is stretching before every exercise. I feel like when I do this, my whole body “cracks” haha… I don’t really know how to explain it, but it’s like I’m preparing myself for the time I’ll spend training.

I also like to listen to music while I exercise. The genre I enjoy the most is electronic music because I feel it gives me energy and pushes me forward.

I’ve asked myself how I can measure my progress. In my case, I notice it when I can lift weights more easily or when the exercises feel less difficult. That’s when I realize it’s time to level up, either by increasing repetitions or adding more weight.

A clear example is push-ups: the more consistent I am at the gym, the easier they become. That’s when I know the exercises are working.

My feelings when I go to the gym—especially since I train at night—often start with a lack of motivation. Sometimes I don’t feel like going or doing the exercises. However, after about 30 minutes of training, that feeling completely changes, and I start to enjoy it.

There are even days when I like going because I feel anxious, and exercising helps me return to the present moment, to be in the “here and now.” That’s why I value this practice so much.

After a workout session, I feel lighter and more energized. It’s like I leave a load of emotions on the machines, like I manage to clear my mind. After my routine, I can continue with my daily activities in a much better way.

What motivates me the most is the physical well-being the gym gives me, more than the aesthetic changes. I know physical results take time, so I prefer to focus on that feeling of well-being that helps me release stress. For me, that alone is already something very positive.

I also really enjoy that after a good workout, I can go for a walk with my dog, Loki. Going outside, feeling the wind, and observing the surroundings after exercising is a very pleasant feeling, and it’s something I truly enjoy.
