title.title: The Hard Choice On Hive _ Spend Now, Grow Later.
title.body: > On Hive, one thing that every user here actually definitely face at some point is this simple but somehow hard decision… do you power up or do you cash out? So at first, it might not even look like a big deal, you just earn, see your rewards, and you are like, okay, let me just take this out and use it, and honestly, there is nothing wrong with that, especially when real life is involved, because bills don’t just pay themselves. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZsq3m6iJX4C977ThqPYiY2DUZ9JQRqCCbkNZYxDFwzd/1776799106747.png) But for me, I have come to realize that I actually prefer to power up my account and let it grow. It did not just start like that though, there was a time recently when I had to power down some of my Hive earnings because I had bills to sort out, and at that moment, it made sense ,You see I needed the money, and I still need the money, and Hive was there for me, so why not? That is one thing I actually appreciate about it, the fact that it can come through for you when you need it. But then something happened. As I was powering down, I started noticing the value of my account dropping, and I won’t even lie here, I didn’t like that feeling at all, It was like watching something you have been building slowly just reduce right in front of you, that was when it really now clicked for me. I started seeing my account not just as something I can withdraw from anytime, but as something I am actually building, like a long term thing, something that, if I am patient with it, can become way bigger than what I am taking out now. That’s when my mindset shifted. I see power up as a way of investing in myself, very time I leave my rewards there or power up instead of cashing out, it feels like I am adding to something that will benefit me later, It is not always easy though, especially when you have needs and responsibilities staring at you. There is always that temptation to just take it out and use it immediately. But then I remind myself that growth takes time, If I keep taking out everything I earn, then I’m not really giving my account the chance to grow to its full potential, and on Hive, growth actually matters, the more you power up, the more influence you have, the more your account starts to carry weight. So for me right now, I’m more focused on building. Yes, there might still be times when I’ll need to power down again, because life happens. But it won’t be my default anymore. I’m now more intentional about letting my rewards stay and grow. Because at the end of the day it is about finding a balance, you cannot ignore the things you need in your life but at the same time you should not keep taking away from something that has the potential to become really valuable like power up does. So yeah if you ask me I will say power up is the way to go, not because cashing out is bad, but because I have seen what happens when you do not give your account the chance to grow into something big with power up. Honestly I am choosing power up and growth this time because I think that power up is important, for growth. *** --- Join Indiaunited Contest [Here](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-7af84b1d12ba8) Image Is Generate With Chat gpt. ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

links.title: Reed Hastings Is Leaving Netflix And The Stock Is Falling Despite Amazing Results
links.body:
Netflix reported first quarter results recently. Revenue came in at $12.25 billion. It beat estimates. Operating profit was up 18%. Engagement hit a record. And what did the stock do? It fell 9% right after the announcement.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPMguFEeL578rshHosuXxNkDKJLGQwFs6e821g5ERRahE/image.png)


Yes, you read that right. And as if that were not enough, Reed Hastings, the man who started it all 29 years ago, announced that he is leaving the Board of Directors.

**WHAT HAPPENED**

You might be wondering, “How does that make sense?

The company is making money and the stock still drops?”

And honestly, that reaction makes sense. It looks irrational. But Wall Street does not only care about what happened. It cares about what it expects will happen next.

And this is exactly where guidance comes into play. Netflix said that for the second quarter it expects revenue growth of 13%. That sounds good, right? But analysts were expecting more. A lot more.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjQTJUAaXTh2C394PvuraDioBvxpzhFm7RwwRsTj33kw/image.png)


Why? Because a few weeks earlier, the Warner Bros acquisition fell apart. Paramount won the battle with a $111 billion offer and paid Netflix $2.8 billion as a breakup fee. Wall Street was thinking, “Great, if the deal is off, then you will probably raise guidance or do buybacks.” It did neither. Operating margin came in at 32.3%. And full year guidance stayed at $50.7 to $51.7 billion. No change.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEfyG57PGjM3UbvKWw6WbPq2mHMVZiqR7KX58uSD1uwk/image.png)


And that was enough for the market to punish the stock. A classic beat and drop. What does that actually mean? Very simply, on Wall Street it is not enough to post strong numbers. You have to post numbers that are better than what the market was already expecting. If you do not clear that bar, you get punished, even if the results were objectively very good.

**HASTINGS STEPS AWAY**

And then came the second big headline. Reed Hastings announced that he will leave the Board in June, after 29 years.

You might say, “Wait, did he not already step down as CEO?” Yes, he did, back in 2023. But he remained Chairman. He was still the soul of the company. He was the person who took a DVD rental business and turned it into the global leader in streaming. Then came ads. Then live sports. Then video podcasts. Every time the market doubted the company, Hastings seemed to make the next move.

Analyst Rich Greenfield of LightShed made a very sharp point: investors will need time to process Hastings’ departure. Bloomberg even described him as someone who was always ahead of the curve.

But that is not the only thing worth watching. On the earnings call, co-CEO Ted Sarandos said something that did not go unnoticed: they are no longer ruling out acquisitions. That means Netflix, a company that was always seen as a builder rather than a buyer, is now opening the door to M&A. Hastings’ departure raises a major question: what is the next big move without the founder still at the table?

**WHAT ANALYSTS ARE SAYING**

And this is where things get even more interesting. Because despite the selloff, most analysts are still saying “buy.”

Morgan Stanley has an overweight rating with a $115 target. Goldman Sachs has a buy rating with a $120 target and argues that the results still support the long term thesis. Piper Sandler also rates it overweight with a $115 target. On the other hand, Wells Fargo is more cautious, with an equal weight rating and a $100 target, saying that Netflix is still a quality compounder, but no longer the share gainer it once was.

So what do they see ahead? Three new growth pillars.

First, advertising revenue. The company is targeting $3 billion this year, double last year’s level.

Second, live sports. Netflix is in talks with the NFL about expanding its relationship, while the World Baseball Classic turned into a major hit.

Third, video podcasts, a new format that helped push engagement to an all time high.

And let us not forget that Netflix now has 325 million subscribers worldwide. It is also targeting 12% to 14% revenue growth for full year 2026.

There is one more thing that matters here. In March, Netflix raised prices across all its plans. The ad supported tier went to $8.99 from $7.99, standard went to $19.99 from $17.99, and premium went to $26.99 from $24.99. This was the first price increase since January 2025. Goldman Sachs believes these increases will be one of the main drivers of profitability in the coming months.

At the same time, the company plans to spend $20 billion on content this year, up 10% from $18 billion in 2025. That explains why margin guidance was not raised. The money is going into investment, not straight into profits.

So what is the takeaway?

The company is changing. It is no longer just about movies and series. It is moving into sports, advertising, and podcasts. It is becoming a full scale media empire. The stock is currently up 4% this year, trades at 26 times earnings, and has a consensus target of $119, which implies about 12% upside from current levels.

And honestly, that is what makes it such an interesting stock to watch, even if I am not planning to buy it tomorrow.

links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdXA3fytdWeoid5hMg6oWVakr3dXceB1iRHGMQ5dV8WM/image.png)
[Source](https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/y3qjzfux/new40k-chaplain-with-jump-pack-revealed/)

... I still want one... at LEAST one! 😂😅

So there is no reason why a person should not be able to use any of the Jump Pack Chaplains that already exist... or slap a new jump pack on a Primaris Chaplain... or slap any jump pack on any Chaplain...

However, there is also something satisfying all the different models that you can for the faction(s) that you play.

I probably do not need one of these for my Space Wolves... perhaps this is a call to arms for me to start building and painting my Blood Angels!

Anyhow... let's have a quick look at what the JP Chaplain does at the moment. There is a good chance that he will get some sort of new juicy boost to sell that model!

For 75pts you get a Chaplain with a Crozius Arcanum (His stick/badge of office) and a Bolt Pistol.

Options-wise you can change the Bolt Pistol out for any of the following:

- Boltgun (meh)
- Combi-Weapon (mkay but meh)
- Grav-pistol (interesting but odd, helps if you battle lots of tanks)
- Inferno Pistol (Also Anti-tank... but better AP)
- Hand Flamer (the opposite of the grav-pistol, for fighting troops)
- Plasma Pistol (Heavy hitter, but can be risky)
- Storm Bolter (OK, reliable)
- Power Fist (Now you're talking! For close combat! But only +2S and +1AP compared to the Crozius)

What is best? It is up to you! I like the fist, the plasma pistol and the inferno pistol.

Meanwhile... he also brings great squad boosts!

**Litany of Hate**
While this model is leading a unit, all their melee attacks get +1 to Wound rolls.

This is a solid buff to take out high-toughness targets!

**Exhortation of Rage**
Each time this model's unit is selected to fight (so works when he is not leading a unit), roll a D6. On a 4-5, deal D3 Mortal Wounds to one enemy unit or on a 6, deal 3 Mortal Wounds.

So that is how he works now. We'll see if he changes or weapon options change.

Thanks for reading this post!

links.title: A huge beehive in the dark of night
links.body: How are you all? Today I have brought you some completely different and exciting pictures. On the night of January 7, 2021, my little nephew Ismail, who was about 4 years old at the time, said that bee had built a nest on a tree in the lemon garden. I immediately asked him where it was, and he showed me from a distance with a flashlight. Then I left Ismail at home and quietly went to the beehive. When I shone the flashlight in the darkness of the night, I saw thousands of bees sitting on top of each other, sitting in complete silence. Maybe they are all resting at the end of the day. It is truly amazing how bees build their homes according to the rules. I took out my phone very carefully and took the pictures with the flash from close up. The familiar yellow-black design of the bees' bodies and the shimmer of their wings were captured beautifully on the camera. From a distance, it looks like a bunch of fruit, but when you get closer, you can understand how scary and beautiful it can be. Sometimes everyone makes a sound to scare you.

/> In its cloister still stands that symbol of immortality, the cypress tree to which the illustrious poet, Gerardo Diego, dedicated one of his celebrated sonnets. However, in our desire to present this symbol of a bygone era—which, in our opinion, was neither better nor worse, merely different—from a different perspective, we prefer to omit the more spiritual aspects of the four arcades that comprise it and focus on that strange, dreamlike vision conjured up by the stonemasons of the various guilds who worked here at the dawn of the 12th century. We wonder what passionate legends might have stirred the fevered imagination of Gustavo Adolfo Bécquer had he exchanged the cloister of the Veruela Monastery for this one, situated in the frigid Castilian steppes: Santo Domingo de Silos.

/>\n\nAlthough the Cartesian heterodoxy of that celebrated godfather of the Knights Templar, Bernard of Clairvaux, saw in them the ever-present specter of absurdity, we, perhaps more inclined toward the world of speculation, go beyond the obscure motivations that transformed them into a style, \

which spread through the churches of numerous regions in its time, to see in them the precursors—also immortal, like Gerardo Diego's cypress—of a supernatural storytelling that would give rise to those chilling tales of popular terrors that have terrified entire generations and that today, when we look at the universe with geopolitical yearnings, still continue to overwhelm us.\n\n
width=\
height=\

/> The gnome satyrs of Moncayo, the lethal nymphs of the Duero and the spectral warrior-monks of Monte de las Ánimas, become here, in this archaic Castilian monastery, the terrors that have always lurked in the dark corners of the human soul, hidden but vigilant in that forbidden universe that C. G. Jung called the Collective Unconscious: Hercules possessed by the homicidal fury of the centaurs when he murdered his children and was condemned by the Gods to perform the twelve impossible labors, some of them in Spain; Jason, when he faced the terrifying harpies, the forerunners of Bram Stoker's famous vampire, in his quest for the Golden Fleece through the lands of Colchis, and the pilgrims who, from the 9th century to the present day, continually encounter them at every landmark along the Way where they pause, so as not to forget that shadow that always accompanies us and which, at times, proves extremely difficult to restrain and exorcise.

links.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXWTd78DP9G7uNYP4KodkFjZwcqG89xA4Uhnza7F4Jwsj/imagen.png)</center>

<div class=\

>



Esta es mi participación en este encuentro de @talentos y la amiga @angelica7 nos invita a escribir sobre \
. Ese ola que nos importa, que nos embate todos los días y  que todos tenemos que superar en algunos problemas a diario. Este es el [Post Encuentro de Talentos: \

](https://ecency.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-la-ola) un espacio para compartir contenido sobre un tema propuesto. Me encanta esa canción que dice que en el mar la vida es más sabrosa, seguramente debe estar relacionado con esa sensación de quitarnos los problemas al lanzarnos al mar. Muchas personas de la antigua escuela recomiendan cuando en la semana todo parece salir mal entrar al mar de espalda y lanzarse a las olas. Se supone que eso quita la pava o mala suerte. Así de importante se vuelve la ola, es todo un aprendizaje que nos da las altas y bajas, que nos enseña cuando somos pequeños a esquivar los problemas o a dejarnos revolver en ellos.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

This is my contribution to this @talentos gathering, and our friend @angelica7 invited us to write about \
That wave that matters to us, that crashes against us every day, and that we all have to overcome in some daily challenges. This is the [Talent Gathering Post: \

](https://ecency.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-la-ola), a space to share content on a proposed theme. I love that song that says life is sweeter at the beach; it must be related to that feeling of washing away our problems by throwing ourselves into the sea. Many old-school people recommend, when everything seems to be going wrong during the week, entering the sea backwards and launching yourself into the waves. It's supposed to get rid of bad luck. That's how important the wave becomes; it's a whole learning experience that gives us the highs and lows, that teaches us when we're little how to avoid problems or how to let ourselves be swept away by them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQYZBqtyPt4ipdRsiDp37eri1GTGNHWBx1o5zEgoomBe2/imagen.png)
Tener un lugar donde el vaivén de las olas se vuelve una gran terapia. Un grandioso lugar donde analizar la vida a través del movimiento de las olas. El embate de las olas se va suavizando a medida que avanzamos en nuestra vida. De verdad cuando somos pequeños las olas la vemos tan enormes y le tenemos mucho temor porque nos revuelcan y nos hacen tragar mucha agua salada. Aprendemos ya sea alejándonos de su fuerza o aferrándonos fuertemente a la orilla arenosa. Avanzamos y nos alejamos de la orilla. Aprendemos a flotar suavemente a medida que avanzamos alejándonos de la orilla. Las olas nos enseñan a mantenernos a flote y a salir adelante con los problemas de la vida.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Having a place where the ebb and flow of the waves becomes a powerful therapy. A wonderful place to analyze life through the movement of the waves. The force of the waves softens as we move through life. When we are children, the waves seem so enormous, and we are terrified of them because they toss us about and make us swallow a lot of saltwater. We learn either by moving away from their power or by clinging tightly to the sandy shore. We move forward and away from the shore. We learn to float gently as we move further away from the shore. The waves teach us to stay afloat and to overcome life's challenges.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLcb2cbV3qNV9C58mDmahVCr6Vk5CibMjkEvD63VPWWn/imagen.png)
A medida que pasa el tiempo aprendemos a mirar las olas como amigas, como ese aprendizaje necesario para que nos quede algo. Sin duda alguna siento que mis olas se han ido suavizando con el tiempo o simplemente ya no las miro con temor. Ese fuerte golpe del agua contra nuestras estructuras de vida nos hace buscar soluciones a veces inesperadas. Ya sean embates económicos, políticos, sociales y familiares la vida nos va preparando a surfear sobre las olas.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

As time goes by, we learn to see the waves as friends, as necessary lessons that leave us with something valuable. Without a doubt, I feel that my own waves have softened with time, or perhaps I simply no longer look at them with fear. That powerful crash of water against our life structures forces us to seek solutions, sometimes unexpected ones. Whether economic, political, social, or familial challenges, life prepares us to ride the waves.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWV5mBCDumoAP8piZxEmSwYwD83ymCqJttCUC5FShFskG/imagen.png)
Una vida sin olas se volvería un poco aburrida, es como los juegos en la computadora te cansas si siempre ganas. Así que la vida necesita esos cambios, esos embates para ponernos a pensar, a mirar la vida de otra forma. ¿Qué puedo utilizar como tabla para ayudarme a sobrevivir a los embates de las olas? La verdad es que puede ser variado desde películas que nos hacen reír, desde hobbies, a veces una simple taza de café puede ser mi mejor tabla para esos embates de las olas que nos da la vida.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

A life without waves would become a bit boring, like computer games—you get tired of them if you always win. So life needs those changes, those jolts to make us think, to see life differently. What can I use as a board to help me survive the onslaught of the waves? The truth is, it can be anything from movies that make us laugh, to hobbies; sometimes a simple cup of coffee can be my best board for those waves that life throws at us.

links.title: Growth Taking Place - Keep Stacking The HIVE
links.body: \n

/> Last week I mentioned in a post I was gaining back lost ground after the hard fork with regard to the HIVE vote values. I took another look last night and it is kind of crazy to see how much the vote value has risen since. I was more than chuffed that I had equaled the vote value prior to the last HIVE hard fork which was 9.54 HIVE per 100% vote.

/> I have done some power ups since then and would not say this was going to be changing things so drastically, but the HIVE vote value is now well above 10 HIVE. Currently at 10.37 per 100% vote and has been as high as 10.50 which is mind blowing.

/></center>

The HIVE vote value is how I judge my growth as this is what directly impacts your growth with regard to curation rewards. The last 6 days in real terms has offered me an extra .96 HIVE vote value which is offering those who I curate an extra 4.8 HIVE daily and the other 4.8 HIVE is directly going to the curation rewards so roughly an extra 144 HIVE being earned monthly.

This type of growth I never really see or expect to see as this I feel is not the normal and takes far longer to unlock these types of vote levels. Maybe it will drop down and level out again, but again who knows how this really works and why expecting nothing is far better than waiting for it to happen.

Stake is that important to our growth on HIVE or any other staking crypto protocol because this is what offers you the ability to earn more through rewards. HIVE is very different to all other crypto as it offers you the ability to earn in many ways besides just staking.

I know each and everyone of us is looking to grow and this is just sharing what is happening on my account which will hopefully inspire others to carry on growing and staking. This is so much fun when you see things like this happen as it justifies all the hours and work you have put in to growing your account. The ability to support and be able to reward others with a higher vote value whilst growing your own account is what this is all about as we need each other in order to grow.

This is why it is important to try and forget the price and focus on what you are doing as the more active you are the quicker one should grow. This does not happen overnight and why having lower expectations does help maintain the enthusiasm. This is over 8 years of work and dedication that has taken place to get to these points and kind of justifies that effort. I honestly had hoped one day to see a 10 HIVE vote value and possibly only next year so this is not something you plan for as it just happens when it happens. Who knows next week the vote value could be back under 10 or over 11 and I am just going with the flow these days with low expectations.

links.title: Phone Photography Contest - #109 |  Street mural from Cumaná
links.body:
These days, one of the main attractions are the murals on the streets, whether created by artists or not; sometimes they’re spontaneous and individual, other times part of a campaign, but they’re always fascinating. This is the case with the three photos I’m sharing today of an attractive mural on Santa Inés Street in Cumaná. Unfortunately, either the artist didn’t sign it or my eye can’t make it out. But one can appreciate a clear pictorial quality in it, in addition to the concept that seems to inspire it, which is to honor a popular figure from Cumaná, linked to cultural elements so characteristic of this area, such as fishing and the consumption of fish and the joy of flowers.
![Foto 2 murales.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23tbRhoT38oKmgCj2MAifKyp6TSRyS2yCAKfHsefjnVuybdoduADjDvRv7UEGbUULBxKw.jpg)

If you're interested in participating, you can visit this [link](https://peakd.com/hive-190931/@untilwelearn/phone-photography-contest-109).

[Versión en español]

En nuestros tiempos, una de las atracciones la constituyen los murales, sean hechos por artistas o no, en las calles; a veces son libres e individuales, otras veces como parte de una campaña, pero siempre de gran interés. Es el caso de las tres fotos que comparto hoy de un atractivo mural hecho en la calle Santa Inés, de Cumaná. Lamentablemente, o su autor no lo firmó, o mi ojo no lo ve. Pero en él puede apreciarse una clara calidad pictórica, además del concepto que parece motivarlo, que es honrar a un personaje popular cumanés, vinculado a elementos culturales tan característicos de esta zona, como lo son la pesca y su consumo, y la alegría de las flores.

links.body:
<center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfD78AXAw8bxmvQgTjtonJkdMUxT8FzvoFgcRgcuNNp3y/incontri.jpg)







![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdshhD7Pb36HTrMADBUHoBQKq9R13N17TwQ4QFfLhJsi/bannereng.jpg)

# Dating in the age of social media

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgcwXScMQp2haeW4zPPZW3jVE3NBMHD3ME9ZyyWdYNx1/benbanner.png)

Hello dear Hive reader friends,
It's been a long time since you read me, due to work and a few private commitments.
In recent months I have been working a lot and dedicating myself a lot to myself and meeting new people.

I've finally started doing some trekking and I'm trying to meet someone who can make my heart beat again.

I then signed up to some dating apps (which I won't name) and to my enormous amazement I discovered that the so-called \

are not only in the male category as some would have us believe.

I will therefore tell you some of my stories not in chronological order.

---

A few months ago I matched with a girl we'll call M.
We write to each other, we joke, she seems very busy... so much so that she even did small \

Example:

G: \
\nM: \

Things that are said in the first approaches when you start to feel something with that person.

After a few weeks of exchanging messages, hearts and kisses begin to flow into the conversations, the messages become very frequent and one day we decide to see each other.

Walk along the seafront and aperitif.

The evening goes very well, so much so that after the aperitif we decide to move on to dinner and eat a pizza.
Once the pizza is finished, we sit in the car to talk for a while and the kiss starts.

We each go back to our own homes and the endless wave of messages accompanied by kisses and hearts continues.
The next day I recorded until the evening in which he told me some of his fears of the moment he was going through... but I thought it was a small outburst.

\

The next day she was working late and I had dinner with some friends, so we didn't text much.
Returning from dinner, in the car I happen to hear a song by Ultimo and I write her a piece of the song's lyrics, referring back to the conversation from the previous evening

\

The next morning, like a bolt from the blue, she sent me a message telling me that it was too much for her and that we seemed to be engaged.

From that moment on, the cold: the hearts disappear, the kisses disappear, the laughter disappears.

Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde

---

Unfortunately I can't relate halfway.
If a person interests me, it's my first thought and I don't know how to filter it.
I'll show you and tell you.
The moment I don't see interest in the other, my interest also wanes.

From the series \
--- Let's see when I will be able to update you on the next appointment ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmag2SzephgymyL2VfbMycV7rM5u1nYuPqV4nxE6qVcWvo/banner.png) Check this NFT Project on Hive [
alt=\

>](https://nftshowroom.com/nftfrappe/gallery)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSFv8kSe16PTwiL2g6oBVLQPvWDWtmvhnqgmSgpc1CJ4V/img_0.1560484347680768.jpg)

# Incontri ai tempi dei social

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgcwXScMQp2haeW4zPPZW3jVE3NBMHD3ME9ZyyWdYNx1/benbanner.png)

Salve cari amici lettori di Hive,
è da molto tempo che non mi leggete, causa lavoro e un po' di impegni privati.
In questi mesi sto lavorando molto e mi sto dedicando molto a me stesso e a conoscere gente nuova.

Ho finalmente iniziato a fare qualche trekking e sto cercando di conoscere una persona che possa farmi battere di nuovo il cuore.

Mi sono iscritto quindi ad alcune app di dating (di cui non farò il nome) e con mio enorme stupore ho scoperto che i cosiddetti \

non sono solamente nella categoria maschile come qualcuno vuole farci credere.

Vi racconterò quindi alcune mie vicende non in ordine cronologico.

---

Qualche mese fa faccio match con una ragazza che chiameremo M.
Ci scriviamo, scherziamo, lei sembra molto presa...tant'è che faceva anche piccoli \

Esempio:

G: \
\nM: \

Cose che si dicono nei primi approcci quando inizi a provare qualcosa con quella persona.

Dopo qualche settimana di scambio messaggi cominciano a fioccare cuori e baci nelle conversazioni, i messaggi si fanno sempre molto frequenti e un giorno decidiamo di vederci.

Passeggiata sul lungomare e aperitivo.

La serata va molto bene, tant'è che dopo l'aperitivo decidiamo di spostarci a cena a mangiare una pizza.
Finita la pizza ci mettiamo un po' in macchina a parlare e scatta il bacio.

Ce ne torniamo ognuno a casa propria e continua l'interminabile onda di messaggi corredati da baci e cuori.
L'indomani stesso registro fino alla sera in cui mi espone alcune sue paure del momento che stava passando...ma io pensavo fosse un piccolo sfogo.

\

Il giorno successivo lei lavorava fino a tardi e io avevo una cena con degli amici, quindi non abbiamo scambiato molti messaggi.
Di ritorno dalla cena, in macchina mi capita di sentire una canzone di Ultimo e le scrivo un pezzo di testo della canzone, riallacciandomi al discorso della sera precedente

\

La mattina successiva come un fulmine a ciel sereno mi manda un messaggio in cui mi diceva che per lei era troppo e che sembravamo fidanzati.

Da quel momento il gelo: scompaiono i cuori, scompaiono i baci, scompaiono le risate.

Dr Jekyll e Mr Hyde

---

Purtroppo non so relazionarmi a metà.
Se una persona mi interessa, è il mio primo pensiero e non so filtrarmi.
Te lo dimostro e te lo dico.
Nel momento in cui non vedo interesse nell'altra, scema anche il mio di interesse.

Della serie \

links.title: Journey on Hive
links.body:
_++**Assalam-o-Alaikum**++__!                                                                                                         My name is __++**Aneeza**++__, and I am from__** **__++**Pakistan**++__.                                                               I recently completed my matric exams, and it honestly feels like one chapter of my life has come to an end. Right now, I have almost two weeks of free time, and this space has given me the chance to reflect and think seriously about my passions.                                                                                                                                 Because of certain environmental and technical situations at my home, my interest gradually shifted toward Hive. Even during my school days, I used to talk about it a lot with my friends.                                                                                               I would share my ideas with excitement, but most of the time, they didn't really find my content interesting_

_Sometimes, their words would hit me deeply...... To be honest, they did demotivate me a little.                                                                                                          I told myself something important... that not everyone will think the same way, and not everyone needs to understand you. If you truly feel connected to something, you shouldn't let it go just because others don't see its value.                                                                                                                                                   That's why I didn't let their opinions take over me, and my connection with Hive stayed just as strong.                                                                                                   Maybe my journey won't be perfect..... maybe I'll make mistakes along the way. I will find the people here who understand me... and if I ever start doubting myself, maybe this platform will remind me why I started in the first place.                                                                                                                         Now that my schooling is complete, like I have been given a great opportunity to take my passion forward.                                                                                                Since I already had some knowledge about this platform, I didn't waste my time and decided to start my journey here.                                                                         My plan now is to continue my first\_year studies while also building a strong presence on Hive. I want to share my life, my thoughts, and my experiences here.                                                                                                                                         Maybe, my journey won't be perfect... I will make mistakes along the way...  But I would not stop. It is not just about earning, it is a place where I can truly express myself.                                                                                                                                __++**THANK YOU**++__** **__                                                                                                                           for reading my introduction. This is not just a post... but it is a small piece of my hope._

 > ​

links.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: ANGÈLICA PECADO (2000).
links.body:
***Hola mi gente bella espero que todos esten super bien, un gran abrazo para todos, amigos hoy la ediciòn es sobre una de las novelas mas increibles que han realizado en Venezuela, una novela que puso a toda la familia a estar pegada de las tv en el horario de las 9 de la noche, creo toda una euforia en la epoca, y para mi es totalente una genialidad, una novela que marca el comienzo de una trilogia del escritor que escribio esta obra.***

---

![194..jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23wCNP5qttATigX8gYVHxMvzzDG5KiwtA9SDekXw5dTgVkBhnyq6hypyfCNRT8nm2M757.jpg)

<center>***Portada realizada por mi.***</center>

---

<center>***INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***Angélica pecado es una telenovela venezolana producida por RCTV y estrenada a finales del año 2000. Escrita por el maestro del misterio Martin Hahn, esta obra inauguró un estilo único en la televisión venezolana: el \

o slasher televisivo. La trama mantuvo a todo el país en vilo intentando descubrir la identidad de un asesino en serie, convirtiéndose en un fenómeno de audiencia.***

---

<center>![httpsi.ytimg.comvi4jNYqzPDN9wsddefault.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/EpnEJU2fZUYRF7XqwJF1mFXpH3i1HPQTknVjZJP4ScTcjUAfJAFFVmxj4gJbyuF45DH.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpsi.ytimg.comvi4jNYqzPDN9wsddefault.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***-Titulo Original: Angèlica Pecado.
-Productora: Radio Caracas Televisión (RCTV).
​-Año: 2000 – 2001 (150 episodios).
​-Guion: Martin Hahn.
​-Dirección: José Alcalde y Mauro Burguillos.
​-Protagonistas: Daniela Alvarado y Simón Pestana.
​-Antagonista Principal: Hilda Abrahamz (como Rebeca del Valle).
​-Elenco Estelar: Eileen Abad, Jaime Araque, Alba Roversi, Margarita Hernández, Hilda Blanco y Javier Vidal.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por Alejandro Montaner.***

---

<center>![httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BZmYwMzg5MTktZjgyMS00OTQyLWE5MDUtYTE0NjY2NzU1MzlkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/Eokbj8Eqf4JoJq1f3NT75YDGxRg7unLAc1U66Q4KCkFphCGqfJFMsUJwtVKsG6erEaK.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BZmYwMzg5MTktZjgyMS00OTQyLWE5MDUtYTE0NjY2NzU1MzlkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***​La historia se desarrolla en torno a la familia Del Valle, dueños de una inmensa fortuna y de los prestigiosos viñedos \

. Angélica Rodríguez (Daniela Alvarado) es una joven humilde y bondadosa que trabaja en la hacienda y se enamora de Marcelo Córdoba (Simón Pestana), el heredero de la familia.***\n\n***​Sin embargo, la ambición por el control del viñedo y la herencia desatan una ola de crímenes atroces cometidos por una figura misteriosa vestida de negro: \

. Angélica se ve envuelta en una red de intrigas, pecados ocultos y muertes, mientras intenta proteger su amor por Marcelo y descubrir quién está eliminando uno a uno a los miembros de la familia y sus allegados.***

---

<center>![httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BNDNmZGM1ZjctMzIyNS00ZjQ4LTk4MzgtMGJlYzk5Yjk4OTBlXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23x1AzfcGoV32GjRoQ1REkx3cMXBjmHoSBdLhVnNTchfkfYDimRqieWS93VrBi9VCucCm.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BNDNmZGM1ZjctMzIyNS00ZjQ4LTk4MzgtMGJlYzk5Yjk4OTBlXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA.***</center>
-

***Angélica pecado fue la primera de la famosa \

de Martin Hahn en RCTV (seguida por La mujer de Judas y Estrambótica Anastasia). La novela rompió récords de sintonía, especialmente en sus capítulos finales, debido al ingenio del guion para presentar a múltiples sospechosos, haciendo que cada personaje tuviera un motivo para ser el asesino.***

***​La crítica elogió la interpretación de Daniela Alvarado, quien a pesar de su juventud demostró una madurez actoral impresionante al enfrentar situaciones de terror y drama. La química con Simón Pestana fue muy sólida, pero fue el personaje de Rebeca del Valle (Hilda Abrahamz) el que se robó gran parte del show por su complejidad y elegancia malvada. La atmósfera de la novela, con sus viñedos oscuros y callejones coloniales, fue fundamental para el éxito de la narrativa.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202012Angelica-pecado-900x900-1.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AJpisGDtDsLEC2hdn5an8nF8gbJfqegUPtuFZnSiy6d7xvt8mf5oCGXLE6PXwg4.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202012Angelica-pecado-900x900-1.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Angélica pecado es recordada como la novela que cambió la forma de hacer televisión en Venezuela a principios del milenio. No solo ofreció una gran historia de amor, sino que retó el intelecto del espectador con un rompecabezas policial fascinante. Su legado reside en haber creado el género del \

, dejando para la historia de la TV venezolana a uno de los asesinos más enigmáticos y recordados: El Cuervo.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202012Angelica-pecado-900x900-0-768x768.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AK9NJi8vTrQcrYCzJFkEsA37cVw3TWRPZA1QXChu3CaFFw2PT6tg9PtMJqMPZyR.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202012Angelica-pecado-900x900-0-768x768.jpg)</center>

---

***Esta es una de las mejores novelas que se han realizado en el pais, es una joya cultural y cinematografica.***

---

links.title: Bucharest with a taste of Papanash... #TheLongestTrip
links.body:
![IMG_20260409_230451_702.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQp37b62BJJtME1DETctPzvrsL9Yawyw2kVR7PLtcTnW6/IMG_20260409_230451_702.jpg)

***I remembered this dessert when I visited the small Romanian town of Sighisoara a year and a half ago... The taste of the famous Romanian dessert haunted me in my dreams 🤪***

![IMG_20260407_233511.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXuPTbMQjFbc2rwoBgFknsxojvxg1D4RLTqUUYWa8rFLP/IMG_20260407_233511.jpg)

So, today in this post I will begin the story of the unforgettable impressions of my three-day visit to Bucharest, the capital of Romania... Which my daughters @bugavi and @darine.darine and I started on Valentine's Day
It's been a few months since we experienced this incredible moment of flying above the clouds and landing in a country whose language we don't speak. Knowing in advance that we would arrive very early and that checking into an Airbnb apartment would not be convenient, we booked one night in a hotel. It was really expensive at $160 for one night, with breakfast and a pool. We had a not-so-pleasant experience with a taxi driver who didn't understand English at all and kept explaining to us the whole way that we should pay him more money... for no reason. Luckily we had 5 euros in cash and gave it to him because he really looked angry 😱

![IMG_20260407_233405_669.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4sRHWZit2wyPk15bHRUsKvtYy6pbFzNEdAC1i33s9mJ/IMG_20260407_233405_669.jpg)

![IMG_20260407_233342_833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXXDZMX7UrUXWjd3yF56h4QtvSCUwWo9sXV1SscHBY2Ms/IMG_20260407_233342_833.jpg)

It was practically the only hotel closest to the airport. It was of good quality, but then we sadly discovered that the restaurant was closed on weekends. So we went to a restaurant, which turned out to be Serbian, on the recommendation of the receptionist. In this way, we had the opportunity to experience two countries at once: Romania and Serbia.
There was a wonderful festive atmosphere for Valentine's Day, I loved the blazing fireplace and the wooden design, and a bright element of decor - serbian national shoes !

https://youtube.com/shorts/Crwl0zezQe8?si=Gu03A3i32ePQPO4W

![IMG_20260407_233345_480.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdHoJqkov7CBSSZ4MfR2kF9ho2ChrRqaRWLPGPaqojD7e/IMG_20260407_233345_480.jpg)

![IMG_20260407_234540.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzbqnFqEG1gZYtgY3jgB8PJiZJTi1vucycWRYV8qU8ag/IMG_20260407_234540.jpg)

The next day we moved to another Airbnb apartment, closer to the center, which cost $80 per day. We traveled by Uber taxi. It is great luck that this service is available there and quite budget-friendly. For example, moving from the apartment to the city center by taxi cost about $5 for the three of us. This saved us a lot of time, and we managed to see a lot during 2 days in Bucharest, in this large ancient and modern city at the same time.

![IMG_20260407_234612.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRaGrsaW63U3caaeTeHLYrxmLSpo9zfmtTPRDFLForR14/IMG_20260407_234612.jpg)

![IMG_20260407_234445.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRWbwLAevU1d5m4K7rDVxD2LaTWH8iEySRdpqQ7Qz55FC/IMG_20260407_234445.jpg)

![IMG_20260407_234428.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTuZLJj7ep62qLwhsmjyeVwtPV7K9dUmw2UNintfn2CZf/IMG_20260407_234428.jpg)

We walked through the narrow streets of old Bucharest, and the rain slowly wrapped everything around us. The stone facades of the buildings breathed history... The rain only enhanced the beauty of the old architecture. The stone grew darker, the ornaments deeper, and the atmosphere even more enchanting. I walked and felt as if I wasn’t just touching a city, but someone’s memories...

![IMG_20260407_234836.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfDxXnX9oem7qBniKVtwsqTLbXfBjPLzZrYgvFWKKwmmF/IMG_20260407_234836.jpg)

![IMG_20260407_233419_412.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaPDBndSah5Ja7h8URmaLbymgKAkafTZ6Drm9VFHKPa8/IMG_20260407_233419_412.jpg)

I'm trying to understand the similarities and differences between this city and all the others I've seen in Europe. There are many similar architectural elements to Kosice, Budapest, Krakow, and I also felt a great similarity to my hometown Lviv. The shape of the roofs, the balconies, the carved bizarre faces on the walls, the street lamps... I walked through these narrow streets as if I were really walking through my hometown and memories flooded my soul.

![IMG_20260407_233427_583.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS8yxu9taEr1FPsBHh9BNb2rJrnKAAfybJDqQNvwEnnEu/IMG_20260407_233427_583.jpg)

![IMG_20260407_233433_801.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfSoFNzBkyBWFvtUHM3Fqe48q6SLzHBMCu5MAVZfVkUUE/IMG_20260407_233433_801.jpg)




![IMG_20260407_235136.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZpUJjxchuZV1AphFUGGNqvLonsGD2LYsPyie2oGcwr3J/IMG_20260407_235136.jpg)

But there was something that showed that we were in a new, unknown city - these were the signs on the doors of cafes and shops. We always have fun when we read strange words, the meaning of which we do not understand, but which have a funny meaning in our native language. And then we often remember these memories and laugh. Here, for example, the inscription \

🤣🤪

![IMG_20260408_205643_664.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1GqLapEaDzhRRQ92Wyjk9PwaifBhV99n9sa4JJMzzAy/IMG_20260408_205643_664.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_205636_931.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRLdZgEz84UDPBGhMTDoTMkKSXRTMwwwJ25GoNhPrD2So/IMG_20260408_205636_931.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_214912.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNPom7AZdnKfq2HAys6hnR64UQQMi3p21NRDvuZNXs8g8/IMG_20260408_214912.jpg)

Looking at every element of architectural design and various advertising items and signs, we suddenly noticed with surprise our Lviv cafe on the streets of the capital of Romania, Bucharest: \

😊
This cafe, located on Rynok Square in Lviv, always attracts a lot of attention from tourists visiting our hometown. And although we have never tasted this liqueur, we felt like we had met someone close to us when we saw the familiar pattern of red cherries with green leaves :)

![IMG_20260408_215049.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb5vk2yvqMobJefebiEkSQau3QgbNYPSfncZoVtfgSs5j/IMG_20260408_215049.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_205913.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmatiAi3gwrUMcNxVgBNya5C2FwsVMQcH5weaZ2sZKZRxS/IMG_20260408_205913.jpg)

The rain kept falling, and the ladies under bright umbrellas were a beautiful decoration on the gray wet cobblestones. But the cold weather took its toll, and our hands were frozen. And we were also very hungry, so we looked very carefully at the cafes to choose a cozy place to hide from the rain and cold. We wanted to find a restaurant with Romanian traditional cuisine, and of course, there would be a dessert called Papanash!
We chose [the tavern \

](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3RoLn5DyNF96DPkY8?g_st=atm) and went inside. And immediately we were immersed in the exclusive atmosphere of ancient Romania, and fell in love with this place!

![IMG_20260408_205829.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeoviUnoVp5igvsWBKEkXYg4LTddzivUoBBdF9L7JjKdZ/IMG_20260408_205829.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_214938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUNWdnF3wXQyHPLSwMDf6TgMZDXnqz7SPHu6G2A1ERSnB/IMG_20260408_214938.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_205436_853.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRRdUGVtDxDQb9CSAU82FRGeEwxHn1XRmvSMVguW1LbSy/IMG_20260408_205436_853.jpg)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 44.43109 lat 26.10118 long  d3scr)

![IMG_20260408_205754_412.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf77VrtztHbRE9oqcLJ7WJCTq3zWTZeMaVVoPAWBiwxe2/IMG_20260408_205754_412.jpg)

Thick walls of red brick divided this room into separate halls, and smoothly turned into arches, which were also lined with red brick on the ceiling. Embroidered towels and national ceramic plates with various patterns were on the walls. In the middle stood a very beautiful conical fireplace, decorated with wood, dishes, and wrought iron products. Around were old chests, tables, benches covered with national bedspreads... 

![IMG_20260409_223500.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfL5yJ2ZGd1MRMZ7fvDZA8zDuMiEb9c7gGcDCDNC8eNv/IMG_20260409_223500.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_205712_688.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcummZsc245JDsGHcsw97qGharsvy46XNC5RhnTUQuAXA/IMG_20260408_205712_688.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_205717_170.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmpvUiMch3eKdBRGnYBurKZ9JJrww7n2Zi4RhjmqD5fc/IMG_20260408_205717_170.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_205433_106.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaU5xzcG7nXeYh8V6oEckGK1w3KpbQQnRBLtXA94Tyksc/IMG_20260408_205433_106.jpg)

Jars of pickled vegetables stood on the windowsill, which created a cozy homely atmosphere. And a special exotic was added by the chairs with the tavern's coat of arms. We chose a table and found our dream dessert on the menu! Imagine our anticipation - like a meeting with a favorite place where you have been for a long time, and again you were in anticipation of pleasure 😊

![IMG_20260408_205803_916.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPXKrCu44Ets22Erw3UnQHkLrEorTCkNG22QcrQ2Bdf9/IMG_20260408_205803_916.jpg)

![IMG_20260408_215358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPpzawPmjUXSLfFMdfaDExpntLMyGP3Y3gSerdDeFSsV8/IMG_20260408_215358.jpg)

Just look at this masterpiece! Two big hot cheese donuts, topped with cream and jam. It looks so beautiful that just looking at it makes your mouth water!

https://youtube.com/shorts/czYla7ezG_k?si=9dZ7L1lfH7_2dYaO

![IMG_20260408_215236.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTzRHc1kRJbARCXeKQjWfFLNTk6p7tnVCw8Nrs37q6HUg/IMG_20260408_215236.jpg)

And in this video you can see our emotional state after dessert 😄🤪

https://youtube.com/shorts/uFdwdo8suPI?si=9HRR-vemcH05tyLN

![IMG_20260408_220758.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ8uj2C4rBZp4xbnR9jVkqAQzcuEX1mJ9LhyR4jhZYSyt/IMG_20260408_220758.jpg)

links.title: The Silver Bloggers Chronicles #42: The place where I was very happy 😊
links.body: ></center><h1 style=\
data-align=\
>The place where I was very happy

> The streets where I spent my childhood are no longer the same. There are no longer children playing on the sidewalks or in the streets, nor adults standing on the corners watching us, talking among themselves about politics and the economy—even though they weren’t economists—or gossiping about people, even if it was all just rumors. The front porches are empty: people stay inside, sheltered, protected. The streets are dangerous. Chilongo’s store—that fat man who used to give us candy—no longer exists. Chilongo isn’t around either; he had a heart attack while swimming in the river. That store near my house sold everything, from a needle to kerosene by the liter. We kids who ran errands knew that if we asked Chilongo for a little something extra, he’d pull candies out of a big jar on the counter. I liked the candies that were shaped like rings because after I finished eating the candy, I’d be left with a ring as a gift. Sometimes I’d fill my fingers with my plastic trinkets.
alt=\

/> The house of “Old Mamía,” the one that used to be full of beautiful rosebushes—which she made sure we didn't break while we played—no longer has a garden. The new owners turned it into a workshop, and now there are only car wrecks. That house, once full of all kinds of plants and guarded by that old woman whom no one liked—because we said she was a witch who ate children—is now filled with junk, and the ground is black from all the oil and gasoline they pour in and out. The street corners—the ones we used to gather at to talk, to play in the afternoons, where someone once asked me to be his girlfriend—are full of rubble and trash. People started taking useless things out of their homes, and they were left in those forgotten areas. So now on the street corners there’s a tree stump, a piece of an old washing machine, a black bag, or a bunch of dogs and cats rummaging through the trash.
alt=\

> The field where we used to play ball or fly kites, where we’d fall and scrape our knees, where we’d sit on the concrete benches at night talking about ghosts and the dead, where time stood still—they’ve taken it over. Crowds of people have made that place their refuge. Now, rather than an open field, there are little houses made of cardboard, wood, and zinc sheets, stacked one on top of the other. The children—those of us who used to go out to play or run along the sidewalks or streets, who would shout as we left the nearby school—grew up and left: they left the neighborhood, the country, or died. Now, that street from my childhood is full of old people and abandoned houses—or perhaps old houses and abandoned people. At Christmas, the time of year I enjoyed most as a child, now few people put up a tree or turn on the colored lights, and few children wait for Santa. In short, that place from my childhood, where I was happy, no longer exists.
></center><h3 style=\
data-align=\
>The main image was created in Canva, and the others are from Pixabay. The text was translated using Deepl.
></center>\n\n<h2 style=\
data-align=\
>Thank you for your support, for reading, and for your comments. Until next time, my friend.
></center>

links.title: Finding Purpose in the Journey
links.body: \n<div class=\

> Life for most of us is a mixture of good and bad days but on the brighter side, most of us choose to keep going. It’s not that we just woke up and decided to keep going, there’s always that thing propelling us forward. I remember when I was way younger and didn’t have much responsibilities. Life was like a life of cake for me cos all I did was wake up, eat, go to school, play and come back home. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqvsK6fMCbA5tcugAK6LUXHU8U76kFL2wvuihXzFnQHL/img_0213.jpg) Now that I’m much older, I sometimes dread some days because life does get to at times. But if there’s one thing that has always inspired me to keep going, it’s the fact that things do get better and with every step, I get to impact someone’s life in a way. You see, there was a point in time I didn’t know what I was doing with my life. It took me years to actually figure out what my calling was and when I found it, I knew that was what I was meant for. Change and impact is something I stand for and I always preach it. Life shouldn’t always be about oneself. The world is full of people, people who need help and honestly, help can come from anyone. I don’t have much but the little I have, in addition to my skills and experiences allow me change lives in my own little way. I’ve had people- strangers even show up for me in way I never imagined and honestly it’s the best feeling you can ever experience when you thought all hope was lost. The only thing that keeps me pushing every single day is my belief that if I can impact someone’s life today, imagine the number of lives I can impact tomorrow and in the coming future. This is what I live for- Change. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

links.title: Shadows of Illumination Chapter Thirteen: The Esalen Institute - How to Build a One World (Counter) Cultural Disorder
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23u69KSjeCWb9GYPAZv3b1sPxghFMTaB8rmyc9w6FjhQCW3CKoSYNLM4zJHfT4ZHjBwTB.png)
[Source](https://www.trippingly.net/lsd-studies/2018/6/15/lsd-blotter-museum-the-institute-of-illegal-images-san-francisco-ca)

Esalen

At the outer ripples of the global transformation project, we find the Esalen Institute. Once again, I am not stating that the institute doesn't comprise genuine people and a liberal sprinkling of naive benevolence. That said, the deeper we dive beneath the surface of its superficial public image, the further we untangle the wiring of its formation and funding, the more we can observe that Esalen is a one-world cultural think tank, the eccentric socially acceptable face of transformative globalism and social engineering. From this perspective it has been highly successful.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23tSxMXDDrgnb9saLpSNVxoERimpau4NG2CvrvNpnBSoRa2vt4kfXwhwod7M5r3DykeKt.png)
[Source]( https://www.esalen.org/ctr-main)
https://media.giphy.com/media/awGYEZoCjwnfi/giphy.gif
Whilst there will be individuals that serve as strands that connect the institute to the centralised body of the spiderweb, many of the people connected to Esalen are more idealistic than nefarious. Still, whilst retaining the veneer of free expression, the institute is heavily infiltrated, steered, and closely monitored. Certainly, there is a lot more occurring here than meets the eye. Any methodologies, processes, narratives, and perspectives that can influence the direction and cultivation of one world transformation are absorbed into the behemothic structure of the communitarian reality overlay.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23tmBhXubU8AWN9vERYwHt9mVGTXGwzq4HFyWV4f7unMokk9YkVHcTyRmdUZdShCrL15K.png)
[Esalen’s Center for Theory & Research (CTR)](https://www.esalen.org/ctr-main)
Ultimately, the pseudo-inclusive counter-cultural ideology of Esalen is akin to a facet of an agenda that seeks to transform society, infiltrating and controlling all contradictions, narratives, and perspectives. Slowly but surely, assimilating them into a technologically enabled system of broadly contrived self-definitions, inconsequential choices and superficial decisions that lead to the same destination. A social administration nexus that (on a multiplicity of levels) utilises the compartmentalised resource of perception to manage emotion and expectation.
The voluntary surrender of independent thinking and the socially manipulative use of feedback loops (echo chambers) and positive/negative social signals were first explored within the (Man-Machine Project) cybernetics group/Macy Conferences. The formative forays into a communitarian governance system that now offers something for everyone, awakening/utopia, or technocratic/dystopia - all now exist at the touch of a button. Unfortunately, behind the veil of the reality overlay, they are two sides of the same equation.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23yTjBdqEGTEDUnhzAcXKyjyuNNxQZuz1cUahJuv3buJn7UKFD4TFdzfHHoKCHzrsaRXH.png)
[Source](https://www.startpage.com/av/proxy-image?piurl=https%3A%2F%2Fs.hdnux.com%2Fphotos%2F22%2F76%2F23%2F4973773%2F5%2F1200x0.jpg&sp=1627898091T18152d5d22d5bdae53e7bd5a8bd5ba798ff461755eb16cdb523dd51f0927c7a2)

Esalen And Aldous Huxley

In 1962 The Esalen Institute was founded by Stanford graduates Michael Murphy (whom as noted in the previous chapter, was a [member](https://www.sourcewatch.org/index.php/Lindisfarne_Association) of the Rockefeller Bros funded Lindisfarne Assoc) and Dick Price. With a focus on “humanistic alternative education,” the formation of the Institute was heavily [inspired]( https://www.esalen.org/post/new-huxley-opens-its-doors-to-perception) by the work of (“Esalen ally”) Aldous Huxley.
His wife, the aforementioned Psychosynthesis Trust connected Laura Huxley, would become a long-term Esalen [mentor](https://www.esalen.org/post/a-new-bridge-a-new-path-a-new-beginning).
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23tSx4CAaCJNzu1MXBh6JAdjngzf2ag6zLGRbWZzMy7fDYdNj6zyDwzk6gddypBPg5ry1.png)
[Source]( https://longreads.com/2015/06/09/aldous-huxleys-influence-on-the-esalen-institute/)
Such was Huxley’s pervasive influence, founder Dick Price integrated his “human potentialities” lecture into a key foundational philosophy of the Institute. Indeed, the first Esalen brochures [contained]( https://longreads.com/2015/06/09/aldous-huxleys-influence-on-the-esalen-institute/) the Huxley-inspired title of “The Human Potentiality”, a seed which eventually took root within the Institute's “Human Potential Movement”. The paradox being, the direction of human potential is simultaneously defined by an ideology that is mentoring it toward a syncretised destination whose ambition is far older than Esalen.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23uFsHY54nVQAvYCqBi7s3hzppL4GjnSS8zxGwMsS1LgTKzvGyeEnNbKuoazoZkA5EmCH.png)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5gCD9OUefjk
In truth, the syncretism of everything has come to mean nothing.
Esalen’s founding principles were focused upon Huxley’s desire to homogenise Eastern and Western culture. A statement that is very much in keeping with the Kabbalistic philosophy that guides the direction of the One World ideology. In unison with my previous observations on the Psychosynthesis Trust, Esalen’s Human Potential Movement pursued the union of Western psychology and Eastern religion/philosophy. The merger of the Western and Eastern psychology speaks to the premeditated manipulation of psychology. Away from the objective and toward the subjective overtures that were apparent within the Kabballah-infused Romanticism that [gave](https://hex.ooo/library/huxley_hesse_cybernetic.html) Huxley inspiration. As I highlighted in a previous article:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23tSx4CAaVJtXfBY1Q4Vb7sNKwpJahHnomda8jN1xqCTGPW21tju1jmWNJ5YXtEtE4snJ.png)
Perceptualflaws
https://media.giphy.com/media/bmy7pTQM9gmti/giphy.gif
Concurrently, through Esalen’s “Center For Theory And Research,” they’re working towards what they term the “[Abrahamic Family Re-union]( https://assets-global.website-files.com/5fc322a34a77e56b48025465/5ff80ed93d1dd8148fce6080_08Abrahamic-Family-Reunion-March2012.pdf)”.
Of course, anyone who has read my previous posts will be able to juxtapose these principles against (UNESCO founder, Eugenics Society [president](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_Huxley), and Planned Parenthood World Population award [recipient](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_Huxley)) Julian Huxley’s officially guided vision of a single world culture. From this perspective, institutions like Esalen serve to galvanise the social manifestation of this overarching (albeit compartmentalised) objective.
![Esalen23.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23viEGSukn8K6WKBJ6CwshWP4PyTztKoGbMTmBJ3JUnrUZsdREfngVRKjUSq4cSkeLJEe.PNG)
[UNESCO: It's purpose and philosophy by Julian Huxley](https://ia801704.us.archive.org/25/items/huxley-unesco-its-purpose-and-philosophy/huxley%20unesco%20its%20purpose%20and%20philosophy.pdf)
My contention from previous chapters remains; it is not so much a rediscovery, rather the realisation of a multi-generational occultic agenda. Disconnection, divide, conquer, then restructure a cynically manufactured perception of the unity we subconsciously yearn for. A socially engineered awakening that is leading toward a transmutated redefinition of humanity. Drawing us ever deeper into the vortex of the envisioned techno-mystical synthetic singularity. Enchantment is akin to a sales pitch. Thus, formatively, we can begin to comprehend how LSD was utilised as a means of deconstructing the values and structures of the prevailing social order and coax us toward a unified (we are one) and utopian ideal. Again, it's all highly Kabbalistic.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23t8B1xtpKCTotT2bnRFTh3Bfrrh9BrefYPTmHGkEw3ZiXHt67qigEDo5KtJswXVXyrMf.png)
[The Cybernetic Society by Timothy Leary & Eric Gullichsen]( https://urbigenous.net/library/huxley_hesse_cybernetic.html)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23wfdKGaSPPLEB9rWuBsAxEJpz2MxaFGvnmNi8ySRRtdZ6JpWbdm7MM2tWpuVretEernQ.png)
We should also never forget that the intended totalitarian consensus-driven pseudo-peace, is brought to you by the same oligarchal control structure that deals in currencies of death, fear, and guilt. Through imbalance and the carefully crafted illusions of fulfilment, power, and success, they have coerced the self-perpetuating devolution of the social order.
Thesis Antithesis Synthesis: Problem Reaction Solution.
The progeny of a built-to-fail infrastructure that filters wealth and resources towards the upper echelons of the pyramid, whilst furtively energising and nudging us toward this age of premeditated transformational crisis. A centralised network that has now created, funded and infiltrated every prominent social and grassroot protest movement, institution, and scientific discipline.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23viLeXxHnMuE6W9hcPFtKqvDcc26zSrKXj6wmNfBpbu6f9rtdVPfUy6QaqFBevZmd2Nt.png)
[Source](https://fightingmonarch.com/2019/10/03/cia-rogues-gallery-timothy-leary/)

Counter Culture?

As documented within previous chapters, Ford are another aspect of the dialectic controlling Rockefeller/C.I.A panopticon.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23t88ngyCNzmGx8Af6aEsaJ3bX9UWJTprDfh4oHgnCcmiA17DotQMnHg76gz3vc5C55W7.png)
[Source](https://muse.jhu.edu/pub/193/oa_monograph/chapter/670983)
Within the previous chapter, we’ve already observed how (alongside [grants]( https://www.sfgate.com/tv/article/Hippies-nudity-and-Don-Draper-Inside-Big-Sur-s-6271471.php) from the Rockefeller Foundation) the formation of Esalen was heavily (personally) financed by Laurence Rockefeller, who was also a close friend of its founder Michael Murphy. Equally, delving a little deeper we find financial and collaborative connections between the Institute and the ubiquitous Ford Foundation. Indeed, the joint Ford – Esalen [project](https://eric.ed.gov/?id=ED058119) in \

was enabled by a Ford grant.</center>

<center>
![Esalen.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23tSsxbVJKQSe2QWTXGPKzVgexaEEpnCHmVpCQ5pZthVLLkx1BB59N8Dyin8FWDuYsbfM.PNG)
</center> <center>[Source](https://issuu.com/brandodimichele/docs/executive_intelligence_review_v20n4)</center>

<center><b>The role-playing element is worth noting as it relates to the structure of the Finders Cult, whose membership \

of The Human Potential Movement.
The formation of these transformative cathedrals of social infiltration were running concurrent to the elite sponsorship of MK-Ultra, LSD experimentation (which galvanised the intended cultural transformation), and their funding of Kinsey’s sexual revolution, whose dark and highly disturbing underbelly I documented in [this](https://peakd.com/deepdives/@perceptualflaws/culture-wars-part-one-population-control-and-the-sexual-perception-deception-slrsx5) post. Certainly, the birth of Esalen very much corresponded with an era where the system was making a concerted and multi-faceted effort to re-engineer and restructure the foundations of society.
This was also occurring at a time when the CIA (through [Operation Chaos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_CHAOS)) were dismantling an attempt at an effective and organic social uprising. Today, all prominent civil rights and social movements are at the forefront of a psuedo-revolution that is financed by the same narrative controlling entities that the Grassroot activist perceives themselves to be fighting.
![Esalen31.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/perceptualflaws/23tw3p5ZrGAp2oCjWMZ9u9tp2nJJS8cTtVLvXwui2gqvGPekU3sNwsXRZYdP4bFSyze34.PNG)
[Source](https://stream.syscoi.com/2019/04/08/gregory-bateson-and-the-counter-culture/)
If you’re able to reframe certain aspects of your reformation as counter-culture, from there it becomes easy to draw in the charismatic social rebels, who in turn self-perpetuate the required narratives and guide the flocks towards their shiny new perceptual penitentiaries. Thus, in the broader scheme of things, most rebels become unwitting conformists.
>All this combined to firmly position Esalen in the nexus of the counterculture of the 1960s. [Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esalen_Institute)
https://media.giphy.com/media/Q5WOIgOtaSg1VZ05Vq/giphy.gif
From a myriad of perspectives, as a means of controlling the narrative, like the prominent new-agers; many of the leaders, psychologists, philosophers, and intellectuals of this era were not organically discovered, they were promoted and elevated into positions of influence. This is further evidenced within the formation of Esalen’s early patrons/speakers and influences, and their centrally funded thought shepherds. Why? Because their philosophies contained principles that were expedient to the narrative.
I’m not saying that some of these saplings haven’t borne fruit, I am saying they’re an explicitly categorised (trial and error) aspect of a (transformative) broader agenda. An agenda that offers the veneer of debate, freedom, and change, whilst (within matters of substance) disarming the consensus mindset, rendering them consequentially impotent to the machinations of the hidden hands that will govern every factor of our lives. Leaving the \
unable to elicit a \

that exists outside the false dichotomies of the controlled narrative.

body.title: Checking Out a New Relaxing Place- Jaerons Agricultural Farm at Calipayan, Culaba, Biliran, Philippines
body.body:
Hello everyone! Hope you all had a great day!

Wish to share with you another relaxing place I just recently checked out with friends. Welcome to Jaerons Agricultural Farm.

![Welcoming School Break_20260421_160854_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/242Nab5TLFpQmqbCbgEaFNRnPYgnT8rCEFdhD7r62x8svofPCcPM1V5LRCenwE1fHNMg8.jpg)

As you can see in the picture, it is famous for its scenic mountain view which is said to be best viewed in the morning as the sun rises. You can also get the top view of the sea and the proper town of Culaba. Not just that, Jaerons Agricultural Farm is also known for its beautiful landscape, varied plantations and it is known as a relaxing camping spot. There is an entrance fee of 25.00 per person.

![1776672197191_041725_edit_1128566425293884.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/246avPR1RhpunK6WzNUKmujQLUVERKD9Jfr2hYLf4Jtw2zqTKM11DpmvoWdUJB6tq7it3.jpg)

![1776672197153_041631_edit_1128590565912791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/246anKqxNENacmtTpQ36ZXU9iGdzsVP2YZfEZbTeXnUX3hZxCUC7DZCnya2HwbFpkhv9Z.jpg)

Many vegetabls, fruits and flowering plants are grown here and the best thing is that you could buy them here for a cheap price. They grow pineapple, cucumber, lettuce, string beans, bitter gourd and many more. 

![1776672197077_041416_edit_1128607381693884.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23s9Ls1qTHFnxetQhqAzDFhsVrUMxms7i8R38aMZdrfdTZqe5JP6btnE4UWWoTatE2heT.jpg)

![1776672196991_041211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23vsG1tWspcFd2niSD873b3UkygAQho5EKj1AtYJLdGCjpBBto4EsS9BKmXagwjERYWdp.jpg)

What caught my attention are some life qoutes hanging around and some were even posted on trees. I also love how the plants are well maintained.

![1776672196891_041027_edit_1128953775145447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xVAv3oqaWp7gUGE9G5y6WiPGVFMocZRdcummVJNaoycBQThPYJGnXMpTmTjRgTTNTH7.jpg)

![1776672196843_040926_edit_1128987454592791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/243qEp8mfjdFh4YLq6rErDQ895aiMXQWBZmFq7EvMyLyXxy1DHCVACyVXhZ9u9tc9o9N8.jpg)

Many have enjoyed overnight camping here. The vicinity is also safe. Only that, it also comes with a fee of 100.00 per person. You may bring your own tent or stay on one of their rooms for rent.

![1776672196759_040704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23yJ8Dqy2DNrn6HHhHseFVRsgKFPeQ9xmBQV7PqqfrzijS4yXKLo7XzENWgfc53RYUX2R.jpg)

![1776672196725_040559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23yJA5vKA7FaLHB62JqvNfm6wX919QYnYunfAmTHCdb8XThBjsj4EX2CoEx7kEPaPAZx5.jpg)

![Messenger_creation_C0C54F7D-F572-47EF-9EA9-69EAAD3CFC0B.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/EqNGdsRfVkmRWfgve8kwA4diJJQ96J6C3BrbHymEnGtsjVgeXSp8EfVDeupywoobybs)

You would love the ambiance of the place and appreciate the cool breeze coming from the plants and trees, I also enjoyed the different flowering plants I saw and took pictures of them. 

**LOCATION AND HOW TO GET THERE**

It is located at the top hill of Barangay Calipayan, Culaba, Biliran, Philippines. It is accessible for any type of vehicles like cars and motorbikes. Also the road going there is cemented so you don't need to worry of any rocky road. But still you must be careful on the way because the road is a bit narrow.

You can get there by riding your own vehicle or by riding a public transportation through a tricycle or a single motorbike from Barangay Bacolod in which you have to pay an up to date fare of 50.00.

Thus, if you love camping with overlooking mountains and kind of want to experience harvesting different kind of plants, this is one best place to go.

Thanks for reading!

Photos are mine and edited with Canva.

body.title: Practice is Keen
body.body:
Consistency isn’t always loud. Sometimes, it looks like quiet loops of practice.

Lately, I’ve been creating small animations like these not for clients, not for trends, but for growth. Just simple motion studies that keep my hands active and my curiosity awake.

What I’ve noticed is this:
the more I practice, the more I *want* to learn.
It naturally pulls me back into tutorials, into experimentation, into refining the little details that make design feel alive.

Animation has a way of teaching patience.
Every frame is a decision. Every movement is intention.

This is my reminder to myself:
keep showing up, even in small ways.

Because those small loops eventually become something bigger.

#DesignProcess #MotionDesign #CreativeGrowth #UIUX #Animation

오늘까지 완벽하게 공부했다고 생각하고 열심히 소통했는데, 의욕이 너무 앞섰는지 AI로 오해를 받기도 했습니다. 하나를 시작하면 열정적으로 하는 성격이라 쉬지 않고 활동했는데, 하이브에는 인스타그램이나 페이스북과는 다른 룰이 있다는 것을 오늘 또 배우게 되었네요! 조금 속상하긴 하지만, 이것 또한 배움의 과정이라 생각하고 감사하려 합니다.

한편으로는 막막하기도 해요. \

하는 걱정도 앞섭니다. 하지만 많이 배우며 천천히 가보겠습니다. 선배님들께서 도움이 될 만한 조언을 해주신다면 큰 힘이 될 것 같아요! 하이브에서 좋은 분들과 진정으로 소통하며 오래오래 함께하고 싶습니다. 새벽이라 저는 이제 자러 갑니다.

시차는 다르지만 전 세계 사람들과 이곳에서 소통할 수 있다는 것이 정말 놀랍고 감사합니다. 내일도 힘내보겠습니다!






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9SSpR4SMdVNJfiZea6wzvacVeN7VEE9dwbDJP4p71R9/1776795464507.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbGuwLdKAqurLTJaWeoLN6QN9sfJoVcVr3k9gRnv3H8Gp/1776795464526.jpg)









**English Translation**

Hello everyone! It’s 3:18 AM here in Korea.  
I’ve reached my 5th day on Hive. I started with so much excitement, but even the sign-up process was intense! Since I’m not fluent in English, I’ve been translating everything to understand the system and get involved.

I thought I had studied enough, so I’ve been very active in communicating today. However, because of my high energy and frequent posting, I was misunderstood as an AI bot. I’m the type of person who goes all-in once I start something, but I’ve realized today that Hive has its own unique rules, different from Instagram or Facebook. It was a bit upsetting at first, but I'm grateful to have learned something new.

Honestly, I feel a bit overwhelmed too. I find myself wondering, \

But I’m determined to keep learning. If any experienced Hivers have tips or advice, I would truly appreciate it! I want to stay here for a long time and build genuine connections.\n\nSince it’s so late, I'm heading to bed now. It’s amazing and wonderful to connect with people all over the world despite the different time zones, cultures, and languages. I'll be back tomorrow with more energy to learn!

body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 5 Foundation packs, Won 2 Epic Cards, Maxed out my summoners, and A battle without Melee Monsters
body.body:
Hello everyone,
How are you all? I hope everyone is fine and doing great in their life.

I am back with another Splinterlands blog, and today was just a normal day. I was not expecting anything extraordinary and simply wanted to follow my regular routine in the game.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6auh2byHn6xd9udicQa5J9MGthfGbF7E1J7d33rAs3Y/image.png)


As usual, I went to the mana well, where I had four Foundation chests. But as you can see in the screenshot below, I actually had five. I bought one from the market because I do not like opening fewer than five chests. So today, we opened five chests to see if we could get something interesting.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWqYb4va7BvA9qcJYSKVFNwsPjwnNLQDfPBioD62UuPw/image.png)


I was not expecting much from them, but recently I realized that I need to upgrade my summoners as soon as possible. So I was hoping to get some summoners from this opening.

In the screenshot below, you can see that I got two epic cards and two summoners. I was happy because both summoners are the ones I need. They are already at level three, so they will be maxed out soon.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYuBT8ejs28Sfdx7qRPhpADJZVX6c8BH1odcq8DuBo5PH/image.png)


Below, you can see the first epic card, which comes from the Life category. The name of the card is Lady Amara, and I need this card because I also want to max it out.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsvytyXsyK9BwNQ5bLBK2eTCyyrEUncybJ16oUWyXURv/image.png)


In the screenshot below, you can see the epic card from the Water category. I already own a good number of copies of this card, but I still need three more to max it out.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEagiDNSAwNSY1ajs1LQbqkUyzhfzW8BNkTJSdhF7MQf/image.png)

While checking my summoners, I realized that I am only one card away from maxing out my Water summoner. As you can see in the screenshot below, if I get one more Marlai Singariel, I will be able to take her to the maximum level.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqZgBiqfZAC5vDcSaZq1MPEx3YJqfWxy4cZF1juuAtwJ/image.png)
 
In another screenshot, you can see that I already had enough copies of Thalgrimore to max it out. So I combined 25 cards and upgraded it to the final level.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxVRu3ASd9puFDwRx19vo6KQkmm9AqFVdWYAJxe16JmX/image.png)

Now let me talk about one of the battles I played today.

Both of us used Aurelia in this battle because it had a rule where melee monsters could not be used. However, my opponent still used Spellmonger, which did not make much sense because it is not useful without melee monsters.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsZjUDfNGAjWDsg9K1S3i37bapTQWk4rtNbKdpHazPxr/image.png)

The battle started, and in Round 3, as shown below, it was 3 vs 3. At that point, I was confident that I would win because winning this battle would allow me to claim my daily rewards at the maximum level.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1rzmUtWcbrRgHju1jXnMRh92vPvDXdsNK5hMgZs3sqN/image.png)

Finally, in Round 6, I won the battle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmace5BGEbeQb4eyHJt3MUezAH4sbDs37jWBu1449ZuST6/image.png)

I was happy because, as you can see in the next screenshot, I received my daily rewards, which included three Foundation chests and nine entries for the weekly draw.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYnBcWEMMYaQ17WtnxwgHKyjCH1mV5YqJMuFMHktXVBqp/image.png)

Now coming to Terracore.

As you can see in the screenshot below, I was facing heavy penalties, so I decided to upgrade my base. I upgraded the damage stat, and after that, the penalty was removed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcKGudf8wroERxPfHn9m9NY36YTDjKTNeKAqfKj1qsyiX/image.png)

In the screenshot below, you can see the attacks I performed today. It did not go very well. I used five attacks and only earned 617 scrap tokens, which was disappointing, especially after upgrading my stats.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsioafLmWsJbbh5jk64PFKEWFtLGBMCS8Wnv6JKjRTjw/image.png)

But that is how the day went.

That is all I did in Splinterlands and Terracore today. I will see you all in my next blog.

Thank you.
