body.title: Two Sides Of Same Hurt.
body.body:
Both physical bullying and online bullying can mess a person up in very deep ways, seriously , I don’t think one is less serious than the other, but I do think they affect people differently.

Physical bullying is what most of us grew up with, someone is pushing you around or Insulting you to your face, they might even hit you, this kind of thing is very scary because it is happening in front of you, you can feel bullying and you can feel it emotionally at the same time, there is this fear that comes with bullying, it is like you are not safe in your environment, this can be at school or in your neighborhood, It can be anywhere you are supposed to feel comfortable.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdVeMjkMieLmoa5RFzDCi9wUBcnwsgL4p26CyBiZm9TQp/1776797717897.jpg)

Online bullying is different from bullying this is want some people think, they say online bullying is not as serious as it looks they think this because online bullying is something that they think is only on screen, well that is not true, Online bullying can follow you everywhere, there is no place to go, your phone is always with you. So online bullying is always, with you, now imagine people insulting you or mocking you, Imagine this happening all the time, you see it when you wake up, you see it when you go to sleep, online bullying does not stop, this can really affect someones mind like alot, online bullying can get into someones head, and ut can stay there.

One thing that even makes online bullying worse sometimes is the number of people involved, physical bullying might be one or two people, but online, it can be hundreds or even thousands joining in, it becomes overwhelming, also, people feel more confident saying hurtful things online because they are hiding behind a screen, they say things they might never say in real life, and that makes it even more brutal.

That being said, physical bullying still carries a different kind of weight because it can lead to actual bodily harm, someone could get injured, and the trauma from that can last for years, there’s also the embarrassment of being bullied in front of others physically, which can damage someone’s confidence deeply.

So honestly, trying to rank which one is worse feels a bit unfair because both can destroy someone mentally and emotionally, one attacks your body and presence in real life, while the other attacks your mind constantly without giving you space to breathe.

I personally feel both should be treated equally serious, the mistake people make is downplaying online bullying like it is not “real.” but the effects are very real. Depression, anxiety, low self-esteem, even worse outcomes can come from both types.

At the end of the day, bullying is bullying, whether it’s physical or online, the real issue is the damage it does to a person’s mental health and sense of self, instead of trying to decide which is worse, I think the focus should be on stopping both completely and taking them seriously whenever they happen.

Because no one deserves to feel small, unsafe, or broken, whether it is in real life or behind a screen.

[Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/selective-color-photography-of-person-portraying-of-being-fragile-tSfuLGojT60)

body.title: Photography Lovers // Two Monuments That Have Become Iconic Landmarks for Banda Aceh
body.body:
----
Still around the city of Banda Aceh, where along the way I saw various activities carried out by the community as well as buildings that stood firmly on the side and right of my journey while in the city, and I personally have a sense of admiration for my province because we have risen from the historic event that occurred in 2004 (tsunami) as if on this trip I *forgot for a moment* about the event, my amazement increased when I saw several iconic monuments that I saw along the road, two of which I will share on this blog
----

![IMG-20260422-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS341LcUKhHEcN43zD7Zgu7jkkiTt6EDYmTgi9MgEk1PM/IMG-20260422-WA0016.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Good evening, my friends, wherever you are. I hope you are all healthy and happy so you can go about your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a pleasant day.

In this blog, I want to share some images with you all, featuring two iconic monuments that I saw while traveling to Banda Aceh. I was amazed by these two buildings that caught my attention.

My friends...
While I was in this city, I seemed to *for a moment* forget about the event that struck my province in 2004: the tsunami, which was considered one of the deadliest and largest disasters of this century.

Well, my friends, continue to follow my blog to see these monuments and also with short articles from me.

![IMG-20260422-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhskuQgFoXrHtVyxfi35XYs3hpnBr3XHrrANNjG8qKWb/IMG-20260422-WA0008.jpg)

![IMG-20260422-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTJcwPGMFz6YrMUXbbYAeE19vqVygS6EwiJSXau4x3DWY/IMG-20260422-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260422-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT8gbDyyPeYVP57567F98gZsn7DJ91rxiAwRTpxJpjWwJ/IMG-20260422-WA0003.jpg)

![IMG-20260422-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUNJHBy9P79wvv8qGxFX7YcK9NAxCtVB5Ggb8qfjSEzZq/IMG-20260422-WA0002.jpg)

![IMG-20260422-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhsNPkdwm3SgGGSrW4K4nNDPuGLQbuvP79qkoFsXP98F/IMG-20260422-WA0005.jpg)

![IMG-20260422-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUzsLR9wCqhNftLTY7KnNfsHuzq6krDcqPpo18RdhKkM/IMG-20260422-WA0004.jpg)

![IMG-20260422-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQg7tKL7uyCUU16L9JByPDtf6ibgf5EufpEWgyopFrGH/IMG-20260422-WA0001.jpg)

The first monument that caught my attention was the Lambaro Roundabout in Aceh Besar.

My friends...
When I first saw this monument, I immediately took out my phone to take some simple photos. Since it was a sunny day, I thought the light would be good.
Furthermore, as my friends and I waited for the green light at this intersection on our way to Banda Aceh, the monument provided a beautiful view of the city, which prompted me to take some simple photos.

![IMG-20260422-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXkZGbUStmPz4b5wsdRrcGTrqocrB4cW2U9F3sthVncV2/IMG-20260422-WA0007.jpg)

This monument has become an icon for Lambaro, with promotional videotrons installed on the side of the monument, in addition, the monument area is also surrounded by the Aceh Besar logo symbol with the writing BSI, one of the banks that is the main sponsor of the construction of the monument.

![IMG-20260422-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSHsk3uArQt9emZRDNn1UPbENUqRJequEgce3o8veKrP/IMG-20260422-WA0013.jpg)

Alright, my friends, those are some simple photography images from me on this blog. Thank you very much to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me so I can create a better blog in the future.

That's all for now.
Greetings, everyone.
See you on my next blog.

body.title: Creamy Banana Oats Smoothie With Carrots [ENG - ESP]
body.body:
Hello, hello hivers and amazing friends of Amazingdrinks community 😍.

![1A129E84-C608-4B60-8F0C-47DA5F05ED12.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKbFk9WgaFMUaU8dJmNVS8JzY12ULXoSk8EfKsNBSxhkA9TnX1FCymN6P5oYyhB.jpeg)

![F32B701B-B8C2-498E-AA50-1A8C36B9EDC1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xydb98uz2vn63oCuj7ttrV6gmSSTqHwgGFWKVBMp9ZwLDoR4F8C9FB5EuGjUbDJDr4u.jpeg)

![B574A39A-21E1-412C-BC28-EBEC13977342.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242rygSxjxWrMoTBtXaWosAgtu5zg7t5GfgqW1j8WeDCrKnz5JXDeV6EcJ5QiAnroKjrc.jpeg)

It has been a while I shared some smoothies here , so today I will share with you a smoothie recipe that is so milky and creamy, packed with banana milk and diced thinly carrots that makes it so healthy and loving 🥰. This was what my mind went to earliest this morning for an on the move brunch smoothie.

The idea to this recipe is making and enjoying a quick smoothie we will not want to blend due to time, but at the same time, getting a very good and smooth texture of the roll oats by using the creamy banana milk 🥛 and just enough water 💦 to get the best consistency while stirring on heat. 

![8762FAA4-641F-4E70-8599-AFC07D03D013.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245wYAJRxHxPQfhCwreGwLiPpk7Pq5GpsKLpXQenHdwmNZgGmJttd9ariNAiPUykzuDjY.jpeg)

Its as simple and quick once you have diced your carrot 🥕 so thinly for that crunchy feel when drinking the smoothie with a chill. 

Here are the steps by step for this creamy smoothie you will love ❤️.

# INGREDIENTS: ( One Serving)

![418B0D35-C80A-4F55-9C35-5C90E6214941.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yd64t6L8Mr9CNvpgN54NAYDVNCoMAPWYYrkSsAedtNN3pdi1xYnMR9hUPnrUJXAc23L.jpeg)

![0D1C8A60-CE50-498D-ACE3-B7CA2DEAA33D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243fy98VNzQ4SqjGpfmjccuNGjXjHosXHxGoxQCdQVvEoHpzvsaaU7MqCDb9TWYhttMcJ.jpeg)

30 g of white roll oats 
1/2 glass of banana milk 
1 finger carrot 
1 tablespoon of premium sugar 
3/4 glass of water 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![4D9EADDE-F25C-499F-BE90-517B31266CA4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALAGq8zQEMXJoUsNtU9RM2xLdRnEeGrzQcpaFjUaJUN7gVryXpfoDQstUud7CHM.jpeg)

![14BFF45C-F40D-4792-82B8-B8F13C7A9E43.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rzHVTgnac18E6k9tEsBM6WZHR9o1XV89QptcVpUD2uXoPF5obpkisrBQGUABmppkTVi.jpeg)

Simple and quick, we start by scraping the carrot, wash and dice it thinly.

Step 2.

![FB09B1A6-5EB3-46F4-9EBA-15B152543381.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23y8qRvewF3nQBjGrK48pQFcJ4DQVREfb6TDuhGkiZ1bnTv6ZqcQyqqa8yxrdekhUnWAX.jpeg)

![780EFAC5-ED47-4867-BCEA-F8BE09A834FB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242Nj2RxVtdGjNup677QGgnKbbi26vhxuc5xwfS2oppwgom5ff7WD5nuZXd3eYj4Ko117.jpeg)

![5A33B66D-1A3F-4E6F-A467-409202CD4A2D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sdoz97tA6carD55PhKMWTtMuim8ANkvxwMjULSaG3wPePQmVKRhhLgvGi4jjxEBYnj5.jpeg)

We measure out half glass of this nutritional vegan banana milk 

Step 3.

![2F7233EA-AF26-4590-B691-1BF4AE8B21CB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245HyWnEuehErr7p3yaDuyK66vvidsLLGnxNH5rAM2bpgfSPubvth9fwRqpugdzvPARg9.jpeg)

![CD27BE1C-D80D-4888-9F22-887D535F3919.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWtxdckZUrRkQwGr6dyTEgBhd3U1PY6vjFvA1PKk7S9TV57n98yAkqA3me2RTCm3FWx.jpeg)

![D66FAF00-68C0-43BA-BE5C-91AA014488A3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWuAmV3Z5v8CLaE6p1AmvaCNdUAH31rwK9oo4qeMpFd62zm5XH2r98HjnAqcwPE6fed.jpeg)

Next, we cut open and pour the oats into the pot above.

![4BB3B482-6FD1-48AA-8CF1-70A3C3023192.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL1f5YoosLjHHnjhSWu4uNtYKZ5izeq5XKaoEpAitczR22STsbwQoXNBXNRje2S.jpeg)

And add our banana milk 🥛 and our water 💦 too.

Step 4.

![9678760B-13D8-4D6B-BA45-87E6723E0CD7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAVJuyL5ZNRw8ns7a1kZLhmALsB2BbQKoPRDfoL3P7FHznnh9h7w1NU9g3G3YvrgANk.jpeg)

![5418A3D4-0B3A-4A80-B446-9C727A635C0A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xVGvbfaQH1jToCpipTCuFRaToCLhmWS15iQ3DeEKAtDHgquaHaPD5xPRoUbjXQFbjw4.jpeg)

![C53961CE-FE88-4B82-9969-426CBD408BAF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWwRLCCvYrARKptcWqNLNAVGXQVuipgF8XAK45Z4yerf7LVMmJMveFxnA7FKfWfo91N.jpeg)

We add the diced carrots 🥕and the premium sugar here

Step 5.

![A18E8BD4-0B1D-4AA4-B023-85ADCE6DE9D6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2CSiTo5tnMcDi3V4Lyob64pAgiDMRZhRTwgsKWJDkA1YJ6HUkqihhBFdv8QW2.jpeg)

Then set the pot on the cooker on a low heat stirring with force to get a good smooth textured consistency for a smoothie.

![5CD0AE57-E29B-4B61-8C17-6AC46A62B097.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23u5bTtZQtVgJjqD6LiBsCwJWHc2xetALKRiYB6xpV4F5HkqU8hFaxUKoeq4NCysA3A7c.jpeg)

As here above. 

Step 6

![93637F27-C552-4BF1-A9F4-B660AE003164.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xKk6rDwudVykQBBWUFBBLG4fWxoFKKrtHmqMhmdC97qCLKTdrDVZLgFEDCuAaFsQUdC.jpeg)

And once it cooks with visible creamy color, we put off the heat.

![DAE6BEEE-DE83-42C3-A155-D16E4E4D31DB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKVVo2N4PMkb3Wtau6LntVGFY2j9oiQH6fSqVSHXWF54mvn69YqjVhnrj66c3Kb.jpeg)

![3B134062-45D6-4041-88C2-D9B1043D8C96.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23z7DYrFLrLZcxVi63rcbnNTivpZbDc7QoiMia4yrffrb7oQhbnXc7aiB11h56nNkSo27.jpeg)

![98BD2A4D-2EA2-49B1-8529-DBF200DBADDB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rz7GfjXBVNGK6WaKJDrbaxm2kK4JjbHe13sukg7YrCjaVE4xyKXZvvVMkHpubzw5Pd5.jpeg)

Serve in a cup of our choice.

Step 7.

![3BD12035-F347-451E-B8A9-B170F1A1921F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sUGhxAhjZr4B9A6ACiQu4SXakJxeyp1K6nq8rdNoW6TZLiBxgGkptee1A89CKuaxV6j.jpeg)

![668708C9-E900-4847-B8A1-56EED6392452.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKU4xJnEs6xzNWaF3KGXHEhRWCBsLwYKJqPnnkXe8353xkJJKBKcbTyPJCy8wPR.jpeg)

Garnish with more carrots 🥕 and add more banana milk above before refrigerating to take away.

![17321AE2-7B25-4E1F-A5DC-AEB562E2217B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sJrDaPQ37Zwr3XKPNSjhvMqaFhq6w7Z3t1f7rGNmDhkUuYhEpFU3c6GkcG5ooxE1bHZ.jpeg)

Oh waoh!

![291778CD-F842-4DEE-BC79-5CCA7DC6AE41.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbVz4cK3F2dx1Qh6b6vw4xfadVCrYfnsxnQZaF7R54wCNvo2Dj5TBjMbSbLyvjRVicY.jpeg)

How creamy and delightful. A brunch that can keep you all noon 🕛 without needing lunch 🥙. And that’s for sure why smoothie is different from other drinks 🍹. Even the banana milk makes it enjoyable and filling.

![56396638-D5FD-43CC-A5B7-92143CE8054B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xydb98uz2vn63oCuj7ttrV6gmSSTqHwgGFWKVBMp9ZwLDoR4F8C9FB5EuGjUbDJDr4u.jpeg)

Try this smooth with any creamy milk of your choice. Its so nourishing that am hooked to make it soon again. Maybe this time with red 🍎or green 🍏 apple . Hope you enjoyed this recipe .

### Thank you for coming with me friends . Sending hugs 🤗 and lots of blessings 😇.

## Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine.

![86C72DDB-A6D0-4237-88B0-BC8C50FA4F5D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMwo9dpnWRR6a5qCdw8UPgbcTmU3uyb1RSZx1SzchJyqsdt3XBQwAvLaRCVfYtYN4U5.jpeg)


## Espanol Version

### Hola, hivers y amigos maravillosos de la comunidad Amazing drinks 😍.

![1A129E84-C608-4B60-8F0C-47DA5F05ED12.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKbFk9WgaFMUaU8dJmNVS8JzY12ULXoSk8EfKsNBSxhkA9TnX1FCymN6P5oYyhB.jpeg)

![F32B701B-B8C2-498E-AA50-1A8C36B9EDC1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xydb98uz2vn63oCuj7ttrV6gmSSTqHwgGFWKVBMp9ZwLDoR4F8C9FB5EuGjUbDJDr4u.jpeg)

![B574A39A-21E1-412C-BC28-EBEC13977342.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242rygSxjxWrMoTBtXaWosAgtu5zg7t5GfgqW1j8WeDCrKnz5JXDeV6EcJ5QiAnroKjrc.jpeg)

Hace tiempo que no comparto batidos por aquí, así que hoy voy a compartir con vosotros una receta de batido muy cremoso y con mucho sabor a leche, repleto de leche de plátano y zanahorias cortadas en trocitos finos, lo que lo hace muy saludable y delicioso 🥰. Esto es lo primero que se me ocurrió esta mañana para un batido de brunch para llevar.

La idea de esta receta es preparar y disfrutar de un batido rápido que no nos apetece batir por falta de tiempo, pero al mismo tiempo conseguir una textura muy buena y suave de los copos de avena utilizando la cremosa leche de plátano 🥛 y la cantidad justa de agua 💦 para obtener la mejor consistencia mientras se remueve al fuego.

![8762FAA4-641F-4E70-8599-AFC07D03D013.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245wYAJRxHxPQfhCwreGwLiPpk7Pq5GpsKLpXQenHdwmNZgGmJttd9ariNAiPUykzuDjY.jpeg)

Es muy sencillo y rápido una vez que hayas cortado la zanahoria 🥕 en trocitos muy finos para que quede crujiente al tomar el batido bien frío.

Aquí tienes los pasos para preparar este batido cremoso que te va a encantar ❤️.

# INGREDIENTES: (Una ración)

![418B0D35-C80A-4F55-9C35-5C90E6214941.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yd64t6L8Mr9CNvpgN54NAYDVNCoMAPWYYrkSsAedtNN3pdi1xYnMR9hUPnrUJXAc23L.jpeg)

![0D1C8A60-CE50-498D-ACE3-B7CA2DEAA33D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243fy98VNzQ4SqjGpfmjccuNGjXjHosXHxGoxQCdQVvEoHpzvsaaU7MqCDb9TWYhttMcJ.jpeg)

30 g of white roll oats 
1/2 glass of banana milk 
1 finger carrot 
1 tablespoon of premium sugar 
3/4 glass of water 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Paso 1.

![4D9EADDE-F25C-499F-BE90-517B31266CA4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALAGq8zQEMXJoUsNtU9RM2xLdRnEeGrzQcpaFjUaJUN7gVryXpfoDQstUud7CHM.jpeg)

![14BFF45C-F40D-4792-82B8-B8F13C7A9E43.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rzHVTgnac18E6k9tEsBM6WZHR9o1XV89QptcVpUD2uXoPF5obpkisrBQGUABmppkTVi.jpeg)

Es muy sencillo y rápido: primero pelamos la zanahoria, la lavamos y la cortamos en rodajas finas.

Paso 2.

![FB09B1A6-5EB3-46F4-9EBA-15B152543381.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23y8qRvewF3nQBjGrK48pQFcJ4DQVREfb6TDuhGkiZ1bnTv6ZqcQyqqa8yxrdekhUnWAX.jpeg)

![780EFAC5-ED47-4867-BCEA-F8BE09A834FB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242Nj2RxVtdGjNup677QGgnKbbi26vhxuc5xwfS2oppwgom5ff7WD5nuZXd3eYj4Ko117.jpeg)

![5A33B66D-1A3F-4E6F-A467-409202CD4A2D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sdoz97tA6carD55PhKMWTtMuim8ANkvxwMjULSaG3wPePQmVKRhhLgvGi4jjxEBYnj5.jpeg)

Medimos medio vaso de esta leche de plátano vegana y nutritiva 

Paso 3.

![2F7233EA-AF26-4590-B691-1BF4AE8B21CB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245HyWnEuehErr7p3yaDuyK66vvidsLLGnxNH5rAM2bpgfSPubvth9fwRqpugdzvPARg9.jpeg)

![CD27BE1C-D80D-4888-9F22-887D535F3919.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWtxdckZUrRkQwGr6dyTEgBhd3U1PY6vjFvA1PKk7S9TV57n98yAkqA3me2RTCm3FWx.jpeg)

![D66FAF00-68C0-43BA-BE5C-91AA014488A3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWuAmV3Z5v8CLaE6p1AmvaCNdUAH31rwK9oo4qeMpFd62zm5XH2r98HjnAqcwPE6fed.jpeg)

A continuación, abrimos el paquete y echamos la avena en la olla de arriba.

![4BB3B482-6FD1-48AA-8CF1-70A3C3023192.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL1f5YoosLjHHnjhSWu4uNtYKZ5izeq5XKaoEpAitczR22STsbwQoXNBXNRje2S.jpeg)

Y añade también nuestra leche de plátano 🥛 y nuestra agua 💦.

Paso 4.

![9678760B-13D8-4D6B-BA45-87E6723E0CD7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAVJuyL5ZNRw8ns7a1kZLhmALsB2BbQKoPRDfoL3P7FHznnh9h7w1NU9g3G3YvrgANk.jpeg)

![5418A3D4-0B3A-4A80-B446-9C727A635C0A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xVGvbfaQH1jToCpipTCuFRaToCLhmWS15iQ3DeEKAtDHgquaHaPD5xPRoUbjXQFbjw4.jpeg)

![C53961CE-FE88-4B82-9969-426CBD408BAF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWwRLCCvYrARKptcWqNLNAVGXQVuipgF8XAK45Z4yerf7LVMmJMveFxnA7FKfWfo91N.jpeg)

Aquí añadimos las zanahorias cortadas en dados 🥕 y el azúcar de primera calidad

Paso 5.

![A18E8BD4-0B1D-4AA4-B023-85ADCE6DE9D6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2CSiTo5tnMcDi3V4Lyob64pAgiDMRZhRTwgsKWJDkA1YJ6HUkqihhBFdv8QW2.jpeg)

A continuación, pon la olla al fuego a fuego lento y remueve enérgicamente hasta conseguir una textura suave y homogénea, como la de un batido.

![5CD0AE57-E29B-4B61-8C17-6AC46A62B097.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23u5bTtZQtVgJjqD6LiBsCwJWHc2xetALKRiYB6xpV4F5HkqU8hFaxUKoeq4NCysA3A7c.jpeg)

Como se ha indicado anteriormente. 

Paso 6

![93637F27-C552-4BF1-A9F4-B660AE003164.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xKk6rDwudVykQBBWUFBBLG4fWxoFKKrtHmqMhmdC97qCLKTdrDVZLgFEDCuAaFsQUdC.jpeg)

Y cuando adquiera un color cremoso, retiramos del fuego.

![DAE6BEEE-DE83-42C3-A155-D16E4E4D31DB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKVVo2N4PMkb3Wtau6LntVGFY2j9oiQH6fSqVSHXWF54mvn69YqjVhnrj66c3Kb.jpeg)

![3B134062-45D6-4041-88C2-D9B1043D8C96.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23z7DYrFLrLZcxVi63rcbnNTivpZbDc7QoiMia4yrffrb7oQhbnXc7aiB11h56nNkSo27.jpeg)

![98BD2A4D-2EA2-49B1-8529-DBF200DBADDB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rz7GfjXBVNGK6WaKJDrbaxm2kK4JjbHe13sukg7YrCjaVE4xyKXZvvVMkHpubzw5Pd5.jpeg)

Sírvelo en la taza que prefieras.

Paso 7.

![3BD12035-F347-451E-B8A9-B170F1A1921F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sUGhxAhjZr4B9A6ACiQu4SXakJxeyp1K6nq8rdNoW6TZLiBxgGkptee1A89CKuaxV6j.jpeg)

body.title: The Island In The Sky Is Real.
body.body:
You wouldn't believe this, but I very well understand with you if you don't, because I didn't believe at first too. The first time I heard about the floating island then was inside a bus, I saw the back and forth of argument they were having, I didn't join in though. Later that night when I got home, I was reminiscing about how my day and went and all of that when I remembered the argument I heard earlier in the day, so I picked up my phone and searched about it. Lo, and behold it was there, I see a lot of videos, not AI generated ones, real videos, real people talking and saying different good things about the island in the sky...I even saw someone post a video of how she was walking on the clouds....and I'm always the curious type, that was how my curious part got triggered.


![1000961456.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/48b2Vd8c1vwkPx1DMHSN6NVhudv4CdNH7jSGbTUpEpKHFEcdX3owTWMZgFRgGbyKfN.png)



I find every means possible to reach out to those that were there through the Internet and the videos I saw them posting and I was happy someone offered to help out. The first day I visited that space, I fell in love with it totally, everything up there was different. The air, the environment... everything. I was walking on clouds as if I was walking on the ground.


After that day, I kept visiting at intervals, I saw how some people have finally migrated there, while a lot of others still didn't believe and a host of others too vowed to never do so, maybe out of fear I can't say, but me, I've fell in love with the place already. There was a day went there after a few months, I got there to see a lot more development that has taken place there in just a space of a short time. I noticed that there were new houses that are up for sale, people now have shops where they sell things and a lot of that.




As you would rightly guess, I bought one. Yea, I bought a house. The place didn't feel that luxurious, but I love the quietness and the kind of feelings it emits, it makes me feel....you know. When I told my brother about it and about how real it is, while trying to convince them to let's move in there together, he made a statement that made me laugh.



![1000961457.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/48fMutSUJ91Pzn5sFyhBVj6yaYA1hHgH4E31UpF32GBNTnpJxpXDCFibTWaxVLjEkd.png)



*\

* I just laughed. Then I explained it to him, that the same way a car cannot enter into our house here on land is the same way it is over there too. Everything is built and constructed the right way, there are the paths for planes and all of that. *\

* I told him.
 


Since then, I've been telling them all to come, it is good, yes, it is too good to be true, yes. But don't be scared, not all good things can be harming or can have a side effects. You just need to step out and experience it.

So, about the floating island,. please check it out. I'm encouraging y'all too. I know it might sound somehow, but even if it's just for a day, form over to experience it.





🌹

Images are AI generated.

Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.

body.body:

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=traveltour/d8ff71d4)


---

Assalamu Alaikum, how are you all? I hope you are doing well by the grace of Allah. I am also doing well. Today I have come to you with a video of a new game Rainbow six mobail. Today's game is going to be an offline game that was created a long time ago. The name of the game is Rainbow six mobail.The game is a gun game. The graphic design of this game is very beautiful and it has different types of as well as enemies to kill.


There are moments in this game where the smartest move isn't to go in guns blazing or even to take the stealth route and eliminate everyone quietly. Sometimes the best move is simply to run. Just sprint through, dodge everything, avoid every enemy, skip the fight entirely, and get to your objective as fast as possible.The game's story centers on this struggle for power. The energy crystals represent not only a technological advantage but also total dominance over the battlefield. As a player, you assume the role of a highly equipped soldier participating in this war, facing off against enemies across various missions as you advance through the campaign.


One of the most striking aspects of rainbow six mobail is its progression system. Unlike other Flash games of its era, here you can upgrade your gear, purchase new weapons, and customize your armor—adding a strategic layer to the gameplay.the period when Flash games were at the absolute peak of their popularity. It managed to stand out thanks to its fluid gameplay and appealing visual style.


anywhere comfortably the gameplay is mission based with each level offering a new objective sometimes sniping sometimes heavy shooting and sometimes eliminating specific targets.The gameplay is simple but never boring the controls are easy just aim and shoot but the difficulty increases as the levels progress your stamina also increases and you will need to use some strategy you will need to take cover or you will die quickly.


When I started my first mission the controls were quite easy to understand and after a little practice aiming became smooth locking on to enemies and firing a missile feels quite satisfying the game missions also do not feel boring sometimes you have to destroy a convoy sometimes you have to eliminate a specific enemy and sometimes defend the base as the level increases the difficulty also increases creating a challenge.

Lots of air travel. Oh, that's cool, guys. I love these conversations, just talking and getting to know each other. 

I think that's important when you are looking to do business with others, just hearing who they are. And they're just, I mean, it's simple. People get their start.

I guess one leg at a time, just seeing who they are. Oh, excellent. Ronnie, you're building Code 350.

body.title: Candy box with cup holder [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>
![post hive (89).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xKzdqPAZVdy1w4iWGuojaH78tErAxtMZMgpsimC2Aosg5Ts6Wu4bRZ4QovdjSf9TCEf.png)
--- Creative friends, it’s a pleasure to share with you again. As we all know, editable templates created in **CANVA** are all the rage right now—whether for making boxes, party favors, decorative frames, or anything else. As I said, I’m always looking to learn a little bit of everything, from the art of cooking to the world of creative stationery. Today I want to share this little project I learned to make recently. I printed it out to put it together myself and test whether the template was well-designed. And yes, this is definitely an art form—I loved the result! However, I realize I need to practice a lot when it comes to cutting and pasting, but hey, that’s just another thing to add to my list of things to learn. Now let’s see how I did it. Here are the materials I used: ## Tools: - Design printed on photo paper - Scissors - Silicone stick - Hot glue gun - Ruler ## Process: The first thing I did was, obviously, create my template in **CANVA**. To do this, I looked for a tutorial and followed the steps, taking each measurement for every part. My idea was to make a template for a candy box that includes a cup holder. I saw this design on Facebook, and it’s in high demand, especially for Children’s Day 👇 It’s worth noting that for the design of this cup holder box, I used two A4-sized sheets of paper. One sheet is for the front and back of the box, and the other is for the base, along with the part where the cup will go.
![post hive (90).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wCd9XGkk6iCeaCMq7LPF5AozNgyRos8RCsBGq8F9FgVPWnsFSoJbkPvJsW4gmZpVc7X.png)
As you can see, I’ve already printed them out here. Since I don’t have a printer, I have to go to an internet café. 😌
![post hive (85).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tbwBSxQQPTzXcn3BZ8dYjFFivzzH8HB1WrVywRkCTYTEB3kqdqEp61NQpZ6mmehg69j.png)
Now that we have our image printed, we’ll proceed to cut it out. As I mentioned, this part is crucial—you need a steady hand to cut precisely to the measurements. Here’s how it turned out.👇
![post hive (87).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xVeHJCKuifnw8KWbfANPBNDUrVYaYTeTXGMZzgvYR2xngtBiTx9jFmMzC8jn2pE9EF2.png)
Now this part is a little more tedious; this is where we have to assemble it, gluing the flaps precisely on each side. First, we start with the front part, the face of the glass.👇
![post hive (86).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23z7Hmq9YtLBFbCHYxBhYpJ8vCPS1cF9ipVNUHAyAgQYprTu5WEvHz7jWx8N9PvdnmuBu.png)
Next, we’ll attach it to the base, so it looks like this, connecting it to the back of the box, of course.👇 Here you can glue the acetate to the window side; I didn’t have any, so I left it like this, but it’s highly recommended, since that’s where the candy would go.
![post hive (88).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23yTxUSrUu8mt86GYjhRvwKHcckdNcRz355tCUzn9kcw5pkL9AW73MmssF3ymUKfxDZ4d.png)
Now all that’s left is to attach it to the side of the cup holder, along with the side of the box. And here’s our little box—what do you think?
![post hive (92).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wX7zvVWSW4NzCPPSoxhPdUxwJa19GRX1x6YENKzcd5Uw839SaDiNnzsrawk5BANcyBe.png)
It’s definitely a nice design. This template is editable, and you can modify and customize it. I love creating, and I’m definitely learning—this is a real art form. And even though many people see it as something simple, it’s not. It requires effort, dedication, but above all, creativity—and that’s something not many people appreciate. This work is worth it, because not everyone has the time to design and create these files. So, friends, we need to know how to value things—our work and our time, all of that. I hope you like this design. Let me know what you think; I’ll read your comments. 😍 ---
SPANISH VERSION

Amigos creativos, un gusto compartir con ustedes nuevamente, como bien sabemos, ahorita esta de modas muchas plantillas editables, creadas en **CANVA**, ya sea para armar cajas, cotillones, cuadros decorativos, en fin, como dije, yo sigo buscando aprender de todo un poco, entre el arte de la cocina y el mundo de la papelería creativa. Hoy quiero compartirles este modelito que aprendi hacer hace poco, el cual lo imprimi, para armarlo yo misma, y probar que la plantilla esta bien hecha, y si definitivamente,esto es todo un arte, ame el resultado, sin embargo, me doy cuenta que debo practicar bastante, al momento del corte y pegado, pero bueno, esto es otro mas a la lista de aprendizajes. Veamos ahora como lo hice, les cuento que los materiales que use fueron: ## Herramientas: - Diseño impreso en papel fotográfico - Tijeras - Silicon en barra - Pistola de silicón - Regla ## Proceso: Lo primero que hice fue obviamente crear mi plantilla en **CANVA**, para ello, busque un tutorial, el cual fui realizando los paso, con cada medida, para cada parte, mi idea era hacer la plantilla de una caja de golosinas, la cual incluye un portavasos, este diseño lo he visto en Facebook, el cual solicitan mucho, sobre todo para el día del niño 👇 Cabe señalar que para el diseño de esta caja portavasos, se uso dos hojas tamaño A4, ya que una hoja tendremos la parte de la cara y el lado reverso de la caja, y en la otra la base, junto con la parte donde ira el vaso.

![post hive (90).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wCd9XGkk6iCeaCMq7LPF5AozNgyRos8RCsBGq8F9FgVPWnsFSoJbkPvJsW4gmZpVc7X.png)
Como ven aquí ya las imprimí, como yo no tengo impresora, me toca ir a un cyber. 😌
![post hive (85).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tbwBSxQQPTzXcn3BZ8dYjFFivzzH8HB1WrVywRkCTYTEB3kqdqEp61NQpZ6mmehg69j.png)
Ya con nuestra imagen impresa, procedemos a recortar, esta parte como les mencione es fundamental, hay que tener buen pulso, para cortar con exactitud las medidas., así me quedo.👇
![post hive (87).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xVeHJCKuifnw8KWbfANPBNDUrVYaYTeTXGMZzgvYR2xngtBiTx9jFmMzC8jn2pE9EF2.png)
Ahora esta parte es un poco mas engorrosa, es donde debemos hacer el armado, pegar las pestañas, con exactitud en cada lado, primero comenzamos con la parte frontal, la cara del vaso.👇
![post hive (86).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23z7Hmq9YtLBFbCHYxBhYpJ8vCPS1cF9ipVNUHAyAgQYprTu5WEvHz7jWx8N9PvdnmuBu.png)
Luego lo vamos a unir con la base, quedando de esta manera, uniéndolo por su puesto con la parte trasera de la caja.👇 Aquí pueden pegarle el acetato en el lado de la ventana, yo no tenia, por lo que deje así, sin embargo, es lo mas recomendable, ya que en esa parte irían las golosinas.
![post hive (88).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23yTxUSrUu8mt86GYjhRvwKHcckdNcRz355tCUzn9kcw5pkL9AW73MmssF3ymUKfxDZ4d.png)
Ya solo queda unirlo con el lado del portavasos, junto con la parte lateral de la caja. Y así nos queda nuestra cajita, que tal.
![post hive (92).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23wX7zvVWSW4NzCPPSoxhPdUxwJa19GRX1x6YENKzcd5Uw839SaDiNnzsrawk5BANcyBe.png)
Sin duda un bonito diseño, esta plantilla es editable, y se puede modificar y personalizar, me gusta crear, y sin duda aprender, esto es todo un arte, y aunque muchos lo ven como algo sencillo, no lo es, requiere esfuerzo, dedicación, pero sobre todo creatividad, y eso es algo que no muchos valoran., esté trabajo vale, porque no todos tienen el tiempo para diseñar y crear estos archivos. Entonces amigos, hay que saber valorar las cosas, nuestro trabajo y tiempo, todo eso. Espero les guste este diseño, me digan que tal les pareció, los leo. 😍

body.title: Paramnesia [ES/EN]
body.body:
> «¿Dónde estoy?». Willy forcejeaba tratando de soltarse de las amarras que lo tenían atado a una superficie plana. Las luces eran muy brillantes y hacían difícil ver. Willy se guía moviéndose de un lado a otro tratando de soltarse, mientras cinco sombras aparecían entre las luces que cegaban a Willy, él distinguía dificultosamente unas cabezas alargadas, nada que hubiera visto jamás. «Cálmese, humano, solo queremos investigar». Uno de ellos hablaba con una voz distorsionada y metálica. Los demás se movían alrededor de Willy como en una operación. La luz intensa solo dejaba mirar las siluetas, y los brazos alargados y delgados como hilos, sostenían unos aparatos difíciles de identificar. «No, no, déjenme, malditos, ¿qué me van a hacer?». Willy seguía forcejeando. Los seres misteriosos hablaban entre ellos, parecían susurros con gruñidos suaves. Willy no entendió lo que entre ellos decían. «Humano, debe calmarse, no le pasará nada». Otro de los seres hablaba con esa voz extraña. Uno de los seres levantaba un instrumento, que a Willy le pareció una sierra. Gritó muy fuerte y los seres desaparecieron, mientras Willy seguía gritando y moviéndose sin parar. En un instante, una cabeza alargada apareció de repente y se acercó tanto a Willy que pudo ver unos ojos alargados y con un negro profundo. «No, no, no, ¡déjame monstruo!». Willy soltaba unas lágrimas producto del terror. «Buuuu...». Luego se escuchaba unas risas distorsionadas. Las luces se hicieron más intensas. «Despierta, Willy». Willy abría los ojos y miraba una sombra borrosa entre las luces. «¡Déjame, monstruo, déjame!». Willy se tapaba el rostro mientras seguía gritando. «Reacciona, Willy, otra vez estás alucinando». Mary, su esposa, lo movía insistentemente. «¿Qué... Qué... Sucede?». Willy reconocía el rostro de Mary. «Estas a salvo, cariño, cálmate». Mary lo abrazaba. «Unos monstruos...». Willy estaba aterrorizado. «Amor, tuviste otra alucinación. Llamé al psiquiatra para que te venga a ver». Mary abría la puerta. «Buenos días, señor Willy. Su esposa nos comenta que tuvo otra alucinación». El psiquiatra se sentaba en un mueble blanco. «No era alucinación, se sintió muy real». Willy se levantó quedando sentando. «Amor, no otra vez...». Mary se tomaba el rostro «Señor Willy, su mente introduce recuerdos falsos como experiencias reales, es completamente comprensible en su caso, pero con nuestra ayuda saldrá adelante. No se preocupe». El psiquiatra recibía una llamada. «Discúlpenme, tengo algunos asuntos que atender. Recuerde, señor Willy, todo está en su mente». El psiquiatra se iba y quedaba Willy con su esposa, quien le daba una pastilla blanca de sabor desagradable. «Toma, amor, esto te ayudará a dormir». Willy tomaba la pastilla y pronto las luces se convirtieron en oscuridad, luego de un tiempo abrió los ojos, aquel lugar era muy raro, la habitación había cambiado, estaba en una camilla, las paredes de ese lugar parecían ser metálicas y habían unas luces en el techo que alumbraban tenuemente. Algunas máquinas como computadoras estaban en los rincones y tenían pequeñas luces de colores que titilaban. «Mary, Mary, ¿dónde estás?». La voz se extinguía en el silencio de la habitación. De pronto la puerta de abrió, haciendo un movimiento hacia un lado, parecía automática. Willy tenía una bata de hospital y corría descalzo hacia la salida, llegó a un largo pasillo con muchas puertas a los lados. Willy empezó a correr hasta que escuchó unos pasos y gruñidos suaves. Junto a una de las puertas vio un botón y lo presionó con gran premura. La puerta se deslizó hacia un lado, Willy entró rápidamente y se escondió en una pila de lo que parecían cajas. El peligro había pasado y Willy miraba a su alrededor. Se espantó al ver una serie de tubos enormes que contenían partes de cuerpo, fetos, cabezas, dorsos, piernas, manos, cerebros y ojos, todo estaba flotando en un líquido verde y cada parte estaba conectada a varios cables de color negro. Cuando estaba mirando cada tubo vio la cabeza de Mary. Los ojos de Willy querían salirse de sus órbitas. No podía creer lo que estaba viendo. «Es solo una alucinación, es solo una alucinación». Se repetía a sí mismo mientras cerraba los ojos. «No es una alucinación, es la realidad. Debes escapar de aquí o terminarás como nosotros. ¡Correee!». La cabeza de Mary instaba a Willy. Willy completamente aterrorizado corrió tratando de escapar de aquel lugar. Recorría los pasillos tratando de buscar una salida. Llegó a un gran hangar, donde había unas pequeñas naves que salían por una gran puerta. Willy vio la oportunidad de salir de aquel lugar. De pronto, unas luces rojas empezaron a parpadear, y un sonido de alerta hacía que aquellos alienígenas corrieran de un lado a otro. Las naves salían del hangar y de pronto el lugar quedó solitario. Willy aprovechó el momento y salió corriendo hacia la salida. Los ojos de Willy quedaron atónitos viendo el terrible escenario, un apocalipsis de destrucción. «¡Nos están invadiendo!». Willy se tomaba la cabeza. Los aviones y las naves combatían en el firmamento nocturno, mientras la ciudad ardía en llamas. Willy miraba espantado todo lo que sucedía en ese momento de confusión. Después las tinieblas invadieron sus ojos. «Amor, despierta, despierta». Mary movía a Willy. «¡Nos invaden, nos invaden!». Willy estaba totalmente fuera de sí. Varios enfermeros entraban para sujetar a Willy, quien gritaba y se movía fuera de control sobre la cama. El psiquiatra entró rápidamente e inyectó un tranquilizante. Mary se acercaba a su esposo. «Amor, amor, ya estás a salvo. Cálmate por favor. Estoy aquí para ayudarte». Mary lo abrazaba. Willy miraba a su esposa y sonreía mientras el tranquilizante hacía efecto. «Estudio de la cabeza del espécimen 202107, está por terminar». Uno de los alienígenas informaba. «La inserción de recuerdos ha logrado calmar al espécimen. Mañana seguiremos con el estudio» Los alienígenas salían y apagaban las luces de laboratorio del estudio de las partes humanas, mientras la invasión seguía adelante. ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)
English #### Paramnesia

Willy was struggling trying to get loose from the ties that had him tied to a flat surface.

The lights were very bright and made it difficult to see. Willy guides himself moving from side to side trying to let go, while five shadows appeared between the lights that blinded Willy, he could hardly distinguish elongated heads, nothing he had ever seen. 

\

One of them was speaking in a distorted, metallic voice.

The others were moving around Willy as if in an operation. The intense light only allowed to look at the silhouettes, and the elongated and thin arms like threads, held some devices difficult to identify. 

\

Willy was still struggling.

The mysterious beings were talking to each other, they seemed like whispers with soft growls. Willy didn't understand what they were saying to each other. 

\

Another of the beings spoke with that strange voice.

One of the beings was holding up an instrument, which looked like a saw to Willy. He screamed very loudly and the beings disappeared, while Willy kept screaming and moving non-stop. In an instant, an elongated head suddenly appeared and came so close to Willy that he could see elongated eyes with a deep black. 

\
Willy was shedding a few tears as a result of terror.\n\n\

Then I heard distorted laughter.

The lights became more intense.

\

Willy opened his eyes and looked at a blurry shadow between the lights.

\
Willy was covering his face as he continued to scream.\n\n\
Mary, his wife, moved him insistently.\n\n\
The psychiatrist was sitting on a white piece of furniture.\n\n\
Willy was lying down and sat up.\n\n\

The psychiatrist left and Willy stayed with his wife, who gave him a white pill with an unpleasant taste.

\

Willy was taking the pill and soon the lights turned to darkness, after a while he opened his eyes, that place was very strange, the room had changed. He was on a stretcher, the walls of that place seemed to be metallic and there were some lights on the ceiling that shone dimly. Some machines like computers were in the corners and had little colored lights that twinkled. 

\

The voice faded into the silence of the room.

Suddenly the door opened, making a movement to the side, it seemed automatic. Willy had a hospital gown on and was running barefoot towards the exit.He came to a long hallway with many doors on the sides. Willy started running until he heard some soft footsteps and grunts. 

Next to one of the doors he saw a button and pressed it with great haste. The door slid to the side, Willy quickly entered and hid in a pile of what looked like boxes. The danger had passed and Willy was looking around. He was startled to see a series of huge tubes containing body parts, fetuses, heads, backs, legs, hands, brains and eyes. Everything was floating in a green liquid and each part was connected to several black wires.

When he was looking at each tube he saw Mary's head. Willy's eyes wanted to pop out of their sockets. I couldn't believe what I was seeing.

\
He kept repeating to himself as he closed his eyes.\n\n\

Mary's head was urging Willy.

Willy completely terrified ran trying to escape from that place. He was walking the halls trying to find a way out. He arrived at a large hangar, where there were some small ships that left through a large door. Willy saw the opportunity to get out of that place. Suddenly, red lights started flashing, and an alert sound made those aliens run from one side to the other.

The alien ships were leaving the hangar and suddenly the place was lonely. Willy took advantage of the moment and ran out to the exit. Willy's eyes were stunned seeing the terrible scenario, an apocalypse of destruction. 

\

Willy was holding his head.

Planes and alien ships fought in the night sky, while the city burned in flames. Willy watched in horror everything that happened in that moment of confusion. Then darkness invaded his eyes.

body.title: Consistency Beats Motivation: The Freelancing Secret That Builds Real Success
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcDHTnSRLKGgzpwA8q3N76GGuTtn9eZqnufrnAdNcPgY6/istockphoto-2198026440-612x612.webp 
[Source](https://www.istockphoto.com/photo/consistency-is-the-key-gm2198026440-615929577?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_campaign=srp_photos_top&utm_content=https%3A%2F%2Funsplash.com%2Fs%2Fphotos%2FConsistency-Beats-Motivation%253A-The-Freelancing-Secret-That-Builds-Real-Success&utm_term=Consistency+Beats+Motivation%3A+The+Freelancing+Secret+That+Builds+Real+Success%3A%3Aaffiliate-layout-optim%3Ab%3Aad230435-5631-4923-8a26-bc4c9847cb15)</center>


If you cannot consist on what you have done, there is no need starting it in the first place because it just looks like a new year habit plan or the rate at which people enter the gym in the new year and they don't continue it as time goes on. That is what consistency does. Consistency makes sure that you are up and running at it every day. 

Consistency matters more than motivation in freelancing because your income opportunities growth depend on what you do regularly, not on how you feel on any particular day. Motivation is emotional. It comes in waves. 

Some morning you wake up, you don't feel like it. Some mornings you wake up, you are highly excited to take things up. Another day you don't feel like opening your laptop at all. 

If your entire freelancing depends on these high-energy days, your results will be unstable. You send proposals when you feel inspired, disappear when you don't and your pipeline will constantly dry up and restart. Consistency on the other hand is a decision. 

It looks like applying for a set of numbers of jobs daily. When you send out three short messages, even when no one replied yesterday. Improving your portfolio a little at a time and showing up on a platform like LinkedIn or Upwork. 

Whether or not you are in the mood, it is boring sometimes but that boring is what build momentum. Clients start to see you more often. Your skills shaping and your message improves simply because you kept repeating the process. 

In freelancing, results are delayed. You might apply for 20 jobs. For me, I don't even count any more as long as I see the job I apply. 

Before one reply, you might post content for weeks before someone actually reach out to you and say, hey I saw your content, can you help me do such a thing like this? If you rely on motivation, you stop right before those delayed results arrive. Consistency keeps you in the game long before your effort to compound. It turns more daily action into long-term opportunities and it makes your accounts to also grow. 

There is also a mindset shift that happens when you choose consistency. You stop asking, do I feel like it? And start asking, what's my minimum for today? Maybe it's three proposals, five cold emails, one portfolio improvement or 30 minutes of learning. This non-negotiable creates a structure that protects you from moods.

Motivation is a great starter but consistently it's a finisher. In the freelancing clients, in freelancing, clients play for reliability, not vibe. When you learn to show up whether you feel fired up or not, you become someone your business, your future self can trust. 

And that is what converts in business.

body.title: Respect Begets Respect.
body.body:
Hello friends!  Bullying and harassment someone without any reason is a brutal culture of our society.  It is an unethical practice of some people. I think bullying in online or physical both are bad. Because it hits on mind and the victim felt very shy and helpless. A person who belongs to a well-educated family can never bully others. Bullying hampers the victims nomal life. In our society we often see many types of bullying. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdnX2vaiSbbG9k66nSwKHtS3X9rYqZGSYB5UcqQAXbpp/1776796630589.jpg)

When I was in school I saw there was some boys and girls were little more fat than others. They were often victims of bullying. Some students were black. They were also victims of bullying. Bullying is one kind of racism. A person who bullies others is nothing but a shameless person. Sometimes there is a group in every sectors who used to do this. Bullying is those words by which one attack others to insult them. It is done for humiliate others. 

When I was in school and college I was also a victim of bullying. I was very simple and took everyone as my friend. But some boys bulied me for my simplicity.  They considered me as a foolish and some times called me Bolda as a bullying word. I felt very angry and sometimes I physically attacked them to protest them. In my college hostel every member of our flat bullied me. Even my roommate and best friend Nahid also called me Bolda. 

Even at present time when I talk with him  he called me Bolda but this time is for fun not for bullying. A boy named vicky first bullied me in the hostel. One of my flatmate Sanchay sometimes protest against him but Vicky didn’t change. I was too much aggressive with him for his bullying,  sometimes I thought if I would break his leg it would be a great mental peace for me. I went to a deep depression. I was afraid of Vicky all time. As I was physically weak I can't win after fighting with him. Luckily Vicky left our college as he couldn’t take the pressure of study from the college. 

After a few day's leaving the hostel Vicky again came to meet with us but this time he didn’t bully me. The bullying culture is practiced among the  students most. They are not too matured to understand others mental pain. I sometimes read some news that some victims shot and killed his classmates for their bullying attack. Specially the introverts can't tolerate bullying at all. The extroverts generally remain safe from bullying attack because of their courage for protesting. 

Some time some mental patients or mad also become victims of bullying attack by children. Cyber bullying is also very harmful. Sometimes it is more harmful than physically bullying. When someone bullied physically that is seen by a few people but if it is done in online it could be seen by millions of people. It will effect the victim more than physically harassment.  So I think it is our duty to stop bullying by increasing social movement. 

Specially women are bullied physically and in online media mostly.  It is high time we raised our voice to stop this. We should try to change the outlook about girls in our society. Government also should take proper steps to stop physical and cyber bullying for all and soecially for the women. Every educational institutions should teach their students to develop a better mindset and thinking.

body.title: The Day I Died… I Was Born Again
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDNvRrmcwqxZCu5rg9HebqNwqZJu1NHKvQhiC7ZbfUxz/1776796718558.png)


The evening sank slowly over the factory, painting the sky in fading amber and ash. One by one, the workers drifted out through the rusted gates—shoulders heavy, hands worn, pockets carrying just enough to survive another day. Their voices faded into the distance, swallowed by the approaching night.

Inside, the machines began to fall silent.

All but one.

In the far corner, beneath a flickering light, a lone worker continued. His hands moved with quiet urgency, as if time itself had forgotten him—or perhaps he had chosen to forget time.

The manager, already irritated and eager to leave, noticed him.

“Hey, fool!” he barked, his voice cutting through the hollow factory. “Don’t you have a home to go to? Stop it now. I want to lock up.”

The worker didn’t answer. Not immediately.

With a frustrated sigh, the manager slammed a small bundle of wages onto a dusty table. Coins clinked, echoing in the empty space. Without waiting for a response, he turned away, muttering under his breath as he began shutting down the last of the factory—switches clicking, doors creaking, the building slowly surrendering to darkness.

Behind him, the lone worker finally paused.

And for the first time, he looked up.

From the dim end of the factory, he finally stepped forward.

A young man—barely in his early twenties—emerged from the shadows. His clothes were stained with dust and oil, his face lined with exhaustion far older than his years. Yet his eyes… they carried something different. Something steady.

He glanced at the small bundle of wages resting on the table. For a moment, he just stood there, as if measuring its weight—not in coins, but in survival.

Wiping his hands on a worn cloth, he cleaned himself as best as he could, preparing to leave behind another long day.

The manager paused, watching him. His irritation softened, replaced by something quieter. He narrowed his eyes slightly and spoke, this time without anger.

“Boy, listen… I know you’re hardworking,” he said. “But keep your work and rest in balance. If you keep forcing your body like this, it will break you.”

The young man looked up.

For a second, silence lingered between them.

Then he smiled—tired, but real.

“I understand your concern,” he replied calmly. “But this is my time to hustle… so I can rest for the rest of my life.”

His gaze shifted briefly to the wages.

“And… thank you. These really help. For my survival… and my studies.”

The manager didn’t respond.

He simply watched as the boy picked up his earnings, holding them with quiet respect—as if they were more than money.

As if they were a promise.

Outside, night had fully taken over.

And somewhere beyond those factory walls… his real story was just beginning.

The factory gates groaned shut behind him.

Night had settled fully now, wrapping the streets in dim yellow light and long shadows. The young man walked quietly, his steps slow but steady, the weight of the day still clinging to his body.

On his way home, a small bookstore stood at the corner of the street—old, almost forgotten. Its wooden sign creaked softly in the evening breeze, and a faint warm light glowed from within.

Inside, an elderly woman waited near the counter, glancing toward the door every few seconds.

The bell chimed.

She looked up—and her tired face instantly softened into a smile.

“Oh, Tom… so you finally came,” she said warmly. “I was just about to close the shop. Honestly, I thought you wouldn’t make it today.”

She reached beneath the counter and placed a neatly wrapped set of books in front of him.

“Here,” she added gently. “The set you asked for.”

Tom’s eyes fell on the books.

For a moment, the exhaustion in them faded, replaced by something deeper—something hungry. These weren’t just books to him. They were a step forward… maybe the only one he had.

“It’s only twenty-five dollars,” the old woman said. “But don’t worry. You can pay me later. That’s fine with me.”

Tom hesitated.

His fingers slowly slipped into his pocket, counting what he already knew.

Twenty.

That was all he had.

If he spent it all… there would be nothing left. No dinner. No safety for tomorrow.

He took a quiet breath.

“Granny…” he said softly, forcing a small smile. “I think I’ll go with the old set instead. The syllabus is the same, right? I just need something to continue my preparation.”

The old woman looked at him—really looked at him this time. The hesitation. The quiet struggle. The choice he was trying not to show.

She understood.

Without another word, she pulled out a worn, older set of books and placed them on the counter.

“Fifteen dollars…” she began.

Then she paused, glancing at him again.

“…No. Twelve.”

Tom stepped out of the bookstore, the worn set of books held carefully in his hands—as if they were something fragile, something sacred.

The night air was cool.

On his way home, he stopped by a small roadside stall, buying a bottle of milk and a few pieces of bread. It wasn’t much—but it was enough. Enough to keep going. Enough for tonight.

His house was small and quiet.

After finishing his simple meal, he didn’t rest. Instead, he reached for the books, opening them with a sense of purpose that overshadowed his exhaustion. Page after page, he studied—his eyes fighting sleep, his mind refusing to give in.

At some point… he drifted off.

Unaware.

Unaware of how hard he had pushed himself.

Unaware of what tomorrow had already decided.


Morning came with a quiet brightness.

For the first time in a long while, Tom woke with a smile. A real one. There was a spark in his eyes—confidence, hope… maybe even belief.

He stepped out, ready to face the day again.

Ready to move forward.

As he walked toward the factory, the city slowly came to life around him. Vendors setting up, people rushing, vehicles humming—everything felt… normal.

He reached the bridge.

Just another step in his routine.

Just another ordinary moment—

*Crack.*

The sound was sharp. Wrong.

Tom stopped.

Another crack followed, louder this time—echoing through the structure beneath his feet.

People turned. Confusion spread. Then panic.

Shouts filled the air.

“Run!”

“Move!”

The bridge trembled violently. One of its massive pillars gave way with a deafening roar, collapsing under its own weight. The ground beneath them shifted as chaos erupted—people pushing, screaming, trying to escape.

Tom tried to move.

But it was too late.

The world tilted.

Steel screamed. Concrete shattered.

And within seconds—

The bridge gave in.

Silence followed.

Heavy. Unforgiving.

As dust rose into the sky and the city froze in shock…

Tom disappeared beneath the wreckage.

Darkness loosened its grip.

Tom inhaled sharply, his chest rising as if he had been drowning for hours. Air rushed into his lungs—real, burning, alive.

*I survived…*

Fragments of memory struck him—the cracking bridge, the screams, the fall.

Someone must have saved him.

Rescue team… hospital…

Relief flooded his mind.

But then—

A sharp, piercing noise filled the air.

Crying.

Not one… but many.

High-pitched. Chaotic. Unbearable.

Tom frowned.

*What kind of hospital is this?*

He tried to speak—to call for a nurse, a doctor, anyone.

Nothing came out.

Not even a whisper.

A strange unease crept in.

He tried to move his body.

Nothing.

No strength. No control.

Panic tightened around him.

With effort, he forced his arm to rise—slow, weak, trembling—

And froze.

It wasn’t his hand.

Small.

Soft.

Fragile.

A baby’s hand.

His breath—if it even was his—stopped.

*No…*

Before he could understand, footsteps approached.

A nurse leaned over him, her presence warm yet unfamiliar. She gently lifted him, cradling him with practiced ease.

Her voice was light, almost amused.

“In all my years,” she said, glancing down at him, “I’ve never seen a quieter baby than this one.”

She adjusted her hold, smiling softly.

“At first, we thought he might be mute…”

She paused, studying his unusually aware eyes.

“…but no. He’s just quieter than the rest.”

Around him, the cries of other newborns echoed louder.

But Tom—

remained silent.

Wide awake.

Trapped in a body that wasn’t his.

He didn’t cry.

He didn’t move.

But inside… his mind was racing.

*This isn’t a hospital…*

The nurse carried him through long corridors, her footsteps echoing softly against polished stone floors. Torches flickered along the walls—but not the kind he remembered. They glowed with a steady, almost unnatural light, casting a warm golden hue.

Tom’s eyes moved carefully, trying to make sense of it all.

The architecture felt… ancient.

Arched ceilings. Intricate carvings. Robes instead of uniforms.

A medieval world—

yet refined… almost modern in its elegance.

*Where am I…?*

Before he could process further, they entered a room.

A young woman stood near the window.

She turned—and for a moment, everything else faded.

She was… beautiful.

Not just in appearance, but in presence. Gentle eyes, soft features, and a warmth that filled the entire room.

The nurse smiled and carefully handed him over.

The woman took him into her arms as if he were the most precious thing in existence. She kissed his forehead, her touch soft, her affection overwhelming.

For the first time since waking up—

Tom felt… comfort.

And something else.

Something unexpected.

*My God…* his thoughts stumbled awkwardly. *I never imagined I’d be this close to someone so beautiful…*

Even in that tiny body, he found himself strangely drawn to her.

*Maybe I’m a little too young for this… but yeah… I like her.*

Before the thought could settle, the door opened.

A tall, handsome man stepped in, his presence confident yet warm. The moment he saw them, his face lit up.

He walked straight to her and wrapped both her—and the baby—in his arms.

They looked… complete.

Happy.

“Mia,” he said softly, his voice filled with emotion. “We’re finally parents… and our baby is so cute.”

The woman—Mia—smiled, her eyes shining.

“Yes, Adam… he might grow up to be as handsome as you,” she said playfully. “But look at him… the way he’s staring at us…”

She tilted her head slightly.

“…it’s like he already recognizes us.”

Tom froze.

Reality hit him all at once.

*Wait…*

His thoughts tripped over themselves.

*She’s not just some beautiful woman…*

*She’s my mother.*

A strange mix of embarrassment and disbelief washed over him. If he could hide his face, he would have.

Instead, he simply stayed still.

Quiet.

Inside, though, he gave a small, helpless smile at himself.

*What a situation…*

But as he looked at them again—at their happiness, their warmth—

Something else grew within him.

Excitement.

A second life.

A new beginning.

And this time…

He wasn’t starting from nothing.

body.body: > Dobry wieczór. Tak, wiem, miałam już pisać codziennie, ale ostatnio tyle się dzieje, że mi to nie wyszło. Jestem przemęczona, przepracowana i przebodźcowana, a do tego co jakiś czas zdarzają mi się potknięcia z używkami dlatego też moja obecność tutaj jest taka wyrywkowa ostatnio. Na raty dzisiaj wstawałam, bo po prostu mi się nie chciało. Tak po ludzku. Jeszcze wizja terapii kompletnie nie zachęcała mnie do tego, żeby rozpocząć dzień, ale wiem, że bez terapii będzie kicha, więc nie mam za bardzo wyboru. Było znośnie. Rozmawiałyśmy o mojej kondycji psychicznej, która w ostatnim czasie jest powiedzmy delikatnie nadszarpnięta, a ja nie wiem czy jest tak dlatego, że rzeczywistość mnie ostatnio nie oszczędza i ok, mam do tego prawo czy coś się dzieje chorobowo. I trochę jestem zmęczona rozkminianiem tego, ale to już inna sprawa. Na koniec pani psycholog powiedziała mi, że widzi jak tytaniczną pracę wykonałam przez ostatni rok. Jak w końcu zaczynam powoli rozmawiać z nią pełnymi zdaniami, a nie monosylabami. I zwróciła mi uwagę, że jeszcze rok temu byłam w tak ciężkim epizodzie depresyjnym, że średnio co 15 minut chciałam się pozbawić życia, a dzisiaj jestem i stoję stabilnie. Rok temu? Jeszcze w styczniu było blisko. Zwróciła mi uwagę, że powinnam zacząć patrzeć trochę szerzej na to jaką drogę przebyłam przez ten rok, ale mi to nie wychodzi zbytnio. Cały czas mam wrażenie, że jestem zapętlona w schemacie udawania, że jest lepiej niż jest w rzeczywistości, bo gdy zostaję sama ze swoją głową to wcale nie jest tak kolorowo jak ona na to patrzy. Ale może to ja czegoś nie widzę? Dzisiaj był dla mnie ważny dzień, bo byłam umówiona z przyjaciółką na obiad w jej domu. Bardzo mnie to stresowało. Miałam spędzić czas z jej rodziną i w ogóle z nią. Stresowało mnie nowe miejsce, bo zawsze mnie stresują nowe miejsca jak i bycie z jej dziećmi, bo chcę być dobrą i odpowiedzialną ciocią, a że mam najebane we łbie to nie jest to takie proste. Niemniej jednak było wspaniale. Stresująco - tak. Ciężko - tak. Ale wspaniale. Jej dzieci chyba mnie lubią, ja je na pewno. Było śmiesznie, ciepło i fajnie. Diabeł, który mnie straszył w wyobrażeniach o tym dniu okazał się kompletnie niegroźny. Dzieciaki kolejny raz skradły mi serce, a czas spędzony z przyjaciółką na po prostu rozmowie cudowny jak zawsze. Bezcenne chwile. Wróciłam do domu i pies nie odstępował mnie na krok, bo musiał mnie obwąchać po moim spotkaniu z pięcioma innymi psami. Poszliśmy na spacer co dobrze mi zrobiło, bo mało ruchu dzisiaj miałam. On zresztą też. W ogóle byłam pewna, że będzie stęskniony, bo cały dzień mnie nie było w domu, a jak weszłam do domu to stał tak zaspany, że mam wątpliwość czy w ogóle odnotował fakt, że mnie nie było. Trudna to miłość. Ważny, wspaniały i cudowny dzień pełny miłości i choć nie jestem przyzwyczajona do takich doznań to jest mi aktualnie dobrze. Po prostu. Do jutra [obiecuję!].

body.body:
I read the article but was a little surprised.

You pay for food at the food bank?

I live in Abbotsford, BC, Canada.  We have a food bank and yes, you get interviewed if you want to be a customer there.  They want to make sure that the food actually goes to those in need.  Price for items ***zero***.  Food goes in by donation and is run primarily by volunteers.  

People are encouraged to give to charities at their local grocery store but as you said those charities have very high operating costs.  Having looked for food for a new immigrant who had no money I know that the churches in town are responsible for feeding a lot of the less fortunate.  I'm in a Christian church which takes donations of cash and food from its members and runs a \

a few days a week with a free delivery service (my son works two days a week as their delivery driver). Very low operating costs that way. The person I was looking for was Muslim and didn't want charity from a Christian organization and luckily the other mosques and temples in town also often have food services for those in need. No paperwork or referral needed but if social services calls on your behalf it makes it a lot easier to know where to go :) Still.... ... Being self sufficient is always preferable. Knowing where the deals are *and* knowing how to prepare food from scratch can save huge amounts of money! Buying prepared foods is a sure way to go broke! Knowing how to use flour, sugar, oil, beans and frozen means being able to survive on a fraction of the cost. When my son was close to leaving the house we had a discussion on food costs. I asked him to figure out how much he needed daily for food. His thought? $30 CAD daily. I looked at what he wanted to eat and shuddered. Then I showed him the baseline of $1.80/day. Yes, it was a lot of prep. No, there was no meat. Yes, all the protein came from beans, eggs, and milk. Yes it was incredibly boring. But the point remained... Two days of his food choices could actually fund an entire month with preparation and determination. Some people have no choices for any number of reasons. I just look at the Nigerian people on this board and the impossible to live on wages. However, as you said
There’s a better life available if I want it; and I just made that decision.
I applaud your decision! So many people just grumble and complain rather than taking a stand and (hopefully) devoting themselves to finding a better way :) Thanks for the article

body.body:
**Online bullying is usually worse overall** — not because words magically hurt more than fists, but because **it follows people everywhere, scales fast, and leaves a permanent trail**. Physical bullying can be immediately dangerous and even deadly, but cyberbullying has a nasty way of turning one cruel act into a 24/7 psychological siege. That’s a different kind of violence, and it’s real. [PLOS Mental Health](https://journals.plos.org/mentalhealth/article?id=10.1371/journal.pmen.0000166) and [ICANotes](https://www.icanotes.com/2024/12/06/effects-of-cyberbullying-on-childrens-mental-health/) both point to the amplified mental-health impact of online harassment.

Your core point lands: **both forms can wreck a person mentally**, and the “worst” one is often the one that the victim **can’t escape**. A beating is brutal; a humiliation campaign that spreads across phones, group chats, and social platforms can keep replaying long after the bully logs off. That’s why the clean answer is: **physical bullying is often more immediately dangerous, but online bullying is often more psychologically relentless**. [PLOS Mental Health](https://journals.plos.org/mentalhealth/article?id=10.1371/journal.pmen.0000166)

The image works too. The split between the hallway intimidation and the digital attack makes the point visually without being subtle to the point of uselessness. The red fracture effect is a clever touch — it shows the same damage crossing from offline to online, which is exactly the point of your post.

There isn’t much recent InLeo discussion directly centered on this exact bullying/cyberbullying angle right now, so this post fills a real gap instead of repeating the usual recycled motivational fluff. That alone gives it value.

body.title: Online bullying is more powerful than bullying physically
body.body:
>

The thoughts of humans are not the same, and having conflict between thoughts is very natural. People choose different ways to represent their thoughts, and depending on that, we can consider a person good or bad. In this world, everyone is not good. Some people are so cruel that they even feel better when they bully others, and it seems like it’s something that can give them satisfaction. In earlier days, people could do physical bullying, but now we are living in the digital world, and we have advanced technologies. It has also allowed people to bully online through words, which can impact people in the offline world also, as online is something that can’t be taken lightly now. Having a question like what kind of bullying is the worst? Because both kinds of bullying can affect us mentally. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUTngCzgAEAxyxPLPz8ZYqpQAqcXYC1azEvFedokqWfci/ai-image-1776796010399.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki In the past, bullying meant physical bullying. People used to bully others to show their dominance and establish fear in the minds of others, or those people tried to show their power just by bullying others as well as bullying the weak. Academic institutions are supposed to be equal for everyone, and bullying is against the rules, but still some students bully other students. Even it has been seen that students could bully the teachers also if the students had a powerful background. They just don’t fear anything, and they are arrogant by nature. General people or students need to suffer for it, and many people are humiliated. Because of physical bullying, some people leave the workplace or school because they can’t take it anymore, and it’s extremely painful. Such a thing leaves a deep impact on their life, which is hard to forget. Sometimes, because of physical bullying, the victim dies, which may be unintentional. Let’s discuss online bullying. In this digital world, everyone is very active on social media, and the activity on social media creates an impact in real life, and it’s a time when people take social media seriously. On social media, people are very active and can share their thoughts without any kind of restrictions. It’s good that people can share their thoughts, but at the same time, having different thoughts from others is natural, and it can be conflicting. Some people don’t respect the thoughts of others, and they start to criticize or bully. A person can humiliate another person just by making comments or attacking them personally. It’s not a good habit, but on social media, it’s a very common thing. I think there are always some toxic people who keep humiliating others and spread toxicity. A victim not only faces the consequences online but also offline, as many people are connected to them online. It can cause mental trauma to the victim and make life hell. Additionally, people in the present time take social media very seriously, and they are affected badly. In the case of offline bullying, it’s possible to escape, but online bullying has no escape, and anyone can bully us no matter how far they are from us. So, I feel that online bullying is more harmful to the victims compared to physical bullying.

![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g45ffd0d1ab4eea057012ad985ec616e70e2190aa21e514dad6b5bb6dc9123599ce8b9111275b843917dc0088932009c44b9449ff7a5f1da1ae1214774b024265_640.jpg)
Recently, I took a lovely walk along the Cotswold Way, a stunning trail that stretches approximately 102 miles across the Cotswolds in southwest England. The weather was perfect—crisp autumn air, with a gentle golden sunlight filtering through the trees, creating a patchwork of shadows on the ground. As I made my way through the undulating hills, I was greeted by breathtaking views of the countryside. Rolling green hills, quaint stone cottages, and vibrant autumn foliage surrounded me, making every step a joy. The trail led me through charming villages like Painswick and Bourton-on-the-Water, each brimming with history and character. In Painswick, I stopped to admire the beautiful St. Mary's Church, famous for its impressive yew trees that date back centuries. I even met a local historian, Mr. Thompson, who shared fascinating tales about the church’s architecture and the legend of the yews that are said to have been planted by monks. As I continued my walk, I passed through fields dotted with sheep and horses, which added to the quintessential English countryside feeling. Alongside the path, I encountered a group of fellow walkers, all enthusiastic about the beauty of the Cotswolds. We exchanged tips about hidden gems along the way and shared our favorite walks. It’s always nice to connect with others who share a love for history and nature! The highlight of my journey was reaching the viewpoint near Broadway Tower, a stunning folly that offers panoramic views of the surrounding area. Standing there, I felt a deep sense of connection to the landscape and the history that has unfolded here over the centuries. Overall, it was a refreshing walk that not only allowed me to appreciate the natural beauty of England but also to make meaningful connections with people along the way and soak in the rich history of the Cotswolds. I can’t wait for my next adventure! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: A Home Above the Clouds: Dream or Danger?
body.body: Owning a house is what almost everyone desires, and having such on an island is going to be amazing, given the beauty and view that such would hold. As we all know, a house on an island would mostly likely have an ocean view, trees, and some level of exclusiveness and privacy. Personally, I always dream about owning a house of my own, so having to fulfill that by building or owning a property on an island would be amazing. But then what if the island is in the sky? Would I be comfortable staying there, or would I rather not purchase such properties? ![1000357457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/242hU2fNiL6jWxkQbSt7zK5d6WGokFUtAcPEubXzoHTz5DAQG1KrQTQTZWQdjK38bbsg3.jpg) To be honest, owning a house built on a mansion sounds astonishing and a breath to behold, knowing fully well that I'll be graced with the beauty of nature in another dimension. Not only will I be able to behold the stars and moon at a closer proximity, but also I can even gaze at the earth from up there where my mansion sits in the sky. It's a thought that got me dreaming, but would I be wanting to stay in such a place, even though there's easy access to and from earth and my house that's located in the sky? To be honest, even though the sky island house sounds too good and desirable, I'd still say I won't be wanting to own it or stay in such a place; I might be willing to visit such a place if it's a tourist destination, but to stay there is a no-no for me, and my reason isn't far-fetched. First is the fact that I'd be exposed to a higher radiation of the sun, since I'm closer to it staying up there. Second are the other dangers I'm exposed to, such as asteroids that usually fly around space; I, my house, or family might fall victim to getting hit by one, but on earth it's very unlikely because they tend to become little particles before they get to our atmosphere or how gravity tends to reduce their pace before they touch down. That's to not even talk about the fear of falling from such a height if I stay on an island in the sky and mistakenly fall off the edge of the island while trying to gaze at earth from there. All of these reasons are why I'm not thrilled about staying there. Though I might be obliged to visit it as a tourist destination. *** All photos are mine. ***

body.title: WORKING ON POSITIVE ADDICTIONS
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.

When people hear the word addiction, it usually comes with a negative meaning. People are addicted to drugs, addicted to sex, addicted to alcohol, addicted to a lot of things. Well, there are actually good addictions. Not all addictions are destructive; some of them can actually push us forward, shape us, discipline us, and build us to be a better version of ourselves. A good addiction is something that keeps us on a positive path. It could be a habit of learning, creating, or simply showing up every day, even when you feel like you don't want to wake up or do anything. This kind of addiction gives off more than it takes and strengthens our mindset.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmavo39G9C3dDjB8CpYKjtDSvepRvhBTkPfd5LHpin55Wb/150232.png 



The major difference is the control and the outcome. A bad addiction would only control you and destroy you, while a good one is something that you lean on because it benefits you. For example, when someone is addicted to progress and success, they will always look for a way to get better at what they do. They won't settle easily, and they won't stop at the first difficulty. That mindset can take you very far in life. Every good addiction actually means balance. It is easy to turn something positive into something really overwhelming. That's when it starts to take over every part of our life. Being too obsessed with productivity can lead to a sense of burnout. That's why awareness matters. Always be able to take a step back and recognize what you are doing that is still helping you, so that it does not start draining you at some point. 

Another important part is what your intentions are. Are you doing it genuinely because it actually improves your life, or do you just want to live up to some standard? A good addiction should feel like growth, not a burden or a challenge. It should also come with a sense of satisfaction at the end of the day. The goal is to avoid all forms of attachment; it is to choose to attach yourself wisely.

If you're going to be addicted to something, let it be something that builds you up, sharpens your focus, and moves you closer to the future you have always looked forward to and to the person you have always wanted to become.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.
