body.title: Empezar de Nuevo / New Beginnings
body.body:
![12674.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/berlissan/23wCJET81jJhQcxnPTdnerwzB2jVs8xVcJRQMPcw9diwBZdJhChBBMCyxt23MQMEL3RCw.jpg)


Se dice que en algún momento volvemos al lugar donde fuimos felices, y para mí esta plataforma representa precisamente eso. Dejé de escribir por muchos motivos, al igual que dejé de pintar. Soy una mujer apasionada; creo que quienes me siguen aquí ya lo saben: pinto y escribo por pura pasión. Sin embargo, cuando dejas que ese fuego se apague, todo muere.

​Este es un lugar donde siempre me sentí querida y, sobre todo, escuchada. Fue mi puerta a un mundo completamente nuevo, maravilloso y desconocido. En aquel entonces, ignoraba lo que era la Web 3.0, la tecnología blockchain o un NFT; no obstante, fue increíble descubrir estas herramientas y conocer a las personas maravillosas que habitan este espacio.

​Lamentablemente, no puedo usar mi cuenta anterior porque perdí mis claves de acceso y la frase semilla. Aunque intento recuperarla, nunca está de más empezar desde cero. Para quienes no me conocen, mi nombre es Berlis Sanoja; soy artista digital y hoy prefiero centrarme en lo que me mueve el alma: leer y redactar reflexiones.
​Me dedico a observar el mundo y analizar la conducta humana, no para emitir juicios, sino para aprender. Soy un ser que busca evolucionar y trascender. Hoy decido presentarme nuevamente para retomar las pasiones que me hacen feliz: la escritura y la pintura. Espero compartir contenido que les agrade, los nutra y sea gratificante para todos.

​¡Nos veremos pronto! Un placer saludarlos.


## **English**

![12674.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/berlissan/23wCJET81jJhQcxnPTdnerwzB2jVs8xVcJRQMPcw9diwBZdJhChBBMCyxt23MQMEL3RCw.jpg)

They say that, eventually, we return to the places where we were once happy, and for me, this platform is exactly that. I stopped writing for many reasons, just as I stopped painting. I am a passionate woman; I believe those who follow me here already know that: I paint and write out of pure passion. However, when you let that fire go out, everything else withers away.

This is a place where I have always felt cherished and, above all, heard. It was my gateway to a completely new, wonderful, and unknown world. Back then, I knew nothing about Web 3.0, blockchain technology, or NFTs; nevertheless, it was incredible to discover these tools and meet the wonderful people within this space.
Unfortunately, I cannot use my previous account because I lost my access keys and seed phrase. Although I am trying to recover it, it is never a bad thing to start from scratch. For those who don't know me, my name is Berlis Sanoja; I am a digital artist, and today I prefer to focus on what moves my soul: reading and writing reflections.

I dedicate myself to observing the world and analyzing human behavior—not to pass judgment, but to learn. I am a being seeking to evolve and transcend. Today, I’ve decided to introduce myself once again to reclaim the passions that make me happy: writing and painting. I hope to share content that you enjoy, that nourishes you, and that is rewarding for everyone.

See you soon! It’s a pleasure to greet you all.

body.title: NORDIC WATERFRONT ARCHITECTURE
body.body:
![Kopia – Whispers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xLBF2yBWc9DCT2WqQHg3caZUhNHqPRAZZe67U2gqybVUWp6ZRQ6pCGvHvQeCDp4LgfJ.jpg)


I was actually supposed to write this post yesterday, but after arriving at the parking lot around 4 PM, I started to feel tired and sleepy. So I decided to take a short nap for about half an hour. When I opened my eyes after that “half hour,” it turned out it was already 9:30 PM. 😁 At that point there was nothing left for me to do but wash up and go back to sleep. And so my thoughts from yesterday are being shared today.

>Tego posta miałam tak właściwie pisać wczoraj, jednak po przybyciu na parking po godzinie 16:00 poczułam zmęczenie i senność. Postanowiłam zatem przespać się pół godzinki. Jak otworzyłam oczy po pół godzinie, okazało się, że jest już 21:30. 😁 Nie pozostało zatem mi nic innego, jak umyć się i iść dalej spać. Tym sposobem moje wczorajsze myśli zostaną przekazane dzisiaj.

About two weeks ago my truck wheels took me to Norway. It’s not a destination I visit often, so I was even more excited when I saw that I got this assignment. Especially since this route is somewhat combined with a bit of a trip, you could say—because on the way back we sail to Germany, not to Denmark like in that direction. So the return ferry takes 20 hours and on board we have a truly full package of amenities.

However today I won’t be writing about the ferry itself, but about what I managed to see before boarding it. The ferry was departing at 2 PM from Oslo. That day I arrived at the port before 10 AM. From what I found out, boarding started at 12 PM, which meant I had two hours to go for a walk. Luckily for me, there was already plenty to see right next to the ferry.

>Jakieś dwa tygodnie temu moje koła ciężarówki pognały mnie do Norwegii. Nie jest to kierunek często odwiedzany przeze mnie, dlatego tym bardziej ucieszyłam się, jak zobaczyłam, że wpadło mi takie zlecenie. Tym bardziej, że trasa ta jest połączona trochę z wycieczką, można powiedzieć, gdyż na powrocie płyniemy do Niemiec, a nie do Danii, jak ma to miejsce w tamtym kierunku. Zatem prom powrotny trwa 20 godzin, a na promie mamy istny \

. Nie będę jednak dzisiaj pisała o samym promie, a o tym, co udało mi się zobaczyć, zanim na niego weszłam. Prom wypływał o godzinie 14:00 z Oslo. W porcie byłam tego dnia przed godziną 10:00. Z tego, co udało mi się dowiedzieć, na prom wpuszczali od godziny 12:00, a to oznaczało, że mam dwie godziny czasu, aby sobie pójść na spacer. Na moje szczęście tuż przy promie jest już co oglądać.

One of the first sights I had the chance to see in the port was a huge ship docked at the harbor. As it later turned out, it was a cruise ship belonging to a Dutch company. Its size was truly impressive. Interestingly, the ship I sailed on from Oslo to Germany was of a similar size.

>Jednym z pierwszych widoków, które było mi dane zobaczyć w porcie, był ogromny statek, zacumowany statek. Jak się później okazało, jest to wycieczkowy statek należący do holenderskiej firmy. Jego rozmiar naprawdę robił wrażenie. Swoją drogą, statek, którym ja płynęłam z Oslo do Niemiec, był podobnych rozmiarów.


![20260410_093106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/2432BDs3Ji919Cz92VxhcJRv4hmcHoLh7Nn6q96EXYvD7NUZdso2oV7AgP5hm7r9ekhLn.jpg)

Right next to the ship along the waterfront, there was also a view of Norwegian buildings. These were not the typical Norwegian houses we usually see on postcards. Instead, it was more of a modern, European-style architecture, while still maintaining a bit of the Norwegian atmosphere. To be honest I didn’t look too closely at what kind of buildings they were exactly, but they seemed to be apartment buildings or office buildings. Now I also understand why some people say that Oslo is not Norway. 😉

>Tuż obok statku, nad samą wodą, rozpościerał się również krajobraz norweskich budynków. Nie są to typowe domki norweskie, jakie zazwyczaj znamy z pocztówek. Mamy tutaj bardziej do czynienia z architekturą, która jest bardziej nowoczesna i europejska, zachowując jednak również trochę norweskiego klimatu. Szczerze mówiąc, nie przyglądałam się za bardzo, jakie to są dokładnie budynki, jednak wyglądały na jakieś apartamentowce tudzież biurowce. Teraz już też rozumiem, dlaczego niektórzy twierdzą, że Oslo to nie Norwegia. 😉


![20260410_093331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/241tSxsvzhqSDe4Az58XkUQ3ZNRDJY6jDvBJiwU1o6q6gGiyKKr15DFry9wMWaDsngTq3.jpg)

![20260410_093317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23z7Bd4SpqDWN5nrD8xcjMTY186kfys6Ei5XGzAEUkFLiY6DyvDj8JxTvM65bisv4TqAC.jpg)

![20260410_093042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zGY94AFvVM8jsEKdqy2xA9W59q9s4kaNo4SxpNYAdN1CPPZaqWyJ8bb3goktMLKA9LC.jpg)

Norwegian architecture is not particularly complex. The buildings are rather simple, but they also appear well thought out. You can see that Norwegians don’t overcomplicate things and focus mainly on simplicity and functionality. Most buildings have large windows, bright facades and open spaces. These buildings do not dominate the landscape, but instead fit nicely into the surroundings and blend well with the water.

>Norweska architektura nie należy do skomplikowanych. Budynki raczej są proste, ale wyglądają też na przemyślane. Widać, że Norwegowie nie kombinują i stawiają przede wszystkim na prostotę i funkcjonalność. Większość budynków posiada duże okna, jasne elewacje i otwarte przestrzenie. Budynki te raczej nie dominują krajobrazy, a ładnie wpisują się w otoczenie, pasują do wody.


![20260410_093138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zbMuA9cgv7vEAGUBifMJGcngPWSW5SCkfwfkgFQnJnborSs7k27eapsA8UH3cmGc4me.jpg)

![20260410_093051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ycyGfXYcBhDSygg3GtrK5XHTYRUXVhnLw9UAJxKJJiWcNwEPkNp4oHch6mYzPLENBba.jpg)


At times I had the impression that there was complete chaos. On one side modern buildings, on the other brick architecture, along with piers, boats, walkways, and various elements. Everything seemed as if it had no clear plan. However, when you look at it more closely, you simply see a city that lives and develops in layers. Norwegians build in a way that is comfortable for living, not necessarily to make everything look perfectly aligned.

>Momentami miałam wrażenie, że panuje tam jeden wielki chaos. Z jednej strony nowoczesne budynki, z drugiej strony ceglana zabudowa, do tego pomosty, łódki, przejścia, dekoracje. Wszystko wyglądało tak, jakby nie miało żadnego planu. Jeśli jednak przyjrzeć się temu uważniej, widać po prostu miasto, które żyje i rozwija się warstwami. Norwegowie budują tak, żeby było wygodnie do życia, a niekoniecznie, żeby wyglądało to \

.

![20260410_093444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/244KJkozHACaiyAvkbt7oT3LNgavU33PYb7TdjffZSbyyCnZVPQ2rzAvCYsqU54bY9JbU.jpg)


![20260410_093430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/244UfM6aXfXoNYERzRmEsAX7QXGCtpDks97n2LwCnJnZ4MRpMxkeENmyvxeHdYnoSG6QM.jpg)

Oslo is, of course, a city strongly connected to water. Outside the tourist season, it’s not as visible, as almost all the boats are put away. I can only imagine how beautifully they blend into the urban landscape during the peak season.

>Oslo to oczywiście miasto silnie związane z wodą. Poza sezonem turystycznym nie widać tego aż tak bardzo, gdyż prawie wszystkie łódki są pochowane. Mogę sobie jedynie wyobrażać, jak pięknie one komponują się w krajobraz miejski w szczycie sezonowym.

![20260410_093801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zGVmKCXPmRWWypoKpVf3MuXqJb8Ckcsgj8YWfLJ67N9wca6WB5hoJAMojyLNbWqhcz3.jpg)


![20260410_093722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/244e859z4obMaM16cPEicybg4ezCBL6ze7ZcJJws2W8Zxgdybe5btHCrN7EbA6v9jEBe3.jpg)

From my short trip to Norway I brought back a mug. This time I managed to find a souvenir shop. It’s a small tradition of mine that from every country I reach by truck, I bring back a mug. Contrary to what it may seem, it’s not that easy. In some countries you can easily buy mugs at gas stations, but in most places, it’s not possible. On top of that it has to have the name of the country, not the city. 😁 And believe me it’s not as easy as it sounds. At some point, I thought that my journey with the truck would end when I collected mugs from every country in Europe. And honestly, for now, I’m in no rush to complete that collection. 😉

>Z mojej krótkiej wycieczki po Norwegii przywiozłam sobie kubek. Tym razem udało się znaleźć sklep z suwenirami. Taką moją małą tradycją jest, iż z każdego kraju, do którego docieram ciężarówką, przywożę sobie kubek. Wbrew pozorom wcale nie jest to takie łatwe zadanie. W niektórych krajach bez problemu można kupić kubki na stacjach benzynowych, jednak w większości krajów nie jest to możliwe. Dodatkowo zadanie utrudnia fakt, iż na kubku nie może być nazwa miasta, a musi być nazwa kraju. 😁 A i uwierzcie mi, nie jest to wcale takie łatwe zadanie, jakby się mogło wydawać. Kiedyś sobie pomyślałam, że moja przygoda z ciężarówką skończy się wtedy, gdy uzbieram kubki z każdego w kraju w Europie. I szczerze mówiąc, na razie nie śpieszy mi się, aby je wszystkie skompletować. 😉


![20260410_115152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xKtBtVEKW8Mtoczf2YZqnTeFN7pRAVEsy9M3YLThkL3MofaNQ5LPY9YEZwtvKZq4iEt.jpg)

body.title: Ready or Not (2019) - Rich People Go Totally Psychotic - REVIEW
body.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/wxwPFL2c/Ready-or-Not-(2019)-REVIEW-000.gif

[Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png

Ready or Not (2019) sits in this very specific sweet spot where you realize about fifteen minutes in, that the movie is not interested in being just one thing and that is both the rarest quality in genre and the thing most studios are too scared to actually commit to, after watching Ready or Not 2 I decided to throw it back and watch the first one too, because pulling off a genuine hybrid where you are laughing out loud and then immediately covering your mouth because something horrible just happened requires everybody on screen to be completely locked in on the same target, just look at the scene I put on the blog post cover, you saw the multiple body explosions at the end right?. We got Grace, played by Samara Weaving, is marrying into the Le Domas family on the same night she discovers that this clan of board game millionaires has a blood ritual tradition that requires new members to draw a random card and play whatever game it says at midnight, and the card she pulls is the one card in the deck that means the entire family has to hunt her down and kill her before sunrise or some ancient deal with a guy named Mr Le Bail comes due in the most catastrophic way possible for all of them. She spends her wedding night running through a massive stone mansion in a ripped dress while her new relatives come after her armed with crossbows and axes and rifles, right from the starts when things start to get menacing you start to get that sense of fear and danger for poor Grace who had no idea what she was getting into, these are not competent satanists, these are wealthy idiots who are terrified of losing their money and their lives, who at the same time are very very incompetent at murder.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt7798634/
- Platform: [Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3)

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXFTfK.png
<div style=\

>Rottentomatoes Rating https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXF9MN.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3) Samara Weaving is the one who carries the movie the entire time and it was by design, if you have not been paying attention to her career before this then Ready or Not is the kind of performance that makes you immediately go back and check what else she has been in, because she carries every single scene on her back without it ever looking like she is working hard to do it. Her dark humor performance is perfect without ever undercutting the actual fear she is selling at the same time, how she basically transform across ninety minutes from a hopeful bride who just wants to be part of a family into a bloodied and furious survivor who is completely done trying to avoid rather to confront and choose violence as her last resource, not because the script hands her some big action hero moment to announce the shift but because she earns it incrementally you can feel it. The supporting cast around her is doing great work too, especially Andie MacDowell who is quietly threatening as the mother in a way that sneaks up that you expect it the least, and then there is the uncle who at one point hides in a bathroom watching a YouTube tutorial on how to load a crossbow because he has never actually used one before, which is the perfect piece of detail because it makes the whole murder family feel like real people who are mostly just rich and scared and out of their territory almost like they just have to be this way without any previous expirience. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXFLPe.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXFsVs.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3) The movie goes hard on the carnage and thats a great thing when its not the best part of it because the performance and drama is very high too, and there is a very specific type of dark comedy that works great with those gory moments but I have to be honest here, this is obvious that this movie is not for everyone, because the deaths are graphic and drawn out in ways that are simultaneously horrifying and absurd and the movie holds both of those at once without letting either one collapse. The pacing is also doing real work here because at ninety minutes this thing is tight and never feels like it is getting over stretch to just fill time gaps, there is no bloated second part where you start checking your watch or wanting to hit the fast forward button, every sequence has its own weight and keeping your attention exactly where the movie needs it, and that kind of discipline is something a lot of horror comedies just do not have or when they attempt to just fail at it, because they assume the concept alone is enough to carry them through. The production quality on the mansion location is impressive too, the whole place is lit with this mix of candlelight and deep shadow that gives it the right atmosphere without feeling like a haunted house movie or going full dark room that you are force to watch the thing on 4k because its just too dark, it does feel like a very expensive trap that was built specifically for someone wearing a white dress on her weeding night. https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXFzG7.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3) https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/22/uXFDp6.png [Source](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-b5393a64-e0af-4199-9888-69b93907d8b3) Where the movie does leave a little on the table is in the action department, because the poster and the marketing give you very specific images of Grace in full savage mode and the actual movie is more interested in keeping her in a reactive and dark humor like survival mode for most part of the movie, which works fine but does make you feel the gap between what you expected and what you actually got when you think about it afterward. There are some scenes that are very cliche too and if you are watching movies constantly you can tell this are been advertise from very long distance so its too predictable in some occasions, certain surprises a little too clearly for anyone paying close attention to the details, and while that is not a problem it does take off from the experience in a couple of moments when the movie probably could have trusted you to be a little more patient because I think they do this kind of things to dumb it down and rush it too at the same time and crunch more content into the movie. It felt rushed towards the end like the script and actors were running out of gas, the classic until dawn survival situation, but the cast still made it watchable because even in the sequences where the script is being a little too obvious about where things are heading, the people on screen are making choices that are interesting enough to keep you in it. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png

> https://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png Compared to other genre movies playing the same dark comedy horror angle in that era, Ready or Not (2019) does something that most of them fail to do which is actually justify its entire setup from the start all the way through to the finish line without losing the thread because during the movie there are moments where it stops to take a small breath and even provides you context that doesnt make you feel disoriented, at the same time when the movies does this it doesnt feel like its trying to get too clever for its own good, and at the end everything tries to come together and it delivers in a way that is completely absurd and completely satisfying at the same time. Grace smoking a cigarette on the front steps covered in other people is one of those final images that you will still remember clearly at the end of the year because it earns everything it is asking you to feel right there in that moment, and not many movies with this kind of silly concept can actually pull that off, there is something about her laughing as the balance change on her favor feels so damn satisfying. This is a solid 8/10 for me and this is kinda bad for the sequel to be honest because then for those who watch them in order as usual feels like the sequel sux, it is the kind of movie that delivers on a genuinely crazy idea without ever getting too smug about how clever it thinks it is, and Samara Weaving has earn her bars either people see it or not because this performance absolutely demands that kind of recognition, totally recommend it. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://i.imgur.com/AbuDA6i.png

**Hello**
**Splinterlands Lovers !**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23tS2jcK9c3qoNsLEXTQHcFC3JZzoWfJ6WFCzUjmno4WS4E1jL1ZZEonHzQ1bkhjHvgay.png)

**Today, friends, I would like to share my experience in Splinterlands with you. I tried very hard today to reach Silver 1, but I was unable to do so. Eventually, I stopped playing battles altogether because—four separate times—I would lose and drop back down from a rank of 1580. This happened to me four times throughout the day. Consequently, I simply gave up on playing battles for a while. This kept happening because, as soon as I managed to climb up the ranks, I would immediately be matched against high-level players wielding high-level cards, causing my rank to plummet once again. However, I had firmly resolved that, come what may, I would reach a rank of 1600—that is, Silver 1—today. I did not lose heart; somehow or other, I finally managed to reach Silver 1 today. At one point today, I felt so discouraged that I thought I would stop playing battles entirely; but then, I motivated myself once again, and ultimately, I succeeded in reaching Silver 1.**


![Screenshot 2026-04-21 203348.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23tGVQSN3jpZT4kUzg8wHXCEmB8BzqsK3gCv1DVBKukg3dto36BEkxnPPngHM13gCDALr.png)

**I received some excellent rewards today in Silver I. These rewards have the potential to significantly boost the performance of my card collection. The reason is that, while I have received these specific cards as rewards before, I currently need to upgrade them to Level 3; therefore, I am actively accumulating these cards right now. Once I perform these upgrades, my card collection will become substantially stronger. At the moment, I am unable to compete in battles against enemies at Level 6 and beyond, as the opposing cards are extremely powerful—making it impossible for me to match them. However, by collecting the cards I am currently receiving as rewards—and subsequently upgrading them to increase their levels—I will be well-equipped to successfully tackle battles at Level 6 and higher. This will further solidify my rank and allow me to reach the Diamond League—a long-cherished dream of mine.**

**Conclusion**

**One valuable lesson I have learned here is that the faster you climb the ranks and unlock higher leagues, the more your earnings will grow. This is your opportunity to truly make a name for yourself within Splinterlands. I absolutely love collecting Splinterlands cards—primarily because they constitute your digital assets, and you should never overlook them. Back in 2021, when the value of every Splinterlands NFT skyrocketed, I was able to sell numerous cards that had previously been considered worthless. Therefore, I firmly believe that if we focus on collecting cards and strengthening our collection today, we can establish a substantial holding within Splinterlands in the future. This very goal is what will guide me toward success in the years to come.**

**Thank U**

body.title: Three Tune Tuesday - CAN
body.body:
## Hello, music lovers! 🎵  

On #threetunestuesday, I reflect on the music I listened to growing up, and I had access to. And when something reminds me of moments from my youth, I try to relive those memories through music. 

It rained yesterday, for the first time in two weeks. At first, it was just a light drizzle, but then it got heavier and heavier, and the wind picked up. It wasn’t too cold, but because of the dark, water-laden clouds, it was quite dark all day long. 
I watched through the window as raindrops hit the glass because of the wind, and a melody came to mind - a song by the band CAN. I played it right away.

Today, once again, along with other songs by this legendary band.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfe4kyWASZq2CHAnKrx8j54iPGhUFK9XpwxYY3Aggv6z/ttt87_can_logo.jpg)

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
For those of you who are not (yet) familiar with #threetunetuesday or #ttt - these are the tags you need to set when you post. 
It's a music initiative started by @ablaze, and with his words, the gist is as follows: 
>*Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs that I like to listen to, and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the reward.*  
 
<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

CAN was a German experimental rock band formed in 1968 in Cologne. They played krautrock—a mix of psychedelia, funk, jazz, electronica, avant-garde, and repetitive rhythms, often with improvised elements and influences from musique concrète.
 
Although they did not achieve great commercial success themselves, their approach to rhythm and sound inspired many later artists and genres such as post-punk, indie rock, post-rock, ambient, and electronic music. They were active until 1979, with occasional reunions in the 1980s and 1990s. During this time, they released 11 studio albums.

Here are some of their songs

## Can - She Brings The Rain 

Well, this is the song that popped into my head yesterday while I was watching the rain through the window. It’s one of their more melodic and, let’s say, more romantic songs. It was released on the 1970 album *Soundtracks*, a collection of various music written for films. This song is for the film 'Ein großer graublauer Vogel' (A Big Grey-Blue Bird) directed by Thomas Schamoni.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xiuuSoPphxI

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>

## CAN - Spoon

The song is from their third album, 'Ege Bamyasi', released in 1972. They wrote it as the theme song for the German TV crime series 'Das Messer', and it became their biggest commercial hit. It was also one of the first rock songs ever to feature an early drum machine.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=giHf9lkCMQ4

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center> 

## CAN - Mushroom

The song is from their second album, Tago Mago, released in 1971. It is often cited as a classic example of krautrock—a minimalist, hypnotic, repetitive, yet highly intense sound featuring undulating guitar lines, a marching drumbeat, improvisation, and a claustrophobic atmosphere.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-V0gcjFbm74

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
As a bonus, Vernal Equinox, an instrumental track from the 1975 album Landed, was performed on the BBC Live show Old Grey Whistle Test. Repetition, improvisation, and groove.

**Can - Vernal Equinox Live**
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I4nHr44vE9I

**Thank you for your attention!**

There’s a fantastic article by Daniel Dieppe in The Critic magazine that blows apart many of the smug conceits about universalism.  In his article Mr Dieppe points out that we are not the same, the morality of the West is not the same as morality elsewhere.  His article points out that concepts such as honesty, a dislike of nepotism, welcoming the stranger are unique to the West and are not found anywhere else.

Mr Dieppe said:

“The mistake Westerners make is to think most people share their Christian-enthused morality and psychology. In the last 15 years, that myth has been shattered. In 2005, 57 per cent of Americans optimistically thought democracy would “probably” be created in Iraq, and vainly spent over $2 trillion failing to create it. According to the most recent Democracy Index, Iraq ranks 126th out of 166 countries for democracy, while Afghanistan is dead last.”

Well said there.  Western morality which is based on Christian and Jewish foundation stones is a product of the West and not found elsewhere unless in former Western colonies that have kept up a Western style social, legal and political order.

Link

Original article by Mr Dieppe.

https://thecritic.co.uk/most-of-the-world-thinks-differently-to-us/

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | How do we overcome doubts and anxities
body.body:
>


https://youtu.be/3J4EEXHfIMo?si=fBUXE353wDU516n9



Our live is always filled with doubts and anxiety that most of the time it might even want to becloud us. Of course there are actually moments that life sometimes feels so heavy and it looks as if the future looks so unclear. I have been there before several times. But the good news is the fact that we are not there alone. 

One of the first thing we actually need to understand is the fact that God knows much more about our fears and we are not alone. He has not forgotten or leave us alone. 


In Philippians 4:6, the Bible says, *\

* You see, we need to come to a point whereby we learn that the answer to anxiety is prayer that is backed up in praise and Thanksgiving. Most of the time and based on my own personal experience, I have come to understand that doubt often comes when we actually focus more on our problems instead of focusing on God solving those problems. Look at the case of Peter, initially Peter was walking on the water as far as his gaze was on Jesus. But the moment his eyes shifted, he begin to sink. That is how many of us are. Sometimes we start strong in faith because at first our gaze is on Christ. But the moment we take our gaze away from God, we begin to fall because life begins to happen to us. The only solution to all these is us setting our eyes to God irrespective of the situation and problem.

body.title: The real companion
body.body:
Greetings!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4GcPjywGRo6xYa4RBokYBpwTcbYi7CoosPAZvSFm3FW/img_20260421_wa0033.jpg)


One thing that I love most in life and that's really being of help to me is friendship. Ever since I started to relate with people, my life has turned to a new leaf and I can boldly say that I'm a living testament to what a healthy relationship can be.

My relationship with Ayo, a friend of mine that I met at the university, was a blessing to me. The friendship between the two of us, took me from the scratch and later made me to be a cornerstone and a being to be reckoned with in the society. 

Although, I have had a series of relationships with different kinds and set of people before I met Ayo in my first year at the university.

But one thing I can say of my former relationships with others is that the relationship was a toxic one which was full of betrayals.

I could remember when Mayo, a friend of mine who I trusted with all my heart took all my money that I saved with him away.

Back then, I was working as a class teacher in one of the private school in our local community and as I was earning my money, I was also saving the money with Mayo, although not all the money, but part of the money and the purpose of me saving the money with him was to use it sponsor my university education.

There was a day I told him that, 

“Mayo, I'm sure you know the reason I'm saving with you.” “Yes, I know,” he responded. “Please, don't let me regret saving with you ooo,” I replied.

So, for someone who knows the purpose of my saving with him to duped me of my money and ran away with it, then, trust became a thing of the past for me and this was because, I couldn't fulfil my dream of going to the university that year even though I was giving admission to study medicine at the university that year 

This singular disappointment broke my heart, but even at that, I didn't relent on my effort to pursue my dream, but this time around, I made sure I did the savings by myself without the help of anybody or friend.

So, the following year, I sat for another UTME examination and I passed creditably well. I was happy because I passed and after the whole admission process, I was offered admission to study the same course I was offered previously which was medicine and surgery. 

However,  when I got to school, I decided to always maintain my lane and not to relate with anybody no matter who they were.

But there's this guy named Ayo who would not leave me alone until I became his friend. I tried all my best not to relate with him, but all to no avail.

I could remember me telling him to give me space, but even with that, Ayo was in the habit of filling the gap whenever I tried to create a space between us.

However, when I realized that Ayo would not give me the needed space, I decided to accommodate him, but I would not do that without telling him what has happened to me in the hands of a friend.

I told him about Mayo, who disappointed and betrayed my trust in him. When he had this, he was moved with emotions and he promised me saying, 

“Sam, I feel for you and with what you told me, I can feel your pain and at the same time, see the reason why you have been avoiding me all these while. However,  I promise you that our own relationship would not be like that.” “Okay, thanks for the understanding,” I said. “You are mostly welcome,” he replied.

After we have had the discussion, we became the best of friends and there's a day I asked him saying, 

“Ayo, who do you choose to be my friend when you have other options?” “Well, I don't know, it's just that ever since I set my eyes on you, I developed this kind interest in you and that's when you were even trying to avoid me, I refused to back off,” he replied. “Hmmm, I'm happy to know you,” I said.

So, both of us continued with our relationship up till the end of our medical program in the school and I can tell you that we both sharpened our academic lives and with that, we were able to come out flying in the result and as graduated with distinctions.

It's after school that I got to know who Ayo is. When we graduated, we both went our separate ways, but at least we still get in touch with each other twice a month with me having nothing to do as I have no connection to those who can connect me to get a better job.

But one day, someone from the ministry of health called me and asked me to come over to the federal ministry of health with my credentials and on getting there after when my credentials have been thoroughly checked, I was offered job in one of the federal medical centre and that the end to my joblessness and when I asked of who recommended me for the job, behold it's Ayo's father who happened to be the permanent secretary in the federal ministry of health.

I immediately called Ayo who on hearing my voice congratulated me and refused to receive my appreciation saying we are no more friends but family as we are now more than a friend. 

Thanks for reading. 

Picture sourced from metaAi.

To a colleague who became a sanctuary and a friend who dared to break the silence I had built around myself, this is a tribute. You listened without a gavel in your hand, offering a space where words could finally breathe without fear of judgment. As you move on to your next chapter, you leave behind a legacy of kindness and a silence that is no longer empty, but filled with the resonance of a true connection.

Anchors of Grace

Days were measured in shadows and walls of stone,
Over the silence where I had walked alone.
Never demanding, you waited for the word,
Notes of a story that finally could be heard.
Always a refuge where judgment had no place.

Mirroring kindness in every steady deed,
Ever a comfort in moments of hidden need.
Radiant spirit that calmed the rushing tide,
Lifting the burdens I used to keep inside.
Years may divide us, but echoes still remain,
A light that persists through the wind and through the rain.
Now as you journey toward a different shore,
Always remember the grace you held and bore.

body.title: It could well be a long, hot and disturbing summer in the United Kingdom.
body.body:
![protest-clipart-2018-24-2719881678-300x212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/245caVWjXNM3MV9Ho2ptfH8TgKp86bvAVcBfMwGo1B954v7fRzgrms2Bm8oapggvjqN9Y.jpg)



I try not to be some sort of Cassandra about Britain and its politics but looking around me it is something that I find increasingly difficult to avoid.  This is because there’s so many different crises happening at the same time that finding any sort of positive outlook is getting harder and harder.

I do believe, based on evidence from news stories and what people are saying, that Britain is approaching a crunch time, a period when lots of different problems coalesce into one big problem.  There’s economic, social, demographic, political and other problems that successive governments have just kicked down the road instead of tackling them.  Now these problems are becoming one big massive ‘omni-problem’ that seems like it is going to burst out at any minute like the monster from John Hurts abdomen in the movie ‘Alien’.

Nobody with any sense trusts the political classes, or the Civil Service, Britain’s nationalised healthcare system, or local government or the police or the judicial system or the charity sector.  All those entities have failed to live up to the high expectations that we once had of them.

It could be the case that Britain is in for a long hot summer of conflict.  What might set it off is anybodies guess but we are only in April and already we’ve got mobs on the streets of Epsom in Surrey facing down the police because the public there do not accept the explanations by the police for the slow progress of the investigation into an alleged gang rape.  Local people have swarmed onto the streets to surround hotels and other accommodations that they believe are housing Dinghy Invaders because they believe that said Dinghy Invaders housed in the town are behind the gang rape allegation.  As I said in a previous article on the Epsom situation, there might be a whole host of legitimate reasons why the investigation is taking so much time but local people are in no mood to listen to any of the police’s explanations, once they might have done but the police are no longer trusted to the extent that they once were.  What’s concerning is that this public scepticism of the police is probably not confined to Epsom, it’s an attitude that is probably building in many other places across the country. 

This sort of attitude by the public towards the police and other authorities where nothing they say is believed is almost unprecedented on the mainland outside of Ulster in post war Britain.  Yes there’s been conflicts in the past where there has been hostility towards the authorities such as in the Miners Strike during the 1980’s.  But in that case the conflict was localised, only to the coalfield areas and were not widespread across the country among those who were not connected to the mining industry or those supporting the miners for political reasons such as those on the Left/Far Left.  Now however the sort of sceptical and hostile attitude towards the authorities is not just confined to one or two towns, it’s across the country.

Other things that could make conflict more likely is the increasing boldness of what could now be reasonably termed as ‘the enemy’ in this case the radical Muslims who are flexing their muscles and might do even more of that if the party that they’ve hollowed out and taken over, The Greens, do well in the May local elections. Also what I’m also factoring in with my predictions is a growth in British people who might feel that they have ‘nothing to lose’ by kicking off.  There are more people now than there were in previous times of stress who because of economic mismanagement, exclusion from services that they need, migrant crime and economic stress from rising energy prices (which is not all the fault of the Iran War) who now could feel that they have more to gain from kicking off than they would lose.  

If the period from May to September of this year is a time where there are long periods of good weather and if it is coupled with even more migrant crime, economic problems and our political classes continue to besmirch their image even more than they are doing already, then we could be in for trouble.  There might be so much trouble and it might become so widespread that it might not be able to be contained by police public order units in anything like the way that it was tackled in 2024 following the Southport Atrocity or after the riots of 2011.  Big cities are well up to speed with dealing with sudden public disorder incidents but more rural police forces, small cities and market towns might not be.  If there is simultaneous disorder in 20 different small to medium sized towns then the current public disorder management systems might not be able to cope.  Oh and don’t think that we can call on the Army to back up the civil law and order powers as we don’t have much of an Army to speak of these days.  Even our much admired Special Forces troops are leaving in droves because of fear of the lawfare of Britain’s enemies and from the political Left. 

What will be the spark and will it be just one spark or several?  I really don’t know.  It could be some awful crime committed by migrants or yet another terrorist attack by Islamic extremists or disturbances like we recently saw in Clapham in South London occurring in some previously peaceful market town or attacks on the elderly.  It’s difficult to say but things do seem to be getting increasingly febrile at the moment and people can almost taste the state failure in the air.

I would prefer that this sort of disturbance and conflict didn’t happen.  I pray everyday for there to be a civil political solutions to my nation’s ills and maybe there will be some last minute reprieve that averts disaster?  Maybe we have a government of national unity which suddenly has a miraculous talent for seeing things as they really are or a snap general election that fills the House of Commons with patriotic realists or something?

I grieve for my nation’s current situation and I grieve even more because many of our current problems may well have been avoidable if the political class had taken correct actions in time.  If the borders had been strengthened, if the justice system was just, if the police were not politicised, if the Islamic extremists had been jumped upon by the state early enough and jumped upon hard and if the economy had been managed far better than it currently is, then I might not be so worried about where things are going.  However we have all the ingredients for a recipe for a dish that many of us have warned about and that meal is going to taste very very bitter indeed.

You may say that I’m an incurable and unrealistic pessimist but sometimes being a pessimist is the correct thing to do.  There were an awful lot of Jews in mid century Europe who were split between pessimism and optimism when the monster Hitler rose to power.  Some among Europe’s Jewry, some of whom had experienced Pogroms and other oppression before, were optimists.  They’d seen all the Jew hating stuff before in Russia, Poland, the Balkan states and elsewhere and thought that Hitler’s regime’s type of Jew hating would be similar to that which drove Pogroms and oppressions in other countries.  They thought that things would not get too bad that there would be temporary oppression, maybe some murders but then things would calm down or they could pop across the border into a ‘safer’ place like France or Belgium or the Netherlands until things got better, which of course as we know today did not work.

We know now that the optimists in that situation were wrong.  The pessimists among the Jews at that time realised just how bad things could get and that it could be worse than previous bouts of oppression. These Jews got out when they could, to Britain, to the USA, Mandate Palestine, wherever they could get to they went and as far away as possible from the dangers to be found on Continental Europe.  The pessimists who fled to places far away from the growing conflict mostly survived, the optimists who stayed behind and hoped for the best did not.

I’d rather be a pessimist and be hopefully proven wrong at some point in the future than be an optimist who thinks things might not get as bad as the pessimist thinks they’ll get only to find that the situation is worse than might be initially imagined.  I’m worried greatly about the way things are going and if you have critical thinking capabilities and awareness of what’s going on then maybe you also should be a bit more pessimistic.

### Serie Documental: Tradiciones de Chumbivilcas / Documentary Series

<center>


![_DSC9077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23wWrjTNvR8v5cMqwdKX3PLFxuhqHL61odQLK9tKpdibEodsuLyXA4pSeUsEa8vS4ex6n.jpg)

*“Detrás de la máscara, hay una historia a punto de pelear.”*

</center>

***

<div class=\

> ### English Hello friends of the Black and White community, here I am one more day showing you the material I have on the customs of Peru, specifically from Chumbivilcas, Cusco. I love the way clothing is perceived in Takanakuy; everything is a personal project, from the taxidermy and the pants to the alias and the mask itself. I hadn't noticed it before, but analyzing the moments before the fights, many gather in groups, all wearing their masks and taxidermy. You never truly know who you are dealing with, or if the person fighting has been photographed before. It is two days of pure adrenaline, celebration, and alcohol. I began to notice the intricate details of the clothes and have started distinguishing each fighter one by one during the bouts. Composition during the fights has been complicated for me due to the chaos, but applying a crop helps a lot to clean the frame. I chose this series of 8 photos; I hope you like it. Good vibes and positive energy to everyone! ### Español Hola amigos de la comunidad en blanco y negro un dia mas por aca mostrandole el material que tengo de las costumbres del Peru, exactamente cusco , chunvivilcas, me encanta la forma como en el takakuy se persiven las vestimentas, todo es un proyecto personal, desde la taxidermia, pantalones, el mismo alias, la mascara, no lo habia notado pero analizando antes de las peleas muchos estan en grupos todos con mascaras y su taxidermias , no sabes con quien estas tratando o el que esta peleando ha sido fotografiado antes, son dos dias, de pura adrenalina, fiesta, alcohol, y me di cuenta del detalle de las ropas y he ido distigiendo una a uno en las peleas. la composicion de las peleas se me complicado pero aplicando el crop y puedo ayudar mucho escogi esta serie de 8 fotos espero les guste, muchas vibras y energias positivas para todos. > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ***

links.title: Europeans Ramp Up Purchases of Locally Produced Arms Amid Security Concerns and Industrial Revival
links.body:
In recent years, European nations have significantly increased their defense spending and shifted toward greater reliance on domestically produced weapons and equipment. This trend reflects a strategic push for **sovereign defense capabilities**, economic reinvestment, and reduced long-term dependence on external suppliers, particularly in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine and evolving transatlantic dynamics.

Defense budgets across the European Union reached a record €381 billion in 2025, marking a sharp rise of nearly 63% since 2020. Procurement and equipment investment have grown even faster, with many countries channeling funds into local industries to rebuild stockpiles depleted by aid to Ukraine and to meet NATO commitments. Analysts forecast that European defense companies could see revenue from regional customers grow by an average of 10.5% to 11.5% annually over the next decade.

A key driver has been the emphasis on \

policies. Governments aim to keep taxpayer money circulating within their economies while expanding industrial capacity in critical areas such as ammunition, armored vehicles, air defense, and drones. For instance, EU initiatives like the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP) and the Act in Support of Ammunition Production (ASAP) have supported joint procurement and capacity-building, favoring European content. Indigenous production now accounts for a substantial share of the market, projected to grow at a faster rate than overall defense spending.

### Notable Examples of Local Expansion

Countries like Germany have seen domestic defense orders double in recent periods, with firms such as Rheinmetall reporting strong growth in ammunition and vehicle production. Eastern European nations and the Nordic-Baltic region have similarly prioritized local or intra-European contracts for tanks, artillery, and missiles. France, Italy, Sweden, and the UK continue to bolster their national champions through large-scale programs in aerospace and naval systems.

Ammunition production offers a striking illustration of this shift. EU capacity surged from around 300,000 rounds per year in 2022 to an estimated 2 million by the end of 2025 — a pace far exceeding peacetime norms. Joint efforts have helped replenish stocks while creating jobs and strengthening supply chains.

While overall European arms imports have more than tripled in volume during 2021–2025 (making the region the world's largest arms importer), much of the growth in local purchases has occurred alongside this. The U.S. share of European NATO imports has declined from 64% to 58%, with increased sourcing from European suppliers like France and Germany, as well as diversified partners. Intra-EU transfers and domestic contracts have gained ground, supported by new funding mechanisms and \

preferences that cap non-EU content in collaborative projects.

### Economic and Strategic Motivations

This move toward local arms procurement serves multiple goals:

- **Strategic autonomy**: Reducing vulnerability to supply disruptions or policy shifts from major allies.
- **Industrial revival**: Revitalizing sectors from steel to high-tech manufacturing, with companies expanding facilities and hiring.
- **Economic multiplier effects**: Defense spending is increasingly viewed as an investment that generates domestic jobs, innovation, and exports.

European defense industry turnover reached around €148 billion in 2024, with exports also rising. Employment in the sector stands at approximately 500,000 people, concentrated in key nations such as France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden.

Challenges remain, including fragmented markets, supply chain bottlenecks (especially in semiconductors and advanced components), and the need for faster procurement processes. However, political momentum — including higher NATO spending targets and EU financial tools like the SAFE loan facility — continues to accelerate the trend.

### Outlook for the Future

As Europe enters 2026 and beyond, the focus on local arms production is expected to intensify. Initiatives promoting collaborative development of next-generation systems (drones, AI-enabled defense, and integrated air defense) aim to close capability gaps while fostering a more competitive and resilient European defense industrial base.

This rearmament wave not only addresses immediate security needs but also positions Europe as a stronger player in global defense markets. By prioritizing locally produced weapons, European governments are investing in both their security and their economic sovereignty for the long term.

The shift marks a departure from decades of underinvestment, transforming defense from a budgetary afterthought into a strategic priority that blends military readiness with industrial policy.

links.title: Orderly chaos.
links.body:
Orderly chaos. With spring comes the time to think about planting a garden. I'm sure you're familiar with this: you want to plant this and that, and you've been making plans all winter, but for some reason, most things tend to fall into a chaotic order, as plans and reality can be on different highways and in different directions. For example, I've been thinking about fencing a plot of land, but I realize that before I can do that, I need to mow the grass and till the soil. After all, I was planning to plant something near the fence. As a result, time spirals out of control and drifts away from the clear plan I worked so hard to create over the winter. LOL. ![DSC00249.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcV5QyiDyuPBBkN8z3CukkbrtWfNwdUqauZp3KEP1B3TJ/DSC00249.JPG) Although, finding yourself in chaos and emerging victorious isn't so bad, at least that's what Roger Zelazny thought when he told us the fictitious story of the nine princes of Amber. Yes, the battle for the harvest is sometimes no less difficult than the battle for the throne. ![DSC01586.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdVxb87GCNRFs7fX666t4Lsa5S7FSRrbxMGbHys8n34RL/DSC01586.JPG) Chaos is a powerful thing, I've experienced it many times, because after you've put your garden in order, you can't leave for duty; chaos is always vigilant, ready to emerge from nowhere and settle in your garden again. ![DSC01715.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmR8c8X9ETdzNhzh9XWMoWwYjfi4jWMrs4oSSvRKCnZLrW/DSC01715.JPG) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. >

Cinco años se dicen rápido, pero cuando te sientas en el sofá y empiezas a echar cuentos, te das cuenta de que es un mundo de tiempo. Ver a Diego de nuevo fue como si nos hubiéramos bajado ayer de la camioneta después de una jornada larga en Halliburton.

<center>
![1000662866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vgalue/23y8mM85WcbwHs5dPzKZV3RLDm3ApoDcyTBE38trgfPV7TtFt7jcP1nQ7XAJvfN6BHYFj.jpg)</center>


Al principio, hubo ese segundo de silencio extraño, el de reconocer que el pelo está más gris o que el ritmo de la vida ya es otro. Pero bastó mencionar a Puerto Ordaz para que se rompiera el hielo. Entre risas, nos acordamos del calor insoportable de la zona industrial, de las guardias eternas y de cómo lográbamos resolver los problemas en el campo con más ingenio que herramientas.

Sentados ahí, con la comodidad de quien no tiene que aparentar nada, la conversación fluyó sola. No hicieron falta grandes lujos; con estar ahí, comentando lo que ha cambiado en Venezuela y lo que nos ha tocado vivir afuera, fue suficiente. Diego sigue siendo el mismo tipo ocurrente, y aunque ahora estemos lejos de los pozos y las oficinas de Guayana, la \

y la confianza quedaron intactas. Antes de que se fuera, saqué el teléfono para capturar el momento. Diego y el resto seguían hablando atrás, relajados, como si planearan la jornada de mañana. Guardé la foto no por la calidad de la imagen, sino por la prueba de que, aunque pasen otros cinco años, hay amistades que simplemente no tienen fecha de vencimiento.

**Foto(s) tomada(s) con mi smartphone Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra.** ![SeparadorSteemit10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vgalue/MGmK4oZF-Separador-Steemit-10.png) ![20200113_094257.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vgalue/ADBBL526-20200113_094257.png)

The more risk you take, the more reward you get. And the safer you play, the less reward you get. This is a universal rule of investment which every investor should understand. It depends on the investor’s nature what type of investor he is. If he is a risk taker, he will choose high reward. But if he is a safe player, he will choose low reward.

Its very simple to understand, those who wants to take high risk they prefer hive coin and those who wants to invest in low risk coin they will prefer #HBD which is the ecosystem's stable coin. Hive have high price fluctuation which has the potential to appreciate or depreciate your wealth but HBD is a stable coin and your investment is safe all the time.

Surely, #Colony is a great token of #arcadecolony, and investing in it is a wise decision. The reason? Because it is a gaming token and it is being used in the best games. It has brighter future ahead because of the coming gaming revolution in the ecosystem.

Games are more valued in this ecosystem, We saw Splinterlands, Rising Stars, then after that #PsyberX, #Holozing. Users are more interested in these games and want to invest in their tokens.

So if you want to invest in #Colony or #Script token, then for you it is a great option to earn APR rewards. Meaning, on one side your investment, and on the other side you get passive income. By investing in the liquidity pool, you can get the best benefit of it.

According to users, they are getting 20–25% APR reward from this pool, which in my view is the best profit APR so far. So in such tokens, taking risk is worth it. For this, you must buy equal amount of swap.hive and colony token.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbknQSJvPZkSgdwvYaVn2XBEVTJqHbsRUPYHLz8XCqH9i/untitled_design_4_.png)




I will explain in very easy steps. First, log in to your favorite exchange. Invest in swap.hive and #colony token. For example, buy $50 swap.hive and $50 colony token.

On #Tribaldex, there is a swap option on the top. Click on it, then go to pools, click on create, so your pair comes in the liquidity pool. Now the next step is to add liquidity. For this, go to add liquidity and select the pair.

The same amount of colony token will be required equal to how much swap.hive you invest. Then click on add liquidity. Your pair is now invested in the pool, and you will keep getting daily APR profit. It depends on market situation how much APR you get, but as users say, they are getting around 20–25% APR, which is best.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZVpkbM3LBrpFQHPyuUDeK8qRWjoq3ixQqYAeX7AZ9Bm/untitled_design_5_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzinfvN61Q17UidpzwDreAnE9J2YvRJjQNmNNeFWc45D/untitled_design_6_.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeUyJyHdqUatcr6PdkaixSmK5GifZjFcFZsKw2oLKK3o4/untitled_design_7_.png)





## In this work, surely there is risk also, and that is impermanent loss. Three scenarios can happen:

**1.** If swap.hive and colony price both increase together, then you get pure profit. This is win-win for you, passive income plus wealth growth.

**2.** If swap.hive price increases and colony does not, then impermanent loss happens. Meaning, when hive price goes up, rebalancing happens, your hive quantity decreases and colony quantity increases. So if you withdraw from the liquidity pool, you get the rebalanced quantity.

But if later hive price comes down again, or colony token goes up, the impermanent loss will end. As long as you are invested in the pool, the loss or profit is not booked. But the moment you withdraw, then you will get the effect of profit or loss.

**3.** If hive and colony both prices go down, then this is not impermanent loss but real value loss. In this case, you get loss from both coins. But that is temporary. If you plan to hold long-term, don’t worry about these losses, just keep earning APR.

This strategy is best for those investors who want to hold long term, because in long term both prices will rise, which will give you capital gain plus passive income.

links.title: Every Form Of Bullying Hurts: It Should Be Put To A Stop
links.body:
# Hello learners and community 😍💕.

I see bullying as an intended motive of backlashing from haters channelled towards their victim to cause them trauma that can lead to frustration, emotional feelings and inward pain of depression or devastation. It could come physically or through the social media, both forms of bullying still leaves hurt  in the targeted victim. 

Be it physical or through the social media which is online, bullying is one act that humans should put to a stop , knowing the after effects it leaves on the person or people that fails pry to them. We know that both forms of bullying are very harmful, as many who are involved suffers emotionally and mentally and which most times leaves damages that can hurt 😔 for a longer period of time.

The fact and truth about bullying is that those involved in this act knows actually what they are doing. Its is either someone who hates you engages with a group of this bullies to distract your focus, knowing you are on a mission of success, or that originally, some group of people don’t naturally like you and will go all the way to bring you down to satisfy themselves.

Physical or online bullying has their different damages and aftermath effects. If it is physical, this can lead to someone getting hurt by injuries, bruises or punches on the process due to the lack of control or endurance from the victim which definitely will leave scars after the initial pain.  It does not also ends here sometimes, as there might be confrontation from time yo time which can cause further problems of trauma.

And when it comes to an online bullying, its even harder because many faces downfall of all kinds if they are not strong enough both mentally and emotionally to face their haters. In fact, online bullying has caused many to take a suicidal action as the last way out. This is a very serious issue and what has to be looked into by those who created and are handling the social media platforms. 

Online bullying has cost 💲 many to loose what they have labored for through the years. The YouTube and Instagram is where its bad, as followers leaves your account like bees 🐝 once you become a pry to haters. Even top celebrities loose brand deals once those brands see that your followers are leaving you. The world 🌎 has really turned to every man 👨 to himself. 

I feel its time bullying should be looked into due to the damages it has caused the world 🌎. People can not just come out in life and become antagonist because they are not happy with themselves. And or because things are not going well for you, then you choose to look for who to bring down with you. 

So I can practically say the physical bullying is more condoning than the online bullying with the online bullying facing it harder with loosing all you have worked for in a long time because it very difficult to delete your account or walk away from them.

links.title: Mommy's Mental Health: Chapter 119 - Mommy's Trip to Space
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmpw1EmhPkcPmGatqYNU4eKuCtFq1ySnqUBS3sfNz6mm/img_20260417_wa0009.jpg)


So, I have actually been planning to at least try to migrate over from most of my medications to more natural stuff, e.g., marijuana. Weed is now legal in Cape Town, and there are shops opening up EVERYWHERE because the demand is so high. *high* ...lol

I while I was acquiring my knitting stuff the other day for [my newest heart scarf](https://ecency.com/hive-127911/@clairemobey/knot-another-knitting-tutorial-chapter-159d6e41c097), I finally, gloriously clad in my pajamas and gown, ventured into the cannabis store that has opened up next door.

They have these ridiculously enormous joints available (see above) that I would have to roll into smaller joints, which sounded like such a mission, just to get stoned - for medical reasons - of course! 🤣 

Anyway, if anything, yesterday was a HECTIC cautionary tale. LOL. First of all, after like 25 years of not smoking, jumping straight back in, as if no time had passed, was a BAAAD idea.

Despite my being extremely cautious.

I have done my research, and I know that sativa, although good for pain, can spike anxiety (which is exactly what I am trying to avoid). So I have been seeking out Indica strains.

Yesterday I finally took the \

and bought some lovely little prerolled joints from the middle of a shopping centre. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZr2tzq9JfKru9EFH9Zv3Vb6A2dhuRnFauRTvgukkBZZT/img_20260421_135600.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWfEdeH1EXBcZ5H47KYYqLfFocRnsLpYYVjedZkvGMYx/img_20260421_135704.jpg)

What a whack experience! I remember the days when I used to smoke: while still at school, we'd buy from the seedy, creepy guy who kept his wide selection in his blazer and sold everything from a ZAR5.00 \

to a full bankie. \n\nLater on, my old bf and I used to buy the stuff in bulk and fill one of those Tupperware cereal dispensers - which we would go through in a month! We hotboxed our apartment so hectically that I think we made our cat a stoner, and when we moved out, we had to paint the walls \

instead of white like they were when we moved in because when we took our posters and pictures off the walls, they left giant white blocks, where the weed had managed to somehow not get to. No matter how many coats of white paint we put on the walls, it just wasn't blending, so we just went with what matched the weed-smoke-stained walls.

So, I am not a newbie to this - or so I thought. I was forewarned, however, that the stuff they sell these days is much purer and stronger than what was available when I was in my youth.

DAMN, but I should have listened A LOT more carefully to that 🤦

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPqiQhdW2ooVuhXn2K1CE8GdbV8yitANbrCgUN96CuCRi/img_20260421_135627.jpg)

So, honestly, the stuff was so pungent that it was seeping out of the sealed bottle and out of my bag.

Being paranoid, I knew that I SPECIFICALLY asked for Indica and not Sativa, so when I got home and started reading the label, I started freaking out when I saw the word \

so, magically, Zak arrived home at exactly this time and was able to take me back to the shop. \n\nTurns out they colour code and illustrate it for people (who might be temporarily mentally challenged) as to what is an upper and what is a \

downer. The green arrow on the side of the bottle pointing up means an upper, and the yellow arrow pointing down means chilled out stuff. Ok, crisis averted.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6LoTn67x255g7Nuw7cCco9JgrzJw11Eao1tGCLsiB4Y/img_20260421_142729_edit_161928898380153.jpg)

[Donavan - Mellow Yellow](https://youtu.be/IQNBQI3UDag?si=f98ywBT3h29rdDSw)

Another sign I should have taken into consideration was how incredibly stoned the staff were! Upon return to the store, the guy that originally helped me, obviously snuck out for some lunch time doobie, and as he came to the front of the shop, he exclaimed:\

🤣🤣

And Zak and I hosed ourselves laughing while I jokingly asked them if they were taking CV's.

[Then I got High - Afroman (Explicit Lyrics)](https://youtu.be/Ls4qXjZtZXI?si=kWyVDFzwGlrN7DJp)
Joke was on me apparently...

So we got home, and @zakludick came outside to support me while I tried it out for the 1st time. 

I promised myself, only two tokes. That would be enough, especially since you take in quite a lot when you're lighting it and getting it going. So I lit it and took my first toke, held it in, noted that I was not axfixiating and coughing my lungs out, I was still horizontal, and so I took a second drag and man, the stuff hit me hard. I then took a third toke, and then a fourth, which was definitely the \

(lol?).

OMG. LOL. Zak videod it. You can actually see the moment where I realized I fucked up 🤣
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYyqZeQcnMwMc1VCuQ13ZJfjr7YBEbqNkQiddXgypmQpr/untitled.png)

If I compare an untouched joint with what I did actually smoked, it's crazy to see that there is still 3/4 of the teenytiny joint left!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQA5ATJnaesqaJdsurU4ib9sghdGhHkV93sUqhHPpBr4P/img_20260421_135722.jpg)



I had planned to have a bath and change my clothes DIRECTLY after, as I did not want to smell like weed or have the house smell like weed. 

This... was a mistake. I had no idea how fucked I was until I was in the water trying to figure out if I'd used shampoo or conditioner or if I was repeating myself and doing my best not to drown between rinses. Then getting out of the bath was HORRIBLE. I really should have asked for help. Shivering in the cold and stumbling my way out of a slimy bath by myself was no easy feat/ feet - I forgot where to put my feet, or my hands. 

\

[Neil Armstrong](https://youtu.be/xSdHina-fTk?si=HJl1T1ssNUmbTq6X)

I had my pajamas all neatly laid out on the bed, hot water bottle ready to go, so when I finally made it out of the bedroom alive, I was like, all I have to do is get dressed and cozy now. Safety was in arm's reach - so I thought.

I went for the undies, socks, pajama top first, and then the pajama pants. In between the pajama top and the pajama pants, my brain fell out of my ass,\
[Zoe's Extraordinary Playlist](https://www.netflix.com/browse?jbv=81031347)\
what...is...password....for PC?\
:null,
:true,
:true,

body.title: A realm of complex problems.
body.body:
A realm of complex problems. If you read the title of this post and think I'm going to talk about Fermat's theorem or some other math problem, no, I'm talking about an area where even a strong mathematician can fail, while someone who struggled with math in school can emerge victorious, thanks to their special intuition. This is about gardeners who prune fruit trees and shrubs in the fall and spring to create a tree crown that's easy to maintain and one that allows sunlight to reach the fruit buds where the gardener wants them, thereby increasing yields. But it is difficult to see the logic in this task, because you have to cut many branches on which many fruits can appear, and here the task is to think about quality, and if there is quality, then the harvest will be good. ![DSC02999.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXwA6XtmuCQxEdynddTjVdkzMwgryJbv9CXqGr8gsyWtb/DSC02999.JPG) I don't know if this principle applies to all trees, for example, those that are supposed to delight us with flowers like the magnolia, not fruit, but I'll look into it soon. ![DSC02652.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSdwU3Pi68ggkk2nVHaRhEAcxu2RPodvAdXR3BdzEGxAb/DSC02652.JPG) There was a time when my father hired a specialist to prune the vineyards and fruit trees, but he later took it up himself. I didn't adopt his experience, as he had other interests at the time, and over time, I became interested in it. When you understand what you're trying to achieve, everything basically becomes clear, and the fear of cutting off unnecessary things disappears, although older trees, and there are more of them in my garden, require more delicate pruning, while young trees are more forgiving of our mistakes. In the harvest season I will find out how well I have learned my lessons and how I have navigated the terrain of difficult challenges. ![DSC02626.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTFnTpnW16cHmDYqTXJcpmL75bC8kjSgdp1hyb7HkZjzu/DSC02626.JPG) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. [Material thoughts about beekeeping №1](https://inleo.io/threads/view/barski/re-leothreads-drl8tnsl) When I visited dense forests, I did not see ideal conditions for bees there, but many beekeepers harvest beekeeping products in such places. [Link to the container with my portfolio](https://inleo.io/threads/view/barski/re-leothreads-z2rexmhq) [Link to the container with my Tag memo for getting coins #1](https://inleo.io/threads/view/barski/re-leothreads-sweaitci?referral=barski) ____ ![reallygreatsite.com.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/barski/AJekn2YQgZ8KwXchdXPG5oEY2tnkyhy4aFudhtwhUJ6R38ZDvj69Dr9W5S1YGzv.gif) ____ ##
More to come!
##
Enjoy viewing the photos and reading the article!
##
Have a blessed day!

body.body: >Today I bring you a unique adventure for my travel blog and channel! Exclusively for Hive, we're going to hike the \
trail, one of the lesser-known trails in the Sintra area, and one that holds a mystery. We'll be explorers trying to unravel the mystery of the \

Is it a 5,000-year-old human construction? Or is it a whim of nature? You can draw your own conclusions... Meanwhile, I'll show you the way...🏔️🌏

#

Hoy te traigo una aventura unica para mi blog y canal de viajes! en exclusiva para hive vamos a realizar el Sendero: \
, de los pocos conocidos de la zona de SINTRA y que alberga un misterio, seremos exploradores para descifrar el misterio del \

se trata de una construccion humana con 5000 anos? o es un capricho de la naturaleza?; podras sacar tus propias conclusiones...Yo mientras tanto te ensenare el camino...🏞️📸 ![LQrn7A1G.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23vhyipkBPFwntgDa2ohvHi4529af8izHWKrhKxjHDBKHEDfgkU8Tao6p6rZZFYeMY5tW.jpg) #

In this picture we can see a comparison between a traditional Dolmen and the Anta Adrenunes, both have very different characteristics in origin and symmetries, but what caught my attention is that it is thought that it was used for ritual purposes, even though they did not bury a person, and that certainly warrants investigation.🙇🏻‍♀️🧭
En este cuadro podemos ver una comparacion entre un Dolmen tradicional y el Anta Adrenunes, ambos tienen caracteristicas muy diferente tanto en origen, como en simetrias pero capto mi atencion que se piensa que si fue usado como fines de rituales, mismo que no enterraran a una persona y eso amerita claro investigar.📍👨🏻‍🏫

The dolmen is located behind the mountain where the Santuario da Peninha is situated. You can actually take the same route and visit both sites, but be prepared physically and mentally. It's a brutal trail with more than 6 hours of hiking, and you'll have to climb over 500 meters and then descend to reach the dolmen. If you're up for it, you should leave very early, between 5 and 6:00 am.🏞️🏕️
El dolmen queda atras de la montana donde se ubica el Santuario da Peninha, en realidad puedes hacer la misma ruta y conocer los dos locales, pero preparate fisica y mentalmente es un sendero brutal con mas de 6h de caminata y tendras que subir mas de 500m y luego bajarlos para llegar al Dolmen, si te animas debes salir bien temprano 5-6:00am🚙🧭

I'd like to tell you it's a trail for the whole family, but no! If you start from where I began: \

it's an extremely difficult route, and of course, it's not suitable for children. What you could do is drive your vehicle to within 1 km of the Dolmen and then walk to the tourist site, but you'd take away all the excitement.📍📸\n\n
Me gustaria decirte que es un sendero para toda la familia pero no! si partes desde donde comence yo: \

es una ruta extremadamente durisima, y claro que no es apta para ninos, lo que podrias es llegar con tu vehiculo hasta 1km cerca del Dolmen y ahi si caminar hasta el sitio turistico, pero le quitarias toda la emocion.🏔️🌏

Janes Village📍🌏 / Aldea de Janes🚩📸

>
Janes is one of those isolated villages in Sintra, located 20 minutes by car from the town center or historic district. I always suggest that when hiking in Sintra, you should come well-prepared because it's very rare to find a place to buy food or drinks! Personally, I love places without tourists, where I can be alone walking in nature. If you share this preference, then this trail is perfect for you.🌍📍 #
Janes es una de esas aldeas que esta aislada en Sintra y que se localiza a 20min en vehiculo del Centro o casco historico, siempre sugiero que hacer senderismo en SINTRA es venir bien preparado porque es demasiado raro localizar un sitio donde comprar alguna bebida o comida! en lo personal me encantan los lugares sin turistas y que solo este yo caminando en la naturaleza, si tienes los mismos gustos entonces el sendero se adecua a tu exigencia.🗺️🚩

Unfortunately for me, it was cloudy and windy, and it even rained a little at one point, so I wasn't very lucky, but I'm sure you'll love the view.🚩📍* *Si las condiciones climaticas son las ideales creeme que tendras aqui uno de los mejores miradores de Portugal, y no exagero! para mi suerte estaba nublado, viento, en un momento llovio un poco asi que no corri con suerte, pero seguro te gustara el paisaje🌻🌺*

#
Some tips for the route📍🌏 / Algunos consejos para la ruta🚩📸
![IMG_9269.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23u62spbRR61svD9vcG6SApcmqxhY8GWeqE2tbh33NX4RHCBLYwVyt9nEX46LwX593joN.JPG) ![IMG_9272.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23zkkUeRTZa9hffMsUd1d95zZWFeXstdofKxRXHJnWU7igv1WR7bTWLfSQncZXpwmKbdt.JPG) ✅ Since it's a long route, prepare with comfortable clothing, long pants, a hat, and walking sticks. ✅ The trail is not circular; you will have to return to the starting point. You might want to use Google Maps if you are unfamiliar with the area to avoid getting lost. ✅ Do not interact with nature by disturbing, breaking, or bothering animals; stay on the paths ✅ Do not touch the fauna and flora, do not leave litter, do not destroy the ecosystem, stay on the path ✅If you are with other elderly people or children, use a vehicle to get closer to the dolmen. ================================================================================= #
Wild Nature📍🌏 / Naturaleza Salvaje🚩📸
![IMG_9275.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/246an1v4PbBkpmxE3ZCNa9jyTN1EvkPAhmFS8GjSgfaqcXkFY3ce5qK2bLutMANW6PJZW.JPG) ![IMG_9274.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23ujfzhNg4TXre7XmYpG3kyTDMqfzyJdVcP6voemX1e2YCCoxB6Mea4YqaHP6Es5Bieik.JPG) ![IMG_9277.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23sJszigSfyGk5N5SSNg37PixYM2zwSMRN6FanvepkzxDaawEzh57avxKoJ4GhFREHcWR.JPG) ![IMG_9280.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/244xnjR8C9w7z4j37n727mWMfQFAyG4oAyGsWapm6X7ePsaEorVyE4KxQ9GRcA3ATwsCq.JPG) ![IMG_9285.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23x131RXmRQQoSczFBQPqT2E8At5jKWJZT5WLguMP7W67rrYXdPoxYWygen13E2xRkCZL.JPG) ![IMG_9288.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/242hUMtWwY8dko9W3xcj9YJ16z4YSzDc2KWRs9i2FxvJPvpxJ8nL76awepL1anQVTDrmS.JPG)
The landscapes are amazing, aren't they? You won't find anything like Sintra anywhere else in Portugal. The closest thing is Arrábida, but it doesn't have the same atmosphere and scenery, plus there aren't such tall pine trees and rocks like these.📸🏞️
Asombroso los paisajes no? como Sintra no vas a conseguir en ninguna otra parte de Portugal, lo mas parecido es a la Arrabida y no tienes la misma atmosfera y paisaje, ademas que no hay pinos tan altos y estas piedras.🚙🧭
