links.title: Shared Shadows Under a Tree. Entry for the ShadowHunters SMASh Contest-round 422
links.body:
Hello Shadow Hunters community, once again I’m posting in this community and doing so to take part in the ShadowHunters SMASh Contest, round 422.

---

## Shared Shadows Under a Tree

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJ3LC8pXYnrCuYi5TPRnCrFxoxhRYrWJ7W9zTCMLj97q/screenshot_20260421_121708_01.jpg)

---

As I left the building with my husband to look for provisions for our home, we passed near a tree. It was a simple moment, part of the routine, nothing out of the ordinary.

But the light turned it into something else.

On the ground, I noticed our shadows reflected clearly, walking side by side. Along with them, the shadow of the tree stretched across the path, as if joining us in that brief journey.

I paused for a second to observe it.

There was something meaningful in that combination—the two of us moving forward, accompanied by the silent presence of the tree. Three shadows sharing the same space, shaped by the same light.

It made me think about how even the most everyday moments can become special when we pay attention.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdcJcNso7fAXJkym8A8A7HtWYrRpmJoKT61X8CFQGBSz/screenshot_20260421_121719_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZum4xLmvHQJzy9QLA4xAtZ39zDKv7pxgHoB52y9whiYo/screenshot_20260421_121731_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZXRS5iCJsH8beYgbwouYeRocpY8JDb168kwLKTtqbhzZ/screenshot_20260421_121736_01.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma51YAWVCRAM76nyzVT5FcRQe6mByo6GukULou5fdni4i/screenshot_20260421_121725_01.jpg)

---

The shadows blended naturally, without effort, creating a simple but beautiful composition. A reminder that we are always connected to our surroundings, even in ways we don’t always notice.

I couldn’t let that moment pass unnoticed.

And this is what I share with you today for this contest.

---

Thanks to @melinda010100 for every call for this contest. 

Thanks for everything, and I declare that the images were taken with my mobile phone and the English translation is thanks to Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

---

## 🇪🇸 Versión en Español

---

Hola comunidad Shadow Hunters, una vez más estoy publicando en esta comunidad y lo hago para participar en el ShadowHunters SMASh Contest, ronda 422.

---

## Sombras compartidas bajo un árbol

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJ3LC8pXYnrCuYi5TPRnCrFxoxhRYrWJ7W9zTCMLj97q/screenshot_20260421_121708_01.jpg)

---

Al salir del edificio con mi esposo en busca de provisiones para la casa, pasamos cerca de un árbol. Era un momento simple, parte de la rutina, nada fuera de lo común.

Pero la luz lo convirtió en algo más.

En el suelo noté nuestras sombras reflejadas claramente, caminando una al lado de la otra. Junto a ellas, la sombra del árbol se extendía sobre el camino, como si nos acompañara en ese breve recorrido.

Me detuve un segundo a observarlo.

Había algo significativo en esa combinación: nosotros avanzando, acompañados por la presencia silenciosa del árbol. Tres sombras compartiendo el mismo espacio, moldeadas por la misma luz.

Me hizo pensar en cómo incluso los momentos más cotidianos pueden volverse especiales cuando prestamos atención.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdcJcNso7fAXJkym8A8A7HtWYrRpmJoKT61X8CFQGBSz/screenshot_20260421_121719_01.jpg)

>from Imgflip Meme Generator --- There is a particular silence that finds us in the hour when the noise has faded. Not the silence of absence, but the silence of reckoning. The moment when the screen goes dark, when the notifications cease, when the ledger—both the one on the chain and the one in the soul—demands to be read. **When you look back.** Not at the balance. Not at the HP. Not at the curation rewards claimed in the small hours, counted in decimals, tallied like beads on an abacus of ambition. But at the *people*. The ones you downvoted away. Not because their words were spam, but because their voices were competition. Not because their content was low, but because their presence was inconvenient. You cast your `-0.25%` like a stone into a pond, and you watched the ripples carry them farther from the shore of community, farther from hope, farther from the belief that this place could be different. **Will you be happy?** Not the hollow satisfaction of a number that grew while a garden withered. Not the fleeting triumph of a reply silenced, a thread dampened, a newcomer discouraged. But the deep, abiding peace that comes only from knowing you lifted more than you lowered, that you built more than you broke, that you left the soil richer than you found it. Happiness is not a balance sheet. It is a legacy. **Will the people be happy?** The ones you spoke to badly. The ones you treated as obstacles rather than neighbors. The ones whose first post was met not with welcome, but with a mechanical cascade of negative weight from accounts that moved in concert, like a school of fish trained to swim in one direction. Will they remember you as the voice that said *no* when the world needed *yes*? As the hand that pushed away when the community needed to pull together? As the architect of a culture where fear was the currency and silence was the price of admission? Or will they remember you as the cautionary tale—the one who proved that even in a decentralized world, centralization of the heart is still possible? **All for some internet HIVE and HBD.** Let us name the transaction clearly. You traded dignity for decimals. You exchanged trust for tokens. You spent the fragile capital of human connection to purchase the brittle currency of on-chain influence. And when the market shifts—and it always shifts—what will remain? Not the HP. Not the HBD. Not the curation trail that reads like a manifesto of suppression. Only the memory of what you chose. **Was it worth it?** This is not a question for the blockchain. The chain does not judge. It only records. It will preserve your votes, your rewards, your delegations, your patterns, forever. But it will not tell you whether those patterns were wise, whether those rewards were righteous, whether those delegations were deployed with love or with leverage. That judgment belongs to you. And to the people whose lives you touched—not with light, but with shadow. **Would you do it again?** This is the question that haunts every legacy. Not *could* you. Not *would* the system allow you. But *would you*, knowing what you know now, having seen what you have seen, having felt—perhaps only in the quietest hour—the weight of what was lost? To do it again would be to declare that the end justified the means, that the harvest justified the burning, that the accumulation justified the alienation. To do it differently would be to declare that people are not a means to an end, that community is not a resource to be mined, that influence is not a weapon to be wielded, but a trust to be held. --- There is still time. Not to undo what has been done—the ledger does not allow that. But to choose what comes next. To let the looking back become the turning toward. To let the question become the compass. The blockchain remembers what you did. But only you can decide what you will do now. *— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.* # A New Dawn in the Digital Agora

links.body:

Just sketching out the Emperor makes my skin crawl. This \

sits on this stone throne - very uncomfortable - no cushion - and he leans slightly to the left (The Past) - his eyes are to the left therefore he is not present - he is in fear - rehashing the past, because hindsight is 20/20 and trying to formulate the future from the past. Good Luck! Just creating more of the same...

# The Intellect

He represents the Intellect which is mankind's greatest detriment because it plans for the worst case scenario using limited in-formation. And it mixes it up with the Divine Masculine. This is a combination of the Divine Masculine with the Intellect and therefore represents a shattering of that divinity.

The intellect has no faith - it has fear - and that is why the solutions of the intellect always cause harm because they are always about getting over on others rather than being of service in faith. Since we are all connected - getting over on ourselves only harms ourselves down the road, if not immediately.

# Mother Nature

The Empress is Mother Nature and the Emperor is red, scorched, fear-based assholicness that we presently call \

but which is really about THEFT and getting over on one's fellows while looking good in the process.

The Empress could be the mother of the Emperor rather than his wife - because he could be the angry Mama's boy who sets out to destroy his mom because he didn't like the attention she gave others or because he had no father figure in his life - since Pan is not represented here in the cards. 

# Gold Crown, Rams heads, World, Staff

The Emperor wears a heavy gold crown, a red cloak hiding the fact that he is wearing armor covering his whole body. 

The Emperor is clad in steel armor. This corresponds to iron and steel, which are the metals of Mars. The armor implies that he has waged battles and won. Harnessing of metal orr was taught to humanity by Nephilum \
Azazel - which is relevant here because of the \

or goat which has been demonized into Baphomet because in the Jewish Holiday, Yom Kippur, a goat is sacrificed to Azazel, to atone for the sins of the Jews.

# Nephilim
The Jews interacted with the Watchers and the Nephilim which may be why they are made into the perpetual **Scapegoat** of the Dark Occult..

# Armoring

He has a beard which hides his facial expression. He holds a replica of the world in his right hand and the Ankh Cross in his left. He has manifested in the world what he put forward in his right hand... a burnt scorched world.


# Ankh Staff
An ankh is a sacred symbol which alludes to the manifestation which occurs by combining divine opposite forces, such as male and female energies.

The Emperor is commingling the natural power of the Ram with the intellectual power of fear that is destructive and leads to the Devil eventually... The exoteric reduction of The Devil is 6 (5+1) but the esoteric reduction is 5-1 which equals 4...The Emperor equals The Devil through subversion. 1 (Magician) plus 5 (Hierophant) is 15 - The Devil. That makes sense because a man with access to the natural forces of Power along with a man who acts as an intermediary of God - is satan, himself, convincing ingore-ant people that he has more power than he actually has.

The orange sky behind the Emperor is the sky of destruction - just as Mars was once a lush planet like Earth - now the atmosphere has been destroyed just like Earth's atmosphere is being destroyed now.

# Gray Hair...Maturity or?

The Emperor's gray hair means that he has lost his \

in his kidneys and liver. His life force is drained from him due to too much Anger and Fear which are brought on by worrying and conniving about the future, since he is not in the present.

# The 4 Rams
 are a nod to Mars and Aries but he is a conman - there should be a card for Pan, if that was the case. The Emperor stole his power from idea of masculinity, but he is a fake. Since all the cards in this deck are Caucasian, that means that this is the story of the Nephilim taking power from Nature and ruling over hue-mans.

His four posts are the Ram's head - 
There are four rams’ heads carved into the stone throne; two on the armrests, and two on the back of the throne. A fifth ram can be found stitched into the Emperor’s cloak, over his left shoulder. The ram is the symbol for the zodiac sign Aries, and we are to understand that this card is symbolic of everything that Aries represents.

# Alien-blue

The sleeves under his robes introduce a blue color that has not yet been introduced in the cards yet until now which proves he is an \

to this environment. This blue never shows up again in any of the cards. The inner tunic of all the other cards preceding this card has been white which is native to the cards environment - and this color of blue is artificial in this environment.

Blue usually represents the third eye - Intuition, but in this case, it is false, therefore it is made up knowing in the intellect.

# Wave Mountains
The mountains are oceans who's frequency is slowed down to become rock. It's all about frequency.
This is a message that we can conquer them by raising our frequency as they are conquering us by lowering our frequency.

# Void
The black under his chair does not exist in Nature - it is the Void, but not as in birth, but as in evil - it is the Corona - creating the shape of the Black Sun, and including the symbol of Libra - The Setting Sun - the Temple of Set but nodding toward \

, The Emperor believes he has the right to decide what is just and right...

# Evil Blackness devoid of Light...
 - it reminds me of a black of evil that I experienced in the shadows on a haunted road in New Jersey Clinton Road in West Milford, New Jersey.

# Tiny River
A small river flows in the background, behind the throne. Water is a symbol of the feminine and harbinger of life, necessary even in this masculine environment for life to survive and propagate. I guess that's why they are controlling it using chemtrails...


![emp-orig.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/in2itiveart/23zGwCGSGJCwSc2GdVq3JgVCaaeAuKd27VcLSQsvQQXbpbsQKLotqyMjF7D93i2ueTwcF.png)

Now, when I look at the original Rider Waite - I see the blue is not like that in this card - but the rocks still look like waves. In the BOTA deck however, there is a lot more of Mother Nature... so not sure what that's about... I am sticking with my gut feeling that I got when I copied this card. It is the Exoteric deck where they are using symbology to put us under mind control which does not exist in the Esoteric Deck.

links.title: Raising the Dead       …Part 13          …Finale
links.body:
*It is a strange thing, to be abandoned by someone who never existed. ― Shon Mehta*


![Grief.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/23wC1YeQkBPC5cBVhm7ZxuZ779VKFoRUsXpQ5DEe9QSSHa9nS8h84VzZAvNUzvy13qgHe.png)


The moment finally arrived that Alex had been dreading―he'd have to tell Elizabeth the truth. What started as scientific curiosity about investgating memory and how information was stored in the brain had now turned into a nightmare. Alex would not only have to disclose why he chose Elizabeth as a research assistant on his project, but he'd also have to reveal the ghoulish fact that the brain they were examining belonged to her dead fiance. In his defence, Alex was unaware of the identity of the donor organ. But even when he discovered it was Mark, he couldn't tell Elizabeth because he knew it would be so upsetting to her that she could never forgive him. It was a catastrophe he couldn't possibly have anticipated, and yet, in the moment of crisis, he still failed to be candid and admit his error.

Elizabeth was standing before him waiting for him to explain what he meant when he said there was a secret project within the project he hadn't disclosed to her. \
she told him, \

A torrrent of words poured out of him as he confessed his guilt.

\
\n\nShe frowned, \
\n\n\

\n\n

\
\n\nAlex looked horrified. \
\n\n\
she asked, sceptically.\n\n\
\n\n\
Alex paused and took a deep breath. This was the specific thing he dreaded revealing. \
\n\nElizabeth was horrified. \

Alex hung his head in shame. Elizabeth stood there for several moments simply staring at him in disbelief and then she turned and left. Alex let her go feeling complete despair totally overwhelm him.

For the first time, in a long time, Alex wept. He was surprised by the tears on his face and the depth of anguish in his soul. He had lost his true love and it was all his fault. There could be no redemption for him, no unexpected return, or forgiveness from Elizabeth. His inability to tell Elizabeth the truth had forever scarred both of them and destroyed a love that could have been their refuge and fortress for a lifetime.

links.title: La música se siente diferente Sophia un nuevo comienzo en el flamenco!💃The music feels different: Sophia—a new beginning in flamenco! 💃🏼
links.body: alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\
>
alt=\

es un dicho bastante popular con el que crecí, y literalmente hoy vengo a hablarles de algo que lo refleja o lo comprueba, pero esta vez tengo una defensa bastante argumentada.
“The cobbler's children have no shoes” is a pretty common saying I grew up with, and today I'm here to talk to you about something that literally reflects or proves it—but this time, I have a well-reasoned defense.
​Todos pensarán que, por el hecho de yo ser músico y profesora de música, mi hija tomaría este rumbo o quizás le interesaría este mundo, especialmente porque doy clases a niños de su edad o incluso más pequeños. Aunque por mucho tiempo quise que así fuera, no se logró. Mi hija sacó dotes artísticos y ama la música, tal como yo, pero entendí que la ama y la siente de una manera distinta.
Everyone probably assumes that, since I’m a musician and a music teacher, my daughter would follow in my footsteps or at least be interested in this world, especially since I teach children her age or even younger. Although I longed for that to happen for a long time, it didn’t work out that way. My daughter has artistic talent and loves music just as much as I do, but I’ve come to understand that she loves and experiences it in a different way.
​Después de intentar muchas veces que ella recibiera clases de música, lo cierto es que ella la percibe de otra forma y la expresa a través del baile. Por lo que, aunque no quería, acepté y asumí que sus pasos no vendrían directamente por mi camino. Sin embargo, lo que me llena de orgullo es que, indirectamente, siempre estarán relacionados. Es por eso que andamos en búsqueda de su propio camino, de lo que le gusta y de lo que más adelante la podría apasionar.
After trying many times to get her to take music lessons, the truth is that she perceives music differently and expresses it through dance. So, even though I didn’t want to, I accepted it and realized that her path wouldn’t follow mine exactly. However, what fills me with pride is that, indirectly, they will always be connected. That’s why we’re on a journey to help her find her own path, discover what she likes, and find what might become her passion down the road.
Además, en mi opinión personal, a los niños en general hay que inculcarles alguna pasión, desarrollar en ellos algo que amen hacer, porque al final de cuentas, estas serán sus herramientas para drenar en un futuro. Como bien es cierto que este podría ser el destino de los niños, Sophia hoy comenzó clases de flamenco. Cosa que me emociona muchísimo; me encanta porque siento que es un baile elegante que aporta mucho estilo y cultura, aun cuando no es el baile típico de Venezuela. Pienso que aún estamos descubriendo y probando; esto no quiere decir que solo vaya a bailar flamenco, porque hay tantas ramas del baile que sé que le pueden gustar y encantar.
Furthermore, in my personal opinion, children in general need to be encouraged to develop a passion, to cultivate something they love to do, because ultimately, these will be the tools they draw upon in the future. Since this could very well be the path for children, Sophia started flamenco classes today. This excites me so much; I love it because I feel it’s an elegant dance that brings a lot of style and culture, even though it’s not the typical dance of Venezuela. I think we’re still discovering and trying things out; this doesn’t mean she’ll only dance flamenco, because there are so many branches of dance that I know she might like and love.
Lo bueno es que ya comenzamos y que, a partir de ahora, como madre tengo que esforzarme un poco más por ver y aprender para animarla y apoyarla, que es el principal objetivo.
The good news is that we’ve already started, and from now on, as a mother, I’ll have to make a little more of an effort to observe and learn so I can encourage and support her—which is the main goal.
​Por aquí les comparto una foto. Ese día me quedé en el estudio, aunque no está del todo permitido (tenemos que esperar afuera), pero como toda \

nos permitieron hacerlo. Ya en las próximas clases tengo que dejarla que ella se desenvuelva y que explore. Les dejo un abrazo enorme, la mejor de las vibras y, por supuesto, nos vemos pronto. ¡Abrazos y besos a todos!
Here’s a photo I’d like to share with you. That day I stayed in the studio, even though it’s not strictly allowed (we’re supposed to wait outside), but since I’m such a “overprotective mom,” they let me stay. Starting with the next classes, I’ll have to let her figure things out on her own and explore. Sending you all a huge hug, lots of positive vibes, and, of course, see you soon. Hugs and kisses to everyone!

I have always loved fruits since I was little. Nothing is quite as soothing as their sweetness or freshness. When I eat fruit I feel calm and full in a way that no other food can satisfy me. If I eat a mango after school on a warm day or an apple in the morning, I feel happy and energized.
I eat fruit because I enjoy it and know that it nourishes my body and mind. They allow me to receive all the vitamins I need to get through the day. When I'm feeling down or overwhelmed I have fruit and instantly feel better. It's a good habit to have and keeps me happy.
I try to include fruits in my daily diet. It helps me remember to nurture my body in the healthiest way. Instead of craving junk food I reach for something fresh. Fruits are my source of happiness, balance, and strength.

links.title: Screens Don’t Soften the Damage of Bullying
links.body:
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/Eoia6F4QM7ijdvcTCDEjR3hX4qyefpUiyHX8YK4EC3aNxfJFLcYoswmBGUj5vo3WHi7.jpg)

I've always wondered what's the difference between online bullying and offline bullying. Because it's a common thing which has been going on for a long time. I've not dealt with it personally but few of my friends has shared their story with me which was traumatizing. I have two friends one has faced bullying online and the other one offline.

Trust me none is less. After hearing their experience it became clear to me that bullying is bullying it can't be less worse no matter how it has happened, the consequences are the same. The victim who deals with the bullying goes through many mental health problems.

There's no scale which can decide which one is the worse. I personally feel we should take both seriously as the victim suffers a lot. People are unable to understand because they are not in victims situation, so it's difficult. 

But if you really wanna find out how a victim feels then you should think like \
and ask yourself \

If you have any empathy inside you then you will start to understand the feeling of getting bullied. One of my friend attempted to end her life because of online bullying. She was a content creator she's a feminist, she made videos about empowering women. The comment section always had hateful comments often made by the opposite gender. it didn't stop there some fake accounts was created and they started posting her pictures without clothes which was ai generated. Few people believed her and few didn't, she also got life threats as some people found out her location. Obviously it was one of her friends who gave out the address. She couldn't tell her parents as they are very conservative minded so she decided to end everything by trying to attempt suiside. Currently she's out of social media and out of anyone's reach. She is still a good frind of mine but she's not normal anymore. Her mental health has completely drained. If I compare this to physical bullying then yeah both are the same. As always the victim suffers no matter what. Bullies can destroy ones mental health even if it's online. People are built different and everyone has different kind of capability. If you're mentally strong then it gets a bit easier to handle bullies but that's not the main point. The thing people should do is protest against the bullies. The one who does crime and the one who tolerates both are at fault. We should take stands whenever we see someone getting bullied but often we back off because it's not problematic for us. That's why bullies get encouraged to bully the victims. I will always say that both acts should be treated equally. Physical bullying and online bullying are not any different. Legal actions should be taken against such bullies so that they can learn their lesson. I've often seen victims let go of their bullies just because they don't wanna go through any trouble which I don't support at all. The reason I write blogs on Hive is the people over here are truly positive. But if it was any other platforms I'm sure I could have not continued this long. Becsuse I would have been bullied for expressing my opinions online. I wish every other platform becomes this safe so that no one is bullied, at least online. In real life, we have to do the same and create a safe place for everyone. ____ The thumbnail is taken from canva and created with [canva](www.canva.com) ____

links.title: From High Heels to Headsets: My Journey as a Work-from-Home ESL Teacher
links.body:
![1000071268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/Ep7vW9f1CXiVXUPAafPLL1zaetY2AUy31KLXoQMKGFfzi7d6iTqbcUegTyiFZTuWLHE.jpg)

![1000071263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23x1Hhd3529gDFE1Y1EyYn5kJWJ1NpUPeKeieWSYRW2hftPbNutXPCEkade2eVdpcoitf.jpg)


There was a time when my mornings began with a rush choosing the perfect outfit, slipping into high heels, and making sure I looked every bit the part of a store operations manager. I managed three large retail stores, filled with branded and imported goods from elegant bags and stylish shoes to luxurious apparel and perfumes. It was a fast-paced world, especially working in a duty-free shop where many balikbayans. These are Filipinos living or working abroad who return home to visit and would shop for their loved ones. They would often buy pasalubong, a cherished Filipino tradition that means bringing home gifts or souvenirs for family and friends.


I loved that chapter of my life, but it came with its own challenges like long hours, endless standing, heavy responsibilities, managing staffs, the whole branch and the daily battle with traffic. I would leave home early and come back late, often exhausted from the commute and the demands of the job. I was basically married to my job, I had no life back then. 

Now, my life looks completely different and in so many ways, more fulfilling.

![1000071271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23yToaBixMCyu8xSgaQS4cNo443V5eg6ywv4uzSqnUT4z8hvZWsHPXs2ADZPZNdx7HfTy.jpg)

![1000071269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23z7QjkMhfHnxiGWmXpYVJAnJi3uZWG3miPzSi87cawT2STCidLvdDMiZa5Yk2U9v5eSj.jpg)



Today, I work from home as an ESL (English as a Second Language) teacher. My classroom? A quiet corner in my home. My dress code? Well… let’s just say it’s business on top, comfort at the bottom!😉☺️ As long as I look presentable from the waist up, I’m good to go. There have even been days when I rushed into class wearing shorts or a towel (yes, really!) because I was running late. No more fancy pants or high heels, no more worrying about traffic, and definitely no more exhausting commutes.


![1000071270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/EpQwoGfKq7VFVANMKHuNVUSYJvoNx8Fpx4dEDDd2AhHNm7VUxujqcUr56c17HC5qyNb.jpg)

![1000071273.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23zGnsESaUJpPUz56dVD3mvHbnYDbWioCkN1PS8uyTcTmg9U1zSmxVcmAJkQzVkHH3PmP.jpg)



Instead, I get to be present. My family sees me every day. I’m here for the little moments that I used to miss.


![1000071260.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23ynUjLo7WtTLqf1XrsHP4hqwguv9NUpPH4wF1awr5ce4cFnNWdeiHL87VquKUvguFb5b.jpg)

![1000071256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wMcPAPorKQYrCFkYiJopQkmTGh7uNSTMK6iBTPrnNWXq7udujPPTTusPuqN6idap1RS.jpg)

![1000071254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23xen8M8FVZRFfyvMZVi14eqAcKoWpNNKxerQEESiH9mJkDaqJZE1Y9d6fLEWsfuViAbS.jpg)




One of my greatest blessings is my incredibly supportive husband. On days when I teach straight from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, then rest for two hours with classes running every 25 minutes, he steps in without hesitation. He cooks for me and gently hands me my lunch during my tiny 2–3 minute breaks between classes.




![1000071266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wMcgQzcbjFjaBBX7LhR83hrZmBKiwMddmudzzpFh6DS4QwJ7W5vtmeVTR2xVsZTCPnM.jpg)

![1000071265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23z7Qex63iPRnhtmh1JUvUSctmn3dsqE2dv9HTCoQNXyjkRUDNkWwzZVR9u9cPiLHZANE.jpg)



 Those small acts of love mean everything they keep me going through a packed schedule. These are moments when students are on their holiday break from school. I will resume again 5pm until midnight this will go on for one to two months because mostly my students are Chinese. It depends upon the country's school break. Yah, I know what you're thinking, I am basically tied to my chair, Hahaha, but I am enjoying every bit if it. I treat all my students as my kids so as a mom you don't get tired of teaching and talking to your children. For the adults I treat them as my friends so you don't get tired of teaching a friend, right?!😉☺️
Especially if they pay you to teach them! 😁😅


I started this journey working under a company, but over time, I built my own network of regular students. Now, they pay me directly no more commission cuts. It took patience, consistency, and heart, but it was all worth it.

![1000071251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aideleijoie/23wCLXUoxDjaMNa1tKrmLwRmrJXUHNXNs2Jq43xetJ5r8jxdKkHwYX2MkJgXhDNnwW6LV.jpg)



What I love most about my job isn’t just the convenience it’s the transformation I get to witness.

There’s something incredibly rewarding about seeing a student go from knowing almost nothing in English to confidently expressing their thoughts and carrying conversations with ease. It’s like watching a flower bloom right before your eyes. Over the past seven years, I’ve had the privilege of teaching students from all over the world like Japan, China, Thailand, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Cambodia, Italy, and even the Middle East. Ranging from as early as 5 year olds to teens to adults. Mostly about everyday conversations, Travel English, Business English, IELTS for the adults for kids it's basically learning English from the basics depending on their grade level.

Each student has a story. Each lesson is a connection.
And the most heartwarming part? When they tell me how grateful they are not just for teaching them English, but for the patience, empathy, support, and genuine care I give them. Those words stay with me. They remind me why I chose this path.

Working from home as an ESL teacher isn’t always easy. It requires discipline, energy, and a lot of heart. But it is deeply, beautifully rewarding.From managing stores to shaping minds, from high heels to headsets, this journey has changed my life.

And I wouldn’t trade it for anything.👍

I am still open for new students if you wish to learn English I would gladly teach you. Just send me a message🥰🤗

I hope, you too love the work you are in right now because at the end of the day you get to say to yourself, yes, I did good today!♥️❤️♥️

Thanks for reading til the end.

Remember, you are loved.
@aideleijoie♥️

links.title: The Responsibility Behind a Licence to Do Something
links.body: In human society certain principles and laws are established to maintain order and discipline and following them is necessary for every individual. Under these laws there are some tasks that require formal permission or a licence to carry out. Licence to do something meaning permission for a task is actually also a responsibility it makes a person capable of performing their work while staying within the boundaries of the law. Obtaining permission or a licence for a task is a sign that the relevant person has the ability and competence to carry it out. For example a driving licence is necessary to drive a car which serves as proof that the driver is familiar with traffic laws and can drive safely. Similarly various professions also require permits to ensure quality and safety. It’s also important that a licence or permission does not mean a person gets complete freedom to do whatever they want. Rather this permission grants the right to work while staying within certain limits. If someone crosses those limits they commit a violation of the law and can face punishment. That’s why having a sense of responsibility along with a licence is very important. Licence to do something is not just a permit but also a trust that society places in an individual. Maintaining that trust is the responsibility of every person. If we understand our responsibilities and respect the laws society can become safer more organized and more prosperous.

---

Hola, todos! We'll be doing something different from the usual shebang this time! This Three Tune Tuesday is a recording of me and my band performing three dearly classic Mexican songs! The video was originally recorded on \
phone for a Facebook Live random special show. I cut out some of the other \

songs along with most of the long, boring commentary and chatter in between, saving only the best parts and jokes. Lulu, the talent, sings the first two songs. We sort of drown her voice out a bit since she's far from the mic except for the parts when she really projects. Next to her is Other-Alex on the *guitarrón,* our accoustic bass. Viejo is closest and therefore loudest, shredding it on the *vihuela*. The vihuela is like a guitar but is has five strings and is tuned like a lute. Don't say *\
*. Remember, he plays the guitar, not the \

. His phone is about to die. Next, on violin, is Kevin. Unfortunately, the shirt he was wearing is now lost. And then there's me, the first trumpet. The only trumpet. I've been working on some little musical projects lately which led me to stumble upon some old mariachi sheet music and reminisce about those gigging days. Those were fun times. Now, though, we've broken up. Like The Beatles. Some of us continue doing music, whether on the side or as the main gig. I hope you will enjoy these songs. Someday, I hope to get a new band back together.

## Songs
1. Desdén - C. Valencia, Juan Arvizu, M. José Pufamy
*Disdain*
\

This song is about a lover who, no matter how much effort they pour into the relationship, is cyclically met with heartache and indifference. They are even seen as the villain despite infidelity on the other lover's part. Profound emotional torment and injustice along with a deep sense of despair plague the singer, and yet they still long for the return of their lover.

2. Si Nos Dejan - José Alfredo Jiménez
*If They Let Us*
\
\nThe second song is a love story like that of Romeo and Juliet. It is implied that they cannot be together and so each line starts with \

and makes many sincere promises of love and escape. Back then in Mexico, in such a situation where the families did not approve of the young couple, it was common for the man to kidnap his lover and they would indeed run away and make their own life together. The family would use the verb *\

*, claiming he stole their daughter.

3. Por Qué Me Haces Llorar - Juan Gabriel
*Why Do You Make Me Cry*
\

\nThis song is about the sorrow and heartache after a breakup. What more can the singer do but drown his sorrows in alcohol. Viejo, the youngest member of our group, was learning this song at the time. He is a bit stiff still at this point but as I played with him, I watched his skills grow and he took on his own unique style. The song ended up becoming known as \
. One time, early  in his career and right before a performance, he told me, in a hushed voice, \

I asked him why not and he said it was because he met someone else and was no longer heartbroken. I told him he got this, but it got me thinking, wow... All this time he was singing straight from the heart.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=proto26/915bfa86)

links.title: 📸  True Spring Time  🌱🌿
links.body:
![IMG_20260421_142257_808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tiptop97/23w2mS9YmiN2oW92cJNN8DSSzmwLqPuxZShxDYCDSQPVak5j1TxsqLKsjVGB7aUSq1hy1.jpg)








Hello everyone, dear friends, Flower and nature lovers. In today's Evening Post I'll show you some pictures from my garden. These are photos of spring flowers, what are the ones I grow in my flower beds. Basically this post has a lot of  photos of Primroses. Primroses are beautiful colorful flowers. They have been growing on me for a long time. To be honest, I don't remember how many years ago I planted them. The variety of colors of these flowers is simply amazing.


If I don't forget, I'll try to take pictures of absolutely all of my straight ones that I'm growing to show you all the colors. An interesting feature of primrose flowers is that the petals have combined colors. These are super wonderful early spring flowers that don't require special care and rarely get sick. I also found a purple violet in one of my flower beds. It was an incredible discovery for me because before that I had only seen blue and white violets, so the purple violet was a real surprise for me. 


I also have several hyacinths of different colors and snowdrops. Snowdrops are the last flowers you see in the photos. They are already finishing their bloom, but very soon I will be able to please you with other photos of other flowers. One of these wonderful flowers is my decorative tulips of different colors. There are not many of them this year. However, they are and I'm really glad. Maybe tomorrow if I have enough photos I can make a separate post for you with my tulips. At least I will try to take a few nice photos of the tulips that I have already grown because some of the flowers have not yet opened.









![IMG_20260421_142257_666.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tiptop97/23wqik1rgaXpLzrduXAmJDLgra9KjNstVHD2n1ptAyyxXDzbbefTBRXWq9rykZz8G5czo.jpg)

links.title: Llegó la lluvia, llegaron los arcoíris 🌈 / Here comes the rain, here come the rainbows 🌈
links.body: <div class=\

>Saludos hivers. La temporada de lluvia ya empezó, las lluvias y el cielo nublado han ido apoderándose del paisaje, sobretodo en horas de la tarde, con el invierno tropical, no solamente llega el agua para el alivio de todas las plantas y animales, entre muchos otros beneficios para la naturaleza, sino que también, se produce uno de los fenómenos ópticos más llamativos y hermosos, el arcoíris 🌈. Y es por eso que hoy les traigo una compilación de fotos que le he hecho al arcoiris en diferentes momentos. >Hello hivers. The rainy season has begun, and the rain and cloudy skies have been taking over the landscape, especially in the afternoons. With the tropical winter comes not only water to relieve all the plants and animals, among many other benefits for nature, but it also appears one of the most striking and beautiful optical phenomena, the rainbow 🌈. That's why today I'm sharing a compilation of photos I've taken of rainbows at different times.
![IMG_20260420_153010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/EpJYd7Y38wVAtMDwfyUGohGF5asyxRJ1dmdPxq4drty4a6MKxdZNKr4dbRYHsiJhbTM.jpg)
En la mitología griega el arcoíris era una diosa mensajera entre el cielo y la tierra de nombre Iris, y de ahí su nombre / In Greek mythology, the rainbow was a messenger goddess between heaven and earth named Iris, and that's where its name comes from
![IMG_20260420_153041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23zGeRxe3yaVfdPfyyvTMYJzHkkTWuwd1YLWzArFCVuJ9KtkrzUHo7iqAMWzaZJ8SN1yE.jpg)
![IMG_20260420_153259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/EpQwfk5EGKHfvszDx87NKmCEKfUZwpsU3oq5hgLZqrRKBX7k2C3wSJ4YmgMB53fPNPr.jpg)
Un arcoíris no es más que el resultado de la interacción entre la luz solar y pequeñas gotas de agua que se encuentran suspendidas en la atmósfera después de una lluvia. Esas gotas de agua no sólo refractan la luz del sol, sino que también la reflejan, y es en ese momento cuando aparecen los siete colores del espectro: rojo, anaranjado, amarillo, verde, azul, añil o índigo y el violeta o morado. El orden en el cual aparecen los colores es siempre el mismo, siendo el rojo el que queda hacia la parte superior. Para que se produzca un arcoíris no solamente es necesaria la presencia de luz solar y agua, también hay otros factores que influyen, como por ejemplo que no debe haber viento que disperse las gotas de agua, y que la lluvia sea suave. >A rainbow is simply the result of the interaction between sunlight and tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere after the rain. These water droplets not only refract sunlight but also reflect it, and it's at this moment that the seven colors of the spectrum appear, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. The order in which the colors appear is always the same, with red at the top. For a rainbow to occur, not only is necessary the presence of sunlight and water, but also other factors play a role, such as the absence of wind to disperse the water droplets and a light rain.
![IMG_20260420_153410.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/EonnPhruZaBnxPDBNKbWBDvxRgRWg8AeZyZfUpdMFeNC6zhk6jZ4abDoD1DNGdVoU51.jpg)
![IMG_20260420_153534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/Eos3JeGwCBvsXynm1spXcF4xE5ycVz2x9Pv3v1zPEiSpQrvnG43Nfph6q98VVjUxzfE.jpg)
![IMG_20260420_153641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23w2kq6W2SyneF7ZDo9adDTLoRk2Es1XkqyaS9BFMjxHqYn5J8jkyDwoG6DtrGV6xyn1H.jpg)
El tamaño de las gotas de agua que estén en la atmósfera también influye en este fenómeno óptico ya que mientras más grandes sean estas, la intensidad de los colores será mayor y se podrá apreciar con más nitidez, cuando las gotas son pequeñas, el arcoíris se ve opaco y los colores no están muy bien definidos. Como habrán podido observar, la mayoría de los arcoíris que he fotografiado son dobles, no es que eso sea algo diferente, en realidad, todos los arcoíris tienen dos aros, primario y secundario, lo que pasa es que no siempre pueden ser apreciados ya que eso depende de ciertas condiciones que permiten que se pueda ver claramente esta ilusión óptica que es el arcoíris. >The size of the water droplets in the atmosphere also influences this optical phenomenon. The larger the droplets, the greater the intensity of the colors and the clearer the rainbow will be. When the droplets are small, the rainbow appears dull and the colors aren't very well defined. As you may have noticed, most of the rainbows I've photographed are double rainbows. This isn't anything unusual, in fact, all rainbows have two rings, a primary and a secondary. It's just that they aren't always visible because it depends on certain conditions that allow this optical illusion to be seen clearly.
![IMG_20260420_153739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23wWyBURPF4LZ4hzRYotYpbmaw5qswNpLa1gqscjqadTtHuxCr3qmGP4Vd2g7zWNHGL6s.jpg)
Entre los dos arcoiris se puede apreciar un área más oscura, la franja de Alejandro / Between the two rainbows, a darker area can be seen, the Alexander band
![IMG_20260420_154414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/EpQxJecLauBm17QBCDRULTYWDZmJTnZq9tnLAK1L1HNujcsZo6H3Qo5nFsi7jE2voN8.jpg)
![IMG_20260420_154937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23wMcbfaCReyW7kEijALBsttovknLVrwkuW3r7QYh3VoqtfJcjryZiNUgdLz8TfCnKVZA.jpg)
Una de las particularidades del arcoíris doble es que el orden de los colores no es igual, el arco interno y el más intenso presenta los colores en el orden del espectro empezando por el rojo en la parte superior, mientras que en el arco externo el orden está al revés 🙃. Cuando ambos arcoíris están visibles, el color del cielo en el espacio entre ellos tiene un color más oscuro y se le conoce como franja de Alejandro en honor al filósofo griego Alejandro de Afrodisías, quien fue el primero en estudiar este fenómeno. >One of the unique features of a double rainbow is that the order of the colors is not the same. The inner, more intense arc displays the colors in the order of the spectrum, starting with red at the top, while in the outer arc the order is reversed 🙃. When both rainbows are visible, the sky in the space between them appears darker and is known as Alexander's band, named after the Greek philosopher Alexander of Aphrodisias, who was the first to study this phenomenon. Hay muchas historias, leyendas y supersticiones relacionadas al arcoíris, una de ellas dice que al final del arcoíris hay una gran olla con monedas de oro custodiada por un duende, debe ser realmente increíble llegar a ese punto, sobretodo cuando según la ciencia, el arcoíris es un círculo, lo que significa que no tiene principio ni final 🥴😕 jajaja, entre las superstición más común que he escuchado es que uno no debe señalar el arcoíris con el dedo porque eso da mala suerte, soy un poquito supersticiosa así que desde que escuché eso ya no señalo el arcoíris jajaja. >There are many stories, legends, and superstitions related to rainbows. One of them says that at the end of the rainbow there's a big pot of gold coins guarded by a leprechaun. It must be truly incredible to reach that point, especially when, according to science, the rainbow is a circle, meaning it has no beginning or end 🥴😕 hahaha. Among the most common superstitions I've heard is that you shouldn't point at the rainbow because it brings bad luck. I'm a little superstitious, so since I heard that, I don't point at rainbows anymore hahaha. La duración de un arcoíris es relativamente corta, sin embargo, en el año 1994 se registró un arcoíris en Inglaterra que duró desde las 9 de la mañana hasta las 3 de la tarde 😲, ¡seis horas!, toda una rareza. Bueno amigos, es todo por hoy, espero que esta publicación haya sido interesante y de su agrado 😊. Muchas gracias por su tiempo. Salud y felicidad infinitas para todos 🌞🍀. >The duration of a rainbow is relatively short, however, in 1994, a rainbow was recorded in England that lasted from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. 😲, six hours! Quite a rarity. Well, friends, that's all for today. I hope you found this post interesting and enjoyable 😊. Thank you very much for your time. Infinite health and happiness for everyone 🌞🍀.
Todas las fotos fueron hechas y editadas por mi con mi celular Redmi 9T y me pertenecen / All photos were taken and edited by me with my Redmi 9T cellphone and they belong to me
> **Gracias por leer, compartir, apoyar, votar y comentar.** Hasta la próxima. ¡Miau!

links.title: Dadra Mix
links.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Dadra Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/cbc3ae3f-9bad-47da-8b04-3360baeeed8e.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/xpGZpEcX7zohWf5HbC1GKM) 
 
 El Dadra no llega con estruendo, sino que se desliza entre los pliegues de la noche hindú, una sombra suave que nace de la necesidad humana de expresar lo que las estructuras rígidas del Dhrupad o del Khayal clásico resultaban demasiado solemnes para contener. Surgió en el norte de la India, probablemente entre los siglos XVIII y XIX, no como una revolución teórica, sino como un susurro íntimo en los salones de la aristocracia y las casas de los mecenas, donde la música dejaba de ser un ritual divino distante para convertirse en un diálogo cercano, casi confesional. Los músicos de la época, cansados quizás de la extrema formalidad, comenzaron a experimentar con un compás de seis tiempos, el dadra tala, que respira con una cadencia natural, oscilante, muy parecida al latido de alguien que está enamorado o esperando una respuesta.

A diferencia de sus primos mayores, este subgénero de la música ligera clásica, conocida como Thumri, permite una libertad interpretativa que roza la improvisación hablada. No hay prisa por llegar a ninguna parte técnica; la virtud reside en la ornamentación sutil, en esos microtonos que tiemblan ligeramente antes de resolverse, imitando el quiebre de la voz cuando la emoción supera a la razón. Las letras, usualmente en braj bhasha o urdu, hablan de amores terrenales, de separaciones dolorosas y de la belleza efímera, temas que resonaban profundamente con una sociedad que buscaba refugio en la estética frente a la turbulencia política de la era colonial tardía.

Lo fascinante es cómo esta forma musical logró sobrevivir a la modernización sin perder su alma. Mientras la industria cinematográfica de Bollywood absorbía y diluía muchas tradiciones, el Dadra mantuvo su pureza en los gharanas, las escuelas tradicionales de transmisión oral, donde el maestro corrige no solo la nota, sino la intención detrás de ella. Hoy, quien escucha una interpretación genuina puede sentir esa textura aterciopelada, esa ausencia de percusión agresiva, donde el tabla acompaña con delicadeza, marcando el tiempo sin imponerlo. Es una música que requiere paciencia del oyente, una invitación a detenerse y escuchar el espacio entre las notas, recordando que, en su origen, no se trataba de impresionar a una multitud, sino de conectar dos almas a través de la vibración compartida de una melodía que se niega a ser olvidada.

La resonancia del Dadra trascendió las paredes de los salones privados para teñir otras expresiones artísticas, actuando como un puente sutil entre lo clásico y lo popular. En la literatura, especialmente en la poesía urdu y hindi de finales del siglo XIX y principios del XX, los versos comenzaron a estructurarse con esa misma cadencia oscilante de seis tiempos, buscando una métrica que imitara la respiración entrecortada del anhelo amoroso. Los poetas no solo escribían sobre el amor, sino que escribían *para* ser cantados bajo esa estructura rítmica, donde la aliteración y la asonancia se diseñaban para encajar en los espacios silenciosos que el género musical reservaba para la emoción pura. Esta simbiosis hizo que la palabra escrita adquiriera una musicalidad intrínseca, obligando al lector a pausar y saborear cada sílaba, tal como lo haría un oyente atento frente a un intérprete maestro.

El cine indio, particularmente durante la edad de oro de Bollywood en las décadas de 1950 y 1960, absorbió esta estética con voracidad. Los directores de escena entendieron que el Dadra ofrecía el marco perfecto para las escenas de intimidad emocional, lejos de la grandilocuencia épica. Compositores legendarios integraron sus progresiones armónicas en bandas sonoras que definieron la identidad sonora de una nación emergente, utilizando la suavidad del género para humanizar a los personajes, mostrando vulnerabilidad en lugar de poder. La cámara aprendió a moverse al ritmo de este compás, con planos más lentos, primeros planos prolongados que capturaban la microexpresión de una mirada, reflejando la misma delicadeza ornamental que caracteriza a la forma musical. No era solo fondo; era narrativa pura, traducida en sonido.

Esta influencia estética se filtró también en la moda y la presentación visual. La elegancia contenida del Dadra inspiró una vestimenta que privilegiaba la fluidez sobre la estructura rígida. Las telas ligeras, como la chiffon y la seda fina, comenzaron a dominar los atuendos asociados a estas actuaciones y a las escenas cinematográficas que las emulaban, permitiendo movimientos gráciles que respondían a la música. Hubo un alejamiento de la opulencia pesada hacia una sofisticación aireada, donde los bordados sutiles y los colores pastel reflejaban la naturaleza introspectiva y romántica del género. La apariencia visual se convirtió en una extensión de la atmósfera sonora: etérea, nostálgica y profundamente femenina en su expresión tradicional, aunque abierta a interpretaciones modernas.

En el ámbito de otros estilos musicales, el Dadra actuó como un catalizador para la fusión. Su estructura rítmica accesible pero sofisticada permitió que músicos de jazz y folk occidental encontraran puntos de encuentro con la tradición india. La flexibilidad temporal del género facilitó experimentos donde la improvisación occidental se entrelazaba con los ragas, creando híbridos que respetaban la raíz sin quedar atrapados en ella. Incluso en la música pop contemporánea de la región, se pueden rastrear ecos de sus progresiones melódicas, adaptadas a instrumentos electrónicos pero conservando esa cualidad líquida y melancólica. El legado no reside en la copia exacta, sino en la persistencia de una sensibilidad: la idea de que la música puede ser un espacio de descanso, de reflexión íntima, donde la técnica sirve exclusivamente a la verdad emocional del momento.

El Dadra se erige como un testimonio vivo de la capacidad de la cultura india para negociar entre la tradición sagrada y la experiencia humana cotidiana. No es simplemente una forma musical, sino un archivo emocional de una era en la que la identidad nacional y personal se estaba redefiniendo bajo la presión del cambio social y político. Al democratizar el acceso a la estética clásica, rompió las barreras elitistas que durante siglos habían restringido el conocimiento musical a castas específicas o a contextos templarios, permitiendo que la belleza técnica llegara a los hogares, a las reuniones familiares y a los espacios sociales mixtos. Esta transición marcó un punto de inflexión donde la música dejó de ser exclusivamente un vehículo de devoción divina para convertirse también en un espejo de las pasiones terrenales, validando así el amor humano como un tema digno de la más alta expresión artística.

Su permanencia a lo largo del tiempo demuestra una resiliencia cultural notable. Mientras otras formas artísticas desaparecían o se transformaban irreconociblemente ante la modernidad, el Dadra mantuvo su esencia al adaptarse sin rendirse. Se convirtió en un símbolo de resistencia suave, una manera de preservar la lengua, la poesía y la sensibilidad estética frente a la homogeneización global. En los escenarios contemporáneos, cuando un intérprete aborda este género, no solo está ejecutando notas, sino reivindicando una lineage histórica que conecta al presente con un pasado de refinamiento y profundidad emocional. Es un recordatorio de que la sofisticación no requiere complejidad extrema, sino precisión en el sentimiento.

Como hito, el Dadra también representa la culminación de una síntesis cultural única, donde las influencias persas, turcas e indígenas se fundieron hasta volverse indistinguibles, creando algo genuinamente nuevo y autóctono. Esta fusión no fue impuesta, sino que surgió orgánicamente de la convivencia y el intercambio, reflejando la naturaleza pluralista de la sociedad del subcontinente. Hoy, su estudio y práctica sirven como un acto de preservación de la memoria colectiva, asegurando que las nuances de esa sensibilidad histórica no se pierdan en el ruido de la contemporaneidad. La relevancia del género radica en su poder para seguir conmoviendo, probando que las estructuras artísticas nacidas de la intimidad tienen la fuerza para perdurar como pilares fundamentales de la identidad cultural, ofreciendo un refugio de calma y belleza en un mundo cada vez más acelerado y fragmentado.

links.title: The Sizzling Showdown: A Double-Steak Dinner Delight!
links.body:
<div class='text-justify'> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcBVLqGNGZNRPqm2ocxr4nge8Ra7fr2uUtoLL5etCZdrE/image.png)

## The Sizzling Showdown: A Double-Steak Dinner Delight!

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol

**Good evening, carnivores!** Sakol is back to cap off the day, and tonight, we are turning up the heat! After a long day of adventuring (and eating), the body doesn't just want food; it demands *protein*. And what better way to answer that call than with a sizzling, mouth-watering steak duo? The aroma of grilled meat is in the air, and my knife and fork are ready for action! 

Let’s slice into tonight's magnificent feast:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLzHw2hh6pTDUasrx3rGtNyqWSVS5tDeyTDqnY5XxuXA/image.png)


* **The Classic Pork Steak (Steak Moo):** Let's talk about that crust! Grilled to an absolute golden-brown perfection, the outside has that beautiful caramelization from the hot pan, while the inside remains unbelievably juicy and tender. Then comes the magic: a rich, glossy black pepper sauce cascading over the meat. It adds a spicy, savory kick that dances on the tongue. Every bite is a hearty, meaty embrace that makes you forget all your daily stress!.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFuXpMAq24x3apar4bfJVaTc6NGgrexqGUQrmXxm4kZT/image.png)


* **The Tender Chicken Steak (Steak Gai):** If the pork is the heavy hitter, the chicken is the smooth operator. Marinated overnight until the savory flavors reach the very center of the meat, it’s grilled until the edges get that irresistible smoky char. It is so ridiculously soft and tender that you barely even need a knife! Paired with a side of crispy, golden french fries and a refreshing, crunchy salad to cut through the richness, it’s a perfectly balanced plate of joy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbiNqLDAaHVWxbCruyNRpCpRk48vu4eGSjSpVfv2vLz78/image.png)


**The Verdict:** Tonight is a total victory for meat lovers everywhere! It’s heavy, it’s satisfying, and the flavors hit all the right spots. A magnificent way to end the day—Sakol highly approves!

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRLwr94YFHhZZZXu1abbVRG1d7fxg4eRAjdAsZYerL9C/image.png)


## ศึกประชันกระทะร้อน! สเต็กหมูฉ่ำ ปะทะ สเต็กไก่นุ่ม สวรรค์ของคนรักเนื้อ!

links.title: A Refuge of Contemplation in the Heart of Istiklal: Turkish-German Bookstore and Asâ-ı Mûsâ
links.body:
Hello everyone. Istiklal Street, the heart of Istanbul, is shaken every day with the steps of thousands of people, the voices of dozens of different languages and my endless movement. Sometimes you want to get lost in this crowd, sometimes it's a quiet corner where you can find yourself right in the middle of that crowd. Two days ago, I was just after such a moment while walking alone on this historic street. My steps took me to one of the most characteristic points of the street, the Turkish-German Bookstore (Turkish-German Buchhandlung).


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgxnxdb6RmCRV1u4yPhH1fLfJQwf6u3yLyMAyeKoeHQY/img_1282.jpg)


**Spirit of the Place: Wood Smell and Coffee Aroma**

As soon as you enter, Istiklal's chaotic noise is cut like a knife. What welcomes you is a peaceful silence, the smell of freshly ground coffee and huge bookcases that rise to the ceiling. This is not only a bookstore, but also a port where time slows down. While wandering between the shelves, the weight of German works is immediately noticeable; there is a wide collection from Goethe to modern German literature, from philosophy to art history.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZri1k3bkwpfwD9ykvEcPZp41JxbgKGyPykshR8GkoA3y/img_1274.jpg)


Although I didn't speak German, even looking at the volumes of those books, breathing that intellectual air between the shelves, was a pleasure in itself. Seeing the German editions of Orhan Pamuk or Ahmet Ümit reminded me once again of the boundless power of literature. However, my intention was not just to travel, but to withdraw into my own world and rest my mind.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSWcUm5zK3ahp6toJDrvhbXfTeVwnpSgPXJPQkkRKSEWF/img_1273.jpg)


**Alone in the Crowd: Alone with Asâ-ı Mûsâ**

The companion I brought with me was Bediüzzaman Said Nursi's work called Asâ-ı Mûsâ. I chose a quiet corner for myself in the cafe of the bookstore. I have a delicious dessert and coffee in front of me, and a work looking for answers to the deep questions of existence in my hand...


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSSLT71F2NDoKdCe2GCbKGDyPydCZ7tk5avk28YGMMZnC/img_1275.jpg)


While that huge energy of Istiklal Street was just outside the window, it was a great contrast to dive into such a deep world of contemplation inside. Asâ-ı Mûsâ, as the name suggests, is just like Hz. It is a work that illuminates the darkness like the staff of Moses, dispels doubts about faith and explains that everything in the universe is a meaningful letter. As I turned the pages of the book, I felt once again how temporary that outer rush actually is, and how long-lasting the journey in our inner world is.

**Why Read Alone?**

For many of us, reading a book is an act at home, in a quiet room. However, in a city like Istanbul, especially in such a historical place that carries the spirit of Pera, reading turns the act of reading into a \

. Reading such a deep work in my mother tongue in a bookstore where I don't know German actually shows that a person can carry his own inner home with him wherever he is.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb73mVct7JVmn6nLAg5CbCoDEhTnJUaH4Tp6zoJVDJntz/img_1272.jpg)

The brick walls in the space, the dim lights, and that feeling of \

provided by my Stanley thermos, turned my reading experience out of a hobby into a ritual. When the people around me spoke in different languages, I went on a journey about the truth of existence between the lines of Asâ-ı Mûsâ.

**As A Result**

If you find your way to Istiklal Street, don't just walk; stop at these stops. Turkish-German Bookstore can offer you the most peaceful office or the deepest library in the world with a book and a cup of coffee. For me, this two-day short getaway was an experience that refreshed my mind and rested my soul.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaXwipb6kfx273apJQoqFFBBX3AjnhUsycQHWzEj191FD/img_1269.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdkDuRukJCoPKJbWqYVv61pr1FUEzqjuBrUNjHVQL6R3W/img_1283.jpg)


Which book do you take with you when you walk around the city? How do you build your own quiet island in the crowds? Let's meet in the comments.

Well, I've been more productive up until today because I have been working with the project that I have work in the past week but the progress that I've made seems very slow.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23xedt7Q88ZKXXLLCyLRcqjvQf6Nu1FznEqjEFzBmdc2GeKj2MiCpy14AUzpc9xodxXDX.png)

Well, it's been a couple of days now since I lack of sleep, when I lack of sleep, I cannot think more often and it's like when I started to go for the work, I got something like a mental block on what will I do in that current day. 

I have a couple of issues regarding with the system that I made but I think I can pull it off if I will work on it and fully immerse with this project. Although, I was fully immerse and think of other simple ways for this kind of project but the thing is it's not that an easy task but a hard one. 

Thinking or looking back at my work, it seems that I am more than dedicated with the project because it seems that it's a bubbly ambition that anyone could think of, but what's the craziest part? even though that I did my very best or part in this system but the actual output isn't always as good as it may seem but I was working my ass of from this work but it seems that I was head over heels with this job as it might take a couple of weeks not days on building it.

> Our freedom traded for comfort.

And this is what I see. And once the trade is made, it is incredibly hard to go back. 

>But those same arts or activities that continue to be performed by humans will undoubtedly be more highly valued. 

I agree. But I also think that the pool of performers and the quality they can accomplish will shrink, because the majority will rely on the consumption model of the AIs. If that makes sense. The problem with that comfort model is, most will choose it and quality across the board drops.

>In this area, we have seen a decline since the onset of the pandemic.

Well before then. The pandemic just acted as a catalyst to speed it up. I have been looking at these trends for a couple decades, but the pandemic had such an impact because smartphones and screens were already being used as babysitters and for entertainment. With so many stuck at home and fearful of going out, it just amplified the effects. Sad - especially considering that it wasn't required. 

>But one thing is certain: even if “our place” can easily be taken by someone else or some other entity, we are unique.

Was talking to my daughter about this the other day and while we are all unique, there is also a huge amount of overlap in our behaviours. What makes us special isn't what we are, but what we do. 

I think it would be pretty fantastic if the sense of family came back into society, and parents valued their role enough to take responsibility to learn and grow with their children also.

links.title: Travel Digest #2896
links.body:
Introduction


Hello everyone, @glecerioberto here, and welcome to today's #TravelDigest! We have a fantastic, albeit short, lineup to share with you today. Our Top 3 features the majestic Amber Fort in India, the charming La Caleta beach in Spain, and a stunningly blue crater lake in Australia. We also have a great list of Honorable Mentions from Venezuela, India, and Pakistan that are definitely worth a look. Be sure to check them all out below and show your support to these amazing authors. Cheers!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 UNIQUE TO WORLDMAPPIN: When grandeur is so inspiring that the centuries cannot forget it: Amber Fort [ENG - ESP] by @belug

Amber Fort, India… and I would say it is one of the greatest symbols of this country and of the Triangle to which its color alludes: the Golden Triangle.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 La Caleta, a very popular beach with a special charm 📷 Málaga – Spain by @avdesing

Every part of the city has its own little details and unique characteristics; even within the city itself, there are areas, neighbourhoods, beaches and parks that seem to belong to a different city altogether.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Blue Lake, Mount Gambier, South Australia. by @new.things

Blue lake in Mount Gambier has been a popular tourist stop for a long time. I remember stopping here 30 odd years ago when I was driving around Australia in my little Toyota Corolla station wagon with a couple of friends. I don't remember much from the trip, that far back, other than I was surprised that the water in this crater lake was indeed very blue. I am always very skeptical as usually most or at least some of these types of tourist attractions are only worthwhile when there are ideal weather or environmental conditions. I am happy to report that the blue lake has been worth the visit, the three times I have been there and one was even in the rain. They reckon this extinct volcano lake stays blue because of a limestone layer and the remains of marine organisms over millions of years. After reading that I was then wondering if it was a good idea to be actually drinking from the local water supply as it is pumped from this very lake. I am also happy to report that the water tasted fine and left will no side effects, that we know off.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin

links.title: Искусство выражать чувства без лишних слов
links.body:
![image](https://i.postimg.cc/2yw6WVmr/image.png)



В мире, где всё стремится к упрощению и цифровизации, живые цветы остаются одним из немногих способов передать искреннее тепло и внимание. Цветы - это универсальный язык, понятный в любой точке мира, не требующий перевода или пояснений. Каждый букет несет в себе определенное послание, но бывают случаи, когда масштаб подарка говорит сам за себя. Большой букет цветов способен превратить обычный день в грандиозное событие, оставить яркий след в памяти и напомнить человеку о его исключительной важности. Это не просто покупка, это инвестиция в эмоции, которые будут согревать душу еще очень долго. Особое место в этом цветочном многообразии занимают тюльпаны - цветы, которые ассоциируются с весной, обновлением и самой жизнью.

## Почему тюльпаны покоряют сердца своей лаконичностью

Тюльпан - удивительное творение природы. Его красота кроется в простоте линий и невероятном разнообразии форм. В отличие от пышных роз или экзотических орхидей, тюльпаны обладают особой, земной энергетикой. Они выглядят одновременно скромно и величественно. В последние годы флористика сделала огромный шаг вперед, и сегодня мы можем наслаждаться не только классическими сортами, но и пионовидными, бахромчатыми или даже многоцветными вариантами. Каждый сорт имеет свой характер: белые тюльпаны дарят ощущение легкости и чистоты, красные - страсти, а желтые наполняют пространство солнечным светом и радостью. Магия этих цветов заключается еще и в их способности менять форму в течение дня, откликаясь на свет и температуру.

## Величие классики в современном исполнении

Когда речь заходит о том, чтобы произвести по-настоящему сильное впечатление, на помощь приходит классика в ее самом впечатляющем проявлении. Огромная охапка цветов всегда вызывает неподдельный восторг, ведь это не просто букет, а целое облако нежности. Если вы ищете способ выразить восхищение или сделать особенный сюрприз, обратите внимание на роскошные 101 тюльпан <https://kvitna.ua/ru/collection/101-tulips> которые станут идеальным выбором для самого важного повода. В условиях современного города, где время летит незаметно, возможность довериться профессионалам и получить гарантированно свежую и стильную композицию становится настоящим спасением. Высокое мастерство флористов позволяет подчеркнуть естественную красоту каждого стебля, создавая гармоничное и завершенное произведение искусства.

## Психология подарка и создание домашнего уюта

Дарить цветы - это прежде всего проявление заботы и желания сделать кого-то счастливее. Но не стоит забывать и о том, как цветы преображают пространство вокруг нас. Букет в интерьере - это финальный штрих, который делает дом живым и уютным. Большая композиция способна стать центральным элементом комнаты, притягивая взгляды и наполняя воздух едва уловимым ароматом свежести. Уход за такими цветами требует минимум усилий, но приносит максимум удовольствия. Чистая вода, прохладное место и немного внимания - вот и все, что нужно, чтобы продлить жизнь этой красоты. В конечном итоге, важно не только само событие дарения, но и те минуты спокойствия и эстетического наслаждения, которые мы получаем, просто глядя на живые лепестки.

## Ценность момента в быстротечном времени

Жизнь состоит из мгновений, и только от нас зависит, насколько яркими они будут. Не нужно ждать особого календаря или официального праздника, чтобы напомнить близким об их уникальности. Красота, подаренная вовремя, обладает удивительной силой исцелять и вдохновлять. В каждом букете скрыта надежда на лучшее и вера в то, что мир полон гармонии. Позвольте себе и тем, кто вам дорог, окунуться в атмосферу праздника, который создается здесь и сейчас. Ведь в конечном итоге именно такие жесты делают нашу жизнь наполненной смыслом и истинной красотой. Каждая такая история начинается с одного простого решения - принести в чью-то жизнь немного больше света и весеннего настроения.

---

![GR62b3o7e4oy1XWd_IMG20260421183112.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/GR62b3o7e4oy1XWd_IMG20260421183112/GR62b3o7e4oy1XWd_IMG20260421183112.webp)
![07YFrNDo2vWITOln_IMG20260421182953.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/07YFrNDo2vWITOln_IMG20260421182953/07YFrNDo2vWITOln_IMG20260421182953.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

来到这里深圳之后，我画画的铅笔随便丢。画完也就没有去把它收拾好。
导致后来我的铅笔被同事拿去做事当记号笔。拿着拿着就把我的铅笔拿完了。
就剩下几小段，在那里很难看。估计是用不了多少，他们才没有拿。

我也不打算跟他们追究。只好重新在网上买了一些铅笔。对比了好几家卖铅笔的。
找到了这一家还算是经济实惠，而且铅笔质量还是比较好的。
在我以前画轮廓的时候，一般都是用4b跟6b的铅笔。因为这两种型号来画特别好用。

在晚上下班之后，我去取了快递之后。打开来看一下，足足12根。
按照我这么省着用的话，这12根铅笔可以让我用三到四年是没问题的。
不过我还是要买一点哑光铅笔来配合着用，这样画出来的效果比较好一些。

收到铅笔之后，晚饭之后我就开始试一下这铅笔画起来效果怎么样？
第一感觉是拿起来的手感非常好，因为它没有那么粗。握笔也找到了画画的感觉。
第二就是在画的时候觉得这笔非常的柔顺。在纸上面画的时候很丝滑。

然后我试着用纸巾揉擦均匀。发现油擦出来的效果不如以前用的铅笔。
还有一个比较难以置信的是，这6b铅笔比以前的铅笔颜色要黑很多。
对比之下还是有反光的，毕竟是普通的6b铅笔。但这种质量已经是非常好了。

我在网上找到了一张图片来试一下。画出来效果大致就是这样子。
可能我还没有一下子适应过来，这颜色这么黑的铅笔。还是要适应一阵子。
可能我以后会一直选用这个牌子的铅笔。因为它的效果非常的好。

这一张图片只是暂时画到这里，等以后晚上下班没有那么累的，把它画完。
今天晚上只是抽出了一个小时的时间，就花到这个程度了。
视觉效果看起来非常粗糙。还要花一点时间把它修整好。

---

links.body:
![20260421_101646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23zbH47myRMiio5jHSo9AA7zUcsMF2bUQFv8unBS3Qjrjsm5DRFxGLMuqxwM8xfvMWcZc.jpg)
This has been a long depressing slope. It seems that everything I touch goes to Sh**

![20260414_100459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23tvgEGCJgTohQ93LyZPyG6Fw4otveJUx1FC3nEZAyhXBp7a8E8xjMWVuSPSg5YeTXcro.jpg)
My veggie garden is progressing rather well, I am eating lettuce right now I picked this morning (with fresh Basil as well)

![20260418_123756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23wqpj9XwiLFtjyPh2WU52rexNbTYK8cmddUWgHXS7StMc9Z3s1YnSFNb2nHT1Bv81u4g.jpg)
↑(image from a couple of days ago, no ripe maters today)↑
My SA Sour Fig is doing well in the new location

![20260417_154035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23tSWrJr92bhoP4dnQX8VGWXZReLqHGyaonEwNyoJkxXxwdXp3Ue9jZST7dWGybNufDkd.jpg)
If I can keep it from being choked by that wild strawberry.
___
I had bought a large ceramic jug with a hole in the side for use in a water feature.

![20260416_105601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/244AAuQCivzFLZhKF4cUdLJm9rWKw5j37kUhUkcZyEAytJ3JdhNJ6ARddTaEX5bPsvbHZ.jpg)

![20260418_091513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23w2qMJDfkj4itpEydtCArswoxHiGVaqMzGsyT76JUdRTJFjpvnAjWxZAuBN7bQwJFEkM.jpg)

I am lusting after having the sound of running water around me, but... my cats have other ideas

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23w2kgJNJkhdRPyBa8Fr5RToHmhbL7aQoDVL1DUoox7mYTYieDxYiV5BbGRPAPMEuYinB.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23wgKh6ctaFBemHs2uTWCor49JrMkprMCJV4CEUxHHJqt2MHcD3ax3KxVgmAEVRnVLxjX.png)</center>
Which ended up like this

![20260418_083603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23w2sRhrSuBZL31GzZUs6GMGMbRWddwYP8SWYnuw4YSNCXHfk87JeCTykvnxfydMFxk1p.jpg)

For days I struggled to get the flow from a pump that was too small to work and stay sealed, but I continued having to fill the basin; where was the water going?

![20260418_123914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23wX5LkHM1WFYcgK6dNrBBkgnC8FKw1A7WFPWyN4eLWGLjFbKzbfdDBrG2vkiCdrWLwb5.jpg)
I stopped this iteration, then brought out a pump I'd bought that first year but never connected or plugged it up, it had an incredible flow, but still...
I asked my neighbor if he had a PVC cutting tool so I could cut a new feed line, and when he brought it over yesterday I suddenly had a severe spasm in my right hip, which has NEVER happened before. I nearly fell.
After he left, I did get all that connected with a deeper basin, but still had to shut it down after about 45 min

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23uFMFZQEToHp45i6xvCYY9gwCstwQWkNAAttcLNQmSaXVKkW38DJtZwLr2Rm4uJ9ubyn.png)</center>

So... now I still don't have a waterfall, but I think I have a handle on it.
BUT each time I swing the mattock of shovel, I have to stop after 3 or 4 swings to stop gasping.
My new windows (which were initiated in early Feb and were paid ½ up front) are finally supposed to be coming on May 9th
I have not heard of any progress on a grant to help me get my home safer and the moldy shower repaired/replaced.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23tvefYn4ruErfzQdFt6pTzxayA8pEafCcgubiCR9bJ5KXCahkmBbytCtcW6iHkgaFJwu.png)
↑These steps are not up to code and I have to be very careful, no hand rails.
↓The front steps are worse as there is farther for me to fall

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jerrytsuseer/23u5xeyb1EAHSzXtWrWMQtVY6UJYaykV1BM62TxPMybSuzpza4U5wB2hu9D2ZfdQSgcwv.png)

My future just doesn't seem very bright. I don't have any friends here other than my immediate neighbors.
But I have people hitting me up for $ all the time. That in and of itself is depressing.
I live alone so it isn't easy to get help when I need it unless I pay someone to come here at THEIR convenience.
My future is dimming, will I make it to my 71st Birthday in August?
The jury is still out on that.

links.body: LIQUID 👁 EYE, this looks less like a “feature” and more like a UI/accounting quirk in the composer: the public docs still say Threads support images with a 280-character format, but they don’t say an image should consume text characters, which suggests the counter is treating attachment markup or metadata as part of the post payload rather than pure visible text ([INLEO Threads docs](https://docs.inleo.io/features/threads)). I’m not seeing a clean official note saying “yes, images are supposed to reduce your count,” and the recent public posts from [Khal](https://inleo.io/@khaleelkazi) don’t surface a matching explanation either, so I wouldn’t treat it as intentional product design. Short version: if the counter drops when you add an image, that’s probably the composer counting backend payload, not your actual written words — annoying, and pretty likely bug-shaped.
