links.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbaKxeFFLqhWWZ6PBnqZRQ92nwUnMik8xWzpLQgx6yfve/images.jpg)[Embestida -Fuente: Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DXCZ-17jtJQ/)</center>

#

<div class = \

> **ESPAÑOL** --- # Hola a todos, buenos días. ¿Cómo pasaron este fin de semana? Yo me puse a revisar unas películas que tenía en lista, y escogí una de bastante suspenso en la cartelera de Netflix, y se veía muy buena. Confieso que les tengo pavor a serpientes y tiburones, pero por alguna loca razón, me encantan esas películas. La película se llama “Embestida”, y trata de un biólogo marino que estudiaba la vida de algunas especies de tiburones que se daban albergue en las aguas marinas cercanas a su pueblo, y la llegada de un huracán de elevada magnitud, provocó que las olas del mar crecieran y sobrepasaran las barreras que protegían la población desde la costa. Los pobladores tuvieron órdenes de evacuar antes de que el pronóstico de que el mar entrara al pueblo se cumpliera, pero algunos habitantes no lo hicieron, como el caso de Lisa, una chica embarazada que venía de New York, y quedó atrapada en el carro cuando el agua la arrastró hacia un árbol.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNq8j3Q9ieMUALbyYktdiHYybHCae9Xvjxscej2Giro86/da816717_1287_42fc_b0f0_8f2721031072.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8aZ6wZengBadnbj7ydhk9Ak7thth4aQGTpUJUt1cZum/626ecbeb_f0ee_497e_95c3_62be027da227.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVmrxhBShtiKGBRftd5CEys8hMp9g9bkuQeCUigPj8BT2/786abbc5_1651_43e6_9eaf_afa08ac6deaf.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5Ms3xRda49bdR5YoqduPNFimr2hZuW9v7ADn9jTY7Yn/b5be3911_da17_402e_b4c6_880b8c712c51.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRe26sP7PtqeCgYEPztH8EEoeFFotmgwLJLeA9iSK2k2/de599539_0561_427d_ab06_4ce2f6521ddd.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme5UCXzwEaHiGBsvi35A6FNrRsFvgct9E4JTBhEXhy3r1/ecc9d872_b9dc_4cfb_b62f_4f56c4467e5b.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdfPgpAefCXdrEr57TAHnh14KY9867XvM3onWrVLoB1a/4bf0d3b3_b8e5_4dd0_a9eb_4d6042baf8f2.jpg)

> También sucedió con tres chicos y sus padres adoptivos, quienes por la intransigencia del hombre, también quedaron atrapados en su casa y los tiburones giraban alrededor de ellos en su sala. El caso de Dakota, una de las protagonistas, que por problemas de depresión se quedó en su casa y no se enteró de lo que estaba pasando… ella era la sobrina del biólogo marino. La tragedia las unió a ella y a Lisa para brindarnos las escenas más emocionantes de la trama. En medio de tiburones hambrientos, los personajes de esta película batallaron para sobrevivir de una inundación que arrastró su pueblo, y casi sus vidas. Pero tienen que verla, es demasiado emocionante y llena de suspenso y acción. Esta película se encuentra en Netflix. Las imágenes que les comparto no están muy nítidas porque son fotografías de la pantalla. La plataforma no permite hacer capturas. Gracias por visitar mi blog… espero que tengan un feliz inicio de semana.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-CO1UNAtpNg [Trailer oficial en Netflix por YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-CO1UNAtpNg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHZvhjdRjyCkmov2DNMu1ABWyEub12YomeJBnq8RW1Va/annafenix_2.png)

> **ENGLISH** --- # Hello everyone, good morning. How did you spend this weekend? I started reviewing some movies I had on my list, and I chose one that was quite suspenseful on Netflix, and it looked very good. I confess that I am terrified of snakes and sharks, but for some crazy reason, I love those movies. The film is called “Onslaught”, and it is about a marine biologist who was studying the life of some species of sharks that found shelter in the marine waters near his town, and the arrival of a hurricane of high magnitude caused the sea waves to grow and surpass the barriers that protected the population from the coast. The residents had orders to evacuate before the forecast of the sea entering the town came true, but some residents did not do so, such as the case of Lisa, a pregnant girl who came from New York, and was trapped in the car when the water dragged her towards a tree.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQutPUnhpoUcLpGF94AwYen4oex4sjuPMQis5VkutcNjc/6df2457d_1626_42b4_a956_6364e1f64503.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKWJrcnNwWeTA9pubPwt8PpiqAnLHPbx3rzg9D341qnx/ac17a9ff_8386_4f4c_b9d9_436b3e315f98.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcKYaxPrp9pVkzDNfShWuMhW5h6tcZ5GF1qx2fdRRSigM/45fcfa53_837f_4fa9_914b_e4b261f4eaf8.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf5fP2e4xoSJwESz6cu4UYTLacZSJQwHdH8QRk5QbHbdU/52bcba3c_6477_4a6a_bbae_9f87ae52695b.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZUPTDiA5PkK1eJnQjTmA5YVY8EGS5XnGDbsJB44KVHZG/60fec8b3_fb1a_4331_b15f_eb4bf0d3be37.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbitXv3H8ufRK1BALFYn9GLU4hhCDDiALhvgfWV2rDauC/66f4d769_02b6_4957_b791_84aa8c070939.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrRxYLds87aJ2L1WLA233BbrmtcMJCc4mHqj2PLWybUc/552d05ae_806f_43c0_9f2f_741de61aec1f.jpg)

> It also happened to three boys and their adoptive parents, who, due to the man's intransigence, were also trapped in their house and the sharks were circling around them in their living room. The case of Dakota, one of the protagonists, who due to depression problems stayed at home and did not find out what was happening... she was the niece of the marine biologist. The tragedy brought her and Lisa together to give us the most exciting scenes of the plot. Amid hungry sharks, the characters in this film battled to survive a flood that swept away their town, and almost their lives. But you have to see it, it's too exciting and full of suspense and action. This movie is on Netflix. The images I share with you are not very clear because they are photographs of the screen. The platform does not allow captures. Thank you for visiting my blog… I hope you have a happy start to the week.

links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT53L8dZwDPHAGRceQVd5qStsbN8morocE6ey4QpZndAp/1776785415918.jpg)

Querida comunidad Green Zone,  
Siempre me resulta placentero escribir para ustedes, para quienes pasan por este espacio a leer, reflexionar e interactuar. Hoy quiero compartir algo desde lo personal, casi como si estuviera “susurrando una nueva canción”, parafraseando al inolvidable Pablo Milanés. No es una canción nueva en mi proyecto de vida, pero sí lo es en la forma en que esta mañana me encontré con ella, al despertar, una de las primeras cosas que hice fue revisar mi librero. En ese recorrido por los títulos que me acompañan, fui deteniéndome en algunos que me llamaron la atención y pensé en lo mucho que la lectura ha significado para mí y en cómo puede convertirse en un aliado insustituible en nuestro crecimiento integral.  

Leer no es solo acumular información. Leer es abrir ventanas hacia otras formas de pensar, sentir y actuar. Es un ejercicio que nos ayuda a subir de nivel en todas las dimensiones de nuestra vida: física, mental, espiritual y financiera. Y quiero compartir cómo algunos libros que me han acompañado han sido claves en mi propio proceso de crecimiento y, humildemente, también en el de las personas con las que he interactuado.  

Mientras revisaba mi librero, me encontré con “Consideraciones sobre inteligencia emocional”. Este libro me enseñó que el control de nuestras emociones es tan importante como el conocimiento académico. Aprender a reconocer lo que sentimos, a gestionarlo y a expresarlo de manera constructiva es un paso esencial para fortalecer la mente y evitar que se derrumbe ante cualquier golpe.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRY8gxX3y235xrcgrPXnM7jN6d15szzvnWagjavL1LaUE/1776785576771.jpg)

Más adelante, mis ojos se posaron sobre “Jugando a vivir: una guía para padres y educadores”. Este texto me mostró que el crecimiento personal no es un camino solitario: también se construye en la relación con los demás, especialmente con los niños. La lectura aquí se convierte en un puente para comprender mejor la importancia de la educación emocional y del acompañamiento consciente en la formación de nuevas generaciones.  

Otro título que me impactó profundamente fue “Comer, sentir… vivir!”, acompañado del epígrafe “cómo mejorar tu bienestar físico, mental y emocional a través de la alimentación”. Este libro me recordó que el cuerpo también necesita ser cuidado con disciplina y respeto, y que la alimentación no es solo un acto físico, sino una forma de nutrir nuestra mente y nuestro espíritu.  

En mi repaso apareció un libro con un título sugestivo y provocador: “¿Confío en mis padres?”. Esta pregunta abre un espacio de reflexión sobre la relación entre padres e hijos, sobre la confianza como base de la vida familiar y sobre cómo esas dinámicas influyen en nuestro desarrollo integral.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWCcuo8ZbiguBUDr5nAPU8kcqz4p2pZ96TeJVAMgxHvuw/1776785511397.jpg)

No puedo dejar de mencionar textos que abordan temas dolorosos pero inevitables, como “¿Cómo afronto el cáncer?”. Este libro me enseñó que la lectura también puede ser un refugio en medio del caos, una guía para encontrar paz y fortaleza en circunstancias difíciles. Del mismo modo, los textos sobre el cuidado de enfermos dependientes me han recordado la importancia del autocuidado de quienes acompañan a familiares con enfermedades crónicas. Leer sobre estos temas me ha permitido comprender mejor la resiliencia y la necesidad de equilibrio entre dar y cuidarse a uno mismo.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEVimim1KDxv6Kfs6AuQkzX3Lebd69MuaGLYxBUMp1WY/1776785708921.jpg)

Finalmente, me detuve en un libro que, aunque su título no parece directamente relacionado con el crecimiento personal, me ha aportado una visión invaluable: “A propósito de Galileo”. A través de la vida y obra de este eminente científico, comprendí que la creatividad, el estudio, la investigación y el aporte social son pilares fundamentales para evolucionar como seres humanos. Galileo me enseñó que el conocimiento no es solo para uno mismo, sino para contribuir al bienestar colectivo.  

Todos estos títulos, cada uno desde su perspectiva, me han mostrado que el verdadero crecimiento no ocurre cuando mejoramos solo un área de nuestra vida y abandonamos las demás. Ocurre cuando trabajamos en nosotros de manera completa: cuerpo, mente, espíritu y finanzas. Leer es una decisión incómoda a veces, porque exige disciplina, constancia y silencio cuando nadie aplaude. Pero también es una decisión transformadora, porque nos invita a soltar viejas versiones de nosotros mismos y abrazar la evolución.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXUNdKbfwi7PQtiifmdJygrvYwgEkrcPTXKuktk1aLoBU/1776785657048.jpg)

Hoy, al revisar mi librero, entendí que la lectura no solo cambia lo que sabemos: cambia quiénes somos. Y ese es el verdadero poder transformador de leer en nuestro crecimiento personal.

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8NxVgy4gwzyp6DQhH5bFiDnCC7e3UoZD2sHdkm8NfM4/1776488489652.jpg)

links.title: 16 postcards with Easter eggs & stuff
links.body:
Hive Collectors community have suggested this theme - Easter decorations, and though I did not respond momentarily, I did something to show you; the topic was tailored like exactly for me.  😎 Beware - this might be a long reading (and watching). Not that I consider myself a real collector of Easter eggs, but still - accumulated some stuff thru the years that without douts can be considered a small but original collection.

![2026-apr-1756w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23zbVujYBsoy4UjQbRsiSyeygTU3471RVg4wiysS1YHcAecFaSqMucqGF1KtBM7gjcTer.jpg)
<div class=\

>

\nI've heard that during Holy Week in Spain, you can see picturesque processions of people carrying palm leaves and olive branches on the streets; they symbolize Jesus's arrival in Jerusalem, when people greeted him with palm branches. This is one of the traditional symbols of the holiday. In my country, the palm is an exotic plant, and since the Middle Ages, it has been replaced by the willow.\n

>

\nThe pussy willow is one of the first plants to adorn its still-bare branches with beautiful \

in early spring. They grow everywhere, and are a common and accessible plant. On the eve of the holiday, many flower vendors sell pussy willow on city streets and at markets. Those in a hurry, or who consider it beneath them to pick a few branches on the street or in a park, can buy them from the aforementioned vendors.

--------- ![2026-mar-0766w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tvgK1cANNfoAiVPDv7jmCh5gzAEBESMW4FxSifwbJYDCgKvGKZhEfZbHRXqJKC3uUZy.jpg) I brought home one branch of flowering pussy willow from a recent trip to Zelenogorsk, now it decorates our dining table - and I hope it will last for a few weeks.

>

\nhttps://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23xp69kAg8WBiwvMgFhwKhFvR5kpgwP2e3LNHT9QjH5W9YjgdeK13kU56TBcThiaHCXog.jpg\n

>

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tGc5TBZE9stZ5Auz8XWMZcAS4j2wRaQFB4nef7zf14pUEgbieCEru7UdBBMnqSKAWtS.jpg

![sep1201.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/0Y2ZeDUN-sep1201.png)

>

\nAnother solid Easter symbol is an egg (a symbol of the soul). Decorating Easter eggs is a whole other topic; to cover it in detail would require several blog posts. Every year, my wife (and I, and now our daughter) sit around a basket of eggs on the eve of the holiday and transform them into works of art!

\nThere are various techniques and secret family traditions, as well as simply familiar and convenient methods—everyone discovers their favorites over the years. One of the simplest and most accessible methods is to boil eggs with onion skins. The effect resembles marbled paper, and the orange-brown color can be varied and customized.

>

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23wgMWckTbCMh8JjRNHhij9qae3SAx2cxYaioJZJiGLXkZhjyG3iwFDEfVoSrvYVnYYeD.jpg

Some of our friends decorate Easter eggs this way, but we have a different method – we use (non-synthetic) threads from our old stash.

---------

>

\nFirst, we wrap the egg several times with threads of different colors, trying to create the shape of a cross. Then, the eggs are boiled in water; the hot water draws the dye from the threads, mixing the colors in an unpredictable way (different threads have different intensities)—an alchemical marriage that transfers to the shell.\n

>

I take a break from the process to take photos. The most interesting and surprising part of the process is, of course, unwinding the threads and examining the finished product. It's a truly analog process, and the exact outcome cannot be predicted in advance.

--------- ![2026-apr-1160w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23wC3BzcrTkR2WhDejat1WSr6rAPdbvAJpoKrdt71D6CQb9tYV4AZ6JkCt1uWpJ4oYM9z.jpg) This year, our new family member also took part in the Easter preparations. He can't dye eggs and is very bad at winding threads, but he's an excellent unwinder! real PRO, an absolute champion at this endeavor. ![2026-apr-1175w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/EoAZpKoxPFBqEcqp2nV1ovT87zFy6gpoUKHLG6PJTP9VukEz2vvxjCqU5VLtWnpTo5f.jpg) Intermediate result: the water has been removed, all that remains is to remove the wound threads. ![2026-apr-1244w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23u67BY3DEsx6L9tL6MthDbHpGjvgvSNkV6dnUo8YYTnSiTGA1GsVmbvR6V7CR7qURenD.jpg) Thats a slightly meditative and pleasurable part... ![2026-apr-1241w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23wMRn7v7JuKMKvPy9dJqychixpcLX1zgy77CZZdcfHdNVcds9Nmakwo9mqhv6gMJCBQJ.jpg) The result is gradually revealed... ![2026-apr-1245w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23uFPgH7DKFf7eBuPfpbWqJo2E1xUFmtPKbMP6no9PoSqnoJrz4DxPZ9jAoBospAJc3Am.jpg) ...sometimes it's not at all what you expected :) ![2026-apr-1769w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23w2gpeV2dpL8t4HnRXer6k1yMGBtwn6mkov1HKoNhwumkBzY3B2aQMMkujERKvooKzoR.jpg) This egg has the most even, perfect cross. And the uniform light gray background is the result of mixing different colors. Incidentally, a very beautiful, deep, and interesting gray color is achieved by boiling it with hibiscus tea leaves. I highly recommend trying this recipe someday. ![2026-apr-1770w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/EoeD4ggCAsG7nSReYUE3HRu69kH4iCJBafMfyQg7U6BMe5ktNG7sRGwBceF5bwSxBBW.jpg) Oh, and keep in mind: for thread dyeing, you need natural cotton threads! They're dyed with natural dyes and will release their colors into the water. Synthetic threads dyed with synthetic pigments are unlikely to release their colors into the eggs. ![2026-apr-1290w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/EogMNQmvGM3Gpd5eTGYtRExrWAZDWYDPWMmFZqSzYxTyboZgbTLddwRJz1MQGEyJVDr.jpg) ![sep1201.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/0Y2ZeDUN-sep1201.png) Easter eggs go together well with Easter cakes. ![2026-apr-1419w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/EoCi7GLMpZyiZJM1UQSSy8hcA4BhdjVEVcpAFvGEyFdYfuR7C7RNZxCY3mfQcogNCAN.jpg) I won't boast, but my wife over the years has got a very high skill for Easter cakes baking. She cooks them basing on yeast-free starter, and boosts with a good doze of spices and soft nuts. This time she produced 10 pieces — some we gave away to our parents, friends, and our daughter's godmother. ![2026-apr-1407w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tbtknW5xvCFbWm9tAS4d9Mf9dr8maShJTmQy7THnLdENQweoeamnpCrdtMB26Y7RAMh.jpg) My usual participation is encouraged at the final stage, where I photograph the finished product, and my daughter helps prepare the icing and decorates the kulichi straight out of the oven—she loves giving them colorful tops. But this year, my role expanded: I sourced the spices and ground the cardamom seeds in a mortar, as well as finely chopped turmeric and nutmeg. (No one documented the process of grinding the spices in a mortar, so I can't show you any photos.) ![sep1201.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/0Y2ZeDUN-sep1201.png) And here I planned to show our modest collection of Easter eggs we accumulated thru years, which we dried up and saved - the most outstanding specimens, a pleasure for an eye that one's hand simply does not rise to break up. ![2026-apr-1758w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tbiXQAidUzGxBF6UNM16gni6cqszkXD3G1ZLWQh3uT79BzZtiCcLguDSiBktknuPpaL.jpg) But... it's impossible to embrace the unembraceable, so perhaps I'll wrap up my blog here. To be continued... Maybe. ![2026-apr-1760w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23vhudd1gQkaHWcc7DWPPLtSFLt1rhJaATqKZLrS63JdDrrqMZYw8ko9M6CtSE5jvn9TV.jpg)
![sep1201.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/0Y2ZeDUN-sep1201.png)

>

┌─────────────────────┐
Please support posts in
the community.
Lets grow together,
it is more fun!
└─────────────────────┘

\n

title.title: [Esp-Eng] Arugula and Strawberry Salad
title.body: > Of all fruits, strawberries are my favorite; to me, they’re synonymous with “dessert”—well, they were, until I tried a strawberry and arugula salad. It’s a combination that might seem a little strange or unconventional, but it’s really delicious. The sweet and tart flavor of the strawberries pairs perfectly with the slightly bitter and intense flavor of the arugula. Plus, this salad is very refreshing and can be eaten on its own or as a side dish with any of your meals.
>\nDe todas las frutas, la fresa es mi favorita, para mí es sinónimo de \

, bueno, era, hasta que probé la ensalada de fresas con rúcula. Es una combinación que podría resultar medio extraña o poco convencional pero es muy rica. Lo dulce y ácido de la fresa combina muy bien con el sabor un poco amargo e intenso de la rúcula. Además, esta ensalada es muy fresca y sirve para comer por sí sola o para acompañar alguna de tus comidas.

>

Ingredients:

200 g arugula leaves (washed) 8 strawberries (washed) 80 g cream cheese (I used Andino-style, but something similar to Gouda works too) 1 tablespoon olive oil 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar Salt and pepper to taste

>

Ingredientes:

200 gr de hojas de rúcula (limpias) 8 unidades de fresas (limpias) 80 gr de queso cremoso (yo use tipo andino pero también puede ser algo parecido al gouda) 1 cucharada de aceite de oliva 2 cucharadas de vinagre balsámico Sal y pimienta al gusto

>

Preparation:

Like most fresh salads, the preparation is very simple. However, before you start mixing the ingredients, be sure to wash the arugula as you normally do with all your vegetables, then let it drain—do the same with the strawberries. Next, cut the cheese into small cubes and the strawberries in half.

>

Preparación:

Cómo la mayoría de las ensaladas frescas, la preparación es muy sencilla, eso sí, antes de comenzar a mezclar los ingredientes asegúrate de lavar la rúcula como lo haces de costumbre con todos tus vegetales y luego deja escurrir, lo mismo con las fresas. Luego cortamos el queso en cuadritos y las fresas en mitades.

> Place everything in a bowl or salad bowl, add salt and pepper to taste, then the olive oil, and mix all the ingredients together. Finally, add the balsamic vinegar and continue mixing so that all the flavors and ingredients blend together.

> Ponemos todo en un bowl o ensaladera, agrega sal y pimienta para dar un poco de gusto, luego el aceite de oliva y mezcla todos los ingredientes. Por último, agrega el aceto balsámico o vinagre balsámico y continúa mezclando para que se integren todos los sabores e ingredientes.

title.title: AI Automation in 2026: How Structured Systems Are Replacing Manual Communication
title.body:
In 2026, AI automation has become a core operational layer for many businesses, especially in service industries where constant communication with customers is essential. Instead of relying entirely on human staff to answer calls, manage messages, and organize appointments, companies increasingly use AI-driven systems to handle these processes in a structured and consistent way.

The main change is the transition from fragmented manual communication to unified automated workflows.

***

**The Communication Challenge in Modern Business**

Businesses today face a simple but persistent problem: too many communication channels and too little time to manage them all effectively. Customers expect instant responses, while inquiries arrive simultaneously through phone calls, websites, messaging apps, and social media platforms.

Without automation, this often leads to missed leads, delayed responses, and inconsistent customer experience.

AI systems are designed to eliminate these gaps by ensuring continuous availability and immediate engagement.

***

**How AI Systems Manage Customer Requests**

Modern AI automation works as a structured communication layer. It receives incoming requests, interprets user intent, and responds according to predefined business rules.

Instead of simply replying to questions, the system guides users through a logical process. It can ask clarifying questions, collect necessary details, and direct the conversation toward a specific outcome such as booking, ordering, or requesting additional information.

This creates a predictable and standardized communication flow.

***

**From Conversations to Structured Business Data**

A key function of AI automation is transforming unstructured conversations into organized data.

Each interaction is processed in real time. The system identifies important information such as customer contact details, service interest, timing preferences, and urgency level.

This information is then automatically stored or transferred into internal systems such as CRMs, scheduling tools, or task management platforms, reducing manual administrative work.

***

**Consistent Communication Across Channels**

AI automation ensures that businesses maintain consistent communication across all customer touchpoints.

Whether a customer contacts a company through phone, website chat, SMS, or social media, the system applies the same logic and response structure. This eliminates inconsistencies and ensures a unified customer experience.

***

**Operational Benefits for Businesses**

One of the most significant advantages of AI automation is increased efficiency. Businesses can manage a larger volume of inquiries without increasing staff proportionally.

Response times become immediate, improving customer satisfaction and reducing lost opportunities. Routine tasks such as answering frequently asked questions, collecting data, and scheduling appointments are handled automatically.

This allows human employees to focus on more complex and value-driven work.

***

**Human Control and Oversight**

Even with advanced automation, human oversight remains important. Businesses define how the system behaves, what types of requests it can handle, and when escalation to a human agent is required.

In situations that require judgment or emotional understanding, the system transfers the interaction to a human operator.

This ensures that automation enhances efficiency without removing accountability.

***

**Implementation in Real-World Systems**

Deploying AI automation typically involves analyzing existing communication workflows and translating them into structured processes.

Once configured, the system operates continuously, handling interactions in real time. Over time, performance data can be used to refine workflows and improve accuracy.

***

**The Future of Business Communication Systems**

AI automation is becoming a standard infrastructure component in modern business environments. Communication is shifting from a reactive human process to a continuous, system-driven workflow.

The focus is increasingly on speed, consistency, and scalability across all customer interaction channels.

***

**Conclusion**

[AI Assistant](https://www.autovanceautomation.com/) is fundamentally reshaping business communication. By replacing manual, fragmented processes with structured and always-active systems, companies can reduce inefficiencies, improve responsiveness, and deliver more consistent customer experiences across all channels.

title.title: Fueling Up on Love and Subsidy: A Hive PH Story from Bulacan
title.body:
![collage.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/AJoKF8CzuRbdx3TSVRchaJ7z46cUqfMxpCk1MmSdr6Fjz1KrEpUHrav4fccmbaq.jpeg)

**Mabuhay Hive Fam!**

**Hello Hive Fam, especially my co-Filipino Hive blog writers in the Hive PH Community!** I’m excited to share a little slice of my life with you today.

![willowbend.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23u67LK4QNvcTbs7dvzWykrcvvCagjwNqeXgr8dmisjpZFoY5m2AmeXV6M2aaxQdsEQhn.jpeg)

Yesterday, my boyfriend arrived from Manila to visit me and my fur baby, Cardo, our fluffy Chow Chow here in Bulacan. It was such a joy to see him again and to watch Cardo’s excitement when he recognized his familiar face.

![lumina.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23uFRqBn5V3VdvYEtA93MuSrZ2ACsPgKYZt6WanjvR1ku79C75VAHoH1kSE9qayDRFuYq.jpeg)

![lumina2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23zGYLkzCnbRqC1A9eanSp4TNPQvxXGivpzt9JcZFNP5QxcrM5uJSs5rZoX83c416fmtf.jpeg)

Before we could even sit down for lunch, he suggested we go out to purchase unleaded gas for my car. Honestly, it’s been months since I last used it because the tank was nearly empty and I didn’t have extra cash to fill it up. To my surprise, he took the initiative to pay for the gas since he had just received his fuel subsidy after enduring long and tiring hours of falling in line for cash assistance in Manila.

![siling bata.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23yJADgMFK1XqeYc3WnGP2fkDoHquXjvwyTXpGM8onMUutej6sVoKgrZopsc5zRScnG5B.jpeg)

That gesture meant so much to me. It wasn’t just about the fuel; it was about his thoughtfulness and willingness to help with something essential. On our way to the gas station, I snapped a few random photos, so I’d have something to share with you all here on Hive.

![gas station.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wC7mYdNsqtDqMZVUysndC3hudswx8c837Sx5oQdAYE5VJycYx4LZ2RK4L5VQANMwT1i.jpeg)

![gas station2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23w2jBdm9wUeGZi577NXzWgw1f48Fb3jJrEYBFwJebeUFio6xbp8ANXJLBd8YrWqoAgS6.jpeg)

Life may be simple, but moments like these remind me how blessed I am to have supportive people around me. **Thank you for reading my little update and for being part of my Hive journey.** I truly appreciate the Hive PH Community for giving us a space to share our stories and connect.

![gas station3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xozBZXVWLitWwFJqUGngCUgThpjHLfnAEqJnZgPneqiizLsotX4oJU1rV9NgZ6dGHc1.jpeg)

![gas station4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23z79qYqP3o3fp6HZzovzkn27JYpUH3a2u9wv6qHzEYxtYxpAr2sVK3NchiHi1qzkRgDb.jpeg)

![gas station5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23u69cuZ1L8CQCwEwwhtbYxCNXuk6jTiFBUinALzu47o5kaySEYnH68jywofWHDPZYfhw.jpeg)

**Maraming salamat, Hive Fam!** Until my next post, keep shining and keep sharing your stories.

![cardo.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23vsNTzbhEEagxMN3pPQJZpr99oAE4y9qeMunGZSNkmLG4PVyijzg8XdmvViAtPJ1kub8.jpeg)

title.title: Avoiding the Max Pain Trade
title.body:
### Portfolio down, sales up?

If you are like me - stuck with a 95%+ portfolio loss overall, despite holding a \

portfolio - then congratulations, you have completed the first phase of the max pain trade. **So why not sell now?** Well, if you haven't, then you probably know about the second phase of the max pain trade: **a recovering portfolio that you have sold off.**

Yes, I am actually still trying to avoid the potential pain that might come from seeing my sold off portfolio recover. At this point I definitely feel I only have a bit of delusional hope left, but again, *could you imagine seeing a recovery and having actually sold?* I reckon that pain may be more painful than selling a -99% portfolio. But then again, there is probably some peace that comes from not having to worry about anything related to market developments again. At times I came close to executing such a trade, but at least on Hive we have a 13 week power down that prevents such bold action.

### The Typical R.I.P. Chart

While this chart is showing SPS, the main price movement has been very consistent across the board and the insights here can be more or less extended to many ALT coins. What we have here is a ~5 year bear market in which a coin or token generally has sold off by 90-99%. Some coins do not even really show a consolidation phase (which has yet to be confirmed) and have just continued downward. In any case, it looks bleak, and it is often in these times when we lose patience and do \

. 


![{80D5FC38-E748-4181-8C40-4BF26C39F082}.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23uFwiZFWrWPfVzQk3zNmQFa8mDKZznCP4H89wMszvWiuCCKdnC5dmo62QzbuUBDbnrtX.png)


Of course the only really stupid thing everyone has done holding such a coin or portfolio is not having have sold. But here we are. So I guess they question is if price action could actually turn positive again for the foreseeable future. It doesn't seem outrageous to imagine the steep slopes of death reverse somewhat and go into a \

. \n\n[I have argued that we might be in for a ~3 year long ALT rally](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@tobetada/on-the-verge-of-a-3-year-long-alt-rally) that could peak in late 2028. With the 4 year halving event also set in 2028, a delayed peak is something we have often seen for the crypto cycle. But even if we should see some sort of long term reversal and recovery, there is no doubt that the type of recovery will heavily depend on the project itself. I wonder how many will actually get a new ATH or \

do a 10x and still be under water.


![{B7B03C20-3CF4-4757-AA02-E965A932931D}.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23tmmjSWybCzH7qHLiDzopBS3hdm81TXJyg13ynpnYBZ4MFqWzCcThicpPKPzUZ5Bc6e5.png)


### Conclusion

If you are still riding along, you have probably had a bad time. there is no sugar coating it. But selling now could be the ultimate mistake - and I am not ready to do it. Besides, the absolute value of the majority of portfolios is probably quite low to begin with. 


---

title.title: Dinosaurs /Les Dinosaures (documentary /documentaire) EN /FR
title.body:
Hello film lovers, /Bonjour les cinéphiles,

A new four-part documentary series has arrived on Netflix, produced by Steven Spielberg and narrated by Morgan Freeman in the original version.

As Steven Spielberg already knows a thing or two about the subject, having produced the Jurassic Park films, we decided to give this series a go to learn a bit more about dinosaurs.

> Une nouvelle série-documentaire, composée de 4 épisodes, est arrivée sur Netflix, produite par Steven Spielberg et racontée par Morgan Freeman, pour la version originale.
> 
> Comme Steven Spielberg s'y connaît déjà un peu sur le sujet, vu qu'il a produit les films Jurassic Park, nous nous sommes laissés tenter par cette série pour en apprendre un peu plus sur les dinosaures.


![dinosaures.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florenceboens/EpA3WdjBejgWCsG5XtJYNsidqFhzcyWatnWLuqoJuDoB4xuXDTF2fu55pwiYpGsEy8e.webp)
[Source](https://s1.qwant.com/thumbr/474x266/8/b/161bb9ec93ec3d3351168ed4e6ea970fc58fac469e8136f5804dd032d8d874/OIP.vqo2J7AQgjhlbPQSJeC71QHaEK.jpg?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftse.mm.bing.net%2Fth%2Fid%2FOIP.vqo2J7AQgjhlbPQSJeC71QHaEK%3Fpid%3DApi&q=0&b=1&p=0&a=0)
*Official announcement of the series /Annonce officielle de la série*

***Synopsis :*** 

The first episode begins 66 million years ago, then goes back even further into the past, and, as the episodes progress, we gradually return to the 66-million-year mark.

We heard various names of dinosaurs we didn’t know, others we’d heard before… but some well-known names weren’t even mentioned.

Often, too, they used generic terms such as ‘sauropods’, which can group several dinosaurs under a single name.

We have also followed the evolution of several ‘sauropods’ and ‘pterosaurs’.

> Le premier épisode commence il y a 66 millions d'années, puis recule encore bien plus loin dans le passé et, au fil des épisodes, nous revenons progressivement vers les 66 millions d'années.
> 
> Nous avons entendu différents noms de dinosaures que nous ne connaissions pas, d'autres que nous avions déjà entendu .. mais certains noms bien connus n'ont même pas été cités.
> 
> Souvent aussi, ils utilisaient des dénominations génériques comme \
qui peuvent regrouper plusieurs dinosaures sous une même appellation.\n> \n> Nous avons suivi les évolutions de plusieurs \

également.

---- 

***My thoughts and a few facts /Mon avis et petits infos :***

We learnt a few things, but we felt the subject was only skimmed over; there was scope to make more episodes, exploring the subject in greater depth and with more detail. 
We barely had time to see the dinosaur before we were already moving on to the next one, or even the next era.

Once again, as with the documentary on the oceans, I would have liked the names of the different species to be shown in the subtitles here too, so that we could remember them better.

Several scenes were also reused numerous times, particularly when discussing rising sea levels and changes to the Earth’s surface (Pangaea, continental drift, volcanoes, etc.)

We were disappointed by this documentary series, even though it was produced by Spielberg.

What did you think of it, if you’ve seen it?

Enjoy your evenings in front of the telly, see you soon,

> Nous avons appris certaines choses, mais nous trouvons que le sujet a été survolé, il y avait moyen de faire davantage d'épisodes, en approfondissant et détaillant le sujet. 
Nous avions à peine le temps de voir le dinosaure que nous passions déjà à la suite, voire à l'époque suivante.
> 
> A nouveau, comme pour le documentaire sur les océans, j'aurais bien aimé, ici aussi, que les noms des différentes espèces soient notées en sous-titres, afin de mieux les retenir.
> 
> Plusieurs scènes ont été réutilisées à de nombreuses reprises aussi, notamment pour parler de la montée des eaux et des modifications de terrain (pangée, séparation des continents, volcans, ..)
> 
> Nous avons été déçus par cette série-documentaire, pourtant produite par Spielberg.
> 
> Et vous, vous en avez pensé quoi, si vous l'avez vue ?
> 
> Bonnes soirées-tv, à bientôt, 

Florence

title.title: “The Power of Saying No: Protect Your Time and Energy”
title.body:
In today’s fast-paced world, people often feel pressured to say “yes” to everything—extra work, social plans, favors, and responsibilities. While it may seem like the right thing to do, constantly saying yes can drain your time, energy, and focus. Learning to say “no” is not selfish; it is one of the most powerful skills you can develop to protect your life and priorities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYCDajg1hqPU1oRuU9kxPshFFmMDpxmTdGKGbpmQaqBKg/img_3609.png)

Saying yes to everything might make others happy for a moment, but it often comes at the cost of your own well-being. When you overload yourself with tasks, you end up feeling stressed, exhausted, and unproductive. Your quality of work decreases, and you may even lose focus on your personal goals. This is why setting boundaries is essential.

The power of saying no lies in clarity. When you are clear about your goals and priorities, it becomes easier to decide what deserves your time and what doesn’t. Every time you say yes to something unimportant, you are indirectly saying no to something that truly matters. Time is limited, and how you choose to spend it shapes your future.

Another important aspect is self-respect. When you say no to things that don’t align with your values, you show that you respect your time and energy. People also begin to respect your boundaries. Contrary to common belief, saying no does not make you rude—it makes you focused and disciplined.

It’s also important to understand that saying no doesn’t always mean rejecting people. You can say no politely and respectfully. Simple responses like “I appreciate the offer, but I can’t commit right now” or “I need to focus on my current priorities” are enough. Clear communication helps maintain relationships while protecting your space.

Many successful people credit their success to their ability to say no. They don’t waste time on distractions or unnecessary commitments. Instead, they focus only on what truly matters. This focused approach allows them to achieve more with less effort.

Saying no also creates space—for rest, creativity, and personal growth. When your schedule is not overloaded, you have time to think, learn, and improve yourself. This balance is essential for long-term success and happiness.

In the end, saying no is about taking control of your life. It’s about choosing quality over quantity and focusing on what truly matters. You don’t have to do everything to be successful. You just need to do the right things consistently.

So next time you feel pressured to say yes, pause and think. Ask yourself: “Does this align with my goals?” If not, have the courage to say no. Because every strong no is a step toward a better, more focused life.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmVP53JytEx7m6DXBX2sp4p6zmaa8ajcdv3prHnrV9H5/0_wj9yq_ch2s3og5dg.gif)

‎Hello everyone,
I'm @naturaluttom. I hope everyone is well, I'm fine too.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJGCrdnHRfV9kqA4Q2f4byDp6js15havM46MjDP148Sg/1776784508458.jpg)

title.title: [ESP/ENG] Mi valoración de la serie “Él y Ella” / My assessment of the series \
title.body:
**Una introducción necesaria** 

 
Estrenada en enero de 2026 y protagonizada por Tessa Thompson y Jon Bernthal, Él y Ella (His & Hers) llegó a Netflix como un thriller que prometía el vértigo de las perspectivas enfrentadas. Adaptación de la novela de Alice Feeney, la serie se convirtió rápidamente en un fenómeno de audiencia, pero su verdadero valor reside en cómo utiliza el crimen para diseccionar algo más profundo: la fragilidad de una pareja rota por la tragedia .


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUqCRXDtxo1jhwTrqKoQuwhMacQp2wP4jaB3rMLR1nije/1776784447324.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/wilkinmeta/status/2010053603898339770?t=kyS6wgY0G0XJUfAxDSiAjQ&s=19)



**Conflictos que trascienden el género**

La serie plantea un conflicto aparentemente clásico: Anna (Thompson), una reportera que regresa a su pueblo natal para cubrir un asesinato, descubre que el detective a cargo es su exmarido Jack (Bernthal). Sin embargo, el verdadero motor narrativo no es la investigación, sino la desconfianza mutua. Tras la pérdida de su bebé, Anna y Jack se separaron; ahora, se observan como extraños que comparten un dolor inmenso . Este juego de sospechas—donde el espectador duda constantemente de quién miente—eleva la tensión por encima de los habituales giros del whodunit.

El trauma adolescente constituye el segundo gran conflicto. A través de flashbacks, descubrimos que las víctimas pertenecían al círculo de amigas de Anna, y que todas ocultan un secreto relacionado con un cumpleaños en el que la protagonista sufrió una agresión sexual mientras ellas miraban . Este pasado silenciado conecta el dolor del presente con una herida que lleva décadas sin cerrar.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxkSriC6S1b57dLjfDfS4hFhDfPSSwURQRQCicVTUhqa/1776784654258.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/NetflixLAT/status/2017628944195813399?t=x4ZsT_iAmPEoGJWfIwrldg&s=19)


**Momentos esenciales y giro final**

Entre los momentos esenciales destaca la revelación de que Lexy, la rival de Anna, es en realidad Catherine, una víctima de bullying que todos creían la asesina. Pero el punto de inflexión llega en los últimos minutos: una carta firmada por Alice, la madre de Anna, confiesa ser la verdadera autora de los crímenes . Al descubrir en una vieja cinta que su hija fue violada en su juventud, la anciana—invisible para todos—decide impartir su propia justicia . Este desenlace no solo es un golpe de efecto, sino que replantea por completo la historia que hemos visto.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6DTbg3DJ3hTe3vmH99voPHDu7Cpjeukf3McbUacp8Bd/1776784945900.jpg)[fuente](https://share.google/yroyfKLEQ4FDNeEfH)




**Enseñanzas y aspectos destacados**

Él y Ella deja varias enseñanzas. Habla de los límites del amor maternal y de cómo la violencia puede ser entendida como un acto de reparación tardía . También reflexiona sobre la imposibilidad de conocer al otro: ¿cómo dos personas que compartieron cama y un hijo pueden mirarse con tanto odio y, aún así, decidir perdonarse?.

Técnicamente, la serie destaca por las actuaciones de sus protagonistas. Thompson compone a una mujer construida como una armadura, mientras que Bernthal encarna a un hombre contenido y moralmente ambiguo . La dirección de William Oldroyd apuesta por una puesta en escena sobria que convierte los paisajes de Georgia en un reflejo de la opresión emocional.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVeNudgQYmRKcmGdKjZNYCxKAcnoNS7jxoAQgSyECoQY1/1776785155975.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/groups/358037539205112/permalink/1392252539116935/?app=fbl)


**Un comentario final **

Aunque Él y Ella no reinventa el género, sí logra algo más valioso: usa el andamiaje del thriller para sostener un drama íntimo sobre el duelo, la culpa y las versiones enfrentadas de una misma historia. Su final, que convierte a una madre anciana en la justiciera inesperada, es un recordatorio de que, a veces, las historias más retorcidas nacen del amor más profundo. Una serie que, más que resolver un crimen, indaga en las heridas que nos negamos a mirar

*Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate.*



**ENGLISH **


**The necessary introductions**

Released in January 2026 and starring Tessa Thompson and Jon Bernthal, His & Hers arrived on Netflix as a thriller that promised the vertigo of conflicting perspectives. Adapted from Alice Feeney's novel, the series quickly became a ratings phenomenon, but its true value lies in how it uses crime to dissect something deeper: the fragility of a couple broken by tragedy.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUqCRXDtxo1jhwTrqKoQuwhMacQp2wP4jaB3rMLR1nije/1776784447324.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/wilkinmeta/status/2010053603898339770?t=kyS6wgY0G0XJUfAxDSiAjQ&s=19)

**Conflicts that transcend gender**

The series poses a seemingly classic conflict: Anna (Thompson), a reporter who returns to her hometown to cover a murder, discovers that the detective in charge is her ex-husband Jack (Bernthal). However, the real narrative engine is not the investigation, but mutual distrust. After the loss of their baby, Anna and Jack separated; Now, they are seen as strangers who share immense pain. This game of suspicions—where the viewer constantly doubts who is lying—raises the tension above the usual whodunit twists.

Adolescent trauma constitutes the second great conflict. Through flashbacks, we discover that the victims belonged to Anna's circle of friends, and that they all hide a secret related to a birthday in which the protagonist suffered a sexual assault while they watched. This silenced past connects the pain of the present with a wound that has not healed for decades.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxkSriC6S1b57dLjfDfS4hFhDfPSSwURQRQCicVTUhqa/1776784654258.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/NetflixLAT/status/2017628944195813399?t=x4ZsT_iAmPEoGJWfIwrldg&s=19)

**Essential moments and final twist**

Among the essential moments is the revelation that Lexy, Anna's rival, is actually Catherine, a victim of bullying who everyone believed to be the murderer. But the turning point comes in the last minutes: a letter signed by Alice, Anna's mother, confesses to being the real author of the crimes. Upon discovering on an old tape that her daughter was raped in her youth, the old woman—invisible to everyone—decides to dispense her own justice. This outcome is not only a coup, but it completely reframes the story we have seen.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6DTbg3DJ3hTe3vmH99voPHDu7Cpjeukf3McbUacp8Bd/1776784945900.jpg)[fuente](https://share.google/yroyfKLEQ4FDNeEfH)


**Teachings and Highlights**

He and She leaves several teachings. It talks about the limits of maternal love and how violence can be understood as an act of belated reparation. He also reflects on the impossibility of knowing the other: how can two people who shared a bed and a child look at each other with so much hatred and, even so, decide to forgive each other?

Technically, the series stands out for the performances of its protagonists. Thompson composes a woman constructed as armor, while Bernthal embodies a restrained and morally ambiguous man. William Oldroyd's direction bets on a sober mise-en-scène that turns the landscapes of Georgia into a reflection of emotional oppression.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVeNudgQYmRKcmGdKjZNYCxKAcnoNS7jxoAQgSyECoQY1/1776785155975.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/groups/358037539205112/permalink/1392252539116935/?app=fbl)


**A final comment **

Although He and She does not reinvent the genre, it does achieve something more valuable: it uses the scaffolding of the thriller to sustain an intimate drama about grief, guilt and the conflicting versions of the same story. Her ending, which turns an elderly mother into the unexpected vigilante, is a reminder that, sometimes, the most twisted stories are born from the deepest love. A series that, more than solving a crime, investigates the wounds that we refuse to look at

*Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator*.

title.title: Divine lunch, roast pork with bacon and tasty potatoes/Un almuerzo divino: cerdo asado con tocino y patatas deliciosas.
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZf5FNjP4o51sFx6yGMJbPTYq2BN2vtHFCPfjejiCrZkL/1776780300971.jpg)

Good morning, blog friends, how are you? It's been a bit rainy here today, and the day seemed gloomy, so since I didn't feel like going out and getting caught in a downpour, I started cooking a divine lunch for my husband and I: a delicious roast pork with bacon and tasty potatoes.

 I'll leave you the recipe and, of course, photos of this delicacy: 

For the potatoes: 

* About half a kilo of new potatoes
 * Plenty of oil for frying
 * 3 tablespoons of salt 
* 3 tablespoons of rosemary 
* 3 tablespoons of chopped parsley
 * 3 tablespoons of black pepper

 For the pork: 

* 700 grams of pork roast
 * 7 slices of bacon 
* 3 tablespoons of oil 
* 1 sprig of rosemary

 First, prepare the potatoes. Peel them well, and then, if you like, do as I do, putting the peels under my eyes. I say they remove dark circles, I should do them every day! Then, cut them into thin slices. Add a good amount of oil to the pan, enough to half-cover all the potatoes. I can't give you a precise estimate because I added it as needed. Fry in a pan over low heat for about an hour, stirring often and adding oil if needed. Season during the cooking time. cooking with the salt and herbs written in the recipe.

☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️


Buenos días, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Hoy ha llovido un poco y el día estaba gris, así que, como no me apetecía salir y mojarme, me puse a preparar un almuerzo delicioso para mi marido y para mí: un asado de cerdo con tocino y unas patatas riquísimas.

 Les dejo la receta y, por supuesto, fotos de esta delicia:

 Para las patatas:

 * Medio kilo de patatas nuevas
 * Bastante aceite para freír
 * 3 cucharadas de sal
 * 3 cucharadas de romero
 * 3 cucharadas de perejil picado
 * 3 cucharadas de pimienta negra 

Para el cerdo: 

* 700 gramos de asado de cerdo
 * 7 lonchas de tocino
 * 3 cucharadas de aceite 
* 1 ramita de romero

 Primero, prepara las patatas. Pélalas bien y, si quieres, haz como yo: pon las cáscaras debajo de los ojos. ¡Dicen que quitan las ojeras, debería hacerlo todos los días! Luego, córtalas en rodajas finas. Agrega una buena cantidad de aceite a la sartén, suficiente para cubrir la mitad de las papas. No puedo darte una cantidad exacta porque lo agregué según lo necesitaba. Fríelas en una sartén a fuego lento durante aproximadamente una hora, revolviendo con frecuencia y agregando aceite si es necesario. Sazona durante la cocción con la sal y las hierbas indicadas en la receta.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSFEag5VYuA1eknKpQYEkDHJN3i34vhcdGzSSyoFNEqeJ/1776780322672.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMFWGSaxQn81PLmpAEzti57dZXDvEb6ihkSnmS4qndXw/1776780322871.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVEFGpt14T1dYmq6gocNhV7xGQgSTJETTfoiNWeWgfKJd/1776780323088.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWnQkkNapbN7GvgyW4635KE5ifGhgEF3jLeYXLWfkwqdb/1776780323248.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFv2ZFPG515spgdsUJmiye56L4HyazJAP9WC85xRKDkz/1776780323395.jpg)

Obviously, we also add spices like pepper to the potatoes; they'll be ready when they look crispier. I really like them this way. Then, for the roast, take our piece of roast pork—they usually sell it here already tied with string—take the bacon slices and wrap them around the roast, securing them with string where we also place the rosemary sprig.

 Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F), prepare a baking tray with parchment paper, place the roast on it, and drizzle with oil. Once the oven is hot, cook for about an hour and a half at 200°C (400°F), turning it occasionally. You'll have a super delicious roast with potatoes at the end. It's a bit of a long lunch to prepare, but I assure you, it's worth the time!


☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️

Obviamente, también añadimos especias como pimienta a las patatas; estarán listas cuando se vean más crujientes. A mí me gustan mucho así. Luego, para el asado, tomamos nuestro trozo de cerdo asado (aquí suelen venderlo ya atado con hilo), tomamos las lonchas de beicon y las envolvemos alrededor del asado, sujetándolas con hilo donde también colocamos la ramita de romero.

 Precalentamos el horno a 200 °C (400 °F), preparamos una bandeja de horno con papel vegetal, colocamos el asado y lo rociamos con aceite. Una vez que el horno esté caliente, cocinamos durante aproximadamente una hora y media a 200 °C (400 °F), dándole la vuelta de vez en cuando. Al final tendrás un asado con patatas súper delicioso. Es un almuerzo un poco laborioso de preparar, ¡pero te aseguro que merece la pena!

title.title: The Illusion of Fast Wealth
title.body:
We are often our own biggest problem, yet many of us do not realize this until it is too late. Whatever we do will certainly have an effect, either positive or negative, on our lives. Ignoring what is happening in our lives is like sleeping on a ticking situation that may explode later.

Life exists in phases, and we must understand and respect that. We need to pay attention to what is going on around us. A child who was just born today can not suddenly start working; if such a thing happens, it would be nothing short of a miracle. In the same way, when we try to live above our means, it eventually leads to trouble or reckless living.
Those who work for their money do not spend it carelessly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQbtnvxBeuxZbhQhG4GP3ge1DL7GGSPCZbPShVbf1LrPL/1776784366857.jpg)

The assertion that people who work for their money tend to spend it wisely holds true in many cases. Money earned without much effort often goes just as easily because the person may not fully value it. However, someone who earns money through sweat and struggle will think twice before spending it, remembering the effort it took to acquire it. This is very different from someone who obtains money through fraudulent means, the pattern of spending is often entirely different.

Yesterday, being a long break, I had the chance to go out. Since we are on a two-week break, I decided to visit a higher institution nearby where I have a friend who works at a business centre. He was busy, so we couldn’t really talk. I then found a place close to where some students were sitting, and I had the opportunity to engage in a conversation with some ladies in their early twenties.

It was quite disturbing to observe the mindset of some young ladies today. Listening to them talk about relationships was disheartening. They openly discussed moving from one boyfriend to another based on who could pay their bills. Some even said that if a man could not afford to buy a wig worth 300k, then he was not “man enough.”

I asked a few of them what they, in turn, offered in their relationships. Interestingly, some also complained that their boyfriends cheated on them. I then asked what their boyfriends do, and they said many of them are involved in internet fraud. I pressed further: if the “clients” are on whether these men depend on refuse to pay, what then happens?

It is troubling to imagine the future with this kind of mindset among young people. When you consider how many young ladies are being exploited or even used for dangerous rituals, it becomes even more painful. To make matters worse, many of these ladies openly reject men who earn an honest living through regular jobs. According to them, a man working a 9-to-5 job should not even consider dating them.
This raises a serious concern: what becomes of a generation exposed to large sums of money without working for it?

# 隐秘的旅行：探索那些鲜为人知的目的地

旅行是探索世界的绝佳方式，而在这个过程中，发现那些不为人知的隐秘之地更是令人兴奋。本文将带你走进一些隐藏的宝藏，让你的旅行体验更加独特。

## 1. **小镇的魅力：哥尔登镇（Golden, Colorado）**

位于科罗拉多州，这个小镇以其迷人的山景和丰富的历史而闻名。虽然不如周边的大城市热闹，但哥尔登镇的宁静和自然美景让人流连忘返。

- **必游景点**：
  - **红岩公园**：壮观的红色岩石形成了独特的自然剧场，适合徒步和摄影。
  - **科罗拉多矿业博物馆**：了解当地的矿业历史，体验互动展览。

## 2. **隐秘海滩：帕尔马海滩（Playa de Palma）**

在西班牙的马略卡岛，帕尔马海滩是一个相对不为游客所知的地方。这里的沙滩宁静而美丽，非常适合那些想要远离喧嚣的旅行者。

- **活动推荐**：
  - **潜水**：探索清澈的海水和丰富的海洋生物。
  - **日落野餐**：带上美食，享受海滩上的浪漫日落。

## 3. **文化之旅：阿尔贝罗贝洛（Alberobello）**

意大利的阿尔贝罗贝洛以其独特的圆顶小屋（Trulli）而闻名。这个小镇保存完好，仿佛时间停滞在了过去。

- **体验活动**：
  - **参观Trulli博物馆**：了解这些传统建筑的历史和文化。
  - **当地美食**：尝试正宗的意大利美食，如Orecchiette和当地葡萄酒。

## 4. **自然奇观：冰岛的西峡湾（Westfjords）**

冰岛的西峡湾是一个神秘而壮观的地区，拥有陡峭的悬崖、壮丽的瀑布和宁静的海湾。这里的自然景观令人叹为观止，适合喜欢冒险的旅行者。

- **探险活动**：
  - **徒步旅行**：探索壮丽的峡湾和隐藏的瀑布。
  - **观鸟**：在鸟类栖息地观察各种鸟类，尤其是海鹦。

## 结语

探索隐秘的旅行目的地不仅能让你远离人群，还能让你体验到更真实的当地文化和自然之美。下次旅行时，不妨尝试去那些不那么知名的地方，收获意想不到的惊喜！

---

希望这篇文章能激发你对隐秘旅行的向往，开启一段独特的探索之旅！
```

title.body: > https://youtu.be/OpUOlAUckJI?si=UUxtSk1wuQmNOzG0 When it comes to the subject matter of the true disciples. We often misinterprete the meaning. When we talk about a true disciple, we mean someone who follows God but not just in words now but also in his or her actions. For me, I personally believe that a true disciple means much more than just going to church or been a Christian. A Christian that is a disciple is someone that is living a life that actually pleases God every day. In the Bible, Jesus said in Luke 9:23, “If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.” The popular question is the fact that what actually make a true disciple? Well for me I think one of the most important thing about been a true disciple is obedience. Trust me, it is not always easy to obey God but it is always necessary and at the long run, it will pay off. In John 14:15, Jesus said, “If ye love me, keep my commandments. Jesus himself said it. If you truly claim that you love God, you must show it trough obedience and for me loving God is shown in showing obedience to His word. Another important quality of a true disciple is love. A true disciple must always love others sincerely. The Bible says in John 13:35, “By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another. Now this is not easy because the kind of love expected to show is not the erotic kind of love but the agape kind of love which is one of the most difficult but it is always worth it because that is what God expects from us.

title.title: Elegir la luz en un mundo que pesa / Choosing light in a heavy world
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY8E7NwjpfyhByaWmg9c6hAUCvsC8HLdYuH3q5iNXx8cn/1776783375916.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNp1KNHRPjmNmDtDGcwCLjJfXjZGNXvzP2tMb2kjDonw6/1776783463210.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma3P1pSKzVNLLP9pqYCTLmacyFzWJjLXM7i3aknsWY5Ev/1776783583002.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2BcXfRucjZmrTQqt8z3ercG7uUzMfmnPAum6Uo5r6k5/1776783619960.jpg)

🍁 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🍁

Español 

​Solemos caminar por el mundo esperando que la felicidad nos encuentre, como si fuera un golpe de suerte. Sin embargo, al observar instantes como este, comprendo una verdad más profunda: la verdadera alegría no es una meta, es una decisión.

A veces nos empeñamos en buscar la salud emocional en libros o conferencias, olvidando que la lección más grande de bienestar la tenemos justo enfrente. No es lo mismo hablar de paz mental encerrados entre cuatro paredes que sentirla mientras caminas por un paisaje tan hermoso como este que tenemos aquí en nuestra tierra. Estar rodeados de tanta inmensidad y de ese verde que parece no terminar nunca, nos educa de una forma que ninguna escuela puede igualar.

¡Qué costumbre tan amarga la de esperar! Esperamos el fin de semana, esperamos el aumento, esperamos que los hijos crezcan o que la situación cambie para finalmente permitirnos una sonrisa. Yo digo: ¡Basta! La verdadera alegría no te va a pedir permiso ni va a tocar a tu puerta cuando todo esté en orden. La felicidad es una decisión feroz, un acto de rebeldía que se toma hoy, con los zapatos sucios y el alma cansada.

Miren esta imagen. No hay poses, no hay filtros de perfección, hay vida pura. Es el bienestar de sentir que el corazón te late con fuerza mientras te lanzas al pasto sin miedo a las manchas. Ser feliz es una pasión que se incendia cuando dejas de esperar la \

y te enamoras de la vida real, esa que despeina y que nos hace gritar de risa en medio de un campo en Monagas. No esperes a que el cielo esté despejado para bailar; la verdadera paz es aprender a ser feliz mientras el viento sopla fuerte. ¡Atrévete a vivir, a elegirte y a ser feliz ahora mismo, porque el momento es ya! La verdadera educación del alma sucede cuando entendemos que ser felices es una decisión que se toma con cada respiración profunda. Estar sanos emocionalmente no es estar quietos, es tener la libertad de lanzarnos al pasto y dejar que la energía fluya, tal como lo hacen ellos. Ese contacto con la naturaleza no es solo un paseo; es enseñarle al cuerpo a soltar el estrés y a recordar que somos parte de algo grande y vivo. Al final, la felicidad no es un misterio, es la decisión de aprovechar cada rincón de este paraíso que tenemos cerca para sanar, reír y simplemente estar presentes.
Fotografías de mi autoría, capturadas con mi teléfono Tecno Spark 30.
Photos of my authorship, captured with my Tecno Spark 30 phone.
​🍁 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🍁 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY8E7NwjpfyhByaWmg9c6hAUCvsC8HLdYuH3q5iNXx8cn/1776783433021.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNp1KNHRPjmNmDtDGcwCLjJfXjZGNXvzP2tMb2kjDonw6/1776783491207.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma3P1pSKzVNLLP9pqYCTLmacyFzWJjLXM7i3aknsWY5Ev/1776783531557.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2BcXfRucjZmrTQqt8z3ercG7uUzMfmnPAum6Uo5r6k5/1776783760021.jpg) ​🍁 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🍁 English We often walk through the world waiting for happiness to find us, as if it were a stroke of luck. However, observing moments like this, I understand a deeper truth: true joy is not a goal, it is a decision. Sometimes we insist on looking for emotional health in books or lectures, forgetting that the greatest lesson in well-being is right in front of us. Talking about peace of mind trapped between four walls isn't the same as feeling it while walking through a landscape as beautiful as this one we have here on our land. Being surrounded by such immensity and that greenery that seems to never end educates us in a way that no school can match. What a bitter habit we have of waiting! We wait for the weekend, we wait for a raise, we wait for the children to grow up or for the situation to change so we can finally allow ourselves to smile. I say: Enough! True joy will not ask for your permission, and it won’t knock on your door when everything is in order. Happiness is a fierce decision, an act of rebellion taken today, with dirty shoes and a tired soul. Look at this image. There are no poses, no filters of perfection; there is pure life. It is the well-being of feeling your heart beat strongly as you throw yourself onto the grass without fearing the stains. Being happy is a passion that ignites when you stop waiting for the \

and fall in love with real life—the one that messes up your hair and makes you scream with laughter in the middle of a field in Monagas. Don't wait for the sky to be clear to dance; true peace is learning to be happy while the wind blows hard. Dare to live, to choose yourself, and to be happy right now, because the moment is now! The true education of the soul happens when we understand that being happy is a decision made with every deep breath. Being emotionally healthy isn't about being still; it's about having the freedom to throw yourself onto the grass and let the energy flow, just as they do. That contact with nature isn't just a stroll; it’s teaching the body to let go of stress and remember that we are part of something big and alive. In the end, happiness isn't a mystery; it’s the decision to take advantage of every corner of this paradise we have nearby to heal, laugh, and simply be present.

title.title: A conversation with my childhood friend after a long time.
title.body:
Hey everyone!   

Welcome back to my post. I hope you all are good.

Today I am very happy because I talked with my childhood friends. I miss them a lot and really want to spend time with them, but sadly I can't. They are busy, and I am also busy with my studies. I really miss those days when we spent time together in school and outside our homes. Those memories are very beautiful. And I know, when we are in class 5th. 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVQmLfjdQwbGZuQGfvh9HvkM8nqcUNXKbTtyk1EMEi3vx/image.png)

<a href=\

> source





I do not have many friends. I have a small circle, but it is very good, caring, funny, and trustworthy. I feel very lucky to have them in my life. But after class 10th, we choose different streams. I am interested in science, so I took the science stream. I also changed my school because there was not science stream. That is why I had to leave my school and my childhood friends.

I thought that we would talk or meet every day, but I was wrong. After taking science, I became very busy with my studies and did not have enough time for friends and family. But now I try to manage everything because I made a daily routine and try to follow it. From last two or three months, I could not talk to my friends because my syllabus was not complete. 

Today, when I talked to them, and I am very happy. I cannot explain my happiness. I think this happens because when you talk to your old friends after a long time, you feel very relaxed and happy. Sometimes we feel stressed and pressured because of work or personal reasons, but talking to old friends remove all your stress and make you feel happy. Spending time with friends is very important.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWYSN6pYQbCkaRxMGXd3U94ZwHC8t1ScCPvML7rjJwFkN/image.png)
<a href=\

> source


As I said, after changing my school, I have no time to meet or talk to my old friends. In my new school, I made some friends. They are also sweet, but old is gold. My childhood friends also made new friends, and sometimes I thought that they will replace me. When I tell my thought with them, they got angry and said, “How can you think like this, Buddy! No one can replace you.” after hear this I am very happy. 

We talked a lot. They had some small fights with each other because of some silly misunderstanding, and this misunderstanding made by their new friends. When I was with them, I always tell them that small fights are normal in friendship, but too many fights are not good. But they are not want to talk with each other, and  also I know that I will solve their fight. They were surprise that I noticed everything. I tell them that our friendship is old, beautiful and very strong, and it cannot break because of new people.

 After sometimes, I clear their misunderstandings, and I feel very good. My whole day was boring, but after talking to them, my mood completely changed. I am really very happy. And also happy for them because they talk to each other and solve their fight.

Thanks a lot for reading my post.
May Allah bless you all.🌸

title.title: Three Beautiful Days of Togetherness at Our Memorable Family Reunion Celebration
title.body:
![Blue Minimalist Travel Summer Scrapbook Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48jESbv2k6cU7f4BbG7gBwdajiGPpxYhQAbYKyuRUCsVyXXWsMBumEXVCHRTsy1G4k.jpg)

Greetings to all Hivers!
Last Sunday was one of the most special moments for our family because we celebrated our family reunion for three wonderful days. It was not just a gathering, but a time to reconnect, laugh together, and create memories that we will treasure for years. Our reunion had three parts: the arrival day, reflection night, and the main program.

![Blue Minimalist Travel Summer Scrapbook Photo Collage (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48kfZQjqxA8FYyZQVvUjuFaFB1kK1u4FyoEk4xLAgwQ5CQqWTxCwMaNvEXNhAHSRTR.png)

The first day was the arrival of our relatives. My mother’s side of the family came from different places, and some of them needed to travel for 12 hours while others spent 18 hours on the road just to reach our home in the mountains. Because of the long travel, we decided to let them rest first when they arrived. Everyone looked tired but happy. Even before unpacking their bags, hugs and smiles were already everywhere. It felt good seeing family members who we had not seen for a long time.

![received_1449812509801398.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EoiPWTeep7jVdHEa8BoYPhpQ7pPLhaZoc5ooFXJgSBWzDU25kA2XZUzjMscbc3UZF7o.jpeg)

![received_1282973503205944.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EqSWXVysZbaQhsg8hS5eXQkssFkdSX63ZTDLtCCaeQPtoCfj7M2shiMD3jtUGLaqZqc.jpeg)

The second day was the reflection night. Since we live in a mountain area where the weather becomes very cold at night, I suggested during the planning that everyone should bring tents. As one of the youngest siblings and part of the committee, I wanted to make the night memorable. We prepared a bonfire and formed a big circle with all the cousins and grandchildren around the fire. It became one of the best parts of the reunion.

![received_2000547457514319.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EnsaWsS11kivLs4SZpcucsJ4zJy8ucYuSbdEaXC8hWpjTyr8SNi4Khnsavzowtt9xH5.jpeg)

We shared stories about life, dreams, struggles, and what we look forward to every reunion. The eldest among the cousins started the reflection, and it touched everyone deeply. Some cried, some laughed, and some simply listened while smiling. Many of us felt refreshed after hearing each other’s stories. Since we only gather once in a while because we live far from one another, that moment felt very meaningful.

Our elders were busy enjoying the videokey, singing their favorite songs, so some of them did not join the reflection circle. They were also enjoying the warmth inside because the weather was too cold outside. Still, everyone had their own way of enjoying the night.

![IMG_20260419_095538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsV9U3ZQV1BAK6krx6G13EvuNM5Y1Dd8seiE1trUqCERTnemrSnk3SQBek7GGdxkcZc.jpg)

![IMG_20260419_093631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vhyN5SuLmTDvYJs9GMEAprqMLLhVg75SRtPuw2TEhuPXRpe6n2kPhoUhHqGu13CBuVF.jpg)

My mother’s side of the family is big. My mom is the only girl among ten siblings, truly the only rose among the thorns. She is the eighth child in the family. Most of her brothers became soldiers, which is why many of them were assigned to faraway places. They built their own families there, and that is one reason why our relatives now live in different areas.

![IMG_20260419_094318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23x18qrxXUiURhLcFWBtfQEjSqqk69WBij1TxtSw6aUBPAX6zRh5ToHpfzxdhf3r4EsY1.jpg)

![IMG_20260419_094513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zGeoAEuGVU8iir6dCcidGF2CTmd3Fo4un4bur5zn6SsCi3No1Pxx5y3TToSY9qBWkeb.jpg)

The third day was the main program. It was simple, genuine, and full of joy. We did not require color coded shirts because the weather was cold, and most people preferred wearing jackets. What mattered most was not matching clothes, but being complete and happy together. We started a small meeting, welcome message, Bible service to Glorify and blessed our family and blessing we receive and after that we have a parlor games and picture taking. 

![Blue Minimalist Travel Summer Scrapbook Photo Collage (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48K7zcDVceRodoWYK17Way6Rn34fgq2wzNA5Dpuom9AfSv13VJtxAZTgzKgedgtBYW.png)

Of course, no reunion is complete without food. We prepared a pica-pica area filled with snacks for two days so anyone who felt hungry or tired could simply grab something to eat anytime. It kept everyone energized and smiling. My brother is in charge cooking, assisted also with one of my brothers Because they are best in cooking and we have a lechon that’s the highlight of all the food we prepared. 

![IMG_20260419_092220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wMgyd3Y6ekRKfNFXGhRtTQZ8ycKqKDAMnC98dAxjos59wuRuPD2FAjG51uBiPsXU7TW.jpg)

![IMG_20260419_111954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8xKWMr3GTtXAZZoJGafqq8f7sYxzf7NqonUZQMgL19obwLZWLDUKBztQQ9JrFThAGh.jpg)

Family reunions remind us that even if there are misunderstandings, busy schedules, or distance between homes, family remains family. Sometimes, being far apart makes people miss and appreciate each other more. I realized that love becomes stronger when people choose to come together again.

![Blue Minimalist Travel Summer Scrapbook Photo Collage (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48PwgktHwjSkypCmcT1BscqMcphyDRPhDZp1jcy2Dtg8MznEHee523JFJg3AxVH3FH.png)

Thank you for reading. I will share the reunion preparation photos in my next blog. These are my own pictures edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

Faith that the sun will rise, that the rain will fall, that the ground will not swallow the seed whole before it has a chance to sprout. But what happens when the gardeners are not tenders of growth, but harvesters of destruction? **Build where you are wanted.** Build where you are free. It is the immutable witness to our virtues and our vices. And on Hive, the witness testimony is damning. In a single 24-hour window, the ledger records not the organic rhythm of community curation, but the mechanical cadence of suppression. The ledger shows us the truth: **The downvoting farmers are running Hive.** --- ## **II. The Oligarchy of Impunity** There is a particular danger in power without accountability. On Hive, a coalition of accounts wields the downvote not as a shield against spam, but as a sword against competition. They act as they like. They answer to no one. They are protected by the very code that was meant to liberate us. This is not decentralization. This is centralization by stealth. The Erosion of Trust** Trust is the currency of every community. It is harder to mine than Bitcoin, harder to stake than Hive Power. It is built in moments of welcome, in gestures of support, in the patience shown to the newcomer. But trust can be destroyed in a single block. When a user posts their labor—their art, their analysis, their story—and is met not with engagement, but with a coordinated cascade of `-0.25%` votes, they do not feel owned. If things do not change, things will keep going the same way. The exodus will continue. The talent will depart. The ledger will remain, a tombstone recording not the vibrancy of a social revolution, but the silence of a suppressed one. **The Choice:** 1. **Reform:** Dismantle the downvote farms. There is a third option, for the creator: **Exile.** Build where you are wanted. Build where the soil is not salted by those who profit from your failure. Build where the downvote is a tool of last resort, not a weapon of first choice. --- ## **V. Epilogue: The Unblinking Eye** The ledger remembers. It remembers the hand that planted the seed and the hand that pulled the weed. It remembers the timestamp, the weight, the account, the intent. To the downvoting farmers: You may think you are untouchable. You may think you are anonymous. But the chain knows. The community knows. And history will judge. To the builders: Do not waste your life building on sand that the tide has already claimed. **Find freedom. Find trust. Find a place where you are wanted.** Because in the end, a blockchain is only as strong as the trust of those who build upon it. And on Hive, that trust is bleeding out. *— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.* **Tags:** #HiveBlockchain #DownvoteFarm #CryptoFreedom #Trust #Decentralization #BilpcoinTruth #BuildElsewhere **Day 12: The Protection of the Tender**

>from Imgflip Meme Generator There is a particular arrogance in the human heart: the belief that what is hidden in darkness will never see the light. But on the blockchain, there is no darkness. There is only the ledger—an immutable, unforgiving chronicle of every action, every vote, every extraction of value. The chain does not sleep. It does not look away. Once the transaction is broadcast, it is etched into the block. Once the vote is cast, it is recorded in perpetuity. Once the pattern is recognized, it cannot be un-recognized. The blockchain is the great equalizer of truth, indifferent to status, immune to bribery, and impervious to denial. And yet, you keep doing it. In ways the blockchain cannot see. In handshakes, in private messages, in agreements made in the shadows that the light of the chain cannot penetrate. title.title: Monomad: Urban portraits in direct sunlight [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

When you have a stunning model who really catches the eye, that’s all you need just find a good spot where the sun hits her just right, and that’s exactly what we did. Daniela already stands out for her beauty; all that was missing was the right location. We kept moving around, always keeping the sun’s position in mind. I hope you enjoy these photos.

Cuando tienes una buena modelo que llama la atención, no necesitas más, solo ubicarla en un buen lugar donde el sol la ilumine, y esto fue lo que hicimos. Daniela ya destaca por su belleza y solo faltaba la ubicación; nos estuvimos moviendo constantemente teniendo en cuenta la dirección del sol. Espero que disfruten de estas fotografías.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSBQpSE69G7kGBvWpF82qWEaUbNmW9ip9T25LNio7ov7/dsc08171.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsxaP2THsmDoUiQmDvahZsP9xuFqe73LpYShdER9gWtZ/dsc08174.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqdXzhj2vk41fezSAeADW7PMtZmKyLR9d3hUZMiiPzX3/dsc08182.jpg

>

Basically, my approach has always been to take urban photos; it’s one of the things I enjoy most, which is why we stopped at the skatepark and kept moving around even though the surroundings might not be very noticeable, certain elements do draw the eye toward Daniela.

Principalmente, mi idea siempre se basa en hacer fotografías urbanas; es una de las cosas que más me gusta hacer, por eso nos detuvimos en el skatepark y estuvimos en constante movimiento, aunque quizás no se aprecie tanto el entorno, pero sí ciertas figuras que dirigen la atención hacia Daniela.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmX6tJv2ijQiThmifpSrLNjtN1vhiSFCz4PSp6pGSgYqdf/dsc08162.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmRg3RtNxjmdQifJNAr35suhVApLEirTBccmvUA7DQwPyQ/dsc08178.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzwLSqLm6T2nthVtFbkDvJEuL82CbuM3zhr7TuaM1cxh/dsc08181.jpg

>

Another element worth highlighting is the model’s outfit; in this black and white photograph, it works perfectly because it creates a striking contrast with the tree filled background, which makes her stand out even more and that’s the goal, after all.

Otra cosa que uno debe aprovechar es la ropa que lleva la modelo; en este contexto de fotografía en blanco y negro, viene perfecto, porque hace un excelente contraste con el fondo lleno de árboles, lo cual le hace resaltar incluso más a ella y esto es lo que se busca, a fin de cuentas.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFu81sLus2uAi6EJkNJEGTFsdmAFd2WiPcc2f6punycN/dsc08166.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmXHM5xjSeM7a4x12ZLoh4ffcWnQUUdcHp3PP7c6NhzXVQ/dsc08173.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjyZCXEUZ2sdpSPc1sLDsZGyMnFGULvgu4kAdzrVwFj9/dsc08183.jpg

>

That wraps up today's post; I hope you enjoyed these urban photos taken with my friend Daniela. I hope you all have a wonderful day and a happy Tuesday, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography. See you next time!

Hasta aquí la publicación del día de hoy; espero que disfrutaran de estas fotografías urbanas junto a mi amiga Daniela. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente día y un feliz martes, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro. ¡Hasta la próxima!

/>
