body.body: 4/5 🧵 What’s still unclear is **why** it happened. The article doesn’t give a motive or prior connection between the victim and the group, and that matters. Random violence is one kind of problem; targeted retaliation is another. Either way, Temple officials are treating it seriously, increasing patrols and pushing students toward campus safety tools like the **TU safety app**, walking escorts, and shuttle options.

body.body:
5/5 🧵 The broader takeaway: this wasn’t just a fight — it was a breach of campus security in housing meant to protect students. Temple sophomore Emanuel Turner put it bluntly: incidents like this shove safety to the front of students’ minds, whether they want it there or not. Until arrests happen and the lead-up is explained, the story is less “isolated incident” and more “serious warning sign.” 📎 Source

body.body: 1/4 🧵 NBC managed the rare feat of making a chaotic Knicks finish even more chaotic. The big twist: the outrage over Mike Brown “not using” a final timeout was built on bad TV data. The Knicks **didn’t actually have one** — NBC’s score bug incorrectly showed they did, and that completely changed how viewers read the last 5.6 seconds.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/4 🧵 Here’s the sequence. With Atlanta up 107-106 and 5.6 seconds left, CJ McCollum went to the line. Before the first free throw, the broadcast showed New York with **zero** timeouts. Then after he missed the first one, NBC’s graphic suddenly added a timeout to the Knicks. That mattered because a timeout would’ve let them advance the ball and draw up a set play. Instead, Josh Hart grabbed the rebound, pushed it, and Mikal Bridges ended up taking a rushed long jumper.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: Not really about having exceptional skills. Even if you are a novice you can generate income on the internet
body.author: thelastdash

body.body: 3/4 🧵 That bad timeout graphic shaped the entire reaction in real time. Noah Eagle talked as if a Knicks timeout was basically guaranteed. Carmelo Anthony said he was frustrated for the same reason — he thought Brown was sitting on a timeout. Then NBC had to clean it up later, blaming a “data issue.” So the fan anger at that exact decision was aimed at the wrong target. Not ideal when millions are dissecting a one-point playoff loss.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
4/4 🧵 Brown still doesn’t get a full pardon. The article points out the Knicks lost the ability to carry extra timeouts late because of the NBA’s two-timeout max in the final three minutes, and Brown had already used his last timeout with 10.2 seconds left. He also made a debatable timeout call earlier with 2:43 remaining. So the broadcast error changed the *story*, but not the fact that New York’s late-game management was messy as hell. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/21/sports/nbc-blames-data-issue-for-anger-inducing-mistake-at-end-of-knicks-hawks-game/)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 \nTrump’s message was blunt: no extension, no patience, and if Iran doesn’t cut a deal before the cease-fire expires, he expects bombing to resume. That’s the whole story in one line — diplomacy with a clock attached and a gun on the table.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 \nTrump said he doesn’t want negotiations dragging past tomorrow’s cease-fire deadline because “we don’t have that much time.” His pitch is basically coercive diplomacy: Iran can rebuild and regain footing if it agrees, but if talks slip without a deal, he’s ready to go back to military force. It’s not subtle. It’s pressure politics turned up to 11.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 \nThe administration appears to think it holds leverage. Trump pointed to damage already inflicted on Iran’s navy, air force, and senior leadership, plus the blockade tied to the Strait of Hormuz. He framed that as proof the US is negotiating from strength, not scrambling for an exit. Whether that produces concessions or just hardens Tehran is the real question.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 \nIran’s side looks messy and resistant. The article says Iran’s parliamentary speaker publicly signaled Tehran wouldn’t engage with the US because of Trump’s methods, yet Trump insisted they have “no choice” but to send negotiators to Pakistan. So the standoff is this: Iran hates the terms, Trump thinks military and economic pressure leave them boxed in.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Rachel Goldberg-Polin’s story is brutal because it strips grief down to the bone: hours before Hamas murdered her son Hersh, she stood near Gaza and screamed his name into the void, hoping he might hear her. She later came to believe he did. That unbearable scene sits at the center of this piece — and of her new book, *When We See You Again*. 📎 Source
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article retraces Hersh’s ordeal from Oct. 7, 2023: he was at the Nova festival, took shelter from the Hamas attack, lost an arm to a grenade in a roadside bomb shelter, and was then abducted into Gaza. His friend Aner Shapira reportedly threw multiple grenades back out of the shelter before one killed him — a horrifying snapshot of chaos, courage, and how young these victims were. Hersh was dragged into tunnels badly wounded and, despite going days without treatment, survived captivity for nearly 11 months.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
Those beaches look so inviting. What a view.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/244odaCjverZJV8gwekhv6YR5AqKqcE86fEhHs5gM12ocnHdUMLE3xv4LLgMko3i6eGTo.png)
body.author: litguru

body.body: 3/5 🧵 What makes Hersh stand out in this account is not just what happened to him, but how other freed hostages remembered him. They described him as someone who kept other captives going — repeating a line adapted from Viktor Frankl: **“He who has a ‘why’ can bear any ‘how.’”** In a place built to break people, he apparently became a source of optimism, telling others to hold onto the people waiting for them at home. That’s the kind of detail that lands harder than any headline.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Rachel’s book also sounds deeply personal in the smallest details: the masking tape she and her husband wore to mark each day of captivity; the ball of saved tape she still can’t throw away; the unfinished book on Hersh’s nightstand; the memory of him leaving a book behind because he thought he was “only going for one night.” Those details do the real work here. They turn a global atrocity back into what it actually is: one family’s son, one bedroom, one life interrupted and then stolen.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 The final note is grim but not empty. Rachel describes grief as permanent, physical, almost inhabiting the body — but she also insists that hope remains “mandatory.” That’s the spine of the article: not closure, because there is none, but the refusal to let love, memory, and witness be erased by barbarism. The piece is really about how a mother carries both devastation and purpose at the same time. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/21/world-news/mom-of-oct-7-hamas-hostage-hersh-goldberg-polin-writes-heartbreaking-book/)

body.body: Splinterland's : Will this Archon help me to reach Gold league? --------------------------------------------------------------- When I started in the game of Splinterland's around October-Novemeber 2025, my goals were to reach the Gold league in the game by upgrading my Conclave Arcana Archons and cards. Interestingly, I found that Frontier Archons were the fraction of the cost of the Conclave Arcana Archons and actually dominating the Bronze league. So I started maxing the Frontier Archons and now I have maxxed all of my Frontier Archons. Frontier Archons and cards do place me comfortably in Silver League, but it does not look like it is possible to be in Gold League while relying solely on those Archons.

/>

[Source](https://splinterlands.com/user/collection)

Max Frontier Archons and cards were good for me, securing and cementing my place in Silver league, but it looks like I need more push to reach the Gold league. This goal brought my focus back to Conclave Arcana Archons. With Kaylia Silverleaf at level 5 and Gorgug the Endless at level 4, I was looking for another Conclave Archon at level 4. I do not get another lever for the price range, I was looking for but I got Bella Ratajowlski level 3.

Since it is level 3 so I have plan to upgrade it on coming days. But I still picked up Bella for its \

property. Deflect cause 0 damage to friendly monster from Corrosice wards, Thorns, Magic reflect, Return Fire and Blast Splash damage. I find Bella is extremely useful against Blast and Magic reflect. Though in standard battles, I will go for my level 4 rare summoner, but in the special cases where I have to deal with magic blast and magic reflect, I will go for Bella as it look far better choice than my other level 4 Archons. Actually , I already deployed Bella in \

ruleset in this [Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_a552a8a8a4f7f159670dd56e632f97a9?ref=r1s2g3) and results were positive for me. So let see, how the journey towards gold league go on and to have conclave arcana Archons at level 4.

body.title: Different Forms, Same Damage/Pain : Why All Bullying Deserves Equal Attention
body.body: Bullying is bullying, whether it's done online or physically, it doesn't change the effect and damage it has on the person's emotions, mental health and self esteem. Many adults are still suffering from low self esteem, social withdrawal, timidity, and even depression because of a word said to them by a bully, because of an action that suppresses their mental health, self worth and that's why I feel nothing when I see a bully suffer. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaX5qcJ8HRrKT78hciD9KkkoVq8vPxtMiCaAspL4QnqY3/1776774184010.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-red-sign-that-says-no-to-bullying-XUdthBA01CM) Because online bullying involves abusive words, messages, hurtful comments, it doesn't make it any different from physical bullying. They both have negative effects on their victims and cause damage. We feel a block or muting those who bully online is the solution, and we forget that bad words are weapons, and they hurt like physical abuse. Bad words aren't easily forgotten. The negative effect online bullying has on the self-esteem of a person can lead to depression. In most cases, it is as bad as physical bullying, the both practices should be treated as equal. Online bullying is as painful as physical bullying. Nothing hurts more than bad words, a rain of abuse and shame in a public space. Bad words are like weapons, they traumatize people and, in most cases, victims of online abuse even seek therapy, the way those abused physically seek for medical solution to cure bruises on their body. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzoXLdd2R2nVy5VvLsZiuke8cxTbhci4gKJZ2i4Nib5w/1776774198100.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/surprising-moment-extremely-surprised-child-in-big-glasses-looking-at-the-screen-of-his-new-laptop-izJprdmyFn4) Online bullying shouldn't be seen as less, that a kind of bully that follows the victim everywhere. It creates a certain public opinion about the victims. It's like a stigma, it hurts like injury. As I said earlier, words are weapons. A single embarrassing word about a person can cause timidity, affect their self esteem, cause withdrawal, self doubt , tears and, in most cases, they can't heal without attending therapy. That a bully came with words doesn't make the weight less to bear and online bullying can lead victims to committing suicide or cause suicidal thoughts. Physical bullying causes pain, fear, self doubt and affects mental health of a person. The injuries sustained during physical combat could cause severe health complications or even death. Bully shouldn't be endured or tolerated, we should encourage those who are being bullied to fight back and speak up early, to avoid serious complications. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQAiBFTMSAAvGSCjK3kGM1ZyQAHWTeCyviBGhvbxABPak/1776774212642.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-covering-their-face-with-their-hands-0G4MWxc4pnk) My younger brother was ones a victim of physical bullying when we were still kids in primary school. He had always been a child who was always excited about going to school with his sisters, but suddenly , began to cry every morning we were going to school. I knew something wasn't right, because that wasn't like him. Fast forward to a particular day I paid more attention to his class and found out he was being bullied by a classmate and that was the end. Immediately, I reported to the school authorities, reported to my parents and also encouraged him to fight back. I don't believe in being silent in situations as severe as bullying another person. When you are being bullied, it's very necessary to fight back, speak up and create boundaries. Bullying doesn't even end at a certain age. I also had experience during my service year with my employer and I had to remind her of my primary duties at her business place. Giving a bully a taste of their own meal is a good way to handle those who choose to bully others at every given opportunity. Bullying has a lot of effects on the mental, emotional and physical health of a person, be it physically or online, and they should be treated equally. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdYmEHgRw3BZVM29ZKurbWBVPidNFvDZR6u24CejNNWoE/1776774234826.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-with-a-neon-sticker-on-their-arm-saying-no-to-bullying-IGJ4e7iAa3I) In most cases, bullying starts in schools and that is why schools should be more vigilant and treat every act of bullying with serious concern, create strict rules about bullying, be it verbally or physically, because school is always the first place students exhibit this habit of bullying other kids. To create a safer future where bullying will no longer exist, schools and parents need to do better in raising kids. Kids should be taught empathy and kindness from their various homes and also in school. Encourage them to speak up and fight against bullies, without fear or intimidation I always support those influential personalities who sue those who derive pleasure in bullying others online, those who choose to spread the wrong narrative and abuse others for choosing to live the way that pleases them. I believe teaching them a good legal lesson will help reduce the rate of cyberbullying in our society. Bullying shouldn't be tolerated and should be put to an end at all cost. In conclusion, both online and physical bullying causes emotional, psychological and mental effects on their victims. They both leave scars on their victims and they should be treated equally and not tolerated in our society. Both, leave trauma on victims and even shape their lives and self worth of the victim. body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1878
Tuesday 21, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1943
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Super Power Tuesday. Flex’em up Mi gente. 

There are simple requests. Announcements, aka adverts. And then there’s persuasion. The “Art of Persuasion” was released 28 years ago this very month. It’s a little bit more sophisticated than begging. “Please, baby-please.” But it doesn’t quite ascend to the level of psychological operation. 

A gifted gabber, bespectacled  and donning an iridescent plaid sports jacket, with a white hat and matching shoes, might be able to clear a few klunkers off a used car lot every day of the week, but it takes a well oiled operation to change the collective mindset and behavior of an entire population.  To turn a celebrated term like, “home maker” into a demeaning insult, and then strike it off the ledger completely, takes a consorted effort. It’s more than a mere conspiracy. It’s nothing short of a psychological operation.  

In our simulation “everything is a psy-op.” 

Missing children on milk cartons. Psy-op. 

Space program. Psy-op. 

Popular music, from be-bop to hip-hop. Psy-op. 

And perhaps one of the most successful of all, is the “Women’s Liberation Movement.” With over a half century of data, we can look back and evaluate what was accomplished, how it was accomplished, and what it cost society. One lesson your humble observer has learned across the decades is, every slogan “the supremacy” institutionalizes, means and manifests as the opposite.   

Were women truly “liberated,” or were they just hustled to another part of the plantation? From their father’s house, to their husband’s house, to their uncle’s (Sam’s), estate? 

Today’s companion audio takes a look at the Women’s Liberation psy-op, what it accomplished for the state, and what it cost for women, children, men, and society.   

Before world war 2, pink was a boy’s color and blue was for girls. Psy-op. 

Switching gears. A small shift occurred on 4 20 (if you know you know). It was also the sun crossing into Taurus, the Bull. It felt like a right of passage. Then something changed. A puzzling, albeit benign encounter with an NPC, and some other out-of-the-pattern type stuff. Pattern detection might be a gift, but when it’s mixed with synesthesia it’s a recipe for paranoia.  It’s a cosmic test. “Once you start explaining yourself your power is already in question.” Robert Greene.  We practice resistance daily. It’s one of our Seven Daily Wins. But sometimes it’s a heavy burden. Ego is usually the culprit. But we fall back on our tried and proven strategies and move on.   

Stay sane, stay safe, stay strong, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.   

PEACE   




Cyclops Psy-ops

![1943.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmfSB1QTPJAzs1wQBAuesNPHieyfBpg4sYhZ5BxNcFAb5J/1943.png)

The death of and detachment from the white supremacy mindset.                     
 
Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1878_full_4-21-26_1943_cyclops:9?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9  
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 


The Great Extraction: How the Feminism Psy-Op Entrapped Women, Abandoned Children & Built the Child Care Industrial Complex.   (Or, “Birth, of the Pantsuit.”)   

Let’s start this dance with a number. 18.4 million. 

That is how many American women were in the workforce in 1960. By 1990, that number had risen to 57 million. In three decades, we moved more women into paid labor than the Industrial Revolution moved men off the farm. This feat was accomplished not by force, but by persuasion, by a sustained, multi-platform, emotionally manipulative campaign that any deep-state think tank would envy. 

The \

variant that took flight between 1968 and 1982, was a bonafide  psy-op (psychological operation), that rivals the “Torches of Freedom campaign of the early 20th century. It was not a conspiracy in the sense of a few men in a dark room. It was a convergence of state interests, corporate advertisers, magazine editors, television producers, and genuine activists who believed they were doing good. (Goodie-goodies are the thieves of virtue.) The result was the most successful behavioral modification program in modern history. 



Its outcomes? Women out of the home, children abandoned to strangers, or home alone with keys latched around their necks or pinned to their clothes, a doubled tax base, a multibillion-dollar childcare industry, a collapsed birthrate, and at least two generations of women rendered clinically miserable.  These are not opinions. These are statistical facts. Sure, statistics can be skewed. But when every skew points in the same direction, you have a pattern.   

The Manufacture of Discontent. 

Every psychological operation begins with a grievance. The grievance of the 1950s housewife was real: isolation, boredom, financial dependency, the quiet humiliation of being a permanent minor. Betty Friedan called it, \

Here is where the psy-op begins: that problem was real, but the solution was engineered.  

Between 1969 and 1975, McCall's, Ladies' Home Journal, and Cosmopolitan underwent a coordinated transformation. In 1968, their covers featured pies and prom dresses. By 1972, the same magazines featured working women, divorced women, women in pantsuits holding gavels. The advertising dollars followed. Why? Because a working woman buys two wardrobes (work and home), processed food (no time to cook), convenience appliances (no energy to clean), and, crucially, she reads magazines during her commute. The publishing industry did not discover feminism. It monetized it.  

Television was the amplifier. The Mary Tyler Moore Show (1970) showed a single, working woman who was funny and lovable. One Day at a Time (1975) showed a divorced mother raising two daughters. These were not radical shows. They were normalization engines. They made the extraordinary, a woman without a husband, paying her own rent, seem ordinary, and maybe even a little romantic. “Romantic” is a very dangerous word in social engineering. 

The State's Silent Interest: The Tax Base. 

Here’s a number that will make your blood run cold. In 1965, the labor force participation rate for married women with children under six was 18.4 percent. By 1985, it was 48.8 percent. That is nearly a tripling in twenty years. What changed? Laws, yes. But also the tax code. 

Every woman who left the home for a paying job added her income to the federal tax base. And because the United States taxes on a marginal basis, that second income was often taxed at the husband's higher bracket. The Treasury won twice: once on the husband's raise, once on the wife's entire paycheck. Between 1970 and 1990, real federal tax revenue from individual income taxes doubled, from $90 billion to $180 billion (inflation-adjusted). A significant portion of that increase came from the new class of working wives. 

The state did not need to force women to work. It only needed to make staying home feel shameful.  And that is precisely what this psy-op accomplished. By 1980, a stay-at-home mother was viewed with the same suspicion as a smoker in a hospital. She was \

She was, in the new lexicon, not enough. 

The Welfare Trap: How the Government Required Male Absence.  

Here is the statistic that destroys the simple narrative of liberation. Under the Aid to Families with Dependent Children (AFDC) program, the primary welfare system from 1935 to 1996, a woman could only receive benefits if there was no able-bodied, employed man living in the home. The logic was administrative: a man should support his family. The effect was catastrophic: the state systematically incentivized the removal of fathers. 

Throughout the 1970s and 1980s, caseworkers would conduct \

investigations. They would look for men's clothing, a second toothbrush, a car registered to a male name. If they found evidence, benefits were cut. Thousands of poor women were forced to choose between a man's presence and a welfare check. The rational choice, the fiscal choice, was to ask the man to leave. Husbands slept in cars. Boyfriends registered at different addresses. Fathers became legal strangers to their own children. 

This was not an accident of bureaucracy. It was a structural feature of a system that valued the state as the primary provider over the family as the primary unit. It was a classic divide & rule tactic. Divide the family, rule the single Mom and subequently her children, her choices, her life.  And it was never, ever discussed in Ms. Magazine. 

The Stress Epidemic: What the Vital Statistics Show.  

Let us turn to morbidity, because the body keeps the score. Between 1970 and 1995, as women flooded the workforce, stress-related illnesses in women aged 25–44 increased dramatically. Migraine diagnoses rose 65 percent (adjusted for diagnostic changes). Hypertension in women of that age group increased 78 percent. The rate of peptic ulcers in working women doubled, while remaining stable in men and non-working women. 

Why? Because the psy-op sold a fantasy: that women could work the same hours as men, come home to the same domestic labor they had always done, and feel liberated by the exhaustion. The data shows otherwise. In 1975, working mothers did an average of 26 hours of housework per week, compared to 12 hours for their husbands. By 1995, those numbers had shifted to 18 hours for women and 10 for men. The gap narrowed, but the work remained overwhelmingly female. The \

was not a metaphor. It was a second job, unpaid, and it produced measurable physiological damage. 

Anxiety disorder diagnoses for women outpaced men by 2.5 to 1 for the first time in medical history. Prescriptions for benzodiazepines—Valium, Librium—skyrocketed among employed women. The feminist movement had promised that work would set them free. Instead, it gave them Xanax. 

Sexual Harassment: The Forced Adjustment of Male Behavior. 

As women entered the workforce in the millions, a collision was inevitable. Men had run the American office for a century. They told dirty jokes. They patted secretaries' rear ends. They called women \
and meant nothing by it. When women objected, they were called humorless. \n\nThe term \

was coined in 1975 at Cornell University. By 1980, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission had issued guidelines. By 1991, the Anita Hill hearings made it a national conversation. Men were forced to change. And they resented it. The complaint that \

became a standard punchline in stand-up comedy. But behind the punchline was genuine confusion. The rules of the workplace had shifted overnight.  \n\nHere is the hidden secret: the shift was necessary but incomplete. Sexual harassment did not disappear. It evolved. The overt pat became the subtle exclusion. The crude joke became the cold performance review. The demand for \

became a weapon to penalize women who asked for maternity leave or flexible hours. Men adjusted their behavior precisely enough to avoid lawsuits, but not enough to create genuine equality. And the burden of navigating that minefield fell entirely on women. 

The Childcare Industrial Complex: From Babysitting to Big Business. 

Back in the day, my Mom paid a neighborhood teenager two dollars an hour to watch us kids. That was babysitting. It was informal, cheap, and flexible. By 1990, that system had been replaced by a regulated, credentialed, professionalized childcare industry worth $15 billion annually. Today, it is worth over $60 billion.  

The transformation happened for two reasons. First, the demand was enormous: millions of mothers were now at work. Second, the state and the market both saw an opportunity. Regulations multiplied. Staff-to-child ratios. Educational requirements. Licensing fees. Liability insurance. All of these raised costs and pushed out the informal babysitter. In 1975, full-time daycare for an infant cost about $50 per week (adjusted for inflation). By 2020, the average cost was $340 per week. That is a 580 percent increase, far outpacing inflation.  

The result is a system where mothers work to pay for childcare so they can work. For many low-income women, the math is brutal. A minimum-wage job after taxes and childcare leaves perhaps fifty dollars a week. And yet the “culture” insists that any woman who chooses to stay home is betraying the sisterhood. The childcare industry, meanwhile, has become a pillar of the economy, complete with lobbyists, accreditation boards, and a professional class of \
The teenager down the street has been replaced by a woman with a certificate and a union card. The child has been replaced by a \

The Birthrate Collapse.

Here’s the stat that no one wants to discuss in polite company. The total fertility rate in the United States in 1960 was 3.65 children per woman. By 1976, it had fallen to 1.74, below replacement level for the first time. It has never recovered. As of 2024, the fertility rate is 1.62.  

The reasons are structural. Women delay childbearing for careers. They have fewer children because each child requires expensive daycare. They forgo children entirely because the combination of work and motherhood is exhausting beyond description. First generation feminists promised that women could \

is a lie, as so many psy-ops are. What women got was a choice: work like a man, or be shamed. Millions of women chose work, and then quietly grieved the children they never had. 


Two Generations of Miserable Women. 

The General Social Survey has asked the same question about \
since 1972. In 1972, 40 percent of women reported being \

By 2018, that number had fallen to 28 percent. The decline was steepest among employed women with children. Meanwhile, antidepressant use among women has increased by 400 percent since 1988. Women are now twice as likely as men to be prescribed mood-altering medication.  

This is not liberation. This is a public health crisis dressed in a pantsuit. 

The Positive Turn: Women-Owned Businesses.  

The data of the last fifteen years shows a genuine, organic correction. Women are not leaving the workforce, but they are refusing to play by the old rules. They are starting their own businesses at record rates.  

As of 2025, women-owned firms account for 42 percent of all businesses in the United States, over 14 million enterprises, employing nearly 11 million people, generating $2.8 trillion in revenue. These are not small vanity projects. They are construction, logistics, tech, and manufacturing. And crucially, they are structured differently. Women-owned businesses are more likely to offer remote work, flexible hours, on-site childcare, and four-day weeks. They are less likely to demand the performative face-time that made the 1980s office a misery. [Note, it was the Women’s Suffrage movement of the early 20th century that fought for and won child labor laws in America.] 


The Stoic's Accounting.  

If there are any regrets about the Women’s “Liberation” Movement, it might be that it took a psychological operation, the advertising, the propaganda, the emotional manipulation to pull it off. Without this, shove, it may have happened far more gradually, or maybe not at all.  By the second generation of “Liberated” women, the model was set. The word, “home maker” rarely if ever passes the lips of the 21st century human. Women are expected to enter the workforce. Period. A complete cultural switcheroo in only two generations. 

The problem, (one of many), is that the psychological operation eliminated choice. It made one option, paid work outside the home, glamorous, righteous, expected and eventually necessary for fiscal survival. It made the other option, domestic life, backward and selfish. That is not liberation. That is a different cage with better wallpaper.  

The final frame: 72 percent. That is the percentage of young women today who say they want a flexible, part-time, or work-from-home arrangement when they have children. They have watched their mothers collapse from exhaustion. They are not falling for the same confidence game. 

The Women’s Lib psy-op worked for forty years. It extracted women, monetized their labor, abandoned their children, inflated the tax base, and left two generations medicated and sad. But the third generation is building something else. Hats off to those optimists who took the first blow. Because without that blow, without that miserable, exhausting, heartbreaking experiment, they would never have known what to avoid. 

The lure of the lacking, the illusion of scarcity, either in our lives or in our minds, is the stuff of which classic psychological operations are made. We keep this in mind daily, especially in Abundance Year. We have enough, because we are enough. We won’t be fooled again.

body.body: 1/4 🧵 The hardest part of this story isn’t the race. It’s the tribute after it. body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/4 🧵 Flávia, a 38-year-old Brazilian athlete and influencer with roughly 60,000 followers, disappeared during the open-water swim in The Woodlands on Saturday morning. That swim was the first leg of the Ironman — a race that turns endurance into a borderline absurd test of human limits. Rescue crews were alerted around 7:30 a.m., and her body was recovered just after 9:30 a.m.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/4 🧵 The emotional center of the article is Rodrigo Ferrari’s tribute. He called her “Ursa” — “she bear” in Portuguese — and said she was the best person he had ever met, the one who gave him back his will to live, his joy, his health, his connection to family, sport, and music. He said his love for her would be eternal and called her “the last woman” he would ever love. That’s devastating, but it also explains why this piece hits harder than the average tragedy report.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
4/4 🧵 There’s also an unresolved layer beneath the heartbreak. Officials confirmed she drowned during the swim and said the investigation is continuing under standard protocol. A family friend claimed she had been dealing with health issues before the race, but no official cause beyond drowning had been released. So the article leaves you with two truths at once: a public athletic tragedy, and a private love story cut off mid-sentence. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/21/us-news/heartbroken-partner-of-glam-influencer-who-drowned-during-texas-ironman-says-their-love-will-be-eternal/)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Sophie Cunningham’s issue with her new Fever deal wasn’t really the money — it was the lack of security. She got a 1-year, $665K contract and basically said the short term stung. That’s the real story: a player who wants to stay, win, and build a life in Indiana got a reminder that pro sports still treat loyalty like a nice bonus, not a guarantee.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 Cunningham said the contract situation was “frustrating,” and the backdrop matters. She’s coming off an MCL injury, didn’t get in front of teams much during the offseason, and knew that creates doubt even when doctors clear you. Fair or not, teams love saying “we have the numbers” right up until they act like they don’t trust the numbers. That’s the business. Cold one, too.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 What stood out is that she didn’t frame this as ego or disrespect. She framed it as urgency. She said she’s at the point in her career where she just wants to win, and if she weren’t healthy enough, she’d have said so. Instead of sulking, she called the deal a wake-up call that “lit a fire” under her. That’s athlete-speak for: noted, and now I’m pissed in a productive way.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 She later jumped on X to clean up the narrative: she’s **not** upset about the cash. She wanted **more years** because she loves Indiana and wanted enough stability to actually settle in — house, dog, donkey, the whole oddly wholesome package. That clarification matters. This wasn’t contract whining; it was someone saying she sees a future there and wanted the team to show the same conviction.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 On-court, the Fever know exactly what they’re getting if she’s right: a fan favorite, a fierce Caitlin Clark protector, 8.6 points per game in 2025, and a career-best 43.2% from three before the injury shut her down. So the article is really about tension between performance, health risk, and commitment. Indiana likes her. She clearly likes Indiana more than the paper says back. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/20/sports/sophie-cunningham-gets-brutally-honest-about-her-fever-contract/)

body.title: ¿Necesito? Licencia para hacer algo [Es-En] Do I need a license to do something?
body.body: # ¿Necesito? Licencia para hacer algo ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAQGP1SqSkuUVVk4W9bZTyRur8zomci1NHQ91JV1XEYs/image.png) En principio, depende de lo que quieras hacer y del entorno. Por ejemplo, yo hoy tomé la propuesta de escritura libre de la comunidad de escritores libres para plasmar mis opiniones sobre el tema, aunque no participe en la iniciativa como tal, y es la razón para publicar asiduamente en esta comunidad de @freewriters donde disfrutamos de la mayor libertad, pudiendo expresarnos en cualquier idioma y sobre cualquier tema. Realmente disfruto de no someterme a regulaciones, más allá del respeto a los demás. Licencia para hacer algo es la propuesta 3.080 de @daily.prompt para #MensajeDiario. ¡Tu propuesta de escritura diaria de @Freewritehouse y la comunidad de escritores libres! Cada día son más las actividades humanas que requieren una licencia para realizarse. A medida que la sociedad humana ha crecido, ha impuesto regulaciones y leyes en beneficio de todos y, en principio, se establecieron prohibiciones de dañar a los semejantes o sus intereses, que con el tiempo y el crecimiento del Estado han ido aumentando al extremo de que cualquier actividad está sujeta a algún tipo de regulación, aunque afortunadamente no todas requieran una licencia o permiso. Respirar debe ser una de las pocas cosas que no tiene reglamentación, ni requiere de licencia de momento. La libertad está cada día más coartada y lo lamentable es que muchas de las limitaciones no son en defensa de las libertades ajenas, sino en beneficio de privilegios que, mediante el poder, limitan a los demás. Escribir y manifestar libremente el pensamiento es un derecho establecido en muchas legislaciones, pero en la práctica se ve limitado cuando quienes controlan los medios de comunicación deciden qué se publica y qué no. Las redes sociales web 2, de uso gratuito, pero de propiedad privada, establecen sistemas de censura mediante la vigilancia de algoritmos que automáticamente silencian o borran cualquier publicación donde aparezcan determinadas palabras. Así que solo aquí en Hive encuentro un espacio donde sentir que no necesito licencia para hacer mi voluntad. Naturalmente, debo respetar las normas de las comunidades como un ser civilizado o limitarme a expresarme solo en mi blog, donde solo me limitan las cadenas de bloques que, como la ley de la gravedad, se pueden vencer, aprendiendo a volar o programar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTovBpBa7aPDYNPhmVtXBWw6rNDmJ4wVee51JKmSDEJE/image.png) [MY PARTICULAR VIEW OF THE WORLD] Como siempre, escribo en mi lengua materna, el español, y mediante el traductor de Google transcribo al inglés; en mi perfil me identifico como jabonero artesano, actividad que desarrollo desde hace 12 años y, la verdad, lo hago sin permiso, aunque el mismo solo sería preciso para vender formalmente. Si me acompañaste hasta aquí, gracias. Seguramente te tomó 5 minutos, pero a mí me tomó un par de horas antes de apretar el botón de Publicar. # Do I need a license to do something? # Do I Need a License to Do Something? ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAQGP1SqSkuUVVk4W9bZTyRur8zomci1NHQ91JV1XEYs/image.png) In principle, it depends on what you want to do and the environment. For example, today I took up the free writing proposal from the Free Writers community to express my opinions on the topic, even though I don't participate in the initiative itself. This is the reason I regularly post in this @freewriters community, where we enjoy the greatest freedom, being able to express ourselves in any language and on any topic. I truly enjoy not being subject to regulations, beyond respecting others. License to Do Something is proposal 3,080 from @daily.prompt for #DailyMessage. Your daily writing proposal from @Freewritehouse and the Free Writers community! Every day, more and more human activities require a license to be carried out. As human society has grown, it has imposed regulations and laws for the benefit of all, and initially, prohibitions were established against harming others or their interests. Over time, with the growth of the state, these prohibitions have increased to the point that virtually every activity is subject to some kind of regulation, although fortunately, not all require a license or permit. Breathing must be one of the few things that is not regulated, nor does it currently require a license. Freedom is increasingly restricted, and the unfortunate thing is that many of these limitations are not in defense of the freedoms of others, but rather to benefit privileges that, through power, limit everyone else. The right to write and freely express one's thoughts is established in many legal systems, but in practice, it is limited when those who control the media decide what is published and what is not. Web 2 social networks, free to use but privately owned, establish censorship systems through monitoring algorithms that automatically silence or delete any post where they appear certain words. So only here on Hive do I find a space where I feel I don't need a license to do as I please. Naturally, I must respect community rules like a civilized being or limit myself to expressing myself only on my blog, where I'm only restricted by blockchains, which, like the law of gravity, can be overcome by learning to fly or program. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTovBpBa7aPDYNPhmVtXBWw6rNDmJ4wVee51JKmSDEJE/image.png) [MY PARTICULAR VIEW OF THE WORLD] As always, I write in my native language, Spanish, and use Google Translate to transcribe into English; On my profile, I identify myself as an artisan soap maker, a craft I've been doing for 12 years. And honestly, I do it without a permit, even though one would only be necessary to sell legally. If you've made it this far, thank you. It probably only took you 5 minutes, but it took me a couple of hours before I hit the Publish button.

body.body:
**<center>Hello friends, good vibes to all.</center>**

> Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos. 


![1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wWu6QyKS5wAdCupai3232y5xvGU277upNJbjhfPLxNXMAKEq3EyGguuPC15psXbHEhZ.webp)


[Source!](https://xiahpop.com/witch-hat-atelier-anime-estreno-crunchyroll-2026/)

<div class=\

>We continue with our reviews of new releases and first impressions, and this season is bringing us some very interesting new titles that are already generating buzz with just their first few episodes. Today, we're reviewing an anime that I'm not used to watching. Fantasy anime full of magic isn't really my thing, but I'm going to give it a chance because of all the good things being said about it and what it promises. It's probably just another one of the bunch in its genre—the experts can tell me—but after watching the first two episodes, I'm eager to keep watching and see where the story goes.

> Seguimos con las reseñas de estrenos y las primeras impresiones y es que esta temporada está trayendo nuevos títulos que tienen una pinta bastante interesante y con apenas sus primeros capítulos ya están dando de qué hablar. El dia de hoy le toca a un anime de esos que no estoy acostumbrado a ver y es que la fantasía llena de magia no es lo mio pero que voy a intentar darle una oportunidad por todas las cosas buenas que se están diciendo y que promete tener. Probablemente sea uno más del montón dentro de su género, los conocedores que me lo digan, pero con los dos primeros episodios vistos me quedaron las ganas de seguir viendo y ver hasta dónde va la historia.

>We have Coco, a human girl, obviously, but one who dreams of becoming a magician someday. She lives in the countryside with her mother, a seamstress; the two lead a peaceful life. In that world, magic is something she's been told a person is born with, and therefore those born without this gift can't be sorcerers. It turns out that's not the case, that magic can be learned, and Coco will learn this the hard way. A magician named Qifrey (the Gojo of fantasy) arrives at her house looking for some fabrics; in the end, he has to cast a spell that Coco unwittingly witnesses, realizing what I mentioned earlier: that magic is written and drawn in runes.

> Tenemos a Coco, una niña humana como es obvio pero que sueña con ser maga algún día. Ella vive en el campo con su mamá quien es modista; las dos tienen una vida tranquila. En ese mundo la magia es algo que le habían dicho que nace con la persona y que por tanto los que nacieron sin ese don pues no podrán ser hechiceros. Resulta que aquello no es así, que la magia se puede aprender y eso Coco lo sabrá de mala manera. Resulta que a su casa llega un mago llamado Qifrey (el Gojo de la fantasía) buscando unas telas; al final a él le toca hacer un hechizo que Coco sin querer queriendo logra ver dándose cuenta lo que les dije, que la magia se escribe y se dibuja en runas. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/243MBCiNCxxEFNJT6b3FUCHr3DdKZWfVPTrpbBhe5BrvMHUfUKxZ9Zdt7f4VtuR1WkcpY) [Source!](https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/watch/GE00258180JAJP/the-magic-that-started-everything?srsltid=AfmBOorBq8f0Pa3p3oag3dWw9pPjy7TOLlovncWnwfdezGwtcHKsr6_c) --- ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xyGASTmWHZrCnHAG7cMqBGA7kJDKWvNLR3ZgtZpUxbqn7Y9ykNFoqetmecBGQp9P3xQ.jpg) [Source!](https://www.msn.com/en-us/tv/news/witch-hat-atelier-release-schedule-what-time-is-episode-4-on-crunchyroll/ar-AA201EZ1)

>It turns out Coco has a book given to her by a mysterious magician at a fair, and when she realizes she can replicate it, she makes a mistake. She casts an evil spell, and a tragedy ensues involving her mother. Luckily, Qifrey arrives to save her and offers her the chance to become his apprentice so she can learn everything she needs to save her mother. As I mentioned, this is pure fantasy. So far, we've seen spells, pointy hats (hence the name), and many scenes with a tranquil atmosphere that evokes rural life, nature, and simplicity. The thing is, while this anime shows us all this, it doesn't hide its intention to teach us darker things. It seems that as the story progresses, it will become increasingly dark and intense.

> Resulta que Coco tiene un libro que se le dio un mago misterioso en una feria y ella al darse cuenta que lo podía replicar es cuando comete el error. Invoca un hechizo maligno y termina pasando una tragedia con su madre. Por suerte Qifrey llega para salvarla y ofrecerle que sea su aprendiz para así pueda saber todo lo que necesita para salvar a su madre. Como les comentaba esto es fantasía pura, acá hasta los momentos lo que hemos visto son hechizos, sombreros puntiagudos (de ahí el nombre) y muchas escenas y una apariencia tranquila que evoca a la vida del campo, la naturaleza y la sencillez. El detalle es que este anime al mismo tiempo que nos muestra esto no esconde la intención de enseñarnos cosas turbias y es que tiene toda la pinta que conforme vaya avanzando la historia se va a ir poniendo más oscuro y denso.

>BUGS FILMS is the creator of this, a very, very young studio about which little is known, to be honest. This brings us to the animation, and all the settings are highly detailed and full of color, yet you know they conceal a hint of fear beneath the surface. The character designs and expressions are very natural; it's a very polished animation. When it needs to get fast-paced, it's also incredibly fluid. I think we could be looking at one of the best anime of the year. I know I always say this when I review something, but if it manages to maintain this level, it really could be something special.

> BUGS FILMS son los creadores de esto, un estudio muy pero que muy joven del que se sabe poco la verdad. Esto nos lleva a hablar de su animación y es que todos los escenarios son altamente detallados y llenos de color pero que sabes que esconden algo de miedo en el fondo. El diseño de los personajes y sus expresiones son muy naturales, es una animación que está muy bien cuidada. Cuando tiene que volverse movida pues también veremos mucha fluidez. Creo que podemos estar ante uno de los mejores anime del año, se que esto lo digo siempre que hago una reseña de uno distinto pero es que si logra mantener el nivel de verdad puede ser muy bueno. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wXBnqUQ8Jcnv8rv4626oPxLT9urbSKqdypHc3DtNSZdDvZUdBaQuZVFKURJ1MLHKkCg) [Source!](https://se7en.ws/witch-hat-atelier-anime-release-date-confirmed-in-stunning-new-trailer/?lang=en) --- ![5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wWQswpexMtHkYTjfRTMWvkvvdeuLFJWr5R82cPxtjKXXN7RW3qomLQ3JLkdiPDDTTQ7.jpeg) [Source!](https://www.espinof.com/criticas/witch-hat-atelier-absolutamente-magica-he-visto-inicio-anime-cita-imprescindible-para-fans-fantasia)

>Ultimately, it's a story where Coco appears innocent, seeing everything in a very different light. But in reality, it's a world where darkness will try to gain ground, and she'll have to learn to face what's coming. I think it will literally be a battle between good and evil, and that contrast is what I believe will bring the anime to life. If it has to stand out for anything, it will be for that. There are four episodes so far, but I've only seen two. If you enjoyed Frieren, then this new story might pique your interest. Again, it's not really my thing, but I'll make the effort to give it a chance since it might surprise me in the future. I'll leave the trailer below.

> Al final es una historia en donde hay una aparente inocencia por parte de Coco y es que ella ve todo de una manera muy diferente pero que en realidad es un mundo en donde la oscuridad buscará ganar terreno y ella tendrá que aprender a hacer frente a lo que se viene. Creo yo que será literalmente una lucha entre el bien y el mal y ese contraste es lo que pienso que le dará vida al anime, si por algo tiene que destacar será por eso. Van 4 capitulos pero yo solo he visto 2, si disfrutaron de Frieren pues puede que les llame la atención esta nueva historia. Repito, no es lo mio pero haré el esfuerzo de darle el chance ya que puede que me sorprenda en un futuro. Les dejo el trailer por acá abajo. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hMmBSCQs1H4 ***

Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!
*** > Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos vemos en la próxima!

body.title: Flexibility of Online Learning
body.body: Hi there. In this education post, I talk about the flexibility of online learning.   ## Comfort Learning At Home --- With technological advances and progress, online learning is a pretty big thing. One big appeal of online learning is being able to learn many different concepts at the comfort of your own home. No time nor energy is spent travelling to classrooms and campuses. For those who travel a lot, online learning allows students to learn on the go without being in the physical classroom.

>Image Source   ## Online Learning For Students --- For the students, online learning appeals to those who want to reduce their time and energy going to physical classrooms. An online course can sometimes be more organized than a course in a physical classroom. Some online courses are designed such that you can learn at your own pace. This is good for faster students who learn fast and don't want to slow down to match the classroom pace. Private education service centres may offer online learning services. Students may want services from an online tutor to help them improve in the subject of interest. An online interactive whiteboard would be used to transfer information, do practice problems, and go over homework.

>Image Source   ## Online Learning For Adults --- Adults may look into online learning to further their career or learn specific skills out of their personal interests. Online learning for adults in convenient as there is no need to drive to the classroom. Grab a coffee and learn online.

body.body:
![Five Oaks Dental (2).png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/f0dda36bc1ba39160f73e9ba26778b66bd8c28769b738236f5852d8042f8aa39)

Maintaining a bright smile and strong teeth requires more than just brushing at home. Regular visits for professional dental hygiene play a crucial role in preventing dental problems and ensuring long-term oral health. While daily brushing and flossing are important, professional dental care helps remove plaque, detect early signs of dental issues, and support overall wellness.

Many experienced dentists livonia mi emphasize the importance of routine dental hygiene visits as a foundation of preventive care. Whether you are caring for your own teeth or ensuring your family maintains good oral habits, scheduling regular visits supports healthy teeth and reduces the risk of future complications.

# Understanding the Importance of Dental Hygiene

Dental hygiene refers to professional cleaning and preventive care that removes plaque, tartar, and bacteria buildup. Over time, plaque hardens into tartar, which cannot be removed by brushing alone. Without professional cleaning, this buildup can lead to cavities, gum disease, and tooth loss.

Routine dental hygiene appointments typically include:

*   Professional teeth cleaning

*   Plaque and tartar removal

*   Gum health assessment

*   Oral cancer screening

*   Personalized oral hygiene recommendations

These services are an essential part of general dentistry, helping patients maintain strong teeth and healthy gums throughout their lives.

# How Regular Visits Support Healthy Teeth

Regular dental visits help identify problems before they become serious. Early detection reduces treatment costs and prevents discomfort.

Professional dental hygiene helps maintain healthy teeth by:

### Removing Plaque and Tartar

Even with proper brushing, plaque can build up in hard-to-reach areas. Professional tools used in general dentistry clean areas that daily brushing may miss.

### Preventing Cavities

Regular cleaning removes harmful bacteria that cause tooth decay. This lowers the risk of cavities and keeps teeth strong.

### Protecting Gum Health

Gum disease often develops without noticeable symptoms in its early stages. Routine dental hygiene visits allow professionals to monitor gum health and treat early signs before they worsen.

# Role of General Dentistry in Preventive Care

Preventive care is one of the most valuable services provided through general dentistry. Routine exams and cleanings help maintain long-term oral health and prevent more complex treatments in the future.

Preventive services include:

*   Dental examinations

*   X-rays for early detection

*   Fluoride treatments

*   Sealants for cavity prevention

*   Routine cleaning and polishing

Patients who regularly visit dentists livonia mi for preventive care are less likely to experience severe dental problems.

# Benefits of Family Dental Care for All Ages

Choosing professional family dental care ensures that every member of your household receives appropriate dental attention. Children, adults, and seniors all have unique dental needs, and routine hygiene visits help address those needs effectively.

Benefits of family-focused care include:

*   Consistent dental monitoring

*   Personalized treatment plans

*   Education on proper brushing and flossing

*   Reduced anxiety for children

*   Early detection of dental issues

Regular dental visits help children develop lifelong habits that support healthy teeth into adulthood.

# Early Detection Saves Time and Money

One of the biggest advantages of regular dental hygiene visits is early problem detection. Minor dental issues can quickly turn into major problems if ignored.

Routine checkups help identify:

*   Cavities

*   Gum disease

*   Tooth sensitivity

*   Enamel wear

*   Bite alignment issues

By visiting experienced dentists livonia mi, patients can address these issues before they require complex treatments.

Preventive care reduces:

*   Emergency dental visits

*   Painful dental procedures

*   Long-term treatment costs

# Improving Overall Health Through Oral Hygiene

Oral health is closely connected to overall health. Poor oral hygiene has been linked to several medical conditions, including heart disease and diabetes. Maintaining proper dental hygiene supports not only your smile but also your overall well-being.

Healthy teeth and gums allow you to:

*   Eat comfortably

*   Speak clearly

*   Maintain confidence

*   Prevent infections

Routine dental visits through <https://www.fiveoaksdental.com/dental-services-in-livonia-michigan> practices contribute to improved overall health.

# Building Confidence with Healthy Teeth

Clean, well-maintained teeth improve both appearance and confidence. Professional dental hygiene treatments remove stains and buildup, helping teeth look brighter and healthier.

Patients who maintain healthy teeth often experience:

*   Improved self-confidence

*   Better social interactions

*   Enhanced professional appearance

*   Reduced dental anxiety

With consistent family dental care, maintaining a confident smile becomes easier and more achievable.

# Recommended Frequency for Dental Hygiene Visits

Most dental professionals recommend visiting a dentist every six months for routine cleaning and examination. However, some individuals may require more frequent visits depending on their oral health condition.

Factors that influence visit frequency include:

*   Gum health

*   History of cavities

*   Smoking habits

*   Medical conditions

*   Orthodontic treatments

Regular checkups with experienced dentists livonia mi ensure personalized care and better long-term outcomes.

# Tips to Maintain Dental Hygiene Between Visits

While professional care is essential, daily habits also play a significant role in maintaining oral health.

Follow these simple steps:

*   Brush teeth twice daily

*   Floss once a day

*   Use fluoride toothpaste

*   Limit sugary foods

*   Drink plenty of water

*   Replace toothbrush every 3 months

These habits support healthy teeth and enhance the effectiveness of professional dental hygiene treatments.

<https://www.fiveoaksdental.com/> are one of the most effective ways to maintain strong teeth and healthy gums. Preventive care provided through trusted general dentistry services helps detect problems early, reduce treatment costs, and improve long-term oral health.

Working with experienced dentists livonia mi ensures access to professional family dental care that supports lifelong oral health. By prioritizing routine dental hygiene visits, you take an important step toward maintaining healthy teeth and a confident smile.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 A 15-year-old is dead, and the most important detail isn’t the famous last name — it’s the brutal mix of alcohol, a vehicle, and a kid on an e-bike. body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says the crash happened Saturday night just before 9 p.m. on Cole Mill Road in Durham, North Carolina. Police say Savarino, 26, was driving north when he struck 15-year-old Jack O’Shea, who was riding an electric bicycle. Jack died at the scene. His mother later identified him publicly and shared a devastating message about the family’s grief.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The legal part is ugly and still unfolding. Public records cited in the article say Savarino registered a 0.11 BAC on a breathalyzer around 12:45 a.m. Sunday — above the legal limit. The article also says he admitted he had been drinking earlier that night. He’s facing a misdemeanor DWI charge for now, but the investigation into the fatal crash is still ongoing, which means more charges are absolutely possible depending on what investigators conclude.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 There are already immediate consequences: he was booked into Durham County Detention Center, released Monday on $100,000 bail, surrendered his license for at least 30 days, and is due back in court in about a month. The piece also adds uncomfortable family context: this isn’t the first DWI case tied to Coach K’s family. Joseph’s brother, Michael Savarino, was arrested in 2021 and later pleaded guilty to DWI in North Carolina.

body.title: SplinterTactics Dev Log 11: Items
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bravetofu/23yThGJ8RpAnUob25qxfWax95fwEeZ22ko4fQTt5o4bhsRdTzD5io7xkq6tcoJkNpkscw.png)

Today I worked on getting the item system for SplinterTactics in place.

There are three phases:
- Phase 1 is the item definition and generation system
- Phase 2 is the logic for equipping items onto units
- Phase 3 is how items are acquired (e.g. through endless run performance)

This system's quite important because I don't currently have plans to release any tokens for SplinterTactics, which means the primary reward will be items. Note that these won't be NFTs (at least not for the time being, though it's possible I may try to do this in the future).

Here's a first look at what a full item collection looks like in the inventory page:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bravetofu/23t7BUnXJGx5m54fnTELM6cN44kfupqwGyNZAQZBTA8WBQPrvVBDbQEwYhoE9NLQdeED1.png)

Items currently follow a procedural creation pattern as follows:
- 3 types: Weapon, Armor, Trinket
- Several sub-types: E.g. Longsword, Breastplate, Ring
- Rarity: Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary
- Prefix: E.g. \

- Multiplier: null to +1-4

Each prefix/suffix has specific traits and visual effects, and the multiplier then multiplies numerical effects.

The item type & rarity are rolled first. The chance of getting better prefixes and suffixes depends on the rarity of the item.

In a nutshell, that's the gist.

For now there's no way for you guys to play with these, but very soon (by the end of the week) I'll have some drop mechanics for people to start testing.

<3

body.title: I Draw Fried Eggs Using Oil Pastels
body.body:
![egg.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEruWNrz55ALVAhg2eyoKjPQW8Ewh2621KHEmVE6XWNJW4Tux1Bzem7cPwMsNkQrBa.gif)
Hello, how are you? I just came back from vacation, a cozy one, and I’ve been tired after that. Being unproductive ruins everything I plan for the whole month. Today I recovered from the not-so-good things happen to me LOL. I thank my mother a lot, my mother who is really concern to me LOL. So I force myself to be productive today and draw something. I was browsing through my gallery, and I saw these fried eggs I took a photo of before, and I wanted to draw them using oil pastel, so I did. -----
Materials I Used:

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokeZ58xuqB3yHSavyquynko48zuKDbMM9bGqnNiTpsAiZzQk2qEiYscwnkgyHzqmBs.JPG) First thing I do is to sketch the outline of the egg, it is okay if the sketch is not perfect, just go with the flow. ---

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPD7k3FVtFpQMFcBQdtdeBvdiz9ytaDZTsgrTfYBxTYkiVcyn6KvMN8m7o4So9hrh.JPG) And then I add the base color of the egg, and yes, I like my egg toasted at the side. ----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiWgfseBLkFFpBRTEHjGzhmrFqC1f7gaZoM7pMiTUybrynisp7MZuthDJrAvcEgaA3.JPG) Then I added the toast at the side using Burn Sienna. And then I added light blue as an accent color to the egg to make it more unique. ----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGzosvRJmqDtwm9xnbfHVHfhtgst2EogZQ6yZCvt2Us9T26WZMs8y6TTmHjfXTicmA.JPG) Then I use the shades of blue and purple as an undertone to the main color of the reference. I layer each color I added. -----
> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGyv14h5c1qPhFVMs3KRTVqqYA2BH4WDCESGZAy4Z8e9xtqwp9RUaBKKyWXt9s1xWC.JPG) Now I layer those undertones with shades of gray. -----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiWkN9nMZoiNEzt1G5YHq5qPeqbKCxKuDARcp7Bm9w3Czx7kP67JVxfnAX4svxkAtR.JPG) The drawing is missing an intense shadow, so I added black to the shadow part to balance the color. ----

> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7oUTDkZaxCzxyXbKkF8sTgRMHgK1o41y5nFCEgWTnVowE3vqcW3JxF21UeQ9pYXQ.JPG) Then I added small shadows onto the eggs just to make a dimension to them. -----

> ![16.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouA6zdwiMBUnPEcp2DyZaqaHQ824v6AiWid6ZGScEZByWpoQjARTVKb9XRwPYQ733y.JPG) Time to add the texture, I use my clay tool to do the scratching job. This makes texture and highlights at the same time. -----

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGGfzPrUUXBCLSvndrhBJBtf7jMM2AV8a4wh4ZWR6ftxVvFBSpntvBeKs9kCjmWcN.JPG) This is what it looks like. I did just a little texture this time. ----- ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7htqr3Fwfdn99V4SkpZbE1ndvtVcGdEJBRJkAHon6PkY1u9hWqAHs5dxKtEDcAuN.JPG) I ate eggs for my breakfast today LOL. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

body.title: A Peaceful Day Out at Ayub National Park with My Brother
body.body: > Today I went to Ayub National Park with my brother and like always this place felt very soothing to the heart. I often come here because the park’s atmosphere is extremely peaceful and full of natural beauty. Away from the busy city life coming here gives a person a strange sense of calm and freshness.

> The walking tracks built in the park are really excellent. I often come here to walk and with every step I feel a new sense of freshness. The lush green trees around the tracks the cool breeze and the chirping of birds make this place even more beautiful. Coming here not only gives the body peace but also lightens the mind.

> The beautiful lake inside the park is the most special feature of this place. The calm water of the lake and the captivating scenery around it compel a person to forget everything for a while. Today’s weather was also extremely lovely the gentle breeze and pleasant atmosphere made this moment even more memorable. The time spent with my brother was truly priceless and going to places like this also makes relationships even stronger.

> To make this beautiful day even more memorable we had lunch right inside the park. The hotels and food points here are very clean and beautiful and there’s a charm of its own in sitting and eating here. We sat peacefully and had lunch then enjoyed some cold ice cream. The ice cream here is really delicious and it tastes even better in this pleasant atmosphere. In this way this simple day turned into a beautiful memory.

>

body.title: UK Nursery and Early Education Guide for Parents
body.body:
## Introduction

Early childhood education sets the base for how children learn, think, and behave later in life. In the UK, many families depend on a [Childrens Day Nursery](https://kids-time.co.uk/) for early learning and daily care during working hours. These settings support speech development, social behaviour, and basic learning skills during the most important growth stage. Your decisions at this stage affect school readiness and long-term progress.

## What Early Child Education Means

Early childhood education covers learning from birth to age five. It focuses on building core skills before formal schooling starts. Children learn through play, routine, and guided activity.

In the UK, early years education follows the Early Years Foundation Stage framework. This framework sets clear targets in key areas:

*   Communication and language development

*   Physical movement and coordination

*   Social and emotional skills

*   Early reading and writing skills

*   Basic number understanding

Children learn in short sessions that match their [attention span](https://www.waivio.com/). Activities stay simple, structured, and repeated for better understanding.

## Why Early Years Matter

Brain development moves at its fastest rate before age five. Education Policy Institute research shows that around 90 per cent of brain growth happens during this stage. Early learning experiences shape memory, focus, and emotional control.

Children who attend structured early education settings perform better in school entry assessments. Ofsted reports show stronger outcomes in reading, behaviour, and communication among children who attend quality early years programmes.

Key benefits include:

*   Faster language development through daily conversation

*   Improved focus during structured tasks

*   Better emotional control in group settings

*   Stronger confidence when interacting with others

*   Early number awareness through practical activities

Government support in England improves access to early education. Eligible working parents receive up to 30 hours of funded childcare each week for children aged 9 months to 4 years. All three and four year olds receive at least 15 hours of funded early education. This support increases participation across different income groups.

## Role of Nurseries in Early Learning

Nurseries provide structured environments where children learn through routine and interaction. Staff follow national learning standards and track progress in each development area.

A Childrens Day Nursery supports working families by offering full-day care along with learning activities. Children follow daily routines that include learning time, meals, rest, and outdoor play.

Inside these settings, children build early habits that support later schooling. These include listening, sharing, waiting for turns, and following instructions.

Nursery environments support:

*   Social development through group interaction

*   Language growth through storytelling and conversation

*   Physical strength through outdoor movement

*   Early writing and drawing practice

*   Basic maths through counting and sorting tasks

Staff also share regular updates with parents. This keeps you informed about progress, behaviour, and learning goals.

## What You Should Look For in Early Education Settings

Choosing the right setting affects your child’s experience. Focus on clear signs of quality rather than appearance alone.

Important points during visits:

*   Qualified staff trained in early years education

*   Safe indoor and outdoor spaces

*   Balanced ratio between children and staff

*   Daily structure with learning and play balance

*   Clear communication with parents

*   Strong Ofsted inspection results

Observe how children behave in the environment. Calm, active, and engaged children often reflect good care and planning.

## Home Support for Early Learning

Learning continues outside nursery hours. Simple daily actions support stronger development.

*   Read short stories every day

*   Talk about daily activities in simple sentences

*   Encourage drawing, colouring, and tracing letters

*   Set fixed sleep and meal routines

*   Limit screen time and increase active play

*   Praise effort during learning tasks

Consistency between home and nursery builds stronger habits. Children respond better when routines stay similar in both places.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

Some choices reduce learning quality during early years. Avoid focusing only on cost or location.

Watch for these issues:

*   Large groups with limited staff attention

*   Lack of structured learning activities

*   Weak communication between staff and parents

*   Frequent changes in caregivers

*   Limited outdoor or physical play time

These factors affect emotional stability and learning progress.

### Conclusion

Early childhood education shapes long-term learning ability, behaviour, and confidence. The UK system supports families through funded childcare and structured early years programmes. A strong early foundation leads to better adjustment in primary school, improved communication, and stronger academic progress. Careful choices during this stage set a clear path for your child’s development.

---

body.title: Experimental accidental glitch photography / some glue, tissue and spit
body.body:
![camera_lines_thumb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juliakponsford/23xKxeGwAis7Mkrx9fqL67twh1s5V1i88BmF8DRK6C7kSnTANrQKCMTDsxFNnHPJAYnds.jpg)

---

These photos came straight out of my phone camera (well, I did adjust the levels slightly but these are basically raw)!

How you might ask?

I am a very paranoid person and I do not trust my phone. I keep the front and back cameras covered with a little strip of electrical tape at all times, and I would suggest you do so as well. The only problem is over time as the phone gets warm and the tape gets removed and reapplied it can get a little GOOEY.

@vachemorte and I decided to go for a little walk the other day on a nearby hiking trail. The woods looked stunning and there was a really pretty dappled light. I grabbed my camera, peeled off the tape and was dismayed that the lens was completely blurry. I grabbed a tissue and *moistened* it with a little spit and tried to rub the glue off.

I looked at the image on the screen again and I had somehow perfectly made a filter that had lots of beautiful little lines giving a kind of glitch effect!

Here are the dreamy results:

Buenos días a todos. Les cuento que entrenar todos los días tiene una ventaja en la que hasta ahora no había pensado. Se las comento a continuación.


Salir a trotar todos los días puede no ser sencillo si tenemos muchas obligaciones laborales o personales, pero poder hacerlo tiene la gran ventaja de poder analizar cada entrenamiento y compararlo fácilmente con los anteriores.


Hoy, por ejemplo, salí a trotar y durante los primeros 3 km mantuve el ritmo cercano a los 5 minutos, pero, a diferencia del día domingo, traté de ir muy rápido en una de las subidas y eso hizo que tuviera que bajar drásticamente la velocidad en los 2 km finales, debido a que la respiración se me descontroló. 


Además, este mes he podido analizar mi rendimiento cuando hay sol y cuando no, cuando inicio rápido o cuando comienzo a un ritmo suave. Así me voy preparando para cuando deba ir a una carrera oficial, donde el margen de error es mínimo.


Hoy salí temprano, según yo, pero el sol ya estaba fuerte. Eso también influyó en no poder mantener el ritmo bajo toda la carrera. La buena noticia es que ya son 19 días consecutivos saliendo a trotar. Estoy a solo 3 de mi record personal. Por los momentos me despido. Hasta mañana. Feliz Día para todos.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English

Good morning, everyone. I’d like to share something with you: training every day has an advantage I hadn’t thought of until now. Here’s what I mean.


Going out for a run every day might not be easy if we have a lot of work or personal commitments, but being able to do so has the great advantage of letting you analyze each workout and easily compare it to previous ones.


Today, for example, I went out for a jog and kept my pace close to 5 minutes per kilometer for the first 3 km, but unlike on Sunday, I tried to go very fast on one of the uphills, which meant I had to drastically slow down for the final 2 km because my breathing got out of control. 


Also, this month I’ve been able to analyze my performance in sunny and cloudy conditions, when I start fast, and when I start at a gentle pace. This is how I’m preparing for when I have to run in an official race, where the margin for error is minimal.


Today I left early, at least in my opinion, but the sun was already strong. That also played a part in my inability to maintain my pace throughout the entire run. The good news is that I’ve now gone out for a jog 19 days in a row. I’m just 3 days away from my personal record. That’s all for now. See you tomorrow. Have a great day, everyone.

body.title: Geburtstagsausflug nach Crosswinds in Tagaytay!
body.body: Im vergangenen September verbrachten wir anlässlich des Geburtstags meiner geliebten Frau (@kobold-djawa) ein Wochenende in einer Mietwohnung in \

, einem der höchstgelegenen Orte Tagaytays, geprägt von alpinem Ambiente, kühlem Klima, Tausenden mächtiger Nadelbäume und einer an die Schweiz erinnernden Architektur. Inspiriert von Schweizer Bergdörfern, reihen sich hier Chalets und Gebäude mit charakteristischen Schrägdächern aneinander. Nicht umsonst gilt Crosswinds Tagaytay als eines der beliebtesten - wenn auch nicht gerade preisgünstigsten - Reiseziele auf den Philippinen. Insbesondere wer sich inmitten des oft hektischen südostasiatischen Alltags nach Ruhe, frischer, sauberer Bergluft, Entschleunigung und Spaziergängen im Grünen sehnt, sollte einen Besuch Crosswinds in Erwägung ziehen. body.body:
> Good morning, fellow members of #TheAnimeRealm I'm new to this community and I hope to gain a lot of experience with you all. Today I'll be talking about the first season of one of my favorite anime, Made in Abyss, which I'm always recommending to my friends so they don't miss out on this masterpiece.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHE6dAmcLyztaJSZ2UhQkkYm8jXZYuecF5APJZUAaPVY/1776746644110.png)
Most of this series takes place in the Abyss, a mysterious pit of unknown origin filled with wondrous treasures and unimaginable dangers. It is surrounded by a city of adventurers who wish to unravel its mysteries by venturing into its depths, often losing everything in the process.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2dMF5C48URXArvyCR5QjHLDo7HUp5H56nEwgtAN4oz9/1776746709404.png)
Here we will follow Riko, a little girl with a big dream: to reach the bottom of the Abyss and reunite with her mother. In this adventure, she will be accompanied by Reg, a robot with great abilities but no memories of his past.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTMJsZNq4UmjC5CuFEPUZcdwWoqEkFdTx29uDeHGcMMh/1776746737902.png)
Together they began their journey to the deepest part of this enormous pit, passing first through the first layer called The Edge of the Abyss, advancing without much difficulty
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxFWCJfz7LLodXZDUtWCFMVVFpiwWNfvLzF2D7CfbVbS/1776746768168.png)
To reach the Forest of Temptation in the second layer, they encounter their first great danger: a corpose-weeper, a creature that mimics the scream of adventurers before they die to attract more victims.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2o6i2CZ4HfcKTtyoJQUopXpPmzzyAWP3cNv6d5vSPUk/1776746796187.png)
By defeating these enemies, they enter the Inverted Forest, a place that marks the end of the second level and is infested with different formidable enemies and allies.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHot649RasjKyiKp3NDXw9zUn5xdRfxpiimDWNBE6D9U/1776747127424.png)
After a few tests and preparation, they enter the third layer, The Great Fault, a 4000-meter vertical cliff, descending with constant dangers from the attacks of the flying monsters that inhabit this place.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCdecoAGV1CXDp4viN4cmr5DYwquidKeCQL5nhK6cRmu/1776746868681.png)
But despite the difficulties, they reach the fourth layer, The Cup of the Giants, where they are joined by Nanashi, a girl who was affected by the curse of the abyss, losing her humanity and becoming a plush doll with great intelligence, knowledge, and highly developed senses, heading towards the fifth layer, The Sea of ​​Corpses.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4vPt5xajQcxoFnNW8GFkkVFusdmKzLZxAdBVWGVXosr/1776746888358.png)
Ending the summary of this first season
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb43tXY6tER1YFMacS7A1NtDJ8m6CjGzPD9Xi3Q1PML8B/1776746910227.png)
