> Buenos días compañeros de #TheAnimeRealm soy nuevo en esta comunidad y espero ganar mucha experiencia junto a ustedes. Hoy les hablare sobre la primera temporada de uno de mis animes favoritos Made In Abyss el cual siempre se lo estoy recomendando a mis amistades para que no se pierdan esta obra de arte.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHE6dAmcLyztaJSZ2UhQkkYm8jXZYuecF5APJZUAaPVY/1776746644110.png)
La mayor parte de esta serie transcurre en el abismo, un foso misterioso de origen desconocido lleno de maravillosos tesoros e inimaginables peligros. Rodeado de una ciudad formada por los aventuros que desean revelar sus misterios adentrandose en sus profundidades y muchas veces perdiendolo todo.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2dMF5C48URXArvyCR5QjHLDo7HUp5H56nEwgtAN4oz9/1776746709404.png)
Aquí seguiremos a Riko una pequeña niña pero con un gran sueño llegar al fondo del Abyss y reunirse con su madre, en esta aventura la acompañara Reg un robot con grandes habilidades pero sin recuerdos de su pasado.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTMJsZNq4UmjC5CuFEPUZcdwWoqEkFdTx29uDeHGcMMh/1776746737902.png)
Juntos empezaron su viaje a lo mas profundo de este enorme poso pasando primero por la primera capa llamada El Borde Del Abismo avanzando sin muchas dificultades
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxFWCJfz7LLodXZDUtWCFMVVFpiwWNfvLzF2D7CfbVbS/1776746768168.png)
Para llegar al Bosque De La Tentación en la segunda capa, donde se encuentran a su primer gran peligro un corpose-weeper una criatura que imita el grito de los aventureros antes de morir para atraer a más victimas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2o6i2CZ4HfcKTtyoJQUopXpPmzzyAWP3cNv6d5vSPUk/1776746796187.png)
Al vencer a estos enemigos se adentran en el Bosque Invertido un lugar que marca el final de el segundo nivel y esta infestado de diferentes enemigos y aliados formidables
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHot649RasjKyiKp3NDXw9zUn5xdRfxpiimDWNBE6D9U/1776747127424.png)
Donde luego de unas cuantas pruebas y preparación se adentran así la tercera capa La Gran Falla un acantilado vertical de 4000 metros descendiendo con constante peligros por los ataques de los monstruos voladres que habitan aquí
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCdecoAGV1CXDp4viN4cmr5DYwquidKeCQL5nhK6cRmu/1776746868681.png)
Pero pese a las dificultades llegan a la cuarta capa La Copa De Los Gigantes donde se les une Nanashi una niña la cual fue afectada por la maldición del abismo perdiendo su humanidad u convirtiéndose en una muñeca de peluche con una gran inteligencia, conocimiento y sentidos muy desarrollados, dirigiéndose a la quinta capa El Mar De Cadáveres.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4vPt5xajQcxoFnNW8GFkkVFusdmKzLZxAdBVWGVXosr/1776746888358.png)
Terminando el resumen de esta primera temporada
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb43tXY6tER1YFMacS7A1NtDJ8m6CjGzPD9Xi3Q1PML8B/1776746910227.png)

body.title: Lana Del Rey now has a song featured in the “007” franchise.
body.body:
<center>[TechPlay](https://techplay.gg/news/lana-del-rey-releases-007-first-light-theme-song)</center>
For years I've followed **Lana Del Rey**'s work, and I always thought she could be the one to create one of the iconic songs that are part of the opening credits of the ***007*** franchise movies. That hasn't happened yet, but last week she released something similar: a specific soundtrack for the game ***007 First Light***. The song is called *”First Light”*, which was written by Lana herself alongside composer **David Arnold**. The collaboration created an incredible result, and one that definitely deserves to be appreciated by listeners. I personally loved it, and I highly recommend it.
In short, the song (which is a perfect fit for a video game, but could easily also be part of the soundtrack of a feature film in this franchise) explores themes such as courage, determination, constant intensity, and great touches of adventure, bringing to the forefront the beginning of **James Bond**'s journey and how he opened the doors to his rise as one of the most famous British spies in the entire universe. In other words, this song reminds me of a short film being narrated through very melodic tones.
The technical work done to compose this song is brilliant, and it particularly made me very happy because it's truly a very well-executed piece of work. The entire orchestration process (which is highly classical) was conceived and developed by **IO Interactive**, along with a partnership with **Amazon MGM Studios**, and brought not only Lana's \

sound style into the spotlight, but also reaffirmed the cinematic nature of the sound. Literally, the track is sometimes so big that it deserves to be something more prominent than a video game soundtrack.\nAlso mixing in a very typical touch of sensuality, although more pronounced this time, the song navigates between great moments. However, it doesn't break patterns that are expected for a song that is part of this franchise (whether in games or movies). The work is undeniably great, Lana's voice is \

(but with a very well-orchestrated production) and everything refers to the universe of the franchise. I've wanted to hear something like this from her for a long time. The business style suits what she does perfectly, because her \

favors that aspect.
---
<center>**Lana Del Rey ahora tiene una canción incluida en la franquicia “007”.**</center>
Durante años he seguido el trabajo de **Lana Del Rey** y siempre pensé que ella podría crear una de las canciones icónicas que forman parte de los créditos iniciales de las películas de la saga ***007***. Aún no ha sucedido, pero la semana pasada lanzó algo similar: la banda sonora del videojuego ***007 First Light***. La canción se titula *“First Light”* y fue compuesta por la propia Lana junto al compositor **David Arnold**. Esta colaboración dio como resultado una canción increíble que sin duda merece ser apreciada por los oyentes. Personalmente, me encantó y la recomiendo ampliamente.
En resumen, la canción (que encaja a la perfección con un videojuego, pero que también podría formar parte de la banda sonora de una película de esta saga) explora temas como el coraje, la determinación, la intensidad constante y grandes toques de aventura, poniendo de relieve el inicio del viaje de **James Bond** y cómo abrió las puertas a su ascenso como uno de los espías británicos más famosos del universo. En otras palabras, esta canción me recuerda a un cortometraje narrado con melodías muy cautivadoras.
El trabajo técnico realizado para componer esta canción es brillante, y me hizo muy feliz porque es una obra realmente bien ejecutada. Todo el proceso de orquestación (de estilo clásico) fue concebido y desarrollado por **IO Interactive**, en colaboración con **Amazon MGM Studios**, y no solo puso de relieve el peculiar estilo vocal de Lana, sino que también reafirmó la naturaleza cinematográfica del sonido. Literalmente, la canción es tan grandiosa en algunos momentos que merecería algo más que una banda sonora de videojuego.
Además, incorpora un toque de sensualidad muy característico, aunque más pronunciado en esta ocasión, y la canción transita entre grandes momentos. Sin embargo, no rompe con los patrones esperados para una canción que forma parte de esta franquicia (ya sea en videojuegos o películas). El trabajo es innegablemente genial, la voz de Lana es “auténtica” (pero con una producción muy bien orquestada) y todo remite al universo de la franquicia. Llevaba mucho tiempo queriendo escuchar algo así de ella. Su estilo empresarial se adapta perfectamente a lo que hace, porque su \

favorece ese aspecto. ---
**Lana Del Rey agora tem uma música dentro da franquia “007”.**
Há anos eu já acompanho o trabalho da **Lana Del Rey**, e sempre pensei que ela pudesse ser a dona de uma das músicas icônicas que fazem parte dos créditos de aberturas dos filmes da franquia ***007***. Isso ainda não aconteceu, mas na última semana ela lançou algo parecido: uma trilha sonora específica para o jogo ***007 First Light***. A música se chama *“First Light”*, que foi escrita pela própria Lana ao lado do compositor **David Arnold**. O trabalho em dupla criou um resultado incrível, e que definitivamente merece ser apreciado pelos ouvintes. Eu particularmente adorei, e recomendo com toda certeza. Em síntese, a música (que tem um encaixe perfeito para um jogo de vídeo game, mas que poderia facilmente também ser parte da trilha sonora de um filme longa-metragem dessa franquia) explora temas como coragem, determinação, intensidade constante e grandes toques aventura trazer para o centro das atenções o início da trajetória de **James Bond** e como ele abriu as portas para à sua ascensão enquanto um dos espiões britânicos mais famosos de todo o universo. Em outras palavras, essa música me lembra um filme curta-metragem sendo narrado através de tons muito melódicos. O trabalho técnico feito para compor essa música é algo brilhante, e que particularmente me deixou muito feliz porque é realmente um trabalho muito bem executado. Todo processo de orquestração (que é altamente clássico) foi pensado e desenvolvido pela **IO Interactive**, juntamente a uma parceira feita com a **Amazon MGM Studios**, e trouxe não apenas o estilo sonoro “peculiar” da Lana para os holofotes, como também reafirmou a característica cinematográfica do som. Literalmente, a faixa às vezes é tão grande que merecia mesmo ser algo mais proeminente do que trilha de vídeo game. Misturando também um toque de sensualidade bem típico, embora mais acentuado desta vez, a música navega entre ótimos momentos. No entanto, não quebra padrões que são esperados para uma música que faz parte dessa franquia (seja em jogos ou em filmes). O trabalho é indiscutivelmente ótimo, a voz da Lana está “crua” (mas com uma produção muito bem orquestrada) e tudo remete ao universo da franquia. Já fazia um bom tempo que eu queria ouvir algo assim vindo da dela. O estilo comercial cai como uma luva para o que ela faz, porque a “essência” dela favorece esse aspecto. body.title: El gafarró: un petit tresor alat dels nostres paisatges
body.body:
**El gafarró: un petit tresor alat dels nostres paisatges**

El **gafarró** (*Serinus serinus*), conegut també com a serín verdecillo en castellà, és un dels fringílids més petits i simpàtics que podem observar a Catalunya i a gran part d’Europa. Amb només 11-12 cm de longitud, aquest ocellet pertany a la família Fringillidae i és parent proper del canari salvatge. La seva presència és habitual en parcs urbans, jardins, horts, boscos oberts i zones agrícoles, on aporta color i alegria amb el seu plomatge i el seu cant característic.

### Aspecte físic i dimorfisme sexual

El gafarró destaca per la seva mida reduïda i el seu bec curt i ample. El plomatge general és verdós-groguenc amb estries fosques al dors, ales i cua. El ventre sol ser més clar, i l’obispill (la part superior de la cua) presenta un groc intens visible en vol. 

Els **mascles** mostren una coloració més brillant: la cara, la gola, el pit i parts del cap són d’un groc viu, especialment durant l’època de cria. Les femelles són una mica més petites i tenen tons més apagats, amb el pit i el centre del cos més grisosos i menys groc prominent. Aquest dimorfisme sexual ajuda a distingir-los fàcilment quan s’observen en parella.

### Hàbitat i distribució

El gafarró és una espècie molt adaptable. Es distribueix per Europa (incloent-hi la conca mediterrània), el nord d’Àfrica i l’oest d’Àsia. A la península Ibèrica i a Catalunya és resident i comú, tot i que les poblacions del nord d’Europa són migradores i només crien a l’estiu.

Prefereix ambients oberts amb arbres dispersos: boscos clars, oliveres, tarongers, parcs urbans i zones agrícoles. És gregari fora de l’època de cria i sovint es pot veure en petits grups buscant aliment. No és una espècie amenaçada; les seves poblacions europees s’estimen entre 17 i 40 milions d’exemplars.

### Alimentació i comportament

S’alimenta principalment de llavors petites d’herbes i plantes, tot i que durant l’època de cria incorpora insectes per proporcionar proteïnes als pollets. El seu vol és ondulant i característic, i sovint emet reclams curts en forma de “triiulit-lit-lit” mentre es desplaça.

### El cant del gafarró

El cant del mascle és un dels més recognoscibles i alegres de la primavera. Es tracta d’un **gorjeig rapidíssim, prolongat i estrident**, compost per diverses estrofes que pot emetre tant posat en un arbre, un cable elèctric o un pal, com en vol amb aletejos lents. Aquest cant serveix per atraure la parella i defensar el territori durant l’època de reproducció.

Per escoltar el cant autèntic del gafarró, pots reproduir aquest àudio d’exemple:

```html
<audio controls>
  <source src=\

> El teu navegador no suporta l'element d'àudio.

Enregistrament del cant de Serinus serinus (font: xeno-canto.org). Pots explorar més enregistraments a

>xeno-canto.

``` (Nota: si l’enllaç directe no funciona al teu dispositiu, visita el web de xeno-canto i busca “European Serin” per escoltar diverses variants del seu cant vibrant.) ### Reproducció i curiositats La nidificació sol produir-se entre març i juliol. El niu, construït per la parella, és una petita cistella feta amb herbes, molsa i plomes, col·locada en arbres o arbustos. La femella pon entre 3 i 5 ous, que incuben durant uns 13 dies. Els pollets deixen el niu al cap de dues setmanes aproximadament. Una curiositat interessant és que el gafarró ha expandit la seva àrea de distribució cap al nord d’Europa durant els segles XIX i XX, adaptant-se bé als ambients humanitzats. A les ciutats catalanes com Barcelona, Girona o Tarragona, és fàcil observar-lo als parcs amb bon arbrat. El gafarró és un exemple perfecte de com la natura s’integra en els nostres espais quotidians. Observar-lo i escoltar el seu cant és una activitat senzilla que connecta amb la biodiversitat local. Si tens l’oportunitat, surt a passejar per un parc o un camp proper a la primavera: amb una mica de paciència, segur que sentiràs el seu alegre i ràpid gorjeig!

body.title: Silent depression that is not visible from outside
body.body:
Silent depression is that thing which is not visible on the face of a person but is slowly hollowing him out from inside the person looks absolutely normal from outside he is laughing talking mixing with everyone but in reality there is such a void inside him which cannot be expressed in words and the strangest thing is that when someone asks how are you so he smiles and says I am fine whereas behind that fineness thousands of broken thoughts are hidden such a person does not share his problems because either he feels that no one will understand or he does not want to become a burden on anyone and this silence keeps breaking him from inside the day passes but the heart does not pass the night comes but sleep does not come and the most heart wrenching thing is that 

people think that everything is fine whereas in reality nothing is ever fine sometimes a person gets so tired that he starts questioning his own life as to why he is here and why he is doing all this but he still remains silent.
 because he feels that speaking will not change anything and this is the biggest pain of silent depression which is neither visible nor understood it just keeps eating the person from within and slowly slowly he starts losing interest in everything he once loved even small things like music food or conversations start feeling empty and meaningless and sometimes he sits alone staring at nothing thinking too much.
 but saying nothing and the worst part is that even in a crowd he feels completely alone as if no one is really there for him and he starts building a wall around himself where no one can reach him and over time this silence becomes his habit and he forgets how to even explain what he is feeling inside.

body.title: Colour-walk 之 大乌龟复活记
body.body:
周末那天我们从老房子那出来后，看着天气非常好，老头子问去哪儿？我说刚好离东港很近，要不我们去东港看看吧，这么好的天气，去东港走走，呼吸一下海边的空气，顺便看看以前的那些大乌龟们怎么样了！

如今的东港就是原来的海之韵公园，曾经那里有浪花雕塑，还有一群栩栩如生的大乌龟们，20多年前，我们还曾经在那里拍过照呢！当时的大乌龟特别的气魄，向着大海的方向，像是要回到大海中，乌龟很大，也很高，是个非常巨大的一个地标性建筑呢！
![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQB723r3W7YqGhsPVVs6cgK1Ewem2Wbrk8oRizrWuUqjb/5.jpg)


![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSAQMSW9RGrEAARQQCaY9oA8ecntQW3pUfXWDNHAqP2a/4.jpg)

但是后来东港变成商务区，海龟的地方要建房子，建地铁，所以填海建楼，大乌龟们在的地方也都填平了，不知道大乌龟们现在啥样了，于是我们开车过去看看。 

没想到，快到海边的地方，还真的看到了大乌龟们，而且也有很多人呢！走近一看，有大人带着孩子在那里玩的，还有工人师傅们正在给大乌龟们重新装饰，让它们焕然一新，正在给大乌龟穿铠甲。 工人师傅们一点点的给给大乌龟的壳上颜色。有两只小乌龟已经涂完，跟真的一样呢！

这些大乌龟们就像在沙中游戏，然后再返回到大海中，工人师傅们涂完之后，真的就像是活了一样！这些大乌龟们给很多人都留下了深刻的印象，这也是东港最美的景点之一。 

看完了大乌龟，我们又到了海边，这里又新添了一个景点就是山海经，不过还没有建好，里面的工人师傅们正在忙着！
![8.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZGeJ8XVbiNf6iXxPzc6TUM72Vpk1oPbLMQ73pzP9T2PS/8.jpg)

沿着步栈道在海边走走，空气中有股烧烤的味道，原来在海边有很多人搭着帐篷，里面都在烧烤，而这些烧烤的海鲜可都是从海里直接打捞上来的海鲜呢！

有个海鲜打捞组合，他们在那里正在将赶上来的战利品摆好，在卖呢！

海边风平浪静，人们享受着阳光明媚，这种惬意的生活真的是太好了！老头子开了句玩笑，说这些人都是闲的，在家里做吃的多好，何必硬到海边来烧烤！

我说那是因为他“老了” ， 你没有玩的心情，本身就说明你老了！萧伯纳不是有句名言吗？我们不是因为老了不玩耍，而是因为不玩耍才变老！🤭我说他就是老了！（We don't stop playing because we grow old ,we grow old because we stop playing . ）

海边的风景优美，远处还能看到在锚地抛锚的那些大船们，海鸥也在头顶不停的飞翔和鸣叫，人们也在用他们的善良在喂养着它们，不时的有海鸥俯冲下来，构成了一幅美丽的海边风景图。 

可惜今天的网络不给力，上传好多张图片都失败了，请大家见谅！

body.title: 探店小记（35） ｜美好春日时光
body.body:
​

这一天我们午饭是在一家叫做 jojo & nana 的店里吃的，这家店装修得很可爱，而且不管是杯子还是盘子都很符合整体的法式风格，在我们吃饭的时候就有很多人来门口拍照。饮料点了一杯肉桂苹果热橙茶，茶里有几片苹果和橙子，还放了一根肉桂卷，不过我觉得应该是调制饮料而不是泡出来的，因为有些太甜了。还有一杯南瓜栗子牛乳，我选的是加一克蜂蜜，不过没喝出来什么甜味，牛奶味居多，饮料上面的拉花应该是栗子酱。


小吃点了一份芥末飞鱼籽炸薯角，配的酱是番茄酱和芥末鱼籽酱，薯角炸得很到位，外酥里嫩，隔了一会儿吃也还是脆脆的。主食有一份九层塔辣炒蛤蜊意面，上面撒了些芝士碎，是意面的冬阴功风味中又多了一些芝士的奶香味，蛤蜊也还不错。还有一份辣白菜玉米芝士焗饭，辣白菜有效的中和芝士玉米的油腻，增添了特殊的风味。还令点了一份饭叫做肉多多打抛猪肉饭，这份饭很香，猪肉碎很好吃。甜点是一个香蕉太妃巧克力蛋糕，蛋糕的夹心中加有几块香蕉块，既为蛋糕增添了果味，又没有破坏蛋糕的绵密口感，整体来说还不错，就是没什么太妃糖的味道。


![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbADhLQVWZdZXvCR1wPcZwmc1zN5iatbKJBHA7Cz915u3/5.jpg)


今天的分享就到这里啦，我们下次再见！

body.title: Modern artworks (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
>
![1000110597.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQvSbhStdTzuWu8YgKFpZd3wjaVZE1NfNuH2zPxJNwGCJjaWkFFx5dnxLEFuqLsfdrY.jpg)
San Antonio of the Eminencia Castle is quite a large complex, so it deserves a separate post to explore the lower level, where relatively new structures have been built, the most important of which is the Cumana Museum of Contemporary Art (MACU), a cultural space established in 1998. I spoke with the staff, and they told me that it wasn’t open to visitors that day because no art exhibition had been scheduled. It’s worth mentioning that behind the museum is a meeting room where various public events are held.
![1000105998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqSV73r3esMySTQzMmvX2Yj2Za5xJcMdaY2wfxwU3uy8EmKkdJWT7dycv9pLpEKdPqX.jpg)
![1000106041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Eq5C7EkU1dXhGPWDEAcqLWAfQywNvWTz8kAgTBLuyKr8qWgHowv3QjjkQ17vpH9oWZY.jpg)
![1000105620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep3dHSvamB9UcukiNixRJ4bkCWGwRNvWr3zovGhPoh6Pu2cZG318t3iv2uPUBoD1oFK.jpg)
![1000105599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Eq362Gx4JTmpaDqzqPqamHHah7HhwipnFZXRt4fNaAc8LLZSVSuGD47BrXoQBGuCosL.jpg)
![1000105582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpA2Z9gw7gAZsrBf8ZGhgTvTARaLthBBokLiUP8KDgtSf8gpbvyF4CJt7kvRkTTyeND.jpg)
I also toured this modern part of the castle; the breeze was very strong, so much so that it blew my hair around, and my white cap even flew off—luckily I was able to catch it right away, otherwise it would have been lost in the abyss, in the void that is felt in this area, which faces the Basilica of Santa Ines.
![1000105653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqBZj4fZC9taZjV5bp7ruAL3bFhfKLu8ByBk9oNwgyg6ySkTZaDtazM7Jxr1yK1V5UM.jpg)
![1000106010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpVBcXoRrG6hgqqidZjkHJW7ysazrAQnegihpeUGQF1xQpyVTtXGHUiDKfKRqTgcpf7.jpg)
![1000106002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpVC6jTRmvyjnhUE82eHv4iejGZ3jPfADhG22tosnzjKrJdJqUM5iMuPMJy3rsSsehG.jpg)
The view from here is breathtaking, as you can not only observe the city from a bird’s-eye view but also appreciate it from a more intimate perspective. Being up high is incredible, but the view from the watchtowers is also spectacular. Each of them, located at the four cardinal points, offers a unique view of Cumaná; they once served as lookout posts and have now become magnificent observation decks.
![1000105986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/242hWWhQCHSgYZx3xUtxJYXNXBFXVGNetg7YEHPCCpEUn2gJG79A3YbSDQPMUvVHCmTip.jpg)
![1000105990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Eq359arJuUXwdf2bM6jBTCxjn9sZGN6wP3BxZkyszufCkWfsfHeUYxxEWhURAVhA9jQ.jpg)
![1000105985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zRtrAyWWqHjMkoZ4N8Dco6bRcjoHPxqZyissZ4hQfHedpDbo1nUaxKBk5HjrTJ9MFTT.jpg)
In this area, there are displays of modern art—pieces so large they cannot be exhibited in the museum itself. A blue geometric sculpture symbolizing a rhombus, and another cylindrical one resembling an anachronistic spaceship. Then there is the mast that distinguishes ships, a tribute to Sucre’s fishing industry. I also noticed three curves representing the sails of a boat and, near them, a wooden base made of rustic logs that could symbolize endurance and the passage of time. Finally, there is a brown metallic installation resembling a stylized anchor that reinforces the nautical theme.
![1000105991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpnEivjSjneZgNHMY4vE6UYf9MmFJeU9cgUXXziMgLYQt9KtBFVZW4qKnJWmirJaEKv.jpg)
![1000105993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqmfdixaE22Z9nTr2jFncPwNBvPDGK6FBTxrDtfJRydofQVjccpzpqk9ja3gjAGWuNy.jpg)
![1000105981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpGS7ZmwMirv6ztP8VckFWtLZshWKjwXsoYW4rftFNP7pbnRnQjqs5YHVgBUBRpat5v.jpg)
![1000105987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/243qK9itGSreFkGvv7S67aavSQ8VtvDDvden7HswUnsRkKJ5mkLFodak193L482WjBC83.jpg)
Xerophytic vegetation is the most abundant; from the entrance to every corner of this National Historic Monument, aloe vera and cacti can be seen in the gardens. On this occasion, they looked somewhat faded, showing signs of dehydration, as Cumaná is currently experiencing a concerning drought. I also noticed trumpet flowers, which were the most striking blooms on the grounds due to the contrast of their vibrant colors against the parched appearance of the other plants.
![1000105950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EprScqPEMeFAGz6gUVgqaV6mntoX5F4WTRF2CJpUUfD6ZNV4insrzpdoqg4n7MEg9tX.jpg)
![1000105953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep3eo1ZWeWBzFUeMCcK3R7hi7BRk6HCWmGyipZim2bAs7bChrJTa35YAPj7PNPdqLqP.jpg)
![1000105760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpNoRWGWtfA4373KRTNLhitBBdqWFMYPeeUkrqR6veWJpgA2hrbw91vtji5wpincw63.jpg)
![1000105983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpnCGdchT3XoQucFKRv9Zegz1EE3GeTmP88Lwkm4saD3SvrajwNeAGiJv6kqVx8ehut.jpg)
My curious gaze also took in the beautiful lion statues embedded in the massive walls. The lion remains a prominent symbol on Spain’s coat of arms and has been used since medieval times. I found these sculptures fascinating, so I climbed up and photographed them more closely.
![1000105749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EoeEQM9LuU1QyBpKg47sTPcFtcrVmhCZexU6sbAcEb26maJCNGJE8NqtoftMfwvvmiL.jpg)
![1000105752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EogMpcPVTKpWYRLu53CnxgMveQad5T7us4UowKkuNdiiV7LqZgkhiVmECK9TcJ8hhsp.jpg)
![1000105618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqhGyAX3xc9xt5Y57Zo2wDCG63JyYdqA3WhoWSdTnrukVaXSbgAA85WeszrnQqzLRra.jpg)
![1000105994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqomTJg2DKHxSHc2CWKLLKopRFX986c9mnHokAtRrVu1sqaxHHHQZuHWnchEtE2Qxf3.jpg)
![1000105997.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqBamU7VUrkJN9fNCnNQQ6s1U9rVLaW9Ws4AnbixXAkpfXfB4mbtcPzpuLqqR4WwjKV.jpg)
What I find delightful is that every time I visit this castle, I discover something appealing that I hadn’t seen before. I hope that the next time I return, I’ll be able to enter the museum area to continue exploring this heritage of Cumaná that never ceases to amaze me. *** ***
## Versión en Español

>
![1000110597.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQvSbhStdTzuWu8YgKFpZd3wjaVZE1NfNuH2zPxJNwGCJjaWkFFx5dnxLEFuqLsfdrY.jpg)
El castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia es un lugar bastante amplio, así que merece otra publicación para explorar el nivel inferior, donde se han construido estructuras relativamente nuevas, siendo la más importante el Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Cumaná (MACU), un espacio dedicado a la cultura que se creó en 1998. Conversé con las personas encargadas y me indicaron que ese día no estaba abierto a los visitantes porque no se había programado ninguna exposición artística. Cabe mencionar que detrás del museo está una Sala de Reuniones donde se realizan diferentes eventos públicos.
![1000105998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqSV73r3esMySTQzMmvX2Yj2Za5xJcMdaY2wfxwU3uy8EmKkdJWT7dycv9pLpEKdPqX.jpg)
![1000106041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Eq5C7EkU1dXhGPWDEAcqLWAfQywNvWTz8kAgTBLuyKr8qWgHowv3QjjkQ17vpH9oWZY.jpg)
![1000105620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep3dHSvamB9UcukiNixRJ4bkCWGwRNvWr3zovGhPoh6Pu2cZG318t3iv2uPUBoD1oFK.jpg)
![1000105599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Eq362Gx4JTmpaDqzqPqamHHah7HhwipnFZXRt4fNaAc8LLZSVSuGD47BrXoQBGuCosL.jpg)
![1000105582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpA2Z9gw7gAZsrBf8ZGhgTvTARaLthBBokLiUP8KDgtSf8gpbvyF4CJt7kvRkTTyeND.jpg)
De igual manera recorrí esta parte moderna del castillo, la brisa era muy fuerte, tanto que ondeaba mi cabello, incluso se voló mi gorro blanco, menos mal que lo pude capturar de inmediato, de lo contrario se hubiera perdido en el abismo, en el vacío que se advierte en esta zona que está orientada hacia la Basílica de Santa Inés.
![1000105653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqBZj4fZC9taZjV5bp7ruAL3bFhfKLu8ByBk9oNwgyg6ySkTZaDtazM7Jxr1yK1V5UM.jpg)
![1000106010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpVBcXoRrG6hgqqidZjkHJW7ysazrAQnegihpeUGQF1xQpyVTtXGHUiDKfKRqTgcpf7.jpg)
![1000106002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpVC6jTRmvyjnhUE82eHv4iejGZ3jPfADhG22tosnzjKrJdJqUM5iMuPMJy3rsSsehG.jpg)
La vista desde acá es asombrosa, pues no solo se puede observar la ciudad de manera objetiva sino que se aprecia desde una mirada más íntima. Estar en las alturas es increíble, pero también la perspectiva que ofrecen las garitas es espectacular. Cada una de ellas, ubicadas en los cuatro puntos cardinales, ofrece una visión única de Cumaná, antes servían como puestos de vigilancia y ahora han pasado a ser magníficos miradores.
![1000105986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/242hWWhQCHSgYZx3xUtxJYXNXBFXVGNetg7YEHPCCpEUn2gJG79A3YbSDQPMUvVHCmTip.jpg)
![1000105990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Eq359arJuUXwdf2bM6jBTCxjn9sZGN6wP3BxZkyszufCkWfsfHeUYxxEWhURAVhA9jQ.jpg)
![1000105985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zRtrAyWWqHjMkoZ4N8Dco6bRcjoHPxqZyissZ4hQfHedpDbo1nUaxKBk5HjrTJ9MFTT.jpg)
En esta zona se han dispuesto unas muestras de arte moderno, piezas tan grandes que no pueden ser exhibidas en el museo interno. Una escultura geométrica de color azul que simboliza un rombo, otra con forma de cilindro semeja una anacrónica nave espacial. Luego está el mástil que distingue a los barcos, un homenaje a la actividad pesquera de Sucre. También observé tres curvas que representan las velas de una embarcación y cerca de ellas una base de madera de troncos rústicos que pudiera denotar la resistencia y el tiempo. Por último se encuentra una propuesta metalizada de color marrón que asemeja un ancla estilizada y refuerza la temática náutica.
![1000105991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpnEivjSjneZgNHMY4vE6UYf9MmFJeU9cgUXXziMgLYQt9KtBFVZW4qKnJWmirJaEKv.jpg)
![1000105993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqmfdixaE22Z9nTr2jFncPwNBvPDGK6FBTxrDtfJRydofQVjccpzpqk9ja3gjAGWuNy.jpg)
![1000105981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpGS7ZmwMirv6ztP8VckFWtLZshWKjwXsoYW4rftFNP7pbnRnQjqs5YHVgBUBRpat5v.jpg)
![1000105987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/243qK9itGSreFkGvv7S67aavSQ8VtvDDvden7HswUnsRkKJ5mkLFodak193L482WjBC83.jpg)
La vegetación xerófila es la más abundante, desde la entrada hasta cada rincón de este Monumento Histórico Nacional se pueden apreciar sábilas y cactus en los jardines. En esta ocasión lucían un tanto descoloridas, síntomas de deshidratación, ya que en Cumaná se está atravesando por una preocupante sequía. También observé trinitarias, las cuales eran las flores más llamativas del lugar debido al contraste de su colorido con la imagen sedienta de las otras plantas.
![1000105950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EprScqPEMeFAGz6gUVgqaV6mntoX5F4WTRF2CJpUUfD6ZNV4insrzpdoqg4n7MEg9tX.jpg)
![1000105953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/Ep3eo1ZWeWBzFUeMCcK3R7hi7BRk6HCWmGyipZim2bAs7bChrJTa35YAPj7PNPdqLqP.jpg)
![1000105760.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpNoRWGWtfA4373KRTNLhitBBdqWFMYPeeUkrqR6veWJpgA2hrbw91vtji5wpincw63.jpg)
![1000105983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EpnCGdchT3XoQucFKRv9Zegz1EE3GeTmP88Lwkm4saD3SvrajwNeAGiJv6kqVx8ehut.jpg)
Mi curiosa mirada también apreció hermosas estatuas de leones incrustadas en los inmensos muros. El León todavía es un símbolo que se distingue en el escudo de España y se utiliza desde la época medieval. Me parecieron fascinantes estas esculturas, por eso subí y las fotografié más de cerca.
![1000105749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EoeEQM9LuU1QyBpKg47sTPcFtcrVmhCZexU6sbAcEb26maJCNGJE8NqtoftMfwvvmiL.jpg)
![1000105752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EogMpcPVTKpWYRLu53CnxgMveQad5T7us4UowKkuNdiiV7LqZgkhiVmECK9TcJ8hhsp.jpg)
![1000105618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqhGyAX3xc9xt5Y57Zo2wDCG63JyYdqA3WhoWSdTnrukVaXSbgAA85WeszrnQqzLRra.jpg)
![1000105994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqomTJg2DKHxSHc2CWKLLKopRFX986c9mnHokAtRrVu1sqaxHHHQZuHWnchEtE2Qxf3.jpg)
![1000105997.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/EqBamU7VUrkJN9fNCnNQQ6s1U9rVLaW9Ws4AnbixXAkpfXfB4mbtcPzpuLqqR4WwjKV.jpg)
Lo que me resulta grato es que cada vez que visito este castillo encuentro algo atractivo que no había visto previamente. Espero que la próxima ocasión que vuelva pueda ingresar a la zona del museo para seguir conociendo este patrimonio de Cumaná que no deja de sorprenderme.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: IT'S WHAT A HERO WOULD DO : HIMMEL FANART
body.body:
Wazzup Anime Fans! This month's Fanart is another character from the Anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. 

The Season 2 of the anime just finished a few weeks ago and I'm sad cause there's no Frieren Friday anymore. I've been waiting for the episodes every week and good thing they announced that there will be Season 3. They also teased us a little bit of what will happen next season and can't wait for it next year.

The Character that I drew this month is Himmel, one of the Party of Heroes who defeated the Demon king (do not worry this is not a spoiler). Even though we only saw him in flashbacks, his impact on the people he had encountered and helped can still be seen after decades since he died and inspired some people not only in the anime but also in real life. Yes! in real life because of this phrase: \

And as the story progress, we slowly know what kind of person he is and that approach is what I like about the anime Frieren.

PROCESS

> Here's my initial Sketch and as you can see it is a little bit detailed because I was trying a new method in drawing. ![Himmel_Sketch.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/EonrJjQBebcwyBTo3ND5KYyooMvnjPb65WARqfZiiDXQ7SAAqLsaTKbHxqSJJJMBfSu.png)

> The new method I tried is that, I painted the base colors over the sketch. I'm not used to this method and it took a lot of time. 😅 ![Himmel_Base.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/EqYwYoDtbLks7KGafKSjoxgpsD8ij44CKiwMKA7nzn4Gg1mxoCsxtNh7UPgc6LuMWwK.png)

> Then I started adding more details and shading on the clothes and his cape. ![Himmel_Cape.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/Eqb4wzE6hz3wiXbj8E6HCs32HtpcofZCCm71dHns39B6pNefstM3dovNkckwpAQRyNt.png)

> I painted the skin before the hair because the skin is below the hair. ![Himmel_Skin.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/Eqb4wz9gpmGaUpNj7uR9nEp11NMNr4nJph96dkQTnrBpP35CEXA4h8Pc4R3vxarSyHA.png)

> After painting the skin, I proceed to paint the the hair and the ring. ![Himmel_Hair_Ring.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/Eqb4wz9fCUTZkkFkuVjetfnUizw8DynuSAA6A3DeYDvwguyzLFwAfcenbq4y2ZtnHVg.png)

> Lastly, I painted the background which is one of the village in the anime. ![Himmel_BackGround.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/EpVEzu4egFUe4DwsGqaH86dy1YyW9k33Fs2wbv4JypCvdTsXNhoCLCG2gPHPfRCFLPo.png)
And here's the final result after several refining. Actually, I finished this artwork very early around 7 hours but was not satisfied on the first result, so I had to redo some parts of the character. ![Himmel_Finale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justnyz/EpVEzu4egFUe4DwsGqaH86dy1YyW9k32VToqEH6usUuRiSaTgcEYnXdc6JKMxeALCdS.png)

TIMELAPSE

https://youtube.com/shorts/Ro4n6JzMKo4
Thank you for reading and I hope you enjoyed it! Have a Good day and see you again next time!

title.title: Gamelan Musical Instruments
title.body:
Greetings to everyone. 
How are you, happy Hive community? Thank you Cross Culture. Everyone loves music and everyone has different tastes in music. 


![IMG_20260421_135358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23w2gpeWcBcLSD2VzchJTb66G9bevJVV2NaYtQLSihWYiri3dm68eoVcPdciewgQehoQ9.jpg)


Gamelan is a traditional music from Indonesia that has existed for a long time, especially in Java, Bali,and Sunda. Gamelan has been around since the Hindu-buddhist kingdom are and had become a musical performance played for the nobility. 


![IMG_20260421_135321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23tmFvJ7tsxRLSrLHuopXBu829sMneTUY2CxoYXe9LjZUHiz74uHtSW67jftgVW3vtSuZ.jpg)
 

Gamelan music is usually used to accompany dances, traditional ceremonies, wayang performances and also for public entertainment. Gamelan music styles baru from region, with some producing solf music and others with dynamic rhythms.


![IMG_20260421_135233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23tSSANk6MV8whBMDUE3Qcm66gdm8quXUEQPRycUvwKQmoz2vRUjUYeEAyC3yfr9FAQsX.jpg)


Gamelan consists of several musical instruments played together. Creating a melodious harmony of tones. There are several sets of gamelan instruments, such as gender, saron, gong, Bonang,kempyang.


![IMG_20260421_135154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/EoGxUDaPe8qwgXzfPcbGdDbRedVWKdNSxzJ7eSUvJCuwhM4RuKPiCDSXN765eSwrK4M.jpg)


Gamelan musical instruments are played by striking or hitting them. A round 20 people or more, play gamelan instruments. In 2014, gamelan music was recognized by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage. 


![IMG_20260421_135113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23vsN2TMRUAXN4a27SuR2KX4aUmk73DUCf1j7zDJQzi2CzntXf3dnM2GRZVRrCZ8aFSWq.jpg)

Thank you for stopping by.

title.title: When Nothing Makes Sense Yet Everything Matters
title.body:
![Uploading image #2...]()






Image source :https://pixabay.com/photos/nothing-new-bye-1785760/

Sometimes life presents a strange scene meaning everything seems fine and also not at all fine. Morning arises daily routine goes on we talk to people but deep inside we feel something is missing but we cannot understand what. A person keeps thinking that what exactly am I doing there is no clear plan the day just keeps passing by. Sometimes it seems that everything will be fine and sometimes it is completely opposite that maybe nothing will be fine. 
Still a person does not stop he does not know on what hope he keeps moving forward. And the funny thing is in this confusion one is also learning a little. There is no proper lesson just experience Mistakes happen and then one quietly realizes that it was not the right thing to do. There is no clap no sense of accomplishment Just something changing deep inside.
Sometimes it feels like a waste of time really. 
But then there comes a moment where it seems that maybe this was all necessary Otherwise how would I have even reached this point of thinking. The simple truth is that there is no perfect time for everything. Sometimes a person is just in a flow half here half there and that is the real story. Neither complete victory nor complete defeat just a strange journey in between which comes to mind later.

title.title: Real K-Rosé! 20 Servings with Buldak Sauce in 1 Hour
title.body: 안녕하세요, rara입니다! 😊 Hello, I'm rara! 😊 동생들과 함께 모여서 저녁을 만들어 먹었어요. 원팬 파스타로 로제, 토마토, 크림 이렇게 3가지 맛을 만들었고요. I got together with my younger friends and made dinner. I made three flavors of one-pan pasta: Rosé, Tomato, and Cream. 1시간 안에 20인분 만든다고 진땀을 흘렸지만 그래도 만족했고 다들 맛있게 먹어서 행복했습니다. 오늘 만들었던 파스타 초간단 레시피를 공유해 보도록 할게요^^ I sweated a bit making 20 servings in just an hour, but it was satisfying and I was happy because everyone enjoyed it. Let me share the super simple pasta recipe I made today! ^^

/> 먼저 보이는 사진은 저희가 만든 3가지 파스타와 배달로 시킨 치킨이에요. 파스타는 로제, 크림, 토마토이고 치킨은 양념과 간장입니다. The first photo shows the three types of pasta we made and the chicken we ordered. We had Rosé, Cream, and Tomato pasta, along with seasoned and soy sauce chicken. 자!! 그럼 초간단 원팬 파스타 레시피 고고 해볼까요? Alright!! Shall we jump into the super simple one-pan pasta recipe?

/> 20인분을 만들려고 하니!! 재료 양도 장난이 아니죠? Making 20 servings!! The amount of ingredients is crazy, right? (재료 / Ingredients) 파스타면, 토마토소스, 불닭소스, 버터, 베이컨, 체다치즈, 양파, 버섯 Pasta noodles, Tomato sauce, Buldak sauce, Butter, Bacon, Cheddar cheese, Onion, Mushrooms.
/> 베이컨, 양파, 버터를 썰어서 재료를 준비해줍니다. 파스타면과 치즈, 버섯도 준비를 해주세요. Slice the bacon, onions, and butter to prepare them. Also, get the pasta noodles, cheese, and mushrooms ready.
/> 베이컨과 버섯은 풍미를 위해 조금만 먼저 볶아주세요. Stir-fry the bacon and mushrooms just a little bit first for better flavor.
/> 자 그럼 이제 모든 재료를 넣습니다. 오늘 만들 파스타는 원팬파스타로 한번에 모든 재료를 넣고 만드는 방법이에요. Now, put in all the ingredients. Today's pasta is 'One-pan pasta', where you put everything in at once.
/> 후라이팬이 2개인 이유는 하나는 로제파스타 하나는 크림파스타를 만들거에요. I'm using two pans because I’m making Rosé pasta in one and Cream pasta in the other.

/> 먼저 기본 재료를 다 한번에 넣고 물을 넣어줍니다. 마지막에 파스타 면을 넣어주는데 제가 사용한 파스타 면은 링귀니입니다. First, put in all the base ingredients and add water. Finally, add the pasta noodles—I used Linguine. 1인분의 양이 얼마인지 모를때는 500원짜리 동전 크기로 면의 양을 측정해서 넣으면 딱 맞아요. 우유 200ml, 물 360ml를 넣어주시면 아주 맛있는 원팬 파스타를 만드실 수 있어요. If you're not sure how much one serving is, measure the noodles to the size of a 500-won coin. Using 200ml of milk and 360ml of water will give you a perfect result.
/> 이때 로제파스타에는 한국의 매운맛 불닭소스를 넣어줍니다. At this point, add the spicy Korean 'Buldak' sauce to the Rosé pasta.
/> 그리고 약한불에서 계속 끓여주기만 하면 돼요. 너무 간단하고 쉽죠? Then, just keep simmering it over low heat. It’s so simple and easy, right?
/> 소스가 끓고 졸여지면 계속 저어주면 돼요. Once the sauce starts boiling and thickening, keep stirring it.
/> 약한불에 계속 저어주면서 끓이면 이렇게 꾸덕한 파스타가 완성이 됩니다 ^^ 맛있겠죠? If you keep stirring over low heat, you'll get this wonderfully creamy and thick pasta ^^ Doesn't it look delicious?

/>

사실 데코레이션은 0점이라는 거 인정하지만, 그래도 동생들과 함께 맛있게 먹었다는 거에 의미를 둡니다. 다음엔 더 맛있게 더 예쁜 데코로 도전해 볼게요!  
I admit the decoration is a zero, but I value the fact that I enjoyed a delicious meal with my friends. I'll try to make it even tastier and prettier next time!

title.title: Nobody Wants To Die | First Impressions of an AAA Freebie From Epic
title.body:
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbJtTavFkygn2gRejQCeSSGzW1Bdxh8aeHA67xGNd6CX1g8m59a6XUXpYBQcGhRTA1b.gif)


Hello gamers, how are you all doing? I hope everyone is doing great and gaming a ton. So, continuing my process of going through the games I have sitting in my Epic library, I decided to finally download this title that Epic gave away not too long ago called Nobody Wants to Die. I'm sure a lot of you remember when this one dropped as a freebie because it really wasn't that long ago, so if you've already played it, no spoilers please LOL! And if you've got it sitting there in your library untouched, I seriously recommend you fire it up because so far, at least from what I've played, this thing is pretty good.

## A Dystopian Future in Manhattan Where Nobody Can Die

![0126 (2)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23t79QNYysSryebH5p5NGTEfUkisetaFQhCE8ZCKe9uPkajE1Vs3Yd6CL5Voh2QpSBGni.jpg)

So right off the bat, the premise of this game is something else. We're talking about New York City in the year 2329, and by this point, humanity has managed to crack the code of immortality. The way it works is that your consciousness, basically your soul and all your memories, gets stored in what they call a memory bank, and from there it can be transferred from one body to another. Sounds incredible, right? Well, not so fast, because this whole system comes with a massive catch that shapes everything in this world: immortality is not for everyone. It's basically a subscription service, and only the rich and powerful can afford it. The rest of humanity? Well, they're basically walking around in bodies they don't even truly own, because the elites put in place something called body subscription laws starting at age 21. So yeah, this future is equal parts fascinating and absolutely brutal when you stop and think about it.

![2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tkjzzs6QactJv4N2JBsM3HPRTXnKWHpuG9yd2nXVFJQ9W6G4HnYc2DaoyuVZwUJQpCL.gif)

The world itself feels like someone took the aesthetic of 1920s noir Manhattan and blasted it 300 years into the future. You've got flying cars, massive holographic advertisements plastered across skyscrapers, acid rain that has basically wiped out all plant and animal life, and the streets ooze with that gloomy, damp, oppressive atmosphere that makes classic noir so compelling. It's honestly one of the most interesting worldbuilding setups I've come across in a game recently, and the fact that it came for free from Epic makes it feel even more wild.

## A Detective With Hallucinations, Reassigned to Get Back in the Game

![0126 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tRsva9AxpEmqeLeCtu6afovMzrCF1XfKBVd7xiHzquzi4kBTyJ9jLvrAHJQccN9gYEV.jpg)

The character we play is Detective James Karra, and this guy checks every single box of the classic hardboiled detective archetype. He's a veteran who has been working in what they call the Mortality Department of the NYPD for nearly a century, which already tells you a lot about how this world operates. He smokes, he drinks heavily, and he's carrying a mountain of personal demons on his shoulders. After being involved in some kind of large-scale public catastrophe that we don't fully understand at first, James gets placed on administrative leave. Not exactly the kind of guy you'd want as your partner, but at the same time, exactly the kind of guy you want solving a mystery in a corrupt, rotten city.

![0126 (2)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tGTsDdz3j6rKch8XrnQ2QXKrxj1jyRXosfuA11ViXL4ut3gtFCPUtrSRkq14nFafqcC.jpg)

Here's where things get really interesting. James is in a state of what the game calls desynchronization, which basically means his mind and his current body are not quite lining up properly anymore. This translates into hallucinations, visual glitches, and moments where reality starts to bend around him in genuinely creepy ways. It's a mechanic that the game uses both narratively and visually, and even in just the short time I played, it already creates this feeling of tension and unease that keeps you on edge. So when his chief offers him an off-the-books case, a chance to get back in action, he obviously takes it, even though everything about his situation says he probably shouldn't be out there.

![0126 (2)(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tkmmkFU71ESPfGEdwCUPF1vwbsLMagRkZaQkikgH6gWcxhUAifaX3EEwg6dJmvdwQxp.jpg)

His partner throughout the investigation is a young police liaison named Sara Kai, and from what I've seen so far the dynamic between the two of them is already pretty solid. She's sharp and keeps things grounded while James is, well, James.

## Graphics That Are Just Spectacular So Far


![0126 (2)(8).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5Sndycj9EfpsJULe72dfePR2TEEbRk4KiuCnmku3GdQE1yg4qvFGLGJtNPQVfBYiuX.jpg)


Now let me talk about this because honestly it's one of the first things that jumps out at you the moment you boot this game up. The visual work is absolutely stunning. The game runs on Unreal Engine 5, and Critical Hit Games, the studio behind this, clearly pushed it hard. The city of Manhattan in 2329 is breathtaking in the most bleak and beautiful way possible. Everything has this very deliberate vintage aesthetic mixed with a far future that somehow works perfectly together. The flying cars look like they were pulled straight out of a 1940s art deco daydream but floating between skyscrapers that pierce through clouds of acid rain. The lighting work is exceptional, with neon reflections bouncing off wet streets and the interiors feeling dense and detailed.

![0126 (2)(7).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbK2GUXQ5Q5A2zockeMhHBsixzjTQqE2vknWzpzvEH3DZwBSCJNgk3kKNfr3WPWXcHi.jpg)

And this is a twenty-person studio. Twenty people made this. That alone is impressive and honestly a little humbling when you're looking at visuals that rival games made by teams ten times that size. The character models are photorealistic in a way that actually serves the noir atmosphere rather than feeling cold or clinical. It all comes together into something that genuinely looks and feels cinematic from the very first moment you get control of James.

## First 30 Minutes: Arriving at the Crime Scene


![0126 (2)(9).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbMFqyVtmkWZJWQMk76U6Xap9ZStrSUAsCsyv2wWPFWj727eoaqqeWWxLHjxDQ2vApM.jpg)


So I'll be honest, I only got about 30 minutes into the game before I had to stop, but even in that window there was already a lot to take in. The setup is laid out to you through dialogue and environmental storytelling before you actually get to any real detective work. The case James is handed involves what appears to be a highly important political victim, someone from the upper echelons of this dystopian society, and the circumstances around their death are already shrouded in that classic noir mystery vibe where nothing is quite what it seems.

![0126 (2)(10).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5X5of1sW33Vp9DrNHSBwTrMCyF6CRn6PCNcJxD2TVjHe6uWkTezTKLPEscEEAznjUz.jpg)

Getting to the victim's apartment and taking in the crime scene for the first time was genuinely impressive. The arrival alone, flying over the city and approaching the building, already sets a tone that feels cinematic and deliberate. Once inside, the scene is eerie and well crafted. I managed to find and photograph the very first piece of evidence before calling it a session, but even that small interaction gave me a taste of how the investigation mechanics work. The game gives you tools like a Reconstructor, which is this wrist gadget that lets you essentially rewind time at the crime scene and watch what happened, kind of like rewinding a holographic recording of events. It's a cool concept and something I'm really looking forward to digging into more once I actually sit down to play properly.

![0126 (2)(11).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23t74pBH1N9R8xUmKE2LJ5T884B4ksk6zYYjeNANgf82ozfNNsic4yXiiRP4gRuuWY829.jpg)

What struck me most in these first 30 minutes though was just how much atmosphere the game packs in. Every corner of the world feels considered and intentional. The dialogue has that sharp, dry, world-weary quality that good noir demands, and the voice acting sells it completely.

![0126 (2)(12).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbKPs836Vafs7vTNXAFTHxffHn7zPaPbKi7q7GVrbbrRkwpXLwEtXGuJySeAoLCeVAM.jpg)

So that's where I'm at for now. The game is only 26 GB which honestly suggests it won't be a super long experience, probably somewhere in the 5 to 8 hour range I'd guess, but from what I've seen so far it looks like it's going to be a tight, focused, and visually stunning ride. I'll be diving back in for the next missions soon and will definitely have more to say once I get deeper into the investigation. So hey gamers, let me know in the comments what you think about this one, have you played it? What did you make of it? See you in the next post!

title.title: Rutina de limpieza con mis productos KIMBEAUTY
title.body:
>Mis queridos amigos, hace un tiempo les conté que seguí los consejos de la comunidad y me fui a hacer un mercado de artículos de limpieza y cuidado de mi rostro, comprando unos productos de la marca KIMBEAUTY y los vende en la cadena de tiendas de MundoTotal. Ahora, les comentaré qué compré y cómo los aplico.
\n\n>

>My dear friends, some time ago I told you that I followed the advice of the community and went to do a shopping of cleaning and facial care products, buying some products from the KIMBEAUTY brand, which are sold in the MundoTotal store chain. Now, I will tell you what I bought and how I apply them.
-------- -------- ![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-30 at 1.00.51 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tvo32m1fFQqGWfuhZxv6TZanA3yuMUHQHELapZfcKzJHAhzAmGNrsDwf5HnbQr31kHC.jpeg) ![dddddddd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wCdfRT1KRT8WVuSmhECACmBjpXKNgMdPHQewbT6CLufiaM86diMjwi3RpNxHX2ZzLa6.png)

> **PH-balanced Cleanser** Starting the routine was very easy. I went looking for the products and read one by one what they offered me. The good thing about KIMBEAUTY products is that the instructions are in Spanish, they are not confusing, and it suggests what else you need to add to the routine. The cleanser is amazing. I give it 5 stars 🌟. *🌸 It smells very good, 🌸 My skin feels TRULY CLEAN, 🌸 It does not irritate or harm my skin, 🌸 A small drop is enough to clean the whole face and neck, 🌸 The foam is very easy to rinse off.* It contains hyaluronic acid and amino acids that help restore the skin.

> **Limpiador con PH balanceado** Iniciar la rutina fue algo muy fácil. Fui buscando los productos y leyendo uno a uno qué me ofrecían. Lo bueno de los productos KIMBEAUTY es que las indicaciones están en español, no son confusas y te va proponiendo qué más necesitas agregar a la rutina. El limpiador es lo máximo. Le doy 5 estrellas 🌟. *🌸 Huele muy bien, 🌸 Mi piel queda VERDADERAMENTE LIMPIA, 🌸 No me sonroja o maltrata la piel, 🌸 Una pequeña gota es suficiente para limpiar toda la cara y el cuello, 🌸 La espuma es muy fácil de limpiar.* Contiene ácido hialurónico y aminoácidos que ayudan a restaurar la piel. ------- -------

> **Sérum facial** Este se me hizo un poco más complicado elegir porque existen muchas opciones y todas tienen beneficios para nuestra piel. Yo decidí este sérum con niacinamida y ácido salicílico porque me gustaron sus beneficios de: *🌸 Piel más clara: así minimizo las manchas que tengo en mi rostro, 🌸 Poros minimizados: en mi rostro se ven los poros abiertos de años de descuido; con este componente, espero disminuir y dejar mi piel más sana. 🌸 Textura refinada: logrando el cometido del punto anterior, mi piel debe verse más tersa y nutrida ¡LO MÁXIMO!* Cuando lo aplico, la piel la siento supersuave, que quiero que me dure muchas horas el efecto 😊.

> **Sérum facial** Este se me hizo un poco más complicado elegir porque existen muchas opciones y todas tienen beneficios para nuestra piel. Yo decidí este sérum con niacinamida y ácido salicílico porque me gustaron sus beneficios de: *🌸 Piel más clara: así minimizo las manchas que tengo en mi rostro, 🌸 Poros minimizados: en mi rostro se ven los poros abiertos de años de descuido; con este componente, espero disminuir y dejar mi piel más sana. 🌸 Textura refinada: logrando el cometido del punto anterior, mi piel debe verse más tersa y nutrida ¡LO MÁXIMO!* Cuando lo aplico, la piel la siento supersuave, que quiero que me dure muchas horas el efecto 😊. -----

> **Facial capsule** I bought these capsules, since they are used twice a week and they help reinforce the work of the aforementioned facial serum. The benefits offered by the capsules are similar to the previous products, but they add the anti-aging commitment. I am already a lady heading into old age and I have to start taking care of my skin so it doesn't show 😆.

> **Cápsula facial** Compré estas cápsulas, ya que se usan dos veces a la semana y vienen a reforzar el trabajo del sérum facial mencionado. Los beneficios ofrecidos por las cápsulas son parecidos a los productos anteriores, pero agrega el compromiso de ANTIEDAD. Ya soy una señora rumbo a la tercera edad y debo ir cuidando mi piel para que no se note 😆. -------

> **Face Masks** The same thing happened to me as with the serum because there were many presentations and benefits. Focusing on results based on pore cleansing, anti-aging, and clearer skin, I chose these made with niacinamide, cherry blossom extract, and vitamin C. I am a bit wary of the last ingredient because usually when I take it, I get pimples on my face; I hope it doesn't happen to me when applying it. Did I like it? I loved it! My skin feels super soft and clean, as well as fresh. I use it once a week, as the packaging says.

> **Mascarillas** Me ocurrió lo mismo que con el sérum porque existían de muchas presentaciones y beneficios. Enfocada en resultados basados en limpieza de poros, antiedad y piel más clara, escogí estas hechas con niacinamida, extracto de flor de cerezo y vitamina C. Con este último ingrediente tengo un poco de recelo porque normalmente cuando lo tomo, me salen granos en la cara; espero no me ocurra al aplicarlo. ¿Me gustó? ¡Me encantó! La piel me queda supersuave y limpia, además de fresca. La uso una vez a la semana, como dice el empaque. ------

> **Anti-wrinkle roller for the eye contour** I used to use a cream, but now I like this version because it is a roll-on that I only apply to the eye contour. Even though I don't have dark circles, I am already noticing some small wrinkles around my eyes 😟. The years don't pass in vain, but I have seen that there are eyelid surgeries because of this same reality of aging. I don't know if I will be on that list, I just know that as long as I can minimize these risks, I will. It cost me less than $1 and I am just trying it out to see how it goes 🤞.

> **Rodillo antiarrugas para el contorno de ojos** Yo usaba una crema, pero ahora me gusta esta presentación porque es un roll-on que solo me aplico en el contorno de ojos. A pesar de que no tengo ojeras, ya me estoy notando unas pequeñas arrugas en el contorno de mis ojos 😟. Los años no pasan en vano, pero he visto que existen cirugías de párpados por esta misma realidad del paso de los años. No sé si estaré en esa lista, solo sé que mientras pueda minimizar estos riesgos, lo haré. Me costó menos de $1 y apenas lo estoy probando a ver cómo me va 🤞. -------

> **Sunscreen** My initial idea was to buy sunscreen, because there is definitely a before and after when using this protection against the harsh rays of the sun in the city I live in. Certainly, here in any store they are very expensive; that's why I wanted one that would protect me and be affordable. The presentations are very varied, and for that reason, I went reading them one by one and discarding, not because they were bad or I didn't care, but I went from the most basic to those that offered greater protection. This presentation that I selected has SPF 30, protects against UVA and UVB rays and cost less than $5. Among the benefits it offers are fighting signs of aging, hydration, antioxidant effects, and improving skin elasticity and firmness. The only negative thing I find is that the size is very small, so I have to manage my triumph well, because if not, I will have to buy it every week or in bulk 🙃.

> **Protector solar** Mi idea inicial era comprar un protector solar, porque definitivamente existe un antes y un después de usar esta protección ante los inclementes rayos del sol en la ciudad que vivo. Ciertamente, acá en cualquier tienda están muy costosos; por eso, quería uno que me protegiera y fuera económico. Las presentaciones son muy variadas y, por ello, fui leyendo una a una y descartando, no porque fueran malos o no me importaran, sino que fui de los más básicos a los que ofrecían mayor protección. Esta presentación que seleccioné tiene SFP 30, protege contra los rayo UVA y UVB y costó menos de $5. Entre los beneficios que ofrece son combatir los signos de la edad, hidratación, efectos antioxidantes y mejora la elasticidad y firmeza de la piel. Lo único negativo que le encuentro es que es muy pequeña la presentación, así que me toca administrar bien mi triunfo, porque si no, me tocará comprar cada semana o por cantidades 🙃. -----

>Siento mi piel más linda y sana. La estoy cuidando mucho mejor.
\n\n

>Me gustaría que hubiese una línea completa, por ejemplo: limpiador, sérum, hidratante... de agua de rosas o de ácido hialurónico y así tener los beneficios enfocados en uno solo. Porque con tantas opciones, siento un cóctel y que las cremas no terminan de hacer su trabajo completo.
\n\n

>Me gustaría que fueran unas presentaciones más grandes, porque esos sobres de 100 g se acaban en una semana y debo estar reponiendo constantemente los productos.
\n\n

>En otra visita a la tienda, voy a expandir mi gusto por la marca KIMBEAUTY y compraré productos para el cuerpo y el cabello.
Gracias por leerme.
_Las fotografías son de mi propiedad. La portada, el banner y el separador los hice en Canva. El traductor que usé fue Google Traductor._
# Hasta la próxima oportunidad 🌸 >

>Final observations. I feel my skin is prettier and healthier. I am taking much better care of it. I would like there to be a complete line, for example: cleanser, serum, moisturizer... with rose water or hyaluronic acid, so that the benefits are focused on just one. Because with so many options, it feels like a cocktail and the creams don’t end up doing their job completely. I would like the products to come in larger sizes, because those 100 g sachets run out in a week, and I constantly have to replenish the products. On another visit to the store, I will expand my appreciation for the KIMBEAUTY brand and I will buy products for the body and hair.

title.title: WOO… That Was Different! Saturn vs Goldberg Revisited
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

There’s something special about moments in wrestling history where expectations get quietly rewritten. Not loudly. Not with fireworks. But in a way where, if you’re really paying attention, you realize something has shifted. That’s exactly the kind of feeling I got when I saw the latest *Shootin’ With Saturn* episode being teased in WOO. As a fan, these are the moments I genuinely look forward to, because they’re not just about nostalgia. They’re about perspective. They’re about hearing the real story behind something we thought we already understood.

>*Watch WOO's very own Perry Saturn and his latest \
video over at [THIS LINK](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vStGgwstymQ). The theme for this latest video production is \

*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23tSN1TAX81psinYhqDjjTN1ttM7zkVmqCtB9FWKEseiQosMzXTG55yNiDjS7hZcrXxHz.png)

---

This episode hits differently because it focuses on a match that, honestly, most fans would probably overlook at first glance. Goldberg was on a streak. He was steamrolling everyone. Matches were short, explosive, and predictable in structure. Then comes Perry Saturn, and suddenly the narrative changes. Not completely, but just enough to make you lean forward and pay attention.

What makes this even better is how WOO frames it. It’s not just “watch this old match again.” It’s “watch this with someone who lived it, felt it, and is now breaking it down without filters.” That’s where the real magic is.

### Some quick thoughts of mine!

* **This was Goldberg’s first real “test” in terms of match length and pacing.**
  
Saturn makes it very clear that up until this point, Goldberg wasn’t used to going long in matches. Most of his bouts were quick finishes, which built his aura but didn’t necessarily test his endurance or adaptability. Hearing that this match was designed to stretch him to around 12 minutes really changes how I look at it. It wasn’t just another match. It was preparation for something bigger down the line.

* **Saturn was trusted to carry that responsibility.**
  
One thing that stood out to me immediately was how Saturn described being approached for this role. He didn’t hesitate when asked if he could carry Goldberg to that duration. That says a lot about both his confidence and the trust the company had in him. As a fan, it made me appreciate Saturn even more because this wasn’t just a performance. It was a responsibility.

* **The “don’t sell too much” instruction added real tension.**
  
The moment where JJ Dillon tells Goldberg not to sell too much is honestly wild when you think about it. Saturn himself calls it a horrible thing to say before the match, and I completely get why. It basically makes the match harder to construct on the fly. As a viewer now, knowing this adds a whole new layer to every exchange in the match.

* **The match wasn’t choreographed, which makes everything more impressive.**
  
Saturn mentions that they called the match in the ring, which is something that always fascinates me. It means what we’re watching is not just physical execution, but real-time decision making. That adds a level of respect for both guys, especially considering Goldberg was still relatively green.

* **The goal wasn’t to win. It was to make people believe.**
  
This might be my favourite takeaway. Saturn talks about trying to make the audience believe, even for a second, that Goldberg might lose. That’s such a pure wrestling philosophy. It’s not about the outcome. It’s about the doubt. That brief moment of “what if.”

---

As a WOO fan, this kind of content is exactly why I stay engaged even when things are quiet on the surface. Because behind the scenes, there’s always something meaningful being built. This episode reminded me that wrestling isn’t just about big moments. It’s about the subtle ones that shape everything that comes after.

And honestly, it makes me want to go back and rewatch matches I’ve probably ignored in the past. Because now I’m wondering how many of those had stories like this behind them.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: When New Life Begins Again
title.body:
This morning’s photos reminded me that recovery does not always happen all at once. Even though the rain has finally started to return, there are still many signs left behind by the dry days. In the garden, I noticed one plant that is only beginning to recover. Some parts of it are still dry and worn out, but at the same time, there are already clear signs of life returning. A fresh bud is slowly growing, and I know that in time it will continue to develop into a stronger stem. ![1000131070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAU3MkPSAdbjE6fXzfgXx3LV4tr8TyPfrbH1iWJ7wKyMGYYaWmH2P79XxkETreKaP7.jpg) That simple sight felt very meaningful to me. Sometimes we expect life to change overnight. We want the hard season to end quickly and for everything to become beautiful again in an instant. But nature does not always work that way, and maybe our lives do not either. Even when healing has already begun, there can still be traces of the struggle we went through. There may still be dry parts, weak moments, and signs of exhaustion. But that does not mean growth has stopped. What matters is that new life is already forming. I think that is what these photos are showing me today. Growth can begin quietly. Better days can start small. A tiny bud can be the beginning of something much stronger and more beautiful than what was there before. Life really is like that sometimes. We go through difficult seasons, and those seasons can leave marks on us. But they can also prepare us for a better transition, one that makes us stronger, wiser, and more appreciative of the good days when they finally arrive. For today, I am thankful to witness that gentle reminder in the garden. Recovery is happening, even if it is still incomplete. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000131068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo44QG6xi3249Y6xff5Pq72DQgXdj5HqYH2ue6TsgbHMyUXJPyddV7yPXkQQyxhYwQj.jpg) ![1000131070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAU3MkPSAdbjE6fXzfgXx3LV4tr8TyPfrbH1iWJ7wKyMGYYaWmH2P79XxkETreKaP7.jpg) ![1000131071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D87Dfn3TwveBdP2F5NYeLHZtYnEhwGJywVpDeMfEnqBxTVhn1JVkfNDnmHzooHrf.jpg) ![1000131073.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCbtnwx25L9o6XkMXRKxPecd64pSCo7T7GmjHYzF7RGAnhdoJQMr7HJyicQrAAcSZx.jpg) ![1000131069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6C8Lrq7AVGGkjDX2QApUnAoZv3P3UJpGyq89KJ9wxqP6gQCXkXqdrhyzYJcSfaimG.jpg) ![1000131072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoJz3e6GzLPfNFscFW1aw5TaTCx9eMB7Kqi3JjUMEiQgwq9V11kfZXwMGvJbbjTQxGV.jpg) ***

title.title: La primera vez que conocí el mar 🌞 The first time I saw the ocean
title.body:
>
#
*** ***
Hoy me emociona mucho venir a contar esta historia que llevo guardada en mi mente y mi corazón desde la infancia. No recuerdo bien en que año fue, pero me imagino que tenia unos 11 años de edad. En esas vacaciones fui realmente feliz y las recuerdo porque compartí con un montón de familiares que recién estaba conociendo y me trataron muy bien. Today, I’m really excited to share this story that I’ve kept in my mind and heart since childhood. I don’t remember exactly what year it was, but I imagine I was about 11 years old. I was truly happy during those vacations, and I remember them because I spent time with a lot of relatives I was just getting to know, and they treated me very well.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/244xsh3qoKHvGnFunZrviy7XcCTEjhvJN1mdsd9NnFAewpffgpcqjwkbtuqwBnifV8Vr1.png)
Todo empezó cuando mi mama invento viaje para Caracas, la capital del país; ahí vivían mis hermanos mayores quienes trabajaban para ayudar en casa a mi mama y mi papa con los gastos de los hermanos menores. Ahí también vivía una tía muy querida, ella era la mas consentidora de todas las tías y junto su esposo ayudaban a todos los sobrinos que venían de provincia en busca de mejores oportunidades. It all started when my mom planned a trip to Caracas, the country’s capital; my older siblings lived there and worked to help my mom and dad cover the expenses for their younger siblings. A very dear aunt also lived there; she was the most indulgent of all my aunts, and together with her husband, they helped all the nieces and nephews who came from the provinces in search of better opportunities.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/245canP9k8DnZfjVgDGM2PHFyXNNmWXgzSjDw4gnNcfobqqj8krV4Ztj5NYefbjno1LzT.png)
Ellos tenían una casa hermosa, era blanca con rejas verdes, muy grande donde ese día que llegamos hubo fiesta, alegría, cantos, comida, risas que alimentaban el alma. They had a beautiful house—white with green railings, very large—and on the day we arrived, there was a party, joy, singing, food, and laughter that warmed the soul.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23u5zfchtkRus5gS2wwW6T6FYdNCkvHeYPpfaMLm877zedK6HmhJ4hjBhVZ1b47xWiwdE.png)
Eran mis primeras vacaciones en un lugar completamente distinto al campo donde yo vivia. Caracas, era una selva de concreto, carros y motos por doquier, grandes edificios, trenes del metro y mucho mas. Nunca se me olvidará que fue l primera vez que me monté en unas escaleras eléctricas, pero no me caí. It was my first vacation in a place completely different from the countryside where I lived. Caracas was a concrete jungle, with cars and motorcycles everywhere, tall buildings, subway trains, and so much more. I’ll never forget that it was the first time I rode an escalator, but I didn’t fall.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/EqFtUzvM1eUktG3qgQDjvZ3z76RAwXucxrSp9p9QbfLXEHbPufmnZRyDdjxxdX9Wt9a.png)
Lo que mas recuerdo de esas vacaciones fue un paseo a la playa que organizó mi tía con toda la familia. Ella tenia la suerte de poseer una casa linda frente a los canales de Río Chico, una población costera del estado Miranda. Les digo que para un niño, ver aquella inmensidad del mar es lo mas sorprendente que puede haber; nunca lo podre olvidar, fue amor a primera vista y de inmediato quise nadar, pero como habíamos llegado casi de noche me tuve que aguantar las ganas hasta el siguiente día. What I remember most about that vacation was a trip to the beach that my aunt organized for the whole family. She was lucky enough to own a beautiful house overlooking the canals of Río Chico, a coastal town in Miranda state. I’ll tell you, for a kid, seeing that vastness of the sea is the most amazing thing there is; I’ll never forget it—it was love at first sight, and I immediately wanted to swim, but since we’d arrived almost at night, I had to hold off until the next day.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/2458QS45NiifYkLgtyNf4JjtBMBXiCA6EMvKPqCLz8eB4gLRJzfYN9DRkQiyrB92sGGv3.png)
Ese fin de semana, conocí el mar, sentí las olas, la arena, jugué muchísimo con ella, vi pescar a mis tíos, sacamos guacuco de la orilla de la playa y con eso hicieron mucha arroz par darle de comer a ese batallón. That weekend, I saw the ocean for the first time, felt the waves and the sand, played with her endlessly, watched my uncles fish, and we gathered guacuco from the beach—which they used to make a huge pot of rice to feed that whole group.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/2432Kh1AmtN5F4KBo7QCWPRfkfxEg7wPu3FkaagbZzsU3fEytKWwWNn9kXNYwCUHRq1rC.png)
El susto de mi vida Por ser temporada de mango todos queríamos comer, pero los mas cercanos estaban dentro del lago, así que tomamos un bote que estaba amarrado en la orilla y remamos hasta donde estaba la mata de mango. Tomamos los que estaban mas cerca pero los mas buenos estaban mas arriba, así que como muchachos al fin decidimos tomarlos como sea. Todos nos acomodamos dentro del bote para que mi primo Carlos saltara y tomara el racimo mas grande, pero al caer nuevamente el bote se volteo y todos caímos al lago. The Scare of My Life Since it was mango season, we all wanted to eat some, but the closest ones were in the lake, so we took a boat that was tied up at the shore and rowed out to where the mango tree was. We picked the ones that were closest, but the best ones were higher up, so as kids, we finally decided to get them no matter what. We all piled into the boat so my cousin Carlos could jump in and grab the biggest cluster, but when he landed, the boat tipped over and we all fell into the lake.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/243qHJCs9qhDuno5Jf4VtC9szUN3LfcXeFfUU6GbSRm8waiaKd6PanR2xsKfUFFz8m3oF.png)
Menos mal que todos sabíamos nadar y como pudimos volteamos el bote, nos montamos y nos fuimos a casa, mojados, asustados, sin mangos pero riéndonos a montones por todo lo que habíamos pasado. Siempre que hay una reunión familiar todos recordamos aquellas vacaciones que año a año disfrutábamos Caracas, junto a la tía mas querida de todos, Mi Tía Geno.
![ver.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23tv2DSq9Zdr1ML56fgm21UKXU9ww3FfZM1uD6XUypE3bqPjNFUftKMshYHjJsxDs42dD.png)
Luckily, we all knew how to swim, and as best we could, we righted the boat, climbed back in, and headed home—soaked, scared, without any mangoes, but laughing our heads off about everything we’d been through. Whenever there’s a family gathering, we all remember those vacations we used to enjoy every year in Caracas, together with the aunt we all loved the most, my Aunt Geno. --- #
*** ***

title.body:
Planning for fertility treatment is both an emotional and financial journey. For couples exploring assisted reproduction, understanding the  is a critical first step toward building their family. With world-class clinics, cutting-edge technology, and internationally renowned specialists, the UAE has become a premier destination for fertility care. However, treatment costs can vary significantly depending on multiple factors. This comprehensive guide breaks down everything you need to know about IVF pricing across the Emirates.

## Factors That Influence IVF Cost in UAE

The total [ivf cost in uae](https://www.artfertilityclinics.com/uae/en/our-clinics/doctors-experts/prof-dr-human-fatemi) is not a fixed number. Several variables determine the final price tag for your treatment journey:

*   **Clinic Location and Reputation** – Clinics in Dubai and Abu Dhabi typically command higher fees due to premium facilities and internationally trained specialists. The average ivf cost in uae generally ranges between AED 20,000 and AED 45,000 per cycle, depending on the clinic and the specific procedures required.

*   **Type of IVF Treatment** – Standard IVF differs from ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection), which involves injecting a single sperm directly into an egg. IVF with ICSI typically adds AED 2,000 to AED 4,000 to the base cost.

*   **Medication Costs** – Ovarian stimulation medications are a significant expense, often ranging from AED 5,000 to AED 10,000 per cycle, depending on the protocol and dosage required.

*   **Add-On Procedures** – Advanced techniques such as Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT), embryo freezing, and blastocyst culture increase the overall investment.

## Typical IVF Cost Breakdown in UAE

Based on current market data, here is a realistic breakdown of the ivf cost in uae:

*   **Basic IVF Cycle (without medications):** AED 18,000 – AED 28,000 per cycle

*   **IVF with ICSI:** AED 22,000 – AED 35,000 per cycle

*   **IVF with PGT (Genetic Testing):** AED 35,000 – AED 65,000 per cycle

*   **IVF with Donor Eggs:** AED 44,000 – AED 73,000 per cycle

## Additional Costs to Consider

When budgeting for the ivf cost in uae, remember to account for these potential add-ons:

*   **Initial consultation and fertility assessment:** AED 500 – AED 1,500

*   **ICSI (if not included in package):** AED 2,000 – AED 4,000

*   **Embryo freezing and annual storage:** AED 1,500 – AED 3,000 per year

*   **Blastocyst culture or time-lapse monitoring:** AED 2,000 – AED 5,000

*   **PGT-A (Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidy):** AED 10,000 – AED 22,000

## Why Choose ART Fertility Clinics?

Under the distinguished leadership of **Prof. Dr. Human Fatemi**, Group Medical Director, ART Fertility Clinics has established itself as a trusted leader in reproductive medicine across the UAE and India. Prof. Fatemi brings over two decades of expertise, holding a PhD in Reproductive Medicine and Surgery, and has earned acclaim from the European Society of Human Reproduction (ESHRE) as well as the European Board and College of Obstetrics and Gynaecology. With over 200+ peer-reviewed publications and more than 300 international conference presentations, his profound contributions to reproductive medicine are globally recognised.

ART Fertility Clinics proudly achieves a remarkable 71% pregnancy rate and a 55% live birth rate, far exceeding regional and international standards. The clinic combines state-of-the-art technology, including an in-house genetics lab (ART Genomics), with transparent, patient-centred pricing.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**1. What is the average IVF cost in UAE for one cycle?**
The average ivf cost in uae typically ranges from AED 20,000 to AED 45,000 per cycle, depending on the clinic, location, and specific procedures required. Medications and add-ons are usually additional.

**2. Does health insurance cover IVF treatment in the UAE?**
Most standard health insurance plans in the UAE do not cover IVF treatment as it is considered an elective procedure. However, some premium plans may include infertility riders. Always check with your insurance provider.

**3. What is included in a typical IVF package?**
A standard IVF package usually includes initial consultations, ultrasound monitoring, blood tests, egg retrieval, embryo transfer, and basic laboratory services. Medications, ICSI, genetic testing, and embryo freezing are often additional.

**4. How does the IVF cost in Dubai compare to Abu Dhabi?**
IVF costs in Dubai typically range from AED 23,000 to AED 40,000, while Abu Dhabi ranges from AED 25,000 to AED 40,000 per cycle. Prices are comparable, though Dubai may offer more premium options.
