body.title: Kitkat
body.body: today I decided to take a break from \

things

had some irl stuff to do so part of my day went towards that, walking around and standing around gets kind of exhausting after a while

I'm also taking a bit of time to reflect on the \

I've worked on these past couple weeks since I got into Claude Code, trying to work back to prioritizing what's important and useful right now to start shipping that out and polishing it. 

I think there's value to be had in the meme widget I've been working on, I may even evolve it a bit more and launch it with some kind of meme token connected to it, with the launch of @maginetwork now it might be a good idea to try connect some services on hive with the broader ecosystem. Will see, it might be hard to make a dent or get some attention in the sea of memecoin garbage these days, I'm not even sure of Sol is the one I should use as it seems to just be pump and dumps lately, will have to give it some more thought, might do two chains as well. Idea is solid, cause one thing we know is there'll always be people on hive and memes will always have a usecase. 

I'm also going to start working on the scrobble idea some more here soon, now with opus 4.7 I had it look into the code again and it found a bug that was causing the app to double post the custom json's, hopefully it's patched now and not just another \

Cause there was a lot of that, but could also be cause I was using Sonnet at times without realizing. 

Trial by error.

There's probably going to be a lot of that, but I wanna make sure the error part isn't something that causes people using my products/services to get in any dangerous grounds, and claude is supposed to be good at finding security breaches so hopefully it judges its own code just as good as other people's. 

A lot of things in the works, but some waiting time still required,

unfortunately. 

That's kind of been the norm working on anything lately, or at least before Claude. There's still things I don't wanna pass alone but I'm edging closer to experimenting with more things and learning along the way. Dunno, it's kind of given me more things to do at a time where I felt like I already had a lot of things to do - hive wise at least. Now I'm getting to a point where I feel like time voting/curating on hive is time lost I could be spending giving prompts to Claude to work on something bigger/more meaningful. For Hive of course, it'll probably take more than a -whatever% we're at now from whatever height you wanna look at (don't say $3 cause that was barely a blip in the history of this coin's price). 

Things feel kind of dull however when prices are this low. Morale is low and it kind of festers and infects you, especially when some keep singing the same tune over and over, makes you just wanna look away before you start judging them too much. 

We all have our intentions, our reasons and our feelings to act the way we do. Some say the price being what it is could be a good thing but looking at how few people here or new ones coming in from the outside powering up is kind of a disappointment. When the tide falls... something something. Dunno, I personally wish I could be buying more Hive at these prices, I also kind of wish I hadn't spent as much as I did on my projects if only to buy more now and not have most of my assets locked up. The looming pressure of my reserves running low is also a thought I don't wanna have too often, especially with hive being this undervalued, it's quite a sucky situation. Most importantly it feels like it's stifling a lot of things from being properly built here.

It does make you think back and wonder if you should've done things differently. Acted earlier, acted more, asked more about the funds being spent, questioned things more. Dunno, there's little point to talking about it now, much less kicking the same dead horse over and over, but it does make me wanna act next time things turn around, not cause I think I could do things better but cause trying something else might be better, or at least not allowing the same things to happen again. Dunno. These messages might be super cryptic to outsiders to read but maybe my usual readers may catch my drift. 

Where's the marketing guys!?

It's pretty good marketing that whenever I think of the word \

, I think of Kitkat. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/243MQHTn9g5kGhAMmfqGgzj89r5aVdmzPXEGZHRjSfmo3y9pazK2Zz2hVPEpHeMohYJ24.png)


I'm pretty sure most projects are in \

currently, not the way someone suggested some projects should go, but more like survival mode, they're still running, barebones probably, but waiting for the tide to rise again so they can start spending for some light in the darkness. It'd be kind of sad if we never got to shoot our shot. We know things work here and work well, we've seen a glimmer of it before and we've made sure that when it returns we'll be ready and can carry the load. The question is will it return and if so when and how. 

Okay, didn't mean to get that weird in this post, maybe I've been reflecting a bit too much and should get back to building. 


[img src](https://pixabay.com/photos/chocolate-candies-confection-6777067/)

The tastes and expectations of the young generation are different from their predecessors, so let them do what they want, it will give them luck, and maybe also money.
https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2120950-daniel-radcliffe-harry-potter-career-stranger-things-advice

body.title: DISCOVERY OF THE LONG-HORNED BEETLE // Photography behind the macro lens camera
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8bnHp6TgeR1T22tB4638i66FMHriSb44jRyTKaREodj/1776771137055.jpg) In this post, I will share my experience and success in capturing the beauty of a long-horned beetle that I found in a palm oil plantation. I can say that the population of this insect is already quite rare in my area and finding it is not an easy thing now, but sometimes luck comes by itself without any warning. This beetle is usually found perched on trees or on leaves,if you look at its appearance, this insect looks a little scary, but it is not a natural predator but is better known as a wood pest. This beetle is also a threat to farmers or wood craftsmen because it can make holes in wood and make holes in it, this is a negative characteristic behind its physical beauty. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwdFYuHC2hhD1ecjnXqRDwCPUtRnggQUouZs91x71x2K/1776771137105.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZc4jmVdnyJgFPErZTANyAf4ciV593Z46UgTA3CsbqDd/1776771137154.jpg) Now let's look at the uniqueness of this insect, starting from its color, this insect has a very striking color combination, there is red or orange on the upper body parts such as the wings and also has black on the legs and antennae. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmzwFugv86yQ5TcDJTkzmqwAtCwt2USxZRRNHAdz6taS/1776771137198.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc35u7H8pLWcyiC8qkXPvme5YyJSypvAuqesMU4qp6N2C/1776771137243.jpg) This color is what makes this insect look quite unique and interesting, even this color can be seen when this insect is flying. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBrDUyHEj2R7ajFCA3f3iTK18dYh6NwqaqiwoQLz6oMe/1776772240174.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZo1jbtDrxWTr1KwKfGXqBVsqmBfD6Ya5uJcQn2MacQ2B/1776772240218.jpg) In addition to its beautiful color, this insect also has a fairly hard body texture, especially on the shell of its wings. This insect is not poisonous, but it is a wood-chewing insect so it certainly has quite strong jaws, so even though this insect is not poisonous, it is not recommended to play with it because it has a very painful bite. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWBYXYuCYKD54WkTbAScgejPPToe4J4frUm9KJEiqrxy/1776772459182.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQhG5Krcqv14rZXiumLnMUDjVa7TreNQYtSe5s7nnKf3/1776772459224.jpg) To get satisfactory results, I tried photographing this insect from various angles, from the side, above, and below. I don't know its true behavior, but at the time, it was calm so I had no trouble photographing it. And now let's discuss its shape, this insect has an elongated body shape with small but quite hard legs, and it also has two antennae that look segmented which is a characteristic of longhorn beetles. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcc1PixYBTqLwi9vjemqKH7e6dYYAGx7UW1HJCkR6Gtz3/1776772751774.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWrgsRbs9CyRGjJsE5dnSN3XsjLpP2hcysNjkmvmbBHQq/1776772751821.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabbyQAZ4h52y6g7fg26VAGHwnF9gdVeraPnonQ466y9C/1776772751865.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNeR6Div5J8ULmQkbWcCcAVbeE2PxKsestZg2vLqUPB5C/1776772751913.jpg) What makes me very interested in this insect is its very beautiful color, and its beauty will be even more visible if we see it directly under the hot sun, but it is very unfortunate that the population of this insect is already quite rare in my area. However, we also need to remember that this is an insect that is considered a pest because it can drill into trees, both living and dead, and according to the information I know, this insect also makes its nest in the tree. So, it can be concluded that even though this insect looks very beautiful, there are some people who may not like it. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

body.title: How Are Data Model Objects Used in Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant Exam Scenarios?\n
body.body:
In the Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant, Data-Con-101 Exam. Data Model Objects (DMOs) are used to organize and standardize data from multiple sources into a unified structure. They help transform raw data from CRM systems, web applications, and external platforms into consistent data models that can be used across Salesforce Data Cloud.  
Within the Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant Certification Exam Scenarios, candidates are evaluated on how effectively they map different data sources into appropriate DMOs. This ensures accurate customer profiles, clean data integration, and reliable data relationships. These concepts are commonly tested through [**Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant Practice Questions**](https://www.pass4future.com/salesforce/exam/data-con-101) for the Data-Con-101 Exam, where scenario-based decisions are required.  
  
DMOs also play an important role in identity resolution and segmentation. They help create unified customer views by resolving duplicate or conflicting records and supporting data-driven segmentation logic. Many candidates rely on Data-Con-101 Exam Practice Questions to strengthen their understanding of real exam scenarios. These objects are directly linked to data modelling , activation, and analytics processes. A Structured learning approach helps candidates prepare more effectively for the exam. It also builds a clear understanding of how DMOs are applied in real-world scenarios.

Hello again,

Im waiting for more than 20 packages with pokemon cards to arrive.
Because of some strikes in post offices all over Europe there are many delays
I've recieved a couple of packs mainly with penny cards
One of the better orders had to have Dragonite promo, but it wasn't there.Just a couple of badly graded cards and this one...

All those were graded ''near mint'' in the website but 1/3 of them were at most ''played''

BUT the last pack that i've received yesterday was THE.BEST.GRADED.SINGLE.CARDS.BULK i've ever bought.

![IMG_20260420_131325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/changeurmindset/23uQxeR6nT4oUiH3eUsU1VsCHUq5yHSDeHoPygmwQKx3XK5gDezb9FbdJpEa4FMHMHh15.jpg)

Those were the main reason i've made this purchase

And ''the rest of the gang''

![IMG_20260420_131631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/changeurmindset/Eo6MMaZ476ojcuWdHmZkW9kcmLimwRLqswhYZE4swYUaiW7n9HTDNHUHjePizfeX69q.jpg)

Some of the cards were in greater condition than i've expected so much better that at first glance i've tought that ''F*** they sent me fake cards''.But the reallity was different... The seller was super nice and he explained to me that he prefers to get some moral ground and downgraded some of the cards he have in order not to have angry clients who complain. 
Sadly his printer did him a trick and the last page of my order did not get printed and ofc did not come with the other cards that i've purchased.
He(Pokemonportalen in Cardmarket if you are from Europe and you are into collecting cards ,visit this user) was super nice and said he will send me today or tomorrow all the rest with a present and free of charge . He recognize the mistake was totally on his side.

p.s. In the future, if there is another nice vendor i will share the nickname with you. The bad ones sadly are more than the good ones but i won't share theirs.

Best of wishes

title.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Sovereign surrender.   ||   Rendición soberana.
title.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
Sovereign surrender
***

> For many years, my life was an exercise in meticulous and constant organisation; naturally, I work in a field as abstract as mathematics. Every minute had a defined purpose, every emotion a sealed compartment. I believed that control was a rope keeping me safe from the abyss, but in reality it was the slipknot that prevented me from breathing. My ‘licence to do something’, my true licence to act, did not come with an academic degree or an official permit, but with the absolute collapse of my own order.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23zkfi2hvBo5YL9QE3GYDEwiTE1UGj7yRop17HuQhQsCqysAPtuCDJ3XyTfhBrkVFjeuy.png)
It was a grey Tuesday afternoon. I found myself facing the untamed sea, with a diary full of commitments that, suddenly, seemed to carry no real weight. I realised that the greatest freedom is not to command external events, but to grant oneself the licence to finally let go of the reins. Absolute control is an exhausting fiction; a heavy iron mask we put on so as not to admit our human frailty. That day, I gave myself permission not to know. I let the wind scatter my papers and chance dictate my next move. I discovered that by letting go of obsessive vigilance, I didn’t fall into the void, but learnt to float. Possessing that ‘licence to do something’—in this case, the licence to be vulnerable—transformed my relationship with the world. I no longer seek to master the tide, but to navigate it calmly. True power does not lie in holding everything with an iron fist, but in the open hand that allows life to unfold. Now, my control is selective; I guard my peace, not my destiny. In that nuance, at last, I found my centre. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:

Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

>\n\nDurante muchos años, mi vida fue un ejercicio de arquitectura milimétrica y constante, claro, soy profesional de una carrera abstracta como lo son las matemáticas. Cada minuto tenía un propósito definido, cada emoción un compartimento estanco. Creía que el control era una soga que me mantenía a salvo del abismo, pero en realidad era el nudo ciego que me impedía respirar. Mi \

, mi verdadera licencia para actuar, no llegó con un título académico ni un permiso oficial, sino con el colapso absoluto de mi propio orden.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23zkfi2hvBo5YL9QE3GYDEwiTE1UGj7yRop17HuQhQsCqysAPtuCDJ3XyTfhBrkVFjeuy.png)
</center>

Fue una tarde gris de un día martes. Me encontré frente al mar indomable, con la agenda repleta de compromisos que, de pronto, carecían de peso real. Entendí que la mayor libertad no es mandar sobre los eventos externos, sino otorgarse la licencia de soltar finalmente las riendas. El control absoluto es una ficción agotadora; una máscara de hierro pesado que nos ponemos para no admitir nuestra fragilidad humana.

Ese día, me concedí la licencia de no saber. Dejé que el viento desordenara mis papeles y que el azar dictara el siguiente paso. Descubrí que al renunciar a la vigilancia obsesiva, no caí al vacío, sino que aprendí a flotar. Poseer esa \

—en este caso, la licencia para ser vulnerable— transformó mi relación con el mundo. Ya no busco dominar la marea, sino navegarla con calma. El verdadero poder no reside en sujetarlo todo con puño de hierro, sino en la mano abierta que permite que la vida ocurra. Ahora, mi control es selectivo, cuido mi paz, no el destino. En ese matiz, por fin, encontré mi centro vital.
*** ***

title.body:
Intentory, boy, that is very intentional, isn't it? It makes you look at it and think about what you're going to say before you say it. 


So you're talking about leads, and some of the best leads that I've had, and connections, actually, I look at them more like connections, because you're really building the formative stages of relationships that have benefited me well over the last almost three years are the IRL connections you can make. It doesn't have to be at a blockchain-centered event.

It could be any type of networking event. It could be maybe your chamber of commerce in your local area, plus networking events, right? And it's a way for small business owners and people to connect with. So I have 30 follow-ups that I will be processing and scheduling for from this week.

Yeah, so I look forward to that. Amazing conversations were had. Got to share what KF media is about, what we're building, how we're building.

What is our differentiator and what is our value proposition and stuff. Yeah, more to come on that, and I will show KF media in a little bit once we get a little bit more people in the room. But I do see the Kodos has their hand up, so I will flip it to them.

Well, thanks. I just wanted to say, as you mentioned the name of the company, I just wanted to touch on that for a moment, Intentory. So basically, the reason why we chose this name is we are building an inventory of intent signals.

You're seeing if the other person is receptive. So these initial connections and an event like December is do we like each other, right? Can we get along? title.title: The Puppeteers
title.body:
It was two days ago I think, when I saw a post on X, referring to an carticle post by a well known news platform. The guy basically posted a TLTR, pointing out that a couple in the article moved to Italy's countryside, for a cheaper and happier life, then after 6 months gave up on the idea and planning to move back to the US, because Italians don't speak English.

I left a comment on the post and what came after still seems shocking. Likes started pouring in, like never before. In an hour, my comment got 200 likes and 14k views. Others got more, don't worry, some comments got 100k views. You have to be insane to think that was organic, so I checked a few accounts that liked my comment and saw the majority were not new accounts, but with few followers. At the end of the day, my comment got to 22k views and God knows how many likes. 

![mavi-atlas-W1y0aDhOU3E-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tm9TnYyQLwLQvEyicrre1ZSXWEBJZGF8acH8M7wLKGHk6K1VMuRNFL3b9rAQf3ieZKz.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash Then when I thought this was over, came another surprise. I saw someone else, posting that European schools are much more strict and burden kids with too much homework, referring to the same article. Obviously comments started to build up and impressions on both the article and comments blew off the roof again. Then today I came across another post, saying ex-soviet countries .... and referring to the same article. I can't even remember what it said but I'm sure Italy has never been a soviet country. Most likely there are hundreds of such posts, each saying something, referring to the same article and this goes to show the intention behind this action or I can call it campaign as well as it seems that's exactly what it was. ![ray-harrington-CyGnf9y1VoA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tmFzniHHbnQcbdzq711sFyMfFGbvG3m3dkDYZvJywfgP57UHJKYLcMZ7WSRjnioDgFX.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash\n \nThinking of what I have just witnessed, brought back some old memories about a comic group that had a very funny play once. There were 5 people sitting on a bench. The first whispered something to the to the next one, who whispered something to the next one and so on. The joke is, that the first message whispered was *\
* and the message that reached the last one, somehow (we know exactly how) became *\

*. I will never forget this scene and even though it was decades ago, you can recognize this effect so often today. 

Due to trading, I'm a regular on X and see a lot of things, but have never noticed any campaign of this magnitude, with such a clear intention of pushing a message and try to mislead the masses. To me, it seemed like a avalanche, but I think you call it snowball effect, if I'm not mistaken. 

![janos-venczak-NvIwXmoRs6o-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tveNgMsgHmGkx5rS8KCcMCxymxkwsE4Wa4D2zLFhn6XjaNkPv5qL4asJfiEQbroz5Q3.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash The original article was published by an outlet requiring subscription, so I can guarantee you, not even 0.001% read the original article and yet so many reacted the the post, what had very little or nothing to do with the original article. The meaning got distorted completely at the end, if there's an end to it yet. I'd like to think this was an isolated case and it's never going to happen again, but would be naive to think that. ![celeste-t-Kn8F0dRc1Ns-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23u616F3ocincK5j6p5mRMzu7ZTbGfipg2ZobRMb9TLpmh4FQKKrvqGVc4F4u5eKUGB28.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Last week I saw something similar, but nowhere near of this magnitude. Hungary had elections on the 12th of April and the opposition was able to win with an astonishing majority, sending home the prime minister after 16 years of domination. The new prime minister elect gave a speech after the results were in and asked the president of Hungary (and a lot of other officials named by the old ruling party) to resign. You can guess, X got flooded with comments like *this is abuse of power* and similar ones insinuating this is illegal. What they didn't know and didn't care either is, that in Hungary, the president is named by the ruling party and the current one has just lost support, so it's just a matter of time till the mandate of the president expires, but he can also resign and leave early. There's nothing abusive about it, but as the masses have no idea about how the system works, they commented on what they were served. ![janos-venczak-FPFoxuctHZk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tbkNrSHYPVdK5yTBJEroDmd6ZPidi5XDziNpeSf7K6mrfu8SJg5Vw8xk5YS5TWuxbTL.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Manipulation got to an unimaginable level and it's becoming a more and more dangerous tool in the hands of some people. The other problem is, the amount of people that can be manipulated so easily is growing day by day as well. It's easier to take sides without know what's true or not, then to check facts and actually learn something that can help you in the future. It gets even more dangerous, when it comes to kids, as they are more vulnerable in this regard. I see so many people dying to get their content monetized on X, they think it's easy to get rich this way and would do anything to get the necessary metrics. But this? It's madness.

></center>

title.title: Poema: Navegante de la vida
title.body:
![Hive Banners 2026 (51).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48Kc47jYDehuU5s3CeS3jrZFZLmtU6WGpgKhSukZf5PEtKcxyAaR3EkXLs6WW8BfXp.png) **Imagen editada con Canva: Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/vintage-papel-mundo-navegacion-14436272/)** A veces levanto la cara; la luna estaba ahí, sonriente, sin otra compañía más que otra estrella, quizás otro planeta.

En el corazón y en el alma el deseo de tomar las maletas y marcharse a buscarse la vida fuera de la comodidad del hogar se hace presente.

Pero la realidad es que, más allá de lo que muchos interpretan como el temor a la vida, es simplemente la sensación de perderse en un camino que no sabes hacia dónde lleva.

He de suponer que así se sintieron aquellos navegantes cuando miraban las estrellas en medio de los mares: en busca de direcciones, de tierra, de una expectativa por lo que pueda haber ahí, al otro lado del mar.

Y si los navegantes de los mares se sintieron así, ¿cómo nos sentiríamos entonces aquellos que buscamos un camino luego de que la vida, junto con malas decisiones, truncaran todos los planes que teníamos?

Fue entonces que decidí que he de buscar el camino con tranquilidad, con expectativas razonables y con la esperanza de que toda esta mala racha de decisiones pésimas fuera solo el mal sueño de alguien con insomnio.

title.title: My twined purpose : God and Family loh 285
title.body:
![IMG-20250928-WA0029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFnp65koZ6USebT4ucp3cXzZfeLDbwo32d9LvAP7AoXu/IMG-20250928-WA0029.jpg)
As I look back, I realized my purpose as a single lady was founded on pleasing the Lord more with my life, just like the Bible puts it that an unmarried woman is concerned about the Lord’s affairs — how she can please the Lord. Since I became a parent, I now have a twine preoccupied purpose: fulfilling God's purpose for my life and taking care of my family; I feel like God entrusted me with the children's welfare.

How do I know this? Most of my decisions and choices revolve around and reveal me optimizing my children as number one before any other thing. I believe it's natural for a mother to feel this way.

Job description and location: It will have to be flexible enough for me to be not just available but present for my children. As a result of this, I have turned down offers that put me hundreds of miles away from my children, especially now that they are in their formative early years where embedding good character development is important. I even had to step down from a job offer so I could concentrate on taking care of my family. That job was not family friendly and highly demanding — even if you were sick, you must show up for work, even on weekends. There was no room for family bonding, and coupled with the fact I was pregnant then, they had zero consideration or empathy, so I left without thinking twice. Going forward I want a job that can help me balance my career and family life. At the end of the day, we are working for our family’s stability and comfort. 

My priority and preference: I always want to see my kids doing fine in every aspect of their life. If they fall sick, it affects my own peace greatly. This shows that their well-being gives me lasting peace and happiness. Even with meal preparation, I have seen myself prioritize the nutritional needs and concerns of my children before mine. I ensure that their health and proper nutrition is not compromised. My children mean a lot and matter dearly to my life. They are like the wings I have to fly, perch and rest tomorrow. My spouse and I are doing our best to provide and equip them for the future by fulfilling our responsibilities as parents and caregivers, as they are still very young children. To ensure that they are loved, safe and protected always, whether they are home or outside.

title.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @Motherhood, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo para hablarles sobre un día especial que tuve con mi pequeño hijo, su cumpleaños, ya cumplió 6 años, en definitiva, el tiempo pasa muy rápido, como recuerdo que hasta hace poco había comenzado a caminar, sus primeras palabras, saliendo sus dientes, cada uno de sus pasos, ciertamente el tiempo pasa volando y cuando menos crees ya están todos grandes, lo cual trae muchos recuerdos y nostalgias al respecto. --- ![REVIEW (28).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uQrWiSZfw5yKZTczyDxjVtNfCB1GCi7Tj85BkbfAGYqDcsrvYdS8FcKTy8W1YbdCxxy.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Es un día en el que definitivamente la nostalgia te agarra, sobre todo cuando a través de las todos te das cuenta de todos los cambios que ha venido teniendo, y también cada cosa que juntos hemos aprendido, es algo muy bonito de recordar, y para este día bueno ya me había planificado un poco que quería hacer, aunque por mi parte tenía trabajo quería ver que le podría hacer algo, una fiesta como tal no pude por una situación personal que presento, pero claro no quería dejarle pasar su día sin nada, aunque también había pensado en picarle una torta con sus compañeros de salón, pero no tuvieron clase por consejo de docentes jeje, así que bueno busque otro plan para hacerle pasar su día diferente y alegre. --- ![REVIEW (29).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tvit2jFLRybmMvzbSz1w793EyFPR8EyXZDSXBdZCNMBZ8wmojVefr9SaobUSKu3WDjB.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>En primera instancia al despertar su regalo y desayuno, él encantado con todo, le decore un poco la sala con globos y con detalles de su color favorito que es el rojo para que se sintiera a gusto, ya después en la hora de almuerzo lo lleve a comer lo que más le gusta, su pizza, sentía que era algo que no podía faltar, aunque ya también él me había dicho que quería comer ello, le encanta mucho y definitivamente la disfruta, así que con más razón no podía dejar de complacerlo, después paseamos un rato comiendo helado y ello, también fuimos a comprar su torta, no pude mandar a otra persona porque todos estaban ocupados pero mejor fui con mi hijo, ya que él mismo la escogió a su gusto jeje, ya de ahí regresamos a casa, esperando a que en la tarde noche se le pudiera cantar su cumpleaños. --- ![REVIEW (30).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wX3cs8dpMyeNvWPwE2keqmdnKBEsvT726NoCmGqoWfGzmk7daeGWKtfExwxXKdNw4hg.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Aunque recibimos la sorpresa de que su Prima se había desocupado y lo invito a comer y cantar cumpleaños con una dona jeje para hacer algo diferente, como tenía reunión deje que entonces saliera con ellos y pasara un rato diferente, ya cuando regreso estaba muy feliz por la salida y como había pasado su día, luego nos preparamos y le cantamos su cumpleaños, me alegro mucho escucharlo decir que todo estaba bonito y que gracias por lo que había hecho por él en su día, fue algo sencillo sin muchas cosas ni fiesta, pero gracias a Dios si le gusto y valió la pena cada detalle que lo hizo sentir feliz y especial. --- ![REVIEW (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23w2mLSyP9GmC4BoPtjW1YgcK5jgYDcMg5A7J3zPkefZzQGJdE9MH5JTqs6Q2HiFZcBZP.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)

> Hello, dear friends at @Motherhood Greetings and blessings to you all. Today I’m here to tell you about a special day I spent with my little boy—his birthday. He’s already 6 years old. Honestly, time flies by so quickly. I remember how just a short while ago he had just started walking, his first words, his teeth coming in, every single step he took. Time certainly flies, and before you know it, they’re all grown up—which brings back so many memories and a sense of nostalgia. --- ![REVIEW (28).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uQrWiSZfw5yKZTczyDxjVtNfCB1GCi7Tj85BkbfAGYqDcsrvYdS8FcKTy8W1YbdCxxy.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>It’s a day when nostalgia definitely sets in, especially when you look back and realize all the changes that have taken place, and also everything we’ve learned together—it’s such a beautiful thing to remember. For this day, I’d already planned a few things I wanted to do; even though I had work, I wanted to see if I could do something special for him. I couldn’t throw a party as such because of a personal situation that came up, but of course I didn’t want to let his day go by without doing anything. I’d also thought about having him cut a cake with his classmates, but they didn’t have class on the teachers’ advice, haha, so I looked for another plan to make his day special and joyful. --- ![REVIEW (29).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tvit2jFLRybmMvzbSz1w793EyFPR8EyXZDSXBdZCNMBZ8wmojVefr9SaobUSKu3WDjB.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>First, when he woke up, I gave him his gift and breakfast, he was thrilled with everything. I decorated the living room a little with balloons and touches of his favorite color, red, so he’d feel comfortable. Then, at lunchtime, I took him to eat what he likes best—pizza. I felt like it was something I couldn’t miss, even though he’d already told me he wanted to eat it. He loves it so much and definitely enjoys it, so all the more reason I couldn’t pass up the chance to make him happy. Afterward, we went for a walk while eating ice cream and such, and we also went to buy his cake. I couldn’t send someone else because everyone was busy, but I decided to go with my son instead, since he picked it out himself, hehe. From there, we went back home, waiting until late in the evening so we could sing “Happy Birthday” to him. --- ![REVIEW (30).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wX3cs8dpMyeNvWPwE2keqmdnKBEsvT726NoCmGqoWfGzmk7daeGWKtfExwxXKdNw4hg.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>Although we were surprised to find out that his cousin was free, and she invited him over for lunch and to sing “Happy Birthday” with a doughnut—hehe—just to do something different, since I had a meeting, I let him go out with them and have a different kind of time. When he came back, he was really happy about the outing and how his day had gone, we got ready and sang “Happy Birthday” to him. I was so glad to hear him say that everything was lovely and thank me for what I’d done for him on his special day. It was a simple celebration without a lot of fuss or a big party, but thank God he liked it, and every little detail that made him feel happy and special was worth it. --- ![REVIEW (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23w2mLSyP9GmC4BoPtjW1YgcK5jgYDcMg5A7J3zPkefZzQGJdE9MH5JTqs6Q2HiFZcBZP.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

Choosing the [best low maintenance agricultural sprayer](https://www.chandakagro.com/) depends on farm size, crop type, and ease of use. For most farmers, a battery-operated sprayer is considered the best option because it reduces manual effort and requires minimal upkeep. These sprayers come with durable motors, adjustable nozzles, and long-lasting batteries, making them ideal for regular use. Compared to manual or fuel-based sprayers, they have fewer moving parts, which lowers the chances of breakdown and repair costs.

A good low maintenance agricultural sprayer should be lightweight, easy to clean, and made from high-quality materials that resist corrosion. Features like pressure control, uniform spraying, and leak-proof tanks also help improve efficiency while saving water and chemicals. Farmers should also look for models that offer easy availability of spare parts and simple servicing.

Investing in a reliable sprayer not only reduces maintenance time but also increases productivity in the field. It ensures consistent crop protection and better yield without frequent interruptions. Overall, a well-designed low maintenance sprayer is a smart choice for modern farming needs.

***

草原（prairie）是一片广阔而宁静的土地，让人感受到自然的博大与辽阔。柔和的风轻拂过金黄色的草浪，仿佛在轻声细语，诉说着大地的故事。在这里，天空显得格外湛蓝，云朵如棉花糖般漂浮，令人心旷神怡。走在草原上，仿佛可以感受到那份悠远的自由和宁静，忘却了城市的喧嚣，沉浸在大自然的怀抱中。每一处细节都让我反思生命的意义，感受到人与自然之间深刻的连接。

title.body:
> But I was thinking on this and was wondering what happens now with automation taking over

This is one of my greatest fears. When that happens, I think everything we’ve achieved up to “today” will be lost. Our freedom traded for comfort. 

> we are going to lose the majority of roles that have been created and even the creative ones, like music and art are being replaced by AI generated versions. 

On this point, I have a slightly different “view.” Surely there will be content and programs developed by computers, or even art galleries featuring works created by AI, cinema, music, etc.... Virtually all creative fields that are today considered achievements we’ve built upon since the days when we made music with a gourd and a stick, or when we drew with stones inside caves to explain an idea—and which later evolved into painting or even sculpture—could be “taken over” by AI. But those same arts or activities that continue to be performed by humans will undoubtedly be more highly valued. In other words, a play performed by humans and developed by humans will be more “exclusive” and have more restricted access. This could be a very important issue. Will there, for example, be first- and second-class cinema? Many questions are plaguing me right now regarding this particular topic, but I don’t think we’re going to “lose” these arts and these qualities to computers. 

> how long before human interaction is again obsolete (...)?

In this area, we have seen a decline since the onset of the pandemic. Much has been lost along the way. The forced isolation lasting several weeks, and the uprooting of children from the normal and desirable environments for their social development, has reached levels that are practically unprecedented. Today we see that the generations aged roughly 12–18 show a marked difference in this area compared to previous generations. I hope that in the near future there will be an awareness of the need for others for our own existence.

> nothing we do really matters to anyone else, and maybe not even to ourselves.

At the end of the day, we are all replaceable. But one thing is certain: even if “our place” can easily be taken by someone else or some other entity, we are unique. We possess a set of genes, memories, and interactions that are in no way replaceable—nor should they be disregarded—for the sake of an inclusive and global society. 

> we become a beta species, unable to support or direct itself, continually degrading until our value is the same as soil.

> what happens when there are no jobs anyone can do?

We must not give up hope of building a better society. And this does not mean seeking personal comfort, but rather fostering a deeper connection with our close family members, our neighbors, and even the stranger we happen to pass on the street—someone we make a point of “greeting” with a slight nod and a simple smile. 

A long time ago—more than 30 years, in fact—I dreamed of starting a family. Having children, a big house, and two dogs. Today, that “dream” feels a little further away. I’d even say it’s been relegated to a reality I don’t see happening in my lifetime. But that doesn’t bother me. When I realize there are still parents like you, who raise their children to be thinking beings, and who let them develop skills that can’t easily be replaced by a book or an app.

title.title: Americano Rotan Coffee
title.body:
>Hello, caffeine hunter. 
Have you had any coffee today? I’m going to take a little trip down memory lane to my recent trip to Solo. I’d just left the Tumurun Museum and, as it was lunchtime, I was absolutely starving and in desperate need of coffee—I’d been walking a long way since leaving the guesthouse that morning. If I were to add it all up, it must have been over ten kilometres.

As I walked and looked around for somewhere to eat, I finally found a coffee shop called Rotan Coffee. Do you know my reaction when I found this café? Yep… it was like finding something incredibly precious. Without hesitation, I went straight in and was greeted by a very friendly barista when I arrived. 

---

![FB_IMG_1776678823213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/244y1dVdJjK36iu12SzpVLXstYzUpfTJqsN89m2mu1ypuRP3rwtpoNxhb56ZDrQMfDrGU.jpg)


---

There were no other customers, so I was free to choose whichever seat I wanted. And since I needed to charge my phone and power bank, I chose a table with a power socket so I could easily top them up whilst enjoying my coffee and a hearty meal. 

---



![FB_IMG_1776678714833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23wqeGG7QeYHvXqAk62DHuiPSVyuTx46dpBR8yUwrviz5Ukh7rsc4tFzFDh87mMFERYfV.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1776678814839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EoyNxnprH4kwrP8pHbNKS4cyvQf2dqtmGoZRCYCfLZhxyQyhe2MMBD6reokTTtDCcVM.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1776678827180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EoptM19ySgzjfp2GFroNHT7r4iu8PYvHeXvfCA6bmtqBeK3A5JASVh3UgDC9KzCnU8g.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1776678745741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EpT4eTUuXEeCe9WFX7Fz4Dhu3H1m2vDEux1jnrn89EdeENF84dkJZ7g1DbWQ7g2xCWH.jpg)


---

I chose my order and immediately asked for an iced Americano, plus a portion of naan and katsu seasoned with black pepper. Although it isn’t very big, this café is very comfortable and the air conditioning works well. Having just walked in the scorching heat, I was instantly happy to step into the cool, clean room. 

---



![FB_IMG_1776678799983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EoK5mkbg3zJmGife2weiB3naD7KYMLTMDt9QkPCQuAexJDTQSwjUaGuhzRVy3B9r266.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1776678806743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23zbHThe194jpRi4ryDyvovWvNnyH6ddbuhQ295jpHYAbN6rD8LVSfoYN38pjsvZd14Bv.jpg)

![FB_IMG_1776678817711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23x15247CZ73tgn2MEpQ6qdSHwbpavipq23j6Y53o9twi99tLcwY2gY1mw8utwoGJyRQV.jpg)


---

Before long, my two orders arrived before me: a delicious rice bowl and a glass of my favourite iced Americano. Imagine how happy my throat felt as this bitter iced coffee slid down. My day felt all the more meaningful with a glass of bitter coffee. Whilst I was enjoying my meal, I also chatted to the barista, who wasn’t too busy at the time; the distance between my table and the barista’s was very close, so we could chat in a normal tone of voice. Besides, the café was very quiet.

In some corners of the café, there were still traces of beautiful Christmas decorations, and various board games were laid out—just in case visitors wanted to play a game with their friends whilst having a coffee. The barista said the café starts to get busy with visitors from late afternoon until evening; at midday like this, it tends to be quiet, especially on weekdays. Ah, as someone on a solo trip, I really needed a quiet café like this, even if just for a short while. After this, I’ll continue my journey to a place I’ve already noted down. One thing you should know—and which really surprised me about this café. The prices are incredibly affordable! How can an iced americano cost just 15,000 rupiah in this day and age, and not even reach 1 USD? Solo is amazing.

That’s all for my coffee journal today. How about you? Fancy staying for another coffee or moving on to somewhere else?

title.body: > I think hive is the place to have long term plans. A good way to lock in long term is to power up. This is a good way to grow on the hive platform. Hive is the platform with good utility. It's only reasonable to invest in your growth. However, I'm also not against using your earnings. I think both can be balanced.

/> When you write on hive and get curated, you're rewarded in the native token. Some of those rewards are already in vested form, which is HP. So in a way, that just adds to total hive power. It means with every post, you grow your hive power. In other sense, this just rewards activity. The more you actively post, the more you get hive power that adds to your growth on the platform. There's also the liquid hive you get as rewards. I use it when I have needs for it. It feels good having to use the rewards you get from a great platform like hive. Also, when I don't have immediate need for it, I choose to power up some myself. This helps my growth on the platform more. At the end of the day, it's about balance for me. Power up when you need to and withdraw when you need to. I think using some of the rewards you get can serve as some sort of encouragement. Generally in life, when there's an incentive, you'd always want to do more. Same applies to hive. The rewards earned are incentives, and it's good to enjoy it once in a while. It increases the motivation to do even better. Personally, I do take steps to grow my hp. I do power ups myself just to boost my hp. I know that growing hp is a really good way to grow on hive. That growth has always been my aim. I hope to reach a hive power of up to 1000 by the end of the year. I know it won't be easy but I intend to try. title.title: How Does a Portable Agricultural Sprayer Pump Save Water and Chemicals
title.body:
![How Does a Portable Agricultural Sprayer Pump Save Water and Chemicals (1).jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/bc481999f1173c916d4b26b2b16fecd91e33c22d030a7b9f79d278579f836299)

A [portable agricultural sprayer pump](https://chandakagro.wixsite.com/home/post/how-does-a-portable-agricultural-sprayer-pump-save-water-and-chemicals) helps farmers use water and chemicals more efficiently by delivering a controlled and targeted spray. Unlike traditional methods that often lead to overuse, these sprayers are designed with adjustable nozzles and pressure control systems that ensure uniform distribution across crops. This precision reduces wastage of pesticides, herbicides, and fertilizers, ultimately lowering input costs.

One of the key advantages is the ability to apply chemicals directly where they are needed. This minimizes runoff and prevents excess chemicals from seeping into the soil or nearby water sources. As a result, farmers not only save resources but also protect the environment. Additionally, portable sprayers are lightweight and easy to handle, allowing farmers to cover large areas quickly without fatigue.

Many modern sprayer pumps come with battery-operated or manual options, giving farmers flexibility based on their needs. With better spray coverage and reduced drift, crops receive the right amount of nutrients and protection, leading to healthier growth and improved yields.

In short, a portable agricultural sprayer pump is a smart investment for farmers looking to optimize resource usage, cut down costs, and adopt more sustainable farming practices.

Оренда в столицях і невеликих містах різниться у 2-3 рази.

title.title: The Beginner's Blueprint to Earning Online With Just One Hour Daily.
title.body:
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXLU8SLbhQAyLdqC6bpQXrqfJVnhUVvC7FGNDGWxoDu8w/e63065bb01d9ce9ef07a69858ada7e07b3a18f5751326ef878b983b72f2a21de.jpg)

# 1 - ++One Hour. That Is All You Need to Start++. : -

Hello my friends. Welcome back. I hope you are safe and doing well wherever you are reading this today. I want to talk about something very real and very practical today. Something that I personally think about a lot because I am building my own online income journey right now alongside you. Here is the honest truth that most people miss completely - You do not need eight hours a day to start earning online. You do not need to quit your job tomorrow or abandon your family responsibilities or sit in front of a screen all day, - You need exactly one focused intentional hour daily. That is it. One hour of consistent action repeated every single day adds up to 365 hours of real work by the end of one year and what's more is this 365 hours of focused online work done in the right direction on the right platforms can genuinely change your financial situation in ways that will surprise you. I have seen this happen. And today I want to give you the complete honest practical blueprint for making that one daily hour count.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBvWbDmJPkgnAJ56zkUEWUymXMPBr6itVA8Nd8N8oq1q/47de6a67e0d02f67d22fabb04df3f3a13bf2f5e2f6a5ae296b1abd65142c9b34.jpg)

# 2 - The Niches That Actually Make Serious Money for Beginners : -

Before we talk about platforms and strategies I need to talk about niches. Because choosing the wrong niche is like digging a well in the wrong location. You can dig for years and find nothing. But choosing the right niche is like finding a natural clean water. The water is already there waiting for you. From everything I have researched and personally experienced, the niches that consistently make serious money for complete beginners are these - Personal finance and money management, - consistently attracts millions of desperate readers every single day because everyone has money problems and everyone wants solutions; Health wellness and mental health is another massive niche because people are suffering in record numbers right now and searching urgently for answers; Spirituality and faith based content is growing rapidly especially during these war times and global uncertainties when people are searching for meaning hope and peace; Artificial intelligence and technology tutorials is perhaps the fastest growing niche of 2026 because every single person on Earth is trying to understand what AI means for their job, their business and their future. Cryptocurrency and blockchain education remains strong because most people still do not understand it and good clear honest explanations earn real loyal audiences. And finally education specifically helping students with subjects like mathematics, physics and science is an evergreen niche that never goes out of demand no matter what else is happening in the world around us. Pick one of these. Just one. Master it. Then expand.


![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWUZGitnJ2x79W8ETeq93yLYsBdsK3UZaqt8ptNnh8YeL/1.jpg)

3 -++** The Platforms That Will Actually Pay You : **++**-**

 Now let us talk about the real platforms. The ones that actually put money in your pocket or crypto in your wallet with just one hour of daily work. Publish0x is where I personally started, back in 2022, and where I still consistently post. It pays you in cryptocurrency tokens just for writing and for reading other people's content. Zero investment required, Zero technical knowledge needed, - just write honestly about what you know and the platform rewards you; Medium Partner Program pays you real money via Stripe direct to your bank account based on how much time paying members spend reading your articles, (based on what I have read and reasearched for, I still don't have medium partner program), Many writers earn between fifty and five hundred dollars, monthly on Medium with consistent daily writing. Substack allows you to build a free newsletter audience first and then convert your most loyal readers into paid subscribers who pay you monthly directly (I have seen people on Substack earning more like medium), Hive Blog and Read.cash pay you in cryptocurrencies - HIVE and Bitcoin Cash respectively, just for posting quality content consistently. For teaching specifically, Skillshare and Udemy allow you to create one simple course and earn passive royalties every month for years from that single hour of initial creation work. Fiverr and Upwork allow you to sell your writing, design, teaching or consulting services starting from just five dollars per gig and scaling up as your reputation grows, and YouTube despite feeling intimidating to beginners rewards consistent creators through the Partner Program once you reach 1000 subscribers and 4000 watch hours which is genuinely achievable within one year of one daily hour of consistent video creation.

![ \

](https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/cachedimages/2340594248-941b1a6b4808de468f35046ecaf9ff704fc51dbdf71d69054e9a9882f0b0c097.webp)

## **4 -** ++**How to Actually Use Your One Hour Every Day**++ **: -**

This is the part that most online earning guides completely skip and I think it is the most important part of everything I am sharing today. Having the right platforms and the right niche means nothing if you do not have a clear simple structure for how you use your one daily hour. Because one hour of scattered unfocused activity produces almost nothing. But one hour of deliberate structured action produces compounding results that build on each other day after day. Here is how I personally think about structuring that one hour. The first fifteen minutes should always be writing or creating. Not planning, not researching, not scrolling, but creating, writing the next paragraph of your blog post, recording the next sixty seconds of your video, writing the next section of your newsletter. Creation first - Always. The next twenty minutes should be publishing and cross posting your content across your chosen platforms. One piece of content posted to Publish0x, Medium and Hive Blog simultaneously, takes only minutes and triples your potential earning reach instantly. The next fifteen minutes should be genuine, authentic, community engagement. Commenting thoughtfully on other people's content, responding to comments on your own content, building real relationships with your audience because relationships are what convert casual readers into loyal paying subscribers over time. And the final ten minutes should be learning something new relevant to your niche. Watch one short YouTube tutorial. Read one article from a successful creator in your space. Study one platform's newest features. Consistent daily learning compounds just as powerfully as consistent daily creating.

**Your Simple One Hour Daily Structure:**

- ✍️ **0 to 15 min** - Create. Write publish record or design something new without distraction.
- 📤 **15 to 35 min** - Publish and cross post across all your active platforms simultaneously.
- 🤝 **35 to 50 min** - Engage genuinely with your community and respond to every comment.
- 📚 **50 to 60 min** - Learn one new thing relevant to your niche or platform growth.

 

![ \

](https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/cachedimages/884812937-0f51469f1d5a6cf5cf922a4fbb59cfa27bc6fba2cc8bec64cfc3082632af8d9d.webp)

## **5 -** ++**The Honest Reality of What to Expect**++ **: -**

I want to be completely real with you here because I think dishonesty about timelines is one of the biggest reasons people give up on online earning before their harvest arrives. In your first month you will probably earn almost nothing. Maybe a few cents on Publish0x. Maybe zero views on your first Medium article. Maybe one or two followers on your new Substack. And I need you to hear this clearly - that is completely normal, that is not failure, that is foundation building. The online creators who are earning thousands of dollars monthly today, all have embarrassing first months in their history that looked exactly like yours will look. By month three, with consistent daily one hour action, you should start seeing small, but real earnings. Between one and twenty dollars across your platforms depending on your niche consistency and content quality. By month six with continued consistency and smart cross posting those numbers should grow to between twenty and one hundred dollars monthly. By the end of your first full year of one daily hour consistently applied you should realistically be looking at somewhere between one hundred and five hundred dollars monthly depending on how well you chose your niche how consistently you showed up and how generously you served your growing audience. These are not extraordinary numbers. But they are real. They are honest. And they are the beginning of something that compounds far beyond year one if you simply do not quit before the harvest comes. Galatians 6:9 in Bible says that let us not become weary in doing good for at the proper time, we will reap a harvest if we do not give up. That verse was written two thousand years ago and it is still the most accurate description of building an online income that I have ever read.

title.body:
<center>![20230711_113158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/243LvvYFKSFF3ka1GDi2VngqH146a7mFTNLEUZwAuHttrzLiVQ4PE9XE7bzehv82EMEtp.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

It's been a long long time since I have been to Minnesota.  I remember when I was much younger, my parents decided to do the Lake Superior circle tour.  In case you aren't familiar with the concept, it's basically just a designated route around Lake Superior (called Gitche Gumee by the Ojibwa).  Each of the Great Lakes has a circle route (at least the three main ones that touch Michigan).  In the case of Superior, it takes you through the upper peninsula of Michigan into Wisconsin, then a short jaunt along the northern shore of the lake until you get into Canada.  Eventually, you find yourself back in Sault Ste. Marie and cross back over into Michigan making the circuit complete.

More recently, I had a flight layover in Minneapolis, but since we never left the airport, I don't really count that as having visited Minnesota.  This Summer, @mrsbozz and I are planning on taking a trip to Wisconsin.  It is very possible we will be making a quick drive over to Duluth to have lunch one day, so although it will be just a taste of the state, we should still be able to count having visited it on our map.


<center>![20230711_104853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23rAtY8EB48skrEdqYXmNTsXSrkuUsnGYbFxTTtEADPDtsk58XwmnX8fwiyG7J2xiLd8R.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

Since I don't really have any photos of Minnesota, I am sharing photos of Lake Superior for this post.  In case you haven't guessed, this weeks #threetunetuesday sponsored by @ablaze brings us to the great state of Minnesota, land of 10,000 lakes.  When I was younger, I used to get annoyed that Minnesota was memorialized for its lakes.  I mean sure, it might have a lot of lakes, but we have the Great Lakes.  How much better is that?  It's funny the things you think are important when you are younger.

In fact, if you look at a map, Minnesota does indeed have a metric crap ton of lakes.  It's honestly no contest, but yes, Michigan still does have the Great Lakes.

Minnesota was actually a bit harder than I would have expected to find songs for this post.  Sure, it's not that easy to rhyme something with Minnesota, but I think we all know by now that not every song has to rhyme, it just makes it easier and a bit more catchy when it does.  

I was able to pick out three songs that I am going to share here, I hope you enjoy them.

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

--------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KwbeHSI-3Co&list=RDKwbeHSI-3Co&start_radio=1)

-------------------------

I know I might catch a lot of flack for this, but I am a huge Indigo Girls fan.  I understand there is this preconceived notion that only gay women like Indigo Girls music, but I think if you actually listen to them you will realize that isn't the case.  Or at least realize that shouldn't be the case.  The harmonies alone are so amazing, and then when you add in the lyrical prowess, there is just something really special about this duo.  

I was going to share a more recent video of the song \

from them, but honestly, these days their voices aren't quite the same as they used to be, so I found an older cut of it.  You just have to get past the overly long intro because it seems like the video is broken at first.  It isn't until about ten seconds in that you really start to hear it.

I really like the line in this song where they talk about the Mississippi River starting in Minnesota.  I've seen pictures of the headwaters of the Mississippi and to be honest, it's nothing special.  There is a little sign and then just a swampy area I think.  The part in the song where they say you can walk across it in five steps is just really poignant to me.

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

---------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sNh-iw7gsuI&list=RDsNh-iw7gsuI&start_radio=1)

---------------------------

I'll be the first to admit, I never really got into Soundgarden when they were popular.  Yes, I knew the couple of big hits they had, but it wasn't until Chris Cornell passed away and it became more apparent just how many creative project he had his hands in and just how amazing he was.  \

has a reference to Minnesota if listen really closely.  I wouldn't have known it if I hadn't looked it up online, but I felt it would just be a little wrong to not include this prolific artist this week.

It doesn't take long to hear the reference to Minnesota.  It happens before we even get to the chorus in fact, but it is there.  If you watch the video with the captions on it is even easier to catch.  I don't have much else to say here.  Soundgarden kind of speaks for themself.

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

---------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bErza7LieSM&list=RDbErza7LieSM&start_radio=1)

-------------------------

Finally, I realized it would be an absolute crime if I didn't include one of Minnesota's favorite sons in this post.  Of course I am talking about Prince and if you know, you know.  As I was preparing for this post yesterday, I realized just how little of his music I actually know.  Yes, I know the big hits, and the smaller ones too, but he had a massive career spanning back to the late 70's and an amazing catalog of music to sift through.

I've made it my mission to take a deep dive into his music on Spotify this week.  That doesn't even include the songs he wrote for so many other people.  

\

is one of the songs that I have probably never heard in my life until now and it's quite simple, but if you listen to the whole thing you will eventually hear the reference to Minnesota. It's too bad that Prince had to be taken from us so soon. I think he really could have made so much more great music.  

I remember maybe about twenty years ago he was in Michigan doing a show near where we lived.  I just kind of laughed it off and didn't have much interest in going to see him, but I really wish I had now.  Just to be able to say I saw a legend.

title.title: 高爾夫球車初體驗
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVuWGvKo8sTfifgTS4abUgTvM4gA5HEvgW14T1CHbBY4r/image.png)

前幾次有提到，我最近開始上非常便宜的高爾夫球課，本來在練習場上課，但最後幾個禮拜到真的高爾夫球場上，然後又給我們開球車。平常租球車的錢就跟這堂課的錢差不多，所以這堂課等於免費了。

這次上課還是我第一次坐並駕駛高爾夫球車。這台球車其實比想像中聰明很多，速度不是想快就快，如果開得太快，它會自動幫你降速。上下坡的時候也很穩，幾乎不會讓人感到晃或不安，對第一次開的人來說真的很安心。前方還有一個螢幕，清楚顯示整個球場的地圖，現在在哪一洞、下一個目的地在哪裡，一眼就能看懂。

球具全部放在車後方，不用自己提著球桿袋在球場上走來走去，實在是太舒服了。想到上一次跟爸媽一起打高爾夫球，因為捨不得租車，幾乎整場都在走路，結束後累得不行，現在再回頭看，只能說下次再來一定會租車，完全不想再省那筆錢。

這次我和一位同學一起坐同一台球車，他以前有開過，所以一開始先簡單教了我怎麼操作，之後就讓我一路開到底。有個人坐在旁邊給點提示，心裡踏實很多，也很快就上手了。

打球的感覺也跟以前很不一樣。上次跟爸媽打的時候，幾乎還沒上過課，常常揮空，球也打不遠，現在因為已經上了一段時間的課，揮桿順多了。雖然談不上打得好，但至少每一顆球都打得到，而且大多都比之前更接近洞口，這種進步真的讓人很開心。

我們四個人一組，用的是那種選最遠落點再繼續打的方式，所以每一洞進行得非常快，不會卡關，也沒有壓力。大家邊玩邊笑，球很快就推進下一洞，整個過程流暢又輕鬆。

那天下課時，其實心裡有點捨不得離開球場。不只是因為開球車好玩，更因為真實地感覺到自己在慢慢進步。現在反而開始期待下一次上課，再一次把球車開上球道，繼續累積高爾夫回憶。

title.title: A juvenile Harrier Hawk landed.
title.body:
There was no way that I could get around a palm tree to get the sun behind me.
![022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpLgYmrZqoksf62Ygf9wCEA1jVDcxGfPeuqe4DrLEsRLdV6nvr3Jbd5t36yn6611ce7.jpg)

This was too good to worry about the position of the sun, and I just had to cope with the conditions.

The African Harrier Hawk (Polyboroides typus) was previously known as a Gymnogene, which suited his athletic prowess as it is one of only a few bird species that can climb trees. 

*The two species of polyboroides (one in Africa and one in Madagascar) are large hawks with very broad, deeply slotted wings, long tails and long, slender legs which have the unique ability of being able to bend backwards and sideways at the tarsal (ankle) joint. This enables them to insert their feet into holes and cracks in rocks and tree stems to pull out bats, lizards, nestling birds, and other prey. Their unusually narrow small head also facilitates probing into holes. They have bare facial skin which changes color from red to yellow according to the bird's state of agitation.*     

Source: Book: Birds of Southern Africa. ISBN: 978-1-77584-668-0.

His call that he made alerted me to his presence, and so I went out to search for him. 
![021.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23ywsaGGqww62Ye3PdiMGM6cZrieRSCDR9J4xpFU8s9V5j7LyYA24ko4PFKTgzrfZ3two.JPG)

They are famous for searching trees for prey. 
![007.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xp2Pm7hwKKbVFeE7Ra3rwmBFnVxQefBdJw6vqAChsDvRtEYVXQiL5xH2MuwuaA7Hti1.JPG)

And this one was scoping the trunk of the tree, as there are little pockets on the trunk that the birds and the squirrels use to nest in. 
![010.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xVRXyBCg9q18TsweJozFYQUdiCh4JnGERuYQbjB3wMSazBYoFTC7pPXQgmtGJ7w1NZe.JPG)

The wind caught him behind the head, resulting in a lovely look.
![027.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Epzz7gf7YNsb7Uj52QVTWBVbJTmuUL3QnPoo1wyTLFfisZ6RZ4zA7Lwo4JJ5FMrrhyh.JPG)

Then he was on his way, but I don't know if he saw anything. 
![017.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23yd1r76yJ6S6T4s4VHRsKmzqPaSwJUEuR6mvVcKfvpNk2CSaUYgmNdiCyWVhy5h1jm34.JPG)

A bit later he appeared lower in the tree.
![019.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xARkE4oDXA3ctK6gWDBVFZTCYU1QmH6gF5Gvx7YSqLEccshpdxJ2LLLyAzHyBFP4cF1.JPG)

I thought that he would attack something below him.
![034.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xempz1BB7NKJYqTUkiiDtXtHyJWSmyXsRanEAQ28DDqFSnZunqJQFg6amsCi8T925sn.JPG)

But not to be, as he rather stepped down and then disappeared behind the tree.
![037.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wMabWQgdDHRWRsmDHVdmbtnkskWsoXW3ZYhuCaThzAj7u3tGYSYPt2g3rkHbtAYA5ma.JPG)

This is the tree that he was in, and you can see the glaring light of the sun.
![025.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqUfHg3Uq4AHVN6MVNiJYnZ6f6K5YfVM5njMu56qZXkWn6S7rbH1MjmBpnf8hnnL7JV.JPG)

As I said above, there was no way I could get behind this tree as it is on a private property, ringed by an electric fence. I don't know if the hawk knew that I couldn't get to him in that tree, maybe but I am only guessing. 
Every season a pair of harrier hawks are born and believe it or not every season I get them on camera. Sometimes I even get them with their prey, mainly small birds and doves. 

We also have a sparrow hawk that patrols the sky here every day, but he is way too fast for me to get him on camera. One just has to stand outside and to see a sudden rush of doves and smaller birds flying off suddenly to know that the sparrow hawk was on its way. But no problem, as I know that someday I will get him in flight. Things have gotten cold here over the last while, and we already had two cold fronts (winter storms) over the past weekend. I will do a post about it to show you. 
Such is life.

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

title.title: THE 5-SECOND DECISION THAT HELPED ME TRUST MYSELF AGAIN ~285
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPnvwXp4wvhCU5WLdzYkrL8VuLic3iJrJyxfoFyYYnkVw/1776769852194.jpg)

An image of me 

There was a time I couldn’t trust myself, not in a dramatic way tho but in small and quiet ways that slowly add up. I would promise myself I’d wake up early, then snooze and dismiss the alarm. I’d plan my day, then scroll it away. I’d say, “this time I’m serious,” but deep down, I didn’t even believe me anymore.

It’s a painful place to be as a woman when your words start to lose weight, even to yourself.

One evening, tired of starting over, I came across a video by Mel Robbins talking about something simple: the 5-second rule, not the one about food but about action.

She said, “If you have an instinct to act on a goal, you must move within 5 seconds before your brain kills it.”

I won’t lie, it sounded too simple, almost silly.

But the next morning, when my alarm rang, I felt that familiar urge to stay in bed. Normally, I would negotiate with myself, lose and sleep again.

But this time, I counted, 5… 4… 3… 2… 1…

I stood up like an armed force personnel resounding to orders 

Just like that, no motivation, no deep thinking, just movement and action 

This felt small but it felt different.

That same day, I used it again, when I wanted to procrastinate, i'd say 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and start. When I felt like avoiding a difficult message, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, do it.

And slowly, something I didn’t expect happened, I started trusting myself again.

Not because I became perfect, but because I stopped overthinking myself out of action.

That’s what this lesson gave me: a way to interrupt fear, doubt, and delay.

As women, we carry so much in our minds, expectations, pressure, “what ifs,” fear of getting it wrong. And sometimes, it’s not that we don’t know what to do, we just don’t move.

That simple countdown became my bridge between knowing and doing.

And that’s why I would recommend learning from Mel Robbins to any woman who feels stuck in her own head.

Because it reminds you that confidence doesn’t come before action, it comes after action

You don’t need to feel ready, you don’t need to have it all figured out.

Sometimes, you just need 5 seconds and the courage to move before your fear speaks louder

Pero tienen algo diferente… ![_DSC2180_copy_3512x2507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23vhsCxZxgtz4CM2XBxhg1tAABR1vjv3Gci7RfXFqwWm6JeYog1JCn2KcYM4at71EHdXz.jpg)
> I almost always try to make each post work as a series, with a clear theme, where all the images are connected. I like there to be an idea that ties them together.

> Casi siempre intento que cada publicación funcione como una serie, con un tema claro, donde todas las imágenes se conecten entre sí. Me gusta que haya una idea que las una. ![_DSC2151_copy_3629x2591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23vsQDEbHJzmyGr4CDDyZizDHg6uqPDmq9k5cDGV1zkZAT2LoFoNQRgmqgDhzneRKiW95.jpg)

> But that didn’t happen this time. I had these photos saved, and no matter how much I looked at them, I couldn’t figure out where to put them. They didn’t fit into any theme, any series… they were just kind of loose.

> Pero esta vez no me pasó eso. Tenía estas fotos guardadas y, por más que las miraba, no encontraba dónde ponerlas. No encajaban en ningún tema, en ninguna serie… estaban como sueltas. ![_DSC2189_copy_3628x2592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23wWwFCEXNhgqN7z6oNeeiqy5zF9UKQ58t86xMe3AsPRTBZm2NVLX3x8Qx8RdnaGEW7Na.jpg)

> And then, after mulling it over, something occurred to me: if they don’t fit anywhere, then that’s the theme. That’s where the title came from: “Photos I Don’t Know Where to Put.” And interestingly, as soon as the title appeared… everything started to make sense.

> Y nada, después de darle vueltas, se me ocurrió algo: si no encajan en ningún lado, entonces ese es el tema. De ahí salió el título: “Fotos que no sé dónde poner”. Y curiosamente, en cuanto apareció el título… todo empezó a tener sentido. ![_DSC2126_copy_3628x2592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23xefazuZcPoqsGbTfdkdMcr13NkzYSVxCYXKecsJ8eV4oRqBbnjQZ8EdjJ2qDeHsWied.jpg)

title.title: Double Tank Strategy with Torch Myrmidon || The Fire Tank That Never Dies
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 21, 2026, 10_44_40 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u64w2uXiL8ehjG7zxg6NZWLaJDNzcDwCadMMmRh6sJKL6qXvMEBQttuBjwiejE9zmVa.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


Torch Myrmidon is a strong monster card in Splinterlands whose stats and abilities are very good. At the start I was thinking of it as a middle line monster and many times I used it in the middle line during battles. But now after getting more information actually it is a frontline monster.

If I talk about the identity of this card you can guess from its visual display. In the background you can see fire signs and in the top corner there is a fire symbol which proves that it belongs to the Fire splinter.

Its main role is a front line tank. It is known as a sustain fighter and its mana cost is eight. You can easily use it in mid to high mana battles while in low mana battles it can create some difficulty because its mana cost is high.

The most surprising and good thing about it is that even while being in the front line meaning while playing the role of a tank monster it can still attack. This is considered its special ability. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 101227.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQLi8GUHdd9hCBUxDeHZbtjPTQSsVfDMLdsuqhzK3LCKgJwFZeVbGgPJh2v1DFdVQCW.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

For example if it is in the front line its armor which is 2 keeps giving it protection and along with that it keeps attacking with +1 every round. That means while staying in the front line it can keep attacking enemy monsters.

Its health is also good and its armor keeps trying to protect its health. Remember whenever you see high health and high armor in any monster card you can use them in the front line.

In the same way this monsters speed is 4 which helps in attacks. Torch Myrmidon has two special abilities that is Reach and Heal.

In Reach what happens is that it can attack from position 2. This means you can place it in position 2 and still attack. The benefit of this is that you can use a double front line. That means you can place one strong tank first and then place this card behind it and take full advantage of its abilities.

Its second ability is healing. That means in every round it restores a portion of its health and this is the strength of this card.

From its visual design I imagine that this monster looks very angry and because of its anger, flames are coming out from its head and a spear is passing above it. It looks like it is trying to damage enemy monsters. Its visual display is very beautiful and I tried to imagine and present this idea.

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 101155.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tSN1PaLJLpZRR7fdeh383u7VSjkF3WYSsWJJZLtwHSjBGUkT3qA5mg5sqfjx6amxEg5.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Now lets talk about its weaknesses because every monster has its own weakness. Its first big weakness is that you cannot select it in low mana battles. Second it has only 1 melee attack so it will struggle against high health enemies. Third it can be affected by high burst damage meaning if the enemy has heavy damage it can make its heal ability useless.

Now if we talk about its price this monster is very strong but still very reasonable in price. In the screenshot you can see its minimum price is 0.087 which means at level 1 you can easily buy it and start your battles. Later if you want to upgrade it you can do that at each level which also impacts the price.

This was the summary of this powerful monster which I tried to explain in the best and simple way so that you can use such monsters correctly in battles.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

title.title: WINS AND LOSSES: Week 11
title.body: > ![wins and losses.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riona09/23xpTS7wCSxqMR9yDXBW81VasHpNwiFtSow1UaowAYmPm15o26ndVNVwgidkErPz8dYUG.jpg) Good day, dear hivers! It's @riona09 again, back with another blog! I am now on week 11 of my wins and losses and so far, so good. This week wasn't something special but slightly heartbreaking. Graduation was definitely on my 2026 bingo card but I didn't know it would make me this emotional. So, week 11 it is. **MY WIN** ![436d2b5b-6f33-47da-b6d5-f18d56e43153.jfif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riona09/23xevRrSP95CdLdHUrow8e4szFci97JXQUKCF7pgnh3kBED18YynP6o39cBYK5XB4p6Py) For this week, all we did was to practice our upcoming graduation rites. It's a bit tiring, especially with the large number of graduates in our school. Now, why am I being so emotional? Even if I only stayed in this beloved school for two years, for me, it was long and amazing. If I were to say, I will always be the transferee girl no one expected to be there, yet everyone never let me feel out of place. It was just two years, but I've known myself more. Still, I'm not yet read to say goodbye. **MY LOSS** ![Loss.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riona09/23w2sdnZYWGBKC7TcA2qWUx8t7piePcJQkdLZ3Jmv5rPsj9FQqgbjpnQDkgPFF9CLDemS.jpg) It's graduation season, and I'm still trying to sink in the fact that I'm leaving high school behind. It was a great loss. High school were basically almost half of my life, it was where I built an identity for myself. The friends, the knowledge, the mindset and even the things I have now, it existed because I was able to go through high school. It was a big part of me and leaving it would also have a very big impact in my life. But it was the reality I can never escape, and all I wish is a fresh and good start of my college era. ![THUMBNAIL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riona09/23uQtsbYk7sd7DCxqCsZFJs4TFV4eSHoPsGrRxd2U7AdkVaZmr8GHepyDr3FVuXymjTWn.png) That's it, dear hivers! I hope I got to entertain you today and thank you for reading until the very end. See you on my next blog!

title.title: Colorful Bougainvillea Flowers
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYGWAjycGfaYBazivp4zmCEnWEgunkdgGY7hgAvo2GqxW/1776759896714.jpg)
How are you, friends? Best wishes to you all, wherever you are.

I'm so happy to see flowers in bloom. The bright colors are so beautiful. This flower is a bougainvillea in a pot. It's a poorly maintained bougainvillea, but it still blooms beautifully. The cuttings come in other colors: pink, purple, yellow, and white.

This bougainvillea is in front of the house, in a simple garden, along with other flowers, typically bougainvillea. Other bougainvillea flowers aren't as beautiful as this one. It caught my attention, and I'm sure others who see it in person will be interested too.

This bougainvillea is approximately 50 cm tall. Grafting bougainvillea in various colors is not easy, especially for beginners who lack patience. So, it all requires patience.

I once grafted bougainvillea in three colors. The result was that only two colors worked. When I asked a friend, they said the connection shouldn't be loose or airy. That's one of the reasons why there are probably many other things we don't understand.

I managed to take several photos of this bougainvillea flower from various positions. You can see the results in this post. We apologize for any shortcomings.
