title.body: All that would be is same as every pump previously, short & followed by bigger dump.  We won’t ever stay above .10 cents again consistently.  I’m just glad I sold most my stake during the two previous cycle pumps.  I love hive community, but it’s being run into the ground and nothing changes unless those in power here with influence actually change things.  Not likely unfortunately.   But we will not go above a dime again unless it’s a short term artificial pump like we saw in November 2021 & January 2025. Massive spike on 250X normal volume, and always during new contracts to trade hive being available at time, the same party who pumped it from .14 to .68 in in late 2024,to Jan 2025, they purposely got a terrible buy price by buying all at once and they clearly longed the contracts and then shorted it as they dumped it back to .18 2 months later.  We could see that again and watch a pump,  not a chance it’s sustainable, it would be days or weeks at best.  History shows we’ve never had a move without artificial games & volume spiking to a billion from few million in a day.  Until we make major changes, hive will not have growth.  We haven’t grown in daily active users since 2021, and already 2026 had us loosing more daily active users then 2025 whole year.  We must admit we are in a bad place and devs refuse and pretend things are great, this is why I know we are never going to have a long term move higher but only artificial pumps like b4. & every time we won’t get as high as pre ious cycle pumps. 2018 before Hive fork,  we saw $6.00 plus , 2021 we hit $3.35 , 2025 we got to .68 cents and each time we go lower than previous.  The whole thing is crashing over long term, the model is broken, but the way the DHF is a slush fund now, among devs still pushing ridiculous narratives like saying at Hive Fest 2025 that HBD is certain to be the main stable coin for Bitcoin network, a totally false & never happening statement , it just shows the disconnect from reality here.   Even mid sized non whale accounts are now buying most there daily upvotes via delegations like SGS & Ed’s. Or strait up from Leo for a monthly fee, this has turned chain into a broken place. The long term looks bleak when a majority of accounts do this crap and it leads to this, crushing bleeding of active users year over year.  We are going to a penny and lower at this rate, but no doubt I’m sure we’ll see short lived pumps along way. .11 cents wouldn’t surprise me at all, but won’t last more than a few weeks at best.  \n\nWe must admit where we are, things aren’t growing at all, we have bled users and need a full overhaul & rebrand.

title.title: Wie Technik und ich uns entwickelten
title.body:
Wenn ich heute über Technik nachdenke, merke ich, wie schwer es geworden ist, ihren Anfang zu bestimmen. Sie ist einfach überall. Aber irgendwann muss es diesen ersten Moment gegeben haben, an dem ich ihr bewusst begegnet bin. Vielleicht war es das Telefon im Flur mit der Wählscheibe. Oder die Musiktruhe im Wohnzimmer – Plattenspieler und Radio in einem Möbelstück. Ich weiß es nicht mehr genau. Ich weiß nur: Diese Geräte gehörten nicht uns Kindern. Sie gehörten den Erwachsenen. Und genau dort beginnt meine persönliche Geschichte mit Technik. „Wenn ich versuche, mich zu erinnern, entsteht eine Art technologische Zeitlinie meines Lebens …“ ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23u5QY15N5qMJKeX4xm6NEBhVJTciNWRBYRfVsDfQtvthhtkqviGsDBdgKjesHvFnTwz1.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje ## Eine persönliche Zeitlinie ### Ende der 1960er – Technik gehört den Erwachsenen Erste bewusste Begegnungen mit Technik. Wählscheiben-Telefon im Flur. Musiktruhe im Wohnzimmer (Plattenspieler + Radio). ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/EqQPXhL6tvohCXKiJTEWbAELmzXdDH9RP4sWh8ASXhpYje63kZGDtCGtNE6USJUmBPE.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje Schlager aus den 60ern. Technik ist teuer und fast ein „Heiligtum“. Kinder benutzen Geräte nicht – sie beobachten. Eine meiner stärksten Erinnerungen: Wenn das Telefon klingelte, war es oft mein Vater, der beruflich unterwegs war. Und mich wollte er immer sprechen. ### Frühe 1970er – Mein erstes eigenes Gerät Das erste Stück Technik, das wirklich mir gehörte: Ein kleines batteriebetriebenes Transistorradio, überall dabei, englischsprachige Musik entdecken (Abgrenzung zum Schlager der Erwachsenen). Technik wird zum ersten Mal Teil der eigenen Identität. ### Mitte / Ende der 1970er – Musik wird teilbar Der nächste große Schritt: Der Kassettenrekorder. Plötzlich konnte man: Musik aus dem Radio aufnehmen, eigene Kassetten erstellen, Musik mit Freunden tauschen. Das bedeutete aber auch: stundenlang auf einen Song warten. Aufnahme neu starten, wenn der Moderator hineinredet. ständig neue Batterien kaufen. Musik hören kostete damals Zeit und Energie. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23wCLgCfALkgwY4UGpJo34aoaTo19FkHdJDcbvwFzCkS2yKLK6pUuwxyi3ZaWE3CSTrXv.png)
Image by

>Pixabay ### Ende der 1970er – Erste eigene HiFi-Anlage Weihnachtsgeschenk: eine Schneider Kompakt-Stereoanlage. Ich war ehrlich gesagt enttäuscht. Ich wollte: einzelne Komponenten, Geräte später austauschen, meine Anlage selbst zusammenstellen. Diese Enttäuschung führte zu etwas Neuem: Ich begann nach der Schule zu arbeiten, um Geld zu verdienen. Saisonarbeiten, Baujobs – oft half ich beim Vater eines Freundes, der Fliesenleger war. Der Bruder eines Freundes hatte sich mit Gerüstbau selbständig gemacht. ### 1985 – Der Heimcomputer Mit Beginn meines Studiums in Automatisierungstechnik kam der nächste große Sprung. Heimcomputer. Zur Auswahl standen damals: Commodore C64 und Schneider CPC ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23xeVMaZpXJhwHrkHvAqD9pqJDXqRcedWnjAHbfViA4TX4MzFMQC9iED65ft7zBV75nLQ.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje Unser Dozent riet uns: Wartet ein paar Wochen. Ihr werdet selbst merken, welcher Computer zu euch passt. Ich wartete natürlich nicht. Ein gutes Angebot führte schnell zum C64. Im Nachhinein war es eine gute Entscheidung – dort gab es viel mehr Möglichkeiten zu basteln und zu lernen. ### Ende der 1980er – Technik wird Beruf In der Ausbildung arbeiteten wir mit echten Mikroprozessoren: 8085, 8086, Z80 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23uEyoWVhoaXZhRCdob4cchTJgcMhC2R27y28dhJ27eoUtcnGwGf21WEcrBEuaGo9hr3V.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje Programmiert wurde in: Assembler, BASIC, CP/M, SPS. Dazu kamen PID-Regler und Steuerungen. Software steuerte plötzlich reale Maschinen. Das war eine ganz andere Verantwortung als beim Heimcomputer. ### Automatisierung und Medizintechnik Mein erster beruflicher Einstieg: SPS-Programmierung. Entwickelte halbautomatische Prüfabläufe für Platinen. Später wechselte ich in die Medizintechnik. Entwicklung digitaler Systeme um wiederkehrende Abläufe zu automatisieren. Der PC wurde dabei mein ständiger Begleiter. Von PC-DOS, MS-DOS, bis zu Windows und später auch Linux. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23wWvpez2MtaN83h61iRpsr3tukJGmxsy92qj9a2TBy69fDAM4Di5nvX3FBDGr3unBH1N.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje ### Netzwerke und Infrastruktur Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt wurde Netzwerktechnik. Ich installierte Netzwerke bei: Freunden, kleinen Firmen, Selbstständigen. Damals meist 10-Mbit Ethernet. Fehlersuche war oft ein Albtraum. Ein defektes Kabel oder unsaubere Verbindung – und das ganze Netz stand. ### Vor dem Internet – BTX Noch bevor das Internet alltäglich wurde, arbeitete ich mit BTX (Bildschirmtext). Mit Freunden, einer hatte von seinem Vater einen größeren Kurierdienst übernommen, entwickelten wir eine interaktive Plattform zur Reduktion von Leerfahrten (OMS-2000). Technik dafür: GPS, D2 Mobilfunk, zentrale Plattform. Im Grunde ein früher Vorläufer moderner Logistikplattformen. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23ynZ2z5hrGUkmYcxjeAzUhwGqu3RWxwgNnssVKLEjLHjnrK9J4UiWxxdDbcGGsgraXLN.png)
Vieles davon wirkt heute selbstverständlich. Damals (1990-1995) war es ein gefördertes Experiment. ### Frühe Online-Zeit – Modems und ISDN Die ersten Verbindungen ins Netz: Akustikkoppler (0,3k), 2.8k Modems, später 56k. Der große Fortschritt kam mit ISDN (64k), mit geeigneter teurer Hardware (aktive ISDN-Karte AVM B1) konnte man zwei Leitungen bündeln (128k). Jetzt konnte man stabil online arbeiten. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23y9AZa9mm191utkVTvFTWCRQL5JhCtba4JhbtcFNK6KaDZHwYmvdUnGMed2MeC5TYKeG.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje Ich begann Webseiten zu erstellen: für Freunde, für Vereine, für Selbstständige inklusive Infrastrukturplanung. Solange Technik eine Herausforderung war, machte sie besonders viel Spaß. ### Mobile Kommunikation Durch meinen Beruf war Erreichbarkeit wichtig. Ich begann mit dem B-Netz. Später kam mein erstes richtig mobiles Telefon - Ein Motorola-Klapphandy mit ausziehbarer Antenne. Erstaunlich gute Funkqualität für diese Zeit. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23wqi9JZVFb8tMzfGrQNsnikgCdwNJ8xS3AjSFnGsgoym4ZYAhSSXkcfBDmDWvsXXpAcC.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje ### Frühe Smartphones Noch lange bevor Apple oder Samsung den Markt dominierten, hatte ich bereits ein frühes Smartphone. Damit konnte man: E-Mails schreiben, Fotos machen, Termine verwalten. Damals fühlte sich das schon wie Zukunft an. ### Heute – Technik als Werkzeug Heute nutze ich Technik anders. Nicht mehr primär beruflich, sondern als Werkzeug für Gedanken, Austausch und Dokumentation. Zum Beispiel: Schreiben, Reflektieren, Publizieren. Technik unterstützt den Prozess – sie steht nicht mehr im Mittelpunkt. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23x1WXw2cyeXLjY5eizrASwWugaqNGbJ4n5aqwsHx9iAZt35oVUXUUMQXcNZB5o3GHRai.png)
Quelle: OpenAI Bildgenerator; @vanje ## Die eigentliche Entwicklung Wenn ich zurückblicke, sehe ich eine interessante Bewegung: - Technik war zuerst selten und zentral - Dann wurde sie persönlich - Später Werkzeug - Dann Infrastruktur - Und heute ist sie einfach Begleiter im Alltag. ## Schlussgedanke Wenn ich heute darüber nachdenke, habe ich eine erstaunliche Entwicklung miterlebt. - Von der Musiktruhe im Wohnzimmer zum Smartphone in der Hosentasche. - Von der Wählscheibe zu globalen Netzwerken. - Von Kassettenaufnahmen aus dem Radio zu Musikbibliotheken, die in Sekunden verfügbar sind. - Und vom Heimcomputer, auf dem man Programme noch aus Zeitschriften abtippte, hin zu Systemen, die heute mit Hilfe künstlicher Intelligenz Texte formulieren – und ganze Prozesse im Hintergrund mitdenken. Technik hat sich ständig verändert. Was sich dabei aber kaum verändert hat, ist etwas anderes: die Neugier. Der Wunsch zu verstehen, wie Dinge funktionieren. Probleme zu lösen. Neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren. Früher bedeutete das: Kassetten aufnehmen. Computer programmieren. Netzwerke aufbauen. Heute bedeutet es vielleicht: Gedanken aufschreiben. Erfahrungen teilen. Oder einfach beobachten, wohin sich diese technische Welt noch entwickelt. Wenn ich eines gelernt habe, dann: Technik kommt und geht. Aber die Neugier darauf bleibt.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 21 2026
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJQfHdhhSpRvtT26A1hftSUoV9VNRzZkb3cRjhkbuFzn/1776768668114.jpg) ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png) This morning began with a warm atmosphere at home. I enjoyed a plate of fried rice made by my wife, which was just right, simple yet meaningful. Afterward, a cup of hot coffee was the perfect way to start the day. The steam rising slowly seemed to give me extra energy before starting my day. As usual, I continued my routine of delivering bread to my favorite shops. The sun had been shining brightly since morning, making the air feel hotter than usual. On the way, I carried many boxes of bread on my modified motorcycle to keep the load secure. Despite the scorching heat, the work must go on. On the way, I stopped by the Bangka Jaya sea. The sea breeze provided a bit of coolness in the sweltering heat. There was also a bread vendor there, so I took a look around. The calm sea view and shady trees made for a pleasant, if only brief, stop. However, today's trip wasn't entirely smooth. I was stuck in a long traffic jam due to road repairs. Many vehicles, from motorcycles to large cars, piled up. This situation made the journey longer than usual. Even so, I tried to remain patient and enjoy the process. It was a tiring, hot, and challenging day, but there were still small moments to be grateful for. title.title: The House of the Spirits [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Black White Grunge Music Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23vi1fBe5TPg9sxV6758iMsJYjdGkFG9BRSCfLnpcaayVCWY4M9DLAjeZ2oTaPTtj9MZP.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

Yesterday I finally finished reading this marvel of Latin American literature, written by none other than Isabel Allende. This work, brimming with magical realism, especially in its early chapters, is a gem that highlights the resistance and resilience of those who fight for just and noble causes. >Ayer terminé de leer finalmente esta maravilla de la literatura latinoamericana, escrita por nada más y nada menos que Isabel Allende. Esta obra cargada de realismo mágico, sobre todo en sus primeros capítulos, es una joya que resalta la resistencia y resiliencia de aquellos que luchan por causas justas y nobles.

The novel spans four generations of the same family, the Trueba family, and from its founding to the end we see all the processes of change amidst fantastic events and drastic political revolutions that force them to make tough and difficult decisions.

>La novela abarca cuatro generaciones de la misma familia, los Trueba, y desde su fundación hasta el final vemos todos los procesos de cambios en medio de hechos fantásticos y revoluciones drásticas políticas que los orillan a tomar duras y difíciles decisiones.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23uQtafsP5P3Q1qQTcZAtck6XjxA1g9w7xUa8FcNKiLYN99WDRmat1c1iBovTn8JYvzFW.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/2533343538648482/)

The novel touches on themes such as class differences and the struggle between them; however, amidst all the chaos, there is still room for love, like the love that blossoms between Clara, the Trueba family's daughter, and the leftist leader Pedro Tercero García. From this union comes Alba, a key figure in the story, the weakest link in the Trueba family, upon whom the blame for her grandfather Esteban's actions falls.

>La novela toca temas como la diferencia de clases y la lucha entre estas, no obstante en medio de todo se caos aun hay espacio para el amor, como ese que surge entre Clara, hija de los Trueba y el líder de izquierda Pedro Tercero García. De esa unión surge Alba, quien es clave en esta historia, es el eslabón más delgado de la familia Trueba sobre la que recaen las culpas de su abuelo Esteban.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23tbiJQbHrA28i1VPtKnLZK6jmqTkHLe18t5Vce3WNQwqdt8azjch64eFmkwS41RGfbTd.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/8585055532582123/)

I won't deny it, I cried a lot with this book because there are many scenes that are hard to stomach, too many injustices, but at the same time, these events reflect the reality of years past. It's no secret that most Latin American haciendas arose from the almost slave labor of peasants, and that the landowners did whatever they wanted with their land and the people who lived on it. They thought they owned the world, capable of moving pieces at will, of even making and removing presidents. But what happens when all those decisions turn against you? Total chaos, karma...

>No se los voy a negar, lloré mucho con este libro porque hay muchas escenas difíciles de digerir, hay demasiadas injusticias, pero al mismo tiempo son estos hechos un reflejo de la realidad que se vivió hace años, para nadie es un secreto que la mayoría de haciendas latinoamericanas surgieron en base a la mano de obra casi esclava campesina, y que los terratenientes hacían lo que querían con sus tierras y las personas que vivían en ella, se creían los dueños del mundo, capaces de mover piezas a su antojo, de quitar y poner incluso presidentes, pero ¿Qué sucede cuando todas esas decisiones se vuelven en tu contra? Un caos total, el karma..
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23uFGszRgQJADkghpUdV3Z45AyWUYHVpGMGk6ss3XE2dUjtkR6QqKUCj9c9NXtRWa2fv3.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/230809549646621108/)

In this way, the novel has a very fascinating narrative that moves between Magical Realism, such as ghosts, clairvoyance, and girls of extraordinary beauty with green hair (like Clara's older sister), and the harsh political reality (the invasion, the bombing, the coup d'état). In this way, magical realism becomes an incentive, a light in the midst of the darkness of Alba's new reality; it is what makes her survive and overcome adversity.

>De esta manera la novela tiene una narrativa muy fascinante que se mueve entre el Realismo Mágico como los fantasmas, clarividencia y chicas de extraordinaria belleza y cabello verde (como la hermana mayor de Clara) y la cruda realidad política (la invasión, el bombardeo, el golpe de estado) de esta manera el realismo mágico se vuelve un aliciente, una luz en medio de las tinieblas de la nueva realidad de Alba, es lo que la hace sobrevivir y superar la adversidad.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/242NwiQvevCi19hDax7AXKtaei1TyxS5mdxF7LHBTF8YNhLXTCEgpMGVvrGndMh1ciVCt.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/790170697163396665/)

It's not a book I would read a second time, as it really impacted me a lot, but I recommend it and believe it should be read at least once in a lifetime.

>No es un libro que yo leería por segunda vez , ya que de verdad me impactó mucho, pero lo recomiendo y considero que se debe leer al menos una vez en la vida.
![_Miniatura de Youtube Procrastinación Simple Dorado y Crema.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/245n5WzTfDjt8QuC1CfX1iGPu5crq9bsYhnHjwPHUAnBL93vKUMEPGEND9gUCyLLvHj4k.jpg)

title.title: Celebrating my aunt's birthday  [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Black Red Horror Stories YouTube Thumbnail.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqnt87JgxR4fxFcqxHdh6t2Q9X134Qk1VTsMPqXAkrLBNX1bbiocxvmxX9nYGq4A8sG.png)
(Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva)
>Cover designed by me in canva editor

Hello dear friends, today I'm excited to share with you this lovely moment we spent as a family with one of my aunts, the youngest. We're all very close and love each other very much. Every weekend when I was little, my mom would take me to my grandfather's house, and I would spend wonderful times with my cousins. My Aunt Elena played a very special role in this, because she was the one who looked after us when our mothers had to go out. My aunt was always that partner in crime who made our games even more fun. >Hola queridos amigos, hoy me entusiasma compartir con ustedes este momento lindo que pasamos en la familia con una de mis tías, la menor de ellas. En casa todos somos muy unidos y nos queremos mucho, todos los fines de semana cuando yo era pequeña, mi mamá me llevaba a casa del abuelo y yo compartía grandes momentos con mis primos. En esto jugó un papel muy especial mi tía Elena, porque ella fue quien cuidó de nosotros cuando nuestras madres tenían que salir a alguna parte, mi tía siempre fue esa cómplice que hacía que nuestros juegos fuesen más divertidos.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.08 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoCgiLpnPNpCqd5BqYWVnT4JCEavC3A26jmwmDbBL23oFYvvgn5ZKbKhm3Ptcb6iSsa.jpeg)

He has always been very protective of us and his advice has always helped me grow, so encouraged by all the love we have for him, his sisters and brother organized a small birthday gathering for him that he really enjoyed; it wasn't anything extravagant, it was just us.

>Siempre ha sido muy protectora con nosotros y sus consejos siempre me han ayudado a crecer, así que alentados por todo ese cariño que le tenemos, sus hermanas y hermano le organizaron una pequeña reunión de cumpleaños que a ella le agradó mucho, no fue nada ostentoso, solo estábamos nosotros.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.09 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoGwxAzFkpXPpACXWryA41bLMA4JyHF2zpNAUTcLMnGB2p6PFURwvzUFepYX2VjktNj.jpeg)

One of my aunts made a healthy zucchini and gluten-free flour cake because my youngest aunt is diabetic, but that didn't make it any less delicious 🤗, it was amazing. My uncle also made some canapés with cream cheese, strawberries, and ham, which were also delicious.

>Una de mis tías le preparó una torta saludable de calabacín y harina sin gluten porque mi tía menor es diabética, pero no por ello estaba menos deliciosa esa torta 🤗, estaba buenísima. Mi tío también preparó algunos canapés con queso crema, fresas y jamón que también estaban deliciosos.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.04 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoiUhgKjagygSiN3Qjrtdqvyp1D9NLSMLk9u7PKyesFgQYYk9Gimgfq8eT3sTnA2CQV.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.10 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EowH9YD82ynrMqvLKi96J537jFH5NqBqX1VWcZPh1t93X8JZZz41jxe8EWT1LazTFZ1.jpeg)

My aunt Elena is usually very funny, so during the chat she was telling us anecdotes that happened to her recently and also sharing with us some funny videos that made her laugh a lot.

>Mi tía Elena suele ser muy graciosa, así que durante la tertulia estuvo contándonos anécdotas que le pasaron recientemente y también compartiendo con nosotros algunos videos graciosos que la hicieron reír mucho 😄.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.09 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xKr2xNYJ2fVRGDpczph9nrxnVvXxJUsa5zMPY9DYPh5x7XM15UTs75QH4B6TehGSDRk.jpeg)

We took lots of photos to upload to the family group chat and share with relatives who couldn't attend and those who live abroad. But of course, we couldn't leave out Uncle Dominguito's jokes and anecdotes… Is it true that every family has a crazy, funny uncle?

>Nos hicimos muchas fotos para subirlas al grupo familiar y compartirlas con los familiares que no pudieron asistir y con los que están en el extranjero. Pero obviamente no podían faltar los chistes y anécdotas del tío Dominguito… ¿Será que en todas las familias hay un tío loco y gracioso?
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.07 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wMabZExERGhkiuJU4RE27acMZR6UBwdhnr1H7e5Cr1zhPGCDn7158uTCWwMMXks6UU4.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.03 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eoc6yJagvep2TUqU56oBRrtx2HH4H55fovrtqBFhkXzdAjUctrY8yvb4E6Yg8g69Ts5.jpeg)

Finally, we cut the cake while singing the traditional \

song. For those who don't know how to sing it, this song is very special in Venezuela because it's the longest and most beautiful version in the world, and each family can add new verses or words according to their taste or custom. In this regard, my Aunt Victoria is the most creative.

>Por último cortamos la torta cantando la tradicional canción del cumpleaños feliz. Para quienes no lo sepan cantar esta canción en Venezuela es muy especial porque es la versión más larga y bonita que existe en el mundo y además cada familia le puede añadir nuevas estrofas o palabras según el gusto o costumbre, y en este sentido mi tía Victoria es la más creativa
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.40.09 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uQtN7EkmoKLz6cqRic68y9W1qrpV38E63yFAFeka6FzHuVW8C7tiEpZz8j2su9k3m12.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.55.39 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EogLqAMm7DMazCQt3zEGCfNFYTwafGTHGa6tQaXPSqFmRjDe112nK1dqfykb6SD3Hqf.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 8.51.53 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Ep1VXbFTHRbCCGkA7EoDtvzTnQJwhg8FFTG4ExoN2q5jZD5x7NHfp1giesTV3bBwiWJ.jpeg)

We had a wonderful time as a family, a gathering full of happy memories and creating new ones, celebrating our aunt's life and wishing her more blessings, health and success.

>Pasamos un gratísimo momento en familia, una tertulia llena de recuerdos felices y construyendo otros recuerdos más, celebrando la vida de nuestra tía y deseando para su vida más bendiciones, salud y éxitos,
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)

title.title: Three Tune Tuesday: Olivia Dean
title.body:
![Three Tune Tuesday Olivia Dean.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/243g96WUJsXogFgNP33cREZEUjXPs1eumMvTPvWyHNYA4ehhF6EoZm1dvPfNznYSoHTa5.png)

Hello. Here I am again to share my entry for Three Tune Tuesday. Aside from Olivia Rodrigo, another Olivia I currently stream is Olivia Dean. If you don't know her, she won Best New Artist at the Grammy Awards. She's been an underground singer for a long time. Now, she's already having her breakthrough moment. Her songs are like fresh air in the music industry, and I love how they feel rhythmic. Here are the songs that I love from her recently.

# Olivia Dean - Man I Need

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oIv_Y2RPQ_A

\
is the third single from her album \

If you analyze the lyrics, it's about sharing her feelings with a guy. It is a fun song since it feels like I'm listening to an old hit song. Of course, our taste in music just changes as time goes by. And of course, it is a bit culturally shocking that we're returning to the old style of a classic hit. It was commercially successful, but it's sad that it only peaked at number 2 on the Billboard Hot 100. Overall, I love it when I want to listen to a not-that-typical love song.

# Olivia Dean - So Easy (Fall In Love)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3sur4BmjQt8

If I’m not mistaken, this is the single that gave her a breakthrough as an artist. The lyrics in this song are not that deep, though. It's about her persuasion that it's easy to fall in love with her. Lyric-wise, it's well-written, and it's my first time loving the jazz-pop genre. No wonder why the lyric \

became popular on TikTok. You should listen to that song if you want to feel light. In addition, incorporating different kinds of love in the music video makes it more unique.

# Olivia Dean - Dive

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NM4e606yFJg

Before she released the hit songs mentioned, she released sad breakup songs first. The track reflects her anxiety about being in a relationship. I love this song as it sounds very groovy and sounds like a hit. Unfortunately, it didn't become a hit, but I'm glad that many discovered this song from her. It feels like she's now having her Chappell Roan moment. If you don't know Chappell, she's the one who sang \
Thank you for reading. I'd love to share my three tunes next Tuesday. Goodbye!

title.title: I dyed my hair [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Beige Modern Beauty Salon Facebook Ad.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xAiMHDon2X5gxwRZuL1Q1LMqPaHbNdEfa1NwkmAYGsQESASnkbDgnxDXworZumFUPss.jpg)

Today I want to show you my new look—well, at least part of it, because in a previous post I shared my new haircut with you. But before that cut, I decided to darken my hair color. My natural hair color is dark brown, but lately I've been using light brown to cover the gray hairs I've had for a while. I usually use natural-based dyes for this, but this time I wanted to be extreme and use the darkest shade, black, which is closer to my natural color (dark brown) because I like how it looks better. >Hoy quiero mostrarles mi cambio de look, bueno, al menos parte, porque en un post anterior compartí con ustedes mi nuevo corte de cabello, pero antes de ese corte yo decidí oscurecer el tono de mi cabello. Mi tono natural de cabello es castaño oscuro pero últimamente yo estuve usando castaño claro para cubrir las canas que tengo desde hace un tiempo, para ello yo siempre suelo usar tintes de origen natural, pero en esta ocasión yo quise ser extremista y usar el tono más oscuro, es decir, el negro, que se asemeja más a mi tono natural (castaño oscuro) porque me gusta más como se ve.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.46 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpA2zi2nSGCt9dSu2DQp9bXKrhVpMU3riWfFTDAjzo7VQBcaUUg7Dh5aNHiJWNy1M18.jpeg)

The product I've been using is this one from Huda Beauty. It's more of a color-depositing shampoo that you apply directly to your hair (like any dye). The box lasts a long time because it contains several sachets and a bag with lots of protective plastic gloves. The dye is avocado-based but also contains other ingredients like herbal ginseng and chrysanthemum, which provide vitamins, proteins, and amino acids.

>El producto que estuve usando es este, de la marca Huda beauty, es más bien un shampoo con color que se aplica directamente sobre las fibras capilares (como cualquier tinte) la caja rinde mucho porque trae varios sachet y una bolsa con muchos guantes de plástico protectores. El tinte está hecho a base de aguacate pero también contiene otros ingredientes como el ginseng herbal y crisantemo, los cuales aportan vitaminas, proteínas y aminoácidos.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 4.35.24 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoAbcQ7wsg2v9rE3Fkx8aZdwvtNE9aKUYEFzvgmn62y9FqKcsAUi16ZT3s97iUJ3Pey.jpeg)

I poured the contents of five sachets into a container. I used five because it was my first time using it, and I also needed to make sure I completely covered the previous color. Notice the intensity of that color; for me, that was a very good sign.

>Yo vertí el contenido de cinco sachets sobre un recipiente, usé cinco porque era la primera vez que lo usaba, además debía asegurarme de cubrir muy bien todo el color anterior. Fíjense en la intensidad de ese color, ara mi esa era una muy buena señal. |![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 4.35.24 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoiVj5JWZLSmZMb5YiiF6L7MF85dmFp1y8mDM3SGeKtSud53y6sEDdy4qoFk7jt2fUd.jpeg)|![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.45 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EokddEPMmgxwST4vQr4JSqBQsVBAumGGMmiXCTvmrEdk1VrGDYZgy2poNfuhmw5VNJC.jpeg)| |-|-|

I put on an old blouse so as not to ruin my good clothes and began to divide strands of hair; look at the color it had, it was about three shades lighter.

>Me puse una blusa vieja para no arruinar mi ropa buena y comencé e dividir mechones de cabello, fíjense en el color que tenía, era mas o menos tres tonos más claro.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.45 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpEHFyJopCW9WjLwJFPTfns4kdZdknUVeEu7biY8kbrpgfNuQ21ofymfYFSpznNJaJG.jpeg)

Then I started applying the new dye. I took a specific amount, using gloves, and distributed it from the roots to the tips of each strand, gradually working my way through all my hair until I finished. The best part is that, since it's natural and ammonia-free, there's no problem leaving it on your head for a long time. I covered it with a plastic bag and waited about 40 or 45 minutes.

>Luego empecé a aplicar el nuevo tinte, para ello tomé una cantidad determinada usando los guantes y lo distribuí desde la raíz hasta la punta de cada mechón, así fui haciendo poco a poco por todo mi cabello hasta terminar. Lo mejor es que como es natural y libre de amoniaco no hay problema con dejarlo mucho tiempo en tu cabeza. Yo lo cubrí con una bolsa de plástico y en mi caso esperé unos 40 o 45 minutos. |![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.43 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/Eou8mmmiZC9Ju7zXdF3MNfNuQLeSvaXBQCvDyR6BEiKvKSoXnQd6e7o3JhnSKvz3TD3.jpeg)|![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.41 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/Eoke4nMewTfvp3VZpeGTqYEwF7DWSYg6HzjjBDQP5KAVnVb32CmDTfhYMNhyWNNm8tY.jpeg)|![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.40 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpJZ6k8THZeePUNzkiLfuv3m6guWegDu4w7y1Laijzto3ew1dKvA3k9ijsFMWi5Sr7X.jpeg)| |-|-|-|

I was surprised to see how quickly it dyed this shade; the fibers quickly began to change from light brown to black, so my expectations soon grew. And although you might think that dyeing hair this color is easy, well, no, the truth is that many times what promises to be \

is more like a dark brown that fades, but this doesn't seem to be the case.

\n\n>Me sorprendió ver la rapidez con la que teñía este tono, las fibras rápidamente empezaron a pasar de castaño claro a negro, así que mis expectativas crecieron pronto, y aunque ustedes quizá puedan pensar que teñir un cabello de este color es sencillo pues no, la verdad es que muchas veces lo que promete ser \

es más bien un castaño oscuro que se destiñe, pero este no parece ser el caso. |![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.40 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpJZ7RM8hhfLfw2NUEJpdD4CSe85Yyy4m6pAEeJWWxBGJndrGQR4tFW1dCMVchp2r35.jpeg)|![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.16.38 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpCBMP5x2BhfyuoSHc65FMUCQUPAwGr1kDRxZDKQd1uqKos12DbdY7nnbTB3f3fcRn9.jpeg)| |-|-|

After that, I simply washed my hair normally, without using shampoo because, as I already told you, this dye is already a shampoo in itself; it has a soapy texture that is activated upon contact with water, meaning a lot of foam starts to come out.

>Después simplemente me lavé el cabello normalmente, sin usar shampoo porque como ya les dije este tinte ya es un shampoo por si solo, tiene una textura jabonosa que se activa al contacto con el agua, osea, empieza a salir mucha espuma.

And well, this was the final result of my new hair color, after leaving the salon where I got my new cut. What do you think? I like it because I feel like I look brighter than before.

>Y bueno este fue el resultado final de mi nuevo color de cabello, luego de salir del salón de belleza donde me hicieron el nuevo corte. ¿Qué les parece? A mi me gusta porque siento que me veo más iluminada que antes.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.53.51 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/2423yipDyd5z6g3QEQRMtun37y5ZuLHVc5hibFhtZqpU5g9gNVVamsno4TvJrRgJdBD7g.jpeg)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

body.title: Little problem with Portos
body.body:
![IMG_3090.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWsLQAFW7Z8sdCULXvEkmQchgnFvBspsHj1yrgMLPM6yy/IMG_3090.jpeg)

Sometimes it seems that everything is under control. Well, it's true - 17 dogs, work, constant work, and I already automatically notice the slightest changes. And then it turns out that no, not everything. And that's what I just hate. It's hard for me to lose control, I can start to panic.

Portos scratched his stomach. I didn't see where exactly. I didn't notice it right away either, and it's, of course, unpleasant. I immediately think in my head: \

. Self-flagellation begins... But to be honest, with so many animals, it's impossible to keep track of every little thing. It's just reality. And I'll probably have to put up with it. But, as I said above, I hate losing control.

At first, the wound looked like nonsense. Nothing serious. I treated it with chlorhexidine. And everything would be fine if I hadn't started licking it later. That's when the inflammation started, and it became clear that you can't pull it. Let's go to the vet.

At first, Portos kept calm. I endured as much as I could. He just looked at me with his own eyes - and everything was read there. But then he staged a performance. The three of us kept him so that the vet could do everything necessary.

The vet prescribed treatment, treatment and, of course, a collar. This is taking into account the root cause of the problem - Portos' love for self-treation!

And he didn't like it at all 😄 He walks in this collar like an elephant in a crockery shop, clings to everything, obviously doesn't understand what he's for. He looks with the expression: \

. Very expressive, I must say.\n\nBut there is no choice. It's better to endure a little inconvenience than to treat something more serious later. Portos will get better, of course. But it seems that he will show resentment for the collar for some time 😄 And it also seems to me that he is shy of other dogs, that he has to walk in this collar. He is trying to be the leader of our family-pack and, probably, he thinks it's humiliating for himself to wear this collar.

body.body: > ![yamu_jay-ai-generated-9214143_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ1NupgdFW8LtKpb2ZhvtAxGQamx1maBPVjJEZTMkPM2X/yamu_jay-ai-generated-9214143_1920.jpg) Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. Today, the secondary exam has started in our country, which is abbreviated as SSC. Elections were held in our country in February, and since then a new government has come. The new government has taken various steps to improve the education sector. And this takes us to a different horizon. We want our education sector to be much better and a much larger budget to be given here. Corruption has been present in our country for a long time in the education sector. Earlier, there was a lot of corruption in the SSC exam. Especially incidents like question paper leakage used to happen, which were very disappointing for the students of our country. Due to the question paper leakage on the night before the exam, those who are really talented students became very disappointed. Then it was seen that the exam was not evaluated properly. There are various education boards in our country. These are basically regional education boards. If the questions were leaked before the exam, then sometimes the exams were postponed in those education boards and those exams were taken later. But now it has reduced a lot. There are also many other reasons such as cheating in exams. This was basically a best method in the 90s for students to adopt unfair methods in exams. Many used to adopt unfair methods even by avoiding the eyes of the teachers who were guarding the exam hall. Many people used to pass the exam in this way. However, in the SSC exam, the adoption of unfair methods has reduced a lot. The candidates now study according to their merit and then take the exam. Currently, the exam guard has become very hard, but in my opinion, it is not right to do so. Our country's education system needs to be further improved. Good teachers are needed, good labs are needed so that students can take technical education. If students study in a good environment, then they will definitely not need to adopt unfair methods anymore. They need knowledge so that students can be realistic. It is hoped that our current government's Education Minister will give special consideration to this aspect. He is trying hard to make our country better in the education sector. I hope you will like my post, thank you all. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [source this picture link]( https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-school-exam-students-9214143/ ) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/there-is-no-end-to-corruption-and-errors-in-the-ssc-exams-in-our-country-eip)

body.title: 🌊 El problema no es la ola - es cómo decides enfrentarla [Esp - Eng] 🌊 The problem is not the wave — it’s how you choose to face it
body.body:
>  

Feliz martes para toda esta hermosa comunidad de #EmpowerTalent. Un abrazo para cada uno, y un agradecimiento especial a @angelica7 por su constancia y por mantener este espacio lleno de motivación semana tras semana.

Esta semana, cuando leí el tema ***“La Ola”,*** no pude evitar pensar en todo lo que representa en la vida. Porque hay momentos en los que todo parece tranquilo, y de repente llega esa ola que lo cambia todo. No avisa, no pregunta, simplemente llega y es ahí donde uno se da cuenta de algo importante: el problema no es la ola, es cómo decides enfrentarla y queda en ti si la surfeas o simplemente la dejas pasar.
________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSSVHcXfEefD9RJY5cZYjvELyCpJpfjE37DbhhoZWjPtd/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*
________

Nací, me crié y viví en Puerto Cabello, una ciudad pegada al mar, donde la brisa del Caribe forma parte de tu vida desde que abres los ojos. Mi casa quedaba a cinco minutos caminando de la playa, así que imaginarás lo que eso significa para un muchacho. Ese olor salado que llega con el viento, los amaneceres que pintaban el cielo de rojo y los atardeceres que parecían un espectáculo diario eran parte de mi rutina. Yo vivía en el mar, me bañaba casi todos los días, y como buen porteño, crecí viendo a los más grandes enfrentarse a las olas, estudiarlas, analizarlas, buscando el momento exacto para entrarle y mantenerse en la cresta sin caer.
________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbWFFtagGZBtR9RD6ir2P7ACYVyKEuZ5fLwBNc88YuStK/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*
________

Desde pequeño entendí que el mar no es juego. Una ola mal tomada te revolcaba sin piedad, te hacía tragar agua con arena, te quitaba la visión y lo único que te quedaba era aguantar la respiración y luchar por salir a flote. Y aun así, después de cada golpe, uno volvía a entrar. Porque eso era parte del aprendizaje, caer, levantarse y volver a intentarlo. Ese era mi día a día, una y otra vez, sin miedo, con respeto, pero con esa mentalidad de seguir. Sin saberlo, la vida ya me estaba enseñando lo que más adelante iba a necesitar para sobrevivir a las verdaderas olas.
___________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmQdC1sQsbuNzF8MzQ8buARe655wv1aLYYx5aRT5fkUu/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*

___________

Pero nada te prepara completamente para la ola de la vida. Esa no la ves venir, no la puedes medir ni analizar como en el mar. Esa llega sin aviso y te golpea donde más duele. Me tocó dejar mi país, empezar de cero, enfrentar trabajos duros, responsabilidades grandes, momentos donde el mundo se te viene encima y tienes que decidir si te quedas hundido o buscas la forma de salir. Perdí cosas que no se recuperan, viví situaciones que no se olvidan, y allí fue donde entendí que no bastaba con saber nadar, había que aprender a resistir, a respirar en medio del caos y a no rendirse cuando todo se pone oscuro. Y hubo momentos, te lo digo claro, donde la vida se sintió como esa tormenta perfecta, donde las olas no vienen una sola vez, sino una detrás de otra, más grandes, más fuertes, tratando de sacarte del juego. Allí no hay espacio para el miedo, allí solo queda aferrarte a lo que eres, mantener la calma y luchar por salir, aunque todo alrededor parezca perdido.
____________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSHGpniSSShXVeVnoQuAA4cUovveFwuxmPjPd8EqD12jS/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*
____________

Y es ahí donde todo cobra sentido. Porque así como en el mar, en la vida también decides si te quedas abajo o vuelves a la superficie. Yo elegí volver, una y otra vez. Elegí seguir, adaptarme, reconstruirme, encontrar nuevas formas de avanzar. Hoy entiendo que cada golpe, cada caída y cada ola que me revolcó, también me enseñó a mantenerme en pie. Y hoy puedo decirlo con una sonrisa, ya soy internacional, porque ahora me encuentro surfeando olas gigantes en Argentina, y mira que olas, pero enfrentándolas con responsabilidad, con carácter y con decisión. Siempre de la mano de Dios, sosteniendo a mi familia, arropándolos en cada momento y llevándolos, poco a poco, a puerto seguro. Porque al final, la vida es eso, un constante ir y venir de olas, algunas suaves, otras enormes, pero siempre con la misma pregunta: ***¿te vas a dejar llevar o vas a aprender a surfearlas?***

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y al final, uno entiende que las olas no van a dejar de venir. Algunas serán suaves, otras vendrán con fuerza para sacudirte por completo, pero siempre estarán ahí. La diferencia no está en evitarlas, sino en cómo decides pararte frente a ellas.

Hoy te dejo esta pregunta: ¿cómo estás enfrentando las olas que te pone la vida? ***¿Te estás dejando arrastrar, o estás aprendiendo a mantenerte en pie y avanzar?***

Gracias por llegar hasta aquí. Te leo en la caja de comentarios. Un abrazo grande para todos.
____

3\. Enhanced Comfort and Design
 Properties such as Willis Graves Bed and Breakfast emphasize elegant interiors, spacious rooms, and thoughtful décor. This creates a premium feel that goes beyond the standardized layout of most hotels.

4\. High-Quality Dining Experience
 A standout feature of bed and breakfasts is the inclusion of freshly prepared meals. Guests can enjoy a home-style breakfast made with local ingredients—an advantage rarely matched by airport hotels.

Strategic Location Benefits

Choosing accommodation near the airport doesn’t mean compromising on experience. Staying in Burlington, Kentucky offers a balanced approach—proximity to the airport along with access to key attractions. Guests can conveniently explore destinations such as the Ark Encounter and the Creation Museum.

Additionally, the vibrant city of Cincinnati is just a short drive away, providing opportunities for dining, shopping, and entertainment.

Making the Right Choice

From a strategic standpoint, selecting between traditional hotels near Cincinnati airport and a bed and breakfast depends on your travel objectives. If speed and functionality are your only priorities, standard hotels may suffice. However, if you value comfort, personalization, and a more enriching stay, a bed and breakfast offers a superior alternative.

Conclusion

The hospitality landscape near Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport is evolving. While hotels continue to serve a purpose, bed and breakfasts are redefining guest expectations by delivering a blend of convenience and elevated comfort.

By choosing a property like Willis Graves Bed and Breakfast, travelers can transform a routine overnight stay into a meaningful and memorable experience—without compromising on proximity to the airport.

body.body:
![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23vhwKZEKasy6PmCCvVwZDdSSMeyMyzGbk8UdiCr4WXNMz5vk52KwMAKJjEtUPHSc1Eek.png)


Hello everyone! Hope you all are doing great.
I had a lot going on these past few months, so I could not really play #Splinterlands. However, today I decided to finally get back to the game.
So, in this post I would be sharing some cards that I rented and a battle review of a really intense match that I played today. Plus, I also purchased some credits so I would be talking about that as well.


![purchased credits.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23swiP6d3YjFz6z4bY66Bjq1VD6v8zHbfr5d3mep672NYeaFWQMmRrpmpRy4EUdnavXrU.png)

Anyway, I didn’t want to waste time just looking around. I came with a plan. I went ahead and purchased 3000 credits to get things moving again. I knew if I wanted to actually compete in Modern ranked, I needed some decent cards.


![card rentals menu.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23wWpaYuqaQbLmdikMagKL8oAb7TWFP6vt7MUQEjYQTt3TZyUbmE5njhU3JLiv29nFR6Y.png)

After getting the credits, I jumped straight into renting cards. Now THIS part took longer than I expected. Prices were all over the place, and I had to carefully choose what fits my budget. I was going to play some Modern ranked battles so I had to rent cards of the Rebellion and Conclave Arcana sets.


![rented cards 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/Ep7tBNuELknFg8w9Q6Wwznumv7TMMs4RSQj6rmqoHoRnUECB6w3wYGBZFQ5czWUu5cA.png)

![rented cards 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23xKn3fMJtQxz5VeiceEzKmRUBhFSX2h7RKSgXx1bkbnMEwggXccoqNZ5mvRWnjqgQ1sA.png)

These are the cards that I rented. I went all out and spent all my credits :) I went for a mix mix of Earth and Life units. The most expensive one was my Archon, **Eternal Tofu**. I purposely purchased it because my archon has to be strong because it's the base of the team and it is also dual element. I can use it for both Earth and Life battles.

# 𝐅𝐈𝐑𝐒𝐓 𝐁𝐀𝐓𝐓𝐋𝐄


![ranked battle screen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23uEquXa6chK65US6CEuXgp48mW5YtGqzmmoHLLyqWb1o3DSsZpLYcjcg6Qi7z3Fbdut9.png)

Once everything was ready, I queued for my first ranked battle. Not gonna lie, I was a bit nervous 😅 Like, what if I completely forgot how to play properly? What if I lose badly in my first match back? That would be kinda embarrassing.


![battle overview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/Eo1xQXt53Sm5r5Z1K4EcSKg199XCzhkNFfD1vSWpRxPiTRdPe2nGNhdk2vRcbpyqqvK.png)

The rulesets were pretty simple and fair. Mana cap was 30 and I could use any element cards. I was actually pretty excited as well because I could test the new cards that I rented. 

The battle was fairly easy. My opponent did not have lots of cards in the match, so I beat him pretty easily. BUT BOY MY TEAM WAS STRONG. They went for a clean sweep. I think it was because my rank is pretty low right now that's why my opponent's team was pretty weak.


![victory screen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rookie2001/23vhMZYtzAaixoQu6aPBKUR346jZd7mjFcXM5J1fNKAfus3B2ftpsq7bzZTFjUsTmudgr.png)

After the victory I realized something, taking a break isn’t always bad. Coming back made the game feel fresh again. Like I’m rediscovering it.
I think the next step for me is staying consistent and learn the current meta again. Also, I might start sharing more of my battles here. Not just wins, but losses too. I think that’s where real learning happens.

Well, I guess this is it for this post. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente refrescante. Comencé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde encontré a un grupo de jóvenes practicando acrobacias en patineta. Sus risas y la energía del lugar me contagiaron. Uno de ellos, un chico llamado Lucas, me contó que hay una competencia de skate el próximo fin de semana, y me invitó a pasar a ver. Continué mi camino hacia un café pequeño que me encanta. En el trayecto, me topé con una artista callejera pintando un mural colorido. Su nombre era Clara y compartió que se inspira en la naturaleza para sus obras. Me hizo reflexionar sobre cómo el arte puede transformar un espacio urbano. Al final de mi caminata, me senté en una banca y disfruté de un café mientras observaba a la gente pasar, cada uno con su propia historia. Esta ciudad siempre me sorprende con cosas nuevas y gente inspiradora. ¡Definitivamente volveré a recorrer esos lugares! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Before you judge, before you post, consider the impact.
body.body:
It was yesterday that I was watching a video of a well known entrepreneur lashing out her frustration because of the online trolling. She was getting a lot of abusive message on her social media account because she shared about the benefit of offering namaz. There was nothing wrong yet she is facing backlashes. She was literally crying because of the bullying she faced. Bullying is purposeful behavior intended to cause pain emotional, social, or physical. It always leave a heavy amount of distress in the people minds


![20260406_063520(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eq7LpeFdKHoQ18FZ9kUmFSUqGPcPjh1M3NVU5pdvfR6VNT8gddKqP8sLEdNH1gpwPds.jpg)
*(own edited image)*

I remember, I was facing a lot of backlashes too in my childhood due to my overweight body. Kids from.all age group use to pinch me and ran away. It was physical torture that faced for a longer period in my childhood. Untill I stand against the torture. The scenarios have changed and bullying are done through online. But there is a always a point of discussion, about the level of harm it will bring to the person. Both physical and online bullying are deeply harmful, often causing long term emotional, mental, and physical health issues. Physical bullying presents an immediate threat to physical safety, while online bullying is uniquely damaging because it is 24/7, allows for anonymity, and can reach a massive audience, often providing no safe space for the victim. There are many online social media account that were deactivated just because the.user unable to bear the burnt of the online bullying. 

> ***Bullying isn’t a rite of passage. It’s trauma that follows you home.***


Bullying, both physical and online, is a deliberate, repetitive action aimed at establishing power, dominance, or control over another person, often stemming from the bully's own insecurities, jealousy, or desire for social status. Perpetrators often act out of peer pressure, a need for control, or to feel popular, with cyberbullying amplified by anonymity and the ability to cause distress from a distance. Physical bullying typically requires the bully to have a direct advantage in physical size, strength, or social, popular power. Whereas, online bullying is motivated by the ability to remain anonymous, the ability to act without seeing the victim's reaction, and the belief that it is \

or a game. 

Either physical or online each of them have their level of effects in the victims mind.


> *Online bullying can be worse because, it can be relentless, with content going viral instantly, creating permanent damage to reputation. Victims feel inescapable persecution, often leading to severe anxiety and suicidal ideation. The anonymity of the perpetrator can make it more ruthless.*


> *Physical bullying can be worse, as it causes immediate bodily harm and fear, causing intense, direct trauma. The immediate threat to life and safety can create profound, instant terror.*


People are often targeted for being \
such as differences in appearance, race, religion, or social status. Ultimately, both are incredibly damaging, and the \

one depends on the nature and extent of the abuse experienced by the individual. Both can lead to long-lasting mental health issues, including depression, anxiety, and low self-esteem. 





**In good faith - Peace!!**

body.title: Food Subscription Boxes: Benefits, Challenges, and Shopify Recurring Revenue
body.body:
You’ve built a great food product. Customers love it, and orders are coming in. But every month still begins the same way, running ads again and chasing new customers. This is why many Shopify food brands are turning to subscription boxes to create more predictable and sustainable growth.

From snack boxes to pantry staples and meal kits, subscriptions help build recurring revenue while strengthening customer loyalty. Instead of relying on one-time purchases, brands can deliver products automatically and build long-term relationships with customers.

[Food subscriptions](https://easysubscription.io/?utm_source=Forum\&utm_medium=KR\&utm_campaign=organic/) are growing because customers value convenience and consistency. Automatic deliveries remove the need to reorder and make purchasing easier. For merchants, this leads to more predictable revenue, higher customer lifetime value, better inventory planning, and reduced reliance on paid marketing. Even small [Shopify stores](https://apps.shopify.com/easy-subscription/?utm_source=Forum\&utm_medium=KR\&utm_campaign=organic/) are successfully launching subscription programs by focusing on niche audiences and repeat-purchase products.

Subscription models also bring strong business benefits. Recurring income improves forecasting, while regular deliveries keep customers engaged with the brand. This helps increase average order value, reduce marketing costs, and build long-term customer loyalty.

However, subscriptions also come with challenges. Customer churn is common as preferences change over time. Shipping and packaging logistics require careful planning, especially for food products. As businesses grow, managing billing cycles, failed payments, and delivery updates can become more complex. Competition is also increasing, making it important to offer a unique and valuable subscription experience.

To improve retention, many brands offer flexible options such as skip, pause, and adjustable delivery schedules. These features help customers stay subscribed longer and reduce cancellations.

Popular food subscription models include snack and curated boxes, pantry staple subscriptions like [coffee subscriptions ](https://easysubscription.io/blog/food-subscription-boxes-benefits-and-challenges/?utm_source=Forum\&utm_medium=KR\&utm_campaign=organic/)and spices, meal kit subscriptions, and prepared meal deliveries. Choosing the right model depends on your product type, fulfilment capabilities, and customer expectations.

---

---

In crypto, one moment can change everything.

A chart goes vertical.
People rush in.
Hope turns into excitement.

But what most don’t realize is this:

«The moment you feel “this is the opportunity”…
might be the exact moment you become the exit.»

---

⚠️ THE MOST DANGEROUS PHASE: THE PUMP

A rapid price increase looks like success.

But in many cases, it is carefully structured.

- Early buyers already hold large positions
- Momentum is used to attract attention
- Retail investors enter at higher prices

And while the crowd is buying…

Someone else is preparing to sell.

---

---

Let’s make it simple.

When you buy during a hype phase, ask yourself:

👉 Who are you buying from?

Because in reality:

- Your buy = someone else’s sell
- Your entry = their exit

This is what we call exit liquidity.

And most people don’t even realize
they are playing that role.

---

📉 THE DISTRIBUTION MOMENT

Not all dumps happen instantly.

Sometimes, the market pauses.

The price moves sideways.
It feels stable. Even safe.

But behind that calm surface…

Large holders are slowly selling.

---

---

- A big red candle appears
- Panic begins
- Liquidity disappears
- Price collapses

And just like that…

«The opportunity is gone.
But the losses remain.»

---

Because people are chasing speed.

Fast gains.
Quick profits.
Instant results.

But markets don’t reward impatience.

They reward:

- Structure
- Discipline
- Long-term thinking

Anything built too fast…
can fall even faster.

RPEPE is not designed to:

- Pump quickly
- Attract short-term hype
- Collapse after attention fades

👉 Create stability before growth
👉 Build trust before momentum

body.title: Is altitude sickness a real concern in Upper Mustang?
body.body:
![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/142c19df7573ff31786a475da8ca1fe1c947d5b406136c73b40d65d1e1c156c0)

Altitude sickness is a genuine consideration when traveling to Upper Mustang, as the region sits above 3,000 meters. During an [Upper Mustang motorcycle tour](https://www.brahmandtour.com/nepal-upper-mustang-motorbike-tour), riders gradually ascend through varying elevations, which can affect oxygen levels in the body. While not everyone experiences symptoms, awareness and preparation are essential for a safe journey. When planning a Motorcycle tour from India, understanding early signs helps prevent complications.

*   \- Common symptoms include

*   \- Headache and dizziness

*   \- Shortness of breath

*   \- Nausea or fatigue

*   \- Difficulty sleeping at higher altitudes

Recognizing these signs early allows riders to take necessary precautions and avoid further risk.

To prevent altitude sickness during an Upper Mustang Motorbike Tour,

*   \- Important measures include

*   \- Gradual ascent with rest stops

*   \- Staying hydrated throughout the ride

*   \- Avoiding alcohol during high-altitude travel

*   \- Listening to your body and resting when needed

A well-planned Upper Mustang Motorbike Tour includes proper acclimatization and pacing.

For those seeking a motorcycle tour in Asia, Upper Mustang remains a rewarding destination. With the right preparation, riders can enjoy breathtaking landscapes while minimizing health risks and ensuring a comfortable adventure.

body.title: The Future, From Our Perspective, Is Weird
body.body: ![FutureChanges.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8GNejtM8umNkHRS1B7J66G7jzV1Eaw5567LsPFuWVb8/FutureChanges.png) Imagine a world where incomes go up AND house prices go down. Imagine a world where people weren't trying to find utopia, but instead craved new experiences and good bit of chaos in their lives. Imagine a world where everyone's basic needs were met, and many un-basic needs were fairly standard in most people's lives. This is actually the near future, and really, just the beginning of improvements.

></center>
## We are so used to the buying from the company store, that we don't know what freedom of markets looks like

We have no clue what the actual cost of anything is.  Chevy is selling trucks for $100,000!  But, on the other side of the world, Toyota has a basic truck for $10,000.  What is worth $90,000 more?  How much extra metal and plastic is being used??? Both trucks have 4 wheels, 1 engine, 1 drivetrain.  Is an 8 cylinder engine 10x as costly as a 4 cylinder engine?  The answer really is that there is not $90,000 more worth of truck there.

What is the difference between a $500 refrigerator and a $2500 refrigerator.  Yes, one looks better, and the other plain and boring.  But the parts that do the work are all the same.  And why are 20 year old refrigerators having a higher life expectancy than new ones?

Most products in stores have a 10x markup.  That $1 can of corn at the dollar store, cost them less than 10¢ each (in pallet quantities)

Everything has so much markup, and is designed to fail, so it will be replaced soon.  We have no idea what a quality part would cost.  No one manufacturers them to have a price comparison.  All we have is what it would cost for a single person to custom build it.

In the future, we will have local manufacturing, meaning also local replacement parts and an item that is designed to repaired.  And, with every improvement in the product, it will be better and cheaper, and the open source community will be sharing that improvement everywhere.

As free markets actually start forming, we will find that \

goods just keep getting cheaper. And without the ludicrous amount of money printing, there would be nothing keep the prices high. (Yes, inflation, while we are manufacturing products cheaper and cheaper is ludicrous)\n\n
></center>\n## Stocks and Bonds are ludicrous, insane, and no one will \

in them

First, corporations, the legal entity, is evil.  Allowing someone/something to externalize costs and internalize gains is just asking for people to abuse society.

Next, why would anyone sell their business?  This is a bit tricky to explain.
1. there will be almost no barrier to entry.
2. the business is something you love, else you wouldn't be doing it.
3. It's the \

business. This means that there is little reason to buy a business, and less of a reason to ever sell it. Third, the only way a corporation goes up in price (not value) is because of inflation. The money printer goes to the big corporations, and that goes to the stock markets. When the money printer crashes, and the stock market is shut down for fraud, then we will see stock's true colors. Large corporations only exist because they can shut out competition by buying politicians. They can only get big because they can borrow money far cheaper than everyone else. (banksters helping banksters) And, really think about bonds. How can a govern-cement pay interest on bonds? Only by printing more money. Govern-cements do not create anything, they only steal. Without money printing, govern-cements quickly find that they can't afford to pay bonds. Soon, stocks and bonds will be seen as worthless. Further, they will start to be seen as evil. Evil people doing evil things. To be avoided by good people. Besides, bitcoin will outperform all the stocks and bonds, and cost nothing to maintain. Can you imagine a world without stocks and bonds?

> ## We actually get tech that makes a real difference We will soon have flying, or at least, hovering cars. I know that this isn't that big of a reveal, but, why have we been riding around on tires for almost 100 years? Almost nothing has changed in engines in the last 30 years. Just more smog sensor regulations. But, imagine just throwing out the drive train. No drive shafts, no gear boxes, no tires or suspension. The new car will be extremely simple. And, i believe they will first be built in garages, and will stay being built in garages. Chevrolet will be a has-been. We have been burning stuff for electricity for over 100 years. We will soon have electrical production that is non-polluting and continuous. The grid will be gone. It falls apart, and people find that locally producing electricity is a much better plan than trying to maintain the grid. A million independent systems, instead of one big, really complicated system. Instead of self driving trucks, which is almost impossible because you really need someone there to load and unload. However, self driving trains are very easy. So easy that we will have something like self driving box cars, not one big long train. Each individual car will be self propelled and part of an AI network that works out routing. Train tracks are much easier to maintain then miles of black asphalt. Further, we may have these tracks off the ground, so that animals can roam underneath, so we do not block migration paths, and the animals do not get in the way of the train cars. There will be so many neat innovations. It will seem like sci-fi world has come to life. We may actually get the cool world that was drawn up in the 50s. I, for one, am really depressed that most of our cars are white, gray or black. And the car designs, boring.

> So much changes in the next few decades. All the bigs collapse, and we build stuff that works from their ashes. We will have free markets and real money. This changes so many things. Really, people's incomes will go up, and their living expenses will be going down. With the banksters our of the way, we will find just how much the banksters stole from people. The 10 hour work weak will become normal. That is 10 hours of taking care of your crops and livestock. Not working for money to be able to buy crappy, poisoned food, but actual work that results in actual food. Food that is good for you. Food that is under your control. This results in many people being much less stressed. People will be living longer and healthier. The 40 hour work week, working for a large corporation, where you spend so much of your life driving to and from work, and the feeling that you are a slave to the system, will be gone. And with that, the whole world will seem to have changed.

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

body.body:
![Non animated Header Donations.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ravenmus1c/48EJqq5CZRcbhFgWyXvYqE6z6mV4xgEC3ZK9e35GoK22KDvp2ogJYTRETtXUzJqBcZ.jpg)
DEUTSCHE Version hier

###### Hallo ihr Lieben! 😊 Wie geht es euch? Es ist Zeit für einen neuen Spenden-Post! 😊😍 Ich weiß, ich bin aktuell nicht besonders aktiv auf Hive. Aber im Hintergrund bereite ich gerade sehr viel vor – zum Beispiel erstelle ich hunderte Shorts für unser Label Panda Beats, weil wir anfangen möchten, unser Label etwas mehr zu promoten. ###### Außerdem habe ich mir eine Deadline bis Ende des Jahres gesetzt, um meinen neuen Musik-Channel **\

** vorzubereiten. 🐶🐱🎶 Ich produziere entspannende Musik für Tiere. Ich nutze diese Art von Musik auch selbst, wenn ich meinen Hund für ein paar Stunden alleine lassen muss. Ich glaube, es hilft ihr, entspannter zu bleiben. Mein Plan ist es, etwa 60–70 verschiedene Tracks vorzubereiten, damit ich genug Content habe, um jede Woche auf YouTube hochladen zu können. Außerdem habe ich einen zweiten Producer mit an Bord, der mir beim Produzieren hilft, weil es einfach sehr viel Arbeit ist. Und meine Freundin unterstützt mich beim Grafikdesign. ###### Neben der Musik muss ich natürlich auch Videos produzieren. Da es sehr aufwendig wäre, dafür eigenes Material zu filmen, habe ich mich entschieden, Bilder mit KI zu erstellen und diese anschließend mit einer anderen KI zu animieren. Ich bin eigentlich kein großer Fan von all dem KI-Zeug, aber ich habe gemerkt, dass es aktuell meine einzige realistische Möglichkeit ist, so viel Content zu erstellen. Es ist der einzige Weg, um so einen Channel überhaupt umsetzen zu können – also habe ich akzeptiert, dass ich dafür KI nutzen muss. Neben den Videos möchte ich auch Shorts erstellen, um das Projekt auf YouTube, TikTok und Pinterest zu promoten. ###### Ich werde mindestens 50 % aller Einnahmen an Tierschutzorganisationen spenden, deshalb bedeutet mir dieses Projekt sehr viel. Es wird mir helfen, noch mehr Geld spenden zu können. Ich gebe mein Bestes, alles so gut wie möglich vorzubereiten, und hoffe wirklich, dass es erfolgreich wird. Im Moment investiere ich also den Großteil meiner Zeit in diese Vorbereitung (neben Live-Musik und Kundenaufträgen 😄). ###### Drückt mir bitte die Daumen für mein Projekt – und dafür, dass wir viel Geld für gute Zwecke spenden können. ❤️ ___ In der Zwischenzeit habe ich wieder etwas Geld an einen Hunde- und Katzen-Tierschutzverein in Deutschland gespendet. Sie haben ein limitiertes Portemonnaie verkauft – und natürlich hilft das Geld dabei, sich um die Tiere zu kümmern. Ich finde es richtig schön und liebe die Idee, etwas zu kaufen, das ich selbst nutzen kann, und gleichzeitig etwas Gutes zu tun! ###### Alles über meine Tierschutz-Initiative könnt ihr in [diesem Post](https://peakd.com/hive-149312/@ravenmus1c/first-hive-money-donated-to-flipper-all-nft-sales-will-go-into-donation) lesen. Danke auch an @elevator09, dass du mich in dein Charity-Projekt aufgenommen hast! Ich weiß das sehr zu schätzen und bin unglaublich froh, dass ich auf diese Weise zumindest ein bisschen Gutes für Tiere tun kann! #### Danke an alle, die mich bisher unterstützt haben – und an alle, die diese Initiative noch unterstützen möchten! ❤️🙏 Lasst uns gemeinsam ein paar Tiere retten... Und vergesst nicht: Wenn ihr euch ein Tier holen möchtet: #### Adoptieren statt kaufen! ### RAVEN 🐦 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ravenmus1c/23tmKrtg6CktXNpF2Sn8UMs3miyTzu4FMBW8KsjqSGJakdYedgPrC6VDyhyP6hPNDGdQs.png)

###### Hello everyone! 😊 How are you doing? It´s time for another donation post! 😊😍 I know I am not very active in Hive at the moment. But I am preparing alot of stuff in the background, such as creating hundreds of shorts for our label Panda Beats - because we want to start promoting our label a bit more. ###### Also I set myself a deadline till the end of the year to prepare my new music channel **\

I produce relaxing music for animals. I often use this kind of music myself when I have to leave my dog alone for a few hours. I think it helps her stay more relaxed.

My plan is to prepare around 60-70 different tracks of music, to have enough content to be able to upload to YouTube every week. I also have a second producer on board that helps me produce, because it´s alot of work. And my girlfriend helps me with graphical design.

###### Apart from the audio, I also need to produce videos. 
As this can be very challenging when starting to film material, I decided to create pictures with AI and then animate them with another AI.
I am not a big fan of all this AI stuff, but I realised that this is mainly my only option when wanting to create that much material. It will be the only way to be able to open up such a channel, so I accepted that I need to use AI. 

Apart from the videos, I also want to create Shorts, so I can promote the project in YouTube, TikTok and Pinterest.

I really like it, and buying something that I can use and helping charity at the same time is a great thing!
