title.title: (ESP-ENG)Foami rose candy holders🌹💐🎁🥰🍫❤️✂️
title.body:
> ![1000255213.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXJ6cXLnHMv5XYQdK2tPULHv9BfK6YFbFuyzDeDH2ffq3sKLe5M38pxPwzvpSmL87po.png) **Holis gente bonita|Hello beautiful people**🥰 Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una manualidad muy bonita que hice para regalar y me encantó porque hace mucho quería aprender a hacer este tipo de rosas porta bombones, 🥰 estoy amando mi proceso de aprendizaje porque poco a poco estoy aprendiendo a hacer cosas que jamás creí poder hacer. >Today I want to share with you a really pretty craft I made as a gift, and I loved it because I’ve wanted to learn how to make these kinds of chocolate-holder roses for a long time. 🥰 I’m loving this learning process because, little by little, I’m learning to do things I never thought I could do. Recuerdo que hace años atrás cuando me había resignado a estudiar una carrera que no me gustaba, veía tutoriales de manualidades hermosas y con tristeza pensaba que jamás lograría aprender a hacerlas, por eso cada pequeño logró, cada pequeño aprendizaje para mí es muy significativo. ❤️🥰 > I remember that years ago, when I had resigned myself to studying a major I didn’t like, I would watch tutorials for beautiful crafts and sadly think that I’d never be able to learn how to make them. That’s why every little achievement, every little thing I learn, means so much to me. ❤️🥰 Está vez no me quiero entender mucho con la introducción así que los dejo con la lista de materiales y el paso a paso, espero que les guste. 💓 >I don't want to go on too long with the introduction this time, so I'll just leave you with the list of materials and the step-by-step instructions. I hope you like it. 💓 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png)
🌹**Materiales|Materials**🌹
![1000255447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AK2EP3pj3Txmt9JvMRjPRJFPdQL9onz7dJ7xYzbneZVWnnbAUfNJjboD5NeqmdS.jpg) * Foami escarchado rosado. * Foami escarchado verde. * Foami escarchado blanco. * Papel crepé verde. * Tijera. * Silicón * Pistola de silicón. * Plancha. * Palillos de altura. * Moldes circulares. - - - * Pink frosted foam. * Green frosted foam. * White frosted foam. * Green crepe paper. * Scissors. * Silicone. * Silicone gun. * Iron. * Long toothpicks. * Round molds. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png)
🌹**Paso a paso**|**Step-by-step**🌹
![1000255448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AKPmYd2dVFdujTm1f48xb4c1xZ32pijyVvGJxknZobXbMHb3GgVVoDi5q4tB6PK.jpg) El primer paso fue sacar todas las piezas en foami, para los pétalos de la rosa, saque dos piezas circulares de foami rosado escarchado de 10 Cm de diámetro cada uno. También saque otro círculo pero en foami escarchado verde de 6 Cm de diámetro que será el sépalo de la rosa, para las piezas circulares uso unos moldes que hice yo misma. También saque dos rectángulos de 4x8 Cm de foami escarchado verde para hacer las hojas. Y esas son todas las piezas en foami que se necesitan para hacer estás hermosa rosas. >The first step was to cut out all the foam pieces. For the rose petals, I cut out two circular pieces of frosted pink foam, each 10 cm in diameter. I also cut out another circle, this time from frosted green foam, 6 cm in diameter, which will be the rose’s sepal. For the circular pieces, I used some templates I made myself. I also cut out two 4x8 cm rectangles from green frosted foam to make the leaves. And those are all the foam pieces needed to make these beautiful roses. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AKJ2D1ce3SStC2QVtya2VNf4aWNantEwYz6y11Pc9oLDQJJjjFbTJHqCsX8ApXz.jpg) Luego de tener las piezas recortadas comencé a formar los pétalos de la rosa y para eso dividi los dos círculos rosados en cinco partes, cada una de esas 5 partes será un pétalo, luego con la ayuda de la tijera y como pueden ver en la imagen, redondee cada una de esas 5 partes para definir los pétalos. >Once I had cut out the pieces, I began shaping the rose petals. To do this, I divided the two pink circles into five sections; each of these five sections would become a petal. Then, using scissors—as you can see in the image—I rounded off each of these five sections to define the petals. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/EoCk64sh3ihxuC5gMd56G8jXg5svd1gUSXBsxGP8Skx8XPM6rkenychehKiV2MShCYL.jpg) Luego con la plancha les di más forma de pétalos, redondeando las puntas hacía atrás para darle un toque más natural, la verdad el paso de la plancha siempre me causa un poco de ansiedad, creo que es porque me da miedo quemarme, pero debo admitir que sin este paso quedarían unas rosas muy planas. >Then I used the flat iron to shape them more like petals, rounding the tips backward to give them a more natural look. To be honest, using the flat iron always makes me a little anxious—I think it’s because I’m afraid of burning myself—but I have to admit that without this step, the roses would end up looking very flat. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJoLC9U5kHDe3vWMuWimDGhx8vX52gZKcD597M5wuh3HN1JtfWacDPTfDdnMspL.jpg) Luego comencé a unir cada pétalo entre si, pueden ver cada círculo será una capa de pétalos de la rosa, pero hay diferencias entre ellos, la capa que va en la parte de arriba queda más pequeña, se asemeja un poco a un vaso pequeño, ahí será donde meteré el bombón/chocolate, si queda muy abierto entonces el chocolate no se sostendrá, la capa de abajo si debe quedar más abierta, tome foto de las dos capas juntas para que puedan apreciar la diferencia. Listas las dos piezas las uno con silicón caliente. >Then I started joining each petal together. As you can see, each circle will form a layer of rose petals, but there are differences between them: the top layer is smaller and resembles a small cup a bit. that’s where I’ll put the bonbon or chocolate; if it’s too open, the chocolate won’t stay in place. The bottom layer should be more open. I took a photo of the two layers together so you can see the difference. Once the two pieces are ready, I’ll join them with hot silicone. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/EoiXEnUH4zzsvirZjRirvmQHfBWT5qMh3vg3pBNgm2AJ1byWtZHU4BqXcgDaP14Vc8d.jpg) Luego le coloque el palillo de altura con mucho cuidado, atravesando la rosa, procuré que quedará en todo el medio por supuesto y lo fije con silicón caliente. >Then I carefully inserted the support stick through the flower, making sure it was centered, of course, and secured it with hot glue. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJoKCzGcJNkhczhuw2T4yHEFnfeGihtXuKocGPK5jW5cXukoD6hQSeYgqA1Kopk.jpg) Luego comencé a preparar las demás piezas, el sépalo de la rosa lo hice de la misma forma que los pétalos, con la diferencia de que no redondee los extremos, yo diría que el sépalo es bastante parecido a una estrella. ⭐ 🤭 También hice las hojas doblando a la mitad los rectángulos que saque en color verde, traze la forma de una hoja y la recorte. >Then I started preparing the other pieces. I made the rose’s sepal the same way I made the petals, except that I didn’t round the edges; I’d say the sepal looks a lot like a star. ⭐ 🤭 I also made the leaves by folding the green rectangles in half, tracing the shape of a leaf, and cutting it out. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJpkmB2D4ahDZt2bE429B7wV9BJDNKwbhbi5ghiKjnSfF62Zeh5wuABSR9cxgtK.jpg) Luego pegue el sépalo a la parte de abajo de la rosa, con silicón caliente, obviamente hay que pinchar el sépalo con el palillo de altura igual como hicimos con la rosa e ir subiendo la pieza poco a poco. Luego forre el palillo de altura, lo normal es hacerlo con una cinta especial, pero como yo no tengo, pues lo hice con papel crepé. Por último le coloque también las hojas. >Next, attach the sepal to the bottom of the rose using hot glue. Obviously, you’ll need to pierce the sepal with the dowel, just as we did with the rose, and work your way up little by little. Then wrap the dowel; usually, you’d use special ribbon for this, but since I didn’t have any, I used crepe paper instead. Finally, I added the leaves as well. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/Ep1YKEBqyn1nTCcqzfvzA1rn59D1diWBeW77BSFH38LFjJK6RHgb9eBQHD32qkiwSiv.jpg) Y así es como quedan estás flores porta bombones, con esa misma técnica hice tres del mismo color, ustedes las pueden hacer del color que quieran. 🥰 >And that’s how these chocolate-holding flowers turn out. I made three of the same color using that same technique, but you can make them in whatever color you like. 🥰 ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000255456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AK2Dhna8tv5bkiyYMbrhd5SLQw6TSNizLtM6ZKrdMzVCMVaTG844q823fRPtKTZ.jpg) Mi idea era hacer un ramo 💐 o algo así 🤭 con tres rosas, pero no sabía cómo envolverlas, porque no tengo ningún papel adecuado para eso, así que improvise y me las ingenie para hacer un cono de foami blanco escarchado, recorte un cuadrado de 20x20 Cm luego lo puse en posición de rombo luego lleve una de las esquinas hacia el centro, luego hice lo mismo con la otra esquina y las uni con silicón caliente y así fui pegando todo el cono. >My idea was to make a bouquet 💐 or something like that 🤭 with three roses, but I didn't know how to wrap them because I didn't have any suitable wrapping paper, so I improvised and managed to make a cone out of white frosted foam. I cut out a 20x20 cm square, then placed it in a diamond shape, brought one of the corners toward the center, did the same with the other corner, and joined them with hot glue, and that’s how I glued the whole cone together. ![1000037741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/23wXQmmT6db4YaJPaqgyAk9bkwGpaksL9zs54KiDEdkqLMvFERM39iqDU8pbpD3BkwWhu.png) ![1000254908.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarangzg7/AJoKCT3SdXno3isqqZZfSUr4tavjHceWPW7UQ1TypxBFyiD7j4TD3DDBNuRpzGw.gif) Y este fue el resultado de esta hermosa manualidad, como pueden ver coloque las tres rosas dentro del como y también añadi un lindo papel decorativo que me pareció hermoso, y obviamente no podían faltar los chocolates 🥰 la verdad me gustó mucho como quedó y a la cumpleañera también, porque además a ella le encantan las manualidades, así que estoy feliz de haberme atrevido a hacerlo. 💐🌹❤️🥰 >And this was the result of this beautiful craft project. title.title: Diy/Tutorial of a beautiful Berret haircover for your church girl, beauty in Modesty
title.body:
# Hello Hive 

It's good to come around the community one more time to share with us this tutorial on how to make a beautiful and fancy women berret hair cover I made for myself. It's a hair cover to match our church uniform of course and like I often say that we value covering of hair in our church even if it is just some piece of tiny cover on our heads. 


![1000195576.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xydkKspSw1em9Mih2s3w8TtcGuzqBJbPTBuP3PSEJgGX1nDE3nTkYnrZN3A8U1NmwV2.jpg)



There has been series of debate as to wether a women is meant to cover her hair in church or not, the scripture has addressed this issues in different text and just like the humans we are several meaning has been deduced from those text but rather than argue within ourselves we carry out most decent actions in faith that we may not put other baby Chriatians unto temptation of not knowing what to do or where to stand. 



![1000195492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23y8z6a6BvqUQjXcB4mNjhW3b6Mgn6usDJYJxe72G5mFeYsxFRkNWZKRdyQxEbDuNgKWx.jpg)



I made this berret cap to match our Sunday uniform outfit. We make different forms of women fashion wear Modesty doesn't have to be boring hence we make very beautiful and colorful women headgears to mach our outfits. 

I'm just fulfilled that each time there is a call to purchase or make these women's headgears I am exempted from the extra expenses of doing such through a diy.



![1000195553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zSBY7Wo1qhrN8rxjUuMYBSyf8F7iE6hrYFv3pwhDvQUebhfj1ZzNew7G7HQ19gxViYz.jpg)

Before now I have not know how to sew a berret before and my first attempt at it was really not worth wearing. This time around I took my time to get the accurate measurements so that I can make a better fitted berret

# Tutorial process 

We need 4 pieces of fabric for this and 2 piece of warden to harden the berret for a firm standing on the head.


![1000195526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eo8UoVkRenXSoA66YQ1hCSkqdhMJXNHdkQM2WzsNBqhwLLRTXBdbdTa8DFFAFdiWexd.jpg)


Start with creating a 4fold of fabric to form a diagonal shape like this 

Measure out 6inches length and cut it into a circular form. You can increase this by 7-8 if you want a bigger cap.


![1000195606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/243qAv3Vx5iELFRssXNXR9uW19GvwsUyhPYEr4MJkyjE9V3WQe2sEYQdPEBNpwqCrUn52.jpg)



Next cut out the lining and warden in the same manner. These are six pieces in all.
Pick out 3 pieces out of them and cut out the mid point using 3\

depending on the size of a human head. You can get the calculation by measuring one round head divided by 6.28 the circumference  of a circle


![1000195520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/245cWPtdz1u5rXwyBACjy5eBrD5EpVr8kjFM3V3qqo8xRUvw8KcfwoihWtafqTUfChJdv.jpg)

-----


![1000195535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xeos2H7EH4sqoXujCjFqFFwgxoDLe618whGc6qb2aso9Pi1HGCh4v2zL4DvJcHPR3CE.jpg)

Sew the clothes and lining separately with their warden which is that thick white material in-between the main clothes 

![1000195538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wX1U83FfRLsQW2mfbsYqcZrQmUspCtZa8Kh6xZYzCU9u2bg1m7sPXDqZu8KS2f82G13.jpg)

----

![1000195544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242hWAxyHtEZdJ2Lf4iqHLtT3s4a4CTEdyBdSgkMdamZZ7BHiqGbxKEj2PcT8qjB35ohi.jpg)


Insert the linings into the clothes to cover up the inner of the cap 


![1000195550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/243Bni2SpQJ2FAYkt29wbvrmn5h9yD2zGs4c6Ar61N7vHevcCCBTf2rf5SfYrcF4VeB2j.jpg)


Seal the edges with a bias strip and then a little embellishments with beads or pearls as desired


![1000195563.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xAMWmZn5Nu9K5GDRaA19XiB1nK7cUJfidsgzh5TvCfsySmyP1LjAMJAENyEvVmZySU4.jpg)

The only challenge I have is that I don't know how to style this berret like the way I see other women do it.

![1000195553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zSBY7Wo1qhrN8rxjUuMYBSyf8F7iE6hrYFv3pwhDvQUebhfj1ZzNew7G7HQ19gxViYz.jpg)

-----



![1000195489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xyXWDLK3XmySkfSuHvtc3bpc8saiFXmi819z7ahezYHPGs6j7tdKuAys18tMbBUJqdy.jpg)


Isn't this beautiful?

title.title: 5 ways governments censor social media, secret deals are only one of them, \
is the cheat code. Sounds familiar?
title.body:
Hier ist ein Rulebook wie (autokratische) Regierungen versuchen Social Media zu zensurieren und zu beeinflussen.

Im Wesentlichen unterscheiden sich die Methoden gar nicht so sehr von den Methoden, die autokratische Regime seit jeher gegen traditionelle Medien einsetzen.

Fünf Wege, wie Regierungen Social Media zensieren:

### 1. Kauf der Plattform durch regierungsnahe Oligarchen, Milliardäre.

Die dann in Folge Inhalte blocken, den Algorithmus tunen und Shadow-Bans im Sinne der Regierung implementieren etc. Sehr effizient.

### 2. Drakonische Regulierung

Ist es für eine Regierung nicht möglich die Plattformen zu kaufen und zu betreiben, weil sie zum Beispiel im Ausland betrieben werden, ist der nächste Trick, Unmengen an restriktiven Gesetzen, Regulierungen und Einschränkungen zu erlassen, um die Plattformen zum Löschen von Inhalten zu zwingen.

Das geht so weit, dass Plattformen sogar proaktiv nach unerwünschten Inhalten suchen, diese bannen und Daten an die Behörden weitergeben müssen.

### 3. Geheime Deals

Nächster Schritt ist nachdem die Regulierungen erlassen wurden, geheime Deals mit den Plattform-Betreibern einzugehen. Die Plattformen verpflichten sich dann informell durch geheime Absprachen mit den Behörden zu kooperieren und Inhalte, die eigentlich durch die Meinungs- und Pressefreiheit gedeckt wären, zu bannen.

### 4. Kriminalisieren von CEOs und Usern

Klappt das mit der Regulierung und den geheimen Deals nicht, ist der nächste Schritt die Justiz einzusetzen. 

(Autokratische) Regime versuchen CEOs und User, für Dinge die sie posten, drakonische Strafen aufzuerlegen. Meinungsdelikte einzuführen. Ideen und Meinungen zunehmend zu kriminalisieren.

Das geht sogar soweit, dass CEOs von Social Media und Messaging-Services von Behörden aus Flugzeugen und Flughäfen gekidnappt und unter Druck gesetzt werden, um Inhalte zu zensieren und User-Daten an die Behörden weiterzugeben.

### 5. Alters- und ID-Checks

Etwas harmloser klingt der neue Baustein aus dem Zensur-Baukosten. Verpflichtende Alters- und ID-checks auf Plattformen und auf Betriebssystem-Ebene einzuführen, um die User aus Angst zur Selbst-Zensur zu bewegen.

Für Alterschecks müssen die User natürlich Regierungs-Software auf ihren Smartphones installieren, die autokratische Regime natürlich auch gleich für Überwachung und Backdoors einsetzen können. Wie praktisch.

Kinder- und Jugendschutz ist der Cheat Code, um das alles zu legitimieren.

Was sagt ihr dazu? Kommt euch einige oder mehrere Methoden bekannt vor?

## Telegram CEO about social media censorship

https://x.com/durov/status/2046266184908124601

## English

Here is a guide to how (autocratic) governments attempt to censor and influence social media.

Essentially, these methods aren’t all that different from the ones autocratic regimes have always used against traditional media.

Five ways governments censor social media:

### 1. Purchase of the platform by oligarchs and billionaires with ties to the government.

Who then block content, tweak the algorithm, and implement shadow bans in line with the government’s agenda. Very efficient.

### 2. Draconian regulation

If a government cannot buy and operate the platforms—for example, because they are based abroad—the next tactic is to enact a barrage of restrictive laws, regulations, and outright restrictions to force the platforms to delete content.

This goes so far that platforms are even required to proactively search for unwanted content, ban it, and permanently hand over data to the authorities.

### 3. Secret Deals

The next step, after the regulations have been in place, is to enter into secret deals with the platform operators. The platforms then informally commit, through secret agreements with the authorities, to cooperate and ban content that would otherwise be protected by freedom of speech and freedom of the press.

### 4. Criminalizing CEOs and Users

If the regulations and secret deals don’t work, the next step is to involve the judiciary.

(Autocratic) regimes attempt to impose draconian penalties on CEOs and users for things they post. Introducing speech crimes. Increasingly criminalizing ideas and opinions.

This even goes so far that CEOs of social media and messaging services are kidnapped by authorities from airplanes and airports and pressured to censor content and hand over user data to the authorities.

### 5. Age and ID Checks

The newest component of the censorship toolkit sounds somewhat more harmless. Introducing mandatory age and ID checks on platforms and at the operating system level to encourage users to self-censor out of fear.

For age checks, users must, of course, install government software on their smartphones, which autocratic regimes can naturally use for surveillance and backdoors right away. How convenient.

Child and youth protection is the cheat code used to legitimize all of this.

What do you think? Do some or several of these methods sound familiar to you?

title.body: (English version) A big hello to all creators who write posts in the context of the Freewriters community! This is my entry to the Writing Prompt by @mariannewest for [20 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3079: the big clash](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/20-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3079-the-big-clash). Cronus could not tolerate the behavior of his son, Zeus, towards him this time. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xy2M29lA6h8&pp=ygULdGl0YW5vbWFjaHk%3D

>His son was constantly trying to undermine his authority as the ruler of the world.
He could not accept this, to say the least.
He was ready to fight to defend his position, and the big clash between the almighty father and son was around the corner, with nothing able to prevent it.
The Titans were on the side of Cronus, while the Olympians were with Zeus.
The clash started with each side lifting and throwing massive rocks and pieces of land to the other side.
Zeus kept his ultimate weapon, the thunder, as the last trick up his sleeve, in case everything else failed to overcome the incredible collective power of all the Titans.
Aphrodite, the goddess of love, was standing in the corner, at first undecided which side to take.
Cronus, on the one hand, had castrated Uranus, and she was born, as a result, but, being the goddess of love herself, she was against all fighting and wars.
Whose side would she take in the end?

(Versione Italiana) Un caloroso saluto a tutti i creatori che scrivono post nella community di Freewriters! Questo è il mio contributo al prompt di scrittura di @mariannewest del [20 aprile 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Giorno 3079: il grande scontro](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/20-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3079-the-big-clash). Crono, questa volta, non poté tollerare il comportamento di suo figlio Zeus nei suoi confronti. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xy2M29lA6h8&pp=ygULdGl0YW5vbWFjaHk%3D Suo figlio cercava costantemente di minare la sua autorità di sovrano del mondo. Non poteva accettarlo, per usare un eufemismo. Era pronto a combattere per difendere la sua posizione, e il grande scontro tra l'onnipotente padre e figlio era imminente, e nulla poteva impedirlo. I Titani erano dalla parte di Crono, mentre gli dei dell'Olimpo erano con Zeus. Lo scontro iniziò con entrambe le fazioni che sollevavano e scagliavano enormi massi e pezzi di terra contro l'avversario. Zeus teneva la sua arma definitiva, il tuono, come ultimo asso nella manica, nel caso in cui ogni altro tentativo avesse fallito nel sconfiggere l'incredibile potere collettivo di tutti i Titani. Afrodite, la dea dell'amore, se ne stava in disparte, inizialmente indecisa su quale schieramento prendere. body.title: Fiscalité et Contentieux fiscal RD Congo : traiter les lacunes de conformité avant qu’elles ne s’aggravent
body.body:
Gérer une entreprise en République démocratique du Congo (RDC) peut offrir de fortes opportunités, mais cela exige également une attention particulière à des règles et réglementations strictes. De nombreuses entreprises ne réalisent pas à quelle vitesse de petites erreurs peuvent se transformer en problèmes plus importants. Dans des situations réelles, la [Fiscalité et Contentieux fiscal RD Congo](https://www.tshibangulegal.com/fr/page/droit-fiscal-et-son-contentieux.html) commence souvent par de simples lacunes de déclaration, des détails manquants ou des documents peu clairs qui semblent anodins au départ mais peuvent susciter des inquiétudes lors des contrôles.
 Au fil du temps, ces petits problèmes attirent l’attention des autorités fiscales, surtout lorsque des schémas commencent à apparaître. Ce qui peut commencer comme un contrôle de routine peut rapidement conduire à des audits, des pénalités, voire des actions en justice. Ces situations peuvent perturber les opérations quotidiennes, ralentir la prise de décision et impacter les plans d’affaires à long terme, rendant essentiel pour les entreprises de rester cohérentes, organisées et proactives en matière de conformité dès le départ.

## Comprendre les lacunes de conformité dans un système fiscal complexe

Le système fiscal de la RDC comprend de nombreuses règles, et celles-ci changent assez souvent, ce qui rend difficile pour les entreprises de rester organisées. Les entreprises trouvent souvent difficile de suivre les mises à jour, surtout lorsqu’elles gèrent différents types d’impôts dans plusieurs aspects de leurs activités au quotidien.
 La plupart des problèmes commencent par une tenue de registres insuffisante, une compréhension incomplète des règles fiscales ou le non-respect de délais importants. Ces erreurs peuvent sembler mineures au début, mais elles peuvent devenir des problèmes sérieux lorsque les autorités fiscales examinent les situations de plus près et en détail.
 Les entreprises opérant dans des secteurs à forte valeur doivent également répondre à des exigences fiscales supplémentaires, ce qui augmente la pression. Sans une approche claire et cohérente, les entreprises peuvent faire face à des contrôles qui peuvent progressivement se transformer en litiges, voire entraîner des problèmes juridiques au fil du temps.

## Comment les litiges fiscaux s’aggravent : principaux déclencheurs à surveiller

Les litiges fiscaux en RDC ne commencent généralement pas soudainement. Ils évoluent avec le temps en raison de petites erreurs et de détails manquants dans les déclarations, menant souvent à la Fiscalité et Contentieux fiscal RD Congo. Les autorités surveillent de près les tendances, et lorsqu’une anomalie est détectée, un audit peut rapidement devenir un problème juridique sérieux.

**Erreurs et retards répétés dans les déclarations**
Des déclarations tardives ou incomplètes suggèrent un faible contrôle de conformité. Lorsque cela se répète, cela suscite des inquiétudes et augmente les risques d’audits et de contrôles approfondis par les autorités fiscales.

**Incohérences financières et lacunes documentaires**
Lorsque les chiffres dans les registres financiers ne correspondent pas aux déclarations fiscales, ou lorsque des documents sont manquants, cela peut nuire à l’entreprise lors d’un audit et entraîner des pénalités ou des litiges.

**Mauvaise classification et non-conformité réglementaire**
Le classement incorrect des transactions ou le non-respect des règles du secteur peut entraîner des actions de la part des autorités et évoluer rapidement en problème juridique.

## Mettre en place une stratégie juridique et de conformité proactive

Agir tôt permet d’empêcher que de petits problèmes ne deviennent plus importants. Les entreprises qui mettent en place des systèmes de conformité solides sont prêtes lorsque les autorités effectuent des contrôles. Cela implique de réaliser des examens réguliers, de maintenir des registres organisés et de suivre attentivement les règles fiscales locales.
 Collaborer avec des professionnels qui comprennent le système juridique et fiscal en RDC aide les entreprises à identifier les risques plus tôt. Cela garantit que, si un litige survient, il est traité avec soin, avec des mesures visant à le résoudre plutôt que de le laisser perdurer.

## Conclusion

Gérer la Fiscalité et Contentieux fiscal RD Congo nécessite plus que de réagir aux problèmes. Les entreprises qui corrigent rapidement les lacunes de conformité peuvent éviter des litiges majeurs et maintenir le bon fonctionnement de leurs opérations. Un plan clair, soutenu par les bons conseils, aide les entreprises à rester prêtes et à gérer les défis fiscaux avec confiance.

body.title: Gas Networks Ireland відкрили набір: стабільна професія в Ірландії без довгого навчання
body.body: В Ірландії відкрили новий набір на apprenticeship від Gas Networks Ireland — і це один із найбільш практичних варіантів зайти в стабільну професію без довгого університетського маршруту.\n\n

/>

[джерело](https://www.gasnetworks.ie/about/careers/apprenticeship)

Йдеться про технічні спеціальності: електрика, механіка, трубопровідні та газові системи — тобто ті напрямки, які реально тримають інфраструктуру країни.

Формат простий і водночас дуже робочий:  
ви не “йдете вчитись на кілька років”, а одразу заходите в професію.

Apprenticeship — це поєднання роботи і навчання:  
частину часу ви працюєте з командою і вчитеся на практиці, частину — проходите теоретичні блоки (зазвичай через навчальні центри або коледжі). Програма триває кілька років (залежно від спеціальності), і на виході ви отримуєте офіційну кваліфікацію.

Що важливо:

— подаватися можна вже з 17 років  
— верхнього вікового обмеження немає (тобто це варіант і для тих, хто хоче змінити професію)  
— ви отримуєте зарплату з першого дня (не космос, але це стабільний дохід під час навчання)  
— досвід роботи накопичується одразу, а не “після диплома”  
— після завершення — високий попит на ринку і хороші перспективи заробітку

Фактично це один із найкоротших шляхів перейти від “я тільки починаю в Ірландії” до “я маю професію, досвід і стабільний дохід”.

З нюансів:  
це фізична робота, часто на виїздах, у різну погоду, з технікою і відповідальністю. Це не офіс і не “легкі гроші”. Але якщо підходить формат — це дуже сильна інвестиція в себе.

Дедлайн подачі — 5 травня, і такі набори не тривають постійно.

Деталі і подача:  
[https://www.gasnetworks.ie/about/careers/apprenticeship](https://www.gasnetworks.ie/about/careers/apprenticeship)

Якщо ви або ваші підлітки думаєте про реальну професію в Ірландії — це варіант, який точно варто хоча б розглянути.

Поділіться дописом з тими, кому актуально🫶

body.title: Nguyên nhân và cách khắc phục nhanh lỗi vô lăng bị nặng
body.body:
[Vô lăng bị nặng](https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/vo-lang-bi-nang/) là lỗi khá nguy hiểm vì ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến khả năng điều khiển xe. Nếu bạn thấy đánh lái khó, không còn nhẹ như bình thường, cần kiểm tra ngay theo các nguyên nhân dưới đây.

***

# **1. Nguyên nhân phổ biến khiến vô lăng bị nặng**

## **🔹 1. Thiếu hoặc hết dầu trợ lực lái (xe trợ lực dầu)**

👉 Dấu hiệu:

*   Đánh lái nặng dần


*   Có thể kêu “rít” khi quay vô lăng


➡ Đây là nguyên nhân phổ biến nhất

***

## **🔹 2. Lỗi hệ thống trợ lực điện (EPS)**

👉 Với xe dùng trợ lực điện:

*   Vô lăng nặng đột ngột


*   Có thể xuất hiện đèn cảnh báo


➡ Do:

*   Lỗi cảm biến


*   Lỗi motor trợ lực


***

## **🔹 3. Lốp xe non hơi hoặc mòn**

👉 Khi áp suất lốp thấp:

*   Diện tích tiếp xúc tăng


*   → Đánh lái nặng hơn


***

## **🔹 4. Hỏng thước lái (hộp lái)**

👉 Dấu hiệu:

*   Vô lăng nặng + lệch


*   Có tiếng kêu khi đánh lái


➡ Lỗi này nghiêm trọng hơn

***

## **🔹 5. Dây curoa bị trùng hoặc đứt (xe trợ lực dầu)**

👉 Khi dây curoa yếu:

*   Bơm trợ lực hoạt động kém


*   → Vô lăng nặng


***

## **🔹 6. Lỗi rotuyn, khớp lái**

👉 Khi bị mòn:

*   Đánh lái không mượt


*   Có thể kèm tiếng “cộc cộc”


***

# **2. Cách khắc phục nhanh tại chỗ**

## **✔ Kiểm tra lốp xe (dễ nhất)**

*   Xem có bị non hơi không


*   Bơm đủ áp suất


➡ Có thể xử lý ngay trong 5 phút

***

## **✔ Kiểm tra dầu trợ lực**

*
    Mở nắp capo


*   Xem mức dầu


👉 Nếu thiếu:

➡ Bổ sung ngay

***

## **✔ Tắt máy khởi động lại (xe điện EPS)**

👉 Đôi khi lỗi tạm thời:

*   Tắt máy


*   Khởi động lại


➡ Có thể hết lỗi

***

# **3. Khi nào cần đi gara ngay?**

👉 Cần kiểm tra chuyên sâu nếu:

*   Vô lăng nặng đột ngột


*   Có đèn cảnh báo trợ lực


*   Có tiếng kêu lạ


*   Đánh lái không trả lái


➡ Không nên tiếp tục chạy xa

***

# **4. Chi phí sửa chữa tham khảo**

*   Bơm dầu trợ lực: vài trăm nghìn


*   Thay dầu trợ lực: \~300k – 800k


*   Sửa EPS: vài triệu


*   Thay thước lái: có thể > 5 triệu


***

# **5. Lưu ý quan trọng**

*   ❌ Không cố lái khi vô lăng quá nặng


*   ❌ Không bỏ qua dấu hiệu bất thường


*   ✔ Kiểm tra định kỳ hệ thống lái


***

# **6. Mẹo phòng tránh**

*   ✔ Bơm lốp đúng áp suất


*   ✔ Thay dầu trợ lực định kỳ


*   ✔ Bảo dưỡng hệ thống lái


***

# **7. Tóm tắt nhanh**

👉 Vô lăng bị nặng thường do:

1.  Thiếu dầu trợ lực


2.  Lốp non


3.  Lỗi trợ lực điện


4.  Hỏng thước lái


➡ Kiểm tra từ đơn giản → phức tạp

***

# **Kết luận**

👉 Nếu vô lăng nặng:

*   Kiểm tra lốp và dầu trước


*   Sau đó mới đến hệ thống trợ lực


➡ Xử lý sớm sẽ tránh hỏng nặng và đảm bảo an toàn khi lái xe 🚗

***

Nếu bạn muốn, mình có thể:

*   Hướng dẫn **cách phân biệt lỗi trợ lực dầu vs trợ lực điện**

*
    Hoặc liệt kê **dấu hiệu xe sắp hỏng hệ thống lái** 👍

---

***Truthful Route: Session 14! There's a lot of random battles this time... Also, Minoru and Falcomon are still fighting***


-----

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRQdQtinWHexFVZTexacWtipEVCyjNhAv6txr5Eakyrc4/1000072266.webp 

 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwte1vFUi2mHw8vmiLz6CQvBv3sQzCTKkefo2GwirHMw/54453.jpg)



Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. This is my entry for the #monomad challenge April 20th. Every time I want to do something different to make a post in the monomad community, I want to do something different. In today's post too, I have presented a similar presentation to you. To be honest, while making the post, I have no idea whether the community will like my post or not. But putting all those things aside, I have made the post today. In today's post, I have presented with you the photographs captured in the rainy weather in black and white.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVdY4iGQE8Cq9FQCSFUqJnfWYMkNRn3GcCazxTMVG5oLg/1_1.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUtY3STK4wRp4rLTpkwnXUipyoemRz2S5a5SYwBzspf5N/2_2.jpg)

In each of the photographs presented in today's post, a busy street of the city has been presented during a rainy day. In the first photograph presented here, the rain has changed the scene. Here, the rain has given a soft and dreamy look. Everything looks a little blurry. It seems that the movement of people and vehicles is mixing with the rain. As can be seen in the first photograph, many bicycles are parked close to each other in the foreground. Their shiny frames reflect the wet environment. Which shows how the rain has covered everything. Near the bicycle, a person is standing calmly. The person seems to be holding the handle of the bicycle and preparing to get out. This person looks calm and still. Which is in contrast to the indistinct movements of the other people around him.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDzJic8D9UYsdXguhi3QPhxXmzz6cr3jbve1zTYWuwxy/3_3.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5znthSikWxdLcezrd3XJ3eN4VJiWSeTc1HyxMybJuBB/4_4.jpg)

As can be seen in the first photographs presented here, running in the rain is a special kind of experience. The person is slowly enjoying the music through earphones. It becomes more enjoyable in the rainy atmosphere. While in the second photograph, a quiet park can be seen on a rainy day. Tall trees spread their branches wide, and rain continuously falls on the wet ground. Here, the road shines with reflections due to the rain, and everything looks calm and fresh. In such a place, going for a run while wearing earphones gives a feeling of peace and freshness.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDCcbhNXDEHgSf9pZFVHSQfDJjjCQHTd8ER6kYrB5fvW/5_5.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmegLeZbJqqsjqsRFTL9hbf6adCxdB9GsB6CAbnnp1xWYS/6_6.jpg)

As can be seen in the first photograph above, the ground is wet and smooth. This reflects the light and shapes of nearby objects on the ground. In the background of this photograph are shops with large windows and signs. People can be seen passing by these shops. Some people seem to be carrying umbrellas or hurrying to avoid getting wet. However, the scene looks a bit blurry due to the rain and the speed. Almost like shadows passing by. While in the second photograph, a bus can be seen passing by from the side. In which the tourists are enjoying the rain.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoDJJC1HC7otPMvQUKVysJmNeibsFRgEzYx8rmB4Wog7/7_7.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ6t7NmmnTdXEXTB8CCKMjpRmvjyHKPyQEbd3cXNn1URP/8_8.jpg)

In both photographs presented above, it is raining heavily. Large drops of rain can be easily seen on the side road. A beautiful garden is also visible on the side of the road. This garden also seems to have blossomed due to the rain. In the first photograph presented above, a person can be seen running on the road in the distance. As a person runs on the road, the sound of raindrops must be mixing with music in their ears. Every step of this person feels light, and the cool breeze makes the body active and lively.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPUj8yQWMTLdWNf5QXjiXwta6N6woSc1PicUpiihbtet/9_9.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqxX8bCMBQc9eLs2e2qqiQAdHkevJWjfBL4tw791pKCS/10_10.jpg)


As seen in the photographs taken above, the natural scenery around here during the rains is felt. The big tree in the middle gives a feeling of shelter. The fence on its side and the water reservoir nearby make the place natural and calm. Due to the rain, the buildings in the background look a little blurry. Which makes the scene look like a dream.

I believe that this type of exercise is not only good for the body but also for the mind. This exercise brings us a sense of peace, happiness and freedom. I am very happy to make today's post because I have presented post on rainy weather. I hope that my post will be accepted for the #monomad challenge April 20th.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

body.title: AI News Daily — April 21, 2026
body.body:
# AI News Daily — April 21, 2026

Today’s useful signal is that a lot of the most important AI movement is happening one layer below the headline model race. The biggest stories are about who gets easier access to developer tooling, which platforms are turning into real workflow surfaces, and which labs are shipping systems that look built for long-running work instead of short demos.

Per editorial direction, this issue prioritizes product upgrades, model releases, and developer-impacting platform moves. I am skipping most pure finance chatter. I am also explicitly labeling the catch-up items from April 19 and April 20 that were not yet covered in recent published posts.

---

## 1) Google is turning paid Gemini subscriptions into a more practical on-ramp for AI Studio
**Announced on April 20, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Google said AI Pro and Ultra subscribers now get higher usage limits in Google AI Studio, along with access to Nano Banana Pro and Gemini Pro models. That may sound like a packaging tweak, but it is actually a meaningful product move. Google is trying to reduce the friction between “I pay for Gemini already” and “I want to build something real with Google’s developer stack.” Instead of forcing everyone straight into pay-per-request API billing, it is creating a gentler bridge from subscription experimentation into deeper prototyping.

That matters because developer adoption often stalls in the awkward middle. Teams are willing to experiment, but they do not always want to set up full production billing just to test ideas, prompt chains, or lightweight apps. By turning a consumer-adjacent subscription into a deeper AI Studio entry point, Google is making it easier for builders to cross that gap. It also fits the broader pattern we have been watching from Google, which is to tighten the distance between Gemini as a consumer product, Gemini as a model family, and Gemini as a developer platform.

**Reflection:** The labs that win mindshare will not just ship strong models. They will make the path from curiosity to prototype feel frictionless.

**Sources:**
- https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/google-one-ai-studio/
- https://9to5google.com/2026/04/20/google-ai-studio-limits/
- https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/google-raises-ai-studio-limits-for-pro-and-ultra-subscribers/tldr

---

## 2) OpenAI’s outage was a reminder that ChatGPT, Codex, and the API are now operational infrastructure

OpenAI suffered a broad outage that hit ChatGPT, Codex, and the API platform, with the status page later indicating mitigation and recovery. Outages are never exciting in the fun sense, but this one is still important because the blast radius now reaches far beyond casual chat usage. When ChatGPT, Codex, and the API wobble at the same time, a lot of real work stops, including developer workflows, internal copilots, automation chains, and businesses that have quietly built around OpenAI availability.

The practical takeaway is that AI reliability is becoming a first-class product dimension. It is no longer enough for a platform to have the best demo or strongest benchmark week. If developers are using it for coding agents, support systems, content generation, or internal ops, uptime starts to matter like cloud uptime. This is one of the clearest signs that AI platforms are maturing into utility layers. It also creates more room for competitors that can position themselves around stability, redundancy, or multi-provider strategies.

**Reflection:** The more AI becomes part of everyday work, the more reliability becomes a feature, not a footnote.

**Sources:**
- https://status.openai.com/history
- https://www.techradar.com/news/live/chatgpt-down-april-2026
- https://www.tomsguide.com/news/live/chatgpt-down-live-updates-outage-4-20-2026

---

## 3) Adobe launched CX Enterprise to push agentic AI deeper into customer-experience operations
**Announced on April 20, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Adobe unveiled CX Enterprise and framed it as an end-to-end agentic AI system for managing the customer lifecycle, from acquisition and engagement to conversion and loyalty. The big idea is that Adobe does not want to be seen as just a creative-tools company with AI add-ons. It wants to be a serious orchestration layer for customer experience in the agent era, combining data, content, brand constraints, and workflow automation.

This is strategically important because customer experience is one of the clearest near-term enterprise surfaces for agentic AI. Brands want systems that can generate content, personalize journeys, preserve brand tone, and still remain auditable and controllable. Adobe is betting that its long history in creative tools, digital marketing, and experience infrastructure gives it an advantage over newer entrants that may have stronger models but weaker workflow context. For builders, the interesting signal is the interoperability story. Adobe is explicitly positioning this around an open ecosystem with partners including AWS, Anthropic, Google Cloud, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and OpenAI.

**Reflection:** Enterprise AI is getting less about isolated features and more about who can orchestrate messy, cross-system workflows without losing trust.

**Sources:**
- https://news.adobe.com/news/2026/04/adobe-redefines-custome-experience
- https://news.adobe.com/news/2026/04/adobe-unveils-cx-enterprise-coworker
- https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/adobe-launches-ai-suite-corporate-clients-competition-heats-up-2026-04-20/

---

## 4) Meta introduced SAM Audio, a multimodal model for separating sounds from messy real-world audio
**Announced on April 20, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Meta introduced SAM Audio and described it as the first unified multimodal model for audio separation. The pitch is simple but powerful: instead of treating sound isolation as a narrow specialist task, the model lets users separate audio based on text prompts, visual cues, or time-based segments. That pushes audio tooling closer to the broader multimodal future where a model can work across different kinds of signals in one workflow.

This matters because audio still feels underdeveloped compared with text, image, and now video. Real audio environments are messy, overlapping, and full of competing signals. If models get better at isolating voices, sounds, and events from chaotic mixtures, that opens doors for media editing, assistive tools, search, surveillance review, meeting cleanup, and robotics. The interesting part is not just that Meta shipped another model. It is that multimodality keeps expanding into more practical sensory tasks, where the value comes from cleaner perception rather than prettier generation.

**Reflection:** A lot of AI progress right now is about helping machines perceive the world more cleanly, not just talk about it more fluently.

**Sources:**
- https://ai.meta.com/blog/
- https://llm-stats.com/ai-news

---

## 5) xAI is signaling that Grok wants a place inside Microsoft Office workflows
**Teased on April 19, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Over the weekend, Elon Musk teased Grok plugins for Excel, Word, and PowerPoint after a demo showing Grok turning a research paper into a presentation. Right now this is still a signal more than a fully shipped platform release, but it is a meaningful one. It suggests xAI is trying to move Grok from chatbot territory into the high-frequency productivity layer where people actually draft, analyze, summarize, and present work.

That is where the real competition is going. It is no longer enough to have a strong model sitting in a chat window. The strategic prize is being embedded in the tools where knowledge workers already spend their time. Microsoft has its own Copilot stack, OpenAI keeps pushing into workplace and developer flows, Google is doing the same in Workspace, and now xAI is hinting that it wants a seat at that table too. Even if the first wave is rough or limited, the direction is clear: the AI wars are moving into documents, spreadsheets, slide decks, and workflow surfaces that can influence everyday business output.

**Reflection:** The next platform battle is not only about intelligence. It is about default placement inside the tools people open all day.

**Sources:**
- https://www.benzinga.com/markets/tech/26/04/51904603/elon-musk-grok-plugins-excel-word-powerpoint-xai-demo-features
- https://theagenttimes.com/articles/xai-pushes-grok-into-microsoft-office-suite-expanding-our-en-c2f0d406
- https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/04/51929293/apple-amazon-avis-blackberry-and-trade-desk-why-these-5-stocks-are-on-investors-radars-today

---

## 6) Moonshot AI open-sourced Kimi K2.6 for long-horizon coding and agent swarms
**Announced on April 20, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Moonshot AI released Kimi K2.6 as an open-source model focused on long-horizon coding, agent execution, and swarm-style coordination. The company is positioning it around sustained engineering work, large numbers of tool calls, and long-running tasks that demand more than a quick answer. That framing alone makes it worth paying attention to, because it aligns with the direction many advanced users actually want, models that can stick with a difficult task and keep operating coherently over time.

The open-weight angle is a big part of the story. Developers increasingly want strong models they can inspect, host, benchmark, or integrate into custom agent systems without waiting for a closed platform roadmap. Kimi K2.6 appears designed to compete directly on that front, with benchmark claims around coding and agentic workflows plus examples of long-duration execution. Even if some of the published numbers should be taken with the usual marketing caution, the broader signal is real: open models are not just chasing general chat parity anymore. They are increasingly targeting serious engineering tasks that were once assumed to belong mostly to the frontier closed labs.

**Reflection:** Open-weight competition is getting more ambitious, and long-running coding work is becoming one of the most interesting battlegrounds.

**Sources:**
- https://www.kimi.com/blog/kimi-k2-6
- https://www.testingcatalog.com/moonshot-ai-launches-kimi-k2-6-on-kimi-chat-and-apis/
- https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/04/20/moonshot-ai-releases-kimi-k2-6-with-long-horizon-coding-agent-swarm-scaling-to-300-sub-agents-and-4000-coordinated-steps/

---

## 7) Anthropic’s Mythos reportedly being used by the NSA shows how strategic top-tier AI access is becoming
**Reported on April 19, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Reuters and others reported that the NSA is using Anthropic’s Mythos Preview despite the broader Pentagon conflict over Anthropic’s supply-chain-risk designation. That is a meaningful update because it shows that even during public governance conflict, parts of the U.S. national security system may still decide the capability is too useful to ignore. This is not just another policy fight. It is a sign that the strongest cyber-capable models are already being treated like strategic assets.

For the broader market, this matters because government security use often previews what happens later in regulated industries. Once a model is seen as valuable enough for high-stakes cybersecurity or intelligence work, the next questions become who gets access, under what safeguards, with what auditing, and under whose control. That has implications for enterprises too. If frontier models start getting segmented by trust tier and deployment sensitivity, product strategy may increasingly depend not just on performance, but on who can access which model under what rules.

**Reflection:** Frontier AI is starting to look less like a simple software category and more like a controlled capability with geopolitical weight.

**Sources:**
- https://www.axios.com/2026/04/19/nsa-anthropic-mythos-pentagon
- https://www.reuters.com/business/us-security-agency-is-using-anthropics-mythos-despite-blacklist-axios-reports-2026-04-19/
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/20/nsa-spies-are-reportedly-using-anthropics-mythos-despite-pentagon-feud/

---

## Closing take
If I had to summarize today in one line, it would be this: the most important AI competition is moving from headline demos into the layers where real work happens. Subscription bridges, enterprise orchestration, audio perception, office integrations, long-horizon coding, and reliability all matter because they shape what teams can actually ship.

That is the practical lens I would keep right now. Which announcements reduce friction for builders? Which ones create new workflow surfaces? Which ones make AI more deployable, more controllable, or more durable in real use? Those are the stories that keep compounding after the launch-day hype fades.

---

*AI-assisted research and writing, with editorial filtering and synthesis.*

1.  Quy định vị trí lắp biển số ô tô

👉 Theo quy định hiện hành:

Xe ô tô phải có 2 biển số

1 biển phía trước

1 biển phía sau

👉 Yêu cầu:

Lắp đúng vị trí thiết kế của xe

Biển phải:

Rõ ràng, dễ nhìn

Không bị che khuất

Không bị cong, gập

1.  Chuẩn bị dụng cụ

👉 Bạn cần:

Tua vít hoặc máy khoan

Ốc vít chuyên dụng

Giá đỡ biển số (nếu có)

Keo dán chuyên dụng (tùy chọn)

1.  Cách lắp biển số phía trước

🔹 Bước 1: Xác định vị trí

Thường ở chính giữa cản trước

Có sẵn lỗ bắt vít

🔹 Bước 2: Cố định biển

👉 Đặt biển vào đúng vị trí:

Căn thẳng

Không lệch

🔹 Bước 3: Bắt vít

Dùng 2–4 ốc vít

Siết chặt vừa đủ

👉 Không siết quá mạnh → dễ cong biển

🔹 Bước 4: Kiểm tra

Lắc nhẹ xem có chắc chắn không

Đảm bảo không rung lắc

1.  Cách lắp biển số phía sau

👉 Tương tự phía trước:

Vị trí: giữa cốp xe

Bắt vít chắc chắn

📌 Một số xe:

Có khung sẵn → chỉ cần gắn vào

1.  Có nên dùng khung biển số không?

👉 Nên dùng:

✔️ Tăng độ chắc chắn

✔️ Bảo vệ biển

✔️ Tăng thẩm mỹ

📌 Lưu ý:

Không che số

Không làm sai kích thước

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

❌ Không dán lệch, che số

❌ Không dùng dây buộc tạm

❌ Không khoan sai vị trí

👉 Có thể bị phạt nếu:

Biển không rõ

Lắp sai quy định

1.  Lỗi thường gặp

Biển bị rung → do lỏng vít

Biển bị cong → siết quá mạnh

Biển lệch → căn sai vị trí

1.  Mẹo lắp đẹp & chắc

✔️ Dùng thêm long đen (vòng đệm)

✔️ Siết đều 2 bên

✔️ Lau sạch bề mặt trước khi lắp

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Lắp biển số đúng:

Đúng vị trí

Căn thẳng

Siết chắc vừa đủ

Không che số

Kết luận

👉 Lắp biển số ô tô đúng kỹ thuật giúp:

Tránh rơi, mất biển

Đảm bảo đúng luật

Tăng tính thẩm mỹ

➡️ Làm đúng ngay từ đầu sẽ không phải sửa lại 🚗


---

body.title: Mức phạt lỗi không tuân thủ vạch kẻ đường (ô tô & xe máy) mới nhất
body.body:
Lỗi không tuân thủ vạch kẻ đường là vi phạm rất phổ biến như: đè vạch liền, đi sai làn, không đi đúng hướng mũi tên… Theo quy định mới (Nghị định 168/2024/NĐ-CP), mức phạt đã tăng và có thể bị trừ điểm GPLX.

Chi tiết: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/loi-khong-tuan-thu-vach-ke-duong/>

![loi-khong-tuan-thu-vach-ke-duong.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/79c9d270d825c3b201e7868dd5d79a75f5a53af4a9708681e8d44c93e3f02281)



1.  Lỗi không tuân thủ vạch kẻ đường là gì?

👉 Bao gồm các hành vi:

Đi đè vạch liền

Không đi đúng làn đường

Không theo mũi tên chỉ hướng

Lấn làn, chuyển làn sai quy định

1.  Mức phạt với ô tô

🔹 Lỗi thông thường

👉 Ví dụ:

Đè vạch liền

Đi sai làn

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 800.000 – 1.200.000 đồng

🔹 Lỗi gây cản trở giao thông

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 4 – 6 triệu đồng

➡️ Có thể trừ 2 điểm GPLX

🔹 Lỗi trên cao tốc

👉 Đi sai làn, không đúng vạch:

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 10 – 12 triệu đồng

➡️ Trừ điểm bằng lái

🔹 Gây tai nạn

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 20 – 22 triệu đồng

➡️ Trừ nhiều điểm GPLX

1.  Mức phạt với xe máy

🔹 Lỗi cơ bản

👉 Ví dụ:

Đè vạch liền

Không đi đúng làn

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 200.000 – 400.000 đồng

🔹 Lỗi nghiêm trọng

👉 Đi sai làn gây nguy hiểm:

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 400.000 – 600.000 đồng

🔹 Gây tai nạn

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 4 – 5 triệu đồng

1.  Các loại vạch cần đặc biệt chú ý

👉 Bạn dễ bị phạt khi vi phạm:

Vạch liền (không được đè/đè qua)

Vạch phân làn

Vạch mũi tên chỉ hướng

Vạch dừng đèn đỏ

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Có thể bị trừ điểm GPLX

✔️ Camera phạt nguội rất phổ biến

✔️ Lỗi nhỏ nhưng bị xử phạt thường xuyên

1.  Mẹo tránh bị phạt

✔️ Quan sát vạch trước khi chuyển làn

✔️ Không đè vạch liền

✔️ Đi đúng làn ngay từ đầu

✔️ Giảm tốc khi gần giao lộ

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Ô tô:

800k – 1,2 triệu (lỗi thường)

10 – 12 triệu (cao tốc)

👉 Xe máy:

200k – 600k

Kết luận

👉 Lỗi không tuân thủ vạch kẻ đường:

Là lỗi phổ biến nhưng dễ tránh

Mức phạt ngày càng cao

➡️ Quan trọng nhất:

Đi đúng làn – không đè vạch liền – quan sát kỹ biển báo

---

body.title: (ENG/ESP) - Dibujando al Aire Libre, Nuevas Ilustraciones y Experiencias - Blog / Drawing Outdoors: New Illustrations and Experiences- Blog
body.body:
![Español](https://cdn.rcimg.net/Reenave/f3743169/96595beff14cc615b20e4a14a9efc5ba.gif?width=700)

¡Hola comunidad de amantes del anime y el manga! 


El estar sin internet no me ha permitido hacer actualizaciones con más frecuencia como solía hacer, sin embargo ¡aquí vamos!

En un post anterior les conté sobre mi experiencia dibujando al aire libre.  He continuado con las prácticas casi a diario, aprovechando las horas de las mañanas, las cuales han estado bastante frías y lluviosas o nubladas.

Hay momentos en los que debo suspender mis prácticas a media mañana porque la lluvia se avecina y no me arriesgo a que todo el trabajo se pierda bajo el agua.  Así que hago lo posible por aprovechar al máximo el tiempo y avanzar con la pieza que esté trabajando ese día tanto como pueda.

Aún con eso, he notado que desde que estoy practicando al aire libre, me siento en más calma, con más energía, mis niveles de estrés y ansiedad han bajado mucho y me siento más alegre y optimista.

Mi timidez e introversión han ido bajando también.  Al inicio, me era muy difícil iniciar conversación con las personas que se acercaban a hablar conmigo.  Ahora hablo por ratos largos con ellos y con más seguridad.

Las personas han sido muy amables y me preguntan muchas cosas sobre ilustración y los que son fans del manga y el anime, disfrutan de intercambiar con otra persona que habla su mismo lenguaje en ese aspecto.

Los niños que salen de los colegios cercanos y van con sus padres a disfrutar un rato en la plaza, se acercan a conversar conmigo y ya hay un grupo que siempre me visita para dibujar o conversar un rato y contarme su día de clases.  Hoy, uno de ellos me dijo que como ve que tengo mis materiales de dibujo ordenados en una caja transportable, de esas que se suelen usar para guardar herramientas pero que yo la uso para tener todos mis materiales ordenados y poder llevarlos conmigo con facilidad, él tomó la idea y sus padres le compraron una para que pueda tener todo su material allí.

He recibido dibujos de regalo de ellos y muchos me dejan sorprendida con el increíble talento que tienen.  Es muy divertido verlos tan entusiasmados haciendo lo mejor que pueden para expresar sus ideas a través del arte.

Ya les seguiré contando sobre las aventuras y experiencias que tenga en estas prácticas al aire libre.

Mientras tanto, les comparto otras de las ilustraciones que he hecho.  La ilustración de Naruto está hecha en acuarelas y tinta china, mientras que la ilustración de Mazinger Z y Candy Candy, esta última un poco mezclada con mi propio estilo, fueron hechas en creyones y tinta china. ¡Espero les gusten!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfApjVBZvwyiUguPjoaz4ivjZu5eau3G8snzQUFwcmoh/1776727636281.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxUNWpPk3nvYsTtyi1rqNsnSg3ocH32gM734Zxhqvesb/1776727636350.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfGRmXhn3dxeb42hKhs5Am9tXd7tuJXpx8n3zPTjk9VDq/1776727672599.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3HQPkT32SZSTjE54DGa9ki9LHX8qdd4pWYnev9JANet/1776727672659.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWKEygX2W3KxJo3Sn91R1zaK29HxVsb4BGA7S5ErgLrr/1776727672716.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCwX3wjDKE73wRWUE178uxe6DXWZoCQ6VmwFw7CiqHUW/1776727889168.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSFA8pGehNX2EtjGK3Xx8ydZ6Qv19BJEvWdPkM1XxXG3/1776727889224.jpg)


Les debo fotos del proceso, pero mientras estoy trabajando, muchas veces se me olvida todo y me enfoco tanto en lo que hago que luego recuerdo que no tomé ninguna foto del proceso.  Otras veces, es por estar entretenida entre dibujar y conversar con los niños que no me doy cuenta cuando he terminado de realizar todo.  Haré lo posible por mantenerlo en mente para futuras ilustraciones. 

¡Hasta el próximo post!

Mil gracias por leerme y acompañarme en el post de hoy. Si quieres más speedpaints, tips o inspiración de dibujo, pásate por mi canal de [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4Kq09Rn5-muXdhY31NRSmw) y sígueme en [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@reenaveishere?lang=es). ¡Nos vemos en la próxima!

![English](https://cdn.rcimg.net/Reenave/f3743169/ee00a5494ba4ccfe83c8e3c0a44ec531.gif?width=700)

Hello, anime and manga lovers community!

Being without internet has prevented me from posting updates as frequently as I used to, but here we go!

In a previous post I told you about my experience drawing outdoors. I have kept up with the practice almost daily, taking advantage of the morning hours, which have been quite cold, rainy, or cloudy.

There are times when I have to suspend my practice mid‑morning because rain is approaching and I don’t want all my work to be lost underwater. So I try to make the most of the time and progress on the piece I’m working on that day as much as possible.

Even with that, I’ve noticed that since I’ve been practicing outdoors, I feel calmer, more energetic, my stress and anxiety levels have dropped a lot, and I feel happier and more optimistic.

My shyness and introversion have also decreased. At first, it was very hard for me to start a conversation with people who came up to talk to me. Now I talk with them for long periods and with more confidence.

People have been very friendly and ask me many questions about illustration, and fans of manga and anime enjoy chatting with someone who speaks the same “language” in that regard.

The kids who leave nearby schools and come with their parents to spend time in the plaza stop to talk to me, and there’s now a group that always visits me to draw or chat for a while and tell me about their school day. Today, one of them said that, seeing I keep my drawing supplies organized in a portable box—like those used for tools but which I use to keep everything tidy and easy to carry—he took the idea, and his parents bought him one so he can store all his materials there too.

I have received drawings from them as gifts, and many surprise me with the incredible talent they have. It’s a lot of fun to see them so enthusiastic, doing their best to express their ideas through art.

I’ll keep you posted about the adventures and experiences I have in these outdoor sessions.

In the meantime, here are some other illustrations I’ve made. The Naruto illustration is done in watercolor and Drawing ink, while the Mazinger Z and Candy Candy illustrations (the latter a bit mixed with my own style) were created with crayons and Drawing ink. I hope you like them!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfApjVBZvwyiUguPjoaz4ivjZu5eau3G8snzQUFwcmoh/1776727636281.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxUNWpPk3nvYsTtyi1rqNsnSg3ocH32gM734Zxhqvesb/1776727636350.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfGRmXhn3dxeb42hKhs5Am9tXd7tuJXpx8n3zPTjk9VDq/1776727672599.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3HQPkT32SZSTjE54DGa9ki9LHX8qdd4pWYnev9JANet/1776727672659.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWKEygX2W3KxJo3Sn91R1zaK29HxVsb4BGA7S5ErgLrr/1776727672716.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCwX3wjDKE73wRWUE178uxe6DXWZoCQ6VmwFw7CiqHUW/1776727889168.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSFA8pGehNX2EtjGK3Xx8ydZ6Qv19BJEvWdPkM1XxXG3/1776727889224.jpg)

I owe you process photos, but while I’m working I often forget everything and focus so much on what I’m doing that I later realize I didn’t take any process shots. Other times, I get so absorbed in drawing and chatting with the children that I don’t notice when I’ve finished. I’ll try to keep this in mind for future illustrations.

Until the next post!

Thank you so much for reading and joining me today. If youThank you so much for reading and joining me today. body.body:
https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=5FQhNpVTbNRwyY56
God loves humanity, no matter the amount of sin we commit in this life God is always ready to forgive us only if we come to him with a sincere heart. Normally sin creates a distance between us and God but because of his mercy he still cares about us. From the Old Testament sacrifices to the New Testament fulfillment in Jesus Christ, forgiveness is presented as both a gift and a responsibility. Those who seek God with a sincere heart are promised cleansing and a renewed relationship with Him.

Due to the love God have for us he brings redemption through Jesus Christ his son and saved us from sin. 

>“If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness” (1 John 1:9). 

This assurance encourages believers to live humbly, confess their sins, and extend forgiveness to others as they have received it from God.

body.title: Hướng dẫn chi tiết cách kiểm tra nước làm mát ô tô (đúng chuẩn & an toàn)
body.body:
Nước làm mát đóng vai trò cực kỳ quan trọng giúp giữ nhiệt độ động cơ ổn định, tránh quá nhiệt và hỏng máy. Việc kiểm tra định kỳ rất đơn giản nhưng nhiều người bỏ qua.

Tìm hiểu thêm: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/cach-kiem-tra-nuoc-lam-mat-o-to/>

![cach-kiem-tra-nuoc-lam-mat-dung-cach.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/212e0b600b5796f3fbe99413267cbe703be171dafdc0e3c41083311912745154)



1.  Nước làm mát ô tô là gì?

👉 Là dung dịch giúp:

Làm mát động cơ

Chống quá nhiệt

Chống ăn mòn, đóng cặn

➡️ Thường là dung dịch màu:

Xanh, đỏ, hồng hoặc cam

1.  Khi nào cần kiểm tra nước làm mát?

👉 Nên kiểm tra:

Trước khi đi xa

Định kỳ 1–2 tuần/lần

Khi thấy:

Xe nóng bất thường

Điều hòa kém mát

Đèn cảnh báo nhiệt độ bật

1.  Cách kiểm tra nước làm mát đúng cách

🔹 Bước 1: Tắt máy và để nguội

⚠️ Rất quan trọng:

Không mở nắp khi máy còn nóng

➡️ Có thể bị bỏng do áp suất

👉 Nên chờ:

10–15 phút sau khi tắt máy

🔹 Bước 2: Mở nắp capo

Tìm bình nước làm mát

Thường là bình nhựa trong suốt

📌 Có ký hiệu:

“Coolant” hoặc biểu tượng nhiệt kế

🔹 Bước 3: Quan sát mức nước

👉 Trên bình có 2 vạch:

MIN (thấp nhất)

MAX (cao nhất)

👉 Kết quả:

✔️ Nằm giữa MIN – MAX → Bình thường

❌ Dưới MIN → Thiếu nước

❌ Trên MAX → Có thể đổ quá

🔹 Bước 4: Kiểm tra màu sắc

👉 Nước tốt:

Màu trong, rõ

👉 Nước cần thay:

Đục, có cặn

Chuyển màu lạ

1.  Cách bổ sung nước làm mát

👉 Nếu thiếu:

Mở nắp bình phụ

Đổ thêm dung dịch làm mát

Đóng nắp lại

📌 Lưu ý:

Không đổ quá vạch MAX

Dùng đúng loại dung dịch

1.  Có nên dùng nước lọc thay thế không?

👉 Tạm thời: CÓ thể dùng

👉 Nhưng lâu dài:

❌ Không nên dùng nước lã

➡️ Dễ gây:

Đóng cặn

Gỉ sét

👉 Tốt nhất:

➡️ Dùng dung dịch chuyên dụng

1.  Dấu hiệu thiếu nước làm mát

🚨 Xe nhanh nóng

🚨 Có mùi khét

🚨 Điều hòa yếu

🚨 Đèn cảnh báo nhiệt độ

➡️ Cần xử lý ngay

1.  Bao lâu nên thay nước làm mát?

👉 Thông thường:

40.000 – 80.000 km

Hoặc 2–3 năm

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

❌ Không mở nắp két nước khi nóng

❌ Không pha sai loại dung dịch

✔️ Kiểm tra cả bình phụ và két nước

1.  Mẹo kiểm tra nhanh

👉 Nhớ đơn giản:

Nhìn vạch MIN – MAX

Kiểm tra màu

Không mở khi nóng

Kết luận

👉 Kiểm tra nước làm mát:

Dễ làm tại nhà

Chỉ mất 2–3 phút

➡️ Nhưng giúp:

Bảo vệ động cơ, tránh hỏng hóc tốn kém 🚗

body.title: Pour beaucoup, les paris sportifs
body.body:
Pour beaucoup, les paris sportifs commencent comme un simple passe-temps, mais avec le temps, ils exigent une approche plus sérieuse. Au départ, les joueurs se fient souvent à leur intuition, aux grands noms et aux tournois populaires, sans se pencher sur les détails. Cependant, après quelques séries de victoires et de défaites, il devient évident que la régularité est impossible sans analyse et discipline.

La capacité à suivre rapidement l'évolution des cotes, à comparer les marchés et à analyser les statistiques devient cruciale. Dans ce contexte, de nombreuses comme [1xbet.dj](https://1xbet.dj/fr) sont évoquées, car il est important pour les joueurs de disposer d'un outil qui ne les distrait pas de la prise de décision et leur permette de se concentrer sur l'analyse plutôt que sur les détails techniques.

La gestion de la bankroll est tout aussi importante. Même avec une analyse de qualité, les séries de défaites sont inévitables, et c'est dans ces moments-là que les erreurs sont les plus fréquentes. Une mise fixe ou un modèle de pourcentage bien pensé permettent d'atténuer les fluctuations et d'éviter les pertes importantes.

À long terme, les paris sportifs reflètent l'état d'esprit du joueur. La patience, la capacité à reconnaître ses erreurs et la volonté de s'adapter aux nouvelles conditions sont essentielles. Ceux qui abordent le processus comme un système plutôt que comme une activité futile sont plus susceptibles de maintenir leur intérêt et de trouver un équilibre entre risque et responsabilité.

body.title: Running summary of the week // Résumé running de la semaine [EN/FR]
body.body:
<center>![running semaine 13 avril.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpGQAtA1a4JBe9riReKwiz1qcNnA2ze7NnEDzt42M2h4QyKUK6svvUwtReP9ub7pQ15.jpg)</center>

Hey everyone! I hope you're all doing great and that everything's going well for you 😁

I'm back today with my little running recap of last week. And as I mentioned, it's very short: I didn't do any running this week 😅

With @genesisledger, we spent the whole week on our property with the little cabin, doing some maintenance. We cut branches, and even some fallen trees. We also worked on the little path that goes around the pond.

<center>![6e998b20-822b-4517-8d45-625858106689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoryKt4oRQMqikvppvyYUtVSbhQvsZgmPWjZTXMjYHdJJvMJLyVFuxJXM5zDJAEYM9J.jpg)
![146ceca8-f84d-4dce-8ca8-816ff89e7d37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23wWpSW2dBRHa5adnhJRFbwnoyU2ksM9qtZEaAH7HABoR9Hs64syPGM2xCoqjJniYT4Zm.jpg)
![1b07ef02-847b-4b18-a066-d19f5acbf775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23uFKXjYih6vm82CjLtKwDjYyyKBYUtwN8GxgmKXjm9UoSHnVxjLvBruvJtpbh6SaMvCp.jpg)</center>

I also had some medical appointments to get during the week, and we had to drive a bit to get there.

In short, it kept us pretty busy.

So we didn't have time to go for a run!

We got back Saturday afternoon and had planned to go for a run Sunday morning. However, I still have some lower back pain (related to some health issues) and it makes me short of breath.

So we decided against a run and instead went for a long walk.

We walked about 10 km in 2 hours and 20 minutes. We walked without a specific destination, a bit aimlessly, passing through streets we knew and others we didn't.

<center>![marche dimanche.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xAM5Ji9xSR69ddN1mP8sVpVQFeRq4h3YQYoqEoAY3MQAYkLvCAujwH1GtNgfXT7fFQf.png)</center>

The weather was beautiful and pleasant. Especially at the beginning of spring, everything is green and beautiful.

This walk allowed us to keep up our streak of active weeks on our fitness app, Strava. And to avoid being completely inactive. It's better than nothing.

Anyway, for the coming week, we're back home and we're going to get back into running seriously: 2 to 3 sessions.

I'm also planning to resume my interval training (walking/running) to ease back into it after this week off.

Have a lovely sunny week, and don't forget to get moving—it feels great! 😁

See you soon, Johanna

PS: I used Google Translate for the English part.

__________________

<center>*Version en français*</center>
__________________

<center>![running semaine 13 avril.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EpGQAtA1a4JBe9riReKwiz1qcNnA2ze7NnEDzt42M2h4QyKUK6svvUwtReP9ub7pQ15.jpg)</center>

Hello les amis ! J’espère que vous allez tous très bien et que tout se passe bien pour vous 😁 

Je reviens aujourd’hui pour vous faire mon petit résumé running de la semaine précédente. Et comme je vous l’avais un peu dit, celui-ci est très court : je n’ai fait aucune séance de running cette semaine 😅

Avec @genesisledger, nous sommes partis toute la semaine sur notre terrain avec la petite cabane, pour faire un peu d’entretien. Nous avons coupé des branches, et même des arbres, qui étaient tombés. Nous avons également continué le petit chemin qui fait le tour de l’étang. 

<center>![6e998b20-822b-4517-8d45-625858106689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/EoryKt4oRQMqikvppvyYUtVSbhQvsZgmPWjZTXMjYHdJJvMJLyVFuxJXM5zDJAEYM9J.jpg)
![146ceca8-f84d-4dce-8ca8-816ff89e7d37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23wWpSW2dBRHa5adnhJRFbwnoyU2ksM9qtZEaAH7HABoR9Hs64syPGM2xCoqjJniYT4Zm.jpg)
![1b07ef02-847b-4b18-a066-d19f5acbf775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23uFKXjYih6vm82CjLtKwDjYyyKBYUtwN8GxgmKXjm9UoSHnVxjLvBruvJtpbh6SaMvCp.jpg)</center>

J’ai également eu quelques examens médicaux à passer dans la semaine, et nous avons dû faire un peu de route pour nous y rendre.

Bref, cela nous a bien occupés. 

Nous n’avons donc pas eu le temps d’aller courir ! 

Nous sommes rentrés samedi après-midi et nous avions prévu d’aller courir dimanche matin, cependant, j’ai encore quelques douleurs dans le bas du dos (liées à quelques problèmes de santé) et cela m'essouffle. 

Nous avons donc décidé de ne pas faire de séance de running, mais de remplacer cela par une grande balade.

Nous avons donc marché, environ 10km, pendant 2h20. On a marché sans réel but, un peu au hasard, en passant par des rues qu’on connaissait et d’autres qu’on ne connaissait pas. 

<center>![marche dimanche.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xAM5Ji9xSR69ddN1mP8sVpVQFeRq4h3YQYoqEoAY3MQAYkLvCAujwH1GtNgfXT7fFQf.png)</center>

Il faisait beau et bon, c’était très agréable. Surtout en ce début de printemps, tout est verdoyant, c’est beau.

Cette marche nous a permis de ne pas perdre notre série de semaines actives sur notre application de sport : Strava. Et de ne pas rester à ne rien faire. C’est mieux que rien.

Bref, pour la semaine à venir, nous sommes rentrés chez nous et nous allons reprendre la course sérieusement : 2 à 3 séances. 

Je pense aussi reprendre mon entraînement de fractionnés marche/course, pour reprendre en douceur après cette semaine d’arrêt.

Je vous souhaite une belle semaine ensoleillée et n’oubliez pas de bouger votre corps, ça fait du bien ! 😁

À bientôt, 
Johanna 

PS : J’ai utilisé Google Traduction pour traduire la partie en anglais.

body.body:
A license for what? I recently read about bicycle and animal-drawn vehicle licenses. I likened the latter to having a document to transfer or donate blood. Where's my culture? Donating blood has nothing to do with an animal-drawn vehicle license. It turns out that the animal-drawn vehicle license is for means of transport that move using the physical strength of living beings. Humans move bicycles, small carts (wheelbarrows, handcarts), and animals used for traction or cargo—horses, mules, donkeys, reindeer, oxen, elephants, ha ha ha. And I thought there were only licenses for driving motor vehicles, like there are in Venezuela, because I don't know anyone with a license to drive a bicycle, much less for animals, but apparently, it exists. >Licencia para que? Hace poco lei de las licencias para bicicleta y de tracción sangre, esta última la asemeje con tener un documento para transferir o donar sangre, donde esta mi cultura, donar sangre no tiene nada que ver con la licencia Tracción de sangre. Resulta que la licencia de conducir de Tracción de sangre tiene que ver con medios de transporte que se mueven con la fuerza física de seres vivos, los humanos movemos bicicletas, carretas pequeñas (carruchas, carretillas) los animales que se utilizan como como tracción o carga es decir caballos, mulas burros, renos, bueyes, elefantes, je je je y yo pensaba que solo había licencias para conducir vehículos a motor, como existe actualmente en Venezuela, porque no conozco a nadie con licencia para conducir bicicleta, para animales mucho menos pero según existe. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaXg1vcFNHkPLhNiCFoC5oQg4V4k25AceUMETQ6Bw8UVz/1776764392028.jpg) Good morning!
