body.title: Visiting the Baiturrahman Grand Mosque in Banda Aceh
body.body:
> ![1000605927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/244y1vmxCiZDMMPXs5mFMtSET9M27uUwQRsNbQ3hLUkvZetGhbQ6oy9arj78grqddFdte.jpg) *** *** Hi friends, when I was walking around the city of Banda Aceh, I really wanted to visit the Baiturrahman Grand Mosque. The Baiturrahman Grand Mosque is very famous in my province. This mosque has been around since 1612, built by Sultan Iskandar Muda as a place of worship for Muslims. This mosque was also burned by the Dutch and rebuilt in 1877. In 2004, a tsunami occurred in the city of Banda Aceh which was very powerful, but this mosque was able to stand strong and thousands of refugees were accommodated in this mosque. That's a brief history that I know about this historic mosque. ![1000605906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ydAEtkKj4vrgdtukw9QsfhexVCsMEMccorCTB8CcvPZYJsxNAE3QcvsgLgeSVkDXW6o.jpg) When traveling to Banda Aceh, I feel like a trip wouldn't be complete without visiting the Baiturrahman Grand Mosque. The building is very spacious and unique, with a clean white feel and seven black domes. In addition, the mosque area has electric umbrellas similar to the Nabawi Mosque in Saudi Arabia. This spacious mosque can accommodate thousands of worshippers to perform prayers. ![1000605909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eq9Vo9648hZsHup2ho6H2MwqQgmbKHVZfGZgcSSRuf3C3nb6yNYDoJzPQwYQPUPWHFq.jpg) ![1000605908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep5o8p72CGWKZejch1A685axzCg7k9sMsbbR8GQVxdyoxyr8L9rz3itgRk7HNDEAFih.jpg) and what amazed me about this mosque was that this mosque was the only building that survived the devastating tsunami, this mosque stood strong in the middle of the buildings around it that collapsed and were carried away by the water, even at the time of the tsunami there were many casualties, at that time including my uncle who died when the tsunami occurred ![1000605904.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eo8TKzxx32NQEQ6Gzyb9sWgdPcQdE6GyzvmpTABot4jVAbA5bLeNfgHo9jTCM58nq5J.jpg) ![1000605902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoGySnF2Mbp8nBuzWK1RAx8Rcs47gkpsuGK3GWRF6dtq2yTkJqHVd6XFb3baTeBh9FQ.jpg) The rest area is also very spacious, separated between men and women. The place is very clean with a very beautiful marble floor. And next to me k jfl kit there are also many bathrooms. The bathrooms are lined up in a row and are also very neat and clean. But unfortunately yesterday I didn't have time to take a picture of the bathroom. ![1000605903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EonkURCw9N15L3jQN4utV4DRM16zm5nxZfbf475xCUZTtgktD2cbeKBAz55icGw7dYm.jpg) In front of the rest area, there are stairs and escalators for us to go up or to the front of the mosque area which is very beautiful and very spacious. There are also photography services there. You can ask the photographer to take photos of you and your family at a fairly cheap price per photo. ![1000605915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpVDZ9Mo2A4vLxNc5yt6w4UyvQXnu8YTx39NWYPULtsRKGTLbKhRo98LuSVdh1s3Fm5.jpg) ![1000605916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMgpSSTPiakm131Cz7VCcA1AFhzjzEoVWr7KK7gVBjhL4FXGcm3AhTNtLZjL8z92mx6.jpg) Entering the main door of the mosque, there are very large and beautiful decorative lights, while the door is also very unique with a touch of dark brown iron door which gives an antique, magnificent and sacred impression which gives an interesting touch and also contrasts sharply with the white walls of the mosque.This door is also often used as a photo spot for tourists visiting this mosque. ![1000605917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23u6BGmL2LtHSYrtUT82LjycCHX9cGBWU4AKSSMqw8RfbC53b6V5mGVGYdr8Kow96r5vh.jpg) Entering the mosque, we can feel the religious atmosphere with its majestic pillars and Mughal architecture, decorated with large decorative lamps and cool marble floors. The main area of the mosque is specifically for people who will perform prayers, men and women are separated. On the edge of the mosque, there are also several glass cabinets for storing mukenas (prayer robes) for women. |![1000605920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpEHE1m5WdDN4nhQBJoqpKrRve6QWXk4LEEDyJ1N8xr9Tq8n4T1vDxGbr8DWYxBL1EF.jpg)|![1000605924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoErxMjSRyLoEpWpac1Fgv8deDAdGqAc9pCs1h9QLYF7fT6ouVahcGZHfsfdZcG1VeJ.jpg) |-|-| |![1000605921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23w2oGkohik3juatARBAjtUY7bCiYPtQowAn67iBYZ4Vy2JyuRPp92vvWopYtjrReWdhi.jpg)|![1000605923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23zGYLiMzAjMpkp5GXoSqpz65D6RAi2BSKAL7qMgiqzqYhE3RqVKKXzCoA6F8vcuJRPb6.jpg) |-|-| Beautiful, magnificent and cool, that's the picture I can describe when we enter the area of this mosque, with a very magnificent mosque atmosphere that makes everyone admire it when they see it. |![1000605922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/244A6gy7Prjvaymcz18gbgsY3cnvs5fUTQLMdD6zKxvZJ9K7tUzifhwpbmgLQSbeR48U6.jpg)|![1000605911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23x1Fg7UDb8QMU17HAyAFyD21q4nzbgPYXevN3GZthLBbqkNEgB5e39Us1JgkhK2wPSgT.jpg) |-|-| I also had time to take a photo with my child. Basically, I love this place, and I've seen many foreign tourists visiting this mosque. However, to enter this mosque, women must wear a headscarf and a long skirt. ![1000606609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/242NqmpMbQhzgZSgbfhRgG5ER3o22idhXQWwfLQLYZKgrTsNeYEjhkGXU1pbYzfMqVRJQ.jpg) *** *** *** ###
Thank you 🙂🤗
### *** *** ***

I am usually called Ryana, I come from Indonesia, my daily activities are working, cooking, taking care of the household, and also traveling, I really enjoy traveling with my husband and children. I also like enjoying culinary delights with my little family,Thank you very much for those who have taken the time to read my post this time, I hope this post is a little useful for the readers, and see you in my next post and I also really hope for the support of all friends, so that what we want while we are here we can make it happen</sub>

body.title: Wiens schönste Müllverbrennungsanlage
body.body:
Liebe Müll-Produzenten,
wer in Wien zum ersten Mal mit der U4 oder U6 an der Station Spittelau vorbeikommt, trifft auf ein überrasched buntes Gebäude, das so gar nicht nach Industrieanlage aussieht — Türme, goldene Kugeln, unregelmäßige Fassaden in Gelb, Blau und Rot und Bäume am Dach. Man könnte meinen, hier wurde ein weiteres [Hundertwasserhaus](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundertwasserhaus_(Wien)) errichtet. Was sich dahinter verbirgt, ist eine ganz gewöhnliche Müllverbrennungsanlage — oder doch nicht so gewöhnlich.

Blick vom Norden, von der Heiligenstädterbrücke über den Donaukanal.
![IMG_4326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/242rtshbry5wD4Xi4uGAg9pBYhX1MSJh6hBswLUEdqSWRt9Cm7rsAivgVcsHurGCe7tHv.jpg)
Die beiden Türme rechts im Hintergrund gehören zum [AKH](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allgemeines_Krankenhaus_der_Stadt_Wien), einem der größten Spitäler Europas, für deren Energieversorgung die ca. 2km entfernte Spittelau erst gebaut wurde. 

##### Von der nüchternen Zweckanlage zum Wahrzeichen
Die Anlage, offiziell \

genannt, wurde 1969-1971 von Simmering-Graz-Pauker errichtet, ein schlichter Industriebau, der seinen Zweck erfüllte und weiter nichts. 1987 zerstörte ein Brand große Teile der Anlage. Statt sie abzureißen, entschied die Stadt Wien, sie neu aufzubauen — und dabei etwas Außergewöhnliches zu wagen. Der Beharrlichkeit des damaligen Wiener Bürgermeisters Helmut Zilk (dessen Porträt heute im Stadtsenats-Sitzungssaal des [Rathauses](https://peakd.com/hive-166496/@stayoutoftherz/das-wiener-rathaus-viennas-city-hall) hängt) ist es zu verdanken, dass [Friedensreich Regentag Dunkelbunt Hundertwasser](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friedensreich_Hundertwasser) die Umgestaltung übernahm (1988-1992).\nDenn Hundertwasser war zuerst alles andere als begeistert: Er lehnte das Projekt aus ökologischen Gründen ab — er wollte nicht etwas verschönern, das der Natur schadet. Letztendlich stimmte er unter drei Bedingungen zu: modernste Filteranlagen, niemand sollte sich in seine Pläne einmischen, und er arbeitete unentgeltlich. So konnte niemand ihn beschuldigen, an einem „schmutzigen\

— eine österreichischen Redewendung für Aufgeben. Die Bauherren nahmen ihn beim Wort und ergänzten die Anlage tatsächlich um besagtes Kapperl, für das Hundertwasser berühmt war, weil er es fast immer trug (er hatte es selbst genäht, denn er war auch ein guter Schneider).
![IMG_4524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/242DNom745J4bvfTNZoo1PiuZfLCqnwodTWRrxbynfYhq4hps3hMppVY5wdwfzyNiS2TQ.jpg)
Links im Hintergrund der Kahlenberg.

Blick vom Dach über den Donaukanal auf die Brigittenau (20. Bezirk Wiens). Man sieht rechts der Bildmitte 2 der insg. 6 [Flak-Türme](https://peakd.com/deutsch/@stayoutoftherz/about-the-flak-towers-in-vienna-die-flak-tuerme-in-wien) (ziemlich genau in deren Mitte weiter hinten das Riesenrad). Rechts vom rechten Flakturm sind die beiden 200m hohen Schlote des Kraftwerks Simmering zu sehen, des größten Kraftwerks Österreichs, das bei Vollast 50% der Wiener Haushalte mit Strom versorgen kann. Aber das ist eine andere Geschichte...
![IMG_4519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/Eq9VLxNFNuWhtH3tuzVKP95pZfd9BHGm5ndgmZgbjXbpHTSCWXtKYeewjo1Y3Lxgv6v.jpg)

Am besten ist natürlich **Abfallvermeidung**! Je weniger Hausmüll entsteht, umso weniger davon muss  aufwendig entsorgt werden!
Zuletzt noch eine Frage: Wohin mit Pizzakartons, Restmüll oder Altpapier? Was meint Ihr?

all pics by @stayoutoftherz

**Fernwärme Wien — Spittelau**
Adresse: Spittelauer Lände 45, 1090 Wien
Erreichbarkeit: U4/U6 Station Spittelau
Führungen (gratis): online anmelden via wienenergie.at

body.title: Flat knot bracelet with the initial of the character Panyin
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hello, #holozing community! It’s a pleasure to greet you all and wish you a happy and blessed Tuesday. Today I’m going to share some fan art inspired by a character known as Panyin. My fan art is a flat knot bracelet made with colored threads and the initial (P) of the character’s name. Without further ado, I invite you to join me in this fascinating creation and get started with the thread.

> **
ENGLISH
** Hola, comunidad #holozing Es un placer saludaros a todos y desearos un feliz y bendecido martes. Hoy voy a compartir un fan art inspirado en un personaje conocido como Panyin. Mi fan art es una pulsera de nudo plano hecha con hilos de colores y la inicial (P) del nombre del personaje. Sin más preámbulos, os invito a que me acompañéis en esta fascinante creación y os pongáis manos a la obra con el hilo. ![1000391027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EowHe4T7dHNGDV48LURtLm9dSMUyGL9VVUDwYS4zjfTPKrrRT84C6N9tZU5DFxr1pWL.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> The materials I used to make this beautiful bracelet are as follows, namely: Thread Scissors Lighter Measuring tape Adhesive tape

> Los materiales que utilicé para realizar esta hermosa pulsera son los siguientes, a saber: Hilo Tijera Encendedor Cinta métrica Cinta adhesiva ![1000391034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoputTQA9Gv8DBGUyqjacJaoC6B8cEmgRKAfdWb7s2admEfGgaCLFg6BqezdfC895ME.jpg)
> To begin this beautiful jewelry I started by cutting two 40cm strands of thread which I will use as the base for our bracelet.

> Para empezar esta preciosa joya empecé cortando dos hebras de hilo de 40 cm que utilizaré como base para nuestra pulsera ![1000391033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eos2M9ULRAPiShnMnazVKTKNFu5k4pSs1sV3XT2CFedSNixe1grDtPCVQdfsBNJo5N5.jpg)
> Then I cut a 130cm strand of thread to make the flat weave of the bracelet.

> Después corté una hebra de hilo de 130cm para realizar el tejido plano de la pulsera. ![1000391032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpNpqY7EvC6QPdt7JZeCR7h8uhPZmRpeyrkPVZ69DCbLVb8TFwzoe4FVC1zvfkXSUtt.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

> Started the bracelet by making flat knots in the following way: First I took the right strand, passed it over the base, made a P shape, then took the left strand, passed it over the right strand (which was on the left side), then passed it over the base and pulled it through the inside of the right strand (the P shape). Then I stretched the thread on each side evenly to make the knot. With your fingers you press it so that it is even on both sides and so we begin our weaving

> Inicié la pulsera realizando nudos planos de la siguiente manera: Primero tomé el hilo derecho, lo pasé por encima de la base , hice una forna de P, luego tomé el hilo izquierdo, lo pase por encima del hilo derecho (que estaba del lado izquierdo) , seguidamente lo pasé por dejado de la base y lo saqué por dentro del hilo derecho (la forma de P). Después estiré el hilo de cada lado uniformemente para hacer el nudo. Con los dedos se presiona para que quede igual de ambos lados Así comenzamos nuestro tejido. ![1000391024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogPD6WbQ3gx59asw2drTCMFRyySbK5Q2AdJ367EEeqUXYGmLWcCHAXhR3YFcYdXYHj.jpg)

> Now I took the thread on the left side and passed it over the base thread, I formed a kind of four, then I passed the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then I passed it under the base thread and took it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then I pressed with my fingers so that both sides have similarity

> Ahora tomé el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formé una especie de cuatro, luego pasé el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasé por debajo del hilo base y lo saqué por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen. Seguidamente con los dedos presioné para que de ambos lados tengan similitud. ![1000391023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoeGnpUNWyc731UXcsxhfpvEnKfBQ5ETyzACdEd4cWie38VDAjiiHgBYfaJCBTBmRdX.jpg)
> I continued making seven complete flat knots until I reached 7 cm.

body.title: How does crypto redefine trust in a monetary system?
body.body:
![0198426c-45ef-72fd-b1cc-bbfaf668d58f.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/2431hYCE1hktWdv4qdEo3VwDTZn4nQEJq4tpGkaiH6nFAYRjDUbCr3UksmGLr4yPWf8FJ.webp)

Every monetary system rests on a foundation of trust. Whether that trust is placed in a central bank, a government, a gold reserve, or an algorithmic protocol, money only functions when enough people believe it will hold its value and move reliably between hands. 

For centuries, that trust has been institutional, mediated by banks, regulated by states, and enforced by legal systems. Cryptocurrency challenges this arrangement at its most fundamental level.

The old system has most countries ultimately reliant on the government and its legal system.

This is what the \

that fiat money has functioned on looks like.

Crypto assets move that trust away from the familiar centralized systems to something else.

Although, the phrase \

is often thrown around when addressing crypto protocols, systems or solutions which leads to a misrepresentation of meaning, but what that usually entail is the absence of centralized intermediaries, not that there isn't a trust layer at all.

There's still a trust element, just in a very different form.

### Solutions born in a crisis

The best solutions or at least, the most marketable ones, are built around existing problems with high demand for a fix. As a result, it helps to try understanding what crypto redefines by looking at what it was built to replace. 

Research shows that the Bitcoin white paper was published on October 31, 2008, by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto, at the precise moment when global trust in traditional financial institutions was collapsing. The document reportedly landed over two weeks after the U.S. government announced a $700 billion bank bailout package under the Emergency Economic Stabilization Act. Hedge funds, central banks, and financial conglomerates had made over-leveraged bets on the economy, socialized their losses onto taxpayers, and largely escaped accountability.

The Bitcoin solution was born amidst a crisis.

People needed an alternative to a system that was too reliant on the actions of a few persons chasing profits at the expense of everyone and everything else.

What Bitcoin was offering wasn't the absence of trust, but a shift away from placing trust in a centralized body.

### Incentives is the new trust layer enforced by math

Crypto's monetary system is fundamentally incentives layers built on math deployed as code of rules, on-chain.

The conventional monetary system operates on what economists call a trust hierarchy. At the apex sits the central bank, which issues base money and serves as the lender of last resort. Below it are commercial banks, which extend credit, hold deposits, and execute payments. 

Individuals and businesses trust this hierarchy because the state backstops it through deposit insurance, regulatory oversight, legal recourse, and, when all else fails, the printing press.

Blockchain-based systems replace this hierarchy with a different mechanism.

That mechanism is incentives. And it does this by \

trust.

Let me say that again:

Blockchains do not eliminate trust they distribute it. Power and trust are shared among the network's stakeholders, developers, miners, validators, and users rather than concentrated in a single individual or institution such as a bank or government.

This means, essentially, that the monetary layer is simultaneously also the governance layer of the entire network's economic system.

The reason this works is because incentives are at the center of it all and the other side of these incentives is a costly risk factor.

So trust isn't merely distributed, that distribution is rewarded and any act of bad faith is punished with a great loss.

One way to phrase is that crypto redefines trust by, ironically, \
the math that groups of diverse humans will rather play fair \

for perceived rewards than risk an individual great loss.

body.title: Có nên mua xe ô tô đứng tên công ty cho cá nhân? Phân tích rõ lợi – hại
body.body:
Đây là câu hỏi rất nhiều người cân nhắc khi muốn tối ưu chi phí và thuế. Câu trả lời không đơn giản là “nên” hay “không”, mà phụ thuộc vào mục đích sử dụng và tình huống cụ thể.

Tìm hiểu thêm: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/mua-xe-o-to-dung-ten-cong-ty/> 

![mua-xe-dung-ten-cong-ty.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/7d9d6382b054bf318a799a4ef009a103a6ea52c89433a72fd0f60013b9733731)



1.  Xe đứng tên công ty là gì?

👉 Là xe được đăng ký sở hữu bởi doanh nghiệp, dù người sử dụng thực tế là cá nhân (giám đốc, nhân viên…).

➡️ Về pháp lý:

Xe thuộc tài sản công ty

Không phải tài sản cá nhân

1.  Lợi ích khi mua xe đứng tên công ty

✔️ 1. Được tính chi phí hợp lý

👉 Công ty có thể hạch toán:

Khấu hao xe

Chi phí xăng dầu

Bảo dưỡng, sửa chữa

➡️ Giúp giảm lợi nhuận chịu thuế

✔️ 2. Khấu trừ thuế GTGT

👉 Nếu đủ điều kiện:

Có hóa đơn VAT

Phục vụ hoạt động kinh doanh

➡️ Có thể khấu trừ VAT đầu vào

✔️ 3. Tối ưu thuế doanh nghiệp

👉 Giảm:

Thuế TNDN

➡️ Đây là lý do chính nhiều người chọn

1.  Nhược điểm cần cân nhắc

❌ 1. Không phải tài sản cá nhân

👉 Bạn không toàn quyền:

Muốn bán → phải qua công ty

Phải làm thủ tục thanh lý

❌ 2. Bị khống chế chi phí

👉 Với xe ≤ 9 chỗ:

Chỉ được khấu hao tối đa 1,6 tỷ đồng

➡️ Xe đắt hơn → phần dư không được tính chi phí

❌ 3. Rủi ro về thuế

👉 Nếu sử dụng xe:

Không phục vụ kinh doanh

Không chứng minh được chi phí

➡️ Có thể bị:

Truy thu thuế

Xuất toán chi phí

❌ 4. Phát sinh thêm thủ tục

Kế toán, chứng từ

Theo dõi chi phí

Quyết toán thuế

1.  Khi nào NÊN mua xe đứng tên công ty?

👉 Phù hợp nếu:

Bạn có doanh nghiệp hoạt động thực tế

Xe phục vụ công việc (đi gặp khách, công trình…)

Muốn tối ưu thuế hợp pháp

1.  Khi nào KHÔNG nên?

👉 Không phù hợp nếu:

Chỉ dùng xe cá nhân

Công ty không phát sinh doanh thu rõ ràng

Không muốn ràng buộc thủ tục

1.  So sánh nhanh

Tiêu chí  Đứng tên công ty  Đứng tên cá nhân

Quyền sở hữu  Công ty  Cá nhân

Thuế  Có lợi  Không tối ưu

Thủ tục  Phức tạp  Đơn giản

Tính linh hoạt  Thấp  Cao

1.  Lời khuyên thực tế

👉 Nếu bạn:

Có công ty hoạt động ổn định

➡️ Nên đứng tên công ty

👉 Nếu bạn:

Chỉ mua để đi lại cá nhân

➡️ Nên đứng tên cá nhân

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Nên mua xe đứng tên công ty khi:

Có hoạt động kinh doanh thật

Muốn tối ưu thuế

👉 Không nên khi:

Dùng cá nhân là chính

Ngại thủ tục

Kết luận

👉 Mua xe đứng tên công ty:

Có lợi về thuế

Nhưng bị hạn chế quyền sở hữu và thủ tục phức tạp

➡️ Quyết định đúng nhất:

Phụ thuộc vào mục đích sử dụng thực tế của bạn

For sure, he got fangs too, so I added that up. - coloring

> ![terrarrionsleeping2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jijisaurart/Eq5B8scMoZx8TL3bTvDb5VYN5A8ZrRvYJWLoc2JWa2qT46ifcLBwMbVF23CcJr8DeZM.png) Base color on the first layer and then clipped airbrushed shading. body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4bff4af1-b37c-45c3-ae36-7cc897da5331.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1c0e2061-fd5c-415e-9a5f-16d2f1b03d57.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ceef8548-5269-4668-aa7b-413720a64cb1.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1e3a3a9f-5912-4501-a43d-6fd7822819a2.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/01af0d1e-f9e3-4129-bca3-b32ff58de3f8.jpg)
🇵🇱 Krótko i konkretnie — dziś rano rozruch na bieżni i lekka siłownia nóg. 10 minut spokojnego biegu, żeby obudzić ciało, a potem siła — bez przesady, bez „bo mogę więcej”. To nie jest trening na wynik. To jest trening pod wynik. Podtrzymanie, aktywacja, czucie nóg. Nic spektakularnego, ale dokładnie to, co trzeba w tym momencie. Czasem forma robi się właśnie tak — po cichu. --- 🇬🇧 Simple and controlled — today started with an easy treadmill warm-up and a light leg session. 10 minutes just to wake the body up, then strength work — no ego, no pushing beyond the plan. This isn’t a workout for results. This is a workout for what’s coming. Maintenance, activation, feeling the legs. Nothing flashy, just exactly what’s needed right now. Sometimes fitness is built quietly.

 **Passing the Torch**

Earlier this year I already posted about the Apple CEO succession and now it’s official: in the same year Apple turns 50, and after 15 years of doing a tremendous job, Tim Cook will hand over the CEO role to John Ternus in September.

Ternus is a longtime Apple insider himself, having led the Hardware division over the past years. There’s that photo of the two of them taking a walk together, it says a lot about this transition, which is a hugely important one for the American tech industry.

It feels a bit like Berkshire: just as with Buffett, Cook has built an exceptional track record over many years, and investors now have to decide whether they can place the same level of trust in the next leader. body.title: Almost Isn’t Enough
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_4988.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tm7KTL8bdBhPGQkSe8ewHgzcxRRx7xeFYGoxD1QEwokTfo6hipVPjobpmfHJCMpPaG8.jpeg)

I came across a video this morning and it’s been bothering me ever since. It’s about the Delaware marathon, featuring one of those moments where everything comes down to the final stretch. One runner was clearly ahead, so close to the finish line that victory was almost certain. It was clear he had endured the distance, and all that was left was a few more steps.

But then, he slowed down and began to celebrate. I suppose he thought he had already won, thinking the finish line was close enough to claim victory before actually crossing it. But  in that little celebratory moment, another runner came from behind and sprinted past him. And just like that, the one who almost won, didn’t. Very sad.

![IMG_4989.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23ywm1wtmz3V6LRs76EPj6H7ry6xCxkW8YAgTs5d9p5jzrhV3U2WE62jt3ZnLDntUXckG.jpeg)

Watching it, my perspective shifted as I thought of how often we do this in our own lives. We get close to a moment we’ve worked so hard for and instead of staying focused until the very end, we relax too soon, assuming the outcome is secured. We celebrate before the work is fully done. Sometimes, that’s all it takes to lose it. This is not because we weren’t capable or because we didn’t put in the effort but because we stopped too early.

That video reminded me that almost is not enough. Being close is not the same as finishing. And until the job is done, like completely done, we owe it to ourselves to keep going with the same energy and same determination we had at the beginning.

There is nothing wrong with celebrating but timing matters as the finish line is not where you think it is, it’s where your effort ends. So the lesson is simple, but heavy. Do not slow down yet or celebrate just yet. Don’t assume you’ve won. Finish first, then celebrate.


<sup>[img](https://pixabay.com/photos/car-racing-race-track-n%c3%bcrburgring-4394450/)</sup>

<sup>[img2](https://pixabay.com/photos/motocross-race-sport-speed-extreme-4948269/)</sup>

body.title: Sportsblock World Cup Competition Open for Entries
body.body:
![World Cup 2026 Fantasy](https://sportsblock.app/marketing/assets/contest-card-void-world-cup-contest.png)

## 48 teams. 4 pots. 16 picks. One trophy.

The **World Cup 2026 Fantasy Contest** is live now at **[sportsblock.app/contests/world-cup-2026](https://sportsblock.app/contests/world-cup-2026)**. Free to enter. **500 HIVE plus 10,000 MEDALS** in the pool. Entries lock at **23:59 UTC on 10 June 2026** — the night before Mexico kicks the whole thing off in the Estadio Azteca. Thanks to @fullcoverbetting for coming up with the format for this flagship event. 

That's roughly seven weeks to go so start planning. Course we don't want you to enter straight away. Injuries could play a crucial part in your selection process over the next couple of week. 

---

## The format

FIFA split 48 nations into 4 pots of 12. You pick **4 teams from each pot** — 16 teams total — and slap a **unique multiplier from 1 to 16** on each. Higher multiplier = you're more confident = more points when that team cooks.

Half fantasy, half conviction test. Yes, you can whack Argentina with a ×16 — but that means you've then only got a ×1 left for whoever you rate from Pot 4, and four of your picks are coming from the likes of Haiti, Curaçao, Cape Verde, Czechia. Those teams don't need to win the thing. They just need to nick a couple of points you weren't expecting.

Then you lodge a **tie-breaker guess**: how many goals the tournament will cough up in regulation time. Group stage plus knockouts. Extra time and pens don't count. Use it to separate yourself from the herd.

---

## How you score

Every match your picked teams play:

- **Win** → 3 points
- **Draw** → 1 point
- **Goal scored** → 1 point per goal

Multiply by the coefficient you gave that team. Then hand it in.

If you've got Brazil on a ×10 and they win 3-0, that's (3 + 3) × 10 = **60 points**.
If you've got Curaçao on a ×1 and they lose 4-0, that's zero. It happens.

---

## Knockout bonuses — this is where it gets interesting

Teams that make it past the group stage rack up cumulative bonuses. Every round reached pays on top of the match points. All multiplied by your coefficient, obviously.

- Round of 32 → **+2**
- Round of 16 → **+3**
- Quarter-final → **+4**
- Semi-final → **+5**
- Runner-up → **+6**
- Champion → **+7**

Pick the eventual winner with a ×16 multiplier and just their knockout bonuses are worth (2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 7) × 16 = **336 points**. On top of every match point they rack up along the way.

This is why your ×16 is a terrifying decision.

---

## The prizes

**500 HIVE + 10,000 MEDALS.** Split 60/25/15 across the top three:

| | MEDALS | HIVE |
|---|---|---|
| 🥇 1st | **6,000** | **300** |
| 🥈 2nd | 2,500 | 125 |
| 🥉 3rd | 1,500 | 75 |

Funded by Sportsblock. Free to enter. If the leaderboard ties, the tie-breaker prediction separates you.

---

## The deadline

**Entries close 23:59 UTC on 10 June 2026.** Roughly 24 hours before Mexico v whoever-wins-qualifying-Group-A in the opener.

Once the first whistle goes, picks are locked forever. No group-stage rebalance. No *\

* No soft-close Thursday extension. The whole point of this contest is that you pick in April and live with it for five weeks.\n\nSo yes — it matters whether you do this today or leave it until 22:00 on 10 June with Wi-Fi that *\

*

---

## How to enter

1. Sign in at **[sportsblock.app](https://sportsblock.app)** — Hive Keychain, HiveSigner, Google, whatever you've got
2. Head to **[/contests/world-cup-2026](https://sportsblock.app/contests/world-cup-2026)**
3. Pick your 16. Assign your multipliers. Lodge your tie-breaker.
4. Hit enter and forget about it until June

No stake. No rolling reselect. No paid premium tier. Just your 16 picks against the rest of Sportsblock for seven weeks of football.

---

**Pure sports. Real rewards. Pick 16.**

body.title: The AI Paradox - how to prepare for the future ?
body.body:
>

We can't deny that the world is changing at a pace that is quite difficult to follow and AI is taking a more and more important role. We see new things coming out, not on a monthly or yearly basis but on a daily basis. There are new models, new ways of working, new interfaces, new user experiences that AI makes possible. 

Nowadays, it's not just a question of whether AI can actually substitute jobs. It's already doing that at a large scale. Companies like Meta are laying off a lot of developers and substituting them with AI. AI is here to stay and AI is evolving. Probably most of us don't really realize at what speed this is happening. 

Some people still think that there are a lot of jobs that won't be affected by that but it's not the truth because AI doesn't come alone. There is so much development at the moment around robots that are actually powered by AI that will replace jobs like electrician or cleaning personnel.

## The AI Paradox
The problem with that, and what I consider an AI paradox is that if people lose their jobs on all fronts, we will have on one side a whole sector of the population that has reduced income and on the other side things, products, and services that get cheaper and cheaper to purchase. But who is going to purchase all that if people don't have any money anymore? The economy lives from the consuming population and if this population can't consume anymore, what will happen? 

> This is something that Ford understood when he started mass producing cars. He made sure that all his employees were earning enough that they could afford to buy a car.

It's a question of what system the future holds for us because the capitalist system that is relying on people getting wages for their work seems to be at a dead end. There is a second level because our government structures are also based on this concept of people having a salary and getting taxed on the salary. 

## Crisis ahead ?
So if employees don't have any money, if governments run out of money, we could think that the economy will come to a kind of standstill. I believe that this is already happening at the moment, that we have actually reduced consuming activity in all the different categories. What is worst for people is that they don't have the security that their income will last.

Let's say that you are a software engineer and then you see that other people are laid off. It brings fear to you. What do you do? You start to reduce your expenses, you save because you don't have trust into the stability of your future employment. This means that less money is circulating. This is a circle that leads sooner or later to an economic negative growth or a crisis. 

So maybe we shouldn't put too much energy into fearing for our jobs. Maybe we should think about how our future could look like in the face of AI and robots taking over a lot of the workforce that exists now. This is the big question and I think that it's worth thinking about. 


## Geopolitical challenges of the future
One other thing that I would like to point out. If products are very cheap to produce and there are no more wages to be paid, there are other things that start to matter even more, like the things that the whole AI economy requires: 
- energy 
- soil 
- primary resources 
- water 

These four elements are the future strategic items that the governments are fighting for. Even if we are not aware of this directly at the moment, it is already happening when you see billionaires that try to go to space to figure out how they could use the resources from space. When China is thinking about building a huge power plant in the atmosphere that would collect the solar energy, when we see China and other countries fighting over our arable land in Africa, all such things contribute to the same picture. This is the future challenge that we all face. The struggle of power will be to have access to these key ingredients: water, energy, soil, and primary resources. 

How do you see it? How do you think the evolution will happen? Will there be a big crash, a big crisis or will it be an organic transition?

body.body:
![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/a723aa4325b3d7e4561365ef1ce25f0f639e14bc5a400e1d53c3737b402e5dc0)

A Motorcycle Tour India offers diverse landscapes, from Himalayan passes to coastal highways. Choosing the right bike defines the experience, and Royal Enfield has become the top choice for riders worldwide. Its strong build, simple mechanics, and comfort make it ideal for long journeys across varied terrain.

What makes Royal Enfield perfect for Exploring India on Motorcycles?

When Exploring India on Motorcycle, reliability matters more than speed. Royal Enfield motorcycles are designed for endurance and stability.

Key advantages include

*   \- Strong suspension suited for rough Indian roads

*   \- Comfortable seating for long-distance travel

*   \- Easy availability of spare parts across India

*   \- High torque engine ideal for mountains and highways

These features ensure a smoother and more confident ride, especially for international travelers unfamiliar with Indian road conditions.

Why choose a Motorcycle road trip on a Royal Enfield in India?

A [Motorcycle ride in India on Royal Enfield](https://www.brahmandtour.com/motorcycle-tours-in-india) is more than transportation. It is about connection with the journey.

Riders benefit from

*   \- Wide service network in major and remote areas

*   \- Classic design that enhances the travel experience

*   \- Trusted performance across Ladakh, Rajasthan, and Kerala

*   \- Perfect for adventure tours like the Himalayas. 

In conclusion, Royal Enfield stands as a reliable partner for any motorcycle adventure in India, delivering both comfort and authenticity for an unforgettable ride.

title.title: La Caleta, a very popular beach with a special charm 📷 Málaga – Spain
title.body:
> --- >Every part of the city has its own little details and unique characteristics; even within the city itself, there are areas, neighbourhoods, beaches and parks that seem to belong to a different city altogether. --- ![Image_1776727595637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqq2XR1cvku8NVyCs8xoHSekN9xvvUmWvkaRPUe1fB55spR6EkVJM3E6SseUW6YvYqG.jpg) --- So far, I’ve visited several beaches; in some cases, I’ve gone specifically to one of them, and in others, I’ve taken a long walk along several, when they aren’t too long. But in this case, I’m bringing you one of the most popular beaches; in fact, I believe, in my opinion and based on my visits, that it’s the second most popular in Málaga. The first is La Malagueta. I usually prefer quieter beaches for relaxing and enjoying the sea, and although at first, when I arrived in Málaga, I used to go to the most famous and touristy one, it was always very crowded, so for quite some time I chose to walk a bit further and head to La Caleta. --- ![20250912_172224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYdMTrVQzkGhYKZCu2mBpVcFVG9nxDzFvLBPu4jFggYFYn2piV1KLVgk8bFQxyP38ro.jpg) ![20250912_172227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243Lxi8U36t9Q9iF2FW2XEDevgHUvikxKaNWDtUCxUgvTdc9nj3Cdd3gdzRQn9h77D4pb.jpg) ![20250912_172234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8oasjGsKp84tNxTtBiuinHf7aqLXgebwTnbH45555Mo9GUqsAwUzszeUZi6qUwG4td.jpg) ![20250922_164416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKrQJ4orJDiTUM9wcK4Hyrb5TtiV9sBGXUeR6y6RtWjohZtTtrJcfrVA82zjiw5zwo5.jpg) ![20250922_174524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4c45gc7kLUjxZ8NjPXRpuSJFkRzPj1cseqmtoDBsiugTT9uQS85mL4baV9fcwHZXS1.jpg) ![20250922_174507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241QTNFMsQyu2orvAL6gxdWxoLUnkueopt151XWu3SLseWhhkn2R6jzKhHEJxtVWXVGrY.jpg) ![20250922_174627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYjfrkbne36RDUh9B8tQRujEnDL23dVgY4TswXioZWtTC5Qe935qGQUmP7i3P2a5JhY.jpg) ![20250922_174631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGa9KSPMgvH9b7SdGJxMvm7MbHdjuBZwbtvoTiSMYy3i5xodmtWJmubGXp1zMKgk4kc.jpg) --- Walking along its promenade offers the chance to look out over the Mediterranean Sea on one side and the various buildings on the other, many of them hotels or places exclusively for tourists, although there are people who have flats overlooking the sea. That’s the best bit of all. The sea is always my favourite thing to see on my walk, but this beach is full of beach bars with excellent restaurants and plenty of space, where you can choose to eat inside or on the terraces with an incredible view of the water and the horizon. --- ![20250922_174734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1nzhcKnUkbLqbGRpbMzyqRcu3wNqxiYnCAzCv9kPoeRXoKEX5xSVb9hRAdWbxJxRHj.jpg) ![20250922_174642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sdfpngHUaa9Rbt6BjVeiXy2GzVtiuiR4fSdJU4PYcAc99wNFEq47yVmY88XWfGdNUsj.jpg) ![20250922_174655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVEhKKc9sPLLUiXBnYKJA4djL1TaaBLdnEvR4wD1K2Qtdh5MiUs1w6epqW5NDfWRMSR.jpg) ![20250922_174736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd5nTzXoxFNLdJmmFX2KimP27GRhgAYvSTUodbk32rq6ZTboz6fzHzfkrEJsLQcNXes.jpg) ![20250922_175047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245ca8mn4bpcpo4SjELecKLzXSM497WvrL6jCfY32ePqBxtwuhTDPCt5doHRSSu5JvMgu.jpg) ![20250922_175332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245TEGnq3Wd3JuEpV6eUPVXcRjC8xekMuiGGyAjiWXGthgEbnJNyDdjfEvKEdNYAaA2Wi.jpg) ![20250922_175400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odaCjverZJV8gwekhv6YR5AqKqcE86fEhHs5gM12ocnHdUMLE3xv4LLgMcQXp88ZzM.jpg) --- It’s a beach full of green spaces near the promenade, with plenty of palm trees, so you can enjoy the shade in the height of summer, have a picnic, or make the most of the sunny spots. To be honest, I prefer the sunny spots; I love sunbathing whenever I can. According to the information signs that appear every now and then on the beach, it stretches for 1,000 metres, although it seems much longer. I usually walk from west to east, but on this occasion I started the other way round. --- ![20250922_174830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vPLieHRRSp3jQuMdH5AXc7GSHgdUzkpLXVtM1HkjJLzBXJ4ZeGMvwuoDJ7dxde8fKNU.jpg) ![20250922_174824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zff9iHrnd5nbNJWP6ZjJWH2qCmnqsfA6GWgnaHvCEsA6FsZY4QyUbWwPg2QjktwwKw.jpg) ![20250922_175315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A2UA8x7q2yJYKwpPUCHLMAHLrzX2MSRHB2SZEhVUkFAmQKhGTAKxTiFzhAporevfX7.jpg) ![20250922_175423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432BAUfB459GtVKPtx5uMEpjtiqMEJNHkL3vU43ugkCt1tX54WWSiU8FkwroZNE6vvtx.jpg) ![20250922_175749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zZRmLTELLXGgdGqwv9Z3ze7CPZ3inbAs93WZxzmd3L3imdbCsWDNymiMArAnGM3rxf.jpg) ![20250922_175427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z7Bd7GXnaK4RSM8Wtkh1WbrP93DiyJwtrgWm7fPSjMfsXPJmQcXKunS72BprdpSy3ub.jpg) ![20250922_175508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432FMRvVm3MLrD7biPLFx3pnaNbo1qQ8RMAZmkh3st5bQ2HT2xmY8qdktoHRs2TxT2A4.jpg) ![20250922_175606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odaD6XoUAXJKyHb462QeD44ExA6XXmDJZuXNEsBHAUZX6NE4MxqGH8EZa71YPyth3d.jpg) --- La Caleta beach is situated between Baños del Carmen beach, or rather, from a stretch of beach just beyond the latter, which forms part of Pedregalejo beach, and extends all the way to La Malagueta beach. It’s in the eastern part of the city, which I think is why it’s one of the most popular with tourists. The beaches in the western part are more family-oriented. The promenade that runs alongside it is the Pablo Ruiz Picasso Promenade. It’s a beach where, although there are plenty of tourists, it’s better maintained than La Malagueta, and over the years I’ve seen various improvements, such as pedestrian walkways and cycle paths, improvements that keep it in good condition and make it appealing to visitors. It is one of the beaches closest to the city centre, which I think is why it is the second most popular choice. --- ![20250922_180016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUGWny88uFHNdNmWMS6nB1sbKGuRwe4Qr3ydumv83BSHJrnX473EfkKsZzZcJ2cSq5P.jpg) ![20250922_180021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241tWyhRV5zsHzBEra6P8BnrcMaePG11Bp1TpNXn13UGXBjrPnE4kxzmLayMefYcCWMtp.jpg) ![20250922_175555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMWDtMTsfswoi64BEVaYMYbzWEKa6oHxMZ2PiwUeWQy6kRho4CXqYLrzgKKgTeBFxaB.jpg) ![20250922_180149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fp1KW4S2KDpCCRgij5Z8bJshbvgFqDvTT9sDLSAQYwhPXqWtxvHVEqRNYNhGPHtG4d.jpg) ![20250922_180248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A4viRH6V6x9nXFCAJbXK1ur2QfzkfczEDDotV3QYRwTxq65zkTQyBHZpcaobNnrqsz.jpg) ![20250922_180143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sJrT1w2RL4atARwnQfmrdsGN99g7SmK49fwMuj14iB46ENJ1gavm5JEDwyk781egp7M.jpg) ![20250922_180332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241Zt6hpZRRPj2PuCw2tnx5vNm5VCuicGEAug7nMhQZi1STsu8oT4UZDKXx6qLTi9Fo7M.jpg) --- In the past, it was also a quiet beach used for fishing, like so many others in the eastern part of the city, but there have been so many improvements that the difference from the others is now very noticeable, particularly in the buildings, structures and even the sand. As I mentioned, every so often along the stretch there is a beach bar with very modern restaurants, each with its own style, and I think this is one of the things that sets it apart the most. --- ![20250922_180432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ujmxJM9HUgfQDW7YA8r86WHFCTCBWkjMhK1vgwuWxkHQoEoPHPn3sd9DVNFEhrxu4YG.jpg) ![20250922_180255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fpTSMdc1gY4VGGzzKWRgQnQ16bR67M2nbBHep1QtSyKLmBW6UYk1jS5BQ27fh68fhP.jpg) ![20250922_180726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245myNMWC8UehzYV5M9KaEvEd2SNpifgMemRg18xcrXHu8FSySL6aB9ea6DKCYu6o6YWq.jpg) ![20250922_180530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eGkUdcfQvXyuo4QnK7AA7cXsiao62tfZ2d1eZg8kiAY4wHmcWSije79Lrf3VBdZ14x.jpg) ![20250922_180526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244y1hGVZtHggo5cGgcSmhsubDQzyBY7eTxE1fE1nFgKPsNk129ZNGztUwk9e8iwetyMt.jpg)
![20250922_180604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqs27pQv4Hjw2hXxh1V3NKp59rtETXJMm8cymURwuXFKidVaHS9QoKrkpScjZyuqY5t.jpg)
![20250922_180608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Y9vRfhuACFGkWJ2u6rim5RtVKxe5sDkNKH3L4bAzG1wk7tGkrHUrw63W76KyeGQbtu.jpg) --- It shares its name with, or derives its name from, the neighbourhood nearby, which was once a very affluent area, home to the bourgeoisie, particularly in the late 19th century. The beach is part of a luxury residential area; indeed, one of the finest hotels, the five-star Hotel Miramar, is situated very close by, overlooking the sea. It is the most luxurious hotel I have ever seen. --- ![20250922_181301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJJkd1qUKYAVX85L6UoLWyuhvj6kCbUNqNgBNDoxyd4bRevqsDkmyzXtB3qRqCJdMuC.jpg) ![20250922_181322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUMBJeiYSr4L38mXtvipDqFgG4gyxhUKXbKRT52danejpz4mg9FpW48qEyeeuNkEFmS.jpg) ![20250922_181331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242ryBXpCCpZJQWcaQiFTSErARFbaXBwNPjjx9axomrsUaeWy71T3cCPDLEHSqd5gMEwH.jpg) ![20250922_181435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NjC3MAVzZYKmbkGhwYWp7HUtSxwsJmntQWMYvG35ncFSzjENvTap8UfGET8zRQ2MzZ.jpg) ![20250922_181334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgMmUxtGVVHBabne4TKuaUfFnKK7xiSna6a7B1C5Uoq5RsR1o1v9A8surNrW3L9Gpze.jpg) --- Furthermore, as you’ll see in the photos, there are several public toilets along the route, and you can also use the toilets at the beach bars, even if you haven’t bought anything. But the toilets on the beach always feature murals in incredible colours. Art is everywhere I look, and that’s one of the things I enjoy most. --- ![20250922_181713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRwAAzvKydJNGgqCwBVFp1WVVdcboiZEBmdV1hJ92KJn4AK7XBP5Akno2EohhrHWRtb.jpg) ![20250922_181528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4dcnEvB42GkqGMKDesdGzz5JbEhpYGqSHAbYGZnB2ZCn1GWRigqnL8jmuSEZ6ukv6A.jpg) ![20250922_181835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Nd7a6LnZfuZnmeci87B6xhmBnQW19wu8mKz7RRQELD4Z2yU7AEZQhYDxjsNuRdP7ZS.jpg) ![20250922_181803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zkprkMBXMmt2PBX7pXWB1VhNC6VA921CJ2HwDwkBz19DVdLEjDMhyHWk6BrojNyEjve.jpg) ![20250922_181911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245TBTyKtmwczZV3hKihGwpjNTzJRxRFcCqWG7C4QEEhbTL8aDAr5UarHPh9G3SSqQRs8.jpg) --- This beach has a distinctive, glamorous style, with modern-style buildings and structures; as you cross the avenue, you come across those beach bars that stand out so much on the beach and can be seen from afar, offering incredible sea views as you stroll along the promenade, which you can explore either on foot or by bike. In fact, many of the bike tours always pass through this spot. --- ![20250922_182005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NjBxF7fDGod5sxegriZq2GGNSJrQGGwpWe1CLfnHXubuBD842VvLSBFEpvovfvRu97.jpg) ![20250922_182011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hURijTEW9kssZJhEkDrfJ3k9W8Sjd5MDeksgW3GFLQXCY6RHgTWWhjYWqJ93neFmNf.jpg) ![20250922_181921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1kvGCKVEtUUjt5vdX4Edr14Qea4xnQ49zqrr9ZuFirmjKdJgp7gv7ce4QWosXK6TaV.jpg) ![20250922_182027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUEwCnaG4Kpppwv85NKhpnYzSYH13Nwf8nWis4LnHfg9RWTChr5XLDH4zjExKsfm6Xs.jpg) --- If we add to all that the islands with their palm trees and a festive, cheerful atmosphere all the time, plus the warm sea wáter, ideal for enjoying yourself, it makes La Caleta beach one of the most visited and also one of the most sophisticated, so to speak. That’s why I said that each one has something special that sets it apart and makes it different from the others. I still have several left to explore, especially in the west, with more walks by the sea. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

title.title: I Say No To Floating Islands.
title.body: > ## Hello, everyone. I welcome you to my blog. I think every human being loves luxury and will want to have a taste of it, and if given the opportunity, they might not resist it or even think twice before saying yes to it. When we live a life that is not in any form luxurious and see those living a luxurious lifestyle, we get to see a thousand reasons to choose and pursue luxury and all that is needed to make our lives luxurious ones. Sometimes I tend not to blame those who go the extra mile and will do anything just to see that the luxurious life they dream of is gotten or achieved. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbfVaEDgAHTmNguhTgJPVPkM1qrnY19VCsZMR8aN2wBv/1776760476229.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/green-trees-on-cliff-I7oLRdM9YIw) Living a life that is not luxurious can be really stressful: having a house near a beach or close to the sea, having to travel by any means that you want or would like to travel by, and having all that you want and need is really something that every human being deserves, not situations where some have it all and some have little or even none at all. There are houses you will enter, and you will not want to go back to yours because it is not well furnished or well decorated like the one that you are in. A well-furnished house gives you that cozy feeling you cannot find anywhere else; it gives you comfort. You eat and sleep with both eyes closed as you are at peace, not the type where you are sleeping and it gets windy outside and you get scared that your roof is about to be blown off, and instead of enjoying the breeze or wind, you are forced to sit up in order to monitor everything and make sure there is nothing wrong. Having access to luxury will take all of that stress away and leave you enjoying peace and comfort. Saw a movie where a husband and a wife went on a vacation at a location where the hotel they lodged in is one that floats; the tides were high, and their room got detached from the others, and they woke up only to find themselves in the middle of the ocean with nowhere to go to, nowhere to turn to. A floating island, unless controlled, can cause one to find oneself in such a situation; you can just wake up and find yourself in a strange place. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYeiBCTTU71JH4YN5AZnAvpUMBbv8syxADsfCJYm58rRU/1776760476181.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-house-floating-in-the-air-surrounded-by-clouds-ODTi88liWEE) So will I accept living on an island that floats? My answer to this is no, as much as luxury is good and I enjoy and love it, but I will not want to do too much of it that might in any way pose danger to my life or that of loved ones that will be living with me. For me, I think living on an island is more than enough luxury; I don't need it to be floating before I confirm it is luxury. Some people, in the name of luxury, put themselves in positions that endanger their lives and those of loved ones. As much as luxury is good, I think it should have a limit or things that are off-limits; you can enjoy yourself and live a luxurious lifestyle without doing things that can cause harm or make something bad happening very easy.

title.title: i212 IC24, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
title.body: > Many blessings to all who are joining me again here on my blog. I hope you are all doing well wherever you are. Comrades, today I'm going to show you the drawing I made of the i212 IC24 card from the game Rising Star. As you can see, it's a nice light blue microphone. This is part of the series I'm doing this week of drawings of common microphones from the game; they're all really interesting. As always, you saw a preview of the finished drawing on the cover, but seeing the finished result isn't the fun part; it's seeing the creative process that led to that result. So, let's see step by step how I made the drawing from beginning to end. To start, I first drew the inner frame of the card, which looks like this: ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTBich6x3QeTPC2QvM3AUP4gUd3S6VDESQhU1hka6QjCRvqq5LZ7TMkgP6.jpg) After finishing the frame, I drew the largest and longest part of the device, that is, its handle. And once I had drawn it, I moved on to drawing the top part above the handle. As you know, that's the part that would capture the sound in real life. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWc1yS6nDoC6BGn6RKUKRvJs2S8nirqb9KxP2fs5zjDvd2UzGmzEjx4X8zG9a.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zk96Q7eN7Co64tVQnhR3LuRmupKngCihp7zuQhi8rskT1u8f6QQtN6YGX5YE.jpg) In the details section, I drew some internal lines on the top to embellish the microphone and make it look better. These lines are also key when filling it in with color later, since each one will have a different color inside, and they help me paint the interior better. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo8ZVfHUn6UVjbP4mrvBXcZ3ZFxD5w7AQhu9idgY2vmteMSGyAGmr6bfYjPWziqtX95.jpg) Now comes the painting. As you can see, I started by painting the outer background first, then the inner frame, followed by the inner background, and finally the microphone. In the following screenshots, you can see the colors I used to fill each area. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EocAT6NrAmvVujrbnUvJfoo8kEjpGLGJ8ZqcRZh6sfXWsJbFAk9qbMXKznyvoHTPv3y.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoXkUxjUY8HqjKw7RBcpA8Jek6PvQpFsiezJuQZURfNooYQCq938MLhB3Kqc5qf2RkG.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eqqmd7Zwm6p5CsoK7ye6jb5oiPpVKhPNX5T2do562uTj34rQfvWmkCos8kDh8TpEf4v.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqkhQoYSMfNjdSvKVYbRNKALWxSPKVAwEdhdejhjDFUhasincKbtoRLrpXW3PaDWGy.jpg) And to finish and say goodbye for today, I'll show you the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqDbuWz7EdDHw8SyLC1SRPmKXLAQQTp8UkgQ21nwVSvoUb5SV3WgwHRy6idZ5VRhqQ4.jpg)

#### [A Hidden Gem in Barquisimeto: Garlic Shrimp at Canarias Port Bar [En-Es]](https://ecency.com/hive-120586/@neruel/a-hidden-gem-in-barquisimeto-garlic-shrimp-at-canarias-port-bar-en-es) by @neruel

> *What an excellent review of the place, covering every detail. It’s true, I love the tableware and the dishes look delicious; it felt as though you were here in Spain, specifically in the south, these are very typical dishes.
As for the service, I suppose they should treat everyone well, regardless of whether they’re regulars or not, but in the waiter’s case, he must have been nervous as he was new, and he shouldn’t be treated so harshly.
Inflation is terrible over there, but it’s true that it’s good for the mind to get away from it all now and then, especially if your mum is with you; making the most of your time together is essential. I loved the presentation, the dishes, the food looks delicious and, above all, the family outing.*

<center>

I’m familiar with the artist, though mostly by name rather than through his work, so this exhibition has really helped me learn more about him and his pieces. I love the horsemen, and the fact that he’s worked with so many different materials yet has never strayed from painting. The sculptures are lovely.

I also love wildlife documentaries and, of course, lions. At home I have a mini lion and a mini panther; I’ve always loved big cats.

> *I’m telling you, not every child would appreciate nature the way you do; that’s something that needs to be taught from a young age, just as your grandparents have done with you. But your grandparents know that nature is wonderful, that it has many benefits, and they’re teaching you that. I hope more children will come to value natural spaces in this way.

*Hello everyone, dear friends*

*Today I am ready to share with you again a new selection of my photos. Spring is a beautiful time of year. Every day you can find something interesting to take a photos. Over the past few years, I have grown so fond of taking photos that I can't imagine my life without it now. I like to capture moments of my life, moments of nature through photography. This brings me a lot of pleasure. This has become one of my favorite hobbies. Today I want to share photos where you will see beautiful little insects.* 


*This strange little beetle that I found on dandelion flowers in my garden caused me a lot of surprise, curiosity and pleasure because I had never seen such beetles and insects before. So for me this is a real discovery. He is so small and wonderful. That I didn't want to leave him.*


*I also found a bee sitting on a dandelion. She was beautiful. Thank you for giving me the opportunity to take some photos little bee. This year I have grown many more daffodils than last year, which makes me very happy because my flowerbed shines with new, fresh colors. I transplanted a few daffodils from the old flowerbed, so my new flowerbed looks much fuller and larger. title.title: The Slovak Tatra Mountains in Black and White Part 2 - MONOMAD CHALLENGE [ENG/PL]
title.body:
*** ![szablon cover — Odzyskano.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wCA6d2Rqajcqp28Srz9PhMrbpFjUS9AD79VGAWVwsDTjjA6N8vSKbdXRtc5JCfmpNs7.jpg) ***
### Hello Black And White Community!

> When I visit mountains, I often think about the processes that shape them. About the immense forces of nature that cause the massive rock masses that make up our planet's crust to rise. And very often, my mind can't comprehend it, though there are days when I can imagine it. Do you can imagine this?
> Kiedy odwiedzam góry, bardzo często myślę o procesach, które je kształtują. O ogromnych siłach natury, doprowadzających do wypiętrzenia się potężnych mas skalnych budujących skorupę naszej planety. I bardzo często moja głowa nie potrafi tego pojąć, choć są takie dni, kiedy jestem w stanie to sobie wyobrazić. A Wy jesteście?
![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png) *** ![PSX_20260420_004923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23uFPqVwbnuQ3jwZTruN9CMbreBHqMg29aztK4Zv4szgK7YanUbMJc8szmsGomHMz2vsr.jpg) ***
Once, these rocks rested peacefully, hidden deep beneath the surface, unobtrusive, unseen. Now, they attract crowds of tourists, like me, eager to witness their vastness and power. Many of these gawkers are likely unaware of the processes that led to the formation of all tall mountains.
> Niegdyś te skały spoczywały spokojnie, ukryte głęboko pod powierzchnią, nikomu nie zawadzały, nie szukały uwagi. Teraz przyciągają masę turystów, takich jak ja, chcących zobaczyć ich ogrom i potęgę. Wielu z tych gapiów jest zapewne nieświadomych procesów, które doprowadziły do powstania wszelkich wysokich gór.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23tH5j8Ypz5i2rJXDJos8EEszkTTB2JbBdKTRzWdUEeYNWYUVzK8KeyYfuX2QtddHTsAK.jpg) ***
It is estimated that the entire formation of the Tatra Mountains took several dozen million years, with the final stage of their uplift occurring 10–15 million years ago. The Alps and Himalayas also formed during a similar period. Although mountain formation ceased long ago, these mountains, like all others, are still being formed in some way.
> Szacuje się, że całkowity proces formowania Tatr trwał kilkadziesiąt milionów lat, a ostateczny moment ich wypiętrzania miał miejsce 10–15 milionów lat temu. W podobnym okresie formowały się również Alpy i Himalaje. Mimo że ruchy górotwórcze ustały dawno temu, to góry te, jak każde inne, wciąż w jakiś sposób są formowane.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23vhz1dzJAGYaLu95hUaT6gF5iRTxhhVCQrQPWoBnNSm7ag9aMXCKbCs56U1yLTVaqM3K.jpg) ***
Wind and rainfall, and especially glaciers, are responsible for the continuous but very long-term transformation of mountains. Glaciers are responsible for the formation of many, if not most, mountain lakes. They are responsible, among others, for the formation of the lakes in the **Valley of Five *Spiš* Lakes**.
> Wiatr i opady deszczu, a w szczególności lodowce, odpowiadają za ciągłe, ale bardzo długotrwałe przekształcanie się gór. Lodowce odpowiadają za powstanie wielu, o ile nie większości, górskich jezior. Odpowiadają między innymi za powstanie jezior w **Dolinie Pięciu Stawów Spiskich**.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23x196MCM8mNFdnTrN6542c5jF3Tp15VGHZNHBAYScNPvTx6TV5mxycTnzcvKoKRG3Qwj.jpg) ***
In this never-ending transformation of the mountain landscape, photography plays a significant role. Perhaps over the course of a lifetime, the changes in the mountain landscape won't be significant enough for us to see clearly, and certainly not overnight. But someone in the distant future who sees photographs of the Tatra Mountains taken in our own time might say, \

> W tej niekończącej się transformacji górskiego krajobrazu fotografia odgrywa sporą rolę. Być może na przestrzeni całego ludzkiego życia zmiany w górskim krajobrazie nie będą na tyle znaczące, abyśmy mogli je wyraźnie zobaczyć, a już na pewno nie z dnia na dzień. Ale ktoś, kto w odległej przyszłości zobaczy zdjęcia Tatr wykonane w naszych czasach, być może powie: „Chwila, przecież te góry wyglądają teraz zupełnie inaczej”.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/241tX7v9pN92CJChicf3KJQLo1Hcj5PYwdx8z8XiaC2MUVVYkfnDgwrFrMAJLoW4pkfzh.jpg) ***
I also think this applies to all other landscapes. The world is constantly changing, and what we consider everyday travel photography can prove to be of immense historical and documentary value for future generations.
> Myślę też, że tyczy się to wszelkich innych krajobrazów. Świat ciągle się zmienia i coś, co dla nas jest codzienną fotografią podróżniczą, dla przyszłych pokoleń może okazać się mieć ogromną wartość historyczną i dokumentalną.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yTctro89SqyprfvZQyFF6pEdX9dhDmSnM4jGEDugFFPwPUE2NyL3R4FtGraZhHNXCp3.jpg) ***
I'd love to have access to photos of the formation of such mountains myself. I'm incredibly curious about what a time-lapse video of mountains forming would look like - photos taken every year, in the same place, at the same time. However, that's a rather abstract dream.
> Sam chciałbym mieć dostęp do zdjęć z formowania się takich gór. Niezmiernie pochłania mnie ciekawość, jak wyglądałby film poklatkowy przedstawiający formujące się góry — zdjęcia wykonane co roku, w tym samym miejscu, o tej samej porze. To jednak dość abstrakcyjne marzenie.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wWvxPry4J2DNfm2umgcpxsytCUTSAT1NTymg5fKWCJFYJakFTM5RZm5L6YtCDPfsjHy.jpg) ***
With this post, I conclude my series on the hike to the Five Spiš Lakes Valley. A hike that taught me several very important things about planning mountain trips and how the mountains can surprise.
> Tym postem kończę serię poświęconą wędrówce do Doliny Pięciu Stawów Spiskich. Wędrówce, która uświadomiła mi kilka bardzo ważnych rzeczy dotyczących planowania górskich wypraw oraz tego, jak bardzo góry potrafią zaskoczyć.

title.title: (EN-ES) My hemorrhoidal crisis-Mi crisis hemorroidal
title.body:
(English version)

Now I know what hemorrhoids feel like!

**Christmas and New Year with hemorrhoids**

People get sick at the most inconvenient times.

Nobody in his or her right mind wants to get sick, more so during a holiday season, such as Christmas and New Year.

Unfortunately, I suffered an acute hemorrhoidal crisis on Christmas Eve, and I struggled to drive to the local public hospital where I was treated in the emergency room.

I spent the night at the hospital, with medical staff keeping an eye on me, in case I suffered any complications.

**Hemorrhoids or something else?**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=\_DR8\_mJdBb0

The blood that I noticed on the toilet paper after having a poo made me very concerned.

I had noticed some blood a few times in the past, too, but I thought it was nothing serious, since bleeding was hardly noticeable, and I attributed it to some spicy food that I might have eaten.

This time, however, the bleeding was heavier, and I had to use quite a few toilet tissues to clean myself up down there.

That was when the suspicion that I had hemorrhoids crossed my mind.

What if it was something more serious, such as a perianal abscess or fistula, or even colon cancer though?

**Treatment of hemorrhoids at the hospital**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=97f2vKYJvLY

My doubt and ignorance about the actual cause of my rectal bleeding made me urge to the emergency room of the local hospital.

If it was only hemorrhoids, they could go away themselves, and healing would be assisted by medication, otherwise I would have to undergo a procedure called thrombectomy, or even a surgical operation, if the problem became worse.

After the surgeon visually inspected my anus, he also put his finger inside to make sure that it was hemorrhoids, and not something else.

I gave a urine sample and had my blood tested, so that doctors could identify the cause of bleeding more precisely, and determine the severity of my case.

**Treatment of hemorrhoids at home**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-rdajRKl9g

After receiving treatment in the emergency room, I was given instructions and a prescription with medication to use at home.

More precisely, I had to drink plenty of water to keep myself properly hydrated.

In terms of the drugs prescribed to me, I had to take Daflon, according to the following dosage: 6 capsules per day for 5 days, then 4 capsules per day for another 5 days, and finally, 2 capsules per day for the last 30 days.

I reckon that doctors believed that my condition would improve, my hemorrhoids would be reduced and be no more swollen, and the symptoms would subside by then, so I wouldn't need to undergo a surgical procedure, whether minor or major.

Additionally, I had to apply Betadine on the prolapsed hemorrhoid after each bowel movement (poo), and a sterilized gauze with xylocaine gel on top of that.

**Unable to work because of hemorrhoids**

In addition to the discomfort that I experienced due to my hemorrhoids problem, I was literally unable to work.

Working as a translator and a writer involves regularly working long hours while seated on a chair.

Since I couldn't literally sit, I couldn't do any work.

Not to mention that leading a heavily sedentary lifestyle again in the future would result in my hemorrhoids coming back.

**Exercise, weight control, and hemorrhoids**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2aIKP-aWWQ

Although I am satisfied with the treatment received from my attending physicians overall, I would like to point out that they should have placed a stronger emphasis on the role of exercise and weight control on addressing the problem of hemorrhoids, as a permanent, long-term solution, compared to drugs.

After searching online myself, I found out something that I had already suspected.

Getting some sort of mild, regular aerobic exercise, such as walking, can help a lot in dealing with constipation, which is a major cause of hemorrhoids; it can also help in having hemorrhoids healed faster.

Last but not least, exercise assists in maintaining a healthy weight, as opposed to having a big belly that applies pressure to internal organs, which can cause hemorrhoids, as a result.

(Versión en Español)

¡Ahora sé lo que se siente tener hemorroides!

**Navidad y Año Nuevo con hemorroides**

La gente se enferma en los momentos más inoportunos.

Nadie en su sano juicio quiere enfermarse, y menos aún durante las fiestas navideñas, como Navidad y Año Nuevo.

Desafortunadamente, sufrí una crisis hemorroidal aguda en Nochebuena y tuve dificultades para conducir hasta el hospital público local, donde me atendieron en urgencias.

Pasé la noche en el hospital, bajo la atenta mirada del personal médico, por si surgía alguna complicación.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=\_DR8\_mJdBb0

La sangre que noté en el papel higiénico después de defecar me preocupó mucho.

Ya había notado algo de sangre un par de veces antes, pero no le di importancia, ya que el sangrado era casi imperceptible, y lo atribuí a alguna comida picante.

Esta vez, sin embargo, el sangrado fue más abundante y tuve que usar bastante papel higiénico para limpiarme.

Fue entonces cuando sospeché que podría tener hemorroides.

¿Y si fuera algo más grave, como un absceso o fístula perianal, o incluso cáncer de colon?

**Tratamiento de las hemorroides en el hospital**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=97f2vKYJvLY

Mis dudas e ignorancia sobre la causa real de mi sangrado rectal me llevaron a acudir a urgencias del hospital local.

Si solo se trataba de hemorroides, desaparecerían por sí solas y la curación se vería favorecida por medicamentos; de lo contrario, tendría que someterme a una trombectomía, o incluso a una cirugía si el problema empeoraba.

Tras la inspección visual del ano, el cirujano introdujo un dedo para confirmar que se trataba de hemorroides y no de otra cosa.

Me hicieron una muestra de orina y un análisis de sangre para que los médicos pudieran identificar con mayor precisión la causa del sangrado y determinar la gravedad de mi caso.

**Tratamiento de las hemorroides en casa**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-rdajRKl9g

Tras recibir tratamiento en urgencias, me dieron instrucciones y una receta con medicamentos para tomar en casa.

Más concretamente, debía beber mucha agua para mantenerme bien hidratado.

En cuanto a los medicamentos recetados, debía tomar Daflon según la siguiente dosis: 6 cápsulas al día durante 5 días, luego 4 cápsulas al día durante otros 5 días y, finalmente, 2 cápsulas al día durante los últimos 30 días.

Supongo que los médicos creían que mi estado mejoraría, que mis hemorroides se reducirían y dejarían de estar inflamadas, y que los síntomas desaparecerían para entonces, por lo que no necesitaría someterme a ninguna intervención quirúrgica, ni menor ni mayor.

Además, debía aplicar Betadine en la hemorroide prolapsada después de cada deposición y, encima, una gasa esterilizada con gel de xilocaína.

**Incapaz de trabajar debido a las hemorroides**

Además de las molestias que sufría por mis hemorroides, literalmente no podía trabajar.

Mi trabajo como traductora y escritora implica pasar largas horas sentada en una silla.

Como no podía sentarme, no podía trabajar.

Sin mencionar que volver a un estilo de vida tan sedentario en el futuro provocaría que me volvieran a salir las hemorroides.

**Ejercicio, control de peso y hemorroides**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2aIKP-aWWQ

Aunque estoy satisfecho con el tratamiento recibido por mis médicos en general, quisiera señalar que deberían haber hecho mayor hincapié en el papel del ejercicio y el control del peso como solución permanente y a largo plazo para las hemorroides, en comparación con los medicamentos.

Tras investigar en internet, descubrí algo que ya sospechaba.

Realizar algún tipo de ejercicio aeróbico suave y regular, como caminar, puede ser de gran ayuda para combatir el estreñimiento, una de las principales causas de las hemorroides; además, puede acelerar su curación.

Por último, pero no menos importante, el ejercicio ayuda a mantener un peso saludable, a diferencia del exceso de peso que ejerce presión sobre los órganos internos, lo que puede provocar hemorroides.

(Esta publicación fue traducida del inglés al español con Google Translate)

_Further reading:_

[Be carefull!!! Hemorrhoid can burst if becomes thrombosed.](https://www.bangkokhospital.com/en/content/do-not-let-broken-hemorrhoids)

[Hemorrhoids. Usually just annoying. But they could be worse.](https://lacolon.com/article/hemorrhoids-the-worst-that-can-happen-ask-a-proctologist)

[How long do hemorrhoids last?](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/322976)

[Hemorrhoids Treatment & Management](https://emedicine.medscape.com/article/775407-treatment)

[Management and Treatment of External Hemorrhoidal Thrombosis](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fsurg.2022.898850/full)

[Treatment of hemorrhoids: A coloproctologist’s view](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4541377/)

* * *

title.title: DIY! SpongeBob and his friend Patrick Star made with foam clay (Tutorial). [ENG] [ESP]
title.body:
> Hello!! Good evening @diyhub family and lovers of handmade crafts and DIY projects. Today I’m going to show you how to make the animated characters SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star using moldable foam clay. I hope the whole community enjoys the creation — I’m super happy to share my experience with this flexible material. Join me!
Hola!! Buenas Noches familia Diyhub, amantes de los trabajos manuales y artesanías, el día de hoy les enseñaré a realizar con foami moldeable (foam clay) a los personajes animados de Bob Esponja y Patricio Estrella. Espero les guste la creación, a toda la comunidad en general y yo súper contento en presentarles mi experiencia con este material flexible. ¡Acompáñame!

>
I'll tell you a little about these funny characters, the stars of the famous kids' TV show SpongeBob SquarePants, which started in 1999. They live amazing adventures under the sea, in Bikini Bottom, always accompanied by his best friend, Patrick Star. With their joy and bright colors, they entertain and visually cheer up the little ones at home. This cartoon was part of my childhood. It was really appealing because of its fun pastimes and wonderful adventures. As a token of affection, here I share with you some designs I made out of foam clay for the Hive community. I know it's not much, but it's my way of expressing myself through art.
Hablado un poco de estos divertidos personajes, protagonistas de la famosa serie infantil de televisión Bob Esponja que comenzó en 1999. Les cuento que viven increíbles aventuras bajo el mar, en Fondo de Bikini, siempre acompañado por su mejor amigo, Patricio Estrella. Con su alegría y colorido, entretienen y alegran visualmente a los más pequeños de la casa. Esta animación fue parte de mi infancia, a sido muy atractiva por sus pasatiempos y aventuras maravillosas. Como muestra de cariño, aquí les comparto unos diseños que hice en foami clay para la comunidad de Hive. Sé que no es mucho, pero es mi manera de expresarme mediante el arte.

>
In the following I will show you step by step the realization of my work. To begin with, I will mention all the materials used:
A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

>

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Blanco / White foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Amarillo / Yellow foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Rosado / Pink foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Verde / Green foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Rojo / Red foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Azul / Blue foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Carmelita / Carmelite foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Violeta / Violet foam clay
  • Herramientas para pasta foami / Kit of foami

>

STEP / PASO 1

In the initial phase, I start by taking a portion of clay in shades of yellow and pink for the bodies of the animated figures. Then, with my hands, I shape the clay into balls, giving them a curious finish.
En la fase inicial, comienzo tomando una porción de arcilla en tonalidades de amarillo y rosado para el cuerpo de los animados. Luego, con las manos moldeó el color en forma de bolas, dándoles una terminación curiosa.

>

STEP / PASO 2

Next, I develop the characters' body parts: their heads, their eyes, for Bob his scarlet red tie and rectangular pants with a black belt, for Patrick his shorts, and generally their legs and arms, always giving my best.
Seguidamente, desarrollo las piezas del cuerpo en los personajes, su cabeza, sus ojos, en Bob su corbata roja escarlata y pantalones rectangulares con cinturón negro, de Patricio sus shorts, en general las patas y brazos, siempre dando lo mejor de mi.

>

STEP / PASO 3

Finally, we make the final touches on the face, the eyes, and connect the parts to form the animated characters. This design is a bit more complex, since the parts are smaller when it comes to molding.
Ya por último, realizamos los retoques finales en el rostro, los ojos y conectó las partes para formar los animados. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de moldear.

>

Final result / Resultado final

It should be noted that this design was searched on Pinterest; but the realization of the animations are made by me, with dedication to make them look more beautiful in your home or bedroom.
Cabe destacar que este diseño fue buscado en Pinterest; pero la realización de los animados son hechos por mí, con dedicación para que luzcan mas bonitos en tu hogar o dormitorio.

>
If you liked it, don't forget to leave a comment and follow me for future posts. I'd love to know your opinion and ideas for the next one. Regards
Si te ha gustado, no olvides dejar tu comentario y seguirme para próximas publicaciones. Me encantaría saber tu opinión e ideas para el siguiente. Saludos

></center>

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV93YBixTKrHaEgFrwWyUZAsFwBzPQRN2kVcXacHfrU7Z/1776752419506.png)
Hello hi everyone how are you greetings to all of you and welcome to my another recipe blog for sharing with all of you. My today recipe is often made by me at home because I and other family members loved to eat **potato and Chana Chat**. I also have shared this chat once time but today is in a different way. So I thought also for sharing with all of you let's start the process. 

**Ingredients**

One kg potatoes 

Half kg white chickpeas 

One big size onion 

Two green chillies 

One tomato 

One bowl yogurt 

**Spices**

Salt 

Chat masala 

Lemon juice 

**Process**

First I soaked white chickpeas for two hours so they boiled well. After soaking two hours I took pressure cooker added potatoes white chickpeas and water for boiling. After half an hour potatoes and white chickpeas boiled. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRm4Hmrp2skZ3w7JADsaECz31GM81w2GHtjngv6u8Vj6V/1776752976258.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDtJG6KoD1kYs65Gz6vhWHti6xYP99JyjrgNMe1KGyeT/1776752850918.jpg)

I also soaked gram flour vermicelli that gives the taste of Chana Chat. At the the other side I cut onions into big slices tomato and green chillies in the small pieces. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmddFkmmUKB3EneTFKLZibzp7Tz3K1Gsvc7g5eYU1pzPFE/1776752947707.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZfwUpgWzPfsbkHaFTuMZpL2BhWifos7Ro7Ec1NFUkKiu/1776752960424.jpg)

After this process I cut boiled potatoes in the small pieces and added boiled chickpeas and cut ingredients also in it and mixed well. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJ2ezS2WRrs6JkXr2Mph34mwWPHZisMFuCiCigSE1Lm8/1776753034373.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFB6dVee7L9jZLcBTVf4MhAmBUd5Wo3VuRJgxTvHSZAZ/1776753050611.jpg)

I spread salt lemon juice and chat masala and again mixed the chat. Some members not like to add yogurt they just spread chat masala and eat. But I like to eat it with mixing yogurt. Its gives more taste. I spread yogurt on my plate and enjoyed at lunch cravings. 

**Final look**


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGemLnkzQPtG5tyzeXMVVD6b5UAbFisRAgZTCqWNg98U/1776753183966.jpg)

Hope you guys will like my lunch cravings chat. Don't forget also giving me feedback and good reviews on my recipe. See you soon with new for sharing in the community. Take care. Bye bye.
