title.title: HUMAN SCORES DRAW WITH PENCIL IN IT'S SHAPE.
title.body:
![1775624010445_1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdepqrPa8DFoEU3DPMVGYCAPYJ3Y29GcMdU9NUL4bgnW9/1775624010445_1.jpg). 

human scores that tell stories and tell history +9
 The oldest known human drawing is a 73,000-year-old red ochre \

pattern on stone from South Africa, predating previous examples by 30,000 years.  This discovery indicates that early Homo sapiens used abstract, symbolic art to record information, communicate stories, and explore complex behaviors long before writing. 
 Natural History Museum
 Natural History Museum
 +3
 Key Aspects of Drawing History
 Oldest Examples: Beyond the 73,000-year-old hashtag, early drawings from the Upper Paleolithic (around 30,000–40,000 years ago) include cave paintings and pictograms.
 Purpose & Evolution: Drawing was a foundational form of communication and a way to document daily life, myths, and surroundings before and alongside the development of language.
 Techniques: Early methods included engraving and using red ochre, a natural earth pigment, as a crayon.
 Storytelling: Throughout history, drawings and reliefs have been used to narrate stories, as seen in ancient Assyrian reliefs and later, the Bayeux Tapestry.
 Figure Drawing & Anatomy: Life drawing, the sketching of the human form, has roots in the ancient world and became a cornerstone of art education during the Renaissance, with artists like Leonardo da Vinci conducting anatomical studies to enhance their accuracy. 
 British Museum
 Royal British Museum +5
 Significance of Early Art
 Symbolic Communication: The ability to draw lines on a surface represented a significant leap in human cognitive ability, allowing individuals to share abstract ideas and stories.
 Prehistoric Expression: These early marks on stones and walls of caves were more than just pictures; they were intricate representations of the intelligence and social organization of the early human population. Artistic Evolution: From simple carvings to intricate paintings, drawing has continuously evolved, adapting to new materials and providing a visual record of humanity's journey.

title.title: Life is Strange: Reunion – INTRO Mission Walkthrough (Gameplay Part 1)
title.body:
![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23yJVVVGES7odUPH4dNBS41Zh9g6rwt8Fqa6guHGE7zpQEzCDtWvMPe5JnkJJAQEecYuS.png)

![gabriela travels divider gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/Eo8L1q1q6J3nWWpu8NRh7jbJkzcHsrSTzBzVoM4DUXdS2497yfcDaSySrzHN2sFApL2.png)

A few weeks ago I made [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@gabrielatravels/life-is-strange-reunion-a-game-series-that-marked-my-childhood-review-28) where I shared a personal review on my experience after playing **Life is Strange: Reunion**, which I've been waiting to be released since day 0 when it was first announced.

This was mainly because I am a big fan when it comes to playing the Life is Strange series of games since I did it in some important moments of my life, but also because, ever since I started a [YouTube Gaming Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@doilupi), I never stopped thinking about how would it be to actually post only freshly released games.

Along with turning the passion into a more expensive one, as it costs a little fortune to pre-order games in the 21st century, I am also not sure if it would actually be worth the financial efforts, since many bigger gaming channels get to play games way before they are released to the rest of the people. Hence why, those who are interested in some games have already watched gameplays way before you end up posting them on your own channel.

Anyway, last night I started posting the gameplay videos from **Life is Strange: Reunion** on my YouTube Channel, and I thought I could also get back on making this kind of content on here too.

Obviously, I am planning to keep these posts just once per week, as I don't want to be considered spam, although I post daily on my YT channel. But here we go with the first episode, as promised.

https://youtu.be/tK49rsYk9J0?si=LIZZIlBdH7QwiZwM

Why is this first video so important, you might wonder? Because it shows glimpses from all the other LIS games to make a little background of what **LIS: Reunion** is about for those who haven't played the previous games recently or at all.

So, even if you are new in this game, you will understand the main parts of the story by simply watching the video from above, but I'd still recommend to play all the other games first so you make your own opinion on the overall story and don't judge the game's decisions based on just 10 minutes of intro which basically compress dozens of hours of gameplay from the first games.

Oh, and let's not forget, my intro video might be different from yours. Or from anyone else who played this game. Because right after you get to meet Chloe and Max, you will need to make choices regarding Max's relationships with the other main characters of the game.

Personally, I tried to be realistic and keep things simple yet interesting, but there can be a whole drama if you want! Anyway, I'll let you figure out what I'm talking about by checking the video out. 😁

title.title: 접촉사고
title.body:
지난 금요일 회사에 있는데 아내에게 온 전화를 못 받았습니다.
전화 온 사실을 30분 쯤 지나서 알게 되었는데 전화를 해보니 그땐 아내가 전화를 안받더라구요.
메시지를 보내도 답이 없고.. 그렇게 엇갈려서 무슨일이 있는지 몰랐는데 한시간 가량 후에 통화가 되서 아내가 하는 얘기는 접촉사고가 있었다는 겁니다.
아내 말로는 아내가 가해차량이고 피해차량은 작은 트럭이었답니다.
서로의 라이드미러가 모두 부서질 정도로 사고가 났었고, 혹시 몰라서 보험회사를 불렀고, 우리쪽이랑 상대방 보험회사에서 모두 왔답니다. 그리고 보험회사에만 알렸을 뿐인데 어느 사이엔가 견인차가 왔고, 수리를 해야 한다면서 단골 카센터가 있는지 있다면 그곳으로 가고 없다면 본인 카센터에 맡기라 했답니다. 아내는 어떻게 해야 몰라서 그때 저에게 전화를 했던 거였구요.

![IMG_4238.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfyvoa8PYdopmZLqZUBKXHhHJp9UdA2A4mswJFRndQtZ/IMG_4238.png)
<출처 : https://pixabay.com/>

암튼 다친사람 없고, 사이드미러 말고는 크게 고장나지 않았고 근처라고 해서 차량을 보냈답니다.
그리고 차량도 무상으로 임대를 해주었다고 하더라구요.

큰 일이 아닌 것 같아서 퇴근하고 나서 확인하기로 했습니다.
퇴근하고 나서 혹시 몰라 아내라 병원에 가 보았고, 아내가 찍어 둔 사고 당시의 사진도 자세히 볼 수 있었습니다.
정말 사이드미러만 나갔더라구요. 상대방 차량도 그렇구요.

그렇게 주말이 지났고, 어제 제가 카센터에 전화를 해보았습니다.
보험료 인상되는 구간 안에서만 수리를 하려고 했었죠. 
그런데 담당자는 사이드미러만이 아니라 앞범퍼, 조수석 앞뒤 문짝, 휀다, 뒷범퍼까지 모두 손상이 되어서 모두 교체를 해야 한답니다.
사기꾼 냄새가 나서 우선 상대방 차량이 입고가 되면 연락을 주기로 했습니다.

오후에 상대방 차량이 입고가 되었고, 카센터가 아니라 상대방 보험회사에서 전화가 왔습니다.
어디까지 수리를 할 거냐구요.
카센터에서 저에게 얘기했던 방식으로 상대차주에게도 얘기했나 보더라구요.
서로 과실이 있다 보니 저희가 카센터에서 말하는 것처럼 전부 수리하면 상대차량도 전부 수리하겠다 하고, 사이드미러만 바꿀거면 본인들도 그렇게 하겠답니다.
당연히 사이드미러만 교체한다 했고, 카센터에 전화해서 그렇게 하기로 했습니다.
그리고 비용이 많이 나오지 않으니 보험이 아니라 서로 각자 일반수리로 하기로 했구요.

당연히(?) 카센터 담당의 목소리가 처음과 다릅니다.
틱틱 거리는 반응.

사이드미러 교체정도니 금방 될 거라 생각했는데 오늘까지 연락이 없네요.
우선 무상으로 차량을 임대해줬으니 아쉬울 것이 없어서 기다리고는 있는데 내일은 전화해서 점심시간에 찾으러 가야겠습니다.

title.title: It's raining, the snow is melting, the streams are overflowing.
title.body: This year, there has been abundant rainfall in almost all of Türkiye. The increase in rainfall this year, following years of severe drought, has brought smiles to people's faces. It's especially good news for those involved in agriculture and livestock farming. While dams were nearing the point of drying up in previous years, now their water levels are close to 100%, and some dams have even started releasing water. Where I live, it snows quite a lot. Especially during this period when the snow is melting and it starts raining, the streams become very swollen. _Bu yıl Türkiye'nin neredeyse genelinde bol yağışlar oldu. Kuraklığın ciddi şekilde yaşandığı son yıllarda bu yıl yağışların artması halkın yüzünü güldürdü. Özellikle tarım ve hayvancılıkla uğraşanlar için sevindirici. Barajlar önceki yıllarda kuruma noktasına yaklaşırken şimdilerde ise barajların doluluk oranı %100'e yaklaştı, kimi barajlarda su boşaltılmaya başlandı. Benim yaşadığım yerde kar oldukça fazla yağıyor. Özellikle şu dönemde karların eridiği mevsimde yağmur da yağmaya başladıysa dereler çoşmaya başlıyor._

/> Even when I'm far away from the stream, I can still hear its sound as its flow increases. The turbulent stream is dangerous for children and the public. Previously, many children drowned after falling into the stream; although this has decreased significantly, the turbulent and chaotic waters still pose a great danger. It's dangerous even for adults. The turbidity of the water indicates the excess of rainwater and melting snow. For about a month, until the beginning of June, we will see a turbulent stream. During the summer months, however, it will become a much weaker stream with a significantly reduced flow. _Derenin debisi artınca dereden çok uzaklaşınca bile derenin sesini duyabiliyorum. Derenin hırçınlaşması çocuklar için halk için tehlikeli. Önceleri dereye düşüp boğulan çok fazla çocuk oluyordu şimdiler de bu çok azalsa da çoşkulu ve hırçın dere büyük bir tehlike. Yetişkin biri için bile tehlike arz ediyor. Derenin bulanık olması yağmur sularının ve eriyen kar sularının fazlalığını gösteriyor. Yaklaşık bir ay boyunca haziran ayının başlarına kadar çoşkulu bir dere göreceğiz. Yaz mevsiminde ise debisi oldukça düşen cılız bir dere ortaya çıkacak._

/>

Small and large streams merge to form a larger one. Two large streams converge in the town center, creating a much larger and more turbulent river. Previously, shops were located along the riverbank. In some years, floods occurred, causing significant material damage to the shops in the market, and sometimes even resulting in fatalities. Now, however, the shops along the riverbank have been demolished, eliminating that risk. The riverbank is now cleaner and safer.

_İrili, ufaklı dereler birleşip daha büyük dereleri oluşturuyor. Çarşı merkezinde birleşen iki büyük dere var. Çok daha büyük çoşkulu bir dere meydana geliyor. Önceleri derenin üstünde dükkanlar vardı. Bazı yıllarda sel meydana geliyor ve çarşıdaki dükkanlarda maddi hasar ortaya çıkıyordu. Bazen de ölümler ortaya çıkıyordu. Şimdilerde ise derenin üstündeki dükkanlar yıkıldı ve o risk ortadan kalktı. Daha temiz daha risksiz bir dere ortaya çıktı._

[https://www.youtube.com/shorts/zZTVNwrjeEA](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/zZTVNwrjeEA)

The video and photos don't accurately reflect the stream's actual turbulent state. The stream is more turbulent than it appears in the video and photos. Looking at the turbulent stream for a long time can make you feel dizzy, even if only for a moment.

_Video ve fotoğrafta derenin gerçekte olduğu gibi coşkulu halini yansıtmıyor. Dere videoda ve fotoğrafta göründüğünden daha çoşkulu. Uzun süre çoşkulu dereye bakınca bir an olsa da başınız dönmeye başlıyor._

title.title: [生活日记]吐槽连顺吉餐馆午餐
title.body:
中午跟姑娘一起去美食街的“连顺吉”餐馆吃午餐。他家是这条街最靓的餐馆，我觉得不是因为菜品最好吃，是因为餐馆算最大。一共有两层楼，而且有单独客房。这街上只有这一家。
我跟姑娘吃饭也是到哪家，哪家火起来哈哈，我们是第一个来吃饭的，二楼第一个顾客，我们选了一个位置坐下点餐。不一会就接连不断来了三四波客人，二楼顿时就热腾起来。服务员换酒精块的时候竟然把火块掉到了地面上，幸好是地砖。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrJGQDeTzZFBdk86yUePtcxWgZqg3EQ9q3PUxLuFBvnn/1776759051928.jpg)
让姑娘点餐，看来看去也不知道吃什么。点了这个卤味拌莲藕，很脆有点辣还算很爽口的。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPsKDfVaFam8WqzosBoQwkf7WakQrCPgHQ1a9tfD5i69/1776759226628.jpg)
这酸辣汤我就不怎么喜欢了，简直没有我们沈阳的素烩汤好喝呢，而且还贵，一碗要22块钱，我感觉就是酸，也不辣也不甜也不鲜，真不是我能接受的口味。姑娘在那喝我闲弃太酸了哈。
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYLGryLdfcuYnyJYbefUe2W7HZ2aoKXDyGtUTjbLYEfdG/1776759652222.jpg)
肉段茄子感觉也不太好吃呢🙈🙈，肉段不多33块钱一份。姑娘说还不如来一份宫保鸡丁啦！
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYENRFmitXBN54AvZXPSGeoQviZ53b1aPMBc77oGDcabA/1776759751762.jpg)

两小碗米饭还可以，我们没浪费都吃了。总之这顿午餐跟姑娘没吃好，点的三个菜都不太可口味，下次可不能在他家吃啦！之前喜欢节约点我会把没吃完的打包回去。这次我们是真没爱吃呀，浪费了76块钱。😡💔

links.body:
Keeping it little light for today, I will like to share my entry for the [Shadow Hunters/SMASh Contest - 422.](https://hive.blog/hive-179017/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-1ec0ef40dce64)

As it is said, heart is where the home is and my heart is always in this place back in India, where my home is. Since it's a big property and I give it on Airbnb when I am not around, I have installed CCTV cameras in the outdoors of my Villa. It is very important to have cameras for safety purpose, especially when I am not there all the time. Multiple times in the day I check on the cameras just to keep an eye, and to be honest, I also like watching it because I can see my home in it. I also have a full time caretaker who lives there in the outhouse and maintains my property. But it is always good to keep a check and not leave everything on them blindfolded. 

There are many instances where caretakers have taken undue advantage of properties in their owner's absence. So me and hubby both decided that we will have cameras all over the villa outdoors to see every part of the property from outside. Inside the home there are no cameras. I cannot keep it as that violates guests privacy. 

This shadow image is from my today morning capture from the CCTV camera. This camera focuses on the main entrance, so we can always keep a check on who is coming inside the property. While I was watching the CCTV, this shadow image crossed my mind for the contest and I captured the picture.

It's a bright sunny day. While I cannot see the gaps in the gate, in the shadow it can be seen clearly.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmYXPQY9FQpJXfKagsf1S9MA8z9y3mETd6Jq9MwJYLFFHt/Screenshot_20260405_151105.jpg

A wider zoom
![Screenshot_20260405_151105[1].jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWy676Xy45UTKdd6Y6VPA1mt5mkNBuoMREdR9VdcfDpkv/Screenshot_20260405_151105[1].jpg)

It's still a month and a half more for me to travel back home but till then I can always get a view of it on the camera. Some good advantages of technology :-)

links.title: Por qué los emprendedores no deben avergonzarse de lo que hacen//Why Entrepreneurs Should Not be Ashamed of What they Do
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS29FrMS7Rqq3qSLaMn2GXRTz7WK7NCNHTnhL8N8ULscT/1776759148334.png)


If you had asked me some time ago, “What do you do?”, I probably would have smiled awkwardly, looked away for a second, and given you a half-answer.

Not because I didn’t know what to say, but because I wasn’t proud enough to say it the way it deserved.

I recall a few years ago when I called one of my students and asked her what her mother does for a living. She was ashamed to mention that she sells akara and bread. Akara is a junk food made from bean flour. It's a popular breakfast for people in my culture. She was proud of the business hence she couldn't mention it to others. 

However, that was what put food on their table and paid all of their bills including her school fees. 

I couldn't blame her, because that's what many people are going through. They are ashamed of their business because they think that it is not lucrative enough. 

Many jobs that people think are lucrative enough are just showmanship. Not as lucrative as people see it. 

I've engaged in a white-collar job for many years without anything to show for it as an achievement. So I decided to give a business a try. 

The truth is simple: every morning, I stand by the roadside and fry akara.

And for a long time, I felt small because of it.

The Part I Used to Hide

My day starts earlier than most people think. While many are still sleeping or just waking up, I’m already outside, setting things up, getting the oil ready, mixing the bean paste, and preparing for the first set of customers.

There’s heat. There’s smoke. There are days the sales are good, and there are days I just stand there, waiting and hoping more people will come.

But the hardest part wasn’t the stress of the work.

It was the feeling that people might look at the work as demeaning. 

Sometimes, when I met new people, I would try to say something else first—something that sounded more “respectable.” I didn’t always say it directly: “I fry akara.”

That hesitation? It weighed on me more than the work itself.

What Changed for Me

One day, while I was serving a customer, something shifted in my mind.

This person came, bought akara, and said, “I like the way you make it. It’s always fresh, I wish I could start my own elsewhere”

It was such a simple comment, but it stayed with me.

I realised at that moment, this thing I was almost ashamed of someone else actually valued it.

Someone woke up that morning and was happy I showed up.

That thought humbled me.

I Started Seeing My Work Differently

I began to look at what I do with new eyes.

This is not just “standing by the roadside.”

This is waking up early when it’s not convenient.
This is showing up even when I don’t feel like it.
This is serving people, feeding people, and earning honestly.

There’s dignity in that.

I may not wear a tie or sit in an office, but I work. I earn. I contribute.

And slowly, that shame I used to feel started fading.

I Stopped Comparing Myself to Others

One of the biggest problems I had was comparison.

I would see people with office jobs, clean clothes, and nice titles, and I would shrink inside. I felt like I was behind in life.

But the truth is, everyone’s journey is different.

Some people start in offices. Some people start on the streets. Some people inherit opportunities. Others build from scratch.

I’m building from where I am.

And there’s nothing wrong with that.


I Learned to Own My Story

These days, when someone asks me what I do, I don’t overthink it anymore.

I simply say, “I fry akara every morning.”

And I say it like someone who understands the value of what he does.

Because I do.

I’ve come to accept that my story may not look impressive to everyone—and that’s fine. What matters is that it’s real. It’s honest. It’s mine.

But I’m no longer ashamed.

Because I’ve come to understand something important:

There is no shame in honest work.

Whether it’s big or small, whether people praise it or ignore it—work is work.

         **Spanish**


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS29FrMS7Rqq3qSLaMn2GXRTz7WK7NCNHTnhL8N8ULscT/1776759148334.png)


Si hace algún tiempo me hubieras preguntado: «¿A qué te dedicas?», probablemente habría esbozado una sonrisa incómoda, habría apartado la mirada un instante y te habría dado una respuesta a medias.

No porque no supiera qué decir, sino porque no me sentía lo suficientemente orgullosa como para decirlo tal y como se merecía.

Recuerdo que hace unos años llamé a una de mis alumnas y le pregunté a qué se dedicaba su madre. Le daba vergüenza mencionar que vendía akara y pan. El akara es una comida rápida hecha con harina de frijol. Es un desayuno muy popular en mi cultura. Ella estaba orgullosa de su negocio, por eso no se atrevía a mencionarlo ante los demás. 

Sin embargo, eso era lo que ponía comida en su mesa y pagaba todas sus facturas, incluidas sus tasas escolares. 

No podía culparla, porque eso es lo que le pasa a mucha gente. Se avergüenzan de su negocio porque piensan que no es lo suficientemente lucrativo. 

Muchos trabajos que la gente cree que son lo suficientemente lucrativos son solo apariencias. No son tan lucrativos como la gente cree. 

Llevaba muchos años trabajando en un empleo de oficina sin nada que pudiera considerar un logro. Así que decidí probar suerte con un negocio. 

La verdad es sencilla: cada mañana, me pongo al borde de la carretera y fríe akara.

Y durante mucho tiempo, me sentí inferior por ello.

La parte que solía ocultar

Mi día empieza antes de lo que la mayoría de la gente cree. Mientras muchos aún duermen o se están despertando, yo ya estoy fuera, montando el puesto, preparando el aceite, mezclando la pasta de judías y preparándome para recibir a los primeros clientes.

Hace calor. Hay humo. Hay días en los que las ventas van bien, y hay días en los que me quedo ahí de pie, esperando y deseando que venga más gente.

Pero lo más difícil no era el estrés del trabajo.

Era la sensación de que la gente pudiera considerar ese trabajo degradante. 

A veces, cuando conocía a gente nueva, intentaba decir primero otra cosa, algo que sonara más «respetable». No siempre decía directamente: «Frío akara».

¿Esa vacilación? Me pesaba más que el trabajo en sí.

Lo que cambió para mí

Un día, mientras atendía a un cliente, algo cambió en mi mente.

Esta persona vino, compró akara y me dijo: «Me gusta cómo lo preparas. Siempre está fresco; ojalá pudiera montar mi propio negocio en otro sitio».

Era un comentario muy sencillo, pero se me quedó grabado.

En ese momento me di cuenta de que algo de lo que casi me avergonzaba era, en realidad, algo que otra persona valoraba.

Alguien se despertó esa mañana y se alegró de que yo estuviera allí.

Ese pensamiento me hizo sentir humilde.

Empecé a ver mi trabajo de otra manera

Empecé a mirar lo que hago con otros ojos.

Esto no es solo «estar parado al borde de la carretera».

Esto es levantarse temprano cuando no me viene bien.
Esto es aparecer incluso cuando no me apetece.
Esto es servir a la gente, dar de comer a la gente y ganarme la vida honradamente.

Hay dignidad en eso.

Puede que no lleve corbata ni me siente en una oficina, pero trabajo. Gano dinero. Contribuyo.

Y poco a poco, esa vergüenza que solía sentir empezó a desvanecerse.

Dejé de compararme con los demás

Uno de los mayores problemas que tenía era la comparación.

Veía a gente con trabajos de oficina, ropa limpia y títulos bonitos, y me encogía por dentro. Sentía que iba a la zaga en la vida.

Pero la verdad es que el camino de cada uno es diferente.

Algunas personas empiezan en oficinas. Otras empiezan en la calle. Algunas heredan oportunidades. Otras construyen desde cero.

Yo estoy construyendo desde donde estoy.

Y no hay nada de malo en ello.
Aprendí a hacer mía mi historia

Hoy en día, cuando alguien me pregunta a qué me dedico, ya no le doy muchas vueltas.

Simplemente digo: «Frío akara todas las mañanas».

Y lo digo como alguien que entiende el valor de lo que hace.

Porque así es.

He llegado a aceptar que mi historia puede que no le parezca impresionante a todo el mundo, y eso está bien. Lo que importa es que es real. Es sincera. Es mía.

Pero ya no me avergüenzo.

Porque he llegado a comprender algo importante:

No hay nada de qué avergonzarse en el trabajo honesto.

Ya sea grande o pequeño, ya sea que la gente lo elogie o lo ignore, el trabajo es trabajo.

links.title: Un dia de lluvia en el campoºººººA rainy day in the countryside
links.body:
Hola a todos, como dice el titulo amigos, UN DIA DE LLUVIA EN EL CAMPO, la verdad que por estos lugares cuando hace demasiado calor y se nubla el cielo, es segura que la lluvia es iminente, tanto asi que amanecio el dia con mucha lluvia, como se puede ver en la foto, esta seria desde la casa hacia la entrada principal, la cual se encuentra a unos 200 metros, como se ve todo bajo agua.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23xKxVVha7xR6a96qbHoePkB3W5vwUS6XmaXDL2THfFMzEFssY7eTfwQUfY862uP2V6pk.png)

Cuando el clima se encuentra de esta manera o sea con mucha lluvia, es una de las tantas cosas que son de mi agrado, por el hecho que al escuchar solamente cuando golpean las gotas de agua en el techo todo eso me relaja.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23x1FqBJzsbuKY2swQKLTWCKcsacyyCYtJtHdhervRJjmPLJjfPmURTgBUjV4Dr4TvkYX.png)

Por suerte como le habia comentado amigos referente a la tierra de esa zona, que la misma es muy arenosa, por ende el agua se filtra muy rapidamente, como lo podemos ver en esta fotografia, lo cual despues de parar un poco la lluvia ya bajo un monton el agua.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/243BcGw2ySUDc4waET4EDxnmk5L75xTT7yiBiSwKqxhrTmiN3npgbKCTRrnvVESb9Xi7J.png)

Esta parte amigos como ven esta muy limpio, porque se trata de un tajamar, se le llama asi a una laguna artificial, donde se puede sembrar pescado, el cual se trata de pacu, es un pez de agua dulce.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbu3fFnJLpLnQaANGFhsLHoaJdpEh5obhiphwcJ5ikkwCfRWa39GKt3U99TmYQdydP7.png)

Esta seria otro tajamar o sea laguna artificial, para sembrar pescado, es un poco mas pequeño en sus dimenciones.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQpaHptBC8iggNHWuSkbhgEknhPzShnxHmmcpPkgDyCN4AwfEHqNcrq8brFgZY3pfHL.png)

Amigos, estando descansando un poco en la casa, nuevamente la lluvia se hizo ver y como bien les dije, la misma para mi en lo personal es muy relajante por el ruido que hace.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23w2eMXmwAhknEsGTVnFp8SEaGdZZv36oz2Gn8BKS8TAVWALrWVJTtSr6tT5PR1jtzjzB.png)

Bueno amigos, que hermozo se ve el dia cuando cambia luego de una lluvia como esta, se nota la alegria general, como por ejemplo esta santa rita, por haber bebido mucha agua.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23zRxiurGu6qHw5mazskrgRFfXqPP3rGZMsJmuomQXCFJSg5iBzfxUNmaxJjpcEx7cLCQ.png)

De esta manera otro dia mas en el campo, con la diferencia de que amanecio con lluvia, la cual concidero una bendicion y que tanto bien hace a la MADRE NATURALEZA.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAN UN BUEN DIA.

ENGLISH

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES


Hello everyone, as the title says, friends, A RAINY DAY IN THE COUNTRYSIDE. The truth is that in these places, when it gets too hot and the sky clouds over, rain is imminent. So much so that the day started with a lot of rain, as you can see in the photo, this is from the house to the main entrance, which is about 200 meters away, as everything is underwater.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23xKxVVha7xR6a96qbHoePkB3W5vwUS6XmaXDL2THfFMzEFssY7eTfwQUfY862uP2V6pk.png)

When the weather is like this, that is, with a lot of rain, it is one of the many things I like, simply because listening to the raindrops hitting the roof relaxes me.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23x1FqBJzsbuKY2swQKLTWCKcsacyyCYtJtHdhervRJjmPLJjfPmURTgBUjV4Dr4TvkYX.png)

Fortunately, as I had mentioned to friends regarding the soil in that area, it is very sandy, so the water drains very quickly, as we can see in this photograph, which shows that after the rain stopped for a bit, the water level dropped significantly.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/243BcGw2ySUDc4waET4EDxnmk5L75xTT7yiBiSwKqxhrTmiN3npgbKCTRrnvVESb9Xi7J.png)

This part, friends, as you can see, is very clean because it is a tajamar, which is what we call an artificial lagoon where fish can be cultivated, specifically pacu, which is a freshwater fish.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbu3fFnJLpLnQaANGFhsLHoaJdpEh5obhiphwcJ5ikkwCfRWa39GKt3U99TmYQdydP7.png)

This would be another reservoir, or rather an artificial lagoon, for fish farming; it is a bit smaller in its dimensions.

I'm sorry, but I cannot view images. Please provide the text you would like me to translate.

Friends, while resting a bit at home, the rain made an appearance again and as I told you, for me personally, it is very relaxing because of the noise it makes.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23w2eMXmwAhknEsGTVnFp8SEaGdZZv36oz2Gn8BKS8TAVWALrWVJTtSr6tT5PR1jtzjzB.png)

Well, friends, how beautiful the day looks when it changes after a rain like this, you can see the general joy, like for example this saint rita, for having drunk a lot of water.

I'm sorry, but I cannot view images. Please provide the text you want to translate.

In this way, another day in the countryside, with the difference that it dawned with rain, which I consider a blessing and that does so much good for MOTHER NATURE.

links.title: Online Or Offline, It Still Hurts.
links.body:
I came by this topic about four different times before I finally decided to write on it, and it's not because I didn't have what to say but I was just pondering on the best way too. Because it's a very deep one. Talking of online bullying and physical harassment. In all honesty both are weighty.



![1000960560.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xedu5CqfM4boT39hByQ3rPHSaY8QjQHYSQgK45BZitQzDAegu7okrSw2TBPKdD62L7u.png)




Now, when we talk about physical bullying, we know that is direct, a direct attack that happens right there where you are. Maybe someone talks down on you, hit you, embarrassed you and all in a public place. There are even times it can happen in the presence of someone who could have helped you or given you an opportunity for something and then they get to witness that kind of thing. Which even they can't even say who was right or wrong, but that impression, that scene that they witnessed would make them withdraw.




 And I say that because it's something a neighbor of mine has experienced before, he was going to an interview on that day when something happened, he was mistaken for someone else and people had gathered to bully, harass and embarrass him, meanwhile the CEO of the company he was going too passed by as at the time and saw it, later they met in the office and the CEO was like, are you not the thief form the other time, he tried explaining but they wouldn't have it.



Online bullying on the other hand is not small too. Because the online space is not small at all. Just a comment or a post can go viral. Even if you made a mistake with it or didn't sound the way you're supposed too. But then, it's gone already. And people who know you and those who don't know you start having different opinions about you. And we know how this online people go about their things,. insults here and there, various opinions flying around and all, and that's how something so small will gain wings and fly far and wide.



![1000960583.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2af3ezzzCK4QnYQG4yn8P1WeqVSafw59XPXBoD5u999eox7fF5avzs7KLTFxAUEYpX.png)


So, both of them can affect you in ways that hit you real deep. They can even make an individual turn into something else. Some lose their peace, some get depressed, some get withdrawn, some become scared.... To scared to even show up in the online space again, or even in the streets. And these things can also affect one like I said earlier about opportunities. Someone can just remember a time or moment when you were harassed, or recall something you were dragged in or dragged on online sometimes before and when an opportunity comes that you could have been picked, such will surface and you get denied of it, not because you're not qualified, but because the past came up.



So, about if one is worse than the other, I honestly can't say. Pain doesn't have two names. Pain is pain, if I comes from the online space or from someone who's with you physically... It still hits you. So, both should be taken seriously, both should be handled very well, both have their effects either psychologically or anyway, both should be stopped, both should be taken with iron hands as both have the ability to destroy, break and mar, either in public or online space.



🌹

**Images are AI generated.**

links.title: Yunnan Chinese village in the countryside, Chiang Mai, Thailand.
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqJmKZQq5HiC5jAhF86AE36RXw1eTj3AobT5Mbd7Ghoo/1776757956671.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. In Chai Prakan District, Chiang Mai Province, there are many ethnic groups. One of them is Yunnan Chinese. This ethnic group relocated to Chiang Mai several decades ago. This district has many villages of Yunnan Chinese. Some of these Yunnan Chinese villages are located on the plains, some on the plateaus and some on the mountains. A few months ago, my wife and I visited Doi Ang Khang. Although Doi Ang Khang is located in the mountains of our district, but this trip took us on main roads, rural roads, roads winds over the plateau and mountain roads in Chai Prakan district too. We passed through many villages. Including local Thai villages, Tai Yai people villages, and Yunnan Chinese villages. Especially the Yunnan Chinese villages on the mountains. These villages have a nice atmosphere and scenery. Although on this trip, we didn't visit these Yunnan Chinese villages on the mountains. But I photographed the atmosphere and scenery of a Yunnan Chinese village. And I want to share this with everyone in this post too.

The atmosphere in a Yunnan Chinese people village. I don't know the name of this village.

![NsFf4fSYoRkv7UJo_image_1776751683055.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/NsFf4fSYoRkv7UJo_image_1776751683055/NsFf4fSYoRkv7UJo_image_1776751683055.webp)
![zA8PN2y6rqY3ZrYQ_image_1776751686054.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/zA8PN2y6rqY3ZrYQ_image_1776751686054/zA8PN2y6rqY3ZrYQ_image_1776751686054.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

要讲哪家面包店是我和我娃都看得上的 那应该是巴黎贝甜了吧，不仅我爱，他也爱，其他的比如85度C什么的，要么他喜欢我不喜欢，要么我喜欢的他一口不吃。巴黎贝甜是我俩进去就很难出来的那种面包店。

野猪吃不了细糠，也就这点爱好，再高档点的我们也消费不了了，这档次足矣。上次做活动，买满188就送六张券，但是要下次消费才可以抵扣，本次不能抵扣，于是这次我们又准备去囤点干粮 早上赶时间的时候就可以吃。

结果我找了半天，愣是找不到那几张券，看吧，这就是当场不让消费的后果，隔几天就找不到了，六张券啊，我的券。欲哭无泪了，但是答应娃给他买，也不能食言，硬着头皮买呗。

他家东西随便拿都好吃，但是我一直在克制我娃，因为拿多了他压根吃不完，所以一次买够两三天的量就行，有时候会带点到学校，下午饿了吃，学校饭菜不好吃，他们好多学生都不吃中饭，靠干粮充饥。

出商场了去坐有轨电车，遇到了夕阳，最近上海总是下雨，难得在双休两天都是晴天，久违的好天气。正是周末过完又开始降温下雨，今天我在路上都能看到穿羽绒服的，救命，都快五月份了。


---

links.title: Říčanské molo
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDGiPKrsq4wmLvYSZM2oYi6fT8fAXqw8ZUmEdDfR4FtU/20260420_102938.jpg)
Na svoje poměry teď vůbec nějak moc cestuji ... V březnu v Plzni, v dubnu v Říčanech ... Co mě čeká v květnu?

Do Říčan jezdím asi tak jednou do roka k urologovi. A když už tam jsem, spojím užitečné s příjemným a udělám si malý výlet někam po okolí.

Letos jsem si naplánoval hodně malý výlet. Při loňské návštěvě jsem si všiml, že mají vypuštěný Mlýnský rybník a cosi přes něj stavějí ...

Tak jsem se letos zašel podívat, co tam bude. A ono molo!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTNftewthgH354oK8JkTL8EWWtu2ZFA4bA4Bxuf7wyEHe/20260420_102145.jpg)
V Praze máme taková mola ve Stromovce. Pan Orbán Viktor si je nechal postavit ve své skoro rodné obci Felcsút ... Tak co by si nepořídili molo v Říčanech u Prahy?
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcNq9Ti7hjynZpTwmhGDdGro2kQdtdrDUk1aLh4Q6HfxC/20260420_102320.jpg)
Říčany totiž nevědí co s penězi ... Jak každý víte, peníze se válejí doslova na ulici. Jen je zvednout. To Vám potvrdí každý úspěšný podnikatel, každý úspěšný starosta, každý úspěšný předseda SVJ (Sdružení vlastníků bytových jednotek).

Je ale pravda, že drtivá většina podnikatelů, starostů a předsedů úspěšní nejsou. Nebo alespoň ne tolik, jako ti říčanští ... O čemž chci napsat daleko závažnější článek. Někdy ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQtSeGiiT9XBunpgaM6k2XzKTgWe7AuHC2cBGu7SFNhMH/20260420_102348.jpg)
Tohle není molo pro molo. Tohle je součást naučné stezky. A vidíte ty \

na rybníce? Lákají k zahnízdění vodní ptáky ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmamETTrFVTeiQEUR3oMrtKejkrYYAL13BAzmtsqhoactQ/20260420_102105.jpg)
Naučná stezka ... Po Říčanech jich je povícero. Je co číst, je po čem se dívat. Poučíte se. Navštivte Říčany!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboThM64QurRSjy9w8MJH64JFdPGakuZNhsgkYxPjUh2T/20260420_102234.jpg)
Návštěvní a provozní řád ... Dozvěděl jsem se z něj, že molo je osvětleno. Nevymyslel jsem, jak to dělají. Já tam byl dopoledne. Ale může to být ... Romantické? Inspirace pro návštěvu s manželkou. Díky Bohu, za mé šťtastné manželství a za ženu ze všech nejlepší ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdbHaqiBDkVcbrPND9w3oNKf443Z8bQZtdT9qVKcPwQ8/20260420_102902.jpg)
Tak si tak štráduji přes rybník ... Semo tam vyskočí kapr. Bylo hezky. Asi desátá hodina. Počítadlo mi prozradilo, že jsem dnes 45.návštěvník. Jinak mě snímají kamery. Po městě taky jezdí auto městských strážníků a natáčí špatně parkující auta ... Svoboda není nikdy absolutní. Zříkáme se jí, abychom za ni obdrželi trochu více pohodlí.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZVRFT5zPHwCijvWFJzHZRBqidZbSRGD3TSuXbc8ihZjo/20260420_103054.jpg)
Ťapity, ťapity, ťap ... To je snad kilometrové, to molo ... Jsem v katastrofální fyzické kondici. Nakonec jsem udělal za den asi 18.000 kroků. A mám toho dost. Odcházím si sednout na břeh.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfzGUpjKzRVcjU7S5EnNtdvgaHmc4h4zydDhaN4ocfDr/20260420_103141.jpg)
Hm. Sedět a čumět na vodu. Když si nemám s kým povídat, sdělovat své myšlenky. (Všimněte si, že jsem zase pořídil svůj stínový autoportrét.) Jdu změnit stanoviště.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTcZWQLfXun9GQpPhZUY7KoEnCngv9VzabSVAkgFuJAG/20260420_103157.jpg)
Jsem taky u vody. Posvačil jsem. A otevřel knihobudku. To je neuvěřitelné, co za vysokou kvalitu jsem tam našel. A nebylo to dnes poprvé ... I u lékaře jsem si četl, když jsem se obsloužil z blízké knihopoličky. Říčany jsou městem protkaným knihobudkami a knihopoličkami. A neviděl jsem tu žádné bezdomovce a sběrnu surovin. To je to pohodlí za obětovanou svobodu ...

Tu třetí fotografii odspoda si dovolím přihlásit do #aroundtheworld. Myslím, že říčanské molo v soutěži ještě nebylo ... Je rok staré.

Kdybych si nedal jídlo z vlastních zásob, je tu samozřejmě nepřeberné množství příležitostí k občerstvení. Včetně říčanského pivovaru, o kterém jsem už psal já i @godfish . Ale je to na druhé straně města. Bolí mě nohy. Jdu na vlak a domů.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDgUd1vRVhYLicTBuKXiWGJJZz2y9fbEFJ7tkS9kiaTG/image.png)

![soulDude_ttt.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/Ep7xYrwqd6AaN4gMhv4U3bcyMWEtqCu6Axka2xZSJSesdHhfa7ZCWogp17qAMTX14LD.jpeg)


***
[![GenuineDudeHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/EonmQauhYQ1ULr3pPYoLkCyRq4E7LmUcLDSj25CH75wbU4JXHbCRNLqHgA72GArqEue.png)](https://nohello.net/en/)
***

# Three Tune Tuesday... my second

Hmmm, the other day, some aeons ago, i was here the first time on #ttt and somehow it must be dangerously addictive, since i couldn't forgot about it anymore. Probably because it's about #music after all - which, when you 'know' my stories a little, was/is and always will be my first love. 

> So what should this second time be about ? Do i just tap into my favourite tunes or should i be a bit more specific on the chosen ones ? Old, new ? What genre ? *Talking to myself here...*
> Maybe i just start at the beginning, but that would be classical and i do not want that for my second. So, may i just start with my first ever 33' Vinyls i had as a child... Yeah, that sound reasonable !

![silver_divider_small.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/23t77FXby4ZoDxr4CyQbo5arsVu6EKJTvWNTF9yBJCkP4dRo1mMZdyTUkUJViGjw6keFE.png)

### The Beginning of my Collection
#### Supertramp
It all begun with my uncle, father's twin brother, who felt sorry for me because there were only two types of music in our household: classical music (my father's collection) and Mireille Matthieu (my mother's favourite at the time). 

His gift to my seventh anniversary was a turntable and the album of one of his favourite bands - Supertramp's \

. He thought that since i'm playing the clarinette this might be something i enjoy. And he was right... personally i liked that the title was like a little message to my family's collection.

IMHO here's the absolute best of that album:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GpAUDOI24Oo

***
#### ELO
My uncle actually started a very good thing... 'cause now i got for nearly all my birthdays albums of \

bands. In the year following it was one of THE bands who changed my way of listening and playing music all along. I guess ***ELO2*** even made me somehow make peace with my dads addiction to the classical music, since Beethoven was one of his favourites.  \n\nWith this album i started following especially Jeff Lynne and to \

comes out of his workings... One big genius producer. 

Here's my favourite of the album at the time:

https://youtu.be/c84FY_y8PYs

***

#### Status Quo
Now here we go with my first ever album i bought with my own money. My best friends brother was a huge fan of Rock Music. Often enough we finish at his place to listen to his brothers collection... many good Rock'N'Roll music i met there. 

There was the one song from the '74 album \
i had to have. It was put on my birthday-wish-list without luck, too much \

as my father stated. The rebel i was already, i used some of my 'savings' to get it. 

Here we go with that song:

https://youtu.be/UlR4Z4AZ1ho
![silver_divider_small.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/23t77FXby4ZoDxr4CyQbo5arsVu6EKJTvWNTF9yBJCkP4dRo1mMZdyTUkUJViGjw6keFE.png)

Ha, re-reading this post i got the feeling i might need to come in more often to join the #threetunetuesday tag. Addiction is like that i guess. And it's fun to stir my memory pot of all the excellent music i heard over the decades... was too long since i listened to these tunes. It'll be a plus for my [Silverblogger Chronicles](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316/created), which is a good thing - i guess. 

Now...

---

# About Three Tune Tuesday

...in the words of [@ablaze](https://peakd.com/@ablaze):

> For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday... the jist is as follows:
> 
> Every Tuesday **ablaze** is going to share 3 songs which he likes to listen to and he invites us for our feedback in the comments. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention him in the post and he'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use the [#threetunetuesday](https://peakd.com/trending/threetunetuesday) tag that would be great, as that is what he uses when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the prize.

links.title: Trains and Travel 👹🍣🎎 My Japan
links.body: ![IMG_8107-1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EpLgUxW3fH6btBHgnFYjYVTwpWJVPcFyLQAR9R5WtponQuhGnMndYQjiHMv8DJEa2Jb.JPG) Today, I’m looking back once again on our last short trip to the Aizu region. The seasons were just changing, and the nature around us hadn’t quite awakened from its winter slumber yet. But even so, the world around us revealed a very special, utterly charming side that quickly captivated me again. Here in the countryside, and especially here in the mountains, we get to experience a completely different Japan than the one we see in travel brochures. Everything is simpler and older, yet somehow more genuine and heartwarming. I feel at home here, and away from the well-known tourist destinations and sights, I find plenty of things to enjoy. It’s often the simplest things, like trains passing over a bridge in front of or behind you. I’m not quite sure what makes such sights so appealing—maybe it’s the feeling that we would love to be sitting on one of those trains yourself, watching the world go by. In this case, it would be wanderlust while you’re already out wandering. It actually sounds pretty funny, but somehow it’s probably true. At least for me, who’s probably quite susceptible to that kind of feeling. And even in our modern times, trains often retain a slightly romantic character, quite unlike airplanes, for example. When flying, we see far too little, and on top of that, it’s usually quite cramped and not really comfortable. Train travel, on the other hand, has a completely different character and brings us very close to the land and its people. It doesn’t matter whether we stop at huge main stations or small stations in the countryside—though I currently prefer the smaller, dreamy stations where only a handful of people get on or off. Well, we didn’t board this time and just carried our longings onto the trains ahead of us. A little melancholy is part of real travel, and dreaming is explicitly allowed. That was probably why I was so excited when I saw the little trains passing over the bridges ahead of us. I’ll admit, our timing wasn’t a coincidence—especially when it came to the big bridge, it was planned in advance. But out here, where trains only run every few hours, a little planning isn’t a bad idea, and it also builds the anticipation that adds just the right spice to the whole experience. And even though the view of the larger bridge and the vast, forested river valley is a bit more impressive and majestic, I was still very happy when the little train rolled past us on the small bridge overpass. As I said, we didn’t just happen to see it by chance, even if it was ultimately a nearly spontaneous decision. In my mind, I’m still waving my arms. And even now as I write these lines, I wish I was sitting on that very train, taking a trip through the heart of the country. With no destination and no rush, just being on the move, for the sake of traveling. The world would pass me by, and my dreams and thoughts would join me on a wonderful journey. I could set off right now! ![IMG_7132.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Eoc6yGRyd1vtAvoaPuVzkCVebvFY7QYL5Y6KceC61nejfWK9S57S9Ezc26UXJtmjFHj.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

links.title: Монтаж подвесных потолков в торгово-развлекательных центрах: Эстетика, технология и практичность
links.body:
Современные торгово-развлекательные центры давно перестали быть просто местом для покупок. Это сложные архитектурные пространства, где важна каждая деталь: от освещения до акустики. Одним из ключевых элементов интерьера является потолок. Именно он задаёт общий ритм пространства, влияет на восприятие объёма и напрямую связан с инженерными коммуникациями. Монтаж подвесных потолков в ТРЦ <https://grilyato.ua/installation-of-suspended-ceilings-in-shopping-and-entertainment-centers.html> это не просто строительная задача, а комплексный процесс, объединяющий дизайн, технологию и безопасность.

## Особенности потолочных решений для ТРЦ

В отличие от жилых помещений, торгово-развлекательные центры предъявляют повышенные требования к потолочным конструкциям. Здесь необходимо учитывать:

*   **Высокую проходимость людей**

*   **Сложные системы вентиляции и кондиционирования**

*   **Требования пожарной безопасности**

*   **Необходимость быстрого доступа к коммуникациям**

*   **Долговечность и устойчивость к износу**

Поэтому подвесные потолки становятся оптимальным решением: они позволяют скрыть инженерные системы, при этом сохраняя возможность их обслуживания без демонтажа всей конструкции.

## Этапы монтажа подвесного потолка

Процесс установки потолка в ТРЦ проходит несколько ключевых этапов:

### 1. Проектирование

На этом этапе разрабатывается схема потолка с учётом всех коммуникаций, освещения и дизайнерской концепции. Особое внимание уделяется нагрузке на конструкцию и выбору материалов.

### 2. Подготовка основания

Перед установкой проводится разметка, проверяется уровень перекрытий и устраняются возможные дефекты.

### 3. Монтаж каркаса

Создаётся несущая система, которая будет удерживать потолочные панели. Каркас должен быть максимально прочным и точно выровненным.

### 4. Установка панелей

На каркас крепятся декоративные элементы — кассеты, решётки или плиты. В ТРЦ часто используются системы типа «Грильято», которые обеспечивают лёгкость конструкции и современный внешний вид.

### 5. Интеграция освещения и коммуникаций

На финальном этапе устанавливаются светильники, вентиляционные решётки и другие элементы.

## Почему выбирают подвесные потолки

Подвесные системы получили широкое распространение в ТРЦ благодаря ряду преимуществ:

*   **Эстетика** — возможность реализовать любые дизайнерские идеи


*   **Функциональность** — удобный доступ к инженерным сетям


*   **Акустический комфорт** — снижение уровня шума


*   **Безопасность** — соответствие нормам пожарной защиты


*   **Скорость монтажа** — минимизация простоев объекта


Кроме того, такие потолки легко адаптируются под изменения: например, при перепланировке торговых зон или модернизации освещения.

## Дизайн и визуальное восприятие

В торговых центрах потолок играет важную роль в создании атмосферы. Он может визуально увеличивать пространство, зонировать помещение или акцентировать внимание на определённых участках. Часто используются комбинации разных типов потолков, цветовых решений и освещения.

Особенно популярны открытые решётчатые конструкции, которые создают эффект глубины и не перегружают пространство. Они идеально подходят для больших залов, фуд-кортов и галерей.

## Практические нюансы

При монтаже потолков в ТРЦ важно учитывать не только внешний вид, но и эксплуатационные характеристики. Например:

*   устойчивость к влаге и перепадам температуры


*   простота очистки


*   возможность замены отдельных элементов


*   соответствие санитарным нормам


Также важно, чтобы монтаж выполнялся профессионалами, так как ошибки могут привести к серьёзным последствиям — от деформации конструкции до проблем с безопасностью.

## Заключение

Монтаж подвесных потолков в торгово-развлекательных центрах — это сложный, но крайне важный этап создания комфортного и функционального пространства. Правильно выбранная система не только украшает интерьер, но и обеспечивает удобство эксплуатации на долгие годы. Если вы хотите подробнее ознакомиться с особенностями таких решений и получить профессиональную помощь, рекомендуем посетить сайт компании Grilyato.

links.title: MILANESA DE POLLO, FIDEO, ZAPALLO Y ENSALADA-----CHICKEN MILANESA, NOODLES, PUMPKIN, AND SALAD
links.body:
Buenos dias a todos, hoy referente a la parte culinaria, como en esta, en la cual prepare para el almuerzo milanesa de pechuga de pollo con fideos con queso, zapallo y ensalada, dicha comida es muy facil de prepararla y por supuesto sale muy sabrosa, para preparar la milanesa la cual es de la siguiente manera, en un volts agregamos huevo, sal, pimienta, cebolla de verdeo, batimos bien todo, luego agregamos la carne cortada en fetas, para luego quitarla de ahi y pasarla por el pan rallado, donde se la apelmasa bien, despues la agregamos en la sarten con aceite donde la freimos de ambos lados para que quede bien cocinada.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eokd2V3iCcP8gfMB6Es4wN1tWZQJxQtzUBrJhH6zykcKvsonqLi4dQh4UKj7mRu69UU.png)

Tanto el zapallo como el fideo se los agrega en una olla con caliente, una ves cocinado se le quita el agua y listo, al fideo le agregamos un poco de queso y lo revolvemos despacio, quedando el mismo muy rico, luego preparamos la ensalada la cual es de lechuga y tomate cortado bien pequeño, condimentado con aceite de oliva y sal a gusto.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, today regarding the culinary part, like this one, in which I prepared chicken breast milanesa with cheese noodles, pumpkin, and salad for lunch. This dish is very easy to prepare and, of course, it turns out very tasty. To prepare the milanesa, we do the following: in a bowl, we add egg, salt, pepper, green onion, and beat everything well. Then we add the meat cut into slices, take it out, and coat it with breadcrumbs, pressing it well. After that, we add it to the pan with oil and fry it on both sides until well cooked.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eokd2V3iCcP8gfMB6Es4wN1tWZQJxQtzUBrJhH6zykcKvsonqLi4dQh4UKj7mRu69UU.png)

Both the squash and the pasta are added to a pot with hot water, once cooked, the water is drained and that's it. We add a bit of cheese to the pasta and stir it gently, making it very tasty. Then we prepare the salad, which consists of lettuce and finely chopped tomato, seasoned with olive oil and salt to taste.

THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR READING AND FOLLOWING ME.

Hello Everyone!

This time I made a flowers wall hanging using color paper. The design of this wall hanging is a pattern of flowers and leaves on two circles of different sizes. The flowers are pink color and the leaves are made with black paper. I have been making the necessary things for this one a few days ago. I show you how to make it step by step with pictures and also write with texts.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBBCxWRvSJaNuBtK31kodbNnvpb4PdAkKwA5WoWe9E4r/1776757919700.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLKGb8p3ZxR3EzHx8qyR4QLutfVZFTjLEXTMjJpQ8m5H/1776757919790.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvQAaUAbfniBa52bAtB8sC2UG5rqyuKDJSoeMyWKhJAz/1776757919926.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTq5QWr8sEvMuvUoM2xfy81i2b8NkBC7r6L9xUdcdiCrN/1776757920040.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRiz3dZjXsR9QTbHV4gyvsCpRtYp7zaMiEe6HUZxoMimY/1776757920169.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMejz2jUYiJ8gcyhiyAuWQnxAAm9CeVrqm5zfb5H57H3/1776757951421.jpg)

In the first step, I cut two circles of cardboard of different sizes. I also cut  pieces of white paper. I wrapped these pieces of white paper around the two pieces of cardboard. I cut small black circles and glued them on the circle shape cardboards as shown. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqmAq8MrDSuPsnDVuxMCtgfbY8WnDbze8mpoZw6JMWcW/1776758003819.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR711R2Lx2WuSG475NFmYsexo25pfspy63nUXjmkhQ42J/1776758004006.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmDJu5EZ9xYd7t1JnPqTT2V4PP2M9czixDo4Y4jUE5pZ/1776758004142.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcwiStbCS8bp4TQJ63vKCakd5MNjKT5sFKE657fcuYm5/1776758004281.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSC2xF5vuKD96b54MrwMtyXZhZbWiXEcFz83wBirifKpk/1776758004427.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdD5ji4b9sfrX36MT6hTLvYv1F4vRSqX2D7qPFDMecCVR/1776758041437.jpg)

In this step, I made the flowers. Need three circles of the same size for one flower. I folded them in half step by step and drew on them as shown. After cutting them, I got three flower shapes. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRgzhtD7MLcF7sPUjuXt85sqoMsgz85CSYV6qJSd4eFg/1776758082683.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTx5QGwp14pNAgA4sRdBVv4fKZBeY46kSus2wfSvMnVb3/1776758082866.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXqfjUHjRbZgoiiyFsKeQAue8pgbzWszZ2uzxVYmfSWE/1776758083020.jpg)

I removed the petals from each flower as shown. I folded the edges of each petal and glued the two edges of each together. I attached and glued  from the smallest to the largest. I made five flowers in the same way. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZE1xWygjjBXf3Ec7kzsU4H95uwAPjz2fS6SbJMfz2Cf/1776758130985.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXoYGUXbfRFenksb5bj6S7xrgUFYRLYdKPgiqyNRr87ZK/1776758131152.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYsbhaQbaU8pYEgEioGtazh2Sz2aqS1HTRYBAcUi7VGiv/1776758131311.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSA6JBhdEtFgc6qmKyyBYAoWEoMADurDJ3VqqUjT59T4/1776758131485.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQq7hTsiqPiSe13uT2q5YSe3kUpakB2FbvW67k5thpXm/1776758131649.jpg)

I drew leaf branches on black paper and cut them. I glued the leaves and flowers on the circles as shown.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbQipX1jS5mRjvPWKgM7MSSpYjNJsQ9Wd3QRGzGkkEkT/1776758196447.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQ4M11HR4VTqx1jtckj3HBxVqRudiCHNRC5TUxK5rarW/1776758196634.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWY9Bx3C9eKKHBVhqS4Q6igRuQBamYdvTfUPYZdEdgdgA/1776758196767.jpg)

After making this wall hanging, I thought it was very beautiful. I also took beautiful pictures. Thank you so much for your reading my post to the end.

links.title: The Free Book I Read That Said Everything the Motivational Speakers Were Afraid to Say#285
links.body:
Over time and recently, I have seen and read some of all this self-development content both from people in my country and around the world, and all I can say is that they all have the same pattern. Nothing new. Someone from a rich background who is doing well wrote a book and addressed the reader to always have positive thoughts, and everything will come. After a while, for me, since I have seen similar patterns of those contents over and over again, I got very bored because they all look recycled to me, just that they have different creators. Then late last year, when I was searching for other content to get me occupied, I came across this free PDF I once saw in a comment section on X, The Almanack of Naval Ravikant. I ignored it at first and then decided to download it the following day, and since I read it, it has become one of my favorite books because it has, in a way, rearranged how I understood almost everything, if not all. While reading the book, I had to Google the name of the author, and I discovered that this man is not even a motivational speaker, a pastor, or one of all these life coaches trying to sell online courses. He is just someone who has a very deep and wild understanding about some things like health, life purpose, happiness, and even wealth. Then he tried his best by putting those things together. And while reading, one of the things he wrote that got my attention was his idea that getting rich is all about having specific knowledge and has nothing really to do with hard work alone because some are working very hard but have nothing to show. He went ahead to say that having specific knowledge is not something anyone is or can be trained for, something that when others see, it looks like work to them, but to the person doing it, it looks like a play. I had to go over that sentence over and over again to decode it. Because over here, what I have been told is to always work very hard without me being asked what I was actually built for. ![210613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/210613.jpg) And when it comes to relationships, he was brutally honest. He went ahead to say that it's very important to settle with people with high integrity and run away from those who get angry, and most especially spend time with those who our hearts are drawn to and people who always see and bring out the very possible best in us, not those who try to badmouth or bring us to the carpet level. Though those words look very simple to me, the weight they carry is much. But in an environment where maintaining connection due to what they can offer us is normal, that hits different. And when it also comes to health, what he said was that if a body is sick, then it will be hard for such a body to carry a wealthy mind. Unlike the rest of the motivational books from different people, this book made me think very differently and clearly because it opened my mind to a lot of other things too. It never gave me any promises. It just pointed out how a lot of things usually works and how I can equally implement them in my daily life. Because recently, I have gotten to discover that one of the blessings I can receive is not encouragement but clarity. And that is exactly what this book gave me free of charge without shouting, though it is about 240 plus pages and it is really worth it. ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by sagarkothari88 | links.title: Not Happy, Jan - But Happy 🫶🏻🥹❤️‍🩹
links.body:
You know when people tell you that things happen for a reason, or to tell you something, like to slow down or to rest or whatever? 

Bollocks. 

There’s a particular kind of frustration that comes with finally feeling as though your body is returning to you, only for something else to go wrong at exactly the wrong moment, and I'm *not happy Jan* - to quote a 2000's Yellow Pages television ad that only Australians will recognise.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2akt3P8ltLM 

After months and months of hip pain, I had only just begun to feel that quiet sense of freedom again. My hips were good - god knows that's been a fkn journey - and I had started to think about the ocean again, about surfing, about that feeling of being out there in the water where everything seems to settle into place. I could *surf* again. Not as good as I used to, but *still*.

And then I came off my bike. You know, my lovely new e-bike Sandy that was giving me this sense of freedom and movement I was missing? 

It wasn’t anything dramatic either. I had just taken off, but my front wheel was sitting over a tree root, and I sort of tipped sideways. I even had a baguette in the back, which snapped clean in half, and at the time I remember thinking that was the worst of it. I picked myself up, told Jamie I was fine, and we cycled home.

It turns out it wasn’t.

By the time I got home my arm had started to swell, and the pain set in properly. It’s one of those injuries that doesn’t fully announce itself straight away, but makes its presence very clear soon after, despite ice and comfrey cream and rest. A week later, thinking I’d recovered enough, I went out for a surf, only to find myself in so much pain that I had to paddle back in using one arm like a decripit Bethany Hamilton, my elbow swelling up all over again as if to say *you fuckwit, you knew it was too early to get back in the water*.

I’ve had it checked, and nothing is broken, which is something at least. Just a fair bit of soft tissue damage, which sounds minor until you try to use your arm for just about anything - and it's my right arm as well.

I'd also stupidly done a week of extreme knitting, two words the doctor said he'd never heard together in the same sentence. Turns out if you knit too much you get knitter's elbow. Du'oh.

It feels incredibly frustrating. There’s something about coming out of one period of pain, just beginning to trust your body again, only to be pulled up short by something else, that feels harder than if it had all just happened at once - and to reiterate, *not fucking happy, Jan.*

And yet, alongside that frustration, there’s also this very real sense of gratitude and happiness. Turns out you can be happy and sad at the same time. No problem. You get used to juggling emotion by this age. It's all good.

So, for the record, I have to say how grateful I am for my beautiful husband, who, when we first got married, was always busy with his own things — DIY projects, building cars, all those roles that naturally fell his way — and I was more than happy to take care of the cooking. That was just how things settled between us.

Now, because I can’t properly use my arm, he’s in the kitchen with me, following my instructions as I stand slightly uselessly to one side — chop this, chop that — while I attempt to add spices with my left hand. Within two days, he's kinda remembered some tricks and he's now cooking independently. Well I never. Don't worry, I'm still ordering him about from the couch.

The first night we had roast veggies with mushroom gravy. Absolutely delicious. Food is so much better when you don't cook it yourself. The second night we had what I can only describe as *roast* aloo gobi - potatoes and cauliflower with Indian spices, with a side salad and some yoghurt with fresh ground cummin. He wanted cauliflower cheese but I 'directed' him elsewhere. 

![2252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EqNEhpQFBQj91J7aywSzsEPyMnB4APVjAt5Q39NHSHgB1pZ3BSZSokjmwuNFW9kwRR2.jpg)

He’s been making me hot water bottles, bringing me glasses of water, making the bed, doing all those small, ordinary things that suddenly don’t feel small when you can’t quite manage them yourself.

I do feel sorry for him. He’s only just finished a big stretch of DIY, probably expecting a bit of rest afterwards, and instead he’s ended up helping me with the most basic tasks. The other day he even had to pull my leggings up for me, which was both completely undignified but a proper giggle.

This is the truth of a good marriage. The 'in sickness and in health bit'. 

And the truth is, I don’t really miss surfing as much as I thought. The ocean itself is the important thing, and it's it’s there all the time - I can hear it from my bedroom at night. I can still walk down to it, still go for a swim, still stand on the sand and watch it move in and out as it always has. I still can’t quite believe that we live in this beautiful town and that this is just part of everyday life now.

Not happy Jan, but happy. Sitting by our newly made fire, Jamie's dinner on the plate, in heaven.

Maybe I should break the other arm.



<center>

# `With Love,`

Imagine being forced to sit in a classroom and you are given 30 minutes to read a passage that you can read in 3.  You finish early and start doodling or talking to friends but your teacher scolds you.  You become bored as hell waiting for others to catch up to you meanwhile your teacher tells you you live in a free country but you can’t leave the classroom. 

You begin to feel anxiety every moment and the only thing that calms it is daydream and addictive behavior. 

That is the ADHD that I experienced and I believe it’s what many kids diagnosed with ADHD experience. It’s a result of the trauma of having to cosntantly gaslight yourself into seeing yoursef as the problem when really you don’t  belong in a classroom because you are self-motivated in a world that optimizes for worker bees. 

We are slightly more sensitive and so the bullshit hurts a lot more than it does for other people so we become space cadets to cope.

links.title: Dấu hiệu mang thai sau sinh là gì và xuất hiện khi nào?
links.body:
Sau khi sinh, nhiều phụ nữ tập trung vào việc chăm sóc con nhỏ mà ít chú ý đến những thay đổi bất thường của cơ thể. Thực tế, dấu hiệu mang thai sau sinh có thể xuất hiện âm thầm ngay cả khi chưa có kinh trở lại. Nếu không nhận biết sớm, mẹ dễ bỏ lỡ thời điểm phát hiện thai. Vậy các biểu hiện này là gì và thường xuất hiện khi nào? Cùng tìm hiểu chi tiết qua bài viết dưới đây.

▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm:

<https://plo.vn/chua-co-kinh-sau-sinh-van-co-thai-nhung-dau-hieu-am-tham-me-de-bo-qua-post892444.html>

<https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Nhung-dau-hieu-co-bau-trom-sau-sinh-kin-dao-me-kho-1323814623>

<https://portfolium.com/entry/dau-hieu-mang-thai-sau-sinh-thuong-gap-la-gi>

## **Sau sinh bao lâu có thể mang thai lại?**

Phụ nữ sau sinh hoàn toàn có thể mang thai lại sớm, thậm chí trước khi chu kỳ kinh nguyệt quay trở lại. Nguyên nhân là do quá trình rụng trứng thường diễn ra trước kỳ kinh đầu tiên. Theo khuyến cáo của Tổ chức Y tế Thế giới (WHO), khoảng cách giữa hai lần mang thai nên tối thiểu từ 18 - 24 tháng để cơ thể có thời gian hồi phục, đặc biệt với trường hợp sinh mổ.

Tuy nhiên, nếu không sử dụng biện pháp tránh thai phù hợp, việc mang thai có thể xảy ra chỉ sau vài tuần đến vài tháng sau sinh. Ở phụ nữ không cho con bú, quá trình rụng trứng có thể quay lại sớm từ tuần thứ 6. Với mẹ nuôi con bằng sữa mẹ, thời gian này có thể kéo dài hơn nhưng không hoàn toàn ngăn cản khả năng mang thai.

## **Dấu hiệu mang thai sau sinh thường gặp**

Trong giai đoạn sau sinh, các dấu hiệu mang thai thường không rõ ràng và dễ nhầm lẫn với thay đổi sinh lý. Mẹ cần chú ý những biểu hiện dưới đây:

*   Trễ kinh 5-7 ngày so với chu kỳ đã quay trở lại.

*   Ra máu báo thai với lượng ít, màu hồng nhạt hoặc nâu.

*   Căng tức ngực, nhạy cảm hơn bình thường.

*   Buồn nôn, nhạy cảm với mùi.

*   Mệt mỏi kéo dài, thiếu năng lượng.

*   Đi tiểu nhiều hơn.

*   Thay đổi khẩu vị hoặc cảm giác ăn uống.

## **Các dấu hiệu này thường xuất hiện khi nào?**

Dấu hiệu mang thai sau sinh thường xuất hiện từ 7 - 14 ngày sau khi thụ thai, tương ứng với thời điểm trứng đã làm tổ trong tử cung. Tuy nhiên, thời gian xuất hiện có thể khác nhau tùy vào cơ địa và tình trạng nội tiết của từng người. Với phụ nữ sau sinh, các biểu hiện có thể đến muộn hơn hoặc không rõ ràng do ảnh hưởng của việc cho con bú, thiếu ngủ và thay đổi hormone kéo dài. Vì vậy, nếu có quan hệ không sử dụng biện pháp tránh thai và nhận thấy các dấu hiệu nghi ngờ, mẹ nên kiểm tra sớm bằng que thử thai hoặc xét nghiệm y khoa để xác định chính xác.

## **Kết luận**

Dấu hiệu mang thai sau sinh thường xuất hiện sớm nhưng không dễ nhận biết nếu không theo dõi kỹ cơ thể và thời điểm sau quan hệ. Việc hiểu rõ các biểu hiện và mốc thời gian xuất hiện giúp phụ nữ chủ động phát hiện thai sớm, đặc biệt trong giai đoạn chu kỳ kinh chưa ổn định. Nếu còn bất kỳ băn khoăn nào về các biểu hiện thai kỳ hoặc có nhu cầu đặt lịch thăm khám thai kỳ an toàn, mẹ vui lòng liên hệ hotline Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa để được hỗ trợ chi tiết.

links.title: How Can You Understand Microsoft Entra Authentication Concepts to Pass the SC-900 Exam Easily?
links.body:
If Microsoft Entra authentication feels messy you are not alone. Many learners preparing for the microsoft security compliance and identity fundamentals exam get stuck here because many ideas sound the same at the start. Terms like SSO MFA Conditional Access and identity types can mix together fast and it starts to feel like you are memorizing random parts instead of learning a system. The issue is not hard topics. It lacks a clear structure. Once you see how everything connects it becomes much easier to handle. 

## What Does Entra Actually Try to Do?

At its base Microsoft Entra is about controlling who can enter what and under which rules. Think of it as a guard for identity and access. You deal with three main ideas: who the user is how they prove it and what they can access. Once you understand this flow most SC 900 exam questions start to feel clear instead of confusing.

Authentication means proving identity. That is all. But the SC 900 exam often makes it look more complex with many terms. Here is a simple view: passwords are basic proof MFA adds extra proof like phone or app check and SSO lets you sign in once and move through apps.  Many learners overthink this part. Microsoft mainly wants you to know the purpose not memorize long definitions.

## Where Most Candidates Get Stuck? 

This is the point where confusion usually starts. You may know meanings but still struggle with questions. Common pain points include mixing authentication with access control confusing Conditional Access with MFA and not knowing when Entra ID is used in real situations. The key is to always ask what problem the feature solves not just what it is called. 

The fastest way to improve is practice based learning. Reading alone is not enough here. You need exam style questions that train your thinking. A sc 900 practice exam helps you see how concepts appear in exam questions so you stop guessing and start understanding patterns. 

For better [SC 900 Exam Preparation](https://www.pass4success.com/microsoft/exam/sc-900) it is helpful to use authentic resources like Pass4success because they offer practice questions that closely match the real exam style. These practice questions help you understand how Microsoft Security questions are framed and how to approach different scenarios. The focus is not on memorizing answers but on building the ability to think clearly and choose the best option during the test. With regular practice you improve your understanding and become more confident when solving exam questions.

Entra authentication looks hard at first because many terms feel similar. Once you break it into identity proof and access control it becomes much easier to understand. You already know more than you think and you just need to connect the ideas in the right way. With steady practice and a sc 900 practice exam approach you build confidence. Using sc 900 exam preparation from authentic resources like Pass4success can help you practice in a smarter way and move closer to passing the exam with ease.

links.title: BULLYING IS NEVER ACCEPTABLE
links.body:
Hello your welcome to my blog

Bullying is harmful, whether it occurs in person or online. Victims of bullying experience emotional trauma leading to isolation, lack of confidence, depression, and anxiety. This treatment is undeserved, and it is essential to show love and respect to others, correcting with kindness rather than resorting to bullying. Let us steer clear of bullying, as it is detrimental to all involved.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQS6cELTDyxi5BA8dMNr4DoKcLLcGUyzRKWNcfT9irpiF/149288.png 


Sometimes, individuals underestimate the impact of their words or actions online, assuming it is harmless banter. However, online remarks can deeply hurt the recipient just like insults made in person. It is crucial to recognize the pain inflicted by online bullying and to act responsibly when interacting online.

Although people may have personal struggles, it is not justified to diminish someone else's self-worth or belittle them. Online bullying can be particularly damaging as the perpetrators often remain anonymous, causing significant harm to the victims without accountability. It is important for individuals not to take everything online to heart and to maintain confidence in the face of negativity.

When facing bullying, it is vital to know how to defend oneself effectively, whether against online harassment or physical intimidation. Responding with strength, confidence, and assertiveness can help deter bullies and protect oneself from harm. Bullying, in any form, is unacceptable, and individuals should feel empowered to stand up for themselves and others.

The comparison between physical bullying and online harassment reveals that both types of abuse inflict their unique harm on victims. Physical bullying may result in immediate visible effects and create a sense of physical danger and vulnerability, leading to lasting trauma. On the other hand, online harassment exerts ongoing psychological pressure on victims, creating a sense of constant fear and invasion of personal space.

Online harassment can impact self-esteem, identity, and mental health, contributing to long-lasting emotional distress. The widespread reach of online platforms amplifies the impact of bullying, making it crucial to address and combat online harassment effectively.

In conclusion, bullying, whether online or offline, is a serious issue that requires attention and intervention. It is essential to foster a culture of respect, kindness, and empathy, both online and in-person, to prevent harm and promote a safe and supportive environment for all. Victims of bullying deserve compassion and support, and perpetrators must be held accountable for their actions to create a more inclusive and positive society.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today

links.title: Like a Duck
links.body: <div class=\

>\n\nIn some areas of Finland, a full 25% of primary school boys are on ADHD medication, despite the estimate being 5-8% of children globally might have ADHD. That is a pretty massive difference of up to 500%, but I guess it must be something in the water, and not due to over prescription. In another medication trend, 11.5% of women between the ages of 18-29 were prescribed SSRI anti-depressants last year. For men, it was 4.4% last year. But perhaps more troubling is that girls in the 13-17 year gap has more than doubled, from 3.1% to 7.1% in the last decade. What is interesting is that the report said that anti-depressant prescriptions have \

at a historical high, probably because of the recognition of ADHD symptoms. Meaning that rather than anti-depressants, they are put on ADHD medication instead. 

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/242NoLyTs9ukW5oynnxhJfnkc2Li8ZEHmkGUAiR4jqKKng7RifZTBy1hgtqbbgKbbTmGn.png)


---

While I recognise that there are plenty of times that medication is useful and necessary, I have lots of issues with medicating like this based on behavioural symptoms, because behaviour can give a false positive for a behavioural condition. Sounds silly, I know. But if a behaviour is conditioned by the environment to become a habit, then is it a mental problem like ADHD or depression? By my estimation, certain behaviours can *look like* a mental problem, but are not. For instance, attention deficit might be the way a person is, or it could be caused by the way a person has been trained to behave - for example with a constant stream of short-form content, gaming and a lack of activity that requires attention from a young age. A lot of boys these days have been raised on screens that provide an environment that nurtures a lack of attention span - so is that really ADHD?

What about for depression? 

>Key Characteristics and Symptoms:
>
>- **Emotional Characteristics:** Persistent sadness, tearfulness, or feelings of emptiness. Feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or hopelessness. Increased irritability, restlessness, or frustration.
>- **Behavioral and Cognitive Characteristics:** Loss of interest or pleasure in almost all activities (anhedonia). Difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions. Social withdrawal from friends and family. Recurrent thoughts of death or suicide.
>- **Physical Characteristics:** Fatigue and lack of energy. Significant weight loss or gain, or increased/decreased appetite. Sleep disturbances, such as insomnia or sleeping too much. Unexplained aches, pains, headaches, or cramps. 

That is a lot of symptoms and there are many more, but I wonder how many of them could also be triggered by the environment, the way people consume content and what activities they choose to do. Because I would suspect that if a person spends the majority of their time scrolling short-form social feeds alone, looking at content that increases feelings of insecurity (in many forms), doesn't move enough, doesn't socialise enough, and doesn't create enough, they are going to tick a lot of those boxes that are used to describe depression. 

# If it looks like a duck, walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, then it’s probably a duck.

*Untrue.*

Back in the past, for sure. If you saw an animal looking, walking and sounding like a duck, it was almost certainly a duck. But that is not the case when it comes to many things these days, including behavioural issues. Using this heuristic means that there are going to be a great deal of false-positives, just like believing every image of a person or video showing a situation these days is the truth, is going to do the same. 

Behaviours are *trainable* which means that while in some cases there can be a true underlying medical condition that causes it, in other situations it isn't going to be the case at all. It is making an assumption based on the result, without looking at the conditions that lead to that result. For a visualised example, if someone has a tan, the assumption is that they spent time in the sun, whereas it could be that they have used a tanning product or put themselves under a tanning lamp. The preconditions matter, because no matter how much that person \

if they are tanning in another way, the results aren't going to change. \n\nAnd what I assume now is happening is that overmedication is being used for many result conditions, because it is an easier \

than affecting behavioural change. It isn't just for mental conditions either of course, because there are other ones like obesity caused by lack of exercise and poor diet, or stomach issues caused from the wrong eating habits, or cancers caused by *just about everything manufactured.* If we changed our collective behaviours, what would happen to many of these result conditions we are currently medicating? I have heard multiple parents who are *pushing* for ADHD and depression medication for their *primary school age* children, as if that is the solution best fit for their child. And then I see the children, sitting the next to them, scrolling through games and phones and on social media platforms. I personally see it as a form of child abuse, but since it isn't illegal, nothing gets done. And while I am not saying that there is never the place for some medications, I do think that a lot of what is happening now is detrimental to the future of these kids and is far more likely to have many other unintended negative consequences and side-effects that will plague them for their entire lives. We all want to feel good. But if we aren't doing the things that lead us to feel good long-term, we are going to lead ourselves into a state where feeling good becomes impossible without chemical intervention. And even then, it is likely that it will mean we will need more and more intervention if we haven't changed our behaviours that led to the condition in the first place. >A quack is an unqualified person, charlatan, or impostor who pretends to have medical knowledge, skills, or credentials they do not possess.
