links.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---  

## Lo que me cambió por dentro… y lo que hoy me mantiene en pie  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYZpRsnWmoFnpHQ8yAdD29bAdNzUeUvYi4G8RKwZiBi97/stocksnap_sunset_2592731_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/sunset-beach-ocean-sea-people-2592731/)

---

Hola hermosa comunidad @ladiesofhive 

Hay aprendizajes que no llegan como una gran revelación. Llegan poco a poco… y cuando te das cuenta, ya no eres la misma persona.

### Algo que me marcó de verdad  

No fue un libro famoso ni una película en particular.

Fue una idea que apareció en un momento en que la necesitaba: entender que no tengo que tener todo resuelto para poder seguir.

Durante mucho tiempo pensé que debía esperar a sentirme lista. A tener claridad. A saber exactamente qué hacer.

Pero la vida no funciona así.

Aprendí —a veces con frustración, otras con cansancio— que uno también avanza con dudas, con miedo, con incertidumbre.

Y que eso no significa que lo esté haciendo mal.

Significa que está pasando.

Esa idea me cambió.

Porque dejé de exigirme tanto.  
De esperar el momento perfecto.  
De paralizarme por no tener todas las respuestas.  

No es algo que siempre logre sostener.

Pero cuando lo recuerdo, todo se vuelve un poco más ligero.

Por eso lo compartiría.

No como una enseñanza perfecta… sino como algo que acompaña.

---

###  Lo que hoy me sostiene  

Si me preguntas ahora mismo cuál es mi razón para seguir, no tengo una sola respuesta grande.

Tengo muchas pequeñas.

Seguir adelante, para mí, no es un gran propósito definido.

Es levantarme, incluso cuando no tengo toda la energía.  
Es intentar hacerlo un poco mejor que ayer.  
Es no rendirme en esos días en que todo pesa más.  

También es encontrar momentos simples que me devuelven a mí.

Una conversación.  
Un instante de calma.  
Un pequeño logro que nadie más ve.  

No siempre es claro.  
No siempre es bonito.

Pero es real.

Y en este momento de mi vida, eso es lo que me mueve.

No una meta lejana.

Sino la decisión diaria de seguir.

De no soltarme.

---

A veces creemos que necesitamos algo grande para sostenernos.

Pero no siempre es así.

A veces basta con seguir, incluso sin tener todo claro.

Y en ese intento… también hay fuerza.

Gracias por leerme 

---

 *Esto es Vera, aprendiendo a sostenerse en lo simple.*

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha utilizando Google Translate.

---

🇬🇧 In English  

---  

## What Changed Me Inside… and What Keeps Me Going Now  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYZpRsnWmoFnpHQ8yAdD29bAdNzUeUvYi4G8RKwZiBi97/stocksnap_sunset_2592731_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/sunset-beach-ocean-sea-people-2592731/)

---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 

Some lessons don’t come as big revelations. They arrive slowly… and before you realize it, you are no longer the same person.

###  Something that truly impacted me  

It wasn’t a famous book or a specific movie.

It was an idea that appeared when I needed it the most: understanding that I don’t need to have everything figured out in order to keep going.

For a long time, I thought I had to wait until I felt ready. Until I had clarity. Until I knew exactly what to do.

But life doesn’t work that way.

I learned —sometimes through frustration, other times through exhaustion— that we can move forward with doubts, with fear, with uncertainty.

And that doesn’t mean we are doing it wrong.

It means we are living.

That idea changed me.

Because I stopped demanding so much from myself.  
Stopped waiting for the perfect moment.  
Stopped freezing for not having all the answers.  

It’s not something I always manage to hold on to.

But when I remember it, everything feels a little lighter.

That’s why I would share it.

Not as a perfect lesson… but as something that stays with you.

---

### What keeps me going right now  

If you ask me what my main reason to keep going is, I don’t have one big answer.

I have many small ones.

Moving forward, for me, is not a defined purpose.

It’s getting up, even when I don’t have all the energy.  
It’s trying to do a little better than yesterday.  
It’s not giving up on the days that feel heavier.  

It’s also about finding simple moments that bring me back to myself.

A conversation.  
A quiet moment.  
A small achievement no one else sees.  

It’s not always clear.  
It’s not always beautiful.

But it is real.

And right now, that is what moves me.

Not a distant goal.

But the daily decision to keep going.

To not let go of myself.

---

Sometimes we think we need something big to sustain us.

But that’s not always true.

Sometimes, just continuing —even without having everything figured out— is already strength.

Thank you for reading 

---

The English version was made using Google Translate.

# INTERNAL MEMO: RE: THE POACHER THEY JUST PUT IN CHARGE OF THE HEN HOUSE

**TO:** Anyone who still thinks the Federal Reserve is a neutral institution  
**FROM:** The part of your brain you've been ignoring  
**DATE:** April 21, 2026  
**RE:** Today's confirmation hearing and what it actually means

---

Let's establish the facts before we editorialize, because the facts are already sufficiently insane.

Kevin Warsh — nominated by the President of the United States to chair the Federal Reserve — walked into his Senate Banking Committee confirmation hearing this morning carrying a 69-page financial disclosure that lists, among other things, stakes in Solana, dYdX, Aave, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polymarket, and a Bitcoin Lightning infrastructure startup called Flashnet. His larger fund holdings, including a $100 million-plus position in the Juggernaut Fund LP, are shielded by confidentiality agreements, meaning the actual crypto exposure could be considerably larger than what's legible.

This is the man who, if confirmed, will set the price of money for the world's reserve currency. He pledged to divest. He showed up this morning and told the Senate that \

He is correct. The Fed must stay in its lane. It is useful to note that Kevin Warsh's disclosed lane runs directly through the DeFi ecosystem.

---

Now: none of this means Warsh is corrupt, captured, or a bad choice. His prepared remarks were hawkish on inflation, notably short on labor market sympathy, and explicitly committed to central bank independence. He's a former Fed governor who genuinely understands the institution. His critique that the Fed has chronically overreached into fiscal and social territory is not wrong — it's actually a defensible position that a lot of serious economists share. The man is not a crank.

But the *structure* of his position is new, and the structure is what matters in institutional terms. We have never had a Fed Chair nominee with disclosed positions across two dozen crypto and blockchain projects, sitting before a committee that oversees legislation governing exactly those projects. The conflicts aren't hypothetical. They're enumerated in a government filing. The divestment pledges are real, and presumably he'll honor them. But the *knowledge* doesn't divest with the assets. The cognitive map of what these protocols do, how they compete, where the regulatory pressure points are — that stays.

Markets, to their credit, are not particularly troubled. They're watching for something much more immediate: whether Warsh, under Trump pressure to cut rates, blinks or holds.

He didn't blink in the prepared remarks. The word \

appears with conviction. The labor market gets one brief mention, the kind of mention you give a relative you don't want to talk to at a family gathering. Powell's term expires May 15. The FOMC meeting is April 28–29. Whatever Warsh says today is now priced.

---

Meanwhile, 815,061.

That's how many bitcoin Strategy now holds. Michael Saylor announced Sunday — with the customary theatrical restraint of a man tweeting \

as a teaser — that the company had spent another $2.54 billion on bitcoin last week, acquiring 34,164 coins at an average price of $74,395. Third-largest purchase in company history. Largest since November 2024, when BTC was flirting with six figures.

The funding mechanism deserves attention because nobody seems to be paying it any. Strategy raised $2.18 billion through STRC perpetual preferred shares — a financial instrument that exists, in practice, to convert retail and institutional demand for bitcoin exposure into capital that buys more bitcoin, which supports the price, which improves MSTR's equity story, which supports demand for STRC. It is a self-referential structure dressed in corporate finance clothing. Brilliant, possibly. Fragile, certainly. At $75,527 average cost basis across 815,061 coins, and bitcoin currently trading in that same zip code, Strategy's cumulative position is approximately breakeven on a mark-to-market basis. MSTR shares dropped 2.5% pre-market Monday after the announcement.

The circular logic only works in one direction.

---

So here is what today actually looks like if you zoom out far enough:

The man set to become the world's most powerful central banker owns positions in crypto protocols. The world's largest corporate bitcoin holder is, for the first time in its history, essentially at cost. The ceasefire that was supposed to unlock rate cuts is fraying at the edges — Israeli airstrikes on Lebanon continued over the weekend; peace talks are apparently going to Pakistan, which is reassuring in the way that a \

light going off in a rental car is reassuring. PCE is heading toward 3.5%.

And Warsh's opening gambit to the Senate was: the Fed is independent, and also it needs to stop doing things it shouldn't be doing.

There is a reading of all this that is coherent and relatively benign. Warsh is a hawk who will hold rates, fight inflation, frustrate Trump, and the crypto holdings are minor venture bets that get divested. Strategy's flywheel keeps spinning as long as bitcoin trades sideways or up. The ceasefire holds long enough for energy prices to normalize. The IMF's base case plays out, 3.1% global growth, muddle through.

There is another reading. In that one, the hearing today produces enough ambiguity that the April 28–29 FOMC meeting becomes genuinely uncertain about its own leadership context. The ceasefire expires today — literally, the US-Iran ceasefire's initial window closes April 21 — and the second round of negotiations hasn't been scheduled. Strategy's preferred stock structure faces a stress test if bitcoin corrects 15% from here. The man replacing Jerome Powell has $100 million in a fund whose contents are confidential.

Institutional memory is the Fed's most valuable asset. It's the thing that makes markets believe, on some level, that the institution will do the right thing eventually, even if it's late, even if it's ugly. Installing a chair whose portfolio maps the exact terrain the Fed will regulate in the next decade is a novel experiment in how much that memory is worth.

We're about to find out.

---
*April 21, 2026*

links.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776755769506-11584b2a27911506.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=rashed.ifte/340a25d5)

---

<div class=\

> While waiting for my powers to return, I focused on parrying the Lizard's heavy strikes. After using a Venom power to thrash the beast, I made a mistake by chasing him onto the walls where he held the advantage. Despite using the Symbiote's rage, the Lizard's raw power led to a second brutal defeat. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQnACGoXjRBjYXfsvqVm3Pg7LP2xrnjBbK68cFuNxYZX7/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWcf7HzvbxZLbEjLTVSmdJQYNFurheFZAG74xPErxkYJ9/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbti2tTAPWiWNPSsqKKpRhbqxMB6sxbPDBqcKQBLXLCNG/screenshot_3_.png) When I was waiting for my powers to regenerate, the Lizard started attacking me with heavy attacks that shook the entire floor. I realized very quickly that the best thing I could do was parrying his attacks because dodging them would not do much good in this situation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRnB2FnEtxf4ccgdrrdxVDkjKbg4tyCNiRRtrYcCSjLPV/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmCMLGiU7dLioXZFddwF3Jeq8nm5w5kANKXnBQtMuUG4/screenshot_5_.png) Then the Lizard suddenly got a hold of me, dragging me across the arena. This happened in a cinematic moment where Peter handled the situation well despite the overwhelming force. It was the same web shooters that helped him get back up on his feet and prepare for the next round of the fight. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhmB58rr74qVPox4HbaQoF5qoQDukyNijUyhe7e99UxX/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQHkGcwsszDZBL6ELXNqKbznwkJDZNHuGXtrvyim1k8L/screenshot_7_.png) Now when the Lizard understood I was starting to overpower him on the ground, he climbed onto the wall and went up far out of reach. As I was just standing there waiting for his move, he suddenly jumped on me from above. I reacted fast and dodged the massive impact as he crashed into the floor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNj9xptvHA4iZArPo4UmbkzbEn2BvUV24ZKmTaR8Mn8Mp/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXL8mTezrBavnc4vyCNHzge7BubGNTVSownCipJT9gnuv/screenshot_9_.png) One of my Venom powers finally regenerated, and I used it to pull the Lizard's head up before thrashing him hard on the floor. It was a very cool move that showed the true strength of the suit. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPvxMGcMoB3aguVrNGrijjeVAScZvzX74pLDX1YTYKRoM/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAaEtBFQh88M6PTXXnEoYqng5k2MDehLShZ4FjdP4Kqd/screenshot_11_.png) The Lizard then jumped on the wall again to gain a height advantage. This time I did not wait for him to jump; I went for him immediately, which proved to be a big mistake. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRyfruKx1fJui6h788WvGa3D6LfNZuFhYpf2GwhVJrbb/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVbWP4uc1VdhrtiR2eRk4Xq3dVnFDHLZFhKJo2EUugLEa/screenshot_13_.png) It was a mistake because the Lizard actually wanted me to go for him since he was much more superior on the walls. He caught me easily and thrashed me off the surface, sending me back toward the center of the room. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQfbVcPk3TSj58tSauvkYSYFpvydFBbniDCN4o39L3JT/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXTbadgi8Vsy3GKQtwQRWfvFeP24ZQrtCWCW6aqjfWrpQ/screenshot_15_.png) The Lizard came back to the ground level and started charging at me with terrifying speed. I was using the symbiote tentacles to defend myself and push him back. Still, the Lizard managed to overpower me with his raw strength and took me down before I could recover. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfP28qBW9PCZ5CPn9j5ZLJF4HHBYDqcEDQ5mdnSdoLoCx/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb5zWoiYCZXJTs8xRRUgxWUf4KQk3vUneXKX22UgfRBPs/screenshot_17_.png) At the restart of the battle, I used the symbiote of rage and gave the Lizard a very good thrash. The dark power flowed through me, allowing me to strike with much more force than before. I guess the Lizard understood he was no match for me while I was in this aggressive state. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMSRaHRwUimMryeYah7H8QtYRi6u49EeRXZfNdxTGwVD/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmF4Fqc1uMZwV23rhWf7aXSPJxKw73eq8dmK9C88MA51/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2B3Jsowib1NaF2BePJKewCJxcGosWjT4BVBNw5Rz3K3/screenshot_20_.png) But I did the same mistake again by going after him while he was clinging to the wall. This time he actually bit me like a real Godzilla. It was a brutal animation that showed just how dangerous this predator could be when he feel cornered. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW3EaJ9Zn61SgZ2KBQVuCGcqyYikUVwkXUb9Fa1pW4MRy/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQtyauuhkzY4hkDLGw2vjfCGDowoxsHpZRWx4ezaHBYor/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd616fF36qNqUtBMhKxQRWLEj1jWVQuZhYJJAicVspcFm/screenshot_23_.png) After getting released from his mouth, I started attacking him again with everything I had left. After doing some decent damage to him, he managed to overpower me once more. The strength of the beast was just too much to handle, and I was taken down once more in the end. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png ----- ##### 🔗 ### Solutions to Episode #42 Exercises

**Exercise 2:** Build 4->32->16->1 model, train on 4D hypersphere data.

import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
X_np = np.random.randn(1000, 4).astype(np.float32)
y_np = ((X_np ** 2).sum(axis=1) < 2.0).astype(np.float32).reshape(-1, 1)

X = torch.from_numpy(X_np)
y = torch.from_numpy(y_np)

for epoch in range(500):

The hypersphere boundary (sum of squares < 2.0) in 4 dimensions is conceptually the same as the 2D circle boundary we've been using, but the model needs more capacity to carve out that decision surface in higher dimensions.

### On to today's episode

In episode #42, we trained a model by loading all data into memory as one big tensor. That works for 500 samples. It does NOT work for 50 million images, a 10 GB text corpus, or streaming sensor data. Real-world training requires efficient data loading, batching, shuffling, and optional augmentation -- without loading everything into memory at once.

PyTorch's data pipeline is built on two abstractions: **Dataset** (defines how to access one sample) and **DataLoader** (handles batching, shuffling, and parallel loading). Together they make training on any data source -- files on disk, databases, web APIs -- seamless. Having said that, the concepts are straightforward once you see them in action. Here we go!

## Dataset: one sample at a time

A PyTorch **Dataset** is any object that implements `__len__` (how many samples) and `__getitem__` (get one sample by index). That's the entire interface. If you've been following the Learn Python Series (espeically the episodes on classes and dunder methods), this will feel natural -- it's just Python's standard protocol for indexable containers.

```python
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import numpy as np

class CircleDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, n_samples=1000):
        np.random.seed(42)
        self.X = np.random.randn(n_samples, 2).astype(np.float32)
        self.y = ((self.X[:, 0]**2 + self.X[:, 1]**2) < 1.5).astype(np.float32)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.X)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return torch.tensor(self.X[idx]), torch.tensor(self.y[idx])

dataset = CircleDataset(1000)
print(f\
)\nx, y = dataset[0]\nprint(f\

)
```

The beauty of this interface: `__getitem__` loads one sample at a time. For an image dataset, this means reading one image from disk when requested -- not loading all images into memory upfront. For a text dataset, it means reading one line from a file. The Dataset handles the *how*; the DataLoader (which we'll see next) handles the *when* and *how many*.

This is a pretty powerful pattern. Your dataset could be terabytes on disk, and PyTorch will only load one sample at a time into memory. The code inside `__getitem__` can do anything -- open a file, query a database, download from a URL -- as long as it returns a tensor. The interface doesn't care about the data source, only the shape of the output.

## DataLoader: batching and shuffling

The **DataLoader** wraps a Dataset and produces batches -- the mini-batches we need for SGD training (as we discussed in episode #41 when implementing mini-batch gradient descent from scratch):

```python
train_data = CircleDataset(800)
val_data = CircleDataset(200)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_data, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_data, batch_size=64, shuffle=False)

# Iterate over batches
for batch_X, batch_y in train_loader:

`shuffle=True` randomizes sample order each epoch -- critical for training because it prevents the model from learning the order of samples in stead of the actual patterns. `shuffle=False` for validation gives you deterministic evaluation results. The batch size controls the noise-vs-accuracy tradeoff from episode #41: smaller batches add more noise (implicit regularization), larger batches give cleaner gradients.

For large datasets, `num_workers=N` enables parallel data loading on multiple CPU cores. While the GPU processes one batch, the CPU prepares the next in the background. Add `pin_memory=True` for faster CPU-to-GPU transfers on CUDA devices. These two flags together can dramatically reduce the time your GPU spends idle waiting for data:

```python
# Production-ready DataLoader configuration
fast_loader = DataLoader(
    train_data,
    batch_size=64,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=4,       # 4 CPU workers loading data in parallel
    pin_memory=True,     # faster GPU transfer (if using CUDA)
    drop_last=True,      # drop incomplete final batch
    persistent_workers=True  # keep workers alive between epochs
)

`drop_last=True` discards the final incomplete batch (if 800 samples / 64 = 12.5, you get 12 full batches instead of 12 full + 1 partial). This avoids batch normalization issues with tiny last batches, and the lost samples are seen in other epochs anyway since we shuffle.

## Data augmentation

With limited training data, augmentation creates variety by applying random transformations to each sample. Each epoch, the same image is seen with a different random crop, flip, rotation, or color shift -- effectively multiplying the dataset size. The augmented samples aren't stored anywhere; they're generated on the fly inside the Dataset's `__getitem__` method (or via the `transform` parameter).

For images, `torchvision.transforms` provides the standard augmentations:

```python
from torchvision import transforms

train_transform = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
    transforms.RandomRotation(15),
    transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(224, scale=(0.8, 1.0)),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
])

# Validation: no augmentation, just resize and normalize

    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225])

## The complete training loop

Now let's put everything together: Dataset, DataLoader, model, loss, optimizer, learning rate scheduler, and proper train/validation separation. This is the template you'll use for practically every PyTorch project going forward:

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

# Data
train_data = CircleDataset(800)
val_data = CircleDataset(200)
train_loader = DataLoader(train_data, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_data, batch_size=64, shuffle=False)

# Model
model = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Linear(2, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.2),
    nn.Linear(32, 16), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.2),
    nn.Linear(16, 1), nn.Sigmoid()
)

# Loss, optimizer, scheduler
loss_fn = nn.BCELoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.01)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=50)

for epoch in range(50):
    # Training phase
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for X_batch, y_batch in train_loader:
        pred = model(X_batch).squeeze()
        loss = loss_fn(pred, y_batch)
        optimizer.zero_grad()

## Saving and loading checkpoints

Models can take hours or days to train. Save checkpoints so you can resume training after a crash, compare different epochs, or deploy the model for inference:

```python
# Save everything needed to resume training
checkpoint = {
    'epoch': epoch,
    'model_state_dict': model.state_dict(),
    'optimizer_state_dict': optimizer.state_dict(),
    'scheduler_state_dict': scheduler.state_dict(),
    'train_loss': train_loss,
    'val_loss': val_loss,
}
torch.save(checkpoint, 'checkpoint.pt')

optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint['optimizer_state_dict'])

start_epoch = checkpoint['epoch'] + 1

`state_dict()` returns a dictionary of all learnable parameters. For the model, these are weights and biases. For the optimizer, these are momentum buffers and adaptive learning rates (for Adam/AdamW -- remember from episode #41 that Adam maintains running averages of first and second moments per parameter). For the scheduler, it's the current step count and internal state. Saving all three ensures you can resume training *exactly* where you left off -- not just the model weights but the optimizer's accumulated state and the scheduler's position in its learning rate curve.

For deployment (inference only), saving just the model is sufficient:

```python
# Inference-only save (smaller file, no optimizer state)
torch.save(model.state_dict(), 'model_inference.pt')

# Load for inference
model.load_state_dict(torch.load('model_inference.pt', weights_only=True))
model.eval()

with torch.no_grad():
    test_input = torch.randn(1, 2)
    prediction = model(test_input)

)\n    print(f\

)
```

A pattern I see in production fairly often: save checkpoints every N epochs during training (so you can resume if the machine dies), and save a final inference-only model at the end. The training checkpoints are large (3x the model size because they include optimizer state) and temporary. The inference checkpoint is small and permanent.

## Mixed precision training

Modern GPUs (NVIDIA Ampere and newer, Apple M-series) have hardware support for **float16** operations that run 2x faster and use half the memory compared to float32. **Mixed precision** training uses float16 for most computations and float32 only where numerical precision matters (loss computation, weight updates):

```python
from torch.amp import autocast, GradScaler

# Create the scaler (handles gradient scaling to prevent underflow)
scaler = GradScaler()

model_mp = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Linear(2, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.2),
    nn.Linear(64, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.2),
    nn.Linear(32, 1), nn.Sigmoid()
)
optimizer_mp = torch.optim.AdamW(model_mp.parameters(), lr=0.001)

# Training loop with mixed precision
for epoch in range(5):
    model_mp.train()
    for X_batch, y_batch in train_loader:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdwnJ9EqjbFMVjnGt3y6oWMLPe2kKhLpshEXvJcGRyvv/1776755855191.jpg)

A first contact event would probably be the most consequential moment in human history. Here’s how it would likely unfold across multiple domains:

**Immediate Chaos (Hours to Days)**

The initial revelation would trigger unprecedented information overload — markets would halt, governments would convene emergency sessions, and social media would either collapse under traffic or become a vector for mass panic and misinformation. Air travel and transportation could freeze as people either flee cities or flood toward the contact site.

**Political & Military Response**

Every nuclear-armed nation would go to some form of elevated alert almost instantly — not out of confirmed hostility, but sheer uncertainty. The UN Security Council would be paralyzed by competing agendas. Nations near the contact site would assert territorial claims, while others would demand internationalization. The question of *who speaks for Earth* would become bitterly contested — no such legitimate authority currently exists.

**Religious Upheaval**

This might be the deepest long-term disruption. Some faiths would face existential crises (“are they God’s creation too?”), while others would reframe the event prophetically. A wave of cult formation around the aliens would be almost certain. Some denominations would fracture; others might find surprising theological accommodation.

**Scientific Revolution**

Every field would be upended simultaneously — biology, physics, linguistics, astronomy. The scramble to communicate would become the biggest collaborative scientific project in history. If they’re visibly biological, the implications for evolution and the origin of life alone would be staggering.

**Economic Collapse & Restructuring**

Markets would likely crash hard in the short term — pure uncertainty drives that. Long-term effects depend entirely on alien intent. The mere *possibility* of superior technology would devalue entire industries overnight (defense, energy, pharma) while creating frenzied speculation in others.

**Social Psychology**

Interestingly, research on how humans respond to existential threats suggests a strong *rallying effect* — humanity might experience a brief but powerful sense of collective identity, with national and ethnic divisions temporarily muted. History suggests this wouldn’t last, but the initial window could be significant.

**The Wild Cards**

- If their appearance is humanoid, acceptance would be faster. If truly alien in form, visceral fear responses could dominate.
- If they arrive at a specific nation’s territory, geopolitical tensions between that nation and rivals could escalate dangerously.
- A single viral video of a negative interaction — real or fabricated — could tip global sentiment toward hostility overnight.
- Domestic extremist groups in multiple countries would almost certainly attempt attacks on the contact site.

**The Long Game**

Assuming no immediate hostility, within a few years you’d likely see the emergence of a genuine world governance body (something the UN has never been), profound shifts in how humanity defines itself, and either a renaissance of curiosity and cooperation — or a slow fracturing as different factions try to monopolize alien access.

The honest answer is that our institutions are almost entirely unprepared for it, which means the outcome would depend heavily on a handful of individual leaders making good decisions under the most extreme pressure imaginable.

links.title: Ese libro que me parte el alma cada vez que lo leo
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZnCCNN2ftJHm5QdzU6bwDhXT7GRYmNgnL6CieRPiVgmp/1776691208299.jpg)

No se si a ustedes les pasa, pero hay libros que duelen. Pero duelen bien. Como esas heridas viejas que uno no quiere que se curen del todo porque en el fondo, esas cicatrices son lo único que nos recuerdan que alguna vez fuimos de verdad.

A mí me pasa con Corazón, de Edmundo de Amicis. Si, ese libro que nos hacían leer en la escuela, ese que parece para chicos. Pero no, no es para chicos. Es para el niño que llevamos adentro y que se niega a crecer, o que crecio pero a las patadas.

Cada vez que lo agarro, las lágrimas me ganan. No puedo evitarlo. Soy como un nene otra vez, sentado en el pupitre de madera, con las piernas colgando y la cartuchera con olor a lápiz recién sacado. Pero no es nostalgia barata. Es otra cosa. Es como si cada página me apretara el pecho.

Los pasajes… ay, los pasajes. El niño que busca a su madre, el maestro que se sacrifica, el compañero que defiende al más débil. Cada uno de esos fragmentos no se lee, se vive. Y cuando terminas el capítulo, tenés que cerrar el libro un segundo, respirar hondo, porque sentís que algo se movió adentro tuyo.

Las enseñanzas de Corazón no son moralejas suaves, esas que se olvidan al otro día. No. Son hierro caliente. Te marcan para siempre. El honor, la lealtad, la patria chica, el respeto por el que sufre, el valor de la familia… todo eso te entra como un fierro candente y deja una huella que no se borra ni con los años, ni con las desilusiones, ni con la vida que a veces te vuelve duro.

Tal vez por eso lloro. Porque cuando lo leo, me acuerdo de lo que quise ser. Del niño que prometió no ser indiferente. Y me duele reconocer que a veces lo olvido. Pero el libro está ahí, esperando. Y cada relectura es como una segunda oportunidad.

Si no lo leíste desde chico, hacelo ahora. Pero preparate. Porque Corazón no te deja igual. Te parte. Y te vuelve a armar. Pero nunca más como antes.

Y si lo leíste, ya sabés. Las lágrimas son el precio de recordar quiénes eramos.

Publicado desde el alma, para la comunidad hive-argentina.
Con cariño, sin filtros y con algunas faltas que son mías nomás.

Title: That book that breaks my soul every time I read it

I don't know about you, but there are books that hurt. In a good way. Like those old wounds you don't want to fully heal because deep down, those scars are the only thing that remind us we were once real.

For me, that book is Heart (Cuore) by Edmondo De Amicis. Yeah, that one they made us read in school. The one that seems like it's for kids. But no, it's not for kids. It's for the child we carry inside, the one who refuses to grow up. Or who grew up the hard way.

Every time I pick it up, the tears get me. I can't help it. I become a little kid again, sitting on that wooden desk, legs dangling, with that pencil case smelling like fresh sharpened pencil. But it's not cheap nostalgia. It's something else. It's like every page squeezes my chest.

The passages... oh, the passages. The boy searching for his mother, the teacher who sacrifices himself, the classmate who defends the weakest one. Each of those fragments isn't read — it's lived. And when you finish the chapter, you have to close the book for a second, breathe deep, because you feel something moved inside you.

The lessons from Heart aren't soft morals, the ones you forget the next day. No. They are hot iron. They mark you forever. Honor, loyalty, the small homeland, respect for those who suffer, the value of family... all of that enters you like a burning rod and leaves a mark that doesn't fade. Not with years, not with disappointments, not with a life that sometimes makes you hard.

Maybe that's why I cry. Because when I read it, I remember what I wanted to be. The child who promised not to become indifferent. And it hurts to admit that sometimes I forget. But the book is there, waiting. And each rereading feels like a second chance.

If you haven't read it since you were a kid, do it now. But be ready. Because Heart doesn't leave you the same. It breaks you. And puts you back together. But never like before.

And if you already read it, you know. The tears are the price of remembering who we were.

Posted from the soul, for the hive-argentina community.
With love, no filters, and some misspellings that are just mine.

links.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wzvNHMRvf924ZPr3dT5zaD79Hi82Ssv6vqfjpnssZ3s5LMTSCdrvjw1nHLPkoa3xvon.jpg)




 --- 

 

### Hello my fellow Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another fresh and juicy Splinterlands post, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying a energetic and peaceful day with your loved ones. For those of you who have made themselves immune to the crypto market and are actively playing this amazing card-based strategy game regularly and working hard to build your NFT card collection, I think most of you are currently busy battling through this new and exciting ranked season. If we take a quick peek at the current ranked season timer, there are still around 9 days and 7 hours left before the season meets its reset point. So there is still enough time in hand to improve your trophy count, secure your goal league tier and win some cool reward chests, and then even make a push for the leaderboard if things go well for you. Just keep in mind to use your battle energy carefully and stay consistent throughout the ranked season.


 --- 

 
![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 11.57.48 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vrrsZchmKs3LPVdHNNiMDnzPQUtNdsiH7R386izGGypvgTWjD2Qmxry7cnzA5zBxYoR.png)



 --- 

 
Now, talking about my own progress in the frontier mode of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier as usual, with a trophy count of around 3,540. My target for this particular season is to reach the 4,200 trophy mark first and then try pushing further for the leaderboard. There is still a fair amount of time left, so I will continue the fight in the bloody arena while hoping for the best.




 --- 

 

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 11.25.47 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23tbPci4N6CVJhYVYsA9FhachBDntiiE5oBTs84iL3MnugXZ1oyu1ey6udHttT7Qz8EDZ.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 11.38.27 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wMPqkMS6176oJZh8BFesTrcMuuxFDd44787naEkzkibDYanKQbAh8ER73z9EoPPPJZ1.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 11.38.49 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wMPdCGeddsq8Bqox7GEttPuYNS5ESSHnpaJ6paiXMWokfxxu4w6hnmedp6nEg7btnqS.png)



 --- 

 
On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle which started just today, I have currently collected a total of 9 entries. With around 6 days and 6 hours left before the raffle draw, I will try to increase this number to somewhere between 54 and 57 entries. Let’s see if luck decides to visit me this time and I finally win something again. Now, in the screenshots above, I have shared the outcome of today's all 3 foundation packs that I won today. As you can see, I have won a legendary, 5 rare cards including 3 archons and all rest common cards. I also was very lucky to win a jackpot card, the Aimee Whisperwind today and the hunt continues for better ones.


 --- 

 
![image-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJg2tKKzFdBACvrkXeBbojpnuYSbJ15rTALXTZ8dn7nbHsGMhK2KAFe5jFgGqWC.png)



 --- 

 
### Phlegmost

Now moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be taking a closer look at another powerful monster from the newest Escalation edition. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Phlegmost. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us dive deeper without any further delay.

The Phlegmost is a monster type card that was introduced in the game with the newest Escalation edition mini cardset. This monster belongs to the Water element and it comes from the Divine Construct bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Common monster, so you will require a total of 400 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. Now, if you want to use this monster in battles, you need to spend 9 mana, which makes it more suitable for medium to high mana limit matches. The attack type of this monster is Magic, and apart from its magical damage, it also comes with a balanced defensive setup of armor and health but at decently low speed. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of four abilities, which makes it a dangerous and durable card. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities below to find out more about this monster.


 --- 

 
![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 12.01.05 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23w28fhFotEK5cWURQXpC9cM3NVfcfRGZL3M88hvkzWPUj26WDWLAnsJK5CixLucFR44U.png)



 --- 

 
#### BRONZE

At level 3, this monster starts with strong stats that consist of 2 magic attack power at 1 speed with 2 armor and 5 health. Apart from these stats, it gains Fury from level 1 and Reprisal from level 3. This gives the monster a dangerous counterplay against heavy attackers and Taunt-based strategies.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23uQiCBFNtVAuHBouXQpw876UjjsrSXqWsSUhprhkjMKA4hC3sTVhANKvNMBpji98Gmgd.png)

`FURY` – Deals double damage if the target has Taunt.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK3dd2P98viS1KvX4W1hpytdUVeHSNVhT5Vkk67q5eH5Q1U7JTo5ftXE6w1jiLJ.png)


`REPRISAL` – If an enemy unit deals more than 5 damage in a round, it gains Taunt and if camouflaged, is revealed.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 5, its stats improve slightly and it now holds 2 magic attack power at 1 speed with 2 armor and 6 health. At this level, it also gains another useful ability called Weaken. This ability weakens the entire enemy team right from the start of battle.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wWnWbgeRXaug6q7cpTf6LPQUYgLt4bCG7Wocou9Tzhgt5pqjjAHnLu51r3KGXZMLRjV.png)


`WEAKEN` – Reduces the maximum health of all enemy units by 1.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 8, its stats improve and it now carries 3 magic attack power at 2 speed with 2 armor and 7 health. Even though it does not unlock a new ability at this level, the higher attack power and better speed make it much more effective.

#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 10, it becomes even harder to remove. It now holds 3 magic attack power at 2 speed with 2 armor and 8 health. At this level, it also gains another powerful ability called Heal. This ability greatly increases its survivability in longer battles.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wMRrQFJaZEJzr8CXcybF59ZWsQE3omp6Bxe1WkwyMEniDgrLvhsaJX1WNDgFrcWsk84.png)

`HEAL` – Each round, heals 1/3 of its maximum health (rounded down).



Last but not least, I think this monster can be extremely useful in many different battles. First of all, it comes with a solid defensive setup and gains Heal at max level, which means it can stay alive for a long time in lengthy matches. Another strong point is its magic attack power, which directly targets enemy health while its armor helps absorb some physical damage early on. Even though the speed starts low, it improves at higher levels. The Fury ability is also very valuable against Taunt monsters. Since it deals double damage, this monster can strike Taunt targets with a massive 6 magic damage at max level. On top of that, the Weaken ability lowers enemy health across the board, while Reprisal can punish enemy monsters that deal 5 or more damage by forcing Taunt onto them. Overall, I think the Phlegmost is a powerful and durable magic monster that becomes even more dangerous in long battles. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about PHLEGMOST. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.



 ---

links.title: Actitudes al descubierto # 12. La disculpa que nunca llegó. [ES/EN]
links.body:
---

**Serie:** Actitudes al descubierto  
**Capítulo 12**  
**Título:** La disculpa que nunca llegó

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX5dDAkr49KubKgoTg2smpfysH2BjcNztYMLZxsFQvh3R/tumisu_couple_4641033_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/couple-argument-crisis-relationship-4641033/)

---

Hay errores que no duelen por lo que pasó… sino por lo que nunca se dijo después.

Hola querida comunidad de @holos-lotus,

Continúo con *Actitudes al descubierto*, esta serie donde observo escenas cotidianas que, aunque parecen simples, terminan revelando mucho más de lo que se dice en palabras.

Esta vez ocurrió en un entorno tranquilo. No hubo discusión, ni voces elevadas, ni gestos bruscos que llamaran la atención. Desde fuera, nada parecía fuera de lugar.

Pero algo había pasado.

No era necesario conocer los detalles exactos. Se notaba en la forma en que uno de ellos hablaba con normalidad, como si nada hubiera ocurrido. En cambio, el otro mantenía una actitud más contenida, como si esperara algo que no terminaba de llegar.

La conversación fluía, pero con una ligera tensión difícil de explicar.

El primero hacía comentarios habituales, retomaba temas, incluso sonreía en algunos momentos. Actuaba con naturalidad.

El segundo respondía.

Sin confrontar. Sin reclamar. Sin mencionar directamente lo sucedido.

Pero tampoco soltaba del todo.

Había pausas más largas. Respuestas más medidas. Una presencia que estaba, pero no completamente.

Y entonces se hizo evidente.

No era lo ocurrido lo que marcaba la distancia.

Era la ausencia de una disculpa.

Porque hay errores que pueden resolverse con una simple palabra. No borran lo que pasó, pero cambian el significado. Abren un espacio para reparar, para reconocer, para volver a un punto en común.

Pero cuando esa palabra no llega… algo queda suspendido.

No se rompe del todo.

Pero tampoco se repara.

Mientras observaba esa escena, no pude evitar pensar en cuántas veces algo similar ha ocurrido en mi propia vida. Momentos en los que no esperaba una explicación larga, ni justificaciones complejas.

Solo un gesto.

Un reconocimiento.

Un “lo siento” dicho a tiempo.

Y cómo, en su ausencia, lo que parecía pequeño empieza a ocupar más espacio del que debería.

Porque cuando no hay disculpa, cada gesto posterior se interpreta distinto. Cada palabra se mide. Cada silencio pesa un poco más.

Y no siempre se trata de orgullo.

A veces es incomodidad.  
A veces es falta de conciencia.  
A veces es simplemente no saber cómo hacerlo.

Pero desde el otro lado, la sensación es clara.

Algo falta.

La conversación continuó. Ninguno mencionó lo ocurrido. Ninguno forzó el tema.

Y, sin embargo, estaba presente en cada intercambio.

Hasta que poco a poco, como suele pasar en estos casos, la distancia dejó de ser momentánea y empezó a sentirse como algo más permanente.

Porque hay errores que no nos alejan por lo que hicieron…

sino por lo que nunca vino después.

Porque a veces no es el error lo que más pesa… sino la disculpa que nunca llegó.

---

En los próximos capítulos de *Actitudes al descubierto* seguiré explorando estos espacios silenciosos donde lo que no se dice termina teniendo más fuerza que las palabras.

---

## English Version

---

**Series:** Attitudes Uncovered  
**Chapter 12**  
**Title:** The Apology That Never Came

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX5dDAkr49KubKgoTg2smpfysH2BjcNztYMLZxsFQvh3R/tumisu_couple_4641033_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/couple-argument-crisis-relationship-4641033/)

---

There are mistakes that don’t hurt because of what happened… but because of what was never said afterward.

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,

I continue with *Attitudes Uncovered*, this series where I observe everyday scenes that, although they seem simple, often reveal much more than what is spoken.

This time it happened in a calm setting. There were no arguments, no raised voices, no obvious gestures that would draw attention. From the outside, everything seemed normal.

But something had happened.

It wasn’t necessary to know the exact details. It showed in the way one of them spoke naturally, as if nothing had occurred. Meanwhile, the other carried a more contained presence, as if waiting for something that never quite arrived.

The conversation flowed, but with a subtle tension that was hard to explain.

The first continued with usual comments, picking up topics, even smiling at times. Acting naturally.

The second responded.

Without confronting. Without complaining. Without directly mentioning what had happened.

But without letting go either.

There were longer pauses. More measured responses. A presence that was there, but not fully.

And then it became clear.

It wasn’t what happened that created the distance.

It was the absence of an apology.

Because there are mistakes that can be eased with a simple word. They don’t erase what happened, but they change its meaning. They open space to repair, to acknowledge, to reconnect.

But when that word never comes… something remains suspended.

It doesn’t completely break.

But it doesn’t heal either.

As I observed that moment, I couldn’t help but think about how many times something similar has happened in my own life. Moments when I didn’t expect long explanations or complex justifications.

Just a gesture.

An acknowledgment.

A simple “I’m sorry” said at the right time.

And how, in its absence, something small begins to take up more space than it should.

Because when there is no apology, everything that follows is interpreted differently. Every word is measured. Every silence carries more weight.

And it’s not always about pride.

Sometimes it’s discomfort.  
Sometimes it’s lack of awareness.  
Sometimes it’s simply not knowing how to do it.

But from the other side, the feeling is clear.

Something is missing.

The conversation continued. Neither mentioned what happened. Neither forced the topic.

And yet, it was present in every exchange.

Until little by little, as it often happens, the distance stopped being temporary and began to feel permanent.

Because there are mistakes that don’t distance us because of what was done…

but because of what never came after.

Because sometimes it’s not the mistake that weighs the most… but the apology that never came.

---

In the next chapters of *Attitudes Uncovered*, I will continue exploring these silent spaces where what is left unsaid ends up carrying more weight than words.

---

>Las imágenes son de Pixabay y para la versión en inglés utilicé el traductor de Google.  
The images are from Pixabay, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

links.body: It's good to think about complex things like this sometimes, gives the brain a workout! :)\n\nI've heard stuff along these lines in some YouTube videos, I think by both <a href=\
>Paulogia and

>Mindshift. \n\nThe idea, at least in my religion of Christianity is that God/Jesus/Holy Spirit wants to have a relationship with me. A relationship requires 2 entities that actually exist. If God is all knowing then He would know what to do if I pray to him for some confirmation of His existence. He did it for \

Thomas who was invited to put his finger in Jesus' wounds to convince him, but seemingly hasn't done that for anyone else ever again.

But then it is said we're supposed to take it on faith, and being proved that He exists takes away our free will to believe or not. I guess that's fine but the stakes are so high. Knowing that, is it really free will?  If I tell my kid that there's a unicorn in the garage, and if you believe me without seeing it then we're going to Disneyland but if you don't then I'm putting you in the basement and lighting you on fire, does the kid really have free will? And why did no one care about Thomas' free will?

I'm also not bothered but fascinated by all these kinds of things.

In the end, there's no proof of anyone's religious supernatural claims. But one can choose to believe in something because of the psychological and sociological benefits even if they conclude the actual truth of the thing is highly improbable. Our brains evolved to help us survive, not necessarily to always find the true things in this world.  Picking a religious team to join can help one survive better.

Or something like that, who really knows! :P  Just throwing words in a reply box. No one needs to take what I say seriously.  I don't always agree with my former self when I read comments I've left in the past.  I change my mind when I have looked at something from other angles. It's good to adapt to new knowledge and change our minds, maybe.

Thanks for the thought provoking post. Wishing you all the best!

links.title: IPL Match Review MI vs GT.
links.body: <div class=\

>
Hello .. !! My dear Hive friends, I am @samadbro08 from Bangladesh. Today is Tuesday , April 21/2026
How are you all, I hope you are well. Today I am reviewing an IPL match that took place yesterday. In the 30th match of IPL 2026, a fierce battle took place between Mumbai Indians (MI) and Gujarat Titans (GT). In this match held at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on April 20, 2026, Mumbai Indians won by a huge margin of 99 runs. Let me discuss the match with you.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAgxoZA1so9a4MqEMmL9uitnzgvJPGdz4pxSxbyYeqyf/1776754788190.jpg)
After losing four consecutive matches, Mumbai Indians finally returned to winning ways. Hardik Pandya's team blew away Gujarat Titans like a piece of cake at their home ground in Ahmedabad. The victory brought smiles to the faces of Mumbai fans with the devastating century of the hero of the match, Tilak Verma, and the combined efforts of the bowlers.
### **Match Summary** * **Toss:** Gujarat Titans (Fielding decision). * **Mumbai Indians:** 199/5 (20 overs). * **Gujarat Titans:** 100/10 (15.5 overs). * **Result:** Mumbai Indians won by 99 runs. * **Man of the Match:** Tilak Verma.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPi7UCEsDooAWrmW6FPDiXJCZ1vh8qVEw67RsQknj8MZZ/1776754846035.jpg)
### **Mumbai's batting: Tilak Verma's tandav** Mumbai was under some pressure when they came out to bat at the beginning. Kagiso Rabada's bowling brought Suryakumar Yadav and the three first-row batsmen back to the dressing room in the powerplay. But then Tilak Verma's magic began. He remained unbeaten on 101 runs in just 45 balls. He hit 8 fours and 7 sixes. He scored 19 runs in the first 22 balls, but scored an incredible 82 runs in the next 23 balls! However, Naman Dhari played a crucial innings of 45 runs in 32 balls, giving Tilak a worthy partner. And so, in the last over, Mumbai scored a huge score of 199 runs, relying on the bats of Hardik Pandya and Tilak.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHZEHtYGZX68CAgt3r5BNxidpB7qDfVZGiodFNM7XVR1/1776754865459.jpg)
### **Gujarat's batting disaster** When they set a target of 200 runs, the Titans' batting lineup collapsed like a house of cards from the beginning. Jasprit Bumrah dismissed Sai Sudarshan in the first over. After this, captain Gill returned to the pavilion after scoring just 14 runs. Washington Sundar scored the highest 26 runs for Gujarat. However, the bowling hero or the most successful bowler for Mumbai was Ashwani Kumar, who took 4 wickets for just 24 runs in 4 overs. In addition, Mitchell Santner and Allah Ghazanfar took 2 wickets each.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbFpcJJiQM6rcTLv4oMTpEvPwXBdWJ6FAHqVL2PhicyJ8/1776754876261.jpg) ### **Special records and points table of the match** Tilak Verma's record, which is the first century of Tilak Verma's IPL career. He also equalled Sanath Jayasuriya's record for the fastest century for Mumbai. With this win, Mumbai has climbed to seventh place in the table with 2 wins from 6 matches. On the other hand, Gujarat Titans are at sixth place with 3 wins from 6 matches.
This win for Mumbai was not only two points, but also a huge confidence booster for them. On the other hand, such a defeat at home is a big warning for Shubman Gill's team. Anyway, I am ending my writing here today, thank you all.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrz5aqaQE8fjygAMZycWabiPgeX3MVzAH2gttLdN2ixX/1752476713171.jpg)
Picture of myself
My name is Md. Abdus Samad. I am a Bangladeshi. My district name is Meherpur and Thana Gangni. Union sixteen taka. My village name is Jugirgofa. Currently there are four people in my family. Especially we are two brothers of parents. I am the eldest son of the family. My educational qualification is I am an honors 4th year student of Bengali department.

links.title: 【万挠】零食爪乐园 Fun Snack Claw
links.body:
有看我文章的朋友一定知道我前几天去了「万挠」(Rawang) 的 Anggun City 那里逛逛最近在周末举办为期三天的【[可吉喵市集](https://peakd.com/hive-105017/@lovelemon/kecimeow-market--anggun-city-rawang)】，在逛完市集并吃饱喝足打算离开的我们突然被一间抓娃娃机的店吸引，并且走了进去。 这间抓娃娃机的店就是下图这间……
零食爪乐园
--- ![Fun Snack Claw](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48SMav9Awdx81VWnexaUU731FVVMpXZG2hF6TuhU4Mo29UrFNsLGxdkceTY1zT6ned.jpeg) **零食爪乐园** 的抓娃娃机抓的不是娃娃，而是零食！这店的老板真的脑洞大开，把零食装进抓娃娃机来给顾客抓，感觉能赚钱的生意，因为不一定抓得到。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48QRdSNf2vnZSPs8oTG7fivsBGGibXGpuCHYN8KdG8oMiw8ZMKKEuCqn2m4kDowAgA.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48fNLAMgfzLWHaMH1HAJ3JgtU6WnG5Krf9Xmj3HTdam3F1PMNo3JiogoB59rVMyxjr.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48WDNK5DeE1KXvAeKubTuCfpCuB67r33MRLYwyRnAFijyTVsshzp21vMkvNz9xd27N.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48bWMwDAp9EXRCMBsXpioCb7HrwRMTcLZc52J6P9B7ZxQkrHropbNt1VVxhW5ZkXjn.jpeg) 我们走进去里面看，里面的机器装的是各种零食、泡面、方便面、速溶饮料、包装和瓶装饮料等等。除了那些吃的喝的之外，竟然连湿纸巾、抽纸、厕纸这类的物品也有，有趣有趣！ 首先得先看看价格，抓一次 1 马币，机器里面的成本价也不止 1 马币，如果真能抓到就当是便宜购买了那个物品。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Z77RMcoAsMmsgd94QJVrVuTACZZB4BUC8EnxRKRvoDHFnsCxjR6xvRb7k4DdLuKA.jpeg) 当下我们决定试试自己的手气，然后投入了一张 10 马币的钞票，换取了 10 粒游戏币。我和米特一人一半各大去抓自己想要的物品。 米特抓了个包装美禄饮料，其实也不算抓到，只是爪子松开原本的那包美禄不小心打到靠近洞口的另一包美禄，然后那一包美禄就掉下来了。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48YchFLq45LWJb4QzEZW3QSbFQV4mEmSsEoKFfSbeFBgz6vgY8FTYkLAKEs71vw7vS.jpeg) 我则是来抓这个厕纸，结果也是跟米特一样，厕纸抓起来爪子就松了，而厕纸掉下撞到另一个靠近洞口的厕纸，反而那个厕纸掉进洞，原本抓了还在里面。这个爪子不行，都抓不稳，真的很靠运气。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48SqX8akFyDu1jfGoE8EuwrToywFRDLocCH44gb2iWAG78AQnen3wpzo9w9TVuHWe3.jpeg) 最后喜得🧻厕纸一卷…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48bWYiw1HZiFRWAyzeq9AxSFHYFUjzjhXiszYa8qxrPScXWq72o6u3diLf8C8FZKnm.jpeg) 还剩下最后一个游戏币，只能测试自己的运气看看能不能抓出这个悬挂式抽纸。投币，移动爪子，点击按键，抓住了！爪子往上提的时候又松开了，真是气死我了！ 没个爪子能抓稳的，有点圈钱的嫌疑…… 幸好最后还是有得到两个物品：厕纸和小包装美禄，但这两个物品都是被撞进洞的。这算是另类的运气？ **共消费：RM10**

links.title: Discovering a broken shepherd’s lodge in the remote forests of Kullu Valley.
links.body:
![Blue Beautiful Mountain And Sky Mood Board Photo Collage .jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/48PTQs4g6tvxfVgN3LNPfN9vfqhEQPzh8ziceHUAwjRBwbV95XmyuwwPSk5bAi8xSx.jpg)


![IMG_7230.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EowG4R9YGxvGMGv5U3YfZL7MetFdeFzBErhtnE87qftewAyMdzMm374x7HvQ1gTqUjN.jpeg)
Julley Everyone,

A new day with a new adventure, so was this beautiful day out here today in the Himalayas as I started my journey. I started my adventure over here in these remote isolated locations and now sharing the moments with you guys through this post as it was the journey it was the exploration, and it was the beautiful magical moments sharing it with you guys as it was out of nowhere that discovering a particular place so amazing that was kind of related with the ancient history, and also a lot of mystery, followed by the exploration of these beautiful magical places.

![IMG_7231.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/Ep1XTfMcZUdSRrS7omuqS7TFCNpaZoEip7B29M16fbSohAUxXFkY84EmDCAhZftDQhT.jpeg)
So the journey kind of begin something like this, as we were literally exploring these beautiful locations around here in the Himalayas and just kept these beautiful moments and now sharing the moments with you guys through the sports as also previously mentioned, so we have been hiking for more than four hours all the way at the top of this particular mountain that was just straight at the top of the place on the way to Manali Highway from kullu Valley, the place named Dobhi and we were at the top of that particular mountain towards the north side.


![IMG_7232.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EoeFReYDmqZ95fAbLY2fqeUMwjXhZCdEsNiGLjDeZSeonHLwYZ2dxDgWfSmGvv3D3mP.jpeg)
Gaining the altitude and gaining the elevation, we have been currently at an altitude of near about 2000 m above the sea level, arranging to all the way 2500 to 2 700 m. All the way in increasing the height and so that we could explore, we could just be at a high altitude place as we have been hiking continuously. It literally was a whole lot of different experience. My friends hiking the woods and enjoying these beautiful fresh mornings over here from these hidden corners around Himalayas.

![IMG_7233.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EowGAxQYakBPPfCqUpEMPoGnrUViWRAVndVpqqxd4MYSuSodo1oopvB9YayfivdpcxC.jpeg)
Also around the corners, there were the snow point where there even was the snow by the side of the trail, as you guys can see in this particular picture that I have captured around the location.

![IMG_7234.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/23tbpaKRu1n7aoxN4tDEgBX6Sy6m8Nm9zveRK3xstmBr3jsXMiWddx7QxGQnREWajKJPu.jpeg)
There were these trees and slowly we’re getting the feeling that we were at a higher altitude location and still going on on and on to the higher location and moreover, my friends, these photographs hiking around the location and enjoying the views or something that I literally enjoyed all the way starting this fresh morning over here at this particular point.

![IMG_7236.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/23xAXxniJYNttq8bHn3nL1geQS2DtWPyf96jUJyrqwXsjV97WaEWpXiRsHDoH8PQyTtK5.jpeg)
It literally was the feeling of this walking and walking continuously, literally somewhere in the middle of nowhere, aiming at no location as literally even did not had any idea that where we were headed to, so we continuously kept on hiking and hiking all that we knew it was that we have to just go down when we need to descend and just be at a lower altitude place. As now we were at the top of the ridge, just hiking and hiking all the way, and in order to just come down, find a perfect spot so that we could just kind of design the mountain and reach at a lower altitude based from where we can catch a direct bus all the way, and just reach at the location where we wanted to.

![IMG_7237.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EqFrwgy2c6gKnpKvbsWpNqqVvBZ5kCT6EeVU6sNpK5stSX2NgNoekHMMdpLT73we26A.jpeg)
And followed by this type of geographical setting. It was the moment where like we did not even had the fear of getting lost in the woods as all that we knew it was that we could easily just reach at a lower altitude place by just descending as they were nearby villages that were around the place, and also followed by the nearby highway that was about closer to the place from where we started journey all the way.

![IMG_7238.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/Eqaz7RnJhNygKHW2YQTTwNs3EDv57btqf41CS9EosZjRd3Vs9SodFeYLcFXGepCRDNu.jpeg)
And that was the story for now, my friends until we reached at this particular corner at this particular spot of our adventure, where, out of the blue, I saw that there was something strange that I saw the broken lodge of the ancient Shepherd, first of all when I just went closer to this kind of setting, I did not recognise it, and then later, I just got to know that I remember in my also previous adventures we have gone in the Himalayas in the higher altitude. This type of setting was that the ancient Shepherd usually use to just make a kind of a lodge or kind of a tent that just protect them so that they could just be here in the mountains in the nature, so it was the left out of the broken ancient lodge of the Shepherd. Called Gaddi or Phuaal in the local language.

![IMG_7239.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EoiWCPKKgu5WEToDtkids7ztKPtcGtVLHWobZr3QqGFWniEJW8Mqui55pekewS6ir9h.jpeg)


![IMG_7240.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EokdCKs8yFNKzmkavRpBZ9Qtc471VkTY6aYkQ5C3MJpQrWc6bcxcSqEFjhhzRvLHQS4.jpeg)

![IMG_7241.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/Eou7DTwpybhKa3pkXjYGjoX9WXzWzFu3XAURw8WkWLSgALUHtet81EGGh4yJjUodVqr.jpeg)
And followed by the main point, the main hotspot of this particular location that I was just so amazed to see that the point where there was this particular point placed was this lodge placed. It was somewhere at the spot from where where you can just get the whole view of the valley, just imagine waking up and living at such a high setting in the mountains. It was just a dream of someone. It was literally a whole lot of a different experience. Just sitting here for a while and enjoying the views was just literally a whole lot of different feeling, and then even that made me fascinated about just thinking about that how peaceful it would be like waking up in this type of beautiful hidden corners around the Himalayas around the world more over to be precise, I would say.

![IMG_7243.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranavinaction/EogMMRfVVrRyZHbuLmxCcBPoCg5nJxpTyfU4YppMFmo9Nkm5WBUe3w3HZmwgB5XWqM8.jpeg)
So in the end, it was really a whole lot of a different experience that I got and I was at this place and I literally just wondered around the place for quite a while, and then made my way all the way to a lower altitude location that I’m gonna share in my upcoming block post, but for now it was the main point. It was the main hotspot of the day that I wanted to share it with you guys through this post, so I tried capturing as many photograph. I occurred all the way and now sharing it with you guys through this post. Do let me know my friends, the particular photographs over the part of my journey. You like the most in the comment section, and I would love to hear it from you.

links.title: Excuses, Excuses, Excuses...
links.body:
We humans seem to be singularly gifted when it comes to making up excuses for why we don't *do* things, or don't *try,* or don't *quit*, or don't *change* things... even when it would clearly be the best thing for us.

![2855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23uFU4G94hMem1Ra8zevNoWanErGA3Cv7wizFEjai1wh3jxewHvhYJWwqtLi3bWTrgi5E.jpg)

But it's still a strategy we seem to use for virtually everything from why we don't want to go to a party, to situations where we choose not to take on a new job even though it might suit us quite well, to why we don't leave an abusive relationship. It would be nice to think we outgrow our childhood claims that *\

* but it seems like we never do.

> *There's always an excuse.*

I'm certainly not claiming that I'm exempt from being part of this pattern, although in more recent years I have grown more willing to just outright state *why* I don't want to do something and choose not to... rather than cooking up some elaborate excuse.

It's not rocket science!

In the past, I think many of my choices were informed by not wanting to *look bad* or somehow look *\

* what the world around me expected of me.

![2796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23x1B9vBDUkvtv5fhKyfRvbg5PGcB9CW1SadyNrh1GT3mrLAP5qkBJZ8yrqzK6XhLsgtp.jpg)

But there comes a time when you have to ask yourself *who* you're really trying to impress, and who it is you're trying to *make happy* in the world. Not suggesting that there's anything wrong with wanting to please other people, just that there's something wrong with doing so at the expense of your own life.

As a friend of mine characterized it, many years ago: you don't need to *\

*

Of course, we also don't want to be *rude,* generally speaking. 

So we end up going to events and parties we don't care about, at the behest of people we don't really like... and promise ourselves that *next* time we'll say no. Except we *don't.*

Much of the time, when I have caught myself starting to fabricate an excuse, the *truth* has been that my head/heart *simply wasn't in it,* whatever *\

* might have been, at the time.

![1291-Fuchsias.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EpGSdqErGPNh4pJXpaPhLhtvhZQ4ENqsJDE8dQv8X4w6tAxKWWDxTct9KVfyxTkniDr.jpg)

It's often what you discover, if you have been a *\
* sort of person for most of your life.\n\nThe thing most of us struggle with is embracing the simple fact that *\

* Even though it is typically just an expression of having healthy personal boundaries, we often come from a background where we were led to believe that it was *rude* to turn down someone asking us to do something.\n\nSimilarly, when we fail to do/accomplish something, we typically feel compelled to come up with all sorts of reasons *other* than the truthful *\

* It was how I felt about most of my years in the IT industry.

I did get out of bed way too late and also was still a bit tired (or lazy) which made me take an afternoon nap not really doing much aside from listening to some youtube podcasts. ---

Pubg is a battleground game. It is a very old game. I have been playing this game for many years. It is currently ranked number 5 in the whole world.There are many maps in the pubg game, they are Erangel map, Lipik map, Miramar map, Sanhok map.The maps here are very large and the ranked matches are roughly 30 to 40 minutes long.

The game also has a TDM mode and a new WoW mode has been added, which includes many unusual games that the user enjoys playing.The game is a very high quality game and its graphics quality is very good and there are many graphics in it, its name is Smooth,Balance,HD,HDR,Ultra HD.The game can be played at a maximum of 120 FPS.

I can play this game very well and in this game I play with 5 fingers and I have to use a lot of reflexes. I am in the game and I use a lot of movements.I play with the gyroscope in games.The game can be played socially with friends and with many people from home and abroad, and you can talk and play games together.

This game was previously ranked number one in the entire world but currently due to some downfalls it is currently at number five but still it is a very good realistic game.To play this HMD, the minimum phone capacity must be 6 GB to 8 GB and a very high-quality processor is required.And a high-quality Android version is required to play this game.

There are many ranks in the game such as Gold Rank, Silver Rank Bronze Rank,Platinum Rank, Diamond Rank and finally there is Conqueror.I really like playing the game and I have a lot of fun playing this game and its a very fun game. 

People will get a lot of joy playing this game and they can enjoy their boring time by playing this game in their boring time.The game was played entirely by me and contains no outside parts or copyrighted parts.

This blog explains how a caterer enhances the guest experience at special occasions and why choosing the right catering services matters. 



![Corporate-Catering-4.jpeg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/eccd5c561e5d729bd3225714659570f5ff94a6fa10d4d556d80ebf83244bfb2b)



Organizing a special event may be daunting. It is a wedding, birthday, corporate event, or a family gathering; every detail counts. Food is one of the most significant aspects of any event. This is where a professional caterer is important. A professional [Caterer Alexandria VA](https://artistrycatering.com/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi) is not just someone who serves meals; they help make the event something to remember for all attendees. We shall discuss how employing professional catering firms can indeed take your event to the next level.

**1. Professional Food Quality and Presentation**

The professional caterer guarantees food of high quality that is both tasty and attractive. The guest would always recollect some things through the food they had eaten. To impress the guests, a caterer uses fresh products, balanced flavors, and appealing methods of presentation. 

Presentation is an added touch, whether it is a dish beautifully plated or a buffet set up that is creatively presented. This not only serves to make your dining experience enjoyable, but also makes your event look more classy and well-coordinated.

**2. Customized Menus for Every Occasion**

Each occasion is special, and so are guests' food preferences. Catering businesses will provide tailor-made menus to your theme and the guests.

For example:

*   Vegetarian or vegan options

*   Regional or international cuisines

*   Special dietary meals (gluten-free, low sugar, etc.)

This flexibility makes all the guests feel appreciated and content. Your event is also made to be more memorable with a personal touch created by a personalized menu.

**3. Stress-Free Event Planning**

Less stress is one of the greatest benefits of employing a caterer. Food management of a large group can be difficult. A professional caterer will look after all the things, including:

*   Food preparation

*   Serving staff

*   Table setup

*   Cleanup after the event

This will enable you to concentrate on your guests and have fun at the event without being preoccupied with logistics.

**4. Professional Service and Hospitality**

A good service is as important as good food. Caterers offer trained professionals who understand how to serve the guests in a polite and effective manner.

They ensure:

*   Timely serving of food

*   Proper table management

*   Friendly interaction with guests

Such professionalism contributes to a positive environment, welcomes guests, and makes them feel relaxed.

**5. Efficient Time Management**

During events, time is important. Late food service can upset the whole schedule. Well-established catering firms know the schedules of events and operate in line with them.

They ensure:

*   Food is served fresh and on time

*   Courses are delivered smoothly

*   Buffets are refilled quickly

This maintains a smooth flow of the event, and none of the guests is left waiting.

**6. Creative Food Experiences**

Modern caterers go beyond traditional food service. They bring creativity to the table with unique ideas such as:

*   Live cooking stations

*   Themed food counters

*   Interactive dessert bars

These elements add excitement and make the event more engaging for guests. It turns dining into an experience rather than just a necessity.

**7. Hygiene and Safety Standards**

Food safety is extremely important, especially at large gatherings. Professional[ Catering Companies in Alexandria VA](https://artistrycatering.com/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi) follow strict hygiene practices.

*   They ensure:

*   Clean cooking environments

*   Safe food handling

*   Proper storage and serving temperatures

This reduces health risks and builds trust among guests.

**8. Cost-Effective Solutions**

Many people think hiring a caterer is expensive, but it can actually save money. Caterers help plan the right quantity of food, reducing waste. They also offer packages for different budgets.

Instead of managing multiple vendors, you get everything in one place, which is both convenient and cost-effective.

**9. Enhances Overall Event Ambiance**

Food is a central part of any celebration. A well-organized catering setup adds beauty and style to the event. From elegant table settings to coordinated themes, caterers help create a visually pleasing environment.

This enhances the overall mood and leaves a lasting impression on guests.

**Final Thoughts**

Hiring a caterer is one of the best decisions you can make for any special occasion. From high-quality food and customized menus to professional service and stress-free planning, caterers play a major role in creating a successful event. Choosing reliable catering companies ensures your guests enjoy every moment, making your event truly unforgettable.

**FAQs**

**1. Why should I hire a caterer for my event?**

Hiring a caterer saves time, reduces stress, and ensures professional food quality and service.

**2. Can catering companies handle different dietary requirements?**

Yes, most [Catering Gainesville VA ](https://artistrycatering.com/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi)companies offer customized menus, including vegetarian, vegan, and special diet options.

**3. How far in advance should I book a caterer?**

It is best to book at least a few weeks or months in advance, especially during busy seasons.

**4. Do caterers provide serving staff as well?**

Yes, most caterers include trained staff for serving, setup, and cleanup.

**5. Is hiring a caterer cost-effective?**

Yes, caterers help manage portions, reduce waste, and offer budget-friendly packages.

**6. What should I consider when choosing a caterer?**

Look for experience, menu options, reviews, hygiene standards, and pricing before making a decision.

I think I realized what this community is driving at which is to remove those stigmatization we have given to certain things limiting it from featuring any forward, it's more like it has gotten a bad name or image that makes people to term it bad even without wanting to dig deeper, so I see this as correcting that impression that we even grew up knowing, we examined one last week and for this week we are back again with a different idealogy which says: Good addiction.


![IMG_20260420_121811_325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/graceze/23xVLyNL3D9xzKNb9ghzhDWpvco56Shiy9VzCScALWVkqViCnVVTNRXTy3JyVhB3J8bCB.jpg)


To be sincere me specifically I am also guilty of this act and in most scenario like 80% I also misjudge addictions to be the negative ones even without proper digging but just on seeing this week prompt, many instances and occurrences started flashing back in my memories where I have actually seen and personally experienced good addiction and on that note I stand to agree that there's actually what is called good addition plus let's not forget the fact that what ever have a disadvantage also have an advantage, so this one is no exception.

The most prominent example of my good addiction that I can give is that of serving God, I can remember a skit I watched where  a lady was in an argument with someone and at some point the person said \
and she was like anything God is not involved in I can't be there, and that skit just sent a message, in real sense i have heard people tell me \

some would say I am always in church, everytime church, church. There are many things I haven't even mentioned but they are part of my good addiction just like I like to lock myself indoors with no much reflection in the room and I just carry my books and read, sometimes I sit on the floor of my room to give me a good stamina for reading, I hear other of my course mates playing and gisting outside, whenever they realized I am inside reading they will start yabing me calling me a first class student. My take on good addiction is that something it's just a pushing force for us to be better and we shouldn't kill it, thank you lovelies for your time. All images used here belongs to me.
