links.title: Blond Cards 408 to 750 Blockchain
links.body: How to make your art forgeproof. Create a numbered blockchain series for all your work: \n
alt=\

/>  \nI don't know much about crypto, Bitcoin etc. but when I heard about blockchain's being like a ledger and how it's essential for things like Bitcoin to hold value, it made me think about all those forgeries hanging up in art galleries and how it's a shame that each artist doesn't have a blockchain of their own work. Apparantly, a quarter of all paintings in top museums are credibly suspected of being forgeries. What's their big solution? Signing. Anyone can fake a signature. Catalogue Raisonee's aren't worth the paper they're written on. No wonder art is riddled with so many fakes. There must be a better way! So I made [Jompiy](https://bitcoinofart.com/), a testnet for [CryptocuRency](https://cryptocurency.org/). Every Jompiy is assigned a number at birth and recorded on the Jompiy blockchain, aka [the Jompiy website](https://bitcoinofart.com/). I called Jompiy \
and started giving them away to members of the public. Here's a photo of me doing this on the Southbank outside Tate Modern a couple of years ago: \n
alt=\

/>  
Jompiy was the begining of [Free Art Frees Art](https://freeartfreesart.com/) and has become my online name on crypto-social sites. It was a testnet in that I didn't know what format to best make the artworks in. I tried around 15-20 and gave each a letter. By far and away the best was Jompiy series G , so when it came to CryptocuRency I used the Jompiy G format to make each of the four CryptocuRency's: [BitcoYn](https://bitcoyn.org/) , [EthereOm](https://ethereom.org/) , [DogecoYn](http://dogecoyn.org/) and [AlgoranB](http://algoranb.org/) The ledger for each cryptocuRency consists of photos and videos that are kept freely available online. Forgeproof. If you have a real Jompiy you can rest assured that no one will be able to make a fake one as detailed front and back photos and videos exist of each one, and each are numbered, meaning it's easy to check if any contender is a forgery. You can't just fake any old Jompiy, like you can a Picasso or Monet. A forger would have to perfectly fake a specific artwork that is, not only, able to be checked via public detailed photos and videos, but is also already in existence somewhere else. It's an impossible task to reliably fake a Jompiy, or any series of works that has such a bullet proof ledger. There's also a confirmed number of each series, again, making forgery impossible. Why the art world hasn't adopted this policy en masse is beyond me. Maybe because there's too much money in fakes being, not only tolerated, but encouraged. I know someone who has worked at two major art auctioneers, and she's told me that if they get a potentially valuable artwork to check, they will send it to ten experts to authenticate. If nine say it's a fake and one says it's genuine, it gets passed as genuine. One famous and reformed forger in England said he once submitted a fake Monet to a major aution house that passed their scrutiny, even though he painted it using household paints instead of oil. What a gap in the market there is for us honest types!  
I've use the Jompiy blockchain model and use it for all my art series. Here's the latest addition to the [Blond Cards](https://blondcards.com/) blockchain. An hour long video I recorded yesterday of numbers 408 to 750. Try and forge one of these:

https://youtu.be/yM\_mLxlB\_DM

links.title: Marriage Is Not a Race, But a Responsibility.
links.body: There are some certain stages in our lives we get to, and we will start to figure out things in a more different way because we have gotten more advanced than what we were before. When we were still young, we saw things like a normal thing because we did not care about what comes out of what the result might be. Then when we get to a certain stage and we see those around us doing well, especially in the aspect of relationships and getting married for those that are due for marriage, we will become bothered and restless about it. \n\n
alt=\

>

Last night, I was in a conversation with a friend of mine who told me about how her parents have been disturbing her to get married and go to her husband's house. Well, at some point, I will agree with parents because most of these people called parents are growing every day, getting old, and getting closer to their graves, and most of the current generation, which is the Gen Z generation, are not ready and willing to marry because they feel it is of no use. But come to think of it, in another aspect, when we get prepared and get married on time, it gives us the ability to fight for our children and provide for them on time.

This also applies because I remembered when I traveled home sometime last year, my dad called me and asked, When are you coming with my fiancée? And I looked at him and smiled. Deep down within my mind, I was thinking that he does not know what he is saying, but looking at it from another angle, I reasoned with what he said, and I told him that he should not worry, that it's very soon. I will come with one and make him happy.

One of the joys of every parent is that when they give birth to each child, they are also able to provide their own offspring because that is what will keep the lineage going. Children are a prestigious gift from God to every human. This is why some people that have a delay in giving birth find it so hard, or some of them whose children died through some circumstances feel so bad when they see other children. But thinking about this generation and the way some people live their lives, one will want to conclude that these generations are somehow going to cause problems for the coming generations because we are doing things that I feel will harm the coming generations.

Lots of toxic relationships out there are producing children, and one thing we don't care about is that little children tend to sense trouble, especially when it is their parent. Imagine a married couple that fights every day in the presence of their children, and the child sees it every day. One day, at one time, the child will adapt to this pain you are imbibing in him or her. This kind of child will become very toxic to people around them due to their parents. My last word of advice today is that we should always do things so that when our children grow, they will look back and appreciate us and not the other way around.


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@the-lead/marriage-is-not-a-race-but-a-responsibility-jqa)

links.title: DIY: Tiny Chef Sculpture [ENG/SPA]
links.body: <div class=\

>

Those who have heard of “The Tiny Chef Show” probably don't need an introduction, but this is the show's little star, the Tiny Chef, who spends his time cooking up all sorts of tiny plant-based dishes.

Well, this was a request, so I got to work and started making a figurine of this charming character. Please join me as I walk you through the creative process behind this piece.

>># Español
>>Quienes hayan escuchado hablar de \

quizás no necesiten presentación, pero este es el pequeño protagonista de este show, el Tiny Chef, quien se dedica a cocinar un montón de platillos diminutos a base de plantas. >> >>Pues bien, esta fue una petición, así que puse manos a la obra y comencé a hacer una figurita de tan simpático personaje. Por favor acompáñenme en el proceso creativo de esta pieza. ![DIY Tiny Chef Sculpture @GaboAMC2393_20260421_003216_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23zGwCkPNQEqpNZpwpQbrGTSZXTxi2J9eBWRPwFVAAArLbjV4KJngRSijNq7r8mSAzFSm.png) # Materials The materials I used to make this figurine were as follows: * Modeling clay * Glue * Wooden skewer * Wire I started by shaping the forms I needed for the figurine’s head and torso out of the modeling clay itself. Notice that the one in the image on the left is black. This is because that modeling clay is used as filler, which I covered with modeling clay in the Tiny Chef’s color. >># Materiales >> >>Los materiales que utilicé para hacer esta figurita fueron los siguientes: >> >>* Plastilina >>* Pegamento >>* Palillo de madera >>* Alambre >> >>Con la propia plastilina comencé a moldear las formas que necesitaba para la cabeza y el torso de la figurita. Fíjense que la de la imagen de la izquierda es de color negro. Esto es porque esa plastilina es de relleno, la cual cubrí con la plastilina del color del Tiny Chef. |![IMG_20260418_191438~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23u5xXKrVLkXSh5dgJiHR4SPWxjHbvRGQMNmiGNzFwxqqEEXcuq6ETdZFUMGCzsqHauWi.jpg)|![IMG_20260418_192532~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/EoeDv9tSr1Jjv7tJz14Nx5SLJwmabbSrjkxy7caExAs7hQ9BFjyCVN3GdaT3u5QkDbn.jpg)| |-|-| I moved on to the limbs; I made the hands and feet thick and plush-like. Then, as you can see in the image on the right, I inserted wooden sticks into the torso and small pieces of wire into the limbs to provide support for all the pieces when assembling them. >>Continué con las extremidades, las manos y los pies los hice gruesos y como si fuesen de un peluche. Luego, como pueden ver en la imagen de la derecha, le coloqué palillos de madera en el torso y trocitos de alambre en las extremidades para dar soporte a todas las piezas al momento de unirlas. |![IMG_20260418_194701~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23uQmtBKGPFkJqs5oXs1eswxcgeRQ79qFF86T4PFDU1WULzSontXatUh9FiAwpTyJc7XD.jpg)|![IMG_20260418_192839~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23wC7M5QbRHum4WP4gg6P9bi7YtLU4HDniR2BHRJK2uq3jmciS5LY3xxKWP3k8r8qiC1e.jpg)| |-|-| Take a look at this interesting thing I made. In the image on the left, you can clearly see a series of different-colored strips of modeling clay; I joined all these strips together into a single strip that mimics the fabric of the Tiny Chef’s apron. Once the strip was complete, I cut it into small pieces to make the apron, as you can see in the image on the right. It’s worth noting that I used glue to join these colored pieces together to make the little vest you can see. >>Fíjense en esto tan interesante que hice. En la imagen de la izquierda se observa claramente una serie de líneas de plastilina de diferentes colores, todas estas líneas las uní en una sola tira que simula la tela del delantal del Tiny Chef. >> >>Una vez hecha la tira completa, la corté en trocitos para hacer el delantal, como pueden observar en la imagen de la derecha. Cabe destacar que usé pegamento para unir estas piezas de colores para hacer el pequeño chaleco que pueden ver. |![IMG_20260418_220107~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23u5zbPy18kASJYdAwRWcU4xZcJoBEn8irU4ukcWb6Eu5abCgjMvP8aRJpgPVcfWQUfKn.jpg)|![IMG_20260418_220415~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23wC387AzD3UzbeUGW8RWmb4erBTbUD6V2i9Br4ab3FhHycZZc3ZHr7z77XRXXUBPL4sa.jpg)| |-|-| I also used glue for the arms and legs, as well as more glue for the apron and the small straps I attached around the neck and back. The last thing I made was the chef's hat, which completed the figurine. >>De igual manera usé pegamento para los brazos y las piernas, además de más pegamento para el delantal y los pequeños tirantes que le hice tanto alrededor del cuello como en la espalda. >> >>También lo último que hice fue el sombrerito de Chef, terminando así la figurita. ![IMG_20260418_221651~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23xKvhx8hjhzXsg9Xx5n62FhtMCxFW49TMun2tAb25t1j1WzWExtpNyZbrzuTAHEZzLhZ.jpg) ### Below are a series of photos showing the final result: >>#### A continuación pueden ver una serie de fotografías del resultado final: ![Diseño sin título_20260421_002008_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23ydLygfZ6QbeogBcFexDCV9fA9w3FMMby7uDDTUi1RDL6obMHRiVxXsp28VD9XpZ5SAe.png) ![Diseño sin título_20260421_002140_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23zSL9RXviQzcggyzt26mLLqbw7tJ6YDrK1r3fbtpWmHVgGQVY8ZewNhymrh7SNMAdmon.png) ![Diseño sin título_20260421_001812_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaboamc2393/23zbeLXcNXuZ7QjPQPrnejkQdVtURE6dg5t43pPZpHUxoSgcNkzYAT8cwPRDQiyXt2Kzn.png) Well, friends, that’s all for now. It’s a little figurine that I really enjoyed making because I got a little creative with the apron, and I think it looks nice—just like the whole figurine. I hope you liked it, so I invite you to leave your thoughts in the comments below; as always, I’d love to read them. With that, I’ll sign off for now...

See you next time!

>>Bien amigos, esto ha sido todo por ahora, es una pequeña figurita que me gustó mucho hacer porque inventé un poco con lo del delantal y creo que se ve bonito, al igual que toda la figurita. Espero que les haya gustado, por eso los invito a dejar sus opiniones abajo en los comentarios, yo como siempre estaré encantado de leerlos. Sin más que agregar, me despido entonces... >> >>

¡Hasta la próxima!

links.title: My father and his kindness lessons
links.body:
Hello everyone, I hope you all are fine, today I am going to show you what a beautiful message was taught to me by my father.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEqReg2K1YhMCTH1KELrPYut3ntBp1hd6wjUaqZyXo6i/img_1654.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUG1B2GT8xTowLoPEAVvbmj6qSEENi83dmajUmwVWz6eQ/img_1653.jpg)

My father is a high school teacher, and he has been teaching there for thirty-five years. Almost, and he is a very learned man, he is thoughtful, and he is sensitive when it comes to nature and our birds and animals and insects. So, he has also placed a vessel for water at the rooftop of our house. So that birds can drink from there. I am telling you about my father how kind and compassionate he is.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPqaSyt6sw3jBoz4ngaUam2LdbEdQ83hzNaig222jsNoP/img_1650.jpg)

So, we went to the park, we always go because this is our routine. And my father is conscious about his health, so am I about him. Because we are worried about him, he has diabetes. This is why we want to work on his weight. He has gained a lot of weight in recent years.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZL2Ww4UvVhKpZ1NUXcXu4dtay3kruUZ6dUDFZFE5bhDP/img_1649.jpg)

Anyways, today as we were walking, we saw some birds, my father told them it is necessary to be kind to them, because they cannot speak, they cannot tell us about their needs. We humans have the ability to speak and convey our message, but these are innocent, they cannot convey their needs, this is why we have to be kind to them, we have to be compassionate to them, we have to provide food and water to them and shelter to them, and he told me to fill in the little pot with water, and the moment I filled it, so many crows and pigeons set there and drink water, my father was so happy looking at it, and I was so happy looking at my father smiling.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxEWHfqcheDBK1Ux4ZzGPrpLr8QNJagTLbV119PP3XFx/img_1645.jpg)

So, this is a message of being compassionate and kind to our feathered friends. No matter where you are from, no matter what you are doing, you should always be kind to them. Because kindness has a way of coming back to you.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZwJAZDgeKvn3fyN5uz35ddTGBr6KYngruA3aQuK8HHc/img_1655.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDcUs8htspEvWVeTTD2QA2b3twNiGkjAu1gdrY2NqcsF/img_1651.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWsscbfs2TWrc7p6LtSU6bGYW7J4GxWt2WDpkWdNorBd/img_1652.jpg)

Thank you so much, I will see you in another blog. Do not forget to follow my account for more such content. I have taken these photos with my iPhone fifteen.

links.title: Cuando las emociones generan una tormenta | When emotions stir up a storm
links.body:
<center>  
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQE9U7QjSCqnchjbAZknemCbWTgXgjeASiKTae1mAeHtz/mi_portada.jpg
</center> 
 
 <center>  
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
</center>  

<div class=\
> \n \n<div class=\

> Más que química, física o biología, creo que la gestión de emociones debería ser parte fundamental de nuestra formación académica. Cuando pienso en todo lo que me ha afectado el estrés, no puedo evitar imaginar lo que podría mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas, la gestión apropiada de lo que siente. Un simple llamado de atención de un jefe, puede convertirse en un huracán devastador y, aunque objetivamente no pasa nada, nuestra mente puede experimentarlo con tanta intensidad, que nos agota en extremo. Cada quien hace lo mejor que puede con las herramientas que tiene, pero ¿qué tal si tuviéramos más herramientas? Y no se trata de reprimir lo que sentimos, sino de colocar cada emoción en su lugar. No es igual vivir una pérdida humana, que perder un empleo, sin embargo, en nuestro interior esto puede parecerse mucho... Aún así, creo que ante cada una debemos encontrar la manera de sobreponernos, con el menor daño posible.

> More than chemistry, physics, or biology, I believe that managing emotions should be a fundamental part of our academic education. When I think about how stress has affected me, I can’t help but imagine how much people’s quality of life could improve if they learned to manage their feelings properly. A simple reprimand from a boss can turn into a devastating hurricane, and even though objectively nothing is wrong, our minds can experience it with such intensity that it exhausts us to the extreme. Everyone does the best they can with the tools they have, but what if we had more tools? And it’s not about suppressing what we feel, but about putting each emotion in its proper place. Experiencing the loss of a loved one is not the same as losing a job; yet, deep down, it can feel very similar… Even so, I believe that in the face of each situation, we must find a way to move forward with as little harm as possible. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmNpnRj28H5oBRG6C5jK75X2bCvk1SqxG3n8Bgf6TQkj4u/20260410_184717.jpg
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> Entonces, la idea no es controlar las emociones, ni tampoco guardarlas bajo la alfombra para que nadie las vea... Lo mejor es agarrar el toro por los cachos y gestionarlas. Y no se trata de un tema de moda, ni de un lujo: es una necesidad básica de supervivencia. Si no somos capaces de identificar y drenar lo que nos afecta, en algún punto colapsaremos y lo peor es que eso no solo nos afecta a nosotros, sino que también alcanza a las personas que amamos (que son las que más nos importan).

> So, the idea isn’t to control our emotions, nor to sweep them under the rug so no one sees them… The best approach is to take the bull by the horns and manage them. And this isn’t just a passing trend or a luxury: it’s a basic necessity for survival. If we aren’t able to identify and release what’s affecting us, at some point we’ll break down—and the worst part is that this doesn’t just affect us, but also the people we love (who matter most to us). ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJ74PrMoXxC3GLj4B7mRg95GX53j9twZWwoTtw2qjL38/20260420_165745.jpg
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> No podemos ser un puerto seguro para nadie, si nosotros mismos no nos sostenemos. Es importante aprender a convivir con el miedo sin permitirle paralizarnos, o a sentir enojo sin que llegue a lastimar a otros. Lo que sentimos es inevitable, pero reaccionar de manera irracional, es opcional. Hoy, ya no me interesa tanto ser la fuerte, más bien intento ser alguien capaz de preguntarse: ¿Por qué me siento así?¿Es eso realmente una amenaza para mí?¿Qué puedo hacer para sentirme mejor? Al gestionar nuestras emociones, elegimos la calma ante la tempestad; mostramos madurez y evitamos lastimar a otros, o a nosotros mismos.

> We cannot be a safe haven for anyone if we cannot support ourselves. It is important to learn to live with fear without letting it paralyze us, or to feel anger without letting it hurt others. What we feel is inevitable, but reacting irrationally is optional. Today, I’m no longer so interested in being the strong one; rather, I try to be someone capable of asking myself: Why do I feel this way? Is this really a threat to me? What can I do to feel better? By managing our emotions, we choose calm in the face of the storm; we show maturity and avoid hurting others—or ourselves. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQo8kegf7ESGpzsyFzx8myHLFu95wSav3H9GL1awnQXRo/20260413_083544.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
> \n \n<div class=\

> Y estas son las reflexiones que quería compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these were my thoughts to share with you today, friends. Every day gives us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, line by line. To you, thank you for joining me in this reading. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

description.title: Splinterlands: Starting to max out some cards in my Foundational Set
description.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this specific post, I will talk about what upgrades I did to my deck from playing in the Foundational ranked battles and claiming Foundational card rewards. 

## What does upgrading cards give you?
Upgrading cards can either increase the stats on a card or give them new abilities. There are two types of cards: archons and monsters. The Archons (summoners) determine the maximum level of the monsters you can use, and some gives buffs/debuffs in the fights.

## Archon Upgrades

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EoprYjC6WkT7Csf4FamfkEWXa3DFQ9HMXPwKTKDvQPBWGK6bNfDbizTvJ7WMM5kQFoC.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFH65RQzD5tqj3AuhfpdtKBkeRR4iKLH82p57zGNE5KzPwWnJw3X4CtJWgrzfbHtSxs.png)
I was able to max out two different archons, and they are the fire and life archons in the Foundation set. I did have my Earth Archon maxed out a while ago.

## Monster Upgrades

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/48J8ReMDaaKDVvQaeYT4cpBmiNMSn2LmSmd665Na6mQvCXvmF2iKmhiqByHCxg64GG.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wMRrNrFKPKya9TFn5KuhM4CzubpB3qjy3w5f7rFEbrW9BcxXDeRkkftT7FM8DQNfm1L.png)
I was able to max out two legendary cards. The first is A'lan Musketeer, and I think this is one of the best cards to upgrade. This card has double strike, and its damage essentially doubles with this upgrade. The other is Celestial Guardian, and this increases its health by 2 and speed by 1. I think the stat increase is quite a bit, and it's now more worth using. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EogLNjghYFd3fxWYqCsAukeRLnBGQ8wdpQbQZnz5LCj3nxVuf1MaiYGbpxN6HP4GmrZ.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tvAfAemiAj5A7QEqcpSWrVjFRif2foNu7hjkfeyu2bCEWxJRG7cHGKePHggSHWN8eqR.png)
My final two upgrades were Sturdy Axe Warden and Wilhelmdale Deputy. These are both common cards, but increasing these cards does increase their health by 1. That makes them more tankier, and who knows if that one health can determine the difference between a win or loss. 

## Conclusion
My deck in Frontier is looking better after these upgrades. With these cards, and the black/gold arcane foil that I got, my deck is starting to look closer to maxing out. I wanted to focus on these cards because they can be used in Frontier, and you never know if that is enough to get me some extra wins. Frontier has been my focus for ranked battles over the past few months, and I am glad that I am starting to get closer to that final goal.

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask and I will do my best to answer.

description.title: Higher or Lower Contest - Round 4
description.body:
From feast to famine! 

We dropped from 17 goals in Round 2 to just 9 goals in Round 3. The earlier kick-offs had provided 6 goals, suggesting an outside chance of another high scoring round but that wasn't to be as just 3 goals were scored across the games in England, Portugal and Italy. 


![Designer (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23yU6RH9ucK3oxzT2bGu13tjtDftfuGT2fXaZZs2nQ9xs3HMgFferW3DpzRt65EJeLmgC.png)


We're back up to 9 players thanks to 5 buy backs yesterday. All those 9 players correctly guessed there would be fewer than 17 goals in yesterday's matches. 

The prize fund is now up to 1600 MEDALS. 

The temptation of course will be to go higher again today but I wonder if anyone is brave enough to buck the trend in order to try and take the win? 

### Brighton v Chelsea

Otherwise know as Brighton v Brighton's old boys. 

Chelsea are in shocking form having suffered 4 defeats on the bounce. By contrast, no side has won more points in the same period than Brighton have (10 from their last 4). 

Another win for the Seagulls would take them ahead of the Blues and all but end Chelsea's hopes of a Champions League spot next season. Given the financial losses that the West London club have already reported, that could be significant for their immediate on and off the field plans. 

No area of the game is working particularly well for Chelsea but most worrying must be the fact that they haven't scored in the league since the 4 March. That's 400+ minutes of Premier League football and counting since they last hit the back of the net. 

Brighton meanwhile have been very consistent since being knocked out of the FA Cup back in February, scoring in all but 1 of their 7 games since then (a 1-0 loss to Arsenal). 

If there is one stat that might suggest a different outcome, it is that Chelsea continue to be the top scoring away team in the Premier League this season with 30 goals in 16 matches. 

<u>Under/over odds </u>
Under 2.5 goals - 2.20
Over 2.5 goals - 1.65

Over 2.5 goals in last 5 games

👈 most recent matches


![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 06.06.10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23tvw8rxYaYNyx8XoBvhzEgDEYbucZq8d5A67yYaWy4BBp4AtL8AfwDSRzSQNhun8MdjX.png)

### Coventry v Portsmouth

Coventry are heading back to the top flight for first time since 2001. I always liked those Coventry teams of the late 90s who played attacking football with the likes of Darren Huckerby, John Aloisi and even a young Robbie Keane. 

They have been by far the best team in the Championship this season but they've kind of limped across the line in recent weeks having drawn their last 3 matches. 

They are 10 points clear at the top while Ipswich, their nearest rivals, have a game in hand. The Tractor Boys don't play until tomorrow night so Frank Lampard and his side can seal the title tonight with a win in front of their home fans. 

Portsmouth's form has been the polar opposite. They have found 3 wins in a row to pull them away from the relegation zone, including a 1-0 victory over Leicester on Saturday in front of a jubilant Fratton Park. 

I watched most of the 2nd half of that game and it was not high quality football. Portsmouth's winner was about as scrappy a goal as you are likely to see but when you're fighting for your lives, it doesn't really matter how they go in. 

That victory took Pompey 7 clear of the drop zone, so again, a win for them will seal their survival in the Championship. 

The 2 wins prior to that for Portmouth were actually against Coventry's main rivals for the title in Ipswich and Boro'. Will they do the Sky Blues another favour and roll over or are they here to fight a little bit longer? 

<u>Under/over odds </u>
Under 2.5 goals - 1.95
Over 2.5 goals - 1.80

👈 most recent matches


![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 06.19.30.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/48PUA9AYB3oYDpwLjZrk4fd8YaaHhbk55pprdut3CyaPEfVRaQp3LEzqnXUJBiAUsY.png)

### Rotherham v Luton 

I picked this game last week for 2 reasons. Firstly, I thought at least non-English fans would recognise Luton after their brief spell in the Premier League a couple of years ago and in the hope that it would have something riding on the result for both sides. 

Unfortunately for Rotherham that's not the case. Despite victory in their game at the weekend, they have been relegated. The Millers now only have pride to play for. 

However, Luton are on the charge. A season that looked like it would fizzle out to a mid-table finish has been reignited by recent form. They are unbeaten in their last 9, scoring 2 goals or more in 8 of those matches. 

That run leaves the Hatters just 3 points off a play-off position with 3 matches to play. They have a very good recent record against Rotherham too, unbeaten in their last 5. 

The bookies certainly favour the away team to win and to win with relative ease. Can Rotherham's new manager Lee Clark get his side to fight in front of their home fans? 

<u>Under/over odds </u>
Under 2.5 goals - 2.1
Over 2.5 goals - 1.67

Over 2.5 goals in last 5 games

👈 most recent matches


![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 06.32.16.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23u6JFeLGRckVDVYTGT6JS7zYDxkVbQKXZPMzxUda6Fo9HChrTKowJrcmDiqstpddgURK.png)

### Real Madrid v Alaves 

From New York (that is where Rotherham play their home games - good to know for football quizzes) to the Bernabéu. 

Real Madrid are licking their wounds after that classic encounter against Bayern last week and it feels like that tie in general has occupied their thoughts for the last couple of La Liga games. 

They dropped points at home to Girona last time out having lost at Mallorca the match before that. It actually means that Real have no win in 4 games in the month of April!

With Barca 9 points clear of them and 7 still to play, this is a must win for Real. 

Alaves have plenty at stake themselves sitting just a point and a place above the relegation zone. However, you would assume that they are targeting other fixtures to get the necessary points on the board for survival. 

You'd think that a team in their position will just park the bus and hope to avoid it descending into a cricket score but in recent weeks Alaves have been involved in some absolutely cracking games. 

A 3-3 at Sociedad last time out, 2-2 against Osasuna and 4-3 win on the road against Celta Vigo prior to that. In total, there have been 24 goals in their last 5 La Liga fixtures! 

Are they going to turn up to the Bernabéu and have a go at a shaky Real team? If they do, this could be both fun and high scoring!

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 06.48.22.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23viChCgTUrd2j8QSB1gNKBSfuGfWZsk9kVNA1HVLsUjfKMbwotS5Aan4UhRktv9vhWX4.png)

### Genk v Charleroi

Lastly we are back to Belgium for Genk v Charleroi. 

Like the Danish League from yesterday, the Belgian top flight splits for the later part of the season with the top clubs battling it out for the Champions League and Europa League places and the middle portion hoping to get into a play-off place for the Conference League. These 2 sides, after disappointing regular seasons, are in the later category. 

Genk, however, are leading the way in the battle to named 'best of the rest'. They were part of the Europa League this season and made it through to the round of 16, so there is some pedigree there. 

Their primary strength is scoring goals. They've managed 50 of them in 33 leagues games this season. Their primary weakness is conceding them. In the regular season, only bottom placed Dender had a worse defensive record than Genk. 

Their opponents Charleroi were on course to get into the top 6 and make the Champions League play-off group before a terrible run of form since February which has seen them win just once in 11 league matches. 

They've failed to keep a clean sheet in any of those matches and have had a player sent off in 4 of them! 

The previous match between these 2 sides finished 2-2 and on current form you'd expect there will be more goals today!

description.title: I'm Excited Living Purposefully, LOH #285.
description.body:
It's a lovely day, Ladies,

Welcome to my blog. Life is beautiful, life is attractive, life is good and life is a gift from the Almighty, the unseen God to all the living, to humanity,  to animals, birds, insects and trees. To every living things, seen and unseen.

**QUESTION TWO**
**Right now in your life, what feels like your main reason for living?**

 Thank you also @ladiesofhive for this week's prompt contest #285. 

My own main reasons or purposes for living are in subsections. One, finding my purpose in God and in his word. I have come to understand that God has allowed me to be alive to serve him as a child of God. 

I'm not perfect, but consciously finding myself at trying to obey or obeying God, being conscious that he watches me to know my actions, inactions and  motives. Yet, speaking, teaching me,  correcting me or even scolding me on daily basis is my number one purpose and joy for living now and in the hope for the future.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfECKupz9eDGH211PezfLKg9kvh1JUWAQbmq2HotU9yHx/1776751716636.jpg)

 I'm also awe that he watches over me and all that concerns me and he has been making ways of escaping dangers of life seen and unseen for me and all that pertains to me, is one among many purposes I'm living for today.

Voluntary soul winning has emanieted from the joy I have that God loves me and I'm obeying his word, it is a joy and a serious passion, a purpose for living now and in the future.

Another passion I have which is among the purposes for my living is having a heart of gratitude to God for where I am to day, because I know clearly where I am coming from in life generally. His mercies has changed my life totally, it's exciting and a motivation for me to keep  living.

Knowing that I have a positive future in God has given me a great chance to pursue my personal growth, learning everyday to achieve goals and my purpose for being alive. Becoming what I was admiring to be some years back is my backbone for living and it's among the amazing reasons why I'm happy to be alive.

**Life is full of choices, it will respond to you according to the choices you make daily, therefore, choose right so you can fulfill your destiny, your purpose and the abilities God has planted in you will both be seen, benefit you, benefit the entire universe and God will be happy to boast of whom you finally became at the end of times**

 Life didn't just started existing, it's owned by someone, the unseen God of Heaven and the earth.
He is the all wise God and has given the humans wisdom and those abilities that he is made up of. You can remember that in the beginning of life, he called out the Trinity....,

 **\

** for this reason, we are like God.

Everything under the earth has seasons and purposes for existence. Therefore, we all have purposes, talents, abilities, reasons why we are living and are still alive till date. Mind you, there's a reconning by the owner of our lives of all we do and are doing daily.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTP24X5S8rjA7iKdfaxFxyyBQutWT6YKJR2hCrsxiygV/1776752181015.jpg)

I would also love to begin by reminding us about a senerio in the Bible; 

**The parable of the Talents from the scriptures, Mathew 25v14-30**

 It was an illustration of the master and his servants. He was about traveling for a long journey and wanted his servants to be useful, not to be idle but to make profits in life, he gave them **Talents by his own discretion, according to each person's abilities in life. He encouraged them to trade with as many or even one talent to make some profits for him and for themselves before he returns. 

Some went into action, trading with their given talents and made huge profits but one among them went and dug the ground and buried his own, he never was mindful of it and never tried buying or selling with it. 

The master was very bitter as he came back. Others were returning with their capitals and profits while the idle servant only came before his master with only the very capital given to him which is himself, we are Gods capitals for trade on the earth. Nothing was added to it. The master was completely angry with him, never showed any other mercy and no other alternatives than casting him into the dungeon of everlasting suffering.

This Biblical illustrations and description is about life and purposes, talents, skills, ability of what and how we can live a purposeful and profitable lives here on the earth. 

Nobody was created empty, you are to find your purpose and begin to work on it or on them to the limelight and then fulfill it because the giver is recording our activities and how we have been using what he gave to us which is why we are still alive.

God is patiently waiting for us to align with his purpose for us which is why we are still alive, the earlier we find it and align, the better for us to live even longer. We are not the sole owner of our lives, God is. 

He has laid down guidelines and principles on how to live life to become fruitful and fulfilling for each and everyone of us. Because if everyone in this world has refused to find their purposes and fulfilling them, this world would have been a dull,  annoying and an uninteresting place,  all we see and enjoy in this life comes from people's purposes and talents, skills and abilities to be alive. 

They found them and are making use of them, we all are enjoying, so do not be that wicked servant that buried his own talent, his master was never happy with him.... There are days for recorning with God, the owner of this vineyard, ....The world in which we live in.

I especially thank you immensely, @merit.ahama. For this deeply well thought questions. These two questions are points of personal motivations to think about oneself on a personal level.

Thank you everyone, for staying with me, have a great day.

description.body: Bạn vừa lắp màn hình android ô tô xong, lái xe về nhà, mọi thứ hoạt động trơn tru. Nhưng một tuần sau, phần mềm bản đồ báo lỗi. Hai tháng sau, màn hình xe hơi đột ngột mất kết nối Bluetooth. Bạn gọi điện về nơi lắp và nhận được câu trả lời: \

Đó là lúc bạn nhận ra: mua màn hình ô tô không chỉ là mua sản phẩm. Bạn đang mua cả một cam kết dịch vụ lâu dài.

Tại AKauto Saigon, hậu mãi sau lắp không phải là \

đó là tiêu chuẩn tối thiểu chúng tôi tự đặt ra cho mình.

╰┈➤ **Tìm hiểu ngay:** <https://akauto.com.vn/man-hinh-o-to>

## **Tại sao hậu mãi quan trọng hơn bạn nghĩ khi lắp màn hình android xe hơi?**

Màn hình android xe hơi không giống một phụ kiện thông thường. Đây là thiết bị tích hợp trực tiếp vào hệ thống điện, hệ thống âm thanh và giao diện điều khiển trung tâm của xe. Mỗi lần cập nhật phần mềm, mỗi lần tích hợp thêm tính năng đều cần kỹ thuật viên am hiểu thực sự về dòng xe và thiết bị.

Thực tế là: màn hình android ô tô chạy trên nền tảng phần mềm liên tục được cập nhật. Bản đồ Vietmap thay đổi dữ liệu định kỳ. Ứng dụng kết nối điện thoại có thể cần cập nhật tương thích. Một số tính năng mới chỉ được mở khóa sau khi nâng cấp firmware. Nếu trung tâm lắp xong rồi \

bạn sẽ tự mình xoay sở với những vấn đề này.

Đó là lý do hậu mãi không phải điểm cộng đó là điểm bắt buộc.

![](https://i.imgur.com/jMXrlyX.jpeg)

## **Hỗ trợ cập nhật phần mềm màn hình ô tô không để bạn tự mày mò**

Nhiều khách hàng lắp màn hình xe ô tô ở nơi khác, sau đó tìm đến AKauto với câu hỏi: \

Câu trả lời thực ra không khó nếu có người hướng dẫn đúng cách. Nhưng nếu không có ai hỗ trợ, việc cập nhật sai firmware có thể làm treo máy, mất cài đặt gốc, thậm chí ảnh hưởng đến kết nối với hệ thống xe.

Tại AKauto Saigon, đội ngũ kỹ thuật sẵn sàng hỗ trợ bạn:

*   Cập nhật phần mềm định kỳ cho màn hình android xe hơi đúng phiên bản tương thích.

*   Nâng cấp bản đồ, ứng dụng dẫn đường theo yêu cầu.

*   Tư vấn và hỗ trợ từ xa qua điện thoại hoặc video call với các lỗi đơn giản.

*   Nhận xe xử lý trực tiếp tại trung tâm khi cần can thiệp kỹ thuật sâu hơn.

Bạn không cần là người hiểu công nghệ. Bạn chỉ cần một cuộc gọi.

## **Xử lý lỗi vặt sau lắp chuẩn chỉnh từ đầu, không để phát sinh phiền toái**

Một trung tâm lắp màn hình android ô tô tốt không chỉ lắp xong rồi giao xe. Họ kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng trước khi bạn lăn bánh.

Tại AKauto, quy trình lắp đặt màn hình ô tô luôn đi kèm bước kiểm tra toàn bộ chức năng: âm thanh, camera lùi, kết nối điện thoại, định vị GPS, cảm ứng màn hình, kết nối với các tính năng nguyên bản của xe. Mục tiêu là phát hiện và xử lý hết lỗi trước khi xe rời khỏi garage chứ không phải để khách hàng phát hiện lỗi trên đường.

Tuy nhiên, sau một thời gian sử dụng, vẫn có thể xuất hiện lỗi vặt do:

*   Cập nhật phần mềm không tương thích.

*   Thay đổi thiết bị kết nối (điện thoại mới, SIM mới).

*   Điều kiện thời tiết, nhiệt độ ảnh hưởng đến phần cứng.

Khi đó, AKauto xử lý nhanh không đùn đẩy, không tính phí ngoài phạm vi bảo hành.

╰┈➤ **Xem thêm:** <https://www.besport.com/post/52963098>

![](https://i.imgur.com/B9HEIbZ.jpeg)

## **Lắp màn hình ô tô không cắt dây, không mất bảo hành xe zin**

Đây là mối lo số một của hầu hết khách hàng khi tìm nơi lắp màn hình android cho ô tô. Và đây cũng là tiêu chuẩn đầu tiên bạn nên hỏi trước khi quyết định.

AKauto Saigon thi công theo phương pháp plug-and-play sử dụng giắc chuyển đổi chuyên dụng theo từng dòng xe, không cắt dây điện gốc, không can thiệp cấu trúc xe. Điều này có nghĩa là:

*   Bảo hành hãng xe của bạn không bị ảnh hưởng.

*   Nếu cần, màn hình có thể tháo ra và hoàn nguyên về trạng thái zin hoàn toàn.

*   Hệ thống điện không bị xâm phạm, an toàn cho xe lâu dài.

Đây không phải lời hứa marketing. Đây là quy trình kỹ thuật bắt buộc với mọi ca lắp đặt tại trung tâm.

## **Nâng cấp tính năng màn hình xe hơi - Thiết bị cũ, trải nghiệm mới**

Một trong những điều thú vị của màn hình android ô tô là: thiết bị không thay đổi, nhưng trải nghiệm có thể tốt hơn theo thời gian nếu được nâng cấp đúng cách.

AKauto hỗ trợ khách hàng nâng cấp tính năng sau lắp, bao gồm:

*   Thêm ứng dụng, cấu hình giao diện theo nhu cầu sử dụng.

*   Tích hợp camera 360 độ, cảm biến áp suất lốp vào màn hình hiện có.

*   Nâng cấp bộ nhớ hoặc ROM cho một số dòng màn hình hỗ trợ.

*   Cấu hình lại các tính năng kết nối CarPlay, Android Auto khi cần.

Thay vì mua thiết bị mới, đôi khi một lần nâng cấp đúng chỗ là đủ để màn hình xe ô tô của bạn vận hành như thiết bị vừa xuất xưởng.

## **Minh bạch giá, rõ cấu hình không mập mờ khi lắp màn hình android ô tô**

Trước khi lắp, bạn cần biết chính xác mình đang lắp cái gì. Không phải tên thương hiệu chung chung, mà là:

*   Dòng màn hình cụ thể: Teyes, Zestech, Safeview, Utour, Elliview, Bravigo, Fly…

*   Cấu hình phần cứng: RAM, ROM, chip xử lý, kích thước màn hình.

*   Tính năng đi kèm: CarPlay, Android Auto, SIM 4G, DSP âm thanh…

*   Giá niêm yết rõ ràng, không phát sinh chi phí ẩn.

AKauto Saigon không báo giá theo kiểu \

. Mỗi dòng màn hình android xe hơi đều có báo giá chi tiết, khách hàng được xem trực tiếp sản phẩm và test thử trước khi quyết định. Bạn biết mình đang trả tiền cho cái gì và bạn nhận đúng cái đó.

╰┈➤ **Tìm hiểu thêm:** <https://www.dailymotion.com/video/xa5eavc>

![](https://i.imgur.com/KgzJZAU.jpeg)

## **Tư vấn đúng nhu cầu không bán ép, không bán thừa**

Không phải chiếc xe nào cũng cần màn hình cấu hình cao nhất. Không phải người dùng nào cũng cần tất cả tính năng.

Đội ngũ tư vấn tại AKauto sẽ hỏi bạn thực sự dùng xe vào mục đích gì đi làm hàng ngày, đi phượt cuối tuần, hay chạy dịch vụ công nghệ. Từ đó mới gợi ý màn hình xe ô tô phù hợp theo dòng xe, nhu cầu thực tế và ngân sách. Không gợi ý thêm tính năng không cần thiết, không đẩy lên sản phẩm cao cấp hơn nếu sản phẩm tầm trung đã đáp ứng đủ.

Điều này có vẻ hiển nhiên nhưng lại là điều nhiều trung tâm không làm được.

## **Bảo hành rõ ràng, hỗ trợ kỹ thuật lâu dài**

Cam kết bảo hành tại AKauto Saigon:

*   Bảo hành thiết bị theo chính sách hãng, có giấy tờ rõ ràng.

*   Bảo hành công lắp đặt riêng, xử lý miễn phí các lỗi phát sinh do kỹ thuật.

*   Hỗ trợ kỹ thuật qua hotline 0903 939 683 trong suốt thời gian bảo hành.

*   Không đùn đẩy giữa hãng và trung tâm, AKauto chịu trách nhiệm đầu mối xử lý cho bạn.

Bạn không cần tự đi tìm hãng để khiếu nại. AKauto làm điều đó thay bạn.

Lắp màn hình android ô tô là một quyết định đáng đầu tư nhưng chỉ thực sự xứng đáng khi bạn được đồng hành đúng cách sau khi lắp. Không phải chỉ trong tuần đầu, mà trong suốt quá trình sử dụng. AKauto Saigon xây dựng thương hiệu trên nền tảng đó tận tâm, uy tín, chuyên nghiệp và giữ cam kết đó với từng khách hàng, từng chiếc xe. description.title: Я просто мама
description.body:
![1000146019.jpg](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776752145411-a32e94b5ed627e2d.webp)

Я просто мама и я просто живу.
А почему-то не хочется просто.
А хочется для других светом быть,
И гореть, чтоб не гаснуть хворостом.

Так жить ,чтоб не только все мысли 
В  работе, в  семье и делах.
Успевать почитать Слово Божье,
А не только бежать впопыхах.

![1000146025.jpg](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776752387093-c7413415795c0863.webp)

Чтобы Духом Святым горела
И конечно согревала других,
Чтобы остался след на земле,
А не  пепел от  слов моих.

Чтобы люди могли через годы
Неожиданно вспомнить мой стих.
Кто свой опыт , мечты и веру
оставил с любовью для них.

![1000146028.jpg](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776752483286-adb01dfa3d5272f6.webp)

Может опыт окажет поддержку,
А мечта вновь подарит надежду.
Вера в Бога поднимет крылья,
Хоть душа болит от бессилия.

Просто жить, нет,это так просто.
Просто петь для себя, это запросто,
А вот жить для других и делиться мечтою,
Дарить радость и просто служить искрою,

![1000146022.jpg](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776752225755-8ea1db0e20966043.webp)

Зажигать потухшие сердца,
Наполнять любовью Господа Отца.
Да , это громко и трудно.
Может страшно,
а кто-то пусть скажет, глупо.

Ну ,а я так хочу наслаждаться плодами своих дел всем другим раздавая.
Угощая от сердца и всей души,
Напоить всех живою водою в тиши.

Чтоб в саду моём от дневного зноя,
Свои двери души приоткроя,
Путники отдыхали,
Пребывая в  Божьем покое.

![1000146031.jpg](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776752559396-1c2182bcd885716b.webp)

Я просто мама и я просто живу.
А почему-то не хочется просто.
А хочется для других светом быть,
И гореть, чтоб не гаснуть хворостом.

Я просто мама и я просто живу.
А почему-то не хочется просто.

description.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776751931932-a941927af8985203.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dmann/70718ddb)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dmann/70718ddb)


---

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well by the grace of Allah Almighty and are healthy with all your family members. I am also doing well with all your family members due to your prayers. However, our situation is a little bit bad due to the extreme heat because we do not have electricity here, due to the continuous wars and the flow of the world. However, overall, by the grace of Allah Almighty, I am doing well. For this, I am expressing my gratitude to Allah Almighty, Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCjMJqby441CjzwSCzcYRoYbHxjs57P69eHEWRp2uEhv/1776750663015.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYGS1Eo3YSJDfqZ6S91kS5zhvMbReqrkvG7dChrSE66Nw/1776750663191.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXStUhApKPLoeapwgK6GBpP1qWZUSnxRNmtnBneQ63vF7/1776750663278.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKuhCvKghcJCkxv1s8P9FqvSX9RpPkBU72VjxDF7F2Md/1776750663376.jpg)

Friends, today I have come up with a new video for you. The video is a video of sugarcane juice. Here I am trying to show you that a machine is needed to make sugarcane juice. With the help of this machine, sugarcane juice is made beautifully. It is a very beautiful and nutritious food to eat. Because in this summer, sugarcane juice is a very beneficial drink for our body. Everyone loves to drink juice. And the sugarcane juice made at the same time is very tasty to eat. And here is what I am trying to show you through the video.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAK1xG2QsNdSueZDEwzmp4yP3QjzYX2iMDcU2ubkDaux/1776750678332.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZTXoqFZq1dcvKiRdLo2NoLEBatFeSxKYBjrorzKYK7sx/1776750678524.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvS4UEBkh8LkVkLLbNfERETRydu1yKuixYkuPwLiUwNm/1776750678722.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdf1aEdmUREb2o4s47iPgNFWbPbJBony4ct4mqjjwcQ3/1776750678844.jpg)

Friends, here you can see many sugarcane jars arranged in a pile, that is, sugarcane juice is prepared here according to the customer's demand. The price of each glass of sugarcane juice is 20 taka and the price of a bottle is 40 taka, that is, if someone wants to take it home, there is also a system here, but the price of each bottle ranges from 20 taka to 40 taka, and some people are drinking this juice sitting here, while others are taking it home to eat with their family. Friends, for each glass of sugarcane, but one sugarcane piece is needed, and if this mixture is first inserted into the sugarcane girl, the sugarcane juice comes out from the front and comes out from the back.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2yCZcjuc4Y7vdXzhddpeLqUGjNuCSiXHdcGUff96MzN/1776750714451.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU3j65p5GXrxy4d7W1Z9WgLXyxcvC1xzAdyeUreMMAdRk/1776750714576.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdp74AgDNaeqxRnqMiuyx5jnJCEP3XmzGdwBGrYCRZ21E/1776750714728.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUXrddGNSmRtf7C1wqEDZk8FVSmxSe93eSvhitWDPytd/1776750714829.jpg)

Friends, the leftover part of sugarcane, i.e. the husk, cannot be thrown away completely because it is used as our fuel. For those of us who cook in clay ovens, this sugarcane husk is a very beautiful material that burns easily when put in the fire and it is a very easy and very simple method of cooking. On the one hand, sugarcane juice satisfies the various needs of our body, on the other hand, we use the husks of sugarcane in cooking. In other words, it is another popular food for every person in our country. Earlier, sugarcane was cultivated in large quantities in our country, but nowadays it is almost on the verge of extinction. However, we should go back to that previous era to make this sugarcane juice and sugarcane curd. That is, we have to start sugarcane cultivation again.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvS4UEBkh8LkVkLLbNfERETRydu1yKuixYkuPwLiUwNm/1776750730141.jpg)

description.title: A Magical Evening at Plazuela de Iloilo: Cute Cartoon Characters
description.body: /> It was a lovely evening. 🌛 We went for a walk at Plazuela de Iloilo. We love going there at night because it is cool and the air is fresh. It is much better than walking under the hot sun during the daytime ☀️ 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 As we walked, we saw many beautiful lights. The whole place felt bright and happy. My favorite part was seeing the cute statues of famous characters. There were Disney Princesses. We saw Snow White and Ariel looking very pretty. 🥰
/> The Frozen Characters. Elsa, Anna, and Olaf were there to greet us as well 😄
/> The Incredibles 😃 The whole superhero family stood together on the grass. 💪
/>\n\nMinions and Pokemon 😍 we even saw the yellow Minions and a happy Pikachu with Meowth 💛

/> The statues are so colorful. They make the place feel like a theme park. I saw kids happily pointing at them. They really enjoyed it. * * * At the front portion of the Plazuela is a big, beautiful fountain. There are also tall pillars and pretty designs everywhere. I love the yellow lights. It's giving the place a unique evening glow. 🌟

/> If you get tired, there are many benches where you can sit down. We sat for a while and listened to a live band playing music. It was very relaxing. There are also many restaurants nearby if you get hungry. It was a great night. If we want a fun and easy walk, we can just visit here again. 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕 🧡 🌕

description.title: Ja so ist das zuweilen... Ich komme auf den geschuetzen Wohnungsmarkt. Und bin darueber Heilfroh.
description.body:
Weil ich dann nicht einfach in einer Einrichtung lande, sondern, ein halbwegs normales Leben weiterfuehren kann. 

Mein Betreuer und ich verstehen uns sehr Gut. Ich habe ihn ja Gestern erst kennen lernen duerfen.

Das Gespraech war Konstruktiv und Angenehm.

Wir haben die dann wirklich vielen Aufgaben um mich herum, aufgeteilt und bearbeiten jetzt im Eiltempo den Papier und Aemterkram.

Da ist alles dran und drin dabei, was eben von mir auch ein bisschen weggeschoben wurde, wie mein Behindertenausweis zum Beispiel.

Wer will schon einen Behindertenausweis? Ich brauche einen, fuer meinen Weg.

Ganz Banale Sachen fallen einem dann auch auf, wie das der normale Ausweis abgelaufen ist, wenn man sich ein Sozialticket kaufen moechte, fuer die Fahrerei, die jetzt fuer mich massenhaft ansteht.

Ich hatte dann alleine die Woche drei Termine, wenn sie rum ist.

Plus die unterminierten Dinge wie die Raeumungsklage, meine erste Raeumungsklage im Leben, als Abschiedsgeschenk von hier zu bearbeiten.

Da stehen so freche und haltlose Vorwuerfe drin, inklusive selbstbelastung der Gegenseite, das man sich nur an den Kopf langen kann.

Zum ersten mal bin ich Froh, das es Gesetze und Regeln gibt, die da fuer mich sprechen, einfach, weil ich Ehrlich bin. So viel Bloedsinn kann man sich naemlich nicht ausdenken, denkt man.

Aber das kommt eben davon, wenn man immer alle andere alles machen laesst.^^ Also nicht ich. Nichtmal jetzt, wo ich wirklich Verholfen werden muss, damit ich nicht voellig einbreche.

Es hat hart Gezerrt und Gejuckt bisher, wie ich hier dastehe. 

Ich wuerde meinen schlechten Ruf verlieren, wenn ich mich nicht zur Wehr setze.

Alles ist auf Eis gelegt, da wiederhole ich mich, das aergert mich am meisten. Ich kann nix Arbeiten, garnix, da kriege ich keine ruhige Minute im Kopf zusammen und bin Froh ueberhaupt irgendwie abschalten zu koennen in der Zwischenzeit.

Ich glaube das ich noch nie so lange fuer irgendwas gebraucht habe und schon garnicht fuer einen Aus, oder Umzug, aber wenn man mir ans Bein pisst, werde ich halt auch zum Arsch und kenne meine Rechte und Pflichten.

Finanziell wird das auch kein Zuckerschlecken, habe ich gerade massiv Kosten an allen Ecken und Enden, die ich sonst nicht gehabt haette.

Der ganze Druck mit dem Theater was jetzt folgt und ja schon im Gange ist, weil ich habe viel hin und her gehabt die letzten Tage, ist auch nicht so einfach, aber da beiße ich mich einfach durch.

Ich mach mein Zeug, irgendwie, dann ja doch. Bin halbwegs zuverlaessig, auch wenns andere zu Recht gerade nicht so sehen, und halte mich daran was man ausmacht.

Deswegen habe ich ueberhaupt erst eine Chance, da auf dem geschuetzem Berliner Wohnungsmarkt zu landen. Weil auf dem normalem Wohnungsmarkt, da wischt man sich die Augen, ist das einfach nicht moeglich fuer jemanden wie mich in der Lage. Da koennte ich der chilligste Mieter der Welt sein, wenn die Kohl vorne und hinten nicht ausreicht fuer die Preise hier.

Aber ich mag nicht in Berlin bleiben, weil es hier so schoen Edel ist in den Palaesten, sondern weil ich mich hier sehr Wohl fuehle mit den Menschen und ich auch einigermaßen viel Kontakte habe und weiterfueheren moechte, was sich sowieso anbietet, einfach hier auch keine Probleme zu bekommen, das mir die Decke auf den Kopf faellt, wenn ich \

bin hier.

Dann gehe ich einfach raus ins Leben. Außerdem bin ich ja jetzt schonmal hier, also warum nicht auch Bleiben.^^

Vielleicht finde ich sogar etwas das ich Machen kann, um mir ein Zubrot zu verdienen.

Das war ja naemlich der eigentliche Plan fuer mich. Auch seitens Jobcenter und so, das man mich hier bei jemandem einfindet, der so einen verrueckten Kopf gebrauchen kann. Das ist alles auch auf Eis gelegt und das Stinkt mir WIRKLICH HART.

Weil ich ja Bewerbungen geschrieben habe und mich bemueht habe das schoen zu Lernen auch weiter.

Das ich nix Arbeite und vor allem Programmieren kann, ist Uebel. Ich habe nich mehr lange bis zur Deadline fuer XBTGPUARC und will meine Gemeinschaft eigentlich nicht noch laenger warten lassen. Auch hier euch Hiveians will ich wieder normal nerven.

Und treffen will ich auch wieder mitmachen. Aber das ist mir derzeit nicht Denkbar.

Glueck im Unglueck, und Unspannend ist es nicht. Ich stehe mit leeren Haenden hier. Habe ja alles zurueckgelassen was ich hatte. Der ein oder andere weis vielleicht wie schnukelig das ausgesehen hat damals bei mir. Ich habs gemocht, jetzt, habe ich nur meine sieben Sachen...

Naja wenigstens, wird es schoen endlich und warm und alles. Aber mein Eis war ich auch noch net essen. Ich glaube ich mach es am Eisessen fest, wanns wirklich wieder aufwaehrts geht, das Fehlt mir. Beides.

Uber den Damm bin ich aber, also den schlimmsten Punkt, habe ich gestern Abend beschlossen, habe ich hinter mir, die Aengste vor der Zukunft und was jetzt wie Moeglich ist und was nicht.

Das war das schlimmste, das Warten und nicht Wissen was los ist.

Nun habe ich einen dicken Plan. Wieder mal unnoetige Bewegung im Leben, aber das kommt davon, wenn man zu allem Ja und Amen sagt, wo man eigentlich denkt. Willst Du mich Verarschen?^^

Salve

Sascha aka Alucian.

description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTVQhXuTXWVtrGNJngFbX8xHkojdBvLGJGmEBb51QcXvu/img_1635.jpg)

Hello everyone, I hope you all are fine. I am here to show you some photographs that I took today.

In our school it was a fascinating day, because exams are going on and students are worried, nervous and excited, because this is one end of their chapter as they will be moving to the next.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYase7LEibxYbNTN5Voysnf1popQdf7vctVLBLrmvbeHp/img_1636.jpg)

So amid this nervousness and excitement, I took a break from everything and went to take photographs of some flowers. Flowers are some really majestic creatures. They are so colourful, so delightful and evergreen that they always amaze me, and I am always mesmerised by their charming charisma, their colours, their freshness and their fragrance. Everything about them is just so amazing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZXGgi6u1d4LueH1E1KNQzm2LJ89gb3N9uni7YsuZVPb/img_1632.jpg)

So I am trying to fill in with all of you. I am trying to learn from all of you. I am trying to be a part of this community through my photography skills, through my understanding of nature, through my efforts.

So these are some photographs. I hope you will like them. I hope you will show some love to these photographs, to these flowers. I believe flowers are the representation of nature, and I am eager to know your thoughts on flowers, on nature, on excitement, on nervousness, on moving to the next part of the story.

description.body:

Hi bloggers and food lovers! How are you all today? Do you like bananas, chocolate, and cheese? Or do you like all three? Let’s combine them all and turn them into a sweet and delicious snack. Okay, let’s get right to it and make these banana choco cheese rice papers—crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside, and oozing with melted mozzarella and chocolate.

- mozzarella cheese
- chocolate bar

description.title: THE LAST MANGO
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdY51mTAMERmGvvqm27yqeJb7PfkahxUnpGMiqdE6ar9M/img_20250702_wa0007.jpg)


Tayo and Femi Adebayo had shared everything since childhood — a room, clothes, punishments from Mama, and even the scar on their left knees from falling off the mango tree behind their house in Surulere. 

Tayo was two years older. Quieter, the one who fixed things. Femi was all laugh and noise, the one who broke them. When their father died in 2019, Tayo dropped out of UNILAG to run the generator repair shop. Femi stayed in school, studying computer science, but every evening he came to the shop to help.

Ada walked in one Tuesday in March. Rain was beating the zinc roof like drums. She had a small red iPhone and a power bank that wouldn’t charge. 

“Abeg, you fit help me? My final project defense na tomorrow.”

Femi got to her first. He was always first with words. He made her laugh while Tayo opened the power bank in the back. Tayo found the fault in ten minutes. Didn’t say much, just handed it back working and told her to avoid fake follow-come chargers.

She came back the next week. And the next. Sometimes her phone was fine. She’d buy plantain chips from Mama’s kiosk and sit on the old generator while Femi argued about football and Tayo worked.

It happened slow. The kind of slow you don’t notice until you’re already in it.

Femi fell first, or at least he said it first. One night over beer and suya at Obalende, he told Tayo: “Bro, I think I love her. I want to ask her out proper.”

Tayo’s hand stopped halfway to his mouth. He’d been planning to walk Ada home that Friday. He’d ironed his good shirt. He hadn’t told anyone, not even himself, that the way she tucked her hair when she was troubleshooting code made his chest tight.

He swallowed. Nodded. “She’s a good girl. Do it.”

Femi asked her Saturday. She said yes. Tayo drove them to the cinema that night and waited outside in the Corolla, listening to the engine tick as it cooled.

For three months Tayo became an expert at leaving rooms. At finding faults in generators that weren’t there. At saying “you two go ahead” when Ada asked him to join them for lunch.

Then came the night in July. NEPA took light and the shop was stifling. Femi had gone to buy fuel. Ada was waiting, laptop open, using the shop’s small inverter. Rain started again.

Tayo was teaching her how to solder a wire when the light from the inverter caught her face. She looked up at him, and something in the air changed. It was half a second. Maybe less. But it was there.

“I’m sorry,” she whispered.

“Don’t,” Tayo said. “He’s my brother.”

Femi came back five minutes later, shaking water from his hair, and the moment was gone.

But Femi wasn’t stupid. He saw it. In the way Ada went quiet when Tayo was around. In the way Tayo stopped coming home for dinner when she was there.

The fight happened in September, under the same mango tree that gave them their matching scars. No shouting. That wasn’t them.

“You love her too,” Femi said. It wasn’t a question.

Tayo didn’t deny it. “It doesn’t matter.”

“It does to me.” Femi kicked at a mango. “I saw your face that night. And I saw hers.”

“So what?” Tayo’s voice cracked. “You want me to fight you for her? She chose you.”

“Did she?” Femi looked at him. “Or did she choose the brother who asked first?”

Neither of them had an answer.

Ada found them there. She’d been calling both of them. She stood in the rain, no umbrella.

“I can’t,” she said before either of them spoke. “I won’t be the reason you two stop being brothers. I watched my uncles do that over a woman. They haven’t spoken in 20 years. I won’t do that to you.”

Tayo started to protest. Femi did too. She held up her hand.

“I love you, Femi. I do. And Tayo... you’re the kind of man my father told me to find. But if being with me means you lose each other, then I’m too expensive. Some things cost more than they’re worth.”

She left them under the tree. Didn’t look back.

For a month the shop was quiet. Femi stopped coming after school. Tayo worked late. Mama asked what happened to “that fine girl” and neither answered.

It was Femi who broke first. He showed up one Wednesday with two bottles of Maltina and sat on the old generator.

“Shop looks empty without her yelling about Man U,” he said.

Tayo snorted. “You mean without you yelling about Man U and her correcting you.”

They didn’t talk about Ada. Not that day. But Femi came back Thursday. And Friday.

It took a year. Sometimes Tayo would see Ada’s name pop up on Femi’s phone and his stomach would still drop. Sometimes he caught Femi staring at the empty chair she used to sit in. 

They never saw her again. Heard she got a job in Abuja, then Canada. 

Two years later, Tayo was getting married. His wife, Kemi, was Mama’s friend’s daughter. Good woman. Loud laugh. She made Tayo laugh too.

At the reception, Femi stood up to give the best man speech. He raised his glass.

“To my brother,” he said, looking at Tayo. “For teaching me that some things are stronger than love. And that the best way to keep a person is to let them go.”

Later that night, after everyone left, they sat behind the shop under the mango tree. Same tree. New scars.

“You think she’s happy?” Tayo asked.

Femi was quiet for a long time. “I think we are,” he said finally. “And I think she’d want that.”

Tayo nodded. He picked up a mango from the ground and split it with his hands. Gave half to Femi.

They ate in silence. Brothers. 

Some loves don’t end because they weren’t real. They end because something else was more real. And sometimes, that’s the only way the story stays whole.

description.title: My Marriage My Choice
description.body:
Someone once told me she envies my marriage because my husband and I don’t fight. She said she has never seen us argue, never heard us raise our voices, never watched me run to family members to report him, or call friends to analyze our issues. To her, everything looked calm, smooth, almost perfect.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3AcVwms81mR74mUmdvHzrLGo9NsQQmUwQq3prjT9kXj/1776751436153.jpg)


[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/love-my-love-love-carrot-2666677/)

I just looked at her with that expression that says, “you must be kidding me.” Who told you we don’t fight? We do. In fact, sometimes it feels like we disagree every single day. The difference is not the absence of conflict, the difference is how we choose to handle it.

I made a personal decision a long time ago that I will not carry my marital issues outside the walls of my home. Not because I don’t have people I trust, but because I understand something very important, no matter how fair people try to be, there is always bias. Even the ones who love you deeply can take sides without realizing it. I experienced that early enough to know better.

Let’s be honest. If I come to you with a story about my husband, I will most likely present my side in a way that favors me. I will highlight his mistakes and quietly skip over mine. And based on that one-sided version, you will form an opinion. You might even start seeing him as the problem. But is that the full truth? No.

Now flip it. If he tells you his own version, he will do the exact same thing, focus on where I went wrong and leave out his own faults. And just like that, I become the one to blame. That is how easily narratives are shaped when outsiders get involved.

So tell me, who really has the right to judge a situation they don’t fully understand? Who made anyone the authority over another person’s marriage?

Because of this, I choose to handle my issues privately. I would rather sit down, argue, misunderstand each other, and still find a way to resolve things together than invite unnecessary voices into something that is deeply personal. What works for my home may not make sense to you, and what works for you may not work for me.

I’m not saying advice is always bad, but unsolicited opinions on sensitive matters rarely help. Most times, they complicate things. They introduce perspectives that don’t align with our reality.

Marriage is not a public performance. It’s not something to be judged from the outside based on appearances. What you see is only a small part of a much bigger picture. So please, respect boundaries. This is my home, my marriage, and my choice. Let me handle it in the way that works best for us.

This is my reply to someone who says my marriage is perfect, is there really a perfect marriage? There might be but I've never seen it before. Issue will arise even if it is just minor but there is no relationship without arguments.





**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

description.body:
![IMG_8351.jpeg](UPLOAD FAILED)



일반 직장인들에게는 평일 연차가 참 달콤하다.
근데 병원이나 특별한 볼 일이 없지 않는 한은 쉽사리 내기 힘든 평일 연차.
그래서 낮시간에 카페에 앉아 여유로운 시간을 보내는 것은 참으로 꿈같은 일인 것 같다.

어쩌다 평일에 돌아다니다보면 길거리에 사람들이 생각보다 많아서 놀란다.
일반 직장인의 상식으로, 이 시간은 사무실에 앉아있어야할 시간.

카페에서는 더더욱 놀란다.
어떻게 이렇게 사람이 많지?

오늘도 그러하다.
연세가 있으신 노부부, 마주 앉아 수다를 떠시거나 태블릿으로 낱발맞추기 게임을 하신다.
자녀와 함께하는 가족, 평일에 시간이 맞아 함께하나보다.
일부 모임하는 사람들, 업무 미팅? 동호회?
물론 홀로 구석에 앉아 책이나 태블릿으로 공부하는 1인 카공족이 젤 많긴 하다.

무튼 좀처럼 같기 힘든 이런 카공족 흉내 내는 이런 시간, 좋으다!

세상은 넓고, 다양한 직업을 가진 많은 사람들이 살아간다.

26년 4월 21일 화요일

body.title: Hive Philippines Street Photography #1141 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1141 - Street Scenes in Vivid Colors for Tuesday. 

Happy Tuesday my Hive family! Your presence here makes a difference. May your Tuesday be filled with good health and plenty of reasons to be happy. Keep buzzing with energy and enjoy every moment of this beautiful day😉. 

Now for our daily shots, here's a shot a Hilltop Street in the marketplace of Baguio city. The road is uphill and usually a route for people and vehicles alike. We could see a crowd of people trailing all the time. Facemasks were still a thing back then and is still now also because pollution here in the metropolitan but not in Baguio City. 
![1000017831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvVvxMXxU3seDHxqc9y5xjcekMyQwfmcQTx4LpfEFPFVWSQ5E3EKGMzhSnCQbfB913e.jpg)

Here's another bigger crowd on another part of Hilltop street in the market area of Baguio city. Lol like there is a zombie apocalypse or something eh 😂🤣. But no joke aside, it's during the holidays season when every households need something to prepare. What amazes me is that there's larger numbers of male shoppers compared to women. 
![1000017854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvVWr96UTmFE82Gzjzq29pPpedE5XwCRP575X6H4dRYZpotePPQZfpqKx127M3p9cqf.jpg)

Here's something different, a lone woman standing and holding her phone by the side of a building wall. Thai scene was at Catantes Street. The lady was also carrying an ecobag so she must have been to the market also. 
![1000017813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wMUHBzeLyNQ58c5os8MpBWR1o6AEPruNriHwD52M9ACHuqMGwP8yKgxPfcouaDNUM2H.jpg)

The famous stair case in Session road where most of the tourists come and take photos with the street signage. This is also a spot for street performers to station and perform their acts. Always a busy crowd here all the time. 
![1000017887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23w2guYz9fooV3Dw1an76hNnBCdCiyAqQZNxejAZj1TPU3zq5CD3pSuUnRPjLwrqTAVzN.jpg)

Follow me on my street travels.
Shot taken in Baguio City, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Panasonic Lumix ZS110. ~rex</center>

Freewriting is a great way to start or maintain a writing habit. And we've been making it easy for you with a daily prompt for over 3000 days!

And, as an added bonus, we are continuing to award **three freewriters a Hive SBI share every single day**!
<center>![giveaway.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJoLtsVsugdVrTuJ5x7bFSQywMHn9X8XiTcDB748kRJdDaiJHvbSAZ6bAHMVj3j.gif)</center>

Every day **three** of the best daily freewrites will be awarded **one** HiveSBI share. 
<sub>Not sure what Hive SBI is? [Find out more here](https://docs.hivesbi.com/)</sub>

What are you waiting for?



# <center>Today's #DailyPrompt is</center>

# <center>licence to do something</center>

...

How to freewrite...

- Set your timer for 5 minutes
- Start writing
- Use the hashtag #freewrite #dailyprompt
- Publish your piece (include a link to this post if you wish)
- Copy and paste your URL into the comment section of **this post**.
<sup>Or, if you don't want to publish your freewrite, just copy and paste as a comment under the prompt post.</sup>
- What if you want to write for longer than five minutes? No problem! There are no rules... 

except...

# Writing help

- A free app: Grammarly. A lot of us are not native English speakers and I am finding it a helpful app. It will underline spelling and grammar mistakes. Remember that it is not always right -especially if you use complex sentence structures. [Here is the link](https://app.grammarly.com/)
- Remember [The Most Dangerous Writing App](https://www.squibler.io/dangerous-writing-prompt-app). You set the time - 5 min - and start typing. Don’t stop!!! It will destroy what you wrote if you stop for more than 3 seconds - and backspace does not count as writing on the app. If you are prone to stop and think - this app forces you to keep going. You can make corrections after the 5 minutes are over.
- A timer. Egg timer is a free tool you can use on your desktop to set a time. This is useful for our freewrites or if you want to work in blocks of time and then take a break. [Here is the link](https://e.ggtimer.com/)

body.title: My Mother's Wedding (2023) || Movie Review
body.body:
![1000104158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/24246X69atW2ph7uqwBpqe9NBz8abLLjsTbV55wTFXF6yq6tH9wWnjRXvvyGYB2EwQccu.jpg)
I think most people would agree that family relationships are among the most complex, yet also the most rewarding for those who are fortunate to be surrounded by understanding people. **My Mother's Wedding (2023)** is an interesting film that centers around family and all the dramas that come with it. The title got my interest and also, seeing that Scarlett Johansson is one of the lead actresses in the movie made me decide to watch it. Directed by Kristin Scott Thomas and based on a screenplay by John Micklethwait, this movie stars Scarlett Johansson, Sienna Miller, Emily Beecham, Freida Pinto and others. It focuses on three sisters living their separate lives who must return home for their mother's third wedding. She's been married twice and widowed. Katherine (Scarlett Johansson), a Royal Navy captain, is reluctant to attend the wedding because she can't get the memory of her late father out of her mind. She keeps insisting that her mother doesn't take her new husband's last name. ![1000104152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EokcDQk5N7VnRbVtP4pJeH6A5vCJbyy1HsEzbNu2uhsCLA6S34fSYTemvgah4R2AtkP.jpg) ![1000104151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoCgG9YHJAVJfvmKW7NK6a29NjfNcgm7ZCdm2NwKpyFuoLB7wp5y5iZxsVoXR9Hsvct.jpg) The eldest sister, Victoria (Sienna Miller), is a successful movie star, vivacious and happy for their mother. She's been married before and divorced and sees nothing wrong with their mother's decision. The youngest sister, Georgina (Emily Beecham), is a nurse and in support of the wedding but her attention is more on whether her husband is cheating or not. She hires a detective to handle it. ![1000104154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoAZK4JRFtnhsqio79UZ7NjnLEdkmeg4bCA37vw2WjAUsRCiSws2NF467wECTiSeieN.jpg) ![1000104156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoErU4jXw8MmwduXHsAtVhYhG6hrygmrnGr3CVk9Ga7jpd1auUZrHpgFpmFSHHwjN11.jpg) The mother's wedding forces the sisters to confront their idealised image of the fathers they lost and how it has affected their adult relationships. Will their mother go ahead with the wedding despite the reservations of Katherine? #### My Review And Rating This movie didn't turn out the way I expected. I hoped it would be more gripping, instead the slow pace and storytelling made it feel like a bit of a drag. Though labeled a comedy drama, I didn't really see much of the comedy in this movie. It concentrates on the three daughters, memories of their late fathers and whether or not they are in support of their mother's wedding. So I'd say the plot is fine: a familiar family drama that some viewers may relate to but nothing remarkable. ![1000104155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoK4KyrLrDEFLqQxqe98K7RyW84uRHfCPDen1nR5oPoFjQdLvtn7gYF8Wp4eNRDgjy5.jpg) ![1000104153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoiTryhPsY3pDzAkkoYmsfnzXSbvYTPtNu8VBoqKR8jjHv5xLQM1xQrckB9VYPauo9z.jpg) The drama however is very present in almost every scene. The movie focuses on the physical and emotional effects of the wedding on the daughters and whether the mother realises these or not. The cartoonish scenes that act as Katherine's flashbacks are a fine touch to the story. It gives viewers an insight into Katherine's mind and the things she's dealing with. For the other sisters, their confrontations and outbursts are the clues that tells us they are struggling too. ![1000104157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoiUoM1Fs4uT1wVGArFpBhehauEz7bYdFkivy9vUpLoZ8vLtSnWNBXdqg9Cn1K1DX2c.jpg) I like that the director gave each of the daughters an equally decent amount of screen time. The focus was on their emotions and the effects on their relationships, family and romantic. There are some subplots like the detective hired to investigate Georgina's husband that I feel distracts us from the central theme of the movie. It overshadows some parts of the main plot that I think the director should have explored. The sisters' have troubled relationships but the movie doesn't shine much light on these relationships and whether they would be resolved. The acting is convincing. Scarlett Johansson and Sienna Miller are audacious actresses and they embodied their roles very well. The three sisters have great chemistry as siblings and their relationship with their mother is interesting to watch. Also, the cinematography is good. The visuals are colourful and okay. Rating this movie, I’d give it 3 stars out of 5 mostly because of the acting. The plot is fine but I think the screenplay might be the reason for the drag or slow pace. I understand this is Kristin Scott Thomas’ directorial debut but the movie doesn't quite hit like I’d hoped. If you have seen this movie, let me know your thoughts. https://youtu.be/tdhh-2iW_n8?si=7IM2gj-Slc1tsh8- ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All the images above are screenshots from the movie* *[Poster image source](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/My_Mother_s_Wedding-833320215-large.jpg)* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《欢迎来到暗黑童话世界》（张晋宜x常斌）PART 2
body.body:
![IMG_5186](https://s1.img-e.com/20260323/69c0e371aaf2e.jpeg)

第一个故事源自《美人鱼》改编，作者很好的同感情骗子结合到一起。童话中的小美人鱼为了爱人自断鱼尾换成双腿，全然不顾亲友的劝阻也要上岸去找心爱的王子。

小美人鱼上岸后发现王子已经有了婚约对象，那些海誓山盟不过是过眼云烟，最后价值被利用殆尽的她失望回到海洋变成泡沫。现实中的案例呢，却比童话还要残忍百倍。

这个副本里的男性玩家代表的是一类感情骗子，他们觉得被「爱情滋养，被汹涌的爱意灌注过的」大脑是最顶级的“甜品”。副本中指的是吃掉脑子，现实中联想到PUA。


这里女主有句台词，她提到了「异食癖」。关于这个我有个更大胆的联想，就是这些男性除了欺骗PUA女性可能还会涉及到谋杀和食用受害者器官的嫌疑，简直背脊发凉。

这个游戏CS的一点是无论高分还是低分作为NPC都得死，被人杀了以后还要被做成标本的屠宰场。现实中无法满足的病态欲望背后是则是极度的自卑，妥妥的废物。

最后的结尾真有点无限流的感觉，男女主抓住了游戏系统bug让系统冲突死机继而争取到了抹杀玩家的机会。最后他们割了玩家舌头（神经端口），终于成功脱离游戏。

副本结束后，女主逐渐接近真相，随即进入第二副本。


（本篇完）


————————
