title.title: Improving Your Prediction Marketplace Platform for Better User Engagement
title.body:
/>

Hey, are you running a prediction marketplace trading platform?👋  
If yes, this might be the right time to rethink how your platform is performing.  
Prediction markets are expanding quickly. User expectations are changing, new strategies are gaining traction, and revenue models are evolving. What worked before may not be enough to keep users engaged or attract new ones.  
If your platform hasn’t been updated in a while, this could be the right time to take a closer look. Even small changes can make a big difference in how your platform performs.  
In this blog, we’ll go over how to upgrade your prediction marketplace platform for 2026 growth and the key improvements that are getting attention right now.  
Let’s get started.  
**Why 2026 Is a Turning Point for Prediction Marketplace Platforms**  
2026 is becoming an important year for prediction marketplace platforms because user expectations are no longer the same. People now look for faster decisions, clearer data, and more engaging trading experiences.  
Platforms that still rely on older approaches may find it harder to keep users active and interested. More platforms are entering the space, each offering new features and different ways to participate in prediction markets.  
This means users have more choices, and they quickly move toward platforms that feel more updated and reliable in daily use. At the same time, technology and data access have improved a lot. This has changed how predictions are made and how users interact with markets.  
Platforms that adjust to these changes can stay relevant, while others may slowly lose attention. That is why 2026 is seen as a key moment to rethink how these platforms are built and used.  
**Key Improvements Needed for Prediction Marketplace Platform Growth**  
Prediction marketplace platforms in 2026 need more than basic trading features. Users expect better interaction, faster insights, and a smoother experience that helps them make decisions with confidence and clarity. To stay aligned with 2026 expectations and improve performance, consider these upgrades:  
Better User Experience  
Make the platform simple, clear, and easy to use so users can quickly find markets and take part without confusion.  
Real Time Updates  
Provide fast market updates so users can make quick decisions based on current data and changing prediction trends.  
Mobile Friendly Design  
Ensure smooth performance on mobile devices so users can access and trade prediction markets anytime, from anywhere, easily.  
User Engagement Features  
Add features like discussions, rankings, and activity feeds to keep users interested and active on the platform regularly.  
Clear Market Structure  
Organise prediction categories in a simple way so users can easily understand and join markets based on their interests.  
Stable Performance  
Maintain consistent speed and reliability so the platform handles traffic well without delays or technical interruptions during usage.  
These improvements play an important role when [developing a prediction marketplace platform](https://www.hashcodex.com/prediction-marketplace-development) that aims for long-term user growth and stronger participation.  
Focusing on these areas can help your platform stay relevant, attract new users, and build a more active trading community in 2026.  
**Types of Prediction Marketplace Platforms to Consider in 2026**  
The world of prediction is evolving fast as 2026 brings new ways to turn knowledge into profit. From sports to global politics, choosing the right environment is the first step toward success.  
Regulated Financial Exchanges  
These sites operate under strict government oversight, like the CFTC. They focus on economic data, interest rates, and political outcomes, offering a professional space for serious traders who value legal clarity.  
Decentralized Blockchain Platforms  
Built on distributed ledgers, these options allow for global participation without a middleman. They use smart contracts for automatic payouts, providing transparency and access to niche markets that traditional sites might avoid.  
Sports Centric Prediction Markets  
These specialized hubs bridge the gap between fan engagement and market trading. Instead of simple odds, users trade shares on season outcomes, player performance, and real-time game shifts.  
Enterprise Forecasting Tools  
Many companies now use private internal marketplaces to gather employee insights. These help leadership make better decisions about product launches or project timelines by tapping into the collective wisdom of their staff.  
Social and Niche Opinion Hubs  
Perfect for pop culture and tech trends, these platforms focus on community interaction. They allow participants to trade on viral moments, awards shows, or the next big breakthrough in artificial intelligence.  
Finding the ideal space depends on your specific interests and risk comfort. Evaluate each option by its ease of use, market variety, and the speed of resolving event results.  
Simple Ways to Improve Performance and User Experience  
Improving performance and user experience plays a major role in keeping users active on a prediction marketplace platform. In 2026, even small updates can make a noticeable difference in how users interact and stay engaged.  
Improve page loading speed so users can access features without waiting  
Simplify navigation to help users find markets and place predictions easily  
Use a clean and clear interface that feels easy for beginners  
Add real-time updates to keep users informed about ongoing activities  
Reduce technical errors to avoid user frustration during participation  
Make mobile access better since many users prefer using phones  
Offer quick sign-up and login options to save user time  
Focusing on these practical changes helps create a better experience for users. When a platform feels easy and reliable, it naturally encourages more participation and long-term engagement.  
**Final Thought**  
We’ve looked at how to upgrade your prediction marketplace platform to match 2026 trends. By making these improvements, your platform can attract more clients, build stronger trust, and increase overall profit over time.  
But making these changes on your own can be challenging. Finding the right experts may not always be easy if you are unsure where to start. That is where **Hashcodex** comes in. Their team understands your needs and can build a prediction marketplace platform that fits your goals. Whether you want to upgrade your existing platform or build one from the beginning, Hashcodex is a reliable option to consider.

**El día empezó con un amanecer precioso, es la vida diciendo que siempre hay algo maravilloso esperándote!**
>The day began with a beautiful sunrise; it's life saying that there's always something wonderful waiting for you!

![IMG_20260416_115535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23vsQfoM2C7T3FGZjSVSRBz5Q9RZwSdfai11qSTuUPxeNQvQ1p1uoxHbmMcJv9AVFLj43.jpg)

**Después un café para realmente empezar el día, expreso sin azúcar para apagar el ruido.**
>Then a coffee to really start the day, an espresso without sugar to turn off the noise.

![213446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23xybRiuArAY8v7HS814EncmZcVskwaCMNWYjFYWLFinw4iiLKq7vqnBkAcbZbxWwV2Bo.jpg)

**Ir al castillo fue lo tercero que hicimos, compré un par de cositas para uno pedido de tops que tenía pendiente, bastante puntual. Mi amiga ama comprar telas conmigo jiji**
>Going to the castle was the third thing we did. I bought a couple of things for a top order I had pending—pretty punctual. My friend loves buying fabric with me, haha.

![IMG-20260416-WA0109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23wqwUxH9QvgGDEneQPP2ggumUboQkCGu5njwCicFaCQ1PJhw4j8p2WNUveDsn919nziF.jpg)

**Y como paso número cuatro de esta cura para días malos, está la amiga loquita que te hace reír cada 5 minutos, que aunque tiene más problemas que tú, sabe escuchar.**
>And as step number Four  of this cure for bad days, there's the crazy friend who makes you laugh every 5 minutes, who, even though she has more problems than you, knows how to listen.

![IMG-20260416-WA0086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23u6JDmSQsQNewH2GLcDuW1x2jMCpbjGj4XQrYxrDyk2eXQSL1nbR11wFtcr1MvLs111a.jpg)

**La cita fue en una pizzería de porlamar, que se ha convertido en uno de mis sitios favoritos, aquí probé el pasticho y me arrepiento de no haber echo una foto, estaba delicioso y súper Instagrameable.**
>The date was at a pizzeria in Porlamar, which has become one of my favorite places. I tried the pasticho there and I regret not taking a picture; it was delicious and super Instagrammable.

![218893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23xp8LSt64TdMAoGvStPTYFqYXqLnzCqn5yg9qDWC1M6R6L83nNJfXt7tZLzpDx3fLFEc.jpg)

![213986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23uFeA1fwfVyAQESoXDJBL8db8XjCGzDwL8tFDkUQ1LJMXgycLAMz2CH3PWXWjszcMdNY.jpg)

**Para terminar de curar los males, vimos un par de tiendas, mi amiga compro ropita linda para su cumple, yo solo compré unos lentes lindos, luego se los muestro (estoy haciendo un post de compras del mes) y me enamoré de este vestido de flores, que se parece mucho a mi.**
>To finish healing our wounds, we went to a couple of shops; my friend bought some cute clothes for her birthday, I just bought some nice glasses. I'll show them to you later (I'm doing a post about my purchases of the month) and I fell in love with this floral dress, which looks a lot like me.


![IMG-20260416-WA0082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/Eos3EpFzUQsMUxkuHPQABjYj7g9KhqoH8cLv7mHfACnPeYNKA7R52vLH2XcWi11EMSb.jpg)


**En fin fue un día lindo, como rico, finiquite tareas pendientes de trabajo, hubo compras, plática, risas, comida rica, complicidad y sobre todo mucho apoyo de parte y parte para seguir con el peso de los días y de la vida en general.**
> All in all, it was a lovely day, I ate well, I finished pending work tasks, there was shopping, conversation, laughter, delicious food. complicity and above all a lot of support from both sides to continue with the weight of the days and of life in general.

![IMG-20260416-WA0098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23uFTqqp4N6rs4DciUhYZ9T6QLMiENAmyco6DBFprgfmWEZpxQuXeJzNgJdWqiTQKxkqm.jpg)


 **El aprendizaje del día? No encerrarse en los pensamientos negativos porque la vida pasa, y pasa muy rápido como para darle peso a las cosas que no suman. Esto es un día a la vez, pero siempre queriendo continuar, y también que siempre es bueno hablar las cosas y tomar aire fresco.**
>Today's lesson? Don't dwell on negative thoughts because life goes by, and it goes by too fast to give weight to things that don't add value. Take it one day at a time. But always wanting to continue, and also that it's always good to talk things through and get some fresh air.


![IMG_20260228_093942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/243zbeRoKcNenT6xamg9tjufXaU96Bzom1Y8sQPMHAY879oypKL8VzRAibtizck2YApdz.jpg)

title.body: > **I started my week yesterday with my energy levels at their peak, and it’s no coincidence—that’s what happens when you give yourself permission to rest as much as you need. This Sunday, I gave myself the whole day—for my family and for me—without guilt or rushing, enjoying those simple moments that do so much to recharge both body and soul. That’s why this Monday, even though I knew a long and possibly exhausting meeting awaited me, the day felt surprisingly light and pleasant, as if everything were aligned to get off to a good start. Like every day, I left home early. The weather was radiant—the kind that fills me with cheer and joy the moment I step outside. I love good weather—that clear sky that illuminates the vibrant colors of the landscapes and makes everything seem more alive. Nature and the city seemed to have conspired to give me a beautiful morning, full of intense hues and sparkles that invited a smile; I’d missed this a bit after several cloudy, gray days. Since my husband and I left early enough, I was able to capture some of those landscapes that nature had gifted us with on my phone. They’re little visual treasures that I like to keep, as a reminder that even on the busiest days, there’s always beauty all around us.**

> *Comencé ayer mi semana con las energías al máximo, y no es casualidad, eso pasa cuando una se da el permiso de descansar lo necesario. Este domingo me lo regalé por completo, para mi familia y para mí, sin culpas ni prisas, disfrutando de esos momentos sencillos que tanto recargan el cuerpo y el alma. Por eso este lunes, aunque sabía que me esperaba una reunión larga y posiblemente agotadora, sentí el día sorprendentemente ligero y agradable, como si todo estuviera alineado para empezar con buen pie. Como cada día, salí temprano de casa. El clima estaba radiante, de esos que me llenan de ánimo y alegría apenas pongo un pie fuera. Adoro el buen clima, ese cielo despejado que ilumina los colores vibrantes de los paisajes y hace que todo parezca más vivo. La naturaleza y la ciudad parecían haberse puesto de acuerdo para regalarme una mañana hermosa, llena de tonos intensos y brillos que invitaban a sonreír, extrañaba un poco esto después de varios días nublados y grises. Aprovechando que mi esposo y yo salimos con tiempo suficiente, pude capturar con mi teléfono algunos de esos paisajes que la naturaleza quiso obsequiarnos. Son pequeños tesoros visuales que me gusta guardar, como recuerdo de que incluso en los días más ocupados siempre hay belleza a nuestro alrededor.*
![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCpk314AACFi29E8SaheEr1C12KFB5GFWWn3LKK7zzcXVqSSRpeZk6Wj5gEa5eo3K.jpg) ![s.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqhNs7stqgCEVPF6e3aaqgJJEUgmcn6bfGcZTSdBWPB2Q4cjfYg3QKnLSqbBo1bqJp8.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-30-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqBcC7n6YoNjxa6zumeUcr6uRDU4KXw1qdUAsgZL15RkX7jtDUrWEMyPsC3wVdkSn9j.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-30-02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wC9MH8HgmrsvRVCamGNJ9Un1vFabCuivdaD2DC9Bzhd1dVyXjBewe1eHuufodyQsLoF.jpg)

> **When I arrived at the Parque Costa Azul Shopping Center, I noticed they were restocking the water dispensers with a cart. I already knew what that meant; when they’re doing that, they don’t provide service. Still, I asked just to be polite, even though the answer was exactly what I expected.**

> *Al llegar al Centro Comercial Parque Costa Azul, noté que estaban surtiendo agua con una gandola. Ya sabía lo que eso significaba; cuando están en ese proceso, no realizan el servicio. Aún así, pregunté por cortesía, aunque la respuesta era la que imaginaba.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGQDqUvmVQk9pFpzUatZnQ4M4CJ9VRMTfpfzARDmLyUbuWbmmnmxQpWX8RhM9DV8QK.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-29-54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EowFatnX1bj2Ku3vwxRcfisetDciXZCwvpTBJVCJ6EXYzmRB8211UWfhfPvgywso3V1.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpxqJhp4fhUD3MpoArjMArdQ8qZqD3waSEnDdgBmdGdj4LcSA4oZfgA94F5h5FPFxmr.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-29-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnBnTB3gbXPhQVcKpZ3yXGxt1EbgrFguGKraqMKe6JSMuwtfF4whhznGpqzFhGeJAJ.jpg)

> **Without wasting any time, I headed to my second destination, the Sunsol Unik Hotel, where we had scheduled our routine disinfection and chlorination of the main tank. It’s a job we know well, since it’s part of our daily routine, but we always carry it out with the same sense of responsibility. After finishing the technical part, we had a meeting to define the new payment method for suppliers and contractors like us, who provide services once or twice a week. I’m happy to report that the meeting was a complete success. I left very satisfied with what was proposed, because everything pointed to improvements for both parties. Those are the kinds of meetings that start out long and a little tense, but end up leaving a sense of relief and satisfaction.**

> *Sin perder tiempo, continué hacia mi segundo destino, el hotel Sunsol Unik, donde teníamos programada nuestra rutina de desinfección y cloración del tanque principal. Es un trabajo que conocemos bien, ya que es parte de nuestra rutina laboral, pero que siempre hacemos con la misma responsabilidad. Después de terminar la parte técnica, nos esperaba la reunión para definir cómo sería la nueva modalidad de pago para proveedores y contratistas como nosotros, que prestamos servicio una o dos veces por semana. Les cuento que la reunión fue todo un éxito. Salí muy conforme con lo planteado, porque todo apuntaba a mejoras para ambas partes. Esas reuniones que empiezan largas y un poco tensas, pero que terminan dejando una sensación de alivio y satisfacción.*
![photo_2026-04-20_23-29-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpQutKeRhmJj3t7Eov2PojRS1pUh9J3QopeqeEwMUHGAEzuxFKeCGRy8mEF33Gv8eNh.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-29-52 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNnQKYEVsPDGFEiz4pJW3ZZw8kn41vuQSPFaP9Kga26NCpMniPrnD8MmQGbZobmfBB.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5CUQm7yYJMRFMv1zj5YzMvYscSQoZDcBGpiJeJTxcGmjyw9pm6R1LoP6FYSxjFkrX.jpg)

> **Once we were done at the hotel, all that was left to do was head home and get ready for the next day. The trip back was an added bonus; nature continued to show off its best side, as if it wanted to bid the day farewell with one last touch of beauty. Surrounded by warm colors and that sense of calm that comes only when a day’s work is done, we returned feeling peaceful, grateful, and ready to rest.**

> *Al finalizar en el hotel, ya no quedaba más por hacer que regresar a casa y prepararnos para el día siguiente. El camino de vuelta fue un regalo adicional; la naturaleza seguía mostrando lo mejor de sí, como si quisiera despedir el día con un último toque de belleza. Entre colores cálidos y ese silencio que solo se siente cuando una jornada se ha cumplido, regresamos tranquilos, agradecidos y listos para descansar.*
![photo_2026-04-20_23-30-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23x18xVoHrsTW8m8kdEKW5Lzi8GeRedZhGGq88MTY4DguZEmJnvzMZPQSiWd9DfreVmYo.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-30-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/48WCoWEux5rEvv8CM5NxCyV189hzqeLhp86AqEWuACtXUMsoq1aQK6pyk2MCoSLKxp.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_23-29-52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqDidraPiFxjJZTyATKqx4ZbQAf1nbZdJxkAatT2dxN5nHoFhT3GzBstcxwKSfn1UGx.jpg)

> **So today I just want to wish you all a wonderful day, filled with those little things that make all the difference. Thank you for joining me for another little slice of my everyday life. Very soon I’ll share another moment, another story, another glimpse of this routine that, though simple, always has something beautiful to share. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Así que hoy solo quiero desearles un día genial, lleno de esos pequeños detalles que hacen la diferencia. Gracias por acompañarme en otro pedacito de mi día a día. Muy pronto les compartiré otro momento, otra historia, otro fragmento de esta rutina que, aunque sencilla, siempre tiene algo bonito que contar. Hasta pronto. Chao.*

Built on Solana, the ecosystem was designed to offer a direct and frictionless experience, eliminating common barriers such as complex registrations and extensive verification processes.

**What is Whale Prediction:**

Whale Prediction is a real-time prediction system that allows users to participate in events 24 hours a day, using only a Solana-compatible wallet.

**Unlike traditional platforms, the adopted model prioritizes:**

- Direct interaction via blockchain

- Total user control of assets

- Global access without operational restrictions

- The platform is available through two main channels:

▪︎ TG Bot → quick and simplified access

▪︎ dApp Dashboard → more robust interface (activated via /dapp command)

**The role of the $WHALE token:**

The $WHALE token is the economic core of the ecosystem, directly connecting the platform's growth to its investors.

**Its main functions include:**

- Participation in prediction events

- Integration with the rewards system

- Alignment of incentives between users and project expansion

**💰 Participation in system profits**

- One of the main differentiators of $WHALE is its revenue sharing model.

- Token investors have direct exposure to the activity of the Whale Prediction system.

Part of the fees generated by the use of the platform, stemming from operations and interactions within the system, is allocated to the ecosystem, creating a continuous flow of value.

**This means that:**

- The greater the volume of platform usage

- The greater the generation of fees

- The greater the potential return for $WHALE holders

- This model connects real adoption → revenue generation → token appreciation, creating a sustainable and growth-oriented structure.

**Model and differentiators:**

***The project stands out for three main pillars:***

1. Total accessibility

No need for KYC or account creation, drastically reducing entry friction.

2. Scalable infrastructure

The use of the Solana blockchain allows for fast and low-cost transactions, essential for real-time events.

3. Aligned economy

With the profit-sharing model, investors are not solely reliant on speculation—they participate directly in the system's performance.

**Long-term vision:**

The goal of the $WHALE ecosystem goes beyond a single product. The proposal aims to consolidate a new category within the Web3 environment: decentralized, accessible prediction systems with shared revenue generation.

*As the project evolves, the focus remains on:*

- Expanding the user base

- Increasing transactional volume

- Sustainability of the economic model

**Conclusion:**
 The $WHALE token and the Whale Prediction system represent a convergence between blockchain technology, digital engagement, and decentralized financial models.

With a system that combines global access, continuous use, and profit sharing, the project positions itself as an innovative alternative within the Web3 ecosystem and the Solana network.

body.title: The Historic Mactan Shrine in Lapu-Lapu City ,Cebu, Phillippines.
body.body: Hello hivers! Have a great day!  Hope you are all doing fine . \nJust sharing the  pride tourist spot of the City of Lapu-Lapu, called \

. 

![1000089335.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/48GEF3YNpzH2pLQbExtSRTWj11TUgGYTqmkUUeSU6Lr85Ne9e8FTsGymDmg2CwRGQg.png)
 Last Sunday, April 19,2026 , I went to Mactan Shrine to watch some activities prior to the annual reenactment of the historic event called  \

which will be reenacted on April 27. This commemorates  the bloody battle between Magellan's people and Lapu-Lapu tribe. 
There are activities at the Shrine like live concert , arm wrestling etc. and some foods and drinks being served . 

![1000089333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EowEGETayptmh4h4V1U2KQPnYzkM7GYowTVaH8v5f9wvGxEGpGiCuD3oJqFLVnk73Dd.jpg)

![1000089332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EowH6pVh1VVuJNNwHMZbA3T7LyqXgTifntM9yPNGqV4B3PZEmkNjL24aYa2oKstUwZu.jpg)

![1000089331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoeD4gT1RygRtGvWjbYzDeGkkuVLAc8AbWoQoWFzgub1fSzZYPEPtZjovuAfuxTTEFc.jpg)
 During ancient time , the site before was a peaceful shore were natives normally live in which fishing was their primary livelihood. 
Everytime I visited the shrine I imagine the shout and cry of the natives during the attacks of Magellan's people in which some natives' houses were burned. Because of this Magellan's assault , Lapu-Lapu's men  were very angry and fiercely confronted and assaulting Magellan's people with their bolos and arrows . It was a bloody unforgettable  battle were dead bodies lied on the shore. 
It was unfortunate for Ferdinand Magellan who was killed on that battle. He was hit to his leg with poisoned arrow  from the native then Lapu-Lapu ran towards him and hit Magellan's nick with a sharp bolo .
When Magellan was killed ,his people were back down for they were frightened by the brave natives .  
This was the first Filipino victory against the foreign invaders . 
 
![1000089266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23zGcdonyHVs3tTTTBC4U7PuWE1zmeBZg3kLMezB9q3ymwbKsCgWJXc8NmCjiN6QLJ1Yz.jpg)
 In this site , Magellan was killed by gallant Datu Lapu-Lapu. 

Every April 27 , the annual reenactment of the Battle of Mactan is highly anticipated. It is witness by tourists and and residents to watch the reenactment . Famous personalities were invited to act as Magellan and Lapu-Lapu and Reyna Bulakna . People are excited to watch even in the intense heat of the sun just to watch the artists . 
Everyone is open to watch . 

![1000089265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23u63FAA6u4i9yzU2QQFUBJsnzwcMXJAPnjMb1FPKyFqYV1ohQMzQzg8DwcEn8Q6FBS1J.jpg)

![1000089245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23wWkWtGMX7S49Vz8KhwJZXf3pmw5zi3ChrCFDmSE4pvAEoC1XEdxQ2uQ7JPyy51bt62m.jpg)

![1000089272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpJY8CMeRi8SqFKGrf6uaFx81jZxMshoyQpCN5snDhYm39miFNTYvqDWjYaDfPQdb6h.jpg)

Till my next blog . Thanks for taking your time reading it.

body.body:
Many players, like me, use third-party bots to automate battles and replace users in manual play. Whether this is fair or not, consider that players pay for the external service with part of the SPS rewards (about 30-35%) earned from victories. Fair or not, many users have had differing opinions on this matter. I'm obviously in favor of it because I honestly don't have the time or desire to play my games during the day, but that doesn't stop me from buying cards and accumulating SPS.

![1000063549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23tS2bRzk6YSnRpT8PwtT3uyH9ngd2zb39ysJRKVp9jZte9WPZMwKkWUHWdeYpTshuBJK.jpg)
___

I would, however, be very much in favor of a bot service created by the Splinterlands team, also using DAO funds, with the distinction that part of the rewards won would be burned forever or would always flow into the DAO. With the first scenario, millions of SPS would be eliminated forever rather than ending up in the hands of the bot service owners, who would obviously sell the token to fund themselves.

With the second scenario, the funds would flow into the DAO and remain off the market, thus having less and less of an impact on the price of the token, which has now been suffocated by mass selling. It could be an idea or a proposal to develop to provide a new use case for SPS, avoiding a depressive cycle from which it now seems difficult to recover.

In the future, when the token price can rise again, this will be an automatic incentive to stop bots and play manually. But in the meantime, millions of SPS tokens won't have been poured into the market. Hey @splinterlands, consider my proposal for the future 😊

# ITA

Molti giocatori come me, utilizzano bot di terze parti per automatizzare le battaglie e sostituire gli utenti nel gioco manuale. Che sia giusto oppure no, considera che i giocatori pagano il servizio esterno con parte delle ricompense SPS (circa il 30/35%) derivanti dalle vittorie. Che sia giusto oppure no, molti utenti si sono scontrati con opinioni diverse a tal riguardo. Io ovviamente sono favorevole perché sinceramente non ho tempo e voglia di giocare le mie partite durante il giorno, ma ciò non m'impedisce di acquistare carte e accumulare SPS.

Piuttosto io sarei molto favorevole ad un servizio bot creato dal team di Splinterlands, attraverso anche fondi del DAO, con la particolarità che parte delle rewards vinte siano bruciate per sempre oppure affluiscano sempre nel DAO. Con la prima ipotesi milioni di SPS sarebbero eliminati per sempre piuttosto che finire ai titolari del servizio bot che ovviamente venderanno il token per finanziarsi. 

Nella seconda ipotesi i fondi confluiranno nel DAO e saranno comunque fuori dal market, incidendo sempre meno sul prezzo del token ormai soffocato dalla vendita massiva. Potrebbe essere un'idea o una proposta sui cui lavorare per fornire un nuovo caso d'uso a SPS, evitando un ciclo depressivo da cui oramai sembra difficile riprendersi. 

In futuro, quando il prezzo del token potrà risalire, questo sarà un incentivo automatico per stoppare i bot e giocare manualmente. Ma intanto milioni di SPS non saranno stati riversati nel mercato. Ehi @splinterlands considera la mia proposta per il futuro 😊

---

Hello Hive friends! I'm back again to show you how I'm drawing **Ryomen Sukuna** in this video. Everyone calls him Sukuna; he's the enemy from the manga and anime series **Jujutsu Kaisen**, a very evil spirit, considered the King of Curses for over a thousand years.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23uFXvR4Zukh6UVRHpc4MdY65tQi7mjqhZaB9gZ6ct2nRtzbw6NtNGgHmtVzgyLseDpaV.png)

I really like **Ryomen Sukuna** because he has incredibly destructive power, using cutting and fire techniques. He's cruel, arrogant, and possesses incredible physical strength. He inhabits Itadori's body like a malevolent parasite, waiting for the perfect moment to sow chaos throughout the world.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/Eoc6yPaHHs3M2sG1o6sdPSPECzN9ue3pDDRw1uBVGLnf3BC5wxm3rosBYqU97NBxDxv.png)

He is very strong, evil, selfish, merciless, and feels no love. When he was born, he was very strong. He made a pact with someone and tore off his fingers to become even stronger, but he was lied to. That's why he now has to recover his fingers and regain his power. When he recovers his fingers, he has to eat them, as that is the only way to regain all the power he once had. But I believe that later on, he will become very strong.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tHC2bGZY67KD4HqtLWRA1w1tLAW2cJEYcEWeUmFPRiFBwnwgvLksZzg3NWQ61Pxrhrb.png)

This character is one of my favorites. This is how it turned out in the end. In the video, I show you how I made it. I hope you watch it and like it a lot.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23u64yL8otaVaRZ2TM6UfCeFnMgc9o77ctUbA32L9eGFxXadXfTy1uTkozRC6aaeJQtfK.png)

___

body.title: Adventures In Homesteading (Day 624)
body.body:
Hello Everyone!

**The hit or miss writing timing, A chilly evening, Sprinting after the dogs, More plants popping up & A random black locust seedling!**

Alright, I am beginning the writing routine a fair bit later than when I was aiming to start... and once again my attention got glued elsewhere while time slipped by. The funny part to that, is how from the moment my ideal 'start time' arrives... until the moment I actually get everything posted and am finished... a little part of my mind nags at me to get it done but upon doing it I am like: *That wasn't so bad!*

Seriously though, I am a very slow typer and it is incredibly challenging to spell things out 'quickly' no matter how much I have tried to learn to do it faster but really it is the editing that I dread. That said, the speed of the typing is not all that big of a deal if I begin early enough... but when it gets late (as it has been on several nights recently) I have to struggle against both fatigue and eye strain and that is just an aggravating experience.

It has been rather odd getting back into the whole writing routine, not just because I notice my writing quirks more... but because this series has been such a 'hit or miss' one with *doing* the writing in general. As a side note, it has been super nice (ever since I have been back at it again) to think 'Oh it is Day 624' and it pop into my head without having to think about it.

Anyways, that colder weather stuck around all evening last night... and this morning the wind finally died down enough that going outside did not require getting bundled up in a jacket. It was so chilly that I had to run the recirculating oil heater all night and until late into the morning... but by afternoon it was rather nice outside and it even got rather sunny for a while.

I think today marks a change in my foot injury, because it was the first day that I have been able to hobble around *mostly* without it being super painful at least a few times during the course of things. Unfortunately, at one point when I let the dogs outside two of them smelled some kind of scent (from some critter) that had passed through the area... and although they did not 'bolt' after it they almost did... and when I sprinted to catch them my foot 'complained fiercely' so to speak!

Thankfully, the intense pain did not last all that long and throughout the rest of the day the injury did not feel like it got any worse... but it assuredly did not feel as okay as it did before *I* bolted after the dogs. In the long run, it probably spared me from trying to do a bunch of the stuff that I was hoping to do... and actually injuring myself further because I stayed off my feet as much as possible afterwards.

Before all the commotion started with the dogs, I got to check on the plants growing in the flower pots atop the chicken coop and now (after all that rain) there are way more plants *and* I even noticed a tiny black locust that I definitely did not plant this year. I guess that one of the black locust seeds that I planted in one of those pots last year or the year before finally popped up.

Well, I do not have much else to report for this entry and am going to keep it short instead of struggling against the fatigue. I hope that everyone is doing well. Ta ta for now.

body.title: ¡Comiendo y fotografiando las cachapas de Caro!🌽🧀[ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! ¿Como han estado? Espero que muy bien, por mi parte, he estado ocupada, lo habitual, con salud gracias a Dios, hoy les quiero compartir unas fotos muy espontáneas y especiales al mismo tiempo, pues conocí a Carolina aquí en la Isla, en su casa solía hacer cada fin de semana cachapas con queso y sopas, fui un par de veces y todo siempre muy sabroso y a un buen precio, con el tiempo fue buscando mejores oportunidades y así ha logrado estar en varios lugares, actualmente se encuentra en Salamanca, la vía principal, donde está haciendo sus deliciosas cachapas con queso y a veces con chorizo, ya que el lugar se especializa en chorizos ahumados. Desde hace un tiempo tenía en mente hablar con Caro para pautar una sesión de regalo, es decir, de sus cachapas y su papelón con limón que le queda espectacularmente sabroso, pues las fotos que tenía eran con su teléfono y se veían borrosas/opacas, pero como últimamente no hemos tenido tiempo, ni ella ni yo jajaja, este día cuando fui por sus ricas cachapas pensé... por qué no tomar las fotos de una vez?? ¡Tenía mi cámara a la mano ese día así que nos atrevimos!! No era el mejor día, la mejor presentación ni nada, fue todo espontáneo, y creo que el resultado quedo bien, a menos se ve muy sabroso y apetitoso que es lo que me interesa, y pues adicional, mi estilo de fotografía, es muy rudo, rústico, detallado, contrastes altos, me encanta y a ella le gusto muchísimo, eso fue lo importante, ahora tiene lindas fotos para promocionar su emprendimiento, y yo feliz de haberle regalado a mi amiga fotos así!!. PD: Nunca habia fotografiado una cachapa, no me juzguen tanto jajaja, hice lo que mi mente me dijo que era lo mejor!! Se aceptan críticas constructivas en los comentarios 😁.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hello friends!! How have you been? I hope you're all doing well. I've been busy, as usual, but thankfully healthy. Today I want to share some very spontaneous and special photos with you. I met Carolina here on the island. Every weekend at her house, she used to make cachapas with cheese and soups. I went a couple of times, and everything was always delicious and reasonably priced. Over time, she sought better opportunities and has managed to set up shop in several locations. Currently, she's in Salamanca, on the main road, where she's making her delicious cachapas with cheese and sometimes with chorizo, since the place specializes in smoked sausages. For a while now, I'd been meaning to talk to Caro about a gift photoshoot—I mean, a photoshoot of her cachapas and her incredibly delicious papelón con limón (a traditional Mexican drink made with unrefined cane sugar and lemon). The photos I had were taken with her phone and looked blurry/faded, but since neither of us has had the time lately, haha, when I went to pick up her delicious cachapas, I thought... why not take the pictures right away? I had my camera with me that day, so we went for it! It wasn't the best day, the presentation wasn't perfect, it was all spontaneous, and I think the result turned out well. At least it looks delicious and appetizing, which is what matters to me. Plus, my photography style is very raw, rustic, detailed, with high contrast—I love it, and she loved it, which was the important thing. Now she has beautiful photos to promote her business, and I'm so happy to have given my friend these photos as a gift! PS: I'd never photographed a cachapa before, so please don't judge me too harshly, haha. I just did what my gut told me was best! Constructive criticism is welcome in the comments 😁.
>Separador de texto\n\nTexto traducido en | Text translated in:

>

Soy una chica enamorada de las aventuras, me encanta conocer nuevos lugares y documentar mi experiencia en ellos, me apasiona fotografiar momentos únicos, paisajes y todo lo que tenga que ver con la naturaleza, de hecho soy fotógrafo de turismo paisajístico, también bailarina profesional, adoro cocinar, llevar un estilo de vida saludable y sobre todo #catlover, amo con locura a mis gatos y a mi manada callejera 😸.

body.title: Biggest wastes in my personal gaming history:  TMNT arcade
body.body:
This is going to be a time capsule for a lot of you because I would imagine that many of you were not alive or if you were, you would have been very very young. But this is back in the days of when arcades were still alive but were dying a slow death as home consoles became more and more powerful. The games that had more than two concurrent players were few and far between and when you saw an arcade game that had 4 joysticks, you really wanted to try it out. oh and just in case you have no idea what the title is

TMNT = Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

https://actionarcades.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/TMNT_3.jpg [src](https://actionarcades.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/TMNT_3.jpg)
Looking back with today's eyes, this game was an obvious rip off or as we called it at one point a \
It was entertaining sure, but the game was specifically designed so that you couldn't really \

at it and certain parts of every level would throw things at you that you couldn't possible escape unscathed.   I don't know what to call this sort of game but there was a lot of them back in the day.  Perhaps *Double Dragon* got it started, but they all kind of functioned in the same way.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/Eou8mfR5ZTqP8KDNS3Xdeq7HsNWzzYZrGL83hrjAvHxAhUKPHbuSHj9kueGkgD64Brf.png)
</center>

Taking on a single opponent wasn't challenging but at times you got stuck into an attack animation and while that was going on, one of the many other opponents would move behind you and smack you.   You were going to take hits, the game made certain of that.  

Adding additional people to the game in the way of a friend that was also playing with you could simply add more enemies as well so while it was more fun that way, there wasn't much point or barring that, there was no real advantage to having 4 turtle ninjas on the screen at once.  It was also kind of difficult to tell which one you were at times.   

Regardless, this game was a lot of fun given the very limited choices we had at the time so I dumped a ton of money into this game.  Well, \

relative to the amount of money that I actually made back in 1989.   

I would later find out by a guy that worked on pinball machines (what a strange and cool job to have ) that almost all arcade consoles have varying degrees of difficulty that the arcade owner could play with in order to try to optimize the amount of money a machine would make.  If people were playing for too long on a single quarter, you would jack it up a bit, if they stopped playing because the game seemed unfair, you lowered it a bit.  The entire objective was to have people putting as much money into each machine as possible and the owners had the tools to play around with this.  

These machines were very expensive, so the owners of the arcades needed them to turn a profit and this could take a long time.  

I didn't take very long on me because I recall one day dropping over $20 (in quarters mind you) into the machine on my own (what a nerd!) and still didn't defeat it.   I wanted to see the end of it and to this day I can't really imagine what that might have been like 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23tmBgyhyHVZNeMp4nA1Smsu1rFvU8wh8bUGKk3K3AtdnGaii6uxKCnmBP9kwJAzA3Hb2.png)
[src](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cUNy8UMFJxQ)</center>

Apparently it just does some really lame animation and tells a story about how the turtles were triumphant.  That's not so mysterious now, is it?  

All in I probably spent around $50 in quarters on this single machine and let me get a calculator out to see what that would be in today's money:  It's just over $135... wow, when you consider that at that point in time I was just doing something like mowing lawns for $10 or so a couple of times a week, Konami did a very good job of relieving a young teenager of his funds.  

There were so many games like this and even though a lot of them were tricky theft sort of games like this, I do still miss arcades.  It used to be such a wonderful experience to go into a new arcade and see what they had on offer.   Don't get me wrong, I am very happy the home gaming industry surpassed them, but I can't really think of anything we have these days that brings about the joy (and loss of quarters) that an arcade used to have on people.
body.author: whoisjohn

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![wrz8H0AnsUSoFESh_IMG_20260317_124625.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/wrz8H0AnsUSoFESh_IMG_20260317_124625/wrz8H0AnsUSoFESh_IMG_20260317_124625.webp)
</center>

YY从四川老家刚回来，还带了她老妈做的腊肉、香肠和野菜粑粑，晚上她切野菜粑粑时，我给错看成了肉饼，心想太实在了，这一大块肉，等她煎好后（实际锅里热热），入口发现是甜的，没吃到肉，一问才知道是野菜，味道不错哦！

接着就是边吃边听YY八卦——她四爷爷去年开始接送刚上小学的孙子，四奶奶负责饮食，而这个孙子简直就是魔丸在世。比如，沉迷手机中，为了看手机从厕所两侧的卧室窗户，爬上爬下去偷手机，总之斗智斗勇，谁也别想锁住手机

这娃平时是不打人，只干可能会威胁自身安全的事，突发奇想说跑到山里去找野猪，是真去；看到路边的小河也说跳就跳，根本不管自己会不会游泳😂。四爷爷一旦严管，娃直接给你来个离家出走

离家出走时被刚会走路的弟弟看见了，娃就干脆小车推着弟弟一起离家（可把家里大人吓够呛，因为一晚上都没找到俩娃，报警了大家都去车站附近找的

结果娃是去了车站，没有身份证不能买票，又推着弟弟回村，找到了一个流浪狗窝，凑合了一晚上自己回家的（还说流浪狗一直叫，后来被娃拿着棍子吓唬的不叫，人和狗才一起睡的

因为这事四爷爷，也离家出走，去了离家不远的一个荒废小岛上，把退休养老金都掏出来自建房子住，誓要远离孙子

不过村里人说娃他爸也这样（跳过长江，漂了得几里路，被救上来了），还说从小闹腾以后看来是干大事的人😂（也许不少那个年龄的小朋友对于长辈们来说可能都是魔丸，只是程度有些差异）

哈哈昨天早晚的路上貌似只有我一个人穿了棉服😂，路人:我们不在同一个季节吗？
嘿嘿发现头发该剪了呢

感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，身体安康！

body.title: Important  Homestead care , massive growth , turnaround  and development  of the Peppers plants
body.body:
# Hello Hive 

![1000195305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFPDpvtW3xHzaUxcDzzSTF8yz8P9rZgVUuty18t6jiviVAfn1BeQhPAr3WegtFNB21r.jpg)

A beautiful new day to us all, I hope that we had a peaceful night rest and are hale and hearty. It is about time to embrace a new day and I am up very much early to visit the homestead for the 

![1000195311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23u62tS77xvwNNCKuHcXtjgfDZHt3FUSoNdLb1okuKTQxiH3Sc66nM5nLnNsm1k9z2S2p.jpg)

----

![1000195299.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23ycu7cTHzDU3MHQkzPSnoWFbMrC56FPYKcx7QYfvdFzCRCp9oJ7WemDkk4iW5S3Pmsnx.jpg)

My daily routine is very much thesame everyday for now unless I chip in a few other things, it is always from the bed to the farm and then back to the house  for chores and sewing and then any other interesting thing. Besides this I am also attending an online school to have a certificate upgrade paradventure that will give me a job. Recently the sewing endeavour hasn't witnessed much patronage and consistently we have to keep working to earn a living


![1000195308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFPgmPWpBDrR82XKUESBKhKAvTGDkLVfwuEFi9puxueTAmNPYeEV8MbLXqjLRRMbSyY.jpg)

 A very good portion of the food we eat comes from the homestead, which reduces our financial burden and stress nevertheless the petty sales of farm produce doesn't always produce as much money needed to keept the children in school and foot other bills.  A lot of people are working 2-3days simultaneous in other  to meet with their financial needs in this economy.

![1000195302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xAW4kbrwFFYuS9G8TNun9T7uSz3zE94fBLS7Xgrpuse5ZRu8KFRGrb7Di8sJQLfjVAo.jpg)

Having completed a good portion of our weeding yesterday I noticed a drastic improvement in the growth of our scotch bonnet pepper and it was such an exciting thing.

It is very much obvious from it's growth the difference between when a crop is grown with raining water and the other through irrigation farming At first we had thought that it was the grasses constituting the setback on the growth of the pepper. The plant couldn't grow beyond this limit just like you can see here.


![1000195330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoGxvmaGBn53saYCUnErVEbNQ93nTj9wWEGr8Wb4aRBCq4ScXpXELMefEsMRtkycbmC.jpg)

-----

![1000195327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eo8TpAMQPTgSQVrcM5SKNZZWB4YxTkb4FfmqTrV3M7tbT1CVxw1VumC2hHXPm5d5DFh.jpg)

Most of the pepper tree produced barely a few pepper and flowering was scanty. The peppers were stunted in their growth and you can see just a few pepper coming up and ripening. 

Regardless of the amount of water being poured here the weather was still very harsh and the ground drying up hastily after every irrigation session.


The observable change in growth started happening gradually which I noted some weeks ago, the pepper plants added some more height and became even much taller. They had drastically grown from something like this here 


![1000178874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Ep3duM4uJUpQnew5KKdYv8ka1qqL8semAPD4sTemttJrd6cn1mNqkjiCL3U8avnveEL.jpg)


To a moment of massive production now they are massively producing more flowers. And we know fully well that the more the number of flowers they produce the more pepper the pepper to be produced and harvested.  




![1000195296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zGXv7S6qSctdyJdBYzjg1pp9DW7jdkmW4uacdRGoes4TcRaRc9F9bFYwdM3dHuNTdZs.jpg)

----

傍晚六点多，飞哥发来消息：晚上去吃龙虾不？

前两天他喝醉酒的事我还憋着气，压根不想理他，就只回了两个表情。他倒好，直接默认我同意了，立马赶了回来。
 
架不住两个孩子也馋得很，他到家后，我只好跟着一起去。我们在家附近的南昌理工学院边上找吃的，以前这边夜宵摊特别多，现在不知都搬去了哪里。路边刚好有两家生意火爆，桌子都摆到了外面。
 
我们选了其中一家，问老板还有没有空位。老板说实在太忙，不介意等的话可以坐，还说烧烤这会儿烤不过来。问到龙虾，他跑去后厨看了一眼，说龙虾不用等太久。我们便找了位置坐下。
 
我提前看到有59元的龙虾团购，可看隔壁桌的分量特别足，老板说那是99元的，还笑着说“羊毛出在羊身上，59的分量肯定少”。于是我们点了一份99元的蒜蓉龙虾，又加了些烧烤，还有大宝点名要的冰镇杨梅。我点了一份凉拌西红柿，龙虾我不能多吃，正好大宝也爱吃。我家小宝倒是没什么特别爱吃的，给她剥点龙虾肉就够了。
 
最先上桌的是冰镇杨梅，接着是凉拌西红柿。我尝了一口，居然有蒜味又有辣椒味，当场就吐了。大宝用筷子沾了点白糖，也说辣。

这肯定是切过菜的刀没洗干净，直接拿来切西红柿了，实在难以下咽。我当即就说，要么给我换一盘新的，要么这道菜我不付钱。
 
飞哥在一旁拉着我，让我算了，别多说，万一人家往我们别的菜里吐痰都不知道。我有点吃惊，还有这样的事？他只说人心难测。

等龙虾端上桌的时候，我还是跟服务员说了情况，她二话不说就把西红柿端走，说给我们换一份新的。
 
没过多久，后厨的阿姨直接把新的端了出来，看着确实不是刚才那盘，是重新切的。她还让我尝尝，我没急着吃，笑着问：“刚才那盘肯定是刀没洗干净吧？”她连忙否认，说都洗过了。我尝了一口，这次是正常的西红柿味道。
 
换作以前的我，在外吃饭就算碰到菜里有头发、肉没熟透这类问题，也从来不会去找店家，总想着多一事不如少一事，自认倒霉就算了。
 
直到与美女同事一起吃饭，我们点了一份酸辣藕尖。正常腌过的藕尖都是脆的，可这份不仅不脆，味道也很一般。我倒是能将就，她直接把老板叫过来，问藕尖为什么口感不对。老板说再炒一盘也这样，她便直接要求换了一道同价位的菜。

类似的事还有很多，她只要觉得菜品味道和往常不一样，就会要求老板重做。有一家老板没顺着她的意思，她还跟人吵了起来，之后再也没去过那家店。
 
还有00后同事更厉害，在夜宵摊吃烧烤，发现有一串肉质明显不新鲜，凭着一张巧嘴，直接让老板给她们整桌免单了。
 
通过这两位同事的案例我才明白:作为消费者，该维护自己合法权益的时候就该大胆站出来，不能因为好说话、怕麻烦就一味忍让、不了了之。你们可曾遇到过类似情况呢？

body.title: ‎The Reason I Wake Up: A Life Anchored in Love ||LOH #285 ‎
body.body:
Hi Hive, 

‎If I could strip everything down to its bare truth right now, my reason for living is simple and deeply rooted to my family. My wife. My children. They are not just part of my life but they are the very center of it.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPubiRPq1T4TEJC8Ss7gsxLJSyvnzzWGiGtyjTTnfb3Ze/IMG_20260323_074431_371.jpg 

‎There was a time when purpose felt like something far away, something I had to chase or define through success, achievements, money, or recognition. But life has a way of deepening your understanding. Today, my purpose is no longer abstract. But right now, it has names, faces, voices, and emotions. It lives in the laughter of my kids, in the quiet strength of my wife, and in the responsibility I carry every each day.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWF8LzggHksxWk5MdGHNqJZi5PK9Xcd3Lrm5cszjxvbV7/IMG-20260411-WA0028.jpg 
  
‎Being a husband and a father has reshaped how I think and see everything. My decisions are no longer just about me. And every step I take, every sacrifice I make now, is tied to a bigger picture, and which is the well-being, happiness, and future of the people I love most. That awareness is what gives my life a kind of clarity I never had before.
‎
‎What keeps me moving forward each single day is not just obligation but it’s love combined with determination. It’s waking up knowing that no matter how tough things get, there are people depending on me, believing in me, and standing with me. Yes!!! No doubt some days are tough. There are moments of pressure , exhaustion, and doubt. But even during those moments, I find strength in the thought of my family and they always remind me the reason why I cannot give up.
‎
‎My wife is my partner in every sense of the word and her presence gives me balance, her support gives me courage, and her belief in me pushes me to do more and better. And my children… they sure are my daily motivation. Their innocence, their dreams, and their trust in me fuel a fire inside me that refuses to go out.
‎
‎My purpose is not about having it all figured out right now. But it’s about showing up every day. It’s about being present, being responsible, and building something meaningful and not just for myself, but for them. And it’s about creating a life where they feel safe, loved, and inspired.
‎
‎I am not just living for myself anymore at this moment in my life. I am living for my family and it's in that, I have found a purpose that feels real, powerful, and worth everything I have to give.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎

body.title: The 20-80 Rule: Why I Stopped Charging My Phone to 100% [ENG/SPA]
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

It has been a while since I switched phones. The main reason was that my previous device had a damaged battery that wouldn't hold a charge at all. After using my new phone for several months, I noticed the battery wasn't lasting as long as I expected, so I started researching how to optimize its use, and here is what I learned.
>#### La regla 20/80: Por qué dejé de cargar mi teléfono al 100%
>Hace un tiempo ya que cambie de teléfono, la principal razón fue que al anterior se le daño la batería y no duraba nada la carga. Tras usar ya por  varios meses mi nuevo equipo, note que la bateria no duraba tanto como yo esperaba, así que me puse a investigar para optimizar su uso y esto fue lo que aprendí.

<center> 
![1000354871.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tbqCWgSZmqjfrymVxQHdYqkHPmxSHYug23shdrtU1GDcxakGznTutteaXxKdLxrL7FA.png)
</center>

I was surprised by how much batteries have evolved. I had my previous phone for over five years, and the only battery care features it offered were a standard \

Those two functions were the only options my old phone provided. >Me sorprendió lo mucho que han evolucionado las baterías. Tuve mi anterior telefono por más de 5 años, y entre las funciones para el cuidado de la batería solo se encontraba el modo ahorro que retira toda aplicación que quede abierta en segundo plano y el modo ultra ahorro de energía, esas dos funciones eran las únicas que ofrecían mi antiguo teléfono.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23xyLz1m9SLSfiHtwXf1Fjd5yFPeqRT4tkZ2q9xDFjpam4c9RK86691T6kFqzvRyP9z6X.jpg
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tvAeAKJUviHR5LGvbXZG1NfKB1UA5rSWVYzJaD4STkUnAkzszvBvgYMWi88Z7bmobHT.jpg
Mi anterior teléfono
*** While looking for those same functions on my new phone to improve battery life, I came across a new feature I didn't know existed. In the \

settings, there is an option to limit charging to only 80% to prolong its lifespan. This made me very curious, and I decided to do a deep dive into why 80% is the target instead of 100%. >Buscando en mi nuevo teléfono las mismas funciones, con el fin de mejorar la duración de la batería, me encontré con una función nueva que desconocía. Al ingresar en el aparato de Protección de la Batería, está la opción de solo cargar hasta el 80% a fin de prolongar su vida útil. Esto me causo mucha curiosidad y decidí investigar a fondo de que se trata y porque hasta 80% y no 100%.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23w2DUMTUbRe1n4GkAGkuEQziFn7aotdsU1tZ7BrwbqhxDooa7fSzHngJzAaYyfQByTda.jpg
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23uEvBgunQZke5AhWjiQqV7Li9ALNkKSwaVSJiAmckf3wpn8q8p9SrqJJGkwBmedethCD.jpg
Mi nuevo teléfono
*** Nowadays, it is recommended to keep Lithium-Ion (Li-ion) batteries between a minimum of 20% and a maximum of 80% to avoid chemical stress on the energy cells. To explain this simply, think of a rubber band: leaving it completely limp represents 0% energy; stretching it to its absolute limit (100%) requires a lot of effort, and keeping it fully stretched eventually wears out its elasticity. >Hoy en día se recomienda que las baterías de Ion de Litio (Li-ion) se cargue entre su 20% como valor mínimo, hasta el 80% como valor máximo, a fin de evitar estre químico de sus celdas de energía. Para explicarlo de forma sencilla se usa el ejemplo de una banda elástica: dejarla floja es el 0% o sin energía, para llevarla al 100% de estiramiento se requiere mucho esfuerzo, y dejarla 100% estirada desgasta su elasticidad.
![1000354866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tvaNQsT6Jfq2SeEaL1jPKyzTkgjugz8KU9f6yVeVNq7EJ7CCZUqb9Cgj4MvnfSW3iDe.png)
Charging a phone above 80% requires higher voltage, which generates more heat. Consequently, the phone's internal components suffer damage and deteriorate faster over time. This is also related to \

Many people believe a cycle occurs every time you plug it in, but in reality, a cycle is the sum of a full 100% discharge. By charging between 20% and 80%, you only use 60% of the capacity at a time, which effectively grants you more battery cycles over the long term.
>Cargar un teléfono encima de 80% requiere más voltaje, eso genera más calor, por lo tanto los componentes del teléfono sufren daño y se deterioran más rápido con el tiempo. Esto esta relacionado con los ciclos de carga, la gente cree que un ciclo es llevar la carga a 100%, pero la verdad es que un ciclo es la suma de una descarga completa al 100%, por eso sí cargas entre 20% al 80% usas solo un 60% de energía lo que te brinda más ciclos de batería. 


<center>  
![1000354870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23swgSgn9NZzAcZHWutRqbuhN4NaDqCAQGoumtfKjBeHpfXcMWEGcvJXNBahpnq8HVS7K.jpg)
  </center>


I have already started performing \

as shown in the graph above, ensuring the charge doesn't drop below 20% and using the 80% limit setting so it stops automatically. I am glad I learned this and wanted to share it, as I am sure many others want their phones to last much longer without the battery deteriorating and losing its charge rapidly >Ya comencé a realizar micro cargas como se ve en el grafico de arriba, no dejando que el porcentaje de carga caiga de 20% y con la programación de carga hasta 80% para que se detenga automáticamente. Me complace aprender esto y por eso lo comparto, ya que estoy seguro que muchos como yo quieren que sus teléfonos le duren por mucho más tiempo y la batería no se deteriore y comience a prender la carga rápidamente.

body.title: - виставка малюнків хатнього розпису
body.body: У славному місті Лева до 10 травня триватиме виставковий проєкт \
: традиційні хатні розписи України. В експозиції представлені матеріали, зібрані учасниками проєкту \

для книги “Квітки‌. Велика книга хатнього розпису”, яка має побачити світ в цьому році.

Головний художній образ виставки, це “квітки‌”, саме так колись люди в селах називали між собою розпис стін. Дослідники фіксують появу хатнього розпису в українських селах в ХІХ ст., а проіснувала ця традиція майже до середини ХХ ст.

Розисували стіни вручну, натуральними рослинними фарбами, які за відсутності хімічних складових досить швидко втрачали яскравість. Через це доводилося періодично поновлювати малюнки перед Великоднем.

Серед експонатів предстана Вінницька, Дніпропетровська, Луганська, Миколаївська, Хмельницька та Черкаська області.

Дата: до 10 травня
Місце: Кав'ярня \

description.body:
> Hello everyone, I hope you are all well and having a great time. Today I am going to share with you about a powerful and interesting card in the Splinterlands game called **Sturdy Axe Warden**. This card can be a very important card, especially for those who like melee attack based gameplay. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS374EsFwiRRvGtKWXiCmYSkScqFdDfnLJ7HRbRiRoCxh/image.png) It is basically a Dwarf type card whose design and look seem quite strong and warrior-like at first glance. The huge axe in its hand and its confident stance mean that it is not one to give up easily in battle. Although the mana cost of this card is relatively average, its damage output and durability make it effective in many cases. The main strength of the card is its attack power and health. Since it is a melee attack, it attacks from the front and can directly pressure the opponent. Since its health is relatively good, it can withstand several hits, which plays an important role in long-lasting battles. Also, its speed is not too high, but not at all low, so it performs well in the middle position. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoYtdwwn8F6bGSVoy5GpZDKHRz5QC32QhdNDYnsYy4NQ/image.png) However, like all cards, it also has some weaknesses. It only uses melee attacks, which means it usually has to be placed in the first position. As a result, if the opponent's attack is stronger, it can be damaged quickly. According to my personal experience, this is a balanced card. It can be a good option for new or mid-level players. If you use the right strategy and team combination, this card can play a big role in winning the match. It is especially effective in low mana battles or melee focused attacks. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ28JDF68vX3PmEapXeDg1UKYquUBwEn5z3xtTtUG5bi7/image.png) All in all, this card is not overpowered at all, but it can be said to be underrated. title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776745509487-9808f965d77a86c4.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/cf69f664)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/cf69f664)


---

In this video, I show that the derivative of the position vector of a particle moving in 3D space is just the velocity, and likewise the acceleration is obtained as the derivative of the velocity. Thus, just knowing the position vector, we can obtain the velocity and acceleration vectors of the particle. And the speed of the object is obtained by calculating the magnitude or length of the velocity vector, which we can calculate via the distance formula. I go over an example of an object moving in 2D to illustrate this, as well as making an awesome calculator with GeoGebra!

#math #vectors #calculus #physics #Geogebra  

Timestamps:

- Motion in Space: Velocity and Acceleration – 0:00
- Drawing a particle moving through 3D space – 0:57
- For small values of the time increment h, the vector shown (which is the average velocity) approximates the direction of the particle along the curve – 4:41
- Velocity vector is the limit of the average velocity as the time increment h approaches zero, which is the definition of the derivative of the position vector – 6:00
- The speed of the particle is the magnitude of the velocity vector – 7:04
- Speed is the rate of change of the distance (or arc length) with respect to time – 8:26
- Acceleration is the derivative of the velocity of the particle – 9:55
- Example 1: Moving Particle in 2D – 11:05
  - Obtaining velocity as the first derivative and acceleration as the second derivative of the position vector – 11:48
  - Speed is the length or magnitude of the velocity, and calculated using the distance formula – 13:33
  - Typo: When t = 1, not t = 0 – 14:33
  - Graphing the velocity and acceleration vectors – 16:33
  - Going over inputs for GeoGebra 2D graphing calculator – 19:30
  - Graphing in GeoGebra – 21:15
  - Simplified the GeoGebra inputs – 22:40

title.title: Celebrating 34 Years of Love: A Simple Anniversary at Home
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbee3eGk65K8c2TKPwW4Hb4AFptqsr8TfemGLguGUPcFP/1776745559479.png)

‎Last night was a very special day for our family. 
‎
‎We gathered to celebrate the 34th Wedding Anniversary of my Mom and Dad. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUGSy97oJ6KrPdazpZw2RotAQXmEGzcnhrGxwMVcCWmxN/1776745607668.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeyDZHJbceyMj6wRrJx5d9ssQgF6F32BEAKNkyqHdrCg/1776745607763.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNmbxEtEPzVEtSBWK7Wn7t7xC8GLD2xsU5theuQViSn2M/1776745607826.jpg)
‎
‎It was a happy moment and so blessed to see them still happy and loving each other after so many years.
‎
‎To be honest, we originally planned to go to Sorsogon to celebrate this special occasion. 
‎
‎My brother thought it would be nice to travel and have a vacation there. 
‎
‎However, when we thought about it very carefully, we realized that traveling there would take a very long time and it would also cost a lot of money. 
‎
‎Because of some financial constraints, we decided to be practical instead. 
‎
‎We agreed that it is better to just stay at home and celebrate there. 
‎
‎But even though we did not go out, we made sure that the celebration was special. 
‎
‎Everyone of us helped in preparing the food. It was really a family effort.
‎
‎My brother decided to cook Adobo sa Asin. And for my part, I cooked Fried Chicken and made a Cucumber Salad. My Mom also cooked Pork Humba which was very tender and tasty, and also Kinunot. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1CmyAdKCVSr9bLPaESHChXtQweUtcc45g7jo5KQn2oa/1776745635425.jpg)

‎We also bought a nice cake for them.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTd8ka2A9HHf7CZbiPHW5hVA8Bg5wDzVHfuEABztMvYib/1776745661939.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeck2NKMhnQ1dcyxrLNpEjKRPjcpWp2aip1EpvfBc2U63/1776745662087.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9vnMdA8cpAf7cVxPLNMuRhaaTddvZZ4tcZ3bFyqZ8Lr/1776745662209.jpg)
‎
‎We just had a simple dinner together, ate, talked, and laughed. 
‎
‎Even if it was just simple, the celebration was a big success for us. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQbA86yrNhM8dSwGbWtPYg8S9WD3q9fKQqRx27BhHXDr/1776745690586.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUC98Kztbutsg3tzUHpDZL117seFwgyVQFdGf7CoNL3w/1776745690693.jpg)
‎
‎We were able to show our love and appreciation to Mom and Dad. And we are all happy that they reached their 34th year together. 🤗🩷
‎
‎We hope they will stay healthy and happy for many more years to come.
‎
‎And we love them both so much! ✨🤍
‎
‎Until our next celebration...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1776745729357.png)

title.title: Pollo guisado con vegetales y verduras [ESP/ENG]
title.body: # Pollo guisado con vegetales y verduras [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Saludos cordiales amigos de la comunidad de @Hivefood, espero que todos hayan tenido una feliz inicio de semana, cargada de abundantes bendiciones para cada uno de ustedes y su familia. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242DT7NddKKS5FA9tc4qs25CFYpEaeaXtXchBhXbN2ENFSZS4CTVQsaQ4CY9efCpjF1sW.jpg)

Hoy me encuentro con ustedes  una vez más paseándome por esta comunidad, de la cual me siento muy complacida porque me ha ayuda a mostrarles cada día, semana, mes, en fin, todas las delicias de recetas caseras que preparo en mi hogar tanto dulces como salado. En este momento les comparto una receta que es bastante sencilla pero que tanto a la vista como al paladar es muy deliciosa y es un deliciosos plata de pollo guisado con vegetales y verduras.

![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Epzz7SerSh8npDHjUucix3PYiYb3tzA8ArtCnh84P6m7Hk2gK3siEPwFrDhEdxUk1gK.jpg)

este plato es rápido para prepararlo y lo maravilloso que es, porque se puede acompañar con diferentes contornos, además de lo versátil que es. En mi caso lo acompañe con dos contornos: arroz amarillo y plátano sancochado y de bebida lo acompañe con un jugo de patilla.

Les comento que quedo muy rico tanto en sabor como en textura. Es un plato que se les puede preparar a los niños, ya que la mayoría aman el pollo en sus diferentes preparaciones.

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8Usq5iwUAmmjuskd7ALzK1VZER8PFkJhB2bsA6LFdn16m9YXNLJDk3wt2pmCTM1M.jpg)

Ahora prosigo mostrándoles e indicándoles los ingredientes y la preparación de la  receta. Es importante mencionar que se utilizan  pocos ingredientes,  esta receta alcanza para tres comensales.

# Ingedientes
* 2 muslos enteros con su cuadril 
* 1/2 calabacin
* 1 tomate
* 2 papas medianas
* 60 gramos de repollo blanco
*1 y ½ litro de agua
* 80 gramos de aliños (celery, cilantro, ajo porro, 1 ají dulce, pimentón, cebolla blanca, ajo porro y 4 dientes de ajo)
* Sal, curcuma y Pimienta al gusto
* 2 cucharadas de aceite

# Preparación
1.Lo primero que debo hacer es lavar con abundante agua el pollo y quitarle la piel, cortar cada muslo en dos piezas, buscar un caldero, colocar agua con sal, al estar caliente gregar los muslos y dejarlo cocinar por 7 minutos, volteando de ves en cuando. 

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoke6qApjikz1NsYKajNm6FR9w2gWGm8WkSxdm8HjEKui4FeYgQh7wrRC1jNsqbVHCg.jpg)|![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLfULWRh4LKnfroRf65d4tZiYFvuNyjeYPXYzd3eWu1EaqHLy9htbWsCS3GP9siagx.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoK3tXKSSXU2VgG7tL3nRhzEPAeRyPjLJE8TPD4TxYUf5jDXwYk8CMuX9yongQTnc12.jpg)
-|-|-

2.Cortar tanto a papa como el calabacín en cuadros pequeños y el repollo en juliana, agregar al caldero  las papas y el calabacín ambos cortados en cuadros pequeños, unido a este agregar los aliños y el tomate pasado por la licuadora, dejar cocinar 5 minutos, agregar la pimienta, aceite, sal y dejar cocinar por 15 minutos o hasta que merme el agua. 

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiUkVvUd3heJp53iJar9h1Ac5kc1kAQSHAL7gjqacrXGbjakNQXhNA692d6y4GVxTM.jpg)|![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243Be1FQXxqCJPt3PF13tRYv6gipnuUWiBrVuf6D8JUv3R5q7Y7b4h2V6wh4yC2vQ8Yxm.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc7aDggpDYmE8ubdbogmYHBfrcY5HfNMLrNQgQkHdrjJ1EES4ytiqQzyamYTtV1ueJ.jpg)|![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoptTabPeDthTbhcGnuEojvCcWpTyLpHX1yK8X3uZNqWrxDUBFdEWFy8oQr1m2Eb2ZE.jpg)
-|-|-|-

3. Colocar el repollo y dejar cocinar 3 minutos, apagar y  emplatar, acompañado de arroz amarillo y plátano sancochado.

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiVAR7WgPkc5325rcRpP9Rr6HyYktW7iZG9s96jv1Yo8EakysFaprzFtUp87N4Caj6.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8Usq5iwUAmmjuskd7ALzK1VZER8PFkJhB2bsA6LFdn16m9YXNLJDk3wt2pmCTM1M.jpg)
-|-

![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyXaeKnqtx6mXnTXHajkL1HwqAvZT795QmPG28Ap9rXTYNNxkd1RLkkdfmyDD2mYZsh.jpg)

Espero que les haya gustado esta receta, les dejo algunas fotografías, nos seguimos leyendo y escribiendo, nos vemos en un próximo post.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Chicken Stew with Vegetables

> Warm greetings to all my friends in the @Hivefood community! I hope you’ve all had a wonderful start to the week, filled with abundant blessings for each of you and your families. Welcome to my blog. ![24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242DT7NddKKS5FA9tc4qs25CFYpEaeaXtXchBhXbN2ENFSZS4CTVQsaQ4CY9efCpjF1sW.jpg) Today I’m here with you once again, browsing through this community, which I’m very pleased with because it helps me share with you every day, week, and month—in short, all the delights of the homemade recipes I prepare at home, both sweet and savory. Today I’m sharing a recipe that’s quite simple but is absolutely delicious both to the eye and the palate: a delicious chicken stew with vegetables. ![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Epzz7SerSh8npDHjUucix3PYiYb3tzA8ArtCnh84P6m7Hk2gK3siEPwFrDhEdxUk1gK.jpg) This dish is quick to prepare, and what’s wonderful is that it can be served with different sides, plus it’s very versatile. In my case, I served it with two sides: yellow rice and boiled plantains, and for a drink, I had watermelon juice. I’ll tell you, it turned out delicious in both flavor and texture. It’s a dish you can make for kids, since most of them love chicken in all its forms. ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8Usq5iwUAmmjuskd7ALzK1VZER8PFkJhB2bsA6LFdn16m9YXNLJDk3wt2pmCTM1M.jpg) Now I’ll continue by showing you and explaining the ingredients and preparation for the recipe. It’s important to note that very few ingredients are used; this recipe serves three people. # Ingredients *2 whole chicken thighs with drumettes *1/2 zucchini * 1 tomato * 2 medium potatoes * 60 grams of white cabbage *1½ liters of water * 80 grams of seasonings (celery, cilantro, leek, 1 sweet pepper, paprika, white onion, leek, and 4 cloves of garlic) * Salt, turmeric, and pepper to taste *2 tablespoons of oil # Preparation 1. First, wash the chicken thoroughly with plenty of water and remove the skin. Cut each thigh into two pieces. Find a pot, add salted water, and once it’s hot, add the thighs and let them cook for 7 minutes, turning them occasionally. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoke6qApjikz1NsYKajNm6FR9w2gWGm8WkSxdm8HjEKui4FeYgQh7wrRC1jNsqbVHCg.jpg) |![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpLfULWRh4LKnfroRf65d4tZiYFvuNyjeYPXYzd3eWu1EaqHLy9htbWsCS3GP9siagx.jpg) |![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoK3tXKSSXU2VgG7tL3nRhzEPAeRyPjLJE8TPD4TxYUf5jDXwYk8CMuX9yongQTnc12.jpg) -|-|- 2.Cut both the potatoes and zucchini into small cubes and julienne the cabbage. Add the potatoes and zucchini (both cut into small cubes) to the pot, along with the seasonings and the blended tomato. Cook for 5 minutes, then add the pepper, oil, and salt, and continue cooking for 15 minutes or until the liquid has reduced. ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiUkVvUd3heJp53iJar9h1Ac5kc1kAQSHAL7gjqacrXGbjakNQXhNA692d6y4GVxTM.jpg)|![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/243Be1FQXxqCJPt3PF13tRYv6gipnuUWiBrVuf6D8JUv3R5q7Y7b4h2V6wh4yC2vQ8Yxm.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc7aDggpDYmE8ubdbogmYHBfrcY5HfNMLrNQgQkHdrjJ1EES4ytiqQzyamYTtV1ueJ.jpg)|![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoptTabPeDthTbhcGnuEojvCcWpTyLpHX1yK8X3uZNqWrxDUBFdEWFy8oQr1m2Eb2ZE.jpg) -|-|-|- 3.Add the cabbage and cook for 3 minutes, turn off the heat, and plate, accompanied by yellow rice and boiled plantains. ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiVAR7WgPkc5325rcRpP9Rr6HyYktW7iZG9s96jv1Yo8EakysFaprzFtUp87N4Caj6.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8Usq5iwUAmmjuskd7ALzK1VZER8PFkJhB2bsA6LFdn16m9YXNLJDk3wt2pmCTM1M.jpg) -|- ![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyXaeKnqtx6mXnTXHajkL1HwqAvZT795QmPG28Ap9rXTYNNxkd1RLkkdfmyDD2mYZsh.jpg) I hope you enjoyed this recipe. Here are a few photos. title.title: 😝 420 Day! / ¡Día 420! 😎
title.body:
>

As of April 2022, **18 states,** including Washington, D.C., had legalized recreational marijuana. Twelve of these states did so through citizen-initiated legislation, six were passed by state legislatures and signed into law by governors, and one was legalized through a constitutional amendment submitted by the legislature. In addition, 13 states have decriminalized recreational marijuana use. In these states, cannabis remains illegal, but instead of first-time offenders receiving jail time, they are fined. It is estimated that nearly half of all Americans live in a jurisdiction where recreational cannabis is legal.

> En abril de 2022, **18 estados,** incluido Washington D.C., habían legalizado la marihuana con fines recreativos. Doce de ellos lo hicieron mediante iniciativas ciudadanas, seis fueron aprobados por las legislaturas estatales y promulgados por los gobernadores, y uno mediante una enmienda constitucional remitida por la legislatura.
Además, trece estados han despenalizado el consumo recreativo de marihuana. En estos estados, el cannabis sigue siendo ilegal, pero en lugar de que los infractores primerizos reciban penas de cárcel, se les impone una multa. Se estima que casi la mitad de los estadounidenses reside en una jurisdicción donde el cannabis recreativo es legal.

Of course, there are still many US states where marijuana is illegal and punishable by jail time. These states include **Idaho, Wyoming, Utah, Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, Iowa, Arkansas, Wisconsin, Indiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia, South Carolina, Florida, West Virginia, and Pennsylvania.** There are various stories about the origin of 420 Day.
