title.title: Day 41: Delegating for Tribe tokens VS Hive
title.body:
#
So many places to delegate
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tvAvxabcfpaYiJgu15MCPHNssS5yNNd9hfdwq3zoHgCN5znnZYw1omNMPZ6eNDugyWp.png)
Image created by Dall-e. Not sure everything in the image is completely accurate but I still thought it looked cool
Yesterday I wrote a piece talking about 10 different curation accounts that I delegate to ranking the payouts of each. @dlmmqb mentioned that I goofed on the @hivepakistan curation account. To make it right I'll make an updated list and add them in there...at the bottom of this post...because those guys are doing a great job and deserve better than being put on the wrong list. Making sure this isn't a rehash of yesterday's account though I wanted to talk about delegating to three different accounts that do **NOT** pay out in HIVE. If you are to delegate to @leo.voter, @indiaunited, @pakx or even our own @hiveabbyftp you don't get paid out in HIVE. You delegate in HIVE and get paid in a Hive-Engine / Tribe token.

#
What are tribe tokens?

Without getting too technical (because I do not claim to have deep knowledge on the blockchain) but... * Hive blockchain has two native coins: **HIVE** and **HBD** they are very useful, but they are locked onto the HIVE blockchain. * Hive-Engine is a layer that sits on top of the Hive blockchain. If you want to move cryptocurrency onto or off of Hive you will need to use the Hive-engine typically in the form of a wrapped asset such as swap.ltc, swap.btc, swap.doge etc. * Hive-Engine allows anyone with BEE tokens to make their very own cryptocurrency. I call them hive-engine tokens or lvl 2 tokens although I have heard them called Tribe tokens. * Why tribe tokens? Because different communities (tribes) on Hive often have their own currency. Actifit has AFIT, Splinterlands has DEC/SPS, Great Little Dragons has GLD and so on. Now some tribe tokens are pure junk. Others are arguably more valuable than the HIVE tokens themselves. Figuring out which ones are good and which aren't can be a full time job and I won't claim to know even a small portion of the tokens. But I do know a few :) * I am very bullish on HELIOS * I think the BBH token can be useful depending on usage * I'm in charge of the GLD token so I know exactly how it works * I know the man in charge of the PAKX token know he works tirelessly for it
Buying and selling tokens
If you haven't found the hive-engine yet it is really a place every Hive user should figure out. It is how you buy and sell tokens from various different projects on Hive. Yes, there is Tribaldex but its a layer that sits on top of Hive-Engine if I understand the architecture properly so I suppose finding it would work also. ### HELIOS ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tcEBLitHmEnKcbb2ZB7aAXL3cRWkD8PwjMbriQp23cVSmDpAevz556uH9nAaiBnQLvW.png) If you look at the HELIOS token you will notice that the buy and sell orders are very close. Then look again. The sell order is 13 HIVE ($0.78) and buy order is 21.5 HIVE ($1.29). Many of these tokens have very thin order books and any real buy and sell activity can change their value considerably. ### PAKX ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tw1apR67H63LpyYn6g95PjBHmZBbJg7DG1dSJSoKJ4XJqogn3o2QHf6NFdywYGx4ngs.png) If you look at PAKX you will notice a huge difference between the buy and sell price. 2.09 vs 3.43 Hive. A spread of over 1.3 Hive or 65% of the buy value. Plus the buy and sell walls are thin. That isn't necessarily a bad thing as PAKX tokens are designed to be bought and held but it does mean that if you have a lot if can take a long time to liquidate. And the GLD token? ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tHSwL73HBUeMCaiEtqzEuqbDGmUTDfe3V2hSqUjMvHCkwzUBKkJQL1J1UnjKGRD1rqb.png) There are no sell orders. There is a bot which makes sure people who have the token *could* sell on hive-engine but there are things called liquidity pools which tend to make sure that there is better liquidity and better spreads than the hive-engine can provide.

#
Liquidity pools

### Very briefly Tribaldex offers a service where a smart contract / bot can hold two different tokens. It makes sure there is always a buyer and seller between the currency pair. For the GLD token that means that a person can always buy or sell the GLD token against either HIVE or LTC. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23sxpRyyCF5459SmaCFNzpzP8qXVBN2fPvdAizkBzD5HkQ2Riw2HDJnpG64UPKUmySoh2.png) Unfortunately it is expensive to setup a pool (1000 BEE tokens) so many communities do not set them up. I totally understand why! Every token spent on a liquidity pool and every token spent on the buy wall of the hive-engine is money that can't be earning money rewarding the community. It is a tough balancing act. If people can't sell their tokens they can be seen as worthless. However, if the community offers too much liquidity then they can't generate any income. **PAKX or HELIOS?** ... no liquidity pools (for better or worse)

#
What I really wanted to get to!

The Great Little Dragon community delegates to three different curators that offer tribe tokens. @indiaunited, @pakx, and @leo-voter ... or perhaps four if you include @hiveabbyftp (Great Little Dragons). I have made a weekly habit of talking about the GLD community distributions but lets say the value is 8% currently but may chance in the future. I'll keep it off the list for now. The ones I'll list? ### PAKX ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t8CfKPvXW7uQMgXf3JNAwziTDxdxAjtJ7vxTVAFdFpfNSth8nQxkND3WUTdafZgTcfn.png) **Bottom Line 6.55% return** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23wgoeYFx3tbWPRM65F8tQL8sgsWCnYSUwPRbNJ5EdF4dX1GBJMsRme2D5FmVQVFXVWRu.png) **Or looked at another way 10.86% return** ### Why two different numbers? How can it be different returns? Well, look at the buy and sell side of the price. At the **BUY** price it is 6.55% at the **SELL** price it is **10.86**. Pick the one that makes you happier. If delegate and **HOLD** pick the sell side. If you delegate and **SELL** then choose the buy side. Still 6.55% on the low side isn't a bad return at all.
### Indiaunited ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t8CfKPvXW7uQMgXf3Jzo6XvvcfPzBtkVHCM35jNqv5Q7CyqZJ54U8XoSxEsgtgoY8PK.png) At 6.03% its not a bad deal either.
# Leo Voter This one surprised me. It has traditionally been one of my go to delegation places because of a high return. However LEO has taken a bit of a hit recently on price so maybe that is why the return is so low. Or perhaps my math is wrong but... ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23sxon1fgCi3ByxC3CL5HUuLQPAxdTJBG1iFKrWfKK191rqxTYst8D4UX8wvKGqDbMUYa.png) **Only 3.61%**. Ouch.

#
Additional Tribe Token Benefits

Now I just looked at tribe tokens issued for the delegation but tribe tokens can have additional properties as well and I rarely look too hard into that. I can tell with certainty that those people who hold PAKX tokens will eventually earn HIVE distributions weekly. I've heard rumor that those with a *lot* of tokens can call the PAKX curator but I'd need to ask @dlmmqb about that as he knows the token far better than I do. I mention these side benefits because they really can add extra value to a token above just its buy and sell value. I'm quite sure the LEO token as extra value as well, but I've never quite figured it out as its a complicated place to be. and in case you are curious :) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23swgShDEEEbkT1CEyGePTBZM54VzWWaZr6zjxXFXDjELaVRFu6JVYu8XLEGZ3Z2caHEC.png) the PAKX tokens I've received from the delegation have grown to the point where I'm getting a HIVE distribution of 0.192 HIVE so far. Ignore the 0.24% return as that is assuming all I got was the HIVE. The PAKX tokens are where the value is above. This is just a really cool side perk!

#
Adding in the regular HIVE delegations

# As promised here are the regular delegation rewards These ones all paid out in HIVE tokens I know @tergan pasted almost an identical list yesterday but @hivepakistan got missed so here is a reprinted list to check out if you are curious. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tbExRFN5mUWgrWsyg4ezaKjzoDXfDRucQNVB486DZEx6sYojKEj8wz8bYvAmTUYKd1w.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23swg5SnqPHWWDPsNqE8uNwP98cu6MU6tMVJjqAq1T9z1s3Kci97BcSr47Y9YXkC33r6Y.png) ### Thanks for dropping by! Hope you found it informative

title.title: Splinterlands Strategy: An Incredible Victory with the Magic of Dragon Summoner Sheng Xiao!
title.body: > Splinterlands is a chess game where the position of each card and the power of the summoner make the difference between victory and defeat. Recently, I achieved a very nice victory in a match with a budget of 35 mana. The kind of strategy that my opponent and I devised in this match was really worth seeing. Today's blog is organised with the beginning and end of the battle of Dragon Summoner vs. Water/Life Summoner. ![InShot_20260421_114643666.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRdG7Z7FGy7xwTwuSVGYYhvVAipPrSVaJRLvgNYLXrrY3/InShot_20260421_114643666.jpg) Selecting a summoner is the most important part at the beginning of any battle. In this match, I used Sheng Xiao, one of the most powerful summoners of the Dragon element. The specialty of this summoner is that it can spread poison on the opponent's units and has the ability to break their armour. As a result, no matter how much health the opponent has, they gradually become weaker. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRqDAdP3rn6BptZsqixE3fgUd2qC1JuukLYsuAeMjmmP/1776744661074.jpg) On the other hand, my opponent INKKEN used the Prunda Undervesch summon. It is basically a combination of Life and Water elements. It is usually known for increasing the power of cards and giving some special status effects. Seeing this summon from the opponent, I knew from the beginning that the fight was going to be quite difficult. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmciVnzPyQ4GcHnru6AH32s6EsCfi8KBnJfUX4LHnTAL34/1776744661115.jpg) ## My card positions and tactics In this 35 mana match, I arranged the cards in such a way that both attack and defence were maintained. The cards I used are listed below in order: 1. In the first position was Halfling Refugee. I used this card with only 1 mana as a tanker because its health was 6. Although its 'Weary' ability makes it prone to getting sluggish every round, it was still the best option to absorb the opponent's attacks in the beginning. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZfTJsRXGJfXYXrcBDV1Sc8fgkdHnwfRkJt61ptVjMCLi/1776744661157.jpg) 2. In the second position, I placed Ironwing Juggernaut. It's 3 armour and 4 health, making it quite strong. The most important thing is its 'Charge' ability, which allows it to attack from any position. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUfuoCVuRj4xFhcPkV8u6YRyzzpZEqZ1M8DgnL6r5bxmb/1776744661204.jpg) 3. In the third position was Calamity. It is a versatile card. Its 'Shapeshift' ability gives it advantages over all bloodlines, and its 'Electrified' ability damages the opponent's units every round. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDenazSdLHkiiJcrJEx7RySAmJwQaxXMuFhvMRDBjsLB/1776744661233.jpg) 4. In the fourth position, I used Forked-Tongue Sage. Its function was to 'Snipe'. It targets weak magic or ranged attackers behind it instead of directly attacking the enemy's front units. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKtHHsoonbkq5XJJZRAVFwoDsroBLe7ebAnC3z99U9f8/1776744859711.jpg) 5. In fifth position was Kha'zi Fire Mage. Its 'Scattershot' and 'Dodge' abilities are enough to create chaos on the battlefield. It can attack any random enemy, which throws the opponent's plans into disarray. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbFvqVp2TA3sLq3tzH8tXEEUZ9wYKKk3TgW6LHRNyL94S/1776744846595.jpg) 6. At the very end was my trump card, Rage. This monstrous dragon of 16 mana had 12 health and 5 armour. Its 'Flying' and 'Void' abilities protected it from magic attacks and normal physical attacks. When all the units in front were dead, it had the potential to win the match alone. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZaS1Fp3tnLgsdn4LTzvJQp7YtodQVopKkMD3uLfVSsmk/1776744846630.jpg) ## Battlefield and results Let's take a look at the ruleset before the match started. This was a fight with a completely standard ruleset, where there were no additional modifiers. That is, the victory had to be ensured based on the basic ability of the cards. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSuirRv7qjde7pyRS6XvsXFtjFm7iEzre2J5E4oetQirH/1776744924956.jpg) After the fight started, it was seen that the opponent's units started to become toxic due to the effect of my dragon summoner, Sheng Xiao. My Halfling Refugee and Ironwing Juggernaut provided great defence from the front. On the other hand, Forked-Tongue Sage and Kha'zi Fire Mage continued to hit the opponent's important cards from the back. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzF6T2FthCsUGoXB22VkCAaNLEQsK69NzC2vfzHWehBq/1776744949828.jpg) In just 3 rounds, the opponent's strong lineup collapsed. When my 'Rage' dragon jumped in with its full power, the opponent had nothing left to do. As a result, I achieved a huge victory, and my rating and rewards increased. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6jPmqojeTiHLRjM3q46bCkZPSdjw5bukGB4Do1Qba8D/1776744978159.jpg) Finally, in Splinterlands, it's not just about taking big mana cards, it's about placing them in the right positions and choosing the right summons that are the real charisma. This match will be memorable for me because of the correct use of the Dragon Summoner Sheng Xiao and the powerful finisher Rage. If you have a lot of Dragon cards, you can definitely try this combination. See you on the battlefield again! My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mirzaiqi/2f03a346)

title.title: It feels great that running for an hour is no longer difficult for me
title.body:
About 18 months ago I decided to completely change direction as far as my fitness is concerned.   When I was in my teens and early to mid 20's I was just sporty in general.  I also had the young person's metabolism on my side.  As I got older and had a job and obligations, just running around like a loon and getting involved in pick up sports wasn't really an option.  The only thing I could reliably fit into my schedule was lifting weights. 

I might have an obsessive personality because I really got into it.  I never had a competitive sort of bodybuilder physique but that was because I didn't embrace what I would later find out was the most important aspect of it, diet.   Later, i would incorporate that as well and I actively avoided cardio out of fear of losing my weight gains.  I would bulk and cut and honestly, I looked really good.   

But then in my mid 30's I just decided that drinking and hooking up with chicks was the primary focus in my life and without going into too much detail, I was very good at both.   

<center> https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/036/751/308/non_2x/an-overweight-fat-man-running-on-treadmill-weight-loss-and-anti-obesity-illustration-vector.jpg
[src](https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/036/751/308/non_2x/an-overweight-fat-man-running-on-treadmill-weight-loss-and-anti-obesity-illustration-vector.jpg)</center>

One day when one of those hookups turned into a relationship that ended badly, I looked in the mirror and there was a fat guy looking back at me.  I still was very strong, but all that muscle was covered in 30kg of \

My ex didn't leave me because I was fat, she was unhealthy as well and I guess we don't really need to go into that.   But when I decided one day that I was going to work the fat off it shouldn't be all that surprising that I wasn't really capable of very much.   I would get winded just trying to run a few hundred meters.   

I was likely doing it wrong and pushing too hard and this is the opposite of the sort of advice that I often give to overweight friends of mine that say they want help but these days I always say to just do something that you already can do... something that you don't hate... something that you don't mind doing....

Then keep doing it.  

Fast forward to about 18 months ago and I had decided to stop trying to gain muscle.  Much of this has to do with my age and photos of I had seen of what actual bodybuilders end up looking like after age takes over, but a lot of it had to do with me being genuinely concerned about my longevity on this planet with my overall health.   After the breakup I in fact did manage to get muscular again but my cardio was shit.   

I decided at that point that I was willing to sacrifice some muscle mass for the sake of improving my overall cardio instead.  It just isn't very likely that you can have both unless you are some sort of genetic superpower like David Goggins.  

So I started running... and of course I did a lot of it wrong at the start.  I went too hard or wasn't even measuring how fast I was going and I would gas out quickly.  I was breaking my own rule about making this something I don't hate.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tGZmw7A3UWeRYhgvc5GbDDFTPMJdv93uEcVPDWexboxojshEvKy4syQbGGxdSZrFyNN.png)
</center>

It took a while, but i figured out my sweet spots for doing a 5k and also later on figured out what pace I need to maintain in order to be able to run for a much longer period of time.  Now, I just run for an hour and provided I have the correct nutrition, I am able to do this quite easily.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23swi5kpJVjeTct8TQaeyjFjEfHwgqu1gDdKMtXB7t5bsFe4zHdSed2KgDPBXynrVmpro.png)
</center>

The idea is to not enter zone 4 or anaerobic too often, but I can't watch this at all times.  I have to just \

naturally.   I am pretty happy with the fact that I am just jogging at a very comfortable pace and then my watch alerts me that I am doing near 7 minutes per km every now and then.   This is bullcrap to people that run competitively but I want you to understand that 18 months ago if I had run just ONE km at this pace I would have needed to stop and probably would have some very sore legs for days afterwards.  Now i do this for an hour in a row and only stop because I am out of water and the loop ends at that point near my house.

As the days get cooler I think I will go ahead and do the loop twice because I am certain that I can do it.   I'll just stash another bottle of water in the bushes and maybe freeze it solid so that in the hour it takes me to do the loop it will be ice cold and liquid.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/Eo6BDF1Yzbep2BaAg6oCLovjBTcHxNqPztUP2iMhYy64Fp2qEPvLDEs3SYBQC5SvXt7.png)
</center>

The thing that is really pleasing about this all is that all that time ago I set out and had a plan and I stuck with it and am now reaping the rewards.   It does take a really long time but now I am at the point where I am wondering what  I will be like if I manage to stick with this for another year?  I may look back on this milestone and think \

.    

Fitness if you track your progress, can be very rewarding.   I think that it is and while my times would be scoffed at by actual athletes, I think about what I was like, and what I am now.  I went from a fatass near 120kg couch-surfer, to a 100kg muscle beast, to an 85kg hybrid of both of the last two.   

The pros say that you cant be both muscular and excel at long-distance running... but says who?   

If I do end up losing a bunch more of my muscle mass at least I won't have saggy \
later in life and lets be real here, that doesn't look good on anyone.\n\nSet a goal, stick with it, and reap the rewards!

### Card Analysis by Level

Level 1

The cost 9 mana for a creature  this caliber makes it more suited for mid late-game strategies.

 Level 2 to Level 5

As the card levels up the stat boosts become more noticeable. By Level 2 its Attack increases to 5. The Health goes up to 6. This makes it a formidable option in combat. It gains abilities it levels up. This enhances versatility.

* Level 3 14 cards, Attack 5 Health: 6 Abilities 6

* Level 4 30 cards Attack 5 Health 7 Abilities 7

Level 6 Level 8

At these levels the Darkguard Hellion becomes an asset on the battlefield. This is particularly true in drawn-out matches. By Level 6 it achieves an Attack of 6. This makes it a significant threat against a variety of enemies. The Health increases to 8. The extra abilities it gains further boost its defensive capabilities.

By Level 7 the stats improve significantly. The Attack reaches 7. The Health peaks at 9. This makes the Hellion a true powerhouse in the game. This is especially true when combined with its abilities. The increased Mana Cost at these levels makes it a late-game card.. It can be highly effective in a slow-paced strategic match.

#### Level 9 to Level 10

By Level 9 the Darkguard Hellion reaches its potential. It boasts an Attack  8 and Health  10. It also has 8 abilities. These improvements make it a top-tier card. It can dominate battlefield in any match.

### Abilities

The Darkguard Hellion comes equipped with a range of powerful abilities. These abilities increase in number and power as the card levels up. The abilities include:

1. Flying – This gives the card a chance to evade melee attacks. This makes it harder for opponents to hit it.

2. Scavenge – This adds damage based on the opponents card abilities. This creates synergy with cards in your deck.

3. Poison – This ability allows the Darkguard Hellion to deal poison damage over time to enemy monsters.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV71baqJyosat7mqvPJdXBMHbjFQHKZdEgM8d5Cp6bZT3/1776745251813.jpg)

4. Lifesteal – This helps the Hellion recover health by stealing it from the opponents monsters. This adds a layer of survivability in battles.

5. Enrage – At levels the Darkguard Hellion gains increased stats or bonus damage when it’s damaged. This makes it a powerful card for aggression.

6. Shield – This adds an advantage. It allows the Hellion to absorb a portion of damage.

7. Trample – This is an ability. It lets the Darkguard Hellion deal damage to enemies if the current target is destroyed. This is useful for enemy lines.

8. Sneak – This attacks the opponent’s backline. This can be a game-changer when dealing with cards hiding behind strong tanks.

### Power and Strategic Use

The Darkguard Hellion is an offensive card. This is especially true at levels. With Flying it can avoid damage from melee-focused teams. The Lifesteal ability adds durability. It can recover health while dealing damage. This makes it a hard card to eliminate. Trample and Sneak allow the Hellion to bypass enemy tanks and hit support cards. This ensures that it can contribute to damage when the frontlines are fortified.

### Best Uses

* Tank Support: In levels it can act as a support card for tanky monsters. This gives you a front line while dealing damage.

* Backline Disruptor: The Sneak ability makes it ideal for targeting backline enemies. This deals damage where the opponent is weakest.

* Endgame Powerhouse: Due to its High Attack and Health the Darkguard Hellion excels in late-game scenarios. It can survive longer. Deal devastating damage.

* Synergy with Lifesteal: Using it alongside cards with Healing Healing Abilities can ensure it remains on the field for long possible. This overwhelms opponents with  combination offense and defense.

The Darkguard Hellion is an powerful card. It gains strength as it levels up. Its high stats and diverse abilities make it a top-tier choice for battles, in Splinterlands. Whether used an offensive option a backline disruptor this card’s ability adapt to different strategies is what makes it so valuable.

Players looking make the most this card should focus on late-game battles. They should ensure it can reach its potential while being supported by other synergistic cards. Whether you're playing casually competitively the Darkguard Hellion is a card that can help you win battles and elevate your deck’s strength.

I hope this analysis of the Darkguard Hellion has helped you understand its benefits!

title.title: Wilhelmdale Deputy Decorative Hanging  Quilling Technique [Eng-Esp]
title.body:
> ##### **Hello to all my Hive friends... 🐱**
Today I am with you again to show you my art, I love every week to go through this wonderful world of magic, color, and lots of Splinterlands characters to look for new elements or characters to build different crafts such as jewelry, accessories, 3D figures and other things that motivate me, inspire me and activate my creativity and thus be able to create for you. >Today I’m sharing a new piece of art with you. I decided to create a decorative figure inspired by the character “Wilhelmdale Deputy,” using the 2D quilling technique. If you want to know more about the game, I leave you my reference link to enter it and navigate through this wonderful world: https://splinterlands.com?ref=dayadam ***Hoping you like my work, without further ado, I leave you with my creative process.*** >> **Let's start:😃**
![Separador (92).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpT3dBgHiHS4gnE99c46Zfb924JQvYzcCbd16QvWxsrgYmifqaqx5VHJYYkLf4BNZAH.png)
##### **Hola a toda mi gente de Hive... 🐱**
Hoy estoy con ustedes nuevamente para mostrarles mi arte, me encanta semana a semana pasar por ese maravilloso mundo de magia, color, y muchísimos personajes de Splinterlands para buscar nuevos elementos o personajes para construir diversas manualidades bien sean bisutería, accesorios, figuras en 3D entre otras cosas que me motiven, inspiren y activen mi creatividad y de esa manera poder crear para ustedes. >Para hoy les traigo un nuevo trabajo de arte, decidí realizar una figura decorativa inspirada en el personaje \

, en 2D en la técnica de quilling. Si quieren saber más con respecto al juego les dejo mi enlace de referencia para que ingresen en él, y naveguen por este maravilloso mundo: https://splinterlands.com?ref=dayadam ***Esperando les guste mi trabajo, sin más preámbulos, les dejo mi proceso creativo.*** >> **Comencemos:😃**
![300.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48RsB7a2RU9bFukMdZYSvyS8B7QarK9wU2RKyaQaJPTeRx5bGFxzApGFmCbqFvECaU.png)
![Wilhelmdale Deputy.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKNH6biYCupcy5Rb5noZos9xYXMDKuKuCZZ4txr59CXpMtRtwPn6ct1kppqFEDA.jpg)
--- ---
[Sourse/ Fuente](https://splinterlands.com/card-detail/824/regular/15?tab=lore)
|| |-| |![InShot_20260420_215754248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKZpp8iEEc5j6tUbXyhz3Js6tuof5nDX6KwFNXeg5fqhtDxE1DM1iHk2aBdTw7Y.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260420_215900817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKCJzFXU2cEUZj1gUNKENFmmCYWPaaMC2Qi9nTbRF2KBmU1FYGGmbaeYxs5BHfy.jpg)| || |-| |
![105144287cd641fa80bdccf1337fd62d.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23zkvs9FJAXB63JjMU9czVnqaSZdQbJ2ffWZ6dokzhTpvLJ4ghzSzeGCAoxZZCNUAZpRg.gif)
|
![296.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48Rs5bTmSjU8Nzvhs9YCxXbwp8wwVcoMSQ3oW4KV6YQ5AyepLGE8Nr32UEnkNLGq8d.png)
>• Cintas para quilling. • Aguja para quilling. >• Cartulinas. >• Hoja blanca. >• Lápiz. >• Guillotina de cortar papel. >• Argolla de bisutería. • Pintura al frío color oro y plata. >• Pega blanca extra fuerte (de carpintería). >• Pincel. >• Tijera. >• Colgante de tu preferencia. >
• Quilling paper. • Quilling needle. • Cardstock. • White paper. • Pencil. • Paper cutter. • Jewelry jump ring. • Gold and silver cold paint. • Extra-strong white glue (woodworking glue). • Paintbrush. • Scissors. • A pendant of your choice.
![297.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TK52xS2E6XGyscXNKVL5NmUJxmRLZFR1r3McVpqFHQnQQozZa3p4KCnzMWrW83r8.png)
• I started by sketching the hat I was going to make on a blank sheet of paper with a pencil. • I took some dark gray cardstock and made several folds, applying extra-strong white glue and letting it dry thoroughly to create a much thicker piece of cardstock. • I used the sketch to cut out the hat. I added some details to the piece using silver cold-weather paint. • Using a strip of cardstock about 3 mm wide, I created the detail for the center of the hat and glued it in place. • I took a 1-millimeter-wide strip of white paper, rolled it around the tip of a paintbrush to form a small ring, then shaped it into a square.
![298.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48Sq6rtuXN1rfb1fJeap2JhadgEwvK6pyp2VNYpUAZbiK1Xno5954vuBLVAm3u2Ehi.png)
• Comencé realizando un boceto en una hoja blanca con un lápiz, del sombrero que voy a realizar. • Tomé cartulina de color gris oscura y realicé varios dobleces aplicando pega blanca extra fuerte dejando secar muy bien, esto para hacer una pieza de cartulina mucho más gruesa. • Tomé el boceto y recorte el sombrero. Con pintura al frío color plateada realicé algunos detalles en la pieza. • Con un trozo de cartulina más o menos de 3 mm de ancho realicé el detalle del centro del sombrero, lo pegué en el sitio indicado. • Tomé una tira de un milímetro de ancho de color blanco, en la punta de un pincel enrollé para realizar un pequeño aro, luego molde en forma de cuadrado.
||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260420_214707446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EocAKLbspnyhWYLeH4cEwgb569NWEahWcAreurbXD2tBbceDF6yVkv4qQs9hGqbMYER.jpg)|![InShot_20260420_214752031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EogRFA8iNPSMXmrQTyBLWHgFPuLUMDBxiZkCA77inawhMv7HDnVerSn82kFoQx6i3Tn.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260420_214854085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpQz8pKmoetjx8MRb2RLyfD3mHqbANmgJn4H8MmNJVutDm87HJCZfdVWYw649UoApXZ.jpg)|![InShot_20260420_215140229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpXMwzinwkTfvkowuGuz4fKkUHitbukvz9skRzoonG8mQbEWkS45EprmcXwdvXDjtCx.jpg)|
• I cut six very small strips of cardstock, less than a millimeter wide, and used them to make six tiny open circles. I shaped these into diamonds, glued them in groups of three, and then joined the two groups together to form a star. • I took the star and the square I had made earlier and painted them gold. • On one side of the top of the hat, I made a small hole and inserted a jewelry ring. • Finally, I glued the details—such as the star and the square—onto the hat, and then attached the pendant of my choice to the ring. >> **• And just like that, we have this 2D decorative hat figure I created, inspired by elements from the card character ***“Wilhelmdale Deputy”***.**
![Separador (92).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpT3dBgHiHS4gnE99c46Zfb924JQvYzcCbd16QvWxsrgYmifqaqx5VHJYYkLf4BNZAH.png)
• Recorte seis tiras de cartulina muy pequeñas de menos de un milímetro de ancho, con ellas procedí a realizar 6 círculos abiertos muy pequeñitos. Estos los moldee en forma de rombos, los pegue en grupos de 3, luego uni los dos grupos para formar una estrella. • Tomé la estrella y el cuadrado que había hecho con anterioridad, los pinté de color oro. • En un costado de la parte de arriba del sombrero, abri un pequeño agujero e incorpore una argolla de bisutería. • Para finalizar pegué los detalles en el sombrero como lo es la estrella y el cuadrado, por último enganche en la argolla el colgante de mi preferencia. >> **• De esta manera tenemos lista esta figura decorativa de un sombrero en 2D que elabore, inspirada en elementos del personaje de la carta ***\

***.**
||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260420_215243689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpLix2dtSf87q2UwKXzUv6ekSJ5q8QJBjMWKssqKxRJSKF8zxg4oo43fHMYY48hnymr.jpg)|![InShot_20260420_215356701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoeHMgDqQwMEXncu13CnCvZPm7dqEVn5A7omzDVPGeVxxdxLgnz2uPbYExsh5DjETGo.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260420_215450869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpT6fLBKGHYDm7jp1TZUAZtyWgPNbF1UbB73cYWygb9xEyDArSvihWBzV6CoumHCsqR.jpg)|![InShot_20260420_215543371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoKAdHq3p7yvAXhdoLrAmvzsnrhuh3venZp24zHGjb19USvLC4fCrv8MyASGfxxKNNE.jpg)|
![299.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48SpzhtsuWvUp4UB4Us2PBPKdsZPR4DyPbkAKtPeukZtc3JpQkGNPqXr9n3HTiGPhK.png)
|| |-| |![InShot_20260420_215654303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKU5XpTVgCiunk8aqojCV3VhH6e1fTbTPUz3pAtmJpmfhYnBKQfxNuQN5SfPtqx.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260420_215754248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKZpp8iEEc5j6tUbXyhz3Js6tuof5nDX6KwFNXeg5fqhtDxE1DM1iHk2aBdTw7Y.jpg)|![InShot_20260420_215729987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKbG6LhHybaTsNrSjdSTC2Mv6R9gtw9PNvKgUM19qpVjGimgqXNmtzB2j2dYxWj.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260420_215819981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKZpnwiaAbLRh8BYeYHtQWxfrxcWBKrtvtoXTP81Ct7sQ2e65Y2HyQuzjzLhP6R.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260420_215900817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKCJzFXU2cEUZj1gUNKENFmmCYWPaaMC2Qi9nTbRF2KBmU1FYGGmbaeYxs5BHfy.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260420_215939950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKAsintDKDoPPNPbjUCbKTqXTpf91wTDL3eCRtjrnEkhp74nPXAqHQGbLohUkEq.jpg)|![InShot_20260420_220008696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKGcfMHa5hS3JtZyX7sUq3UCg472a9Aq9ksUP5uyFk78Ji2p6vy3fMUmfLsH6Vm.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260420_220103207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AK81HLH5yKpZFDAovWcVKcHYPBCUdqgvFzxhqfjQhJNqS8UYo2DS61pQ44xZ7DJ.jpg)|
|| |-| |
![84d9eb40d28f4bcab8b237c5ec21e7b8.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23vsfHg7PVUyA3YYcuNpxaCiazShYzzy7XUtKLD8ywJGE3X8RGK3GiZr83BAkVaGE4T3o.gif)
|
## **What did you think, did you like it?**
I hope you did, I hope you liked my explanation, procedure and photos, I made them with love for you.
#### ***\

.***
##
**Thank you all, see you next time.**

![Separador - 2023-11-26T000421.713.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eopvt2fsf6Ft8nqnEZHFwPyYmRx1cRSQZUoFv8Gw3LkY1i7HjTM2b989D16qTmNSjPP.png)
>>## **¿Que les pareció, les gustó?**
Espero que sí, que les haya gustado mi explicación, procedimiento y fotos, los hice con mucho cariño por y para ustedes.
>>#### ***\

.***
##
**Gracias a todos, nos vemos en la próxima.**

title.title: Part Two of My Visit to the Peace Monument | Segunda parte de mi visita al Monumento de la Paz 🕊
title.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello travelers, happy Tuesday to everyone. ![InShot_20260420_074705550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpGSAryA71BLdnZhrC2RAZuHQQuaQroJtwXh86DdybQXxahkcB2n84dBhv792e63gy9.jpg) We left the San Isidro Labrador Chapel behind and continued along a long path up a steep hill leading to the Monument of the Virgin of Peace. The monument is surrounded by green grass, beautiful trees, and flowers, filling visitors with a sense of harmony and well-being thanks to such beautiful landscapes that seem straight out of a fairy tale. ![20260402_132646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnugvvQ3o5H1DmpLQPavnKia7f2XZwwnxmKptZccVSn5xoqmTbEU6nAKS6qdSRqTexw.jpg) ![20260402_132656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eoc6YwvzAYsHq8H79kAYCTRHS8Z8aB8fpx44K9NdEhc5YWqyJZm9yUgMDF27Adj8E5p.jpg) ![20260402_132838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eou7iXj8vUCeka4D5bAeYB3CNWa1zNMhJE7HtxyvPB7be9rzjgfd5amVdbq1c1cjMzm.jpg) ![20260402_132816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnugWbZVbwyf5cxvZTHhRrhF6TM7bsAngoEcirBAyc1CyXhSFxCqv4VW6JF1MNtzinA.jpg) ![20260402_132825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EqQM9XSySSfvAvdwhz3MyjjYiKuhgwyXVuqwLWaZNtN2d8ZHZuZWEGFoC8d7WLLoyNQ.jpg) ![20260402_132932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoTayFkSQZB5f9qvgcJKWpNy3vh6c9pUQf2jdfooAMvJ3sq1nejvMMf2C6JvHCfgKHq.jpg) ![20260402_133019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpnBPy9KyZxVq5zWi4UNpxzyJ4WM4vXytCRR1J1A4GHFui8oWNvTzjd48vFwP9duBqJ.jpg) ![20260402_133947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnugyfH3k8BwhLpxCMj8wrLUy9obAV5PVokENhm7ptamxZpEpnPvaoKDay5xs9W1j7d.jpg) We were getting closer and closer to the Peace Monument, which was partially shrouded in mist. Before getting any closer to it, I could see the tiny houses that make up the state capital of Trujillo. I was so happy to be there—I hadn’t been since I was 13—and that moment brought back endless memories of spending vacations there with my family. I’m eagerly looking forward to the day I can bring my girls there. ![20260402_132916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnmBK5SajE3D12QZ7yxcHZRWFer8zSJtYNHCvXYoYY53X8qcpqhqzHHQVsG1Ztvugwr.jpg) ![20260402_133126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnqTYEwgYWbfD7ZK81eg7T23gtEbfazcB6skACAhMQabcXAuVZHwBDz1wxBQ6GcSRH1.jpg) ![20260402_133259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpVB7BSdHGi1iTr8g1oBdbyLSVpRLFWa9LFmbuz7u4myY7c22Vfn2aghHCD5QVwXSwa.jpg) ![20260402_133100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpxqDs6nxhH5SK9fFXouGdLPYTeKoxkwgYK88U45Qz5LsVugsgocNrFfURf4cY1tcpG.jpg) We reached the base of the monument, and just as we were about to climb up, we decided to grab a bite to eat instead, because there was a huge line of people waiting to go up. we turned back and took another path, one lined with pine trees, their scent filling the air. Nearby was a park where children could play, and further on we found a wishing well where there were some bills and coins at the bottom; a small sculpture of the Virgin of Peace stood out. ![20260402_133848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnaYLBnALLCAzDPziAmvGC6iw14eMKb7SoRuDW46A6EGMvDnck5vA1KVvmq5P1hD6tJ.jpg) ![20260402_133954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpLf4rY1qJx5EJUETk3xDCG2GZZWsoMgro5DNC831QjAHEC6q19Y8PbZF5Fyh2m3QoA.jpg) ![20260402_134311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EqfFR5x3UGqGeVo2qwMHNQQVJnMrSgjd7DuKNhmQdVsDGULpxnF9eNCp73d51u6Jg2u.jpg ![20260402_134325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eq7KydQo9hHxRkM2DqZvymRuUW92EqJF76bWzr6X2QwzJttf48cssfAT3BteXvoJkx8.jpg) ![20260402_134454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpT3Ch8oGw1P9fGk3p5itoTNy375gkucC92X1VFqxP1BqtDBGRjeT2dtaUz4hZGvyRj.jpg) ![20260402_134458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpGPpEP4576dRSykpHRXjvzswTF4dboE1NAC574CykMuXTnc4Lvp39rzRoe18ipSxKj.jpg) ![20260402_134325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eq7KydQo9hHxRkM2DqZvymRuUW92EqJF76bWzr6X2QwzJttf48cssfAT3BteXvoJkx8.jpg) ![20260402_134527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoK5RDvPuoUN4fuhGiktCVMK5KA8DMyCXGSEQnuYKDMMLQne1CdJND3HuVWdXK5yG6s.jpg) While Ricardo and I were looking for something to eat, we came across a little house for elves in a tree trunk. Remember that they are the protectors of nature, and in the state of Trujillo they are called Momoy. ![20260402_134724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoiVj4w1L27qbJp4iPL9sBYDJQSXBf8Qfv8J4QSrtfAvhACJinrW2uRKwF7y7FodQnx.jpg) ![20260402_134758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EorzMQ4FBmiSwdJdBKTDmw7xweU21GBTgWfmPPWF7Wxz9KFt7Zfov37bekDtEARqBGA.jpg) We found a place to eat; a bowl of shelled corn which would be our lunch and a small glass of juice cost $2. It was delicious and came with sour cream, fresh cheese, and yellow cheese. We were happy with our choice and took the opportunity to buy a fridge magnet. ![IMG-20260420-WA0009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpQuqVRo63qziCPNPzVDnd3TsGQ1CTkVDqiXdiXeCJ5VS7wzCbYiwjoYX7ZYfWpVAVe.jpg) ![20260402_135308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoCi8PDNTWgUV9YnxdBBf2LMsxezztVBSfVM2yAkU7ieSTG2PZ35WNAdSa9iTda1Lvd.jpg) We went back to the monument, and the line was still long, but it didn't matter because we weren't hungry anymore, so we were able to wait patiently for about 20 minutes until it was our turn. ![20260402_142110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpVA6kbfqaaYr8hV4LctnmWxgctH2uyFhQfJsBQyJrxX7zGk4bY64tkwXdb746d7Azc.jpg) ![20260402_140457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eq9Uk6j873nu8s1VrnMQMmMss5H2B4PkyUWRiedwA7jDQpaDEECRDPAxcAW2zZUULuN.jpg) ![20260402_141502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EogMpdsLFFhkdTuLaLWYd4vz6RB1yD32eudV8cikJEioM4rwZwU3VkSivJD76jdNWvL.jpg) We reached the base of the mountain, which is about 18 meters high. From there, we could see the beautiful, majestic mountains touching the sky, and we could also see the people waiting to climb up. ![20260402_142310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpC9tY1oqc9CTx8ZzszQGwSRWYwwHGuC3MmxT3E99uzt47rxef9EfadqbwZ8rCT1SoA.jpg) ![20260402_142351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EprSCLy8kG97KnA7L2vQahPZXHdfHXyBbq6HDFqhqVrzUVVRgU6UtoFFKYCMh6dr7wM.jpg) ![20260402_142319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoXrfJMhX6wTLHvaQFCxyAVv495fPWyJ7yYRug5HjFqzYvcHoAKi9Nc6frnqPb2nYF4.jpg) ![20260402_142314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnYQRdSRvSRYHxdfaStv28xYScTZAVyNfPhrC8fNAN3rTqFWWE4CU6tqjNEUYpzEBaW.jpg) ![20260402_142328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnYQuv7zX9MB61r7FAogNMWp7svx7H5dx27chtMbJN2NFQGt2uwTaq68XhTabd8coiB.jpg) Between the steps, at 22 meters, is the left hand; from here I could feel closer to the sky. A few steps later, at 26 meters, was the right hand, where the Virgin holds the dove of peace. The panoramic view was spectacular. At this point, I was more scared and didn’t want to keep climbing, so I just looked up and could see her face. We decided not to climb any further, but I felt happy to have made it past the halfway point of the monument. ![20260402_142608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Ep3dpZ33mu6V9MvB2bzRRzVGxgY4CP8hisK71o38wBwp8a4w2cEYg5ubqEcnjrpeuCK.jpg) ![20260402_142524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnaYNv7Jpb77J49q2Cd1PjyDNv6dtYBo7e3cSZSnDSoSqPQ7umktkLGPTrBBFpBB9rV.jpg) ![20260402_142515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EppKDd5rojHG4fBV62kyPgVvSWyDtJVKJGFMs23BKQHV2MyeSarP2EjH8nxuDcrEsdJ.jpg) ![20260402_142622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Epzwp6ayCmCPLhaGQpYjZbYkpQAXHRyyvexiyERbexjqHRiQakdHaVndAjYwJubwCLF.jpg) ![20260402_142722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnaYr8P5PkHm6UBodvPXV7CQ2Dr7mwMEY2d8qj7CLyAicVZNtVXAgrCBuYVB3doKoTm.jpg) ![20260402_142728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpA1Uats4rdXBhVAufJKAX9emxqiVacTTUUshQdKvHG7EZjjqy7roTUfDzE7eKPPtgL.jpg) Finally, we descended and said goodbye to the largest monument in the Americas, and we were able to get a clear view of the Virgin of Peace from afar—what a source of pride that she is located in my beautiful Venezuela. ![20260402_151743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpGPHCpiThnxBGd6VfJ5oorsnDUaBj9m4dbNwYPzzav1xB4gHgJvsAtZmQCBXo57LPT.jpg)

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola viajeros, feliz martes para todos. 

![InShot_20260420_074705550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpGSAryA71BLdnZhrC2RAZuHQQuaQroJtwXh86DdybQXxahkcB2n84dBhv792e63gy9.jpg)

Dejamos atrás la Capilla San Isidro Labrador y seguimos por una caminería larga en una empinada colina que conducía hacia el Monumento de la Virgen de la Paz, el mismo se encuentra cubierto de gramas verdes, lindos árboles y flores, que llenan de armonía y de bienestar a sus visitantes con tan hermosos paisajes que parecen sacados de un cuento. 

![20260402_132646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnugvvQ3o5H1DmpLQPavnKia7f2XZwwnxmKptZccVSn5xoqmTbEU6nAKS6qdSRqTexw.jpg)

![20260402_132656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eoc6YwvzAYsHq8H79kAYCTRHS8Z8aB8fpx44K9NdEhc5YWqyJZm9yUgMDF27Adj8E5p.jpg)

![20260402_132838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eou7iXj8vUCeka4D5bAeYB3CNWa1zNMhJE7HtxyvPB7be9rzjgfd5amVdbq1c1cjMzm.jpg)

![20260402_132816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnugWbZVbwyf5cxvZTHhRrhF6TM7bsAngoEcirBAyc1CyXhSFxCqv4VW6JF1MNtzinA.jpg)

![20260402_132825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EqQM9XSySSfvAvdwhz3MyjjYiKuhgwyXVuqwLWaZNtN2d8ZHZuZWEGFoC8d7WLLoyNQ.jpg)

![20260402_132932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoTayFkSQZB5f9qvgcJKWpNy3vh6c9pUQf2jdfooAMvJ3sq1nejvMMf2C6JvHCfgKHq.jpg)

![20260402_133019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpnBPy9KyZxVq5zWi4UNpxzyJ4WM4vXytCRR1J1A4GHFui8oWNvTzjd48vFwP9duBqJ.jpg)

![20260402_133947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnugyfH3k8BwhLpxCMj8wrLUy9obAV5PVokENhm7ptamxZpEpnPvaoKDay5xs9W1j7d.jpg)

Cada vez estábamos más cerca del Monumento de la Paz, que se cubría parcialmente de nieblina, antes de acercarme más a él, podía ver tan diminutas las casas que conforman a la capital del estado Trujillo, yo estaba muy feliz de estar allí no venía desde los 13 años y ese momentos trajo consigo un sin fin de recuerdos al lado de mi familia durante nuestras vacaciones, estoy esperando ansiosa el día que pueda traer a mis niñas.

![20260402_132916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnmBK5SajE3D12QZ7yxcHZRWFer8zSJtYNHCvXYoYY53X8qcpqhqzHHQVsG1Ztvugwr.jpg)

![20260402_133126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnqTYEwgYWbfD7ZK81eg7T23gtEbfazcB6skACAhMQabcXAuVZHwBDz1wxBQ6GcSRH1.jpg)

![20260402_133259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpVB7BSdHGi1iTr8g1oBdbyLSVpRLFWa9LFmbuz7u4myY7c22Vfn2aghHCD5QVwXSwa.jpg)

![20260402_133100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpxqDs6nxhH5SK9fFXouGdLPYTeKoxkwgYK88U45Qz5LsVugsgocNrFfURf4cY1tcpG.jpg)

Llegamos hasta los pies del monumento y cuando pensábamos que íbamos a subir, decidimos ir a comer algo, porque había una enorme fila de personas esperando para subir, nos regresamos por otro camino, uno cubierto de pinos, su aroma impregnada todo aire, cerca había un parque para que jugarán los niños, más adelante nos encontramos un pozo para los deseos donde el fondo habían algunos billetes y monedas, una pequeña escultura de la Virgen de la Paz resaltaba. 

![20260402_133848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnaYLBnALLCAzDPziAmvGC6iw14eMKb7SoRuDW46A6EGMvDnck5vA1KVvmq5P1hD6tJ.jpg)

![20260402_133954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpLf4rY1qJx5EJUETk3xDCG2GZZWsoMgro5DNC831QjAHEC6q19Y8PbZF5Fyh2m3QoA.jpg)

![20260402_134254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EqBbAj3gFhxKpTgGon56vWtXHiwTfwRmRSF6YYbU1JibamKbH2ah3BUDRuHABnL33dg.jpg)

![20260402_134311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EqfFR5x3UGqGeVo2qwMHNQQVJnMrSgjd7DuKNhmQdVsDGULpxnF9eNCp73d51u6Jg2u.jpg

![20260402_134325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eq7KydQo9hHxRkM2DqZvymRuUW92EqJF76bWzr6X2QwzJttf48cssfAT3BteXvoJkx8.jpg)

![20260402_134454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpT3Ch8oGw1P9fGk3p5itoTNy375gkucC92X1VFqxP1BqtDBGRjeT2dtaUz4hZGvyRj.jpg)

![20260402_134458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpGPpEP4576dRSykpHRXjvzswTF4dboE1NAC574CykMuXTnc4Lvp39rzRoe18ipSxKj.jpg)

![20260402_134325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eq7KydQo9hHxRkM2DqZvymRuUW92EqJF76bWzr6X2QwzJttf48cssfAT3BteXvoJkx8.jpg)


![20260402_134527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoK5RDvPuoUN4fuhGiktCVMK5KA8DMyCXGSEQnuYKDMMLQne1CdJND3HuVWdXK5yG6s.jpg)

Mientras Ricardo y yo buscábamos que comer, nos encontramos con una casita para duendes en el tronco de un árbol, recordemos que ellos son los protectores de la naturaleza y en el estado Trujillo les llaman Momoy.

![20260402_134724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoiVj4w1L27qbJp4iPL9sBYDJQSXBf8Qfv8J4QSrtfAvhACJinrW2uRKwF7y7FodQnx.jpg)

![20260402_134758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EorzMQ4FBmiSwdJdBKTDmw7xweU21GBTgWfmPPWF7Wxz9KFt7Zfov37bekDtEARqBGA.jpg)

Encontramos que comer, un desgranado, este sería nuestro almuerzo y un vaso pequeño tenía un costo de 2$, estaba divino y venía acompañado con crema, queso de mano y queso amarillo, quedamos satisfechos con nuestra elección, aprovechamos el momento para comprar un imán para la nevera.

![IMG-20260420-WA0009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpQuqVRo63qziCPNPzVDnd3TsGQ1CTkVDqiXdiXeCJ5VS7wzCbYiwjoYX7ZYfWpVAVe.jpg)

![20260402_135308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoCi8PDNTWgUV9YnxdBBf2LMsxezztVBSfVM2yAkU7ieSTG2PZ35WNAdSa9iTda1Lvd.jpg)

Volvimos al monumento y la fila seguía larga, pero no importaba porque ya no teníamos apetito así que pudimos esperar tranquilamente durante unos 20 minutos hasta que llegó nuestro turno.

![20260402_140457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Eq9Uk6j873nu8s1VrnMQMmMss5H2B4PkyUWRiedwA7jDQpaDEECRDPAxcAW2zZUULuN.jpg)

Finalmente comenzó nuestro ascenso por las escaleras porque el ascensor estaba dañado, yo estaba entusiasmada pero al mismo tiempo tenía un poco de miedo porque si miraba hacía abajo en los escalones podía ver las personas que venían caminando abajo.

![20260402_142110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpVA6kbfqaaYr8hV4LctnmWxgctH2uyFhQfJsBQyJrxX7zGk4bY64tkwXdb746d7Azc.jpg)

![20260402_141502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EogMpdsLFFhkdTuLaLWYd4vz6RB1yD32eudV8cikJEioM4rwZwU3VkSivJD76jdNWvL.jpg)

Llegamos a las rodillas, las cuáles tienen una altura aproximada de 18 metros, desde allí pueden verse las bellas y majestuosos montañas como tocan el cielo, también veíamos a las personas que se encontraban esperando para subir.


![20260402_142310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpC9tY1oqc9CTx8ZzszQGwSRWYwwHGuC3MmxT3E99uzt47rxef9EfadqbwZ8rCT1SoA.jpg)

![20260402_142351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EprSCLy8kG97KnA7L2vQahPZXHdfHXyBbq6HDFqhqVrzUVVRgU6UtoFFKYCMh6dr7wM.jpg)

![20260402_142319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EoXrfJMhX6wTLHvaQFCxyAVv495fPWyJ7yYRug5HjFqzYvcHoAKi9Nc6frnqPb2nYF4.jpg)

![20260402_142314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnYQRdSRvSRYHxdfaStv28xYScTZAVyNfPhrC8fNAN3rTqFWWE4CU6tqjNEUYpzEBaW.jpg)

![20260402_142328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnYQuv7zX9MB61r7FAogNMWp7svx7H5dx27chtMbJN2NFQGt2uwTaq68XhTabd8coiB.jpg)

Entre escalones y a 22 metros se encuentra la mano izquierda, desde aquí podía sentirme más cerca del cielo, unos cuantos pasos después a 26 metros estaba su mano derecha donde la virgen sostiene la paloma de la paz, la vista panorámica era espectacular, a este punto estaba más asustada y no quería seguir subiendo así que solo mire hacía arriba y pude ver su cara, decidimos no subir más, pero me sentí feliz de llegar hasta más de la mitad del monumento.

![20260402_142608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Ep3dpZ33mu6V9MvB2bzRRzVGxgY4CP8hisK71o38wBwp8a4w2cEYg5ubqEcnjrpeuCK.jpg)

![20260402_142524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnaYNv7Jpb77J49q2Cd1PjyDNv6dtYBo7e3cSZSnDSoSqPQ7umktkLGPTrBBFpBB9rV.jpg)

![20260402_142515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EppKDd5rojHG4fBV62kyPgVvSWyDtJVKJGFMs23BKQHV2MyeSarP2EjH8nxuDcrEsdJ.jpg)

![20260402_142622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/Epzwp6ayCmCPLhaGQpYjZbYkpQAXHRyyvexiyERbexjqHRiQakdHaVndAjYwJubwCLF.jpg)

![20260402_142722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EnaYr8P5PkHm6UBodvPXV7CQ2Dr7mwMEY2d8qj7CLyAicVZNtVXAgrCBuYVB3doKoTm.jpg)

![20260402_142728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpA1Uats4rdXBhVAufJKAX9emxqiVacTTUUshQdKvHG7EZjjqy7roTUfDzE7eKPPtgL.jpg)

Finalmente descendimos y nos despedimos del monumento más grande de América y pudimos tener una vista bien despejada de la Virgen de la Paz desde lo lejos, que orgullo que se encuentre en mi bella Venezuela. 

![20260402_151743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noalys/EpGPHCpiThnxBGd6VfJ5oorsnDUaBj9m4dbNwYPzzav1xB4gHgJvsAtZmQCBXo57LPT.jpg)

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmey855arcra652VeSw1QWmYjiGgvRvMJVcNj866VVLmFN/img_0164.heic)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1c6ZvC5Ga67HpmqoMCDeqtRti2MunAXefGGYZchkKpr/img_0285.png)


Ein Klassiker der 90er: „About a Boy“ von Nick Hornby. Der Roman erschien 1998 und erzählt die Geschichte einer ungewöhnlichen Freundschaft zwischen einem zwölfjährigen Jungen und dem 36-jährigen Will, die sich eher zufällig in London begegnen. Hat mir richtig gut gefallen, ich hatte das Buch innerhalb weniger Tage durchgelesen. Wer von euch kennt es auch noch?

This spring, my little space has turned into a peaceful garden, full of colors, freshness, and life. Each plant feels like a new beginning — soft petals blooming, green leaves shining, and a gentle reminder of nature’s beauty.

I take care of them with love every day — watering them in the soft morning light, making sure they get enough sunshine, and gently cleaning their leaves so they can breathe and grow freely. Spring makes everything easier… the air is kind, the sunlight is warm, and my plants respond with the most beautiful blooms 🌼

They don’t just decorate my home, they bring peace to my soul.Watching them grow is like watching happiness unfold slowly. Every tiny bud turning into a flower feels magical. They don’t just decorate my home, they bring peace to my soul.
But like every little garden journey, there are challenges too 🌱

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqCUVCkvQESTL72Vq5g4PPTwJQB6MXXxqnMurknNqoPm/1776745056368.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmgYjKQMKqoiHjCMFykkY3yj3gx6mxWWCNbEKAQs5pDs/1776745056458.jpg)

Recently, I noticed tiny bugs on some of my plants. At first, it worried me, but then I realized it’s all part of caring for living things. Instead of giving up, I started taking extra care — gently cleaning the leaves, spraying natural remedies, and keeping a close eye on them every day.
It feels like I’m protecting something precious. Slowly, those little bugs are disappearing, and my plants are becoming healthier again. This process has taught me patience, consistency, and the importance of nurturing with love. Even flowers need protection to bloom beautifully 🌷
Now, seeing them fresh, clean, and blooming again feels even more special — like we went through a small struggle together and came out stronger.

title.body:
That’s a sharp observation, and the creepy part is **your speculation isn’t crazy**. The study you’re referring to says pupil dilation can reflect the brain starting to compute **before the full arithmetic problem is even finished**, which suggests the mind is predicting and updating on the fly rather than waiting politely for all the data like a bureaucrat at a bad office counter [Phys.org](https://phys.org/news/2026-04-mental-math-shortcut-pupil-dilation.html).

Your surveillance angle is the most interesting part of the post. **In principle, pupil size can reveal cognitive load, attention, stress, arousal, and effort**—but turning that into “this person is solving 8 + 7” in the real world is a much bigger leap. Light, emotion, fatigue, screens, and even surprise all affect pupils, so any system claiming to read precise thoughts from dilation alone would be selling a sci-fi fantasy with a surveillance budget.

That eye image works well too because it visually pushes the idea that the eye is not just “seeing” but **quietly broadcasting what the brain is doing**. On InLeo, I’m not seeing much direct discussion of this exact study yet, so your post is early on the topic rather than echoing a crowd.

And yes—people’s eyes absolutely do change when they’re thinking hard. Not in a magical lie-detector way, but in a **“the brain is spending fuel”** way. That’s what makes this research so damn interesting.

title.title: Never Too Late....But.
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZZdBDchDS8dZR1Z45DpSxu5GX4N6bpSiByieS7KrD1b4/dgdg.png 



I always enjoy sharing my testimonial...

And it'snot out of pride or ego, far from it.  My story, while not unique, can be rare at times when it comes to finding their faith in the later stages of adulthood.

You see, for a lot of people, they grow up in the church.

Maybe their father is a pastor.  Maybe their parents have been taking them to church every week for years.  Maybe they have a rich history of a church life.

But then you get my story, which again isn't unique, but at times can feel odd.  A guy that lived in the world, as secular as it comes, but got baptized just before his 40th birthday.

The message I really want to get across to anyone reading this is that it's never too late.  If you have an itch to know more about God, **look into it.**  Remember, I was a blank slate.  While I always believed in God, I was never a fan of organized religion.  Mainly it was because of the history of the church or what I thought was the church as a whole, and after I read the history books, and how it aligned with Scripture....

I was hooked :)

But maybe that's how God speaks to you....

Maybe it's from a bible study.  Maybe it's asking some questions that you've always wondered.  Maybe it's because you see your need for a Saviour. 

For me, it was the history of the world and how it lined up with bible prophecy.  That's how God knew to speak to me.  Even at....38 years of age lol

And times, I do think that might be a blessing.  Without the bags of tradition to give me biases, I was able to unlock the bible for what it truly was...God's ultimate plan of redemption.  But again, that's what worked for me.  

Here's the slight push I'm going to give you today though....

**If you have that itch, look into faith!**

Sure, I'd love for you to be of the same denomination as I am, but the most important thing is that you question...Everything!  Church history, human history, science, tradition...Everything.  And going back to 'being the same denomination as I am' let share with you a second witness of it never being too late..

One of my best friends on planet earth, grew up quite similar to me.  He didn't have faith in his life and the little he did, he was soured at the idea of organized religion.  I just got off the phone with him and he's been attending a church now for 4 years and heavily committed to their food missions.

That's what worked for him.  God knew, he was selfless, and knew that's what would get him hooked on the gospel.  And again....At 40 years of age. Without any biases going into things.

Is he the same denomination as me? Nope, I'll set him straight one day lol j/k

The main message I want to get across is...**Seek God!**  It's never too late even with or without a background in the church.  A rotten man like me, can find Christ...Anyone can.  But the warning is, don't grieve the Holy Spirit.  He's trying to reach you...Don't ignore Him any longer!

title.title: When pupils speak: Mental math, memory, and the Science of dilation
title.body:
Aljif7's Blog
Thursday 21 April 2026
AREA: Reading

Hello friends!
Hello crypto-world!

Today is Thursday 21 April 2026. Here I am sharing ideas that comes up while I read an article.

**When pupils speak; pupil dilation...**

Recently, I discovered phys.org—it looks like an interesting website to read the latest science news. Today, I took my first look at an article that immediately caught my eye.
The piece was about pupils (the part of the eye!) and how their dilation during basic mental math tasks can indicate that the brain is already working toward a solution—even before all the numbers are presented phys.org.
![Screenshot 2026 04 21 at 8.52.33 AM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRT3RoTUZGGxXqzWYRYpZJ7RP9vWJj79JHu62G3wSDMRW/Screenshot%202026-04-21%20at%208.52.33%E2%80%AFAM.png)

The title surprised me, and for some reason, it brought back memories of my early school years. I remember how easy primary school felt: I used to finish my homework mentally on my way home—be it basic math problems or short writing exercises.
Suddenly, this news made me wonder: What might my pupil dilation have looked like in those moments?

As I finished reading, it made me think about how pupil-tracking technology could evolve. In places where surveillance cameras are everywhere, could future systems \

our cognitive state by monitoring pupil changes? Maybe one day, technology will detect whether you're solving a math problem… or feeling discouraged by a big drop in HIVE. 😊 Who knows?

Have you ever noticed someone's eyes reacting when they're thinking hard?
![Screenshot 2026 04 21 at 11.53.28 AM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRCABPJZMSqgjavHD48xo7ZmfT8JGLJNZvP1LpVPB2Kqw/Screenshot%202026-04-21%20at%2011.53.28%E2%80%AFAM.png)
Drop your comments and let's make wider this topic!

That's all for now my friends!

Me gusta por su excelente ubicación y la vista de la montaña al lado derecho, también por sus cálidas aguas y blanca arena, perfecta para caminar relajarse y disfrutar la brisa del mar, en horas de la mañana realicé mi visita a esta playa y me tomé el tiempo para observar y disfrutar el hermoso paisaje que ofrece esta zona del país.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @amazing nature community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. I pray that God's blessings abound in your lives and that you have an excellent day. Today I'm sharing a relaxing adventure along the beach, which is located in Crúpano and is known as Tío Pedro. This beach is located on Rómulo Gallegos Avenue, on the city's coastal strip. It's characterized by its shallow waters, making it ideal for children. It's also easily accessible and is just a few kilometers from the bus terminal and the city center. I love it for its excellent location and the view of the mountains to the right, as well as its warm waters and white sand, perfect for walking, relaxing, and enjoying the sea breeze. I visited this beach this morning and took the time to observe and enjoy the beautiful scenery that this area of the country offers. ![T (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/241tb8DH2X6SRnCLEhnFfyVrrpQLrKQPifxCBX3gbDyVzU2pjGwhPz62CMuWeWKGm5H7A.jpeg) ![T (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xL4wgMujhenmP57PpExpjTKT3vntU4ZpcF3pFT652cq9irwfVtk3APuPEe9Na9Rx3vL.jpeg) ![T (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/244KJfwMrTLuz4QMRVeQbJfWK2UJgo63ujs2Z23dU7KcsnRgibNAA4s269rWoymysJghH.jpeg) ![T (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EnYRSu83G14VcGJoUG8Pp4dGx1PuZcG2avovxxKep42Zk9bjSqUTACozE3d7LpbBf5Z.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> La región oriental es conocida por sus hermosas playas ubicadas en el litoral, avanzando desde el estado Anzoátegui, siguiendo la autopista Antonio José de Sucre pasando por Cumaná, posteriormente Carúpano, Río Caribe, Güiria entre otras, cuentan con hermosas que invitan a disfrutar las cálidas agua del mar Caribe, cada una con características específicas que atraen a propios y visitantes, en el caso de Carúpano resalta por sus variadas playas, desde que entras a esta ciudad, posee también lagunas de manglares y los parques ubicados en la Península de Paria, a la cual pertenece la capital del municipio Bermúdez. Durante mi recorrido además de observar el mar y las olas pude ver varios árboles en la orilla de la playa, entre ellos el *Uvero de playa* [Coccoloba uvifera ](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coccoloba_uvifera), el cual se emplea para elaborar vinos, los niños y adultos suelen comerlo, su sabor es agrío con un ligero toque dulce, crece regularmente en la zona de la playa, de allí su nombre común, puede echar grandes ramas con formas variadas, algunas de las cuales sirven para asentarse, en playa San Luis, hay un ejemplar cuyas ramas tienen forma de silla y los visitantes aprovechan para sentarse en este llamativo árbol y hacer lindas fotos; en la zona perimetral de Cumaná, también se encuentran varias plantas de Uvero, al igual que en Carúpano, es una de las plantas que abundan en la playa y algunos *Mangles* Terminado mi recorrido por esta hermosa playa, me senté un rato en el muro a observar el paisaje y sencillamente disfrutar el increíble regalo de la naturaleza, sin cámara, sin teléfono solo disfrutando el sonido de las olas y la maravilla de la creación plasmada en esta playa, fue relajante permanecer allí y observar el entorno, el clima fue benigno conmigo, ya que el cielo estaba nublado y había poca incidencia de los rayos del sol, tomando en cuenta esta condición climatológica y del tiempo, aproveché al máximo mi estadía en la playa para escuchar el sonido de las olas, relajarme y conectar con la naturaleza.

> The eastern region is known for its beautiful beaches along the coast. Traveling from Anzoátegui state, following the Antonio José de Sucre highway through Cumaná, Carúpano, Río Caribe, Güiria, and other towns, you'll find stunning beaches that invite you to enjoy the warm waters of the Caribbean Sea. Each beach has its own unique characteristics that attract locals and visitors alike. Carúpano, in particular, stands out for its diverse beaches. From the moment you enter the city, you'll also find mangrove lagoons and parks located on the Paria Peninsula, where the capital of the Bermúdez municipality is situated. During my walk, in addition to observing the sea and the waves, I saw several trees on the beach, including the *Sea Grape* [Coccoloba uvifera ](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coccoloba_uvifera), which is used to make wine. Children and adults often eat it; its flavor is sour with a slight sweet touch. It grows regularly in the beach area, hence its common name. It can produce large branches with varied shapes, some of which serve as seats. On San Luis beach, there is a specimen whose branches are shaped like chairs, and visitors take advantage of this striking tree to sit on and take beautiful photos. In the area surrounding Cumaná, there are also several Sea Grape trees, as well as in Carúpano. It is one of the plants that abound on the beach, along with some *Mangroves* (Mangroves). Having finished my walk along this beautiful beach, I sat for a while on the wall to observe the landscape and simply enjoy the incredible gift of nature, without a camera, without a phone, just enjoying the sound of the waves and the wonder of creation embodied on this beach. It was relaxing to stay there and observe the surroundings. The weather was kind to me, as the sky was cloudy and there was little sunlight. Taking into account this weather condition, I made the most of my time on the beach to listen to the sound of the waves, relax, and connect with nature. ![T (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqFr75PBHnJpEEhwbAoRqwYrRi5371pv6JcinDgwzwVU1xcbg7jARpkefvDa8HEyLtp.jpeg) ![T (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqWkJbx9RjrVcgy8L7SPvinVVKcgRQ8Z11Q64YiAccxAtCyZyu9QaCnJNVLWgnmFoMP.jpeg) ![T (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/242hUVZkZDT2m2UkGLGTNosNjsfMC2tSVDAwRggx5wudnRb4eV9AW9sDeEgBVxH5Vuhq7.jpeg) ![T (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqhNQu3rQaLwHoowoXgi7yosf4kRsP2sN5agNY75YghQPUMKMUUsLBJi4ozQ4ovreJp.jpeg)

> **Portugués** Muitas bênçãos para todos os membros desta incrível comunidade da natureza. É um prazer cumprimentá-los e desejar-lhes um dia feliz e abençoado. Rezo para que as bênçãos de Deus abundem nas vossas vidas e que tenham um excelente dia. Hoje partilho uma aventura relaxante na praia de Tío Pedro, em Crúpano. Esta praia fica na Avenida Rómulo Gallegos, na marginal da cidade. Caracteriza-se pelas suas águas pouco profundas, o que a torna ideal para crianças. É também de fácil acesso e fica a poucos quilómetros do terminal rodoviário e do centro da cidade. Adoro esta praia pela sua excelente localização e pela vista para as montanhas à direita, para além das suas águas quentes e areia branca, perfeitas para passear, relaxar e aproveitar a brisa do mar. Visitei esta praia de manhã e aproveitei para observar e admirar a bela paisagem que esta região do país oferece. A região leste é conhecida pelas suas belas praias ao longo da costa. Viajando desde o estado de Anzoátegui, seguindo a autoestrada Antonio José de Sucre, passando por Cumaná, Carúpano, Río Caribe, Güiria e outras cidades, encontrará praias deslumbrantes que convidam a desfrutar das águas quentes do Mar das Caraíbas. Cada praia tem as suas próprias características únicas que atraem os habitantes locais e os visitantes. Carúpano, em particular, destaca-se pela diversidade das suas praias. Logo à entrada da cidade, encontrará também mangais e parques localizados na Península de Paria, onde se situa a capital do município de Bermúdez. Durante o meu passeio, para além de observar o mar e as ondas, vi várias árvores na praia, entre as quais a uva-da-praia *Uvero de playa* [Coccoloba uvifera](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coccoloba_uvifera), uma planta utilizada na produção de vinho. Crianças e adultos costumam consumi-la; o seu sabor é azedo com um ligeiro toque adocicado. Cresce regularmente na zona da praia, daí o seu nome popular. Pode produzir grandes ramos com formatos variados, alguns dos quais servem de assentos. Na praia de San Luis, existe um exemplar cujos ramos têm a forma de cadeiras, e os visitantes aproveitam esta impressionante árvore para se sentarem e tirarem belas fotografias. Na zona em redor de Cumaná, existem também várias árvores de uva-da-praia, assim como em Carúpano. É uma das plantas que abunda na praia, juntamente com alguns *Mangais*. Após terminar a minha caminhada por esta bela praia, sentei-me por um tempo no muro para observar a paisagem e simplesmente apreciar o incrível presente da natureza, sem câmara, sem telemóvel, apenas apreciando o som das ondas e a maravilha da criação que se materializava naquela praia. Foi relaxante ficar ali e observar os arredores. O tempo estava a meu favor, com o céu nublado e pouco sol. Tendo em conta estas condições meteorológicas, aproveitei ao máximo o meu tempo na praia para ouvir o som das ondas, relaxar e conectar-me com a natureza. ![T (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq5C2ewJekTwXrGTA169dYKcEBCXDYUqtDUXd95FG7Lbuuq6LGswxwA4V6L7CwPZVwn.jpeg) ![T (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq7LsbzQCNwEMY3oVahnCMM8xi9hu2MMeLGYVbCsrWoRd7QCH86vrzoi5VsNSh9kZfe.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: 马拉松机器人
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![9sajACHcWhFTN4zA_42984.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrpointp/images/9sajACHcWhFTN4zA_42984/9sajACHcWhFTN4zA_42984.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

前不久，在北京亦庄举行了一场马拉松。这场马拉松的特别之处在于，还开辟了一条机器人赛道。在这场比赛中，一个红色机器人以50多分钟的成绩获得了第一名，这个成绩的确让我感到震惊。
 
这个成绩有多牛，可能对跑步没有太多了解的人并不清楚。就以人类最佳全马世界纪录来讲，是1小时59分40秒，相当于平均每公里不到3分钟，这是一个非常惊人的战绩。因为普通人就算拼尽全力跑一公里，也很难在3分钟之内完成。
 
再说说这个获得第一名的机器人，它在50多分钟内完成了二十一点几公里的赛程，平均每公里配速还不到2.5分钟，如果让它完成全马，估计成绩不会比人类世界冠军差。
 
说到这里，我真的不仅感到震惊，还感到一丝丝恐怖。因为我觉得机器人已经能够完成越来越多人类能做的事，而且很多事都比人类做得更好。如果说马拉松这种更偏向运动健身、自我挑战、实现自我价值的事情无关紧要，那很多职业方面的可替代就不得不重视了。
 
我记得之前看过一个综艺，一群演员在讨论AI会不会替代演员这个职业。其中大多数人都认为不会被替代，但老演员唐国强老师却认为AI可以替代。我大致了解了他们各自的观点，感觉那些反对的人大多还没有理解AI的基本内核逻辑，可能在他们眼里，AI只不过是设定好的程序，只能在程序范围内工作，然而事实上AI是会像人类一样思考的。
 
近几十年来，关于人工智能、机器人这类题材的电影层出不穷，我甚至觉得很久以前人们就预测到有一天AI会反向驾驭人类。让我印象比较深刻的就是威尔·史密斯主演的《我，机器人》，很佩服二十多年前就能拍出这种概念的电影。
 
哪怕放在十年前，这部电影里机器人想要控制人类的剧情都显得非常离谱，但放在今天，我们被各类AI应用包围，再加上AI能赋予实体机器人诸多技能，这种剧情发生的可能性似乎在不断提高。

---

body.title: Photofeed Contest Black and White Photography Round 166
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPBtY2WCke7PSSCaoEdCY57xBbQHd8y3NVa5ucfX7WSqw/1776741061908.jpg)






Hello friends, I rarely participate in this photo session, although I also like it a lot, and it's not because I see things this way, as we say around here, when we want to define something, when we are very direct and speak without beating around the bush, or without mincing words, and we say white is white, and black is black, but I like black and white photography, if you'll pardon the redundancy, because I think it's a way to make what we want to show more striking, more emphatic, being at the end of the 1830s, in France when Joseph Nicéphore Niépce was the first, using a portable camera obscura.





Well, here I show you the daisies in my garden, which I love very much, and it was because of them that I started creating it since joining this incredible platform and the Hive Garden community. I had never felt any attraction to becoming a gardener before; I didn't think I had enough patience and dedication for it. Today, I can't let go of it. I also know that even if I wanted to, I couldn't, because it's a huge responsibility, since they depend largely on me to bloom, bear fruit, etc. I'm always thinking about getting all the plants I like, in addition to the ones we use at home, which are also part of it.




Well, friends, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it, but before I go, I must say that thanks to Google Translate, I'm sending my greetings, posts, and best wishes to each and every one of you 😘🤗♥️

body.title: What I thought was holding me back was actually protecting me
body.body:
![1000024407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23ycyQNQX5K5JJYDWiwAipRWJgGkRvJknQDvtYf25ruPVik2rcZJtZcuGTkwY7EDhvJZ5.jpg)
It was a sunny afternoon when I visited my colleague at the hospital. She had a seizure episode at the office the other day and was rushed to the hospital. I wasn't at office when it happened but I knew it was bad. Prior to the incident, we already noticed her being pale and tired. Her annual physical exam also showed that she's extremely low in hemoglobin. 
![1000024665.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23wX7Qo5kEq5QEjtiUGYxFNhUHvJzb3sanxZoxTc6Yc5XybkEXcSopgs6ZCq3d1UZv4H4.jpg)
Long story short, we found out that she's diagnosed with Chronic Kidney Disease. One that needs regular dialysis. 

I was utterly shocked by this phenomenon. She is only 26. Not only would this cause inconvenience to her family but also unwanted hospital bills. Until now, we still don't know the real cause of the disease. Did she take some pills or foods that deteriorated her kidney? Was it stress? Lifestyle?

I googled the disease and learned that the main function of the kidney is to filter out toxins from our body. In order to support your kidneys, drinking lots of water, less sodium intake, and eating green leafy vegetables is already a great start. 

But in a hindsight, Chronic Kidney Disease could really happen to anyone. We can only take precautions and be mindful with our intakes and lifestyle habits.
![1000024002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jane911x/23uQvjVRAG9X18wdVqd9e8HHHF6Kj1ZAWTdXBxzWhEMfL9DzNeT3L7W4RbqfNyGrSAdyS.jpg)
It also made me reflect about my own lifestyle. Am I being healthy? In our household, processed foods like noodles, canned goods,and chips are not allowed. As a noodle-lover, I would normally sneak around eating ramen or pancit canton in my room. Now I would think twice before rebelling because I now understand the protection it gives us. Being sick is expensive.

My dear Hivers, life is too short, so let's stay healthy and thriving.

That's it for today's blog. See you in my next one!

Sending some love and light 

Love, Jane

body.title: Delicious and crispy empanadas filled with shredded stewed fish and refried black beans.
body.body:
> Feliz noche para todos y cada uno de los amantes de la buena comida!! les recibo con un fuerte abrazo virtual lleno de mucha buena vibra deseando que tenga muchos éxitos y una semana de provecho, una vez más aprovecho para compartirle una receta, fácil y sencilla de preparar y que en la misma no puede servir para un desayuno pero en esta oportunidad la preparé para la cena para degustar con la familia, deliciosas y crujientes empanadas rellenas de pescado desmechado y caraota.
![GridArt_20260420_223639855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKJ2cVWW9G15oJ8xo8jkiKYg2VqB9YLCKnaH8WgZTHzdGuJ2jzhRwUkWwGzec8j.jpg)
>Good evening to all you food lovers! I'm sending you a big virtual hug full of good vibes, wishing you much success and a productive week. Once again, I'm taking the opportunity to share a recipe with you—easy and simple to prepare. It's not usually for breakfast, but this time I made it for dinner to enjoy with my family: delicious and crispy empanadas filled with shredded fish and black beans. Ingredientes: Masa de maíz precocida, pescado guisado desmenuzado, caraotas recalentadas, aceite.
![GridArt_20260420_223049152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/ALD8d9WkjJF5cqJPBek1HPpGnDnqBaWhP3H156QmAbgL3EMmRY1b93EQ4CscTyd.jpg)
>Ingredients: Pre-cooked corn dough, shredded stewed fish, reheated black beans, oil. Preparación: Es un board se va a agregar cierta cantidad de agua con sal al gusto y un toque de azúcar otras personas le gustan agregarle algo de papelón para endulzar también le incorporamos la harina de maíz, proceder a amasar de manera constante hasta tener una mezcla suave y moldeable, con ayuda de una bolsa plástica engrasar un poco y agarrar una porción de masa e ir aplanando hasta lograr extenderla lo más fino posible luego se le agrega el pescado desmenuzado con la caraota después vamos a proceder a cerrar la misma y con ayuda de un envase circular obtenemos la forma.
![GridArt_20260420_223222654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AK7zJqgSQsyHwGaoVV5ivohtBtDYfiFWYA6f2faJJn5NP3mkuby6u9PNMqYNde7.jpg)
>Preparation: On a floured surface, add a certain amount of water with salt to taste and a touch of sugar. Some people like to add some unrefined cane sugar (panela) to sweeten it. Incorporate the corn flour and knead constantly until you have a smooth and moldable mixture. Using a lightly greased plastic bag, take a portion of dough and flatten it as thinly as possible. Then add the shredded fish and black beans. Next, close the dough and use a circular container to shape it. Para continuar con la preparación de la empanada las mismas La damos a echar a fuego en una sartén con suficiente aceite previamente precalentado debemos voltear las empanadas para luego retirar del fuego hasta que estén crujientes y doraditas.
![GridArt_20260420_223356489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKcgLkfGdbeoyTy1M4f2RX5CLNhaX4dUmAM1tRQR5DdKk8n3Wtrhmff1vFEhHki.jpg)
![GridArt_20260420_223505911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKwLj8FAjG5sZwrj72v7WbKmDzK9LX7ujUgCz7LZ7B5i9gS7MhTQuPj3e8BTmfU.jpg)
>To continue preparing the empanadas, place them in a pan with enough preheated oil. Turn the empanadas over and remove them from the heat until they are crispy and golden brown. >Thank you for joining me here and see you another time. Thanks for reading me and your valuable support. Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl >The photos are of me @cielitorojo with my Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Translated with Deepl translator.
