body.title: 社牛間的較勁
body.body: >Unsplash 晚上跟朋友們聊到聚餐的事情，有一位朋友R就有點小情緒來了，他講的理由是，主辦者沒有像以往給兩三個日子投票，而是直接決定日子，當然每個人在意的點都不一樣，我個人就覺得還好。 另一位朋友則是發言緩和，說辦這種活動雖然也不是甚麼難事，但要有心來辦，他說他曾經了解過，主辦者越辦越心累，所以就沒有管那麼多，直接訂下日子，如果有空來參加的就參加，沒空來的就下次參加。 後來隔了幾天，抱怨的朋友R不在場的時候，又有人提起這個話題，於是語音裡又討論了起來，得到了可能抱怨的那位朋友R有點忌妒心理，主辦者好像都是以另一個朋友M為主，這兩個都是社牛，所以有點私下較勁的意味。 其實在之前的聚會就有觀察到，主辦者跟M去日本滑雪回來的時候，主辦者就不斷吹捧M，當時R是個局外人，就開始有點那種吃味的情緒浮現，也許他覺得沒有很明顯，但是就是因為有些突兀，才會被人發覺。 其實R、M本來就是好朋友，我也不懂這種忌妒情緒是怎樣生成，也許是社牛間才有的瑜亮情節? 身為一個社交普通偏低的人來說，是比較不能夠理解的部分，看看之後事情會怎樣發展吧。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/65om5h)

body.title: [ESP-ING] St. Joseph Parish in Cagua
body.body:
width=472 height=49 border=0>
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.18708 lat -67.46051 long d3scr)

> Las iglesias siempre tienen un toque misterioso no se a mi me parece eso, no se si a otros les sucede, pero lo que también puedo ver es que me recuerdan a esas épocas de la Colonia, me recuerdan a pueblo y a personas con necesidad de buscar un poco de espiritualidad; esta iglesia fue fundada en 1879 y remodelada en el 2025 cuando reabrió sus puertas al público en general, fue remodelada por dentro y por fuera, preservando su estilo barroco.

> A la iglesia le sustituyeron el techo completo, todo de madera, al entrar se logra ver la profundidad del mismo que son como bovedas y ahora tienen unos ventiladores para refrescar un poco a todos aquellos feligreses que llegan a este santuario, aquí también hay algunas pinturas religiosas y las grandes columnas y algunos retablos dorados que transportan al pasado y dejam ver como hay un aire de majetuosidad que recuerdan las riquezas. Cada detalle a la entrada de la iglesia y dentro de ella son dignos de admirar, la entrada tiene dos puertas grandes, con pequeñas puntas doradas que llaman la atención y las columnas blancas grandes y con toques dorados invitan a admirar la belleza arquitectónica que ha sido creada con tanto esmero. Esta es la iglesia principal de cagua y al entrar pude ver algunas personas que van rezar según sus creencias y a pedir con fe, algo que siempre me ha llamado la atención es que estas iglesias grandes y principales siempre están abiertas y eso es bueno porque muchas personas recurren allí en cualquier momento en busca de consuelo y pueden encontrarlo.

> Las bancas son de maderas, de esas antiguas que se pueden ver hasta en las películas, pero es bonito ver cosas de épocas, las columnas y arcos que aquí se encuentran hacen una decoración especial para darle un toque perfecto a esta iglesia, los arcos tienen unos bordes que llaman mucho la atención, están como en relieve, y en medio del arco una lámpara y en las paredes existen varias figuras representativas eclesiásticas que dan armonía y espiritualidad al lugar.

> Me pareció que el podio o la parte principal es bastante sencilla, pero me llamo mucho la atención cuando iba saliendo es que en la puerta principal en la parte de arriba hay una especie de terraza que ve hacia el frente, y aunque no se parecía muy bien en la foto hay como una ventaba vitral, se ve muy bonito, este fue mi pequeño recorrido por esta iglesia de San José de Cagua.

It was renovated both inside and out, preserving its Baroque style. > >

> > >The church had its entire roof replaced; all made of wood. Upon entering, you can see the depth of the vaulted ceiling, and now there are fans to provide some relief to the parishioners who come to this sanctuary. Here, there are also some religious paintings, large columns, and gilded altarpieces that transport you to the past and reveal an air of grandeur reminiscent of former riches. > >Every detail at the church’s entrance and inside is worth admiring; the entrance has two large doors with small golden tips that catch the eye, and the large white columns with golden accents invite you to admire the architectural beauty that has been created with such care. > >This is the main church in Cagua, and upon entering, I saw people praying according to their beliefs and making requests with faith. Something that has always struck me is that these large, main churches are always open, and that is a good thing because many people turn to them at any time in search of comfort and can find it there. > >

> > >The pews are made of wood the kind of old-fashioned ones you see even in movies but it’s nice to see things from bygone eras; the columns and arches here create a unique decor that adds the perfect touch to this church. The arches have edges that really catch the eye they’re sort of embossed—and in the center of each arch is a lamp. On the walls, there are several religious figures that bring harmony and spirituality to the place. > >

> > >I thought the altar or main section was pretty simple, but what really caught my eye as I was leaving was that there’s a sort of terrace at the top of the main entrance that looks out toward the front. And even though it didn’t show up very well in the photo, there’s a stained-glass window there—it looks really beautiful. That was my little tour of the San José de Cagua church. > >

links.title: The Problem With Perfect
links.body:
I'm going to attempt to explain something that isn’t fully polished. I’m tempted to write about it anyway, because I suspect that the act of writing it might help me think it through.


![d253ac0d-57f3-43e8-93a5-812c2318c851.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23wqgR51AT9N2fNMfkateTKVrC9YWd9sbTvNZ6oNaBJm4PoUPqkhM5MX96ebKVNbhMV6s.png)


I want to preface this odd little post with a caveat of sorts. It’s not my intention to fight anyone, or to convince anyone that I’m right and they’re wrong. I’m simply putting into words the storm brewing in my head.

I’ve heard from plenty of people in my life that God is a perfect being. The word perfect is key to what follows, so I want to plant a flag there. Perfection, by necessity, implies rigidity—it cannot change. If something changes, then either it wasn’t perfect to begin with and is moving toward perfection, or it was perfect and the change moved it away from it. This matters for the rest of the thought.

When it comes to faith and theology, I’ve often been conflicted by the idea that morality is dictated by a holy book. Not because I can’t find good things in the Bible or the Quran—I obviously can—but because historically, interpretations of these texts have supported ideas that would be unacceptable in civil society today.

To put it plainly: slavery was once not only commonplace, but considered morally correct. The idea that some humans were lesser was treated as obvious truth. I’m grateful we’ve moved away from those barbaric beliefs, and that aside from fringe voices, no one seriously argues for their return. A practice, mind you, that was at times justified and guided by scripture.

Apologetics offers answers here, and for years I’ve been able to square that circle, at least temporarily. It’s not unreasonable to say that we, as flawed humans, misunderstood. That we evolved—if that’s the right word—in our moral understanding.

Recently, I learned that Jehovah’s Witnesses have updated their stance on blood transfusions. They now seem to allow them, but only if it’s your own blood that was stored beforehand. I suspect this may be a transitional position before fully accepting established medical science, but it illustrates my point.

As I said, for people of faith, this isn’t necessarily a problem. Many issues can be attributed to human error. But a new thought entered my mind while hearing this reasoning again.

Perfect. That word keeps coming back.

If God alone is perfect, then is the Bible perfect? Logically, it would seem not. That would explain the changes, the versions, the reinterpretations.

Sitting with a strong cup of coffee, turning this over in my mind, another thought surfaced:

>Am I to conclude that a perfect being can be an imperfect communicator?

Yes, we may be flawed listeners—limited, biased, prone to misunderstanding. But a perfect communicator would know how to overcome those limitations. It would know how to make things unmistakably clear to minds like ours.

I can’t say I’m in the same place I was the first time I heard the apologetic arguments about shifting morality versus a perfect source. But maybe because I’m older now, I find myself less bothered… and more fascinated.

—MenO

links.title: Making a salad with chicken, beets, potatoes, and cabbage.[Esp-Eng]
links.body:
#### <center> ¡Hola comunidad! </center>

#### <center> Hello community! </center>

<div class=\

>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido inicio de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, las ensaladas son muy saludables y rápidas de preparar, hoy les quiero compartir la receta de una ensalada de pollo, remolacha, papas y repollo ideal para acompañar con el contorno de nuestra preferencia y disfrutar en el almuerzo o cena, aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Happy and blessed start to the week! It’s a pleasure to share with you once again. Salads are very healthy and quick to prepare. Today I’d like to share a recipe for a chicken, beet, potato, and cabbage salad—perfect to serve with your favorite side dish and enjoy for lunch or dinner. Here’s a step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.

<hr>


![GridArt_20260418_201422328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoeHm4t6R8Hu14dQkDGEpXwqs74TuRMufvRtvxxNBSBZNBXmLubjNaQDjrgWRpU8Xa8.jpg)


<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoGyuyzqTRHbK41zdYgdErR8oh52UDwRs4XHT2Fxp1iFpLLpRim2GTixiGREKoS8Aj2.jpg - 1/2 pechuga - 2 remolachas - 3 papas - 150 gramos de repollo - 1 cebolla pequeña - Cilantro - Mayonesa - Mostaza - Miel - Sal al gusto >- 1/2 chicken breast >- 2 beets >- 3 potatoes >- 150 grams of cabbage >- 1 small onion >- Cilantro >- Mayonnaise >- Mustard >- Honey >- Salt to taste
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Para preparar esta ensalada lo primero que haremos es cocinar el pollo lo ponemos en una olla con agua que las cubra y le ponemos una ramita de celery y cocinamos hasta que ablande, dejamos enfriar y desmenuzamos, lavamos y cocinamos las remolachas y papas éstas yo las puse al vapor, pero si lo prefieren pueden sancocharlas, y las cortamos en cubos al igual que la remolacha; lavamos y desinfectamos el repollo y los picamos finamente. >To make this salad, the first thing we’ll do is cook the chicken: place it in a pot with enough water to cover it, add a sprig of celery, and cook until tender. Let it cool, then shred it. Wash and cook the beets and potatoes—I steamed them— but if you prefer, you can boil them, and cut them into cubes, just like the beets; wash and sanitize the cabbage and chop it finely.
![GridArt_20260418_202547865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoCj6wmiBuL5KkasuDQcNdTbDZumcVcyY8nH3RHB4eAEXnnqy7U5LjAbZmewQkRaF9h.jpg)
En un bol colocamos el pollo y le agregamos las papas junto con la remolacha, le colocamos el repollo, la cebolla y el cilantro que estamos finamente. >Place the chicken in a bowl and add the potatoes and beets, then add the finely chopped cabbage, onion, and cilantro.
![GridArt_20260418_202833617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoCm4cdAdyzE9NQR6wDD8W32UYontV6QM1EWFSvBgHJGwxNsE4DvcQQv3NyaD5CxvR7.jpg)
Aderezamos la ensalada con sal, mostaza, miel y mayonesa mezclamos y ya lista nuestra ensalada. >Season the salad with salt, mustard, honey, and mayonnaise, mix it all together, and your salad is ready.
![GridArt_20260418_203202446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eos2hgbj2asa1MYe6RkrL9SW5w9G4biWzRkH3eW85LZY8BqLb6gNu7avPiHHZxPLEg1.jpg)
Servimos la ensalada con el contorno de nuestra preferencia para disfrutarla en una cena o almuerzo. >Serve the salad with your favorite side dish to enjoy it for dinner or lunch.
![GridArt_20260418_201549579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EopvHq5woTNzHohicA9kkzdc2hSowDSKrmapSW7Qkzqta6vxwda5A1RfaZsuA2HDKXY.jpg)
Espero que esta sencilla receta que les comparto el día de hoy sea de su completo agrado hasta la próxima y muchas bendiciones. >I hope you enjoy this simple recipe I’m sharing with you today. Until next time, and many blessings.

body.title: Peace
body.body: https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTVp79tMjP1sDJYo1hPhb7qC8XtqJzpfaNcU9jemcMb4Z/17767437653671768722371087911487.png [source] (https://pixabay.com/photos/meditate-lake-mood-4882027/) I often find peace in that quiet moment of morning, when the first sunlight falls silently into the courtyard as if saying, “Stay energetic, don’t tire.” Sometimes I find peace in a drop of dew on a leaf, which, before falling, wants to encompass the entire sky in its transparency Sometimes I find peace hidden in the womb of a forest as an invisible footprint, which suddenly opens a silent path in the tangled recesses of my inner self, when I begin to wander within my own fear. I avoid wrongdoing lest this stream of love, which has flowed pure and peacefully for generations, becomes muddy in my hands. Peace isn't always present, but lets countless streams of affection flow through my life. Sometimes these streams shine as faith in the eyes of a stranger, sometimes in the silent waves of an old friend, sometimes in the touch of a blessing in the hands of an elder I fear that some mistake of mine might force these streams of affection to dry up. I fear that those whose silent prayers include my name, may stop rising for me. Thank you so much for reading. Have a great day 😊🙏 @vikbuddy Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vikbuddy/peace--8h9)

body.title: Starting the week with a balanced and healthy meal: baked potatoes 🥔 with pork and salad 🍅🥒
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz noche para todos, el día de hoy decidí iniciar la semana con un menú bastante balanceado; además muy saludable y por supuesto muy delicioso; no quise preparar pasta o arroz que es lo que tradicionalmente preparamos para el almuerzo; decidí cambiarlo por unas papas que cociné al horno sazonadas con orégano y la acompañé con una carne de cerdo asada en paila y una ensalada de tomate y pepino

> **
ENGLISH
** Good evening, everyone! Today I decided to start the week with a well-balanced meal—one that’s also very healthy and, of course, delicious. I didn’t want to make pasta or rice, which is what we usually have for lunch, so I decided to switch it up with some oven-roasted potatoes seasoned with oregano, served with pan-roasted pork and a tomato and cucumber salad. ![IMG_20260420_134252_348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMepnrsUkeER14mnEKSH93LgtjtUWxkHvGQDzoYwi9KcxT5M4YToWXVazDTZ9okoBhV.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** papas, carne de cerdo, orégano, sal, tomate, pepino

> **
INGREDIENTS
** potatoes, pork, oregano, salt, tomatoes, cucumbers ![IMG_20260420_112510_685.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Ep1XTfMcujX4ExaydkBkP4jFgWJkEXt7xNA85whpQm7Pr7rZs1baHkusjwfATmyo7AZ.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Después de lavar muy bien las papas, retiré la cáscara, la corté en trozos medianos, sazoné con sal, bastante orégano, un poco de aceite; mezclé muy bien, llevé a una bandeja y al horno a 180 grados por aproximadamente 50 minutos . Para la carne, la lavé muy bien, igualmente la sazoné con sal y orégano, llevé a cocinar volteando por ambos lados hasta que quedó dorada y acompañé con una ensalada de tomate y pepino la cual sazone con sal y un poco de mayonesa

> **
PROCEDURE
** After washing the potatoes thoroughly, I peeled them, cut them into medium-sized pieces, seasoned them with salt, plenty of oregano, and a little oil; I mixed them well, placed them on a baking sheet, and baked them at 180 degrees for about 50 minutes. For the meat, I washed it thoroughly, seasoned it with salt and oregano, and cooked it, turning it on both sides until it was browned. I served it with a tomato and cucumber salad, which I seasoned with salt and a little mayonnaise. ![Collage_2026-04-20_21_27_04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wCBmufn4Rx9MhV8zbn6f7kEirArj8WF8ECMZNgwT9Z8bgn261KXwhUSNKbNAaaq1m3r.jpg) ![Collage_2026-04-20_21_26_33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMcNfMS92UCtDNj4WfEDBZLFtYVHMVVDRvRwSkRzoN9SM4Qie4nBjuyZpt4YQFv3CzZ.jpg)
> Una vez listo, servimos y disfrutamos este menú acompañado de un vaso de jugo de mango. Espero haya sido de su agrado. Gracias por visitar mi blog ! Dios te bendiga🙏

> Once it's ready, serve and enjoy this meal with a glass of mango juice. I hope you enjoyed it. Thank you for visiting my blog! God bless you🙏 ![IMG_20260420_134301_509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Eos2fqrc88u53BUmLuCNuiTJtZwS2MGRDd4vZW8c8GUPVGSzXTkSCYRkYGnKmBMXvMz.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_134255_514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wgUS8UBuzfADxJTM3eG4GB5mp3KTVY1yyGT8y8pubkoWJ5xbRmCSXHnFECZxmdMqr3W.jpg)

body.title: Brigadeiro de chocolate (un poco rebelde) | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
body.body:
![1000515268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u5ztCZrPeqQYrcvAVzqeuyh26ypZkmgbKUg2t49i7Y12HMf6U58D5DGvTEBJSKD8Bup.jpg)





<div class=text-justify> 

Soy una foodie rebelde, ¿qué más les puedo decir? (Lol) Y es que después de ver mil y una recetas de brigadeiro, me provocó hacer una a mi manera. 

El sabor estuvo allí, pero la consistencia no, así que les comento que este sería un brigadeiro para colocar como dripping, para coronar una tres leches o para servir de relleno con un ancho anillo de contención, pero no les va a ser de mucha utilidad si quieren rellenar y decorar una torta solo con él.

Como les dije, el sabor está presente, sabe deliciosa y con un profundo sabor a chocolate, pero no ayudará a que tu pastel tenga una buena estructura usándola sola. 

Yo la utilicé para rellenar y cubrir un bizcocho de chocolate y el pastel se fue rodando poco a poco... Gajes del oficio. Las capas deslizaban ante el suntuoso brigadeiro; no sé cuál fue la falla: si la fluidez del brigadeiro, no haber puesto anillo de contención o haber cortado las capas del bizcocho muy delgadas.

Sin embargo, a pesar de que no lucía lindo en conjunto, las rodajas se veían apetitosas y, hasta el momento, es el pastel de chocolate más delicioso que he probado. 

Les debo la foto de las capas, pues se me pasó capturarlas. ¡Oh, gula, qué me has hecho!


> I’m a rebellious foodie—what else can I say? (Lol) After seeing a thousand and one brigadeiro recipes, I just had to make one my own way. 

>The flavor was there, but the consistency wasn’t, so I’ll tell you that this would be a brigadeiro to use as a drizzle, to top a tres leches cake, or to serve as a filling with a wide ring mold, but it won’t be very useful if you want to fill and decorate a cake with just this.

>Like I said, the flavor is there—it tastes delicious with a rich chocolate flavor—but it won’t help your cake hold its shape if you use it on its own. 

>I used it to fill and cover a chocolate sponge cake, and the cake started to fall apart little by little... Part of the job. The layers were sliding under the rich brigadeiro; I’m not sure what went wrong: whether it was the brigadeiro’s fluidity, not using a ring mold, or cutting the sponge cake layers too thin.

>However, even though it didn’t look pretty as a whole, the slices looked appetizing, and so far, it’s the most delicious chocolate cake I’ve ever tasted. 

>I owe you a photo of the layers, since I forgot to take one. Oh, gluttony, what have you done to me!


------------------
#### <center>Ingredientes <sup>(Ingredients)</sup> </center>
------------------------------


<div class=\
> * 340 g de leche condensada. * 100 g de crema de leche. * 20 g de cacao en polvo. * 50 g de chocolate amargo 60%. * 15 g mantequilla.

> * 340 g condensed milk. * 100 g heavy cream. * 20 g cocoa powder. * 50 g dark chocolate 60%. * 15 g butter. ------------------ ####
Preparación (How to make it)
------------------------------ * Empieza colocando la leche condensada y el cacao tamizado en una olla. >Start by placing the condensed milk and sifted cocoa powder in a saucepan. ![1000515249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgFYzaNTpkuHcpeFvyQmLnxp2dJbQqSgH3o7vpW3LATpwWRoE4XaRCL4XBDEZczQMXN.jpg) ![1000515250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xKxj4t3DtyTZKap35sDCBqyHBEJyQadt4An3NcNs7tS1p7xbU11XMaKxck4oKfGeqLj.jpg) * Agrega la crema de leche y el chocolate amargo. >Add the heavy cream and dark chocolate. ![1000515255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23uFKd6aHTmpT87Jfq89hK4JHZ4vUYndAJyWgbHJfLLokSQ3ZoeZnDRbk6dgjUT96mEYp.jpg) ![1000524596.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23w2qV2JgWbMNTGHXXbxnjixs3je4bJmXtnaQ79wuyNW7SAXbfQVARKsDYnNH9YM4Zuij.jpg) * Mezcla y lleva a fuego bajo para que el chocolate se derrita y todos los ingredientes se mezclen bien. *Algo que entendí luego de hacer este brigadeiro es que no basta con que empiece a hervir para retirarlo del fuego. Se debe cocinar hasta que espese bastante para poder tener una consistencia más estable. Así que esa es mi mayor recomendación: cocina bien, mezclando constantemente hasta lograr una consistencia espesa.* > Stir and place over low heat so the chocolate melts and all the ingredients blend well. > *Something I learned after making this brigadeiro is that you shouldn’t take it off the heat just because it starts to boil. You need to cook it until it thickens significantly to achieve a more stable consistency. So that’s my top tip: cook it thoroughly, stirring constantly until it reaches a thick consistency.* ![1000515268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u5ztCZrPeqQYrcvAVzqeuyh26ypZkmgbKUg2t49i7Y12HMf6U58D5DGvTEBJSKD8Bup.jpg) ![1000515266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23w2exgHTgrqhSTufekmJypmYYR115NUKg9opNUan2HouGk3yHWm4ADy35TESaB2kyhea.jpg) * Una vez listo, coloca papel film encima de la mezcla para que no se forme una capa gruesa. Lo dejé reposando a temperatura ambiente y luego en la nevera toda la noche. > Once it's ready, cover the mixture with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming. I let it sit at room temperature and then refrigerated it overnight. ![1000515270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgHuqmH17D14cgue6GefWc8nd7FrNAR2KSWiZP8qPbQ7K33Uy6oxzJ4wwjU44hLGRvA.jpg)
**¡Espero que te guste esta receta, cocina fácil y con sabor**!
**I hope you like it!**

title.title: RURAL MONTALBÁN - (PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES)
title.body:
![Ccats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AJefb3YGcLBiq9cRdwVmuUuJjVBHSCjsryz1jiBw6KRNxC6hBWf6g1y663SXWbq.jpg)

----

**I** have the privilege of, practically on any free afternoon, taking my old bicycle or even walking (because, as you know, I love to walk) and getting away from the town streets for about four or five kilometers and immersing myself in that space which I like to call \

and that's what I did today, and these photos correspond to my afternoon visiting the farm where a former high school classmate named Juan Carlos works, whom I found there along with his son and grandson doing some farm work...\n\n>**T**engo el privilegio de, prácticamente en cualquier tarde libre, tomar mi vieja bicicleta o incluso caminando (porque, como ustedes saben, amo caminar) y alejarme de las calles del pueblo unos cuatro o cinco kilómetros y así sumergirme en ese espacio el cual me gusta llamar \

, y eso fue lo que hice hoy, y estas fotos corresponde a mi tarde visitando la granja en donde labora un antiguo compañero de secundaria llamado Juan Carlos, a quien encontré allí junto con su hijo y su nieto haciendo algunas labores de campo... 


![C01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tvZvsDKNJ4XXAmPqTt98u6TGZ2bRgvcgaL7H6kjkcf1LQpxaHVtYM9ieAEGGtNncr8G.jpg)

![C02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vhuRbVMcAZtx5A7pDHV8LWVVsXD72hmyGsJrrwgWML21Rb4bB6L9zDRWSRrBLN4wpwE.jpg)

![C03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqkachz9XtQs8uMW5qXzh39aAZTEQLbwok7iijd7iA8RwisDUJPo9QnA24h4t8w9jEY.jpg)

![C04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wMTpa6wpRDByGubLJe9sHin5WWM1KPfAyjLyLaoWSQtgZSDhNZ4zvJKvJTLjSHakwxa.jpg)

![C05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yJGFWAmJZfqMeFw29qYX1k4RUVGzBgzsRHW6Uu47dv4oz9GAAjYAFkiUGUtu6ZgQ5sw.jpg)

**W**hen I say that taking these kinds of trips is a privilege for me, I mean it. Truly incredible things happen to me in these places, like finding that old farm tractor on the farm where Juan Carlos works. It's the same one that was used on these and other properties almost forty years ago, back when my friend and I were teenagers and spent time fishing or picking mangoes to eat on these lands... Little did my friend know he'd end up using that old tractor for work! The land has changed hands, but some things, like that tractor, remain...

>**C**uando digo que, para mi, hacer este tipo de paseos es un privilegio, lo digo muy en serio. Pues en estos lugares me suceden cosas realmente increíbles, como el hecho de encontrar allí, en la granja en donde trabaja Juan Carlos, ese viejo tractor agrícola, el cual es el mismo que se usaba en estos y otros terrenos casi cuarenta años atrás, cuando precisamente tanto mi amigo como yo, éramos adolescentes y pasábamos algún tiempo pescando o buscando mangos para comer en estas propiedades... ¡Que se iba a Imaginar mi amigo que él terminaría usando ese viejo tractor para trabajar!... Las tierras han cambiado de dueños, pero algunas cosas como ese tractor siguen allí... 


![C06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uQp8FLw67ppMURCM29qg7h1hXfQtoshYas5LhLYUZK7DZHqjp6bWDqhnueFPUm7HgRk.jpg)

![C07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wC7QLha9JQr4wCZM3joKyA7iAvpYbKgH2MRWJyh3D8R1xq53eJ1bqfM6c3pMMafBcMu.jpg)

![C08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vsNPeRGPQMKzBSdURo2scomV2H9ZeRwqHQZTnAt9mLhaVH831NUZDD9ghk27Bmxzbqx.jpg)

![C09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uFS1KTCRJhevjKvvZtMth6NGzHHUyErYSexeTzQxxu647i64BjjyEHjK6W3HW158Efo.jpg)

![C10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tvZzfU8m1BYvMs1sdK9GAeusEAuCvvk8r3taDGtsiFgdZ6a4h1JdyFbiqydmMpbHRkT.jpg)

**A**nd in fact, making these occasional forays into rural areas is, for me, like a kind of journey back to a time that never was. Many things, besides that lovely old tractor, of course, remain the same... The old stoves in the kitchens of the little houses, the landscape with its pastures, the way of cultivating and harvesting, even the old dirt roads look just as they did when I was a boy, and appreciating all of this in this way is, for me, \

...\n\n>**Y** de hecho, hacer estas incursiones ocasionales en los espacios rurales, es para mi como una especie de viaje a tiempos que no pasaron. Muchas cosas, además de ese lindo tractor antiguo por supuesto, siguen iguales... Las viejas estufas de las cocinas en las casitas, el paisaje con pastizales, la manera de cultivar y cosechar, hasta las viejos caminos de tierra lucen como cuando yo era un muchacho, y apreciar todo esto así, es eso para mi: \

... ![C11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wWvxPrxvXnALaZPT6AY6748WkLtuucmjD83mrc92mxNuzPLLifPHgPceYoxmC9CVKPJ.jpg) ![C12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23r1uSi7ohfkDvS1BZdYrJknwiooSsd5KQEAMkf6Uf2Awq6RVjQP4hcYWLEQVhtSP9kKS.jpg) ![C13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xVEdyfUyDkFN9qd2GYHiMrxbKuuCaHao2AQc9nc3Zgv9Mxt2gUrZuiGubYbR2i1nMsd.jpg) ![C14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vsGJP5p9mmZ8yzfJ7eJ1eTtsX7sQf3w93qndrWC2Vv2qm2KEnfYSaba8xi9kGAJ2jZa.jpg) ![C15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yJC1BDF3pu3mekyw4iU95gS5asEJzBJedGB1sZVaN1N4VDFukiVqf1tomvZGNYgQSb3.jpg) ---- ##

title.title: Chicken and Smoked Chorizo Rice (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> A new culinary adventure brings us back into the kitchen. This time, we’ll be making rice with chicken and smoked chorizo—a flavorful combination where the ingredients blend together to create a colorful, delicious dish with an exquisite aroma.
![1000110553.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVW945WbUkp8sh7nkUYY4LtQmHBeB6b7KszLwFzrGZPrTXeAcN6ZCWRWC268VzsFBaM.png)
## Ingredients: - 1 chicken thigh - 1 smoked chorizo - 1 carrot - 2 onions - 1 bell pepper - 7 sweet peppers - 2 tablespoons of salt - 1 cup of rice - 3 cups of water - Oil
![1000110534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wqwBhAQEqnk8szghjZhEPkNr8rbaRPt5iNuHwZ3TSdPmkq7zhTrGqJdYhnjTP8RiP3J.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the herbs in a bowl of water, then removed the seeds from the chili peppers and chopped them into small pieces. Next, I peeled the onions and chopped them in the same way. Then I washed the chicken pieces and the chorizo; I cut the chicken in half and the chorizo into half-moons. Then I peeled the carrots and cut them into medium-sized pieces.
![1000110537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wCLU76oQCg4VRm584ikn5qj1t6SaLdSf4cCKFVndPM8vHccmXVF2Au1JWefNpez5fnR.jpg)
![1000110540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tSh88Dk921Nxh8TGrTKuaAFGSQv9xfjqmEGt9YSEn2P2VV2uAgA279BMnYh8MVxRBSY.jpg)
Next, I heated a skillet with two tablespoons of oil and sautéed the herbs. Ten minutes later, I added the carrots, stirred well, and immediately added the chicken and the chorizo pieces.
![1000110543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tc3VsuyXHw8DrCJWWvEBGSD9vo7mjrUnSL2xvLojtt4iVpPT9dTZy8NoWWWmrkR1HV2.jpg)
A few minutes later, I added the rice, letting it sit for a while so the flavors could blend and the grains could coat themselves in the oil. Then I poured in the three cups of water and the salt. I turned the heat down to low. The rice finished cooking in 30 minutes. I liked this combination; no single ingredient stole the show from another. The smoky flavor infused the rice, the saltiness was perfectly balanced, and the sofrito, including the chicken, gave it a spectacular taste. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Una nueva aventura culinaria nos trae de regreso en la cocina, esta vez prepararemos arroz con pollo y chorizo ahumado, una combinación con mucho sabor, donde los ingredientes se fusionan dando paso a un plato colorido, delicioso y con exquisito aroma.
![1000110553.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVW945WbUkp8sh7nkUYY4LtQmHBeB6b7KszLwFzrGZPrTXeAcN6ZCWRWC268VzsFBaM.png)
## Ingredientes: - 1 muslo con encuentro - 1 chorizo ahumado - 1 zanahoria - 2 cebollas - 1 pimentón - 7 ajíes dulces - Dos cucharadas de sal - 1 taza de arroz - 3 tazas de agua - Aceite
![1000110534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wqwBhAQEqnk8szghjZhEPkNr8rbaRPt5iNuHwZ3TSdPmkq7zhTrGqJdYhnjTP8RiP3J.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase con agua lavé los aliños, luego retiré las semillas de los ajíes y dividí en pedazos pequeños. Posteriormente retiré las cortezas de las cebollas y piqué de la misma forma. Después lavé las piezas de pollo y el chorizo, el primero lo corté en dos y el segundo en medias lunas. Luego quité la corteza de la zanahoria y corté en fragmentos medianos.
![1000110537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wCLU76oQCg4VRm584ikn5qj1t6SaLdSf4cCKFVndPM8vHccmXVF2Au1JWefNpez5fnR.jpg)
![1000110540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tSh88Dk921Nxh8TGrTKuaAFGSQv9xfjqmEGt9YSEn2P2VV2uAgA279BMnYh8MVxRBSY.jpg)
De allí monté un sartén con dos cucharadas de aceite y sofreí los aliños, diez minutos más tarde agregué las zanahorias, removí muy bien para de inmediato añadir el pollo y los pedazos de chorizo.
![1000110543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tc3VsuyXHw8DrCJWWvEBGSD9vo7mjrUnSL2xvLojtt4iVpPT9dTZy8NoWWWmrkR1HV2.jpg)
Minutos más tarde añadí el arroz, dejé un rato que los sabores se mezclaran y que los granos se cubrieran con el aceite. Luego vertí las tres tazas de agua y la sal. Ajusté a fuego bajo. El arroz terminó de cocinarse en 30 minutos. Me gustó esta combinación, ningún ingrediente robó el protagonismo a otro, el sabor ahumado se trasladó al arroz, el punto de sal estuvo equilibrado y el sofrito, incluyendo al pollo, concedió un gusto espectacular. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: PHYSICAL VS. DIGITAL: WHY THE IMPACT OF BULLYING IS IDENTICAL
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLmNjZasTJrEbwbesCPUow9Y4yYMR3yLcCxgkZRpXVeC/1776742725634.png)
image generated using Gemini AI 

People are built differently, and as such, they react differently to things and situations. Now, to the topic of bullying, just as in different cases and how people are built, this(bullying) affects people differently. Some people might feel the effect only when done physically, while others can feel it even online. Not everyone has thick skin for resisting situations, and as such, bullying shouldn't be taken lightly. Bullying a person physically has as many negative effects as bullying a person online.

Before we go further in our discourse, we need to answer the question \

It is the act of intimidating a person into doing something, especially through repeated coercion or persistent acts that make life unpleasant for another person.  
With these definitions, you see that bullying can have a lot of effects on a person, which include trauma, low self-esteem, fear, and depression, to name a few. I remember, during my secondary school days, when we were still junior students, we were all scared of being bullied by senior students. We would try to hide from them every time and pray that nothing would bring us together. Thankfully, we were in separate hostels, which kept us safe during our junior school. I remember how my closest friend then left the school when we were being promoted to the senior class and was supposed to join the other boys at the main campus. The fear of bullying made him change schools, which was the story of many of us back then.

Now, one who has been intimidated whether physically or online and doesn't have or grow a thick skin to these and ends up having any or all of these as issues in their life will most likely not have a normal life and this in turn cuts short a potential addition to making the world better because when all hands are on deck, it makes the work easier meaning, if all humans function to the best of their abilities without any limitations, in this case, bullying, then everyone will give in their best to living and the world will be a better place.

This is to say that, whether physical or online, bullying has the same effects on people and should be treated in the same way. You can't tell the extent to which bullying can affect any fragile human, so whether online or physically, it still has effects and, as such, should be treated the same.

There is no competition to see who feels the pain the most, whether a person is being harassed physically or online; both have a psychological impact, and it affects them mentally. When bullying is not checked in schools for instance, the full potential of that child might not be utilized by the individual, there is always a psychological effect to it, which is also the same with the online bullying, stop one from getting bullied or having checks for bullying doesn’t only save an individual, it saves the societies from losing people with kind heart, brilliant minds and an innovative mind in the long run.

Thank you for reading. My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive Learners weekly Featured Content Week 214 Episode 01: “ONLINE VS PHYSICAL”.

body.title: Steamroller Art
body.body: /> Who doesn't want to make prints with a steamroller? _Don't know if I want to know that person._ This past Saturday, for the second year in a row, my partner and I headed down to the CeLOUbrate Print at the Portland Museum in west Louisville to make us some prints with a steamroller.

/>\n\nA month or so before, [we'd participated](https://ecency.com/hive-194913/@coloneljethro/carving-up-a-time) in one of the many carving workshops taking place around town in the run up to steamroller day. Using the same tools you'd use for linocut printmaking, we'd carved 12\
wood blocks with the designs for our prints.\n\n

/> Saturday we finally got to put our work to work, along with plenty of other folks who braved the rain and Thunder to make a little art. The forecast for the day had been rather ominous, but with everything was either indoors or under canopies (even the steamroller) the festivities continued unhindered by the wet weather.

/> If you're not making a mess, are you even having fun? _Hope you didn't wear your good clothes._ The process was as simple as it was messy, just roll out some ink with a brayer and then roll it onto your woodblock, with the carved out spacing being the white areas on the print.
/> Once inked up, your block got laid in front of the steamroller messy side up, with whatever you were printing on atop it.
/> Then it was just a matter of covering it up and running it over.
/> After that, there was nothing to do but hang up your new print to dry.
/> There was plenty to see while you waited on your print, with artists, vendors and the Portland Museum itself to explore.
/> Some were familiar faces from previous years, while others were new.

/> After getting our fill of that, there was nothing for it but to collect our creations and flee the scene before the half million or so people at the air show and fireworks extravaganza downtown made traffic a complete nightmare.
/>\n\n_Now to figure out what to carve next. . ._

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Elite Force: Questions and Answers
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmck8Pnc4An545rqjhcABfHzPJ4g8QSfRKmTSQnxqr5QHq/Portada%20-%20Elite%20Force%20-%20Questions%20and%20Answers.png </center>

<center>After trying to find out about some doubts regarding **Anemic**, now it would be the turn of the other Ruleset that arrived with the update of **April 14** which is **Elite Force**, being a limiting Ruleset with a clear description and without leaving room for interpretations:</center>

><center>Ya después de intentar averiguar sobre algunas dudas de **Anemic** ahora le tocaría a la otra Ruleset que llegó con la actualización de **14 de abril** que es **Elite Force** que siendo una Ruleset limitante con una descripción clara y sin dejar espacio a las interpretaciones:</center>

### <center> Elite Force</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ9a7pxik6Wqjw2jb1PppkmNrXLgDiQndVqe8U2WJzvD2/img_combat-rule_elite-force_150.png</center>

- **Elite Force:** You can not summon common units.
>- **Elite Force:** No puedes invocar unidades comunes.

<center>There are not many doubts as it is an absolute condition that is over the gameplay, so it does not usually interact with abilities, but it is always good to clarify these doubts for the curious, new players, or if there is a bug or intentional gap from the **Splinterlands** team for the players most committed to getting the most advantage out of each battle.</center>

><center>No hay muchas dudas al ser una condición absoluta que está sobre el gameplay por lo que no suele interactuar con las habilidades pero siempre es bueno aclarar estas dudas para los curiosos, los jugadores nuevos o si hay un fallo o una brecha intencional del equipo de **Splinterlands** para los jugadores más comprometidos a sacarle la mayor ventaja a cada batalla.</center>

### <center>[Clash with **Rise of the Commons** | Choque con **Rise of the Commons**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/72fb06c4b8428561ee8f9570643585d506a10e15?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>One of the first curiosities or doubts is what happens if by coincidence in a battle appear the Rulesets **Elite Force** and **Rise of the Commons**. If you don't pay attention, you might think that you couldn't play that battle, as would happen with **Wands Out** and **Lost Magic** or **Going the Distance** with **Broken Arrows**. In **Splinterlands**, they are configured not to coincide with each other to avoid errors by not being able to use any unit. But if you read carefully, **Elite Force** only limits **Common** cards, but **Rise of the Commons** only allows playing **Common** and **Rare** cards, so in this type of battle, only that single rarity could be used.</center>

><center>Una de las primeras curiosidades o dudas es qué pasa si por coincidencia en una batalla aparecen las Ruleset **Elite Force** y **Rise of the Commons**. Si no se fijan pudieran pensar que no se podrían jugar esa batalla como pasaría con **Wands Out** y **Lost Magic** o **Going the Distance** con **Broken Arrows**. En **Splinterlands** están configurados para no coincidir entre ellas para evitar errores al no poder usar ninguna unidad. Pero si se lee atentamente **Elite Force** solo limita las tarjetas **Comunes** pero **Rise of the Commons** solo permite jugar tarjetas **Comunes** y **Raras** por lo que en este tipo de batalla solo se podrían usar esa única rareza.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTs8trxKANuNZFmgMKw7WLGxfHLTrKeqQpt6qPboihVFZ/1%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle, you can see this combination of Rulesets where everything outside the Archons only **Rare** cards can be used, creating strange but entertaining teams for battles from time to time.</center>

><center>En esta batalla se puede ver esta combinación de Rulesets donde todo fuera de los archons solo se puede usar tarjetas raras creando equipos extraños pero entretenidos para batallas de vez en cuando.</center>

## <center>Summoning abilities | Habilidades de invocación</center>

<center>Another doubt is whether this Ruleset also affects abilities that allow the use of cards from other sets or elements, which is a reasonable doubt but can follow the rules of other limiting Rulesets that do not let you use specific cards like with **Lost Legendaries**, but it is good to test them to make sure.</center>

><center>Otra de las dudas es si esta Ruleset afecta también a las habilidades que permiten usar tarjetas de otros conjuntos o elementos lo que es una duda razonable pero que puede seguir las reglas de otras Ruleset limitantes que no dejan usar tarjetas específicas como con **Lost Legendaries** pero es bueno probarlas para asegurarnos.</center>

### <center>[Conscript](https://splinterlands.com/battle/50c8e8a9bc288e0c0cae5a83d191b0a167c8e82d?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>**Conscript** is among the first abilities that allow the use of cards that otherwise cannot be used normally, but if you could use **Common** cards in battles with **Elite Force**, it would be a very strong advantage since that set has very powerful cards due to having **Bloodlust** and cards that power them up.</center>

><center>**Conscript** es de las primeras habilidades que permite usar tarjetas que de otro modo no se pueden usar de manera normal pero que si puede usar tarjetas **Comunes** en batallas con **Elite Force** sería una ventaja muy fuerte ya que ese conjunto cuenta con tarjetas muy poderosas por tener **Bloodlust** y tarjetas que las potencian.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXDE2sZWew6UFy3ayUjXCcvCbUkk4HcwwvVCidP3LtXKH/Conscript%20V2.png </center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXJ5F3JYu4KNyA6LAt56kuEnGAaTE8abSP4qRRPv69QQr/Conscript%201%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle, it can be seen that from the team creation screen, no cards appear when the card filter is used so that only **Common** cards from the **Gladiator** set appear, so **Conscript** does not bypass **Elite Force**, making it necessary to use cards of other rarities. But there is still another ability to test if **Elite Force** can be bypassed.</center>

><center>En esta batalla se puede ver que desde la pantalla de creación de equipo no aparecen tarjetas cuando se usa el filtro de tarjetas para que solo aparezcan las tarjetas **Comunes** del conjunto **Gladiator** por lo que **Conscript** no salta **Elite Force** haciendo que se tengan que usar tarjetas de otras rarezas, pero todavía hay otra habilidad para probar si se puede saltar **Elite Force**.</center>

### <center>[**Bloodline Dominion** | **Bloodline Dominion**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/2722947b138a1a38723b2f41bb6058cdf139fac9?ref=durlan)</center>

<center>**Bloodline Dominion** is the other ability that allows the use of cards in a special way that can also have a special interaction with **Elite Force** and allow the use of common cards.</center>

><center>**Bloodline Dominion** la otra habilidad que permite usar tarjetas de manera especial que también puede tener una interacción especial con **Elite Force** y dejar usar tarjetas comunes.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmernN8zsw8zLzrMMgwejGayxKyx4RvWZacBi2YdEFTSoj/Dominion%20Bloodline%20V2.png</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUK1zgRQFNvTyQn37DMGJBz8zYPQVfLTRmwyiihk5EsMv/Bloodline%20Dominion%201%20V2.png </center>

<center>This ability follows the same patterns as **Conscript**, so from the team creation screen, no card with a **Bloodline** of **Common** rarity can be used either.</center>
><center>Esta habilidad sigue los mismos patrones que **Conscript** por lo que desde la pantalla de creación de equipo tampoco se puede usar ninguna tarjeta con un **Bloodline** de rareza **Común**.</center>

### <center>Conclusion | Conclusión</center>

<center>**Elite Force** is a new limiting Ruleset that changes battles quite a bit, even more than **Lost Legendaries**, making us change strategies significantly so they function similarly, making **Elite Force** one of the most interesting since one does not realize how important **Common** rarity units are until you cannot use them and must use a different approach or look for substitutes.</center>

><center>**Elite Force** es una nueva Ruleset limitante que cambia bastantes las batallas incluso mayor que **Lost Legendaries** haciendo que cambiemos mucho las estrategias para que tengan un funcionamiento parecido volviendo a **Elite Force** una de las más interesantes ya que uno no se da cuenta de lo importantes que son las unidades de rareza **Común** hasta que no puedes usarlas y debes usar un enfoque diferentes o buscar sustitutos.</center>

<center>It will surely stay that way since there is no ability that allows bypassing it, at least for now, but in the future, this might change with cards with **Double Rarity** as happened with **Double Element** cards, although this would be more complicated since rarity has different rules outside the game, such as the number of copies needed to level them up.</center>

><center>Seguro se mantendrá así ya que no hay habilidad que permita saltarla por lo menos por ahora pero puede que en el futuro esto cambie con tarjetas con **Doble Rareza** como pasó con las tarjetas de **Doble Elemento** aunque esto sería más complicado ya que la rareza tiene reglas distintas fuera del juego como el número de copias necesario para subirlas de nivel.</center>

Assalamu Alaikum. Greetings students. How are you? I hope you are doing well and your academic activities are going well. Today I am here to write for you on a wonderful topic. And that is, what are the ways to overcome laziness in students.

![pexels-yankrukov-8199628 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVnVuoW42urXhdrErXFrPmvAGg9WjcJAYgubPUG981V3i/pexels-yankrukov-8199628%20(1).jpg)

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/three-people-in-the-library-8199628/)

Basically, laziness is the worst thing in the present time. When laziness appears in a person, he does not want to do any work. Basically, although he wants to work, then due to laziness he cannot complete his own activities. 

In the same way, when laziness appears in students, students cannot continue their educational activities. Students need a lot of energy in their bodies to study. When the energy in a student's body becomes weak, he cannot express any interest in that education. 

I have seen in many schools and private rooms. There, the teacher is trying to explain any subject to the students on the blackboard. But the students do not show any interest in that subject. Rather, the students are closing their eyes and going to sleep and their laziness seems to have no end. 

Basically, to remove this laziness, students have to complete several activities. One of these is that students have to exercise regularly.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFQunR86i2MK73ZdJSBuNvubd4wiRMhKzTp6Mu7mopYt/1776742059227.jpg)


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-lying-with-legs-raised-on-wall-5409047/)




Exercise plays a very important role for a student. If students exercise regularly to manage their lives, it helps to restore energy in their body. Exercising increases the body's immunity and the cells return to their proper position. As a result, some energy comes to the body. 

It is not possible to eliminate laziness by exercising alone. To eliminate laziness, the right quality of nutrition and vitamins must be applied to the body. A student must eat energy-rich and protein-rich food in the morning. Believe that after waking up in the morning, drink water with lemon and water. Moreover, there is a possibility of good benefits if you mix honey with it. 

Students may have a deficiency of vitamin C in their body. D If there is a deficiency of vitamin C in the human body, laziness occurs. Therefore, vitamin C and vitamin D multivitamins must be taken at the same time. Especially if we can arrange for our students to feed green vegetables, this is very beneficial for their body. 

Basically, the most terrible thing in a student's body is laziness.  If laziness occurs, the student cannot continue his/her studies. Problems arise in various fields and laziness destroys the student. So let us keep an eye on our bodies and the bodies of our students so that laziness does not take root. If there is a need for vitamins in their bodies, we must try to fulfill them immediately. I think it is very important to go to the doctor and get adequate treatment if necessary.

How did you like the ways to eliminate laziness in students. Are you a student or a parent? If you find the points useful today, then do not forget to leave a nice comment. Thank you very much for enjoying and being with the education community.

body.title: Monday Sunshine!🌞………My Actifit Report Card: April 20 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71776734226.766535) It’s Monday once again, and whereas a lot of folks dread it as it’s the start of the workweek, I don’t mind it so much. I suppose it could be because with a few exceptions, I rarely work on a Monday. That’s not to say that sometimes it’s difficult to start the day. We woke up to sunshine this morning. That’s always nice for in the Pacific Northwest, due to the oceanic influence, you never know what to expect. It can change on a dime. Here’s a pic of Mt. Baker from the other day when it wasn’t so sunny. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71776734447.915514) I headed up the mountain today to visit my friend who lost her husband this past November. I was happy to see she seemed a bit happier than I’ve seen her since he died. She had on some earrings and a necklace which gave me a bit of encouragement that she was feeling a little bit better emotionally. You can’t just turn off grief-it’s a navigational emotion that at times, hits you especially hard when you least expect it. It’s always there. Only time can take the edge off. We spent a couple hours visiting and she’s agreed to come to our church’s ladies gathering on May 2nd with me. I’m looking forward to it! 😎👍 Once home, I waited patiently for @silvertop to finish what he was in the middle of so that we could go to Safeway and get my lettuce for the week and some eggs as well. 🥚🥚🥚 I always find something to photograph at the floral department there. body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeBuskTdbshTVvKnu8cGvCnUi7X7SQCJk8hxSj7dsKGF2/IMG_4735.jpg 

It’s Monday, the start of a new week, and of course… I’m at the gym. I like beginning my week with movement because it sets the tone for everything else. It’s like telling myself from the very first day: “we’re doing this, we’re staying disciplined, and we’re going for our goals.” There’s something powerful about starting strong.

Even if I feel a little sleepy or slow at first, once I get into the workout, everything changes. My energy comes up, my mind clears, and I feel more focused on what I want to achieve this week. The gym has become my reset button — a place where I reconnect with myself and build both physical and mental strength.

Today I chose to start with action, with effort, and with intention. Because Mondays are not just another day, they are a new opportunity to do things better. And yes… nothing better than starting the week in the gym. 💪✨

>Es lunes, inicio de semana, y claro… tocó gym. Me gusta empezar la semana en movimiento porque marca el ritmo para todo lo demás. Es como decirme desde el primer día: “vamos con todo, con disciplina y con enfoque en nuestras metas”. Hay algo muy poderoso en comenzar fuerte.

>Aunque al inicio me sienta un poquito cansada, en cuanto empiezo a entrenar todo cambia. La energía sube, la mente se despeja y me siento más enfocada en lo que quiero lograr esta semana. El gym se ha vuelto mi lugar para reiniciarme, para conectar conmigo y fortalecerme tanto física como mentalmente.

>Hoy elegí empezar con acción, con esfuerzo y con intención. Porque los lunes no son cualquier día, son una nueva oportunidad de hacerlo mejor. Y sí… no hay mejor forma de iniciar la semana que en el gym. 💪✨

body.title: Starting to Understand Hive Better
body.body:
When I first joined Hive, I thought it was simple:
Post content -> Earn rewards

But after spending some time here, I’ve realized it’s much deeper than that.

What I’m Understanding Now:
Hive is not just about posting. It’s about:
‐ Building connections
- Engaging with others
- Providing value consistently

One thing that surprised me is how important commenting is.

At first, I ignored it.
But now I see that meaningful comments can:
- Help you get noticed
- Bring people to your profile
- Even earn rewards

Challenges I’m Facing:
- Low visibility as a beginner
- Understanding how rewards actually work
- Staying consistent

What I’m Focusing On:
- Improving my content
- Writing better comments
- Learning more about how Hive works

I’m starting to enjoy the process, not just the idea of earning.

Still early in the journey - a lot more to learn

If you’ve been on Hive longer, I’d love to hear your tips!

#hive #web3 #learning #crypto #blog

**Y he estado unos días ausente por aquí pero debo decir que estuve haciendo cosas que ame y que sin duda alimentaron mi alma. Algo que quería hacer hace mucho tiempo era este taller de merengue italiano, así que este viaje fue de mucho provecho y hacer este taller de merengue italiano me hizo muy feliz. Siempre quería hacerlo y por una u otra razón nunca se podía y debo decir que aprendí mucho.**

>I've been away for a few days, but I must say I've been doing things I love and that have definitely nourished my soul. Something I've wanted to do for a long time is this Italian meringue workshop, so this trip was very rewarding, and taking this workshop made me very happy. I always wanted to do it, but for one reason or another, it never happened, and I must say I learned a lot.


![IMG-20260415-WA0032.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKJhZ2nowLdwLFYUPLcvTsG164jHKET4oyjqrRZiB1bQ/IMG-20260415-WA0032.jpg)

**Este día llegué bastante temprano al lugar donde iba a ser dictado el taller de merengue italiano, la profesora estaba ocupada desmoldado un bundt cake y yo observé mientras ella trabajaba, ya la conocía de días anteriores ya que ella es amiga de la profesora que impartió la clase de Chantilly.**

>I arrived quite early this day at the place where the Italian meringue workshop was going to be held. The teacher was busy unmolding a bundt cake and I watched while she worked. I already knew her from previous days since she is a friend of the teacher who taught the Chantilly class.

>On the counter were the cakes, with the filling we would put in them, we had the guide with the recipes we were going to use in class and each cake had a topper with the name of each of the participants.

![IMG-20260415-WA0027.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcBHvVNnBMTYAzuYcnLSCFVEaYipPtcBgTxFsd7hVZUfS/IMG-20260415-WA0027.jpg)

**Lo primero que hicimos fue ver cómo la profesora preparaba el ganache de chocolate oscuro para preparar el aro de contención y es que esto nos ayuda a darle estabilidad a la torta. Luego fue el momento de nosotras de armar nuestras tortas tal y como nos explicaron.**

>The first thing we did was watch the teacher prepare the dark chocolate ganache to make the support ring, which helps stabilize the cake. Then it was our turn to assemble our cakes, just as they explained.

>Then came the most anticipated moment of this workshop, which was to start making Italian meringue. The teacher gave us many tips so that we could make a good Italian meringue at home.

body.title: Starting Young Plants in a 7cm Pot / 省スペースで育苗
body.body:
![3A4EB74D-3A2E-4198-8C86-F93DAC6BCCA6_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23wgFbvqxcDWMAdhwpV4n2xaqraABKjMUJGemdjr3orxvKrTeAVvoXLdaS6jrobAf4af2.jpeg)

Last year I learned about a seedling method called the “snail method,” and I tried it using some leftover bio fleece. Some plants worked well and others didn’t, but this year I used plastic bags and it worked smoothly 😅

The photo at the beginning shows my Bonsai Chilli, a small but very spicy chili pepper that I grow every year. Even I want to grow many plants—for myself, for friends, and for the local market—they can grow surprisingly well in one 7 cm pot. The roots had developed nicely.

![1D8AD56D-4E4E-4421-B11C-C786611C048A_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23wWuAiJ9aiabg9WTk8wSWEYTRykb8rBaYqZHzXeK7dZdiwpyvpQm9giK2F1cXG8YfcB3.jpeg)

I gently separated them by hand and planted about 4–5 seedlings per pot. In total, I ended up with 11 pots, which means around 50 plants. Amazing!

I also grew my favorite green onions this way, which really helped save space. I brought them to the garden and planted them here and there as companion plants.

![DE44BCD2-781E-4F2F-9213-09292E97A541_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoCiA7o2PBr8oMoxiCoVHqBZEXt69Y9DQwfNsmW1NFN9cDWFSi1oYrJJNgQWBSVhFML.jpeg)

At first, I used plastic bags from my kitchen, but then I realized I can simply reuse them. Now I keep suitable ones together with my seed packets and use them again.

![54C5E568-9E6C-4179-8C73-DB8C179E4E11_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uQpegWPFbd1U9JnBPqPTm1Z5QtrNsq6dM2JVgHnww1Mwt2vqcbsSZkqnqQM3PhDKLWR.jpeg)

The place I live in now isn’t very big—not the balcony, and not the indoor space—so every year growing seedlings feels like solving a puzzle. Today, I visited a garden center early in the morning and found some narrow seedling trays on sale. They fit perfectly on my windowsill, so I’m thinking of getting a few more.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EopsU7e8ie2PJaN45XsGzLyYTgfoeqxd1XsnEj4isSgnaDD1bbME8jjQBG6Mj5HqYeg.jpg)

The temperature in Germany has dropped again, and I’m still waiting for the right timing to sow cucurbit seeds. I hope it will finally get warm and stable by mid-May.

Happy gardening! 🌱

---

去年スネイルメソッドという育苗方法を知って、余っていたビオフリースを使ってトライしたらうまくいったものアリ・いかなかったものアリだったのですが、今年はプラスチックのバッグを使ったらすんなりうまくいきました😅

冒頭の写真は毎年育てている小さくて辛い唐辛子がなるBonsai Chilliです。

自分用、友人用、近所のマーケット用とたくさん育てたい場合でも7cmのポットでこんなに育ちます。巻いていたのをほどいてみるとこんな感じでいい感じに根をはっていました。

![1D8AD56D-4E4E-4421-B11C-C786611C048A_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23wWuAiJ9aiabg9WTk8wSWEYTRykb8rBaYqZHzXeK7dZdiwpyvpQm9giK2F1cXG8YfcB3.jpeg)

手で優しく分けて、1鉢あたり4-5本、11鉢になったので、50本ほど植物が育っていたことになります。すごい！

私の大好物のネギの苗も省スペースで育てられて助かりました。ネギは庭に持って行って、コンパニオンプランツ的にあちこちに植えました。

![DE44BCD2-781E-4F2F-9213-09292E97A541_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoCiA7o2PBr8oMoxiCoVHqBZEXt69Y9DQwfNsmW1NFN9cDWFSi1oYrJJNgQWBSVhFML.jpeg)

当初、台所で使っているプラスチックのバッグを使っていましたが、再利用すればいいんですよね。良い感じのものを種袋と共にとっておいて再利用するようになりました。

![54C5E568-9E6C-4179-8C73-DB8C179E4E11_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uQpegWPFbd1U9JnBPqPTm1Z5QtrNsq6dM2JVgHnww1Mwt2vqcbsSZkqnqQM3PhDKLWR.jpeg)

今住んでいる家はバルコニーもさながら、居住スペースもそこまで大きくはないので、毎年育苗はパズルのよう。今日は朝イチで見に行った園芸センターで幅の細い育苗ケースがセールになっていたので買ってみました。うちの窓際にぴったりだったので、もういくつか買い足そうと思っています。

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EopsU7e8ie2PJaN45XsGzLyYTgfoeqxd1XsnEj4isSgnaDD1bbME8jjQBG6Mj5HqYeg.jpg)

ドイツはまた気温が下がって、いつ瓜類の種をまこうかタイミングを見計らっているところです。無事5月半ばには安定して暖かくなってくれるといいな。

それではみなさん、Happy Gardening!

despite how well preserved they look, they sometimes surprise their drivers with an unexpected breakage.


![43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23yJGbPkuHqQAUDdLDy6frHmj6Vaw7ZSDYDW55Bu2uPQ8r6vrEkN2eQ3V6fNjNqf6Kqqs.jpg)




Anyway, here I leave you, so you can enjoy photos of the people of Cuba.  Most of these Images are already a few years old, but I wanted to put them for your consideration; I hope you like them and I will be grateful if you comment on them. I will always answer them. 
Good morning everyone and we will continue to see each other in this community. 
Greetings and until next time.

Gente de Cuba 

Hola Hivers,  saludándolos cordialmente,  me acerco nuevamente a esta magnífica comunidad de fotografías en blanco y negro para mostrarles una nueva publicación. 
Son fotos ocasionales de nuestra gente,  la maravillosa gente de Cuba.


 Son imágenes donde se ven a los cubanos 
en las calles, lo mismo participando en diversas actividades y llevando la bandera como símbolo de identidad o simplemente disfrutando de momentos de ocio o descanso en el trabajo. 


También vemos gente en el transcurrir de la vida diaria y cotidiana, ya sea transitando por las calles,  a pie o en autos, situaciones graciosas y asombrosas, como la de la señora refrescándose con el agua de la Fuente de la India o  el músico tocándole a la estatua de Chopan. 


Sin dudas caminando nos encontramos con cosas interesantes y novedosas. Donde nunca faltan el carro americano, esos que en la actualidad son testimonios vivientes de épocas pasadas, que a pesar de lo bien conservados que se ven, a veces sorprenden a sus chóferes con  una rotura inesperada.


En fin aquí les dejo, para que disfruten fotos de la gente de Cuba.  La mayoría de estas Imágenes ya tienen algunos años, pero quise ponerlas a su consideración; espero que sean de su agrado y yo estaré agradecida si las comentan. 
Siempre les responderé. 
Muy buenos días a todos y seguiremos viéndonos por esta comunidad. 
Saludos y hasta la próxima.

body.title: 持续出摊
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![nrBRxBE7lCZFmMx9_MEITU_20251223_221451892.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/nrBRxBE7lCZFmMx9_MEITU_20251223_221451892/nrBRxBE7lCZFmMx9_MEITU_20251223_221451892.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

我早上在单位附近过早，经常去一家包子铺，然后点一个酸菜粉丝的包子+一个卤鸡蛋+一杯豆浆，总共6元钱。

期间我做了多钟口味的尝试，最后发现自己可能最喜欢这个。再然后，就经常买这3样，还偶尔给跟老板聊两句。

就这样，我把老板给数据驯化了，当我远远地走近老板的摊位前，老板张口就来一句：还是老三样？我说，嗯，是的。直接付钱，整个过程极其丝滑。

有没有觉得这很像互联网的算法。

最近，连续两次到老板那边，点老3样，结构老板连续2天，我喜欢的都没有了。我有点不开心，最后放弃了去老板家买包子了。

一次不好的数据，可能算法上就影响了我后面的决策，因为老板变得不确定性了。我不确定再去老板那边，能不能买到我喜欢的包子，所以干脆不去冒险了。

这样的经验还发生在有两次我去买我喜欢的炸面窝，连续两天老板没出摊，后面我也就不怎么去了。再后来，就再也没看见老板出摊了。

我之前看到过九边提过一个观点：就是要持续出摊。他大概总结为什么他能成为公众号大佬，就是持续出摊，行情好行情不好都出摊。出摊得足够久，就跑赢了很多人。

再后来，我发现“持续出摊”的“智慧”也体现在好多的互联网的算法里。

公众号的流量就是这样的，然后MakerWorld的流量也是这样的。

平台会有一定的推荐流量鼓励你持续的活跃，当然这个不会决定你的收益，但是是基本盘，收益要靠爆款。

但是反过来，一旦很长时间不出摊了，推荐流量就可能会减少。

从人生角度来说，**如果找到一个自己的热爱，然后“持续出摊”，这可能是最好的“复利”**。

---

body.title: Clase Especial: las series en el arte [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the lifestyle community. Today I’m joining you here to share another day in my life. This time, I’m bringing you a glimpse into the classroom. This week, the children were assigned the task of choosing a theme they wanted to paint to explore a concept I’ve been wanting to include for a while: artistic series. This refers to a series of works that are related to one another. For example, they might be related because they share the same color palette, use the same textures, tell the same story (as in realism), and so on. They’re used to working on a single piece, but I want them to start expanding those projects a bit so they can create a narrative with identity and depth. Along the way, they’ll find their own style that they’ll defend tooth and nail.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos a la comunidad de lifestyle. El día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. En esta ocasión les traigo un nuevo día en el aula de clase. Para esta semana los niños tenían la tarea de buscar un tema que desearan pintar para tratar un contenido que tenía rato queriendo incluir: las series artísticas. Esto significa una serie de obras que guardan relación entre sí. Por ejemplo pueden guardar relación por tener la misma paleta de colores, usar las mismas texturas, llevar la misma historia (cómo en el realismo), etcétera. Ellos están acostumbrados a trabajar con una sola obra pero yo quiero que empiecen a expandir un poco esos trabajos para que puedan crear una narración con identidad y profundidad. Encontrando en el camino, un estilo propio que defienda a capa y espada.

![IMG_3288.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpGSAmT9K6PCaRqVJBQjH5wrNm23gSkS8NnUbY1BM5Pz5kGRefP9PZGvVxS3tpUnCX6.jpeg) ![IMG_3286.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EptcRFm874fjNcPBzuuRYqBPDk3vxtcwTMWRyQJGTnFaT4mbuQbjyCx93B9R9BY38Dn.jpeg) ![IMG_3302.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpGSdxuVtEkqeM144AkRnwUj8Q6jCFV16MyKVsZ1ziHs1sf7mhu5hpS2AqSeFCZfzep.jpeg) ![IMG_3312.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23u6BKdKqDjQzf2mD7Ugjfuu9HcRmDskRiTrwssWN8tXDNRhvezwL1aGs8i6ndtmZxQcp.jpeg) ![IMG_3279.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EopuuSJRxKQCvwizfqc1hTXtQ8PJM7Q52B8VYFv1k3z3bquqzTZqw9jhcLJHfeHB4aY.jpeg) ![IMG_3282.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EopvHvsmk6xjqwhQVrFXbFHUMXABwzNcRh48dFrqmworbTrQ1vc8VVkwtja49BPxFfP.jpeg) ![IMG_3281.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EouBA4HbSceJH5ze7DGyoapUmVnxNAFp5syVrKB7Gu5GvJnntvqLpjEx2wo2EnyzUQT.jpeg) ![IMG_3276.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EppMAesZL1wRnjA3oe1cBE4Ae7zHhpRp5LdSNan5BQ5MZ95MWCR7gUxKoCPDyyGiE5d.jpeg) ![IMG_3304.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23uQxSse3xoTczwix3tcFWwgaaHF17pjgQ6pyCDb4ufDZjjdXGurnwMn4c8if43RiN3Ef.jpeg) ![IMG_3299.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqDm19CSsWeL5bq6YbX6Njv2taAWB9ZEq3RPf9YM8qDThsxkoHHiCKe1siN1UnvaN5n.jpeg)

>The children brought five small rectangles of cardstock (the support) measuring 12 cm by 8 cm. They had never worked with such a small format before, and that is also important, since sometimes children get used to working in a single way and do not realize they have the freedom to choose (including) the size of the work they will create. Of course, since the format was smaller than usual, they found it much easier to work with, as the margin for error is reduced and the intimacy helps—it’s easier to work on a small scale than a large one. So I saw them much more at ease.

\n\n

>One thing in particular I notice is that there’s still a certain shyness/rigidity or difficulty in letting themselves get carried away by the work. They struggle with making mistakes; they prefer not to take risks. And not just with experimentation, but also with the initial planning. By this I mean that even though I offer them the freedom to choose a theme, the materials to use, and so on, sometimes it’s hard for them (with so many possibilities) to pick the right option. I think they need to understand that there is no ideal option, since it’s about working on the fly and gradually discovering the pros and cons of a technique, a material, etc. Here are the results. Thanks again for stopping by and reading my post.

\n\n>

>Los niños trajeron cinco rectángulos pequeños de cartulina (el soporte) que tenían un tamaño de 12 cm por 8 cm. Nunca antes habían trabajado con un formato tan pequeño y eso también es importante, ya que a veces los niños se acostumbran a trabajar con una sola forma de hacer las cosas y no comprenden que tienen la libertad para elegir (incluso) el tamaño en donde ellos van a trabajar. Por supuesto, al ser un formato más pequeño al acostumbrado, sintieron mucha más facilidad para hacer las cosas ya que se reduce el margen de errores y la cercanía ayuda puesto que es más fácil trabajar una escala pequeña que una grande. Así que los ví mucho más cómodos.

\n\n>

>Una cosa en particular que noto es que sigue existiendo cierta timidez/rigidez o dificultad para dejarse llevar por el trabajo. Les cuesta cometer errores, prefieren no arriesgarse. Y no solo con la experimentación, sino también con el preámbulo. Con esto quiero decir que aunque ofrezco la libertad para escoger un tema, los materiales a usar y demás, a veces es difícil para ellos (con tantas posibilidades) elegir una opción idónea. Creo que deben entender que no hay opción ideal pues se trata de trabajar sobre la marcha y descubrir poco a poco las bondades y desventajas de una técnica, un material, etc. Aquí van los resultados. Nuevamente gracias por pasar por aquí y leer mí publicación.

![IMG_3271.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpGS9mKpzuZtmJsZYRLgpirPG3q9WnxLt7Yu8o7eM6tpKwwmoHpPh393jJAMCGMddKL.jpeg) ![IMG_3274.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Ep7vYyu8s38gnhPinzaetWPaNKyCPsfBrvPGczwSkZWKSkzeSt5RdXDoxvwCgL4tRM2.jpeg) ![IMG_3300.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23w2ktwAxqMHAKbY2xDkrCvcUeEQZot7PbofPZ7GAN3KT3SkYfAVZVne6KWGosQWXRAZs.jpeg) ![IMG_3315.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoGyKgxk6hCutj5nrgZqf6NYRZynhna4hyFQXgUNJeaJjT1BdnFLSrRGtqfJC57Ezzb.jpeg) ![IMG_3270.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EonkbW1YHbKAJxHqFTGmUNY8qxcxkZQmwnmp2w6JqJ1f5PmebQh4dCbg36c3TGoAEKZ.jpeg) ![IMG_3297.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqNGfWtKHBZVcW1zBPjB8Zii1Z1fFi19bDyXVfqqRD36HZuEe3Bo2JwuUeEAGewo6CG.jpeg) ![IMG_3278.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EprU7JRrq49SQ69u9hjdRH5udjm6uyTNxbixpMvLhhqkGM5Z7zfjGnmKBHPxiKEoYqi.jpeg) ![IMG_3296.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoyQyDfEUJ7ADchJ2FjBmYrCyLnem4nZgzeYKhsm85ifR2PDQK511F2iLXNW1KBGbtd.jpeg) ![IMG_3284.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23uFYN4iDC4xcNo7gLFTxMhJ4R5puHd8At2TYRqcc3qATbwMaZeMwGP73jhW716n5duMU.jpeg) ![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

body.title: Chicken and Pea Soup (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today’s recipe was a delicious pea soup to which I added a chicken thigh to give it more flavor. I love peas because they’re an amazing source of nutrients; among all legumes, they’re my favorite for their taste, texture, and versatility. This time, I opted for a light soup, so I avoided combining it with smoked bones, ribs, chorizo, or other traditional ingredients.
![1000110523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/2432BKAtavJmrubtQBMTHJgV7hcwqLzgx96LM5y2uCZddnvxmczHyPYSRkaA7HxuVyPiP.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 1 chicken thigh - 100 grams of peas - 1 potato - 4 sweet peppers - 1 onion - 4 cups of water - Oil - Salt to taste
![1000110508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ynKwGep7K79Ug3G5vZnFKNKPmkKojvPsUuQryZTakhpLezcvgC4wCf52DSirLRRiiin.jpg)
## Preparation: I soaked the peas in plenty of water for about five hours; sometimes it’s a good idea to put them in the fridge the night before to ensure they’re tender and ready to eat. After that time, I rinsed them, removing any debris. Then I put them on to boil with two cups of water and half a tablespoon of salt, and I put a lid on the pot to speed up the process. They were tender in forty minutes.
![1000110514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y8oSCdXwKM283Jpgrx6MvTVTdEgpZHvbdgug6oPKwLaRNSB5JAXrEn8SW9BJSHgnXDA.jpg)
Then I set about removing the seeds from the chili peppers, peeling the onion, and peeling the potato. I cut everything into small pieces, placed them in a skillet with a little oil, sautéed them, and shortly after added the piece of chicken, which I had previously washed and skinned.
![1000110517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvkpfSRASzGxYsjrixo1mzd8BKXjnUa4Ebd9yT2drmT6t7J7d3gmg43obWnoKkmvqTd.jpg)
![1000110520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2qBaLx4ZBqJA98rcXD4CmfaxauEULXGfPgBhCso2J54a4nRtk1N5rXonUactkVeahB.jpg)
Finally, I combined both mixtures so the flavors would blend together. At this point, I adjusted the seasoning and cooked it for another fifteen minutes, which was enough time for the chicken and potatoes to cook through. The final step was to serve and enjoy my delicious chicken and pea soup. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La receta de hoy fue una deliciosa sopa de arvejas a la que le adicioné un muslo de pollo para darle más sabor a la preparación. Me encantan las arvejas porque son una fuente de nutrientes espectacular, entre todos los granos es mi favorito por su sabor, textura y versatilidad. En esta ocasión me incliné por una sopa ligera, de allí que evité combinar con huesos ahumados, costillas, chorizo u otros ingredientes tradicionales.
![1000110523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/2432BKAtavJmrubtQBMTHJgV7hcwqLzgx96LM5y2uCZddnvxmczHyPYSRkaA7HxuVyPiP.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 1 muslo de pollo - 100 gramos de arvejas - 1 papa - 4 ajíes dulces - 1 cebolla - 4 tazas de agua - Aceite - Sal al gusto
![1000110508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ynKwGep7K79Ug3G5vZnFKNKPmkKojvPsUuQryZTakhpLezcvgC4wCf52DSirLRRiiin.jpg)
## Preparación: Coloqué a remojar las arvejas con suficiente agua por alrededor de cinco horas, a veces es recomendable guardarlas en la nevera desde la noche anterior, así se asegura que estén blandas y aptas para comer. Transcurrido ese tiempo las limpié, retirando todas las impurezas. Después las monté a sancochar junto a dos tazas de agua y media cucharada de sal, le puse una tapa a la olla para apresurar este proceso. Estuvieron blandas en cuarenta minutos.
![1000110514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y8oSCdXwKM283Jpgrx6MvTVTdEgpZHvbdgug6oPKwLaRNSB5JAXrEn8SW9BJSHgnXDA.jpg)
Luego me dispuse a retirar las semillas de los ajíes, desconchar la cebolla y pelar la papa. Dividí todo en pedazos pequeños que coloqué en un sartén con un poco de aceite, allí los sofreí y poco después agregué la pieza de pollo previamente lavada y despellejada.
![1000110517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvkpfSRASzGxYsjrixo1mzd8BKXjnUa4Ebd9yT2drmT6t7J7d3gmg43obWnoKkmvqTd.jpg)
![1000110520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23w2qBaLx4ZBqJA98rcXD4CmfaxauEULXGfPgBhCso2J54a4nRtk1N5rXonUactkVeahB.jpg)
Finalmente uní ambas preparaciones para que se integran los sabores, en este punto ajusté el punto de sal y cociné por quince minutos adicionales, tiempo suficiente para que el pollo y las papas se cocinaran por completo. El paso final fue servir y disfrutar de mi deliciosa sopa de arvejas con pollo.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.body: **, la novela póstuma de **Gabriel García Márquez**. Salió a la luz este año, diez años después de la muerte del autor. Trata sobre Ana Magdalena Bach, una mujer que cada agosto viaja a una isla para visitar la tumba de su madre y, de paso, tener una aventura con un desconocido. Ha dado mucho de qué hablar porque el propio \
pidió que el libro se destruyera, pero sus hijos decidieron publicarlo, lo que abrió un debate ético gigante en el mundo literario.\n\nEstoy por recibir **\

**, la nueva novela de **Sally Rooney** (la autora de Normal People). Se publicó hace muy poco y ha paralizado las redes sociales y las listas de preventa. Ha sido escrito en inglés y aún no se habla de edición traducida al español, pero estoy seguro de que pronto lo publica.

La historia gira en torno a dos hermanos, Peter e Ivan Koubek, que no se parecen en nada y no se llevan especialmente bien. Peter es un abogado de treinta y tantos, exitoso y carismático en apariencia, pero está colapsando emocionalmente. Ivan, de 22 años, es un ajedrecista profesional, socialmente torpe y mucho más introvertido.

Instruir sus vidas mientras se enredan en relaciones amorosas complicadas: Peter navega entre el amor de su vida y una chica mucho más joven, e Ivan se enamora de una mujer mayor que él, lo que genera tensiones familiares.

<sup>NOTA: Mi hijo Matthew maneja un amplio vocabulario para su edad. Jugamos mucho Scrabble en tres idiomas: español (paterno), inglés (materno) y francés (pensum en la escuela).</sup>
