body.title: Speech bubble  for school
body.body: >Esta será una semana muy estresante ya que en la escuela estan pidiendo muchas cosas por ser la semana aniversario de la escuela, realmente tenia que haber hecho dos cosas y solamente hice una porque no tengo tiempo de dedicarme a hacer tantas manualidades para la escuela, a pesar de que pidieron dinero para comprar decoraciones tambien quieren que nosotros hagamos decoraciones a mano, me parece bastante absurdo, en fin, solo accedí a hacer esta speech bubble que es como un dialogo de caricatura, por alguna razón querían que fuese con forma de pastel y con el numero 59 para hacer referencia a los años que esta cumpliendo la escuela. > This is going to be a really stressful week because the school is asking for so much since it’s the school’s anniversary week. I really should have done two things, but I only did one because I don’t have time to make so many crafts for the school. Even though they asked for money to buy decorations, they also want us to make handmade decorations—which seems pretty absurd to me. Anyway, I only agreed to make this speech bubble, which is like a cartoon dialogue. For some reason, they wanted it to be shaped like a cake and have the number 59 on it to mark the school’s anniversary. ![IMG_20260420_203743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xouo8yHsFZYHcrxcSUquG4mZ8AHzHc9VcZzUb5PbVD5Bsqzo36wmwWcnpiXQ62hpscu.jpg)

>Muy pocas veces he dibujado comida o dulces, asi que hacer el pastel fue un poco difícil y mas tomando en cuenta el tamaño que pidieron, de hecho, creo que tenía que ser más grande, pero es el tamaño máximo que pude lograr sin que me saliera deforme. Decidí hacer un pastel de chocolate con crema de fresas jaja, tambien hice el numero 59 en grande justo en el centro, el nro 5 había quedado super hermoso pero el 9 si quedo un poco extraño. > I rarely draw food or sweets, so making the cake was a bit tricky—especially given the size they requested. In fact, I think it should have been bigger, but this was the largest size I could manage without it turning out misshapen. I decided to make a chocolate cake with strawberry cream, haha. I also drew a big number 59 right in the center. The 5 turned out really beautiful, but the 9 ended up looking a little weird. ![IMG_20260419_102513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/Eo27aVMn3A9R44VrZKVWgmXZyzqJ2X2VpEHTBsKJi6bFvi8fxvX5vFLf4wDsuFzhUv4.jpg)

>Después de hacer el boceto repase con marcador negro, intentando ser un poco mas precisa. Ignorando las líneas esquizofrénicas del boceto y luego borrando todo rastro del boceto a lápiz, dejando el dibujo bastante limpio, por cierto use una cartulina gruesa para este trabajo. > After sketching, go over it with a black marker, trying to be a little more precise. Ignore the jagged lines of the sketch and then erase all traces of the pencil sketch, leaving the drawing fairly clean. By the way, I used thick cardstock for this project. ![IMG_20260419_103526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoGztZJX7kHeMiSrfJTznR6jt4CPkDnaNSSAYsQdaGHJfWAPmXZMwhR2RYKZUWw8H3i.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_104008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoK8GeBXDuDQ66HrPeVt8R9KTNdwnGjhhLZisQfMYMrJ4jjPKLKD4NEWs6kRdvMxwCb.jpg)

>El resto consistió en pintar usando lápices y marcadores, para la parte marrón tuve que usar colores obligatoriamente porque mis marcadores ya estan muriendo, los colores marrones que me quedan no son los mejores asi que no logre un color profundo como lo imaginé. Pero tampoco iba a estresarme demasiado por eso, al final es algo que es para la escuela y probablemente en dos días termine en la basura. Para el nro 59 use un marcador dorado, creo que fue lo mas satisfactorio de pintar. > The rest involved coloring with pencils and markers. For the brown parts, I had to use colored pencils because my markers are running out; the brown colors I have left aren’t the best, so I didn’t achieve the deep shade I’d imagined. But I wasn’t going to stress too much about it—after all, it’s just for school and will probably end up in the trash in two days. For No. 59, I used a gold marker; I think that was the most satisfying part of the project. ![IMG_20260419_105106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoeHHy7V3ZvxDABTH2FujRL88HqVPUu8ch1ME2fAjMDnDWtUzKNrjcLTXbSSXhhuBrG.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_115009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/Eoke1w2Mc4Lhf6ZZbWCdXe8CuBxQ5XoMsU9rpVhrTF5qjw3XCPDmhDFKkqssdRSkB7h.jpg)

>Termine el resto con marcadores rosas y lilas y una vez terminado recorte el pastel y le pegue un palillo detrás, pegar ese palillo fue terrible porque no me había dado cuenta que me quedaba poco silicón, asi que hice magia para poder pegarlo, espero que no se suelte jaja. > Finish the rest with pink and lilac markers, and once you’re done, cut out the cake and glue a toothpick to the back. Glueing that toothpick was a nightmare because I hadn’t realized I was running low on silicone, so I had to work some magic to get it to stick. I hope it doesn’t come loose, haha. ![IMG_20260419_121206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoeEppL92E7djYrw93pAeb87Ah3UUrvUA4gNhGb7EvKXUazZWrFTKMcByWo2EmAGVAN.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_203747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/241tXLWRf4Mq87VKFipgCxcV92MryPHHYRTwtc2yN9rT4iEEEqeiAmerExpzYb9ji7ewv.jpg)

body.title: Elaborando y degustando sabroso menú de: Espaguetis mixtos con jamonada, zanahorias, y puré de plátano. (Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español 
# Saludos amigos amantes de la comida💁🌈
¡Feliz día para todos!
Esta semana la quise iniciar con un suculento menú con pastas, compuesto por: Espaguetis mixtos con jamonada de pollo, zanahoria, y un suave puré de plátano.Una delicia en degustación amigos, de la que les quiero compartir  las recetas que empleé para su obtención, esperando que les gusten  y que pronto la recréen  para deleite familiar.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_151238920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR37Koc3x91c7rRDbGJCPdpWvF3jYEtrjjs4WQtQD5PCh4HQ3q8aTLfmvXpRbJQ5TZZ.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Ingredientes generales del menú para tres comensales✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_152132741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wgWfFaMVK2sT4anNbAEaFNepFrCedC8f9awvMFH16qTJCmdgAHaCH7qC2uzvEyByqs6.jpg)
</center>
#
.Especias: 3 cebollas medianas, 2 pimientos, 9 dientes de ajo.
.Espaguetis: 1 paquete de 500g
.Jamonada de pollo: 1/2 libra
.Zanahoria troceada: 1 lata de 411g
.Plátanos verdes: 5 unidades.
.Pasta de tomate: 5 cucharadas 
.Aceite de oliva: 6 cucharadas 
.Agua: 3 tazas para los espaguetis, y suficiente para el lavado y preparado de los alimentos.
.Sal: 1/2 cucharada  para los espaguetis, 1/3 para la cocción de los plátanos.

# ✨Modo de confección✨
Las pastas mixtas, fue el primer alimento que elaboré.
# ✨Espaguetis mixtos con jamonada de pollo y zanahorias.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_152319253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsZMTWx9qnh9joB23CBxmwEnLh53Kg6wfTaFMNfhfYHkUSorWoFgCfvARwBgf7D1MSx.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder lavando  las especias: cebolla, pimientos; despojándolas de sus partes no comestibles, y cortándolas en delgadas tiras.Seguidamente, tomé la jamonada de pollo, y con ayuda de un cuchillo,  la corté en pequeños cuadraditos.Luego, con ayuda de un abridor, logré la apertura de la lata de zanahorias, a la que le extraje su saludable contenido interno.
Ya teniendo todos los ingredientes listos, pasé a cocer las pastas de la siguiente forma:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_152958763.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6BsUbTnRRoQ1C7Lnv6MJFMmXZnMBPRFTkc4ZuASeK3VxyDSCktXWn6NRxhKgkwDpkj.jpg)
</center>
#
En una olla incorporé 3 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, las especias preparadas, 3 cucharadas de pasta de tomate, y comencé a saltearlas por unos segundos.Seguidamente, agregué al sofrito, la jamonada de pollo, las zanahorias troceadas, y continué salteándolos por unos segundos más.Luego,  agregué a la olla : 3 tazas de agua,1/2 cucharada de sal y dejé hervir el agua condimentada por un minuto, para que se impregnara del sabor de las especias, además, de evitar que las pastas se adhirieran unas a otras, como suele suceder, cuando se vierten en agua fría inicialmente. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_153233241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi8TSutZdrqYgmGJTQmDbzacgeuBiDJwmA1TXukm57GgeJDGJo4iiDZG4iUPt1tHfGC.jpg)
</center>
#
Proseguí la elaboración,  abriendo el paquete de espaguetis, troceándolos centralmente, y vertiéndolo en el agua condimentada.Tapé la olla, y la puse a presión por cinco minutos.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_153418906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242DQXRGP5u5f8Vonzx9RiSdKkK3hoRQcHtUA66gkw4UUaLY53hGj61hrr8WV2kuCaUNE.jpg)
</center>
#
Apetecible a la vista, quedó ésta rica pasta mixta resultante.
El segundo alimento que elaboré para complementar los espaguetis, fue el puré de plátano.

# ✨Puré de plátano
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_153543265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR37ixLNyBy5kso34UaB95yLtatgfwxGM6HasEbnXuG4QSQRgM9xutCeQSVr2DqGETN.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder lavando, pelando y cortando centralmente 5 plátanos verdes. Seguidamente, los incorporé en una olla con agua que los cubriera, 1/3 cucharada de sal, una cucharada de vinagre, y los puse a presión por 7 minutos.Transcurrido el tiempo, los plátanos se encontraban con su textura blanda, así, que proseguí a extraerlos del agua para un recipiente, dónde con ayuda de un tenedor, fui aplastándolos hasta lograr un puré homogéneo, al que condimenté con: ajo previamente triturado y 2 cucharadas de aceite de oliva. ¡Delicioso el puré, amigos, que no pude evitar decorarlo asemejando el pastel de  Blanca Nieves y los 7 enanitos, al venirme en pensamientos  durante su proceso de cocción, ésta magnífica película animada.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_154246249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zGoR8oR8iUmqazki2HopMx21u6C2qEWfgSP5dtUW1yrQCNcRhjn47ALnjeQ1p6m9JvU.jpg)
</center>
#

Tanto los espaguetis mixtos cómo el puré de plátanos,¡ me encantaron!, y más,  al ser degustados con mi familia, quiénes dieron muestra de aprobación al sazón deleitado, con exclamaciones gratificantes. Bueno  amigos, me despido por hoy,  deseándoles a todos vibras positivas y una próspera semana.¡Abrazos!
Fotografías propias.
*** 
# English
# Preparing and tasting tasty menu of: Mixed spaghetti with ham, carrots, and mashed banana. 
# Greetings fellow foodies💁🌈
Happy day to everyone!
I wanted to start this week with a succulent pasta menu, consisting of: Mixed spaghetti with chicken ham, carrots, and a soft banana puree.A delight in tasting friends, of which I want to share the recipes that I used to obtain it, hoping that you like them and that soon I will recré it for family delight.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_151238920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR37Koc3x91c7rRDbGJCPdpWvF3jYEtrjjs4WQtQD5PCh4HQ3q8aTLfmvXpRbJQ5TZZ.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨General menu ingredients for three people✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_152132741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wgWfFaMVK2sT4anNbAEaFNepFrCedC8f9awvMFH16qTJCmdgAHaCH7qC2uzvEyByqs6.jpg)
</center>
#
.Spices: 3 medium onions, 2 bell peppers, 9 garlic cloves.
.Spaghetti: 1 package of 500g
.Chicken ham: 1/2 pound
.Chopped carrot: 1 can of 411g
.Green bananas: 5 units.
.Tomato paste: 5 tablespoons 
.Olive oil: 6 tablespoons 
.Water: 3 cups for spaghetti, and enough for washing and preparing food.
.Salt: 1/2 tablespoon for spaghetti, 1/3 for cooking bananas.

# ✨Mode of preparation✨
Mixed pasta was the first food I made.
# ✨Mixed spaghetti with chicken ham and carrots.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_152319253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsZMTWx9qnh9joB23CBxmwEnLh53Kg6wfTaFMNfhfYHkUSorWoFgCfvARwBgf7D1MSx.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the procedure by washing the spices: onion, peppers; stripping them of their inedible parts, and cutting them into thin strips.Next, I took the chicken ham, and with the help of a knife, I cut it into small squares.Then, with the help of an opener, I managed to open the can of carrots, to which I extracted its healthy internal contents.
Having all the ingredients ready, I went on to cook the pasta as follows:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_152958763.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23u6BsUbTnRRoQ1C7Lnv6MJFMmXZnMBPRFTkc4ZuASeK3VxyDSCktXWn6NRxhKgkwDpkj.jpg)
</center>
#
In a pot I incorporated 3 tablespoons of olive oil, the prepared spices, 3 tablespoons of tomato paste, and started to saute them for a few seconds.Next, I added the chicken ham, the chopped carrots to the sofrito, and continued to sauté them for a few more seconds.Then, I added to the pot: 3 cups of water, 1/2 tablespoon of salt and let the seasoned water boil for a minute, so that it would be impregnated with the flavor of the spices, in addition, to prevent the pasta from sticking to each other, as usually happens, when they are poured into cold water initially. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_153233241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi8TSutZdrqYgmGJTQmDbzacgeuBiDJwmA1TXukm57GgeJDGJo4iiDZG4iUPt1tHfGC.jpg)
</center>
#
I continued the preparation, opening the package of spaghetti, chopping them centrally, and pouring it into the seasoned water.I covered the pot, and put it on pressure for five minutes.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_153418906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242DQXRGP5u5f8Vonzx9RiSdKkK3hoRQcHtUA66gkw4UUaLY53hGj61hrr8WV2kuCaUNE.jpg)
</center>
#
Appetizing to the eye, this resulting rich mixed pasta remained.
The second food I made to complement the spaghetti was mashed banana.

# ✨Mashed banana
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_153543265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR37ixLNyBy5kso34UaB95yLtatgfwxGM6HasEbnXuG4QSQRgM9xutCeQSVr2DqGETN.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the process by washing, peeling and cutting 5 green bananas centrally. Then, I incorporated them in a pot with water to cover them, 1/3 tablespoon of salt, a tablespoon of vinegar, and put them under pressure for 7 minutes.After a while, the bananas were with their soft texture, so, I continued to extract them from the water for a container, where with the help of a fork, I crushed them until I achieved a homogeneous puree, which I seasoned with: previously crushed garlic and 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Delicious the mash, friends, I couldn't help but decorate it resembling the cake of Snow White and the 7 dwarfs, when I came in thoughts during its cooking process, this magnificent animated movie.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260420_154246249.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zGoR8oR8iUmqazki2HopMx21u6C2qEWfgSP5dtUW1yrQCNcRhjn47ALnjeQ1p6m9JvU.jpg)
</center>
#

Both the mixed spaghetti and the mashed bananas, I loved them!, and more, when being tasted with my family, who gave a sign of approval to the delighted seasoning, with gratifying exclamations. Well friends, I say goodbye for today, wishing you all positive vibes and a prosperous week.Hugs!
Own photographs.

body.title: Film Review: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang (1932)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/jxTIZLp9Oz3Dp2nPsR3PuSH9F4J.jpg)



In the history of cinema, numerous grand films have ascended to classic status through the sheer quality of the talents assembled both behind and in front of the camera. Yet, the chances for obtaining such hallowed recognition were invariably magnified if the filmmakers also possessed the impeccable timing. Few films in history have benefited from being crafted at such a perfectly opportune moment as the 1932 prison drama *I Am a Fugitive from a Chain Gang*. Released at the nadir of the Great Depression and in the brief, audacious window of Pre-Code Hollywood, the film harnessed a potent blend of social outrage, raw narrative power, and cinematic modernity to create a work that remains a searing indictment of systemic injustice and a landmark of American realism.

The film’s formidable impact is rooted in its startling provenance: the true-life ordeal of Robert Elliott Burns. A World War I veteran, Burns had gained notoriety for escaping Georgia’s notoriously brutal penal system, rebuilding his life in Chicago as a respected publisher, only to be rearrested and returned to prison. Following a second, successful escape, he took refuge in New Jersey with his brother, Vincent Godfrey Burns, a Congregationalist minister. Together, they crafted his memoirs, initially serialised in *True Detective*, as part of a public relations campaign to forestall a second extradition. This sensational story, echoing the archetypal struggles of Victor Hugo’s Jean Valjean, captured the imagination of Warner Bros. executives Jack L. Warner and Daryl F. Zanuck. They swiftly secured the rights, assigning the project to director Mervyn LeRoy, a rising master of gritty, contemporary drama.

The screenplay by Howard J. Green and Brown Holmes hewed closely to Burns’s harrowing account, albeit with a degree of protective fictionalisation. The protagonist was renamed James Allen, portrayed by Paul Muni. The film opens in the aftermath of the Great War, with Allen, a decorated veteran, returning to a nation ill-equipped to reward his service. Rejecting the stifling monotony of his old factory job, he embodies the displaced American dream, seeking meaningful work in construction where he can “build things.” This aspiration, however, curdles into a desperate odyssey of low-paid, transient labour that leads him, penniless, to the American South. There, a fateful encounter sees him coerced into participating in a petty diner robbery—a crime for which he bears minimal culpability but receives maximum punishment: ten years of hard labour on a chain gang.

What follows is a descent into a hellscape of institutionalised brutality. LeRoy’s direction refuses to aestheticise the suffering; the clanking chains, the relentless sun, and the casual violence of the guards are rendered with a documentary-like starkness. In this inferno, Allen forges crucial bonds with two fellow inmates: the seasoned, pragmatic Bomber Willis (Edward Ellis) and the younger Barney Sykes (Allen Jenkins). It is Bomber who advises Allen on the necessity of a meticulously planned escape, suggesting he seek outside help from Barney upon the latter’s release. The escape itself is a masterclass in suspense, aided by a moment of quiet solidarity from Sebastian (Everett Brown), a black inmate who strikes Allen’s chains to loosen them. In a detail that would soon become verboten under the impending Hays Code, Allen’s actual break for freedom is facilitated by the simple, human ruse of feigning the need to relieve himself in the bushes.

Achieving liberty in Chicago, Allen, under the alias “Allen James,” painstakingly reconstructs a life. He ascends from labourer to respected manager in a construction firm, a poignant fulfilment of his original ambition. Yet, the film shrewdly avoids a simplistic redemption arc. His marriage to his landlady, Marie (Glenda Farrell), is a hollow transaction that disintegrates under the weight of her infidelities and his own emotional attachment to another woman, the compassionate Helen (Helen Vinson). This personal turmoil proves his undoing. In a fit of vindictive rage, Marie exposes his true identity, triggering his arrest. The ensuing extradition battle becomes a public spectacle, with Allen’s eloquent denunciation of the chain gang’s barbarism winning widespread sympathy. A cynical compromise is offered: return as a trustee and receive a pardon in ninety days. In a decision that seals his tragic fate, Allen accepts, only for the humiliated Southern authorities to renege, throwing him back into chains to serve his full, monstrous sentence.

The second escape, undertaken with Bomber, is even more desperate and ends in tragedy with Bomber’s death. Allen’s final flight to Chicago is a ghostly farewell. In one of the most devastating climaxes in cinema history, he meets Helen in shadows. When she asks how he will survive, his reply—delivered by Muni with a hollow, haunted finality—is an epitaph for the American Dream: “I steal.” The scene fades to black as he retreats into the darkness, a moment of inspired improvisation born from a blown fuse on set that LeRoy astutely retained. This ending is far bleaker than Burns’s own eventual pardon in 1945, a fictional turn that elevates the story from individual biography to a universal parable of a system designed to crush the human spirit.

*I Am a Fugitive from a Chain Gang* was blessed by its historical moment in two profound ways. Firstly, it emerged in the thrilling, short-lived era of Pre-Code Hollywood, after the advent of sound but before the strictures of the Hays Code enforced a moralistic straitjacket on film content. LeRoy, a maestro of this period following successes like *[Little Caesar](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-little-caesar-1931)*, directs with a brisk, modern tempo, utilising authentic exterior locations and editing that feels remarkably contemporary. The film’s modernity is etched in provocative details later deemed unacceptable: the interracial solidarity with Sebastian, the urination ruse, and the unambiguous implication that the released Barney is a pimp, who offers one of his women, Linda (Noel Francis), to comfort the fugitive Allen—an offer the broken man reluctantly accepts. This unvarnished realism grants the film a power that later, more sanitised social dramas lacked.

Secondly, its release coincided with the peak of the Great Depression. Audiences, themselves grappling with economic desperation and a loss of faith in institutions, saw their own struggles reflected in Allen’s plight. He was not a criminal by nature but a victim of circumstance, chewed up by a merciless societal machine. This resonance transformed the film from a mere thriller into a cultural lightning rod, contributing to its significant box-office success. That commercial triumph was matched by critical acclaim, culminating in Academy Award nominations for Best Picture and Best Actor for Paul Muni’s monumental, psychologically nuanced performance.

The film’s legacy is immense. It cemented Warner Bros.’ reputation as Hollywood’s most socially conscious studio, willing to tackle gritty, politically charged material. It is a definitive Pre-Code artifact, a testament to what American cinema could achieve when freed from puritanical censorship. While later adaptations, such as HBO’s 1987 television film *The Man Who Broke 1000 Chains* starring Val Kilmer, might hew more accurately to Burns’s biography, they lack the raw, immediate fury and timeless artistic force of LeRoy’s original. 


RATING: 8/10 (+++)

body.title: Are We Ready for Short-form Content?
body.body: I've been seriously mulling over my idea to create a community and curate it. I have a rough plan in place. The question I keep thinking that leaves me wondering is if the type of shortform content I'm considering would be accepted. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBwPFBEPXLWiojPzhvBLGmkdPSvZi1CaXD5jBAnUFob7/1776740353688.jpg)(Created with Bing) The content itself isn't anything vile, illegal, immoral or shocking. I've heard some on Hive don't care for shortform content and are more likely to downvote it. The reality is that not only do most curators not want to read 1000+ words, your average person reading something on Hive doesn't want to stick around that long. I think that's where we lose a good number of people. Blame whoever you like, but most people these days have the attention span of a gerbil. I'm sure I already lost 60% of readers well before that sentence when they saw this massive block of text. Shortform content doesn't need to be profound or enlightening. It simply needs to entertain the reader and keep them scrolling and coming back for more. When people realize they can post that same content on Hive and be rewarded, then you've caught their interest. Once they realize even they can do it, now they're dipping in their toe. Once you get them connected into a community, then they're hooked. It's what drew me in, why I'm still here and looking to take the next step. So, what do you think? Is Hive ready for a new trend of shortform content other than Ecency Waves and Snapie? I think so, but are enough people willing to experiment and take a chance? ![1000017156.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulliontools/23uEyyyWCHidcDUBLiCySb4thnoMosshmypAS8GVUkhHC52LCiQqrB6L9Fom29shmtCMN.gif)

body.title: (ESP//ENG) GALLETAS POLVOROSAS 🧡 // CRUMBLY COOKIES 🧡
body.body: > Hola Feliz noche para todos ❤️ Deseo que estén de maravilla... Por aquí estoy súper mega feliz ¿Saben por qué? Es que al fin logré realizar mis querídas *Galletas Polvorosas* y es que ustedes no se imaginan lo mucho que me gustan estás galletas y lo difícil que había sido para mí realizarlas; intenté uff muchas recetas pero ninguna me quedaba bien... Estos días atrás encontré una receta y un video donde explicaban cosas que yo no sabía y en mis mezclas pasadas no quedaban así. Entonces me dije: ¿Por qué no insertar nuevamente? Y así hice, con mucho amor y fe, me puse manos a la obra e hice mis galletas; quedando súper deliciosas y con la textura ideal, al mordelas literal se vuelven polvito... Les cuento como las hice: **INGREDIENTES:** 125GR DE MANTECA 125GR DE AZÚCAR 250GR DE HARINA DE TRIGO 1 CUCHARADITA DE VAINILLA 1/2 CUCHARADITA DE CANELA ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWYRTp52huC4PUcnk1YyZHESs8kYpjhJdofWJZjpWDoj/1776739657924.jpg) **PASO A PASO:** Primero se debe pesar todos los ingredientes para ya tenerlos listos a la mano. Ahora bien debemos cremar la manteca con ayuda de un batidor eléctrico preferiblemente, cuando logremos la textura suave se le coloca la canela y la vainilla y volvemos a mezcla hasta integrar todo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXLEwhPcVMtiP75Pw5CLZVRvGcYJvFtfVP9WgzWyY6Tg9/1776739875202.jpg) Se incorporar el azúcar y con el batidor integramos todo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1WvrAQhRmNfYwNinTYJrrdRDmMDwCc1TTsyawvkWrCR/1776739906902.jpg) Luego se agrega la harina de trigo, yo lo hice en dos partes. La primera parte la incorpore con ayuda de una paleta y la segunda parte de la harina lo hice con mi mano, poco a poco hasta lograr esa textura de arena mojada (todo integrado pero no cremoso ni compacto) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRBWe6w3LvfbATEpXAkiEaQCod8NBZ1dMbiNrpu8NjkS/1776740001112.jpg) En este punto fui ya encendiendo el horno a 160° y preparando mi bandeja la cual le coloque aceite y luego harina. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecwsqDPmJ7uj4dzXuqpZLtzsCK1od3LapFXbvQr5R22Z/1776740119179.jpg) Ahora bien con ayuda de una cuchara mediadora (la medida más grande) fui tomando porciones de la mezcla y luego con cuidado la fui sacando y colocando en la bandeja, hasta que me quedé sin mezcla. Con un tenedor fui presionando cada galletita para darle esa fórma rallada en la parte de arriba.. Me salieron 24und ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUvkVZcW6fFVPUhx8aWxtVoN84ZqsraqwmsRjEDECb6v/1776740243735.jpg) Las lleve al horno durante 10 min ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXczDhKt7dGryoQMAVQRzwrumNLSfwbT1XCeNZjxgCkg5/1776740323276.jpg) Las retire pasado el tiempo y dejé reposar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmegzVASQ5vE5FNK3PUeZrhu7oe4dCpDjeYPXikbTBajxX/1776740347323.jpg) Así de linda quedaron las galletitas, como dije en un principio con la textura ideal y correcta, quedé muy satisfecha con el resultado. Uno de los típs más importante es cremar la manteca e integrar la harina a mano, para lograr esa textura de arena húmeda. Esto fue lo que me ayudó a lograr hacerlas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT1zRe9DhkwBXJ4ahDaYWLnBPoPjjueUWm8AaA2tC9m7U/1776740459520.jpg) Finalicé colocando algo de azúcar glas por el encima y listo (esto es opcional) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbCRN5KVJRL6gJvZLm1mxbVJ2H1fb5bgqBWvxy6uK3DD/1776740519867.jpg) Gracias a Dios logre al fin dar con la receta ideal... Listas para degustar... **Portada editada con Canva** **Fotografías de mi propiedad** **Traductor DeepL** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfEfpPRbGmw5ujWfgr7t6WFnB3QmewshX1rbk9AALma1G/1776739213728.jpg) Hi, everyone! Have a wonderful evening ❤️ I hope you’re all doing great... I’m super, super happy over here. Do you know why? Because I finally managed to make my beloved *Crumbly Cookies*, and you have no idea how much I love these cookies and how hard it had been for me to get them right; I tried so many recipes, but none of them turned out right... A few days ago, I found a recipe and a video that explained things I didn’t know, and my previous batches didn’t turn out that way. So I said to myself: Why not try again? And that’s what I did—with lots of love and faith, I got to work and made my cookies; they turned out super delicious and with the perfect texture—when you bite into them, they literally crumble into dust... Here’s how I made them: **INGREDIENTS:** 125g BUTTER 125g SUGAR 250g WHEAT FLOUR 1 TEASPOON VANILLA EXTRACT 1/2 TEASPOON CINNAMON ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWYRTp52huC4PUcnk1YyZHESs8kYpjhJdofWJZjpWDoj/1776739657924.jpg) **STEP-BY-STEP:** First, weigh all the ingredients so they’re ready and within reach. Next, cream the butter using an electric mixer (preferably). Once you achieve a smooth texture, add the cinnamon and vanilla, and mix again until everything is well combined. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXLEwhPcVMtiP75Pw5CLZVRvGcYJvFtfVP9WgzWyY6Tg9/1776739875202.jpg) Add the sugar and mix everything together with the mixer. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1WvrAQhRmNfYwNinTYJrrdRDmMDwCc1TTsyawvkWrCR/1776739906902.jpg) Then add the wheat flour; I did this in two parts. I incorporated the first part using a spatula, and I added the second part of the flour by hand, little by little, until I achieved a wet sand texture (everything incorporated but not creamy or compact) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRBWe6w3LvfbATEpXAkiEaQCod8NBZ1dMbiNrpu8NjkS/1776740001112.jpg) At this point, I preheated the oven to 160°C and prepared my baking sheet by greasing it with oil and then dusting it with flour. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecwsqDPmJ7uj4dzXuqpZLtzsCK1od3LapFXbvQr5R22Z/1776740119179.jpg) Now, using a measuring spoon (the largest size), I scooped out portions of the mixture and carefully placed them on the baking sheet until I ran out of batter. I used a fork to press down on each cookie to give them that crisscross pattern on top. I ended up with 24 cookies ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUvkVZcW6fFVPUhx8aWxtVoN84ZqsraqwmsRjEDECb6v/1776740243735.jpg) I baked them for 10 minutes ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXczDhKt7dGryoQMAVQRzwrumNLSfwbT1XCeNZjxgCkg5/1776740323276.jpg) I took them out after that time and let them cool. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmegzVASQ5vE5FNK3PUeZrhu7oe4dCpDjeYPXikbTBajxX/1776740347323.jpg) The cookies turned out this pretty—just as I said at the beginning, with the perfect texture. I was very satisfied with the result. One of the most important tips is to cream the butter and mix in the flour by hand to achieve that wet sand texture. That’s what helped me make them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT1zRe9DhkwBXJ4ahDaYWLnBPoPjjueUWm8AaA2tC9m7U/1776740459520.jpg) I finished by sprinkling some powdered sugar on top, and that’s it (this is optional) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbCRN5KVJRL6gJvZLm1mxbVJ2H1fb5bgqBWvxy6uK3DD/1776740519867.jpg) Thank goodness I finally found the perfect recipe... Ready to taste... **Cover edited with Canva** **Photos are my own** **DeepL Translator**

body.title: Film Review: Rental Family | Services that help you appreciate life more. 🎥🎭 [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
![1000174137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tmHhTCtY5Uc6pEd2xVzmahiMM38XJiLMaEaoB9j8Z1YMBZFvfe2jsHMUENMZ9CiD2Dx.jpg)


<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/gmKqBIgcltpVT3y9r)</sub></center>

Hello, film buffs! I hope you’re having a good start to the week. I’d seen several posts about the film **Rental Family**, including one from my friend @erigm, who always shares great reviews and insights with us. Her post piqued my curiosity about the film, not least because it stars Brendan Fraser, who plays the lead role. Another thing that caught my attention was that it was filmed in Tokyo and the whole story is set in that city, which makes this kind of story seem more original to me. I really liked this film, so I’d love for you to read my review of **Rental Family**, where nothing is what it seems. 

> Hola amigos cinéfilos, deseo que estén teniendo un buen inicio de semana. Había visto varias publicaciones de la película **Rental Family**, entre ellas la de mi amiga @erigm quien siempre nos comparte grandes reseñas y reflexiones. Su post me causó curiosidad por la película y también porque sale Brendan Fraser quien es el protagonista de la historia. Otra cosa que me llamó la atención fue que la filmaron en Tokio y todo el contexto de la historia se da en esa ciudad, lo que hace que me parezca más original este tipo de historias. Me gusto mucho esta película así que me gustaría que leyeran mi reseña de la película **Rental Family** donde nada es lo que parece. 


![1000143967.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23x1aktBcUwE3cnZqnH6GKvG6KLtF5EQ9gvnpksp9VH61hgnYegN2itwDejBAJ1f9z3eG.png)


![1000174139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoAaAxuMVn5cKoYerJewPpiePoHKNgZ6Ayg1a7a94Xf8uq8xgVQGmNopsS5NKtKko1v.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/LwV7DZxjAgd1b0DjC)</sub></center>

The story follows Philip (Brendan Fraser), a man who is in debt and desperately needs to find a new job. That’s when he comes across a company called **Rental Family**, which promises him he can continue doing what he loves—acting—but this job is different and rather unusual. Fraser must follow certain rules when hired as an actor to fulfil various requests from people seeking the service, and in return they can pay him for his performance. At first, he is very professional, even though he knows what he is doing isn’t entirely right, but he carries on because he needs the job and the money. Until he forms too close a bond with the people he meets, and from there everything begins to change. 

> La historia sigue a Philip un hombre (Brendan Fraser) quien está endeudado y necesita con urgencia encontrar un nuevo trabajo. Es allí cuando conoce una empresa llamada **Rental Family** que le promete poder seguir haciendo lo que le gusta —que es la actuación—, pero este trabajo es diferente y muy particular. Fraser debe seguir ciertas reglas al ser contratado como actor para cumplir con diferentes favores que necesitan las personas que buscan el servicio y a cambio pueden pagarle por su actuación. Al comienzo el es muy profesional aunque sabe que no está del todo bien lo que hace, pero continúa porque necesita el trabajo y el dinero. Hasta que conecta de más con las personas que conoce y desde allí todo empieza a cambiar. 

![1000143967.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23x1aktBcUwE3cnZqnH6GKvG6KLtF5EQ9gvnpksp9VH61hgnYegN2itwDejBAJ1f9z3eG.png)

![1000174140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/2423x9jAzmtMMxM7ea6AHGHmv6arc8pgFaYihp7585MeqWGvYtAcTRSuhTsupETUcGjT2.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/MmtHBZcWxwymlb67R)</sub></center>

Following his success in the film *The Whale*, Brendan Fraser takes on a story that blends two distinct genres: drama and comedy. This time, he must do what he does best: act. So, amidst his financial difficulties, he decides to accept the role, even though he knows it’s a delicate matter and that he must be very cautious. Fraser gives off an aura of being a very kind and empathetic person, and he conveys this very same quality in the film; he is concerned that the job isn’t just a job, and he looks for ways to do it well without hurting anyone in the process. 


> Después de su éxito en la película The Whale (La Ballena) Brendan Fraser apuesta por una historia donde se mezclan dos géneros distintos: el drama y la comedia. En esta ocasión debe hacer lo que mejor sabe hacer: actuar, por lo que en medio de sus problemas financieros decide aceptar el trabajo aunque sabe que es algo delicado y que debe ser muy prudente. Fraser me da un aura de ser una persona muy amable y empática y esto mismo lo transmite en la película, el se preocupa porque el trabajo no sea solo trabajo, busca la manera de hacerlo bien sin lastimar a nadie durante el proceso. 

![1000174141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23u5teD7d3B4pWAycLyNWfHwxoVrsXHhTgkibFafGWG16yhGbDJLxBB5vsAdJHpezP4gP.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/59hmSqnm124RO5QO9)</sub></center>

And that’s where things get more complicated, because he begins to empathise with an elderly man who is depressed and showing early signs of dementia; his daughter has hired him to help lift the man’s spirits and make him feel that his work has been worthwhile. During this time, Fraser becomes a writer who supposedly comes to gather the story of the old man’s life because he greatly admires him and wants to publish it in a major newspaper. At first, the old man refuses, but he later feels more at ease with him, to the point where he always wants to do things that his own daughter won’t allow him to do because she is struggling with the onset of dementia.

> Y es allí donde se complican más las cosas porque empieza a empatizar con un adulto mayor que está deprimido y que tiene principios de demencia, su hija contrata los servicios para que este se sienta menos deprimido y pueda sentir que su trabajo ha valido la pena. Durante este tiempo Fraser se convierte en un escritor, que supuestamente va a buscar la historia de la vida del señor porque le tiene gran admiración y porque lo quiere publicar en un periódico importante. Al comienzo el Señor se niega pero luego se siente más en confianza con el, a tal punto que siempre quiere hacer cosas que su propia hija no le permite porque tiene problemas con el inicio de la demencia. 

![1000174138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23x12aSd3qUcYEg72UPQMf3iDgyKPqXSRX9z6cwdMTgdJiCiTUH3DPTrmPVGLtoqbMpQc.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/oMA0kymguJAdJXOnB)</sub></center>

The other role is a bit more delicate: Fraser has to play a father so that a young girl can start at a new school; her mother hires him for the job and introduces them. Although at first the girl wants nothing to do with him, over time they end up connecting more deeply than anyone expected. It’s perhaps one of the roles I liked best that he played, and it moved me to see how he tried to portray, as best he could, an absent father returning from another country to meet his daughter and build a relationship with her. The scenes between the two of them are very touching, and you get the sense that, more than just a job, Fraser is beginning to connect emotionally with his ‘clients’. 

> El otro trabajo es un poco más delicado, Fraser debe ser un padre para que una niña pueda entrar en una nueva escuela, la madre de ella contrata los servicios y los presenta. Aunque al comienzo la niña no quiere tener ningún tipo de relación con el, terminan con el tiempo conectando más profundamente de lo que se esperaba. Tal vez es de los trabajos que más me gustó que hiciera y que me hizo sentir emocionada al ver como intentaba intérpretar de la mejor manera a un padre ausente que vuelve de otro país para conocer a su hija y tener una relación con ella. Las escenas de ambos son muy bonitas y se siente que más que un trabajo, Fraser empieza a conectar emocionalmente con sus \

. 

![1000174142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uQpZvK14G3NjfdTGX3CY33E1M8on38NdCkjCsCoydsvVKohbwk31EgxZR4TgK4vLVzp.jpg)

<center><sub>[source](https://share.google/7DilJ5J75uJQbvwGl)</sub></center>

The company, called Rental Family, presents itself as a normal business but provides this kind of service, and it employs two other Japanese staff members who serve the same purpose as Fraser. However, it is rather strange and sad that someone should have to hire such a service, and that the person providing it has to pretend to be someone they are not. Nevertheless, thanks to Fraser’s performance, I felt I connected deeply with the story; although there is drama and a touch of comedy, I felt I was watching a story that was worthwhile and that leaves you with a positive feeling of having seen a good film. I’m glad that Brendan Fraser is still acting and that, despite the time he spent away from the screen, he still feels passionate about what he does. 

> La empresa llamada Rental Family se encubre como una empresa normal pero da este tipo de servicios y tiene a otros dos trabajadores japoneses que también cumplen el mismo propósito que Fraser. Sin embargo, puede ser algo muy curioso y triste que alguien tenga que contratar un servicio y que el que lo da tenga que fingir ser alguien que no es. Sin embargo, con la interpretación de Fraser sentí que conecte mucho con la historia, aunque puede verse el drama y también un poco de comedia, me sentí viendo una historia que valía la pena y que deja una sensación positiva de haber visto una buena historia. Me alegra que siga Brendan Fraser actuando y que a pesar del tiempo que estuvo sin actuar, aún sienta pasión por lo que hace. 

![1000174146.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uQjtvYrfNpwj9XvNjraZo6oTv8DgRYReJFrg1dWf3x4Nmc9Px3Pn4Fx4NFbNax8B1Z4.gif)

<center><sub>[source](https://www.tumblr.com/freshmoviequotes/807399854563262464/rental-family-2025?source=share)</sub></center>

The situations depicted are crazy, but they manage to leave you with something to think about, particularly because, through this kind of work, Fraser was able to find a safe space and people with whom, although he met through work, the bond was far more important. I really enjoyed this story and loved the film; I feel that Fraser’s acting is genuine and that he’s well worth watching on screen. What’s more, the set design and direction in **Hikari** gave it that authentic feel of being in a country like Japan, so modern and developed in so many ways. It’s worth noting that the visuals were spectacular and really showcase just how incredible Japan is, with its towering buildings and unique customs. If you’re looking for something to make you laugh now and then and leave you with a warm feeling, don’t hesitate to watch this film – it’s absolutely brilliant. 🎥🍿

> Las situaciones que se presentan son alocadas, pero que tienen una forma de dejarte una buena reflexión sobre todo porque al hacer este tipo de trabajo, Fraser pudo encontrar un espacio seguro y personas que aunque conoció por el trabajo, el vínculo fue más importante. Disfrute mucho de esta historia y me encantó la película, siento que la forma de actuar de Fraser es genuina y que vale la pena verlo en escena. Además, la escenografía y la dirección de **Hikari** le dio ese toque de estar en un país como Japón, tan actualizado y desarrollado en tantos aspectos. Hay que destacar que las imágenes fueron espectaculares y muestran lo increíble que es Japón, con sus grandes edificios y las costumbres de ese país. Si quieren ver algo que les haga reír de vez en cuando y que también les dejé una sensación bonita, no duden en ver esta película que está increíble. 🎥🍿

body.title: Spring's icy breath on the gulf
body.body:
Spring on the Gulf of Finland is always special. It seems that winter doesn't want to retreat at all, and the ice still holds firm, but you can already see how the water is reclaiming its own. These huge, somewhat dirty ice floes, piled up by the shore, look like frozen waves. And there, in the distance, the outlines of the city are visible, reminding that life goes on, despite this harsh beauty. The sky is so clear, deep blue, with light clouds, it's hard to believe that everything here was covered in snow not long ago. A fresh wind pierces, but the sun already warms differently, promising quick warmth. You stand, look at this struggle of elements, and understand that every season has its unique charm.

https://i.ibb.co/CsYFQzJ0/DSC-1573.jpg

I love photography. I spend time in nature, walking around the city. And I often take pictures when I see something interesting.

I always edit my pictures (mostly using Lightroom) and love sharing them with the community.

And here you can see some of my works, that you can find in my blog

The great thing about buying online is that the prices are even cheaper than in the physical store, because they come directly from the manufacturer. This also means that the items aren't immediately available but are made to order, so our dining set was going to take a few days to arrive._

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8c9927cf-e394-4680-bb2a-fdf295eae8cc.jpg) Now early today I went to church we my wife and when I got the the car I looked at my wife and thought.... I've seen this pose before. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ce4b2541-0660-429c-a596-a8f255f5e0a7.jpg) Rosie the riveter from ww2 poster Anyways the steps were the same as always. Walk the dog in the morning. Walk the dog again in the evening. Same path, same park, same time... But sometimes routine is a good thing. Past that? My son has an old motorbike. I believe it is a 1991 Honda CB1. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/17420bae-71e1-40a5-8817-44b21bb590b3.jpg) As a dad I like it because.... It is small enough displacement at 390cc that it isn't super fast. But.. It is a high revving for cylinder engine so it sounds really cool ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7dd3b2cf-eeb3-4265-9220-dcd01b64542a.jpg) Notice how it redlines at 13,500rpm. How cool is that. My son went riding it with his girlfriend and there is one other reason I like it. The things keeps dying on him. A little sad because he has spent how trying to fix it and just spent $1100 for a repair shop to do the trip. Unfortunately it died on the ride home from the shop. As a dad it means my son isn't riding the motorcycle and I work every time he goes out on it ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/da137ade-74a3-4e2e-896f-09578d86e9ef.jpg) As a side note he has given up on the motorcycle. Because he found something he likes more. His Talaria. It's got torque .. it puts the wind in his hair .... Plus it's really cheap to get to work. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/85410c85-3d00-48f9-b0f1-93e666f2d2bc.jpg) At 80kph max it isn't as fast as the motorcycle but really fast enough to get him to work. Not importantly it doesn't need insurance, is super cheap on fuel (just electric) and lets him park in bike stalls. Now he actually prefers the Talaria because it is just easier and less stress. So... I'll walk places and he bikes places and I hope he sells the motorcycle because it would just make me happier if it was gone. And that's my report for the day Thanks for doing by

body.title: Sporting memories:  Learning a new football throw-in and getting penalized for it
body.body:
When I was in my early to mid teenage years, I was about as good at football of the soccer variety as I would ever be in my life.   I was so much better than a majority of the people that I played against that it was a situation of me kind of toying with my opposition a lot of the time.   This probably sounds like I am being arrogant but i am proud of this domination because it didn't come as a gift, I worked very hard to make it this way.   Hundreds of hours were spent practicing and honing my skills while my friends were off doing silly stuff like smoking pot and getting drunk and in trouble.   

Well one year, I had heard about this kind of throw in called the Volga I think it was, that involved doing a flip and then releasing the ball at the end of it.   This would result in the ball traveling much further and unless you are trying to turn a throw in into a corner kick of sorts, it isn't actually terribly useful because it is completely lacking in accuracy and mostly just gives the ball away to the defense.   It is, however, quite impressive to see it get done.

<center> https://s3.amazonaws.com/assets.thisisasn.com/production/attacheds/5170/original/MHarris_MikeRussellFoto-2.jpg?1389829032
[src](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/0/01/Do-a-Flip-Throw-in-Soccer-Step-8-Version-3.jpg/v4-460px-Do-a-Flip-Throw-in-Soccer-Step-8-Version-3.jpg)</center>

There was a guy on our team that was also a gymnast and he could do this flawlessly.  I struggled to do a flip so I instead did a rolling somersault that kids learn how to do at a very young age.   

I was only doing this to show off because like I mentioned, this is actually a pretty terrible tactical decision if you are trying to maintain possession of the ball.


There was one really big problem though and that was the officials and while I hope they have sorted this out in the 30 years since I was playing, the officials during games back in those days, had a very rudimentary knowledge of how the game is ruled.  

One thing that officials or referees loved to call out back in those days was improper throw ins and I look back and still roll my eyes about this.   It is such a minor part of the game and if you watch today even in the pros, the officials will allow a lot of lee-way as far as the point of the throw is concerned.  But in my league they seemed to want absolute pinpoint accuracy as far as the point of the throw was concerned.  A lot of time was wasted as far as these \

are concerned, and a lot of the kids were quite confused as to why the ball was lost.  In younger leagues I noticed some kids would rage-quit and cry because they don't like getting told off by an official.

To get back to me and my flip-throws.  I was very aware of the rules, often I was much more aware of them than the officials were.   The rule is merely that both feet must remain on the ground and that the ball must be thrown directly over the head.   There is nothing in the rules that says you cannot do a flip or spin around or whatever the hell else you want to do.   When I did my somersault throw and when my gymnast friend would do his proper flip throwin, our feet were both firmly on the ground that the ball came straight over our heads.  Yet, often, we would be whistled for a foul and the ball was given to the other team. 

<center> https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/0/01/Do-a-Flip-Throw-in-Soccer-Step-8-Version-3.jpg/v4-460px-Do-a-Flip-Throw-in-Soccer-Step-8-Version-3.jpg
[src](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/0/01/Do-a-Flip-Throw-in-Soccer-Step-8-Version-3.jpg/v4-460px-Do-a-Flip-Throw-in-Soccer-Step-8-Version-3.jpg)</center>   

One thing that the refs were really good at back in those days was asserting authority though, and often this arguing on our part merely resulted in us getting carded.  On one particular game after I got carded for the yellow, my coach actually got the official rulebook out and pointed out to the referee that the referee was wrong..... and then my coach got carded as well.

It didn't really matter because we won that game 5-0 but that's not the point.   The point is the officials didn't know how to do the job correctly and you would have to imagine that this impacted aspects of the game that actually DID matter.

body.title: Forget the mind.
body.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/12977273/pexels-photo-12977273.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-shot-of-a-fly-on-blooming-blue-flowers-12977273/ ) We humans are forgetful, it is not a disease, forgetting is an innate habit. We can sometimes remember the things we want to forget, but we often forget the things we want to remember. In fact, this remembering and forgetting is not controlled by us in any way. Which thing will remain in our memory and which thing we will forget is a matter completely unknown to us. Only the thing that can leave an impression in our subconscious mind and memory and seems worth remembering, then that thing remains in our memory or remains in our memory. And the thing that does not remain in our memory means that the event is not stored anywhere in the brain. In fact, forgetting is a habit that is innate in us. If you pay attention a little, you will see that we think about many things that we will remember, but we can never remember that thing, we forget it. In fact, our efforts do not matter. Remembering or forgetting is not within our power. Many people blame us for not considering something or a particular person as important, so we forget that thing or that particular person, but in fact, it is not like that at all. Giving importance to something or a person is one thing and forgetting is a completely different thing. If we pay attention to it, we will realize that we often forget to do many important things, which later causes us a lot of pain and makes us very angry with ourselves that how we forgot such an important thing. So whether a task is important or less important does not depend on our forgetting. In fact, we forget because we spend our whole day going through different types of tasks and we keep thinking about different types of tasks. As a result, we completely forget about another task during one task. There are many people who have a disease of forgetfulness or there are many who are very eccentric and do not feel the need to remember anything in that way or work with importance. Those people are completely different. But the case of ordinary forgetful people is completely different. Many times, when we are very worried about something or when we fall into a problem, we keep thinking in different ways to get out of that problem. Because of these reasons, we often forget to do our important tasks. Many people complain that a person has forgotten to wish their loved one on a very important day, such as a birthday or a special day, or has forgotten to give him a gift. In fact, no one does this thing of forgetting intentionally. People are constantly stuck in various troubles, due to which the human brain gets involved in different types of thoughts every second. It takes only a few seconds for a person to go from one object or one thought to another, so when a person starts thinking about one thing, he may completely forget the previous thing. There is no fault of any person in this. When a person is upset, he wants to refrain from doing various activities and wants to spend time alone, and at this time people forget many important things, words and even days. If you are upset, if you are unwell, if you are under pressure from various work, if you are in a problem, or even if you are worried about a particular person or thing, any normal person can forget any important thing. So if someone forgets something, then without getting angry with him, you should try to understand him and try to know about his problem. If we can be free from our worries and try to focus on various tasks well, then it is possible to fix our forgetful mind to a great extent. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)

body.title: Forget the mind.
body.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/12358249/pexels-photo-12358249.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-photograph-of-forget-me-not-flowers-12358249/ ) We humans are forgetful, it is not a disease, forgetting is an innate habit. We can sometimes remember the things we want to forget, but we often forget the things we want to remember. In fact, this remembering and forgetting is not controlled by us in any way. Which thing will remain in our memory and which thing we will forget is a matter completely unknown to us. Only the thing that can leave an impression in our subconscious mind and memory and seems worth remembering, then that thing remains in our memory or remains in our memory. And the thing that does not remain in our memory means that the event is not stored anywhere in the brain. In fact, forgetting is a habit that is innate in us. If you pay attention a little, you will see that we think about many things that we will remember, but we can never remember that thing, we forget it. In fact, our efforts do not matter. Remembering or forgetting is not within our power. Many people blame us for not considering something or a particular person as important, so we forget that thing or that particular person, but in fact, it is not like that at all. Giving importance to something or a person is one thing and forgetting is a completely different thing. If we pay attention to it, we will realize that we often forget to do many important things, which later causes us a lot of pain and makes us very angry with ourselves that how we forgot such an important thing. So whether a task is important or less important does not depend on our forgetting. In fact, we forget because we spend our whole day going through different types of tasks and we keep thinking about different types of tasks. As a result, we completely forget about another task during one task. There are many people who have a disease of forgetfulness or there are many who are very eccentric and do not feel the need to remember anything in that way or work with importance. Those people are completely different. But the case of ordinary forgetful people is completely different. Many times, when we are very worried about something or when we fall into a problem, we keep thinking in different ways to get out of that problem. Because of these reasons, we often forget to do our important tasks. Many people complain that a person has forgotten to wish their loved one on a very important day, such as a birthday or a special day, or has forgotten to give him a gift. In fact, no one does this thing of forgetting intentionally. People are constantly stuck in various troubles, due to which the human brain gets involved in different types of thoughts every second. It takes only a few seconds for a person to go from one object or one thought to another, so when a person starts thinking about one thing, he may completely forget the previous thing. There is no fault of any person in this. When a person is upset, he wants to refrain from doing various activities and wants to spend time alone, and at this time people forget many important things, words and even days. If you are upset, if you are unwell, if you are under pressure from various work, if you are in a problem, or even if you are worried about a particular person or thing, any normal person can forget any important thing. So if someone forgets something, then without getting angry with him, you should try to understand him and try to know about his problem. If we can be free from our worries and try to focus on various tasks well, then it is possible to fix our forgetful mind to a great extent. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/one-should-never-be-friends-with-an-enemy-kw)

body.title: Kittens playing in the park (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> ![1000694604.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKe7EwXorCbBu7A9ezP1EiLYoaNvR6hD3b4V2u7qT8fnNoCDQSGPyjFZveMPzPe.png) ##### Greetings, fellow gatos lovers.This is my first post in this community./ Saludos amigos amantes de los gatos. Esta es la primera vez en esta comunidad. # A family of cats lived in the playground of the neighborhood where I live. The mother had given birth to two kittens that looked just like her—orange and white. They, along with other cats that have come here or been abandoned here, are our cats—the community’s cats >En el parque para niños de la Urbanización donde resido vivía una familia de gatos. La gata había parido dos gatitos iguales a ella, de color naranja y blanco. Ellos junto con otros gatos que han llegado aquí o que han sido abandonados acá, son nuestros gatos, los gatos de la comunidad.
![1000523942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKDhHaxRUSjJxyeh2CGeXxRX4cx1FriAhXxWjegQjSwKbRwU4Q9PCXMWHTtYGUt.jpg)
To protect them and keep them from getting wet in the rain, someone put them in a box under the concrete bench. There, we fed the mother cat, and she nursed the kittens as they grew, until they started climbing out of the box to explore and play in the park. They were such a handful. >Para protegerlos y evitar que se mojaran con las lluvias, una persona los colocó en una caja debajo del banco de cemento. Allí le dabamos comida a la gata y los gatitos eran amamantados por ella, mientras iban creciendo, hasta que comenzaron a salirse de la caja para explorar y jugar en el parque. Eran muy tremendos. ***
![1000528676.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AJkR9FNPEgua1FomS1UKTRsDFGGWCaLrXqzSTiHUF4ynoyugH67Hf6m8oBSPm9f.jpg)
That day, while walking my dog Isis, I decided to take some pictures of them. They were playing alone on the seesaw. They looked very funny and were having fun, just like children do in the park. >Ese día mientras paseaba a mi perra Isis, decidí tomarles unas fotografías. Estaban solos jugando sobre el sube y baja. Se veían muy graciosos y estaban divirtiendose, como lo hacen los niños en el parque.
![1000528663.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKcexpLWd4cZXh6hbiGtcNDMpbGC8x7i6UpU3snWQar6ubQMjNDduDLa2o3bJXR.jpg)
I stayed there for a while watching them. They were so cute. And I wondered where their mom might be. >Me quedé un rato viendolos. Eran muy lindos. Y preguntandome donde estaría su mamá.
![1000528673.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKNK1rBp5744cnRwZUeBju3HNcdT5ynGi2Uu9VtBxPSDvHQGiKbLdjBNG3U7PqS.jpg)
After a while, she arrived, approached her kittens, and when she realized my dog Isis was there, very close to them, she pounced on her. Isis, who is afraid of them, ran out of the park. >Al rato llegó ella, se acercó a sus hijos y cuando se dio cuenta que mi perra Isis estaba allí, muy cerca de ellos, le brinco encima. Isis que les tiéne miedo salió corriendo del parque. ![1000528674.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AJegaHKsKZEsVePWPa9KiV4cPzFeTtBEMTotjxWpCYU6cWMki197t1cw5dkgh7Z.jpg) And the kittens, as if they’d been scolded by their mom for going out without her permission, ran back to their cardboard box home. >Y los gatitos así como si hubieran sido regañados por su mamá, por salir sin su permiso, corrieron hacia su caja- casa.
![1000528661.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKGZ6LdojjdPM5geJyvKirgd2W68osUAgHnk1QVePhBjGrAFnkekpyQgfh4PQiL.jpg)
*** The story of these kittens had a happy ending, because most of the time this doesn’t happen with stray cats. When the kittens were older, they were taken to an adoption event and were adopted. The mother was spayed and still lives safely within the neighborhood, cared for by people like me who love cats >La historia de estos gatitos tuvo un final felíz, porque la mayoría de las veces esto no sucede con los gatos de la calle. Cuando los gatitos estuvieron mas grandes fueron llevados a una jornada de adopción y fueron adoptados. La madre fue esterilizada y aún vive protegida dentro de la urbanización, cuidada por personas que como yo amamos a los gatos. ![1000323690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23viVTayTnuDW3eNvB4SsJp66oNHnncYPjhDnqnAt1y6y7kMHM6ookpUUPQ38V46kRQDa.jpg) Thank you very much for reading, and I welcome any comments. *** ![17767374172593252274605545311118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yJLuSDVwFfxjCTSHxZWiY4o7ZnrwH96deWhqKQeQJDbiJtiAa3WBUFDQifakvWbjsCT.jpg) Todas las fotografías son propias tomadas con un teléfono Samsung A15. Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

body.title: The Fire Dragon Castle, is my Favorite....but so is the Island.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRdtdJhvrg3iPB3f6YZPiVaXf7bqe2YaK71vGgqcxYYb/1776735665825.jpg)

And what a cool little community for Toys that i have found.  These new little spots to post is still a new thing to me sometimes but i get it now, more than ever.

This little ship is just a start of this journey of course, like how we are all on the ship of life.

So happy holidays you animals (4-20), now lets get down with some Lego.

---
---

## Castles and Islands ##

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmceEwBH3LFU9aqm5aHBz3nRJuauRA3VPxnehjGNr7pCo3/1776734916642.jpg)

Here, my lovely Fire Dragon castle set.  From roughly 1993, a cool set from the time.  Which i somehow managed to keep all this time.  Only losing a couple parts along the way.  This one i just cant get rid of.  It means too much to me....

From the memory of putting it together for the first time....to taking it down, to then build it once again.  I used to keep it on my dresser like the 1st picture.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRwCvsA6U3hTZMmFpH7TnXydUEMd96GuLwFd6qeGmM1m6/1776735142344.jpg)

This one here (just above) is similar to my last post talking about how i kept all my pieces in a giant box, only to rediscover everything, build it all, and sadly sell some of it off on ebay 😔.  The Island is there on the top left too (next post).

body.title: Leer para educar, escribir para vivir [esp-eng]
body.body:
![1000024229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wCG1LmwtWZ18c8XNtizG3CmSGr8Srvu8TGw3FLcJaFSHk7JMCfFSRYeuVF81X1G4SXn.jpg)
Leyendo el trabajo de la amiga @damarysvibra en @holos-lotus, me detuve a analizar mis lecturas, y es que abril cobija el Día del Libro 📕. Para leer su post ingresa [aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/que-estoy-leyendoororwhat-am-i-reading) ​Anteriormente redacté mi participación en la comunidad @hiveargentina, donde nos invitaron a reflexionar sobre cuál había sido ese libro que nos marcó. Ante aquella pregunta, una sonrisa se esbozó en mis labios y me llevó a la puerta de mi querido amigo [Papelucho](https://peakd.com/hive-161447/@issymarie2/el-libro-una-puerta-que-se-abre-y-jamás-se-cierra-esp-eng). ​Así es; ese libro infantil que leí en mi propia infancia fue la catapulta hacia mi amor por las letras y por crear relatos. Porque una cosa es cierta: existe el amor por leer y existe el amor por crear, y aunque ambas caminan por la misma vereda, no siempre van tomadas de la mano. ​Como todo escritor que hace vida en #hive sabe, escribir conlleva ese estrés que aceptamos sin reparos, porque de ese mismo caos nacen historias que, ¡madre mía!, hasta a nosotros mismos nos asombran.

​¿Qué estoy leyendo en estos momentos?

​Honestamente, diré que mis únicas lecturas actuales son los [textos de base curricular](https://www.curriculumnacional.cl/4), mismos que hojeo con antelación a cada clase. Afortunadamente, Internet nos abre las puertas a una lectura distinta. Esta lectura digital es “casi” lo mismo —y digo casi, porque al no poder sentir el papel en las manos, ni ese aroma a impresión y tinta, la experiencia cambia—, sin embargo, cumple su propósito. Mis horas de lectura avanzan entre el lenguaje, donde deambulo sobre cómo usar el diccionario de buena manera y cómo la “y” es ese conector que une palabras e ideas; luego, avanzo por el camino de los números, pues las matemáticas cambian año tras año. Continúo la travesía leyendo sobre la naturaleza, los animales domésticos y las cadenas tróficas, ideando formas lúdicas para explicar mejor; y, al finalizar mi semana lectora, me sumerjo en las normas de buena convivencia para acabar con la cultura azteca: sus creencias religiosas, su política y su vida cotidiana. ​Entre mis libros están los recién nombrados, los que me ayudan a crear las guías y los que me preparan para brindar una mejor educación. Sin embargo, no puedo negar que extraño mis novelas, los relatos de terror y los cuentos infantiles. Para mí, cada libro abre una puerta a diversos mundos, y adoro asomarme a esos lugares donde una sonrisa tiene superpoderes, donde lo que crees real no lo es, y donde el amor siempre vence. ​Si pudiera leer un libro con concentración en estos tiempos, diría que sería: **La maldición de Hill House, de la escritora Shirley Jackson**. Hace un tiempo vi la serie basada en la novela, pero la inquietud por leer sus páginas y descubrir si la serie fue fiel al libro es lo que me mantiene en ascuas.
![1000024230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tvVkkyDwdji56EmaQCkkhUTc7nY53gtaEUFZSbsg6a98eqvsN16zt37cHwbygbLjTu5.jpg)
[Fuente/Source](https://www.buscalibre.com/int-es/libro-maldicion-de-hill-house-la/9786073128902/p/46420968) ​Como decía anteriormente, quizás no pueda leerlo en formato físico, pero la edición digital podría ser la solución. ​Para finalizar, solo quiero expresar que leer nutre la mente, aunque a veces olvidemos alimentarla. Es ella la que nos permite actuar ante diversos eventos, manteniéndonos “despiertos” a lo que sucede a nuestro alrededor. *** ###
English
***
![1000024229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wCG1LmwtWZ18c8XNtizG3CmSGr8Srvu8TGw3FLcJaFSHk7JMCfFSRYeuVF81X1G4SXn.jpg)
While reading my friend @damarysvibra’s post on @holos-lotus, I stopped to reflect on my own reading – after all, April is when we celebrate World Book Day 📕. To read her post, click [here](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/que-estoy-leyendoororwhat-am-i-reading). ​I previously wrote a post for the @hiveargentina community, where we were invited to reflect on which book had left a lasting impression on us. Faced with that question, a smile spread across my lips and led me to the door of my dear friend [Papelucho](https://peakd.com/hive-161447/@issymarie2/el-libro-una-puerta-que-se-abre-y-jamás-se-cierra-esp-eng). That’s right; that children’s book I read in my own childhood was the springboard for my love of literature and of creating stories. Because one thing is certain: there is a love of reading and there is a love of creating, and although both walk the same path, they do not always go hand in hand. As every writer who makes a living on #hive knows, writing comes with that stress we accept without hesitation, because from that very chaos stories are born that, my goodness, even amaze us.

​What am I reading at the moment?

​Honestly, I’d say my only current reading is the [curriculum texts](https://www.curriculumnacional.cl/4), which I skim through before each class. Fortunately, the internet opens the door to a different kind of reading. This digital reading is ‘almost’ the same — and I say almost, because not being able to feel the paper in my hands, or that scent of print and ink, changes the experience — yet it serves its purpose. My reading hours unfold through language, where I wander through how to use a dictionary effectively and how the ‘and’ acts as that connector linking words and ideas; then, I move along the path of numbers, as maths changes year after year. I continue the journey by reading about nature, domestic animals and food chains, devising playful ways to explain things better; and, at the end of my reading week, I immerse myself in the rules of good coexistence to conclude with Aztec culture: their religious beliefs, their politics and their daily life. Among my books are the ones I’ve just mentioned, those that help me create the guides and those that prepare me to provide a better education. However, I cannot deny that I miss my novels, horror stories and children’s tales. For me, every book opens a door to different worlds, and I love peeking into those places where a smile has superpowers, where what you think is real isn’t, and where love always triumphs. If I could read a book with real focus these days, I’d say it would be **The Haunting of Hill House by Shirley Jackson**. I watched the series based on the novel a while back, but the urge to read the book and find out whether the series was faithful to the original is what’s keeping me on tenterhooks.
![1000024230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tvVkkyDwdji56EmaQCkkhUTc7nY53gtaEUFZSbsg6a98eqvsN16zt37cHwbygbLjTu5.jpg)
[Source](https://www.buscalibre.com/int-es/libro-maldicion-de-hill-house-la/9786073128902/p/46420968) ​As I said earlier, I might not be able to read it in physical format, but the digital edition could be the solution. ​To conclude, I just want to say that reading nourishes the mind, even though we sometimes forget to feed it. It is the mind that allows us to respond to various events, keeping us ‘alert’ to what is happening around us. ***
![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)
**Créditos / Credits:** ​Las imágenes usadas fueron creadas en Gemini AI. El texto fue traducido en DeepL versión free. ​
