body.title: So Long, Honor of Kings – Wild Rift, Here I Come: A New Quest Begins.
body.body:
![1776736148506-processed(lightpdf.com) (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/23wC9vSRRUjm5iiUabbDhC4D3T1nX7jNfGJ1Gh6o9NVuHeoevfXMUmbxU6y5knzeSNTmD.png)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. Tiempo sin saber de ustedes, tiempo sin pasarme por acá. Esta vez sí espero ser más constante con todo esto. Simplemente he estado un poco perdido y sin ánimos de hacer algo; no tenía ganas de escribir y simplemente podríamos decir que me estaba pudriendo en mi propia miseria, pero entre ayer y hoy he decidido salir de todo eso, dando un paso al frente para afrontar mis problemas. En mi inactividad, como muchos sabrán debido a mis publicaciones, me encanta jugar un moba llamado Honor of Kings. Esta temporada estaba bastante buena; subí demasiado rápido a Gran Maestro, pero simplemente el juego ya no es lo mismo. Encuentro una gran problemática que al día de hoy deben solucionar para que yo decida volver, y es que me refiero a los trolls. Encuentro imposible divertirme jugando si en casi todas las partidas te emparejan con dos trolls en el equipo. Lo peor es que el juego sabe que son trolls porque al hacer el reporte les baja puntos, pero simplemente se siente como si tú hubieras perdido de igual forma y el troll sale ganando porque, si él se dedica a hacer eso, el juego le premia, quitándonos una estrella/punto a todos. Al ver un notable incremento de esto, simplemente decidí cambiarme de juego, al tan conocido y mimado por Riot, Wild Rift. ¿Será mejor, será peor? Lo averiguaremos a continuación.

Good morning, good afternoon or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Long time no see, long time since I last came by. This time I do hope to be more consistent with all this. I've simply been a bit lost and unmotivated to do anything; I didn't feel like writing and we could just say I was rotting in my own misery, but between yesterday and today I've decided to get out of all that, taking a step forward to face my problems. During my inactivity — as many of you will know from my posts — I really enjoy playing a MOBA called Honor of Kings. This season was pretty good; I climbed to Grand Master too quickly, but the game just isn't the same anymore. I've come across a big problem that they really need to fix before I decide to come back, and I'm talking about the trolls. I find it impossible to enjoy playing when in almost every match you get paired with two trolls on your team. The worst part is that the game knows they're trolls because when you report them, they lose points, but it still feels like you've lost anyway and the troll comes out on top because by dedicating themselves to doing that, the game rewards them, taking a star/point away from all of us. Seeing a notable increase in this, I simply decided to switch games, to the well-known and Riot-coddled Wild Rift. Will it be better, will it be worse? We'll find out next.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/EoASz19PKE6QCST3bKksvQdH24iHNX33jDvTH7BByZpjBM14QUELTGfwL96VqmodXPr.jpg
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Iniciando el juego, lo primero que te lanzan es un tutorial, aunque hayas dicho que has jugado mobas para celular antes, por lo que después de aburrirme un poco el juego te regala un héroe para que puedas jugar las clasificatorias. En mi caso fue Lux. Tengo que decir que es una héroe bastante cómoda de jugar y con un combo demasiado sencillo. Varios amigos me dijeron que es buena pero de alguna u otra forma la odian por una razón: ¿por qué? Aún no lo sé, quizás lo descubra después. Un amigo me dijo que buscara otro héroe con el cual jugar, que Lux no aguantaba mucho. Yo simplemente seguí mis instintos básicos, los cuales son: ver héroes que se parezcan a algunos que haya jugado antes en Honor of Kings y enfocarme en esos, y con esa idea comencé mi travesía, la cual no duró ni cinco minutos. Descubrí a Annie, que tiene un oso llamado Tibbers, un niño que lanza un oso. Simplemente me recuerda a Agudo y su oso. Tenía que jugar con ella, además era mid, por lo que era totalmente perfecto para mí. Aunque el héroe decía que era fácil de usar, tengo una curva de aprendizaje en mi contra, porque hay varias cosas que son diferentes a los otros mobas. Wild Rift es simplemente más lento: tener que regresar a base, muchos más objetos, más objetivos, posiciones de cosas que conozco en otros lados y así, además de aprender qué hace cada objeto y cada héroe.

When you start the game, the first thing it throws at you is a tutorial, even if you've said that you've played mobile MOBAs before. So after getting a bit bored, the game gives you a free hero so you can play ranked matches. In my case, it was Lux. I have to say she's a pretty comfortable hero to play, with a very simple combo. Several friends told me she's good, but they hate her for some reason or another — why? I don't know yet; maybe I'll find out later. One friend told me to look for another hero to play with, because Lux couldn't hold up much. I simply followed my basic instincts, which are: look for heroes that resemble ones I've played before in Honor of Kings and focus on those. With that idea, I began my journey, which didn't even last five minutes. I discovered Annie, who has a bear called Tibbers — a child who throws a bear. It simply reminds me of Agudo and his bear. I had to play with her; plus she was mid, so it was totally perfect for me. Even though the hero said she was easy to use, I have a learning curve against me, because there are several things that are different from other MOBAs. Wild Rift is simply slower: having to recall to base, many more items, more objectives, positions of things that I know from elsewhere, and so on, as well as learning what each item and each hero does.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/syberia/EoAT16NGVkbks52rSVWFna79P8ePemkojLtvFKYmcGksiZLMY9DxhEkXb4hnYxGHf4U.jpg
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Annie es un héroe bastante sencillo de usar. Es simplemente acercarte lo más posible al enemigo y fulminarlo con un stun con la ulti y lanzarle todos los demás ataques, ya sea con flash o con el cinturón que dispara balas. Poco a poco me he ido acostumbrando y creo que ya estoy mejorando con el personaje. Actualmente me encuentro en Oro I; sé que es muy bajo, pero he ido subiendo rápido. El problema quizás lo encuentro en la posición secundaria, donde selecciono algo y el juego me pone donde le da la regalada gana, no permitiéndome ganar puntos en esa posición para asegurarla. Por ende, usualmente la gran parte del tiempo cuando eso ocurre me toca jungla, donde siempre decido jugar con Dr. Mundo porque simplemente se me hace muy fácil de jugar y sencillo: aguanta mucho y pega bastante. Qué más se puede pedir de él, yo digo que nada. Usualmente me salen bien las rotaciones, por lo que no me quejo, pero quizás en lo que sea malo es farmeando la jungla; no conozco el recorrido con exactitud. En fin, lo que me gusta de este pinche juego es la diferencia de que si un jugador se desconecta o se pone a trollear, no te quitan nada. Pura perfección, pura chulada. Fue de las primeras cosas que pude notar. Creo que la única queja hasta ahora es la optimización, donde en team fights hay bajones de FPS, teniendo yo que jugar a 30 FPS limitados. Así que sin más nada que decir, me despido por el día de hoy.

Annie is a fairly simple hero to use. You just get as close as possible to the enemy and obliterate them with a stun using your ultimate, then throw all your other attacks at them, whether with Flash or with the belt that shoots bullets. Little by little I've been getting used to it and I think I'm already improving with the character. Currently I'm in Gold I; I know it's very low, but I've been climbing quickly. The problem perhaps lies with the secondary position, where I select something and the game puts me wherever it damn well pleases, not allowing me to earn points in that position to secure it. So, most of the time when that happens, I end up in the jungle, where I always decide to play with Dr. Mundo because I just find him very easy and simple to play: he can take a lot of hits and deals a lot of damage. What more could you ask of him? I'd say nothing. Usually my rotations go well, so I can't complain, but the thing I might be bad at is farming the jungle; I don't know the route exactly. Anyway, what I like about this bloody game is the fact that if a player disconnects or starts trolling, you don't lose anything. Pure perfection, pure brilliance. That was one of the first things I noticed. I think my only complaint so far is the optimisation, where there are FPS drops during team fights, forcing me to play at a capped 30 FPS. So with nothing more to say, I'll say goodbye for today.

___
Traducido con DeepSeek / Translated with DeepSeek

body.body:
> En la cocina muchas veces nos toca improvisar, y aunque algunas veces resulta todo bien, otras veces las cosas no salen como esperamos, pero por suerte el día de hoy el resultado fue bastante bueno a pesar de haber tenido que resolver sobre la marcha y terminé con un platillo que nunca había preparado y ni siquiera hubiese pensado en prepararlo de esa manera, y se trata de pasta con mollejas de pollo y vegetales.
In the kitchen, we often have to improvise, and although things sometimes turn out fine, other times they don’t go as planned. Luckily, today the result was quite good, even though I had to make things up as I went along, and I ended up with a dish I’d never made before and wouldn’t even have thought of preparing that way: pasta with chicken gizzards and vegetables.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWth3cuVQzfoqyfNz8uNSNSukgF63cZ6gbisXQyhdxnpV/1776739364551.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El tema es que hoy tenía pensado preparar mollejas guisadas con papas y zanahoria y acompañarlas con arroz, y cuando ya tenía listo todo para el guiso me di cuenta que no tenía arroz en casa y no me sentía nada bien para salir a comprar, así que se me ocurrió que podía realizar el guiso pero en lugar de arroz prepararía pasta, y fue así como terminamos con la receta del día de hoy.
The thing is, I’d planned to make gizzards stewed with potatoes and carrots today, to be served with rice, and just as I’d got everything ready for the stew, I realised I didn’t have any rice in the house and I didn’t feel up to going out to buy some, so it occurred to me that I could make the stew but serve it with pasta instead of rice, and that’s how we ended up with today’s recipe.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFACUUN9jh8TTyv2STHCaY5WYwaCRYHEKEP5ezWtptss/1776739364929.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 500 grs de pasta 500 grs de mollejas 1 zanahoria 1/2 cebolla 2 ramitas de cebollín 2 dientes de ajo 1/2 pimentón 2 ajíes 1 ramita de cilantro 1/4 de cucharadita de pimienta 1 cucharadita de orégano en polvo Sal
## Ingredients 500 g pasta 500 g sweetbreads 1 carrot 1/2 onion 2 sprigs of chives 2 cloves of garlic 1/2 red pepper 2 chillies 1 sprig of coriander 1/4 teaspoon of pepper 1 teaspoon of dried oregano Salt
## Procedimiento/Procedure Lo primero que hice fue lavar las mollejas, limpiarlas muy bien y cortarlas en trozos pequeños.
The first thing I did was wash the gizzards, clean them thoroughly and cut them into small pieces.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPzBdT4yXhCjpF68JQks5xgFwaJ7Jw7uADudAo7LT1cH/1776739365425.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente nos encargamos de cortar todos los vegetales que vamos a utilizar para el sofrito, al igual que la zanahoria, y aunque pensaba utilizar papas en un principio, pensé que quizá no quedaría bien, pero una vez listo el plato me di cuenta que le hubiese ido muy bien, así que si tienen papas en casa le ponen con toda confianza.
Next, we chop all the vegetables we’re going to use for the sofrito, including the carrots. Although I’d originally planned to use potatoes, I thought they might not work well, but once the dish was ready, I realised they would have been a great addition, so if you have potatoes at home, feel free to add them.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7vgeGBFjKwrARS9vSLB6oR5nYkJcN6tZdnhq6xFfAdV/1776739365170.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeB27KtYkUT9mY3Brvujf8pKTzDU51NTg1Sx6JFEEJdV/1776739475776.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez tenemos cortados los vegetales agregamos aceite a la sartén, calentamos y sofreímos el ajo, la cebolla, pimentón, ají y cebollín por 4 minutos y agregamos sal, pimienta y orégano.
Once the vegetables have been chopped, add oil to the frying pan, heat it up and sauté the garlic, onion, paprika, chilli and spring onion for 4 minutes, then add salt, pepper and oregano.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ6UkUpVa3wGhyb7GrsjuKsoXvzt3dQgUkqPRhEQ8rJgm/1776739365671.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez transcurridos los 4 minutos agregamos las mollejas de pollo, un poco más de sal y sofreímos por 5 minutos, agregamos una taza de agua, tapamos y dejamos cocinar hasta que estén suaves.
Once the 4 minutes are up, add the chicken gizzards and a little more salt, and fry for 5 minutes. Add a cup of water, cover, and leave to cook until tender.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdELynvnnS7AYVTanKXwMkzMmKERyrZDzJKgjsNkrpbs4/1776739476036.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRffQDUr7BmKsFThzsiDptxbjZXfefqARxH3zEdR4VFy/1776739476306.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez las mollejas están suaves agregamos la zanahoria y ponemos a cocinar la pasta como de costumbre. >Once the gizzards are tender, add the carrot and cook the pasta as usual. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2fRqvgtgJnhWWv9g9xoBc1c7dvYtjYhaEULXFzb3Hmo/1776739476565.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Cuando la pasta esté casi lista la agregamos a la sartén donde tenemos las mollejas, agregamos media taza del agua de la cocción, incorporamos el cilantro, rectificamos la sal y dejamos cocinar por 5 minutos más y servimos. >When the pasta is almost ready, add it to the frying pan containing the sweetbreads, pour in half a cup of the pasta cooking water, stir in the coriander, season with salt to taste, cook for a further 5 minutes, then serve. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZYN9pCvLKXqLugzR1yx4LR9LNhGAmTARju869hQZTsCo/1776739476856.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVt5MPw4uaadwy1PnKNd9vdFDpb4EkMu77qVA78oTcv7P/1776739710992.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcgDzpc2PxyhT6HN9v1UXMCteCy2Zy1kHmDHWPy7G3h3z/1776739711262.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPm9zxb6ycpcaDYEiwVzN8Hfk5eKZMSkdoK9pNv1vdm4e/1776739711526.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPawcQZjgDkYx4V2eE83DTgod9yYrBnweM22hLek26SZR/1776739711803.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Les cuento que el experimento resultó bastante bien, pero creo que con papas y pasta de tomate quedarían muchísimo mejor, así que ese será el plan para la próxima vez que prepare mollejas con pasta. >I have to say the experiment turned out quite well, but I reckon it would be much better with potatoes and tomato purée, so that’s the plan for the next time I make sweetbreads with pasta.
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@rlathulerie,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera⁰⁰/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

body.title: Nadi (my dog) is welcomed almost anywhere
body.body: The other day someone I had never met said to me \
and it was at that point that I realized that I am somewhat \

in the community over here. Not because I am anything special, but because my dog has a reputation of being a sweetheart that is really well-behaved. I think this is part of the reason why when we go places that in the west probably wouldn't allow dogs or any other pets, Nadi is welcomed.

> We had never been to this particular coffee shop before, so I asked permission before I brought her in. They of course were ok with it and initially I put Nadi on a chair but she needed to cool down so she hopped onto the floor. I was worried she might cause problems (not really) but I was worried that people might think she was going to cause problems. She does nothing of the sort though. She just sits near me calmly, and will watch people go by.

> I love this about her. If someone approaches she will offer up a bit of attention, but she isn't like other dogs: She is not very needy for attention unlike other dogs I know that will wag their tails like crazy if you approach. In fact, and this is even true for me, most of the time I think she would prefer to just be left alone. If you have food, the situation changes obviously. This is the first time we have been in GOLO coffee and the staff immediately fell in love with her. It's easy to understand why though.

>
</center> 

I don’t believe there are any rules in Vietnam about health and safety that bars dogs or other animals from entering a place that serves food.  I think it is just left up to the owners of the place and since there are so many coffeeshops in this area as well as all the other ones, I think they kind of let people do whatever they want if that means that they are going to be able to sell a few more cups of Jo.  

<center> </center>

She will go back and forth between the two spots:  One in the chair where our fan is pointed right at her because she has a fur coat on and I do not, and the other on the nice cool tile for her to relax.  

There is only one danger in these sorts of environments and that is children.  Nadi really doesn't like children and she will bite them.   I didn't train her to do this, she just doesn't like them... or cats.   I think this originates from many years ago when I worked at a villa rental operation in Thailand and some of the staff brought their kids to work with them.   While children mostly mean no harm, they do get a bit grabby and pull on ears and stuff and well, Nadi probably doesn't like that very much.

But that's easy enough to handle because I never leave her unattended.  If I have to use the restroom, she comes with me.   That might sound strange but Nadi gets really concerned when she cannot see me anymore and will start to act erratically in that situation.  

She loves going everywhere with me, and I love bringing her along.  Thankfully, I live in a part of the world where this is not only tolerated, but I think kind of encouraged.
body.author: gooddream

body.title: Your Home Kitchen Has Everything 🐓 Except This One Trick 🥩🧑‍🍳The Secret Behind Every Menu
body.body: > When I go out for food with my family, we try to explore new tastes and eat new foods, but one thing I want to write here is that every food looks the same but its flavors are different. We went to eat at famous hotels in our area. When we saw their menu, there were many names of dishes written in it. Every dish was made from the same meat but its names were different. We tried to try dishes made from meat which have different names but the same type of meat is used. Suppose if you want to eat mutton kadai, then you will get a kadai made from button in different flavors. Mutton. Apart from that, if you want to eat food made from beef, then you will get beef food with different flavors and names. Similarly, if you want to eat food made from chicken, then the flavors of these foods will also be different and the names will also be different. So we tried a few chicken I ate the food made from it and I'm telling you the truth, their flavors were amazing, they were so perfect that my heart kept telling me to eat them again and again. When we entered any hotel to eat, we would see a long list of dishes. If I talk about dishes made from chicken, there was no difference between their names and those made from mutton and beef, but the flavors were completely different. I want to tell you some names. Chicken Desi Kadhai. This chicken Desi Kadhai was made from indigenous ingredients. The ingredients used in it were completely indigenous. Indigenous ingredients mean that such vegetables as green chillies, coriander or whatever ingredients were included in it were cultivated indigenously. And this was their claim that no kind of fertilizer was used in their ingredients. Apart from this, the meat of indigenous chicken was used in it. Those indigenous chickens are not broilers or farm chickens, but these chickens are raised in homes. When these chickens are raised in homes, they are free and then Their meat is completely different in taste from barra or farm chicken, so the first dish we tested was the desi chicken kadai. You can see that I am eating the desi chicken kadai and the pictures I have made on my table are of the kadai made with the same desi chicken meat. Its taste was amazing, it was amazing. I asked the chef how he made it. The way he told me how he made it, I will tell you here how he made it. But I don't think any chef will share his recipe with anyone, but what he told me, I will tell you here. ![IMG_20260419_152148.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb6YYppMD5iEqTrqqAgqiGZAk3uYorwy4fE2rdepLCMZ4/IMG_20260419_152148.jpg) First of all, he told me that the method of preparing the meat of farm chicken is completely different, while the method of cooking the meat of desi chicken is completely different. He told me that the desi chicken is different from the desi meat. It does not decompose quickly. It does not cook quickly, but it takes a long time to cook. He told me that first of all, put the meat in hot water and then clean it well. While cleaning it well, add a little salt and vinegar to this water. Clean the meat well with this vinegar. When the meat is thoroughly cleaned, then put the meat in a clean water that is boiling and keep this meat in this water until it decomposes. When the water is half dry and the meat is 70% decomposed, then you have to remove the meat with water and then in the second step, you have to brown the onion and then add tomatoes, green chilies and other hot spices, turmeric, coriander powder and Kashmiri chicken kadhai powder. When this For example, if it is cooked well, then you have to add the same meat that was in the water in which the meat was being cooked along with the water and then fry it well for 20 minutes. When it is well fried, then you have to take it out and eat it with fresh wheat bread. ![IMG_20260419_153009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRuPx9fgzYjHA6sXBfM6mMh2HhmQfijH7UUKtgjCapkM/IMG_20260419_153009.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_153006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme4y9kcqaSoB63anzGEutLSfLbHtg4tSGs4WScwZTdcYP/IMG_20260419_153006.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_152138.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbL4mUcNSdr9q9qaDENxTHQkGLmZu3dWEPsutuiFAr1sR/IMG_20260419_152138.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_152131.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUBqwQJjvBAYK4SNdiPzQaX2bUPEzh938R39BNsAiwwVz/IMG_20260419_152131.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_152011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWASVH14PUVrpq6bmHWBKF7TyES3FL5gRFmzm373bo1D8/IMG_20260419_152011.jpg) ![IMG_20260419_152006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSURYFnFiThjyaxuMc9JT2nh7hv6pt3HKQDfEMvUkdUQ/IMG_20260419_152006.jpg) The chef told us the formula for desi chicken kadai. Now we will try to make this chicken kadai together with our friends under this formula and see how much benefit we get from it and whether the taste of the desi chicken kadai we ate at the hotel also tastes the same as the one prepared by a professional chef. But it is true that the method of making it is different for professors and professional chefs. They keep guiding us and telling us the ingredients, but they are masters in this. They know how to make their recipe flavorful, how to make it delicious, then how spicy to keep it, how to add the other spices in it, but one thing that I noticed in the ingredients of this recipe is that whatever ingredients the chef told us were common ingredients that are used in almost every home kitchen and I did not see any such thing in them. There were no rare or unknown examples, they were the same examples that we use in our daily home kitchens for whatever food we cook, but whenever we prepare any of these recipes, we also use the same examples, but the taste of the desi chicken kadai we ate at the hotel was completely unique and we will use this method at home too and see how good it tastes. So thank you all very much for liking my today's recipe article.

body.title: Paseo en familia a Playa Guacarapo-Sucre/Venezuela🇻🇪
body.body:
Hola a todos en la comunidad de Hive. Hoy paso por aquí para relatarles una escapada muy especial que tuve hace poco con mi familia. A veces, entre tantas responsabilidades en el hospital, las guardias y los estudios finales de medicina, uno necesita una tarde de sol y sal para recargar las baterías y despejar la mente. Esta vez el destino elegido fue Playa Guacarapo, un rincón del estado Sucre que siempre tiene una vibra muy particular y que me permitió desconectar por unas cuantas horas de la rutina académica.

![IMG_9163.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdkmkHHWT5NFeQEsbLNqN1Y1ssQZJXoAVjpjEKEfpGdQE/IMG_9163.jpeg)



No logramos salir tan temprano como hubiésemos querido porque mis tíos tenían compromisos laborales importantes y les tocó trabajar hasta mediodía. Finalmente logramos arrancar de Carúpano a eso de las dos de la tarde, lo que para algunos podría parecer tarde para un día de playa, pero nosotros estábamos decididos a aprovechar cada minuto. El trayecto duró aproximadamente una hora y media y nos tocó pasar por Cariaco. El camino se disfrutó muchísimo porque siempre hay algo que ver en la carretera y los cuentos entre nosotros nunca faltan, lo que hace que el tiempo pase volando a pesar del calor característico de nuestra zona.






Cuando por fin llegamos a Playa Guacarapo, nos encontramos con un panorama que nos quitó cualquier rastro de cansancio del viaje. El mar estaba sumamente tranquilo, casi como si fuera una piscina natural, lo cual es ideal para relajarse y simplemente flotar sin preocuparse por olas fuertes o corrientes. A pesar de que llegamos en la tarde, todavía había muchos bañistas disfrutando del agua y el ambiente estaba muy animado. Había mucha gente compartiendo en familia, lo que le daba al lugar una sensación de calidez y seguridad muy agradable.




Lo que más me llenó el corazón fue ver cómo disfrutaron todos, desde los adultos hasta los más jóvenes. Fue especialmente cómico ver al más pequeño del grupo totalmente entretenido en la orilla. En lugar de buscar juguetes convencionales, se puso a jugar con las algas que el mar traía de forma natural. Estaba encantado manipulándolas y creando sus propias historias en la arena, demostrándonos que la felicidad está en las cosas más simples y que no se necesita mucho para pasarla bien cuando se tiene imaginación. Verlo tan feliz con algo tan sencillo nos recordó a todos la importancia de disfrutar el presente sin tantas complicaciones.




Para mí este paseo fue fundamental para soltar un poco el estrés acumulado de las rotaciones clínicas y de todo el trabajo que implica estar cerrando mi último año de pregrado. Aproveché la luz de la tarde para tomarme algunas fotos con mi sombrero y mi traje de baño favorito, sintiéndome muy cómoda con los resultados que he visto en mi cuerpo gracias a la constancia con el ejercicio funcional que vengo realizando desde febrero. Esos momentos de sentirte bien contigo misma mientras compartes con la gente que amas son los que realmente le dan sentido al esfuerzo que hago a diario en mi carrera.




Al final de la tarde, cuando el sol empezó a bajar, nos preparamos para el regreso con una sensación de paz muy bonita. Aunque fue una visita corta por haber salido tarde, valió totalmente la pena el recorrido desde Carúpano. Regresamos a casa con el corazón contento y la mente renovada, listos para enfrentar una nueva semana de retos en el hospital. Espero que este relato les recuerde que siempre es buen momento para buscar un espacio de recreación con la familia, sin importar la hora o los planes de trabajo previos. Gracias por leerme y por acompañarme en estos pedacitos de mi vida que comparto con tanto cariño por aquí.

body.body:
> Gente bella de Hive, es un placer saludarles, les doy la bienvenida a este espacio donde suelo compartir canciones que han dejando una huella en mis recuerdos. Hoy me dí cuenta que tenía una canción en mi galería que había grabado para la temporada de semana santa, pero por múltiples ocupaciones no pude subirla, así que hoy la edité para traerla a hive. Esperanza de vida es una banda cristiana que seguí en un tiempo porque sus letras eran hermosas y además el registro vocal de sus cantantes me encantaba, el timbre vocal de las chicas y esa manera de interpretar era algo que disfruté en su tiempo, también me recuerda a mi hermana pues a ella le gustaba muchos sus temas y solía cantarlos junto a ella. Precioso Jesús fué una de sus canciones icónicas, de hecho pocos conocen a esta banda, pero este tema muchos cristianos lo conocen porque fué popular y muchas chicas solían presentarla en la iglesia. Sin más que agregar, deseo que disfruten de esta hermosa canción.
*
English
*
Dear friends at Hive, it’s a pleasure to greet you. Welcome to this space where I usually share songs that have left a lasting impression on me. Today I realized I had a song in my gallery that I’d recorded for Holy Week, but because I’ve been so busy, I couldn’t upload it, so today I edited it to share it on Hive. Esperanza de Vida is a Christian band I used to follow because their lyrics were beautiful, and I also loved the vocal range of their singers—the girls’ vocal timbre and their style of performance were something I really enjoyed back then. It also reminds me of my sister, since she really liked their songs and I used to sing them with her. “Precioso Jesús” was one of their iconic songs. In fact, few people know this band, but many Christians know this song because it was popular, and many girls used to perform it at church. Without further ado, I hope you enjoy this beautiful song.

body.title: 潮汕遊6 - 潮州古城景點
body.body: 來到潮州古城，當然要遊覽一下古城內的景點。微信有一個叫潮州古城全域旅遊導覽的小程序，顯示了古城內的景點、著名餐廳、茶館等資料，跟著地圖走就行。 首先我沿著牌坊街走到南門，再到了城牆邊。潮州古城美名古城，其實城牆只剩下韓江邊的一小段，而且只有一小部份有修葺過，例如我看到的這一部份，其實就只是一段爛土牆，哈哈。
/> 看完土牆我去了開元寺，這是潮州古城一個必去景點吧，開元寺建於唐開元年間，當年唐玄宗全國到處建開元寺，潮州就是其中之一，至今已有1200年，保留了唐代的寺廟格局再融合了之後宋元明清等的建築風格，是建築界的瑰寶，現在有粵東第一古剎的美稱。可惜我不懂建築，更不熟佛教建築，領略不了，只是略略參觀了一下就離去了，而進到寺裡最感到有趣的，就是僧人都要坐接待處了。
/> 離開開元寺，我穿過一條小巷，卻在巷中看到了唐伯元故居。唐伯元是明代大儒、潮州八賢之一，官至吏部郎中，他的故居就隱於這小巷中。翻查歷史，這故居在上世紀被改建為電影院，再後來拆掉成為停車場，直到2018年才由其後人捐資原貌重建而成，所以現在看到的整個故居都已經不是以前那個了。 我在門口偷看了一下，以為裡面就只有個茶館就沒有進去了，後來才知道裡面都有些小展覽的，可惜了。
/> 然後，我去了鎮海樓。 鎮海樓又叫府城樓，是以前潮州府衙門前的城樓，曾於辛亥革命時期被毀，一直荒廢到2021年才重建而成。相傳鎮海樓上有108隻𤠣子木雕，以猴子諧音代表「侯」，我終於知道為何潮州古城那麼多猴子裝飾了，原來故人已經會玩諧音梗了......現在鎮海樓是一個小博物館，前面城樓是介紹潮州府歷史及功能，後面則有潮州歷史還有潮州名人的故事，我還見到了誠哥哈哈。
/> 逛完鎮海樓我繼續往北走，到了許駙馬府，這個駙馬叫許珏，是宋英宗的駙馬，也是潮汕唯一駙馬，而這個許駙馬府已是全國極少數還保留下來的宋代建築了。我本想好好參觀一下，只可惜剛好有很多小孩，而且是超級吵，我走了一陣子實在是沒有心情，很快就走了。但不得不說，駙馬不愧是駙馬，家很大......
/> 走到這裡有點累了，去吃了個火鍋，然後再到韓江走一走廣濟橋。廣濟橋由宋代開始興建，集石橋、木橋、浮橋三種形式於一身，被譽為「中國四大古橋」之一，也被稱為世界上最早的啟閉式橋樑。廣濟橋兩邊是石橋及亭台，中間則是由船組成的浮橋，需要時中間浮橋會打開開出通道讓船穿過，現在則是晚上約6點開橋，加上燈光讓遊客拍照。
/> 穿過橋到了對岸，就是韓文公祠了。韓文公祠是紀念大文學家韓愈而建的，韓愈因諫佛骨被貶為潮州刺史，任內驅除鱷魚、發展農桑、贖放奴婢、延師興學，深得潮州人民愛戴，當地甚至將江山易姓為「韓」。
/>\n\n至此，潮州古城的著名景點就差不多走完了，這裡沒有西安、洛陽、南京之類的波瀾壯麗，不過仍自有一個城的故事留下，而重點是，有很多好吃嘛，哈哈。

afterwards, lol! So I checked, and discovered it was a cover of another artist's song. My curiosity was piqued, not for Efi, but for Avicii, who released the [original version](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UtF6Jej8yb4&list=RDUtF6Jej8yb4&start_radio=1) in 2014. Avicii (Tim Bergling in real life) is a Swedish DJ, remixer, songwriter, and record producer credited for pioneering Electronic Dance Music and crafting emotional, melodic tracks, some of which I'm sharing today in the Three Tune Tuesday initiative by Ablaze. ### Waiting for Love
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cHHLHGNpCSA&list=RDcHHLHGNpCSA&start_radio=1
This uplifting electro-house track was released in 2015 as the lead single of Avicii's second studio album, Stories. The track features a pulsating, melodic synth hook, aggressive piano chords, a catchy and emotional vocal performance (by Simon Aldred), and an upbeat, danceable melody. The song has done quite well, topping the charts (#1) in Sweden, and peaked at #7 on the US Billboard Hot Dance/Electronic Songs chart. As of this writing, the music video has garnered over 1.3 billion views on YouTube since its release. Anyway, the next tune was the track that became Avicii's breakout hit and signature song, one of the first commercially successful songs released as EDM was going mainstream in the United States in 2010. *[(1)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levels_(Avicii_song))* ### Levels
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_ovdm2yX4MA&list=RD_ovdm2yX4MA&start_radio=1
Oh, I love the energetic club vibe of this track. It has that bright, high-pitched synthesizer melody that sounds like a playful ringtone, which instantly sticks in the head on first hearing. It made me want to dance. According to critics, this is an EDM masterpiece, an important pop and electronic hit of the 21st century. They also credit it with helping bring EDM into the mainstream in the US, paving the way for artists like Marshmello and The Chainsmokers. And tune 3 is also one of Avicii's earlier releases (2013) ### Hey Brother
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Go0NdU1tMBQ
A blend of traditional bluegrass country music with high-energy European electronic dance music. It is quite an emotional song, yet energetic enough for a party and sentimental enough for a quiet day. The warm acoustic guitar and a steady, stomping drum beat give it a folk-song feel. The soulful vocals were performed by Dan Tyminski. Accordingly, Avicii chose him specifically because he wanted an honest and human voice to contrast with the electronic production, making the song feel raw and authentic.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DSaN7oLN3y3/) The track topped the UK Dance Chart in 2013, peaked at #16 on the US Billboard Hot 100, becoming the singer's final hit before his unfortunate death (suicide) in 2018. He did leave a profound legacy as a pioneering DJ who revolutionized EDM by blending melodic house with acoustic elements, taking it mainstream radio. For more of his timeless arrangements, check out his official [YT Channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPHjpfnnGklkRBBTd0k6aHg).
--- --- **

>Smile... laugh often... love more... be grateful always!** --- ---

body.title: Translating the Past: The Book of Mudora and the Ancient Hero : TLOZ : A Link to the Past #03 [ENG|ESP]
body.body: > Greetings, Hive Gaming community! I hope you're all having a fantastic day. Today we dive into the third chapter of our adventure in *The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past*. After meeting the elder Sahasrahla and obtaining the Pegasus Boots, it was finally time to face my first major challenge: the Eastern Palace. To be honest, I was a bit nervous about entering the first real dungeon of the game, but I felt well-equipped and ready to prove my worth as a hero. My goal was clear: navigate the ancient corridors and claim the Pendant of Courage. # Entering the Eastern Palace was quite interesting. The architecture is full of stone statues and narrow paths that test your reflexes. Almost immediately, I had to deal with mechanical traps and moving platforms. The dungeon layout is a classic example of early Zelda design, where you have to find keys to unlock doors and navigate through different levels. One of the highlights of this exploration was finding a large chest that contained the Bow. This legendary weapon is essential for this dungeon, as many enemies and even some puzzles require long-range attacks to be solved or defeated. # As I pushed deeper into the temple, the enemies became more aggressive. I encountered groups of Armos statues that came to life as I approached, forcing me to use a combination of sword strikes and arrows to clear the way. Navigation became a bit more complex when I reached a dark area, but thanks to the lamp I got earlier, I was able to find my way through the shadows. Finally, after securing the Big Key, I stood before the entrance to the boss chamber. The tension was palpable as I prepared to face the guardians of the first pendant. # The battle against the six Armos Knights was an intense dance of movement and precision. I had to use my arrows to take them down one by one while avoiding their heavy jumps that shook the floor. After defeating the last knight, I was rewarded with a Heart Container and, most importantly, the Pendant of Courage! With this first trophy in my possession, I returned to talk to Sahasrahla, who praised my progress and gave me the Book of Mudora, an ancient tome that will allow me to translate the Hylian language. We are one step closer to the Master Sword! Thank you very much for reading my publication. See you in the next chapter!

> ¡Saludos, comunidad de Hive Gaming! Espero que todos estén teniendo un día fantástico. Hoy nos sumergimos en el tercer capítulo de nuestra aventura en *The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past*. Después de conocer al anciano Sahasrahla y obtener las Botas de Pegaso, finalmente llegó el momento de enfrentar mi primer gran desafío: el Palacio del Este. Para ser honesto, estaba un poco nervioso por entrar en la primera mazmorra real del juego, pero me sentía bien equipado y listo para demostrar mi valor como héroe. Mi objetivo era claro: navegar por los antiguos pasillos y reclamar el Colgante del Valor. # Entrar en el Palacio del Este fue bastante interesante. La arquitectura está llena de estatuas de piedra y caminos estrechos que ponen a prueba tus reflejos. Casi de inmediato, tuve que lidiar con trampas mecánicas y plataformas móviles. El diseño de la mazmorra es un ejemplo clásico del diseño inicial de Zelda, donde tienes que encontrar llaves para desbloquear puertas y navegar a través de diferentes niveles. Uno de los puntos culminantes de esta exploración fue encontrar un cofre grande que contenía el Arco. Esta arma legendaria es esencial para esta mazmorra, ya que muchos enemigos e incluso algunos acertijos requieren ataques a larga distancia para ser resueltos o derrotados. # A medida que avanzaba en el templo, los enemigos se volvían más agresivos. Me encontré con grupos de estatuas Armos que cobraban vida al acercarme, lo que me obligó a usar una combinación de golpes de espada y flechas para despejar el camino. La navegación se volvió un poco más compleja cuando llegué a una zona oscura, pero gracias a la lámpara que obtuve anteriormente, pude encontrar mi camino a través de las sombras. Finalmente, tras asegurar la Llave Grande, me encontré ante la entrada de la cámara del jefe. La tensión era palpable mientras me preparaba para enfrentar a los guardianes del primer colgante. # La batalla contra los seis Caballeros Armos fue una intensa danza de movimiento y precisión. Tuve que usar mis flechas para derribarlos uno por uno mientras evitaba sus pesados saltos que sacudían el suelo. Después de derrotar al último caballero, fui recompensado con un Contenedor de Corazón y, lo más importante, ¡el Colgante del Valor! Con este primer trofeo en mi poder, regresé a hablar con Sahasrahla, quien elogió mi progreso y me entregó el Libro de Mudora, un antiguo tomo que me permitirá traducir el idioma Hyliano. ¡Estamos un paso más cerca de la Espada Maestra! Muchas gracias por leer mi publicación. ¡Nos vemos en el próximo capítulo! ------ ---- |

我家附近新开了好几家视野绝佳的露营地，其中一家名为树下的营地，是老公的朋友经营的。此前他已经单独去了几次，每次回来后都说下次我该和他一起去感受下树下的氛围，终于在这周日下午，我有空带娃去了树下玩。


树下营地就在水街大舞台背后，走路过去很近，旁边就是人工湖与塔楼，而且这里毕竟是新打造，顾客很少，我倒喜欢这种清静。

这里确实是非常适合和朋友放松休闲的地方，老公比我先来，我来时，他正和三位好友组队打掼蛋，见我过来，老公就让位让我打，以往我只在家中和老公两人消遣玩掼蛋，这是我第一次和新朋友组队玩。

一开始我担心自己的牌技太烂，有点怕当猪队友，结果发现其实大家的牌技相差无几，没有激烈的博弈压力，对局期间，我和我的队友因为牌不好连续落败，对家从打6连跳几级，后来就带帽了，我想自己老是输，颜面全无，哈哈，结果没想到最后一局，对家打出同花顺的关键时刻，我恰好有压牌，直接把手里的牌打完，意外翻盘，瞬间让整场游戏趣味倍增。

和我们一同打牌的，还有这家露营地的女老板，她人不错，而且我们还住在一个小区，也算有缘呢！

到了六点，我们围坐在树下，开启了晚餐时光。几个大菜，几杯酒，凉风习习，人是如此的聊得到一堆，几个娃在一边自己玩耍，这氛围感，真拉满。

新结识的几位朋友待人真诚，性情温和，真是相处得舒服自在。我们就这样不知不觉闲谈到晚上十点半，要不是第二天还要上班，大家绝对又要喝高兴才走。


---

body.title: A La Pared [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

A La Pared. La propuesta de hoy es super intensa, porque vamos a estar usando como apoyo una pared, para que todo nuestro cuerpo trabaje de manera incansable. El uso de este tipo de apoyo es crucial, ya que permite mejorar la estabilidad y postura corporal. Por otra parte; al realizar sentadillas apoyados en la pared y luego abriendo piernas; sin duda alguna que la columna, núcleo y tren inferior están activos de manera poderosa. Y eso no es todo; porque al realizar planchas normales e invertidas con pies en la pared; la intensidad se incrementa de manera exponencial, haciendo que todo el tren superior se sienta en absoluta tensión, mientras el núcleo y piernas trabajan a millón. De verdad que esta rutina es demasiado potente y ya saben; cada quien ejercitando a su ritmo. No se diga más y vamos a la acción. >Against the Wall. Today’s workout is super intense, because we’ll be using a wall for support, so that our entire body works tirelessly. Using this type of support is crucial, as it helps improve stability and posture. Furthermore, when performing wall squats and then spreading your legs, there’s no doubt that your spine, core, and lower body are working hard. And that’s not all; because when you do regular and reverse planks with your feet against the wall, the intensity increases exponentially, putting your entire upper body under intense tension while your core and legs work like crazy. This routine is seriously intense, and as you know, everyone should exercise at their own pace. Enough said—let’s get to it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJgi2RFFjPcQ4BkoiHgp2QPJpUu7HbAEEoatDWPMJKMZ/1776704951679.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **RODILLAZOS MÁS PATADAS ALTERNAS CON EXTENSIÓN Y FLEXIÓN DE CODOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados, manos a nivel de la cabeza. >[**Warm-up 1**, **KNEES TO CHEST AND ALTERNATING KICKS WITH ELBOW EXTENSION AND FLEXION**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms at your sides, hands at head level.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMi1FHnPHepJ5ypuhVwgNtfX1fkXb1sXDNuXGkNTjQpw/1776704951854.gif)
[Ejecución]() Activos en la postura indicada, ejecutamos un rodillazo; rápidamente extendemos los codos llevando los brazos hacia abajo, los cuales se quedan allí mientras damos la patada. Al terminar con la patada, los codos se vuelven a flexionar. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Starting from the position shown, perform a knee strike; quickly extend your elbows, bringing your arms down, and keep them there as you deliver the kick. Once you’ve finished the kick, bend your elbows again. 3 minutes of exercise.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXf1qe6q3GsxaA66NMrs1uADtuAP3M2osMpswtwEzACQt/1776704951946.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TIJERA DE PIERNAS MÁS GOLPES ALTERNOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas juntas con brazos en posición de combate. >[**Warm-up 2**, **LEG SCISSORS WITH ALTERNATING KICKS**]() >[Stance]() >Feet together, arms in a fighting stance.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4VrSLXEkgAs79BAc4JZfdbCFuEqozqryefFFGjqE2yV/1776704952169.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos de actividad; a través de pequeños saltos, vamos abriendo y cerrando piernas; al mismo tiempo de las aperturas, vamos lanzando golpes frontales alternos. >[Execution]() >For 3 minutes, we’ll be doing small jumps while opening and closing our legs; as we open our legs, we’ll throw alternating front punches.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNRsnDufn8KRTcBA2osb8LLM7LDhoD6hrRhAHcEWC9Kr/1776704952278.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **ESCALADOR RÁPIDO DECLINADO CON APOYO DE PARED**]() [Postura]() La intensidad comienza con este movimiento; para ello, nos ubicamos boca abajo con manos en el piso y extendemos las piernas, colocando los pies en la pared; cuerpo recto. Notemos algo; normalmente para este ejercicio, las manos se ubican a nivel del pecho; en nuestro caso están colocadas a nivel del rostro, esto genera mayor complejidad. >[**Station 1**, **QUICK DECLINED CLIMBER WITH WALL SUPPORT**]() >[Position]() >The intensity begins with this movement; to perform it, we position ourselves face down with hands on the floor and extend our legs, placing our feet against the wall; keep the body straight. Note something: normally for this exercise, the hands are positioned at chest level; in our case, they are placed at face level, which makes it more challenging.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjCYDcT5TpTLRG85zxdFxAFhu1kBVaNwtGLVWF8bSgjf/1776704972528.gif)
[Ejecución]() Todo el peso corporal lo sentimos en el tren superior, mientras se mantienen activos el núcleo y las piernas. Un ejercicio demasiado explosivo, ya que vamos a mover las piernas de manera rápida. Para ejecutar el movimiento; simplemente, estando en la postura indicada, vamos llevando las rodillas de forma rápida y alterna contra el abdomen. Nos vamos con 20 rodillazos en 4 series por pierna. >[Execution]() >We feel the full weight of our body in our upper body, while keeping our core and legs engaged. This is a very explosive exercise, as we’ll be moving our legs quickly. To perform the movement, simply start in the correct position and quickly bring your knees up toward your abdomen, alternating legs. We’ll do 20 knee raises in 4 sets per leg.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYv1MDxuJQupqmyxhXYEeDymDjWjRnVUCAsqaW9B3FuCh/1776704972797.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **APERTURA DE PIERNAS EN SENTADILLA CON APOYO DE PARED**]() [Postura]() Flexionamos las rodillas, colocamos la espalda en la pared como si estuviéramos sentados en una silla. Brazos al frente con codos flexionados y piernas juntas. >[**Station 2**, **WALL-SUPPORTED SQUAT WITH LEG SPREAD**]() >[Position]() >Bend your knees and place your back against the wall as if you were sitting in a chair. Keep your arms in front of you with your elbows bent and your legs together.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR26tWHaQo9erigw8piUo6o9Ruj9p5PakNSjQ6VJL24E5/1776704973037.gif)
[Ejecución]() Con este movimiento se fortalece la espalda, el núcleo y todo el tren inferior. Si al hacer este ejercicio de forma isométrica es efectivo; imagínense activando las piernas de lado a lado. Para llevarlo a cabo; solo debemos abrir las piernas de lado a lado, mientras el cuerpo se mantiene en tensión. Son 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This movement strengthens your back, core, and entire lower body. If doing this exercise isometrically is effective, imagine how effective it is when you move your legs from side to side. To perform it, simply spread your legs from side to side while keeping your body tense. Do a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcY3suMHxc48FfhdmWPDMPf1oc4g2tjDvwAD2RoWwW9yD/1776704973246.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **ESCALADOR INVERTIDO EN PLANCHA EN V CON APOYO DE PARED**]() [Postura]() Ahora le toca al escalador invertido; aquí nos colocamos boca arriba, manos en el piso detrás de la espalda; las mismas quedan debajo de los hombros. Ubicamos los pies en la pared, quedando la cadera un poco hacia abajo; el cuerpo forma una V. >[**Station 3**, **INVERTED V-PLANK CLIMBER WITH WALL SUPPORT**]() >[Position]() >Now it’s time for the inverted climber; here, we lie on our backs with our hands on the floor behind our backs, directly under our shoulders. We place our feet against the wall, with our hips slightly lowered; our body forms a V shape.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPFBd1ZC5yWeCYf6NNc6rpexkMFKHFyJhxAXgF8Gfbq5/1776704998003.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin duda alguna todo el cuerpo está trabajando; el tren superior soporta el peso corporal y la cadera se fortalece un mundo. Una sugerencia; como en este ejercicio la cadera soporta gran presión, pueden ejecutar la estación sin apoyar los pies en la pared, los ubican extendidos en el piso. Para realizarlo, solo deben llevar las rodillas de forma alterna contra el abdomen. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >There’s no doubt that your entire body is working; your upper body supports your body weight, and your hips get a tremendous workout. Here’s a tip: since this exercise puts a lot of pressure on your hips, you can do the exercise without resting your feet against the wall—just place them flat on the floor. To perform it, simply bring your knees up toward your abdomen one at a time. Do a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTMB6b5EwSUxb8UtjCC29j8cxzpRCLHynLsFZio4xNEA/1776704998239.gif)
[**Relajación**, **ELEVACIÓN DE RODILLAS CON GIRO**]() [Postura]() De pie, con piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Relaxation**, **KNEELIFT WITH TWIST**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your legs hip-width apart; bend your elbows and hold your arms in front of you.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6cuL782iE1dNRwnurgEoS5soXyqYNfPuhHpv5Aymb6b/1776704998472.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, vamos elevando las rodillas de forma alterna y las giramos hacia atrás. Se extiende el codo del brazo del mismo lado. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; during 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we lift our knees one at a time and rotate them backward. Extend the elbow of the arm on the same side.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUC4d2gn6zeVRJ5jUQMYi61tLicEBYQbVt81WmqzYsLc3/1776704998605.gif)

### Defend
It's rare to have people who will defend you in a place where others are talking negatively about you. Imagine being talked about without you knowing. It can be painful if you hear it yourself. Then came a person who will not agree on what he hears, and defends you. He may not be too close to you, but such person deserves to be in your circle. He has that trait of loyalty. 
Going back to those people trash talking on your back, they may even be those claiming as your friend when you're around, and you consider them as well. The truth is they're being a snake to you. If you can't completely break the connection, limit the time you're spending with them. They might even be gathering more information about you. 

### Tuesday 
Woke up not quite early today. I'm retaining energy from our activities last week. I have some chores in mind as well as online tasks. My friend called and invited us for the wedding later. Quite late but we will go. Hehe 

### Potato and Carrot Farm

body.title: A Nail in the Saturday Dream [ENG/SPA]
body.body:
>
Greetings to the Hive family, especially the Top Family community. Today I decided to participate in the  contest Observe Think Write . I'm very grateful for this initiative from @lanzjoseg, who brings us this writing exercise that I enjoy so much.

Today I'm sharing a story that's close to my heart, as it's something I remember from my childhood. Although I don't exactly recall a flat tire on my dad's car, I do remember the excitement we felt about trips to the beach and the times my dad got lost along the way.

### A Nail in the Saturday Dream
I woke up incredibly early, although the truth is I'd barely been able to close my eyes all night. My mind was racing, thinking about the long-awaited beach day; that mix of excitement and anxiety kept me on edge. Besides, there was the remote possibility that the trip could be canceled due to some unforeseen event, which was a constant worry for both my siblings and me.

To make sure everything went perfectly and that the plan didn't fall apart, we got to work at dawn. We did all the housework with unusual enthusiasm: we cleaned, tidied up, and got everything ready so Mom wouldn't have any excuses. It had taken so much effort to make this dream a reality that we didn't want to leave any loose ends. The weather, for its part, seemed to be on our side; the sky was clear and the weather was simply perfect.
Dad still hadn't arrived home. He had gotten up at three in the morning to start his shift, transporting the workers on the third shift. His plan was to return home and immediately take us to the coast. Since it was Saturday, we knew we had to leave as soon as possible; the few times he took us, the trip turned into an ordeal because Dad always got lost along the way. However, we didn't mind taking extra detours because we always ended up on the beautiful, warm beaches of Puerto Cabello.

Oh, but that day! Fate had an unexpected twist in store for us. When we finally heard the car engine and ran out to meet him, disappointment hit us hard. Unfortunately, we couldn't travel: the car tire was completely flat. My dad, resigned, had to take the vehicle to an emergency tire shop. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arribaeltelon/23xedoKLUBnM6s2UWpV7sqSdxza5AUF2He6t4eRhn5MCG3kz7N3Rp1XbtAwLezBdUCKbN.png)

[Sources](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-8fe489d7947e8)

> Here's a picture of the culprit: a long, bent nail had driven deep into the tire, a nail that had blocked our path. This small object was solely responsible for us not enjoying the sea today, but we are not discouraged; next weekend, without fail, the sea will be waiting for us.

*Fuentes*
*Image provided by the contest
I used Google Translate*

---
### SPANISH 
Saludos a la gran familia de Hive, en especial a la comunidad Top Family. Hoy decidí participar en el concurso \

. Estoy muy agradecida por esta iniciativa de @lanzjoseg, quien nos trae este ejercicio de escritura que tanto me gusta.

Hoy les traigo una historia que me toca de cerca, pues es algo que rescato de mi niñez. Aunque no recuerdo exactamente un caucho espichado en el carro de papá, sí recuerdo la ilusión que nos daban los viajes a la playa y las pérdidas que se daba mi papá en el camino.

### Un clavo en la ilusión del sábado
Me desperté sumamente temprano, aunque la verdad es que durante toda la noche apenas pude cerrar los ojos. Mi mente no dejaba de dar vueltas pensando en la llegada del esperado día de playa; esa mezcla de emoción y ansiedad me mantenía alerta. Además, existía la posibilidad remota de que el viaje se suspendiera por cualquier imprevisto, lo cual representaba una preocupación constante tanto para mis hermanos como para mí.
Para asegurar que todo saliera perfecto y que el plan no se cayera, nos pusimos manos a la obra desde la madrugada. Hicimos todos los oficios de la casa con un entusiasmo inusual: limpiamos, ordenamos y dejamos todo listo para que mamá no tuviera excusas. Nos había costado tanto que este sueño se hiciera realidad que no queríamos dejar ningún cabo suelto. El clima, por su parte, parecía estar de nuestro lado; el cielo estaba despejado y el tiempo era simplemente perfecto.
Papá aún no había llegado a casa. Él se había levantado a las tres de la madrugada para cumplir con su jornada de trabajo, pues hacía el transporte de los trabajadores del tercer turno. Su plan era regresar y, de inmediato, llevarnos rumbo a la costa. Como hoy es sábado, sabíamos que debíamos salir lo más pronto posible; las pocas veces que nos llevaba, el viaje se convertía en una odisea porque papá siempre se perdía en el camino. Sin embargo, no nos importaba dar vueltas de más, porque al final siempre llegábamos a las hermosas y cálidas playas de Puerto Cabello.
¡Ay, pero ese día! El destino nos tenía preparada una jugada inesperada. Cuando finalmente escuchamos el motor del carro y salimos corriendo a recibirlo, la decepción nos golpeó de frente. Lamentablemente, no pudimos viajar: el caucho del carro llegó totalmente espichado. Mi papá, con resignación, tuvo que llevar el vehículo a una cauchera de emergencia. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arribaeltelon/23xedoKLUBnM6s2UWpV7sqSdxza5AUF2He6t4eRhn5MCG3kz7N3Rp1XbtAwLezBdUCKbN.png)

[Sources](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-8fe489d7947e8)

> Aquí les comparto la foto del culpable: un clavo largo y torcido se había incrustado profundamente, un clavo que se atravesó en nuestro camino. Este pequeño objeto fue el único responsable de que hoy no estemos disfrutando del mar, pero no nos desanimamos; el próximo fin de semana, sin falta, el mar nos estará esperando.

*Imagen proporcionada por el concurso

body.title: The Garden of San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
>

When we arrive at San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle, located in Cumana, we are greeted by a small garden that is a delight to the eye just before we begin the climb up to the great fortress. You can see stones painted white as decorative elements around some plants, and other rock formations have been arranged to create an eye-catching design in this garden, which is not fenced in but is bordered by a small wall painted yellow. At the entrance, you can also see a castle-shaped booth, a checkpoint for people and cars.

<center>
![1000105932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep7u78GCXLTYhoGBjrJHmjrVMQAQ9zUfoMXbg3kFwpeeu7KhN55G1v36uNpHXw4NfPh.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![1000105931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq7KuvBNDu9iQwBLT8htTHJMHx932MwC5zp5ATa4ydgwh94jnKx47hSA8dP5FBaqZsM.jpg)
</center>

I found a striking plant called Alpinia zerumbet 'Variegata,' with its light-colored leaves speckled with cream and yellow—a very distinctive pattern that makes them unique. They can grow up to 3 meters tall and are distributed throughout various spots in this garden. Their unique leaves make them one of the most exotic plants in the area.


There are also some Areca palms (scientifically known as Rhapis excelsa). Their stems resemble bamboo canes and feature a dark brown fiber. Their leaves are unique; the tips appear to be \

They are very common in this type of garden because they are hardy and adapt well to the climate.
![1000105927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpNnyQGphbcUahNBXMebwmaxv14Tg55swK7sn6C7Nx4B4MULs3JGDorszaRkzPvCsWL.jpg)
![1000105928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpNnWLSGAjS8W4UsB7puaTSTcR7wzEiyGgNLzMcNivx5y7xrhhV44GGd9B127duVWcP.jpg)
Another of the most striking plants I found here was the Acalypha (Acalypha wilkesiana). It has large, copper-red leaves, a color that intensifies in sunlight, and since Cumana gets plenty of sun, it makes for quite a visual spectacle. This plant can grow to a height of about three meters. As seen in the photo, the stem is erect with many branches covered in fine hairs. In my research, I discovered that the leaves of this plant are used to treat skin conditions.
![1000105939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EonkXUKGUgnc6JQh1FvJu5K7EFFv84EHYjq6svj6vj9kikQZedLPi914rhxpNxFx5zc.jpg)
![1000105934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpzxispbnqSKwtwPaxCGsweCJJekbCuDwa8x7WAiLJkTjKtZZgyE7NxxVSpTf8UMrtK.jpg)
The purple maguey (Tradescantia spathacea) is another species that stands out, particularly because it is green on top and purple underneath—a unique combination found in nature that we can admire in this garden. Its ornamental use has spread throughout Central America; in fact, it is used as a decorative element, although it also has medicinal properties, as it is used to aid wound healing and treat inflammation and respiratory infections.
![1000105936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eo4D4WGMiWuDtL64oZLfHo4rai3BGuJEMLjWe4G7NYgqqDjGftVXjrsA5Bbg5Hc3ANr.jpg)
![1000105940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoK6JqwDDmGfB5c5MRqBZ3e7NbcnSUzw9GXFRkLk99uvz5mXZEWxSg3fXmc4ghhNMnm.jpg)
Among other varieties is a Silver Button Mangrove, which stood alone on a small plot of land. It is also resistant to sun and drought. The color of its leaves is silvery green or grayish, a characteristic that makes it more visually appealing since it doesn’t blend in with the typical green color of most plants. I love these colorful variations—this natural diversity that truly delights the senses.
![1000105937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoAamojCVM7TcgByFgS13hNfEZ2G2A37oy5aPZZVSLsgU7248bGL1eCTx95m7qBqWsr.jpg)
![1000105930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eo8SsMH8Z4yzLzStBRSoA8towibCHRuL9mKzLAHFQpLEJHqYfYAjbhkwArANkpC9SZG.jpg)
What is clear about these species is that they do not require much care; for this reason, they can survive in this arid environment without major complications. With staff dedicated to maintaining the gardens, these spaces are prepared for tourists to enjoy, and this is appreciated because it reflects well on the people of Sucre.
![1000105935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoAaFt4VEegjZ2Ssm5AVpNBzKu86zAvoebc4gkkRqLi6zSr3kroMrVpKEWeatPbYwoz.jpg)
It is undoubtedly difficult to establish a botanical garden in this area; water scarcity, high temperatures, and the scorching sun take their toll on the vegetation. In Guaiquerí Park, there is a reserve of green spaces, but these have been gradually giving way to open land due to environmental conditions. Here at the castle, the same thing is happening, but at least the foresight was taken to create gardens with plants that can survive in a hostile environment. *** ***
## Versión en Español

>

Cuando llegamos al Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia, ubicado en Cumaná, nos recibe un pequeño jardín, el cual alegra la vista justo antes de empezar a subir hacia la gran fortaleza. Se pueden observar piedras pintadas de blanco como elementos decorativos alrededor de algunas plantas, también otras formaciones rocosas se organizaron para presentar un diseño llamativo en este jardín, que no se encuentra cercado, pero sí delimitado por un pequeño muro pintado de amarillo. En la entrada también se puede observar una casilla en forma de castillo, un punto de control para el paso de personas y automóviles.

<center>
![1000105932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep7u78GCXLTYhoGBjrJHmjrVMQAQ9zUfoMXbg3kFwpeeu7KhN55G1v36uNpHXw4NfPh.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![1000105931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq7KuvBNDu9iQwBLT8htTHJMHx932MwC5zp5ATa4ydgwh94jnKx47hSA8dP5FBaqZsM.jpg)
</center>

Encontré una llamativa planta denominada  Alpinia zerumbet 'Variegata', con sus hojas claras con pintas colores crema y amarillo, un diseño muy particular que las hace únicas, ellas pueden alcanzar hasta 3 metros de altura y en este lugar se encuentran distribuidas en varios lugares de esta jardín. Sus particulares hojas las vuelven una de las más exóticas del lugar.

También se encuentran algunas Palmas de área (conocidas científicamente como Rhapis excelsa). Sus tallos parecen cañas de bambú y se nota una fibra marrón oscura. Sus hojas son curiosas, en las puntas dan la sensación de estar \

. Son muy comunes en este tipo de jardines ya que son resistentes y se adaptan a las condiciones climáticas.
![1000105927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpNnyQGphbcUahNBXMebwmaxv14Tg55swK7sn6C7Nx4B4MULs3JGDorszaRkzPvCsWL.jpg)
![1000105928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpNnWLSGAjS8W4UsB7puaTSTcR7wzEiyGgNLzMcNivx5y7xrhhV44GGd9B127duVWcP.jpg)
Otra de las plantas más llamativas que encontré acá fue la Acalifa (Acalypha wilkesiana), se pueden observar hojas grandes de color rojo cobrizo, el cual se intensifica con los rayos solares, y en Cumaná hace bastante sol, así que es un espectáculo visual. Esta planta puede alcanzar un tamaño de unos tres metros de altura. Como se aprecia en la fotografía, el tallo es erecto con muchas ramas de pelos finos. En mi investigación descubrí que las hojas de esta planta se usan para curar enfermedades de la piel.
![1000105939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EonkXUKGUgnc6JQh1FvJu5K7EFFv84EHYjq6svj6vj9kikQZedLPi914rhxpNxFx5zc.jpg)
![1000105934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpzxispbnqSKwtwPaxCGsweCJJekbCuDwa8x7WAiLJkTjKtZZgyE7NxxVSpTf8UMrtK.jpg)
El Maguey morado (Tradescantia spathacea), es otra especie que se puede distinguir y más por ser de color verde por arriba y púrpura por debajo, una combinación singular que se aprecia en la naturaleza y lo podemos contemplar en este jardín. Su uso ornamental las ha extendido por Centroamérica, de hecho la utilizan como elemento decorativo, aunque también tenga propiedades medicinales ya que se utiliza en casos de cicatrización de heridas, antiflamatorio e infecciones respiratorias.
![1000105936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eo4D4WGMiWuDtL64oZLfHo4rai3BGuJEMLjWe4G7NYgqqDjGftVXjrsA5Bbg5Hc3ANr.jpg)
![1000105940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoK6JqwDDmGfB5c5MRqBZ3e7NbcnSUzw9GXFRkLk99uvz5mXZEWxSg3fXmc4ghhNMnm.jpg)
Entre otras variedades está un Mangle Botoncillo Plateado, el cual estaba solo en un pequeño terreno. Además es resistente al sol y a la falta de agua. El color de sus hojas es verde plateado o grisáceo, característica que le otorga un mayor atractivo visual al no identificarse con el color verde habitual de la mayoría de las plantas. Me agradan estas variantes coloridas, esta diversidad natural que definitivamente alegra los sentidos.
![1000105937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoAamojCVM7TcgByFgS13hNfEZ2G2A37oy5aPZZVSLsgU7248bGL1eCTx95m7qBqWsr.jpg)
![1000105930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eo8SsMH8Z4yzLzStBRSoA8towibCHRuL9mKzLAHFQpLEJHqYfYAjbhkwArANkpC9SZG.jpg)
Lo que es evidente en estas especies es que no requieren de muchos cuidados, por tal razón pueden sobrevivir en este ambiente árido sin mayores complicaciones. Al contar con un personal encargado de los jardines, estos espacios se acondicionan para disfrute turístico y ello se agradece porque deja en alto al gentilicio sucrense.
![1000105935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoAaFt4VEegjZ2Ssm5AVpNBzKu86zAvoebc4gkkRqLi6zSr3kroMrVpKEWeatPbYwoz.jpg)
Sin duda resulta complicado sembrar un jardín botánico en esta zona, la escasez de agua, las altas temperaturas y el sol incandescente atentan contra la vegetación. En el parque Guaiquerí existe una reserva de áreas verdes, pero las mismas han ido cediendo espacios a extensiones de tierra debido a las condiciones ambientales. Acá en el castillo sucede lo mismo, pero al menos se tomó la previsión de crear jardines con plantas que sobrevivan en un ambiente hostil.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.
